meanings.note: Pinyin: yī. Changes tone to yí before 4th tone (一个 yí gè) and yì before 1st/2nd/3rd tones (一杯 yì bēi).

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yí xià. Placed after an action verb to make a request or suggestion sound casual and brief (看一下, 等一下).

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

一下子.gloss: all at once, all of a sudden

meanings.en: all at once, all of a sudden
meanings.note: Adverb yíxiàzi ('in one stroke, suddenly').

examples.text: 你一下子说成自己的标准了。
examples.trans: All of a sudden you turned that into your own criteria.

examples.text: 天气一下子变冷了。
examples.trans: The weather suddenly turned cold.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yì sī sī. Reduplicated diminutive quantity phrase 一 ('one') + 丝丝 ('fine silk thread / hair's breadth'); yī shifts to yì before 1st-tone sī.

examples.text: 把钢调音扳手往右轻轻拧一丝丝，音准就刚刚好了。
examples.trans: Turn the steel tuning wrench just a tiny hair to the right and the pitch is spot on.

examples.text: 柠檬挞里加了一丝丝盐，反而让甜味显得更清爽。
examples.trans: Adding a tiny fraction of salt to the lemon tart makes the sweetness taste even brighter.

examples.text: 台阶上放着一个用白纸包着的小木盒。
examples.trans: A small wooden box wrapped in white paper was sitting on the steps.

examples.text: 哪怕只有一个客人入住，我们也会准备好热腾腾的早饭。
examples.trans: Even if only one guest checks in, we still prepare a piping hot breakfast.

examples.text: 他从美国回来下一个月也都是满的，而且这些时间随时都在变动。
examples.trans: Next month after he returns from abroad is completely full too, and his hours shift constantly.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Indefinite quantity yìxiē ('some').

examples.text: 里面准备了一些饮品。
examples.trans: Some drinks are prepared inside.

examples.text: 我还有一些问题。
examples.trans: I still have a few questions.

examples.text: 工作上没什么特别的事情发生，就是十二歌王有一件事情我觉得有点不妥。
examples.trans: Nothing unusual happened at work, except there was one detail on Twelve Singers that felt slightly off to me.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 我来跟您请示一下，能不能要一份您的工作日程啊？
examples.trans: I came to ask if I might get a copy of your work schedule.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 等一会儿。
examples.trans: Wait a while.

examples.text: 过一会儿。
examples.trans: After a while.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yí gòng. Sums up items or prices before the verb or number (一共十二块 'twelve yuan in total').

examples.text: 在这儿！一共三十八块，找回十二块零钱。
examples.trans: Right here! Thirty-eight yuan in total, with twelve yuan back in change.

examples.text: 四杯红茶一共二十八块钱。
examples.trans: Four cups of black tea come to twenty-eight yuan in total.

一分不差.gloss: not a minute off; right on the dot

meanings.en: not a minute off; right on the dot
meanings.note: Pinyin: yì fēn bù chā. Four-character idiom 一分 ('one minute/point') + 不差 ('not off at all'); yī shifts to yì before 1st-tone fēn.

examples.text: 院子门口的铜铃在下午三点整响了，一分不差。
examples.trans: The brass bell at the courtyard gate rang at three o'clock sharp, not a minute off.

examples.text: 老陈修好的那只挂钟走得极准，每天都一分不差。
examples.trans: The wall clock Chen repaired keeps time with pinpoint accuracy, not a minute off any day.

meanings.note: comprehensive pronoun covering every matter

examples.text: 吉总说一切按数据说话。
examples.trans: President Ji says everything speaks according to the data.

examples.text: 现场的一切都已经安排好了。
examples.trans: Everything on set has already been arranged.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yí kè. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一刻钟 ('a quarter-hour').

examples.text: 快跑吧，小晴。四号房七点一刻就醒！
examples.trans: Run fast, Qing. Room four wakes up at a quarter past seven!

examples.text: 现在是八点一刻，早餐刚开始。
examples.trans: It is a quarter past eight right now, and breakfast has just begun.

meanings.note: Compound numeral yìqiān qībǎi.

examples.text: 这些东西一共是一千七百块。
examples.trans: These items total 1,700 yuan.

examples.text: 会场能坐一千七百名观众。
examples.trans: The hall seats 1,700 audience members.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yí bàn. Combines 一 ('one') + 半 ('half'); note yī shifts to yí before 4th-tone bàn.

examples.text: 这壶热茶我们已经喝了一半。
examples.trans: We have already drunk half of this pot of hot tea.

examples.text: 第二页乐谱有一半还没有写完。
examples.trans: Half of the second page of sheet music is still unfinished.

examples.text: 我觉得我跟他离得好远，他跟我说一句话，我脑子就直接充血，使劲转不停。
examples.trans: Yet he feels so far away — when he speaks one sentence to me, the blood rushes to my head and my mind spins!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 一号机准备。
examples.trans: Camera one ready.

examples.text: 看一号机。
examples.trans: Look at camera one.

meanings.note: Adverb yíxiàng ('consistently, always').

examples.text: 改版这种事一向都是受质疑的。
examples.trans: Major format overhauls have always faced skepticism.

examples.text: 他工作一向严谨，从不马虎。
examples.trans: He has always been rigorous in his work.

examples.text: 惠美一直要求清空所有的日程，现在一周里面有半周她都是空闲的。
examples.trans: Huimei insisted I clear her bookings, so now she leaves half of every week completely open.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Adverb yíwèi ('blindly, unthinkingly').

examples.text: 为什么我不管做什么，你都要一味地迁就我？
examples.trans: Why do you endlessly give in to me no matter what I do?

examples.text: 做节目不能一味模仿别人，必须有原创精神。
examples.trans: Producing TV must not blindly copy others; it needs originality.

meanings.note: Showbiz noun yīgē ('agency's top male artist').

examples.text: 你们经纪公司的一哥不是荣思纶吗？
examples.trans: Is your agency's leading man not Rong Silun?

examples.text: 这位实力派歌手稳坐乐坛一哥的位置多年。
examples.trans: This powerhouse singer has been the music scene's leading man for years.

meanings.note: Colloquial adverb yíkuài ('together').

examples.text: 他能跟她一块成长。
examples.trans: He can grow alongside her together.

examples.text: 周末咱们一块去看电影吧。
examples.trans: Let us go see a movie together this weekend.

meanings.note: Colloquial adverb yíkuàir ('together').

examples.text: 一会儿咱们一块儿去吃饭吧。
examples.trans: Let us go eat together in a moment.

examples.text: 我希望也能跟你们一块儿做节目。
examples.trans: I hope to produce shows together with you too.

examples.text: 您是东海经纪的涂盛涂总吗？我是荣思伦哥哥的铁杆大影迷，你能不能跟他说一声我要嫁给他！
examples.trans: Wait — are you Director Tu Sheng of Donghai Talent? I'm Rong Silun's biggest die-hard fan; please tell him I want to marry him!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

一声令下.gloss: at a single word of command

meanings.en: at a single word of command
meanings.note: Idiom yìshēng-lìngxià ('as soon as the order is given').

examples.text: 只等淳于总一声令下，稿子就发。
examples.trans: At one word from Mr Chun Yuqiao, the article goes out.

examples.text: 导演一声令下，全场安静下来。
examples.trans: At the director's command, the whole set fell quiet.

examples.text: 一夜之间，广告商全改口支持咱们了啊！
examples.trans: Overnight, every single advertiser changed their tune to back us!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

一大堆.gloss: a big pile of, tons of

meanings.en: a big pile of, tons of
meanings.note: Phrase yídàduī ('a huge pile of').

examples.text: 二部提了一大堆没法用的方案。
examples.trans: Unit Two turned in a big pile of unusable drafts.

examples.text: 桌上放着一大堆文件。
examples.trans: A big pile of documents sits on the desk.

examples.text: 一大早来打扰你很不好意思，我走了。
examples.trans: Sorry to disturb you so early in the morning — I'll head out now.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 我是因为他才来到咱们公司的。我生活里的每一天，全部都是他。
examples.trans: He is the sole reason I came to our company. Every single day of my life revolves around him.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Fixed phrase yìtiāndàowǎn ('from morning till night, constantly').

examples.text: 看你一天到晚魂不守舍那样。
examples.trans: Look at how distracted you are all day long.

examples.text: 他一天到晚都在忙节目。
examples.trans: He is busy with the show all day long.

meanings.note: Used with 有 to mean having an effective way of handling things.

examples.text: 对付这种事他很有一套。
examples.trans: He really has a knack for handling things like this.

examples.text: 每个人都有自己的一套办法。
examples.trans: Everyone has their own set of methods.

一如既往.gloss: as always, just as in the past

meanings.en: as always, just as in the past
meanings.note: Idiom yìrú-jìwǎng ('just as before').

examples.text: 一如既往，我们会保留节目的精华。
examples.trans: As always, we will preserve the finest parts of the show.

examples.text: 感谢观众朋友们一如既往的支持。
examples.trans: Thank you to our viewers for your support as always.

meanings.note: Showbiz noun yījiě ('number-one female artist in an agency').

examples.text: 你已经是你们公司的一姐了。
examples.trans: You are already your agency's top female star.

examples.text: 她是电视台当之无愧的一姐。
examples.trans: She is the network's undisputed leading host.

一字不差.gloss: word for word; to the letter

meanings.en: word for word; to the letter
meanings.note: Pinyin: yí zì bù chà. Four-character idiom 一字 ('one character/word') + 不差 ('not off at all'); yī shifts to yí before 4th-tone zì.

examples.text: 我们对公众开放的咖啡角和读书角，跟市政厅的规定一字不差！
examples.trans: Our public café corner and reading nook match City Hall's requirements word for word!

examples.text: 小晴把姑姑留下的菜谱一字不差地抄在了新卡片上。
examples.trans: Qing copied the recipe left by the aunt onto a new card word for word.

examples.text: 我的妈呀，大获全胜啊这一季！
examples.trans: Oh my goodness — this season is a total landslide victory!

examples.text: 这一季节目未播先火，我是真没想到。
examples.trans: This season is already red-hot before airing a single frame; I truly didn't see this coming.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yí dìng. Expresses strong certainty or a warm, firm promise (请一定写下来).

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

examples.text: 一定转达！请慢用。
examples.trans: I certainly will! Please enjoy your meal.

examples.text: 昨天一宿去趟香港，我现在很困。
examples.trans: I spent all last night on a trip to Hong Kong; I'm just sleepy right now.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 举办了一届校际桌式足球比赛。
examples.trans: So I put together an intercollegiate table-football tournament.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.en: completely; down to the last drop
meanings.note: Pinyin: yì gān èr jìng. Vivid four-character idiom ('clean and spotless').

examples.text: 他上楼之前把蔬菜汤喝得一干二净。
examples.trans: Before going upstairs, he drank every last drop of the vegetable soup.

examples.text: 小猫把碟子里的温牛奶舔得一干二净。
examples.trans: The kitten licked every last drop of warm milk from the saucer.

examples.text: 杏子姐，我到公司才不到一年就升职这么快，我是咱们史上升职最快的吗？
examples.trans: Xingzi, I've been at the company less than a year and got promoted so fast — am I the fastest promotion in company history?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Idiom yìnián-yídù ('annual').

examples.text: 一年一度的盛典今晚正式开始。
examples.trans: The annual gala begins tonight.

examples.text: 这是一年一度的音乐节。
examples.trans: This is an annual music festival.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yì nián nián. Reduplicated time phrase 一 + 年年 ('year after year'); yī shifts to yì before 2nd-tone nián.

examples.text: 一年年过去，院子里的老树长得越来越高。
examples.trans: Year after year passed, and the old tree in the courtyard grew taller and taller.

examples.text: 那本旧相册记下了客栈一年年的变化。
examples.trans: That old photo album recorded the inn's changes year after year.

examples.text: 星天娱乐一直是备受投资界关注的明星企业，公司估值一度突破百亿。
examples.trans: Xingtian Entertainment has long been a star company watched closely by investors, with its valuation once topping ten billion.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 这是一律啊。
examples.trans: This is uniformly.

examples.text: 那个一律好。
examples.trans: That uniformly is good.

meanings.note: Before a verb like 开发 or 打造, means built by one's own hands.

examples.text: 这档节目是他一手开发出来的。
examples.trans: He developed this programme single-handedly.

examples.text: 老导演一手培养了很多年轻人才。
examples.trans: The veteran director personally trained many young talents.

meanings.note: Idiom yìshǒuzhētiān ('cover the sky with one hand, wield total control').

examples.text: 在公司里他也不能一手遮天吧。
examples.trans: Even at the firm he cannot control everything alone.

examples.text: 没有人可以在行业里一手遮天。
examples.trans: Nobody can monopolise the whole industry alone.

examples.text: 台里那边你放心，我召集了一批专家给政策面上做咨询。
examples.trans: Don't worry about the network; I gathered a panel of scholars to advise leadership on media policy.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 我一个人去没意思，你们要不要一块儿，就像当年咱们那次比赛一样再玩一把？
examples.trans: Going by myself would be boring — want to join in together and have one more round just like our contest nine years ago?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

一整天.gloss: the whole day, all day long

meanings.en: the whole day, all day long
meanings.note: Emphasises an entire uninterrupted day.

examples.text: 我们今天一整天都在开会。
examples.trans: We were in meetings all day long today.

examples.text: 他在演播室忙了一整天。
examples.trans: He stayed busy in the studio for a whole day.

examples.text: 一旦决定就不要改。
examples.trans: Once decided, do not change.

examples.text: 一旦下雨就不去了。
examples.trans: Once it rains, we won't go.

examples.text: 新闻刚发了一条消息！
examples.trans: A breaking news alert just came out!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 王尔老师，我敬您一杯！
examples.trans: Mr Wang Er, let me toast a glass to you!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yí yàng. Pairs with 跟/和 in 跟…一样 ('the same as…').

examples.text: 等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！
examples.trans: Wait—it is dark blue, the same as yours!

examples.text: 哎呀！我跑得太急，包装看着都一样！
examples.trans: Oh no! I was running in such a rush that the wrappers all looked alike!

meanings.note: Locative noun yīlóu ('first floor').

examples.text: 一楼的碎玻璃都已经修过了。
examples.trans: The broken glass on the first floor has already been fixed.

examples.text: 前台接待处就在一楼大厅。
examples.trans: The reception desk is right in the first-floor lobby.

meanings.en: completely identical; cast from the same mold
meanings.note: Pinyin: yì mú yí yàng. Note second-tone mú here ('one mold, one look').

examples.text: 外面一模一样，可是你看里面！
examples.trans: The outside is identical, yet look inside!

examples.text: 咬一口……志豪，闭上眼睛！跟爷爷的蛋糕味道一模一样！
examples.trans: One bite... Zhihao, close your eyes! That tastes exactly like Grandfather's cake!

examples.text: 你们现在都是大牌唱将，约一次太难了，都太火。
examples.trans: All of you are top-tier vocal stars now — getting everyone together once is so hard because you're all so popular.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

一次次.gloss: again and again, time after time

meanings.en: again and again, time after time
meanings.note: Reduplicated adverbial yícìcì ('repeatedly').

examples.text: 他一次次带我看到更真实的世界。
examples.trans: Again and again he showed me a truer world.

examples.text: 她一次次修改自己的策划案。
examples.trans: She revised her proposal time after time.

meanings.note: Describes top talent, quality, or standards in a field.

examples.text: 他是业内一流的节目制作人。
examples.trans: He is a top-tier television producer in the industry.

examples.text: 这支团队拥有一流的专业水准。
examples.trans: This team possesses first-rate professional standards.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yì diǎn. Before a noun, means 'a little bit of' (一点糖); after an adjective, 'a bit more' (快一点).

examples.text: 只有一点点牛奶、两个鸡蛋，一点黄油都没有！
examples.trans: Only a tiny bit of milk, two eggs, and no butter at all!

examples.text: 太好了！请加牛奶和一点糖。
examples.trans: Wonderful! With milk and a little sugar, please.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yì diǎnr. Erhua quantifier/adverb 一 ('one') + 点儿 ('little bit'); used after adjectives (低一点儿 'a tiny bit flat') or before 也不/都没 ('not at all').

examples.text: 那根高音钢丝听起来还稍微低一点儿，再调一下吧。
examples.trans: That treble steel string still sounds a tiny bit flat; let's tune it a touch more.

examples.text: 水性的花园油漆气味很小，走廊里一点儿也不呛人。
examples.trans: Water-based garden paint has very little odour and isn't pungent in the hallway at all.

meanings.note: Clock time expression combining 点 and 半.

examples.text: 我们下午一点半在会议室集合。
examples.trans: We are meeting in the conference room at one thirty.

examples.text: 昨晚他忙到凌晨一点半才离开机房。
examples.trans: Last night he worked until half past one before leaving the suite.

meanings.en: a tiny bit; just a little
meanings.note: Pinyin: yì dián diǎn. Affectionate reduplication stressing how small an amount is.

examples.text: 只有一点点牛奶、两个鸡蛋，一点黄油都没有！
examples.trans: Only a tiny bit of milk, two eggs, and no butter at all!

examples.text: 我的红茶里只加一点点蜂蜜就够了。
examples.trans: Just a tiny bit of honey in my black tea is plenty.

meanings.note: Fixed expression describing pure, undivided goodwill.

examples.text: 大家对你都是一片真心。
examples.trans: Everyone treats you with genuine sincerity.

examples.text: 别辜负了朋友的一片真心。
examples.trans: Do not let down a friend's sincere goodwill.

examples.text: 一百人。
examples.trans: One hundred people.

examples.text: 一百个。
examples.trans: One hundred.

meanings.note: Compound numeral yìbǎi sānshí.

examples.text: 后台有一百三十个人。
examples.trans: There are a hundred thirty people backstage.

examples.text: 这本书有一百三十页。
examples.trans: This book has a hundred thirty pages.

meanings.note: Short spoken numeral yìbǎisì ('140').

examples.text: 我们已经捐了百分之一百四。
examples.trans: We have already donated 140 percent.

examples.text: 这件外套只要一百四。
examples.trans: This jacket costs just 140 yuan.

examples.text: 我不明白，为什么老大能救我们一百次，而我们连一次都救不了他。
examples.trans: I just don't understand why our boss can rescue us a hundred times while we can't save him even once.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yì zhí. Describes walking straight (一直走) or doing something non-stop.

examples.text: 出大门往左拐，一直走到石桥。
examples.trans: Go out the front gate, turn left, and walk straight to the stone bridge.

examples.text: 志豪先生！您一直站在后面吗？！
examples.trans: Mr Zhihao! Were you standing right there behind us?!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yí shùn jiān. Combines 一 ('one') + 瞬间 ('blink of an eye / instant'); yī shifts to yí before 4th-tone shùn.

examples.text: 闪电在一瞬间照亮了整个院子。
examples.trans: Lightning lit up the entire courtyard in a split second.

examples.text: 门打开的那一瞬间，大家都笑了。
examples.trans: The instant the door opened, everyone smiled.

examples.text: 我给了那个女人一笔钱，她就扔下小允出国去了，我不能丢下他不管。

meanings.note: Modifies plural nouns such as shows, plans, or measures.

examples.trans: The company launched a series of new shows this year.

meanings.note: Describes an expression visibly written across someone's face.

examples.text: 行李都放好了，大家快上车吧！
examples.trans: All luggage is loaded—hurry and hop in!

examples.text: 上车以后请大家系好安全带。
examples.trans: Please fasten your seatbelts once aboard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng mian. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 最上面 ('the very top').

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

examples.text: 上面有名字或者电话号码吗？
examples.trans: Is there a name or a phone number on it?

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià. Used for downward motion ('go down'), location ('under'), or 'next' (下周).

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 签个字，这是下一期闻娱论，我要让洛琳上这个节目跟她好好聊一聊！
examples.trans: Sign right here — for the next episode of my talk show, I'm bringing Luo Lin on air for a proper chat!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 下一步我们要做的，就是中国本土的原创节目。
examples.trans: Our very next step is creating homegrown original Chinese programs.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

下不起来.gloss: fail to start pouring (of rain or snow)

meanings.en: fail to start pouring (of rain or snow)
meanings.note: Potential complement indicating heavy rain will not build up.

examples.text: 看天色，这场雨应该下不起来。
examples.trans: Judging by the sky, this rain probably will not pick up.

examples.text: 风太大了，雪一直下不起来。
examples.trans: With wind this strong, the snow never really gets going.

examples.text: 十二歌王第三季将于下个月重新启幕，我们将融入全新的节目改版。
examples.trans: Season Three of Twelve Singers premieres next month, featuring a brand-new revamped competition format.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià wǔ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个下午 ('an afternoon').

examples.text: 您尽管看，宋老师。星期一下午大堂暗。
examples.trans: Go right ahead, Teacher Song. Monday afternoon the lobby was dim.

examples.text: 先别对外面透露一个字！让两兄弟先过完这个星期五下午！
examples.trans: Not a single word to anyone outside yet! Let the two brothers have their Friday afternoon first!

下厨房.gloss: go into the kitchen to cook

meanings.en: go into the kitchen to cook
meanings.note: Verb-object phrase xià chúfáng ('cook in the kitchen').

examples.text: 要么练练厨艺，要么就别下厨房了。
examples.trans: Either practise your cooking or stay out of the kitchen.

examples.text: 周末他难得亲自下厨房做了几道菜。
examples.trans: Over the weekend he cooked a few dishes himself.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià qù. Compound directional complement 下 ('down') + 去 ('away from speaker'), often attached after action verbs like 按下去 ('press down').

examples.text: 把开关轻轻按下去，走廊的灯就亮了。
examples.trans: Press the switch gently down and the hallway light comes on.

examples.text: 如果雨一直下下去，我们就在屋里喝茶。
examples.trans: If the rain keeps coming down, we will drink tea indoors.

meanings.note: Administrative verb xiàfā ('send down orders or notices').

examples.text: 总监全会的系统指令已经下发了。
examples.trans: The system order for the directors' meeting was issued.

examples.text: 新的排班表今天下午下发各部门。
examples.trans: The new shift schedule goes out to all units today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià zhōu. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 下一周 ('the coming week').

examples.text: 下周我保证把半个市政厅的同事都带来小美这儿喝咖啡。
examples.trans: Next week I promise to bring half my City Hall colleagues to Mei's tables.

examples.text: 下周二我要去成都出差。
examples.trans: Next Tuesday I am going to Chengdu on business.

下地.gloss: get out of bed; step on the ground

meanings.en: get out of bed; step on the ground
meanings.note: Pinyin: xià dì. Separable verb-object compound 下 ('step down onto') + 地 ('ground/floor'), often used when recovering from an injury or illness.

examples.text: 多亏你们俩不让我下地，我的脚踝已经消肿一半了。
examples.trans: Thanks to you two not letting me step on the ground, my ankle has already gone down by half.

examples.text: 医生叮嘱她先在椅子上休息两天，暂时不要下地走路。
examples.trans: The doctor advised her to rest in a chair for two days and not put weight on her foot yet.

meanings.note: Workplace noun xiàshǔ ('subordinate').

examples.text: 其实你没必要对下属太过于严苛。
examples.trans: There is really no need to be so harsh on your staff.

examples.text: 好领导懂得倾听下属的真实想法。
examples.trans: A good leader listens to staff members' honest ideas.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià ba. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个下巴 ('a chin'). Neutral tone on the second syllable.

examples.text: 那位邻居把小提琴轻轻夹在下巴底下，准备拉琴。
examples.trans: That neighbour tucked the violin gently under his chin, getting ready to play.

examples.text: 老陈摸了摸下巴，仔细看着账本上的房间号码。
examples.trans: Chen stroked his chin and looked closely at the room numbers in the ledger.

meanings.note: used in 打下手 meaning to assist as an apprentice

examples.text: 你这几天就跟着杏子姐姐，给她打打下手。
examples.trans: For the next few days, shadow Sister Xingzi and lend her a hand.

examples.text: 刚进组的时候，我先给导演打下手。
examples.trans: When I first joined the crew, I assisted the director first.

meanings.note: Colloquially refers to later developments in a story or situation.

examples.text: 这件事后来还有下文吗？
examples.trans: Was there any follow-up to this matter later?

examples.text: 要是有下文记得告诉我。
examples.trans: If anything happens next, remember to tell me.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià lái. Compound directional complement for downward motion or writing something down to keep.

examples.text: 快问他叫什么名字！记下来！
examples.trans: Quick, ask him what his name is! Write it down!

examples.text: 请一定写下来！三楼热水：满分十分！
examples.trans: Please be sure to write that down! Third-floor hot water: ten out of ten!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià lóu. Verb-object compound for heading down to a lower floor.

examples.text: 七点半有八位饿肚子的客人下楼啊！
examples.trans: At seven thirty, eight hungry guests are coming downstairs!

examples.text: 我手表七点二十九分。客人下楼了。
examples.trans: Seven twenty-nine on my watch. Guests are coming down the stairs.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià cì. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 下一次 ('the next occasion').

examples.text: 下次来成都，一定再来住我们客栈！
examples.trans: Next time you come to Chengdu, be sure to stay at our inn again!

examples.text: 今天聊得很开心，我们下次见！
examples.trans: It was lovely chatting today—see you next time!

meanings.note: Friendly farewell xiàcì jiàn.

examples.text: 今天聊得很开心，下次见！
examples.trans: Great chatting today, see you next time!

examples.text: 我们下次见！
examples.trans: See you next time!

meanings.note: Verb-object xiàshuǐ ('go into the water').

examples.text: 别碰我，我今天绝对不下水！
examples.trans: Hands off me—I am definitely not getting into the water today!

examples.text: 下水拍摄之前一定要穿好救生装备。
examples.trans: Put on life-saving gear before entering the water to film.

下狠手.gloss: pull out all the stops, make a drastic/all-out move

meanings.en: pull out all the stops, make a drastic/all-out move
meanings.note: Colloquially refers to going all out or taking ruthless action.

examples.text: 为了追到心上人，他这次真是下狠手了。
examples.trans: To win her heart, he really pulled out all the stops this time.

examples.text: 剪辑师下狠手删掉了所有拖沓的镜头。
examples.trans: The editor boldly cut out every dragging shot.

meanings.note: Verb-object xiàbān ('finish work for the day').

examples.text: 我今天提前下班了。
examples.trans: I got off work early today.

examples.text: 你几点下班？
examples.trans: What time do you get off work?

meanings.note: Formal verb xiàdá ('transmit orders downward').

examples.text: 命令请通过系统下达到行政处。
examples.trans: Please issue orders to admin through the system.

examples.text: 公司今天下达了新的通知。
examples.trans: The company issued a new notice today.

meanings.note: verb + object

examples.text: 该下锅时还是得下！
examples.trans: When it is time to jump into the pot, you still have to jump in!

examples.text: 该下锅时还是得下！
examples.trans: When it is time to jump into the pot, you still have to jump in!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià yǔ. Literally 'fall rain'; Mandarin expresses weather with verb + weather noun.

examples.text: 停电的时候，纸还能用。
examples.trans: Paper still works when the power goes out.

examples.text: 每次弹完琴，他都问为什么下雨天钢琴声音更暖。
examples.trans: Whenever I finished playing, he asked why the piano sounded warmer on rainy days.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià mian. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 最下面 ('the bottom part').

examples.text: 快拿到楼下灯光下面看看吧！
examples.trans: Let's bring it downstairs under the light and take a look!

examples.text: 志豪先生早！在木房梁下面睡得好吗？
examples.trans: Morning, Mr Zhihao! Did you sleep well beneath the wooden beams?

下马.gloss: be cancelled, be axed (of a project)

meanings.en: be cancelled, be axed (of a project)
meanings.note: Industry metaphor for halting or scrapping a project.

examples.text: 预算不足导致那个新项目被迫下马。
examples.trans: A budget shortfall forced that new project to be scrapped.

examples.text: 大家都在努力保住节目不让它下马。
examples.trans: Everyone is fighting to save the show from being cancelled.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bù. Standard negation for present/future/habitual verbs and adjectives; shifts to bú before a 4th tone (不是 bú shì).

examples.text: 停电的时候，纸还能用。
examples.trans: Paper still works when the power goes out.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

meanings.note: bù yīyàng — commonly used in the comparative structure A 跟/和 B 不一样 ('A is different from B') or as a predicate.

examples.text: 我跟他不一样，我要了一个实习生的名额。
examples.trans: I am different from him; I asked for one intern spot.

examples.text: 每一个时期、每一个版本，还有每一个出版社，他们的注解都不一样。
examples.trans: Across every era, every edition, and every publisher, the commentaries all differ.

examples.text: 淳总，十二歌王今天走台，但是惠美怎么都联系不上，已经迟到三个小时了！
examples.trans: Mr Chun, Twelve Singers has stage blocking today, except nobody can reach Huimei — she's already three hours late!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

不为过.gloss: not an exaggeration, not too much to say

meanings.en: not an exaggeration, not too much to say
meanings.note: Follows a strong claim to say it is entirely fair.

examples.text: 称他为行业先锋一点也不为过。
examples.trans: Calling him an industry pioneer is no exaggeration at all.

examples.text: 说这档节目改变了市场格局并不为过。
examples.trans: It is fair to say this programme reshaped the market.

meanings.note: Complement buliǎo after a verb ('cannot carry out').

examples.text: 这儿真的用不了你。
examples.trans: We really cannot use you here.

examples.text: 今天太忙，我走不了。
examples.trans: Today is too busy for me to leave.

examples.text: 乔木这首歌非常充满东方风味，我觉得这是上天赐给你不二的选择。
examples.trans: This song Arbor brims with Eastern poetic charm; I believe it is a match made in heaven for you.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

不二人选.gloss: the undisputed first choice, the only person for the job

meanings.en: the undisputed first choice, the only person for the job
meanings.note: Four-character idiom for an irreplaceable candidate.

examples.text: 他是出演这个角色的不二人选。
examples.trans: He is the undisputed first choice to play this role.

examples.text: 大家一致认为她是主持晚会的不二人选。
examples.trans: Everyone agreed she was the ideal choice to host the gala.

examples.text: 如果我们台能够率先垂范接受这个方案，不仅会提高我们的品牌价值。
examples.trans: If our network sets the example by adopting this plan, it will elevate our entire brand value.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 你甭纠结，他基本上不会记得你是谁。
examples.trans: Do not agonise over it — he basically will not remember who you are.

examples.text: 你甭纠结，他基本上不会记得你是谁。
examples.trans: Do not agonise over it — he basically will not remember who you are.

meanings.note: Correlative conjunction búdàn ('not only...').

examples.text: 不但没有让我失望，反而让我觉得他更对。
examples.trans: Far from disappointing me, it made me sure he was right.

examples.text: 新赛制不但刺激，而且更显公平。
examples.trans: The new format is not only exciting, it is fairer too.

meanings.note: Complement búzhù ('cannot keep down/hide').

examples.text: 当然了，这件事我也瞒不住你。
examples.trans: Clearly I could never keep this hidden from you.

examples.text: 听到获奖名单时，她激动得止不住眼泪。
examples.trans: Hearing the winners' list, she could not hold back tears.

meanings.note: Formal adjective bùjiā ('not good, subpar').

examples.text: 文章指责星天现场服务不佳。
examples.trans: The article blamed Xingtian for poor on-site service.

examples.text: 昨晚没休息好，今天精神不佳。
examples.trans: After sleeping poorly last night, my spirits are low today.

examples.text: 办公室恋情多有不便。以小谷的资质，你把她调到二部，独当一面完全没问题啊。
examples.trans: Office romances bring endless headaches. With Xiaogu's talent, transferring her to Unit Two to lead projects on her own would work great.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 我觉得我跟他离得好远，他跟我说一句话，我脑子就直接充血，使劲转不停。
examples.trans: Yet he feels so far away — when he speaks one sentence to me, the blood rushes to my head and my mind spins!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Adverb bùguāng ('not merely, not solely').

examples.text: 我这么做也不光是为了你。
examples.trans: I did not do this solely for your sake.

examples.text: 不光是你，大家都很期待。
examples.trans: Not only you, everyone is looking forward to it.

meanings.note: Describes conduct one cannot be proud of openly.

examples.text: 靠不光彩的手段赢不了真正的尊重。
examples.trans: Underhanded tactics never earn genuine respect.

examples.text: 他从不做任何不光彩的事情。
examples.trans: He never stoops to anything dishonorable.

meanings.note: Verb phrase bùguān ('not concern someone').

examples.text: 这件事只是我在负责，不关别人的事。
examples.trans: I alone am responsible; it concerns nobody else.

examples.text: 这次失误不关后台场务的事。
examples.trans: This oversight had nothing to do with floor crew.

examples.text: 我父亲答应不再和那个女人联系，才保住了他们的婚姻，但他确实是我的亲弟弟。
examples.trans: My father promised never to contact that woman again to save their marriage, yet the boy is truly my half-brother.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Modal/verb bùzhǔn ('must not, prohibit').

examples.text: 公司的所有节目他们不准露面。
examples.trans: They are barred from appearing on any company show.

examples.text: 演播厅里不准大声喧哗。
examples.trans: Loud noise is forbidden inside the studio.

meanings.note: Búdào ('under a threshold' or 'unable to reach').

examples.text: 他入职不到一年。
examples.trans: He has been on the job less than a year.

examples.text: 以后可能见不到面了。
examples.trans: We may not see each other anymore.

meanings.note: Adjective phrase búdàowèi ('not up to the mark').

examples.text: 前期的铺垫沟通不到位，上了会得被毙。
examples.trans: Without thorough groundwork beforehand, the pitch will get rejected.

examples.text: 灯光调试还不到位，需要再改一下。
examples.trans: The lighting setup is not quite right yet and needs tweaking.

examples.text: 此次严重侵权事件恐将打击星天信誉价值，实际造成的损失尚不可预期。
examples.trans: This serious infringement case threatens Xingtian's reputation, and the full financial losses remain unpredictable.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: bù kěnéng — negates 可能; functions as a predicate adjective or a standalone response meaning 'No way!'.
used adverbially before a verb phrase to express strong certainty that an action or event will not happen.

examples.text: 我们家希不可能跟星天合作了。
examples.trans: There is no way our Jiaxi can work with Xingtian anymore.

examples.text: 我的私事没有必要告诉你，而且那儿不可能得到真相。
examples.trans: There is no need to tell you my private affairs, and you will never get the truth from there.

examples.text: 就静静地待在那儿，他们有什么动静了你就来告诉我，前途不可限量。
examples.trans: Stay quietly right where you are, report every move they make back to me, and your future will be boundless.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Adjective bùtóng ('distinct, different').

examples.text: 历代学者都在做不同的注解。
examples.trans: Scholars across ages wrote different commentaries.

examples.text: 每个人都有不同的看法。
examples.trans: Everyone holds a different view.

examples.text: 这就是我前两天的见闻。淳于总的过去有过洛琳，有过钟阳子，现在都已经不在他的生活里了。
examples.trans: That's what I witnessed overseas these past two days: Luo Lin and Zhong Yangzi were chapters of Mr Chun Yu's past, and neither is in his life anymore.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 我知道您对俗事不在乎，您做音乐只是为了音乐本身。
examples.trans: I know you care nothing for worldly affairs and make music purely for music's sake.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 我其实不太擅长谈恋爱。那不是应该的吗？这是我作为男朋友的义务啊。
examples.trans: Truthfully, I'm not very skilled at romance — isn't taking your words seriously my duty as your boyfriend?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Formal verb bùshī ('without losing').

examples.text: 大家尴尬又不失礼貌地微笑着。
examples.trans: Everyone smiled awkwardly yet without losing politeness.

examples.text: 这档节目热闹又不失深度。
examples.trans: This show is lively without losing depth.

examples.text: 去年的事我当然记得，那段时间心情不好，惹了不少事。
examples.trans: Of course I remember last year; I was in a bad mood back then and stirred up plenty of trouble.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 小谷啊，我知道你是为了这个大师兄才来的星天，可他现在这样对你，你心里一定不好受吧。
examples.trans: Xiaogu, I know you joined Xingtian for your senior alumnus, and seeing him date a superstar must sting.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.en: excuse me; sorry to bother you; shy
meanings.note: Pinyin: bù hǎo yì si. Polite everyday softener for minor apologies or getting someone's attention.

examples.text: 晚上好。不好意思，把干净地板弄湿了。
examples.trans: Good evening. Sorry for getting your clean floor wet.

examples.text: 打扰一下，志豪先生？不好意思这么晚敲门。
examples.trans: Excuse me, Mr Zhihao? Sorry to knock so late.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bù rú. Compares two options ('not equal to / less than'), or introduces a suggestion ('might as well').

examples.text: 坐公交车去集市还不如走路快。
examples.trans: Taking the bus to the market is not even as fast as walking.

examples.text: 今天风大，我们不如坐在屋子里喝茶。
examples.trans: It is windy today; we might as well sit indoors and drink tea.

examples.text: 我觉着非常不妥，演技浮夸。
examples.trans: I thought throwing the game looked clumsy — the acting was way over the top.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

不妨.gloss: might as well, there is no harm in

meanings.en: might as well, there is no harm in
meanings.note: Polite adverb bùfáng ('might as well try').

examples.text: 现在有了外部力量推动，我们不妨试试。
examples.trans: With outside momentum behind us, we might as well try.

examples.text: 有新想法不妨在会上提出来。
examples.trans: If you have fresh ideas, feel free to share them.

meanings.note: Formal modal bùyí ('not advisable to').

examples.text: 两周之内不宜外出。
examples.trans: Going out is inadvisable within two weeks.

examples.text: 睡前不宜喝浓茶。
examples.trans: Strong tea is inadvisable before bed.

meanings.note: Four-character phrase meaning no trespass or disrespect is tolerated.

examples.text: 他的个人领地不容侵犯。
examples.trans: His personal territory is strictly off limits.

examples.text: 职业尊严绝对不容侵犯。
examples.trans: Professional dignity must never be violated.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bú duì. Negated adjective 不 ('not', shifting to 2nd-tone bú before 4th-tone duì) + 对 ('right/correct'); often used mid-sentence for a sudden realization ('wait, no!').

examples.text: 左边是糖……不对，もしかしたら右边那罐才是白糖？
examples.trans: The left jar is sugar... wait, no, could the right jar be the sugar?

examples.text: 老陈听了一下琴声说：“不对，这根弦还差一点点。”
examples.trans: Chen listened to the piano and said, 'Hold on, this string is still slightly off.'

meanings.note: Pinyin: bù xiǎo xīn. Literally 'not careful'; placed before a verb to mean 'by accident / inadvertently'.

examples.text: 我刚才不小心把水洒在桌子上了。
examples.trans: I accidentally spilled water on the table just now.

examples.text: 他没戴眼镜，不小心看错了日期。
examples.trans: Without his glasses, he accidentally misread the date.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bù shǎo. Litotes literally meaning 'not few', i.e. 'quite a lot of / plenty of'.

examples.text: 星期六早上有不少邻居来买热面包。
examples.trans: Quite a few neighbours come to buy warm bread on Saturday morning.

examples.text: 打折以后，我们省下了不少零钱。
examples.trans: After the discount, we saved plenty of spare change.

examples.text: 这是不就好了啊。
examples.trans: This is wouldn't it be fine.

examples.text: 那个不就好了好。
examples.trans: That wouldn't it be fine is good.

examples.text: 毕竟这些俗事对淳于总还有我们来说，也是抛不开的尘世烦恼。
examples.trans: After all, for Mr Chun Yu and the rest of us, these worldly tangles are troubles we cannot simply shake off.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Complement bùdé after verbs ('cannot be done').

examples.text: 以他现在的身体状况，这事急不得。
examples.trans: Given his current health, this cannot be rushed.

examples.text: 高精密的录音设备千万大意不得。
examples.trans: High-precision audio gear allows no carelessness.

不得不.gloss: have no choice but to, cannot help doing

meanings.en: have no choice but to, cannot help doing
meanings.note: Double negative expressing necessity.

examples.text: 为了保护团队，他不得不做出让步。
examples.trans: To protect the team, he had to make concessions.

examples.text: 时间太紧，我们不得不通宵加班。
examples.trans: With time so tight, we had no choice except to work all night.

examples.text: 白杨，你不用模仿任何人，也不必模仿我。
examples.trans: Bai Yang, you don't need to imitate anyone — and you certainly don't need to imitate me.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 我不怕您看我的上网记录，真的。
examples.trans: I'm not afraid of you seeing my browsing history, honestly.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 在倒是在，你要不怕死的话，你就进去吧。
examples.trans: He's inside, alright — if you aren't afraid of dying, go right on in.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 我不想看你的上网记录。关门。
examples.trans: I have zero interest in your browsing history. Close the door.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 闻老师，你不愧是独步江湖的段子手，我们开个讨论会你还卖关子呢。
examples.trans: Mr Wen, you truly live up to your reputation as a master storyteller — keeping us in suspense during a review meeting!

examples.text: 不愧是商业世家之子呀，真是人尽其用。我没问题。
examples.trans: Spoken like the heir to a business family — putting everyone's strengths to full use. Count me in.

examples.text: 这是不愿意啊。
examples.trans: This is not willing.

examples.text: 那个不愿意好。
examples.trans: That not willing is good.

meanings.note: Parallel maxim bùgǎi-zésǐ ('stagnate and die').

examples.text: 改则生，不改则死，这句话说得好！
examples.trans: Reform and live, fail to reform and die—well said!

examples.text: 面对市场变化，传统栏目不改则死。
examples.trans: Facing market shifts, old shows must reform or perish.

不敢当.gloss: you flatter me, I hardly deserve that

meanings.en: you flatter me, I hardly deserve that
meanings.note: Polite formula bùgǎndāng ('too kind, I dare not accept').

examples.text: 不敢当，你才是真正的金牌制作人。
examples.trans: You flatter me—you are the true gold-medal producer.

examples.text: 您这么夸奖我实在是不敢当。
examples.trans: Such high praise from you is more than I deserve.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bú shì. In 不是……吗？, forms a rhetorical question ('didn't you...? / isn't it...?'); bù shifts to bú before 4th-tone shì.

examples.text: 你不是说今天下午要去集市吗？
examples.trans: Didn't you say you were going to the market this afternoon?

examples.text: 那把钥匙不是一直放在抽屉里吗？
examples.trans: Hasn't that key been in the drawer all along?

examples.text: 王尔不止那一次泄密，他一直给我们的竞争对手提供情报。
examples.trans: Wang Er didn't leak secrets just once; he acted like an informant feeding intel to our competitors for years.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 这不比那好。
examples.trans: This does not compare to that.

examples.text: 不比从前。
examples.trans: Not compared to the past.

meanings.note: Adjective/noun bùmǎn ('unhappy with').

examples.text: 电视台对吵架的事特别不满。
examples.trans: The network is very unhappy about the quarrel.

examples.text: 观众对节目改版有些不满。
examples.trans: Viewers felt somewhat displeased with the revamp.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bù rán. Links a warning or alternative ('otherwise…').

examples.text: 快去跟他聊聊，小晴，不然木地板都要踩破了！
examples.trans: Go talk to him quickly, Qing, or he will wear right through the wooden floorboards!

examples.text: 快带上雨伞吧，不然会淋湿的。
examples.trans: Bring an umbrella quickly, otherwise you will get soaked.

examples.text: 你也不用太悲观了，可以试试云海卫视。
examples.trans: You do not need to be too pessimistic either; you can try Yunhai Television.

examples.text: 这是不用。
examples.trans: This is 不用.

examples.text: 没事，我们不等大腕儿我们等谁啊？
examples.trans: It's fine — if we don't wait for a superstar, who else would we wait for?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

不算什么.gloss: be nothing special, count for little

meanings.en: be nothing special, count for little
meanings.note: Colloquial predicate búsuàn shénme ('no big deal').

examples.text: 解决那两个嘉宾的事根本不算什么。
examples.trans: Sorting out those two guests was really nothing.

examples.text: 这点加班对制片人来说不算什么。
examples.trans: A bit of overtime is nothing to a producer.

examples.text: 那我也不能不管吧，这怎么办啊？
examples.trans: Well, I cannot just ignore it either — what should I do?

examples.text: 这是不管。
examples.trans: This is 不管.

不管怎样.gloss: no matter what, in any case

meanings.en: no matter what, in any case
meanings.note: Discourse connector introducing an unconditional point.

examples.text: 不管怎样，我们都要试试。
examples.trans: No matter what, we have to give it a try.

examples.text: 不管怎样，你先休息一下吧。
examples.trans: In any case, take a rest first.

meanings.note: Without deliberate notice or intent.

examples.text: 他在聊天时不经意提到了这件事。
examples.trans: He mentioned this inadvertently while chatting.

examples.text: 镜头捕捉到了她不经意的微笑。
examples.trans: The camera caught her unguarded smile.

meanings.note: Modal verb bùkěn ('refuse to').

examples.text: 他们两个就是不肯公开道歉。
examples.trans: The two of them flatly refuse to apologise publicly.

examples.text: 她怎么也不肯放弃这个机会。
examples.trans: She refuses to give up on this chance.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bù néng. Modal negation expressing inability or prohibition ('cannot / must not'); bù stays 4th tone before 2nd-tone néng.

examples.text: 油漆还没干，现在不能坐在椅子上。
examples.trans: The paint is not dry yet, so you cannot sit on the chairs right now.

examples.text: 修电线的时候千万不能开总开关。
examples.trans: You must not turn on the main switch while repairing electrical wires.

meanings.note: Formal phrase used in notices and PR statements.

examples.text: 这次失误给公司造成了不良影响。
examples.trans: This mistake caused a negative impact for the company.

examples.text: 公众人物要注意避免带来不良影响。
examples.trans: Public figures should avoid setting a bad example.

examples.text: 这是不行啊。
examples.trans: This is cannot.

examples.text: 那个不行好。
examples.trans: That cannot is good.

examples.text: 不要太着急了，招聘竞争都很激烈。
examples.trans: Do not get too anxious; the hiring competition is very fierce.

examples.text: 这是不要。
examples.trans: This is 不要.

examples.text: 你这么好的姑娘，我为什么不见呀？
examples.trans: Why wouldn't I meet such a talented young woman?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: strict modal expression prohibiting an action

examples.text: 不是说过实习生不许进总编室吗？
examples.trans: Did you not say interns are not allowed inside the chief editor's office?

examples.text: 录影开始以后不许随便走动。
examples.trans: Once taping begins, walking around freely is not allowed.

不负.gloss: live up to, not let down

meanings.en: live up to, not let down
meanings.note: Concise literary verb in phrases like 不负所望 or 天不负.

examples.text: 团队终于不负众望拿下了收视冠军。
examples.trans: The team lived up to expectations and won top ratings.

examples.text: 只要坚持努力，时光终将不负有心人。
examples.trans: If you keep working hard, time will not let down the devoted.

不走心.gloss: half-hearted, not putting one's heart into it

meanings.en: half-hearted, not putting one's heart into it
meanings.note: Colloquial opposite of 走心.

examples.text: 敷衍了事的策划一看就很不走心。
examples.trans: A slapdash proposal looks half-hearted at a glance.

examples.text: 对待感情如果太不走心就没意思了。
examples.trans: Romance feels pointless if you do not put your heart into it.

meanings.note: Adjective/noun bùzú ('shortage, inadequate').

examples.text: 同质化其实是原创力不足的表现。
examples.trans: Copycat shows reflect a lack of original creativity.

examples.text: 经验不足可以通过多练来弥补。
examples.trans: Lack of experience can be made up through practice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bú guò. Gentle conversational 'though / however', softer than 但是.

examples.text: 很安静，谢谢，不过这个行李箱今天特别重。
examples.trans: Very quiet, thank you, though this suitcase feels especially heavy today.

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

meanings.note: Fixed commercial phrase refusing price negotiation.

examples.text: 加急项目的报价一向不还价。
examples.trans: Quotes for rush projects are strictly non-negotiable.

examples.text: 这家老店明码标价，从来不还价。
examples.trans: This old shop posts clear prices and never haggles.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bú cuò. Warm everyday praise meaning 'really quite good!'.

examples.text: 第二天上班，干得不错，新手。
examples.trans: For day two on the job, nicely done, rookie.

examples.text: 这家小店的红茶味道真不错。
examples.trans: The black tea at this little shop tastes really good.

meanings.note: Continuing without any break.

examples.text: 指挥系统七十二小时不间断运行。
examples.trans: The command system runs non-stop for seventy-two hours.

examples.text: 工作人员进行了不间断的现场测试。
examples.trans: Staff carried out uninterrupted on-site testing.

examples.text: 你是我的粉丝会会长，你想见我一面并不难啊，这是何必呢？
examples.trans: You are president of my fan club — meeting me wasn't hard in the first place, so why go to such lengths?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Adjective bùyǎ ('indecent, unseemly').

examples.text: 网上的那些不雅照片其实是合成的。
examples.trans: Those indecent online photos were digitally fabricated.

examples.text: 公共场合请注意不要有不雅举动。
examples.trans: Please avoid improper behaviour in public places.

meanings.note: Colloquial adjective for people or plans that cannot be counted on.

examples.text: 这个计划听起来不太靠谱。
examples.trans: This plan does not sound very reliable.

examples.text: 他办事有时候真不靠谱。
examples.trans: The way he handles things is really flaky sometimes.

meanings.note: Formal preposition/conjunction yǔ ('with; and').

examples.text: 他不宜与艺人见面。
examples.trans: He should not meet with artists.

examples.text: 这事与你无关。
examples.trans: This matter has nothing to do with you.

meanings.note: Correlative conjunction yǔqí ('rather than...').

examples.text: 与其签在别的公司，不如选更自由的地方。
examples.trans: Rather than signing elsewhere, choose a freer place.

examples.text: 与其在家着急，不如亲自去问问。
examples.trans: Rather than worrying at home, go ask in person.

examples.text: 不管接受与否，我都会认真地对待辛惠美的情感。
examples.trans: Whether I accept her feelings or not, I will treat Xin Huimei's heart with complete sincerity.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuān yè. Describes skilled, professional work or a field of study.

examples.text: 别瞒了，小晴，我们很专业！先生，我们敬重成都旅游指南！
examples.trans: No hiding it, Qing, let's be professional! Sir, we respect the Chengdu Travel Guide!

examples.text: 他的声学测量工具非常专业。
examples.trans: His acoustic measuring tools are very professional.

meanings.note: Noun zhuānmàidiàn ('official brand shop').

examples.text: 这个包在法国专卖店买比较便宜。
examples.trans: This handbag is cheaper at an official boutique in France.

examples.text: 商场一楼新开了一家音响设备专卖店。
examples.trans: A new audio-gear boutique opened on the mall's ground floor.

meanings.note: Someone with deep skill or authority in a field.

examples.text: 他是电视制作方面的专家。
examples.trans: He is an expert in television production.

examples.text: 我们请了几位行业专家。
examples.trans: We invited several industry specialists.

meanings.note: Adjective/adverb zhuānmén ('specialized; specifically').

examples.text: 公司没有专门的行政部。
examples.trans: The firm has no dedicated admin department.

examples.text: 我专门来谢谢你。
examples.trans: I came specifically to thank you.

meanings.note: Noun phrase shìshàng ('in this world').

examples.text: 世上没有后悔药。
examples.trans: There is no medicine for regret in this world.

examples.text: 世上有两样东西管不住。
examples.trans: Two things in this world cannot be controlled.

examples.text: 不愧是商业世家之子呀，真是人尽其用。我没问题。
examples.trans: Spoken like the heir to a business family — putting everyone's strengths to full use. Count me in.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì jiè. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个世界 ('a world'). 世界真小 means 'what a small world!'.

examples.text: 梧桐巷的世界真小，大家原来早就认识！
examples.trans: What a small world on Wutong Lane—it turns out everyone knew each other long ago!

examples.text: 老地图教授走遍了世界各地，最想念的还是小院的热茶。
examples.trans: The old cartography professor travelled all over the world, yet missed the courtyard's hot tea most of all.

meanings.note: Workplace noun yènèi ('inside the profession/industry').

examples.text: 这件事已经把业内全都吓怕了。
examples.trans: This affair has rattled the entire industry.

examples.text: 他在业内一直有很好的口碑。
examples.trans: He has always enjoyed a strong reputation in the industry.

meanings.en: business; commercial operations; line of work
meanings.note: yèwù — refers to the core operational or commercial activities of a company or organization (e.g., 核心业务 'core business').
refers to specialized professional duties as opposed to administrative or support tasks (e.g., 业务能力 'professional competence').

examples.text: 我问你个问题，节目制作的核心业务在哪儿？
examples.trans: Let me ask you a question: where does the core business of show production lie?

examples.text: 听说星天重业务轻行政，没有专门的行政部。
examples.trans: I hear Xingtian prioritises production work over administration and has no separate admin department.

meanings.note: Business noun yèjì ('track record, results').

examples.text: 这是二部成立以来的业绩曲线。
examples.trans: Here is Unit Two's performance curve since launch.

examples.text: 今年团队的业绩非常好。
examples.trans: The team's performance is great this year.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dōng. Cardinal direction; 往东走 ('walk east'), 东边 ('the east side').

examples.text: 出了小院大门，顺着梧桐巷往东数二十步就到了。
examples.trans: Step out the courtyard gate and count twenty paces east along Wutong Lane to get there.

examples.text: 清晨的阳光从东边的窗户照进九号房。
examples.trans: Early morning sunlight shines into Room Nine through the eastern window.

examples.text: 就一定能够征服有数千年文化情感的东方观众？
examples.trans: is enough to win over Eastern audiences shaped by thousands of years of cultural emotion?

examples.text: 乔木这首歌非常充满东方风味，我觉得这是上天赐给你不二的选择。
examples.trans: This song Arbor brims with Eastern poetic charm; I believe it is a match made in heaven for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dōng xi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个东西 ('a thing / item').

examples.text: 深呼吸，周经理。还没人写任何东西呢。
examples.trans: Take a deep breath, Manager Zhou. Nobody has written anything yet.

examples.text: 白纸里面包的东西是给我哥哥志鹏的，不是我的。
examples.trans: What is wrapped inside that white paper is for my brother Zhipeng, not mine.

meanings.note: Classifier after 一/半 for tiny amounts of hope, chance, or feeling.

examples.text: 只要还有一丝希望，我们就绝不放弃。
examples.trans: As long as a shred of hope remains, we will never give up.

examples.text: 他的语气里没有露出一丝紧张。
examples.trans: Not the slightest trace of nerves showed in his voice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sī dài. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条丝带 ('a ribbon').

examples.text: 告诉他们，我箱子上面口袋里有红丝带！
examples.trans: Tell them there is a red ribbon inside the top pocket of my case!

examples.text: 我的行李箱！快打开上面口袋……对，红丝带！
examples.trans: My suitcase! Let me open the top pocket... yes, the red ribbon!

meanings.note: Pinyin: diū. Often follows a verb as a result complement (弄丢 'lose by accident').

examples.text: 停电的时候，纸还能用。
examples.trans: Paper still works when the power goes out.

examples.text: 我以为卖房子时早就丢了！为什么一直替我留着？
examples.trans: I thought it was lost long ago when we sold the house! Why keep it for me?

examples.text: 我给了那个女人一笔钱，她就扔下小允出国去了，我不能丢下他不管。
examples.trans: I gave that woman a sum of money and she abandoned him to go abroad; I couldn't leave him behind.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Verb-object/adjective diūrén ('lose face, disgraceful').

examples.text: 咱们担心他丢人，人家自己不在乎。
examples.trans: We worry he will lose face, yet he does not care.

examples.text: 在直播现场忘词可就太丢人了。
examples.trans: Forgetting lines on live TV would be embarrassing.

丢人现眼.gloss: embarrass oneself in public, make a spectacle of oneself

meanings.en: embarrass oneself in public, make a spectacle of oneself
meanings.note: Idiom describing humiliating public failure.

examples.text: 他最怕在舞台上丢人现眼。
examples.trans: He is most afraid of embarrassing himself on stage.

examples.text: 没准备好就上台会丢人现眼。
examples.trans: Going on stage unprepared will make a spectacle of you.

meanings.note: Verb-complement diūdiào ('lose or forfeit').

examples.text: 可以把去年丢掉的硕士学位拿回来。
examples.trans: You can earn back the master's degree you missed last year.

examples.text: 无论走多远，都不能丢掉做节目的初心。
examples.trans: No matter how far we go, never lose our original creative heart.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liǎng. Used instead of 二 when counting things with a measure word (两个, 两把, 两间).

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 这是两个啊。
examples.trans: This is two.

examples.text: 那个两个好。
examples.trans: That two is good.

meanings.note: Numeral liǎngqiān ('two thousand').

examples.text: 老子在两千多年前写下这本书。
examples.trans: Laozi wrote this book over two thousand years ago.

examples.text: 现场坐了两千名观众。
examples.trans: Two thousand audience members sat in the hall.

examples.text: 这部电影票房两千多万。
examples.trans: This movie made over twenty million at the box office.

examples.text: 粉丝两千多万。
examples.trans: Over twenty million fans.

meanings.note: Warm colloquial term for spouses.

examples.text: 他们两口子感情一直很好。
examples.trans: The two of them have always had a great marriage.

examples.text: 小两口子都在电视台工作。
examples.trans: The young couple both work at the television station.

examples.text: 杏子，前两次的沟通啊，我们有点误会。
examples.trans: Xingzi, there was a tiny misunderstanding in our last two conversations!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Noun liǎngbiān ('both sides').

examples.text: 他们两边你觉得最后谁能赢？
examples.trans: Between the two camps, who do you think will win?

examples.text: 自从出事以后，两边的关系很紧张。
examples.trans: Relations between both sides have been tense since then.

meanings.note: Adjective yángé ('strict').

examples.text: 严格来说，这种拍摄侵犯版权。
examples.trans: Strictly speaking, such filming infringes copyright.

examples.text: 他对节目质量要求非常严格。
examples.trans: He sets very strict standards for show quality.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yán jìn. Formal compound 严 ('strictly') + 禁 ('forbid/prohibit'), common on public signs and used playfully for strict household or kitchen rules.

examples.text: 小美脚后跟底下垫着两个枕头，今天严禁沾地！
examples.trans: Mei has two pillows propped under her heel and is strictly forbidden to touch the floor today!

examples.text: 为了保护八十年的老木头地板，阳光房里严禁乱扔烟头。
examples.trans: To protect the eighty-year-old wooden floor, littering or smoking is strictly forbidden in the sunroom.

meanings.note: Adjective yánkē ('strict and demanding').

examples.text: 你没必要对你的下属太过于严苛。
examples.trans: There is no need to be overly harsh on your subordinates.

examples.text: 他对舞台音质有着近乎严苛的标准。
examples.trans: He holds stage audio to an almost unforgiving standard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yán zhòng. Describes serious problems or damage.

examples.text: 比水管严重……中午房东寄来了一封挂号信。
examples.trans: Worse than a pipe... at noon a registered letter arrived from the landlord.

examples.text: 好在漏水不严重，很快就能修好。
examples.trans: Thankfully the leak is not serious and can be fixed soon.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gè. Most common Mandarin measure word (量词), placed between a number/demonstrative and a noun (一个人, 这个).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gè rén. Describes personal items or individual matters.

examples.text: 那个人为什么不拿回自己的箱子就跑了？
examples.trans: Why did that person run off without taking his own suitcase back?

examples.text: 请带好您的个人随身物品。
examples.trans: Please remember your personal belongings.

meanings.note: Document summarizing education and work experience.

examples.text: 请把你的个人简历发到人事部邮箱。
examples.trans: Please email your personal résumé to human resources.

examples.text: 她在个人简历里列出了参与过的节目。
examples.trans: She listed the shows she worked on in her résumé.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gè zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 高个子 ('a tall build').

examples.text: 我手在发抖——车上下来穿深灰色外套的高个子男人吗？
examples.trans: My hands are shaking—is a tall man in a dark grey coat stepping out?

examples.text: 高个子，深灰色外套，正抬头看我们客栈招牌呢！
examples.trans: Tall, dark grey coat, looking up at our inn sign right now!

meanings.note: Noun gèxìng ('distinct character, individuality').

examples.text: 个性和商业之间的界限很难区分。
examples.trans: The line between individuality and commerce is hard to draw.

examples.text: 这位年轻歌手很有自己的个性。
examples.trans: This young singer has strong individuality.

meanings.note: Noun gè'àn ('individual or isolated case').

examples.text: 制作一部没有个案。
examples.trans: Unit One has no isolated cases.

examples.text: 这只是一个个案。
examples.trans: This is only an isolated case.

examples.text: 小谷这丫头路子野，说不定不会影响你们感情。
examples.trans: Xiaogu is a spirited girl — working together might not hurt your chances after all.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhōng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个中心 ('a center').

examples.text: 我梦寐以求的咖啡馆，就开在自家庭院里！等着瞧我去告诉整条街的人吧！
examples.trans: My dream café—right in our own courtyard! Wait until I tell the whole street!

examples.text: 这是我人生中最棒的第一周！
examples.trans: This is the best first week of my whole life!

meanings.note: Verb zhòngshāng ('maliciously defame').

examples.text: 绝对不能让她们再中伤老大。
examples.trans: We cannot let them slander our boss again.

examples.text: 不要在背后恶意中伤别人。
examples.trans: Do not maliciously malign others behind their backs.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhōng wǔ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个中午 ('a noon hour').

examples.text: 先生？他说：请别打开白纸包，我星期五中午来。
examples.trans: Sir? He says: Please do not open the white paper parcel; I will come Friday at noon.

examples.text: 等星期五中午箱子主人进来，我一定坐第一排看！
examples.trans: When the suitcase owner walks in Friday at noon, I am sitting in the front row!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhōng yāng. Compound 中 ('middle') + 央 ('center'); also used in music for the middle register (中央八度 'middle octave').

examples.text: 院子中央摆着一张干净的木头圆桌。
examples.trans: A clean round wooden table stands in the center of the courtyard.

examples.text: 请把手放在钢琴键盘的中央。
examples.trans: Please place your hands at the center of the piano keyboard.

meanings.note: Noun zhōngxīn ('centre, hub').

examples.text: 我们提前选好几家救助中心。
examples.trans: We pre-select several aid centres in advance.

examples.text: 演播厅在市中心附近。
examples.trans: The studio hall is near the city centre.

meanings.note: Broadcast studio term zhōngkòngshì ('central control room').

examples.text: 导演待在中控室里指挥。
examples.trans: The director directs from the control room.

examples.text: 中控室的画面很清楚。
examples.trans: The screens in the control room are clear.

meanings.note: Advertisement inserted mid-episode during a show.

examples.text: 这档热门综艺的中插广告非常抢手。
examples.trans: Mid-roll ad slots on this hit variety show are in high demand.

examples.text: 播出前必须严格审核每一条中插广告。
examples.trans: Every mid-roll commercial must be vetted strictly before air.

examples.text: 上个月你三天绕地球飞了一整圈，回来开电话会议，中文英文一个字没错过。
examples.trans: Last month you flew around the globe in three days and took a bilingual conference call without missing a single word!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 这是中毒啊。
examples.trans: This is poisoning.

examples.text: 那个中毒好。
examples.trans: That poisoning is good.

meanings.note: Compound noun referring to both Chinese and English versions.

examples.text: 新名片上的中英文头衔都必须仔细核对无误。
examples.trans: Both the Chinese and English titles on new business cards must be checked.

examples.text: 国际电影节的宣传手册采用了中英文双语排版。
examples.trans: The film festival brochure uses a bilingual Chinese-and-English layout.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhōng jiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 正中间 ('the exact middle').

examples.text: 当然不能偷看……咦，自己翻开在中间那页了！
examples.trans: Of course we must not peek... oh, it fell open to the middle page by itself!

examples.text: 两栋砖房中间是一个安静的小院。
examples.trans: Between the two brick buildings lies a quiet small courtyard.

meanings.note: Adjective/verb fēngfù ('rich, varied').

examples.text: 平时写文章多，你的想象力真丰富。
examples.trans: Writing so much has given you a vivid imagination.

examples.text: 这位老导演的现场经验非常丰富。
examples.trans: This veteran director has rich floor experience.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fēng shèng. Specifically praises a generous spread of food.

examples.text: 太好了！现在我想吃一顿丰盛的早餐。
examples.trans: Wonderful! Now I would like to eat a big breakfast.

examples.text: 周末早上的早餐总是格外丰盛。
examples.trans: Weekend morning breakfast is always extra hearty.

meanings.note: Classifier chuàn for things in a line or cluster.

examples.text: 你手上这一串针眼，看着挺疼吧？
examples.trans: That row of needle marks on your hand must hurt, right?

examples.text: 门口挂着一串喜庆的红灯笼。
examples.trans: A string of festive red lanterns hangs by the door.

examples.text: 他们串通好了。
examples.trans: They colluded together.

examples.text: 不要和坏人串通。
examples.trans: Do not collude with bad people.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wèi. Introduces a beneficiary or purpose before the verb (为您准备 'prepare for you').

examples.text: 请别担心！我们特意为您准备好了安静的三楼阁楼书房。
examples.trans: Please do not worry! We specially prepared our quiet third-floor attic study for you.

examples.text: 等周经理听说他为分贝慌了一整夜，表情一定精彩！
examples.trans: Wait until Manager Zhou hears he panicked all night over decibels!

meanings.en: in order to; for the sake of
meanings.note: Pinyin: wèi le. Introduces a goal or purpose, typically at the start of the sentence.

examples.text: 为了一个木头小火车紧张？这事越来越怪了。
examples.trans: Nervous over a wooden toy train? This story gets stranger by the hour.

examples.text: 说实话，我选这一带，也是为了一桩家里的旧事。
examples.trans: Honestly, I also chose this neighbourhood for an old family matter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wèi shén me. Asks for a reason; answered with 因为 ('because').

examples.text: 那个人为什么不拿回自己的箱子就跑了？
examples.trans: Why did that person run off without taking his own suitcase back?

examples.text: 为什么把鞋和木头小火车留到星期五呢？
examples.trans: Why leave the shoes and little wooden train here until Friday?

examples.text: 这是为此啊。
examples.trans: This is for this.

examples.text: 那个为此好。
examples.trans: That for this is good.

为难.gloss: make things difficult for; feel put on the spot

meanings.en: make things difficult for; feel put on the spot
meanings.note: As a verb ('give someone a hard time') or adjective ('awkward/hard').

examples.text: 别在公开场合故意为难年轻同事。
examples.trans: Do not deliberately make things hard for junior colleagues in public.

examples.text: 如果这件事让你太为难就算了。
examples.trans: If this puts you in too difficult a spot, let it go.

examples.text: 如今传出以辛惠美为首的黄金一班五位唱将，一起加盟十二歌王。
examples.trans: Now word has broken that five powerhouse vocalists of the Golden Class led by Xin Huimei are joining Twelve Singers together.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

主业.gloss: main profession, primary line of business

meanings.en: main profession, primary line of business
meanings.note: Contrasts one's core work with side pursuits.

examples.text: 内容制作始终是这家传媒公司的主业。
examples.trans: Content production remains this media company's core business.

examples.text: 他开玩笑说攀岩才是自己的主业。
examples.trans: He joked that rock climbing was actually his true profession.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǔ rén. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位主人 ('an owner / host').

examples.text: 箱子的主人肯定很快会来找的。
examples.trans: The suitcase's owner will surely come looking for it soon.

examples.text: 等星期五中午箱子主人进来，我一定坐第一排看！
examples.trans: When the suitcase owner walks in Friday at noon, I am sitting in the front row!

meanings.note: Title zhǔrèn ('department director').

examples.text: 我们主任不喜欢喝咖啡。
examples.trans: Our director does not like coffee.

examples.text: 这位是新来的主任。
examples.trans: This is the newly arrived director.

meanings.note: Compound noun zhǔhuìchǎng ('main event hall').

examples.text: 制作一部负责主会场。
examples.trans: Unit One is in charge of the main venue.

examples.text: 主会场的灯光准备好了。
examples.trans: Lighting in the main venue is ready.

meanings.note: Acting on one's own without waiting to be asked.

examples.text: 她今天主动提出要帮忙。
examples.trans: She proactively offered to help today.

examples.text: 遇到问题要主动沟通。
examples.trans: When problems come up, communicate proactively.

主动出击.gloss: take the initiative and make one's move

meanings.en: take the initiative and make one's move
meanings.note: Proactively stepping forward rather than waiting passively.

examples.text: 面对好机会，就应该果断主动出击。
examples.trans: When a good opportunity comes along, make your move decisively.

examples.text: 在感情上他劝朋友早点主动出击。
examples.trans: In romance he urged his friend to make a move early.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǔ chú. Combines 主 ('chief/head') + 厨 ('cook/kitchen'); measure word: 位 (wèi).

examples.text: 小美主厨坐在两个枕头上，用木勺指挥整个厨房。
examples.trans: Head Chef Mei sat propped on two pillows, directing the whole kitchen with a wooden spoon.

examples.text: 这位年轻的主厨最擅长烤酥脆的杏仁柠檬挞。
examples.trans: This young head chef specializes in baking crisp almond lemon tarts.

examples.text: 据我所知，她和白石公司的合约没有任何法律效力，如果她不出来主张权利，咱们就没有办法。
examples.trans: From what I learned, her contract with Baishi has no legal validity — yet unless she steps forward to claim her rights, our hands are tied.

examples.text: 如果您愿意出来主张一下，对我们的公司会起到非常大的帮助。
examples.trans: If you are willing to step forward and assert your rights, it will help our company immensely.

meanings.note: Noun zhǔyi ('idea, plan').

examples.text: 他们商量出一个好主意。
examples.trans: They talked over a good plan.

examples.text: 你有什么好主意？
examples.trans: Do you have any good ideas?

主持.gloss: host, preside over (a show or meeting)

meanings.en: host, preside over (a show or meeting)
meanings.note: Verb zhǔchí ('host a programme or chair a meeting').

examples.text: 从这期开始，这档节目就由我来主持。
examples.trans: Starting this episode, I will be hosting this programme.

examples.text: 今天的制作例会由总制片人亲自主持。
examples.trans: Today's production meeting is chaired by the chief producer.

meanings.note: Broadcast noun zhǔchírén ('TV/event host').

examples.text: 上个月跳槽的那个女主持人很有名。
examples.trans: The female host who left last month is well known.

examples.text: 主持人正在台上介绍嘉宾。
examples.trans: The host is introducing guests onstage.

主持公道.gloss: uphold justice, stand up for what is fair

meanings.en: uphold justice, stand up for what is fair
meanings.note: Speaking or acting to set an unfairness right.

examples.text: 大家都希望董事长能出来主持公道。
examples.trans: Everyone hopes the chairwoman will step in to uphold justice.

examples.text: 遇到不公平的事要有人敢主持公道。
examples.trans: When unfairness happens, someone has to stand up for justice.

meanings.note: Media noun zhǔbō ('news or live-stream anchor').

examples.text: 当时主播的耳机都被打掉了。
examples.trans: Even the anchor's earpiece got knocked off.

examples.text: 这位新闻主播声音很清楚。
examples.trans: This news anchor has a very clear voice.

meanings.note: Noun/attributive zhǔliú ('mainstream').

examples.text: 像星天这样的主流公司才是最好的消息源。
examples.trans: Mainstream companies like Xingtian are the best news source.

examples.text: 这种风格已经成为市场的主流。
examples.trans: This style has become the market mainstream.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhú guǎn. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位主管 ('a supervisor').

examples.text: 别抢人，小美！小晴，你愿意留下来当正式前台主管吗？
examples.trans: No poaching, Mei! Qing, are you willing to stay on as our permanent front-desk manager?

examples.text: 新来的前台主管做事又快又稳。
examples.trans: The new front-desk supervisor works quickly and steadily.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǔ yào. Describes the main pipe, main reason, or chief task.

examples.text: 主要设计小图书馆和院子，测量老石墙怎么挡住街上噪音。
examples.trans: Mostly small libraries and courtyards, measuring how old stone walls block street noise.

examples.text: 这条老街主要是安静的小茶馆。
examples.trans: This historic lane is mainly quiet little teahouses.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jǔ. Action verb for holding something up in the air with one's hand (举到光线下 'hold up to the light', 举手 'raise one's hand').

examples.text: 小晴把一号水彩卡片举到窗边，让志豪看清上面的记号。
examples.trans: Qing held Watercolour Card One up by the window so Hao could see the mark clearly.

examples.text: 院子里的邻居们一起举起茶杯，祝贺九号房重新开张。
examples.trans: The neighbours in the courtyard raised their teacups together to celebrate Room Nine reopening.

examples.text: 举办了一届校际桌式足球比赛。
examples.trans: So I put together an intercollegiate table-football tournament.

examples.text: 这联赛就没有再举办过第二届。
examples.trans: And that league never held a second tournament again.

举报.gloss: report misconduct, blow the whistle on

meanings.en: report misconduct, blow the whistle on
meanings.note: Filing an official complaint with management or authorities.

examples.text: 员工向公司管理层举报了账目问题。
examples.trans: Staff reported the accounting irregularities to management.

examples.text: 发现违规行为可以随时实名举报。
examples.trans: Anyone who spots violations may report them formally.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jǔ qǐ. Resultative verb compound 举 ('lift/hold aloft') + 起 ('upward'), used for raising a teacup in a toast or lifting one's hand.

examples.text: 大家都举起热茶杯，一起敬重获新生的九号房。
examples.trans: Everyone raised their warm teacups in a toast to the newly restored Room Nine.

examples.text: 小美举起手里的木勺，像乐队指挥一样轻轻敲了两下。
examples.trans: Mei lifted the wooden spoon in her hand and tapped twice like an orchestra conductor.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǔ. Describes duration rather than physical length (很久 'a very long time').

examples.text: 三年等得太久了，小晴。两个冬天前我就该打电话给他。
examples.trans: Three years was too long to wait, Qing. Two winters ago I should have phoned him.

examples.text: 让你久等了。
examples.trans: Sorry to keep you waiting so long.

examples.text: 我其实不太擅长谈恋爱。那不是应该的吗？这是我作为男朋友的义务啊。
examples.trans: Truthfully, I'm not very skilled at romance — isn't taking your words seriously my duty as your boyfriend?

examples.text: 义务？跟我谈恋爱，用不着拿出尽义务的心态。
examples.trans: Duty? Dating me doesn't call for the mindset of fulfilling an obligation!

meanings.note: literary possessive particle linking modifier and noun

examples.text: 今天是十二歌王决赛之夜！
examples.trans: Tonight is the finals night of Twelve Singers!

examples.text: 今天是十二歌王决赛之夜！
examples.trans: Tonight is the finals night of Twelve Singers!

meanings.note: fixed phrase placed at the end of a noun phrase for 'one of ...'

examples.text: 尹正宇是我们确定的三个最佳人选之一。
examples.trans: Yin Zhengyu is one of the three top candidates we settled on.

examples.text: 这是今年最受欢迎的节目之一。
examples.trans: This is one of the most popular shows this year.

meanings.note: Postposition zhīxià ('under a situation').

examples.text: 在灰度不同的对局之下，黑白会颠覆。
examples.trans: Under shifting shades of a match, black and white reverse.

examples.text: 情急之下，他直接跑去了现场。
examples.trans: In the urgency of the moment, he ran straight to the set.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhī nèi. Measure word (量词): 段, e.g. 三天之内 ('within three days').

examples.text: 十分钟之内你能跑个来回吗？
examples.trans: Can you run there and back within ten minutes?

examples.text: 三天之内一定给您回电话。
examples.trans: We will definitely call you back within three days.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhī qián. Measure word (量词): 段, e.g. 那之前 ('before that time').

examples.text: 好。端上去之前，在上面撒这些新鲜绿香草。
examples.trans: Good. Before serving them, sprinkle these fresh green herbs on top.

examples.text: 先生，上楼之前，我要诚恳跟您道个歉。
examples.trans: Sir, before going upstairs, I owe you an honest apology.

examples.text: 喝完热茶之后，我带你去二楼看看房间。
examples.trans: After we finish our hot tea, I will take you upstairs to see the room.

examples.text: 从那一天之后，他每周五都会来客栈喝一杯茉莉花茶。
examples.trans: From that day onward, he came to the guesthouse every Friday for a cup of jasmine tea.

meanings.note: Postposition zhīwài ('outside of, apart from').

examples.text: 约定之外的项目我们实在没法兼顾。
examples.trans: We cannot take on extra projects beyond our agreement.

examples.text: 工作之外她喜欢在茶馆安静看书。
examples.trans: Outside work she likes reading quietly in teahouses.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhī yè. Literary attributive 之 + 夜 ('night'), used in event titles such as 开幕之夜 ('opening night').

examples.text: 星期五的音乐之夜吸引了许多街坊。
examples.trans: Friday's music night drew many neighbors.

examples.text: 大家都期待着小院客栈的开幕之夜。
examples.trans: Everyone is looking forward to Courtyard Inn's opening night.

examples.text: 不愧是商业世家之子呀，真是人尽其用。我没问题。
examples.trans: Spoken like the heir to a business family — putting everyone's strengths to full use. Count me in.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 你听那个疯婆子胡说！我之所以拿这件事情做文章，就是因为我算准了全世界没有人能找到钟阳子！
examples.trans: Don't listen to that crazy woman's nonsense! The whole reason I built my trap around this song is that nobody on earth can find Zhong Yangzi!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 星天有很多部门，这些部门之间都是平行的。
examples.trans: Xingtian has many departments, and all of these departments are on equal footing.

examples.text: 这是之间。 (Example)
examples.trans: This is 之间.

meanings.note: Idiom describing an organization ruined by intrigue or disorder.

examples.text: 内斗把原本团结的部门搞得乌烟瘴气。
examples.trans: Infighting turned the once united department completely toxic.

examples.text: 新主管决心整顿乌烟瘴气的办公风气。
examples.trans: The new manager resolved to clean up the toxic office climate.

examples.text: 九年前的著名歌手大赛梦想之声，打造出了流行乐坛的黄金一班。
examples.trans: Nine years ago, the famed singing competition Voice of Dreams forged pop music's legendary Golden Class.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǔ jīn. Traditionally 'the five metals' (gold, silver, copper, iron, tin); modern term for tools, screws, and hardware.

examples.text: 街角的五金店卖螺丝、锤子和胶带。
examples.trans: The hardware shop on the corner sells screws, hammers, and tape.

examples.text: 老陈去五金摊买了一卷新电线。
examples.trans: Chen went to the hardware stall and bought a roll of new wire.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǔ jīn diàn. Measure word (量词): 家 (jiā), e.g. 一家五金店 ('a hardware store').

examples.text: 冬天用掉最后一个了。只有桥那边的老五金店有这个尺寸。
examples.trans: Used the last one in winter. Only the old hardware shop past the bridge carries this size.

examples.text: 那家五金店早上几点开门？
examples.trans: What time does that hardware shop open in the morning?

meanings.note: Pinyin: yà má. Combines 亚 ('flax/linseed') + 麻 ('hemp/plant fiber'); used for natural woven linen cloth (亚麻桌布 'linen tablecloth').

examples.text: 四块白亚麻桌布都已经熨得平平整整了。
examples.trans: All four white linen tablecloths have already been ironed nice and flat.

examples.text: 夏天铺上透气的亚麻桌布，整个阳光房都显得格外清爽。
examples.trans: With breathable linen tablecloths laid out in summer, the whole sunroom looks extra fresh.

examples.text: 一些。
examples.trans: Some.

examples.text: 好些。
examples.trans: Many.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiāo. Often pairs with 给 (交给 'hand over to') or 到 (交到 'deliver to').

examples.text: 交给我吧。我们下楼欢迎他。
examples.trans: Leave it to me. Let's go downstairs and welcome him.

examples.text: 您为什么不直接去志鹏家门口把木头小火车交给他呢？
examples.trans: Why not go straight to Zhipeng's door and hand him the wooden train?

meanings.note: Verb jiāodài ('give instructions' or 'give an explanation').

examples.text: 上面交代不让你去。
examples.trans: Management instructed me not to let you go.

examples.text: 想要怎么交代都可以。
examples.trans: Whatever accounting you want is fine.

交差.gloss: report completion of a duty, account for one's task

meanings.en: report completion of a duty, account for one's task
