examples.text: 别催了，我马上就写完了。
examples.trans: Stop rushing me; I am almost done writing.

meanings.note: Medical verb cuītù ('induce emesis in emergency care').

examples.text: 昨晚到了医院先紧急做了催吐。
examples.trans: At the hospital last night, doctors first induced vomiting.

examples.text: 误食有害物品后需要医生专业催吐。
examples.trans: Accidental poisoning requires medical treatment.

meanings.note: Adjective shǎ ('silly, naive').

examples.text: 因为我曾经很傻。
examples.trans: Because I used to be very foolish.

examples.text: 别站在风口吹冷风，傻不傻呀？
examples.trans: Do not stand in the cold draft—why be silly?

examples.text: 你觉得我是那个被人当枪使的傻子，还是天天需要被你保护的麻烦精啊？
examples.trans: Do you see me as a fool used as someone's pawn, or a walking disaster who needs your protection every day?

examples.text: 我现在是你的女朋友，我有这个知情权！我也不是傻子！
examples.trans: I am your girlfriend now, and I have a right to know! I am nobody's fool!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàng. Introduces a likeness or example ('look like, be like').

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 他长得真像他哥哥。
examples.trans: He really looks like his older brother.

examples.text: 我倒是觉得，我们董事长像是真给吓着了。
examples.trans: If you ask me, our chairwoman looked genuinely startled.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàng yàng. Describes a proper meal, repair, or setup.

examples.text: 阁楼里真的有像样的床吗？
examples.trans: Does the attic really have a proper bed?

examples.text: 十分钟就做出了一顿像样的早餐。
examples.trans: In ten minutes she put together a proper breakfast.

examples.text: 这是僵啊。
examples.trans: This is stiff.

examples.text: 那个僵好。
examples.trans: That stiff is good.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a part used in conversational Mandarin.

examples.text: 我有一个儿。
examples.trans: I have a 儿.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的儿。
examples.trans: This is a very good 儿.

examples.text: 他叫小允，是我父亲的儿子。我从来都不知道我父亲会出轨。
examples.trans: His name is little Yun — he is my father's son. I never imagined my father would have an affair.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Verb/noun yǔnxǔ ('allow; permission').

examples.text: 未经过允许的拍摄是不合规的。
examples.trans: Filming without permission is against the rules.

examples.text: 公司不允许员工随便迟到。
examples.trans: The company does not allow staff to arrive late.

meanings.note: Noun yuánlǎo ('long-serving company veteran').

examples.text: 公司里一些元老一直比较抵触改革。
examples.trans: Some company veterans have long resisted reform.

examples.text: 他是电视台建台时期的老元老了。
examples.trans: He is a founding veteran of the TV station.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiōng dì. Measure word (量词): 对 (duì), e.g. 一对兄弟 ('a pair of brothers').

examples.text: 宋老师，快多讲讲梧桐巷那两兄弟吧！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, tell me more about those two brothers on Wutong Lane!

examples.text: 听听保养大师说的！昨天修热水器，今天修两兄弟！
examples.trans: Listen to the maintenance master! Yesterday fixing the boiler, today fixing two brothers!

related.gloss: a pair of brothers (measure word 对)

examples.text: 这是兄弟们啊。
examples.trans: This is brothers.

examples.text: 那个兄弟们好。
examples.trans: That brothers is good.

meanings.note: Adjective chōngfèn ('full, sufficient').

examples.text: 二部在改版期间得到了充分的锻炼。
examples.trans: Unit Two gained thorough training during the revamp.

examples.text: 上台之前主持人做了非常充分的准备。
examples.trans: The host made thorough preparations before going onstage.

examples.text: 乔木这首歌非常充满东方风味，我觉得这是上天赐给你不二的选择。
examples.trans: This song Arbor brims with Eastern poetic charm; I believe it is a match made in heaven for you.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 我觉得我跟他离得好远，他跟我说一句话，我脑子就直接充血，使劲转不停。
examples.trans: Yet he feels so far away — when he speaks one sentence to me, the blood rushes to my head and my mind spins!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiān. Placed before the verb to sequence actions: 先…再… ('first…, then…').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiān sheng. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位先生 ('a gentleman').

examples.text: 等等——先生您好！您问那个深蓝色行李箱吗？
examples.trans: Wait—hello, sir! Are you asking about that dark-blue suitcase?

examples.text: 先生，箱子安全锁在柜子里。请问您贵姓？
examples.trans: Sir, the bag is locked safely in our closet. May I ask your surname?

meanings.note: Pinyin: guāng. Rays of light or brightness (阳光 'sunlight', 灯光 'lamplight').

examples.text: 早上的光从玻璃窗照进阳光房里。
examples.trans: Morning light shines through the glass windows into the sunroom.

examples.text: 换上新灯泡以后，屋子里的光很柔和。
examples.trans: After putting in the new bulb, the light in the room is very gentle.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guāng lín. Polite hospitality word paired with 欢迎 in 欢迎光临 ('Welcome!').

examples.text: 欢迎光临！早上好，您好！
examples.trans: Welcome! Good morning, hello!

examples.text: 欢迎光临我们的院子咖啡馆！
examples.trans: Welcome to our courtyard café!

meanings.note: Adverb guāngshì ('just, alone').

examples.text: 这一句光是注解就有三页。
examples.trans: On this one line, the commentary alone runs three pages.

examples.text: 光是准备道具就花了三天。
examples.trans: Preparing props alone took three full days.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guāng huá. Combines 光 ('polished/sleek') + 滑 ('smooth'); often paired in 又光滑又柔软 ('both smooth and supple').

examples.text: 揉好的面团表面又光滑又柔软，按下去马上弹回来。
examples.trans: The kneaded dough is both smooth and supple on the surface, springing right back when pressed.

examples.text: 打磨过的核桃木桌面摸起来非常光滑。
examples.trans: The sanded walnut tabletop feels wonderfully smooth to the touch.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guāng tū tū. Vivid ABB adjective 光 ('bare') + 秃秃 ('bald/stripped'), used for leafless branches or unpainted bare wood.

examples.text: 冬天的树枝光秃秃的，一片叶子也没有。
examples.trans: In winter the branches are bare, without a single leaf.

examples.text: 打磨完的木板光秃秃地靠在墙边。
examples.trans: The sanded wooden boards leaned bare against the wall.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guāng xiàn. Measure word (量词): 道 (dào), e.g. 一道光线 ('a beam of light').

examples.text: 挂在书桌右边吧，那里光线好。
examples.trans: Hang it to the right of the desk, where the light is good.

examples.text: 向阳的阁楼早上光线特别好。
examples.trans: The south-facing attic has wonderful morning light.

related.gloss: a beam of light (measure word 道)

meanings.note: Pinyin: kè. Standard metric measure word for weight (两百克杏仁粉 'two hundred grams of almond flour'; 一千克 'one kilogram').

examples.text: 做这个蛋糕需要两百克杏仁粉和软黄油。
examples.trans: Making this cake takes two hundred grams of almond flour and soft butter.

examples.text: 小美用厨房秤仔细称了五十克白糖。
examples.trans: Mei carefully weighed out fifty grams of white sugar on the kitchen scale.

meanings.note: Short verb used in 免了职 or 免去.

examples.text: 他突然被公司免了行政职务。
examples.trans: He was suddenly stripped of his executive post.

examples.text: 持工作证可以免登记直接入场。
examples.trans: Staff badge holders may enter without signing in.

免去.gloss: relieve of, remove from (an official post)

meanings.en: relieve of, remove from (an official post)
meanings.note: Formal verb used in personnel announcements.

examples.text: 公告宣布免去他的部门主管职务。
examples.trans: The bulletin announced his removal as department head.

examples.text: 免去行政头衔反而让他更轻松了。
examples.trans: Being relieved of executive titles actually left him lighter.

meanings.en: so as not to; lest; to avoid
meanings.note: miǎnde — conjunction introducing an undesirable consequence that the preceding action seeks to prevent; slightly more conversational than 以免.

examples.text: 我们先把资料准备好，免得耽误他的时间。
examples.trans: Let's prepare the materials first, so as not to waste his time.

examples.text: 你快点跟她解释清楚，免得产生误会。
examples.trans: Hurry up and explain it clearly to her, lest there be a misunderstanding.

related.gloss: in order to avoid; lest (more formal)

免职.gloss: remove from office, dismiss from a post

meanings.en: remove from office, dismiss from a post
meanings.note: Stripping someone of a management position.

examples.text: 听说总监突然被免职，大家都愣住了。
examples.trans: Hearing the director was suddenly dismissed stunned everyone.

examples.text: 这次免职并没有影响他在团队里的威信。
examples.trans: This dismissal did not dent his prestige with the team.

meanings.note: Pinyin: miǎn fèi. Literally 'exempt from fee'.

examples.text: 今晚半价，而且一整周早餐免费！
examples.trans: Half price tonight, plus free breakfast all week!

examples.text: 住店客人早上都可以免费喝热茶。
examples.trans: Overnight guests can enjoy complimentary hot tea every morning.

兔子不吃窝边草.gloss: don't romance right around your own desk

meanings.en: don't romance right around your own desk

examples.text: 兔子不吃窝边草，明白吗？你要是天天上班下班跟她见面，新鲜感没有了。
examples.trans: A smart rabbit doesn't graze right by its burrow, get it? If you see her at work every single day, all the spark disappears.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

入住.gloss: check in, move into (a hotel or residence)

meanings.en: check in, move into (a hotel or residence)
meanings.note: Taking up lodging for an event or trip.

examples.text: 所有参赛歌手都已经入住酒店了。
examples.trans: All competing singers have checked into the hotel.

examples.text: 凭身份证就可以在前台办理入住。
examples.trans: You can check in at the front desk with your ID.

入场.gloss: enter the venue, take one's seat

meanings.en: enter the venue, take one's seat
meanings.note: Verb-object rùchǎng ('audience/guests entering a venue').

examples.text: 对手连嘉宾出发和观众入场都提前直播了。
examples.trans: Our rivals even broadcast guest departures and audience arrivals early.

examples.text: 请持票观众提前半小时有序检票入场。
examples.trans: Ticketed audience members, please enter in order half an hour early.

meanings.note: Idiom/noun rùshìdìzǐ ('close disciple taught personally by a master').

examples.text: 恭喜你正式成为老大的入室弟子！
examples.trans: Congratulations on becoming our boss's personal apprentice!

examples.text: 他是这位名导唯一的入室弟子。
examples.trans: He is this famed director's sole close apprentice.

入组.gloss: join the production crew/cast on set

meanings.en: join the production crew/cast on set
meanings.note: Industry term for an actor or guest reporting to set.

examples.text: 新替补的嘉宾明天一早就正式入组。
examples.trans: The replacement guest officially joins the shoot tomorrow morning.

examples.text: 艺人们提前两天入组熟悉拍摄流程。
examples.trans: The performers joined the crew two days early to learn the flow.

入职.gloss: join a company, start a job

meanings.en: join a company, start a job
meanings.note: Workplace verb rùzhí ('onboard, take up a post').

examples.text: 你确认真的可以入职吗？
examples.trans: Are you sure you can really start the job?

examples.text: 他入职还不到一年。
examples.trans: He joined the company less than a year ago.

meanings.note: Formal verb rùzhù ('take up residence or station at').

examples.text: 一转眼我们已经入驻星天两个月了。
examples.trans: Before we knew it, we have been stationed here two months.

examples.text: 多家文化公司今年入驻了创意园区。
examples.trans: Several media firms moved into the creative park.

meanings.note: Pinyin: quán. Emphasizes entirety before 都 or a verb (全都 'every single one').

examples.text: 怪不得这么重，全是木头和皮鞋！
examples.trans: No wonder it was so heavy—all wood and leather shoes!

examples.text: 四张桌子，八把椅子，全摆好了！
examples.trans: Four tables, eight chairs—everything is set in place!

meanings.note: Noun quánshìjiè ('the entire world').

examples.text: 你是全世界第一个夸他可爱的人！
examples.trans: You are the first person in the whole world to call him cute!

examples.text: 全世界的观众都能看到直播。
examples.trans: Viewers around the whole world can watch the stream.

meanings.note: Noun quánhuì ('all-hands executive meeting').

examples.text: 明天公司要召开一次总监全会。
examples.trans: Tomorrow the company is holding an all-directors meeting.

examples.text: 全会的通知已经发到每个人邮箱。
examples.trans: Notice of the plenary meeting went to every inbox.

全副武装.gloss: bundled up head to toe; in full gear

meanings.en: bundled up head to toe; in full gear
meanings.note: Idiom quánfù-wǔzhuāng ('fully geared/disguised').

examples.text: 至于吗，去个医院还全副武装呢。
examples.trans: Was it necessary to bundle up in full disguise for a hospital visit?

examples.text: 摄影组全副武装地出发去拍外景了。
examples.trans: Fully geared up, the camera crew set out for location shooting.

meanings.note: Adverb quánlì ('with full force').

examples.text: 他们现在全力进入全明星计划。
examples.trans: They are now throwing their full weight into the All-Star project.

examples.text: 全组同事都在全力准备明晚的直播。
examples.trans: The whole team is preparing all-out for tomorrow's broadcast.

meanings.note: Noun quántái ('everyone across the television station').

examples.text: 当年他离开时得罪了全台的人。
examples.trans: When he left back then, he offended the whole station.

examples.text: 这档晚会动员了全台的力量。
examples.trans: This gala mobilised the entire TV station.

meanings.note: Every member of a unit without exception.

examples.text: 决赛前夕，制作部全员留在台里加班。
examples.trans: On the eve of the finale, the entire crew worked late at the station.

examples.text: 新规定需要全员认真学习并配合。
examples.trans: Everyone on the team must study and follow the new rules.

meanings.note: Every team member ready to act immediately.

examples.text: 直播开始前两小时，后备组全员待命。
examples.trans: Two hours before air, the backup crew is all hands on standby.

examples.text: 遇到恶劣天气，技术部门全员待命。
examples.trans: During severe weather, the tech department stands by in full.

meanings.note: Noun quánguó ('nationwide').

examples.text: 全国观众都会看直播。
examples.trans: Viewers nationwide will watch the live show.

examples.text: 这档节目在全国很有名。
examples.trans: This show is famous across the country.

examples.text: 我确实是单身，而且这全城也没有人知道我生日。
examples.trans: I really am single, and nobody in this whole city knows my birthday.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 他真是个全才。
examples.trans: He is really an all-rounder.

examples.text: 公司需要全才。
examples.trans: The company needs all-rounders.

meanings.note: Pinyin: quán xīn. Stronger than 新 ('completely brand-new').

examples.text: 您看，这件软羊毛开衫是全新的，试试吧。
examples.trans: Look, this soft wool cardigan is brand-new; try it on.

examples.text: 浴室里刚换上了全新的铜阀门。
examples.trans: Brand-new brass valves were just fitted in the bathroom.

examples.text: 看全景。
examples.trans: Look at the wide shot.

examples.text: 拍全景。
examples.trans: Shoot a wide shot.

meanings.note: Workplace noun quán'àn ('end-to-end full proposal').

examples.text: 这是布小谷做的全案，核心设计也是她。
examples.trans: Bu Xiaogu built the full proposal and its core design.

examples.text: 策划团队花了一周时间打磨这份全案。
examples.trans: The planning team spent a week polishing this full deck.

meanings.note: Every stage of a broadcast or production.

examples.text: 导演组今天把晚会全流程彩排了一遍。
examples.trans: Today the directing team rehearsed the entire gala rundown.

examples.text: 电视台已经同步了明晚直播的全流程。
examples.trans: The TV station has synced the full rundown for tomorrow's live show.

meanings.note: Noun quánqiú ('worldwide, global').

examples.text: 全球好多华人都是您的粉丝。
examples.trans: Chinese people worldwide are your fans.

examples.text: 全球观众都在关注决赛。
examples.trans: Viewers around the globe are watching the finale.

meanings.note: Adverb/noun quánchéng ('throughout the entire process').

examples.text: 今晚全程盯住现场。
examples.trans: Watch the floor closely all evening.

examples.text: 比赛全程现场直播。
examples.trans: The match is broadcast live from start to finish.

examples.text: 今天的稿子铺满，全网推送！
examples.trans: Flood every channel with today's story and push it across the entire web!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Throwing all one's energy and focus into something.

examples.text: 她全身心地投入到了新节目里。
examples.trans: She threw herself wholeheartedly into the new show.

examples.text: 创作需要全身心的专注。
examples.trans: Creative work requires wholehearted focus.

meanings.note: Pinyin: quán bù. Combines 全 ('whole') + 部 ('part'): precedes numerals + measure words or nouns (全部四张桌子).

examples.text: 小晴把全部窗户都擦得干干净净。
examples.trans: Qing wiped all the windows sparkling clean.

examples.text: 客人们把盘子里的点心全部吃完了。
examples.trans: The guests ate up all the pastries on the plate.

meanings.note: Emphatic adverb quándōu ('all without exception').

examples.text: 网上留言全都是抗议。
examples.trans: Every single comment online is a protest.

examples.text: 好几个网站全都瘫痪了。
examples.trans: Several websites have all crashed.

examples.text: 我已经做了打持久战的准备，十二歌王开播全靠你们自己了。
examples.trans: I am prepared for drawn-out talks abroad, so launching Twelve Singers rests entirely on your shoulders.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Adjective/adverb quánmiàn ('all-round, complete').

examples.text: 主任希望老大直接全面接管这档节目。
examples.trans: The director hopes our boss will take over the show fully.

examples.text: 公司即将启动一次全面的管理改革。
examples.trans: The firm is launching a comprehensive management reform.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bā. Cardinal number 8.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 七点半有八位饿肚子的客人下楼啊！
examples.trans: At seven thirty, eight hungry guests are coming downstairs!

八九不离十.gloss: pretty close to the mark, mostly accurate

meanings.en: pretty close to the mark, mostly accurate
meanings.note: Idiom bājiǔ-bùlíshí ('eight or nine out of ten—very close').

examples.text: 圈里人的事，我猜得八九不离十吧。
examples.trans: About people in our circle, my guesses are pretty close to the truth.

examples.text: 虽然还没公布结果，但大家猜得八九不离十了。
examples.trans: Though unannounced, everyone has guessed pretty close.

meanings.note: Numeral bāshí ('eighty').

examples.text: 今天上午要完成八十分钟的拍摄素材。
examples.trans: This morning we need eighty minutes of usable footage.

examples.text: 这位年过八十的老歌唱家依然嗓音洪亮。
examples.trans: Past eighty, the veteran singer still has a ringing voice.

meanings.note: Colloquial noun/adj bāguà ('entertainment gossip; gossipy').

examples.text: 这八卦新闻每天这么多。
examples.trans: There is so much tabloid gossip every single day.

examples.text: 我是那么八卦的女人吗？
examples.trans: Do I look like such a gossipy woman?

meanings.note: Pinyin: bā dù. Musical interval of eight scale degrees: 八 ('eight') + 度 ('degree/interval').

examples.text: 请把这段旋律升高一个八度再弹一次。
examples.trans: Please raise this melody by one octave and play it again.

examples.text: 钢琴中央八度的音色最温暖。
examples.trans: The tone of the piano's middle octave is the warmest.

八角.gloss: eight-pointed; octagonal (also star anise as noun)

meanings.en: eight-pointed; octagonal (also star anise as noun)
meanings.note: Pinyin: bā jiǎo. Attributive modifier meaning 'eight-cornered / eight-pointed' (八角罗盘花 'eight-point compass rose'). As a kitchen noun, 八角 means star anise.

examples.text: 卡片右下角画着一朵精致的八角罗盘花。
examples.trans: In the bottom-right corner of the card is drawn a delicate eight-point compass rose.

examples.text: 公园中心有一座古老的八角石亭。
examples.trans: In the middle of the park stands an old octagonal stone pavilion.

meanings.note: Contrasts with 私 ('personal/private') in 一公一私 or 公事公办.

examples.text: 在工作场合要分清公和私的界限。
examples.trans: In the workplace one must keep official and private matters distinct.

examples.text: 他一向坚持公事公办，从不偏袒熟人。
examples.trans: He always handles official business strictly by the book.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gōng shì. Measure word (量词): 件 (jiàn), e.g. 一件公事 ('a piece of official business').

examples.text: 说得对。公事等一等——先放在账本旁边。
examples.trans: Right you are. Paperwork can wait—set it beside the ledger for now.

examples.text: 今天不谈公事，只喝茶聊天。
examples.trans: No work business today—just tea and conversation.

related.gloss: a piece of official business (measure word 件)

meanings.note: Pinyin: gōngjiāochē. Measure word: 辆.

examples.text: 我每天坐公交车去上班。
examples.trans: I take the bus to work every day.

examples.text: 公交车站就在前面不远。
examples.trans: The bus stop is just a short distance ahead.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gōng zhòng. Measure word (量词): 群, e.g. 一群公众 ('members of the public').

examples.text: 每天服务街坊邻居——就像对公众开放的早间咖啡馆？！
examples.trans: Serves neighbours daily—like a morning café open to the public?!

examples.text: 小院花园每天上午向公众开放。
examples.trans: The courtyard garden opens to the public every morning.

related.gloss: members of the public (measure word 群)

examples.text: 公关部门。
examples.trans: Public relations department.

examples.text: 危机公关。
examples.trans: Crisis public relations.

meanings.note: Workplace noun gōngguānbù ('PR department').

examples.text: 这也算省了我公关部的麻烦了。
examples.trans: That saved my public-relations department some trouble.

examples.text: 公关部已经准备好了正式声明。
examples.trans: The PR department has prepared the official statement.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gōng sī. Measure word (量词): 家 (jiā), e.g. 一家公司 ('a company').

examples.text: 搬家公司清空房子之前，我从阁楼架子救下了这个盒子。
examples.trans: Before the movers cleared the house, I saved this box from the attic shelf.

examples.text: 他工作的律师公司在市中心。
examples.trans: The law firm where he works is downtown.

meanings.note: Formal announcement issued by a company or organization.

examples.text: 公司刚在宣传栏贴出了一份人事公告。
examples.trans: The company just posted a personnel bulletin on the board.

examples.text: 请大家仔细阅读群里发布的最新公告。
examples.trans: Please read the latest notice posted in the group carefully.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gōngyuán. Measure word: 个, 座.

examples.text: 周末我们去公园散步吧。
examples.trans: Let's go for a walk in the park this weekend.

examples.text: 公园里有很多小孩在玩耍。
examples.trans: There are many children playing in the park.

meanings.note: Noun gōng'ānjú ('public security bureau, police station').

examples.text: 我昨晚在公安局过的夜。
examples.trans: I spent last night at the police station.

examples.text: 公安局就在前面那条街。
examples.trans: The police station is on the street ahead.

examples.text: 就我之前处理这样问题的经验来看，娱乐圈里面公布恋情是最快的办法。
examples.trans: From my past experience handling crises like this in show business, announcing a relationship is the fastest shield.

examples.text: 爆炸性地公布了恋情，此前的隐婚传闻被证明为谣言。
examples.trans: With this bombshell romance announcement, the earlier secret-marriage rumors have been proven false.

examples.text: 对啊，他们之前一直排挤您，我早就看不顺眼了，觉得特别不公平。
examples.trans: Yes! Seeing them push you out back then never sat right with me — it felt completely unfair.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Phrase gōngpíng jìngzhēng ('fair competition').

examples.text: 一会儿在提案会上咱们公平竞争。
examples.trans: Let us compete fairly at the pitch meeting shortly.

examples.text: 市场需要健康的公平竞争。
examples.trans: A healthy market relies on fair competition.

meanings.note: Adjective/adverb gōngkāi ('in public, open').

examples.text: 要求他们必须当众公开道歉。
examples.trans: Demand that they apologise openly in public.

examples.text: 比赛结果将在今晚公开宣布。
examples.trans: Match results will be announced publicly tonight.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gōng jīn. Standard metric weight classifier ('kilogram', equal to two 斤 jīn).

examples.text: 小美在水果摊买了三公斤黄柠檬。
examples.trans: Mei bought three kilos of yellow lemons at the fruit stall.

examples.text: 这个竹篮子最多能装五公斤水果。
examples.trans: This bamboo basket can hold at most five kilograms of fruit.

meanings.note: Non-profit initiatives serving society.

examples.text: 电视台推出了多档关注环保的公益节目。
examples.trans: The station launched several public-interest shows on conservation.

examples.text: 许多艺人积极参加帮助老人的公益活动。
examples.trans: Many artists actively join charity events supporting seniors.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liù. Cardinal number 6.

examples.text: 老陈……小晴……快告诉我今晚六号房空着。
examples.trans: Chen... Qing... please tell me room six is free tonight.

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

examples.text: 我干了六七年了都没你得宠，走走走，快去！
examples.trans: I've worked for him six or seven years without being half as favored — off you go!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Verb-object gòngshì ('be coworkers').

examples.text: 现在可以一起共事，好开心啊。
examples.trans: Getting to work together now makes me so happy.

examples.text: 我们在一起共事三年了。
examples.trans: We have worked together for three years.

examples.text: 共享信息不方便。
examples.trans: Sharing data on my personal machine is inconvenient.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Adverb/adjective gòngtóng ('jointly; shared').

examples.text: 本届盛典由卫视和星天共同呈现。
examples.trans: This gala is jointly presented by the network and Xingtian.

examples.text: 做好节目是我们共同的目标。
examples.trans: Making great shows is our shared goal.

meanings.note: Noun phrase gòngtóng huàtí ('shared topics to talk about').

examples.text: 这样两个人才有共同话题嘛。
examples.trans: That way the two of them have common ground to talk about.

examples.text: 都喜欢音乐让他们很快有了共同话题。
examples.trans: Loving music quickly gave them shared topics.

共进退.gloss: stand or fall together, advance and retreat together

meanings.en: stand or fall together, advance and retreat together
meanings.note: Set phrase gòngjìntuì ('share the same fate loyally').

examples.text: 我们退出今晚直播，跟老大共进退。
examples.trans: We are stepping off tonight's broadcast to stand or fall with our boss.

examples.text: 整个总编室团队决定留下来与总监共进退。
examples.trans: The entire editorial team chose to stay and stand with their director.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guān. Used for closing doors/windows and turning off lights, taps, or valves.

examples.text: 拿稳了！你已经关掉总水阀了吗？
examples.trans: Steady! Did you turn off the main water valve already?

examples.text: 关掉了，水也放空了。把左边那把重扳手递给我。
examples.trans: Turned off and drained. Pass me that heavy wrench on your left.

meanings.note: verb 关 plus resultative 上 emphasizing closing completely

examples.text: 我说的关门，是在外边把门关上。
examples.trans: When I said close the door, I meant close it from the outside.

examples.text: 外面太吵了，把窗户关上吧。
examples.trans: It is too noisy outside; let us close the window.

examples.text: 关于这事。
examples.trans: Regarding this matter.

examples.text: 关于他。
examples.trans: Regarding him.

meanings.note: Verb guānxīn ('care about, be concerned with').

examples.text: 大众关心的是艺人的绯闻。
examples.trans: What the public cares about is celebrity gossip.

examples.text: 谢谢你一直这么关心我。
examples.trans: Thank you for caring about me all along.

关机.gloss: power off, switch off a phone/machine

meanings.en: power off, switch off a phone/machine
meanings.note: Turning off a mobile phone or device.

examples.text: 飞机起飞前请把手机调成飞行模式或关机。
examples.trans: Before takeoff, put your phone in airplane mode or turn it off.

examples.text: 他的手机一直关机，谁都联系不上他。
examples.trans: His phone has been switched off, so nobody can reach him.

examples.text: 星天娱乐一直是备受投资界关注的明星企业，公司估值一度突破百亿。
examples.trans: Xingtian Entertainment has long been a star company watched closely by investors, with its valuation once topping ten billion.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Media metric measuring audience interest.

examples.text: 预告片发布后，新剧的关注度迅速攀升。
examples.trans: After the trailer dropped, buzz around the new drama soared.

examples.text: 请明星客串是为了推高节目的关注度。
examples.trans: Inviting celebrity guests was meant to boost the show's buzz.

meanings.note: Number of followers on social or streaming platforms.

examples.text: 他的直播账号一夜之间关注量突破百万。
examples.trans: His streaming account topped a million followers overnight.

examples.text: 优质内容自然会带来稳定的关注量。
examples.trans: High-quality content naturally brings steady follower growth.

关照.gloss: look out for, take care of

meanings.en: look out for, take care of
meanings.note: Polite verb guānzhào ('look after kindly').

examples.text: 他平时对你这么关照。
examples.trans: He looks out for you so thoughtfully.

examples.text: 初来乍到，请大家多多关照。
examples.trans: I am new here; thank you all for looking out for me.

examples.text: 我们的关系很好。
examples.trans: Our relationship is very good.

examples.text: 没关系。
examples.trans: It doesn't matter.

meanings.note: Noun/verb guānlián ('connection, related').

examples.text: 好几个关联公司的网站瘫痪了。
examples.trans: Several affiliated companies' sites went down.

examples.text: 这两件事没有直接关联。
examples.trans: These two matters have no direct link.

examples.text: 比起资本风险，更关键的是机会成本。
examples.trans: Compared with capital risk, the far bigger issue is opportunity cost.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: The central factor determining success or failure.

examples.text: 她一眼就看出了这次危机公关的关键点。
examples.trans: She spotted the crux of this crisis response at a glance.

examples.text: 双方谈判的关键点在于版权归属。
examples.trans: The key point in the talks is ownership of the format rights.

examples.text: 我不想看你的上网记录。关门。
examples.trans: I have zero interest in your browsing history. Close the door.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Adjective xīngfèn ('excited').

examples.text: 第一次出国拍节目，心里很兴奋吧？
examples.trans: Excited to fly abroad for your very first shoot?

examples.text: 听到方案全票通过，全组人都兴奋地鼓起掌来。
examples.trans: Hearing the pitch passed unanimously, the crew clapped excitedly.

examples.text: 谢谢您这么看重我，可是兴许明天那帮人就把我开除了。
examples.trans: Thank you for thinking so highly of me, though that crowd might fire me first thing tomorrow.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Noun qízhōng ('among which, in it').

examples.text: 其中之一就是别人的嘴。
examples.trans: One among them is other people's mouths.

examples.text: 我也是其中的一员。
examples.trans: I am also one of them.

meanings.note: qítā — determiner/pronoun used before nouns (often with 的 for inanimate nouns, or directly before nouns like 人 'other people' or 地方 'other places').

examples.text: 他不能再上其他的节目，只能取消通告。
examples.trans: He cannot appear on any other shows, so we can only cancel the booking.

examples.text: 其他人都已经下班了，办公室里只剩下她一个。
examples.trans: Everyone else had already left work, leaving her alone in the office.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qí shí. Gently reveals the real truth behind a misunderstanding.

examples.text: 其实我下楼是想问问，洗手间水龙头怎么有点凉。
examples.trans: Actually, I came down to ask why the bathroom tap felt a bit cool.

examples.text: 你的服务值得十分！其实我是声学建筑师。
examples.trans: Your service deserves ten points! Actually, I am an acoustic architect.

meanings.note: Adjective/noun diǎnxíng ('quintessential, typical').

examples.text: 他是典型的富二代，很有影响力。
examples.trans: He is a classic wealthy heir with strong clout.

examples.text: 这是一个非常成功的典型案例。
examples.trans: This is a classic success case.

meanings.note: Verb yǎng ('bring up children; nurse health').

examples.text: 凭什么耍威风？谁都是父母养大的！
examples.trans: Why put on airs? Every one of us was raised by loving parents!

examples.text: 胃病三分靠治，七分靠平时慢慢养。
examples.trans: Healing stomach trouble takes medicine plus gentle daily care.

meanings.note: Verb-complement yǎngchéng ('develop a habit').

examples.text: 你刚来，不要养成这样的坏习惯。
examples.trans: You just joined—do not form that kind of bad habit.

examples.text: 从小养成爱读书的好习惯受益终身。
examples.trans: Forming a reading habit early benefits you for life.

meanings.note: Used formally or humorously for raising pets, fish, or livestock.

examples.text: 他最近迷上了在家养殖小鱼。
examples.trans: Lately he has gotten into raising small fish at home.

examples.text: 养殖宠物需要很多耐心。
examples.trans: Keeping pets takes a lot of patience.

meanings.note: Verb-complement yǎnghuo ('provide for, support').

examples.text: 想同时养活咱们姐俩，胃口太大了。
examples.trans: Trying to support both of us sisters is too ambitious.

examples.text: 她毕业后靠自己的能力养活自己。
examples.trans: After graduation she supported herself on her own.

meanings.note: Parents who raised an adopted child.

examples.text: 他从小在养父母的悉心照顾下长大。
examples.trans: He grew up under the loving care of his adoptive parents.

examples.text: 每逢假期他都会回老家看望养父母。
examples.trans: Every holiday he travels home to visit his adoptive parents.

养病.gloss: recuperate, rest up to recover from illness

meanings.en: recuperate, rest up to recover from illness
meanings.note: Taking rest at home or hospital to heal.

examples.text: 医生再三嘱咐他回家安心养病。
examples.trans: The doctor urged him repeatedly to rest up at home.

examples.text: 既然选择在家养病，就别再操心工作了。
examples.trans: Since you chose to recuperate at home, stop fretting over work.

meanings.note: Food noun yǎngwèizhōu ('gentle rice porridge for the stomach').

examples.text: 我妈做的养胃粥可好喝了。
examples.trans: My mum's stomach-soothing porridge tastes wonderful.

examples.text: 胃不舒服的时候喝碗热乎乎的养胃粥最合适。
examples.trans: Warm stomach-soothing porridge is best when your stomach aches.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiān. Links two simultaneous roles, titles, or functions held by one person or establishment (咖啡馆兼客栈 'café-cum-guesthouse').

examples.text: 小院客栈正式获批成为街坊老建筑咖啡馆兼客栈。
examples.trans: Courtyard Inn was officially approved as a neighbourhood heritage café and guesthouse.

examples.text: 在我们的厨房里，志鹏今天是面包学徒兼试吃员。
examples.trans: In our kitchen today, Peng is both apprentice baker and taste tester.

meanings.note: Verb jiāngù ('give due attention to multiple tasks').

examples.text: 约定之外的项目我们实在没法兼顾。
examples.trans: We truly cannot juggle extra projects beyond our deal.

examples.text: 好方案既要兼顾收视，也要兼顾口碑。
examples.trans: A good show balances ratings with reputation.

meanings.note: Postposition marking a time window or area.

examples.text: 短期内她不打算从国外回来了。
examples.trans: She does not plan to return from abroad in the near term.

examples.text: 请大家在半小时内赶到会议室。
examples.trans: Please get to the conference room within half an hour.

meanings.note: Noun nèiróng.

examples.text: 小心自己传播的内容。
examples.trans: Be careful about the content you spread.

examples.text: 节目内容很精彩。
examples.trans: The show's content is wonderful.

meanings.note: Unpublicised facts known only to insiders.

examples.text: 外人根本不清楚这件事的真正内幕。
examples.trans: Outsiders have no idea of the real inside story.

examples.text: 记者试图打听这次换人事件的内幕。
examples.trans: Reporters tried to dig into the inside story of the recasting.

meanings.note: Refers to cultural depth of a person or deeper meaning of a work.

examples.text: 这档节目很有文化内涵。
examples.trans: This programme has real cultural depth.

examples.text: 做一个有内涵的人很重要。
examples.trans: Being a person of inner substance is important.

meanings.note: Locative noun nèibù ('in-house, internal').

examples.text: 内部的技术人员正在检查硬盘。
examples.trans: In-house technicians are checking the drives.

examples.text: 这是公司内部的会议资料。
examples.trans: These are internal company meeting materials.

meanings.note: Colloquial workplace noun nèiguǐ ('inside ghost').

examples.text: 证明谁是内鬼。
examples.trans: Prove who the mole is.

examples.text: 公司抓到了内鬼。
examples.trans: The company caught the mole.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. Marks a next step in sequence (先提再推) or a future repetition (再见 'see you again').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 我知道当年我拿总冠军，你们心里没一个服气的，还敢再战吗？
examples.trans: I know none of you were convinced inside when I won the championship back then — dare to battle me again?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 我拒绝和白杨再次同台。
examples.trans: I refuse to share the stage with Bai Yang a second time.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 自从修好了密封条，这扇木窗就再没漏过风。
examples.trans: Ever since the weatherstripping was fixed, this wooden window has never let in a draft again.

examples.text: 那位神秘的客人留下一封感谢信后，就再没出现过。
examples.trans: After leaving a thank-you letter behind, that mysterious guest never appeared again.

meanings.note: Bringing back past glory, scenes, or ratings.

examples.text: 这部纪录片生动再现了当年的创作历程。
examples.trans: This documentary vividly recreates the creative journey back then.

examples.text: 新团队希望能再现王牌节目的高收视率。
examples.trans: The new team hopes to match the hit ratings of the flagship show.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài jiàn. Standard Mandarin farewell at any time of day.

examples.text: 路上小心，我们明天再见！
examples.trans: Take care on the road—see you again tomorrow!

examples.text: 谢谢您的帮忙，再见！
examples.trans: Thank you for your help—goodbye!

meanings.note: Conjunction/verb zàishuō ('besides; talk later').

examples.text: 再说了，还是跟着淳于总最好。
examples.trans: Besides, working under Chun Yuqiao is still best.

examples.text: 这件事等明天开完会再说吧。
examples.trans: Let us talk about this after tomorrow's meeting.

meanings.note: Adjective màoshi ('blundering, tactless').

examples.text: 刚才我太冒失了，不好意思。
examples.trans: I was too careless just now; excuse me.

examples.text: 做事不要这么冒失。
examples.trans: Do not act so rashly.

meanings.note: Verb màofàn ('offend, disrespect').

examples.text: 渣男也有被冒犯的时候啊。
examples.trans: Even a cad has moments when he feels affronted.

examples.text: 刚才说话太直接，如有冒犯请多包涵。
examples.trans: I spoke bluntly just now; please forgive any offence.

meanings.note: Verb-object màoxiǎn ('take risks').

examples.text: 没有平台愿意冒险去投资本土原创节目。
examples.trans: No platform wants to risk investing in domestic originals.

examples.text: 不肯冒险尝试新形式，就永远做不出爆款。
examples.trans: Without risking fresh formats, you never create a breakout hit.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mào yǔ. Compact verb phrase meaning 'go out despite the rain'.

examples.text: 谢谢你们实话实说，没让我冒雨再找地方。
examples.trans: Thank you both for speaking honestly instead of sending me back into the rain.

examples.text: 邮递员冒雨送来了一封挂号信。
examples.trans: The mail carrier braved the rain to deliver a registered letter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiě. Used for writing characters, notes, letters, or reviews.

examples.text: 到星期五？没写名字，也没签名！
examples.trans: Until Friday? No name written, and no signature either!

examples.text: 只剩三十五分钟了！他肯定会写一星差评！
examples.trans: Only thirty-five minutes left! He will surely write a one-star bad review!

examples.text: 这是写到啊。
examples.trans: This is write onto.

examples.text: 那个写到好。
examples.trans: That write onto is good.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiě zì bǎn. Combines 写字 ('write characters') + 板 ('board'); measure word: 块 (kuài) or 个 (gè).

examples.text: 志鹏拿起写字板笑道：“写字板准备好了，小美主厨请下令吧！”
examples.trans: Picking up the clipboard, Peng grinned: 'Clipboard ready—give your orders, Chef Mei!'

examples.text: 小晴把星期三的检查清单夹在写字板上，逐条核对。
examples.trans: Qing clipped Wednesday's checklist onto the writing board and checked off each item.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiě wán. Resultative verb compound 写 ('write') + 完 ('finish').

examples.text: 宋老师终于在傍晚前写完了整首圆舞曲。
examples.trans: Teacher Song finally finished writing the whole waltz before dusk.

examples.text: 我写完这张明信片就去邮局寄出。
examples.trans: As soon as I finish writing this postcard, I will mail it at the post office.

examples.text: 老大立了军令了，说有什么变化的话一定要向他通报。
examples.trans: Our boss gave strict orders before leaving to notify him immediately of any changes.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

军规.gloss: military regulations; strict team ground rules

meanings.en: military regulations; strict team ground rules
meanings.note: Used playfully for Chun Yuqiao's strict studio rules.

examples.text: 总编室立下了著名的三十七条军规。
examples.trans: The editorial office laid down thirty-seven famous ground rules.

examples.text: 新人进组第一天就要背熟团队军规。
examples.trans: Newcomers must memorise the team's ground rules on day one.

meanings.note: Media verb/noun guànmíng ('title sponsorship').

examples.text: 台上的冠名饮料摆错了。
examples.trans: The title-sponsor drinks onstage were placed wrong.

examples.text: 这家公司冠名了今年的晚会。
examples.trans: This firm title-sponsored this year's gala.

meanings.note: Broadcast noun guànmíngshāng ('headline commercial sponsor').

examples.text: 工作人员弄错了冠名商的产品摆放。
examples.trans: Staff mixed up the title sponsor's product placement.

examples.text: 冠名商是电视台最重要的客户。
examples.trans: The title sponsor is the network's biggest client.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dōng tiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个冬天 ('a winter').

examples.text: 冬天用掉最后一个了。只有桥那边的老五金店有这个尺寸。
examples.trans: Used the last one in winter. Only the old hardware shop past the bridge carries this size.

examples.text: 两个都买下！留一个备用明年冬天也省心。
examples.trans: Buy both! Keeping a spare saves worry next winter too.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bīng. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块冰 ('a piece of ice').

examples.text: 别担心！用冰气泡水一擦，橙汁就掉。
examples.trans: Do not worry! Wipe it once with cold sparkling water and orange juice comes right out.

examples.text: 杯子里加了两块冰。
examples.trans: Two ice cubes were added to the glass.

related.gloss: a piece of ice (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: bīng liáng. Vivid adjective stronger than 凉.

examples.text: 到明天早上，淋浴喷头的水就会冰凉。
examples.trans: By tomorrow morning, the shower water will be ice-cold.

examples.text: 冰凉的洗澡水？！成都旅游指南评审员就住在三楼啊！
examples.trans: Ice-cold shower water?! The Chengdu Travel Guide inspector is staying on floor three!

meanings.note: Pinyin: bīng kuài. Combines 冰 ('ice') + 块 ('cube/chunk'); measure word: 块 (kuài) or 包 (bāo).

examples.text: 快把脚抬到椅子上放着，我去用干净毛巾包点冰块敷一下。
examples.trans: Prop your foot up on the chair while I go wrap some ice cubes in a clean towel for it.

examples.text: 夏天喝柠檬薄荷水的时候，加两块冰块最解暑。
examples.trans: When drinking lemon mint water in summer, adding two ice cubes is the most refreshing.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bīng xiāng. Measure word (量词): 台, e.g. 一台冰箱 ('a refrigerator').

examples.text: 送牛奶的车在城外坏了。你们看冰箱！
examples.trans: The milk delivery van broke down outside town. Look at the fridge!

examples.text: 我把新鲜牛奶放进冰箱里了。
examples.trans: I put the fresh milk into the refrigerator.

meanings.note: Cafe noun bīngměishì ('iced Americano coffee').

examples.text: 我的话，一杯冰美式就可以了。
examples.trans: For me, an iced Americano will do.

examples.text: 请给我一杯冰美式，不加糖。
examples.trans: An iced Americano with no sugar, please.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chōng. Used for pouring boiling water to brew tea or coffee (冲茶 'brew tea').

examples.text: 小晴你真是救星！先给我牛奶冲咖啡。
examples.trans: Qing, you are a lifesaver! Hand me the milk first to make coffee.

examples.text: 慢慢拧……听！水冲进来了！
examples.trans: Turning slowly... listen! Water is rushing in!

meanings.en: to decide; to resolve; to make up one's mind
meanings.note: juédìng — verb taking a verb phrase or clause as its object, or used intransitively with 了 to mean 'I have decided'.
used as a noun with verbs like 做/做出 ('make a decision') or 改变 ('change a decision').

examples.text: 我决定了，我要去见他，跟他学习！
examples.trans: I have made up my mind — I am going to see him and learn from him!

examples.text: 他们已经取消了今夜现场的通告，决定来录我们的文娱论。
examples.trans: They already cancelled their appearance on Tonight Live and decided to record our Entertainment Talk.

related.gloss: to make up one's mind; determination

meanings.note: noun

examples.text: 今天是十二歌王决赛之夜！
examples.trans: Tonight is the finals night of Twelve Singers!

examples.text: 今天是十二歌王决赛之夜！
examples.trans: Tonight is the finals night of Twelve Singers!

meanings.note: Conjunction kuàngqiě ('moreover, besides').

examples.text: 况且你也已经跟公司签了合同了。
examples.trans: Besides, you have already signed the contract.

examples.text: 时间太晚了，况且外面还在下雨。
examples.trans: It is late, and besides, it is raining outside.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lěng. Describes cold weather, unheated rooms, or cold water.

examples.text: 热汤？在冷雨中走过来之后，这听起来太棒了。
examples.trans: Hot soup? After that cold walk in the rain, that sounds wonderful.

examples.text: 那今晚房间会冷吗？也没有热水了吗？
examples.trans: Will the rooms get cold tonight? And is there no hot water either?

meanings.note: Pinyin: léng shuǐ. Measure word (量词): 杯 (bēi), e.g. 一杯冷水 ('a glass of cold water').

examples.text: 周经理，给您干净布和冷水。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou, here is a clean cloth and cold water for you.

examples.text: 定好闹钟吧，老陈。明早我们跑赢冷水！
examples.trans: Set your alarm, Chen. Tomorrow morning we outrun the cold water!

related.gloss: a glass of cold water (measure word 杯)

meanings.note: Adjective lěngqīng ('bare, quiet and cheerless').

examples.text: 这直男的房间看起来非常冷清啊。
examples.trans: A bachelor's room like this looks remarkably austere and empty.

examples.text: 直播结束散场以后，空荡荡的演播厅格外冷清。
examples.trans: Once the live crowd leaves, the empty studio feels extra quiet.

examples.text: 秋天的冷雨敲打着客栈的木窗。
examples.trans: The cold autumn rain tapped against the wooden windows of the guesthouse.

examples.text: 迎着冷雨走了二十分钟，进门看到温暖的炉火真让人舒心。
examples.trans: After walking twenty minutes against the cold rain, seeing the warm hearth fire upon stepping inside was a true relief.

meanings.note: Adjective/verb lěngjìng ('calm down; cool-headed').

examples.text: 两位老师请先冷静一下！
examples.trans: Teachers, please calm down first!

examples.text: 遇到突发状况一定要保持冷静。
examples.trans: Always stay calm in a sudden emergency.

meanings.note: Verb dòngjié ('freeze assets or agreements').

examples.text: 他们跟辛惠美的签约已经冻结了。
examples.trans: Their contract signing with Xin Huimei has been frozen.

examples.text: 项目预算暂时被财务部门冻结了。
examples.trans: The project budget was temporarily frozen by finance.

meanings.note: Adjective qīliáng ('bleak, forlorn').

examples.text: 当时没有人陪，心里感觉特别凄凉。
examples.trans: With nobody beside me back then, it felt terribly lonely.

examples.text: 秋风吹过空荡荡的外景地，显得有些凄凉。
examples.trans: Autumn wind across the empty backlot felt somewhat bleak.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǔn. Describes accurate clocks or spotting something accurately (看准).

examples.text: 一定看准里面铜圈是二十毫米宽。
examples.trans: Make sure the brass ring inside is twenty millimetres wide.

examples.text: 这块老钟走得非常准。
examples.trans: This old clock keeps very accurate time.

meanings.note: Colloquial noun for reliable confirmation.

examples.text: 明天我一定给你一个准信。
examples.trans: Tomorrow I will definitely give you a firm answer.

examples.text: 这件事到现在还没有准信。
examples.trans: There is still no definite word on this matter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǔn bèi. Used for preparing rooms, breakfast, or plans.

examples.text: 大家早上好！欢迎你，小晴。都准备好了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning, everyone! Welcome, Qing. Is everything ready?

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

meanings.note: Media headline term combining 准 ('prospective') and 夫君 ('husband').

examples.text: 八卦媒体把那位制作人称作她的准夫君。
examples.trans: Gossip outlets dubbed that producer her husband-to-be.

examples.text: 粉丝们都在讨论这位神秘的准夫君是谁。
examples.trans: Fans are all buzzing about who this husband-to-be might be.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǔn shí. Praises trains or guests arriving right on schedule.

examples.text: 我？哦，我只是喜欢准时！七点十四分真美妙！
examples.trans: Me? Oh, I simply love punctuality! Seven fourteen is a lovely minute!

examples.text: 早上七点半的火车一向很准时。
examples.trans: The seven-thirty morning train is always right on time.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liáng. Describes pleasantly cool air or hot water/food that has cooled down (放凉).

examples.text: 谢谢你，小美。刚才吓了一跳，手都凉了！
examples.trans: Thank you, Mei. That gave me such a start just now that my hands went cold!

examples.text: 摸摸热水管——下面是温的，上面变凉了。
examples.trans: Feel the hot-water pipe—the bottom is warm, while the top is turning cool.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liáng shuǐ. Measure word (量词): 杯 (bēi), e.g. 一杯凉水 ('a glass of cool water').

examples.text: 志豪先生，喝口凉水吧。纸上写的什么？
examples.trans: Mr Zhihao, drink a sip of cool water. What is written on that paper?

examples.text: 夏天洗把凉水脸真舒服。
examples.trans: Splashing cool water on your face in summer feels refreshing.

related.gloss: a glass of cool water (measure word 杯)

meanings.note: Light, low-calorie food prepared for losing weight.

examples.text: 她每天中午都自己带减肥餐。
examples.trans: She brings her own diet meal every day at noon.

examples.text: 这份减肥餐做得特别清淡。
examples.trans: This diet meal is made very lightly.

减薪.gloss: cut salary, take a pay cut

meanings.en: cut salary, take a pay cut
meanings.note: Reducing regular wages as a penalty or cost measure.

examples.text: 公司宣布对他处以减薪一半的处罚。
examples.trans: The company announced a penalty cutting his pay in half.

examples.text: 宁可自己减薪，他也不愿裁掉团队成员。
examples.trans: He would rather take a pay cut himself than lay off team members.

meanings.note: Verb-object còuqián ('chip in money').

examples.text: 粉丝们凑钱帮她交违约金。
examples.trans: Fans pooled money to help pay her penalty fee.

examples.text: 大家凑钱给她买了一份生日礼物。
examples.trans: Everyone chipped in to buy her a birthday gift.

meanings.note: Pinyin: níng rǔ. Combines 凝 ('congeal/set into a smooth custard') + 乳 ('milk/creamy emulsion'); 柠檬凝乳 is the culinary term for lemon curd.

examples.text: 要是我坐在椅子上休息，明天早上的柠檬凝乳谁来熬呢？
examples.trans: If I sit resting in a chair, who will cook tomorrow morning's lemon curd?

examples.text: 用新鲜蛋黄和柠檬汁慢火熬出的柠檬凝乳又香又滑。
examples.trans: Lemon curd cooked slowly over low heat with fresh egg yolks and lemon juice is fragrant and silky.

meanings.note: Verb nínggù ('congeal, become fixed').

examples.text: 万物之理，永不凝固。
examples.trans: The pattern of all things never freezes in place.

examples.text: 空气仿佛在一瞬间凝固了。
examples.trans: The air seemed to freeze in an instant.

examples.text: 团队凝聚力强。
examples.trans: The team has strong cohesion.

examples.text: 增强凝聚力。
examples.trans: Enhance cohesion.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jǐ. Asks about small numbers (几点 'what time', 几个 'how many') before a measure word.

examples.text: 真的？您不介意多爬几步楼梯？
examples.trans: Really? You do not mind climbing a few extra stairs?

examples.text: 那家五金店早上几点开门？
examples.trans: What time does that hardware shop open in the morning?

examples.text: 学校几个球友打不过我，嫌没劲。
examples.trans: None of the campus players could beat me, so they complained it wasn't fun.

examples.text: 这几天又有几个八卦微博在说你已婚的事情，我们经纪部出了几个方案，需要你配合一下。
examples.trans: Over the past few days several gossip accounts on Weibo started claiming you're secretly married; management drafted response plans for you.

examples.text: 这几天又有几个八卦微博在说你已婚的事情，我们经纪部出了几个方案，需要你配合一下。
examples.trans: Over the past few days several gossip accounts on Weibo started claiming you're secretly married; management drafted response plans for you.

examples.text: 我这几天没空。
examples.trans: I don't have spare time over the next few days.

examples.text: 可是前几年您与白石公司签订了一份合约，按照法律来讲，对您的权益是有所损害的。
examples.trans: Yet a few years ago you signed a contract with Baishi that legally infringed upon your own rights.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Question phrase jǐdiǎnzhōng ('what hour').

examples.text: 那师兄今天几点钟下班？
examples.trans: What time do you get off work today, Senior?

examples.text: 请问明天的飞机是几点钟？
examples.trans: What time is tomorrow's flight?

meanings.note: given-name character of guest mentor Liu Fan

examples.text: 有请本场十二歌王的客座导师，刘凡先生！
examples.trans: Please welcome tonight's Twelve Singers guest mentor, Mister Liu Fan!

examples.text: 刘凡是今晚特邀的客座导师。
examples.trans: Liu Fan is tonight's specially invited guest mentor.

凭.gloss: on the basis of, judging by

meanings.en: on the basis of, judging by
meanings.note: Preposition píng ('by virtue of, given').

examples.text: 就凭你给我们添那么多麻烦，我不该整你吗？
examples.trans: Given all the trouble you caused us, do you not deserve payback?

examples.text: 她凭自己的实力考进了传媒学院。
examples.trans: She got into Media College on her own merit.

examples.text: 凭着我五千个小时的主播生涯，我一定让这个满嘴谎话的女人当场现出原形！
examples.trans: With five thousand hours as a live host behind me, I will expose that lying woman's true colors right on camera!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Colloquial adjective xiōng ('fierce / excessive').

examples.text: 你最近熬夜太凶了。
examples.trans: You have been staying up way too late lately.

examples.text: 他说话有点凶。
examples.trans: He speaks a little fiercely.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chū. Core directional verb meaning 'outward'.

examples.text: 糟了！周经理，小晴，厨房出急事了！
examples.trans: Oh no! Manager Zhou, Qing, we have a kitchen emergency!

examples.text: 出大门往左拐，一直走到石桥。
examples.trans: Go out the front gate, turn left, and walk straight to the stone bridge.

examples.text: 这是出事啊。
examples.trans: This is happen something.

examples.text: 那个出事好。
examples.trans: That happen something is good.

examples.text: 你们星天要是不嫌弃的话，我个人愿意出任新一季十二歌王的主持人。
examples.trans: If Xingtian doesn't mind, I would personally love to serve as host for the new season of Twelve Singers.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 我刚才听见她打电话了，她要出卖淳于总！
examples.trans: I just heard her making a phone call — she is going to betray Director Chun Yu!

examples.text: 这是出卖。
examples.trans: This is 出卖.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chū qù. Directional compound moving from inside to outside.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

examples.text: 雨停了，我们出去走走吧。
examples.trans: The rain has stopped—let's go outside for a walk.

related.gloss: come fresh out of the oven

meanings.note: Verb chūfā ('depart; start from a point').

examples.text: 成败取决于你从哪个角度出发去想。
examples.trans: Success depends on which angle you start thinking from.

examples.text: 明早七点大巴从公司门口准时出发。
examples.trans: Tomorrow at seven the bus departs promptly from the gate.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chū shòu. Formal verb used on property notices ('put up for sale').

examples.text: 产权转让通知：八号小院整栋建筑将作为商业办公楼出售。
examples.trans: Property Transfer Notice: Courtyard Building Eight offered for sale as commercial offices.

examples.text: 商业办公楼出售？！把我们的客栈和厨房变成灰色办公室？！
examples.trans: Commercial office sale?! Turn our inn and kitchen into grey offices?!

related.gloss: come fresh out of the oven

examples.text: 我给了那个女人一笔钱，她就扔下小允出国去了，我不能丢下他不管。
examples.trans: I gave that woman a sum of money and she abandoned him to go abroad; I couldn't leave him behind.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Verb chūchǎng ('make an entrance onstage').

examples.text: 有请我们的神秘嘉宾出场。
examples.trans: Please welcome our mystery guest onstage.

examples.text: 下一位歌手马上出场。
examples.trans: The next singer comes onstage right away.

meanings.note: Verb-object chūshēng ('utter a sound').

examples.text: 老大一直没有出声。
examples.trans: The boss stayed quiet the whole time.

examples.text: 大家看电影时都没出声。
examples.trans: Nobody made a sound during the film.

出头.gloss: stand up for someone, take the lead in a dispute

meanings.en: stand up for someone, take the lead in a dispute
meanings.note: Stepping forward to defend someone who was wronged.

examples.text: 前辈主动站出来替受委屈的新人出头。
examples.trans: A senior colleague stepped up to defend the wronged newcomer.

examples.text: 谢谢你关键时刻站出来帮我出头。
examples.trans: Thank you for standing up for me at a critical moment.

出头之日.gloss: day of breakthrough, chance to shine at last

meanings.en: day of breakthrough, chance to shine at last
meanings.note: Idiom for emerging from suppression or obscurity.

examples.text: 只要作品够硬，总会有真正的出头之日。
examples.trans: As long as the work is strong, its day to shine will come.

examples.text: 如果项目被无限期搁置就没有出头之日了。
examples.trans: If shelved indefinitely, the project will never see the light of day.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chū qí. Often used with adverbial 地 before an adjective (出奇地轻 'surprisingly light', 出奇地安静 'remarkably quiet').

examples.text: 这个方包裹看起来很大，拿在手里却出奇地轻。
examples.trans: This square parcel looks large, yet feels surprisingly light in the hand.

examples.text: 清晨六点半的梧桐巷出奇地安静，只听得见鸟叫。
examples.trans: Wutong Lane at half past six in the morning is remarkably quiet, with only birdsong audible.

examples.text: 他在。他最近要去美国出差了，我去帮您通报一下。
examples.trans: He's inside preparing for his upcoming overseas business trip — let me let him know you're here.

examples.text: 你怎么来了？我今天要去美国出差。
examples.trans: What brings you to the office? I'm flying overseas on business today.

examples.text: 不好意思啊，我应该在出差之前多找时间陪陪你的，我疏忽了。
examples.trans: I'm sorry — I should have carved out more time to spend with you before my trip; that was careless of me.

meanings.note: Formal verb chūxí ('attend an event or show').

examples.text: 听说辛惠美本人也会出席节目。
examples.trans: I hear Xin Huimei herself will attend the show.

examples.text: 多位嘉宾出席了今晚的盛典。
examples.trans: Several guests attended tonight's gala.

meanings.note: Noun chūxi ('future promise, accomplishment').

examples.text: 老写负面八卦没什么大出息。
examples.trans: Writing negative gossip forever offers little future.

examples.text: 父母总盼着孩子将来有出息。
examples.trans: Parents always hope their children will do well in life.

examples.text: 王尔老师，他们说这次是您出手做局，是真的吗？
examples.trans: Mr Wang Er, people at the office say you engineered this whole setup — is that true?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chū lái. Directional complement for coming out or figuring something out (认出来).

examples.text: 明信片上整齐的方格字，我两秒钟就认出来了。
examples.trans: That neat block handwriting on the postcard—I recognized it in two seconds.

examples.text: 看合页边露出来的折纸图纸——一楼画着一扇暗门！
examples.trans: Look at the folded blueprint sticking out of the hinge—a hidden door is drawn on the ground floor!

related.gloss: come fresh out of the oven

出格.gloss: out of line, over the top

meanings.en: out of line, over the top
meanings.note: Adjective chūgé ('crossing proper bounds').

examples.text: 他这次在会上闹成这样真是太出格了。
examples.trans: Making a scene like that in the meeting crossed the line.

examples.text: 开玩笑要注意分寸，别做出格的事。
examples.trans: Keep jokes within bounds and never cross the line.

meanings.note: Verb-object chūqì ('vent pent-up frustration').

examples.text: 我这么做也不光是为了帮你出气。
examples.trans: I did not do that just to help vent your anger.

examples.text: 好朋友受了委屈，她总想替人出气。
examples.trans: When friends are wronged, she wants to stand up for them.

出演.gloss: appear in, star in (a film, play, or drama)

meanings.en: appear in, star in (a film, play, or drama)
meanings.note: Formal entertainment verb for taking a role.

examples.text: 观众都很期待他出演这部古装新剧。
examples.trans: Viewers are eager to see him star in this new costume drama.

examples.text: 多位实力派演员受邀出演重要角色。
examples.trans: Several accomplished actors were invited to play key roles.

出炉.gloss: come fresh out of the oven

meanings.en: come fresh out of the oven
meanings.note: Pinyin: chū lú. Literally 'exit the oven' (刚出炉 'freshly baked').

examples.text: 刚出炉的：星期五柠檬蛋糕，多切了边角！
examples.trans: Fresh from the oven: Friday lemon cake, with extra corner pieces!

examples.text: 第一盘肉桂卷刚从烤箱出炉。
examples.trans: The first tray of cinnamon rolls has just come out of the oven.

meanings.note: Noun chūbǎnshè ('book publisher').

examples.text: 每一个出版社的注解都不一样。
examples.trans: Every publishing house prints different annotations.

examples.text: 这家出版社出过很多经典好书。
examples.trans: This publisher has released many fine classics.

出现.gloss: to appear, to arise, to emerge

meanings.en: to appear; to show up; to come into view
meanings.note: chūxiàn — used when a person or object becomes visible or arrives on the scene.

meanings.en: to arise; to emerge; to occur (of problems, phenomena)
meanings.note: often takes a post-verbal subject (e.g., 出现了新问题 'a new problem emerged') or is followed by 在 to pinpoint where an issue occurred.

examples.text: 有些人的名字不能提，你提到他，他就会出现。
examples.trans: Some people's names must not be mentioned; if you mention him, he will appear.

examples.text: 问题出现在一个实习制片身上，是个案。
examples.trans: The problem arose with an intern producer; it was an isolated case.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chū zū chē. Measure word (量词): 辆 (liàng), e.g. 一辆出租车 ('a taxi').

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

examples.text: 一辆黄色出租车刚停在铁大门外头！
examples.trans: A yellow taxi just pulled up outside the iron gate!

出诊.gloss: make a house call (of a doctor)

meanings.en: make a house call (of a doctor)
meanings.note: Medical verb-object chūzhěn ('visit a patient off-site').

examples.text: 医疗设备还有出诊费用没有任何问题。
examples.trans: Medical gear and house-call fees will not be a problem at all.

examples.text: 老专家每周三上午在综合门诊部出诊。
examples.trans: The senior specialist holds clinic hours every Wednesday morning.

meanings.note: Noun chūlù ('way forward, survival path').

examples.text: 我只知道如果不改变就没有出路。
examples.trans: All I know is that without change there is no way forward.

examples.text: 勇于创新才是老牌综艺唯一的出路。
examples.trans: Bold innovation is the only path forward for veteran shows.

examples.text: 他叫小允，是我父亲的儿子。我从来都不知道我父亲会出轨。
examples.trans: His name is little Yun — he is my father's son. I never imagined my father would have an affair.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

出远门.gloss: set out on a long journey; travel far from home

meanings.en: set out on a long journey; travel far from home
meanings.note: Pinyin: chū yuǎn mén. Separable verb-object compound 出 ('go out of') + 远门 ('distant gate / long trip').

examples.text: 出远门回家以前，我和您姑姑藏了一个小铁盒时间胶囊。
examples.trans: Before setting out on my long journey home, your aunt and I hid a small tin time capsule.

examples.text: 老陈每次出远门以前，都会把工具抽屉整理得干干净净。
examples.trans: Before going away on any long trip, Chen always tidies his tool drawer spotless.

meanings.note: Standard showbiz verb-object compound (出 + 道) for entering the entertainment industry professionally.

examples.text: 她十九岁就作为歌手正式出道了。
examples.trans: She officially debuted as a singer at nineteen.

examples.text: 出道十年，他依然保持着对音乐的热爱。
examples.trans: Ten years after debuting, he still keeps his love for music.

meanings.note: Verb-object chūcuò ('make an error').

examples.text: 手头事情很多，千万不要出错。
examples.trans: There is plenty to do, so make sure nothing goes wrong.

examples.text: 直播现场任何一个环节都不能出错。
examples.trans: Not a single link can go wrong during a live broadcast.

meanings.note: Media noun chūjìnglǜ ('on-camera exposure').

examples.text: 双败淘汰制增加了新秀的出镜率。
examples.trans: Double elimination increases screen time for newcomers.

examples.text: 这位年轻主持人在各大晚会上的出镜率很高。
examples.trans: This young host gets plenty of screen time at major galas.

meanings.en: go out the door; head out
meanings.note: Pinyin: chū mén. Separable verb-object compound for leaving home or the inn.

examples.text: 你们守着，我出门啦！
examples.trans: Hold the fort—I am heading out the door!

examples.text: 出门左拐，直走到桥。要过河吗？
examples.trans: Left out the gate, straight to the bridge. Do I cross the river?

meanings.note: Verb-object chūyuàn ('leave hospital after treatment').

examples.text: 你怎么这么快就办手续出院了？
examples.trans: How come you checked out of the hospital so soon?

examples.text: 医生说再观察两天就可以顺利出院了。
examples.trans: The doctor said he can leave hospital after two more days.

meanings.note: Verb-object chūmiàn ('appear in person to handle something').

examples.text: 你为什么不出面澄清呢？
examples.trans: Why do you not step forward to clarify?

examples.text: 这件事需要经理出面解决。
examples.trans: The manager needs to step in to settle this.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fēn. Counts clock minutes (五分), test/review points (十分), and currency cents.

examples.text: 十、十一、十二。一分不差，谢谢！
examples.trans: Ten, eleven, twelve. Exact to the last cent—thank you!

examples.text: 我手表七点二十九分。客人下楼了。
examples.trans: Seven twenty-nine on my watch. Guests are coming down the stairs.

meanings.note: Potential phrase fēnbuqīngchu ('cannot distinguish').

examples.text: 观众有时候都分不清楚哪个是哪个了。
examples.trans: Viewers sometimes cannot even tell which show is which.

examples.text: 这两份初稿太像，让人分不清楚。
examples.trans: These two drafts look so alike it is hard to tell them apart.

meanings.note: Verb fēnxiǎng ('share information or joy').

examples.text: 这些数据在公司都没有分享过吧？
examples.trans: These figures have never been shared inside the firm, right?

examples.text: 谢谢你跟我分享这个好消息。
examples.trans: Thank you for sharing this good news with me.

meanings.note: Adverb/verb fēnbié ('each separately; part ways').

examples.text: 安排他们分别在嘉宾面前进行介绍。
examples.trans: Arrange for them each to introduce themselves before the guests.

examples.text: 两位导演分别负责舞台和灯光。
examples.trans: The two directors handle stage and lighting respectively.

分寸.gloss: sense of measure, proper bounds, tact

meanings.en: sense of measure, proper bounds, tact
meanings.note: Noun fēncun ('proper limits in speech/action').

examples.text: 我行事向来有自己的分寸。
examples.trans: I always keep my own sense of measure in how I act.

examples.text: 好的访谈主持人提问既有锋芒又有分寸。
examples.trans: A skilled interviewer asks sharp yet tactful questions.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fēn chéng. Resultative compound 分 ('divide') + 成 ('into / become').

examples.text: 小美把热柠檬挞分成了八小块。
examples.trans: Mei divided the warm lemon tart into eight small pieces.

examples.text: 我们可以把大扫除分成三个简单的步骤。
examples.trans: We can divide the big cleanup into three simple steps.

meanings.note: Verb-object fēnshǒu ('part ways romantically').

examples.text: 咱俩都分手两年了。
examples.trans: The two of us broke up two years ago.

examples.text: 他们上个月和平分手了。
examples.trans: They parted amicably last month.

meanings.note: Adjective/verb fēnsàn ('dispersed, unfocused').

examples.text: 大项目最忌讳管理分散。
examples.trans: Big projects must avoid scattered management.

examples.text: 上课时别分散注意力。
examples.trans: Do not let your attention wander in class.

examples.text: 已有行业分析师论断，此事必将造成星天娱乐股权整合及上市进程大幅拖慢。
examples.trans: Industry analysts warn the lawsuit will severely delay Xingtian's share restructuring and public listing.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 由此引发的股东内部分歧与高管层问责风暴，可能是比侵权本身更为严重的企业危机。
examples.trans: The resulting shareholder rifts and executive accountability storm may prove even deadlier than the lawsuit itself.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 工作的时候分神，那可从来都没有。老大，你有问题！
examples.trans: Spacing out during work has never happened before — boss, something's up with you!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fēn bèi. Acoustic unit measuring sound volume; takes numbers directly.

examples.text: 仔细看这一页——记的是分贝和安静度，不是酒店星级！
examples.trans: Look closely at this page—it records decibels and quietness, not hotel stars!

examples.text: 分贝？所以九分不是给我前台服务打的分？
examples.trans: Decibels? So nine points was not a score for my front-desk service?

meanings.note: Pinyin: fēn zhōng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 五分钟 ('five minutes').

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiē. Used for slicing bread, cake, fruit, or vegetables with a knife.

examples.text: 他爷爷会切热柠檬蛋糕，上面撒一层白糖粉！
examples.trans: His grandfather sliced warm lemon cake with a dusting of powdered sugar on top!

examples.text: 刚出炉的：星期五柠檬蛋糕，多切了边角！
examples.trans: Fresh from the oven: Friday lemon cake, with extra corner pieces!

examples.text: 我们抓到了切实证据，董事长才开除了他。
examples.trans: Only after we caught rock-solid evidence did the chairwoman fire him.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

列.gloss: measure word for trains and rows

meanings.en: measure word for trains and rows
meanings.note: Pinyin: liè. Counts multi-car trains and lined-up series (一列火车 'a train').

examples.text: 五分钟演讲稿，列了十九条理由解释那年春天我们都错了。
examples.trans: A five-minute speech listing nineteen reasons why we were both wrong that spring.

examples.text: 下一列火车八点到站。
examples.trans: The next train arrives at the station at eight o'clock.

examples.text: 他一手把真的合同递到了法务，一手把假的授权列表备案到我们版权库里头。
examples.trans: With one hand he sent the real contract to legal, and with the other he logged a fake song list into our copyright database.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: common Chinese surname Liu

examples.text: 有请本场十二歌王的客座导师，刘凡先生！
examples.trans: Please welcome tonight's Twelve Singers guest mentor, Mister Liu Fan!

examples.text: 刘老师已经到化妆间了。
examples.trans: Teacher Liu has already arrived at the dressing room.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gāng. Placed right before a verb to show the action happened moments ago.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

examples.text: 一到七号钥匙全拿走了，八号房刚刷了油漆。
examples.trans: Every key from one to seven is taken, and room eight just got fresh paint.

examples.text: 邮递员刚刚把这封挂号信放在前台桌上。
examples.trans: The mail carrier put this registered letter on the front desk just a moment ago.

examples.text: 雨刚刚停，石板路上还映着灯笼的倒影。
examples.trans: The rain stopped just a moment ago, and the flagstones still reflect the glow of the lanterns.

meanings.note: Adverb gānghǎo ('just recovered/happened; just right').

examples.text: 你病刚好，千万不能生气。
examples.trans: You have only just recovered from illness and must not get angry.

examples.text: 我到车站的时候，地铁刚好进站。
examples.trans: Right when I reached the station, the train pulled in.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gāng cái. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 刚才那一刻 ('that moment just now').

examples.text: 谢谢你，小美。刚才吓了一跳，手都凉了！
examples.trans: Thank you, Mei. That gave me such a start just now that my hands went cold!

examples.text: 您刚才忘在楼下前台汤碗旁边了。
examples.trans: You left it downstairs beside the soup bowl at the front desk.

related.gloss: that moment just now (measure word 个)

meanings.note: Serious psychological or bodily injury.

examples.text: 那场变故给他留下了漫长的感情创伤。
examples.trans: That upheaval left him with lasting emotional wounds.

examples.text: 温暖的陪伴能慢慢抚平心里的创伤。
examples.trans: Warm companionship can slowly heal inner wounds.

meanings.note: Media noun chuàngyì ('creative idea').

examples.text: 我觉得孤岛的创意特别有代入感。
examples.trans: I find the creative concept of Lonely Island deeply relatable.

examples.text: 年轻编导们在头脑风暴会上提出了十几个好创意。
examples.trans: Junior producers pitched a dozen sharp ideas in brainstorming.

examples.text: 对于一个引进节目做这种高度的本土化创新，这在中国的电视界从来没有过。
examples.trans: Taking an imported format and giving it such deep homegrown innovation has never been done in Chinese television.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Verb chuàngzào ('create, achieve').

examples.text: 这次特别直播创造了惊人的收视成绩。
examples.trans: This special live broadcast achieved astonishing ratings.

examples.text: 优秀的幕后团队总能在危机中创造奇迹。
examples.trans: Great backstage crews find ways to create miracles in a crisis.

meanings.note: Adverb/attributive chūcì ('first-time').

examples.text: 初次见面啊，淳于总。
examples.trans: Our very first meeting, Mr Chun Yuqiao.

examples.text: 初次上台做提案，小谷心里难免有些紧张。
examples.trans: Pitching onstage for the first time, Xiaogu felt a bit nervous.

meanings.en: first draft; rough draft; preliminary manuscript
meanings.note: chūgǎo — compound of 初 ('initial') and 稿 ('draft/manuscript'); contrasts with 定稿 or 最终稿 ('final draft').

examples.text: 你们俩的论文初稿都已经通过了。
examples.trans: Both of your first thesis drafts have already passed.

examples.text: 我已经把策划案的初稿发到你邮箱了。
examples.trans: I have already sent the first draft of the proposal to your email.

related.gloss: finalized draft; to finalize a draft

meanings.note: Adjective chūjí ('elementary, junior').

examples.text: 我想应聘初级行政助理。
examples.trans: I want to apply for junior admin assistant.

examples.text: 这是初级汉语课程。
examples.trans: This is an elementary Mandarin course.

meanings.note: Compound chūxuǎn ('initial screening').

examples.text: 我们要做艺人初选。
examples.trans: We need to make the initial artist shortlist.

examples.text: 她通过了初选。
examples.trans: She passed the first round.

meanings.note: Verb shān ('delete text or posts').

examples.text: 原文虽然删了，但有人截了图。
examples.trans: Though the original post was deleted, someone took screenshots.

examples.text: 请把表格里重复的那一行删掉。
examples.trans: Please delete the duplicate row in the spreadsheet.

meanings.note: Compound verb for erasing video files.

examples.text: 系统后台清楚地记录了昨晚删片的时间。
examples.trans: The backend log clearly recorded when the footage was deleted.

examples.text: 未经总制作人同意，任何人不得擅自删片。
examples.trans: Nobody may delete footage without the chief producer's consent.

meanings.note: Formal verb shānchú ('delete digitally').

examples.text: 我们把虚假报道上线又删除的事写成了文章。
examples.trans: We wrote up how the fake story went live and got deleted.

examples.text: 重要邮件请不要随便删除。
examples.trans: Please do not casually delete important emails.

meanings.note: Verb/noun pànduàn ('judge; judgment').

examples.text: 您怎么能判断它的广告价值就是低的呢？
examples.trans: How can you judge ahead of time that its ad value is low?

examples.text: 总制片人必须在关键时刻做出准确的判断。
examples.trans: A chief producer must make accurate calls in key moments.

利器.gloss: secret weapon, powerful tool, sharp weapon

meanings.en: powerful tool; secret weapon; trump card (figurative)
meanings.note: lìqì — literally 'sharp weapon/implement'; in modern usage, almost always used figuratively for an indispensable tool or effective means to achieve a goal.

examples.text: 这杯苏打水是我熬夜的利器。
examples.trans: This cup of soda water is my secret weapon for staying up late.

examples.text: 好的内容依然是吸引观众的最大利器。
examples.trans: Great content remains the ultimate trump card for attracting audiences.

related.gloss: staying up late; pulling an all-nighter

examples.text: 据悉，诉讼包括歌曲利润所得三倍以上的天价索赔，以及星天娱乐公开道歉。
examples.trans: Reports say the lawsuit demands triple-profit damages along with a formal public apology from Xingtian Entertainment.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 这次你又被骗了，你又被利用了，我会生气，我会心疼。
examples.trans: This time you were deceived and used all over again — that makes me angry, and it hurts me.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 白石自己的使用权还没整利索呢，他们也就是唬唬你们可以！
examples.trans: Baishi hasn't even sorted out its own usage rights cleanly — all they can do is bluff you people!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Adjective lìluo ('brisk, clean and efficient').

examples.text: 这位大师兄办事真的很利落。
examples.trans: Our senior alumnus handles work very crisply.

examples.text: 林姐说话做事都特别利落。
examples.trans: Lin Jie speaks and acts with brisk efficiency.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bié. Most commonly means 'do not' in polite commands (别担心 'don't worry'); as a verb, 'pin/clip on'.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

examples.text: 您先坐下，别着急，我们马上看行李牌。
examples.trans: Please sit down first and do not worry; we will check the luggage tag right away.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bié rén. Refers to someone else ('other people').

examples.text: 让我猜猜，你把没有的房间答应给别人了？
examples.trans: Let me guess: you promised someone a room we do not have?

examples.text: 别拿错了别人的蓝色行李箱。
examples.trans: Be careful not to take someone else's blue suitcase by mistake.

examples.text: 别去打扰他，这事我们自己解决。你说是王尔动的手脚，有证据吗？
examples.trans: Don't disturb Yuqiao — we'll solve this ourselves. You say Wang Er tampered with the files, so do we have proof?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Adjective bièniu ('weird, ill at ease').

examples.text: 听他那么客气，我心里也怪别扭的。
examples.trans: Hearing him speak so meekly felt mighty strange to me too.

examples.text: 这句台词读起来有点别扭，咱们顺一顺吧。
examples.trans: This line reads a bit awkwardly—let us smooth it out.

examples.text: 别查了，翻来覆去查了好几遍了，没有。
examples.trans: Stop searching; I checked the pages front to back over and over, and it isn't there.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Determiner biéde ('other').

examples.text: 别的部门不要。
examples.trans: Other departments do not want it.

examples.text: 还有别的问题吗？
examples.trans: Are there any other questions?

meanings.note: Pinyin: guā. Covers scraping a surface (刮响 'scrape noisily', 刮花 'scratch up') as well as wind blowing (刮风 'the wind blows').

examples.text: 把桌子轻轻抬起来，别让木头桌腿把石板刮响了。
examples.trans: Lift the table up gently so the wooden legs do not scrape noisily against the stone.

examples.text: 星期五下午突然刮起了大风，吹得树叶沙沙响。
examples.trans: On Friday afternoon a strong wind suddenly blew up, rustling the tree leaves.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guā hén. Measure word (量词): 道 (dào), e.g. 一道刮痕 ('a scratch').

examples.text: 滴了一点温机油，铁盒盖子顺顺当当地打开了，一道刮痕都没有。
examples.trans: With a tiny drop of warm oil, the tin lid popped smoothly open without a single scratch.

examples.text: 老核桃木钢琴保养得很好，表面看不见半道刮痕。
examples.trans: The old walnut piano is so well cared for that not half a scratch shows on its surface.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dào. Works as main verb ('arrive') or result complement ('succeed in reaching/perceiving', 找到, 听到).

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

到任.gloss: take up a post, assume office

meanings.en: take up a post, assume office
meanings.note: Formal verb for a newly appointed official or executive arriving.

examples.text: 新总监今天正式到任并主持了部门早会。
examples.trans: The new director formally assumed office today and chaired morning meeting.

examples.text: 他到任后的第一件事就是调研各组情况。
examples.trans: His first move upon taking office was surveying every unit.

meanings.note: literally 'reach spot'

examples.text: 你到位没有？
examples.trans: Are you in position yet?

examples.text: 你到位没有？
examples.trans: Are you in position yet?

meanings.note: Pinyin: dào chù. Usually pairs with 都 ('everywhere').

examples.text: 啊，我的皮笔记本！谢谢！我正到处找呢。
examples.trans: Oh, my leather notebook! Thank you! I was looking everywhere for it.

examples.text: 我到处找眼镜，原来在桌子上。
examples.trans: I looked everywhere for my glasses, and they were on the table.

到头.gloss: reach the end, come to a close

meanings.en: reach the end, come to a close
meanings.note: Colloquial verb phrase indicating something is finished.

examples.text: 沿着这条走廊一直走到头就是会议室。
examples.trans: Walk straight to the end of this corridor for the conference room.

examples.text: 靠炒作维持的热度很快就会走到头。
examples.trans: Buzz sustained by hype alone quickly runs out of road.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dào dǐ. Adds urgent curiosity inside a question (到底在哪儿？ 'where on earth is it?').

examples.text: 老弟，你到底撞进了一家什么神奇客栈？
examples.trans: Little brother, what kind of magical inn did you stumble into?

examples.text: 这家客栈向来只有八间客房！九号房到底在哪儿？！
examples.trans: This inn has only ever had eight guest rooms! Where on earth is Room Nine?!

到手.gloss: to obtain, in one's possession, in hand

meanings.en: to come into one's possession; to obtain; in hand; secured
meanings.note: dàoshǒu — used either as a predicate verb ('be obtained') or as an attributive modifier with 的 (到手的… 'already secured / in one's grasp').

examples.text: 你敢说你不是为了他，放弃到手的金饭碗？
examples.trans: Dare you say it wasn't for him that you gave up a golden rice bowl you already had in hand?

examples.text: 眼看冠军就要到手了，绝对不能在这个时候出错。
examples.trans: With the championship almost in our grasp, we absolutely cannot make a mistake now.

examples.text: 到时候想回头就来不及了，所以这不是一条能回头的路。
examples.trans: By then it will be too late to turn back — so this is a road with no turnaround.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Verb-complement dàoqí ('everyone has arrived').

examples.text: 现场的同学们都已经到齐了。
examples.trans: All the classmates on site have arrived.

examples.text: 人到齐了咱们就出发吧。
examples.trans: Now that everyone is here, let us head out.

meanings.en: production (of TV shows, films, music); manufacture
meanings.note: zhìzuò — central term in media and entertainment (e.g., 节目制作 'program production', 后期制作 'post-production').

meanings.en: to produce; to make; to create
