meanings.note: used as a transitive verb for crafting media works, handicrafts, or food items.

examples.text: 我问你个问题，节目制作的核心业务在哪儿？
examples.trans: Let me ask you a question: where does the core business of show production lie?

examples.text: 让她去，总编室不缺人，真正的制作也不是她能干的。
examples.trans: Let her go; the chief editor's office is not short of people, and real production work is not something she can handle anyway.

meanings.note: zhìzuòrén — oversees the creative and operational production of a show or album (e.g., 联合制作人 'co-producer', 总制作人 'executive/chief producer').

examples.text: 你是联合制作人的助理，跟我们不一样。
examples.trans: You are the co-producer's assistant — you are different from us.

examples.text: 我就不该来当什么联合制作人。
examples.trans: I never should have come to be some co-producer.

examples.text: 想带新人随便，但是别带到制作会上来。
examples.trans: Mentor newcomers all you like, but do not bring them to the production meeting.

examples.text: 想带新人随便，但是别带到制作会上来。
examples.trans: Mentor newcomers all you like, but do not bring them to the production meeting.

examples.text: 最重要的部门还是这边，淳于乔领导的制作部。
examples.trans: Still, the most important department is right here: the production unit led by Chun Yuqiao.

examples.text: 这是制作部。 (Example)
examples.trans: This is 制作部.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhì tú yuán. Combines 制图 ('make maps/charts') + occupational suffix 员 ('person/specialist'); measure word: 位 (wèi) or 名 (míng).

examples.text: 那时我是个年轻的制图员，你们阳光房的热茶救了我淋湿的地图。
examples.trans: Back then I was a young mapmaker, and your sunroom tea saved my rain-soaked maps.

examples.text: 这位细心的制图员用钢笔在厚纸上画出了整条老街。
examples.trans: This careful mapmaker drew the entire old lane on heavy paper with a fountain pen.

meanings.note: Noun zhìdù ('institutional rules').

examples.text: 这是按照公司制度核准的。
examples.trans: This was approved under company rules.

examples.text: 我们要遵守公司的制度。
examples.trans: We must follow company regulations.

meanings.note: Verb zhìzhǐ ('restrain, put a stop to').

examples.text: 没有制止他乱吃药是我们的失误。
examples.trans: Not stopping him taking pills carelessly was our error.

examples.text: 保安及时制止了争吵。
examples.trans: Security promptly stopped the quarrel.

meanings.note: Television noun zhìpiàn ('producer').

examples.text: 入职不到一年的新制片不能去。
examples.trans: New producers with under a year may not go.

examples.text: 请问三部的制片是什么级别？
examples.trans: What rank do Unit Three's producers hold?

meanings.note: Television/film title zhìpiànrén ('producer').

examples.text: 我还不算是正式的制片人。
examples.trans: I do not really count as an official producer yet.

examples.text: 优秀的制片人需要懂内容也懂市场。
examples.trans: A strong producer understands both content and audience.

meanings.note: Keeping power in check within an organization.

examples.text: 健康的管理制度需要各部门相互制衡。
examples.trans: Sound governance requires departments to balance one another.

examples.text: 没有专业对手制衡，他行事越来越霸道。
examples.trans: With no peer left to check him, he grew increasingly domineering.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuā. Used for painting walls, brushing, or swiping a card.

examples.text: 一到七号钥匙全拿走了，八号房刚刷了油漆。
examples.trans: Every key from one to seven is taken, and room eight just got fresh paint.

examples.text: 周末我们要刷院子里的木门。
examples.trans: This weekend we are going to paint the wooden courtyard gate.

刷卡.gloss: swipe a keycard / badge (or bank card)

meanings.en: swipe a keycard / badge (or bank card)
meanings.note: Using an electronic badge to unlock doors or pay.

examples.text: 进出后期机房都必须刷卡登记。
examples.trans: Entering and leaving the editing suite requires swiping a badge.

examples.text: 门禁记录显示他昨晚一点半刷卡进了门。
examples.trans: Door logs show he swiped his badge to enter at one thirty.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuā zi. Combines 刷 ('brush') + noun suffix 子; measure word: 把 (bǎ).

examples.text: 老陈留了一把小刷子专门刷窗板的边角。
examples.trans: Chen saved a small paintbrush specifically for painting the edges and corners of the shutters.

examples.text: 用完油漆刷子以后，要马上用温水洗干净晾起来。
examples.trans: Right after using a paintbrush, wash it clean in warm water and hang it up to dry.

meanings.note: Internet verb shuāpíng ('spam or dominate feeds').

examples.text: 粉丝都在网上刷屏了。
examples.trans: Fans are flooding every feed online.

examples.text: 这条新闻今天刷屏了。
examples.trans: This news story flooded feeds today.

meanings.note: Setting a new benchmark or bringing fresh life.

examples.text: 这档新节目刷新了收视纪录。
examples.trans: This new show broke the ratings record.

examples.text: 好创意能刷新整个市场。
examples.trans: A great idea can refresh the entire market.

刷漆.gloss: paint; apply paint with a brush

meanings.en: paint; apply paint with a brush
meanings.note: Pinyin: shuā qī. Separable verb-object compound 刷 ('brush') + 漆 ('paint/lacquer').

examples.text: 天晴的时候最适合给木头窗板刷漆。
examples.trans: Clear sunny weather is best for painting wooden shutters.

examples.text: 老陈戴上手套，准备给旧木门刷漆。
examples.trans: Chen put on gloves and got ready to paint the old wooden door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kè. Used as a verb for carving wood/stone (刻着) or noun/classifier for 15 minutes (一刻).

examples.text: 等一下……梧桐巷十二号，角落里还写着两个童年名字的首字母！
examples.trans: Wait a moment... Number twelve, Wutong Lane, with two childhood initials written in the corner!

examples.text: 木头盒上刻着他的名字。
examples.trans: His name is carved onto the wooden box.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a noun used in conversational Mandarin. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个刻度 ('a 刻度').

examples.text: 我有一个刻度。
examples.trans: I have a 刻度.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的刻度。
examples.trans: This is a very good 刻度.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qián. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个前面 ('a front side').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

examples.text: 这就是我前两天的见闻。淳于总的过去有过洛琳，有过钟阳子，现在都已经不在他的生活里了。
examples.trans: That's what I witnessed overseas these past two days: Luo Lin and Zhong Yangzi were chapters of Mr Chun Yu's past, and neither is in his life anymore.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 这首歌曲的侵权事件前几天闹得沸沸扬扬，可是现在却有了一个戏剧性的转变。
examples.trans: The copyright uproar around this song raged for days, yet now it has taken a dramatic turn.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

前半段.gloss: first half (of a piece, journey, or text)

meanings.en: first half (of a piece, journey, or text)
meanings.note: Pinyin: qián bàn duàn. Combines 前 ('front/first') + 半 ('half') + 段 ('section/passage'); contrasts with 后半段 ('second half').

examples.text: 后半段旋律接上三十年前的前半段，流淌得非常自然。
examples.trans: The second half of the melody joins the thirty-year-old first half and flows so naturally.

examples.text: 这首圆舞曲的前半段轻快明亮，后半段温暖柔和。
examples.trans: The first half of this waltz is bright and lively, while the second half is warm and gentle.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qián tái. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个前台 ('a front desk').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 您刚才忘在楼下前台汤碗旁边了。
examples.trans: You left it downstairs beside the soup bowl at the front desk.

meanings.note: Time noun referring to two days ago.

examples.text: 前天我们在会议室见过面。
examples.trans: We met in the conference room the day before yesterday.

examples.text: 那份报告我前天就交了。
examples.trans: I turned in that report two days ago.

examples.text: 那是他的前女友。
examples.trans: That is his ex-girlfriend.

examples.text: 我看到我的前女友了。
examples.trans: I saw my ex-girlfriend.

meanings.note: Noun qiánxián ('old resentment').

examples.text: 我跟她之间没有任何前嫌。
examples.trans: There is no past grudge between her and me.

examples.text: 大家握手言和，不计前嫌。
examples.trans: Everyone shook hands and let bygones be bygones.

meanings.note: Four-character idiom qiánsuǒwèiyǒu ('unprecedented').

examples.text: 半小时降雨五十毫米，真是前所未有的大。
examples.trans: Fifty millimetres in half an hour is an unprecedented downpour.

examples.text: 多路手机信号同时切入电视直播是前所未有的尝试。
examples.trans: Cutting multiple phone feeds straight to live TV was unprecedented.

examples.text: 这点我深有体会。我在这个圈子混了二十年了，这样的改版方案我前所未见。
examples.trans: I know that firsthand. In twenty years in this industry, I have never seen a revamp proposal like this.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Noun qiánpái ('front row of seats').

examples.text: 以前常请大学生做前排观众。
examples.trans: College students were often invited as front-row audience.

examples.text: 请拿到票的同学坐在前排。
examples.trans: Students with tickets please sit in the front row.

meanings.note: Noun qiántí ('prerequisite condition').

examples.text: 合作的前提是你们放弃那边的节目。
examples.trans: The condition is that you drop the rival show.

examples.text: 安全是所有现场工作的前提。
examples.trans: Safety is the premise of all studio work.

meanings.note: Playful historical metaphor for a previous boss's tenure.

examples.text: 新主管上任后要求大家少提前朝旧事。
examples.trans: After taking over, the new head told everyone not to dwell on the old era.

examples.text: 她偏要重提前朝旧事来证明原创的价值。
examples.trans: She insisted on revisiting the former era to prove the value of originals.

meanings.note: Time noun qiánqī ('preliminary/upfront stage').

examples.text: 否则前期投入的广告就全都白费了。
examples.trans: Otherwise all the upfront ad spending goes to waste.

examples.text: 节目前期调研花了整整两个月时间。
examples.trans: Early-stage research for the show took two full months.

前站.gloss: advance party, scouting team (in 打前站)

meanings.en: advance party, scouting team (in 打前站)
meanings.note: Noun qiánzhàn ('advance scouting work').

examples.text: 这次录制你跟凯文先飞过去打前站。
examples.trans: For this shoot, you and Kaiwen fly ahead as the advance team.

examples.text: 制片组提前一周派人去外景地打前站。
examples.trans: Production sent scouts a week ahead to prep the location.

meanings.note: Literary verb qiánxíng ('advance forward').

examples.text: 因为他是给我动力、让我前行的人。
examples.trans: Because he is the one who gives me drive to forge ahead.

examples.text: 哪怕遇到风雨，追梦的人也会坚定前行。
examples.trans: Even through storms, dreamers keep forging ahead.

examples.text: 就静静地待在那儿，他们有什么动静了你就来告诉我，前途不可限量。
examples.trans: Stay quietly right where you are, report every move they make back to me, and your future will be boundless.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qián mén. Combines 前 ('front') + 门 ('door/gate'); contrasts with 后门 ('back door'); measure word: 扇 (shàn).

examples.text: 都已经晚上十点了，是谁在敲我们小院的前门呀？
examples.trans: It is already ten o'clock at night—who could be knocking at our front gate?

examples.text: 每天早上七点，老陈都会准时打开客栈的前门迎接客人。
examples.trans: Every morning at seven sharp, Chen opens the front gate of the inn to welcome guests.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qián mian. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 最前面 ('the very front').

examples.text: 前面锁扣有个小锁孔，再看底下贴着：一把旧铜钥匙！
examples.trans: There is a tiny keyhole on the front latch, and taped underneath: an old brass key!

examples.text: 前面路口往右拐就是火车站。
examples.trans: Turn right at the intersection ahead and you are at the station.

meanings.note: Noun jiàn ('double-edged sword').

examples.text: 头顶上一直有一把剑，就是不落下来。
examples.trans: A sword has hung overhead all along without falling.

examples.text: 舞台剧演员手里拿着一把长剑。
examples.trans: The stage actor holds a long sword in hand.

meanings.note: Short noun used in 一部剧, 古装剧, 电视剧.

examples.text: 最近网上有部古装剧讨论度特别高。
examples.trans: A costume drama has been generating huge buzz online lately.

examples.text: 演员们正在抓紧时间排练新剧。
examples.trans: The cast is rehearsing the new drama intensively.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shèng. Describes time, items, or money remaining (只剩五分钟 'only five minutes left').

examples.text: 而且他今晚八点到这里——只剩四十分钟了！
examples.trans: And he arrives here at eight o'clock this evening—in forty minutes!

examples.text: 只剩三十五分钟了！他肯定会写一星差评！
examples.trans: Only thirty-five minutes left! He will surely write a one-star bad review!

meanings.note: What stays behind after other options or items are gone.

examples.text: 桌子上只剩下两杯咖啡了。
examples.trans: Only two cups of coffee are left on the table.

examples.text: 现在只剩下最后一个办法了。
examples.trans: Now only one last method remains.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǎn. Action verb specifically for cutting with two-bladed scissors, shears, or clippers.

examples.text: 别剪那根绿藤条，把它放到花架上吧。
examples.trans: Don't cut that green vine; lift it onto the trellis.

examples.text: 小晴从院子里剪了两枝新鲜薄荷。
examples.trans: Qing snipped two sprigs of fresh mint from the courtyard.

examples.text: 把这些线剪掉。
examples.trans: Cut off these threads.

examples.text: 这个镜头被剪掉了。
examples.trans: This scene was cut out.

副.gloss: measure word for glasses, sets, expressions

meanings.en: measure word for glasses, sets, expressions
meanings.note: Pinyin: fù. Counts eyeglasses, gloves, chess sets, and facial expressions (一副眼镜 'a pair of glasses').

examples.text: 法律条文我戴两副眼镜看都头疼！
examples.trans: Legal clauses give me a headache even with two pairs of glasses!

examples.text: 桌子上放着一副旧眼镜。
examples.trans: A pair of old glasses is sitting on the table.

meanings.note: Senior executive rank below president or CEO.

examples.text: 他被董事会任命为集团分管内容的副总裁。
examples.trans: The board appointed him vice president in charge of content.

examples.text: 副总裁在战略大会上代表经纪部门发言。
examples.trans: The vice president spoke for talent management at the strategy summit.

力推.gloss: champion strongly, push with full backing

meanings.en: champion strongly, push with full backing
meanings.note: Verb lìtuī ('strongly endorse/promote').

examples.text: 这是我坚决力推的改版方案。
examples.trans: This is the overhaul proposal that I strongly champion.

examples.text: 公司今年力推三档原创音乐节目。
examples.trans: This year the company is strongly backing three original music shows.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lì qi. Combines 力 ('force/strength') + neutral-tone 气 ('energy').

examples.text: 搬这张厚木桌需要不少力气。
examples.trans: Moving this thick wooden table takes quite a bit of strength.

examples.text: 开旧锁要靠巧劲，光用力气可不行。
examples.trans: Opening an old lock takes knack; sheer muscle alone won't do.

meanings.note: Noun lìliang ('strength, force').

examples.text: 各部的制片力量全部调用进来。
examples.trans: Production staff from every unit are called in.

examples.text: 团队的力量非常大。
examples.trans: The strength of a team is immense.

meanings.note: Verb quàn ('persuade, urge').

examples.text: 我劝你别闹了。
examples.trans: I advise you to stop making a fuss.

examples.text: 现在来劝我回头了吗？
examples.trans: Have you come now to urge me to turn back?

劝架.gloss: step in to break up a fight, mediate

meanings.en: step in to break up a fight, mediate
meanings.note: Verb-object quànjià ('separate people who are fighting').

examples.text: 两边打起来了，快跟我一块劝架去吧！
examples.trans: A fight broke out—hurry and come break it up with me!

examples.text: 幸好场务及时上前劝架，才没闹出大事。
examples.trans: Thankfully crew stepped in quickly to break up the scuffle.

examples.text: 那我也不能不管吧，这怎么办啊？
examples.trans: Well, I cannot just ignore it either — what should I do?

examples.text: 这是办。
examples.trans: This is 办.

meanings.note: Verb-object bànshì ('handle tasks').

examples.text: 我办事什么时候糊弄过呀？
examples.trans: When have I ever been sloppy in handling tasks?

examples.text: 她年纪轻轻，办事却很稳重。
examples.trans: Though young, she handles work very reliably.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bàn shì yuán. Combines 办事 ('handle official business') + agent suffix 员 ('staff member').

examples.text: 市政厅的办事员星期三下午三点过来检查。
examples.trans: The city hall clerk is coming over at three on Wednesday afternoon to inspect.

examples.text: 窗口的办事员耐心地帮我们填好了表格。
examples.trans: The clerk at the counter patiently helped us fill out the form.

办公.gloss: to work in an office, to handle official business

meanings.en: to work (in an office); to handle official business; to have one's office
meanings.note: bàngōng — separable verb (VO compound: 办 'handle' + 公 'public/official affairs'); also used attributively in compounds like 办公系统 ('office system') and 办公桌 ('desk').

examples.text: 我想问一下，方教授在哪办公啊？
examples.trans: May I ask where Professor Fang has his office?

examples.text: 有什么命令直接通过办公系统下达到行政处，我随时奉命。
examples.trans: Send any order straight to administration through the office system, and I will carry it out at any time.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bàn gōng shì. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间办公室 ('an office').

examples.text: 失陪一下，宋老师，我先回办公室整理一下！
examples.trans: Excuse me a moment, Teacher Song; I shall step back to my office to tidy up!

examples.text: 说实话，我比以前灰色办公室喜欢这儿多了。
examples.trans: Honestly, I like this place far better than my old grey office.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bàn gōng lóu. Measure word (量词): 栋 (dòng), e.g. 一栋办公楼 ('an office building').

examples.text: 产权转让通知：八号小院整栋建筑将作为商业办公楼出售。
examples.trans: Property Transfer Notice: Courtyard Building Eight offered for sale as commercial offices.

examples.text: 商业办公楼出售？！把我们的客栈和厨房变成灰色办公室？！
examples.trans: Commercial office sale?! Turn our inn and kitchen into grey offices?!

examples.text: 现在去办手续。
examples.trans: Go complete the paperwork right now.

examples.text: 快去办手续啊，人事那边等着你呢。
examples.trans: Hurry off and finish your paperwork — HR is waiting for you.

meanings.note: Noun bànfǎ ('method, solution').

examples.text: 我有一个办法解决这个问题。
examples.trans: I have a way to solve this problem.

examples.text: 他没有办法完成演出。
examples.trans: He has no way to finish the performance.

examples.text: 没有，我是从来没有办过这么热闹的生日聚会，给我吓懵了。
examples.trans: Not at all; I've simply never had such a lively birthday party before, so it stunned me.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 黄金一班的事有你的功劳，也有许天泽的功劳，主要是许天泽的功劳。
examples.trans: You deserve credit for the Golden Class reunion, and so does your rich friend — mostly him.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Used in 下功夫 ('put real work into').

examples.text: 想做出精品节目必须在细节上下功夫。
examples.trans: Making a flagship show requires real effort on the details.

examples.text: 这份详尽的报告一看就花了不少功夫。
examples.trans: You can tell at a glance this detailed report took serious effort.

meanings.note: Deeply practiced craft in hosting, writing, or production.

examples.text: 那位资深主持人的现场即兴功底非常深厚。
examples.trans: That veteran host has rock-solid live improvisation skills.

examples.text: 扎实的文字功底让她的策划案脱颖而出。
examples.trans: Solid writing skills made her proposal stand out from the rest.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiā. Used for adding sugar, milk, or extra items (加糖 'add sugar').

examples.text: 请给我不加糖的红茶，再来一片热面包。
examples.trans: Black tea without added sugar, please, and one slice of warm bread.

examples.text: 太好了！请加牛奶和一点糖。
examples.trans: Wonderful! With milk and a little sugar, please.

meanings.note: Verb/conjunction jiāshàng ('in addition to').

examples.text: 加上台里的团队一共一百三十人。
examples.trans: Plus the network team, there are 130 people.

examples.text: 今天刮风，加上下雨，特别冷。
examples.trans: Wind plus rain makes today very cold.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiā bèi. Means doubling an effort or amount.

examples.text: 哎呀！透过窗户看见周经理了？我明明加倍用力微笑了！
examples.trans: Oh dear! You spotted Manager Zhou through the window? I smiled twice as wide!

examples.text: 有了好搭档，干活效率加倍。
examples.trans: With a great partner, our work goes twice as fast.

meanings.note: Verb jiārù ('join a meeting, group, or team').

examples.text: 我们很荣幸邀请两位老师加入讨论。
examples.trans: We are honoured to invite both teachers to join in.

examples.text: 欢迎新同事加入我们的制作团队。
examples.trans: Welcome new colleagues joining our production crew.

examples.text: 写完稿子再睡好不好？大家加把劲！
examples.trans: Finish writing your articles before sleeping, alright? Keep pushing, everyone!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Verb-object jiāyóu ('keep it up!, good luck!').

examples.text: 今天开会一定要加油！
examples.trans: Give it your very best at today's meeting!

examples.text: 大家一起加油把这期节目录好。
examples.trans: Let us all pitch in to tape a great episode.

meanings.note: Verb-object jiābān ('work extra hours').

examples.text: 一部的同事晚上都在公司加班呢。
examples.trans: Unit One colleagues are all working overtime tonight.

examples.text: 我天天加班，哪有时间去面试？
examples.trans: Working overtime daily, when could I go interview?

examples.text: 我自己加盟十二歌王，然后参加宣传，你看这样怎么样？
examples.trans: I'll join Twelve Singers myself and take part in the publicity — how does that sound?

examples.text: 如今传出以辛惠美为首的黄金一班五位唱将，一起加盟十二歌王。
examples.trans: Now word has broken that five powerhouse vocalists of the Golden Class led by Xin Huimei are joining Twelve Singers together.

meanings.note: Abstract noun wùshíxìng ('down-to-earth practicality').

examples.text: 这能让大家了解到慈善基金的务实性。
examples.trans: This lets everyone see the charity fund's practicality.

examples.text: 评委很看重节目方案的务实性。
examples.trans: Judges value the practicality of a show plan.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dòng. Used for physical movement (别动 'don't move!').

examples.text: 全都别动！现在几点？九点三十五分！
examples.trans: Hold everything! What time is it right now? Nine thirty-five!

examples.text: 别动，你们俩。听到路边汽车停下的声音了吗？
examples.trans: Hold still, both of you. Hear that car engine stopping at the curb?

meanings.note: Noun dònglì ('motive power, drive').

examples.text: 他是给我动力、让我不断进步的人。
examples.trans: He is the one who gives me drive to keep improving.

examples.text: 观众的好评是幕后团队最大的创作动力。
examples.trans: Audience praise is a backstage crew's greatest motivation.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dòng dong. Tentative reduplication of 动 ('move'); second syllable takes neutral tone.

examples.text: 小晴轻轻帮小美脱下鞋子说：“你能动动脚趾给我看看吗？”
examples.trans: Gently slipping off Mei's shoe, Qing asked, 'Can you wiggle your toes for me to see?'

examples.text: 在钢琴前坐久了，站起来动动肩膀和手指会舒服很多。
examples.trans: After sitting at the piano for a long time, standing up to stretch your shoulders and fingers feels much better.

meanings.note: Verb dòngyuán ('rally people to join in').

examples.text: 昨晚我亲自回学校动员同学们。
examples.trans: Last night I went back to campus in person to rally students.

examples.text: 导演在直播前给大家做动员。
examples.trans: The director rallied everyone before the live show.

meanings.note: Noun dònggǎn ('dynamic feel').

examples.text: 新节目的名字首先得有十足的动感。
examples.trans: First of all, the new show's title needs dynamic energy.

examples.text: 开场舞节奏明快，充满了青春的动感。
examples.trans: The opening dance has a brisk beat full of youthful energy.

meanings.note: Verb-object dòngshǒu ('lay hands on; set to work').

examples.text: 你说话归说话，可千万别动手！
examples.trans: Argue with words all you like, just keep your hands off!

examples.text: 大家马上动手布置明天的会场。
examples.trans: Let us get started setting up tomorrow's hall.

meanings.note: Separable V-O idiom for fudging accounts, votes, or personnel.

examples.text: 在预算账目上暗中动手脚是绝对不被允许的。
examples.trans: Secretly tampering with budget accounts is strictly forbidden.

examples.text: 实力不够的人才总想在人事安排上动手脚。
examples.trans: Only those short on real skill try playing tricks with personnel.

动用.gloss: mobilise, draw upon, put to use

meanings.en: mobilise, draw upon, put to use
meanings.note: Bringing resources, connections, or funds into play.

examples.text: 为了核实消息，他动用了海外所有的关系。
examples.trans: To verify the news, he mobilised every overseas connection.

examples.text: 不到紧急关头，不能随便动用备用资金。
examples.trans: Emergency funds must not be tapped unless truly urgent.

meanings.note: Grammar noun dòngcí ('verb').

examples.text: 逃亡这个动词特别有游戏性和紧迫感。
examples.trans: The verb escape feels playful like a game and carries urgency.

examples.text: 标题里用一个有力的动词能立刻抓住眼球。
examples.trans: Using a punchy verb in a title grabs attention right away.

meanings.note: Noun dòngjing ('sound or movement').

examples.text: 那两个人一直都没动静。
examples.trans: Those two have shown no sign of activity all along.

examples.text: 屋里安安静静的，一点动静也没有。
examples.trans: The room is quiet without a single stir.

meanings.note: Stage noun zhùyǎn ('guest/backing performer').

examples.text: 七位歌手和助演团队坐同一辆大巴过来。
examples.trans: All seven singers and their backing performers rode the same bus.

examples.text: 总决赛邀请了交响乐团担任现场助演。
examples.trans: A symphony orchestra was invited as backing performers for the finale.

meanings.note: Special guest invited to perform alongside contestants.

examples.text: 决赛之夜请来了四位重量级助演嘉宾。
examples.trans: Finale night brought in four heavyweight guest performers.

examples.text: 助演嘉宾正在后台和参赛歌手对词。
examples.trans: The guest performer is running lines with the contestant backstage.

meanings.note: zhùlǐ — placed after a role title (e.g., 制作人助理 'producer's assistant') or before a senior title to denote an associate rank (e.g., 助理教授 'assistant professor').

examples.text: 你是联合制作人的助理，跟我们不一样。
examples.trans: You are the co-producer's assistant — you are different from us.

examples.text: 这部分数据是实习助理布小谷做的。
examples.trans: This section of data was prepared by intern assistant Bu Xiaogu.

助阵.gloss: turn out to cheer and support

meanings.en: turn out to cheer and support
meanings.note: Verb-object zhùzhèn ('cheer on, bolster a lineup').

examples.text: 传媒学院助阵的同学全都到位了。
examples.trans: All the Media College students cheering us on are in place.

examples.text: 好几位老朋友今晚来现场助阵。
examples.trans: Several old friends came tonight to lend support.

meanings.note: Adjective/adverbial nǔlì ('hardworking; work hard').

examples.text: 布小谷做事很努力。
examples.trans: Bu Xiaogu works very hard.

examples.text: 去努力工作！
examples.trans: Go work hard!

meanings.note: Taking people or vehicles by force.

examples.text: 海外警方正在全力调查人质被劫持的案件。
examples.trans: Overseas police are investigating the hostage-taking case.

examples.text: 官方尚未排除失踪人员遭到劫持的可能。
examples.trans: Officials have not ruled out that missing persons were seized.

meanings.note: Colloquial adj jìnbào ('explosive, juicy').

examples.text: 董事长您今天讲的八卦实在太劲爆了！
examples.trans: Chairwoman, the gossip you shared today was truly explosive!

examples.text: 压轴歌手带来了一首节奏劲爆的摇滚快歌。
examples.trans: The finale singer performed an explosive rock number.

meanings.note: Common four-character idiom advising rest alongside hard work.

examples.text: 工作再忙也要注意劳逸结合。
examples.trans: No matter how busy work gets, balance work and rest.

examples.text: 懂得劳逸结合效率才会更高。
examples.trans: Efficiency rises when you know how to balance work and rest.

meanings.note: Noun yǒngqì ('courage').

examples.text: 放弃铁饭碗来追梦需要很大的勇气。
examples.trans: Giving up a safe job to chase a dream takes real courage.

examples.text: 台下的掌声给了新秀歌手继续唱下去的勇气。
examples.trans: Applause from the hall gave the rookie courage to sing on.

examples.text: 别勉强。
examples.trans: Do not force it.

examples.text: 很勉强。
examples.trans: Very forced.

meanings.note: Coercing concessions by threatening exposure or harm.

examples.text: 对方气急败坏地指责他拿视频勒索。
examples.trans: Flustered, the other man accused him of blackmail over the video.

examples.text: 遇到敲诈勒索一定要第一时间报警。
examples.trans: If you face extortion or blackmail, call the police right away.

meanings.note: Verb/noun mùjuān ('raise donations').

examples.text: 谁在网上组织这次募捐啊？
examples.trans: Who is organizing this fundraising drive online?

examples.text: 学校正在为山区儿童募捐图书。
examples.trans: The school is raising book donations for rural kids.

meanings.note: Adjective qínláo ('industrious').

examples.text: 你今天来得这么早，真是勤劳啊！
examples.trans: Here so early today — how hardworking of you!

examples.text: 她是办公室里最勤劳的年轻策划。
examples.trans: She is the most diligent young planner in the office.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sháo. Used both as a noun (勺子 'spoon') and as a measure word for spoonfuls (一勺蜂蜜 'a spoonful of honey').

examples.text: 喝热柠檬茶的时候，加一勺蜂蜜最香。
examples.trans: Hot lemon tea smells best when you add a spoonful of honey.

examples.text: 请给我拿一把干净的小木勺。
examples.trans: Please bring me a clean little wooden spoon.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sháo zi. Measure word (量词): 把 (bǎ), e.g. 一把勺子 ('a spoon').

examples.text: 小勺子和餐巾放在哪里？
examples.trans: Where do the small spoons and napkins go?

examples.text: 每个蓝杯子旁边放一张餐巾和一把小勺子。
examples.trans: Beside every blue cup, put one napkin and one small spoon.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yún. Used both as a stative adjective and as a resultative complement after verbs like 刷 ('brush') or 搅 ('stir'): 刷匀 ('brush evenly'), 搅匀 ('stir smooth').

examples.text: 小晴顺着木纹薄薄地把绿油漆刷匀，不留一点滴痕。
examples.trans: Qing brushed the green paint on thinly and evenly along the wood grain without leaving a single drip.

examples.text: 揉面之前先把温水和酵母搅匀。
examples.trans: Stir the warm water and yeast until even before kneading the dough.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bāo. As a verb, 'wrap up' (白纸包着); as a noun/classifier, 'bag/packet'.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

examples.text: 等一下，小晴……你拿了哪一包黄油？
examples.trans: Wait a second, Qing... which packet of butter did you grab?

包在我身上.gloss: leave it to me, I've got it covered

meanings.en: leave it to me, I've got it covered
meanings.note: Confident colloquial promise to take full charge of a task.

examples.text: 放心吧，这件事包在我身上！
examples.trans: Rest assured, leave this matter to me!

examples.text: 订场地的事就包在我身上。
examples.trans: Leave booking the venue to me.

examples.text: 这是包括啊。
examples.trans: This is include.

examples.text: 那个包括好。
examples.trans: That include is good.

meanings.note: Polite verb bāohan ('forgive, make allowances').

examples.text: 第一次见面，还请您多包涵。
examples.trans: Please bear with us on your first visit.

examples.text: 招待不周，请多包涵。
examples.trans: Please excuse any shortcomings in our hospitality.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bāo zhuāng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个包装 ('a wrapper / package').

examples.text: 最上面架子上金色包装那包。怎么了？
examples.trans: The gold-wrapped packet on the top shelf. Why?

examples.text: 哎呀！我跑得太急，包装看着都一样！
examples.trans: Oh no! I was running in such a rush that the wrappers all looked alike!

meanings.note: Pinyin: bāo guǒ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个包裹 ('a parcel'). Also used as a verb meaning 'wrap up'.

examples.text: 第三块石板底下藏着一个用厚黄蜡布包着的方包裹。
examples.trans: Underneath the third flagstone was hidden a square bundle wrapped in heavy yellow waxed cloth.

examples.text: 前台刚收到一个从外地寄来的快递包裹。
examples.trans: The front desk just received an express parcel mailed from out of town.

meanings.note: Pressed for time without leisure.

examples.text: 你这次出差来得太匆忙，都没空吃顿饭。
examples.trans: Your trip this time was so rushed we barely had a meal.

examples.text: 早上走得太匆忙，我把伞落在家里了。
examples.trans: Leaving in such a rush this morning, I left my umbrella at home.

meanings.note: Literary verb-object huàyǒu ('transform into allies').

examples.text: 亲可成仇，敌可化友。
examples.trans: Allies can turn into foes, and enemies can become friends.

examples.text: 巧妙的沟通往往能化敌化友。
examples.trans: Skillful communication can turn rivals into friends.

meanings.note: Applying cosmetics for work or stage.

examples.text: 上台录节目之前，主持人都要先化妆。
examples.trans: Hosts always put on makeup before going on stage to tape.

examples.text: 她每天早上花十分钟化个淡妆，简单化妆就出门。
examples.trans: Every morning she puts on light makeup in ten minutes and heads out.

examples.text: 在化妆间。
examples.trans: In the dressing room.

examples.text: 去化妆间。
examples.trans: Go to the dressing room.

meanings.note: Smoothing away tension, conflict, or resistance.

examples.text: 她一句话就化解了尴尬。
examples.trans: With one remark she defused the awkwardness.

examples.text: 我们要想办法化解这次危机。
examples.trans: We need to find a way to resolve this crisis.

meanings.note: Pinyin: běi. Direction noun; combines with 往 ('toward') as 往北 ('northward') or 边 as 北边 ('the north side').

examples.text: 如果你们有一天重开九号房，从老树往北数三块平石板！
examples.trans: If you ever reopen Room Nine, count three flat flagstones north from the old tree!

examples.text: 阳光房朝南的窗户最亮，北边的木墙正好放书架。
examples.trans: The south-facing windows of the sunroom are brightest, while the north wooden wall is ideal for bookshelves.

匹配.gloss: match, measure up to, pair with

meanings.en: match, measure up to, pair with
meanings.note: Aligning in scale, quality, or style.

examples.text: 文化供应应该与庞大的观众需求相匹配。
examples.trans: Cultural supply ought to match massive audience demand.

examples.text: 这段配乐和画面的节奏非常匹配。
examples.trans: This soundtrack matches the pacing of the visuals wonderfully.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qū. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个区 ('a district').

examples.text: 真奇怪！我们坐同一班早火车到同一个区。
examples.trans: How strange! We rode the very same morning train to the same district.

examples.text: 我们住在安静的老城区。
examples.trans: We live in the quiet old district.

meanings.note: Verb qūfēn ('tell apart, draw a line between').

examples.text: 个性和商业之间的界限很难区分。
examples.trans: The boundary between individuality and commerce is hard to draw.

examples.text: 这两份初稿用不同颜色区分开来。
examples.trans: These two drafts are distinguished by different colours.

meanings.note: Medical verb yīzhì ('give medical treatment').

examples.text: 病情该如何医治，我们全听医生的安排。
examples.trans: On how to treat his illness, we will follow the doctor completely.

examples.text: 经过及时医治，他的急性胃病已经稳定下来。
examples.trans: Thanks to prompt treatment, his acute stomach flare-up stabilised.

meanings.note: Noun yīshēng ('physician, doctor').

examples.text: 我已经跟抢救的医生谈过了。
examples.trans: I already spoke with the emergency doctors.

examples.text: 要不要我去找医生来看看？
examples.trans: Should I go fetch a doctor to check?

meanings.note: Noun/attributive yīliáo ('medical').

examples.text: 现场医疗设备和药品都已经准备齐全。
examples.trans: On-site medical equipment and medicines are all ready.

examples.text: 大型户外节目录制必须配备专业的医疗保障组。
examples.trans: Major outdoor shoots must staff a dedicated medical team.

meanings.note: Compound noun yīyàodān ('hospital/medical expense slip').

examples.text: 拿着这张医药单找你姐报销去吧！
examples.trans: Take this medical bill to your sister for reimbursement!

examples.text: 请把医院开具的医药单收好。
examples.trans: Please keep the hospital medical receipt safe.

examples.text: 这是医院啊。
examples.trans: This is hospital.

examples.text: 那个医院好。
examples.trans: That hospital is good.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí. Cardinal number 10; building block for 11–99.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

examples.text: 十一个人。
examples.trans: Eleven people.

examples.text: 十一号。
examples.trans: Number eleven.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí èr. Cardinal number 十 ('ten') + 二 ('two').

examples.text: 阳光房里一共可以摆十二把木椅。
examples.trans: Twelve wooden chairs in all can be arranged in the sunroom.

examples.text: 一年有十二个月。
examples.trans: There are twelve months in a year.

meanings.en: Twelve Singers (name of a flagship singing competition variety show)
meanings.note: Shí'èr Gēwáng — proper noun referring to a premier music television program in Behind the Scenes (幕后之王); literally 'Twelve Kings of Song'.

examples.text: 跟着我，肯定是上十二歌王了。
examples.trans: Working under me, you will definitely be on Twelve Singers.

examples.text: 《十二歌王》是电视台今年最受关注的音乐节目。
examples.trans: Twelve Singers is the TV station's most anticipated music show this year.

meanings.note: Numeral shíwǔ ('fifteen').

examples.text: 方案会还有十五分钟就要开始了。
examples.trans: The proposal meeting starts in fifteen minutes.

examples.text: 中场休息一共是十五分钟。
examples.trans: Intermission lasts fifteen minutes in total.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí liù. Cardinal number 十 ('ten') + 六 ('six').

examples.text: 这首圆舞曲最后还缺少十六个小节。
examples.trans: This waltz is still missing sixteen bars at the end.

examples.text: 茶壶里泡的薄荷茶够倒十六小杯。
examples.trans: The mint tea steeped in the teapot is enough to pour sixteen small cups.

examples.text: 客人对顶楼那间带阳台的客房十分满意。
examples.trans: The guest is very pleased with the top-floor room with the balcony.

examples.text: 老陈做事十分细致，账本上的每一笔数字都清清楚楚。
examples.trans: Old Chen is very meticulous in his work; every single figure in the ledger is crystal clear.

examples.text: 合同是去年十月签的。
examples.trans: This licensing contract was signed last October.

examples.text: 去年十月？那时候我刚刚来星天实习，是王尔老师带我实习的！
examples.trans: Last October? That was right when I started interning at Xingtian under Wang Er!

十有八九.gloss: nine times out of ten, most likely

meanings.en: nine times out of ten, most likely
meanings.note: Idiom expressing near certainty.

examples.text: 他今天迟到，十有八九是堵车了。
examples.trans: If he is late today, nine times out of ten it is traffic.

examples.text: 这件事十有八九能办成。
examples.trans: Nine times out of ten this matter will work out.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí zú. Literally 十 ('ten out of ten') + 足 ('sufficient/complete'); often follows nouns such as 中气十足 ('full of resonance'), 信心十足 (' brimming with confidence').

examples.text: 修好轴销以后，中央瑞音听起来清脆又有劲，中气十足！
examples.trans: Now that the center pin is fixed, middle D sounds crisp, strong, and full of resonance!

examples.text: 喝过热茶以后，大家干活都精神十足。
examples.trans: After a cup of hot tea, everyone worked with full energy.

examples.text: 一千块钱。
examples.trans: One thousand yuan.

examples.text: 几千人参加了会议。
examples.trans: Thousands of people attended the meeting.

meanings.en: by all means; be sure (not) to
meanings.note: Pinyin: qiān wàn. Strong, caring emphasis before 别 or 要 (千万别忘 'whatever you do, don't forget').

examples.text: 我还没喝早咖啡呢，千万别说急事！
examples.trans: I have not had my morning coffee yet; please do not say emergency!

examples.text: 小美，千万别因为我们多忙活。
examples.trans: Mei, please do not go to extra trouble on our account.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shēng. Means 'rise' (太阳升起来) or 'promote' someone to a higher post (升职).

examples.text: 小晴做事认真，经理升她做正式前台。
examples.trans: Qing works conscientiously, so the manager promoted her to permanent receptionist.

examples.text: 太阳升起来以后，石板路很快就干了。
examples.trans: Once the sun rose, the flagstone path dried quickly.

meanings.note: Formal verb shēngrèn ('rise to a post').

examples.text: 恭喜您升任我们公司的首席内容官！
examples.trans: Congratulations on your promotion to Chief Content Officer!

examples.text: 她凭借出色的业绩升任部门主管。
examples.trans: She was promoted to department head on strong results.

meanings.note: Rising to a higher alert level or better version.

examples.text: 气象台刚刚把暴雨预警升级到了橙色。
examples.trans: The weather bureau just upgraded the rainstorm alert to orange.

examples.text: 演播室的音响系统今年全面升级了。
examples.trans: The studio's sound system received a full upgrade this year.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shēng zhí. Separable verb-object compound 升 ('rise/promote') + 职 ('post/rank').

examples.text: 哥哥上个月刚升职，请全家人吃了一顿晚饭。
examples.trans: My older brother just got promoted last month and treated the whole family to dinner.

examples.text: 她工作认真负责，很快就升职了。
examples.trans: She works conscientiously and was promoted before long.

午休.gloss: take a lunch break, rest at noon

meanings.en: take a lunch break, rest at noon
meanings.note: Midday break for lunch and brief rest.

examples.text: 大家先停一下，去午休吧。
examples.trans: Everyone pause for now and take your lunch break.

examples.text: 我习惯利用午休时间喝杯茶。
examples.trans: I like having a cup of tea during my lunch break.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǔ cān. Combines 午 ('noon') + 餐 ('meal'); slightly more formal/menu-friendly than 午饭.

examples.text: 咖啡角每天中午提供热汤和面包做午餐。
examples.trans: Every day at noon the café corner serves hot soup and bread for lunch.

examples.text: 我们星期天中午一起吃顿简单的午餐吧。
examples.trans: Let's have a simple lunch together at noon on Sunday.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǔ fàn. Measure word (量词): 顿 (dùn), e.g. 一顿午饭 ('a lunch').

examples.text: 午饭以后，两位能帮我们把地下室的桌子搬进来吗？
examples.trans: After lunch, could you two help us carry the cellar tables in?

examples.text: 老陈，午饭以前能修好吗？你有新的保险丝吧？
examples.trans: Chen, can you fix it before lunch? You do have new fuses, right?

meanings.note: Pinyin: bàn. Follows a measure word for 'and a half' (七点半 '7:30') or precedes a measure word for 'half a' (半个小时).

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

examples.text: 七点半有八位饿肚子的客人下楼啊！
examples.trans: At seven thirty, eight hungry guests are coming downstairs!

meanings.note: Pinyin: bàn jià. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 半价优惠 ('a half-price rate').

examples.text: 今晚半价，而且一整周早餐免费！
examples.trans: Half price tonight, plus free breakfast all week!

examples.text: 因为我们的失误，今晚半价，还送早餐。
examples.trans: Because of our mistake, tonight is half price, with complimentary breakfast.

examples.text: 这是半决赛啊。
examples.trans: This is semi-finals.

examples.text: 那个半决赛好。
examples.trans: That semi-finals is good.

examples.text: 惠美一直要求清空所有的日程，现在一周里面有半周她都是空闲的。
examples.trans: Huimei insisted I clear her bookings, so now she leaves half of every week completely open.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

半壁江山.gloss: half the country; half of an entire field

meanings.en: half the country; half of an entire field
meanings.note: Idiom describing dominant market share or influence.

examples.text: 合并后的新公司几乎占据了业内半壁江山。
examples.trans: After the merger, the firm commanded nearly half the industry.

examples.text: 原创综艺如今撑起了晚间收视的半壁江山。
examples.trans: Original variety shows now hold up half of prime-time ratings.

半夜.gloss: midnight; the middle of the night

meanings.en: midnight; the middle of the night
meanings.note: Pinyin: bàn yè. Everyday spoken noun 半 ('half') + 夜 ('night').

examples.text: 半夜突然下起了大雨，把院子的石板淋湿了。
examples.trans: Heavy rain suddenly started at midnight and wet the courtyard flagstones.

examples.text: 半夜街上很安静，连一辆车都没有。
examples.trans: At midnight the street is quiet, without a single car.

半天.gloss: half a day; a long time, ages

meanings.en: half a day (a morning or an afternoon)
meanings.note: bàntiān — literal time duration referring to roughly half of a daytime period or workday.

meanings.en: a long time; quite a while; ages (colloquial)
meanings.note: used hyperbolically after a verb (e.g., 等了半天 'waited for ages', 找了半天 'searched for a long time') to emphasize that an action took longer than expected.

examples.text: 待了半天我就回来了呗。
examples.trans: I stayed half a day and came back, that was all.

examples.text: 我在楼下等了你半天，你怎么才下来？
examples.trans: I waited for you downstairs for ages — why are you only coming down now?

related.gloss: half a day; a long time (colloquial)
all day long; a whole day

examples.text: 离开学校半年就学会喝闷酒了？听说你找男朋友了，超级富二代。
examples.trans: Barely half a year out of school and already drinking alone? Word is you found a super-rich boyfriend.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 是跟你平级好吗？我明明比你高半级！
examples.trans: Same rank as you, okay? I'm clearly half a grade higher than you!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 你这半辈子都没追过人，都是人追你的。
examples.trans: Half your life you have never chased anyone — people have always chased you.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Noun huárén ('Chinese people worldwide').

examples.text: 全球好多华人都是您的粉丝。
examples.trans: Many Chinese worldwide are your fans.

examples.text: 海外华人也很喜欢这个节目。
examples.trans: Overseas Chinese love this show too.

meanings.note: Verb xiétiáo ('coordinate, mediate').

examples.text: 这件事我亲自去协调。
examples.trans: I will go coordinate this matter in person.

examples.text: 各部门之间需要好好协调。
examples.trans: Departments need to coordinate smoothly.

meanings.note: Before a verb, means prepared or done separately for one case.

examples.text: 这份盒饭是厨房单做的。
examples.trans: This box lunch was made separately by the kitchen.

examples.text: 这件事我们一会儿单聊。
examples.trans: Let us talk about this matter separately in a bit.

examples.text: 我想问一问，贵公司是否认为单凭你们在海外娱乐产业发达的经验和资源，
examples.trans: Let me ask you one question: does your group truly believe that relying solely on your overseas entertainment experience and resources

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dān zi. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张单子 ('a list').

examples.text: 看我的单子：两桶绿油漆，十二个简单的杯子，还有市场的柠檬。
examples.trans: Look at my list: two cans of green paint, twelve simple cups, and lemons from the market.

examples.text: 请在这张单子上写您的名字。
examples.trans: Please write your name on this form.

meanings.note: Adverb dāndú ('independently, solo').

examples.text: 二部完全有能力单独掌握好节目制作。
examples.trans: Unit Two is fully capable of handling the production on its own.

examples.text: 散会后总监留他下来单独聊了几句。
examples.trans: After the meeting the director kept him behind for a private word.

meanings.note: Not in a romantic relationship or marriage.

examples.text: 她目前还是单身状态。
examples.trans: She is still single at the moment.

examples.text: 我的好几个同事都是单身。
examples.trans: Several of my colleagues are single.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mài. Everyday verb for selling goods; fourth tone contrasts with 买 (mǎi 'buy').

examples.text: 三年前爷爷去世以后，我和志鹏因为卖老房子大吵了一架。
examples.trans: Three years ago after Grandfather passed away, Zhipeng and I argued bitterly over selling the old house.

examples.text: 我以为卖房子时早就丢了！为什么一直替我留着？
examples.trans: I thought it was lost long ago when we sold the house! Why keep it for me?

examples.text: 闻老师，你不愧是独步江湖的段子手，我们开个讨论会你还卖关子呢。
examples.trans: Mr Wen, you truly live up to your reputation as a master storyteller — keeping us in suspense during a review meeting!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Verb-object màiqián ('monetise, sell').

examples.text: 只是自己喜欢唱歌，纯喜欢，不卖钱。
examples.trans: I simply love singing for myself—pure love, not for sale.

examples.text: 这些旧书她打算捐出去，不拿去卖钱。
examples.trans: She plans to donate these old books rather than sell them.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nán.

examples.text: 大雁在秋天向南飞。
examples.trans: Wild geese fly south in autumn.

examples.text: 我们住在城市的南边。
examples.trans: We live in the southern part of the city.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nán fāng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 南方地区 ('a southern region').

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

examples.text: 成都冬天没有北方那么干，属于南方气候。
examples.trans: Chengdu winters are milder and belong to southern China's climate.

meanings.note: Verb bó ('court or win favour/attention').

examples.text: 那也是无奈之举，博个眼球嘛。
examples.trans: It was out of necessity, just to grab eyeballs.

examples.text: 好节目靠品质，不靠低俗噱头博关注。
examples.trans: Great shows rely on quality, not cheap stunts for attention.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhàn. Read 4th-tone zhàn when meaning 'take up space or time' (占地方 'take up room').

examples.text: 这张大圆桌占了客厅一半的地方。
examples.trans: This big round table takes up half the space in the living room.

examples.text: 折叠椅收起来以后一点也不占地方。
examples.trans: Once folded up, the folding chairs take up almost no space at all.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kǎ. Read 3rd-tone qiǎ or colloquial kǎ when something gets wedged tight in a slot, hinge, or latch.

examples.text: 硬币卡在抽屉缝里，拿不出来了。
examples.trans: The coin got wedged in the drawer crack and won't come out.

examples.text: 有一张旧纸卡在木头合页后面。
examples.trans: An old sheet of paper is wedged behind the wooden hinge.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiǎ zhù. Describes a door handle, zipper, or hinge jamming (also spoken kǎ zhù).

examples.text: 星期一你打开了卡住的门；这一周你救了客房、水管、早餐和租约。
examples.trans: On Monday you opened our sticking door; this week you saved rooms, pipes, breakfast, and our lease.

examples.text: 抽屉被一本厚账本卡住了。
examples.trans: The drawer got jammed on a thick ledger.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kǎ kòu. Mechanical catch, buckle, or side latch that locks a folding frame or lid in place.

examples.text: 轻轻按下金属卡扣，椅子就能收起来。
examples.trans: Press the metal latch lightly and the chair folds right up.

examples.text: 背包上的塑料卡扣扣得很紧。
examples.trans: The plastic buckle on the backpack snaps shut tightly.

meanings.note: Small paper card for notes, gifts, or study.

examples.text: 礼物盒里放着一张小卡片。
examples.trans: Inside the gift box sits a small card.

examples.text: 他在卡片上写了几句祝福。
examples.trans: He wrote a few wishes on the card.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kǎ chē. Phonosemantic compound 卡 (from English 'car/cart') + 车 ('wheeled vehicle').

examples.text: 清早有一辆送蔬菜的小卡车停在巷口。
examples.trans: Early in the morning a small vegetable truck stopped at the lane entrance.

examples.text: 重卡车开过老街时，窗户都会轻轻震动。
examples.trans: When a heavy truck drives down the old street, the windows vibrate slightly.

meanings.note: Room for sleeping at home.

examples.text: 客人突然敲门，他赶紧让她先去卧室待着。
examples.trans: With guests at the door, he hurried her into the bedroom.

examples.text: 阳光透过窗帘照进了安静的卧室。
examples.trans: Sunlight filtered through the curtains into the quiet bedroom.

meanings.note: Idiom wòhǔ-cánglóng ('crouching tigers, hidden dragons — packed with unnoticed talent').

examples.text: 看来星天真是卧虎藏龙啊。
examples.trans: It seems Xingtian really is full of hidden talent.

examples.text: 这个小小的部门里卧虎藏龙。
examples.trans: This small department hides remarkable talent.

meanings.note: Provincial or national satellite broadcast feed.

examples.text: 明晚的总决赛将在卫星频道同步直播。
examples.trans: Tomorrow night's finale airs live on the satellite channel.

examples.text: 技术组正在调试卫星频道的传输信号。
examples.trans: The tech crew is testing the satellite channel transmission.

examples.text: 你也不用太悲观了，可以试试云海卫视。
examples.trans: You do not need to be too pessimistic either; you can try Yunhai Television.

examples.text: 这是卫视。
examples.trans: This is 卫视.

meanings.note: Printing cards, posters, or documents.

examples.text: 行政部刚帮新入职的同事印好了名片。
examples.trans: Administration just printed business cards for the new hires.

examples.text: 宣传册上的节目播出时间千万别印错了。
examples.trans: Make sure the broadcast time on the brochure is not misprinted.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yìn zhāng. Measure word (量词): 枚, e.g. 一枚印章 ('a seal / stamp').

examples.text: 邮递员刚让我签收的，上面盖着红色房产印章。
examples.trans: The postman just had me sign for it; it carries a red property-office stamp.

examples.text: 通知右下角盖着一枚圆印章。
examples.trans: A round official stamp sits in the bottom-right corner of the notice.

examples.text: 经济危机。
examples.trans: Economic crisis.

examples.text: 化解危机。
examples.trans: Resolve a crisis.

meanings.note: Media/PR phrase wēijī gōngguān ('crisis PR').

examples.text: 我们这儿正在做危机公关呢。
examples.trans: We are handling crisis public relations right here.

examples.text: 面对突发谣言，危机公关必须迅速透明。
examples.trans: Facing sudden rumours, crisis PR must be swift and transparent.

meanings.note: Paired with 也 to introduce a hypothetical concession.

examples.text: 即使遇到突发状况，直播也必须按时进行。
examples.trans: Even if emergencies arise, the live broadcast must start on time.

examples.text: 即使预算有限，团队依然做出了高品质成片。
examples.trans: Even on a tight budget, the team delivered a high-quality cut.

meanings.note: Performed spontaneously without a script.

examples.text: 暴雨中断比赛时，他带来了一段精彩的即兴主持。
examples.trans: When rain halted the contest, he delivered brilliant impromptu commentary.

examples.text: 爵士乐手在舞台上展开了默契的即兴演奏。
examples.trans: The jazz musicians launched into seamless improvisation on stage.

meanings.note: Formal adverb jíjiāng ('on the verge of').

examples.text: 众星闪耀的红毯仪式即将开始。
examples.trans: The star-studded red carpet is about to begin.

examples.text: 列车即将到达终点站。
examples.trans: The train is about to reach the terminal.

meanings.note: Standard closing formula on official company notices.

examples.text: 这项新的人事决定从发布起即日生效。
examples.trans: This new personnel decision takes effect immediately.

examples.text: 新规章制度经董事会批准，即日生效。
examples.trans: Approved by the board, the new policy is effective today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: què. Always sits AFTER the subject and BEFORE the verb to mark contrast ('yet, surprisingly').

examples.text: 等等，咸黄油配果酱不行，做炒蛋却棒极了！
examples.trans: Wait—salted butter fails with jam, yet for scrambled eggs it is amazing!

examples.text: 没错。外面大街很吵，进了院子却只听见树叶和小鸟。
examples.trans: Exactly. Outside on the main road it is noisy, yet inside the courtyard you only hear leaves and birds.

meanings.note: Pinyin: juǎn. Read 3rd-tone juǎn as the measure word for rolled items (一卷胶带 'a roll of tape', 一卷纸 'a roll of paper').

examples.text: 工具箱里还有半卷黑色的胶带。
examples.trans: There is still half a roll of black tape in the toolbox.

examples.text: 画家把三卷白纸放进了布袋里。
examples.trans: The painter put three rolls of white paper into a cloth bag.

meanings.note: Pinyin: juán chǐ. Measure word (量词): 把 (bǎ), e.g. 一把卷尺 ('a tape measure').

examples.text: 我弟弟早饭还没吃完，就拿着卷尺跑下来了。
examples.trans: My little brother grabbed his tape measure before he even finished breakfast.

examples.text: 老陈用卷尺量了一下门。
examples.trans: Chen measured the door with a tape measure.

meanings.note: Pinyin: juǎn lián mén. Measure word (量词): 扇 (shàn), e.g. 一扇卷帘门 ('a rolling shutter').

examples.text: 太好了！卷帘门开了吗？
examples.trans: Great! Is the shutter open?

examples.text: 早上八点，五金店准时拉开了铁卷帘门。
examples.trans: At eight sharp, the hardware shop pulled up its rolling metal shutter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiè. Means taking parts off a frame/hinge (卸下来) or unloading cargo from a vehicle.

examples.text: 老陈先把旧木窗板从合页上卸下来打磨。
examples.trans: Chen first took the old wooden shutters off their hinges to sand them.

examples.text: 工人们正在把木箱从卡车上卸下来。
examples.trans: The workers are unloading the wooden crates from the truck.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lì shǐ. Measure word (量词): 段, e.g. 一段历史 ('a stretch of history').

examples.text: 一位研究成都历史小院建筑的建筑师啊！
examples.trans: An architect who studies historic courtyard buildings in Chengdu!

examples.text: 这条老街已经有两百年的历史了。
examples.trans: This old street already has two hundred years of history.

related.gloss: a stretch of history (measure word 段)

examples.text: 上周的报告看了吗？十二歌王收视率第一，超过第二名三个点，这是历史纪录。
examples.trans: Did you read last week's report? Twelve Singers ranked number one in ratings, beating second place by three full points — a historic record.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: adjective praising sharp skill or impressive ability

examples.text: 那就太好了，好厉害！
examples.trans: Then that is wonderful — you are amazing!

examples.text: 这位制作人在业内非常厉害。
examples.trans: This producer is really formidable in the industry.

压.gloss: press down; weigh down; pin underneath

meanings.en: press down; weigh down; pin underneath
meanings.note: Pinyin: yā. Action verb for pressing from above or holding flat under an object (压着 'pinned/resting underneath').

examples.text: 快看铁盒子最底下的薄纸下面，还压着一个小方信封！
examples.trans: Look underneath the tissue paper at the very bottom of the tin box—a tiny square envelope is tucked underneath!

examples.text: 老陈拿了一块光滑的鹅卵石，把桌上的图纸压稳。
examples.trans: Chen took a smooth river pebble to weight the drawing paper down steadily on the table.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yā lì. Measure word (量词): 种 (zhǒng), e.g. 一种压力 ('a kind of pressure').

examples.text: 坏消息。老热水器上的铜压力阀门裂了。
examples.trans: Bad news. The brass pressure valve on the old water heater cracked.

examples.text: 换了新阀门，三楼的水压没有压力问题了。
examples.trans: With the new valve in place, the upstairs water pressure is steady.

related.gloss: a kind of pressure (measure word 种)

meanings.note: Popular humorous phrase playing on massive pressure.

examples.text: 接手这个大项目后我压力山大。
examples.trans: Since taking on this big project I have been under huge pressure.

examples.text: 面对总决赛，选手们都压力山大。
examples.trans: Facing the grand finale, the contestants are all under immense pressure.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lí mǐ. Metric unit classifier 厘 ('one-hundredth') + 米 ('metre'); takes numerals directly without 个 (两厘米 'two centimetres').

examples.text: 把院子上面的气窗推开两厘米，让走廊的空气流动起来。
examples.trans: Push the courtyard transom window open two centimetres so the air in the hallway circulates.

examples.text: 左边这扇窗板再往上抬半厘米就正好对齐了。
examples.trans: Lift this left shutter half a centimetre higher and it will line up squarely.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hòu. Describes thick coats, walls, books, or blankets.

examples.text: 我床上有厚被子，今晚睡着很舒服。
examples.trans: I have a thick quilt on my bed, so sleeping tonight is very comfortable.

examples.text: 我在看天气，小美！铃铛旁边这封厚信是谁放的？
examples.trans: I am checking the weather, Mei! Who put this thick letter beside the bell?

meanings.note: Pinyin: hòu hòu. Vivid reduplication of 厚 ('thick'), usually followed by 的 before a noun (厚厚的杯子).

examples.text: 冬天盖着厚厚的棉被睡得真香。
examples.trans: Sleeping under a nice thick quilt in winter is so cosy.

examples.text: 这种厚厚的白瓷碗端在手里不烫。
examples.trans: This kind of thick white porcelain bowl doesn't burn your hands when held.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuán wèi. Used after directional verbs like 放回原位 ('put back in its original place') or 回到原位.

examples.text: 老陈把大石板稳稳放回原位，院子地面又平平整整了。
examples.trans: Chen set the heavy flagstone steadily back in its original place, leaving the courtyard floor flat again.

examples.text: 用完前台的剪刀，请记得放回原位。
examples.trans: After using the front-desk scissors, please remember to put them back in their original spot.

examples.text: 不是吧？洛琳亲口说是原作者钦点她唱这首歌的！
examples.trans: No way! Luo Lin claimed with her own mouth that the songwriter personally handpicked her to sing that song!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 你就愿意顶着这身脏水被黑一辈子？你还有没有原则了，你怕什么呀？
examples.trans: Are you willing to wear this filthy slander for the rest of your life? Where are your principles — what are you afraid of?!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Attributive/noun yuánchuàng ('original creation').

examples.text: 我觉得这是一个真正的本土原创节目。
examples.trans: I think this is a genuinely original domestic show.

examples.text: 鼓励原创音乐人是这档比赛最大的亮点。
examples.trans: Championing original musicians is this contest's top highlight.

meanings.note: Compound noun yuánchuànglì ('capacity for originality').

examples.text: 跟风模仿其实是原创力不足的表现。
examples.trans: Copycatting shows a shortage of original creativity.

examples.text: 团队的核心优势在于强大的原创力。
examples.trans: A team's core edge lies in strong originality.

meanings.note: Noun yuányīn ('cause, reason').

examples.text: 这不是他生病的原因。
examples.trans: That is not the cause of his illness.

examples.text: 我们要查清楚事故的原因。
examples.trans: We need to find out the cause of the accident.

meanings.note: Place noun yuándì ('the spot where one is').

examples.text: 让病人在原地躺好，千万不要随便移动。
examples.trans: Keep the patient lying right where he is and do not move him.

examples.text: 请各机位摄像师留在原地等待导播口令。
examples.trans: Camera operators, hold your positions and await booth cues.

原封不动.gloss: untouched; kept intact without a single change

meanings.en: untouched; kept intact without a single change
meanings.note: Pinyin: yuán fēng bú dòng. Four-character idiom 原封 ('original seal') + 不动 ('unmoved/untouched'); bù shifts to 2nd-tone bú before 4th-tone dòng.

examples.text: 姑姑当年的星期五钢琴茶叙时间，原封不动地写在了新木牌上！
examples.trans: My aunt's original Friday piano-tea hour is written right on the new wooden sign without a single change!

examples.text: 抽屉里那叠三十年前的旧乐谱一直原封不动地保存着。
examples.trans: That stack of thirty-year-old sheet music in the drawer has been preserved completely intact.

meanings.note: Noun yuánwén ('the original text').

examples.text: 原文虽然删了，但已经有人截了图。
examples.trans: Although the original post was deleted, screenshots remain.

examples.text: 翻译之前请先仔细阅读一遍原文。
examples.trans: Read the original text carefully before translating.

meanings.note: Adverb/adjective yuánběn ('originally').

examples.text: 她原本是你们公司的老对头。
examples.trans: She was originally a rival of your company.

examples.text: 这间办公室原本是用来放道具的。
examples.trans: This room was originally used to store props.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuán lái. Marks an 'aha!' discovery ('so it was X all along!').

examples.text: 原来星期五的神秘客人一直睡在我阁楼屋顶下面。
examples.trans: So our mystery Friday caller was sleeping under my attic roof all along.

examples.text: 原来留着爷爷旧物的神秘人一直是你，志豪。
examples.trans: So the mystery person holding Grandfather's keepsake was you all along, Zhihao.

meanings.note: Noun yuánbǎn ('the original edition/format').

examples.text: 美国原版每一季我都认真看过了。
examples.trans: I have watched every season of the original American version.

examples.text: 书架上摆着几本英文原版的电影教材。
examples.trans: Several original English film textbooks sit on the shelf.

meanings.note: Noun phrase yuánjìhuà ('the initial plan').

examples.text: 咱们就按照原计划继续进行吧。
examples.trans: Let us carry on according to the original plan.

examples.text: 虽然下起小雨，外景拍摄仍按原计划开始。
examples.trans: Despite light rain, outdoor filming began as planned.

meanings.note: Verb yuánliàng ('forgive, pardon').

examples.text: 你觉得我们就能原谅你吗？
examples.trans: Do you think we will forgive you?

examples.text: 请原谅我的失误。
examples.trans: Please forgive my oversight.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chú fáng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间厨房 ('a kitchen').

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

examples.text: 糟了！周经理，小晴，厨房出急事了！
examples.trans: Oh no! Manager Zhou, Qing, we have a kitchen emergency!

meanings.note: Noun chúyì ('culinary skill').

examples.text: 要么你就好好练练你的厨艺。
examples.trans: Either you practise your cooking skills properly...

examples.text: 没想到平时严肃的导演厨艺居然这么好。
examples.trans: Who knew the serious director was such a good cook?

meanings.note: Pinyin: qù. Movement away from the speaker, as main verb (去车站) or directional complement (上去).

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qù shì. Respectful verb meaning 'die / pass away'.

examples.text: 三年前爷爷去世以后，我和志鹏因为卖老房子大吵了一架。
examples.trans: Three years ago after Grandfather passed away, Zhipeng and I argued bitterly over selling the old house.

examples.text: 老房子是爷爷去世前留给他们的。
examples.trans: The old house was left to them before their grandfather passed away.

meanings.note: Time noun qùnián ('last year').

examples.text: 可以把去年丢掉的学位重新拿回来。
examples.trans: You can earn back the degree you missed out on last year.

examples.text: 去年冬天录制跨年晚会时下了一场大雪。
examples.trans: Heavy snow fell while taping the New Year gala last year.

meanings.note: Verb-complement qùdiào ('eliminate, strip out').

examples.text: 要是去掉所有媒体评审，宣传怎么配合？
examples.trans: If we drop the entire media jury, how does publicity tie in?

examples.text: 请把台本里重复的那两句去掉。
examples.trans: Please cut those two repeated lines from the script.

meanings.note: Verb cānyù ('be involved in').

examples.text: 我没想到你也参与了这次策划。
examples.trans: I never expected you took part in this plan too.

examples.text: 全组同事都积极参与了讨论。
examples.trans: Every team member actively joined the discussion.

meanings.note: Anyone taking part in an event or production.

examples.text: 必须确认节目每一位参与者的平安。
examples.trans: We must confirm the safety of every participant on the show.

examples.text: 所有参与者都签署了保密协议。
examples.trans: All participants signed a confidentiality agreement.

meanings.note: Verb cānjiā.

examples.text: 她参加我们的节目。
examples.trans: She joins our show.

examples.text: 明天谁参加会议？
examples.trans: Who is attending tomorrow's meeting?

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòu. Marks an action repeating, or pairs two qualities in 又A又B ('both A and B').

examples.text: 真的可以吗？看着又好看又暖和！
examples.trans: Is that really alright? It looks both lovely and warm!

examples.text: 又是深蓝色行李箱！这是宋老师的吗？
examples.trans: Another dark-blue suitcase! Is this Teacher Song's?

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a noun used in conversational Mandarin. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个叉子 ('a 叉子').

examples.text: 我有一个叉子。
examples.trans: I have a 叉子.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的叉子。
examples.trans: This is a very good 叉子.

examples.text: 已有行业分析师论断，此事必将造成星天娱乐股权整合及上市进程大幅拖慢。
examples.trans: Industry analysts warn the lawsuit will severely delay Xingtian's share restructuring and public listing.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Adjective/adverb jíshí ('timely, right in time').

examples.text: 幸好老大及时发现了舞台上的错误。
examples.trans: Luckily our boss spotted the stage error in time.

examples.text: 发现问题一定要及时汇报。
examples.trans: Report issues promptly whenever you spot them.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuāng. Counts naturally paired items: shoes, socks, chopsticks, hands (一双皮鞋 'a pair of leather shoes').

examples.text: 两双棕色大男鞋，还有灰色毛衣。
examples.trans: Two pairs of big brown men's shoes, plus grey sweaters.

examples.text: 天哪……看这双眼睛！第三级台阶上的小志豪？！
examples.trans: Good heavens... look at those eyes! Little Zhihao from the third step?!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuāng bèi. Combines 双 ('double/two') + 倍 ('times/fold'); used before nouns with 的 or after verbs.

examples.text: 既然星期五要多来十位老街坊，小美得准备双倍的黄柠檬啦！
examples.trans: Since ten extra neighbours are coming on Friday, Mei will need to prepare double the yellow lemons!

examples.text: 周末客栈客人多，我们今天揉了双倍的面团。
examples.trans: Because the inn has many guests on weekends, we kneaded double the dough today.

meanings.note: Noun shuāngfāng ('both sides in an agreement or dispute').

examples.text: 电视台派人常驻，双方关系会很紧张。
examples.trans: With network staff stationed here, ties will be tense.

examples.text: 合作双方今天正式签署了协议。
examples.trans: Both parties formally signed the deal today.

meanings.note: Compound noun shuāngshuòshì ('holder of two master's degrees').

examples.text: 我是新闻学和艺术管理双硕士。
examples.trans: I hold dual master's degrees in journalism and arts.

examples.text: 她毕业拿到了传播学双硕士学位。
examples.trans: She graduated with dual master's degrees in media.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuāng bāo tāi. Measure word (量词): 对 (duì), e.g. 一对双胞胎 ('a pair of twins').

examples.text: 呀，这就是星期一火车上那只双胞胎箱子吗？
examples.trans: Oh, is this that twin suitcase from Monday's train?

examples.text: 这两个蓝箱子长得就像一对双胞胎。
examples.trans: Those two blue suitcases look just like a pair of twins.

related.gloss: a pair of twins (measure word 对)

meanings.note: Competition noun shuāngbài táotàizhì ('double elimination').

examples.text: 我要讲的是全新的双败淘汰制。
examples.trans: What I am presenting is the double-elimination format.

examples.text: 双败淘汰制给了实力歌手第二次舞台机会。
examples.trans: Double elimination gives strong singers a second chance onstage.

meanings.note: Echo or reception from viewers and readers.

examples.text: 第一支预告片播出后，网上的反响特别热烈。
examples.trans: After the first trailer aired, online reaction was electric.

examples.text: 这篇文章在行业里引起了很大的反响。
examples.trans: This article stirred strong buzz across the industry.

meanings.note: Disagreeing with or resisting a plan.

examples.text: 刚开始几乎所有人都反对改版。
examples.trans: At first almost everyone opposed the revamp.

examples.text: 你为什么反对这个提议呢？
examples.trans: Why do you object to this proposal?

meanings.note: Pinyin: fǎn yìng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个反应 ('a reaction').

examples.text: 呼，好在反应快，早餐又有救了！
examples.trans: Phew, quick thinking saves breakfast once again!

examples.text: 听到这个好消息，大家的反应都很开心。
examples.trans: Hearing the good news, everyone reacted with joy.

meanings.note: Verb fǎnyìng ('voice feedback; mirror').

examples.text: 有很多观众反映这两档节目太像了。
examples.trans: Many viewers report that the two shows look too alike.

examples.text: 收视数据真实反映了观众的喜好。
examples.trans: Ratings figures genuinely reflect viewer tastes.

meanings.note: Adverb fǎnzhèng ('anyway, regardless').

examples.text: 反正以后也见不到面了。
examples.trans: We will not see each other again anyway.

examples.text: 反正时间还早，慢慢走吧。
examples.trans: It is still early anyway, so let us walk slowly.

meanings.note: Adverb fǎn'ér ('instead, on the contrary').

examples.text: 他不发脾气的时候反而更吓人。
examples.trans: When he does not lose his temper, he is even scarier instead.

examples.text: 遇到难题别慌，冷静下来反而更容易解决。
examples.trans: Do not panic at hurdles—calming down solves them faster.

meanings.note: Literary verb fǎnbèi ('invert, turn into its opposite').

examples.text: 天道循环，阴阳反背。
examples.trans: Heaven's way cycles round, and yin and yang reverse.

examples.text: 局势有时会在一夜之间反背。
examples.trans: A situation can reverse course overnight.

examples.text: 更让人想不到的是，星天娱乐竟然拿到了钟阳子的亲笔授权书，并将代表她反诉白石音乐公司！
examples.trans: Even more astonishing, Xingtian Entertainment has obtained Zhong Yangzi's handwritten authorization and will countersue Baishi on her behalf!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Phrase fǎnguòlai ('in reverse, the other way round').

examples.text: 这三个字反过来读也能读得通。
examples.trans: Read backwards, these three characters still make sense.

examples.text: 反过来想，这也许是个好机会。
examples.trans: Looked at the other way round, this might be a chance.

meanings.note: Verb fā ('issue / release / post').

examples.text: 辛惠美发了新歌！
examples.trans: Xin Huimei released a new song!

examples.text: 我给你发了消息。
examples.trans: I sent you a message.

examples.text: 好，你发个地址给我，我马上过去！
examples.trans: Alright, text me the address and I'll head right over!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 是金子就会发光的，别的不用理它。
examples.trans: True gold will always shine — ignore everything else.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

发呆.gloss: stare blankly, zone out, stand in a daze

meanings.en: stare blankly, zone out, stand in a daze
meanings.note: Lost in thought or shock without acting.

examples.text: 听到这个意外消息，大家站在原地发呆。
examples.trans: Hearing the surprise news, everyone stood rooted in a daze.

examples.text: 别坐在电脑前发呆了，赶紧把方案改完。
examples.trans: Stop zoning out at your screen and finish revising the plan.

meanings.note: Noun fàxíng ('hairstyle').

examples.text: 我每天早上做发型都要弄四十分钟！
examples.trans: I spend forty minutes styling my hair every morning!

examples.text: 化妆师替主持人整理了一下发型。
examples.trans: The stylist neatened the host's hairstyle.

meanings.note: Verb/noun fāzhǎn ('grow, develop').

examples.text: 公司里的各个部门都是要发展的。
examples.trans: Every department in the company needs to grow.

examples.text: 电视行业这几年发展得很快。
examples.trans: The TV industry has grown rapidly in recent years.

examples.text: 欢迎各位来到十二歌王第三季新闻发布会的现场。
examples.trans: Welcome to the official press conference for Season Three of Twelve Singers.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Internet verb-object fātiě ('publish a forum/social post').

examples.text: 粉丝会长在网上发帖号召大家。
examples.trans: The fan-club head posted online to rally everyone.

examples.text: 他在校园论坛上发帖找室友。
examples.trans: He posted on the campus forum looking for a roommate.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fā dǒu. Describes hands or voice trembling from cold or nerves.

examples.text: 我手在发抖——车上下来穿深灰色外套的高个子男人吗？
examples.trans: My hands are shaking—is a tall man in a dark grey coat stepping out?

examples.text: 外面风太大，他冷得手有点发抖。
examples.trans: The wind outside was so cold his hands shivered slightly.

meanings.note: Noun fàyóu ('styling oil or pomade').

examples.text: 他头发上的发油简直越抹越多。
examples.trans: He slicks more and more pomade onto his hair.

examples.text: 舞台灯光太热，别抹太多发油。
examples.trans: Stage lights run hot, so go easy on hair oil.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fā huǒ. Literally 'emit fire'.

examples.text: 怎么样？他发火了吗？要退钱吗？
examples.trans: How did it go? Did he lose his temper? Did he ask for a refund?

examples.text: 遇到急事也要冷静，别乱发火。
examples.trans: Stay calm in an emergency instead of losing your temper.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fā xiàn. Used when noticing a clue or uncovering an object.

examples.text: 椅子找到了——在一堵旧砖墙后面，我还发现了这个。
examples.trans: Found the chairs—and behind an old brick partition wall, I also uncovered this.

examples.text: 打扫地下室的时候，他发现了一个旧木盒。
examples.trans: While cleaning the cellar, he discovered an old wooden box.

examples.text: 发生了什么事？
examples.trans: What happened?

examples.text: 事情发生的太快了。
examples.trans: It happened too quickly.

发疯.gloss: go crazy, act out of one's mind

meanings.en: go crazy, act out of one's mind
meanings.note: Used figuratively when someone acts recklessly out of emotion.

examples.text: 好端端的，你今天怎么跟着我一块发疯？
examples.trans: Out of nowhere, why are you acting crazy right alongside me?

examples.text: 为了赶明早的播出带，剪辑师快忙得发疯了。
examples.trans: Rushing tomorrow's broadcast tape nearly drove the editor crazy.

发病.gloss: have an acute flare-up, fall ill

meanings.en: have an acute flare-up, fall ill
meanings.note: Medical verb-object fābìng ('onset of illness').

examples.text: 医生说这次发病是酒精引起的。
examples.trans: Doctors say this flare-up was triggered by alcohol.

examples.text: 幸好发病时身边有同事及时送医。
examples.trans: Luckily a colleague was nearby when the attack hit.

meanings.note: Noun fāpiào ('tax invoice/receipt').

examples.text: 一共是一千七百块，您需要开发票吗？
examples.trans: That is 1,700 yuan in all; do you need an invoice?

examples.text: 公司报销需要正式发票。
examples.trans: Company reimbursement requires an official receipt.

examples.text: 发稿人是谁？
examples.trans: Who is the press release issuer?

examples.text: 停止发稿。
examples.trans: Stop the press release.

examples.text: 这是发给啊。
examples.trans: This is sent to.

examples.text: 那个发给好。
examples.trans: That sent to is good.

meanings.note: Verb-object phrase fā píqi ('get angry').

examples.text: 你有没有发现最近他发脾气可少了？
examples.trans: Have you noticed how much less he loses his temper lately?

examples.text: 真正的专业领导靠实力服人，不靠乱发脾气。
examples.trans: True leaders earn respect through skill, not temper tantrums.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fā biǎo. Combines 发 ('issue/put forth') + 表 ('make known publicly'), used for publishing musical works, articles, or speeches.

examples.text: 街上的陌生人怎么会知道这首从来没发表过的圆舞曲呢？
examples.trans: How could a stranger on the street know this waltz that was never published?

examples.text: 宋老师年轻时在音乐杂志上发表过好几首钢琴小品。
examples.trans: When Teacher Song was young, she published several short piano pieces in music magazines.

examples.text: 我发誓。
examples.trans: I swear.

examples.text: 发过誓。
examples.trans: Have sworn.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fā chē. Verb-object compound 发 ('dispatch/set out') + 车 ('train/bus') for scheduled departures.

examples.text: 去成都东站的那趟火车晚上七点发车。
examples.trans: That train to Chengdu East Station departs at seven in the evening.

examples.text: 请大家提前十分钟上车，大巴马上发车。
examples.trans: Please board ten minutes early; the coach is about to depart.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fā ruǎn. Describes knees going weak or wet cardboard softening.

examples.text: 啊……不好。我的椅子在哪儿？我腿发软。
examples.trans: Oh... oh no. Where is my chair? My legs feel weak.

examples.text: 纸箱淋了雨，边角有点发软。
examples.trans: Caught in the rain, the corners of the carton went soft.

meanings.note: Adjective fādá ('well-developed, flourishing').

examples.text: 现在的粉丝文化已经很发达了。
examples.trans: Fan culture nowadays is already highly developed.

examples.text: 这座城市的文化产业非常发达。
examples.trans: This city's cultural sector is very developed.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fā nián. Inchoative compound 发 ('become/turn') + 黏 ('sticky/tacky').

examples.text: 刷油漆的时候要薄薄地刷，要是涂得太厚就会一直发黏。
examples.trans: When painting, brush on thin coats; if the paint goes on too thick, it will stay tacky.

examples.text: 夏天空气潮湿的时候，木头桌面要常擦才不会发黏。
examples.trans: When the summer air is humid, wooden tabletops need regular wiping so they don't feel sticky.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shū shu. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位叔叔 ('an uncle').

examples.text: 我想起来了！我十岁的时候，叔叔叫它冬天茶室！
examples.trans: Now I remember! When I was ten, my uncle called it the winter tea room!

examples.text: 我叔叔在成都开了一家小饭馆。
examples.trans: My uncle runs a small restaurant in Chengdu.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a verb used in conversational Mandarin.

examples.text: 我有一个取。
examples.trans: I have a 取.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的取。
examples.trans: This is a very good 取.

meanings.note: Verb phrase qǔjuéyú ('be determined by').

examples.text: 事情的成败有时取决于你想问题的角度。
examples.trans: Success or failure sometimes hinges on your angle of thought.

examples.text: 外景能不能拍取决于明天的天气。
examples.trans: Whether we shoot outdoors depends on tomorrow's weather.

取消.gloss: to cancel, to call off, to revoke

meanings.en: to cancel; to call off; to abolish; to revoke
meanings.note: qǔxiāo — transitive verb used for cancelling scheduled events, bookings (通告), qualifications (资格), or orders.

examples.text: 他不能再上其他的节目，只能取消通告。
examples.trans: He cannot appear on any other shows, so we can only cancel the booking.

examples.text: 他们已经取消了今夜现场的通告，决定来录我们的文娱论。
examples.trans: They already cancelled their appearance on Tonight Live and decided to record our Entertainment Talk.

related.gloss: to call a halt; to stop

meanings.note: Pinyin: shòu. Used for experiencing or enduring conditions.

examples.text: 那你们的客栈租约就受市里法律再保护十年！
examples.trans: Then your inn lease is protected by city law for another ten years!

examples.text: 这间咖啡馆很受街坊欢迎。
examples.trans: This café is very popular with the neighbors.

meanings.note: Potential complement shòubuliǎo ('cannot tolerate').

examples.text: 他那个酒量，喝多了身体根本受不了。
examples.trans: With his low tolerance, his body cannot handle liquor.

examples.text: 连续熬夜三天，铁打的人也受不了。
examples.trans: Nobody can withstand three straight all-nighters.

examples.text: 如果你让她受到任何的伤害，那么我闻思默于公于私，都将会成为你最坚决的敌人。
examples.trans: If you ever let her get hurt in any way, then professionally and personally I will become your fiercest enemy.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Noun shòukùnzhě ('person stranded in an emergency').

examples.text: 市民纷纷开放住处，给路上的受困者避雨。
examples.trans: Residents opened their homes so stranded commuters could shelter.

examples.text: 救援车队连夜把高架桥下的受困者安全接走。
examples.trans: Rescue vans worked overnight to pick up people stranded under bridges.

meanings.note: Person harmed by fraud, an accident, or a crime.

examples.text: 公益节目专门为受骗的受害人提供法律援助。
examples.trans: The charity special offers legal aid to victims of the scam.

examples.text: 警方正在联系此案的受害人核实情况。
examples.trans: Police are contacting victims of the case to verify details.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shòu cháo. Verb-object compound 受 ('be affected by') + 潮 ('dampness/moisture').

examples.text: 木头琴键受潮以后就容易卡住。
examples.trans: Once wooden piano keys absorb dampness, they easily stick.

examples.text: 饼干要放进密封罐里，免得受潮变软。
examples.trans: Keep the biscuits in an airtight jar so they don't get damp and soft.

meanings.note: The side that gains from an arrangement or reform.

examples.text: 节目火了，大家都是受益方。
examples.trans: Once the show becomes a hit, everyone benefits.

examples.text: 观众才是这次改版最大的受益方。
examples.trans: Viewers are the biggest beneficiaries of this revamp.

meanings.note: Verb-object shòufá ('receive punishment').

examples.text: 你调去做行政是受罚，还是保护？
examples.trans: Was moving you to admin a punishment, or protection?

examples.text: 出了严重失误自然要按规定受罚。
examples.trans: Serious lapses naturally bring penalties under the rules.

examples.text: 你总自虐干吗呀？哪回你自虐，最后受苦的不是我们？
examples.trans: Why do you always torture yourself? Every time you do, aren't we the ones who suffer too?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Noun shòuyāorén ('person on the invitation list').

examples.text: 我看受邀人名单里面有辛惠美。
examples.trans: I noticed Xin Huimei is among the invitees.

examples.text: 所有受邀人都已经回复了。
examples.trans: Every invitee has replied.

meanings.note: Pinyin: biàn. Describes a shift in state (变凉 'turn cool', 变成 'turn into').

examples.text: 摸摸热水管——下面是温的，上面变凉了。
examples.trans: Feel the hot-water pipe—the bottom is warm, while the top is turning cool.

examples.text: 我一紧张，句子就变得又长又正式！
examples.trans: Whenever I get nervous, my sentences turn long and formal!

examples.text: 他从美国回来下一个月也都是满的，而且这些时间随时都在变动。
examples.trans: Next month after he returns from abroad is completely full too, and his hours shift constantly.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Noun/verb biànhuà ('change, shift').

examples.text: 不好意思，现场的安排突然有点变化。
examples.trans: Sorry, the on-site schedule suddenly changed a bit.

examples.text: 这两年城市的变化很大。
examples.trans: The city has changed a great deal in two years.
