examples.text: 如果你是个富人的话，你会让自己变得更好。
examples.trans: And if you are wealthy, you push yourself to become a better person.

examples.text: 这些人也太夸张了吧，变得太极端了吧！
examples.trans: These people are outrageous — talk about a complete one-eighty!

meanings.note: Verb-complement biànchéng ('change into').

examples.text: 老大本来想留她，现在变成这个样子。
examples.trans: The boss meant to keep her, yet now it has turned out like this.

examples.text: 短短一年，这档小栏目变成了王牌节目。
examples.trans: In one short year, this small segment became a flagship show.

meanings.note: Major unexpected change in life or relationships.

examples.text: 一场突如其来的变故改变了他的职业轨迹。
examples.trans: A sudden upheaval changed the trajectory of his career.

examples.text: 经历过家庭变故后，她变得更加坚强成熟。
examples.trans: After going through family upheaval, she grew stronger and wiser.

变着法子.gloss: try every clever or devious angle, find new ways

meanings.en: try every clever or devious angle, find new ways
meanings.note: Colloquial phrase for inventing ways to do something.

examples.text: 奶奶总变着法子给孩子们做可口的饭菜。
examples.trans: Grandma always invents new ways to cook tasty meals for the kids.

examples.text: 竞争对手变着法子想打听我们的新策划。
examples.trans: Rivals keep trying every angle to pry into our new pitch.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dié. Used for folding cloth or paper and for piling things up (叠衣服 'fold clothes').

examples.text: 宋老师，小心脚下。请帮我叠这块白布。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, watch your step. Please help me fold this white sheet.

examples.text: 小美把干净的毛巾叠好了。
examples.trans: Mei folded the clean towels neatly.

meanings.en: mouth; doorway; measure word for sips/breaths
meanings.note: Pinyin: kǒu. Counts mouthfuls of food/tea, breaths of air (一口气), or family members.

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

examples.text: 宋老师早上好！看昨晚大门口送来了什么。
examples.trans: Good morning, Teacher Song! Look what arrived at our front gate last night.

meanings.note: Locative phrase kǒuzhōng ('as spoken of by people').

examples.text: 原来同事口中的一手遮天是这样的。
examples.trans: So this is what the power colleagues speak of really means.

examples.text: 她就是大家口中那位最勤劳的新人。
examples.trans: She is the hardworking rookie everyone talks about.

口气.gloss: tone of voice; pent-up frustration (in 咽下这口气)

meanings.en: tone of voice; pent-up frustration (in 咽下这口气)
meanings.note: Used both for manner of speaking and stomaching an insult.

examples.text: 受了这么大的委屈，谁都没法轻易咽下这口气。
examples.trans: Wronged that badly, nobody could swallow the insult easily.

examples.text: 和合作伙伴沟通时请注意说话的口气。
examples.trans: Mind your tone of voice when speaking with partners.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kǒu dài. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个口袋 ('a pocket').

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

examples.text: 告诉他们，我箱子上面口袋里有红丝带！
examples.trans: Tell them there is a red ribbon inside the top pocket of my case!

句.gloss: measure word for sentences and remarks

meanings.en: measure word for sentences and remarks
meanings.note: Pinyin: jù. Counts spoken or written sentences (一句话 'one sentence / a word').

examples.text: 先说三句短话。第一句：你好，志鹏，谢谢你来。
examples.trans: Start with three short lines. First: Hello, Zhipeng, thank you for coming.

examples.text: 你好，志鹏，谢谢你来。好，这句记得住。
examples.trans: Hello, Zhipeng, thank you for coming. Okay, I can remember that line.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jù zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个句子 ('a sentence').

examples.text: 我一紧张，句子就变得又长又正式！
examples.trans: Whenever I get nervous, my sentences turn long and formal!

examples.text: 请用这个新词写一个简单的句子。
examples.trans: Please write a simple sentence with this new word.

meanings.note: Determiner lìng ('other, another').

examples.text: 另一个人说必须先私下向他道歉。
examples.trans: The other person insists on a private apology first.

examples.text: 我们还需要另外准备一套方案。
examples.trans: We need to prepare another backup plan.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lìng wài. Before a number + measure word, means 'the other…' (另外两把 'the other two chairs').

examples.text: 这六把椅子放院子，另外六把放屋里。
examples.trans: Put these six chairs in the courtyard and the other six indoors.

examples.text: 我买了一袋苹果，另外还买了一罐果酱。
examples.trans: I bought a bag of apples, and in addition a jar of jam.

另当别论.gloss: be another matter altogether, count as an exception

meanings.en: be another matter altogether, count as an exception
meanings.note: Idiom setting a special case apart from a general rule.

examples.text: 普通项目按流程走，王牌节目当然另当别论。
examples.trans: Routine projects follow standard rules; flagship shows are another matter.

examples.text: 如果有特殊紧急情况，那就另当别论了。
examples.trans: If there is a genuine emergency, that is another story altogether.

examples.text: 但是如果现在另有安排，是不是太自私啊？
examples.trans: If I make other arrangements for my own sake now, wouldn't that be far too selfish?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ. Read zhǐ as the adverb 'only' before verbs, and zhī as a measure word for cups, boxes, and small animals.

examples.text: 而且他今晚八点到这里——只剩四十分钟了！
examples.trans: And he arrives here at eight o'clock this evening—in forty minutes!

examples.text: 只剩三十五分钟了！他肯定会写一星差评！
examples.trans: Only thirty-five minutes left! He will surely write a one-star bad review!

meanings.note: Conjunction/adverb zhǐbúguò ('it is only that').

examples.text: 只不过吵架的事转移了大家的注意力。
examples.trans: It is just that their quarrel distracted attention.

examples.text: 我只不过是实话实说而已。
examples.trans: I am simply telling the plain truth.

examples.text: 只是我的性格，我只会为了恋爱而恋爱，只会跟自己真正喜欢的人在一起。
examples.trans: That is simply who I am: I only date for love itself, and I will only be with someone I truly love.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ shì. Softens an explanation ('I simply…').

examples.text: 不怪你们。只是我身上只有这件外套！
examples.trans: It is not your fault. Still, I only have this one coat on me!

examples.text: 我只是检查安全。这是我的工作。
examples.trans: I am simply checking security. That is my job.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhí yǒu. Combines 只 ('only') with 有 ('have / there is').

examples.text: 不在，只有我的笔和三张旧收据！
examples.trans: Not there—only my pen and three old receipts!

examples.text: 只有裙子、乐谱，还有我最喜欢的茶杯！
examples.trans: Only dresses, sheet music, and my favourite teacup!

只能.gloss: can only, have no choice but to

meanings.en: can only; have no choice but to; be forced to
meanings.note: zhǐnéng — modal combination (只 'only' + 能 'can') placed before a verb phrase to indicate that circumstances leave no alternative option.

examples.text: 他不能再上其他的节目，只能取消通告。
examples.trans: He cannot appear on any other shows, so we can only cancel the booking.

examples.text: 您第一次来，只能给您安排在那儿了。
examples.trans: Since this is your first visit, we could only seat you over there.

related.gloss: have no choice but to; cannot help but
have no alternative; cannot help it

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ yào. Pairs with 就 in the next clause: 只要…就… ('as long as…, then…').

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

examples.text: 只要一点黄油，谢谢。周经理，您怎么老看手表？
examples.trans: Just a little butter, thank you. Manager Zhou, why do you keep looking at your watch?

meanings.note: Idiom zhǐ wén qí míng ('have heard the name without meeting in person').

examples.text: 我对这位制作人一直是只闻其名。
examples.trans: I have known this producer only by reputation.

examples.text: 那家茶馆我只闻其名，今天第一次来。
examples.trans: I had only heard of this teahouse until visiting today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiào. Introduces a person's given or full name (我叫小晴 'My name is Xiaoqing') or calls a cab.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

meanings.note: Verb-object jiàohǎo ('acclaim, cheer').

examples.text: 节目播出以后，外面观众是一片叫好！
examples.trans: After the broadcast aired, audiences everywhere cheered in praise!

examples.text: 这段即兴清唱赢得全场观众齐声叫好。
examples.trans: That improvised a cappella performance won cheers across the hall.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiào xǐng. Resultative verb compound 叫 ('call') + 醒 ('awake').

examples.text: 明天早上五点半叫醒我——六点整我们在厨房集合！
examples.trans: Wake me up at five-thirty tomorrow morning—we meet in the kitchen at six sharp!

examples.text: 清晨院子里的小鸟叫声把大家都温柔地叫醒了。
examples.trans: The birdsong in the courtyard at dawn gently woke everyone up.

meanings.note: Calling back a former leader, envoy, or defective product.

examples.text: 团队成员一致希望董事会把总制作人召回公司。
examples.trans: The team unanimously hoped the board would recall the chief producer.

examples.text: 外派海外的记者顺利完成任务后被总部召回。
examples.trans: After completing the assignment abroad, the correspondent was recalled.

meanings.note: Formal verb zhàokāi ('convene a conference').

examples.text: 今天召开这个会议，想征集大家的意见。
examples.trans: We convened today's meeting to gather feedback.

examples.text: 董事会决定明天上午召开总监全会。
examples.trans: The board decided to convene all directors tomorrow.

examples.text: 台里那边你放心，我召集了一批专家给政策面上做咨询。
examples.trans: Don't worry about the network; I gathered a panel of scholars to advise leadership on media policy.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Giving thoughtful instructions before parting.

examples.text: 出国前他再三叮嘱助理照顾好大家。
examples.trans: Before going abroad, he repeatedly urged his assistant to look after everyone.

examples.text: 奶奶拉着我的手，叮嘱我在外按时吃饭。
examples.trans: Grandma held my hand and reminded me to eat on time.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kě. Adds emphatic warmth before an adjective/verb, or means 'but'.

examples.text: 我可不穿四十四码的鞋！
examples.trans: I certainly do not wear size forty-four shoes!

examples.text: 今天外面的风可真大。
examples.trans: The wind outside today is really strong.

可不可行.gloss: whether it is feasible or not

meanings.en: feasible or not; workable or not
meanings.note: A-not-A question form of 可行 ('feasible, workable').

examples.text: 我们先开会讨论一下这个方案可不可行。
examples.trans: Let's hold a meeting first to discuss whether this plan is feasible.

examples.text: 预算这么紧，你看这样做可不可行？
examples.trans: With the budget this tight, do you think doing it this way is workable?

meanings.note: Pinyin: ké yǐ. Polite modal verb for asking or granting permission (可以吗？ 'Is that alright?').

examples.text: 真的可以吗？看着又好看又暖和！
examples.trans: Is that really alright? It looks both lovely and warm!

examples.text: 阁楼书房？我可以先上去看看吗？
examples.trans: An attic study? May I go up and see it first?

meanings.note: Adjective kěpà ('frightening, terrible').

examples.text: 你以前不是说女人最可怕吗？
examples.trans: Did you not say before that women are the scariest?

examples.text: 直播出错的后果非常可怕。
examples.trans: The fallout from a live broadcast error is scary.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kě lián. Often used affectionately or playfully ('poor Chen!') as well as genuinely ('pitiful').

examples.text: 可怜的周经理急得连手里的咖啡杯都忘了。
examples.trans: Poor Manager Zhou was so flustered he forgot the coffee cup in his hand.

examples.text: 那只淋了雨的小猫看起来真可怜。
examples.trans: That little cat caught in the rain looked truly pitiful.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kě xī. Expresses sympathetic regret.

examples.text: 可惜没有电话号码，只有两个字母和老街名字。
examples.trans: Unfortunately there is no phone number, only two letters and an old street name.

examples.text: 真可惜，最后一盘柠檬蛋糕刚卖完。
examples.trans: What a pity—the last plate of lemon cake just sold out.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kě shì. Conversational 'but' introducing a contrast.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 外面一模一样，可是你看里面！
examples.trans: The outside is identical, yet look inside!

meanings.note: Adjective kě'ài ('lovable, cute').

examples.text: 那他还挺可爱的呀。
examples.trans: Then he is actually pretty endearing.

examples.text: 这只小狗真可爱。
examples.trans: This puppy is adorable.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kěsuàn.

examples.text: 你可算来了，我们等了好久。
examples.trans: You finally arrived; we have been waiting for a long time.

examples.text: 这场雨可算停了。
examples.trans: This rain has finally stopped.

meanings.note: Noun/modal kěnéng ('likely, possible').

examples.text: 我们以后很有可能会常驻星天。
examples.trans: We will very likely stay stationed at Xingtian.

examples.text: 明天可能会下雨。
examples.trans: It might rain tomorrow.

meanings.note: Degree to which an outcome might happen.

examples.text: 目前还不能完全排除延迟播出的可能性。
examples.trans: We still cannot rule out the possibility of delaying broadcast.

examples.text: 大家认真评估了各种方案成功的可能性。
examples.trans: Everyone weighed the likelihood of each plan succeeding.

meanings.note: Classifier/noun tái ('stage; classifier for equipment/TVs').

examples.text: 演播室的设备一人盯一台。
examples.trans: Watch one piece of studio equipment per person.

examples.text: 桌上有两台笔记本电脑。
examples.trans: There are two laptops on the desk.

meanings.note: Locative noun táishàng ('up on the stage').

examples.text: 台上的冠名饮料摆错了。
examples.trans: The sponsor drinks onstage were set out wrong.

examples.text: 台上的歌手唱得非常投入。
examples.trans: The singer onstage sang with deep emotion.

台下.gloss: below the stage, in the audience

meanings.en: below the stage, in the audience

examples.text: 现在就需要问一下台下的这位绅士，淳于乔先生。
examples.trans: Now we just need to ask the gentleman seated below the stage — Mr Chun Yuqiao.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Four-character phrase táiqián mùhòu ('front of house and backstage').

examples.text: 他觉得自己能操控台前幕后的一切。
examples.trans: He thinks he can control everything onstage and backstage.

examples.text: 晚会成功离不开台前幕后的工作人员。
examples.trans: A gala's success relies on everyone onstage and off.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tái dēng. Measure word (量词): 盏 (zhǎn), e.g. 一盏台灯 ('a desk lamp').

examples.text: 好：有床、桌子和椅子，可是没有床头台灯。
examples.trans: Okay: there is a bed, a table, and a chair, yet no bedside lamp.

examples.text: 楼下我的工具房里有一盏铜台灯。
examples.trans: Downstairs in my workshop there is a brass desk lamp.

meanings.note: Industry shorthand for TV-and-web simulcasting (台网联动/联合).

examples.text: 这次决赛采用了全新的台网联合直播模式。
examples.trans: This finale used a brand-new joint TV-and-online live format.

examples.text: 台网同步播出让节目的观众翻了好几倍。
examples.trans: Simulcasting across TV and web multiplied the show's audience.

meanings.note: Compound noun táijiǎo ('foot/corner of a stage').

examples.text: 他在台脚放了一颗宝石。
examples.trans: He placed a gem at the foot of the stage.

examples.text: 灯光照在舞台的台脚上。
examples.trans: The lights shone along the edge of the stage.

meanings.note: Workplace noun táilǐ ('inside the television station').

examples.text: 这次红毯仪式由台里负责。
examples.trans: The network is handling the red-carpet ceremony.

examples.text: 台里的同事今天都来了。
examples.trans: Colleagues from the station all came today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tái jiē. Measure word (量词): 级 (jí), e.g. 一级台阶 ('a step').

examples.text: 等等，低头看石头台阶上。
examples.trans: Wait—look down on the stone step.

examples.text: 我们不知道。有人放在台阶上，按了门铃。
examples.trans: We do not know. Someone set it on the step and rang the bell.

meanings.note: In 推到台面上, means bringing a proposal into formal view.

examples.text: 他把这个方案推到了台面上。
examples.trans: He put this proposal openly on the table.

examples.text: 有些问题应该摆到台面上谈。
examples.trans: Some issues should be placed on the table and discussed openly.

examples.text: 下面这首歌曾经在中国的流行乐史上留下过浓重的一笔，请欣赏！
examples.trans: This next song left a vivid mark on Chinese pop music history — please enjoy!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòu. Pairs with 往 or 边: 往右 ('to the right'), 右边 ('the right side'); opposite of 左.

examples.text: 往右用力转一下……开了！
examples.trans: One firm turn to the right... and it's open!

examples.text: 过了桥往右走。
examples.trans: After the bridge, go right.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòu shàng jiǎo. Location noun combining 右 ('right') + 上 ('upper') + 角 ('corner'); takes 在 directly without 里.

examples.text: 四张水彩卡片的右上角，都用蓝墨水标着数字。
examples.trans: In the upper-right corner of all four watercolour cards, numbers are marked in blue ink.

examples.text: 请在明信片的右上角贴好邮票再投进邮筒。
examples.trans: Please stick a stamp on the top-right corner of the postcard before dropping it in the postbox.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòu xià jiǎo. Location noun combining 右 ('right') + 下 ('lower') + 角 ('corner'); counterpart to 右上角.

examples.text: 志豪一眼就认出了卡片右下角那朵小小的八角罗盘花。
examples.trans: At a glance Hao recognised the tiny eight-point compass rose in the bottom-right corner of the card.

examples.text: 画师通常会在素描的右下角签上名字和日期。
examples.trans: Artists usually sign their name and date in the lower-right corner of a sketch.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòu shǒu. Measure word (量词): 只 (zhǐ), e.g. 一只右手 ('a right hand').

examples.text: 对，过了桥，右手边会经过一家绿药店。
examples.trans: Right, after crossing the bridge, you pass a green pharmacy on your right.

examples.text: 进大门往右手边看就是前台。
examples.trans: Step through the main gate and look to your right for the front desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòu jiǎo. Combines 右 ('right') + 脚 ('foot'); contrasts with 左脚 ('left foot'); measure word: 只 (zhī).

examples.text: 我从矮凳往下迈的时候，右脚鞋子在横档上滑了一下。
examples.trans: When I stepped down from the low stool, my right shoe slipped on the rung.

examples.text: 弹钢琴到柔和的乐段时，宋老师轻轻踩下了右脚的延音踏板。
examples.trans: Reaching the gentle passage on the piano, Teacher Song lightly pressed the sustain pedal with her right foot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòu bian. Measure word (量词): 边 (biān), e.g. 右边 ('the right side').

examples.text: 这面圆镜子挂哪儿？窗户左边还是右边？
examples.trans: Where should I hang this round mirror? Left of the window or right?

examples.text: 挂在书桌右边吧，那里光线好。
examples.trans: Hang it to the right of the desk, where the light is good.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yè zi. Measure word (量词): 片 (piàn), e.g. 一片叶子 ('a leaf'). Formed from 叶 ('leaf') + nominal suffix 子.

examples.text: 那本绿布面旧书里夹着好几片干薄荷叶子。
examples.trans: Pressed inside that old green cloth-bound book are several dry mint leaves.

examples.text: 秋风一吹，院子里梧桐树的黄叶子慢慢飘下来。
examples.trans: When the autumn breeze blows, yellow leaves from the courtyard wutong tree drift slowly down.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hào. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个号码 ('a number').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Verb/noun hàozhào ('issue an appeal').

examples.text: 会长发帖号召粉丝一起帮忙。
examples.trans: The club leader posted an appeal to rally fans.

examples.text: 大家积极响应公司的号召。
examples.trans: Everyone responded actively to the company's call.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hào mǎ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个号码 ('a number').

examples.text: 上面有名字或者电话号码吗？
examples.trans: Is there a name or a phone number on it?

examples.text: 可惜没有电话号码，只有两个字母和老街名字。
examples.trans: Unfortunately there is no phone number, only two letters and an old street name.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sī jī. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi) or 个 (gè), e.g. 一位司机 ('a driver').

examples.text: 送货司机把木箱轻轻放在大门口。
examples.trans: The delivery driver set the wooden crate gently at the front gate.

examples.text: 出租车司机很熟悉这条老街。
examples.trans: The taxi driver knows this old street very well.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chī. Everyday verb for eating meals, bread, or snacks.

examples.text: 太好了！现在我想吃一顿丰盛的早餐。
examples.trans: Wonderful! Now I would like to eat a big breakfast.

examples.text: 先喝杯热茶，吃个肉桂卷坐十分钟吧！
examples.trans: Have a cup of hot tea and a cinnamon roll for ten minutes first!

吃相.gloss: table manners; way one chases profit

meanings.en: table manners; way one chases profit
meanings.note: Metaphorical noun chīxiàng ('deportment in pursuing gain').

examples.text: 跟风确实赚了一些钱，但是吃相太难看。
examples.trans: Copycatting made money, yet the greed looks ugly.

examples.text: 做商业植入也要顾及观众感受，吃相不能难看。
examples.trans: Product placement must respect viewers instead of looking greedy.

meanings.note: Verb-object chīyào ('take medication').

examples.text: 病人需要按时吃药。
examples.trans: Patients need to take medicine on time.

examples.text: 我不知道他以前怎么吃药。
examples.trans: I do not know how he took medicine before.

吃饭.gloss: to eat a meal, to have a meal

meanings.en: to eat a meal; to dine; to have food
meanings.note: chīfàn — separable verb (VO compound: 吃 'eat' + 饭 'cooked rice/meal', e.g., 吃过饭了 'already ate'); also used figuratively to mean 'make a living'.

examples.text: 没事，那我带您去吃饭。
examples.trans: No worries — then let me take you out to eat.

examples.text: 现场的兄弟们中午去吃饭，结果食物中毒，全部都进了医院。
examples.trans: The crew members on set went to eat at noon, got food poisoning, and all ended up in the hospital.

related.gloss: to treat someone to a meal

吃香.gloss: in high demand, very popular, well-favored

meanings.en: in high demand, very popular, well-favored
meanings.note: Colloquial adjective for sought-after skills or people.

examples.text: 既懂内容又懂数据的复合型人才在业内很吃香。
examples.trans: Producers who know both content and data are in high demand.

examples.text: 这几年优质原创编剧在市场上越来越吃香。
examples.trans: Top original screenwriters have grown ever more sought-after.

meanings.note: Determiner gè ('each respective').

examples.text: 现在各台和各网站的竞争非常激烈。
examples.trans: Competition across every network and site is fierce.

examples.text: 以后各部门还要齐心协力一起做节目。
examples.trans: All departments will work together on shows from now on.

meanings.note: Determiner gègè ('every single, various').

examples.text: 要先认清公司里的各个部门。
examples.trans: You must learn every department in the firm first.

examples.text: 全国各地的观众都在看。
examples.trans: Viewers in every region are watching.

meanings.note: polite pronoun for 'everyone here'

examples.text: 观众朋友们，欢迎各位！
examples.trans: Friends in the audience, welcome everyone!

examples.text: 观众朋友们，欢迎各位！
examples.trans: Friends in the audience, welcome everyone!

meanings.note: Determiner gèjiā ('each agency or company').

examples.text: 现场聚集了国内的各家媒体。
examples.trans: Domestic media outlets of every stripe gathered on site.

examples.text: 各家电视台都在报道盛典。
examples.trans: Every TV network is covering the gala.

各就各位.gloss: take your positions, everyone to your marks

meanings.en: take your positions, everyone to your marks
meanings.note: Set command gèjiù-gèwèi ('everybody to your stations').

examples.text: 现场各就各位，马上准备开录！
examples.trans: Everyone take your positions on set—rolling shortly!

examples.text: 导演喊了一声各就各位，灯光立刻亮起。
examples.trans: At the director's call for places, the stage lights flared.

meanings.note: Noun gèfāng ('all sides involved').

examples.text: 这么一改，各方老板心里可就翻江倒海了。
examples.trans: A change like this has every stakeholder's stomach churning.

examples.text: 协调各方档期是制片组最头疼的工作。
examples.trans: Coordinating every party's schedule is production's toughest job.

各有千秋.gloss: each has its own merits and strengths

meanings.en: each has its own merits and strengths
meanings.note: Idiom comparing two styles or people favorably.

examples.text: 两位制作人的风格不同，可以说是各有千秋。
examples.trans: The two producers differ in style, each with distinct strengths.

examples.text: 传统电视和网络综艺在表现形式上各有千秋。
examples.trans: Broadcast TV and streaming variety shows each have their own merits.

各种各样.gloss: all kinds of, every sort of

meanings.en: all kinds of, every sort of
meanings.note: Describes rich variety or many facets.

examples.text: 做现场节目会遇到各种各样的突发状况。
examples.trans: Live production runs into all kinds of unexpected situations.

examples.text: 经历过许多事，她看到了各种各样的他。
examples.trans: Through many events, she saw every side of who he is.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé. Used for closing a book/lid (合上) or matching parts together.

examples.text: 正合我心意。楼梯在哪儿？
examples.trans: Just what I wanted. Where are the stairs?

examples.text: 快合上送上去——等等，那是什么金属响声？
examples.trans: Close it quickly and take it up—wait, what was that metallic clanking sound?

合不拢嘴.gloss: grinning from ear to ear; unable to close one's mouth

meanings.en: grinning from ear to ear; unable to close one's mouth
meanings.note: Pinyin: hé bu lǒng zuǐ. Idiomatic potential complement phrase 合不拢 ('unable to bring together/close') + 嘴 ('mouth'), almost always after 笑得 ('smiling so wide that...').

examples.text: 周经理站在院子中间，看着新挂好的绿窗板笑得合不拢嘴！
examples.trans: Standing in the middle of the courtyard, Manager Zhou grinned from ear to ear at the newly hung green shutters!

examples.text: 听到办事员夸奖柠檬挞好吃，小美高兴得合不拢嘴。
examples.trans: Hearing the clerk praise the lemon tart, Mei beamed from ear to ear.

examples.text: 是啊，辛惠美和黄金一班合体，经纪公司知道的全都扑上来了。
examples.trans: Right — once word got out that Xin Huimei and the Golden Class were reuniting, every agency came rushing over.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 现在我们已经确定要跟尹家希先生合作了。
examples.trans: We have now confirmed that we want to work with Mister Yin Jiaxi.

examples.text: 我们家希不可能跟星天合作了。
examples.trans: There is no way our Jiaxi can work with Xingtian anymore.

examples.text: 希望作为最大的战略合作伙伴，能够帮我们把原创的节目打进西方主流市场。
examples.trans: When that day comes, we hope our strategic partner will help bring our original shows into mainstream global markets.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Business or production partner.

examples.text: 我们要先征求所有合作方的同意。
examples.trans: We need to seek consent from all our partners first.

examples.text: 这家公司是我们长期的合作方。
examples.trans: This company is our long-term partner.

meanings.note: Adjective hékǒu ('to one's liking in flavour').

examples.text: 你觉得他们家做的菜还合口吧？
examples.trans: Do the dishes at this restaurant suit your taste?

examples.text: 食堂新请的大师傅做的家常菜很合口。
examples.trans: Home-style dishes by the canteen's new chef suit everyone.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé tong. Measure word (量词): 份 (fèn), e.g. 一份合同 ('a contract').

examples.text: 房产信？让志豪和我看看——我管市政合同，他懂老建筑保护法！
examples.trans: A property letter? Let Zhihao and me see it—I handle municipal contracts, and he knows heritage building law!

examples.text: 等等，志鹏——你还在市政厅合同科工作？！
examples.trans: Wait, Zhipeng—you still work at City Hall's contract office?!

合奏.gloss: play music together; perform in ensemble

meanings.en: play music together; perform in ensemble
meanings.note: Pinyin: hé zòu. Combines 合 ('join together') + 奏 ('play music'); also used as a noun for an instrumental ensemble.

examples.text: 他就是当年每个星期五跟您姑姑合奏的音乐老师！
examples.trans: He is the very music teacher who used to play Friday duets with your aunt back then!

examples.text: 小提琴和核桃木钢琴在阳光房里合奏出温暖的旋律。
examples.trans: The violin and the walnut piano played a warm melody together in the sunroom.

meanings.note: Joining two companies, departments, or files into one.

examples.text: 两家经纪公司合并后艺人阵容更加庞大。
examples.trans: After the two agencies merged, their artist roster grew huge.

examples.text: 请把这两个同类项目的预算表合并成一份。
examples.trans: Please merge the budget sheets of these two projects into one.

合影.gloss: take a group photo, pose for a photo together

meanings.en: take a group photo, pose for a photo together
meanings.note: Used both as verb ('pose together') and noun ('photo together').

examples.text: 答辩结束后，同学们纷纷上前找他合影。
examples.trans: After the defence, students crowded up to take photos with him.

examples.text: 这张珍贵的合影一直摆在她的书桌上。
examples.trans: This cherished photo together sits on her desk.

meanings.note: Verb héchéng ('composite or doctor images').

examples.text: 网上那些照片其实是合成的。
examples.trans: Those photos circulating online were digitally composited.

examples.text: 后期团队正在合成片头的视觉特效。
examples.trans: Post-production is compositing the opening visual effects.

meanings.note: Adjective hégé ('meeting professional standards').

examples.text: 布小谷的方案没有问题，是合格的。
examples.trans: Bu Xiaogu's plan has no flaws and meets standards.

examples.text: 她已经成长为一名合格的制片。
examples.trans: She has grown into a qualified producer.

examples.text: 很合理。
examples.trans: Very reasonable.

examples.text: 不合理。
examples.trans: Not reasonable.

meanings.note: Noun héyuē ('written contract, agreement').

examples.text: 你跟公司是有合约的。
examples.trans: You have a contract with the company.

examples.text: 明年她的合约就到期了。
examples.trans: Her contract expires next year.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé shì. Describes clothes fitting well or an arrangement suiting everyone.

examples.text: 宋老师，您穿着很合适。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, it fits you very well.

examples.text: 弄好了！蓝地毯放在床旁边正合适。
examples.trans: Done! And the blue rug right beside the bed fits just right.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé yè. Measure word (量词): 副 (fù), e.g. 一副合页 ('a set of hinges').

examples.text: 看合页边露出来的折纸图纸——一楼画着一扇暗门！
examples.trans: Look at the folded blueprint sticking out of the hinge—a hidden door is drawn on the ground floor!

examples.text: 给老木门的合页上点油就不响了。
examples.trans: Put a drop of oil on the wooden door's hinges and they stop squeaking.

related.gloss: a set of hinges (measure word 副)

examples.text: 吉总您好，王尔老师让我来跟您接洽。
examples.trans: Hello President Ji; Teacher Wang Er sent me to coordinate with you.

examples.text: 吉总，我们时间特别紧。
examples.trans: President Ji, we are really pressed for time.

meanings.en: Ji Xiu (personal name of a company president in Behind the Scenes)
meanings.note: Jí Xiù — proper noun; character in the television drama Behind the Scenes (幕后之王).

examples.text: 我是总裁，叫我吉秀就好。
examples.trans: I am the president — just call me Ji Xiu.

examples.text: 我终于明白为什么你们不去见吉秀了。
examples.trans: I finally understand why none of you went to see Ji Xiu.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tóng. Combines with 一 + measure word to mean 'the very same' (同一个 'the same one').

examples.text: 真奇怪！我们坐同一班早火车到同一个区。
examples.trans: How strange! We rode the very same morning train to the same district.

examples.text: 二十五年前？就在同一栋房子里？
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago? Right inside that very same house?

examples.text: 真巧，我们今天早上坐的是同一班火车！
examples.trans: What a coincidence—we rode the very same train this morning!

examples.text: 这两把铜钥匙虽然款式相似，却不是开同一扇门的。
examples.trans: Although these two brass keys look similar in style, they do not open the same door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tóng shì. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位同事 ('a colleague').

examples.text: 下周我保证把半个市政厅的同事都带来小美这儿喝咖啡。
examples.trans: Next week I promise to bring half my City Hall colleagues to Mei's tables.

examples.text: 我的两位新同事都特别热心。
examples.trans: Both of my new colleagues are wonderfully warm-hearted.

examples.text: 现场的各位媒体同仁，以及收看直播的所有观众朋友们，大家好。
examples.trans: To our media colleagues in the hall and all viewers watching the live broadcast, hello everyone.

examples.text: 各位媒体同仁，接下来可以自由提问了。
examples.trans: Members of the press, the floor is now open for your questions.

meanings.note: Verb-object tóngtái ('appear onstage together').

examples.text: 建议不要让那两位评论员同台出现。
examples.trans: He advises against putting those two hosts onstage together.

examples.text: 两位老朋友今晚再次同台演唱。
examples.trans: The two old friends sing onstage together again tonight.

examples.text: 辛惠美在第一支竞演曲目里，启用了神秘的外卡队员与她同场演出。
examples.trans: For her very first competition song, Xin Huimei has brought in a mysterious wild-card singer to perform alongside her.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tóngxué. Literally 'studying together'; applies to peers in the same class or school.

meanings.en: student (used as a polite form of address)
meanings.note: Commonly used by teachers, campus staff, or older adults when addressing young people or students directly (e.g., 小同学).

examples.text: 你好，小同学。
examples.trans: Hello, young student.

examples.text: 同学们都到齐了，今天真是多亏大家帮忙！
examples.trans: All my classmates are here; thank you everyone so much for helping today!

examples.text: 小谷跟小许，他们俩同岁。
examples.trans: Xiaogu and that young fellow are the exact same age.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tóng yì. Combines 同 ('same') + 意 ('thought/intent').

examples.text: 周经理立刻同意让宋老师补写那首圆舞曲。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou immediately agreed to let Teacher Song complete that waltz.

examples.text: 大家都同意星期三用扁豆汤做午餐。
examples.trans: Everyone agreed on serving lentil soup for Wednesday's lunch.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tóng shí. Combines 同 ('same') + 时 ('time').

examples.text: 两个人同时伸手去拿最后一块杏仁饼干。
examples.trans: The two of them reached for the last almond biscuit at the same time.

examples.text: 那场大雨弄坏了屋顶，同时还淋湿了钢琴。
examples.trans: That heavy rain damaged the roof and wet the piano at the same time.

meanings.note: Adjective tóngyàng ('identical, the very same').

examples.text: 观众不管转到哪个台，看到的都是同样的东西。
examples.trans: Whichever channel viewers pick, they see the same thing.

examples.text: 同样的失误绝对不能再犯第二次。
examples.trans: The exact same mistake must never happen twice.

meanings.note: Adverb/verb tóngbù ('synchronously; sync').

examples.text: 你在电脑上的文件我都同步看。
examples.trans: Every file on your computer syncs straight to me.

examples.text: 节目今晚在卫视和网络平台同步播出。
examples.trans: Tonight the show airs simultaneously on TV and online.

meanings.note: Media/economics noun tóngzhìhuà ('uniform sameness across products').

examples.text: 让我们聊一聊电视节目同质化的现象。
examples.trans: Let us discuss the phenomenon of copycat TV shows.

examples.text: 打破同质化需要真正的原创精神。
examples.trans: Breaking out of sameness takes real originality.

meanings.note: noun

examples.text: 我是传媒学院的研究生，年级第一名。
examples.trans: I am a graduate student at the Media College, first in my year.

examples.text: 我是传媒学院的研究生，年级第一名。
examples.trans: I am a graduate student at the Media College, first in my year.

examples.text: 这栋百年老宅如今登记在他们兄弟俩名下。
examples.trans: This century-old house is now registered under the names of the two brothers.

examples.text: 祖父退休前把这家小客栈转到了孙女名下。
examples.trans: Before retiring, Grandfather transferred this little guesthouse into his granddaughter's name.

meanings.note: Idiom míngbù-xūchuán ('well-deserved fame').

examples.text: 星天总编室的精英团队果然名不虚传。
examples.trans: Xingtian's elite editorial team truly lives up to its name.

examples.text: 尝了一口才发现这家老店确实名不虚传。
examples.trans: One bite proved this famous old shop lives up to its name.

examples.text: 这是名义啊。
examples.trans: This is name.

examples.text: 那个名义好。
examples.trans: That name is good.

meanings.note: Pinyin: míng dān. Measure word (量词): 份 (fèn), e.g. 一份名单 ('a guest list').

examples.text: 停电的时候，纸还能用。
examples.trans: Paper still works when the power goes out.

examples.text: 今天的住店客人名单在电脑里。
examples.trans: Today's guest list is on the computer.

meanings.note: Media noun míngzuǐ ('famous sharp-tongued talk host').

examples.text: 红毯请了两位名嘴碰头。
examples.trans: Two famous commentators were booked for the red carpet.

examples.text: 他是电视圈里出了名的名嘴。
examples.trans: He is a famously eloquent host in television.

meanings.note: Noun míngshēng ('public reputation, name').

examples.text: 他的坏名声已经传出去了。
examples.trans: His bad reputation has already gotten around.

examples.text: 这家制作公司在业内名声很好。
examples.trans: This production firm enjoys a great reputation.

meanings.note: Colloquial word for an impressive official title.

examples.text: 他不在乎虚名头，只关心节目能不能做好。
examples.trans: He cares nothing for grand titles, only whether the show is good.

examples.text: 名片上印着一长串头衔，名头听起来挺响亮。
examples.trans: A long string of titles on the card sounded mighty grand.

meanings.note: Pinyin: míng zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个名字 ('a name').

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

examples.text: 上面有名字或者电话号码吗？
examples.trans: Is there a name or a phone number on it?

meanings.note: Printed card bearing one's name, company, and title.

examples.text: 初次见面时，双方礼貌地交换了各自的名片。
examples.trans: Meeting for the first time, both sides politely exchanged business cards.

examples.text: 一部好作品就是制作人最亮眼的行业名片。
examples.trans: A great show is the brightest calling card a producer can have.

examples.text: 名誉受损。
examples.trans: Reputation damaged.

examples.text: 维护名誉。
examples.trans: Protect reputation.

meanings.en: quota; allotted number of people; available spot or slot
meanings.note: Pinyin: míng'é. Takes the classifier 个 (gè); frequently paired with verbs like 留 (save), 抢 (compete for), or 放弃 (give up) in hiring, admissions, and competitions.

examples.text: 我跟他不一样，我要了一个实习生的名额。
examples.trans: I am different from him; I asked for one intern spot.

examples.text: 每个导师确实有个外卡名额，但是你之前已经放弃了。
examples.trans: Every mentor does get one wild-card spot, except you already waived yours earlier.

meanings.note: Locative noun hòu ('afterwards; behind').

examples.text: 您看完修改后的方案觉得如何？
examples.trans: What do you think after reading the revised plan?

examples.text: 许久后我才明白他的良苦用心。
examples.trans: Only much later did I understand his good intentions.

后半段.gloss: second half (of a song, road, or event)

meanings.en: second half (of a song, road, or event)
meanings.note: Pinyin: hòu bàn duàn. Combines 后 ('back/latter') + 半 ('half') + 段 ('section/stretch').

examples.text: 这首曲子的后半段比开头更温柔。
examples.trans: The second half of this piece is gentler than the opening.

examples.text: 电影的后半段让大家都看入迷了。
examples.trans: The second half of the film captivated everyone.

examples.text: 去后台。
examples.trans: Go backstage.

examples.text: 在后台。
examples.trans: Backstage.

meanings.note: Used as a modifier before nouns like 后备方案 ('backup plan') or 后备人选 ('standby candidate').

examples.text: 做大型节目一定要准备好后备方案。
examples.trans: When producing a major show, you must prepare a backup plan.

examples.text: 导演组已经挑好了两位后备歌手。
examples.trans: The directing team has already selected two reserve singers.

meanings.note: Standby unit ready to step in during emergencies.

examples.text: 制作二部今天作为后备团队进驻演播厅。
examples.trans: Unit Two moved into the studio today as the backup team.

examples.text: 大型直播必须配备经验丰富的后备团队。
examples.trans: Major live broadcasts must have a seasoned backup crew.

meanings.note: Meaning: backup plan.

examples.text: 后备方案也行不通了！
examples.trans: The backup plan fell through too!

examples.text: 这是后备方案。
examples.trans: This is 后备方案.

meanings.note: Colloquial locative hòutou ('later ahead; at the back').

examples.text: 怕是更丢人的事还在后头呢。
examples.trans: Worse embarrassment probably still lies ahead.

examples.text: 真正精彩的压轴表演还在后头。
examples.trans: The most exciting finale act is still to come.

meanings.en: to regret; to repent; to feel remorseful about past actions
meanings.note: Pinyin: hòuhuǐ. Functions primarily as a stative/psychological verb (can be modified by 很 or 有点, and can take a verb phrase or clause as its object), and occasionally as a noun meaning 'regret'.

examples.text: 尝一下，尝了准不后悔！
examples.trans: Have a taste — once you try it, you definitely will not regret it!

examples.text: 莫不是因为小谷的事，有点后悔了是不是？
examples.trans: Could it be that you're feeling a bit regretful over what happened with Xiaogu?

examples.text: 淳于总这个人高深莫测，后招很多的，我劝您也别太放松了。
examples.trans: Mr Chun Yu is unfathomable and always keeps backup moves up his sleeve, so I advise you not to relax too soon either.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Showbiz noun hòuyuánhuì ('organized fan club').

examples.text: 他是辛惠美粉丝后援会的会长。
examples.trans: He is president of Xin Huimei's fan club.

examples.text: 和后援会搞好关系对节目很重要。
examples.trans: Good ties with fan clubs matter greatly to shows.

meanings.note: Facility housing editing, colour, and sound suites.

examples.text: 所有剪好的节目成片都保存在后期中心。
examples.trans: All finished master cuts are stored in the post-production centre.

examples.text: 进出后期中心需要专门的门禁权限。
examples.trans: Entering the post-production centre requires special badge access.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hòu lái. Time noun referring exclusively to what happened later in the PAST (unlike 以后, which works for past or future).

examples.text: 起初天还晴着，后来半夜就下起了大雨。
examples.trans: At first the sky was clear, and then later at midnight heavy rain began.

examples.text: 后来客栈住满了客人，那间屋子就一直锁着。
examples.trans: Later the inn filled with guests, and that room stayed locked.

meanings.note: Informal spoken word for stepfather.

examples.text: 小姑娘从小跟着妈妈和后爹在国外生活。
examples.trans: The little girl has lived abroad with her mum and stepfather.

examples.text: 虽然是后爹，但他对孩子一直非常好。
examples.trans: Though he is her stepfather, he treats the child wonderfully.

meanings.note: Colloquial location noun equivalent to 后面.

examples.text: 她悄悄坐在总制作人那张大办公桌后边。
examples.trans: She sat quietly behind the chief producer's big desk.

examples.text: 演播厅后边有一间安静的嘉宾休息室。
examples.trans: Behind the studio sits a quiet lounge for guests.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hòu mén. Combines 后 ('back/rear') + 门 ('door').

examples.text: 后门旁边挂着一盏防风的旧灯笼。
examples.trans: An old windproof lantern hangs beside the back door.

examples.text: 从厨房的后门出去就是小院子。
examples.trans: Stepping out through the kitchen's back door leads right into the small courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hòu mian. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 最后面 ('the very back').

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

examples.text: 志豪先生！您一直站在后面吗？！
examples.trans: Mr Zhihao! Were you standing right there behind us?!

meanings.note: Colloquial verb tǔcáo ('roast, vent complaints').

examples.text: 这家店就是同事们的吐槽胜地。
examples.trans: This lounge is colleagues' favourite spot to vent.

examples.text: 大家下班后常聚在一起吐槽。
examples.trans: After work everyone often gathers to blow off steam.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàng. Preposition or verb complement indicating direction of movement or orientation (歪向一边 'lean toward one side').

examples.text: 向日葵总是朝着太阳的方向生长。
examples.trans: Sunflowers always grow toward the sun.

examples.text: 小晴笑着向窗外的朋友们挥了挥手。
examples.trans: Qing smiled and waved toward her friends outside the window.

meanings.note: Adverb xiàngqián ('forward').

examples.text: 过去的事情不纠结，步步向前看。
examples.trans: Do not dwell on the past; look forward step by step.

examples.text: 请大家排好队依次向前走。
examples.trans: Please line up and move forward in order.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàng lái. Emphasizes how something has always been up to now.

examples.text: 这家客栈向来只有八间客房！九号房到底在哪儿？！
examples.trans: This inn has only ever had eight guest rooms! Where on earth is Room Nine?!

examples.text: 他做事向来又仔细又稳重。
examples.trans: He has always been careful and steady in his work.

向死而生.gloss: fight back to life from the brink of defeat

meanings.en: fight back to life from the brink of defeat
meanings.note: Philosophical/idiomatic phrase for thriving under desperate odds.

examples.text: 面对绝境绝不放弃，这才是真正的向死而生。
examples.trans: Refusing to yield in a corner is what fighting back from the brink means.

examples.text: 这次危机公关让整个团队完成了一次向死而生。
examples.trans: This crisis campaign let the whole team snatch victory from the jaws of defeat.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàng yáng. Literally 'facing the sun'—prized for warm rooms in China.

examples.text: 那间向阳的旧阁楼书房……快跟我来！
examples.trans: That sunny old attic study... follow me, quickly!

examples.text: 快坐在向阳窗户边，宋老师！先别急着上楼！
examples.trans: Sit right down by the sunny window, Teacher Song! No rush to go back upstairs yet!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià. Used when a sudden noise or surprise startles someone.

examples.text: 谢谢你，小美。刚才吓了一跳，手都凉了！
examples.trans: Thank you, Mei. That gave me such a start just now that my hands went cold!

examples.text: 刚才的响声吓了我一跳。
examples.trans: That noise just now gave me a start.

meanings.note: literally 'scare people'

examples.text: 职场是一个火锅，想想真的够吓人的。
examples.trans: The workplace is a hotpot; just thinking about it is scary enough.

examples.text: 职场是一个火锅，想想真的够吓人的。
examples.trans: The workplace is a hotpot; just thinking about it is scary enough.

meanings.note: Colloquial verb xiàhu ('bluff or rattle someone').

examples.text: 我以为吓唬一下小姑娘是个突破口。
examples.trans: I figured rattling a young assistant would open a door.

examples.text: 别拿这种没有根据的话来吓唬人。
examples.trans: Stop trying to scare people with baseless talk.

meanings.note: Verb-complement xiàpà ('frighten into caution').

examples.text: 众筹成立基金会的事已经把业内吓怕了。
examples.trans: Crowdfunding a foundation has rattled the whole industry.

examples.text: 上次的直播事故把大家都吓怕了。
examples.trans: Last time's broadcast mishap rattled everyone.

吓我一跳.gloss: startled me!, gave me a fright

meanings.en: startled me!, gave me a fright
meanings.note: Common spoken reaction to sudden news or noise.

examples.text: 你突然这么严肃地叫我，真是吓我一跳！
examples.trans: Calling me over so seriously out of the blue really startled me!

examples.text: 门猛地被推开，把屋里的人吓了一跳，真是吓我一跳。
examples.trans: The door flew open and gave me quite a start.

meanings.note: Colloquial verb-complement xiàsǐ ('terrify').

examples.text: 刚才现场突发过敏，真是吓死我了。
examples.trans: That sudden allergy onstage scared me half to death.

examples.text: 道具差点倒下来，把前排工作人员吓死了。
examples.trans: The prop nearly tipped over, giving the crew a huge fright.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ma. Placed at the end of any statement to turn it into a neutral yes/no question.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Formal conjunction fǒuzé ('otherwise').

examples.text: 比赛规则必须得改，否则拉不开距离。
examples.trans: The rules must change, otherwise we cannot pull ahead.

examples.text: 请提前备份文件，否则容易丢失资料。
examples.trans: Back up files early, otherwise data may be lost.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ba. At the end of a sentence, softens commands into friendly suggestions ('let's…') or asks for confirmation.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

meanings.note: Polite noun/verb fēnfù ('instructions from a superior').

examples.text: 秦助理，叫我过来有什么吩咐啊？
examples.trans: Assistant Qin, what instructions do you have for me?

examples.text: 照林姐刚才的吩咐去做吧。
examples.trans: Do as Lin Jie instructed just now.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tīng. Focuses on the act of listening; add 见 or 到 (听见, 听到) for actually hearing.

examples.text: 老陈，你听到了吗？有人按了大门门铃！
examples.trans: Chen, did you hear that? Someone rang the front gate bell!

examples.text: 我在院子里老远就听到你们喊黄油了。
examples.trans: All the way out in the courtyard I heard you shouting about butter.

examples.text: 很多歌迷听到这个消息无比振奋，观众对十二歌王的期待值正在飙升。
examples.trans: Countless music fans are thrilled by the news, and audience anticipation for Twelve Singers is skyrocketing.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.en: have a listen; listen a bit
meanings.note: Pinyin: tīng ting. Reduplicated verb making an invitation to listen warm and unhurried.

examples.text: 听听他说的！老陈比我们好奇两倍！
examples.trans: Listen to him! Chen is twice as curious as we are!

examples.text: 听听保养大师说的！昨天修热水器，今天修两兄弟！
examples.trans: Listen to the maintenance master! Yesterday fixing the boiler, today fixing two brothers!

听天由命.gloss: leave things to fate, resign oneself to luck

meanings.en: leave things to fate, resign oneself to luck
meanings.note: Idiom tīngtiān-yóumìng ('accept whatever fate brings').

examples.text: 方案会那天咱们就听天由命吧。
examples.trans: On pitch day we will just have to leave things to fate.

examples.text: 准备得越充分，上台就越不用听天由命。
examples.trans: The better prepared we are, the less we leave to luck.

meanings.note: Verb-complement tīngdǒng ('follow what is said').

examples.text: 您说的这些太复杂，我真的都没听懂。
examples.trans: What you said is so complex I truly did not follow.

examples.text: 这段专业术语观众能听懂吗？
examples.trans: Will home viewers understand this technical jargon?

meanings.note: Pinyin: tīng jiàn. Result compound: 听 ('listen') + 见 ('perceive') = 'actually hear'.

examples.text: 没错。外面大街很吵，进了院子却只听见树叶和小鸟。
examples.trans: Exactly. Outside on the main road it is noisy, yet inside the courtyard you only hear leaves and birds.

examples.text: 关上木窗就听不见外面的车声了。
examples.trans: Close the wooden window and you cannot hear the street traffic.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tīng shuō. Everyday opener for news heard from someone else.

examples.text: 等周经理听说他为分贝慌了一整夜，表情一定精彩！
examples.trans: Wait until Manager Zhou hears he panicked all night over decibels!

examples.text: 听说街角新开了一家面包店。
examples.trans: I heard a new bakery opened on the street corner.

examples.text: 在冷雨里走了一路，喝碗热汤听起来太棒了。
examples.trans: After walking all the way in the cold rain, having a bowl of hot soup sounds wonderful.

examples.text: 你的这个主意听起来既省钱又实用。
examples.trans: Your idea sounds both economical and practical.

meanings.note: Verb qǐdòng ('start up, activate').

examples.text: 今天下午正式启动三班制。
examples.trans: We officially start three shifts this afternoon.

examples.text: 新项目下周启动。
examples.trans: The new project launches next week.

examples.text: 十二歌王第三季将于下个月重新启幕，我们将融入全新的节目改版。
examples.trans: Season Three of Twelve Singers premieres next month, featuring a brand-new revamped competition format.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 辛惠美在第一支竞演曲目里，启用了神秘的外卡队员与她同场演出。
examples.trans: For her very first competition song, Xin Huimei has brought in a mysterious wild-card singer to perform alongside her.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chǎo. Describes noisy streets or rooms, or arguing aloud.

examples.text: 说真的，我怕一楼吵。我太喜欢这间房了！
examples.trans: Truthfully, I dislike noisy ground-floor rooms. I love this room!

examples.text: 没错。外面大街很吵，进了院子却只听见树叶和小鸟。
examples.trans: Exactly. Outside on the main road it is noisy, yet inside the courtyard you only hear leaves and birds.

meanings.note: Verb-object chǎojià ('have a noisy argument').

examples.text: 两个嘉宾在红毯上吵架了。
examples.trans: The two guests got into a quarrel on the red carpet.

examples.text: 同事之间有分歧也别吵架。
examples.trans: Even when colleagues disagree, do not quarrel.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cháo xǐng. Result compound: 吵 ('noisy') + 醒 ('awake'); the person woken follows (吵醒客人 'wake the guests').

examples.text: 那么小美的咖啡馆和宋老师的钢琴，不会吵醒楼上的客人吧？
examples.trans: So Mei's café and Teacher Song's piano won't wake the guests upstairs?

examples.text: 对不起，我把你吵醒了吗？
examples.trans: Sorry, did I wake you up?

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a verb used in conversational Mandarin.

examples.text: 我有一个吸。
examples.trans: I have a 吸.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的吸。
examples.trans: This is a very good 吸.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chuī. Used for wind blowing or blowing on hot tea.

examples.text: 热汤？在冷雨中走过来之后，这听起来太棒了。
examples.trans: Hot soup? After that cold walk in the rain, that sounds wonderful.

examples.text: 晚上院子里吹着凉风。
examples.trans: A cool breeze blows through the courtyard in the evening.

examples.text: 我们俩就不要相互吹捧了。
examples.trans: The two of us don't need to flatter each other.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ya. Gentle exclamation of surprise or realization.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 呀，这就是星期一火车上那只双胞胎箱子吗？
examples.trans: Oh, is this that twin suitcase from Monday's train?

meanings.note: Formal verb chéngxiàn ('present on screen or stage').

examples.text: 一年一度的盛典将在今晚完全呈现。
examples.trans: The annual gala will be presented in full tonight.

examples.text: 舞台灯光呈现出很美的效果。
examples.trans: Stage lighting presented a beautiful effect.

meanings.note: Verb gào ('sue in court; inform').

examples.text: 他们说一定要告我们公司。
examples.trans: They say they intend to sue our company.

examples.text: 有事请及时告诉我。
examples.trans: Please tell me promptly if anything comes up.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gào su. Takes a person directly followed by the information (告诉我 'tell me').

examples.text: 太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
examples.trans: Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

examples.text: 告诉他们，我箱子上面口袋里有红丝带！
examples.trans: Tell them there is a red ribbon inside the top pocket of my case!

告辞.gloss: to take leave; to say goodbye

meanings.en: to take one's leave; to bid farewell (said by the person departing)
meanings.note: Pinyin: gàocí. Polite, somewhat formal intransitive verb used when excusing oneself from a host, meeting, or elder; often framed as 我先告辞了.

examples.text: 打扰了，那我先告辞了。
examples.trans: Sorry for the intrusion — I will take my leave first.

examples.text: 时间不早了，我们就不多留，先向您告辞了。
examples.trans: It's getting late, so we won't stay any longer and will say goodbye to you now.

related.gloss: to bid farewell; to part from
to excuse oneself; to leave early

呗.gloss: modal particle for obviousness or resignation

meanings.en: sentence-final particle indicating that something is obvious, simple, or goes without saying
meanings.note: Pinyin: bei (neutral tone). Colloquial northern Mandarin particle roughly equivalent to 'obviously', 'naturally', or 'that's all there is to it'.

meanings.en: sentence-final particle expressing reluctant acceptance or casual resignation
meanings.note: Used when agreeing to something for lack of a better option (e.g., 去就去呗, 'Fine, I'll go then').

examples.text: 待了半天我就回来了呗。
examples.trans: I stayed half a day and came back, that was all.

examples.text: 我就是一小助理呗，哪有那么大能量啊。
examples.trans: I'm obviously just a junior assistant — how could I wield that kind of clout?

related.gloss: modal particle for suggestion or softening
modal particle for emphasis or tone

meanings.note: Workplace noun yuángōng.

examples.text: 别把员工当棋子。
examples.trans: Do not treat employees like pawns.

examples.text: 公司有很多新员工。
examples.trans: The company has many new staff.

meanings.note: Workplace noun yuángōng shǒucè ('staff manual').

examples.text: 员工手册已经全部发完了。
examples.trans: All the employee handbooks have already been handed out.

examples.text: 新入职的同事请先阅读员工手册。
examples.trans: New hires should read the employee handbook first.

meanings.note: Workplace noun yuángōng shítáng ('company cafeteria').

examples.text: 以后中午你就在员工食堂吃饭吧。
examples.trans: Eat lunch in the staff canteen from now on.

examples.text: 中午十二点员工食堂的菜品种类最丰富。
examples.trans: At noon the staff canteen offers its widest selection.

meanings.note: Workplace noun yuángōngcān ('company meal for employees').

examples.text: 公司给一部准备了高级的员工餐。
examples.trans: The firm prepared a deluxe staff meal for Unit One.

examples.text: 今天中午的员工餐特别丰盛。
examples.trans: Today's staff lunch is generous.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ne. After a noun, asks 'what about X?' (你呢？); at the end of a statement, highlights an ongoing situation.

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhōu. Surname of Manager Zhou (周经理); as a noun/classifier, means 'week'.

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

examples.text: 放心吧，周经理。房间干净，毛巾也是新的。
examples.trans: Relax, Manager Zhou. The room is clean, and the towels are fresh.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhōunián. Measure word: 个.

examples.text: 今天是他们结婚十周年纪念日。
examples.trans: Today is their tenth wedding anniversary.

examples.text: 公司举行了成立周年的庆祝活动。
examples.trans: The company held a celebration for its anniversary.

meanings.note: Noun zhōuqī ('cycle, schedule window').

examples.text: 咱们魅力远航的筹备周期实在是太紧了。
examples.trans: Our preparation cycle for Charming Voyage is super tight.

examples.text: 大型季播综艺的制作周期一般为半年。
examples.trans: A seasonal variety show's production cycle usually spans six months.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhōu mò. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个周末 ('a weekend').

examples.text: 是谁啊？又有人订周末的房间吗？
examples.trans: Who is it? Someone else booking a room for the weekend?

examples.text: 周末早上来院子喝咖啡的人最多。
examples.trans: Weekend mornings bring the biggest crowd to the courtyard for coffee.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a noun used in conversational Mandarin. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个味 ('a 味').

examples.text: 我有一个味。
examples.trans: I have a 味.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的味。
examples.trans: This is a very good 味.

meanings.note: Colloquial erhua form of 味.

examples.text: 这道菜太淡了，没什么味儿。
examples.trans: This dish is so bland it has hardly any flavour.

examples.text: 屋子里有一股好闻的咖啡味儿。
examples.trans: There is a nice smell of coffee in the room.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wèi dào. Measure word (量词): 种 (zhǒng), e.g. 一种味道 ('a flavor / aroma').

examples.text: 咬一口……志豪，闭上眼睛！跟爷爷的蛋糕味道一模一样！
examples.trans: One bite... Zhihao, close your eyes! That tastes exactly like Grandfather's cake!

examples.text: 刚泡好的薄荷茶味道真清香。
examples.trans: Freshly brewed mint tea has such a clean aroma.

related.gloss: know (a fact or piece of information)

meanings.note: Pinyin: hū. Imitates letting out a relieved breath.

examples.text: 呼，好在反应快，早餐又有救了！
examples.trans: Phew, quick thinking saves breakfast once again!

examples.text: 呼，终于赶上早班火车了。
examples.trans: Phew, we finally caught the morning train.

meanings.note: Verb hūyù ('appeal to the public').

examples.text: 呼吁所有的网民一起来关注暴雨灾情。
examples.trans: Call on everyone online to pay attention to the storm emergency.

examples.text: 主持人在节目结尾呼吁大家理性支持原创音乐。
examples.trans: At the close of the show, the host appealed for support of original music.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hū xī. Pairs with 深 in 深呼吸 ('take a deep breath').

examples.text: 深呼吸，周经理。还没人写任何东西呢。
examples.trans: Take a deep breath, Manager Zhou. Nobody has written anything yet.

examples.text: 雨后院子里的空气呼吸起来特别舒服。
examples.trans: After the rain, the courtyard air feels wonderful to breathe.

meanings.note: Verb hūhǎn ('call out loudly, cheer').

examples.text: 请同学们高声呼喊，调动现场情绪。
examples.trans: Please cheer loudly to lift the crowd's energy.

examples.text: 观众席上传来热烈的呼喊声。
examples.trans: Warm cheers rang out from the stands.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mìng. Appears in lively colloquial idioms like 救命 ('save someone's life / bail someone out').

examples.text: 夏天喝一杯冰柠檬水真是救了我的命！
examples.trans: A glass of iced lemonade in summer truly saved my life!

examples.text: 多亏你提醒我，不然我就忘带钥匙了，真是救命啊。
examples.trans: Thanks to your reminder I didn't forget my keys—what a lifesaver.

meanings.note: Noun/verb mìnglìng ('official order').

examples.text: 他们没有通过办公系统下命令。
examples.trans: They did not issue an order through the office system.

examples.text: 有什么命令请直接下达到行政处。
examples.trans: Send any official order straight to administration.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé. Joins nouns or pronouns ('A and B'), NEVER two whole clauses; also means 'with' (和你一样).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé hǎo. Describes friends or family patching things up after a quarrel.

examples.text: 我的茶杯完好无损，两兄弟和好了，小晴也找到了新家。
examples.trans: My teacup survived unharmed, two brothers made peace, and Qing found a new home.

examples.text: 喝了一壶热茶，两兄弟终于和好了。
examples.trans: Over a pot of hot tea, the two brothers finally made up.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé xián. Combines 和 ('harmonious/together') + 弦 ('musical string'); measure word: 个 (gè).

examples.text: 最后一个温柔的和弦，高一个八度——又回家了。
examples.trans: And there is our gentle final chord, one octave higher—home again.

examples.text: 宋老师在钢琴上轻轻弹下第一个温暖的大调和弦。
examples.trans: Teacher Song gently played the first warm major chord on the piano.

meanings.note: Colloquial idiom huòxīní ('play peacemaker by blurring right and wrong').

examples.text: 你是部门总监，别总是在这儿和稀泥。
examples.trans: You are a unit director; stop trying to muddle both sides.

examples.text: 遇到原则问题不能和稀泥。
examples.trans: Never fudge matters of principle.

examples.text: 两人和解。
examples.trans: The two reconciled.

examples.text: 达成和解。
examples.trans: Reach reconciliation.

meanings.note: Balanced, peaceful, and mutually supportive.

examples.text: 他们团队的气氛一直很和谐。
examples.trans: The atmosphere on their team has always been harmonious.

examples.text: 两个人性格互补，相处很和谐。
examples.trans: Their personalities complement each other in harmony.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kā dā. Onomatopoeia imitating the crisp snap of a light switch, lock, or latch.

examples.text: 咔嗒一声，铜锁终于打开了。
examples.trans: With a crisp click, the brass lock finally opened.

examples.text: 她按下墙上的开关，咔嗒一声灯就亮了。
examples.trans: She pressed the wall switch, and with a click the lamp came on.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gū dū. Onomatopoeic verb/mimetic word imitating the gentle bubbling sound of soup or tea simmering in a pot.

examples.text: 在石头厨房里听着热扁豆汤慢慢咕嘟，心里特别踏实。
examples.trans: Listening to the hot lentil soup bubble gently in the stone kitchen feels wonderfully grounding.

examples.text: 炉子上的铜茶壶咕嘟咕嘟地冒着热气。
examples.trans: The copper kettle on the stove bubbled softly, sending up puffs of steam.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kā fēi. Measure word (量词): 杯 (bēi), e.g. 一杯咖啡 ('a cup of coffee').

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 我还没喝早咖啡呢，千万别说急事！
examples.trans: I have not had my morning coffee yet; please do not say emergency!

related.gloss: a cup of coffee (measure word 杯)

meanings.note: Pinyin: kā fēi tīng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间咖啡厅 ('a café').

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

examples.text: 一楼阳光最好的角落是我们的咖啡厅。
examples.trans: The sunniest corner of the ground floor is our café lounge.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kā fēi bēi. Compound 咖啡 ('coffee') + 杯 ('cup').

examples.text: 周经理左手拿着一只热乎乎的咖啡杯。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou is holding a warm coffee cup in his left hand.

examples.text: 小美把洗干净的咖啡杯整齐地摆在架子上。
examples.trans: Mei arranged the washed coffee cups neatly on the shelf.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kā fēi jiǎo. Combines 咖啡 ('coffee/café') + 角 ('corner/nook'); measure word: 个 (gè).

examples.text: 木牌上写着：九号房花园咖啡角——鲜汤、热面包、柠檬挞与清茶。
examples.trans: On the wooden sign it reads: Room Nine Garden Café Corner—Fresh Soup, Warm Bread, Lemon Tart & Tea.

examples.text: 阳光洒进一楼的咖啡角，四张木桌看起来格外温暖。
examples.trans: Sunlight pours into the ground-floor café corner, making the four wooden tables look extra warm.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kā fēi guǎn. Measure word (量词): 家 (jiā), e.g. 一家咖啡馆 ('a café').

examples.text: 每天服务街坊邻居——就像对公众开放的早间咖啡馆？！
examples.trans: Serves neighbours daily—like a morning café open to the public?!

examples.text: 比现在翻一倍！我们真的要对整条街开放小院咖啡馆吗？
examples.trans: Double what I bake now! Are we really opening the courtyard café to our whole street?

meanings.note: Pinyin: yí. Natural spoken interjection when noticing something unexpected.

examples.text: 当然不能偷看……咦，自己翻开在中间那页了！
examples.trans: Of course we must not peek... oh, it fell open to the middle page by itself!

examples.text: 咦，我的钥匙放哪儿了？
examples.trans: Huh, where did I put my keys?

examples.text: 台里那边你放心，我召集了一批专家给政策面上做咨询。
examples.trans: Don't worry about the network; I gathered a panel of scholars to advise leadership on media policy.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǎo. Used for biting into food or mechanical threads gripping tightly.

examples.text: 咬一口……志豪，闭上眼睛！跟爷爷的蛋糕味道一模一样！
examples.trans: One bite... Zhihao, close your eyes! That tastes exactly like Grandfather's cake!

examples.text: 他咬了一口热乎乎的面包。
examples.trans: He took a bite of the warm bread.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǎo hé. Describes gear or pipe threads fitting cleanly together.

examples.text: 一圈，两圈……看新铜螺纹咬合得多干净。
examples.trans: One turn, two turns... look how cleanly the new brass thread fits.

examples.text: 旧钥匙和锁孔依然咬合得很好。
examples.trans: The old key still engages cleanly inside the keyhole.

meanings.note: Colloquial inclusive pronoun zán ('we/us').

examples.text: 姐姐，咱不能够改行啊！
examples.trans: Sister, we could never let you change careers!

examples.text: 咱有什么话就当面直说吧。
examples.trans: Whatever we have to say, let us say it face to face.

meanings.en: we; us; our (inclusive of both the speaker and the listener)
meanings.note: Pinyin: zánmen. Unlike 我们 (which can exclude the listener), 咱们 specifically includes the person spoken to, creating a warm, collegial, or colloquial tone. Directly modifies nouns without 的 in set expressions like 咱们这行.

examples.text: 干咱们这行，谁不想跟他学习？
examples.trans: In our line of work, who wouldn't want to learn from him?

examples.text: 淳于总已经批准咱们的方案了。
examples.trans: Director Chun Yu has already approved our proposal.

meanings.note: Colloquial pronoun zánliǎ ('you and I, the two of us').

examples.text: 咱俩都分手两年了。
examples.trans: The two of us broke up two years ago.

examples.text: 咱俩一起去喝杯茶吧。
examples.trans: Let the two of us go get a cup of tea.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xián. Describes salted butter or savory dishes.

examples.text: 那是海盐咸黄油！甜果酱面包卷要无盐黄油！
examples.trans: That is sea-salt butter! Sweet jam rolls need unsalted butter!

examples.text: 咸黄油能配甜草莓果酱吗？
examples.trans: Can salted butter go with sweet strawberry jam?

meanings.note: Used literally or figuratively in 咽下这口气.

examples.text: 他强忍着怒火，不肯白白咽下这口窝囊气。
examples.trans: Holding back his anger, he refused to swallow such an unfair insult.

examples.text: 嗓子疼的时候连咽口水都觉得费劲。
examples.trans: With a sore throat, even swallowing water feels painful.

examples.text: 惠美刚被法国的品牌选为亚洲区的代言人，因为这件事对方要解约了。
examples.trans: Huimei was just chosen as regional ambassador for an international brand, and now they want to terminate her contract.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 如果我们台能够率先垂范接受这个方案，不仅会提高我们的品牌价值。
examples.trans: If our network sets the example by adopting this plan, it will elevate our entire brand value.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Noun pǐnzhì ('intrinsic quality').

examples.text: 一线卫视最注重的就是节目品质。
examples.trans: Top networks care most about programme quality.

examples.text: 好口碑来自每一期稳定的品质。
examples.trans: Good word of mouth comes from steady quality.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǒng. Used for gently soothing a child or calming someone down.

examples.text: 宋老师，那怎么哄他开心呢？
examples.trans: Teacher Song, how did you coax him into smiling again?

examples.text: 哥哥正在耐心地哄弟弟。
examples.trans: The older brother is patiently soothing his little brother.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dō yīn. Combines solfège 哆 (dō, 'Do / C') + 音 ('musical note').

examples.text: 先按下中央哆音，听听琴弦的声音准不准。
examples.trans: Press middle C first and listen to whether the strings are in tune.

examples.text: 这首练习曲从明亮的哆音开始。
examples.trans: This etude begins on a bright C note.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wā. Expresses admiration or delight.

examples.text: 哇，看这间房！大木头房梁，窗户正对着院子！
examples.trans: Wow, look at this room! Big wooden beams, and a window facing the courtyard!

examples.text: 插上老陈的铜台灯……哇，黄色灯光真暖和！
examples.trans: Plug in Chen's brass lamp... wow, how warm that yellow light is!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hā. Expresses sudden realization or cheerful laughter.

examples.text: 哈！你怕签了名字，倔脾气大哥就不出门了！
examples.trans: Aha! You feared that if you signed your name, stubborn big brother would stay home!

examples.text: 哈，原来钥匙就在口袋里！
examples.trans: Aha, the key was in my pocket all along!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hā hā. Hearty laughter.

examples.text: 哈哈！跟我到院子里来一分钟，给你们看我真正做什么！
examples.trans: Haha! Come out to the courtyard for a minute—let me show you what I really do!

examples.text: 哈哈，我们俩想到一块儿去了！
examples.trans: Haha, the two of us had the exact same thought!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎng. Used for bells, phones, pipes, or alarms ringing or clanking.

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎng shēng. Measure word (量词): 阵, e.g. 一阵响声 ('a burst of noise').

examples.text: 快合上送上去——等等，那是什么金属响声？
examples.trans: Close it quickly and take it up—wait, what was that metallic clanking sound?

examples.text: 楼下水管的响声已经完全停了。
examples.trans: The clanking sound in the downstairs pipe has completely stopped.

related.gloss: a burst of noise (measure word 阵)

meanings.note: Pinyin: āi yā. Expresses mild dismay or sudden surprise.

examples.text: 我的眼镜怎么会在……哎呀！在我头上！
examples.trans: Why would my glasses be in... oh dear! They are on my head!

examples.text: 我来帮您。哎呀，里面装了石头吗？
examples.trans: Let me help you. Goodness, did you pack stones inside?

meanings.note: Pinyin: āi yō. Natural spoken exclamation of effort, surprise, or mild pain.

examples.text: 哎哟，这扇旧木窗板卡得真紧呀！
examples.trans: Ugh, this old wooden shutter is stuck so tight!

examples.text: 哎哟，茶杯还很烫，端的时候小心点儿。
examples.trans: Ooh, the teacup is still very hot—be careful carrying it.

examples.text: 这是哥啊。
examples.trans: This is brother.

examples.text: 那个哥好。
examples.trans: That brother is good.

meanings.note: Casual northern Mandarin word for close male friends.

examples.text: 我们俩可是认识十年的好哥们。
examples.trans: The two of us are good buddies of ten years.

examples.text: 有困难尽管找哥们帮忙。
examples.trans: Whenever trouble hits, just ask your buddies for help.

meanings.note: Affectionate northern spoken form of 哥们.

examples.text: 咱们认识这么久，早就成了铁杆好哥们儿。
examples.trans: Having known each other so long, we are solid buddies.

examples.text: 有事尽管开口，哥们儿一定帮你想法子。
examples.trans: Just say the word—your buddy will help find a way.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gē ge. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个哥哥 ('an older brother').

examples.text: 那里住着一位老木匠和两个孙子——哥哥弹钢琴，弟弟最爱小火车！
examples.trans: An old carpenter lived there with two grandsons—the older brother played piano, and the younger loved toy trains!

examples.text: 哥哥性格爽朗声音大，弹音阶总是急匆匆的。
examples.trans: The older brother was bold and loud, always rushing through his scales.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ò. Signals realization or acknowledgment.

examples.text: 哦？我的预订有问题吗？
examples.trans: Oh? Is there a problem with my booking?

examples.text: 我？哦，我只是喜欢准时！七点十四分真美妙！
examples.trans: Me? Oh, I simply love punctuality! Seven fourteen is a lovely minute!

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǎ. Combines with a measure word to ask 'which?' (哪个 'which one?', 哪间 'which room?').

examples.text: 等一下，小晴……你拿了哪一包黄油？
examples.trans: Wait a second, Qing... which packet of butter did you grab?

examples.text: 对！左边有两条小路——我走哪一条？
examples.trans: Yes! There are two small lanes on the left—which one do I take?

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǎge (also pronounced něige in casual speech). Compound of interrogative 哪 ('which') + general classifier 个; can stand alone as a pronoun or directly precede a noun phrase.

examples.text: 你喜欢哪个明星？
examples.trans: Which celebrity do you like?

examples.text: 请问这个职位是属于哪个部门？
examples.trans: Excuse me, which department does this position belong to?

meanings.note: Interrogative pronoun nǎxiē ('which plural items').

examples.text: 策划有哪些点不满意，请提出来。
examples.trans: Whichever points in the plan dissatisfy you, name them.

examples.text: 今晚出席盛典的有哪些歌手？
examples.trans: Which singers are attending tonight's gala?

meanings.note: Polite interrogative nǎwèi ('which person/guest').

examples.text: 您最期待的明星是哪位？
examples.trans: Which star are you most looking forward to?

examples.text: 请问刚才是哪位打来的电话？
examples.trans: May I ask who called just now?

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǎr. Spoken northern/standard variant of 哪里 ('where').

examples.text: 正合我心意。楼梯在哪儿？
examples.trans: Just what I wanted. Where are the stairs?

examples.text: 这面圆镜子挂哪儿？窗户左边还是右边？
examples.trans: Where should I hang this round mirror? Left of the window or right?

examples.text: 你总自虐干吗呀？哪回你自虐，最后受苦的不是我们？
examples.trans: Why do you always torture yourself? Every time you do, aren't we the ones who suffer too?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 这是哪怕啊。
examples.trans: This is even if.

examples.text: 那个哪怕好。
examples.trans: That even if is good.

meanings.note: Playful or modest rhetorical denial.

examples.text: 您在场，我们哪敢随便偷懒呀！
examples.trans: With you here, how would we dare slack off!

examples.text: 跟您开个玩笑而已，我哪敢真生气。
examples.trans: Just joking with you—how would I dare get angry for real.

meanings.note: Question pronoun nǎbiān ('which direction/side').

examples.text: 请问行政部的茶水间在哪边？
examples.trans: Excuse me, which way is the admin pantry?

examples.text: 舞台入口在左边还是在哪边？
examples.trans: Is the stage entrance on the left or which side?

meanings.note: Pinyin: ná lǐ. Everyday question word for place; stays after 在 (在哪里 'where is it?').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 小勺子和餐巾放在哪里？
examples.trans: Where do the small spoons and napkins go?

meanings.note: Pinyin: kū. Everyday verb for crying.

examples.text: 那你告诉我，前台后面那位先生为什么快哭了？
examples.trans: Then tell me why that gentleman behind the front desk looks ready to cry.

examples.text: 小孩子找不到妈妈，急得哭了。
examples.trans: The child could not find his mother and cried anxiously.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hēng. Read 1st-tone hēng when softly humming a tune under one's breath (哼歌 'hum a song').

examples.text: 小美一边揉面团，一边轻轻哼着歌。
examples.trans: Mei softly hummed a tune while kneading bread dough.

examples.text: 宋老师看着旧乐谱，小声哼出了第一句。
examples.trans: Looking at the old score, Teacher Song softly hummed the opening phrase.

examples.text: 白石自己的使用权还没整利索呢，他们也就是唬唬你们可以！
examples.trans: Baishi hasn't even sorted out its own usage rights cleanly — all they can do is bluff you people!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Adjective wéiyī ('the single, sole').

examples.text: 这条视频是我们的唯一漏洞。
examples.trans: This video is our single remaining loophole.

examples.text: 努力是通往成功的唯一办法。
examples.trans: Hard work is the sole path to success.

meanings.note: Emphatic adverb wéidú ('solely, with this one exception').

examples.text: 唯独你们拍的视频拍到了那瓶水。
examples.trans: Only the video you filmed caught that water bottle.

examples.text: 大家都走了，唯独她还在加班。
examples.trans: Everyone left; she alone stayed working overtime.

meanings.note: Verb chàng ('sing').

examples.text: 二位真是说得比唱得好听。
examples.trans: The two of you talk even sweeter than singing.

examples.text: 今晚压轴嘉宾会现场唱两首新歌。
examples.trans: Tonight's finale guest will sing two new songs live.

meanings.note: Verb-object chànggē ('sing').

examples.text: 只是自己喜欢唱歌，纯喜欢。
examples.trans: I simply enjoy singing for myself—pure affection.

examples.text: 周末她喜欢在家里安静地听音乐唱歌。
examples.trans: On weekends she likes listening to music and singing at home.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shāng yè. Measure word (量词): 种 (zhǒng), e.g. 一种商业 ('a line of commerce').

examples.text: 产权转让通知：八号小院整栋建筑将作为商业办公楼出售。
examples.trans: Property Transfer Notice: Courtyard Building Eight offered for sale as commercial offices.

examples.text: 商业办公楼出售？！把我们的客栈和厨房变成灰色办公室？！
examples.trans: Commercial office sale?! Turn our inn and kitchen into grey offices?!

related.gloss: a line of commerce (measure word 种)

meanings.note: Business revenue and monetary return.

examples.text: 在安全面前，商业利益必须放在第二位。
examples.trans: Before human safety, commercial interests must come second.

examples.text: 好制作人不会为了眼前商业利益牺牲品质。
examples.trans: A good producer never sacrifices quality for quick profit.

meanings.note: Entertainment noun shāngyè huódòng ('promotional event').

examples.text: 今天晚上的商业活动，我可以过去。
examples.trans: That commercial event tonight—I can attend after all.

examples.text: 这位主持人很少参加纯粹的商业活动。
examples.trans: This host rarely attends purely commercial events.

meanings.note: Noun shāngpǐn ('commercial product').

examples.text: 别签在把你当成商品一样的公司。
examples.trans: Do not sign with a firm that treats you like a commodity.

examples.text: 货架上的商品摆放得整整齐齐。
examples.trans: Merchandise on the shelves is neatly arranged.

meanings.note: Verb shāngliang ('consult, talk things over').

examples.text: 他们连夜开会商量出一个主意。
examples.trans: They met overnight and worked out a plan.

examples.text: 这件事我得跟家人商量一下。
examples.trans: I need to talk this over with my family.

meanings.note: Pinyin: a. Expresses sudden realization at the start of a line, or softens warmth at the end.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 你好，小美，很高兴认识你！好香啊！
examples.trans: Hello, Mei, nice to meet you! Something smells wonderful!

meanings.note: Colloquial pronoun shá ('what, anything').

examples.text: 这两个人最近没啥大问题。
examples.trans: Those two have had no big issues lately.

examples.text: 中午你想吃点啥？
examples.trans: What do you feel like eating at noon?

meanings.note: Pinyin: la. Colloquial fusion of 了 + 啊 adding cheerful energy at the end of a sentence.

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 你们守着，我出门啦！
examples.trans: Hold the fort—I am heading out the door!

meanings.note: Pinyin: pā. Sound word for a sharp crack, a slap, or a blown fuse.

examples.text: 就按一下——啪！……哎呀。
examples.trans: Just one quick click—pop! ... Oh dear.

examples.text: 啪的一声，杯子掉在地上了。
examples.trans: With a snap, the cup fell to the floor.

meanings.en: hello (used when answering or initiating a phone call)
meanings.note: Pronounced wéi (second tone) in phone greetings to sound polite and attentive.

meanings.en: hey;喂 (used to call out or get someone's attention)
meanings.note: Typically pronounced wèi (fourth tone) when calling out to someone at a distance or expressing impatience; note that 喂 (wèi) is also a verb meaning 'to feed'.

examples.text: 喂，你好，我是星天娱乐的布小谷。
examples.trans: Hello, this is Bu Xiaogu from Xingtian Entertainment.

examples.text: 喂，你把重要的文件忘在会议室里了！
examples.trans: Hey, you left your important documents in the conference room!

meanings.note: Verb shànhòu ('handle fallout after an incident').

examples.text: 主任点名要求我们一部负责善后。
examples.trans: The director named Unit One to handle the aftermath.

examples.text: 出了直播事故必须派专人善后。
examples.trans: After a broadcast mishap, someone must manage fallout.

meanings.note: Adjective shànliáng ('kind-hearted').

examples.text: 他虽然嘴硬，心里还是挺善良的。
examples.trans: Tough as he talks, he still has a kind heart underneath.

examples.text: 小谷真诚善良的性格赢得了前辈们的信任。
examples.trans: Xiaogu's sincere, kind nature won her senior colleagues' trust.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎn. Used for calling out to someone across a courtyard or street.

examples.text: 我在院子里老远就听到你们喊黄油了。
examples.trans: All the way out in the courtyard I heard you shouting about butter.

examples.text: 有人在大门口喊你的名字。
examples.trans: Someone is calling your name at the front gate.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chuǎn. Pairs with 气 in 喘口气 ('catch one's breath').

examples.text: 老陈，两个铜阀门给你！喘口气？没空！
examples.trans: Chen, here are both brass valves! Catch my breath? No time!

examples.text: 他跑上三楼，先喘一口气。
examples.trans: He ran up to the third floor and paused to catch his breath.

meanings.note: Noun xǐjù ('comedy').

examples.text: 他是来自泰国著名的喜剧大咖。
examples.trans: He is a renowned comedy star from Thailand.

examples.text: 周末看一场轻松的喜剧电影最解压。
examples.trans: Watching a lighthearted comedy on the weekend relieves stress.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xǐ huan. Everyday verb for liking food, rooms, or people.

examples.text: 只有裙子、乐谱，还有我最喜欢的茶杯！
examples.trans: Only dresses, sheet music, and my favourite teacup!

examples.text: 说实话，我比以前灰色办公室喜欢这儿多了。
examples.trans: Honestly, I like this place far better than my old grey office.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hē. Used for drinking tea, coffee, water, juice, AND soup in Mandarin (喝汤).

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 我还没喝早咖啡呢，千万别说急事！
examples.trans: I have not had my morning coffee yet; please do not say emergency!

meanings.note: Potential complement hēbuliǎo ('cannot drink').

examples.text: 我胃不好，喝不了冰咖啡。
