examples.trans: My stomach is weak, so I cannot drink iced coffee.

examples.text: 这么多饮料我一个人喝不了。
examples.trans: I cannot finish all these drinks alone.

examples.text: 走，今天晚上带你喝大酒去！
examples.trans: Come on, tonight I'm taking you out for a proper drink!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 他昨天说到约你喝茶，可能是觉得喝茶太俗了吧。
examples.trans: Yesterday he mentioned inviting you for tea — maybe he felt tea was too ordinary.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Verb-object hējiǔ ('have alcoholic drinks').

examples.text: 同事们晚上到这儿来都是喝酒。
examples.trans: Colleagues come here in the evening for drinks.

examples.text: 开车的时候绝对不能喝酒。
examples.trans: Never drink alcohol when driving.

examples.text: 离开学校半年就学会喝闷酒了？听说你找男朋友了，超级富二代。
examples.trans: Barely half a year out of school and already drinking alone? Word is you found a super-rich boyfriend.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pēn quán. Measure word (量词): 座 (zuò), e.g. 一座喷泉 ('a fountain').

examples.text: 听得很清楚。你站在小石头喷泉旁边吗？
examples.trans: Loud and clear. Are you standing beside the little stone fountain?

examples.text: 小广场中间有一座石头喷泉。
examples.trans: There is a stone fountain in the middle of the small plaza.

meanings.note: Modal particle lou ('here comes...!, alright!').

examples.text: 庆祝升职的蛋糕来喽！
examples.trans: Here comes the celebration cake!

examples.text: 收工喽，大家早点回去休息吧！
examples.trans: That is a wrap—head home early and rest!

meanings.note: Pinyin: sǎng mén. Colloquial compound 嗓 ('throat/voice') + 门 ('gate/opening'); measure word: 副 (fù); 大嗓门 means a booming, carrying voice.

examples.text: 小美，在这栋房子里你有六双手帮忙，还有一副大嗓门呢！
examples.trans: Mei, in this house you have six pairs of helping hands and one booming voice!

examples.text: 隔着整个院子都能听见老陈爽朗的大嗓门。
examples.trans: You can hear Chen's hearty, booming voice all the way across the courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wēng wēng. Onomatopoeia describing the low hum of an appliance, bee, or transformer.

examples.text: 新冰箱在角落里轻轻地嗡嗡响。
examples.trans: The new fridge hums softly in the corner.

examples.text: 春天花园里的蜜蜂在花朵旁嗡嗡飞。
examples.trans: In spring, bees in the garden buzz around the blossoms.

examples.text: 嗯，还有谁能看到？
examples.trans: Hmm, who else would be able to see it?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Broadcast noun jiābīn ('guest star on a show').

examples.text: 有请今晚的神秘嘉宾出场。
examples.trans: Please welcome tonight's mystery guest.

examples.text: 节目请来了好几位嘉宾。
examples.trans: The show invited several special guests.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ma. Sentence-final particle reminding the listener of something natural or obvious.

examples.text: 总得有人照顾院子里的花草嘛。
examples.trans: Somebody has to look after the courtyard plants, after all.

examples.text: 都是老街坊，不用客气嘛。
examples.trans: We are all old neighbors—no need to be so formal.

meanings.note: Warmly telling someone what to remember.

examples.text: 医生嘱咐他一定要按时吃药。
examples.trans: The doctor urged him to take his medicine on time.

examples.text: 出门前妈妈反复嘱咐我注意安全。
examples.trans: Before I left, Mum repeatedly told me to stay safe.

meanings.note: Noun zuǐ ('mouth').

examples.text: 管不住的是别人的嘴。
examples.trans: What cannot be controlled is other people's mouths.

examples.text: 喝口水润润嘴吧。
examples.trans: Take a sip of water.

嘴上.gloss: on one's lips, in what one says aloud

meanings.en: on one's lips, in what one says aloud
meanings.note: Locative noun zuǐshàng ('verbally, on the surface').

examples.text: 不管她们嘴上说什么，心里是佩服你的。
examples.trans: Whatever they say aloud, deep down they admire you.

examples.text: 他嘴上说不紧张，手心却已经出汗了。
examples.trans: He claimed not to be nervous, yet his palms were sweating.

嘴型.gloss: lip shape, movement of the lips

meanings.en: lip shape, movement of the lips
meanings.note: Used when mouthing words silently ('read my lips').

examples.text: 现场太吵听不清，他只能看导演的嘴型行事。
examples.trans: With the set too loud to hear, he read the director's lips instead.

examples.text: 配音演员必须让台词和画面里人物的嘴型对上。
examples.trans: Voice actors must match lines cleanly to the character's lip movements.

examples.text: 吉秀？我告诉你，那是全中国嘴巴最严的女人！
examples.trans: Ji Xiu? Let me tell you, she is the tightest-lipped woman in the entire country!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: In 磨破嘴皮子, means talking oneself hoarse persuading someone.

examples.text: 为了劝他去医院，大家简直磨破了嘴皮子。
examples.trans: To talk him into visiting the hospital, everyone talked themselves hoarse.

examples.text: 光靠耍嘴皮子可做不出好节目。
examples.trans: Slick talk alone never produces a great show.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuǐ yìng. Literally 'mouth hard'—acting stubborn on the outside while caring inside.

examples.text: 志鹏不会走的。他总是嘴硬五秒钟，心马上就软了。
examples.trans: Zhipeng will not leave. He always talked tough for five seconds, then softened right away.

examples.text: 他虽然嘴硬，其实心里很关心弟弟。
examples.trans: Even though he talks tough, deep down he cares deeply about his brother.

meanings.note: Locative phrase zuǐlǐ ('from one's own lips').

examples.text: 我还想在你嘴里得到证实。
examples.trans: I still want to hear it confirmed from your own lips.

examples.text: 这句实话终于从他嘴里说出来了。
examples.trans: That honest truth finally came from his own lips.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sī. Onomatopoeic interjection imitating a sharp intake of breath through the teeth when feeling sudden pain or cold.

examples.text: 嘶……我往下迈的时候，右脚踝不小心扭了一下！
examples.trans: Ooh... when I stepped down, I twisted my right ankle!

examples.text: 刚出炉的烤盘真烫，志鹏不小心碰到边缘，嘶地倒吸了一口冷气。
examples.trans: The baking tray fresh from the oven was so hot that Peng gasped sharply when he brushed the edge.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a part used in conversational Mandarin.

examples.text: 我有一个嘿。
examples.trans: I have a 嘿.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的嘿。
examples.trans: This is a very good 嘿.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zào yīn. Measure word (量词): 阵, e.g. 一阵噪音 ('a burst of noise').

examples.text: 主要设计小图书馆和院子，测量老石墙怎么挡住街上噪音。
examples.trans: Mostly small libraries and courtyards, measuring how old stone walls block street noise.

examples.text: 厚砖墙挡住了大街上的汽车噪音。
examples.trans: The thick brick wall blocks the traffic noise from the avenue.

related.gloss: a burst of noise (measure word 阵)

meanings.note: Fixed phrase often paired with 打压 or 灭...嚣张气焰.

examples.text: 这场漂亮的胜仗彻底打压了对手的嚣张气焰。
examples.trans: That decisive win completelydeflated the rival's arrogant bluster.

examples.text: 面对无理挑衅，绝不能助长对方的嚣张气焰。
examples.trans: Faced with provocation, never feed the other side's arrogance.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sì. Cardinal number 4.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

examples.text: 这本厚厚的留言簿已经记录了四十位客人的故事。
examples.trans: This thick guestbook has already recorded the stories of forty guests.

examples.text: 这条老街上超过四十年的老字号店铺还有好几家。
examples.trans: There are still several time-honored shops over forty years old along this historic street.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sì shí wǔ. Cardinal number 四十 ('forty') + 五 ('five'); 五点四十五分 is 5:45 ('a quarter to six').

examples.text: 才五点四十五分——大家已经到了吗？！
examples.trans: It is only five forty-five—are people arriving already?!

examples.text: 这盘杏仁柠檬挞要在烤箱里慢烤四十五分钟。
examples.trans: This tray of almond lemon tart needs to bake slowly in the oven for forty-five minutes.

meanings.note: Colloquial numeral phrase sìshí hǎojǐ ('forty-something, well past forty').

examples.text: 他都是四十好几的人了，还装年轻！
examples.trans: He is well into his forties already!

examples.text: 这位老摄像入行时才二十，如今四十好几了。
examples.trans: This cameraman started at twenty and is now past forty.

四周.gloss: all around; the four sides; surroundings

meanings.en: all around; the four sides; surroundings
meanings.note: Pinyin: sì zhōu. Location noun meaning 'all four sides / all around'; takes 在 directly (在四周砌了砖头 'laid bricks around all four sides').

examples.text: 方坑的四周砌着四块红砖头，把泥土和雨水挡在外面。
examples.trans: Around all four sides of the square pit are laid four red bricks, keeping soil and rainwater out.

examples.text: 小院四周种满了花草，夏天坐在这儿喝茶真凉快。
examples.trans: Flowers and plants grow all around the small courtyard, making it wonderfully cool for summer tea.

examples.text: 小谷，你把他工作日程调出来我记录一下。四月份这么满啊？
examples.trans: Xiaogu, pull up his calendar so I can jot it down — April is packed this tight?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sìbǎi. Requires an appropriate classifier (such as 个, 名, or 张) between the numeral and a countable noun.

examples.text: 这些资料，还有这四百个小时的录像资料。
examples.trans: These files, plus these four hundred hours of video recordings.

examples.text: 这次节目录制现场一共来了四百名观众。
examples.trans: A total of four hundred audience members came to the live recording of this show.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huí. As a verb, 'return' (回家, 回来); as a measure word, 'occasion/time' (这回 'this time').

examples.text: 那个人为什么不拿回自己的箱子就跑了？
examples.trans: Why did that person run off without taking his own suitcase back?

examples.text: 他没要回那个装木头小火车的箱子吗？
examples.trans: Did he not ask back for that case with the wooden train?

examples.text: 谈到义务了，你跟洛琳的过去到底是怎么一回事？
examples.trans: Speaking of duty, then — what exactly happened in the past between you and Luo Lin?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 我还约了人，你们先回去吧。
examples.trans: I also have an appointment with someone; you two head back first.

examples.text: 这是回去。
examples.trans: This is 回去.

meanings.note: Coming back from abroad.

examples.text: 她在海外进修两年后决定回国发展。
examples.trans: After two years studying abroad, she decided to return home.

examples.text: 拍摄一结束，全组就立刻买机票回国了。
examples.trans: Right after wrapping filming, the crew flew back home.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huí shēng. Measure word (量词): 阵, e.g. 一阵回声 ('an echo').

examples.text: 因为湿木头百叶窗会柔化石板路传回来的回声……
examples.trans: Because wet wooden shutters soften the echo bouncing off the flagstones...

examples.text: 空荡荡的大厅里能听见脚步的回声。
examples.trans: In the empty hall you can hear the echo of footsteps.

meanings.note: workplace verb/noun for replying to a message or call

examples.text: 现在等他们回复，应该就是他了。
examples.trans: Now we wait for their reply; it should be him.

examples.text: 收到邮件以后请尽快回复。
examples.trans: Please reply as soon as possible after receiving the email.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huí tóu. Appears in the friendly farewell 回头见！ ('See you soon!').

examples.text: 我先去送热茶，我们回头聊！
examples.trans: Let me deliver this hot tea first—we will talk soon!

examples.text: 今天辛苦了，回头见！
examples.trans: Great work today—see you soon!

meanings.en: see you later; catch you soon
meanings.note: Pinyin: huítóu jiàn. Casual, friendly parting phrase where 回头 figuratively means 'in a little while' or 'later on'; common among coworkers and friends expecting to meet again soon.

examples.text: 我先去开会了，咱们回头见！
examples.trans: I'm heading off to my meeting first — see you later!

examples.text: 今天聊得很开心，回头见！
examples.trans: It was great chatting today; see you soon!

meanings.note: Pinyin: huí jiā. Verb-object compound 回 ('return') + 家 ('home'); takes no location particle between them.

examples.text: 买完菜以后，我们一起走路回家吧。
examples.trans: After finishing the grocery shopping, let's walk home together.

examples.text: 下班回家的路上，我买了一束鲜花。
examples.trans: On my way home from work, I bought a bunch of fresh flowers.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huí xíng zhēn. Measure word (量词): 枚, e.g. 一枚回形针 ('a paperclip').

examples.text: 等等——通知背面回形针还别着第二页折起来的纸……
examples.trans: Wait—clipped to the back of the notice is a folded second page...

examples.text: 两页合同用一枚银色回形针别在一起。
examples.trans: The two contract pages are clipped together with a silver paperclip.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huí yì. Measure word (量词): 段, e.g. 一段回忆 ('a fond memory').

examples.text: 老房子连着旧回忆——那种争吵最伤人。
examples.trans: Old houses are tied to old memories—arguments like that cut deepest.

examples.text: 老钢琴里藏着他们童年最美的回忆。
examples.trans: The old piano holds their fondest childhood memories.

meanings.note: Noun huíyìlù ('memoir, autobiography').

examples.text: 我留点采访资料，以后好给你写个回忆录。
examples.trans: Let me save some interview notes so I can write your memoirs someday.

examples.text: 老台长退休后动笔写下了一本电视人回忆录。
examples.trans: After retiring, the station chief penned a broadcaster's memoir.

meanings.note: Gathering signed forms or inspection reports back in.

examples.text: 所有转播车的检修报告都已经全部回收了。
examples.trans: Maintenance reports from every broadcast truck have been collected.

examples.text: 活动结束后请把借用的对讲机统一回收。
examples.trans: After the event, please collect all borrowed walkie-talkies.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huí lái. Directional compound for returning toward the speaker's place.

examples.text: 一点没破！是谁送回来的？
examples.trans: Not cracked at all! Who brought it back?

examples.text: 付了现金！打开工具箱等我，我往桥那边跑回来了！
examples.trans: Paid in cash! Open your toolbox and wait—I am running back across the bridge!

meanings.note: Verb/noun huídá ('reply, answer').

examples.text: 这属于我拒绝回答的问题。
examples.trans: That falls under questions I decline to answer.

examples.text: 不管何时问起，我都会这么回答。
examples.trans: Whenever asked, I will answer the exact same way.

meanings.note: Verb/noun huígù ('recap, review past highlights').

examples.text: 热场时段先播放往期精彩花絮回顾。
examples.trans: During the warm-up slot they aired a recap of past highlights.

examples.text: 年末特辑带观众一起回顾这一季的感人瞬间。
examples.trans: The year-end special looks back on this season's moving moments.

meanings.note: Formal verb huíkuì ('give back in gratitude').

examples.text: 你们拍视频无非是为了回馈粉丝。
examples.trans: You filmed the video simply to give back to fans.

examples.text: 公司年底举办活动回馈老客户。
examples.trans: The firm holds year-end events to thank loyal clients.

meanings.note: Concise formal preposition opening official notices.

examples.text: 因天气原因，户外拍摄改在室内进行。
examples.trans: Owing to weather, outdoor filming moved indoors.

examples.text: 该员工因表现突出获得了特别嘉奖。
examples.trans: Owing to standout work, the employee received a special award.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yīn wèi. Introduces a reason; often paired with 所以 ('therefore') in the next clause.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 因为楼梯窄，而且周经理在那儿放了旧灯箱子。
examples.trans: Because the stairs are narrow, and Manager Zhou put old lamp boxes up there.

meanings.note: Formal conjunction linking cause and result.

examples.text: 节目口碑极佳，因此吸引了众多品牌赞助。
examples.trans: Word of mouth was stellar, attracting numerous sponsors.

examples.text: 他坚持严控品质，因此赢得了全组的敬重。
examples.trans: He insisted on strict quality control and thus earned the crew's respect.

meanings.note: Noun tuán ('troupe, group, delegation').

examples.text: 门外这浩浩荡荡的探病天团来了。
examples.trans: Here comes that whole grand hospital-visiting delegation.

examples.text: 海外评审团对这档原创音乐节目给予高度评价。
examples.trans: The international jury praised this original music show highly.

meanings.note: Noun tuánzhǎng ('leader of a troupe or fan group').

examples.text: 嘉宾是辛惠美和她的粉丝团团长。
examples.trans: The guests are Xin Huimei and her fan-club leader.

examples.text: 艺术团的团长正在后台指挥。
examples.trans: The troupe leader is directing backstage.

meanings.note: Noun tuánduì ('work or legal team').

examples.text: 律师团队已经起诉了。
examples.trans: The legal team has already filed suit.

examples.text: 请更改你们团队的声明。
examples.trans: Please revise your team's statement.

meanings.note: Noun yuánlín ('traditional landscaped garden').

examples.text: 这家茶馆是仿江南园林建造的。
examples.trans: This teahouse is modeled after a classical garden.

examples.text: 苏州园林的景色一年四季都很美。
examples.trans: Classical gardens look lovely in every season.

examples.text: 昨天一宿去趟香港，我现在很困。
examples.trans: I spent all last night on a trip to Hong Kong; I'm just sleepy right now.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Difficult situation hard to break out of.

examples.text: 她在论文里分析了传统电视面临的困境。
examples.trans: In her thesis she analysed the dilemma facing traditional TV.

examples.text: 越是在困境中，团队越要保持冷静。
examples.trans: The deeper the predicament, the calmer the team must stay.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wéi. Often followed by 着 (围着桌子 'gathered around the table').

examples.text: 傍晚大家围着木桌一边喝茶一边聊天。
examples.trans: At dusk everyone gathered around the wooden table drinking tea and chatting.

examples.text: 院子四周用青砖围成了一道矮墙。
examples.trans: Blue bricks form a low wall surrounding all four sides of the courtyard.

meanings.note: Verb wéirào ('centre around, surround').

examples.text: 建立一个围绕你自己的音乐空间。
examples.trans: Build a musical space centred around yourself.

examples.text: 今天的讨论主要围绕新节目的赛制展开。
examples.trans: Today's discussion centres on the new show's format.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wéi qún. Combines 围 ('wrap around') + 裙 ('skirt/apron'); measure word: 条 (tiáo).

examples.text: 解下围裙吧——星期五六点到了！
examples.trans: Untie your aprons—six o'clock on Friday is here!

examples.text: 小美系上干净的白围裙，开始在厨房里揉面团。
examples.trans: Mei tied on a clean white apron and began kneading dough in the kitchen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a verb used in conversational Mandarin.

examples.text: 我有一个固定。
examples.trans: I have a 固定.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的固定。
examples.trans: This is a very good 固定.

meanings.note: Noun guó ('country').

examples.text: 这几年中泰两国的文化合作愈加频繁。
examples.trans: Cultural ties between the two countries have grown frequent.

examples.text: 优秀的音乐作品能够跨越国与国的语言障碍。
examples.trans: Great music bridges language barriers across nations.

meanings.note: Locative noun guónèi ('within the country').

examples.text: 现场聚集了国内的各家媒体。
examples.trans: Domestic media outlets gathered at the venue.

examples.text: 这部电视剧在国内非常受欢迎。
examples.trans: This drama is very popular nationwide.

meanings.note: Outside one's home country.

examples.text: 他女儿目前跟着家人在国外读书。
examples.trans: His daughter is currently studying abroad with family.

examples.text: 这档节目专门去国外几个城市取景拍摄。
examples.trans: This show filmed on location across several cities abroad.

meanings.note: Noun/attributive guójì ('international').

examples.text: 你在一部操作过多少国际团队？
examples.trans: How many international teams did you handle in Unit One?

examples.text: 今年盛典邀请了三支国际知名的乐队。
examples.trans: This year's gala invited three internationally known bands.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tú. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张图 ('a plan').

examples.text: 里面有……一把大门钥匙、一张蓝色的图，还有明信片。
examples.trans: Inside there's... one big door key, a blue plan, and postcards.

examples.text: 老陈在纸上画了一张去五金店的图。
examples.trans: Chen drew a map to the hardware shop on a piece of paper.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tú shū. Collective noun 图 ('charts/illustrations') + 书 ('books'), used for shared reading collections (共享图书 'shared books').

examples.text: 小晴在九号房门边放了一个街坊共享图书的小竹篮。
examples.trans: Qing placed a small bamboo basket by the door of Room Nine for neighbourhood book sharing.

examples.text: 街坊们喝茶的时候，都喜欢从竹篮里挑一本喜欢的图书来看。
examples.trans: While drinking tea, neighbours love picking a book they like from the bamboo basket to read.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tú shū guǎn. Measure word (量词): 座 (zuò), e.g. 一座图书馆 ('a library').

examples.text: 主要设计小图书馆和院子，测量老石墙怎么挡住街上噪音。
examples.trans: Mostly small libraries and courtyards, measuring how old stone walls block street noise.

examples.text: 市图书馆保存着很多老城区的历史图纸。
examples.trans: The city library preserves many historic blueprints of the Old Quarter.

meanings.note: Noun túpiàn ('digital image or picture').

examples.text: 包括你上网浏览的每一张图片。
examples.trans: Including every single image you browse online.

examples.text: 请为演示文稿配上清晰的高清图片。
examples.trans: Please illustrate the slide deck with crisp images.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tú zhǐ. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张图纸 ('a blueprint').

examples.text: 看合页边露出来的折纸图纸——一楼画着一扇暗门！
examples.trans: Look at the folded blueprint sticking out of the hinge—a hidden door is drawn on the ground floor!

examples.text: 桌子上摊开着一张老房子的建筑图纸。
examples.trans: An architectural blueprint of the old house is spread out on the table.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuán. Describes round tables, seals, or shapes.

examples.text: 这面圆镜子挂哪儿？窗户左边还是右边？
examples.trans: Where should I hang this round mirror? Left of the window or right?

examples.text: 院子中间有一张圆木桌。
examples.trans: There is a round wooden table in the middle of the courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuán yuán. Affectionate reduplication of 圆 ('round'), followed by 的 (圆圆的月亮 'round full moon').

examples.text: 盘子里放着四个圆圆的黄柠檬。
examples.trans: Four plump round yellow lemons sit on the plate.

examples.text: 中秋节晚上，圆圆的月亮挂在院子上方。
examples.trans: On Mid-Autumn night, a round full moon hangs above the courtyard.

圆润.gloss: mellow and round (of tone or shape)

meanings.en: mellow and round (of tone or shape)
meanings.note: Pinyin: yuán rùn. Combines 圆 ('round/full') + 润 ('smooth/mellow/moist'), used for resonant musical tone, singing voices, or polished jade and wood.

examples.text: 修好后的中央瑞音既清亮又圆润，一点杂音都没有。
examples.trans: After the repair, middle D sounds both clear and mellow, without a trace of buzz.

examples.text: 这把旧小提琴的音色非常圆润，最适合拉抒情的圆舞曲。
examples.trans: This old violin has a wonderfully mellow tone, ideal for playing lyrical waltzes.

examples.text: 所以我们的美国之行圆满了，辛苦了。
examples.trans: That brings our overseas trip to a fulfilling close — thank you for all your hard work.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuán wǔ qǔ. Compound from 圆 ('circle') + 舞 ('dance') + 曲 ('musical piece'). Measure word: 首 (shǒu).

examples.text: 宋老师在钢琴上弹了一首轻快的圆舞曲。
examples.trans: Teacher Song played a lively waltz on the piano.

examples.text: 这首老圆舞曲让人想起三十年前的晚茶会。
examples.trans: This old waltz brings back memories of evening tea gatherings thirty years ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: quān. Counts full turns of a key, wrench, or lap around a block (一圈 'one full turn').

examples.text: 一圈，两圈……看新铜螺纹咬合得多干净。
examples.trans: One turn, two turns... look how cleanly the new brass thread fits.

examples.text: 我绕着广场走了一圈。
examples.trans: I walked one lap around the square.

examples.text: 这点我深有体会。我在这个圈子混了二十年了，这样的改版方案我前所未见。
examples.trans: I know that firsthand. In twenty years in this industry, I have never seen a revamp proposal like this.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Colloquial noun quānlǐrén ('someone in the entertainment circle').

examples.text: 大家都是圈里人，规矩都懂。
examples.trans: We are all industry insiders and know the rules.

examples.text: 这话只有熟悉内情的圈里人才听得懂。
examples.trans: Only insiders who know the backstory catch that meaning.

圣意.gloss: imperial will; what the top boss secretly wants (humorous)

meanings.en: imperial will; what the top boss secretly wants (humorous)
meanings.note: Court-drama term used jokingly in 揣摩圣意.

examples.text: 与其整天揣摩圣意，不如脚踏实地做出好作品。
examples.trans: Rather than guessing the boss's mind all day, build solid work.

examples.text: 宫斗剧里的大臣最擅长察言观色、揣摩圣意。

meanings.note: Verb zàihu ('care about, mind').

meanings.note: Verb zàiyú ('consist in, hinge on').

examples.text: 他从来不在意别人怎么议论他。

在我看来.gloss: in my view, as I see it

meanings.note: Adjective zàixiào ('enrolled on campus').

meanings.note: Logged in and reachable in real time.

examples.text: 总决赛期间，指挥系统要求全员保持在线。

examples.text: 有问题随时发消息，我今晚一直在线。
examples.trans: Message anytime if issues arise—I am online all night.

meanings.en: on the floor; on the ground

meanings.note: Pinyin: dì xià shì. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间地下室 ('a cellar').

meanings.note: Pinyin: dì tǎn. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块地毯 ('a rug').

examples.text: 老陈，你账本里夹着的那张塑封卡片是什么？
examples.trans: Chen, what is that laminated card tucked inside your ledger?

examples.text: 小晴把新印好的咖啡馆菜单塑封起来，就不怕茶水弄湿了。
examples.trans: Qing laminated the newly printed café menus so spilled tea cannot get them wet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sāi. Used for slipping a note into an envelope or plugging a gap.

examples.text: 小晴，把床单角塞紧！放上两个软枕头。
examples.trans: Qing, tuck the sheet corner tight! On go the two soft pillows.

examples.text: 快把那张纸折起来，塞进口袋里。
examples.trans: Fold up that sheet of paper right now and tuck it into your pocket.

填空.gloss: fill in the blanks; serve as an emotional stand-in

meanings.en: fill in the blanks; serve as an emotional stand-in
meanings.note: Literally filling exam blanks; figuratively filling lonely gaps.

examples.text: 感情需要真诚，谁也不愿只做别人孤单时用来填空的替代品。
examples.trans: Love needs sincerity—no one wants to be a mere stand-in.

examples.text: 请用合适的词语把句子里的空白处填空。
examples.trans: Please fill in the blanks in the sentence with suitable words.

meanings.note: Noun jìngjiè ('level of attainment').

examples.text: 把对手变成朋友，这是危机公关的最高境界。
examples.trans: Turning rivals into allies is peak crisis PR.

examples.text: 艺术创作需要不断追求更高的境界。
examples.trans: Creative work means striving for higher mastery.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiáng. Measure word (量词): 堵 (dǔ), e.g. 一堵墙 ('a wall').

examples.text: 拐弯小心点，别碰到墙！
examples.trans: Careful on the turn—do not bump the wall!

examples.text: 当然记得！每到星期五弹错一个音，他就对着墙皱眉头。
examples.trans: Of course I remember! Every Friday when he missed a note, he frowned at the wall.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiáng shang. Measure word (量词): 面 (miàn), e.g. 一面墙上 ('on a wall surface').

examples.text: 墙上也没镜子，地上没铺地毯有点空。
examples.trans: No mirror on the wall either, and the floor feels bare without a rug.

examples.text: 墙上挂着一幅成都老街的画。
examples.trans: A picture of an old Chengdu lane hangs on the wall.

related.gloss: on a wall surface (measure word 面)

墙边.gloss: beside the wall; against the wall

meanings.en: beside the wall; against the wall
meanings.note: Pinyin: qiáng biān. Combines 墙 ('wall') + locality suffix 边 ('side/edge').

examples.text: 打磨好的四扇窗板正靠在院子墙边。
examples.trans: The four sanded shutters are leaning beside the courtyard wall.

examples.text: 墙边种着一排翠绿的常春藤。
examples.trans: A row of emerald-green ivy is planted along the wall.

meanings.note: Verb zēngjiā ('increase').

examples.text: 双败淘汰制大大增加了新秀的出镜率。
examples.trans: Double elimination greatly boosts newcomers' screen time.

examples.text: 新环节为整场晚会增加了不少悬念。
examples.trans: The new segment added plenty of suspense to the gala.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mò shuǐ. Liquid writing ink for fountain pens. Measure word: 瓶 (píng, 'bottle').

examples.text: 这页旧信是用深蓝色墨水写的。
examples.trans: This old letter page was written in dark blue ink.

examples.text: 桌上的钢笔没墨水了，我得去加一点。
examples.trans: The fountain pen on the desk is out of ink; I need to refill it.

meanings.en: sound; voice; measure word for sounds
meanings.note: Pinyin: shēng. Counts cries, knocks, or chimes (一声 'one sound').

examples.text: 来不及了！他说了声谢谢就挂断了！
examples.trans: Too late! He said thank you and hung up!

examples.text: 非常安静！不过刚才你听到奇怪的金属敲击声了吗？
examples.trans: Very quiet! Though did you hear a strange metallic knocking sound just now?

meanings.note: Pinyin: shēng xué. Measure word (量词): 门 (mén), e.g. 一门声学 ('the field of acoustics').

examples.text: 你的服务值得十分！其实我是声学建筑师。
examples.trans: Your service deserves ten points! Actually, I am an acoustic architect.

examples.text: 声学建筑师！您设计音乐厅吗？
examples.trans: An acoustic architect! Do you design concert halls?

related.gloss: the field of acoustics (measure word 门)

meanings.note: Noun/verb shēngmíng ('official statement').

examples.text: 今天早上他们发了官方声明。
examples.trans: They posted an official statement this morning.

examples.text: 声明说昨晚只是一个意外。
examples.trans: The statement says last night was an accident.

meanings.note: Formal noun shēngyù ('good name, public standing').

examples.text: 我们电视台是行业第一，声誉很重要。
examples.trans: Our network leads the industry, and prestige matters.

examples.text: 一部好作品为公司赢得了良好的声誉。
examples.trans: A strong show earned the company high prestige.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shēng yīn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个声音 ('a voice / sound').

examples.text: 声音客气吗？年轻人还是老人？
examples.trans: Was the voice polite? A young person or an older person?

examples.text: 声音轻，很有礼貌，大概三十多岁，有点紧张。
examples.trans: Soft-spoken, very polite, around thirty-something, and a bit nervous.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a noun used in conversational Mandarin. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个壳 ('a 壳').

examples.text: 我有一个壳。
examples.trans: I have a 壳.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的壳。
examples.trans: This is a very good 壳.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hú. Spouted vessel for tea, milk, or water (茶壶 'teapot', 牛奶壶 'milk jug'); also used as a measure word ('a pot of').

examples.text: 白色茶壶旁边放着一个小牛奶壶。
examples.trans: Beside the white teapot sits a small milk jug.

examples.text: 客人刚坐下，小晴就泡了一壶热花茶。
examples.trans: As soon as the guests sat down, Qing brewed a pot of hot flower tea.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hú zuǐ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个壶嘴 ('a teapot spout').

examples.text: 小心，周经理，壶嘴很宽！
examples.trans: Careful, Manager Zhou, the pitcher spout is wide!

examples.text: 倒茶的时候留神壶嘴里的热气。
examples.trans: Mind the steam from the spout when pouring tea.

meanings.note: Verb chǔ ('get along with') or noun chù ('office').

examples.text: 你在学生会不是关系处得挺好的吗？
examples.trans: Did you not get along great in the student union?

examples.text: 邻居之间处得像一家人。
examples.trans: The neighbours get along like family.

examples.text: 几天前我确实是单身，没有处在任何情感关系中，更没有结过婚。
examples.trans: Up until a few days ago I really was single — not in any relationship, and certainly never married.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 我欣赏的生活态度，就是不管你身处在什么处境，你都要做最好的自己。
examples.trans: The life attitude I admire is striving to be your very best self, no matter what circumstances you are in.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

处处.gloss: everywhere, in every respect, at every turn

meanings.en: everywhere, in every respect, at every turn
meanings.note: Reduplicated adverb emphasizing pervasiveness.

examples.text: 这位前辈在工作中处处照顾刚入行的新人。
examples.trans: This senior colleague looks out for newcomers at every turn.

examples.text: 好的节目策划在细节上处处体现着巧思。
examples.trans: A strong show proposal reveals thoughtful touches everywhere.

meanings.note: Workplace verb chǔlǐ.

examples.text: 事情都处理完了。
examples.trans: Everything has been handled.

examples.text: 我马上处理这件事。
examples.trans: I will handle this right away.

examples.text: 星天娱乐一直是备受投资界关注的明星企业，公司估值一度突破百亿。
examples.trans: Xingtian Entertainment has long been a star company watched closely by investors, with its valuation once topping ten billion.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

备受瞩目.gloss: attract intense public attention, highly anticipated

meanings.en: attract intense public attention, highly anticipated
meanings.note: Four-character phrase common in entertainment news.

examples.text: 这部备受瞩目的古装大剧终于公布了主演名单。
examples.trans: This highly anticipated costume drama finally unveiled its cast.

examples.text: 年度战略大会在全公司的备受瞩目中拉开帷幕。
examples.trans: The annual strategy summit opened under company-wide scrutiny.

examples.text: 他一手把真的合同递到了法务，一手把假的授权列表备案到我们版权库里头。
examples.trans: With one hand he sent the real contract to legal, and with the other he logged a fake song list into our copyright database.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bèi zhù. Combines 备 ('for reference') + 注 ('note/annotation') in ledgers, forms, or margins.

examples.text: 姑姑在登记本下面写了一行清楚的备注。
examples.trans: My aunt wrote a clear note at the bottom of the guest book.

examples.text: 请在订单备注里写明不要放糖。
examples.trans: Please write 'no sugar' in the order notes.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bèi yòng. Describes a spare key, spare bulb, or backup plan.

examples.text: 工具箱里有备用的铜阀门吗？
examples.trans: Is there a spare brass valve in your toolbox?

examples.text: 两个都买下！留一个备用明年冬天也省心。
examples.trans: Buy both! Keeping a spare saves worry next winter too.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bèi cài. Separable culinary compound 备 ('prepare') + 菜 ('vegetables/dishes'): washing, slicing, and arranging ingredients before cooking.

examples.text: 这是小美在厨房里见过最整齐、最精确的备菜。
examples.trans: This is the neatest, most precise food prep Mei has ever seen in her kitchen.

examples.text: 只要早上把备菜做好，中午客人多的时候就不会手忙脚乱。
examples.trans: As long as food prep is done in the morning, the kitchen won't be flustered during the midday rush.

meanings.note: Verb/noun fùchóu ('revenge').

examples.text: 老大露出了复仇之笑！
examples.trans: The boss just flashed a smile of revenge!

examples.text: 这是一部关于成长与复仇的电影。
examples.trans: This is a film about growth and revenge.

examples.text: 职场里边很复杂，你听我的，先顾自己。
examples.trans: Inside the workplace things are complicated; listen to me and look after yourself first.

examples.text: 这是复杂。
examples.trans: This is 复杂.

meanings.note: Meaning: revival round.

examples.text: 现在吗？复活赛不是明天才录吗？
examples.trans: Right now? Is the revival round not supposed to tape tomorrow?

examples.text: 这是复活赛。
examples.trans: This is 复活赛.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià tiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个夏天 ('a summer').

examples.text: 房东律师寄来的？奇怪——我们房租一直交到明年夏天了。
examples.trans: Sent by the landlord's lawyer? Strange—our rent is paid right through next summer.

examples.text: 夏天坐在大树底下乘凉最舒服。
examples.trans: Sitting in the shade beneath the big tree in summer is bliss.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià rì. Slightly poetic / culinary counterpart to 夏天 ('summer'), common in dish titles like 夏日莓果蛋糕 ('Summer Berry Cake').

examples.text: 卡片上用蓝钢笔写着“夏日莓果杏仁小院蛋糕”。
examples.trans: Written in blue fountain pen on the card is 'Summer Berry and Almond Courtyard Cake'.

examples.text: 一杯冰镇薄荷茶最适合晴朗的夏日午后。
examples.trans: A glass of chilled mint tea is ideal for a bright summer afternoon.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wài. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个外面 ('an outside area').

examples.text: 等等——现在十米外的院子里坐着谁？
examples.trans: Wait—who is sitting ten metres away in our courtyard right now?

examples.text: 门外站着一位拿箱子的客人。
examples.trans: A guest holding a suitcase is standing outside the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wài cè. Place noun 外 ('outer') + 侧 ('side/flank'); contrasts with 内侧 ('inner side').

examples.text: 我的骨头没事，就是右脚踝外侧稍微扭了一下。
examples.trans: My bones are fine—I just twisted the outer side of my right ankle slightly.

examples.text: 老陈在绿窗板的外侧又仔细刷了第二遍防水油漆。
examples.trans: Chen carefully brushed a second coat of weatherproof paint onto the outer side of the green shutters.

meanings.note: Meals ordered via app or phone to home/office.

examples.text: 加班太晚的时候，大家通常一起点份外卖。
examples.trans: When working late, everyone usually orders takeout together.

examples.text: 门铃响了，应该是刚才订的外卖送到了。
examples.trans: The doorbell rang—the takeout we ordered must be here.

examples.text: 杰瑞，是我。我有一个外卡歌手，需要参加第一期的录制。
examples.trans: Hello? It's me — I have a wild-card singer who needs to join our Episode One taping.

examples.text: 外卡？每个导师确实有个外卡名额，但是你之前已经放弃了。
examples.trans: A wild card? Every mentor does get one wild-card spot, except you already waived yours earlier.

examples.text: 有个事情找你帮个忙，惠美想安排个外卡歌手。
examples.trans: I need a favor from you — Huimei wants to add a wild-card singer to tonight's show.

meanings.note: Informal descriptive name given by peers or fans.

examples.text: 因为他作风强硬果断，业内给他起了个魔鬼鱼的外号。
examples.trans: His tough, decisive style earned him the nickname Manta Ray.

examples.text: 他在海外版权圈很熟，大家都叫他伦敦灵这个外号。
examples.trans: Well-connected in UK licensing, he picked up the moniker London Ling.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wài guó. Combines 外 ('outside/foreign') + 国 ('country'); used as an attributive modifier in 外国明信片 ('foreign postcard').

examples.text: 刚才邮递员往门口信箱里塞了一张厚厚的外国明信片。
examples.trans: Just now the postman slipped a thick foreign postcard into the gate mailbox.

examples.text: 许多外国客人也喜欢坐在院子的大梧桐树下喝热茶。
examples.trans: Many foreign guests also love sitting under the big courtyard plane tree drinking hot tea.

meanings.note: Noun wàiguórén ('foreign national').

examples.text: 尤其是当着外国人的面，别太严苛。
examples.trans: Avoid being overly harsh, especially in front of foreign guests.

examples.text: 现场安排了同声传译协助几位外国人。
examples.trans: Simultaneous interpreters assisted the foreign guests on set.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wài tou. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 外头院子 ('the space outside').

examples.text: 有人吗？晚上好！大门前根本没人啊！
examples.trans: Hello? Good evening! Nobody is standing at the gate!

examples.text: 周经理，看院子窗户外头——有人跑进大门了！
examples.trans: Manager Zhou, look out the courtyard window—someone just ran in the gate!

meanings.note: Pinyin: wài tào. Measure word (量词): 件 (jiàn), e.g. 一件外套 ('a coat').

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

examples.text: 不怪你们。只是我身上只有这件外套！
examples.trans: It is not your fault. Still, I only have this one coat on me!

meanings.note: Production noun wàijǐngdì ('on-location shoot site').

examples.text: 咱们下个礼拜就要飞去外景地拍摄了。
examples.trans: Next week we fly out to shoot at the filming location.

examples.text: 制片组提前考察了三个海边外景地。
examples.trans: Production scouted three coastal locations ahead of time.

meanings.note: Verb wàiliú ('leak out to outsiders').

examples.text: 拍摄素材外流是行业大忌。
examples.trans: Leaking raw footage outside is an industry taboo.

examples.text: 公司严禁内部资料外流。
examples.trans: The company strictly forbids leaking internal files.

meanings.note: Noun wàijiè ('outside observers, public').

examples.text: 外界都觉得他在公司混得春风得意。
examples.trans: Outsiders all assume he is thriving effortlessly here.

examples.text: 不要让未证实的消息传到外界去。
examples.trans: Do not let unverified rumours leak to the public.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wài pí. Measure word (量词): 层 (céng), e.g. 一层外皮 ('an outer crust').

examples.text: 正在架子上放凉呢——金黄外皮配甜柠檬糖霜！
examples.trans: Cooling on the rack right now—golden crust with sweet lemon glaze!

examples.text: 法式面包烤得外皮金黄香脆。
examples.trans: The bread baked up with a golden, crisp crust.

meanings.note: Formal modifier for foreign citizens or artists.

examples.text: 节目组邀请了两位外籍音乐人担任特邀嘉宾。
examples.trans: The crew invited two foreign musicians as special guests.

examples.text: 聘请外籍艺人需要提前办理相关演出手续。
examples.trans: Hiring foreign artists requires filing performance permits in advance.

meanings.note: location noun meaning on the outside

examples.text: 我说的关门，是在外边把门关上。
examples.trans: When I said close the door, I meant close it from the outside.

examples.text: 请大家先在走廊外边等候。
examples.trans: Everyone please wait outside in the corridor first.

meanings.note: Locative noun wàibù ('external forces').

examples.text: 现在有了外部力量推动，我们不妨试试。
examples.trans: With outside forces pushing reform, let us give it a try.

examples.text: 公司同时邀请了外部专家参与评审。
examples.trans: The firm also invited outside experts onto the jury.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wài mian. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 外面世界 ('the outside').

examples.text: 外面一模一样，可是你看里面！
examples.trans: The outside is identical, yet look inside!

examples.text: 外面下着大雨，街上酒店全满了！我们怎么办？
examples.trans: It is pouring rain outside and every hotel on the street is full! What do we do?

meanings.note: Pinyin: duō. Means 'many' as an adjective, 'how…?' before adjectives (多大), or 'more than' after round numbers (三十多).

examples.text: 声音轻，很有礼貌，大概三十多岁，有点紧张。
examples.trans: Soft-spoken, very polite, around thirty-something, and a bit nervous.

examples.text: 说实话，我比以前灰色办公室喜欢这儿多了。
examples.trans: Honestly, I like this place far better than my old grey office.

examples.text: 我也想问一下，实习多久才可以来这儿工作？
examples.trans: I would also like to ask: how long must we intern before we may work here?

examples.text: 我也想问一下，实习多久才可以来这儿工作？
examples.trans: I would also like to ask: how long must we intern before we may work here?

meanings.note: Pinyin: duō kuī. Gives warm credit for avoiding trouble.

examples.text: 这一周的街道记录全在里面，多亏了你。
examples.trans: All my street notes from this week are inside—thanks to you.

examples.text: 多亏你提醒我，差点忘了拿钥匙。
examples.trans: Thanks to your reminder, I nearly forgot to grab my keys.

meanings.note: Meaning: unnecessary.

examples.text: 我们已经在录制了，担心都是多余的。
examples.trans: We are already taping; all that worry is unnecessary.

examples.text: 这是多余。
examples.trans: This is 多余.

meanings.note: Formal adverb duōjiā ('give extra attention to').

examples.text: 但是您平时一定要多加保重身体！
examples.trans: Still, you really must take extra care of your health!

examples.text: 外景拍摄天气多变，请大家多加留意安全。
examples.trans: Outdoor weather shifts fast, so please take extra care.

meanings.note: Pinyin: duō bàn. Expresses an educated guess ('more than half likely').

examples.text: 多半是粉刷街边木窗那种无聊通知吧。
examples.trans: Probably some boring notice about painting the street shutters.

examples.text: 看天上的云，下午多半要下雨。
examples.trans: Judging by those clouds, it will probably rain this afternoon.

examples.text: 我私人去找她，不会有那么多媒体关注到我。我发誓不会伤害到任何人，你相信我！
examples.trans: I'll visit her privately without going through the company so the media won't notice me. I swear nobody will get hurt — trust me!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: duō shao. Asks about larger numbers, prices, or room/phone numbers (多少钱 'how much money?').

examples.text: 等等，换房间我们给他打多少折？
examples.trans: Wait—what discount do we offer him for changing rooms?

examples.text: 小美，你的烤箱每天早上最多能烤多少肉桂卷和柠檬蛋糕？
examples.trans: Mei, how many cinnamon rolls and lemon cakes can your oven bake each morning?

meanings.note: Pinyin: duōnián. Temporal expression often used adverbially before a verb (多年攒下), with 来 as 多年来 ('for many years now'), or after 这么/那么 as a duration complement (这么多年).

examples.text: 这些资源都是我多年攒下的。
examples.trans: All of these contacts are ones I saved up over many years.

examples.text: 你做我经纪人这么多年，没想到会做出这种事。
examples.trans: You were my manager for so many years, yet I never thought you would do this.

related.gloss: over the years; for many years now
all year round; year after year

meanings.note: Colloquial predicate duōzhene ('loads of, far more than a little').

examples.text: 快去吧，总编室那边事情多着呢。
examples.trans: Hurry over; there is plenty of work in that office.

examples.text: 想上这档节目的歌手多着呢。
examples.trans: Singers wanting on this show are countless.

examples.text: 你听错了吧，你别多管闲事啊。
examples.trans: You must have misheard; do not go meddling in other people's business.

examples.text: 这是多管闲事。
examples.trans: This is 多管闲事.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yè. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个夜晚 ('a night').

examples.text: 等周经理听说他为分贝慌了一整夜，表情一定精彩！
examples.trans: Wait until Manager Zhou hears he panicked all night over decibels!

examples.text: 雨夜里，客栈的灯光很温暖。
examples.trans: On a rainy night, the inn's lamplight feels warm.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yè kōng. Measure word (量词): 片 (piàn), e.g. 一片夜空 ('an expanse of night sky').

examples.text: 抬头看夜空下那些金色灯笼——真宁静啊！
examples.trans: Look up at those golden lanterns against the night sky—how peaceful!

examples.text: 雨停以后，夜空格外干净。
examples.trans: After the rain stopped, the night sky looked remarkably clear.

related.gloss: an expanse of night sky (measure word 片)

夜里.gloss: at night, late in the night

meanings.en: at night, late in the night
meanings.note: The middle of the night.

examples.text: 昨天夜里下了一场很大的雨。
examples.trans: A heavy rain fell late last night.

examples.text: 夜里气温低，出门记得多穿件外套。
examples.trans: Temperatures drop at night, so wear an extra jacket.

meanings.note: adverb

examples.text: 职场是一个火锅，想想真的够吓人的。
examples.trans: The workplace is a hotpot; just thinking about it is scary enough.

examples.text: 职场是一个火锅，想想真的够吓人的。
examples.trans: The workplace is a hotpot; just thinking about it is scary enough.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gòu dào. Resultative compound 够 ('stretch/reach') + 到 ('attain').

examples.text: 站在木梯子上就能轻松够到顶上的拱窗。
examples.trans: Standing on the wooden ladder, you can easily reach the top arched window.

examples.text: 书架最高那一层太高了，我够不到。
examples.trans: The top shelf of the bookcase is too high; I cannot reach it.

meanings.note: Praise for a friend who really comes through.

examples.text: 百忙之中还帮我带礼物，你真够意思！
examples.trans: Bringing me gifts amid your crazy trip—you are a true pal!

examples.text: 关键时刻不掉链子，这朋友太够意思了。
examples.trans: Coming through when it counts makes him a solid friend.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà. Everyday adjective for size, age, and strong wind or rain.

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 两双棕色大男鞋，还有灰色毛衣。
examples.trans: Two pairs of big brown men's shoes, plus grey sweaters.

meanings.note: Phrase dàbuliǎo ('at worst; a big deal').

examples.text: 没什么大不了的，别怕。
examples.trans: It is no big deal; do not be afraid.

examples.text: 大不了我们从头再来。
examples.trans: At worst, we start over from scratch.

examples.text: 这是大事啊。
examples.trans: This is major event.

examples.text: 那个大事好。
examples.trans: That major event is good.

meanings.note: Noun dàrénwù ('influential figure').

examples.text: 连粉丝团的大人物你都不知道吗？
examples.trans: Do you not even know the VIPs of the fan club?

examples.text: 今晚来了好几位行业大人物。
examples.trans: Several industry heavyweights came tonight.

meanings.note: Noun dàzhòng ('the public, audiences').

examples.text: 大众关心的是艺人之间的绯闻。
examples.trans: What the public cares about is celebrity gossip.

examples.text: 这档节目很受大众欢迎。
examples.trans: This show is very popular with the public.

meanings.note: Colloquial collective pronoun dàhuǒ ('everybody in the group').

examples.text: 吃鱼成了一部大伙的惯例。
examples.trans: Eating fish became a tradition for everyone in Unit One.

examples.text: 大伙一起努力把节目做好。
examples.trans: Everyone pitched in together to make the show great.

meanings.note: Warm erhua form of 大伙.

examples.text: 这件事连累了您，大伙儿心里都过意不去。
examples.trans: Dragging you into this left everybody feeling bad.

examples.text: 天色不早了，大伙儿赶紧收拾东西回家吧。
examples.trans: It is getting late—everybody pack up and head home.

examples.text: 董事会已经要求召开董事大会问责。
examples.trans: And Xingtian's board has demanded an emergency board meeting to assign blame.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Colloquial noun dàlǎo ('powerful tycoon/boss').

examples.text: 你不怕我的那些富豪大佬吗？
examples.trans: Are you not afraid of those moguls rumoured around me?

examples.text: 晚会现场来了不少影视行业的大佬。
examples.trans: Quite a few film and TV moguls attended the gala.

meanings.note: Diplomatic mission representing a country abroad.

examples.text: 遇到海外突发事件，首先要联系当地大使馆。
examples.trans: In an overseas emergency, contact the local embassy first.

examples.text: 工作人员正在向大使馆核实最新的安全消息。
examples.trans: Staff are checking the latest safety updates with the embassy.

大做文章.gloss: make a huge fuss over, exploit an issue for drama

meanings.en: make a huge fuss over, exploit an issue for drama
meanings.note: Idiom for blowing up a topic to serve an agenda.

examples.text: 八卦媒体最喜欢抓着艺人的一点私事大做文章。
examples.trans: Tabloids love seizing on a tiny personal detail to stir up drama.

examples.text: 竞争对手借着这次延播事故在媒体上大做文章。
examples.trans: Rivals seized on the broadcast delay to stir up media fanfare.

meanings.note: Giving strong backing or effort to an action.

examples.text: 领导在会上大力支持我们的想法。
examples.trans: Management strongly backed our idea at the meeting.

examples.text: 公司正在大力培养年轻制作人。
examples.trans: The company is vigorously training young producers.

examples.text: 你真的不用这么大动干戈。
examples.trans: You truly didn't need to go to such extraordinary lengths.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 你来这儿大半年了，在幸福面前，何必考虑什么人事压力？
examples.trans: You've worked here over half a year amid constant gossip — in the face of happiness, why worry about office politics?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 国际大单被退约，收入损失是小，可如果损害了她的声誉，会对以后的事业造成长远的影响。
examples.trans: Losing the fee is minor, whereas lasting damage to her reputation will hurt her entire career.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà tīng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个大厅 ('a lobby').

examples.text: 大厅的灯黑了！我把厨房的烤箱也弄坏了吗？
examples.trans: The lobby lamp went dark! Did I break the kitchen oven too?

examples.text: 客人在大厅里等您。
examples.trans: A guest is waiting for you in the lobby.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà chú. Combines 大 ('great/head') + 厨 ('cook/chef'); measure word: 位 (wèi).

examples.text: 那太好了，大厨，我们刚从集市买回四十个新鲜柠檬。
examples.trans: Good thing too, chef, because we just brought back forty fresh lemons from the market.

examples.text: 大家都夸小美是我们这条巷子里最厉害的甜点大厨。
examples.trans: Everyone praises Mei as the finest pastry chef on our whole lane.

meanings.note: Phrase dàfǎnzhuǎn ('complete reversal of expectations').

examples.text: 谁也没想到这起事件最后结局大反转。
examples.trans: Nobody expected a complete turnaround at the end.

examples.text: 比赛最后一轮出现了精彩的大反转。
examples.trans: A thrilling turnaround unfolded in the final round.

examples.text: 谁是大叔？
examples.trans: Who are you calling an older uncle?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Polite noun dàmíng ('renowned name').

examples.text: 在学校的时候就听说过你的大名了。
examples.trans: I heard of your famous name back in college.

examples.text: 久闻您的大名，今天终于见面了。
examples.trans: I have heard so much about you and finally meet you today.

大吵.gloss: have a loud quarrel, argue fiercely

meanings.en: have a loud quarrel, argue fiercely
meanings.note: Heated argument with raised voices.

examples.text: 因为理念不合，两人在会议室里大吵了一架。
examples.trans: Clashing over creative vision, the two had a loud row in the meeting room.

examples.text: 冲动大吵解决不了问题，只会伤害彼此的感情。
examples.trans: Arguing loudly on impulse solves nothing and only hurts feelings.

meanings.note: Entertainment slang dàkā ('major celebrity, heavyweight').

examples.text: 最让人期待的大咖其实还在后面。
examples.trans: The biggest A-listers everyone awaits are still to come.

examples.text: 今晚的盛典请来了不少业内大咖。
examples.trans: Tonight's gala invited many industry heavyweights.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà gē. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位大哥 ('an older brother').

examples.text: 哈！你怕签了名字，倔脾气大哥就不出门了！
examples.trans: Aha! You feared that if you signed your name, stubborn big brother would stay home!

examples.text: 而且大哥想装作镇定的时候，绝对不会早到。
examples.trans: Besides, when older brothers want to act calm, they never arrive early.

meanings.en: lobby; main hall (of an inn or hotel)
meanings.note: Pinyin: dà táng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个大堂 ('a lobby').

examples.text: 满分十分给九分？！没人会去测量庭院，除非……
examples.trans: Nine out of ten?! Nobody measures courtyards unless...

examples.text: 您尽管看，宋老师。星期一下午大堂暗。
examples.trans: Go right ahead, Teacher Song. Monday afternoon the lobby was dim.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà shēng. Combines 大 ('big/loud') + 声 ('voice/sound'); modifies verbs of speaking or reading directly (大声念 'read aloud').

examples.text: 小晴，把木牌上的字大声念给我听听吧。
examples.trans: Qing, read the words on the wooden sign aloud for me to hear.

examples.text: 周经理在院子里大声宣布九号房咖啡角正式通过了审核。
examples.trans: In the courtyard, Manager Zhou announced aloud that the Room Nine café corner had officially passed the review.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà dà. Reduplication of 大 ('big/wide'); before 地 + verb (大大地打开), means 'wide open / generously'.

examples.text: 把拱窗大大地打开，让大树底下的人都听见钢琴声！
examples.trans: Open the arched windows wide so everyone under the big tree hears the piano!

examples.text: 小晴在红标签上大大地写了一个“糖”字。
examples.trans: Qing wrote a big bold character for 'SUGAR' across the red label.

examples.text: 上大学的时候，为了练习做节目。
examples.trans: Back in university, I wanted practice organizing a live program.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Noun dàxuéshēng ('college student').

examples.text: 台里常请在校大学生做前排观众。
examples.trans: The station often invites college students as audience.

examples.text: 这群大学生充满了活力。
examples.trans: These college students are full of energy.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà jiā. Warm collective pronoun including everyone in the group.

examples.text: 大家早上好！欢迎你，小晴。都准备好了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning, everyone! Welcome, Qing. Is everything ready?

examples.text: 有进步！今天小院迎接兄弟重逢——大家保持安静端庄！
examples.trans: Progress! Today our courtyard hosts a brotherly reunion—quiet dignity from everyone!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà xiǎo. Antonymic abstract noun combining 大 ('big') + 小 ('small') to mean 'relative size'.

examples.text: 大小一样的胡萝卜丁在锅里熟得一样快。
examples.trans: Carrot cubes of the exact same size cook through at the exact same speed in the pot.

examples.text: 这四块亚麻桌布的大小正好配九号房的方木桌。
examples.trans: The size of these four linen tablecloths fits Room Nine's square wooden tables just right.

meanings.note: Noun dàjú ('overall control or bigger picture').

examples.text: 公司内部到底是谁占大局？
examples.trans: Inside the company, who holds overall sway?

examples.text: 关键时刻每个人都要以公司大局为重。
examples.trans: At crunch moments everyone puts the big picture first.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà shān. Combines 大 ('big/great') + 山 ('mountain'); takes measure word 座.

examples.text: 清晨的薄雾笼罩着远处的座座大山。
examples.trans: Morning mist drapes the distant mountains.

examples.text: 把大难题拆开，大山也会变成小山丘。
examples.trans: Break a big problem apart and even a big mountain turns into small hills.

meanings.note: Noun dàbā ('large passenger coach').

examples.text: 歌手和助演团队坐同一辆大巴赶往会场。
examples.trans: The singers and backing crew rode the same coach toward the venue.

examples.text: 剧组包了两辆大巴接送群演往返摄影棚。
examples.trans: Production chartered two coaches to shuttle extras to the studio.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà shī. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位大师 ('a master').

examples.text: 听听保养大师说的！昨天修热水器，今天修两兄弟！
examples.trans: Listen to the maintenance master! Yesterday fixing the boiler, today fixing two brothers!

examples.text: 那位木匠真是一位修老家具的大师。
examples.trans: That carpenter is truly a master at restoring old furniture.

examples.text: 见到你的大师兄了，感觉怎么样？
examples.trans: Now that you have met your senior alumnus, how does it feel?

examples.text: 见到你的大师兄了，感觉怎么样？
examples.trans: Now that you have met your senior alumnus, how does it feel?

examples.text: 已有行业分析师论断，此事必将造成星天娱乐股权整合及上市进程大幅拖慢。
examples.trans: Industry analysts warn the lawsuit will severely delay Xingtian's share restructuring and public listing.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Noun dàjì ('strictly forbidden mistake').

examples.text: 拍摄素材外流是电视行业的大忌。
examples.trans: Leaking raw footage is a grave taboo in television.

examples.text: 直播迟到是主持人的大忌。
examples.trans: Arriving late for a live show is a host's worst taboo.

meanings.note: Friendly teasing term for someone swamped with requests.

examples.text: 你这个大忙人今天怎么有空来喝咖啡了？
examples.trans: How did a busy bee like you find time for coffee today?

examples.text: 总监不在公司，他一下子成了各部门争抢的大忙人。
examples.trans: With the chief away, he suddenly became the busiest man in demand.

meanings.note: Verb/adjective dàyi ('underestimate, be careless').

examples.text: 原以为这是个容易的突破口，没想到大意了。
examples.trans: I thought she was an easy target — clearly I misjudged.

examples.text: 越是熟悉的流程越不能粗心大意。
examples.trans: Never get careless even on familiar routines.

大战.gloss: wage a major battle, work flat out through

meanings.en: wage a major battle, work flat out through
meanings.note: Used figuratively for intense work marathons.

examples.text: 制作组在海外连续大战了半个月才杀青。
examples.trans: The crew battled flat out overseas for half a month to wrap.

examples.text: 今晚大家又要通宵大战剪辑室了。
examples.trans: Tonight everyone will battle through an all-nighter in editing.

大批.gloss: large batch of, huge number of

meanings.en: large batch of, huge number of
meanings.note: Modifies people, artists, or goods.

examples.text: 合并之后公司旗下拥有大批优秀的年轻歌手。
examples.trans: After the merger, the agency represented scores of talented young singers.

examples.text: 预告片上线后吸引了大批忠实观众留言支持。
examples.trans: Once the trailer went live, crowds of loyal viewers left supportive comments.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà mǔ zhǐ. Measure word (量词): 根 (gēn), e.g. 一根大拇指 ('a thumb'). Literally 'big mother-finger'.

examples.text: 用一根大拇指轻轻按住铁盒盖子中间，再平平地往上提。
examples.trans: Press the centre of the tin lid gently with one thumb, then lift straight and evenly.

examples.text: 尝了一口蜂蜜蛋糕，老陈微笑着竖起了大拇指。
examples.trans: After tasting a bite of the honey cake, Chen smiled and gave a thumbs-up.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà fang. Praises generous hospitality or natural poise.

examples.text: 真大方！你们听到楼下大门门铃了吗？
examples.trans: How generous! Did you hear the front gate bell downstairs?

examples.text: 小姑娘说话做事都很大方。
examples.trans: The young woman speaks and carries herself with natural poise.

大早上.gloss: crack of dawn, bright and early

meanings.en: crack of dawn, bright and early
meanings.note: Colloquial time noun dàzǎoshang ('first thing in the morning').

examples.text: 谁让你们大早上不打招呼就来拍的？
examples.trans: Who told you to barge in filming at the crack of dawn?

examples.text: 大早上六点化妆间就已经热闹起来了。
examples.trans: By six in the morning the dressing room was already bustling.

meanings.note: Severe rainstorm grade in weather alerts.

examples.text: 气象台提醒市民今晚将有一场大暴雨。
examples.trans: The weather bureau warned residents of a heavy rainstorm tonight.

examples.text: 大暴雨来临前必须加固所有户外设备。
examples.trans: All outdoor gear must be secured before the torrential rain hits.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà gài. Estimates quantities or likelihood.

examples.text: 声音轻，很有礼貌，大概三十多岁，有点紧张。
examples.trans: Soft-spoken, very polite, around thirty-something, and a bit nervous.

examples.text: 从这儿走到药店大概只要五分钟。
examples.trans: Walking from here to the pharmacy takes roughly five minutes.

meanings.note: Colloquial adj/noun dàpái ('big-name celebrity').

examples.text: 他们公司多大牌艺人没签过呀？
examples.trans: What big-name artist has their agency not signed before?

examples.text: 这档音乐节目邀请了好几位大牌歌手。
examples.trans: This music show invited several A-list singers.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà bái huà. Measure word (量词): 句 (jù), e.g. 一句大白话 ('plain talk').

examples.text: 请用大白话说！第十四条写了什么？
examples.trans: In plain words, please! What does Clause fourteen say?

examples.text: 律师用最简单的大白话解释了那条法规。
examples.trans: The lawyer explained that legal clause in plain everyday language.

大红人.gloss: huge star, hot favourite of the moment

meanings.en: huge star, hot favourite of the moment
meanings.note: Someone currently enjoying peak popularity or favour.

examples.text: 自从新节目播出，他成了圈里的大红人。
examples.trans: Since the new show aired, he has become a huge star in the circle.

examples.text: 他现在可是公司领导面前的大红人。
examples.trans: Right now he is the big favourite with company leadership.

meanings.note: Media noun dàjiéjú ('series or conflict finale').

examples.text: 主任说明天是大结局，让我离近点看。
examples.trans: My boss called tomorrow the grand finale and told me to watch close.

examples.text: 这部剧今晚八点播出大结局。
examples.trans: This drama airs its grand finale at eight tonight.

meanings.note: Colloquial northern expression for adult men.

examples.text: 几个大老爷们聚在一起聊球赛。
examples.trans: Several grown men gathered to chat about the ballgame.

examples.text: 大老爷们做事就应该痛快一点。
examples.trans: Grown men ought to be straightforward in what they do.

examples.text: 总编室淳于总制作人这次的改版方案非常大胆，我个人非常喜欢。
examples.trans: Chief Producer Chun Yuqiao's revamp proposal from the chief editor's office is remarkably bold, and I personally love it.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Colloquial, often self-deprecating noun.

examples.text: 他笑着说自己小时候是个大胖子。
examples.trans: He joked that he used to be a chubby kid.

examples.text: 坚持运动让他不再是大胖子了。
examples.trans: Sticking to exercise meant he was chubby no longer.

meanings.note: Colloquial showbiz noun dàwàn ('top star').

examples.text: 没事，我们不等大腕还能等谁啊？
examples.trans: No problem—if we do not wait for a big star, who would we wait for?

examples.text: 今年的慈善晚会请来了好几位影视圈大腕。
examples.trans: This year's charity gala invited several screen superstars.

examples.text: 没事，我们不等大腕儿我们等谁啊？
examples.trans: It's fine — if we don't wait for a superstar, who else would we wait for?

examples.text: 这和大腕儿不大腕儿的没什么关系，你知道我工作从来不迟到，今天真的是第一次，实在不好意思。
examples.trans: Superstar or not has nothing to do with it; you know I am never late for work — today is truly my first time, and I'm terribly sorry.

meanings.note: Knowing the main picture without every detail.

examples.text: 我已经大致翻看完了这档新节目的策划案。
examples.trans: I have roughly looked through the proposal for this new show.

examples.text: 两边团队对合作方向已经达成了大致共识。
examples.trans: Both teams have reached broad agreement on the direction.

examples.text: 我的妈呀，大获全胜啊这一季！
examples.trans: Oh my goodness — this season is a total landslide victory!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà jiē. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条大街 ('a main street').

examples.text: 没错。外面大街很吵，进了院子却只听见树叶和小鸟。
examples.trans: Exactly. Outside on the main road it is noisy, yet inside the courtyard you only hear leaves and birds.

examples.text: 出了小巷子就是热闹的大街。
examples.trans: Step out of the small lane and you are on the bustling main street.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà yī. Combines 大 ('large/outer') + 衣 ('garment/coat'); measure word: 件 (jiàn); verb: 穿 (chuān).

examples.text: 周经理站在院子外面的毛毛雨里，连大衣都忘了穿！
examples.trans: Manager Zhou is standing outside in the courtyard drizzle and even forgot to put on his coat!

examples.text: 雨天出门的时候记得穿上一件保暖的厚大衣。
examples.trans: Remember to put on a warm overcoat when heading out in the rain.

examples.text: 按国际大赛规则，怎么样？
examples.trans: Shall we play by international tournament rules?

examples.text: 九年前的著名歌手大赛梦想之声，打造出了流行乐坛的黄金一班。
examples.trans: Nine years ago, the famed singing competition Voice of Dreams forged pop music's legendary Golden Class.

meanings.note: Noun dàdūhuì ('bustling metropolis').

examples.text: 这座梦幻般的大都会骤然陷入暴雨之夜。
examples.trans: This dreamlike metropolis was suddenly plunged into a stormy night.

examples.text: 繁华的大都会里每天都在上演追梦的故事。
examples.trans: Stories of chasing dreams unfold daily in the bustling metropolis.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà mén. Measure word (量词): 扇 (shàn), e.g. 一扇大门 ('a front gate').

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

examples.text: 老陈，你听到了吗？有人按了大门门铃！
examples.trans: Chen, did you hear that? Someone rang the front gate bell!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà mén kǒu. Location noun built from 大门 ('main gate') + 口 ('entranceway').

examples.text: 送货车停在客栈大门口等我们签字。
examples.trans: The delivery van parked at the inn's front gate waiting for us to sign.

examples.text: 大门口的两盆绿植物刚浇过水。
examples.trans: The two pots of green plants by the main gate were just watered.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà yǔ. Measure word (量词): 场 (chǎng), e.g. 一场大雨 ('a heavy rainstorm').

examples.text: 外面下着大雨，街上酒店全满了！我们怎么办？
examples.trans: It is pouring rain outside and every hotel on the street is full! What do we do?

examples.text: 外面的大雨下了整整一个晚上。
examples.trans: The heavy downpour outside lasted the entire night.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà yǔ qīng pén. Four-character set phrase: 大雨 ('heavy rain') + 倾盆 ('upturning a basin').

examples.text: 半夜突然大雨倾盆，幸好我们关好了窗户。
examples.trans: At midnight rain suddenly poured down in torrents; luckily we had shut the windows.

examples.text: 刚跑进走廊，外面就大雨倾盆了。
examples.trans: Just as we ran into the hallway, the sky opened up in a downpour outside.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一整天 ('a whole day').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第二天上班，干得不错，新手。
examples.trans: For day two on the job, nicely done, rookie.

meanings.note: Noun tiānxià ('the world; unmatched realm').

examples.text: 大家都说魔鬼鱼在圈里是天下第一高冷。
examples.trans: Everyone jokes that Manta Ray is the most aloof boss in the world.

examples.text: 好作品靠品质说话，才能真正打动天下观众。
examples.trans: Great shows rely on quality to move audiences everywhere.

meanings.note: Idiom tiānxià dìyī ('unrivalled number one').

examples.text: 节目由天下第一的魔鬼鱼亲自监制。
examples.trans: The show is supervised by the peerless Manta Ray.

examples.text: 他总觉得自己的策划天下第一。
examples.trans: He always thinks his proposals are second to none.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiān liàng. Subject-predicate compound meaning 'daybreak arrives'.

examples.text: 老砖墙保暖，房间到天亮都暖和，放心。
examples.trans: Old brick walls hold heat, so the rooms stay warm until daybreak—don't worry.

examples.text: 雨在天亮以前终于停了。
examples.trans: The rain finally stopped before daybreak.

examples.text: 据悉，诉讼包括歌曲利润所得三倍以上的天价索赔，以及星天娱乐公开道歉。
examples.trans: Reports say the lawsuit demands triple-profit damages along with a formal public apology from Xingtian Entertainment.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

天后.gloss: pop diva, reigning queen of song

meanings.en: pop diva, reigning queen of song
meanings.note: Entertainment noun tiānhòu ('diva').

examples.text: 听天后唱现场，果然价值不菲。
examples.trans: Hearing a pop diva sing live is truly priceless.

examples.text: 这位歌坛天后下个月要开巡回演唱会。
examples.trans: This pop diva kicks off a concert tour next month.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiān na. Natural exclamation of surprise.

examples.text: 天哪！桌子上一滴没洒……全洒在我领带上了！
examples.trans: Good heavens! Not a drop spilled on the table... it all spilled on my tie!

examples.text: 天哪……看这双眼睛！第三级台阶上的小志豪？！
examples.trans: Good heavens... look at those eyes! Little Zhihao from the third step?!

meanings.note: Idiom tiānrǎng zhī bié ('as far apart as heaven and earth').

examples.text: 其他部门和一部相比简直是天壤之别。
examples.trans: Other units are worlds apart compared with Unit One.

examples.text: 专业拍摄和手机跟拍真是天壤之别。
examples.trans: Pro studio shoots and phone clips are worlds apart.

meanings.note: Reduplicated noun tiāntiān functioning adverbially before the verb.

examples.text: 老师天天夸你。
examples.trans: Your teacher praises you every day.

examples.text: 她最近天天熬夜。
examples.trans: She stays up late every day lately.

examples.text: 男友是被誉为天才制作人的淳于乔，出现在大众媒体的面前。
examples.trans: Her boyfriend is none other than genius producer Chun Yuqiao, stepping before the public media together.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiān qì. Measure word (量词): 种 (zhǒng), e.g. 一种好天气 ('pleasant weather').

examples.text: 我在看天气，小美！铃铛旁边这封厚信是谁放的？
examples.trans: I am checking the weather, Mei! Who put this thick letter beside the bell?

examples.text: 今天天气晴朗，最适合晒被子。
examples.trans: Today's weather is bright and sunny—ideal for airing quilts.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiān qì yù bào. Combines 天气 ('weather') + 预报 ('advance report / forecast').

examples.text: 天气预报说星期一整天都会下大雨。
examples.trans: The weather forecast says it will rain heavily all day Monday.

examples.text: 出门刷漆以前，老陈总会先看一眼天气预报。
examples.trans: Before heading out to paint, Chen always checks the weather forecast first.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiān shēng. Describes an inborn gift or temperament.

examples.text: 小晴，你真是天生的店长！我的血压保住了！
examples.trans: Qing, you are a born innkeeper! My blood pressure is saved!

examples.text: 她有一副天生的好嗓子。
examples.trans: She has a naturally lovely voice.

meanings.note: Can be warm ('innocent') or sharp ('naive in business').

examples.text: 商场竞争残酷，想法太天真很容易吃亏。
examples.trans: Business competition is fierce, and naive thinking gets burned easily.

examples.text: 孩子们天真的笑容让现场气氛一下子轻松起来。
examples.trans: The children's innocent smiles lightened the mood on set at once.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiān kōng. Disyllabic noun 天 ('sky/heaven') + 空 ('expanse/air').

examples.text: 擦干净玻璃以后，外面的蓝色天空清楚极了。
examples.trans: After wiping the glass clean, the blue sky outside looked crystal clear.

examples.text: 雨停以后，天空出现了一道彩虹。
examples.trans: After the rain stopped, a rainbow appeared in the sky.

examples.text: 天色晚了，早点回去休息吧。
examples.trans: It's getting late — you should head back early and get some rest.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiān huā bǎn. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块天花板 ('a ceiling panel').

examples.text: 四米宽，六米长，左边是砖墙，上面是木头天花板。
examples.trans: Four metres wide, six metres long, a brick wall on the left, a wooden ceiling above.

examples.text: 太好了！我们去阳光房试试天花板上的灯！
examples.trans: Wonderful! Let's go test the ceiling lamp in the sunroom!

天道.gloss: the Way of Heaven, natural law

meanings.en: the Way of Heaven, natural law
meanings.note: Classical noun tiāndào ('cosmic/natural order').

examples.text: 天道循环，阴阳反背。
examples.trans: The Way of Heaven moves in cycles, and yin and yang reverse.

examples.text: 古人常讲天道酬勤。
examples.trans: Ancients often said Heaven rewards diligence.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tài. Often frames 太 + adj + 了 for warm exclamations (太好了！ 'Wonderful!').

examples.text: 太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
examples.trans: Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

examples.text: 不用担心，淳于乔不会在那个位置上待太久的，总编室早晚是我的！
examples.trans: Don't worry — Chun Yuqiao won't last long in that seat, and the chief editor's office will be mine sooner or later!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 他昨天说到约你喝茶，可能是觉得喝茶太俗了吧。
examples.trans: Yesterday he mentioned inviting you for tea — maybe he felt tea was too ordinary.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a adv used in conversational Mandarin.

examples.text: 我有一个太多。
examples.trans: I have a 太多.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的太多。
examples.trans: This is a very good 太多.

太好了.gloss: wonderful!; that's great!; good thing too!

meanings.en: wonderful!; that's great!; good thing too!
meanings.note: Pinyin: tài hǎo le. Exclamatory frame 太...了 ('so / exceedingly...') around 好 ('good').

examples.text: 那太好了，大厨，我们刚从集市买回四十个新鲜柠檬。
examples.trans: That's wonderful, chef—we just brought back forty fresh lemons from the market.

examples.text: 太好了，雨终于停了，我们可以把折叠椅搬到院子里了！
examples.trans: Wonderful—the rain has finally stopped, so we can carry the folding chairs out into the courtyard!

examples.text: 这一切都太巧了，所有事都太巧了。
examples.trans: All of this is far too coincidental — every single piece lines up too neatly.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Phrase tàiguòhuǒ ('excessive, over the line').

examples.text: 你自己也知道昨晚玩得太过火了吧？
examples.trans: Even you know last night's stunt went way too far, right?

examples.text: 开玩笑不能太过火，免得伤和气。
examples.trans: Never take jokes too far lest feelings get hurt.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tài yáng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个太阳 ('a sun').

examples.text: 热面包，热茶，早上的太阳，一点冷风也没有！
examples.trans: Warm bread, hot tea, morning sun, and not a bit of cold wind!

examples.text: 今天太阳很好，我们去院子里坐坐吧。
examples.trans: The sun is lovely today; let's go and sit in the courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fū qī. Measure word (量词): 对 (duì), e.g. 一对夫妻 ('a married couple').

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

examples.text: 那对老夫妻每年春天都来住一周。
examples.trans: That elderly couple comes to stay for a week every spring.

examples.text: 从法律层面上来讲，这家公司已经违约在先了，所以他们手中的这份合约已经失效。
examples.trans: Legally speaking, the publisher breached its contract first, rendering the agreement in its hands null and void.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Courteous interjection/verb shījìng ('my respects!').

examples.text: 原来您也是双硕士，真是失敬啊！
examples.trans: You hold dual master's degrees too — my respects!

examples.text: 早听说过您的大名，今日一见真是失敬。
examples.trans: Having long heard your name, it is an honour to meet.

examples.text: 老师，我稍微感觉有点失望。
examples.trans: Professor, I feel slightly disappointed.

examples.text: 这是失望。
examples.trans: This is 失望.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shī wù chù. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个失物处 ('a lost-and-found desk').

examples.text: 小晴，马上给火车站失物处打电话。
examples.trans: Qing, call the train station lost-and-found office right away.

examples.text: 火车站失物处每天都会登记客人落下的行李。
examples.trans: The station lost-and-found logs luggage left behind by passengers daily.

失眠.gloss: suffer from insomnia, lie awake unable to sleep

meanings.en: suffer from insomnia, lie awake unable to sleep
meanings.note: Difficulty falling or staying asleep.

examples.text: 大型演出结束以后，歌手很容易因为兴奋而失眠。
examples.trans: After a big concert, singers easily get insomnia from adrenaline.

examples.text: 喝浓茶太晚的话，我晚上肯定会失眠。
examples.trans: If I drink strong tea too late, I will definitely lie awake.

meanings.note: Verb-object/noun shīzhí ('dereliction of duty').

examples.text: 那天是因为我的工作失职才出了意外。
examples.trans: That night's accident happened through my own lapse.

examples.text: 安全检查不到位属于严重的失职。
examples.trans: Skipping safety checks counts as a serious lapse.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shī wù. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个失误 ('an oversight').

examples.text: 因为我们的失误，今晚半价，还送早餐。
examples.trans: Because of our mistake, tonight is half price, with complimentary breakfast.

examples.text: 这是我们工作上的小失误，请您原谅。
examples.trans: That was a small oversight on our part; please forgive us.

meanings.note: Verb/noun shībài ('failure, defeat').

examples.text: 消息漏出去就是你们公关部的重大失败。
examples.trans: Any leak would be a major failure for your PR team.

examples.text: 一次提案失败阻挡不了她的热情。
examples.trans: One failed pitch never dampened her enthusiasm.

meanings.note: Verb shīzōng ('be missing, vanish').

examples.text: 他被法国人领养的弟弟在袭击里失踪了。
examples.trans: His brother adopted in France went missing during the attack.

examples.text: 救援队正在全力搜寻暴雨中失踪的车辆。
examples.trans: Rescue teams are searching all out for vehicles missing in the storm.

meanings.note: Official news/diplomatic term for missing individuals.

examples.text: 救援人员正在全力搜寻名单上的失踪人士。
examples.trans: Rescue teams are searching all-out for the missing persons.

examples.text: 有关部门公布了此次事件中的失踪人士信息。
examples.trans: Authorities released information on the missing persons.

meanings.note: Person unaccounted for after an incident.

examples.text: 家属焦急地等待着失踪者的最新消息。
examples.trans: Families waited anxiously for word on the missing.

examples.text: 官方刚刚核实并确认了失踪者名单。
examples.trans: Officials just verified and confirmed the missing-persons list.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shī péi. Polite phrase when stepping away briefly (失陪一下 'please excuse me a moment').

examples.text: 失陪一下，宋老师，我先回办公室整理一下！
examples.trans: Excuse me a moment, Teacher Song; I shall step back to my office to tidy up!

examples.text: 得救了！失陪一分钟，宋老师，您慢喝热茶！
examples.trans: Saved! Excuse me one minute, Teacher Song—enjoy your hot tea!

meanings.note: Prefix/noun tóu ('first, initial; head').

examples.text: 开篇的头一句就是道可道。
examples.trans: The very first line at the opening is Dao Ke Dao.

examples.text: 这是我头一回进大型演播室。
examples.trans: This is my very first time inside a major TV studio.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tóu shang. Measure word (量词): 顶, e.g. 头上帽子 ('on the head').

examples.text: 我的眼镜怎么会在……哎呀！在我头上！
examples.trans: Why would my glasses be in... oh dear! They are on my head!

examples.text: 老奶奶头上戴着一顶暖和的羊毛帽。
examples.trans: Grandmother is wearing a warm wool hat on her head.

meanings.note: Noun tóufa ('head hair').

examples.text: 你看他头发上的发油越抹越多。
examples.trans: Look at him slicking more and more oil onto his hair.

examples.text: 上台之前造型师帮嘉宾整理了头发。
examples.trans: Before air time, the stylist fixed the guest's hair.

meanings.note: Informal term for the head of a group or clique.

examples.text: 他是那个著名粉丝团的头子。
examples.trans: He is the leader of that famous fan club.

examples.text: 大家都在找这帮人的头子。
examples.trans: Everyone is looking for the leader of this group.

meanings.note: Media noun tóutiáo ('front-page or trending headline').

examples.text: 那件事三天就从头条上下来了。
examples.trans: That story dropped off the headlines in three days.

examples.text: 这条新闻又上了今日头条。
examples.trans: This news hit today's top headlines again.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tóu téng. Means a literal headache or something causing a headache.

examples.text: 法律条文我戴两副眼镜看都头疼！
examples.trans: Legal clauses give me a headache even with two pairs of glasses!

examples.text: 复杂的数字总是让他觉得头疼。
examples.trans: Complicated numbers always give him a headache.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a noun used in conversational Mandarin. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个头盔 ('a 头盔').

examples.text: 我有一个头盔。
examples.trans: I have a 头盔.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的头盔。
examples.trans: This is a very good 头盔.

meanings.note: Noun tóuxù ('starting clue, clear thread').

examples.text: 每一环我都查过了，现在终于有点头绪。
examples.trans: After checking every link, I finally have a clear lead.

examples.text: 事情太多的时候要先理清头绪。
examples.trans: Sort out the main threads whenever tasks pile up.

meanings.note: Formal job or honorary title.

examples.text: 对他而言，做出好节目比拥有高头衔重要得多。
examples.trans: To him, making great shows matters far more than holding grand titles.

examples.text: 新名片上的头衔只写着制作一部总制作人。
examples.trans: The title on the new card read simply Unit One Chief Producer.

meanings.note: Locative noun tóudǐng ('above one's head').

examples.text: 头顶上一直悬着一把剑。
examples.trans: A sword has been hanging right overhead all along.

examples.text: 头顶的追光灯突然亮了起来。
examples.trans: The spotlight overhead suddenly lit up.

examples.text: 每位住客都夸陈师傅烤的面包卷又香又脆。
examples.trans: Every guest praises Master Chen's baked rolls for being fragrant and crisp.

examples.text: 大家都夸小美年纪轻轻却把客栈打理得井井有条。
examples.trans: Everyone praises Mei for running the guesthouse in such orderly fashion at such a young age.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kuā kua. Reduplicated form of 夸 ('praise warmly').

examples.text: 小晴，炒蛋真好吃，替我夸夸小美！
examples.trans: The scrambled eggs are delicious, Qing. Tell Mei my compliments!

examples.text: 今天早餐做得这么棒，真该好好夸夸你！
examples.trans: Breakfast turned out so well today that you deserve warm praise!

meanings.note: Verb/noun kuājiǎng ('praise, compliment').

examples.text: 谢谢您的夸奖，我们会继续努力。
examples.trans: Thank you for the compliment; we will keep working hard.

examples.text: 得到前辈的夸奖让她很开心。
examples.trans: Winning praise from a senior producer made her happy.

meanings.note: Adjective/verb kuāzhāng ('exaggerated').

examples.text: 他的发油越抹越多，简直太夸张了。
examples.trans: He uses more and more hair oil — way over the top.

examples.text: 写新闻报道要真实，不能随便夸张。
examples.trans: News writing requires accuracy without exaggeration.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiā. First-tone jiā: hold something pinched between two surfaces, such as under one's arm (夹在胳膊底下) or inside book pages.

examples.text: 周经理把绿色登记本夹在胳膊底下走来走去。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou paced back and forth with the green guest book tucked under his arm.

examples.text: 她在旧书里夹了一片干树叶做书签。
examples.trans: She tucked a dried leaf inside the old book as a bookmark.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qí guài. Everyday adjective for anything unusual.

examples.text: 真奇怪！我们坐同一班早火车到同一个区。
examples.trans: How strange! We rode the very same morning train to the same district.

examples.text: 非常安静！不过刚才你听到奇怪的金属敲击声了吗？
examples.trans: Very quiet! Though did you hear a strange metallic knocking sound just now?

meanings.note: Noun qíwén ('bizarre or absurd news item').

examples.text: 这篇奇闻上线不到几分钟就被删了。
examples.trans: That bizarre story was deleted minutes after going live.

examples.text: 网上每天都会冒出各种各样的奇闻。
examples.trans: All sorts of strange tales pop up online daily.

meanings.note: Formal verb fèngquàn ('advise earnestly').

examples.text: 有一句话我还是要奉劝你。
examples.trans: There is still one word of earnest advice I would offer you.

examples.text: 医生奉劝他以后千万不要再空腹喝浓咖啡。
examples.trans: The doctor cautioned him never to drink strong coffee on an empty stomach.
