meanings.note: Formal verb-object fèngmìng ('follow official orders').

examples.text: 制作一部奉命接管演播室。
examples.trans: Unit One is under orders to take over the studio.

examples.text: 我随时奉命去办这件事。
examples.trans: I stand ready to carry out orders anytime.

meanings.note: Formal verb fèngpéi ('accompany or match someone to the end').

examples.text: 想要怎么交代，我任意奉陪。
examples.trans: Whatever accounting you demand, I will oblige.

examples.text: 既然你想比试，我奉陪到底。
examples.trans: Since you want to compete, I will see it through.

examples.text: 除了工作，我什么都无所谓。所以现在，契约解除。
examples.trans: Outside of work, nothing matters to me at all. So as of right now, our pact is dissolved.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Workplace noun jiǎngjīn ('financial bonus').

examples.text: 公司的项目奖金也可以少分一点。
examples.trans: They can also take a smaller share of the project bonus.

examples.text: 年底大家拿到了丰厚的奖金。
examples.trans: Everyone received a generous bonus at year's end.

meanings.en: set; suite; series (classifier for coordinated items, plans, clothes, or housing)
meanings.note: Pinyin: tào. Very common measure word for matching collections, systems, apartments, or complete proposals (e.g., 一套方案, 一套房子).
As a noun, figuratively refers to a scheme or trap (下套 'to lay a trap', 钻套 'to walk into a trap'), and literally to an outer cover (手套 'gloves', 外套 'coat').

examples.text: 又不是只有一套方案。
examples.trans: It is not as if we only have one set of plans.

examples.text: 你还看不出来吗？这就是个套！
examples.trans: Can't you see it yet? This whole thing is a setup!

meanings.note: Adjective nǚ ('female').

examples.text: 上个月跳槽的那个女主持人很有名。
examples.trans: That female host who switched stations last month is famous.

examples.text: 她是一位非常优秀的年轻女导演。
examples.trans: She is an outstanding young female director.

meanings.note: Noun nǚrén ('adult woman').

examples.text: 你以前不是说女人最可怕吗？
examples.trans: Did you not say before that women are the scariest?

examples.text: 她是一位独立又自信的职场女人。
examples.trans: She is an independent, confident career woman.

meanings.note: Woman who founded or leads a major enterprise.

examples.text: 董事长是一位备受尊敬的杰出女企业家。
examples.trans: The chairwoman is a deeply respected, accomplished businesswoman.

examples.text: 论坛邀请了多位成功的女企业家分享创业经历。
examples.trans: The forum invited several leading businesswomen to share their stories.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǚ shì. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位女士 ('a lady').

examples.text: 打扰了，女士……等等，这个声音！教钢琴的宋老师？！
examples.trans: Excuse me, ma'am... wait, that voice! Teacher Song, my piano teacher?!

examples.text: 前台有位姓宋的女士在等您。
examples.trans: A Ms. Song is waiting for you at reception.

meanings.note: Noun nǚhái ('girl, young woman').

examples.text: 你只是一个简单的女孩。
examples.trans: You are simply a straightforward girl.

examples.text: 那个扎丸子头的女孩就是新来的实习生。
examples.trans: That young woman with the hair bun is the new intern.

meanings.note: Formal noun nǚxìng ('women, female').

examples.text: 恶意攻击成功的女性是非常无耻的。
examples.trans: Maliciously attacking a successful woman is shameless.

examples.text: 越来越多优秀的女性担任节目总制片人。
examples.trans: More and more outstanding women serve as chief producers.

meanings.note: Noun nǚpéngyou ('girlfriend').

examples.text: 还要肯花时间陪女朋友。
examples.trans: He also has to be willing to spend time with his girlfriend.

examples.text: 周末他陪女朋友去听了一场音乐会。
examples.trans: Over the weekend he took his girlfriend to a concert.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǎi nai. Reduplicated kinship noun; second syllable is neutral tone; also used respectfully for elderly women; measure word: 位 (wèi).

examples.text: 志鹏说他以前每个星期天都帮奶奶揉面烤甜面包。
examples.trans: Peng said he used to help his grandmother knead dough and bake sweet bread every Sunday.

examples.text: 住在巷子口的陈奶奶最喜欢喝小美熬的热扁豆汤。
examples.trans: Grandma Chen at the end of the lane loves drinking the hot lentil soup Mei simmers.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǎi bái sè. Warm off-white shade literally meaning 'milk-white colour'.

examples.text: 这种奶白色的粗陶茶杯摸起来很温润。
examples.trans: These cream-white stoneware teacups feel smooth and warm to the touch.

examples.text: 阳光房的窗帘是柔和的奶白色。
examples.trans: The curtains in the sunroom are a soft cream-white.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǎi lào. Measure word (量词): 片 (piàn), e.g. 一片奶酪 ('a slice of cheese').

examples.text: 三瓶牛奶、二十个鸡蛋、黄油、奶酪和红苹果！
examples.trans: Three bottles of milk, twenty eggs, butter, cheese, and red apples!

examples.text: 热面包夹一片奶酪特别香。
examples.trans: Warm bread with a slice of cheese smells wonderful.

related.gloss: a slice of cheese (measure word 片)

meanings.note: Pinyin: tā. Third-person singular feminine pronoun; written with the woman radical 女.

examples.text: 看拉链旁边……对，有她的名字缩写！
examples.trans: Check beside the zipper... yes, her name initials are here!

examples.text: 等等——星期一你们坐同一班火车，并拿走了她的箱子？
examples.trans: Wait—so you rode the same train on Monday and took her suitcase?

meanings.note: Plural feminine pronoun tāmen.

examples.text: 我怕她们两个又在电视上乱说话。
examples.trans: I worry the two of them will talk wildly on TV again.

examples.text: 她们都是制作一部的骨干成员。
examples.trans: They are all key members of Production Unit One.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎo. Main adjective 'good'; as a result complement after a verb, means 'ready/completed properly' (修好, 准备好).

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 写完稿子再睡好不好？大家加把劲！
examples.trans: Finish writing your articles before sleeping, alright? Keep pushing, everyone!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Idiom hǎobùróngyì ('after much effort, hard-won').

examples.text: 这些同学都是我好不容易找来的。
examples.trans: I worked so hard to bring all these classmates here.

examples.text: 我们好不容易才抢到两张票。
examples.trans: We barely managed to get two tickets.

meanings.note: Noun phrase hǎozhǔyi ('great idea').

examples.text: 用手机接入电视信号，真是好主意啊！
examples.trans: Patching phone feeds straight onto TV is a brilliant idea!

examples.text: 多亏她临时想出这个好主意，化解了冷场危机。
examples.trans: Thanks to the bright idea she improvised, the awkward pause was saved.

examples.text: 好久不见！
examples.trans: Long time no see!

examples.text: 朋友，好久不见。
examples.trans: Friend, long time no see.

meanings.note: Compound hǎoshì ('good matter').

examples.text: 这是一件好事。
examples.trans: This is a good thing.

examples.text: 今天有什么好事？
examples.trans: What good news is there today?

好事将近.gloss: wedding bells are near, happy news is right around the corner

meanings.en: wedding bells are near, happy news is right around the corner
meanings.note: Idiom referring to an approaching engagement or wedding.

examples.text: 看他们俩这么甜蜜，粉丝都猜好事将近了。
examples.trans: Seeing them so sweet together, fans guess wedding bells are near.

examples.text: 朋友们纷纷祝福这对恋人好事将近。
examples.trans: Friends showered the couple with wishes for approaching nuptials.

meanings.en: effective; useful; working well; easy to use
meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎoshǐ. Colloquial adjective (especially common in northern Mandarin) used both for tools/devices functioning smoothly and for methods, connections, or names carrying real clout. Negated as 不好使.

examples.text: 你去了提我的名字，准好使。
examples.trans: Mention my name when you go, and it will definitely work.

examples.text: 这台新换的剪辑设备特别好使，省了不少时间。
examples.trans: This newly replaced editing equipment works really well and saves a lot of time.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎo xiàng. Softens an observation ('it seems like…').

examples.text: 听到了！好像是隔壁洗手间的热水管响了。
examples.trans: I heard it! It sounded like the hot-water pipe in the bathroom next door.

examples.text: 门外好像有人在按门铃。
examples.trans: Someone seems to be ringing the doorbell outside.

meanings.note: Phrase hǎojǐgè ('several, quite a few').

examples.text: 高层在里面开会已经好几个小时了。
examples.trans: Executives have been meeting inside for several hours.

examples.text: 好几个网站全都瘫痪了。
examples.trans: Quite a few websites crashed completely.

examples.text: 别查了，翻来覆去查了好几遍了，没有。
examples.trans: Stop searching; I checked the pages front to back over and over, and it isn't there.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎo chī. Literally 'good to eat'; contrast 好喝 for drinks.

examples.text: 小晴，炒蛋真好吃，替我夸夸小美！
examples.trans: The scrambled eggs are delicious, Qing. Tell Mei my compliments!

examples.text: 小美烤的肉桂卷真好吃！
examples.trans: The cinnamon rolls Mei bakes are delicious!

examples.text: 这是好吧啊。
examples.trans: This is okay.

examples.text: 那个好吧好。
examples.trans: That okay is good.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎo tīng. Built from 好 ('good') + 听 ('listen'); compare 好看 ('good-looking') and 好吃 ('tasty').

examples.text: 一点回声也没有！木头和玻璃让音乐更好听。
examples.trans: No echo at all! Wood and glass make music sound even better.

examples.text: 你的声音真好听。
examples.trans: Your voice sounds really lovely.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎo hē. Combines 好 ('good/pleasant to') + 喝 ('drink'), parallel to 好吃 ('tasty to eat').

examples.text: 加了柠檬汁的金黄扁豆汤特别好喝。
examples.trans: The golden lentil soup with lemon juice added is especially delicious.

examples.text: 小美泡的热薄荷茶清香好喝。
examples.trans: The hot mint tea Mei steeped is fragrant and delicious.

examples.text: 好嘞，好。
examples.trans: Sure thing — will do.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎo zài. Relieved adverb introducing a saving grace.

examples.text: 呼，好在反应快，早餐又有救了！
examples.trans: Phew, quick thinking saves breakfast once again!

examples.text: 好在我们备了两把新钥匙。
examples.trans: Thankfully we kept two spare keys ready.

meanings.note: Noun hǎochu ('benefit, advantage').

examples.text: 撕破脸对谁也没有好处。
examples.trans: Falling out does nobody any good.

examples.text: 早睡早起对身体有好处。
examples.trans: Sleeping and waking early is good for health.

meanings.note: Warm spoken counterpart of 很多 (hǎoduō).

examples.text: 公司里有好多工作。
examples.trans: There is so much work at the company.

examples.text: 来了好多人。
examples.trans: So many people came.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hào qí. Note fourth tone hào when meaning 'curious'.

examples.text: 真好奇！那张行李牌上的字看着很眼熟。
examples.trans: How curious! The handwriting on that tag looked very familiar.

examples.text: 听听他说的！老陈比我们好奇两倍！
examples.trans: Listen to him! Chen is twice as curious as we are!

meanings.note: Pinyin: háo hǎo. Placed before a verb to urge doing it well (好好看看, 好好休息).

examples.text: 您好好休息，有事随时按铃。
examples.trans: Rest well, ma'am; ring the bell anytime if you need anything.

examples.text: 把电话给我，我来好好问他！
examples.trans: Hand me the phone; let me ask him properly!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hào kè. Combines 好 (hào, 4th tone 'be fond of') + 客 ('guests'); frequently paired in 热情好客 ('warm and hospitable').

examples.text: 热情好客正是这栋老房子八十多年来最拿手的事。
examples.trans: Warm hospitality is the very thing this old house has been best at for over eighty years.

examples.text: 梧桐巷的街坊邻居都十分好客，见了面总爱请人喝杯热茶。
examples.trans: The neighbours on Wutong Lane are all very hospitable and love inviting people in for hot tea.

meanings.note: Comfortable, joyful times ahead.

examples.text: 熬过这段忙碌期，好日子就来了。
examples.trans: Once we get past this busy stretch, good days will arrive.

examples.text: 大家都盼着过上安稳的好日子。
examples.trans: Everyone looks forward to living peaceful, happy days.

meanings.note: Adverb hǎodǎi ('at the very least, after all').

examples.text: 好歹你也是部门总监，别和稀泥。
examples.trans: At least you are a department director; stop muddling things.

examples.text: 出门前好歹喝口热汤吧。
examples.trans: Have at least a sip of warm soup before heading out.

meanings.note: Adjective hǎowán ('fun, entertaining').

examples.text: 我知道比这更好玩的，快去拍吧！
examples.trans: I spotted something way more entertaining — go film it!

examples.text: 这个游戏环节设计得特别好玩。
examples.trans: This game segment is designed to be super fun.

examples.text: 侯总好球。
examples.trans: Nice shot.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: polite, crisp affirmative reply

examples.text: 好的，王老师。
examples.trans: Alright, Teacher Wang.

examples.text: 我们等你，好的，谢谢！
examples.trans: We will wait for you — alright, thank you!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎo kàn. Literally 'good to look at'.

examples.text: 真的可以吗？看着又好看又暖和！
examples.trans: Is that really alright? It looks both lovely and warm!

examples.text: 院子里新挂的纸灯笼真好看。
examples.trans: The paper lanterns newly hung in the courtyard look lovely.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎoxiào.

examples.text: 他讲的笑话一点都不好笑。
examples.trans: The joke he told was not funny at all.

examples.text: 我觉得这个故事非常好笑。
examples.trans: I find this story very hilarious.

好让.gloss: so that; in order to let

meanings.en: so that; in order to let
meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎo ràng. Purpose conjunction introducing the desired result in the second clause.

examples.text: 把窗户打开吧，好让新鲜空气吹进来。
examples.trans: Open the window so that fresh air can blow in.

examples.text: 希望明天出太阳，好让木板上的新油漆快点干透。
examples.trans: Let's hope the sun comes out tomorrow so that the fresh paint on the boards dries quickly.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎo yùn. Compound 好 ('good') + 运 ('luck/fortune'), common in wishes like 祝你好运 ('wish you good luck').

examples.text: 明天就是正式检查了，祝大家好运！
examples.trans: Tomorrow is the official inspection—good luck, everyone!

examples.text: 在集市淘到了最后一套白茶杯，真是好运！
examples.trans: Finding the last set of white teacups at the market was real good luck!

好险.gloss: close call!, phew, that was close!

meanings.en: close call!, phew, that was close!
meanings.note: Colloquial exclamation hǎoxiǎn ('what a narrow escape!').

examples.text: 我刚想提醒你爱惜身体，好险没说出口！
examples.trans: I was seconds from lecturing you on your health—close call!

examples.text: 好险，差一点就错过最后一班地铁了。
examples.trans: Close call—I nearly missed the last subway train.

examples.text: 如今传出以辛惠美为首的黄金一班五位唱将，一起加盟十二歌王。
examples.trans: Now word has broken that five powerhouse vocalists of the Golden Class led by Xin Huimei are joining Twelve Singers together.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Formal interrogative pronoun rúhé ('how').

examples.text: 旧的病情该如何医治，全听您的安排。
examples.trans: How his condition should be treated is completely up to you.

examples.text: 不管外界评价如何，把内容做好才是根本。
examples.trans: Whatever outside reviews say, making strong content comes first.

meanings.note: Idiom rúyì suànpan ('calculating plan assuming everything goes one's way').

examples.text: 找完麻烦又上节目道歉，在打如意算盘吗？
examples.trans: Causing trouble then apologising on air — what a neat scheme!

examples.text: 他心里的如意算盘最终落空了。
examples.trans: His wishful little calculation fell flat in the end.

meanings.note: Pinyin: rú guǒ. Standard conditional conjunction ('if'), often paired with 就 in the main clause.

examples.text: 如果你同意，我想把这首曲子补写完整。
examples.trans: If you agree, I would like to finish writing this piece of music.

examples.text: 如果明天不下雨，我们就把桌子搬到院子里。
examples.trans: If it doesn't rain tomorrow, we will move the tables out into the courtyard.

如此.gloss: so, like this, to such a degree

meanings.en: so, like this, to such a degree
meanings.note: Polished demonstrative common in phrases like 不止如此.

examples.text: 观众反响如此热烈，让主创团队倍感振奋。
examples.trans: Such an enthusiastic audience response energized the creative team.

examples.text: 他之所以如此严格，是为了对每一位观众负责。
examples.trans: The reason he is so strict is accountability to every viewer.

meanings.note: Colloquial kinship noun mā ('mum').

examples.text: 我妈做的养胃粥特别好喝。
examples.trans: My mum's stomach-soothing porridge tastes wonderful.

examples.text: 周末回家我妈做了一桌子拿手好菜。
examples.trans: When I visited home, my mum cooked a table full of favourites.

examples.text: 我的妈呀，大获全胜啊这一季！
examples.trans: Oh my goodness — this season is a total landslide victory!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mā ma. Everyday warm word for mother (second syllable neutral tone).

examples.text: 我妈妈做的柠檬果酱一点也不腻。
examples.trans: The lemon jam my mum makes is not cloying at all.

examples.text: 周末回家，我给妈妈带了一罐百花蜂蜜。
examples.trans: Going home for the weekend, I brought Mum a jar of wildflower honey.

meanings.note: Pinyin: miào. Describes a clever idea or delightful moment.

examples.text: 生活安排的二重奏比我们自己写得更妙，孩子们。
examples.trans: Life arranges finer duets than we write ourselves, boys.

examples.text: 这个主意真是太妙了！
examples.trans: That idea is truly wonderful!

examples.text: 王尔就是这次侵权事件的始作俑者，我担心您相信错误的人了。
examples.trans: Wang Er is the very culprit who engineered this infringement trap; I'm afraid you have trusted the wrong man.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Adverb shǐzhōng ('all along, consistently').

examples.text: 我们感怀的，始终是过去和未来。
examples.trans: What warms our hearts is always our shared past and future.

examples.text: 面对重重压力，他始终没有放弃原创理想。
examples.trans: Facing heavy pressure, he never once gave up his original vision.

meanings.note: respectful workplace suffix after a senior female colleague's name

examples.text: 谢谢你，杏子姐！
examples.trans: Thank you, Sister Xingzi!

examples.text: 这件事你可以先去问问李姐。
examples.trans: You can go ask Sister Li about this matter first.

meanings.note: Colloquial noun/pronoun jiěliǎ ('the two sisters').

examples.text: 想同时养活咱们姐俩，他们胃口太大了。
examples.trans: Trying to support both of us sisters is too big an appetite.

examples.text: 她们姐俩在歌坛关系一直最好。
examples.trans: The two of them have always been closest in music.

meanings.note: affectionate respectful title for a slightly older female colleague

examples.text: 你这几天就跟着杏子姐姐，给她打打下手。
examples.trans: For the next few days, shadow Sister Xingzi and lend her a hand.

examples.text: 办公室里的姐姐们都很照顾新人。
examples.trans: The senior women in the office all look out for newcomers.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gū gu. Specifically father's sister (second syllable neutral tone); distinct from 阿姨 / 姨妈 (mother's sister).

examples.text: 周经理的姑姑以前也住在这座老院子里。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou's paternal aunt used to live in this old courtyard too.

examples.text: 我姑姑年轻的时候最喜欢弹钢琴。
examples.trans: When my aunt was young, she loved playing the piano most of all.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gū niang. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个姑娘 ('a young woman').

examples.text: 早上好，姑娘。我有一个宋名下的预订。
examples.trans: Good morning, young lady. I have a booking for Song.

examples.text: 多烤几块边角，好姑娘！
examples.trans: Bake plenty of corner pieces, dear girl!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xìng. Takes the family name directly as object (我姓宋 'My surname is Song').

examples.text: 早上好，姑娘。我有一个宋名下的预订。
examples.trans: Good morning, young lady. I have a booking for Song.

examples.text: 请问您贵姓？我姓陈。
examples.trans: May I ask your surname? My surname is Chen.

meanings.note: Adjective/noun wěiqu ('feel wronged or underused').

examples.text: 做全公司的杂务，你不觉得委屈吗？
examples.trans: Doing chores for the whole firm, do you not feel shortchanged?

examples.text: 受了委屈可以跟我说。
examples.trans: Tell me whenever you feel wronged.

meanings.note: Verb/noun wēixié ('threaten, coerce').

examples.text: 他最讨厌被别人拿绯闻威胁。
examples.trans: He hates most of all being threatened with gossip.

examples.text: 面对威胁，他从来不会轻易低头。
examples.trans: Faced with threats, he never bows easily.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yúlè. Used as a noun in industry compounds like 娱乐圈 ('showbiz/entertainment circle') and 娱乐公司 ('entertainment agency'), and occasionally as a verb meaning 'to amuse oneself or entertain'.

examples.text: 我放弃电视台，去星天娱乐。
examples.trans: I'm giving up the TV station to join Xingtian Entertainment.

examples.text: 喂，你好，我是星天娱乐的布小谷。
examples.trans: Hello, this is Bu Xiaogu from Xingtian Entertainment.

examples.text: 没这点事，还叫娱乐圈吗？
examples.trans: Without a little gossip like that, could you even call it show business?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

娱乐精神.gloss: good-natured sense of humour in showbiz

meanings.en: good-natured sense of humour in showbiz
meanings.note: Being able to laugh at harmless jokes or publicity.

examples.text: 做公众人物总得有一点豁达的娱乐精神。
examples.trans: Public figures need a bit of easygoing showbiz humour.

examples.text: 她笑着回应调侃，展现了十足的娱乐精神。
examples.trans: She answered the teasing with a smile, showing real good humour.

examples.text: 他是一名娱记。
examples.trans: He is an entertainment reporter.

examples.text: 娱记们在等明星。
examples.trans: The entertainment reporters are waiting for the star.

examples.text: 我父亲答应不再和那个女人联系，才保住了他们的婚姻，但他确实是我的亲弟弟。
examples.trans: My father promised never to contact that woman again to save their marriage, yet the boy is truly my half-brother.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Noun méitǐ.

examples.text: 做媒体一定要小心。
examples.trans: Working in media, you must be careful.

examples.text: 很多媒体都来了。
examples.trans: Many media outlets came.

meanings.note: Noun méitǐrén ('person working in media').

examples.text: 这一刻绝不是媒体人该逃脱的时刻。
examples.trans: This moment is never one for media professionals to run away from.

examples.text: 突发事件面前更能检验一位媒体人的担当。
examples.trans: Breaking emergencies test what a media professional is made of.

meanings.note: Compound noun méitǐxí ('media section in an auditorium').

examples.text: 媒体席的位置一直很满。
examples.trans: Seats in the press row are completely full.

examples.text: 记者们都坐在媒体席上。
examples.trans: Reporters are seated in the press section.

meanings.note: Often used jokingly of marrying off a workaholic boss or friend.

examples.text: 她去年嫁给了一位大学同学。
examples.trans: Last year she married a college classmate.

examples.text: 朋友们都开玩笑想把他早点嫁出去。
examples.trans: His friends joke about marrying him off soon.

examples.text: 您是东海经纪的涂盛涂总吗？我是荣思伦哥哥的铁杆大影迷，你能不能跟他说一声我要嫁给他！
examples.trans: Wait — are you Director Tu Sheng of Donghai Talent? I'm Rong Silun's biggest die-hard fan; please tell him I want to marry him!

examples.text: 你有他电话吗？你先把他电话给我，我真的要嫁给他！
examples.trans: Do you have his phone number? Give me his number first — I really mean it!

examples.text: 学校几个球友打不过我，嫌没劲。
examples.trans: None of the campus players could beat me, so they complained it wasn't fun.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 你们星天要是不嫌弃的话，我个人愿意出任新一季十二歌王的主持人。
examples.trans: If Xingtian doesn't mind, I would personally love to serve as host for the new season of Twelve Singers.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Legal noun xiányírén ('criminal suspect').

examples.text: 合成照片的嫌疑人也已经抓到了。
examples.trans: The suspect who doctored the photos has been caught.

examples.text: 警方正在依法审讯那名嫌疑人。
examples.trans: Police are questioning the suspect according to law.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nèn. Describes tender scrambled eggs or fresh young tea leaves.

examples.text: 小晴买了海盐黄油，今天我们做嫩炒蛋！
examples.trans: Qing bought sea-salt butter, so today we are making soft scrambled eggs!

examples.text: 今天的炒蛋又香又嫩。
examples.trans: Today's scrambled eggs are fragrant and tender.

子.gloss: nominal suffix (forming everyday nouns like 桌子, 椅子, 盘子)

meanings.en: nominal suffix (forming everyday nouns like 桌子, 椅子, 盘子)
meanings.note: Pinyin: zi. Neutral-tone noun suffix attached to roots such as 桌 ('table'), 椅 ('chair'), 盘 ('plate'), and 罐 ('jar').

examples.text: 晚上和周末，我们一起做木桌子和隔音木板！
examples.trans: Evenings and weekends, we are building wooden tables and acoustic panels together!

examples.text: 院子里的木桌子和竹椅子都已经擦得干干净净了。
examples.trans: The wooden tables and bamboo chairs in the courtyard have all been wiped spotless.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kǒng. Used for small neat holes such as screw holes (螺丝孔) or keyholes (钥匙孔); measure word: 个 (gè).

examples.text: 您看右边——清漆下面本来就有两个小小的螺丝孔。
examples.trans: Look on the right—there were two tiny screw holes under the clear varnish all along.

examples.text: 老陈往旧锁孔里滴了一点油，钥匙立刻就转得顺畅了。
examples.trans: Chen put a drop of oil into the old keyhole, and the key turned smoothly right away.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zì. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个字 ('a written character').

examples.text: 真好奇！那张行李牌上的字看着很眼熟。
examples.trans: How curious! The handwriting on that tag looked very familiar.

examples.text: 先别对外面透露一个字！让两兄弟先过完这个星期五下午！
examples.trans: Not a single word to anyone outside yet! Let the two brothers have their Friday afternoon first!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zì mǔ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个字母 ('an alphabet letter').

examples.text: 可惜没有电话号码，只有两个字母和老街名字。
examples.trans: Unfortunately there is no phone number, only two letters and an old street name.

examples.text: 行李牌背面写着两个英文字母。
examples.trans: Two English letters are written on the back of the luggage tag.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zì jì. Literally 'character traces' (字 + 迹): a person's recognizable script on paper.

examples.text: 虽然过了三十年，墨水字迹还是很清楚。
examples.trans: Even after thirty years, the ink handwriting is still crystal clear.

examples.text: 我一眼就认出了爷爷本子上的字迹。
examples.trans: I recognized the handwriting in my grandfather's notebook at first glance.

meanings.note: Being real or part of someone's world.

examples.text: 这些珍贵的回忆是因为大家一起努力才存在的。
examples.trans: These precious memories exist because everyone worked together.

examples.text: 方案里还存在几个需要修改的小细节。
examples.trans: A few small details needing revision still exist in the plan.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sūn zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个孙子 ('a grandson').

examples.text: 那里住着一位老木匠和两个孙子——哥哥弹钢琴，弟弟最爱小火车！
examples.trans: An old carpenter lived there with two grandsons—the older brother played piano, and the younger loved toy trains!

examples.text: 老爷爷周末常带小孙子来买面包。
examples.trans: The grandfather often brings his grandson to buy bread on weekends.

meanings.note: Classifier/noun jì ('quarter of a year; TV season').

examples.text: 我们肯定要拍下一季的。
examples.trans: We will definitely film a next season.

examples.text: 第一季的收视率非常高。
examples.trans: Ratings for the first season were very high.

meanings.note: Literal island or metaphor for creative solitude.

examples.text: 每位坚持原创的制作人心里都有一座孤岛。
examples.trans: Every producer who insists on originality carries a lone island inside.

examples.text: 大雾散去后，海面上露出一座安静的孤岛。
examples.trans: When the fog cleared, a quiet island emerged on the sea.

meanings.note: Attributive phrase gūdǎoshì ('cut-off island style').

examples.text: 咱们这是全封闭的孤岛式培训。
examples.trans: Ours is fully enclosed, island-style training.

examples.text: 孤岛式集训让嘉宾暂时告别了手机和网络。
examples.trans: Island-style training unplugged the guests from their phones.

meanings.note: Acquiring a habit, skill, or healthier attitude.

examples.text: 你应该学着照顾好自己的身体。
examples.trans: You ought to learn to take good care of your health.

examples.text: 刚进组的实习生正在跟着前辈学剪辑。
examples.trans: The new intern is learning editing from senior staff.

meanings.note: Noun xuéyè ('academic studies').

examples.text: 入职之前我有梦想也有学业。
examples.trans: Before working I had dreams and my studies.

examples.text: 希望你顺利完成学业。
examples.trans: I hope you finish your studies smoothly.

meanings.en: to study; to learn; to emulate
meanings.note: Pinyin: xuéxí. Takes a subject or skill directly as its object (学习制作); when learning from a person, pair with prepositions 跟 or 向 (e.g., 跟他学习 / 向他学习). Also used as a noun meaning 'studies'.

examples.text: 干咱们这行，谁不想跟他学习？
examples.trans: In our line of work, who wouldn't want to learn from him?

examples.text: 可是我是真的很想学习节目制作。
examples.trans: Yet I truly want to study television program production.

examples.text: 离开学校半年就学会喝闷酒了？听说你找男朋友了，超级富二代。
examples.trans: Barely half a year out of school and already drinking alone? Word is you found a super-rich boyfriend.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Noun xuéwèi ('university degree').

examples.text: 没交论文，我的学位没了。
examples.trans: Having missed the thesis, my degree is gone.

examples.text: 她今年拿到了硕士学位。
examples.trans: She earned her master's degree this year.

meanings.note: verb 学 plus result complement 到 ('manage to learn')

examples.text: 我相信你一定能学到不少东西。
examples.trans: I believe you will definitely learn quite a lot.

examples.text: 在节目组里我学到了很多经验。
examples.trans: In the production crew I learned a lot of experience.

examples.text: 作为版权的所有者，你愿意相信我的这位学员吗？
examples.trans: As the copyright holder, are you willing to place your trust in my student?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xué xiào. Measure word (量词): 所, e.g. 一所学校 ('a school').

examples.text: 热茶和柠檬蛋糕！小晴，你该给紧张的弟弟开个学校。
examples.trans: Hot tea and lemon cake! Qing, you ought to open a school for nervous brothers.

examples.text: 附近有一所安静的音乐学校。
examples.trans: There is a quiet music school nearby.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xuésheng (second syllable neutral tone). General term for anyone enrolled in school or university, or someone mentored by a specific teacher (老师). Takes classifiers 个 or 名.

examples.text: 老方，这批学生有没有好的？
examples.trans: Old Fang, are there any good ones in this batch of students?

examples.text: 我听说你是传媒学院最优秀的学生。
examples.trans: I heard that you are the top student at the School of Communication.

meanings.note: Campus noun xuéshēnghuì ('student council/union').

examples.text: 你在学生会不是关系处得挺好的吗？
examples.trans: Did you not get along well in the student union?

examples.text: 学生会正在筹备迎新晚会。
examples.trans: The student union is planning the welcome gala.

meanings.note: Noun xuéwen ('scholarship, learning').

examples.text: 我想请教您一些学问，可以吗？
examples.trans: May I ask your guidance on some scholarship?

examples.text: 做电视制作其实里头大有学问。
examples.trans: Television production actually holds deep craft inside.

meanings.note: noun

examples.text: 我是传媒学院的研究生，年级第一名。
examples.trans: I am a graduate student at the Media College, first in my year.

examples.text: 我是传媒学院的研究生，年级第一名。
examples.trans: I am a graduate student at the Media College, first in my year.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hái zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个孩子 ('a child').

examples.text: 而你们两个孩子把十二号最珍贵的部分留在这儿了。
examples.trans: And you two boys kept the most precious part of Number twelve right here.

examples.text: 生活安排的二重奏比我们自己写得更妙，孩子们。
examples.trans: Life arranges finer duets than we write ourselves, boys.

meanings.note: Younger male twin.

examples.text: 那位演员为了寻找失踪的孪生弟弟推掉了所有通告。
examples.trans: To search for his missing twin brother, the actor cancelled all bookings.

examples.text: 他和孪生弟弟长得几乎一模一样。
examples.trans: He and his twin brother look almost identical.

meanings.note: Conjunction nìngkě ('would rather ... than').

examples.text: 硬盘如果修不好，宁可当场销毁。
examples.trans: If a drive cannot be fixed, we would rather destroy it.

examples.text: 他宁可自己累一点，也不麻烦别人。
examples.trans: He would rather work harder himself than trouble others.

meanings.note: Pinyin: níng jìng. Warm, poetic cousin of 安静.

examples.text: 抬头看夜空下那些金色灯笼——真宁静啊！
examples.trans: Look up at those golden lanterns against the night sky—how peaceful!

examples.text: 清晨的小院有一份难得的宁静。
examples.trans: The early-morning courtyard holds a rare tranquility.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tā. Third-person singular pronoun for objects, animals, and places.

examples.text: 是啊，宋老师，还在等它的主人呢。
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, still waiting for its owner.

examples.text: 别念叨它，宋老师！我现在差不多喜欢上那两声响了。
examples.trans: Don't tempt it, Teacher Song! I have almost grown fond of those two rings now.

它们.gloss: they; them (for things, plants, or animals)

meanings.en: they; them (for things, plants, or animals)
meanings.note: Pinyin: tā men. Non-human plural pronoun 它 ('it') + plural suffix 们.

examples.text: 这几扇旧窗板都是灰色的，我以前都没注意过它们。
examples.trans: These old shutters are all grey; I never even noticed them before.

examples.text: 把工具擦干净以后，请把它们放回木箱里。
examples.trans: After wiping the tools clean, please put them back in the wooden chest.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shǒu. Used for minding the front desk or keeping watch over a shop.

examples.text: 你们守着，我出门啦！
examples.trans: Hold the fort—I am heading out the door!

examples.text: 一家雨夜修阁楼台灯、还替陌生人守箱子的客栈。
examples.trans: One that fixes attic lamps on a rainy night and guards a stranger's bag.

meanings.note: Resultative verb meaning hold the line without yielding.

examples.text: 无论遇到多大风浪，团队都决心守住原创阵地。
examples.trans: Whatever storms hit, the team resolved to hold the original-content fort.

examples.text: 只有守住品质底线，节目品牌才能长久。
examples.trans: Only by guarding the quality baseline can a show brand endure.

examples.text: 淳总。你跟我走，升职培训！高级制作人有三十七条内部守则，淳总定的。
examples.trans: Mr Chun. Now come with me for promotion training — senior producers have thirty-seven internal rules set by Mr Chun himself.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Workplace noun ānbǎo ('security personnel/measures').

examples.text: 我们安排了专业的安保在隔壁二十四小时待命。
examples.trans: We arranged professional security standing by next door 24/7.

examples.text: 红毯现场的安保工作做得非常严密。
examples.trans: Security along the red carpet was tightly organized.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ān quán. Describes safe storage or safe travel.

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

examples.text: 现在他的箱子还安全锁着呢。
examples.trans: For now, his suitcase stays safely locked up.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ān ān quán quán. AABB reduplication of 安全 ('safe/secure'), expressing reassuring completeness ('safe and sound').

examples.text: 您的老花镜安安全全装在西装口袋里呢，一点儿也没丢。
examples.trans: Your reading glasses are tucked safe and sound inside your suit pocket, not lost at all.

examples.text: 暴雨来临以前，大家把所有的木窗板都安安全全搬进了走廊。
examples.trans: Before the storm hit, everyone carried all the wooden shutters safe and sound into the hallway.

meanings.note: Offering warmth to someone grieving or upset.

examples.text: 朋友一直耐心地陪在身边安慰难过的她。
examples.trans: Her friend stayed patiently beside her to comfort her.

examples.text: 他留在国外安慰思念儿子的年迈养父母。
examples.trans: He stayed abroad to comfort the elderly adoptive parents missing their son.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ān pái. Used as both verb ('arrange a room') and noun ('an arrangement').

examples.text: 我在做梦吗？！志豪，这场重逢是你安排的吗？
examples.trans: Am I dreaming?! Zhihao, did you plan this whole reunion?

examples.text: 生活安排的二重奏比我们自己写得更妙，孩子们。
examples.trans: Life arranges finer duets than we write ourselves, boys.

meanings.note: Verb ānchā ('secretly place someone inside').

examples.text: 不要在我身边安插眼线。
examples.trans: Stop planting informants around me.

examples.text: 他在公司里安插了人。
examples.trans: He planted someone in the company.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ān jìng. Core A1 adjective for quiet courtyards and rooms.

examples.text: 很安静，谢谢，不过这个行李箱今天特别重。
examples.trans: Very quiet, thank you, though this suitcase feels especially heavy today.

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sòng. Family name of Teacher Song (宋老师).

examples.text: 早上好，姑娘。我有一个宋名下的预订。
examples.trans: Good morning, young lady. I have a booking for Song.

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, room four on the second floor! Was the train ride tiring?

meanings.note: Pinyin: wán. Most often follows an action verb as a result complement meaning 'finish doing' (读完, 弹完).

examples.text: 每次弹完琴，他都问为什么下雨天钢琴声音更暖。
examples.trans: Whenever I finished playing, he asked why the piano sounded warmer on rainy days.

examples.text: 十二下敲完了……大门外面街上空荡荡的。
examples.trans: Twelve chimes have finished... and the street outside the gate is completely empty.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wán le. Colloquial exclamation when something goes wrong; after a task, means 'finished'.

examples.text: 完了！昨天我没戴眼镜，在平板上接了电话预订！
examples.trans: Disaster! Yesterday without my glasses I took a phone booking on the tablet!

examples.text: 志豪先生，看第一页：下个月改建商业办公室。我们完了！
examples.trans: Mr Zhihao, look at page one: commercial office conversion next month. We are finished!

meanings.note: Pinyin: wán quán. Emphasizes 100% agreement or completeness (完全正确 'completely right').

examples.text: 完全是意外！到表哥家打开一看，里面是乐谱和红丝带。
examples.trans: Completely by accident! At my cousin's home I opened it and saw sheet music and a red ribbon.

examples.text: 完全正确！目前你们四张桌子只接待住店客人。
examples.trans: Exactly right! Right now your four tables only serve overnight inn guests.

meanings.note: Verb/adjective wánshàn ('make thorough and sound').

examples.text: 我们要完善这两个月以来的调查报告。
examples.trans: We want to refine our two-month review report.

examples.text: 新制度让节目审核流程更加完善。
examples.trans: New rules made the show review workflow more thorough.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wán hǎo. Describes fragile items surviving a trip unbroken.

examples.text: 里面的茶杯呢？还完好吗？
examples.trans: And the teacup inside? Is it still intact?

examples.text: 包裹里的瓷茶杯依然完好。
examples.trans: The porcelain teacup inside the parcel is still intact.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wán hǎo wú sǔn. Four-character idiom praising fragile items kept safe.

examples.text: 我的茶杯完好无损，两兄弟和好了，小晴也找到了新家。
examples.trans: My teacup survived unharmed, two brothers made peace, and Qing found a new home.

examples.text: 寄了上千公里，箱子里的老瓷杯依然完好无损。
examples.trans: Shipped over a thousand kilometers, the porcelain cup arrived completely intact.

meanings.en: to complete; to finish; to accomplish; to fulfill
meanings.note: Pinyin: wánchéng. Transitive verb commonly paired with objects like 任务 ('task/mission'), 工作 ('work'), 目标 ('goal'), or 计划 ('plan').

examples.text: 行了，别站着了，去完成你的任务！
examples.trans: Alright, stop standing around — go complete your mission!

examples.text: 让他看见宝石，他才会有信心完成演唱。
examples.trans: Only when he sees that gem does he have the confidence to finish his vocal performance.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wán zhěng. Describes something with no part missing or broken (又干净又完整 'clean and whole').

examples.text: 小晴，你看这些白琴键，又干净又完整。
examples.trans: Qing, look at these white keys—clean and whole.

examples.text: 这张老地图还很完整。
examples.trans: This old map is still complete.

meanings.note: Formal/crisp completion marker after 准备/检查/检修.

examples.text: 所有摄像和灯光设备都已经调试完毕。
examples.trans: All camera and lighting gear has been fully tested.

examples.text: 全组人员集合完毕，随时可以出发。
examples.trans: The entire crew has finished assembling and is ready to roll.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wán měi. Praises a flawless result.

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

examples.text: 热红茶配柠檬蛋糕真是完美！
examples.trans: Hot black tea with lemon cake is simply perfect!

meanings.note: Idiom praising bold, sweeping goals.

examples.text: 年轻人刚工作时都怀着宏图壮志。
examples.trans: Young people starting out all carry grand ambitions.

examples.text: 光有宏图壮志不够，还要脚踏实地。
examples.trans: Grand ambition alone is not enough; you need solid action.

examples.text: 平时最痛恨的就是你的官僚作风，今天你真是立大功了！
examples.trans: Normally I can't stand your bureaucratic paper slips, yet today your habit saved the company!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Adjective/noun guānfāng ('official').

examples.text: 他们的官方微博发了声明。
examples.trans: Their official Weibo posted a statement.

examples.text: 官方网站都被粉丝挤爆了。
examples.trans: The official website crashed from fan traffic.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dìng. Used for setting a time or booking an appointment (定好 'settle/fix').

examples.text: 定好闹钟吧，老陈。明早我们跑赢冷水！
examples.trans: Set your alarm, Chen. Tomorrow morning we outrun the cold water!

examples.text: 我们已经定好了明天见面的时间。
examples.trans: We have already set the time to meet tomorrow.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dìng hǎo. Resultative compound 定 ('decide/fix') + 好 ('settled/complete').

examples.text: 星期三咖啡角的菜单已经全部定好了。
examples.trans: Wednesday's menu for the café corner is now completely set.

examples.text: 我们定好了明天早上八点一起刷窗板。
examples.trans: We set eight o'clock tomorrow morning to paint the shutters together.

meanings.note: Colloquial noun bǎoshū ('beloved treasure of a book').

examples.text: 我这本书可是陪我从小到大的宝书。
examples.trans: This book has been my cherished treasure ever since childhood.

examples.text: 这本写满批注的导演手册被她当成宝书。
examples.trans: She treats that note-filled directing manual like a treasured book.

meanings.note: Noun bǎoshí ('precious or artificial stone').

examples.text: 他在舞台上没有看到那颗宝石。
examples.trans: He did not see that gemstone on the stage.

examples.text: 这颗蓝色的宝石真漂亮。
examples.trans: This blue gemstone is lovely.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎo zàng. Measure word (量词): 份 (fèn) or 批 (pī). Note pronunciation zàng ('storehouse/trove', not cáng 'hide').

examples.text: 周经理在大门口告诉我，你们在树底下挖出了宝藏！
examples.trans: Manager Zhou told me at the gate that you dug up buried treasure under the tree!

examples.text: 这盒三十年前的素描和菜谱，是我们小院真正的宝藏。
examples.trans: This thirty-year-old box of sketches and recipes is our courtyard's true treasure.

实不相瞒.gloss: truth be told, to be completely frank

meanings.en: truth be told, to be completely frank
meanings.note: Idiom shíbù-xiāngmán ('not hiding the truth from you').

examples.text: 其实实不相瞒，他从大学起就是我的偶像。
examples.trans: Truth be told, he has been my idol ever since college.

examples.text: 实不相瞒，我对这次跨国拍摄既期待又紧张。
examples.trans: To be honest, I feel both excited and nervous about shooting abroad.

examples.text: 实习感觉怎么样？
examples.trans: How does the internship feel?

examples.text: 这是实习。
examples.trans: This is 实习.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shíxíshēng. Formed from 实习 ('to intern / practice in the field') + agentive suffix 生 ('student/trainee'). Mentors 'lead' or 'train' interns using the verb 带 (带实习生).

examples.text: 星天要招实习生？新鲜啊！
examples.trans: Xingtian wants to recruit an intern? Now that is something new!

examples.text: 他的习惯是不带实习生的。
examples.trans: His habit is never taking on interns.

meanings.note: Real competence backed by skill and resources.

examples.text: 在电视行业里，最终还是要靠作品和实力说话。
examples.trans: In television, ultimately your work and real capability do the talking.

examples.text: 这支年轻团队在危机中展现出了惊人的实力。
examples.trans: This young team displayed remarkable strength during the crisis.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí zài. Describes sturdy materials, unpretentious food, or dependable people.

examples.text: 钢琴里面全是实在的木头、毛毡和钢丝。
examples.trans: Inside a piano it is all solid wood, felt, and steel wire.

examples.text: 这碗热扁豆汤用料实在，喝一碗就饱了。
examples.trans: This bowl of hot lentil soup is made with hearty ingredients; one bowl fills you right up.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí xīn. Describes solid metal, wood, or stone objects (实心黄铜 'solid brass'); opposite of 空心 ('hollow').

examples.text: 绒布袋里装着一个沉甸甸的实心黄铜指南针。
examples.trans: Inside the velvet pouch sits a weighty solid-brass pocket compass.

examples.text: 阳台栏杆是用实心老橡木做的，结实极了。
examples.trans: The balcony railing is built of solid seasoned oak and is remarkably sturdy.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí qíng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个实情 ('the real situation').

examples.text: 对，小晴。那个蓝行李箱是我的——我把实情全告诉你们。
examples.trans: Yes, Qing. That blue suitcase is mine—and I will tell you both the whole truth.

examples.text: 他决定把实情一五一十告诉大家。
examples.trans: He decided to tell everyone the plain truth.

meanings.en: to implement; to put into effect; to carry out
meanings.note: Pinyin: shíshī. Formal verb typically applied to plans (方案), policies (政策), laws, or strategic measures rather than everyday errands.

examples.text: 方案是你想出来的，当然应该由你来实施。
examples.trans: You thought up the plan, so of course you should be the one to carry it out.

examples.text: 这项新规定将从下个月起正式实施。
examples.trans: This new regulation will be officially implemented starting next month.

related.gloss: to put into practice; practical implementation

实现.gloss: fulfil; come true; realize (a dream, wish, or prophecy)

meanings.en: fulfil; come true; realize (a dream, wish, or prophecy)
meanings.note: Pinyin: shí xiàn. Takes abstract goals, dreams, or promises as object (实现梦想 'realize a dream', 实现预言 'fulfil a prophecy').

examples.text: 周经理不小心多订的椅子，居然实现了三十年前的预言！
examples.trans: Manager Zhou's accidental extra chair order actually fulfilled a thirty-year-old prophecy!

examples.text: 两兄弟终于实现了一起在小院喝星期五下午茶的心愿。
examples.trans: The two brothers finally fulfilled their wish of sharing Friday afternoon tea in the courtyard.

meanings.note: Verb shíxíng ('carry out a system or rule').

examples.text: 一部现在实行三班制，大家都很忙。
examples.trans: Unit One now runs three shifts, keeping everyone busy.

examples.text: 下个月起公司实行新的考勤制度。
examples.trans: Next month the firm implements new attendance rules.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí huà. Measure word (量词): 句 (jù), e.g. 一句实话 ('an honest word').

examples.text: 说实话，我比以前灰色办公室喜欢这儿多了。
examples.trans: Honestly, I like this place far better than my old grey office.

examples.text: 说实话，今晚我自己都想住这儿了！
examples.trans: Honestly, I almost want to sleep up here myself tonight!

meanings.en: to tell the plain truth; speak frankly
meanings.note: Pinyin: shí huà shí shuō. Four-character idiom ('speak honest words honestly').

examples.text: 谢谢你们实话实说，没让我冒雨再找地方。
examples.trans: Thank you both for speaking honestly instead of sending me back into the rain.

examples.text: 遇到问题别瞒着，实话实说客人最能体谅。
examples.trans: When an issue comes up, speak frankly—guests appreciate honesty most.

meanings.note: Adjective/noun shíjì ('practical, actual').

examples.text: 方案是按照几周前的实际改版总结的。
examples.trans: The plan summarises the actual revamp done weeks ago.

examples.text: 做预算必须结合项目的实际情况。
examples.trans: Budgets must match the project's actual needs.

meanings.note: Adverb shíjìshang ('in reality, actually').

examples.text: 实际上那就是一场负面新闻炒作。
examples.trans: In fact, that was purely a negative publicity stunt.

examples.text: 他表面严厉，实际上非常关心下属。
examples.trans: He looks stern outside, yet actually cares for his staff.

meanings.note: Testing an innovative broadcast or technical approach.

examples.text: 这次大胆的联合直播实验取得了圆满成功。
examples.trans: This bold joint-broadcast experiment was a complete success.

examples.text: 技术团队在开播前做了好几轮信号实验。
examples.trans: The tech team ran several signal trials before going live.

meanings.note: Companion animal kept at home.

examples.text: 她在家里养了一只可爱的宠物。
examples.trans: She keeps an adorable pet at home.

examples.text: 周末很多人带着宠物去公园散步。
examples.trans: Many people walk their pets in the park on weekends.

meanings.note: Verb shěn ('examine and approve copy').

examples.text: 最后的稿子我们要审。
examples.trans: We have to review and approve the final draft.

examples.text: 节目播出之前总编室必须严格审片。
examples.trans: The chief editor's office must vet every cut before broadcast.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shěn hé. Combines 审 ('examine carefully') + 核 ('verify/check'); used as both a noun and a verb for official permit reviews.

examples.text: 信封上写着：街坊老建筑咖啡馆审核——星期三下午三点整。
examples.trans: On the envelope it read: Neighbourhood Heritage Café Review—Wednesday at three o'clock sharp.

examples.text: 市政厅办事员仔细审核了九号房的窗户、消防出口和茶点。
examples.trans: The City Hall clerk carefully reviewed Room Nine's windows, exits, and refreshments.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kè rén. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位客人 ('a guest').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

examples.text: 此外就是客座明星的人选问题。
examples.trans: Besides that, there is the question of choosing the guest star.

examples.text: 此外就是客座明星的人选问题。
examples.trans: Besides that, there is the question of choosing the guest star.

meanings.note: Broadcast noun kèzuò zhǔchí ('visiting or guest presenter').

examples.text: 最近几期节目她都是客座主持。
examples.trans: She has been the guest host for the past few episodes.

examples.text: 下周我们请来一位知名客座主持。
examples.trans: Next week we are bringing in a famous guest host.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kè fáng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间客房 ('a guest room').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 星期一你打开了卡住的门；这一周你救了客房、水管、早餐和租约。
examples.trans: On Monday you opened our sticking door; this week you saved rooms, pipes, breakfast, and our lease.

examples.text: 找客服帮忙。
examples.trans: Ask customer service for help.

examples.text: 客服电话。
examples.trans: Customer service number.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kè zhàn. Measure word (量词): 家 (jiā), e.g. 一家客栈 ('an inn').

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

examples.text: 我们客栈都是五星级服务……哎呀！
examples.trans: At our inn, everything is five-star service... whoops!

meanings.note: Pinyin: kè qi. Famous in 不用客气 / 别客气 ('you're welcome / don't stand on ceremony').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 太客气了，周经理。半杯就好。
examples.trans: How polite of you, Manager Zhou. Half a glass is fine.

meanings.note: Adjective kèguān ('objective, unbiased').

examples.text: 我只是客观地评断每一份方案。
examples.trans: I simply judge every proposal objectively.

examples.text: 评价一档节目要保持客观公正。
examples.trans: Judging a programme requires staying fair and objective.

meanings.note: Verb/noun xuānchuán ('publicity, marketing promotion').

examples.text: 如果去掉媒体评审，后台宣传怎么配合？
examples.trans: Without a media jury, how does publicity coordinate?

examples.text: 新节目开播前的宣传非常到位。
examples.trans: Pre-launch publicity for the new show was spot on.

examples.text: 黄金一班刚刚宣布阵容！
examples.trans: The Golden Class reunion lineup was only just announced!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì nèi. Place noun 室 ('room/chamber') + 内 ('inside'); contrasts with 室外 ('outdoors').

examples.text: 检查清单第二条要求室内座位明亮安全。
examples.trans: Item Two on the checklist requires indoor seating to be bright and safe.

examples.text: 拱窗打开以后，室内的钢琴声一直飘到了院子大树下。
examples.trans: Once the arched windows were opened, the piano music from indoors drifted out under the courtyard tree.

meanings.note: Popular Chinese television genre about imperial court rivalries.

examples.text: 近几年古装宫斗剧在各大平台收视率都很高。
examples.trans: Costume palace-intrigue dramas have scored huge ratings in recent years.

examples.text: 她吐槽公司里的权谋手段简直像在演宫斗剧。
examples.trans: She joked that the office maneuvering felt straight out of a palace drama.

meanings.note: Verb hài ('cause harm to').

examples.text: 真的不是我害他的。
examples.trans: I truly did not harm him.

examples.text: 熬夜会害了自己的身体。
examples.trans: Staying up late harms your own health.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiā. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个家 ('a home').

examples.text: 上面怎么用铅笔整齐画了这条街三家客栈？
examples.trans: Why are three inns on this street neatly sketched in pencil on it?

examples.text: 看我们这家旁边写着：院子宽度、街道声音、安静九分！
examples.trans: Look beside ours: Courtyard width, street noise, quiet score nine points!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiā rén. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位家人 ('a family member').

examples.text: 因为房子只是砖头和木头，志鹏，家人才是留住的东西。
examples.trans: Because a house is only brick and timber, Zhipeng—family is what we keep.

examples.text: 周末能跟家人坐在一起吃饭最幸福。
examples.trans: Sitting down to a meal with family on the weekend is pure happiness.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiā jù. Measure word (量词): 件 (jiàn), e.g. 一件家具 ('a piece of furniture').

examples.text: 这张老照片我真喜欢，可是新的家具太贵了！
examples.trans: I truly love this old photo, but new furniture costs a fortune!

examples.text: 周经理，谁说要买很贵的新家具了？
examples.trans: Manager Zhou, who said anything about buying expensive new furniture?

related.gloss: a piece of furniture (measure word 件)

meanings.note: Noun jiājìng ('family circumstances').

examples.text: 最好还要长得帅，家境好。
examples.trans: Ideally he should also be handsome and from a good family.

examples.text: 虽然家境普通，但她读书非常刻苦。
examples.trans: Though from a modest background, she studied diligently.

meanings.en: Jiaxi (Chinese given name; refers to pop singer Luo Jiaxi in Behind the Scenes)
meanings.note: Pinyin: Jiāxī. Often preceded by 我们 ('our') by managers or team members (我们家希) to express protective familiarity.

examples.text: 我们家希不可能跟星天合作了。
examples.trans: There is no way our Jiaxi can work with Xingtian anymore.

examples.text: 家希这次的新歌舞台表现非常出色。
examples.trans: Jiaxi's stage performance for his new song this time was outstanding.

meanings.note: Home life and family unit.

examples.text: 再忙也别忽略了自己的家庭生活。
examples.trans: However busy you get, do not neglect family life.

examples.text: 她在一个温暖的家庭里长大。
examples.trans: She grew up in a warm household.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiā lǐ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 家里地方 ('home').

examples.text: 说实话，我选这一带，也是为了一桩家里的旧事。
examples.trans: Honestly, I also chose this neighbourhood for an old family matter.

examples.text: 哦？您家里人以前住在这附近吗？
examples.trans: Oh? Did your family live near here once?

meanings.note: Noun jiāmén ('door of one's home').

examples.text: 别提了，刚一出家门就被大雨困在这儿了。
examples.trans: Do not even ask—right outside my doorstep I got trapped by the rain.

examples.text: 暴风雨夜里，热心邻居主动打开家门收留路人。
examples.trans: On the stormy night, kind neighbours opened their doors to passers-by.

examples.text: 你现在有空吗？能不能陪我去趟日本？那就在我们家门口见！
examples.trans: Are you free right now? Could you accompany me on a quick trip to Japan? Let's meet right outside my building!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Bound morpheme detached when 整容 takes aspect particle 过 (整过容).

examples.text: 他幽默地调侃自己既年轻不再又没整过容。
examples.trans: He joked wryly that he was neither young nor surgically enhanced.

examples.text: 自然真诚的笑容比任何修饰都更能打动观众。
examples.trans: A genuine smile moves audiences more than any cosmetic touch-up.

examples.text: 这淳于乔眼里容不下别人，我早跟你说过了。
examples.trans: Chun Yuqiao has no room in his eyes for anyone else — I warned you about him from the start.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: róng yì. Stative adjective ('easy to do'); before a verb, 很容易 / 不容易 means 'easily / not prone to'.

examples.text: 厚陶瓷杯很结实，不容易摔破。
examples.trans: Thick ceramic cups are sturdy and don't break easily.

examples.text: 有老陈带路，找五金摊就容易多了。
examples.trans: With Chen leading the way, finding the hardware stall is much easier.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kuān. Describes wide streets, courtyards, or rooms.

examples.text: 小心，周经理，壶嘴很宽！
examples.trans: Careful, Manager Zhou, the pitcher spout is wide!

examples.text: 一点也不介意！窗下这张宽书桌正适合我工作。
examples.trans: Not at all! And this wide desk beneath the window suits my work ideally.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kuān dù. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个宽度 ('a width').

examples.text: 看我们这家旁边写着：院子宽度、街道声音、安静九分！
examples.trans: Look beside ours: Courtyard width, street noise, quiet score nine points!

examples.text: 他用尺子量了一下木门的宽度。
examples.trans: He measured the width of the wooden door with a ruler.

宽限.gloss: grant an extension, allow extra grace time

meanings.en: grant an extension, allow extra grace time
meanings.note: Verb kuānxiàn ('extend a deadline').

examples.text: 咱们能给星天宽限时间，台里不会给我们宽限。
examples.trans: We can grant Xingtian extra time, yet the network will not extend ours.

examples.text: 请再宽限两天，我们一定把终稿交上来。
examples.trans: Grant us two more days and we will turn in the final draft.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jì. Used for mailing letters, postcards, or parcels.

examples.text: 从那天起我们就再没说过话。上周我给他寄了一张明信片。
examples.trans: Since that day we have not spoken again. Last week I mailed him a postcard.

examples.text: 房东律师寄来的？奇怪——我们房租一直交到明年夏天了。
examples.trans: Sent by the landlord's lawyer? Strange—our rent is paid right through next summer.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jìjiànrén. Measure word: 位, 个.

examples.text: 包裹上没有写寄件人的名字。
examples.trans: The sender's name was not written on the package.

examples.text: 请确认寄件人的地址是否正确。
examples.trans: Please confirm whether the sender's address is correct.

meanings.note: Numeric or character code unlocking a door or computer.

examples.text: 为了安全起见，机房门禁每个月都会更换密码。
examples.trans: For security, the editing suite door code changes monthly.

examples.text: 输入正确的密码才能打开这份加密文件。
examples.trans: Enter the right password to open this encrypted file.

meanings.note: Colloquial noun fù'èrdài ('child of wealthy entrepreneurs').

examples.text: 他是典型的富二代，在圈里很有号召力。
examples.trans: He is a classic rich heir with real pull in fan circles.

examples.text: 虽然是富二代，他工作却很拼命。
examples.trans: Though from a wealthy family, he works very hard.

examples.text: 如果你是个富人的话，你会让自己变得更好。
examples.trans: And if you are wealthy, you push yourself to become a better person.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Noun fùháo ('rich magnate').

examples.text: 哪个富豪能忍得了她的脾气呀？
examples.trans: What tycoon could put up with her temper?

examples.text: 传闻有位神秘富豪资助了这个艺术展。
examples.trans: Rumour had it a wealthy patron funded the art show.

meanings.note: Literary noun hánchuāng (as in 六年寒窗, 'years studying by a cold window').

examples.text: 六年寒窗，你就只有一个目标。
examples.trans: Through six years of study, you held onto one goal.

examples.text: 十年寒窗终于换来了今天的成绩。
examples.trans: Years of hard study finally paid off today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cùn. Traditional unit of length; 一寸都不会挪动 ('won't budge a single inch').

examples.text: 吃午饭以前，老陈和他的纸账本一寸都不会挪动。
examples.trans: Until lunchtime, Chen and his paper ledger will not budge a single inch.

examples.text: 请把这张水彩画再往左边挪半寸就正好了。
examples.trans: Move this watercolour painting half an inch further left and it will sit dead straight.

寸步不离.gloss: never leave someone's side, stay within a step

meanings.en: never leave someone's side, stay within a step
meanings.note: Four-character idiom showing devoted care or close guarding.

examples.text: 他生病住院那几天，她几乎寸步不离地守着。
examples.trans: While he was in hospital, she stayed right by his side.

examples.text: 小狗跟在主人身后寸步不离。
examples.trans: The puppy trotted right at its owner's heels.

meanings.note: Pinyin: duì. Means 'correct!' on its own, 'right' as a result complement (拿对), or 'to/toward' before a noun.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 看拉链旁边……对，有她的名字缩写！
examples.trans: Check beside the zipper... yes, her name initials are here!

examples.text: 授权附表和咱们系统里的记录对不上！
examples.trans: The signed licensing appendix doesn't match the record in our internal database!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: duì bu qǐ. Sincere apology; typically answered with 没关系 ('it's alright').

examples.text: 宋老师，真对不起，那边还没有消息。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, I am truly sorry; they have no news over there yet.

examples.text: 我念念：对不起拿错了，请帮我保管到星期五。
examples.trans: Let me read it: Sorry for taking the wrong one; please keep mine until Friday.

meanings.note: Conversational opener introducing a newly remembered topic.

examples.text: 对了，差点忘了把这个好消息告诉你。
examples.trans: By the way, I nearly forgot to tell you the good news.

examples.text: 对了，明天的会议时间改到下午两点了。
examples.trans: Oh right—tomorrow's meeting moved to two in the afternoon.

对事不对人.gloss: focus on the issue, not the person

meanings.en: focus on the issue, not the person
meanings.note: Idiom duìshì búduìrén ('judge work objectively without personal bias').

examples.text: 改革讲究的是对事不对人。
examples.trans: Reform is about work standards, never personal grudges.

examples.text: 他在会上批评方案向来对事不对人。
examples.trans: His critiques in meetings always target work, not people.

meanings.note: Preposition duìyú ('with regard to').

examples.text: 现在的学生对于这种事积极性不高。
examples.trans: Students nowadays are not keen regarding this sort of gig.

examples.text: 对于新员工，公司会安排培训。
examples.trans: Regarding new hires, the firm arranges training.

meanings.note: Verb duìfu ('go up against, deal with').

examples.text: 从那件事就能看出来，有人要对付淳于乔。
examples.trans: From that stunt alone, clearly someone is targeting him.

examples.text: 光靠老办法很难对付突发危机。
examples.trans: Old methods will not handle a sudden crisis.

meanings.note: Colloquial noun duìtóu ('opponent, rival').

examples.text: 大家都知道她原本是你们公司的对头。
examples.trans: Everyone knows she used to be your company's rival.

examples.text: 两家卫视在周末档一直是老对头。
examples.trans: The two networks have long been weekend rivals.

meanings.note: Noun duìjú ('chess match or strategic contest').

examples.text: 在灰度不同的对局之下，黑白有时会颠覆。
examples.trans: Across strategic matches of shifting grey, black and white flip.

examples.text: 这不仅是一场谈判，更是一场心理对局。
examples.trans: This is not just negotiation, it is a psychological match.

examples.text: 不管接受与否，我都会认真地对待辛惠美的情感。
examples.trans: Whether I accept her feelings or not, I will treat Xin Huimei's heart with complete sincerity.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 对手那边拼着命地跟我们抢人。
examples.trans: The rival network is fighting tooth and nail with us to snap up talent.

examples.text: 对手那边拼着命地跟我们抢人。
examples.trans: The rival network is fighting tooth and nail with us to snap up talent.

meanings.note: Workplace verb duìjiē ('act as point of contact').

examples.text: 您的生活起居都由我们导演组直接来对接。
examples.trans: Your daily routine will be coordinated directly by our directors.

examples.text: 小谷负责跟海外场地方对接设备清单。
examples.trans: Xiaogu is coordinating the gear list with the overseas venue.

meanings.note: Noun duìfāng ('the other side in talks or competition').

examples.text: 那档谈话节目是对方的王牌节目。
examples.trans: That talk show is the rival network's flagship programme.

examples.text: 合同已经发给对方公司审核了。
examples.trans: The contract was sent to the other party for review.

meanings.note: Noun duìxiàng ('target recipient or interview subject').

examples.text: 由辛惠美现场选定一家资助的对象。
examples.trans: Xin Huimei picks one recipient to fund on the spot.

examples.text: 这次折腾四天的采访对象到底是谁？
examples.trans: Who is the interview guest who took four days to book?

meanings.note: Verb duìzhì ('cross-examine or confront in person').

examples.text: 给他们打电话，把他们叫出来当面对质。
examples.trans: Call them right now and bring them out to confront you.

examples.text: 真相一当面对质就清楚了。
examples.trans: The truth comes out once people confront each other.

meanings.note: Pinyin: duì miàn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 街对面 ('across the street').

examples.text: 等等——您本来打算让店员把箱子交给他，自己躲在街对面看？！
examples.trans: Wait—you were planning to let the clerk hand him the bag and watch from across the street?!

examples.text: 客栈正对面是一家安静的花店。
examples.trans: Directly across from the inn is a quiet flower shop.

寻宝.gloss: hunt for treasure; go on a treasure hunt

meanings.en: hunt for treasure; go on a treasure hunt
meanings.note: Pinyin: xún bǎo. Verb-object compound (寻 'seek' + 宝 'treasure'); 寻宝队 = 'treasure-hunting crew'.

examples.text: 早上好，寻宝队！我给大家端了三杯热咖啡过来。
examples.trans: Good morning, treasure hunters! I brought three hot mugs of coffee out for everyone.

examples.text: 星期六上午，大家拿着指南针去梧桐巷寻宝。
examples.trans: On Saturday morning, everyone heads down Wutong Lane with the compass on a treasure hunt.

meanings.note: celebrity coach/mentor on a competition show or academic advisor

examples.text: 有请本场十二歌王的客座导师，刘凡先生！
examples.trans: Please welcome tonight's Twelve Singers guest mentor, Mister Liu Fan!

examples.text: 四位导师都已经入座了。
examples.trans: All four mentors have already taken their seats.

meanings.en: production control room; broadcast gallery (in television or live streaming)
meanings.note: Pinyin: dǎobōshì. Compound of 导播 ('broadcast director / live switcher') + 室 ('room'), where multi-camera feeds and audio signals are monitored and switched live.

examples.text: 这边是导播室，所有的信号都传到这儿来。
examples.trans: Over here is the control room; every signal comes through to here.

examples.text: 收到！导播室，一号机准备就位，二号机就位！
examples.trans: Copy that! Control room, camera one ready in position, camera two in position!

meanings.note: Film/TV noun dǎoyǎn ('director').

examples.text: 优秀的制片人和导演我合作过很多。
examples.trans: I have collaborated with many fine producers and directors.

examples.text: 现场导演正在通过耳麦指挥机位切换。
examples.trans: The floor director is calling camera switches over the headset.

meanings.note: Production noun dǎoyǎnzǔ ('team of directors').

examples.text: 所有行程都得由我们导演组统一对接。
examples.trans: Every schedule item is handled by our directing team.

examples.text: 导演组连夜开会确定了明天的拍摄路线。
examples.trans: The directing team met overnight to lock tomorrow's route.

meanings.note: Verb dǎozhì ('cause an undesirable result').

examples.text: 同质化竞争导致观众看到的都是同样的东西。
examples.trans: Copycat rivalry leads viewers to see the same shows everywhere.

examples.text: 设备老化导致彩排推迟了半小时。
examples.trans: Aging gear caused rehearsal to start thirty minutes late.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fēng. Counts sealed letters and mail items (一封信 'a letter').

examples.text: 我在看天气，小美！铃铛旁边这封厚信是谁放的？
examples.trans: I am checking the weather, Mei! Who put this thick letter beside the bell?

examples.text: 太好了……趁着等他们，我扫一眼这封房东来信。
examples.trans: Wonderful... while we wait, let me glance at this letter from the landlord.

meanings.note: Media verb fēngshā ('shut out from appearances').

examples.text: 你要在所有节目里封杀他们吗？
examples.trans: Are you blacklisting them across all our shows?

examples.text: 恶意炒作的艺人很容易被行业封杀。
examples.trans: Artists who stage ugly stunts risk industry blacklisting.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fēng pí. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng) or 层 (céng). Refers to the outer front/back cover of a book or ledger.

examples.text: 另一半菜谱就夹在那本绿封皮的花园叶子书里！
examples.trans: The other half of the recipe is pressed inside that green-covered book of garden leaves!

examples.text: 老陈先翻开旧书的封皮内侧，找到了当年的门牌号。
examples.trans: Chen checked inside the front cover of the old book first and found the house number from back then.

meanings.note: Noun fēngmiàn ('album/magazine cover').

examples.text: 这次的封面不好看。
examples.trans: This cover does not look good.

examples.text: 谁选的封面？
examples.trans: Who picked the cover?

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiāng. Formal future marker seen in official notices and legal documents.

examples.text: 产权转让通知：八号小院整栋建筑将作为商业办公楼出售。
examples.trans: Property Transfer Notice: Courtyard Building Eight offered for sale as commercial offices.

examples.text: 咖啡馆将于明早八点开放。
examples.trans: The café will open tomorrow morning at eight.

将功折罪.gloss: atone for a fault by good service

meanings.en: atone for a fault by good service
meanings.note: Idiom jiānggōng-zhézuì ('make amends through merit').

examples.text: 我将功折罪的机会终于来了。
examples.trans: My chance to redeem my mistake has finally arrived.

examples.text: 上次出了差错，这次他想将功折罪。
examples.trans: Having slipped up last time, he wants to make amends now.

将就.gloss: make do with, put up with

meanings.en: make do with, put up with
meanings.note: Verb jiāngjiu ('make do for now').

examples.text: 房间重新给您布置过了，您就先将就一下吧。
examples.trans: We redecorated the suite for you—please make do with it for now.

examples.text: 时间太紧来不及去食堂，午饭先吃块三明治将就一下。
examples.trans: Too rushed for the canteen, I made do with a sandwich.

examples.text: 我们先沟通好了，以免将来产生误会。
examples.trans: Let us communicate clearly first, so we avoid misunderstandings in the future.

examples.text: 我们先沟通好了，以免将来产生误会。
examples.trans: Let us communicate clearly first, so we avoid misunderstandings in the future.

meanings.note: Sense of personal or professional honor.

examples.text: 为了维护职业尊严，他果断拒绝了不合理要求。
examples.trans: To uphold his professional dignity, he firmly refused unreasonable demands.

examples.text: 真正尊重团队的领导会守护每个人的尊严。
examples.trans: A leader who truly respects the team safeguards everyone's dignity.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zūn jìng. Combines 尊 ('honor/revere') + 敬 ('respect'); used as a polite salutation in formal speeches (尊敬的…… 'Esteemed...').

examples.text: 周经理拿着五页纸念道：“尊敬的市政代表……”
examples.trans: Holding five sheets of paper, Manager Zhou read aloud: 'Esteemed municipal representative...'

examples.text: 宋老师是整条梧桐巷最受大家尊敬的钢琴老师。
examples.trans: Teacher Song is the most respected piano teacher along the entire length of Wutong Lane.

meanings.note: Verb/noun zūnzhòng ('respect, value').

examples.text: 有时候粉丝的合理意见我们要尊重。
examples.trans: At times we must respect reasonable fan opinions.

examples.text: 认真倾听是对嘉宾基本的尊重。
examples.trans: Listening attentively shows basic respect for guests.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo. Everyday adjective for small size; also prefixes younger colleagues' names warmly (小晴, 小美).

examples.text: 早上好，姑娘。我有一个宋名下的预订。
examples.trans: Good morning, young lady. I have a booking for Song.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.note: Compound xiǎoshì ('minor detail').

examples.text: 每一件小事都很重要。
examples.trans: Every small detail matters.

examples.text: 这只是小事。
examples.trans: This is just a small matter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo huǒ zi. Affectionate everyday term for an energetic young man; takes plural suffix 们 when addressing a group directly; measure word: 个 (gè) or 位 (wèi).

examples.text: 小美笑着对志鹏和志豪说：“小伙子们，举起茶杯吧！”
examples.trans: Mei smiled at Peng and Hao and said, 'Boys, raise your teacups!'

examples.text: 那两个年轻的小伙子一个早上就把厨房的面团和浓汤都准备好了。
examples.trans: Those two young fellows got both the bread dough and the rich soup ready in a single morning.

小声.gloss: in a low voice; quietly; in a whisper

meanings.en: in a low voice; quietly; in a whisper
meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo shēng. Adverbial phrase literally meaning 'small voice'; 小声点 ('keep your voices down / whisper!'), opposite of 大声 ('aloud').

examples.text: 你们俩小声点——楼上的客人还在睡觉呢！
examples.trans: Whisper, both of you—the upstairs guests are still asleep!

examples.text: 宋老师小声提醒志豪先把节奏放慢一点。
examples.trans: Teacher Song quietly reminded Hao to slow the tempo down a little first.

meanings.note: Affectionate/colloquial noun xiǎogūniang ('young girl/woman').

examples.text: 我以为吓唬一下助理小姑娘很容易。
examples.trans: I thought bluffing a young assistant would be easy.

examples.text: 别看她是个年轻小姑娘，做事特别稳。
examples.trans: Though young, she handles her work remarkably steadily.

meanings.note: Colloquial term for a young man, teasing or annoyed.

examples.text: 那个送戒指的小子真是什么招都想得出来。
examples.trans: That guy with the ring really will try every trick in the book.

examples.text: 这小子虽然年轻，干起活来倒挺利索。
examples.trans: Though young, that fellow works briskly.

examples.text: 新闻说惠美跟一个小孩被拍了！
examples.trans: The news says Huimei was just photographed with a child!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo xiǎo. Reduplication of 小 ('small'); adds a vivid, affectionate nuance ('tiny little').

examples.text: 您看右边——清漆下面本来就有两个小小的螺丝孔。
examples.trans: Look on the right—there were two tiny screw holes under the clear varnish all along.

examples.text: 每个小玻璃瓶里都插着一片小小的绿柠檬叶。
examples.trans: A tiny green lemon leaf is tucked inside each small glass jar.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo xīn. Literally 'small heart'—pay close attention.

examples.text: 小心，周经理，壶嘴很宽！
examples.trans: Careful, Manager Zhou, the pitcher spout is wide!

examples.text: 拐弯小心点，别碰到墙！
examples.trans: Careful on the turn—do not bump the wall!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo tí qín. Combines 小 ('small') + 提 ('hold/carry in hand') + 琴 ('stringed instrument'); measure word: 把 (bǎ).

examples.text: 三十年前，每个星期五傍晚他都带着一把小提琴来九号房。
examples.trans: Thirty years ago, every Friday evening he brought a violin to Room Nine.

examples.text: 老先生答应星期五带上小提琴，和宋老师的钢琴一起合奏。
examples.trans: The elderly gentleman promised to bring his violin on Friday and play a duet with Teacher Song's piano.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo shí. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个小时 ('an hour').

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

examples.text: 七点整——比早餐早半个小时。
examples.trans: Seven sharp—half an hour earlier than breakfast.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo shí hou. Measure word (量词): 段, e.g. 小时候时光 ('childhood days').

examples.text: 小时候就住隔两条街。星期五对我来说……是重要日子。
examples.trans: Two streets over, when I was little. Friday for me... is an important day.

examples.text: 等一下……梧桐巷十二号，角落里还写着两个童年名字的首字母！
examples.trans: Wait a moment... Number twelve, Wutong Lane, with two childhood initials written in the corner!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo qíng. Friendly name of Courtyard Inn's new receptionist.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

meanings.note: Idiom xiǎoyǒu-míngqì ('fairly well known').

examples.text: 你现在在圈里也算小有名气了。
examples.trans: You have built a modest name for yourself in the circle now.

examples.text: 这家独立书店在大学生当中小有名气。
examples.trans: This indie bookshop is fairly well known among students.

examples.text: 小朋友才刚开始实习。
examples.trans: The youngster has only just started her internship.

examples.text: 小朋友才刚开始实习。
examples.trans: The youngster has only just started her internship.

meanings.note: Colloquial nickname xiǎofěnhóng ('little pink one').

examples.text: 小粉红笔记本？这是你私藏的吗？
examples.trans: A little pink notebook? Is this from your stash?

examples.text: 桌上的那本小粉红记满了电话号码。
examples.trans: That little pink book on the desk is full of numbers.

小红花.gloss: little red paper flower (kindergarten gold star)

meanings.en: little red paper flower (kindergarten gold star)
meanings.note: Used jokingly among adults for wanting praise.

examples.text: 表现这么积极，你是想跟老师要朵小红花吗？
examples.trans: Being so eager—are you hoping for a gold star from the teacher?

examples.text: 幼儿园老师给乖巧的小朋友发了小红花。
examples.trans: The kindergarten teacher handed out little red stars to good kids.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiáo měi. Friendly name of Courtyard Inn's baker and barista.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

examples.text: 你好，小美，很高兴认识你！好香啊！
examples.trans: Hello, Mei, nice to meet you! Something smells wonderful!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo jié. In music notation, counts bars/measures between vertical barlines (二十四小节 'twenty-four bars').

examples.text: 这首圆舞曲的前八个小节特别轻快。
examples.trans: The opening eight bars of this waltz are especially light and lively.

examples.text: 宋老师用铅笔在第四小节旁边做了记号。
examples.trans: Teacher Song made a pencil mark beside the fourth bar.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎoshī. Measure word: 首.

examples.text: 他在卡片上写了一首小诗。
examples.trans: He wrote a short poem on the card.

examples.text: 这首小诗虽然短，但意境很美。
examples.trans: Although this short poem is brief, its mood is beautiful.

meanings.en: Xiaogu (given name / affectionate address for protagonist Bu Xiaogu)
meanings.note: Pinyin: Xiǎogǔ. Dropping the surname 布 (Bù) and using the given name 小谷 reflects workplace familiarity or friendship among colleagues.

examples.text: 小谷，准备好和淳于乔开会。
examples.trans: Xiaogu, get ready to have a meeting with Chun Yuqiao.

examples.text: 小谷一直梦想成为一名优秀的节目制作人。
examples.trans: Xiaogu has always dreamed of becoming an outstanding television producer.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo lù. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条小路 ('a small lane').

examples.text: 对！左边有两条小路——我走哪一条？
examples.trans: Yes! There are two small lanes on the left—which one do I take?

examples.text: 院子后面有一条通往河边的小路。
examples.trans: Behind the courtyard runs a footpath down to the river.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo duì. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè) or 支 (zhī), e.g. 一支小队 ('a crew'). Warm, playful word for a small group of friends.

examples.text: 素描底下写着：“星期五下午茶小队，五月”。
examples.trans: Pencilled along the bottom of the sketch is: 'Friday Tea Crew, May'.

examples.text: 小晴、周经理和志豪组成了今天的梧桐巷寻宝小队。
examples.trans: Qing, Manager Zhou, and Hao formed today's Wutong Lane treasure-hunt crew.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo yuàn. Measure word (量词): 座 (zuò), e.g. 一座小院 ('a small courtyard').

examples.text: 有进步！今天小院迎接兄弟重逢——大家保持安静端庄！
examples.trans: Progress! Today our courtyard hosts a brotherly reunion—quiet dignity from everyone!

examples.text: 产权转让通知：八号小院整栋建筑将作为商业办公楼出售。
examples.trans: Property Transfer Notice: Courtyard Building Eight offered for sale as commercial offices.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo yuàn kè zhàn. Eight-room boutique courtyard inn on Wutong Lane in Chengdu.

examples.text: 欢迎来到小院客栈，小晴。明天不会无聊了。
examples.trans: Welcome to Courtyard Inn, Qing. Tomorrow will not be boring.

examples.text: 小院客栈，早上好！我是小晴。
examples.trans: Courtyard Inn, good morning! This is Qing speaking.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiáo niǎo. Measure word (量词): 只 (zhǐ), e.g. 一只小鸟 ('a little bird').

examples.text: 没错。外面大街很吵，进了院子却只听见树叶和小鸟。
examples.trans: Exactly. Outside on the main road it is noisy, yet inside the courtyard you only hear leaves and birds.

examples.text: 早上树上有两只小鸟在唱歌。
examples.trans: Two little birds are singing in the tree this morning.

meanings.note: Adjective/adverb shǎo ('less, few').

examples.text: 今天店里已经算人少了。
examples.trans: The shop actually counts as quiet tonight.

examples.text: 哪有粉丝捐钱少的道理？
examples.trans: How could fan donations ever be small?

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a adj used in conversational Mandarin.

examples.text: 我有一个尖。
examples.trans: I have a 尖.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的尖。
examples.trans: This is a very good 尖.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiānduān. Measure word: 个.

examples.text: 针的尖端非常锐利。
examples.trans: The point of the needle is extremely sharp.

examples.text: 他们掌握了世界上最尖端的技术。
examples.trans: They have mastered the most cutting-edge technology in the world.

examples.text: 毕竟这些俗事对淳于总还有我们来说，也是抛不开的尘世烦恼。
examples.trans: After all, for Mr Chun Yu and the rest of us, these worldly tangles are troubles we cannot simply shake off.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 此次严重侵权事件恐将打击星天信誉价值，实际造成的损失尚不可预期。
examples.trans: This serious infringement case threatens Xingtian's reputation, and the full financial losses remain unpredictable.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

尚可一战.gloss: still ready to fight and win

meanings.en: still ready to fight and win

examples.text: 别抛弃，别放弃，重出江湖，尚可一战！
examples.trans: Don't give up, don't back down — step back into the arena and fight!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cháng. Specifically tasting food or drink (尝一尝 / 尝一下); contrast 试 ('try out' objects or clothes).

examples.text: 快来尝一口刚出炉的热面包！
examples.trans: Come taste a bite of warm bread fresh from the oven!

examples.text: 卖蜂蜜的大姐请我们尝了一小勺山蜂蜜。
examples.trans: The honey vendor invited us to taste a little spoonful of mountain honey.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cháng chang. Softened reduplication of 尝 ('taste'), standard when inviting someone to sample food.

examples.text: 快来尝尝我刚烤出来的杏仁柠檬挞！
examples.trans: Come have a taste of the almond lemon tart I just baked!

examples.text: 你先尝尝这碗番茄汤咸淡合适不合适。
examples.trans: Have a taste of this tomato soup first to see if the seasoning is right.

examples.text: 来看你啊！我可是人生第一次尝试传说中的办公室恋爱。
examples.trans: I came to see you! This is my very first time trying out a legendary office romance.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Adverb yóuqí ('above all, especially').

examples.text: 尤其是当着外国人的面，别太凶。
examples.trans: Do not be too harsh, especially in front of foreign guests.

examples.text: 今晚的演出非常精彩，尤其是最后的大合唱。
examples.trans: Tonight's show was wonderful, especially the finale chorus.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù. Highlights immediacy, exact location (就在这里), or smooth consequence ('then').

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

就事论事.gloss: judge a matter purely on its own merits

meanings.en: judge a matter purely on its own merits
