meanings.note: Idiom for staying objective without personal bias.

examples.text: 评价对手的能力时，他一向坚持就事论事。
examples.trans: When assessing a rival's skill, he always sticks strictly to the facts.

examples.text: 开会讨论问题应该就事论事，不要翻旧账。
examples.trans: Meetings should judge issues on their merits rather than dredging up old grudges.

就位.gloss: take one's post, be in position

meanings.en: take one's post, be in position
meanings.note: Verb-object jiùwèi ('be in position on set').

examples.text: 助阵的同学们全部都已经就位了。
examples.trans: All the cheering classmates are in position.

examples.text: 四号机位已经就位了吗？
examples.trans: Is Camera Four in position yet?

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù xiàng. Introduces a vivid comparison.

examples.text: 每天服务街坊邻居——就像对公众开放的早间咖啡馆？！
examples.trans: Serves neighbours daily—like a morning café open to the public?!

examples.text: 住在这里就像回到自己家一样舒服。
examples.trans: Staying here feels just as cozy as coming home.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù shì. Adds emphatic certainty before a noun ('is the very one').

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

examples.text: 没关系！您就是志豪先生吧？
examples.trans: No problem at all! You must be Mr Zhihao, right?

examples.text: 就是因为下雨，我们没去。
examples.trans: Just because it rained, we didn't go.

examples.text: 就是因为这个，我生气了。
examples.trans: Just because of this, I got angry.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù suàn. Pairs with 也 in the next clause: 就算…也… ('even if…, still…').

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 留下来，小美。就算他转身走出大门，我也认了。
examples.trans: I am staying, Mei. Even if he turns around and walks straight out the gate.

就绪.gloss: be in readiness, all set and standing by

meanings.en: be in readiness, all set and standing by
meanings.note: Verb jiùxù ('everything ready in order').

examples.text: 导播室，户外直播现场已经准备就绪！
examples.trans: Control room, the outdoor live unit is all set and standing by!

examples.text: 灯光音响全部调试就绪，随时可以开录。
examples.trans: Lighting and sound are tuned and ready to roll at any moment.

examples.text: 谢谢你今天帮我，但是如果你再继续说下去的话，我就要带着小允走出去了。
examples.trans: Thank you for helping me today, yet if you keep suggesting a fake romance, I will take my brother and walk out.

examples.text: 现在我就要隆重介绍一下我的男朋友，星天娱乐的首席内容官，淳于乔先生。
examples.trans: Allow me to proudly introduce my boyfriend — Xingtian Entertainment's chief content officer, Mr Chun Yuqiao.

meanings.note: Adjective gāngà ('awkward').

examples.text: 大家只能尴尬又不失礼貌地微笑着。
examples.trans: Everyone could only keep an awkward yet polite smile.

examples.text: 忘词的那几秒钟让现场气氛有点尴尬。
examples.trans: Forgetting the lines for seconds made the set awkward.

meanings.note: Character name in the television drama Behind the Scenes (幕后之王).

examples.text: 尹家希在节目里的表现让大家都刮目相看。
examples.trans: Yin Jiaxi's performance on the show made everyone look at her with new eyes.

examples.text: 导演专门找尹家希谈了下一场演出的安排。
examples.trans: The director spoke specifically with Yin Jiaxi about the arrangements for the next performance.

meanings.en: Yin Zhengyu (Chinese full name of a candidate in Behind the Scenes)
meanings.note: Pinyin: Yǐn Zhèngyǔ. Composed of the Chinese surname 尹 (Yǐn) and the two-character given name 正宇 (Zhèngyǔ).

examples.text: 吉总推荐最近两个星期的最佳人选尹正宇。
examples.trans: President Ji recommends the top candidate of the past two weeks, Yin Zhengyu.

examples.text: 尹正宇是我们确定的三个最佳人选之一。
examples.trans: Yin Zhengyu is one of the three top candidates we settled on.

related.gloss: candidate; person selected for a role

meanings.note: Pinyin: chǐ zi. Combines 尺 ('measuring rule / Chinese foot') + noun suffix 子; measure word: 把 (bǎ).

examples.text: 志鹏开玩笑说，志豪真会拿一把尺子去量每一颗胡萝卜丁！
examples.trans: Peng joked that Hao really would take a ruler to measure every single cube of diced carrot!

examples.text: 挂欢迎木牌以前，老陈先用尺子量好了门框两边的高度。
examples.trans: Before hanging the welcome sign, Chen used a ruler to measure the height on both sides of the doorframe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chǐ cun. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个尺寸 ('a size / measurement').

examples.text: 冬天用掉最后一个了。只有桥那边的老五金店有这个尺寸。
examples.trans: Used the last one in winter. Only the old hardware shop past the bridge carries this size.

examples.text: 这两个铜阀门的尺寸完全一样。
examples.trans: The dimensions of these two brass valves are identical.

meanings.note: Verb jìn ('put forth one's utmost').

examples.text: 我想尽我全力地好好去爱你。
examples.trans: I want to love you with everything I have.

examples.text: 只要尽了最大努力，无论结果如何都不后悔。
examples.trans: Give your utmost effort and you will have zero regrets.

examples.text: 义务？跟我谈恋爱，用不着拿出尽义务的心态。
examples.trans: Duty? Dating me doesn't call for the mindset of fulfilling an obligation!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Verb-object jìnlì ('put forth every effort').

examples.text: 我们已经尽力改进了每一个细节。
examples.trans: We did our utmost to improve every single detail.

examples.text: 不管结果如何，大家尽力就好。
examples.trans: Whatever the outcome, doing our best is what counts.

examples.text: 这是尽快啊。
examples.trans: This is as soon as possible.

examples.text: 那个尽快好。
examples.trans: That as soon as possible is good.

meanings.en: feel free to; go right ahead
meanings.note: Pinyin: jín guǎn. Warm host adverb inviting someone not to hesitate (尽管说 'feel free to ask').

examples.text: 您尽管看，宋老师。星期一下午大堂暗。
examples.trans: Go right ahead, Teacher Song. Monday afternoon the lobby was dim.

examples.text: 不够喝的话，请尽管叫我添热茶。
examples.trans: If you want a refill, feel free to ask me for more hot tea.

meanings.note: Adverb jìnliàng ('to the fullest extent possible').

examples.text: 一会儿让同学们尽量往前站。
examples.trans: Have the classmates stand as far forward as possible.

examples.text: 有困难我们会尽量帮你解决。
examples.trans: If trouble comes up, we will try our best to help.

meanings.note: Measure word for games, matches, or rounds of competition.

examples.text: 两档音乐节目正面交锋，我们漂亮地赢下了这一局。
examples.trans: When the two music shows clashed head-on, we won this round cleanly.

examples.text: 比赛采用三局两胜制决定最终胜负。
examples.trans: The contest uses a best-of-three format to decide the winner.

meanings.note: The broader landscape of a company or negotiation.

examples.text: 她临危受命，努力维持公司内部稳定的局面。
examples.trans: Stepping up in a crisis, she worked to preserve company stability.

examples.text: 新节目的成功彻底打开了原创市场的局面。
examples.trans: The new show's success broke the original-format market wide open.

层.gloss: measure word for floors and layers

meanings.en: measure word for floors and layers
meanings.note: Pinyin: céng. Counts building stories (三层 'third floor') and coatings/layers (一层糖粉 'a layer of powdered sugar').

examples.text: 他爷爷会切热柠檬蛋糕，上面撒一层白糖粉！
examples.trans: His grandfather sliced warm lemon cake with a dusting of powdered sugar on top!

examples.text: 面包上面撒了一层白糖粉。
examples.trans: A thin layer of powdered sugar is dusted over the bread.

examples.text: 从法律层面上来讲，这家公司已经违约在先了，所以他们手中的这份合约已经失效。
examples.trans: Legally speaking, the publisher breached its contract first, rendering the agreement in its hands null and void.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Adverb jūrán ('unexpectedly').

examples.text: 你们居然在这儿直接吃饭吗？
examples.trans: Are you actually eating right here on set?

examples.text: 短短一天居然筹到了这么多钱！
examples.trans: In one short day they actually raised this much money!

屈尊.gloss: condescend, humble oneself to accept a lower spot

meanings.en: condescend, humble oneself to accept a lower spot
meanings.note: Polite/humorous verb asking respected peers to put up with less.

examples.text: 她诚恳地请求两位前辈屈尊留下来并肩作战。
examples.trans: She sincerely asked the two seniors to swallow their pride and stay.

examples.text: 没想到著名大导演竟愿意屈尊来客串一个小角色。
examples.trans: Nobody expected the famous director to graciously cameo in a small role.

meanings.note: Verb-object/adjective qūcái ('waste high talent on small tasks').

examples.text: 只让你写娱乐文章真是太屈才了。
examples.trans: Having you write mere gossip pieces wastes your talent.

examples.text: 博士毕业做简单打字未免有些屈才。
examples.trans: Routine typing underuses a doctoral graduate's skills.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wū zi. Warm colloquial word for an indoor room (second syllable neutral tone). Measure word: 间 (jiān).

examples.text: 灯一开，整间屋子都亮堂起来了。
examples.trans: As soon as the lamp came on, the whole room brightened up.

examples.text: 窗户打开以后，屋子里满是桂花香。
examples.trans: Once the window was opened, the room filled with sweet osmanthus fragrance.

屋檐.gloss: eaves, roof (figurative in 在屋檐下低头)

meanings.en: eaves, roof (figurative in 在屋檐下低头)
meanings.note: Evokes the proverb 人在屋檐下，不得不低头.

examples.text: 雨水顺着古老庭院的屋檐一滴一滴落下来。
examples.trans: Raindrops dripped one by one from the eaves of the old courtyard.

examples.text: 为了保住心血之作，大家暂时在别人的屋檐下忍耐。
examples.trans: To save their labor of love, everyone endured under a rival's roof for now.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wū lǐ. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 屋里空间 ('space inside the room').

examples.text: 从明天早上八点开始！屋里四张桌，树下三张桌！
examples.trans: Starting tomorrow morning at eight! Four tables indoors, three tables under the tree!

examples.text: 开了暖气，屋里一下子暖和起来了。
examples.trans: With the heat on, the inside of the room warmed right up.

related.gloss: space inside the room (measure word 间)

meanings.note: Pinyin: wū dǐng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个屋顶 ('a roof').

examples.text: 听屋顶上的雨声，这儿真温馨！
examples.trans: Listen to the rain on the roof—it feels so cosy up here!

examples.text: 哇……你们看这木头屋顶的比例！
examples.trans: Wow... look at the proportions of this timber roof!

meanings.note: Pinyin: píng mù. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块屏幕 ('a screen').

examples.text: 等等，让我把平板屏幕和纸本子放一起看。
examples.trans: Wait—let me look at the tablet screen and the paper ledger side by side.

examples.text: 电脑屏幕上显示着今天的预订信息。
examples.trans: Today's reservation details are showing on the computer screen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǎn kāi. Resultative verb joining 展 ('spread out, extend') + 开 ('open'), used for folded paper, maps, or cloth.

examples.text: 顺着原来的折痕把画纸慢慢展开，炭笔线条还很清楚。
examples.trans: Unfold the drawing paper slowly along its original crease, and the charcoal lines are still crisp.

examples.text: 志豪在公园长椅上把四张水彩卡片拼在一起展开。
examples.trans: On the park bench Hao spread the four watercolour cards out together.

examples.text: 这属于个人隐私。
examples.trans: This belongs to personal privacy.

examples.text: 这辆车属于公司。
examples.trans: This car belongs to the company.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shān. Measure word (量词): 座 (zuò), e.g. 一座山 ('a mountain').

examples.text: 这种深色蜂蜜是山里的蜂农送来的。
examples.trans: This dark honey was brought in by beekeepers from the mountains.

examples.text: 雨停以后，远处的青山看得特别清楚。
examples.trans: After the rain stopped, the green hills in the distance looked crystal clear.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shān qiū. Combines 山 ('mountain/hill') + 丘 ('mound/knoll').

examples.text: 把一座大山分成三座小山丘就不觉得难了。
examples.trans: Once you divide a big mountain into three small hills, it no longer feels hard.

examples.text: 村子后面有一片长满绿草的小山丘。
examples.trans: Behind the village lies a stretch of small green hills.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shān máo jǔ mù. Fine-grained hardwood (山毛榉 'beech tree' + 木 'wood') traditionally used in piano actions and hammer shanks.

examples.text: 钢琴里面的许多小零件都是用坚硬的山毛榉木做的。
examples.trans: Many small parts inside a piano are made of hard beechwood.

examples.text: 修山毛榉木的时候动作一定要轻，免得弄裂。
examples.trans: When repairing beechwood you must work gently so as not to split it.

meanings.note: Pinyin: suì. Measure word for age; follows numbers directly without 个 (八十岁 'eighty years old').

examples.text: 声音轻，很有礼貌，大概三十多岁，有点紧张。
examples.trans: Soft-spoken, very polite, around thirty-something, and a bit nervous.

examples.text: 这位老木匠今年七十岁了。
examples.trans: This veteran carpenter is seventy years old this year.

meanings.note: Colloquial synonym of 年纪.

examples.text: 闻老师虽然在主播里岁数最大，却最受年轻人欢迎。
examples.trans: Though oldest among streamers, Mr Wen is the biggest hit with youth.

examples.text: 父母岁数大了，平时要多抽空陪陪他们。
examples.trans: As parents get on in years, make time to keep them company.

meanings.note: Verb chóngbài ('admire deeply').

examples.text: 听说你进星天是因为崇拜淳于总？
examples.trans: I heard you joined Xingtian out of admiration for Chun Yuqiao?

examples.text: 不少学传媒的大学生都非常崇拜这位金牌制作人。
examples.trans: Many media students deeply admire this ace producer.

meanings.note: Showbiz verb/noun xúnyǎn ('go on tour; concert tour').

examples.text: 十二歌王已经季后巡演到一半了。
examples.trans: Twelve Singers is halfway through its post-season tour.

examples.text: 乐队今年夏天将在全国十个城市巡演。
examples.trans: The band tours ten cities nationwide this summer.

examples.text: 那是你的工位，你坐那儿。
examples.trans: That is your desk — you sit over there.

examples.text: 这是工位。 (Example)
examples.trans: This is 工位.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gōng zuò. Measure word (量词): 份 (fèn), e.g. 一份工作 ('a job').

examples.text: 我只是检查安全。这是我的工作。
examples.trans: I am simply checking security. That is my job.

examples.text: 一点也不介意！窗下这张宽书桌正适合我工作。
examples.trans: Not at all! And this wide desk beneath the window suits my work ideally.

meanings.note: Workplace noun gōngzuò rényuán ('crew/staff').

examples.text: 您带来的这些工作人员就可以先回去了。
examples.trans: All the staff handlers you brought along may head back now.

examples.text: 散场后工作人员仔细检查了每一排座椅。
examples.trans: After the show staff checked every row of seats.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gōng zuò shì. Combines 工作 ('work') + 室 ('room/studio'), used for architecture, design, art, or craft studios.

examples.text: 志豪给建筑工作室的搭档打了个电话。
examples.trans: Hao called his partner at the architecture studio.

examples.text: 她的音乐工作室里摆着一架老立式钢琴。
examples.trans: An old upright piano stands in her music studio.

meanings.note: Someone who lives and breathes work around the clock.

examples.text: 大家都知道总制作人是个彻头彻尾的工作狂。
examples.trans: Everyone knows the chief producer is an out-and-out workaholic.

examples.text: 别再当工作狂了，周末也该出去放松一下。
examples.trans: Stop being a workaholic and go relax on the weekend.

meanings.note: Concise summary of ongoing tasks and progress.

examples.text: 每个项目组每周五都要提交一份工作简报。
examples.trans: Every project unit submits a concise work brief each Friday.

examples.text: 新主管要求全员在下班前交齐工作简报。
examples.trans: The new head ordered all staff to hand in work briefs before leaving.

meanings.note: Noun gōngzuòzhě ('professional worker').

examples.text: 请所有的表演工作者和幕后同仁听好。
examples.trans: All performing artists and backstage colleagues, please listen closely.

examples.text: 向每一位坚守一线的电视工作者致敬。
examples.trans: Hats off to every television worker holding the front line.

meanings.note: Workplace noun gōngzuòcān ('on-duty crew meal').

examples.text: 米娜的工作餐你照顾得特别合他胃口。
examples.trans: You arranged Mina's crew meal right to his taste.

examples.text: 录制间隙场务给大家发了热腾腾的工作餐。
examples.trans: During the break crew handed out hot box lunches.

meanings.note: implement used mechanically or figuratively as a pawn

examples.text: 在他眼里，我们都是工具。
examples.trans: In his eyes, we are all tools.

examples.text: 数据只是辅助决策的工具。
examples.trans: Data is only a tool to assist decision-making.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gōng jù fáng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间工具房 ('a tool room').

examples.text: 楼下我的工具房里有一盏铜台灯。
examples.trans: Downstairs in my workshop there is a brass desk lamp.

examples.text: 扳手和螺丝刀都挂在后院的工具房墙上。
examples.trans: Wrenches and screwdrivers hang on the wall of the back-courtyard tool room.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gōng jù xiāng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个工具箱 ('a toolbox').

examples.text: 工具箱里有备用的铜阀门吗？
examples.trans: Is there a spare brass valve in your toolbox?

examples.text: 付了现金！打开工具箱等我，我往桥那边跑回来了！
examples.trans: Paid in cash! Open your toolbox and wait—I am running back across the bridge!

meanings.note: Noun gōngfu ('time to spare; effort').

examples.text: 我晚上还有个约会，没那工夫。
examples.trans: I have plans tonight and do not have the time.

examples.text: 一眨眼的工夫，天就黑了。
examples.trans: In the blink of an eye, it grew dark.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a adv used in conversational Mandarin.

examples.text: 我有一个工工整整。
examples.trans: I have a 工工整整.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的工工整整。
examples.trans: This is a very good 工工整整.

工整.gloss: neat and regular; carefully formed (of handwriting)

meanings.en: neat and regular; carefully formed (of handwriting)
meanings.note: Pinyin: gōng zhěng. Specifically praises tidy, well-proportioned handwriting or layout (字迹工整 'neat handwriting').

examples.text: 这张米色菜谱卡片是用工整的蓝钢笔字写的。
examples.trans: This cream recipe card is written in neat blue fountain-pen handwriting.

examples.text: 宋老师在欢迎卡片上写了两行工整漂亮的毛笔字。
examples.trans: Teacher Song wrote two lines of neat, graceful brushwork on the welcome card.

examples.text: 工资还没拿呢，就干上活了？
examples.trans: You have not even collected your pay yet, and you have already started working?

examples.text: 这是工资。 (Example)
examples.trans: This is 工资.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuǒ. Measure word (量词): 边 (biān), e.g. 左边 ('the left side').

examples.text: 上楼梯，平台往左拐，最上面最后一扇门。
examples.trans: Up the stairs, turn left at the landing, last door at the very top.

examples.text: 出大门往左拐，一直走到石桥。
examples.trans: Go out the front gate, turn left, and walk straight to the stone bridge.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuǒ tóu. Colloquial locality compound 左 ('left') + 头 ('end of a long object').

examples.text: 我抓住木窗板的左头，你扶着右头。
examples.trans: I'll grab the left end of the wooden shutter while you hold the right end.

examples.text: 长木桌的左头放着一篮新鲜柠檬。
examples.trans: A basket of fresh lemons sits at the left end of the long wooden table.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuǒ shǒu. Combines 左 ('left') + 手 ('hand').

examples.text: 你的咖啡杯就在你左手里拿着呢！
examples.trans: Your coffee cup is right there in your left hand!

examples.text: 弹圆舞曲的时候，左手负责稳定的三拍子节奏。
examples.trans: When playing a waltz, the left hand keeps the steady three-beat rhythm.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuǒ bian. Measure word (量词): 边 (biān), e.g. 左边 ('the left side').

examples.text: 这面圆镜子挂哪儿？窗户左边还是右边？
examples.trans: Where should I hang this round mirror? Left of the window or right?

examples.text: 对！左边有两条小路——我走哪一条？
examples.trans: Yes! There are two small lanes on the left—which one do I take?

examples.text: 我没想到辛惠美的影响这么巨大，会有这么好的效果。
examples.trans: I never imagined Xin Huimei's influence would be so immense and bring such amazing results.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chà. Tells minutes 'to' the hour (差五分十二点 'five to twelve') or 'not short a cent' (一分不差).

examples.text: 十、十一、十二。一分不差，谢谢！
examples.trans: Ten, eleven, twelve. Exact to the last cent—thank you!

examples.text: 十二点以后再拆吧，老板！看钟：差五分十二点！
examples.trans: Open it after twelve, boss! Look at the clock: five minutes to twelve!

meanings.en: almost the same; nearly; just about
meanings.note: Pinyin: chà bu duō. Literally 'differ by not much'.

examples.text: 别念叨它，宋老师！我现在差不多喜欢上那两声响了。
examples.trans: Don't tempt it, Teacher Song! I have almost grown fond of those two rings now.

examples.text: 这两个铜阀门的大小看着差不多。
examples.trans: These two brass valves look just about the same size.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chà diǎnr. Erhua colloquial adverb 差 ('fall short by') + 点儿 ('a tiny bit'): indicates something came within a hair's breadth of happening.

examples.text: 听到敲门声的时候，周经理的心差点儿跳过了院子里的树！
examples.trans: When he heard the knock at the gate, Manager Zhou's heart nearly jumped over the courtyard tree!

examples.text: 小晴差点儿把白盐当成白糖放进柠檬酱里。
examples.trans: Qing almost put white salt into the lemon curd thinking it was sugar.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chà píng. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条差评 ('a negative review').

examples.text: 只剩三十五分钟了！他肯定会写一星差评！
examples.trans: Only thirty-five minutes left! He will surely write a one-star bad review!

examples.text: 客栈开业三年，从来没收到过差评。
examples.trans: In three years open, the inn has never received a bad review.

examples.text: 您是领导，是师兄，是我的偶像。我们两个的差距太大了，我应该跟您好好学习。
examples.trans: You are my executive, my senior alumnus, and my idol; the gap between us is huge, and I should learn from you.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Literary/concise adverb yǐ ('already').

examples.text: 本应该属于我的，都已在我手中。
examples.trans: Everything that rightfully belongs to me is already in my hands.

examples.text: 直播倒计时已进入最后五分钟。
examples.trans: The live countdown has already entered its final five minutes.

examples.text: 这几天又有几个八卦微博在说你已婚的事情，我们经纪部出了几个方案，需要你配合一下。
examples.trans: Over the past few days several gossip accounts on Weibo started claiming you're secretly married; management drafted response plans for you.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 已有行业分析师论断，此事必将造成星天娱乐股权整合及上市进程大幅拖慢。
examples.trans: Industry analysts warn the lawsuit will severely delay Xingtian's share restructuring and public listing.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǐ jīng. Often pairs with sentence-final 了 (已经到了 'has already arrived').

examples.text: 没错！你已经很习惯这儿了。
examples.trans: Exactly! You already fit right in here.

examples.text: 还好烤箱里的面团已经放进去了。
examples.trans: My dough is already in the oven, at least.

meanings.note: Vivid adverb bābāde ('earnestly, painstakingly').

examples.text: 危机公关我还巴巴地做什么方案？
examples.trans: Why did I painstakingly draft crisis-PR plans?

examples.text: 他一大早就巴巴地跑去机场接人。
examples.trans: Early in the morning he eagerly hurried to the airport.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàng zi. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条巷子 ('a lane').

examples.text: 走花摊旁边第二条路，别进窄巷子。
examples.trans: Take the second lane beside the flower stall; do not enter the narrow alley.

examples.text: 梧桐巷是一条种满老树的安静巷子。
examples.trans: Wutong Lane is a quiet alley lined with old trees.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì. Used in city names (成都市) and phrases like 市里 ('downtown / municipal authorities').

examples.text: 市里的工作人员明天上午来院子参观。
examples.trans: Staff from the city office are coming to visit the courtyard tomorrow morning.

examples.text: 星期六一早，城南的花鸟市就热闹起来了。
examples.trans: Early Saturday morning, the flower-and-bird market in the south of the city comes alive.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì chǎng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个市场 ('a market').

examples.text: 给我袋子和现金！路口市场七点开门。
examples.trans: Give me a bag and cash! The corner market opens at seven.

examples.text: 我梦寐以求的咖啡馆，就开在自家庭院里！等着瞧我去告诉整条街的人吧！
examples.trans: My dream café—right in our own courtyard! Wait until I tell the whole street!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì zhèng. Measure word (量词): 项, e.g. 一项市政 ('municipal service').

examples.text: 房产信？让志豪和我看看——我管市政合同，他懂老建筑保护法！
examples.trans: A property letter? Let Zhihao and me see it—I handle municipal contracts, and he knows heritage building law!

examples.text: 市政工人正在修路边的石板。
examples.trans: Municipal workers are repairing the flagstones along the road.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì zhèng tīng. Measure word (量词): 座 (zuò), e.g. 一座市政厅 ('a city hall').

examples.text: 等等，志鹏——你还在市政厅合同科工作？！
examples.trans: Wait, Zhipeng—you still work at City Hall's contract office?!

examples.text: 下周我保证把半个市政厅的同事都带来小美这儿喝咖啡。
examples.trans: Next week I promise to bring half my City Hall colleagues to Mei's tables.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì lǐ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 市里部门 ('city office').

examples.text: 那你们的客栈租约就受市里法律再保护十年！
examples.trans: Then your inn lease is protected by city law for another ten years!

examples.text: 这份保护条例是市里去年通过的。
examples.trans: This preservation regulation was passed by the city last year.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bù. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块布 ('a piece of cloth').

examples.text: 周经理，给您干净布和冷水。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou, here is a clean cloth and cold water for you.

examples.text: 请拿一块干净的布擦桌子。
examples.trans: Please take a clean cloth to wipe the table.

related.gloss: a piece of cloth (measure word 块)

meanings.note: proper name

examples.text: 布小谷到位！
examples.trans: Bu Xiaogu is in position!

examples.text: 布小谷到位！
examples.trans: Bu Xiaogu is in position!

examples.text: 房间布局。
examples.trans: Room layout.

examples.text: 新布局。
examples.trans: New layout.

meanings.note: Verb bùzhì ('arrange a venue or assign tasks').

examples.text: 明天我负责提前布置大会会场。
examples.trans: Tomorrow I am responsible for setting up the hall.

examples.text: 美术组把访谈演播室布置得很温馨。
examples.trans: The art team arranged the talk-show set warmly.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bùmiàn. Measure word: 个.

examples.text: 这本书是布面精装的。
examples.trans: This book is a clothbound hardcover.

examples.text: 这个椅子的布面脏了，需要清洗。
examples.trans: The cloth surface of this chair is dirty and needs washing.

meanings.note: Adjective shuài ('handsome').

examples.text: 最好还要长得帅，家境好。
examples.trans: Ideally he should also be handsome and well-off.

examples.text: 穿上西装的主持人看起来真帅。
examples.trans: In his suit, the host looks really sharp.

meanings.note: Campus/workplace address shīxiōng ('senior male fellow student').

examples.text: 我有好多事情想向师兄请教。
examples.trans: I have many questions to ask you, Senior.

examples.text: 那师兄今天几点钟下班？
examples.trans: What time do you finish work today, Senior?

meanings.note: Pinyin: xī wàng. Works as both verb ('hope that…') and noun ('hope').

examples.text: 周经理的意思是……希望每位客人都觉得有十分满意！
examples.trans: What Manager Zhou means is... we hope every guest feels ten-out-of-ten satisfied!

examples.text: 希望您今晚在我们客栈睡个好觉。
examples.trans: We hope you sleep soundly at our inn tonight.

帖.gloss: online post, forum thread (in 转帖/发帖)

meanings.en: online post, forum thread (in 转帖/发帖)
meanings.note: Bound/colloquial noun tiě ('internet post').

examples.text: 很多热心网友都在自发帮受困市民转帖。
examples.trans: Countless warm-hearted netizens are sharing rescue posts voluntarily.

examples.text: 这条互助寻人帖在短短十分钟内被转发上万次。
examples.trans: That mutual-aid post was shared ten thousand times in ten minutes.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dài. Used for carrying keys, tools, or luggage with you.

examples.text: 这么快就修好了？老陈你随身带着螺丝刀啊！
examples.trans: Fixed that fast? Chen, you carry a screwdriver everywhere on you!

examples.text: 说实话，我选这一带，也是为了一桩家里的旧事。
examples.trans: Honestly, I also chose this neighbourhood for an old family matter.

examples.text: 想带新人随便，但是别带到制作会上来。
examples.trans: Mentor newcomers all you like, but do not bring them to the production meeting.

examples.text: 想带新人随便，但是别带到制作会上来。
examples.trans: Mentor newcomers all you like, but do not bring them to the production meeting.

examples.text: 钟小姐特别把这首歌和授权书专门托人带给我们。
examples.trans: Ms Zhong specially entrusted a messenger to bring both this new song and her authorization letter to us.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dài lù. Separable verb-object compound 带 ('lead') + 路 ('way/road').

examples.text: 志鹏熟悉这片老街，让他在前面带路吧。
examples.trans: Peng knows these old streets well—let him lead the way in front.

examples.text: 谢谢你带路，不然我们肯定找不到这家小店。
examples.trans: Thank you for leading the way, or we never would have found this little shop.

带队.gloss: lead a team, head a crew on location

meanings.en: lead a team, head a crew on location
meanings.note: Personally leading a group on an assignment.

examples.text: 这次海外拍摄由总制作人亲自带队出发。
examples.trans: The chief producer personally led the crew abroad for this shoot.

examples.text: 有经验丰富的前辈带队，大家心里很踏实。
examples.trans: With a seasoned senior leading the team, everyone feels reassured.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bāng. Everyday verb for helping someone (帮我一下 'give me a hand').

examples.text: 我来帮您。哎呀，里面装了石头吗？
examples.trans: Let me help you. Goodness, did you pack stones inside?

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

帮上.gloss: manage to help; be of help

meanings.en: manage to help; be of help
meanings.note: Pinyin: bāng shàng. Resultative verb compound 帮 ('help') + 上 ('achieve/manage to'), often with object 忙 (帮上忙 'be of real help').

examples.text: 我们给周经理安排什么活，才能让他觉得自己帮上了忙呢？
examples.trans: What job can we give Manager Zhou so that he feels he really helped out?

examples.text: 多亏志豪今天早上在厨房一起切菜，真是帮上了大忙。
examples.trans: Thanks to Hao chopping vegetables in the kitchen this morning, he was a huge help.

examples.text: 有个事情找你帮个忙，惠美想安排个外卡歌手。
examples.trans: I need a favor from you — Huimei wants to add a wild-card singer to tonight's show.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Noun/verb bāngzhù ('help').

examples.text: 下班后听大家聊天，对我很有帮助。
examples.trans: Listening to everyone chat after work helps me a lot.

examples.text: 谢谢你在工作中给我的帮助。
examples.trans: Thank you for your help at work.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bāng máng. Separable verb-object compound (帮个忙 'do a favor').

examples.text: 我们替他看管了一周蓝箱子，他一定愿意帮忙！
examples.trans: After we guarded his blue suitcase all week, he will gladly help!

examples.text: 行李箱太重了，让我来帮忙吧。
examples.trans: That suitcase is heavy—let me give you a hand.

examples.text: 我看他们太忙了，就想上去帮把手。
examples.trans: I saw they were too busy, so I wanted to step up and lend a hand.

examples.text: 这是帮把手。 (Example)
examples.trans: This is 帮把手.

meanings.note: Noun chángshì ('everyday thing').

examples.text: 拍节目在现场等等人也是常事。
examples.trans: Waiting around a little on a film set is routine.

examples.text: 熬夜改稿对电视编导来说简直是家常便饭的常事。
examples.trans: Staying up revising scripts is routine for TV producers.

meanings.note: Adjective chángbèi ('routinely stocked for emergencies').

examples.text: 节目组有常备药箱。
examples.trans: The show crew keeps a stocked medical kit.

examples.text: 家里应该准备一些常备药。
examples.trans: Every home should keep basic medicines.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cháng chūn téng. Literally 常 ('ever') + 春 ('spring/green') + 藤 ('climbing vine'): evergreen ivy.

examples.text: 院子石墙上的常春藤一直爬到了窗板旁边。
examples.trans: The ivy on the courtyard stone wall climbed right up beside the shutters.

examples.text: 老陈轻轻把常春藤挪到木花架上，一片叶子也没伤着。
examples.trans: Chen gently lifted the ivy onto the wooden trellis without harming a single leaf.

meanings.note: Used as noun or modifier ('conventional/standard').

examples.text: 除了走常规法律程序，我们还得做好舆论沟通。
examples.trans: Beyond standard legal steps, we must also handle public communication.

examples.text: 敢于打破常规才能做出让人眼前一亮的原创节目。
examples.trans: Only daring to break convention creates original shows that dazzle.

meanings.note: Noun chángshí ('basic industry or everyday knowledge').

examples.text: 内部修不好宁可销毁，这是常识。
examples.trans: Destroying unrepairable drives in-house is basic common sense.

examples.text: 安全用电是生活常识。
examples.trans: Safe electricity use is everyday common sense.

meanings.note: Verb chángzhù ('be permanently or long-term based at').

examples.text: 以后我们很有可能会常驻星天。
examples.trans: We will likely be stationed at Xingtian long term.

examples.text: 他是电视台的常驻嘉宾。
examples.trans: He is a regular guest on the network.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mào zi. Combines 帽 ('headgear/hat') + noun suffix 子; measure word: 顶 (dǐng); verb for wearing: 戴 (dài).

examples.text: 钢琴弹到第二页的时候，门外的老先生把灰帽子摘下来了。
examples.trans: When the piano reached page two, the older gentleman outside the gate took off his grey hat.

examples.text: 太阳大的时候，老陈在院子里干活总戴着一顶草帽子。
examples.trans: When the sun is strong, Chen always wears a straw hat while working in the courtyard.

幅.gloss: measure word for paintings, sketches, maps, and cloth

meanings.en: measure word for paintings, sketches, maps, and cloth
meanings.note: Pinyin: fú. Standard classifier for framed pictures, scrolls, sketches, and woven textiles (一幅素描 'a sketch', 一幅画 'a painting').

examples.text: 我们把这幅炭笔素描装进画框，挂在钢琴上方吧。
examples.trans: Let us put this charcoal sketch in a frame and hang it above the piano.

examples.text: 老教授送给客栈一幅手绘的梧桐巷水彩地图。
examples.trans: The old professor gifted the inn a hand-painted watercolour map of Wutong Lane.

examples.text: 幕后工作者。
examples.trans: Behind-the-scenes worker.

examples.text: 走向幕后。
examples.trans: Go behind the scenes.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gàn. Read gàn when meaning 'do work / get a job done' (干得不错 'nicely done!').

examples.text: 第二天上班，干得不错，新手。
examples.trans: For day two on the job, nicely done, rookie.

examples.text: 不许盯着客人看。把箱子交还，干自己的活。
examples.trans: No staring at guests. Hand back the bag and do our own work.

examples.text: 工资还没拿呢，就干上活了？
examples.trans: You have not even collected your pay yet, and you have already started working?

examples.text: 这是干上。 (Example)
examples.trans: This is 干上.

meanings.note: Colloquial phrase gàn shénme asking what someone is doing or intends.

examples.text: 约我来干什么呀？
examples.trans: Why did you ask me out here?

examples.text: 你在那个部门干什么？
examples.trans: What do you do in that department?

meanings.note: Pinyin: gān jìng. Note first tone gān ('dry/clean'), never fourth tone.

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

examples.text: 放心吧，周经理。房间干净，毛巾也是新的。
examples.trans: Relax, Manager Zhou. The room is clean, and the towels are fresh.

meanings.note: Energetic motivation in tackling work.

examples.text: 新来的实习生每天都干劲十足。
examples.trans: The new intern is brimming with drive every day.

examples.text: 被表扬之后，大家的干劲更足了。
examples.trans: After being praised, everyone's enthusiasm grew even stronger.

meanings.note: brisk everyday spoken question word (gàn má)

examples.text: 你在这儿干吗？
examples.trans: What are you doing here?

examples.text: 你这么着急跑过来干吗？
examples.trans: Why did you come running over in such a hurry?

meanings.note: Colloquial question word gànmá ('what for, why').

examples.text: 淳于总，您让我写这篇论文干嘛用呢？
examples.trans: Mr Chun Yuqiao, what is writing this paper for?

examples.text: 女朋友要是会治病，那还要医生干嘛？
examples.trans: If girlfriends cured illnesses, what would we need doctors for?

examples.text: 干得漂亮！不过这个不要送到会议室，去扫描一下，交给闻思默老师！
examples.trans: Brilliant work! Don't take this into the conference room, though — scan a copy and send it straight to Mr Wen Simo!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 没有人可以干扰首席内容官的工作日程，他必然有他要做的事。
examples.trans: Nobody interferes with our chief content officer's schedule — he certainly has vital work of his own to handle.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gān mù tou. Combines 干 (gān, 'dry') + 木头 ('wood').

examples.text: 刚打磨好的干木头千万不能淋雨。
examples.trans: Freshly sanded dry wood must never get rained on.

examples.text: 炉子里添了两块干木头，火苗一下就旺了。
examples.trans: Two pieces of dry wood were added to the stove and the flames sprang right up.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gān bēi. Festive toast raised with tea, juice, or wine.

examples.text: 为小院客栈干杯——成都最热闹的安静角落！
examples.trans: Cheers to Courtyard Inn—the liveliest quiet corner in Chengdu!

examples.text: 来，为我们大家的友谊干杯！
examples.trans: Come on, let's raise a glass to our friendship!

examples.text: 干活累。
examples.trans: Working is tiring.

examples.text: 努力干活。
examples.trans: Work hard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gān zào. Praises dry storage or a dry attic room.

examples.text: 干燥、暖和、安静。快说还缺什么。
examples.trans: Dry, warm, and quiet. Tell me quickly what is still missing.

examples.text: 三楼向阳，冬天屋里也很干燥。
examples.trans: Because the third floor faces south, it stays dry even in winter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gān shuǎng. Combines 干 (gān, 'dry') + 爽 ('crisp/refreshing'): pleasantly dry without a trace of dampness.

examples.text: 幸好搬得及时，四扇木窗板都干爽得很。
examples.trans: Luckily we moved them in time; all four wooden shutters are bone-dry.

examples.text: 秋天的空气干爽舒适，最适合晒被子。
examples.trans: Autumn air is crisp and dry, ideal for airing quilts.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gān cuì. Suggests cutting straight to a clean solution.

examples.text: 大门门铃响了。干脆有力的一下。
examples.trans: There goes the gate bell. One firm, decisive ring.

examples.text: 既然雨这么大，干脆留下来吃晚饭吧。
examples.trans: Since it is raining this hard, you might as well stay for dinner.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gān tòu. Resultative compound 干 (gān, 'dry') + 透 ('thoroughly / all the way through').

examples.text: 要等第一层绿油漆完全干透，才能刷第二层。
examples.trans: You have to wait until the first coat of green paint dries completely before brushing on the second.

examples.text: 姑姑把九号房锁上，想等屋顶先干透。
examples.trans: My aunt locked Room Nine, wanting to wait until the roof dried completely.

meanings.note: Pinyin: píng. Used as a stative adjective ('flat/level') or resultative complement after verbs (收平 'fold flat', 铺平 'smooth flat').

examples.text: 把折叠椅收平以后，就能靠墙放好了。
examples.trans: Once you fold the chair flat, you can lean it neatly against the wall.

examples.text: 院子中间的石板路铺得很平。
examples.trans: The flagstone path in the middle of the courtyard is laid very flat.

meanings.note: Pinyin: píng tái. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个平台 ('a landing / platform').

examples.text: 上楼梯，平台往左拐，最上面最后一扇门。
examples.trans: Up the stairs, turn left at the landing, last door at the very top.

examples.text: 二楼楼梯平台放着一盆绿植。
examples.trans: A potted plant sits on the second-floor stair landing.

meanings.note: Pinyin: píng píng. Reduplication of 平 ('flat/even/smooth'), often followed by 的 after resultative 得 (熨得平平的 'ironed nice and flat').

examples.text: 小晴把四块白亚麻桌布都熨得平平的，没有一道褶子。
examples.trans: Qing ironed all four white linen tablecloths nice and flat without a single crease.

examples.text: 刚铺好的石板路平平的，推着小餐车走非常稳。
examples.trans: The newly laid flagstone path is nice and flat, making it very steady to roll a serving cart along.

meanings.note: Noun píngshǒu ('even tie in competition').

examples.text: 就算再努力，在这方面顶多打个平手。
examples.trans: Even at full strength, at best we fight to a draw.

examples.text: 两档音乐节目昨晚收视打了个平手。
examples.trans: The two music shows tied in last night's ratings.

meanings.note: Pinyin: píng shí. Measure word (量词): 段, e.g. 平时日子 ('ordinary days').

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

examples.text: 那我们平时为什么不租给客人呢？
examples.trans: Then why do we never rent it out to guests?

meanings.note: Pinyin: píng bǎn. Measure word (量词): 台, e.g. 一台平板 ('a tablet').

examples.text: 完了！昨天我没戴眼镜，在平板上接了电话预订！
examples.trans: Disaster! Yesterday without my glasses I took a phone booking on the tablet!

examples.text: 等等，让我把平板屏幕和纸本子放一起看。
examples.trans: Wait—let me look at the tablet screen and the paper ledger side by side.

examples.text: 已经跟咱们俩平级了！
examples.trans: She's already at the exact same rank as the two of us!

examples.text: 是跟你平级好吗？我明明比你高半级！
examples.trans: Same rank as you, okay? I'm clearly half a grade higher than you!

examples.text: 跟我们平级了已经，我必须好好消化一下这件事。小谷，请吃饭啊！
examples.trans: Already on our level — I need a moment to digest this! Xiaogu, dinner is on you!

examples.text: 星天有很多部门，这些部门之间都是平行的。
examples.trans: Xingtian has many departments, and all of these departments are on equal footing.

examples.text: 这是平行。 (Example)
examples.trans: This is 平行.

meanings.note: Pinyin: píng miàn tú. Architectural compound 平面 ('flat plane/horizontal level') + 图 ('drawing/diagram'); measure word: 张 (zhāng).

examples.text: 志豪量过平面图了：九号房里面摆四张桌子，外面灯笼底下摆四张。
examples.trans: Hao measured the floor plan: four tables inside Room Nine and four outside under the lanterns.

examples.text: 在这张详细的建筑平面图上，每一扇拱窗的位置都标得清清楚楚。
examples.trans: On this detailed architectural floor plan, the position of every arched window is marked crystal clear.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nián. Time classifier taking no 个 directly after numbers (六年 'six years', 今年 'this year').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 老橡木，八十年了，一滴水都不漏。
examples.trans: Old oak, eighty years old—not a single drop leaks.

meanings.note: Workplace noun niánjià ('annual paid leave').

examples.text: 我已经向公司请了年假，这几天照顾你。
examples.trans: I already took annual leave so I can look after you these few days.

examples.text: 忙完总决赛直播，全组终于可以轮流休年假了。
examples.trans: Once the live finale wraps, the crew can finally take annual leave.

meanings.note: noun

examples.text: 我是传媒学院的研究生，年级第一名。
examples.trans: I am a graduate student at the Media College, first in my year.

examples.text: 我是传媒学院的研究生，年级第一名。
examples.trans: I am a graduate student at the Media College, first in my year.

meanings.note: In one's youth.

examples.text: 团队里有很多充满活力的年轻编导。
examples.trans: The team has many energetic young writer-directors.

examples.text: 年轻的时候多经历一些挫折其实是好事。
examples.trans: Facing a few setbacks while young is actually a good thing.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nián qīng rén. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个年轻人 ('a young person').

examples.text: 声音客气吗？年轻人还是老人？
examples.trans: Was the voice polite? A young person or an older person?

examples.text: 巷子里来了不少喜欢老建筑的年轻人。
examples.trans: Many young people fond of historic architecture visit the lane.

related.gloss: handle with care (lift gently, set down gently)

meanings.note: Colloquial noun phrase niánqīngbǎn ('younger edition/version').

examples.text: 最好是一个年轻版的你。
examples.trans: Ideally a younger version of you.

examples.text: 大家都说这个实习生像年轻版的总监。
examples.trans: Everyone says this intern resembles a younger version of the director.

meanings.note: Noun niánlíng ('a person's age').

examples.text: 你这是性别歧视还是年龄歧视啊？
examples.trans: Is that gender bias or age discrimination?

examples.text: 这档音乐节目适合不同年龄的观众。
examples.trans: This music show suits viewers of every age.

examples.text: 她仔细锁好大门，并把铜钥匙挂回了木板上。
examples.trans: She locked the front gate carefully and hung the brass key back on the wooden board.

examples.text: 他把旧信封收进抽屉，并在笔记本上记下了日期。
examples.trans: He tucked the old envelope into the drawer and noted the date in his notebook.

meanings.note: Conjunction bìngqiě ('and also, moreover').

examples.text: 并且星天有我非常信任的人。
examples.trans: And moreover, Xingtian has someone I deeply trust.

examples.text: 方案已经通过了，并且下周就开始录制。
examples.trans: The plan passed, and moreover taping starts next week.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bìngpái.

examples.text: 他们两人并排走在小路上。
examples.trans: The two of them walked side by side on the path.

examples.text: 这两栋楼是并排建的。
examples.trans: These two buildings were built side by side.

meanings.note: Business verb/noun bìnggòu ('corporate merger').

examples.text: 对手刚刚完成了一次大型传媒并购。
examples.trans: Our rival just completed a major media merger.

examples.text: 并购之后他们拥有的媒体资源更多了。
examples.trans: After the merger they control far more media outlets.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xìng kuī. Sentence-level adverb expressing relief that something prevented a mishap.

examples.text: 老陈，幸亏您带着机油来了，不然盖子真打不开！
examples.trans: Thank goodness you came with the oil, Chen, otherwise the lid really would not open!

examples.text: 幸亏我们星期天提前试烤了三种糖霜。
examples.trans: Thank goodness we test-baked all three glazes ahead of time on Sunday.

meanings.note: Polite greeting verb xìnghuì ('pleased to meet you').

examples.text: 斯戴拉姐，幸会啊！
examples.trans: Sister Stella, charmed to meet you!

examples.text: 久仰大名，今天真是幸会。
examples.trans: I have heard so much about you—what a pleasure today.

meanings.note: Adverb xìnghǎo ('fortunately').

examples.text: 幸好我还有你这个好朋友。
examples.trans: Luckily I still have a good friend like you.

examples.text: 幸好今天带了雨伞。
examples.trans: Luckily I brought an umbrella today.

meanings.note: Idiom xìngzāi-lèhuò ('take pleasure in others' trouble').

examples.text: 我总觉得小秦有点幸灾乐祸的意思。
examples.trans: I cannot shake the feeling Qin Xiao is gloating over our jam.

examples.text: 同行遇到困难时应当帮忙，绝不能幸灾乐祸。
examples.trans: When peers hit trouble, lend a hand rather than gloat.

meanings.note: Adjective/noun xìngfú ('deeply happy, fulfilled').

examples.text: 那时候我每天都特别幸福。
examples.trans: Back then I was so happy every single day.

examples.text: 祝你们一家人永远幸福。
examples.trans: Wishing your family lasting happiness.

meanings.note: Adjective xìngyùn ('lucky').

examples.text: 我觉得自己是个特别幸运的人。
examples.trans: I feel that I am a remarkably fortunate person.

examples.text: 能加入顶尖团队学习对新人来说非常幸运。
examples.trans: Joining a top team to learn is fortunate for any newcomer.

meanings.note: Noun/verb huànxiǎng ('rosy illusion; daydream').

examples.text: 他一次次把我不切实际的幻想打碎。
examples.trans: Again and again he shattered my unrealistic illusions.

examples.text: 做制片不能只靠幻想，要看执行力。
examples.trans: Producing takes execution, not mere daydreams.

meanings.note: Lacking adult judgment.

examples.text: 拿自己的前途去开玩笑，这种做法太幼稚了！
examples.trans: Gambling with your own future like that is way too childish!

examples.text: 经历过几次风浪后，她比以前成熟多了，不再幼稚。
examples.trans: After weathering a few storms, she outgrew her naivety.

meanings.note: Adjective yōumò ('humorous').

examples.text: 我也开玩笑的，我是不是还挺幽默的？
examples.trans: I was joking too—do you not find me pretty humorous?

examples.text: 闻老师主持风格既睿智又幽默，深受观众喜爱。
examples.trans: Mr Wen's witty, humorous hosting style is loved by audiences.

meanings.note: Adjective guǎng ('broad, wide-ranging').

examples.text: 这里有最广的热点娱乐资讯。
examples.trans: Here you find the widest hot entertainment news.

examples.text: 这位主持人的知识面很广。
examples.trans: This host has a broad range of knowledge.

meanings.note: Noun guǎnggào ('advertising, commercial').

examples.text: 否则前期投入的广告就全都白费了。
examples.trans: Otherwise all the upfront advertising spend goes to waste.

examples.text: 高收视率很快吸引了好几家品牌投广告。
examples.trans: High ratings quickly drew several brands to buy ads.

meanings.note: Business noun guǎnggàoshāng ('advertising client').

examples.text: 今天的会议请来了广告商和经纪代表。
examples.trans: Today's meeting invited advertisers and agency reps.

examples.text: 广告商对新一季的冠名方案非常满意。
examples.trans: The advertisers are pleased with next season's sponsorship plan.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guáng chǎng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个广场 ('a public square').

examples.text: 再往左拐进小广场，找一扇蓝木门。
examples.trans: Then turn left into the small square and look for a blue wooden door.

examples.text: 早上有不少老人在小广场散步。
examples.trans: Plenty of seniors stroll around the small square in the morning.

meanings.note: Noun guǎngbō ('radio broadcasting').

examples.text: 你在网络广播上公开骂他。
examples.trans: You roasted him openly on online radio.

examples.text: 每天早上他习惯边吃早饭边听广播。
examples.trans: Every morning he listens to the radio over breakfast.

meanings.note: Dinner held to celebrate a successful show or project.

examples.text: 等节目圆满收官，咱们一起去吃庆功宴！
examples.trans: Once the show wraps triumphantly, let us hit the celebration banquet!

examples.text: 谁今天答错问题，庆功宴就由谁来买单。
examples.trans: Whoever misses a question today picks up the tab at the wrap party.

examples.text: 真的没事，再说了，我们刚好给布小谷开一个庆祝会！
examples.trans: Honestly it's fine — besides, we just used the time to throw Bu Xiaogu a promotion party!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chuáng. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张床 ('a bed').

examples.text: 阁楼里真的有像样的床吗？
examples.trans: Does the attic really have a proper bed?

examples.text: 有，结实的木床、干净书桌，风景全院最好。
examples.trans: Yes, a solid wooden bed, a clean desk, and the best view in the courtyard.

meanings.note: Resting or lying on a bed.

examples.text: 病还没好利索，快回床上踏实躺着吧。
examples.trans: You have not recovered yet—get back in bed and lie down.

examples.text: 怎么能穿着外面的大衣直接躺在床上呢？
examples.trans: How can you lie in bed still wearing your street coat?

meanings.note: Pinyin: chuáng dān. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张床单 ('a bedsheet').

examples.text: 我去柜子拿干净的白床单！
examples.trans: I will fetch clean white bedsheets from the cupboard!

examples.text: 小晴，把床单角塞紧！放上两个软枕头。
examples.trans: Qing, tuck the sheet corner tight! On go the two soft pillows.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chuáng tóu. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个床头 ('the head of a bed').

examples.text: 好：有床、桌子和椅子，可是没有床头台灯。
examples.trans: Okay: there is a bed, a table, and a chair, yet no bedside lamp.

examples.text: 床头小桌上放着一盏暖光台灯。
examples.trans: A warm bedside lamp sits on the nightstand.

related.gloss: the head of a bed (measure word 个)

meanings.note: Verb yìngfu ('manage, cope with').

examples.text: 启动三班制，再多的工作我们也应付得过来。
examples.trans: On three shifts, we can handle any amount of work.

examples.text: 她一个人很难应付这么多客人。
examples.trans: It is hard for her to handle so many guests alone.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yìng jí. Verb-object compound 应 ('respond to') + 急 ('urgent need'); often modifies nouns (应急灯 'emergency light').

examples.text: 前台抽屉里一直放着一把手电筒应急。
examples.trans: There is always a flashlight kept in the front-desk drawer for emergencies.

examples.text: 多准备四把椅子，客人多的时候可以应急。
examples.trans: Keep four extra chairs ready in case we need them for a sudden crowd of guests.

examples.text: 我们有一个应急方案。
examples.trans: We have an emergency plan.

examples.text: 请启动应急方案。
examples.trans: Please activate the emergency plan.

meanings.note: Workplace noun yìngjí yù'àn ('contingency protocol').

examples.text: 快启动凯文准备好的应急预案！
examples.trans: Trigger Kaiwen's emergency contingency plan right away!

examples.text: 大型直播活动必须提前制定详细的应急预案。
examples.trans: Major live broadcasts must prepare contingency plans beforehand.

meanings.note: Tech noun yìngyòngchéngxù ('app').

examples.text: 请马上登录星天直播应用程序传回画面。
examples.trans: Log in to the Xingtian live app right away to transmit your video.

examples.text: 这款新上线的应用程序支持多路高清连麦直播。
examples.trans: This newly launched mobile app supports multi-way HD livestreaming.

meanings.note: Verb yìngpìn ('apply for an open position').

examples.text: 我想回星天应聘初级行政助理。
examples.trans: I want to return to Xingtian to apply for junior admin.

examples.text: 今天有很多毕业生来应聘。
examples.trans: Many graduates came to apply today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yīng gāi. Expresses obligation or confident expectation.

examples.text: 今晚我应该能睡个好觉了。
examples.trans: Tonight I should be able to sleep well after all.

examples.text: 八点半了，邮递员应该快到了。
examples.trans: It is eight thirty; the mail carrier should be here soon.

meanings.note: Noun dǐ (as in 透个底, 'reveal the inside truth').

examples.text: 你就跟我透个底吧，他们谁能赢？
examples.trans: Give me an inside tip — which side is going to win?

examples.text: 充分彩排以后，大家心里都有底了。
examples.trans: After a full rehearsal, everyone felt confident.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dǐ xia. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 最底下 ('the bottom').

examples.text: 看车轮底下——铅笔写的你和我的名字还在那儿。
examples.trans: Look underneath the wheels—your name and mine in pencil are still right there.

examples.text: 前面锁扣有个小锁孔，再看底下贴着：一把旧铜钥匙！
examples.trans: There is a tiny keyhole on the front latch, and taped underneath: an old brass key!

examples.text: 这是底层啊。
examples.trans: This is low-level.

examples.text: 那个底层好。
examples.trans: That low-level is good.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dǐzuò. Measure word: 个.

examples.text: 雕像的底座是大理石做的。
examples.trans: The base of the statue is made of marble.

examples.text: 请把台灯固定在底座上。
examples.trans: Please fix the desk lamp onto its base.

meanings.note: Pinyin: diàn. Measure word (量词): 家 (jiā), e.g. 一家店 ('a shop / inn').

examples.text: 完全正确！目前你们四张桌子只接待住店客人。
examples.trans: Exactly right! Right now your four tables only serve overnight inn guests.

examples.text: 这条街上有好几家小店。
examples.trans: There are several small shops along this street.

meanings.note: Pinyin: diàn zhǔ. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位店主 ('a shopkeeper').

examples.text: 速度真快！店主给你收据了吗？
examples.trans: Impressive speed! Did the shopkeeper give you a receipt?

examples.text: 隔壁花店的店主每天早上送鲜花来。
examples.trans: The flower-shop owner next door delivers fresh blooms every morning.

meanings.note: Pinyin: diàn yuán. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位店员 ('a shop clerk').

examples.text: 门上方只画着一把金色钥匙。拿旧阀门给店员看。
examples.trans: Only a golden key painted above the door. Show the clerk the old valve.

examples.text: 等等——您本来打算让店员把箱子交给他，自己躲在街对面看？！
examples.trans: Wait—you were planning to let the clerk hand him the bag and watch from across the street?!

meanings.note: Pinyin: diàn zhǎng. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位店长 ('a store manager').

examples.text: 小晴，你真是天生的店长！我的血压保住了！
examples.trans: Qing, you are a born innkeeper! My blood pressure is saved!

examples.text: 面包店的店长请大家尝新烤的蛋糕。
examples.trans: The bakery manager invited everyone to taste the freshly baked cake.

meanings.note: Pinyin: diàn mén. Measure word (量词): 扇 (shàn), e.g. 一扇店门 ('a shop door').

examples.text: 店门外面有大招牌吗？
examples.trans: Is there a big shop sign outside the door?

examples.text: 早上七点半，咖啡馆准时打开店门。
examples.trans: At seven thirty sharp, the café opens its shop doors.

meanings.note: Describes massive scale in population, organization, or data.

examples.text: 国内拥有非常庞大的电视观众群体。
examples.trans: The country has an enormous television audience.

examples.text: 支撑这场晚会需要一个庞大的幕后团队。
examples.trans: Backing this gala takes a vast behind-the-scenes crew.

meanings.note: Colloquial noun fèihuà ('empty talk, drivel').

examples.text: 你整天不干正事，还说一堆废话！
examples.trans: Skipping real work all day just to spout nonsense!

examples.text: 时间紧迫，咱们少说废话直接开会。
examples.trans: Time is tight, so skip small talk and start the meeting.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dù. Marks degrees of temperature, angles, or measured levels.

examples.text: 仔细看这一页——记的是分贝和安静度，不是酒店星级！
examples.trans: Look closely at this page—it records decibels and quietness, not hotel stars!

examples.text: 今天下午的气温是二十度。
examples.trans: The temperature this afternoon is twenty degrees.

座.gloss: measure word for bridges, buildings, mountains

meanings.en: measure word for bridges, buildings, mountains
meanings.note: Pinyin: zuò. Counts large, fixed structures on a base (一座石桥 'a stone bridge', 一座钟楼 'a clock tower').

examples.text: 何止认识！整整六年，每个星期五我都爬那座木楼梯教钢琴！
examples.trans: More than know it! Every Friday for six whole years I climbed those wooden stairs to teach piano!

examples.text: 前面有一座古老的石桥。
examples.trans: There is an old stone bridge ahead.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuò wèi. Combines 座 ('seat/place') + 位 ('spot/position'); measure word: 个 (gè).

examples.text: 九号房里的十二个室内座位既明亮又宽敞。
examples.trans: The twelve indoor seats inside Room Nine are both bright and spacious.

examples.text: 请给面包师和音乐老师在钢琴旁边留两个好座位。
examples.trans: Please save two good seats beside the piano for the baker and the music teacher.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuò bǎn. Compound 座 ('seat') + 板 ('wooden board'): the hinged wooden seat panel of a folding chair.

examples.text: 把木头座板往上轻轻一提，椅子就合上了。
examples.trans: Lift the wooden seat board slightly upward and the chair folds shut.

examples.text: 老陈用砂纸把椅子座板打磨得很光滑。
examples.trans: Chen sanded the chair seat board completely smooth with sandpaper.

meanings.note: Legal phrase tíngwài-héjiě ('settle out of court').

examples.text: 她昨天跟原野已经达成了庭外和解。
examples.trans: Yesterday she reached an out-of-court settlement with Yuanye.

examples.text: 双方律师建议进行庭外和解。
examples.trans: Lawyers on both sides advised settling out of court.

examples.text: 客栈中央的庭院里种着一棵高大的老槐树。
examples.trans: A tall old locust tree grows in the courtyard at the center of the guesthouse.

examples.text: 晴天的时候，客人们最喜欢坐在庭院的石桌旁喝早茶。
examples.trans: On sunny days, guests love sitting by the stone table in the courtyard for morning tea.

meanings.note: Medical verb kāngfù ('recuperate fully').

examples.text: 一直到老大身体康复，我们绝不打扰他。
examples.trans: Until our boss recovers fully, we will not disturb him.

examples.text: 祝您早日康复，回到工作岗位。
examples.trans: Wishing you a speedy recovery and return to work.

meanings.note: Abbreviation of 延迟播出 common in television.

examples.text: 一听说新节目可能要延播，合作方都急了。
examples.trans: Hearing the new show might be delayed rattled every partner.

examples.text: 是否延播关系重大，必须由高层开会决定。
examples.trans: Postponing broadcast is huge and requires an executive decision.

meanings.note: Pushing a scheduled event later.

examples.text: 由于天气原因，航班起飞时间延迟了两个小时。
examples.trans: Owing to weather, flight takeoff was delayed two hours.

examples.text: 为了确保万无一失，他建议节目延迟一周播出。
examples.trans: To be completely safe, he suggested delaying the broadcast a week.

meanings.note: Verb jiàn ('build, establish').

examples.text: 这家茶馆是仿江南古典园林建的。
examples.trans: This teahouse was built like a classical southern garden.

examples.text: 新演播大楼是去年刚刚建好的。
examples.trans: The new broadcast building was completed last year.

建成.gloss: to complete construction; to be built

meanings.en: to finish building; to complete construction; to establish
meanings.note: Pinyin: jiànchéng. Verb-complement compound of 建 ('to build/construct') + resultative 成 ('completed/into being'); used for buildings, facilities, systems, and large infrastructure projects.

examples.text: 从建成到现在，一天都没有停。
examples.trans: From the day it was built until now, it has not stopped for a single day.

examples.text: 这座新的影视基地预计明年年底建成。
examples.trans: This new film and television studio complex is expected to be completed by the end of next year.

meanings.note: Verb jiànlì ('build, set up').

examples.text: 建立围绕你自己的音乐空间。
examples.trans: Build a musical space centred around yourself.

examples.text: 合作双方需要慢慢建立起信任。
examples.trans: Partners need to build mutual trust step by step.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiàn zhù. Measure word (量词): 栋 (dòng), e.g. 一栋建筑 ('a building').

examples.text: 产权转让通知：八号小院整栋建筑将作为商业办公楼出售。
examples.trans: Property Transfer Notice: Courtyard Building Eight offered for sale as commercial offices.

examples.text: 一位研究成都历史小院建筑的建筑师啊！
examples.trans: An architect who studies historic courtyard buildings in Chengdu!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiàn zhù shī. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位建筑师 ('an architect').

examples.text: 你的服务值得十分！其实我是声学建筑师。
examples.trans: Your service deserves ten points! Actually, I am an acoustic architect.

examples.text: 声学建筑师！您设计音乐厅吗？
examples.trans: An acoustic architect! Do you design concert halls?

meanings.note: Verb/noun jiànyì ('recommend; suggestion').

examples.text: 他建议不要让那两位评论员同台。
examples.trans: He advises against having those two hosts share a stage.

examples.text: 谢谢你提出这么好的建议。
examples.trans: Thank you for offering such a helpful suggestion.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi. Versatile verb for opening doors, starting business, turning on taps/lights, or water boiling.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 当然不能偷看……咦，自己翻开在中间那页了！
examples.trans: Of course we must not peek... oh, it fell open to the middle page by itself!

开业.gloss: open for business; hold a grand opening

meanings.en: open for business; hold a grand opening
meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi yè. Separable verb-object compound 开 ('open/start') + 业 ('business/trade'); also used as a noun after modifiers (正式开业 'grand opening').

examples.text: 您邀请那位老先生来参加我们星期五傍晚六点的正式开业了吗？
examples.trans: Did you invite that elderly gentleman to come to our grand opening this Friday at six?

examples.text: 街坊们听说九号房咖啡馆要开业，纷纷停下来看门外的木牌。
examples.trans: Hearing that the Room Nine café was opening for business, neighbours stopped to read the wooden sign outside.

开会.gloss: to hold or attend a meeting

meanings.en: to hold a meeting; to attend or be in a meeting
meanings.note: Pinyin: kāihuì. Separable verb-object compound (离合词: 开 + 会), so aspect particles, durations, or modifiers insert between the two characters (e.g., 开了两个小时的会, 开完会). Use 和/跟 + person + 开会 to specify participants.

examples.text: 因为我们不用和他开会！
examples.trans: Because we do not have to attend meetings with him!

examples.text: 小谷，准备好和淳于乔开会。
examples.trans: Xiaogu, get ready to have a meeting with Chun Yuqiao.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi guān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个开关 ('a switch').

examples.text: 周经理，等一分钟，先别碰那个铜开关。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou, wait a minute—don't touch that brass switch yet.

examples.text: 老板，这是三十年的老电线。我检查以前，千万别按开关。
examples.trans: Boss, this wire is thirty years old. Never flip a switch before I check it.

examples.text: 他把自己股份的百分之九十九全捐出来了，研究人类的潜能开发了。
examples.trans: He donated ninety-nine percent of his own shares to research unlocking human potential.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

开口.gloss: open one's mouth to ask or speak up

meanings.en: open one's mouth to ask or speak up
meanings.note: Often refers to broaching a request or favor.

examples.text: 没有充分的材料，就算老朋友也很难替人开口。
examples.trans: Without solid materials, even an old friend finds it hard to ask a favor.

examples.text: 只要你开口帮忙，这件事肯定能顺利解决。
examples.trans: If you put in a word, this matter is sure to go smoothly.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi tóu. Noun (or separable verb) 开 ('open/start') + 头 ('head/beginning').

examples.text: 这首圆舞曲开头的旋律轻快又明亮。
examples.trans: The opening melody of this waltz is light and bright.

examples.text: 故事的开头发生在一个下着大雨的五月夜晚。
examples.trans: The beginning of the story takes place on a rainy night in May.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi shǐ. Everyday verb for starting work, breakfast, or a lesson.

examples.text: 听……街口钟楼开始敲十二下了！
examples.trans: Listen... the clock tower at the end of the street is starting to strike twelve!

examples.text: 从明天早上八点开始！屋里四张桌，树下三张桌！
examples.trans: Starting tomorrow morning at eight! Four tables indoors, three tables under the tree!

meanings.note: Formally starting activities, sports, or campaigns.

examples.text: 公司鼓励员工多开展体育运动。
examples.trans: The company encourages staff to take part in sports.

examples.text: 新项目下周就要正式开展了。
examples.trans: The new project will officially launch next week.

meanings.note: Getting straight down to work on a task or shoot.

examples.text: 谈妥合作条件后，数据团队立刻连夜开工。
examples.trans: Once terms were settled, the data team started work that very night.

examples.text: 新剧组定于下周三在影视基地正式开工拍摄。
examples.trans: The new drama crew is slated to begin filming next Wednesday.

开幕.gloss: opening (of an exhibition, festival, or venue)

meanings.en: opening (of an exhibition, festival, or venue)
meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi mù. Literally 开 ('open/raise') + 幕 ('stage curtain').

examples.text: 志豪决定留在成都参加星期五的开幕之夜。
examples.trans: Hao decided to stay in Chengdu for Friday's opening night.

examples.text: 社区音乐节将在下星期六正式开幕。
examples.trans: The neighborhood music festival will officially open next Saturday.

开张.gloss: open for business; hold a grand opening

meanings.en: open for business; hold a grand opening
meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi zhāng. Separable verb-object compound 开 ('open') + 张 ('spread/set up shop'), the classic word for a shop or café opening.

examples.text: 两位先生，快提上灯笼——九号房开张了，下一个谜团就在树底下！
examples.trans: Grab the lantern, gentlemen—Room Nine is open for business, and our next mystery starts under the tree!

examples.text: 星期五傍晚六点，我们的小院咖啡馆正式开张。
examples.trans: At six o'clock on Friday evening, our courtyard café officially opens for business.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi xīn. Literally 'open-hearted'—everyday word for feeling happy.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 宋老师，那怎么哄他开心呢？
examples.trans: Teacher Song, how did you coax him into smiling again?

examples.text: 我已经做了打持久战的准备，十二歌王开播全靠你们自己了。
examples.trans: I am prepared for drawn-out talks abroad, so launching Twelve Singers rests entirely on your shoulders.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi fàng. Describes opening a courtyard, garden, or café to visitors.

examples.text: 每天服务街坊邻居——就像对公众开放的早间咖啡馆？！
examples.trans: Serves neighbours daily—like a morning café open to the public?!

examples.text: 比现在翻一倍！我们真的要对整条街开放小院咖啡馆吗？
examples.trans: Double what I bake now! Are we really opening the courtyard café to our whole street?

examples.text: 有什么情况你随时给我打电话，不要管时差的事，我在美国会二十四小时开机。
examples.trans: Call me anytime something comes up regardless of the time difference; my phone will stay on twenty-four hours a day.

examples.text: 杰瑞哥交代过我了，您在美国日程上要是有什么改变随时通知我，我二十四小时开机。
examples.trans: Her manager briefed me — if anything changes in your schedule abroad, notify me anytime; my phone stays on round the clock.

开机率.gloss: television turn-on rate, active viewing share

meanings.en: television turn-on rate, active viewing share
meanings.note: Industry metric for the percentage of households turning on TVs.

examples.text: 现象级好节目甚至能拉高整个周末晚间的电视开机率。
examples.trans: A phenomenon-level hit show can lift weekend TV turn-on rates nationwide.

examples.text: 行业报告分析了近五年传统电视开机率的变化。
examples.trans: The industry report analyzed shifts in TV turn-on rates over five years.

开涮.gloss: play a trick on, make sport of

meanings.en: play a trick on, make sport of
meanings.note: Colloquial verb kāishuàn ('make a fool of, tease').

examples.text: 你们不敢惹一部，就拿小行政开涮吗？
examples.trans: Afraid to provoke Unit One, so you pick on junior admin?

examples.text: 别拿老实人开涮了。
examples.trans: Stop playing tricks on honest folks.

meanings.note: Making light-hearted remarks.

examples.text: 好了，不跟你开玩笑了，咱们聊正事吧。
examples.trans: Alright, enough kidding around—let us talk business.

examples.text: 他只是随口开玩笑，你千万别当真。
examples.trans: He was just joking casually; do not take it seriously.

开篇.gloss: opening of a book or essay

meanings.en: opening of a book or essay
meanings.note: Literary noun kāipiān ('opening section').

examples.text: 开篇的头一句就是道可道。
examples.trans: The very first sentence at the opening is Dao Ke Dao.

examples.text: 这部纪录片在开篇就抓住了观众。
examples.trans: This documentary hooks viewers right from the opening.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi shān. Measure word (量词): 件 (jiàn), e.g. 一件开衫 ('a cardigan').

examples.text: 您看，这件软羊毛开衫是全新的，试试吧。
examples.trans: Look, this soft wool cardigan is brand-new; try it on.

examples.text: 起风了，披上一件羊毛开衫吧。
examples.trans: The breeze is picking up—put on a wool cardigan.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi guò. Directional/resultative compound 开 ('drive') + 过 ('past/across').

examples.text: 刚才有一辆送货卡车从巷子口开过。
examples.trans: A delivery truck just drove past the mouth of the lane.

examples.text: 公交车慢慢开过种满梧桐树的老街。
examples.trans: The bus drove slowly down the old street lined with plane trees.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi suǒ. Separable verb-object compound.

examples.text: 老板正在开锁呢！别挂电话，等我一秒钟。
examples.trans: The owner is unlocking it right now! Stay on the phone, wait one second.

examples.text: 老铜锁需要先把钥匙往右转才能开锁。
examples.trans: With the old brass lock, turn the key right first to unlock it.

meanings.en: open the door; open for business
meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi mén. Means both opening a physical door and opening a shop for the day.

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

meanings.note: Idiom kāimén-jiànshān ('open the door and see the mountain—be direct').

examples.text: 大家坐吧，那咱们就开门见山。
examples.trans: Take a seat, everyone; let us get straight to the point.

examples.text: 她说话喜欢开门见山，从不拐弯抹角。
examples.trans: She likes speaking straight to the point without beating around the bush.

meanings.note: Formal workplace verb kāichú.

examples.text: 他已经被公司开除了。
examples.trans: He has already been fired by the company.

examples.text: 违反规矩会被开除。
examples.trans: Breaking the rules gets you dismissed.

meanings.note: Colloquial call announcing mealtime.

examples.text: 盒饭送到了，大家快过来开饭吧！
examples.trans: Box lunches are here—come eat, everyone!

examples.text: 忙完这一段我们就准时开饭。
examples.trans: Right after finishing this bit, we will eat on time.

meanings.note: Idiom yìkǒu-tóngshēng ('unanimously in one voice').

examples.text: 两人在文章里异口同声指责星天。
examples.trans: In the article both blamed Xingtian with one voice.

examples.text: 大家异口同声地赞成这个新创意。
examples.trans: Everyone backed the new idea with one voice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nòng. Colloquial action verb before result complements (弄丢 'lose', 弄湿 'get wet', 弄好 'fix up').

examples.text: 停电的时候，纸还能用。
examples.trans: Paper still works when the power goes out.

examples.text: 弄好了！蓝地毯放在床旁边正合适。
examples.trans: Done! And the blue rug right beside the bed fits just right.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nòng huài. Colloquial resultative compound 弄 ('make/do/handle') + 坏 ('broken/spoiled').

examples.text: 三十年前的那场暴风雨弄坏了阳光房的屋顶。
examples.trans: That storm thirty years ago damaged the sunroom roof.

examples.text: 用工具的时候慢一点，别弄坏了旧木头。
examples.trans: Go slowly with the tools so you don't damage the old wood.

examples.text: 到底为什么生气，我去弄清楚！
examples.trans: Wait — let me go back inside and figure out why he was upset!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Verb-complement nòngzāng ('make dirty').

examples.text: 纸质的书容易弄脏，先去洗一下手。
examples.trans: Paper books get dirty easily; wash your hands first.

examples.text: 下雨天小心别把新鞋子弄脏了。
examples.trans: Be careful not to muddy your new shoes in the rain.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nòng liè. Resultative compound 弄 ('cause to become') + 裂 ('cracked/split').

examples.text: 老陈用细镊子装轴销，一点也没弄裂山毛榉木。
examples.trans: Chen seated the pin with fine tweezers without splitting the beechwood at all.

examples.text: 钉钉子以前先钻个小孔，才不会把木板弄裂。
examples.trans: Drill a tiny pilot hole before hammering a nail so you won't split the board.

meanings.note: Verb-complement nòngcuò ('make a mistake with').

examples.text: 那天工作人员弄错了冠名商的产品。
examples.trans: That day staff mixed up the title sponsor's product.

examples.text: 请核对一下名单，千万别弄错了。
examples.trans: Check the guest list so nothing gets mixed up.

引入.gloss: introduce from outside, bring in (systems or capital)

meanings.en: introduce from outside, bring in (systems or capital)
meanings.note: Adopting foreign workflows, technology, or investment.

examples.text: 他打算把全套英式制作流程引入公司。
examples.trans: He plans to bring a full British production workflow into the company.

examples.text: 新设备的引入大大缩短了后期渲染的时间。
examples.trans: Introducing the new gear greatly shortened post-production rendering.

meanings.note: Verb yǐnfā ('spark, set off').

examples.text: 服药过量意外引发了严重的心脏病。
examples.trans: Taking excess medicine triggered a severe heart attack.

examples.text: 这期深度话题引发了观众的热烈讨论。
examples.trans: This in-depth topic sparked lively audience discussion.

examples.text: 车走了，把记者引开了！
examples.trans: The car's rolling — luring the reporters away!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

引荐.gloss: recommend, introduce someone to an influential contact

meanings.en: recommend, introduce someone to an influential contact
meanings.note: Polite verb for making a professional introduction.

examples.text: 她特地赶到演播室恳请前辈向导演引荐优秀演员。
examples.trans: She hurried to the studio to ask the veteran host to introduce the actor.

examples.text: 多亏老朋友热心引荐，我们才联系上了那位专家。
examples.trans: Thanks to an old friend's kind introduction, we reached that specialist.

meanings.note: Verb yǐnqǐ ('attract attention; cause').

examples.text: 这次发病是饮用酒精引起的。
examples.trans: This flare-up was brought on by alcohol.

examples.text: 新颖的赛制很快引起了业内的模仿。
examples.trans: The fresh format soon sparked imitators across TV.

meanings.note: Verb yǐnjìn ('import technology or IP').

examples.text: 自从这档节目引进中国，我一直在研究。
examples.trans: Ever since this show was imported to China, I have studied it.

examples.text: 电视台去年引进了一套先进的灯光系统。
examples.trans: Last year the network imported an advanced lighting rig.

meanings.note: Domestic remake adapted from a licensed foreign show.

examples.text: 前些年各大卫视播出了不少海外综艺的引进版。
examples.trans: In past years satellite networks aired many licensed format remakes.

examples.text: 引进版虽然稳妥，但本土原创才代表长远未来。
examples.trans: Licensed remakes are safe, yet domestic originals are the long-term future.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dì di. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个弟弟 ('a younger brother').

examples.text: 那里住着一位老木匠和两个孙子——哥哥弹钢琴，弟弟最爱小火车！
examples.trans: An old carpenter lived there with two grandsons—the older brother played piano, and the younger loved toy trains!

examples.text: 那抱着木头小火车的弟弟呢？
examples.trans: And what about the younger brother holding the wooden train?

张.gloss: measure word for flat surfaces and paper

meanings.en: measure word for flat surfaces and paper
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhāng. Counts tables, beds, paper sheets, tickets, receipts, and luggage tags (一张桌子, 一张纸).

examples.text: 不在，只有我的笔和三张旧收据！
examples.trans: Not there—only my pen and three old receipts!

examples.text: 旁边的把手上系着一张小纸牌。
examples.trans: There is a small paper card tied on the side handle.

meanings.note: Repairing a mistake, slight, or regret.

examples.text: 他想请她吃饭来弥补上次的失礼。
examples.trans: He wants to treat her to dinner to make up for his rudeness.

examples.text: 再多道歉也难以弥补这次损失。
examples.trans: No amount of apologies can easily make up for this loss.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wān. Used as a stative/resultative complement (掰弯 'bend out of shape') or verb (转弯 'turn a corner').

examples.text: 我们生怕用力太猛，把彩绘铁盒盖子掰弯了。
examples.trans: We were afraid of using too much force and bending the painted tin lid.

examples.text: 窄窄的石头小巷往南拐了一个弯。
examples.trans: The narrow cobbled lane curved around to the south.

examples.text: 我直话直说，你们星天的经纪部太弱了，我希望你能够亲自出马。
examples.trans: Speaking frankly, Xingtian's talent management unit is far too weak — I hope you will step in personally.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

弱势群体.gloss: vulnerable groups, disadvantaged members of society

meanings.en: vulnerable groups, disadvantaged members of society
meanings.note: Standard sociological and public-welfare term.

examples.text: 媒体应当多关注老人和残障人士等弱势群体。
examples.trans: Media should pay closer attention to seniors and other vulnerable groups.

examples.text: 这档公益专栏致力于为弱势群体发声并提供帮助。
examples.trans: This charity column gives voice and practical aid to vulnerable groups.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tán. Used for playing the piano or guitar (弹钢琴 'play the piano').

examples.text: 那里住着一位老木匠和两个孙子——哥哥弹钢琴，弟弟最爱小火车！
examples.trans: An old carpenter lived there with two grandsons—the older brother played piano, and the younger loved toy trains!

examples.text: 哥哥性格爽朗声音大，弹音阶总是急匆匆的。
examples.trans: The older brother was bold and loud, always rushing through his scales.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tán qín. Separable verb-object compound.

examples.text: 宋老师？！每星期五教我哥哥弹琴的宋老师？！
examples.trans: Teacher Song?! The Teacher Song who taught my brother piano every Friday?!

examples.text: 每天下午她都在窗边安静地弹琴。
examples.trans: Every afternoon she plays the piano quietly by the window.

meanings.note: Adjective qiáng ('strong').

examples.text: 今晚这里有最强的明星阵容。
examples.trans: Tonight features the strongest celebrity lineup.

examples.text: 他们团队的执行力非常强。
examples.trans: Their team's execution is very strong.

meanings.note: Workplace verb qiángtuī ('force through despite resistance').

examples.text: 如果只在内部强推改革，难免伤感情。
examples.trans: Forcing reform purely from inside risks bruised feelings.

examples.text: 好制度需要先沟通，不能一味强推。
examples.trans: New rules need communication rather than brute force.

meanings.note: Verb guī ('come under someone's charge; return').

examples.text: 从今以后，二部的人归一部现场组管。
examples.trans: From now on, Unit Two staff report to Unit One's floor team.

examples.text: 这间素材房归行政部门管理。
examples.trans: This archive room is managed by administration.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dāng. Means 'act in the role of' (当哥哥 'be an older brother', 当前台主管 'serve as front-desk manager').

examples.text: 老陈，你真懂当哥哥的人。
examples.trans: Chen, you really understand older brothers.

examples.text: 别抢人，小美！小晴，你愿意留下来当正式前台主管吗？
examples.trans: No poaching, Mei! Qing, are you willing to stay on as our permanent front-desk manager?

当上.gloss: become; take up a post or role

meanings.en: become; take up a post or role
meanings.note: Pinyin: dāng shàng. Resultative compound 当 ('serve as') + 上 ('attain a role').

examples.text: 志鹏笑着说他们兄弟俩当上了正式试吃员。
examples.trans: Peng joked that the two brothers had become official taste testers.

examples.text: 苦练三年以后，她终于当上了乐团的首席乐手。
examples.trans: After three years of dedicated practice, she finally became first chair in the orchestra.

meanings.note: Used in 当下 ('at present') or 解决当下的问题.

examples.text: 与其纠结过去，不如齐心协力做好当下的工作。
examples.trans: Rather than dwelling on the past, pull together on the work at hand.

examples.text: 公司当下的首要任务是稳住核心制作团队。
examples.trans: The company's top priority right now is steadying the core crew.

meanings.note: Locative noun dāngzhōng ('in the process of; among').

examples.text: 现在红毯仪式正在进行当中。
examples.trans: The red-carpet ceremony is currently underway.

examples.text: 年轻制片在项目当中成长得最快。
examples.trans: Young producers grow fastest in the middle of projects.

meanings.note: Modern times we live in now.

examples.text: 这篇论文研究的是当代电视艺术的创新。
examples.trans: This thesis studies innovation in contemporary television art.

examples.text: 博物馆正在举办当代青年艺术家的画展。
examples.trans: The museum is holding an exhibition of contemporary young artists.

meanings.note: Adverb dāngzhòng ('in front of a crowd').

examples.text: 要求他们两个必须当众公开道歉。
examples.trans: Demand that both of them apologise in public.

examples.text: 导演很少在演播厅里当众发脾气。
examples.trans: The director rarely loses his temper in front of everyone.

meanings.note: Time noun dāngchū ('at that earlier time').

examples.text: 当初把你保下来的就是魔鬼鱼吧？
examples.trans: The one who protected you back then was Manta Ray, right?

examples.text: 她一直记得当初选择做电视的初心。
examples.trans: She always remembers why she chose TV at the start.

当前.gloss: in front of one, at hand, right now

meanings.en: in front of one, at hand, right now
meanings.note: In 任务当前, means facing an urgent task right ahead.

examples.text: 重要任务当前，大家必须团结一致。
examples.trans: With a vital task ahead, everyone must stand united.

examples.text: 解决当前的问题才是最紧要的。
examples.trans: Solving the problem at hand is what matters most.

当务之急.gloss: most urgent priority, pressing task of the moment

meanings.en: most urgent priority, pressing task of the moment
meanings.note: Idiom for what must be handled immediately.

examples.text: 当务之急是尽快查清事故原因并向公众说明。
examples.trans: The most urgent priority is finding the cause and informing the public.

examples.text: 挽回节目声誉成了总编室眼下的当务之急。
examples.trans: Restoring the show's reputation became the office's top priority.

examples.text: 我说那些主意呢，你也别太当回事，别往心里去。
examples.trans: Forget those silly ideas I gave you earlier; don't take them to heart.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Adverb dāngchǎng ('live on the spot').

examples.text: 两个人当场互相吵了五分钟。
examples.trans: The two argued right there onstage for five minutes.

examples.text: 问题当场就得到了解决。
examples.trans: The issue was resolved right on the spot.

当官.gloss: hold an official or executive title

meanings.en: hold an official or executive title
meanings.note: Colloquially refers to serving as a boss/executive.

examples.text: 他笑着说不当官反而能专心做节目了。
examples.trans: He joked that holding no executive title lets him focus on shows.

examples.text: 比起在公司当官，他更喜欢待在剪辑室。
examples.trans: Rather than being an executive, he prefers the editing room.

meanings.note: Time noun dāngnián ('in bygone years, back then').

examples.text: 当年他离开卫视时得罪了不少人。
examples.trans: Back when he left the network, he offended many people.

examples.text: 她想起当年刚进大学时的梦想。
examples.trans: She recalled her dreams from her freshman days.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dāng xīn. Friendly caution on slippery steps or with hot pots.

examples.text: 当心那把角落椅子，等十秒我拧紧螺丝。
examples.trans: Mind that corner chair—wait ten seconds while I tighten the screw.

examples.text: 石板路刚下过雨，走路请当心。
examples.trans: It just rained on the flagstones—watch your step.

meanings.note: Verb-complement dāngchéng ('treat/regard as').

examples.text: 别签在把你当成商品一样的公司。
examples.trans: Do not sign with a firm that treats you as merchandise.

examples.text: 同事们早把总编室当成了第二个家。
examples.trans: Colleagues treat the editorial office like a second home.

meanings.note: Time noun dāngshí ('at that exact time').

examples.text: 我看你当时一直躲我，还以为讨厌我。
examples.trans: Seeing you dodge me back then, I thought you disliked me.

examples.text: 当时我在现场亲眼看到了整个经过。
examples.trans: I was on site at the time and saw everything.
