examples.text: 你觉得我是那个被人当枪使的傻子，还是天天需要被你保护的麻烦精啊？
examples.trans: Do you see me as a fool used as someone's pawn, or a walking disaster who needs your protection every day?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dāng rán. Warm, reassuring reply ('Of course!').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 当然不能偷看……咦，自己翻开在中间那页了！
examples.trans: Of course we must not peek... oh, it fell open to the middle page by itself!

当着.gloss: in front of, to someone's face

meanings.en: in front of, to someone's face
meanings.note: Preposition dāngzhe ('right in front of').

examples.text: 你有本事当着老大的面说呀！
examples.trans: If you dare, say that right in front of our boss!

examples.text: 别当着客人的面吵架。
examples.trans: Do not argue in front of guests.

meanings.note: Adverb dāngmiàn ('in person').

examples.text: 把他们叫出来，跟他们当面对质。
examples.trans: Call them outside and confront them face to face.

examples.text: 这份文件我要当面交给他。
examples.trans: I want to hand him this file in person.

examples.text: 录个视频。
examples.trans: Record a video.

examples.text: 把声音录下来。
examples.trans: Record the sound.

meanings.en: to record video; to tape a broadcast or show
meanings.note: Pronounced lùxiàng; functions as a separable verb-object compound (e.g., 录完像, 录了三个小时的像) in TV and studio production.
Used as a noun referring to recorded video material or tape (measure words: 段, 盘, 份).

examples.text: 欢迎来到星天，这会儿正在录像呢。
examples.trans: Welcome to Xingtian; they are taping right at this moment.

examples.text: 这些资料，还有这四百个小时的录像资料。
examples.trans: These files, plus these four hundred hours of video recordings.

录入.gloss: enter data, log into a system

meanings.en: enter data, log into a system
meanings.note: Verb lùrù ('input into a database').

examples.text: 借调手续已经录入公司系统了。
examples.trans: The transfer paperwork is already logged in the system.

examples.text: 请把嘉宾名单今天下午录入电脑。
examples.trans: Please enter the guest list into the computer this afternoon.

meanings.note: Meaning: taping.

examples.text: 我们已经在录制了，担心都是多余的。
examples.trans: We are already taping; all that worry is unnecessary.

examples.text: 这是录制。
examples.trans: This is 录制.

examples.text: 我代表星天总编室欢迎您啊！惠美全国巡演就要开始了，这段时间特别忙，录完这期节目就得出发。
examples.trans: On behalf of Xingtian's chief editor's office, welcome! Huimei's national tour kicks off soon, so she has to set off right after taping.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: studio video recording of a television program

examples.text: 王尔老师，淳于总提前了录影时间！
examples.trans: Teacher Wang Er, Director Chun Yu moved up the taping time!

examples.text: 今晚的录影非常顺利。
examples.trans: Tonight's taping went very smoothly.

形势.gloss: situation, balance of forces, state of play

meanings.en: situation, balance of forces, state of play
meanings.note: Strategic circumstances in politics or workplace.

examples.text: 面对严峻的市场形势，公司决定加快转型步伐。
examples.trans: Facing tough market conditions, the firm decided to speed up transformation.

examples.text: 刚到一个新环境，先看清周围形势再行动最稳妥。
examples.trans: In a new workplace, size up the lay of the land before acting.

meanings.note: Noun xíngshì ('outer form, format').

examples.text: 从表面的形式上已经说明了辩证的道理。
examples.trans: Its surface form already illustrates that dialectical truth.

examples.text: 新节目的表现形式非常新颖。
examples.trans: The presentation format of the new show is fresh.

meanings.note: In media production, refers to a show's structural format.

examples.text: 这档节目的形态在当时非常新颖。
examples.trans: This show's format was very novel at the time.

examples.text: 改版会彻底改变原有的节目形态。
examples.trans: The revamp will completely change the old show format.

形成.gloss: form, give rise to, take shape

meanings.en: form, give rise to, take shape
meanings.note: Verb xíngchéng ('form, develop into').

examples.text: 这样长期下去就会形成一个恶性循环。
examples.trans: Over the long run that forms a vicious cycle.

examples.text: 经过两季磨合，团队形成了独特的工作默契。
examples.trans: Over two seasons the crew formed a distinct working rhythm.

meanings.note: Noun xíngxiàng.

examples.text: 不符合她的形象。
examples.trans: Does not match her image.

examples.text: 艺人的形象很重要。
examples.trans: An artist's public image matters a lot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cǎi huì. Attributive modifier or noun (彩绘盖子 'colour-painted lid', 彩绘地图 'painted map').

examples.text: 红金铁盒的彩绘盖子上画着漂亮的杏仁花。
examples.trans: Delicate almond blossoms are painted across the colour-illustrated lid of the red-and-gold tin.

examples.text: 这扇老木窗边还留着精致的传统彩绘花纹。
examples.trans: Delicate traditional painted patterns still remain along this old wooden window.

meanings.note: Verb/noun yǐngxiǎng ('affect, influence').

examples.text: 要是影响到直播就坏了。
examples.trans: If it affects the live broadcast, we are in trouble.

examples.text: 坏天气影响了航班起飞。
examples.trans: Bad weather affected flight departures.

meanings.note: Noun yǐngxiǎnglì ('sphere of influence, reach').

examples.text: 视频转发太多，影响力已经扩散了。
examples.trans: With so many reposts, its reach has already spread.

examples.text: 他在粉丝圈里边很有影响力。
examples.trans: He carries strong influence inside fan circles.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǐng zi. Second syllable neutral tone. Measure word: 个 (gè) or 道 (dào).

examples.text: 夕阳把竹子的影子投在白墙上。
examples.trans: The setting sun casts the bamboo's shadow onto the white wall.

examples.text: 灯光下，我看见琴盖后面有一个白纸影子。
examples.trans: Under the lamplight, I spotted the shadow of white paper behind the piano lid.

meanings.note: Compound modifier for actors, studios, and dramas.

examples.text: 合并后的经纪部签下了许多实力派影视演员。
examples.trans: After the merger, talent management signed many film and TV actors.

examples.text: 这座城市吸引了众多影视制作公司前来取景。
examples.trans: This city attracts scores of film and television crews to shoot on location.

examples.text: 您是东海经纪的涂盛涂总吗？我是荣思伦哥哥的铁杆大影迷，你能不能跟他说一声我要嫁给他！
examples.trans: Wait — are you Director Tu Sheng of Donghai Talent? I'm Rong Silun's biggest die-hard fan; please tell him I want to marry him!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Adjective/adverb chèdǐ ('completely, once and for all').

examples.text: 以后见不到面了，彻底放手吧。
examples.trans: We will not meet again, so let go completely.

examples.text: 我们要彻底解决这个问题。
examples.trans: We must solve this problem thoroughly.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǎng. Guides movement in directions (往上提 'lift upward', 往左拐 'turn left').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǎng shàng. Directional phrase 往 ('toward') + 上 ('up'), placed directly before action verbs (往上抬 'lift upward').

examples.text: 先把窗板轻轻往上抬一点，再往外拉。
examples.trans: Lift the shutter slightly upward first, then pull outward.

examples.text: 到了中间部分，圆舞曲的旋律一步步往上升。
examples.trans: In the middle section, the waltz melody climbs upward step by step.

meanings.note: Adverbial phrase wǎngqián ('forward').

examples.text: 一会儿让同学们尽量往前站。
examples.trans: Have the classmates stand as far forward as possible.

examples.text: 再往前走两百米就到地铁站了。
examples.trans: Walk two hundred metres forward to reach the subway.

往后.gloss: from now on, in the future

meanings.en: from now on, in the future
meanings.note: Time adverb wǎnghòu ('henceforth, going forward').

examples.text: 往后每周录节目，咱俩就成同事了。
examples.trans: Taping every week from now on makes us colleagues.

examples.text: 往后遇到难题随时可以来总编室找我。
examples.trans: Going forward, drop by my office anytime you hit snags.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǎng wài. Directional phrase 往 ('toward') + 外 ('outside').

examples.text: 透过擦干净的拱窗往外看，整个院子绿油油的。
examples.trans: Looking outward through the clean arched window, the whole courtyard is lush green.

examples.text: 这两扇木头窗板是往外推开的。
examples.trans: These two wooden shutters swing open outward.

往心里去.gloss: take to heart, hold a grudge

meanings.en: take to heart, hold a grudge
meanings.note: Colloquial verb phrase wǎng xīnlǐ qù ('take offence').

examples.text: 老大让我带话，请您千万别往心里去。
examples.trans: The boss asked me to tell you not to take it to heart.

examples.text: 同事之间讨论方案说话直接，谁也不会往心里去。
examples.trans: Coworkers debate pitches bluntly without taking offence.

meanings.note: Media noun wǎngqī ('past episodes of a show').

examples.text: 对手把往期花絮回顾也拿出来提前播了。
examples.trans: Our rival even pulled out past-episode highlight reels to air early.

examples.text: 观众可以在视频网站免费点播节目的往期内容。
examples.trans: Viewers can stream previous episodes of the show on demand.

examples.text: 就一定能够征服有数千年文化情感的东方观众？
examples.trans: is enough to win over Eastern audiences shaped by thousands of years of cultural emotion?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Formal verb zhēngjí ('collect suggestions or submissions').

examples.text: 今天开会是想征集一下大家的意见。
examples.trans: Today's meeting aims to gather everyone's feedback.

examples.text: 节目组正在网上征集下一期的观众问题。
examples.trans: The crew is collecting viewer questions online.

meanings.en: to stay; to remain; to hang around
meanings.note: Pronounced dāi in this sense; commonly followed by 在 + location or a duration complement (e.g., 待在家, 待了半天).
Pronounced dài in compounds and more formal registers (e.g., 等待 'to wait', 对待 'to treat').

examples.text: 今天晚上您还是待在中控室里进行指挥吧。
examples.trans: Tonight you had better stay in the control room to direct.

examples.text: 待了半天我就回来了呗。
examples.trans: I stayed half a day and came back, that was all.

meanings.en: in a little while; shortly; in a moment
meanings.note: Pronounced dāihuǐr (or dāihuìr) with standard Northern erhua; placed before the subject or directly before the verb to mark the immediate future.

examples.text: 待会儿你就知道了。
examples.trans: In a little while you will find out.

examples.text: 十点有制作会，雷总让你待会儿去送茶水。
examples.trans: There is a production meeting at ten, and Director Lei wants you to serve drinks shortly.

待命.gloss: stand by for orders, be on call

meanings.en: stand by for orders, be on call
meanings.note: Verb-object dàimìng ('stand ready on call').

examples.text: 专业安保就在隔壁房间二十四小时待命。
examples.trans: Security staff are standing by on call twenty-four hours next door.

examples.text: 急救车在户外录制现场全程待命。
examples.trans: An ambulance stands by throughout the outdoor shoot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hěn. Links a subject to a simple predicate adjective without needing 是 (今天很冷 'It is cold today').

examples.text: 你好，小美，很高兴认识你！好香啊！
examples.trans: Hello, Mei, nice to meet you! Something smells wonderful!

examples.text: 没错！你已经很习惯这儿了。
examples.trans: Exactly! You already fit right in here.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hén jiǔ. Often follows a verb or precedes 以前.

examples.text: 老砖房顶楼平时要等很久水才热。
examples.trans: Top floors in old brick houses usually wait ages before the water warms up.

examples.text: 我们在站台上等了很久。
examples.trans: We waited on the platform for a long time.

examples.text: 这是很多啊。
examples.trans: This is many.

examples.text: 那个很多好。
examples.trans: That many is good.

examples.text: 作为王尔的手下，你没有被连坐清除出星天，已经是很大的幸运了。
examples.trans: As Wang Er's intern, not getting swept out of Xingtian alongside him was already huge luck for you.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Adverb/adjective hěnshǎo ('seldom, very few').

examples.text: 选择做行政的毕业生倒是很少见。
examples.trans: Graduates choosing admin work are quite rare.

examples.text: 他平时很少喝冰咖啡。
examples.trans: He seldom drinks iced coffee.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hěn kuài. Describes quick speed or imminent arrival.

examples.text: 箱子的主人肯定很快会来找的。
examples.trans: The suitcase's owner will surely come looking for it soon.

examples.text: 别着急，热水很快就会上来了。
examples.trans: No rush—the hot water will come up very soon.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǜ shī. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位律师 ('a lawyer').

examples.text: 房东律师寄来的？奇怪——我们房租一直交到明年夏天了。
examples.trans: Sent by the landlord's lawyer? Strange—our rent is paid right through next summer.

examples.text: 我弟弟是一位专门管房产合同的律师。
examples.trans: My younger brother is a lawyer specializing in property contracts.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tú dì. Combines 徒 ('follower/apprentice') + 弟 ('junior/younger brother'); pairs with 师父 ('master craftsperson'); measure word: 位 (wèi) or 个 (gè).

examples.text: 小美满意地点点头说：“两位徒弟，我的面包房交给你们放心了！”
examples.trans: Mei nodded with satisfaction and said, 'Apprentices, I can trust my bakery to the two of you!'

examples.text: 志鹏跟着小美当了一天徒弟，已经学会了怎么揉光滑的面团。
examples.trans: After spending a day as Mei's apprentice, Peng has already learned how to knead smooth bread dough.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Read de after a verb to introduce how it goes (走得快 'walk fast'); read děi before a verb to mean 'must'.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Verb dédào ('gain, obtain').

examples.text: 我还想在你嘴里得到证实。
examples.trans: I still want to obtain confirmation from your own lips.

examples.text: 她的努力终于得到了大家的认可。
examples.trans: Her hard work finally won everyone's recognition.

examples.text: 我干了六七年了都没你得宠，走走走，快去！
examples.trans: I've worked for him six or seven years without being half as favored — off you go!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de hěn. Post-adjectival degree complement (干爽得很 'bone-dry / very dry').

examples.text: 搬进走廊的四扇木窗板全都干爽得很。
examples.trans: All four wooden shutters carried into the hallway are bone-dry.

examples.text: 老陈修门锁的手艺稳当得很。
examples.trans: Chen's craftsmanship in fixing door locks is rock-steady.

meanings.note: Adjective déyì ('proud of a pet plan, pleased').

examples.text: 现在让他们最得意的方案换人，他们肯定不高兴。
examples.trans: Making them change their proudest proposal upsets them.

examples.text: 取得了一点成绩也别太得意。
examples.trans: Do not get overly smug after a small success.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dé jiù. Note second tone dé ('obtain rescue').

examples.text: 得救了！失陪一分钟，宋老师，您慢喝热茶！
examples.trans: Saved! Excuse me one minute, Teacher Song—enjoy your hot tea!

examples.text: 找到那份老条例，我们的客栈终于得救了！
examples.trans: Finding that historic regulation finally saved our inn!

meanings.note: Verb dézuì ('offend, alienate').

examples.text: 咱们这么做是不是得罪孙总太深了？
examples.trans: Did doing this offend Mr Sun far too deeply?

examples.text: 能得罪的人，干脆一次都得罪光吧。
examples.trans: Whoever we might offend, let us offend them all at once.

meanings.note: Potential complement deguòlai ('can keep up with').

examples.text: 再多的工作我们也应付得过来。
examples.trans: No matter how much work there is, we can keep up.

examples.text: 这么多事你一个人忙得过来吗？
examples.trans: Can you handle all these tasks by yourself?

meanings.note: Verb/noun xúnhuán ('move in cycles').

examples.text: 天道循环，阴阳反背。
examples.trans: Heaven's way moves in cycles, and yin and yang reverse.

examples.text: 导播室里的背景音乐正在循环播放。
examples.trans: Background music is looping in the control room.

meanings.note: Noun wēibó ('microblogging platform').

examples.text: 今天早上他们的官方微博发了声明。
examples.trans: Their official Weibo posted a statement this morning.

examples.text: 这条消息在微博上很火。
examples.trans: This post is trending on Weibo.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wēi xiào. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个微笑 ('a smile').

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

examples.text: 哎呀！透过窗户看见周经理了？我明明加倍用力微笑了！
examples.trans: Oh dear! You spotted Manager Zhou through the window? I smiled twice as wide!

meanings.note: Verb/noun wēidiào ('minor adjustment').

examples.text: 十二歌王每一季都有一些微调。
examples.trans: Every season of Twelve Singers has featured subtle fine-tuning.

examples.text: 上台前音响师对麦克风音量做了最后微调。
examples.trans: Before curtain the sound engineer fine-tuned the mic levels.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wēi fēng. Combines 微 ('gentle/slight') + 风 ('wind/breeze'); measure word: 阵 (zhèn) or 缕 (lǚ).

examples.text: 窗户全都大敞开了，下午温暖的微风轻轻吹进九号房。
examples.trans: All the windows are wide open, and the warm afternoon breeze blows gently into Room Nine.

examples.text: 傍晚的微风吹过院子，带来了柠檬挞和薄荷茶的清香。
examples.trans: The evening breeze blew across the courtyard, carrying the fresh scent of lemon tarts and mint tea.

meanings.note: Noun dé ('moral conduct, ethics').

examples.text: 但您这德吧，真不好说。
examples.trans: As for your moral character, though, that is hard to praise.

examples.text: 做艺人和做人一样，都要重艺德。
examples.trans: Artists, like anyone else, must value moral integrity.

德才兼备.gloss: possess both moral integrity and talent

meanings.en: possess both moral integrity and talent
meanings.note: Idiom décái-jiānbèi ('have both virtue and ability').

examples.text: 今天广播的话题不是德才兼备吗？
examples.trans: Is today's radio topic not having both virtue and talent?

examples.text: 公司选拔干部一贯讲究德才兼备。
examples.trans: The company selects leaders for both character and talent.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīn. Measure word (量词): 颗 (kē), e.g. 一颗心 ('a heart').

examples.text: 我心跳得好快！小晴你去说，你声音稳重诚实！
examples.trans: My heart is pounding! Qing, you explain it—you sound calm and honest!

examples.text: 志鹏不会走的。他总是嘴硬五秒钟，心马上就软了。
examples.trans: Zhipeng will not leave. He always talked tough for five seconds, then softened right away.

examples.text: 义务？跟我谈恋爱，用不着拿出尽义务的心态。
examples.trans: Duty? Dating me doesn't call for the mindset of fulfilling an obligation!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Noun xīnsi ('what one is thinking; affection').

examples.text: 问题在于老大的心思可能是要完全改版。
examples.trans: The issue is that in the boss's mind, he wants a full overhaul.

examples.text: 你对我的心思我都明白。
examples.trans: I understand your feelings toward me.

meanings.note: Noun xīnqíng ('mood').

examples.text: 今天他心情不好，咱们都小心一点。
examples.trans: He is in a bad mood today, so tread carefully.

examples.text: 喝杯热茶，心情会好很多。
examples.trans: A cup of hot tea lifts your mood.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīn yì. Measure word (量词): 份 (fèn), e.g. 一份心意 ('a thoughtful gesture').

examples.text: 正合我心意。楼梯在哪儿？
examples.trans: Just what I wanted. Where are the stairs?

examples.text: 这盒茶叶是我的一点心意，请收下。
examples.trans: This box of tea leaves is a small token of appreciation—please take it.

meanings.note: Something deeply hoped for over time.

examples.text: 制作一档原创节目是她最大的心愿。
examples.trans: Producing an original show is her greatest wish.

examples.text: 这么多年的心愿今天终于实现了。
examples.trans: A wish held for so many years finally came true today.

meanings.note: Medical noun xīnlǐ yīshēng ('psychologist').

examples.text: 我已经找了专业的心理医生去帮他。
examples.trans: I have already called in a psychologist to help him.

examples.text: 高压工作下找心理医生聊聊很有帮助。
examples.trans: Talking with a therapist helps under heavy job stress.

examples.text: 这次你又被骗了，你又被利用了，我会生气，我会心疼。
examples.trans: This time you were deceived and used all over again — that makes me angry, and it hurts me.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Medical noun xīnzàngbìng ('heart condition').

examples.text: 那是一种很严重的心脏病。
examples.trans: That is a very serious heart condition.

examples.text: 这不是他心脏病发的原因。
examples.trans: That is not what triggered his heart attack.

examples.text: 放在心里。
examples.trans: Keep in mind.

examples.text: 心里明白。
examples.trans: Understand in mind.

心里头.gloss: inside one's heart, on one's mind

meanings.en: inside one's heart, on one's mind
meanings.note: Colloquial spoken variant of 心里.

examples.text: 他今天看起来心里头有点乱。
examples.trans: His mind looks a bit tangled up today.

examples.text: 有什么话别总憋在心里头。
examples.trans: Do not keep everything bottled up inside.

meanings.note: Colloquial noun xīnlǐhuà ('what is truly in one's heart').

examples.text: 今天过来也是想跟各位说一下心里话。
examples.trans: I came tonight to share a few candid words with you all.

examples.text: 好朋友之间才愿意说出真心实意的心里话。
examples.trans: Only close friends share their innermost thoughts.

examples.text: 已有行业分析师论断，此事必将造成星天娱乐股权整合及上市进程大幅拖慢。
examples.trans: Industry analysts warn the lawsuit will severely delay Xingtian's share restructuring and public listing.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 没有人可以干扰首席内容官的工作日程，他必然有他要做的事。
examples.trans: Nobody interferes with our chief content officer's schedule — he certainly has vital work of his own to handle.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Noun/adj bìyào ('need; necessary').

examples.text: 我的私事没有必要告诉你。
examples.trans: There is no need to tell you my private affairs.

examples.text: 开拍之前非常有必要再检查一遍设备。
examples.trans: Checking gear once more before rolling is essential.

examples.text: 必须完成。
examples.trans: Must be completed.

examples.text: 你必须去。
examples.trans: You must go.

meanings.note: Verb/noun jìhui ('avoid as a serious pitfall').

examples.text: 项目大，最忌讳的是管理分散。
examples.trans: On a big project, scattered management is the worst pitfall.

examples.text: 拍戏的时候有很多行内忌讳。
examples.trans: Film sets have many industry taboos.

meanings.note: Verb rěn ('bear silently, hold in').

examples.text: 看他这么忍着，我都替他着急。
examples.trans: Seeing him hold it all in makes me anxious for him.

examples.text: 胃疼的时候千万别硬忍着。
examples.trans: Do not just tough out a stomachache.

examples.text: 堂堂魔鬼鱼，这点事都忍不住。别想了，快走吧。
examples.trans: Even the mighty Manta Ray couldn't hold back! Stop overthinking and go.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Successfully keeping tears, laughter, or words inside.

examples.text: 本来不想说的，可刚才实在没忍住就说出来了。
examples.trans: I meant to stay quiet, yet just could not hold it back.

examples.text: 听到这个滑稽的借口，大家都没忍住笑出了声。
examples.trans: Hearing that comical excuse, nobody could hold back laughter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhì háo. Given name of Zhipeng's older brother, an acoustic architect.

examples.text: 没关系！您就是志豪先生吧？
examples.trans: No problem at all! You must be Mr Zhihao, right?

examples.text: 是的，我叫志豪。昨天打电话订了七号房。
examples.trans: Yes, my name is Zhihao. Yesterday I booked room seven by phone.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhì péng. Given name of Zhihao's younger brother.

examples.text: 白纸里面包的东西是给我哥哥志鹏的，不是我的。
examples.trans: What is wrapped inside that white paper is for my brother Zhipeng, not mine.

examples.text: 您为什么不直接去志鹏家门口把木头小火车交给他呢？
examples.trans: Why not go straight to Zhipeng's door and hand him the wooden train?

meanings.note: Pinyin: wàng. Everyday verb for forgetting an item or fact (忘了 'forgot').

examples.text: 您刚才忘在楼下前台汤碗旁边了。
examples.trans: You left it downstairs beside the soup bowl at the front desk.

examples.text: 星期五之前我想在附近找个安静地方，结果不好意思要回箱子！
examples.trans: I needed a quiet place nearby before Friday, and honestly felt too shy to ask for my bag!

meanings.note: Verb-object wàngshì ('be forgetful').

examples.text: 您还会忘事呢？真是难得。
examples.trans: Even you forget things sometimes? How rare.

examples.text: 最近太忙，我老爱忘事。
examples.trans: I have been so busy lately that I keep forgetting things.

meanings.note: Verb-complement wàngdiào ('put out of mind').

examples.text: 当我忘掉过去的自己，才真正成长。
examples.trans: Once I forgot my former self, I truly grew.

examples.text: 快忘掉昨天的不愉快，重新开始吧。
examples.trans: Forget yesterday's unpleasantness and start fresh.

meanings.note: Failing to remember someone or something.

examples.text: 我忙得差点忘记了今天是周五。
examples.trans: I got so busy I nearly forgot today is Friday.

examples.text: 她从来不会忘记朋友的生日。
examples.trans: She never forgets a friend's birthday.

meanings.note: Pinyin: máng. Describes a busy person, morning, or shop.

examples.text: 啊！忙着行李箱、热水器和来信，我完全忘了！
examples.trans: Oh! With the suitcases, the water heater, and the letter, I completely forgot!

examples.text: 早上前台总是特别忙。
examples.trans: The front desk is always especially busy in the morning.

meanings.note: Potential complement mángbuguòlái ('overwhelmed with work').

examples.text: 缺了人手，总编室真的忙不过来。
examples.trans: Short of staff, the office truly cannot keep up.

examples.text: 年底晚会太多，大家都忙不过来。
examples.trans: With so many year-end galas, everyone is swamped.

meanings.note: Pinyin: máng luàn. Describes a frantic morning rush.

examples.text: 你看，早餐忙乱和神秘电话你都挺过来了！
examples.trans: Look, you made it through both the breakfast rush and the mystery phone call!

examples.text: 早高峰虽然人多，前台却一点也不忙乱。
examples.trans: Even with the morning crowd, the front desk is never hectic.

meanings.en: bustle about; keep busy with chores
meanings.note: Pinyin: máng huo. Warm colloquial verb for working busily.

examples.text: 小美，千万别因为我们多忙活。
examples.trans: Mei, please do not go to extra trouble on our account.

examples.text: 她在厨房里忙活了一整个早上。
examples.trans: She bustled around the kitchen all morning long.

meanings.note: Noun/adjective zhōngxīn ('steadfast loyalty').

examples.text: 通过她对淳于总的忠心，我明白了很多。
examples.trans: Through her loyalty to Chun Yuqiao, I understood plenty.

examples.text: 凯文和杏子对团队一直忠心耿耿。
examples.trans: Kaiwen and Xingzi have stayed devoted to the team.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kuài. As an adjective/adverb, 'fast/quickly'; in 快…了, 'about to'.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 小晴，快看里面！这不是我的箱子！
examples.trans: Qing, look inside quickly! This is not my case!

meanings.note: Pinyin: kuàijiàn. Measure word: 件.

examples.text: 我有一个快件需要寄。
examples.trans: I have an express delivery to send.

examples.text: 你的快件已经送达。
examples.trans: Your express package has been delivered.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kuài diǎn. Everyday prompt to pick up speed.

examples.text: 快点——我刚听到二楼楼梯有脚步声！
examples.trans: Hurry—I just heard footsteps on the second-floor stairs!

examples.text: 火车快开了，我们走快点吧。
examples.trans: The train is about to leave—let's walk a bit faster.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kuài sòng. Concise shopfront/van phrase combining 快 ('fast/express') + 送 ('deliver').

examples.text: 家具店的货车上写着“同城快送”四个字。
examples.trans: The furniture shop's van has 'Same-City Express Delivery' painted on the side.

examples.text: 早上订的新鲜牛奶，中午快送就到了。
examples.trans: The fresh milk ordered in the morning arrived by express delivery at noon.

meanings.note: Noun kuàidì ('courier package').

examples.text: 你这快递里装的是什么呀，这么重？
examples.trans: What is inside your courier parcel that weighs so much?

examples.text: 前台有你的一个大箱子快递。
examples.trans: There is a large parcel waiting for you at reception.

examples.text: 可如果我们不跟他们合作，为了快速抢滩登陆，他们很有可能会跑到我们的竞争对手那边去。
examples.trans: Yet if we turn them down, in their rush to gain a foothold they may run straight into the arms of our competitors.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: niàn. Used for reading a letter or notice out loud (念第一行 'read the first line aloud').

examples.text: 二十毫米、铜的、热水器阀门——我一路念过去！
examples.trans: Twenty millimetres, brass, water-heater valve—I will repeat it all the way!

examples.text: 十九条理由？！您是迎接哥哥，还是念火车时刻表呀？
examples.trans: Nineteen reasons?! Are you welcoming your brother or reading a train timetable?

meanings.note: Pinyin: niàn dao. Describes mentioning someone warmly over and over.

examples.text: 别念叨它，宋老师！我现在差不多喜欢上那两声响了。
examples.trans: Don't tempt it, Teacher Song! I have almost grown fond of those two rings now.

examples.text: 奶奶平时总爱念叨小时候的老街。
examples.trans: Grandmother always talks fondly about the old street from her childhood.

meanings.note: Pinyin: niàn nian. Softened reduplication of 念 ('read out').

examples.text: 我念念：对不起拿错了，请帮我保管到星期五。
examples.trans: Let me read it: Sorry for taking the wrong one; please keep mine until Friday.

examples.text: 字太小了，你帮我念念信上写的什么。
examples.trans: The print is tiny—read aloud for me what the letter says.

meanings.note: Bound/split noun tài (used in 表个态, 'state one's stance').

examples.text: 我代表淳于总先向您表个态。
examples.trans: Let me state our stance on Mr Chun Yuqiao's behalf.

examples.text: 关键问题上每个负责人都要明确表态。
examples.trans: Every lead must state a clear position on key issues.

meanings.note: Noun tàidu ('attitude, stance').

examples.text: 那两位嘉宾现在是什么态度？
examples.trans: What attitude are those two guests taking now?

examples.text: 她对待工作的态度一直非常认真。
examples.trans: Her attitude toward work has always been earnest.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zěn me. Before a verb, asks 'how to do X?' (怎么走) or 'how come…?' (怎么还没来).

examples.text: 我的眼镜怎么会在……哎呀！在我头上！
examples.trans: Why would my glasses be in... oh dear! They are on my head!

examples.text: 宋老师，怎么了？您按了门铃！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, what happened? You rang the bell!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zěn me bàn. Everyday phrase when facing a dilemma.

examples.text: 外面下着大雨，街上酒店全满了！我们怎么办？
examples.trans: It is pouring rain outside and every hotel on the street is full! What do we do?

examples.text: 钥匙锁在屋里了，这下我们怎么办？
examples.trans: The key is locked inside the room—what do we do now?

怎么回事.gloss: what is going on?, what happened?

meanings.en: what is going on?, what happened?
meanings.note: Question phrase zěnme huí shì ('what is the matter?').

examples.text: 林姐，停一下，那边是怎么回事？
examples.trans: Lin Jie, hold on—what is going on over there?

examples.text: 音频信号突然中断，到底是怎么回事？
examples.trans: The audio feed just dropped—what on earth happened?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zěn me yàng. Asks for an opinion or update on how things are going.

examples.text: 怎么样？他发火了吗？要退钱吗？
examples.trans: How did it go? Did he lose his temper? Did he ask for a refund?

examples.text: 小晴，今天我的领带怎么样？一滴橙汁都没有！
examples.trans: Qing, how does my tie look today? Not a single drop of orange juice!

examples.text: 怎么说也是朋友。
examples.trans: No matter what, we are friends.

examples.text: 怎么说他都不听。
examples.trans: No matter what is said, he won't listen.

meanings.note: Interrogative zěnyàng ('how; what would happen').

examples.text: 这样的消息传出去会怎样？
examples.trans: What happens if news like this gets out?

examples.text: 你最近工作得怎样？
examples.trans: How has your work been going lately?

meanings.note: Pinyin: pà. Expresses fear, worry, or sensitivity to noise/cold (怕吵 'dislike noise').

examples.text: 说真的，我怕一楼吵。我太喜欢这间房了！
examples.trans: Truthfully, I dislike noisy ground-floor rooms. I love this room!

examples.text: 哈！你怕签了名字，倔脾气大哥就不出门了！
examples.trans: Aha! You feared that if you signed your name, stubborn big brother would stay home!

examples.text: 我什么时候怕死过？
examples.trans: Since when have I ever been afraid of dying?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 你们俩要做好思想准备。
examples.trans: The two of you need to be mentally prepared.

examples.text: 这是思想。
examples.trans: This is 思想.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sī kǎo. More deliberate and analytical than everyday 想 ('think/want').

examples.text: 志豪站在拱门下，安静地思考房间的回声。
examples.trans: Hao stood under the archway quietly pondering the room's acoustics.

examples.text: 做决定以前，最好先坐下来认真思考一下。
examples.trans: Before making a decision, it is best to sit down and think it through carefully.

meanings.note: Noun sīlù ('line of thinking, concept').

examples.text: 长期下来，淳于总的改版思路我就明白了。
examples.trans: Over time, I grasped Mr Chun Yuqiao's revamp direction.

examples.text: 这份新策划案的整体思路非常清晰。
examples.trans: The overall line of thinking in this new pitch is crystal clear.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jí. Describes rushing or feeling anxious.

examples.text: 哎呀！我跑得太急，包装看着都一样！
examples.trans: Oh no! I was running in such a rush that the wrappers all looked alike!

examples.text: 快坐在向阳窗户边，宋老师！先别急着上楼！
examples.trans: Sit right down by the sunny window, Teacher Song! No rush to go back upstairs yet!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jí shì. Measure word (量词): 件 (jiàn), e.g. 一件急事 ('an urgent matter').

examples.text: 糟了！周经理，小晴，厨房出急事了！
examples.trans: Oh no! Manager Zhou, Qing, we have a kitchen emergency!

examples.text: 我还没喝早咖啡呢，千万别说急事！
examples.trans: I have not had my morning coffee yet; please do not say emergency!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jí cōng cōng. Vivid ABB-pattern adverb.

examples.text: 哥哥性格爽朗声音大，弹音阶总是急匆匆的。
examples.trans: The older brother was bold and loud, always rushing through his scales.

examples.text: 他夹着公文包急匆匆地跑进了院子。
examples.trans: Tucking his briefcase under his arm, he hurried into the courtyard.

meanings.note: Medical adjective jíxìng ('sudden and severe').

examples.text: 医生诊断他是酒精引起的急性胃出血。
examples.trans: Doctors diagnosed acute alcohol-induced stomach bleeding.

examples.text: 急性肠胃炎需要马上休息治疗。
examples.trans: Acute gastroenteritis requires immediate rest and care.

急需.gloss: urgently need, be in pressing need of

meanings.en: urgently need, be in pressing need of
meanings.note: Strong compound verb for immediate requirements.

examples.text: 为了说服导演组，我们现在急需一份权威数据报告。
examples.trans: To persuade the directors, we urgently need an authoritative data report.

examples.text: 灾区现场急需饮用水、帐篷和医疗物资。
examples.trans: The disaster zone urgently needs drinking water, tents, and medical supplies.

meanings.note: Noun xìngbié ('gender').

examples.text: 你这是性别歧视还是年龄歧视？
examples.trans: Is that gender discrimination or age bias?

examples.text: 招聘只看能力，不看性别和年龄。
examples.trans: Hiring looks only at ability, never gender or age.

meanings.note: Noun xìngzi ('temper, personality').

examples.text: 我们制片部门的人员性子都比较直。
examples.trans: People in our production crew tend to have direct temperaments.

examples.text: 慢工出细活，校对字幕一定要耐住性子。
examples.trans: Careful work takes patience—steady your temper proofing subtitles.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xìng gé. Measure word (量词): 种 (zhǒng), e.g. 一种性格 ('a personality').

examples.text: 哥哥性格爽朗声音大，弹音阶总是急匆匆的。
examples.trans: The older brother was bold and loud, always rushing through his scales.

examples.text: 两兄弟性格不同，却都很热心。
examples.trans: The two brothers have different personalities, yet both are warm-hearted.

examples.text: 你跟老大的事呢，怨我。
examples.trans: What happened between you and our boss is my fault.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guài. As a verb, 'blame' (别怪我); as an adjective/adverb, 'strange / quite'.

examples.text: 不怪你们。只是我身上只有这件外套！
examples.trans: It is not your fault. Still, I only have this one coat on me!

examples.text: 为了一个木头小火车紧张？这事越来越怪了。
examples.trans: Nervous over a wooden toy train? This story gets stranger by the hour.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guài bu de. Literally 'cannot blame it'—used when a puzzle suddenly clicks.

examples.text: 怪不得这么重，全是木头和皮鞋！
examples.trans: No wonder it was so heavy—all wood and leather shoes!

examples.text: 原来窗户没关严，怪不得屋里有点凉！
examples.trans: So the window was not shut tight—no wonder the room felt cool!

examples.text: 这是怪事啊。
examples.trans: This is strange thing.

examples.text: 那个怪事好。
examples.trans: That strange thing is good.

meanings.note: Colloquial word for unconventional people or things.

examples.text: 在他眼里，那群不按常理出牌的创意人简直像怪胎。
examples.trans: To him, those unconventional creatives seemed like total misfits.

examples.text: 不少伟大的艺术创新最初都被保守派视为怪胎。
examples.trans: Many great artistic breakthroughs were first dismissed as oddities.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǒng. Indicates what consistently happens or must happen (总得有人 'somebody has to').

examples.text: 总得有人照顾院子里的花草嘛。
examples.trans: Somebody has to look after the courtyard plants, after all.

examples.text: 拿稳了！你已经关掉总水阀了吗？
examples.trans: Steady! Did you turn off the main water valve already?

meanings.note: Conjunction zǒngzhī ('in short, anyway').

examples.text: 总之你下了班以后回学校跑一趟吧。
examples.trans: In short, make a trip back to campus after work.

examples.text: 总之安全永远是第一位的。
examples.trans: In short, safety always comes first.

meanings.note: Noun/adverb zǒngtǐ ('overall, as a whole').

examples.text: 这次星光盛典总体非常成功。
examples.trans: Overall, this Star Night gala was a big success.

examples.text: 新节目的总体方向已经确定了。
examples.trans: The overall direction of the new show is set.

meanings.note: Adverb zǒnggòng ('altogether').

examples.text: 我们总共有一百三十个人的队伍。
examples.trans: We have a crew of 130 people in total.

examples.text: 这两本书总共五十块钱。
examples.trans: These two books cost fifty yuan in total.

examples.text: 我知道当年我拿总冠军，你们心里没一个服气的，还敢再战吗？
examples.trans: I know none of you were convinced inside when I won the championship back then — dare to battle me again?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 这是总决赛啊。
examples.trans: This is finals.

examples.text: 那个总决赛好。
examples.trans: That finals is good.

meanings.note: Top creative head overseeing an entire programme.

examples.text: 虽然不当高管了，他依然是节目的总制作人。
examples.trans: Even without the executive post, he remains chief producer.

examples.text: 总制作人对每一个镜头的要求都非常严格。
examples.trans: The chief producer sets exacting standards for every shot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǒng shì. Placed before a verb to describe a consistent habit.

examples.text: 哥哥性格爽朗声音大，弹音阶总是急匆匆的。
examples.trans: The older brother was bold and loud, always rushing through his scales.

examples.text: 志鹏不会走的。他总是嘴硬五秒钟，心马上就软了。
examples.trans: Zhipeng will not leave. He always talked tough for five seconds, then softened right away.

meanings.note: Comparative adverbial zǒngbǐ ('at least better than').

examples.text: 我一个人走，总比让他受影响强。
examples.trans: Leaving on my own is far better than hurting him.

examples.text: 提前做好预案总比临时手忙脚乱好。
examples.trans: Preparing a backup plan always beats scrambling late.

meanings.note: Corporate title zǒngjiān ('department director').

examples.text: 我这个公关总监签字就能生效。
examples.trans: My signature as PR director takes effect right away.

examples.text: 她是公司的艺术总监。
examples.trans: She is the company's art director.

meanings.note: Broadcast title zǒngjiānzhì ('chief producer').

examples.text: 这次由淳于总来担任总监制。
examples.trans: Chun Yuqiao will serve as chief producer this time.

examples.text: 总监制对整个节目负责。
examples.trans: The chief producer oversees the entire show.

meanings.note: Verb/noun zǒngjié ('sum up lessons or results').

examples.text: 这份方案是按照之前的实际改版总结的。
examples.trans: This plan sums up the actual revamp done weeks ago.

examples.text: 每次直播结束后团队都会开会总结。
examples.trans: After every live broadcast, the crew meets to review.

examples.text: 那儿就是淳于乔的总编室。
examples.trans: Over there is Chun Yuqiao's chief editor's office.

examples.text: 这是总编室。 (Example)
examples.trans: This is 总编室.

meanings.en: president; chief executive (of a corporation or enterprise)
meanings.note: Pronounced zǒngcái; in everyday workplace address, speakers usually shorten it to Surname + 总 (e.g., 吉总, 雷总).

examples.text: 我是总裁，叫我吉秀就好。
examples.trans: I am the president — just call me Ji Xiu.

examples.text: 新任总裁上任后，立刻调整了公司的制作方向。
examples.trans: After taking office, the new president immediately adjusted the company's production direction.

examples.text: 与星天的战略合作被总部收回重审，消息已经公布了。
examples.trans: Meanwhile, the overseas group's headquarters has pulled the strategic partnership back for review and announced the freeze.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Noun liànrén ('romantic couple').

examples.text: 恋人之间不就是应该有什么话都说出来吗？
examples.trans: Should romantic partners not tell each other everything openly?

examples.text: 这部爱情电影讲述了一对年轻恋人的成长故事。
examples.trans: This romance film tells how a young couple grew together.

examples.text: 办公室恋情多有不便。以小谷的资质，你把她调到二部，独当一面完全没问题啊。
examples.trans: Office romances bring endless headaches. With Xiaogu's talent, transferring her to Unit Two to lead projects on her own would work great.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 只是我的性格，我只会为了恋爱而恋爱，只会跟自己真正喜欢的人在一起。
examples.trans: That is simply who I am: I only date for love itself, and I will only be with someone I truly love.

examples.text: 来看你啊！我可是人生第一次尝试传说中的办公室恋爱。
examples.trans: I came to see you! This is my very first time trying out a legendary office romance.

examples.text: 此次严重侵权事件恐将打击星天信誉价值，实际造成的损失尚不可预期。
examples.trans: This serious infringement case threatens Xingtian's reputation, and the full financial losses remain unpredictable.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 恐怕他不会同意。
examples.trans: I am afraid he will not agree.

examples.text: 今天恐怕要下雨。
examples.trans: I am afraid it will rain today.

meanings.note: News noun phrase kǒngbùxíjī ('terrorist attack').

examples.text: 欧洲的朋友告诉我，那边确认是恐怖袭击。
examples.trans: My friend in Europe told me they confirmed it was a terrorist attack.

examples.text: 突发恐怖袭击的消息让海外连线组气氛骤然紧张。
examples.trans: Word of a sudden terrorist attack made the overseas desk tense.

meanings.note: Verb/noun kǒnghuāng ('panic, feel terror').

examples.text: 他一上台心里就开始恐慌了。
examples.trans: The moment he went onstage, he began to panic.

examples.text: 遇到突发情况不要恐慌。
examples.trans: Do not panic in an emergency.

meanings.note: Medical/colloquial verb-object kǒngshuǐ ('fear water').

examples.text: 他恐水这个事，经纪公司不应该瞒着我们。
examples.trans: His phobia of water is something your agency should never have hidden.

examples.text: 如果有嘉宾恐水，水上环节就必须提前调整。
examples.trans: If a guest fears water, pool games must be adjusted beforehand.

恐袭.gloss: terror attack (short for 恐怖袭击)

meanings.en: terror attack (short for 恐怖袭击)
meanings.note: Abbreviated noun kǒngxí ('terrorist attack').

examples.text: 嘉宾的弟弟现在在恐袭现场生死不明。
examples.trans: Our guest's younger brother is unaccounted for after the terror attack.

examples.text: 新闻频道正在滚动播报这起突发恐袭的最新进展。
examples.trans: News channels are airing rolling updates on the sudden attack.

meanings.note: Verb huīfù ('recover, come back online').

examples.text: 网站过了七个钟头还没恢复过来。
examples.trans: The website still had not recovered after seven hours.

examples.text: 病人的身体正在慢慢恢复。
examples.trans: The patient's health is slowly recovering.

meanings.note: Formal disapproving adverb used in disciplinary language.

examples.text: 公告指责他恣意更改拍摄计划。
examples.trans: The bulletin accused him of arbitrarily altering shooting plans.

examples.text: 任何人都不能利用职权恣意妄为。
examples.trans: No one may abuse authority to act wilfully.

meanings.note: Polite verb gōngxǐ ('congratulations!').

examples.text: 恭喜你正式成为老大的入室弟子！
examples.trans: Congratulations on becoming our boss's apprentice!

examples.text: 恭喜你的第一个节目策划顺利通过。
examples.trans: Congratulations on getting your first show pitch approved.

examples.text: 你说这话肉不肉麻啊，恶不恶心？
examples.trans: Don't you find talking to your car like that super cheesy and gross?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 你说这话肉不肉麻啊，恶不恶心？
examples.trans: Don't you find talking to your car like that super cheesy and gross?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Idiom èxìng xúnhuán ('self-reinforcing bad cycle').

examples.text: 不肯投原创，长期下来就会形成恶性循环。
examples.trans: Refusing to fund originals creates a vicious cycle over time.

examples.text: 熬夜导致白天没精神，很容易陷入恶性循环。
examples.trans: Late nights drain daytime focus, easily starting a vicious cycle.

meanings.note: Noun/attributive èyì ('malicious intent').

examples.text: 这种恶意的攻击和构陷非常无耻。
examples.trans: Such malicious attacks and framing are shameless.

examples.text: 平台会及时清理恶意造谣的帖子。
examples.trans: The platform promptly removes malicious rumour posts.

meanings.note: Adverb qiāoqiāo ('quietly, without a sound').

examples.text: 不属于我的心意，就悄悄地珍藏起来吧。
examples.trans: Feelings that cannot be mine I will quietly tuck away.

examples.text: 她怕打扰大家开会，悄悄从后门走了进来。
examples.trans: Not wanting to interrupt, she slipped quietly in the back door.

meanings.note: Coming to understand an unspoken truth on one's own.

examples.text: 有些道理需要自己慢慢去悟。
examples.trans: Some truths you have to figure out slowly on your own.

examples.text: 听了他的点拨，我一下子就悟了。
examples.trans: After hearing his hint, it clicked for me right away.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yōu jiǔ. Combines 悠 ('far-reaching in time') + 久 ('long-lasting'); most famously collocated with 历史 ('history': 历史悠久 'rich in history').

examples.text: 八十多年来，这座历史悠久的小院一直向街坊敞开。
examples.trans: For over eighty years, this historic courtyard has always stood open to the neighbourhood.

examples.text: 成都的茶馆文化历史悠久，最讲究慢悠悠的人情味。
examples.trans: Chengdu's teahouse culture has a long-standing history and treasures unhurried human warmth.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nín. Respectful singular 'you' used with elders, teachers, and guests (您好！).

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nín hǎo. Respectful greeting using polite 您 ('you') for elders, teachers, and guests.

examples.text: 您好，欢迎来到小院客栈！
examples.trans: Hello, welcome to Courtyard Inn!

examples.text: 老师您好，请进屋喝杯热茶。
examples.trans: Hello, Teacher—please come inside for a cup of hot tea.

悬.gloss: up in the air, in jeopardy

meanings.en: up in the air, in jeopardy
meanings.note: Colloquial adjective xuán ('dicey, likely lost').

examples.text: 要是让领导听到，我这个月的奖金又悬了！
examples.trans: If bosses hear that, my monthly bonus is toast again!

examples.text: 再不抓紧出发，赶上末班地铁就悬了。
examples.trans: Unless we leave now, catching the last train is dicey.

meanings.note: Adjective bēishāng ('sorrowful').

examples.text: 听到这个评价，我是应该兴奋还是悲伤呢？
examples.trans: Hearing praise like that, should I feel thrilled or sad?

examples.text: 这首抒情慢歌旋律里带着淡淡的悲伤。
examples.trans: A gentle sadness runs through the melody of this ballad.

examples.text: 你也不用太悲观了，可以试试云海卫视。
examples.trans: You do not need to be too pessimistic either; you can try Yunhai Television.

examples.text: 这是悲观。
examples.trans: This is 悲观.

examples.text: 这是情况啊。
examples.trans: This is situation.

examples.text: 那个情况好。
examples.trans: That situation is good.

meanings.note: Used for emotional life or relationship advice.

examples.text: 朋友们都笑称她是情感专家。
examples.trans: Friends jokingly call her a romance expert.

examples.text: 好的音乐能打动观众的情感。
examples.trans: Good music can move the audience's emotions.

meanings.note: Noun qíngxù ('emotional energy, spirits').

examples.text: 请大家高声呼喊，把现场情绪调动起来。
examples.trans: Cheer loudly to get the crowd's energy up.

examples.text: 上台前要先稳定好自己的情绪。
examples.trans: Steady your nerves before stepping onstage.

examples.text: 我不是跟你说了吗？想要情路顺利，工作上别走太近！
examples.trans: Didn't I tell you yesterday? If you want romance to go smoothly, keep some distance at work!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Adjective jīngrén ('astonishing').

examples.text: 这场暴雨直播创造了惊人的收视纪录。
examples.trans: This rainstorm broadcast set an astonishing ratings record.

examples.text: 年轻歌手在总决赛舞台上爆发出了惊人的能量。
examples.trans: The young singer unleashed astonishing energy on the finale stage.

examples.text: 不要惊动他。
examples.trans: Do not disturb him.

examples.text: 这事惊动了警察。
examples.trans: This matter disturbed the police.

examples.text: 惊喜！谢谢大家给我过生日，谢谢！
examples.trans: What a surprise! Thank you everyone for celebrating my birthday!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jīng yà. Describes surprise at unexpected news.

examples.text: 宋老师，您一脸惊讶！您认识梧桐巷十二号吗？
examples.trans: Teacher Song, you look amazed! Do you know Number twelve, Wutong Lane?

examples.text: 看到二十年没见的老朋友，他十分惊讶。
examples.trans: Seeing an old friend after twenty years, he was astonished.

meanings.note: Colloquial adjective cǎn.

examples.text: 你们把我骗得太惨了！
examples.trans: You fooled me terribly!

examples.text: 输得太惨了。
examples.trans: Lost badly.

examples.text: 按照惯例，我们要开会。
examples.trans: According to convention, we need to have a meeting.

examples.text: 打破惯例。
examples.trans: Break the convention.

meanings.en: want to; would like to; think; miss
meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎng. Before a verb, expresses a polite wish ('would like to'); before a noun/person, 'think of / miss'.

examples.text: 太好了！现在我想吃一顿丰盛的早餐。
examples.trans: Wonderful! Now I would like to eat a big breakfast.

examples.text: 宋老师早！您想喝咖啡还是红茶？
examples.trans: Morning, Teacher Song! Would you like coffee or black tea?

想不到.gloss: never expect, fail to think of

meanings.en: never expect, fail to think of
meanings.note: Unable to anticipate a detail or twist.

examples.text: 这么细微的技术问题，我绝对想不到。
examples.trans: I never would have thought of such a tiny technical detail.

examples.text: 真想不到他们能在三天之内搭好整个舞台。
examples.trans: Who would have thought they could build the whole stage in three days.

meanings.note: Potential complement xiǎngbuqǐlai ('cannot remember').

examples.text: 总觉得有事没做，但是又想不起来。
examples.trans: I feel something was left undone, yet cannot recall what.

examples.text: 我一时想不起来他的名字了。
examples.trans: I cannot recall his name at the moment.

meanings.en: to think up; to come up with; to figure out
meanings.note: Pronounced xiǎng chūlái; verb 想 plus directional/resultative complement 出来 indicating bringing an idea into existence. Potential forms are 想得出来 / 想不出来.

examples.text: 方案是你想出来的，当然应该由你来实施。
examples.trans: You thought up the plan, so of course you should be the one to carry it out.

examples.text: 我们开了整整一夜的会，终于想出来一个好点子。
examples.trans: We held a meeting all night long and finally came up with a great idea.

related.gloss: to figure out; to think of

meanings.note: Resultative verb xiǎngdào.

examples.text: 你是怎么想到的？
examples.trans: How did you think of it?

examples.text: 我没想到这个办法。
examples.trans: I did not think of this method.

examples.text: 这是想办法啊。
examples.trans: This is think of a way.

examples.text: 那个想办法好。
examples.trans: That think of a way is good.

meanings.note: Adverb xiǎngbì ('one presumes, surely').

examples.text: 他当年离开卫视，想必得罪了不少人。
examples.trans: When he left the station, he must have offended many.

examples.text: 忙了一整天，想必你也累了吧。
examples.trans: After working all day, you must be tired.

meanings.note: reduplicated verb for doing an action a little bit

examples.text: 职场是一个火锅，想想真的够吓人的。
examples.trans: The workplace is a hotpot; just thinking about it is scary enough.

examples.text: 职场是一个火锅，想想真的够吓人的。
examples.trans: The workplace is a hotpot; just thinking about it is scary enough.

meanings.note: Noun xiǎngfǎ ('idea, concept').

examples.text: 请两位名嘴碰头，也算是有想法。
examples.trans: Pairing two famous hosts shows some creative thought.

examples.text: 大家有什么新想法都可以提出来。
examples.trans: Anyone with fresh ideas is welcome to share.

meanings.note: Verb xiǎngyào ('want, desire').

examples.text: 这就是你想要的结果吗？
examples.trans: Is this the outcome you wanted?

examples.text: 想要怎么交代都可以。
examples.trans: Whatever explanation you want is fine.

meanings.note: Verb/noun xiǎngxiàng ('imagine, picture').

examples.text: 真无法想象他一个人经历了多少。
examples.trans: It is hard to imagine how much he endured alone.

examples.text: 舞台效果比我想象的还要好。
examples.trans: The stage effect is even better than I imagined.

examples.text: 他的速度你想象不到。
examples.trans: His speed is beyond your imagination.

examples.text: 这是我想象不到的。
examples.trans: This is something I cannot imagine.

meanings.note: Noun xiǎngxiànglì ('power of imagination').

examples.text: 平时写文章多，您的想象力越来越丰富吧？
examples.trans: Has writing articles made your imagination run wild?

examples.text: 策划新综艺需要大胆的想象力。
examples.trans: Devising a new variety show takes bold imagination.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiáng qǐ lái. Literally 'think up-come': a memory coming back to mind (我想起来了 'now I remember').

examples.text: 我想起来了！我十岁的时候，叔叔叫它冬天茶室！
examples.trans: Now I remember! When I was ten, my uncle called it the winter tea room!

examples.text: 我想起来了，钥匙在抽屉里！
examples.trans: Now I remember, the key is in the drawer!

想都不想.gloss: without a second thought, without hesitation

meanings.en: without a second thought, without hesitation
meanings.note: Acting immediately without weighing pros and cons.

examples.text: 一听说朋友有难，他想都不想就赶过去帮忙了。
examples.trans: Hearing a friend was in trouble, he rushed to help without a second thought.

examples.text: 要是有这样的好机会，我想都不想就会答应。
examples.trans: Given a chance like that, I would say yes without hesitation.

examples.text: 惹麻烦。
examples.trans: Cause trouble.

examples.text: 不要惹他生气。
examples.trans: Don't make him angry.

examples.text: 你回来了？对不起啊，我惹麻烦了。
examples.trans: You're back? I'm so sorry — I caused a huge mess.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Formal adverb yùjiā ('more and more').

examples.text: 两国在文化领域上的合作愈加频繁。
examples.trans: Cultural cooperation between the two nations grows ever more frequent.

examples.text: 随着总决赛临近，比赛气氛愈加紧张。
examples.trans: As the finals near, the competition grows ever more intense.

meanings.note: Adjective yúkuài ('pleasant, agreeable').

examples.text: 听说闻老师跟淳于总闹不愉快了。
examples.trans: Rumour says Mr Wen Simo and Mr Chun Yuqiao had an unpleasant clash.

examples.text: 祝各位嘉宾今晚在演播室度过愉快的时光。
examples.trans: Wishing every guest a pleasant evening in the studio.

meanings.note: Polite formal phrase yìxià rúhé ('what is your view on this?').

examples.text: 希望两位共同制作，不知您意下如何？
examples.trans: We hope you two will co-produce — what do you say?

examples.text: 我提议下周启动改版，各位意下如何？
examples.trans: I propose starting the revamp next week; thoughts?

meanings.note: Noun yìyì ('meaning, value').

examples.text: 必须完全革新，否则的话没有意义。
examples.trans: We must innovate completely; otherwise there is no point.

examples.text: 这次公益演出对年轻歌手来说很有意义。
examples.trans: This charity show carries real meaning for young singers.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yì wài. Works as an adjective ('unexpected') or noun ('a surprise').

examples.text: 完全是意外！到表哥家打开一看，里面是乐谱和红丝带。
examples.trans: Completely by accident! At my cousin's home I opened it and saw sheet music and a red ribbon.

examples.text: 真是个让人开心的意外惊喜！
examples.trans: What a delightful surprise!

meanings.note: Often used humorously for trying to move things with one's mind.

examples.text: 光靠意念可解决不了实际困难。
examples.trans: Sheer mental willpower will not solve practical problems.

examples.text: 他盯着手机，好像在用意念催消息。
examples.trans: He stared at his phone as if willing a message to arrive.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yì si. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个意思 ('a meaning').

examples.text: 周经理的意思是……希望每位客人都觉得有十分满意！
examples.trans: What Manager Zhou means is... we hope every guest feels ten-out-of-ten satisfied!

examples.text: 哎呀，怎么好意思拿房东烦心事打扰付钱的客人！
examples.trans: Oh dear, how could we bother a paying guest with our landlord troubles!

meanings.note: Noun yìjiàn ('view, suggestion, objection').

examples.text: 有时候粉丝的意见我们也要尊重。
examples.trans: Sometimes we need to respect fan feedback too.

examples.text: 大家对这个新方案有什么意见？
examples.trans: Does anyone have feedback on this new proposal?

meanings.note: Verb phrase gǎn xìngqù ('take an interest in').

examples.text: 你整天对人家八卦隐私那么感兴趣。
examples.trans: All day long you take such interest in others' private gossip.

examples.text: 布小谷从小就对电视制作很感兴趣。
examples.trans: Bu Xiaogu has been interested in TV production since youth.

meanings.note: Experiencing an emotion such as happiness, pride, or relief.

examples.text: 看到团队一起成长，他由衷地感到高兴。
examples.trans: Watching the team grow together made him genuinely happy.

examples.text: 每天勉强自己去感到幸福其实很累。
examples.trans: Forcing yourself to feel happy every day is exhausting.

meanings.note: Verb/adjective gǎndòng ('deeply touched').

examples.text: 看你这么讲义气，我都快感动了。
examples.trans: Watching your loyalty almost moves me to tears.

examples.text: 公益访谈的真实故事让全场观众很感动。
examples.trans: True stories on the charity special moved the audience.

meanings.note: Noun/verb gǎnshòu ('how someone feels; experience').

examples.text: 你在派对上黑着脸，有想过我的感受吗？
examples.trans: Frowning through the party, did you consider my feelings?

examples.text: 做真人秀最看重嘉宾在镜头前真实的感受。
examples.trans: Reality TV prizes guests' genuine feelings on camera.

感怀.gloss: recall with deep emotion, cherish fondly

meanings.en: recall with deep emotion, cherish fondly
meanings.note: Literary verb gǎnhuái ('reflect fondly with emotion').

examples.text: 我们感怀的，始终是那些温柔的记忆。
examples.trans: What warms our hearts with emotion is always gentle shared memories.

examples.text: 老歌响起时，台下不少观众纷纷低头感怀往事。
examples.trans: As the classic song played, many in the crowd reflected on old times.

meanings.note: Noun gǎnqíng ('interpersonal feelings or bond').

examples.text: 如果在内部强推改革，难免会伤感情。
examples.trans: Forcing reform internally is bound to bruise feelings.

examples.text: 一起熬夜做节目的同事感情最深。
examples.trans: Colleagues who pull all-nighters together bond deeply.

感情用事.gloss: let emotions cloud judgment, act on personal feelings

meanings.en: let emotions cloud judgment, act on personal feelings
meanings.note: Idiom contrasting emotional impulse with objectivity.

examples.text: 处理重大危机时必须保持冷静，绝不能感情用事。
examples.trans: Handling major crises demands calm; never let emotion rule.

examples.text: 他工作上极度理性，唯独面对朋友时容易感情用事。
examples.trans: Utterly rational at work, he turns soft-hearted toward friends.

examples.text: 实习感觉怎么样？
examples.trans: How does the internship feel?

examples.text: 这是感觉。
examples.trans: This is 感觉.

meanings.note: Verb gǎnxiè ('thank formally').

examples.text: 我们得特别正式地感谢一下您。
examples.trans: We must thank you very formally.

examples.text: 非常感谢大家今天的支持。
examples.trans: Thank you all very much for today's support.

meanings.note: Monosyllabic verb used in 愿不愿意 ('willing or not').

examples.text: 无论前路多难，大家都愿陪着团队一起坚持下去。
examples.trans: However tough the road ahead, everyone is willing to stick together.

examples.text: 愿你们的新节目开播大吉、收视长虹！
examples.trans: Wishing your new show a smash premiere and soaring ratings!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuàn yì. Used when accepting an invitation or job offer.

examples.text: 我们替他看管了一周蓝箱子，他一定愿意帮忙！
examples.trans: After we guarded his blue suitcase all week, he will gladly help!

examples.text: 别抢人，小美！小晴，你愿意留下来当正式前台主管吗？
examples.trans: No poaching, Mei! Qing, are you willing to stay on as our permanent front-desk manager?

meanings.note: Noun/adjective císhàn ('charitable, charity').

examples.text: 他们成立了一个公开透明的慈善基金。
examples.trans: They founded a transparent charity fund.

examples.text: 不如用惠美慈善访谈做个开始吧。
examples.trans: Let us kick things off with Huimei's charity special.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huāng. Describes feeling rattled or panicked (别慌 'don't panic').

examples.text: 等周经理听说他为分贝慌了一整夜，表情一定精彩！
examples.trans: Wait until Manager Zhou hears he panicked all night over decibels!

examples.text: 对。我一慌，按了门铃，把星期五纸条贴在把手上。
examples.trans: Yes. In a panic I rang the bell and taped the Friday note onto the handle.

examples.text: 这是慎重啊。
examples.trans: This is cautious.

examples.text: 那个慎重好。
examples.trans: That cautious is good.

meanings.note: Pinyin: màn. Everyday adjective for slow speed; doubled in 慢慢 ('slowly, take your time').

examples.text: 得救了！失陪一分钟，宋老师，您慢喝热茶！
examples.trans: Saved! Excuse me one minute, Teacher Song—enjoy your hot tea!

examples.text: 再等几分钟，志豪先生。中午城里堵车总是很慢。
examples.trans: Give it a few more minutes, Mr Zhihao. Midday city traffic is always slow.

meanings.note: Pinyin: màn màn. Polite host phrase: 慢慢吃 ('take your time eating'), 慢慢走 ('walk safely').

examples.text: 凉？啊——对！老街水管早上需要慢慢热身！
examples.trans: Cool? Ah—yes! Old-street water pipes need a gentle morning warm-up!

examples.text: 把蓝色转轮慢慢往左拧开——别太快。
examples.trans: Turn the blue wheel open slowly to the left—not too fast.

meanings.note: Colloquial phrase màndiǎn ('go easy, watch your step').

examples.text: 大家慢点啊，注意脚下安全！
examples.trans: Take it easy everyone, watch your step!

examples.text: 雨天路滑，开车慢点。
examples.trans: Roads are slick in the rain, so drive slowly.

meanings.note: Pinyin: màn yòng. Courteous café and restaurant phrase meaning 'please enjoy at your leisure'.

examples.text: 一定转达！请慢用。
examples.trans: I certainly will! Please enjoy your meal.

examples.text: 您的热红茶和肉桂卷齐了，请慢用。
examples.trans: Here are your hot black tea and cinnamon roll—please enjoy.

慢走.gloss: take care on your way out

meanings.en: take care on your way out
meanings.note: Polite send-off mànzǒu ('walk slowly / safe travels').

examples.text: 董事长，会议结束了，您慢走。
examples.trans: Chairwoman, the meeting is over — take care!

examples.text: 门口有台阶，各位嘉宾请慢走。
examples.trans: Mind the steps at the door; take care on your way out.

examples.text: 你心里有什么憋屈的话，你说出来行不行？我求求你了。
examples.trans: If something is eating at you inside, please just say it out loud — I'm begging you!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dǒng. Means 'understand' (听懂 'understand by listening').

examples.text: 老陈，你真懂当哥哥的人。
examples.trans: Chen, you really understand older brothers.

examples.text: 房产信？让志豪和我看看——我管市政合同，他懂老建筑保护法！
examples.trans: A property letter? Let Zhihao and me see it—I handle municipal contracts, and he knows heritage building law!

懂行.gloss: know the ropes; know the trade

meanings.en: know the ropes; know the trade
meanings.note: Pinyin: dǒng háng. Note 行 is read 2nd-tone háng ('trade/profession') here, not xíng! Literally 'understand the trade'.

examples.text: 小美一闻柠檬皮就知道新不新鲜，真懂行！
examples.trans: Mei knows whether lemons are fresh from one whiff of the peel—she really knows her stuff!

examples.text: 买老木头家具，最好请懂行的师傅一起去看。
examples.trans: When buying old wooden furniture, it's best to ask someone who knows the trade to come along.

examples.text: 没有，我是从来没有办过这么热闹的生日聚会，给我吓懵了。
examples.trans: Not at all; I've simply never had such a lively birthday party before, so it stunned me.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 这是一出好戏。
examples.trans: This is a good play.

examples.text: 他演戏演得很好。
examples.trans: He acts very well.

meanings.note: Showbiz noun xìfèn ('portion of stage/screen time').

examples.text: 可是明星导师们的戏份也跟着降低了。
examples.trans: Yet the celebrity mentors' share of screen time drops too.

examples.text: 虽然他的戏份不多，但表现非常抢眼。
examples.trans: Though his screen time is brief, his performance stands out.

examples.text: 这首歌曲的侵权事件前几天闹得沸沸扬扬，可是现在却有了一个戏剧性的转变。
examples.trans: The copyright uproar around this song raged for days, yet now it has taken a dramatic turn.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chéng. Frequently serves as a result complement meaning 'into' (变成, 改成).

examples.text: 商业办公楼出售？！把我们的客栈和厨房变成灰色办公室？！
examples.trans: Commercial office sale?! Turn our inn and kitchen into grey offices?!

examples.text: 超过八十年的小院建筑，只要一楼每天服务街坊邻居，禁止改成私人办公室。
examples.trans: Any courtyard building over eighty years old may not become private offices as long as the ground floor serves neighbours daily.

meanings.note: Verb chéngwéi ('turn into, become').

examples.text: 他努力多年才成为公司的核心人物。
examples.trans: He worked for years to become the firm's core leader.

examples.text: 这首歌很快成为了热门金曲。
examples.trans: This song quickly became a hit.

meanings.note: Exclamation sealing a bet, promise, or transaction.

examples.text: 一言为定，咱们就这么愉快地成交了！
examples.trans: Word is bond—consider it a deal!

examples.text: 双方谈妥条件，很快就签字成交了。
examples.trans: Once terms were agreed, both sides signed and sealed the deal.

meanings.note: Verb/adjective chénggōng ('succeed; successful').

examples.text: 你们的偷袭计划没有成功。
examples.trans: Your ambush plan did not succeed.

examples.text: 今晚的演出非常成功。
examples.trans: Tonight's performance was a great success.

meanings.note: Noun/verb chéngjiù ('accomplishment').

examples.text: 我只是仰慕他在行业里的成就。
examples.trans: I simply admire his achievements in the industry.

examples.text: 这是整个团队共同的成就。
examples.trans: This is the shared achievement of the whole team.

meanings.note: Adjective chéngshú ('seasoned, experienced').

examples.text: 咱们从成熟的制片里边挑两个留下来？
examples.trans: Shall we pick two seasoned producers to stay on?

examples.text: 经过几次直播，她的策划成熟多了。
examples.trans: After several live shows, her planning is much more mature.

成片.gloss: finished master cut, final edited programme

meanings.en: finished master cut, final edited programme
meanings.note: Completed broadcast-ready video file.

examples.text: 熬了一个月通宵，节目的成片今天终于剪出来了。
examples.trans: After a month of late nights, the master cut is finally finished.

examples.text: 交台之前，总制作人习惯再亲自审一遍成片。
examples.trans: Before delivery, the chief producer always reviews the final cut.

meanings.note: Verb chénglì ('establish, set up').

examples.text: 这是二部成立以来的业绩曲线。
examples.trans: This is Unit Two's performance curve since its founding.

examples.text: 盛典联合项目组今天正式成立。
examples.trans: The joint gala project team was formally established today.

meanings.note: Noun chéngbài ('outcome, success or failure').

examples.text: 做一件事情的成败取决于思考的角度。
examples.trans: Success or failure sometimes hinges on your angle of thought.

examples.text: 细节往往决定一档现场直播的成败。
examples.trans: Details often decide the success or failure of live TV.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chéng dū. Historic southwestern Chinese city famed for courtyards and tea houses.

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

examples.text: 真的吗？您在成都认识什么人吗？
examples.trans: Really? Do you know someone here in Chengdu?

meanings.en: to grow up; to mature; to develop professionally or personally
meanings.note: Pronounced chéngzhǎng; intransitive verb often used with 为 or 成 ('grow into'), and frequently used nominally for personal development.

examples.text: 你早晚会成长的，要对自己有信心。
examples.trans: Sooner or later you will grow; you need to have confidence in yourself.

examples.text: 能跟她一块成长，这样两个人才有共同话题嘛。
examples.trans: Someone who can grow alongside her so the two of them share common ground.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ. First-person singular pronoun; add 的 for 'my' (我的) and 们 for 'we/us' (我们).

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ men. First-person plural pronoun; add 的 for 'our' (我们的).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a part used in conversational Mandarin.

examples.text: 我有一个我的。
examples.trans: I have a 我的.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的我的。
examples.trans: This is a very good 我的.

我行我素.gloss: do things strictly one's own way

meanings.en: do things strictly one's own way
meanings.note: Idiom wǒxíng-wǒsù ('follow one's own course').

examples.text: 我做事向来我行我素，从不做糊涂事。
examples.trans: I have always done things my own way, never muddle-headedly.

examples.text: 他在创作上我行我素，从不迎合流俗。
examples.trans: In creative work he goes his own way without pandering.

meanings.note: Finger ring, often associated with romance or proposals.

examples.text: 他打开精致的小盒子，里面放着一枚闪亮的戒指。
examples.trans: He opened the small box to reveal a sparkling ring.

examples.text: 半夜跑去办公室送戒指，把大家都惊呆了。
examples.trans: Showing up at midnight with a ring stunned everyone.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huò zhě. Joins options in statements—contrast 还是 ('or') in questions.

examples.text: 上面有名字或者电话号码吗？
examples.trans: Is there a name or a phone number on it?

examples.text: 早上您可以喝红茶，或者来一杯热咖啡。
examples.trans: In the morning you can have black tea or a cup of hot coffee.

examples.text: 我一进公司就听人说那边的人来开会，我想把这个送上去，或许有帮助！
examples.trans: The moment I walked in, I heard they were meeting upstairs, so I rushed to bring this up in case it helps!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

战力.gloss: fighting strength, execution power of a team

meanings.en: fighting strength, execution power of a team
meanings.note: Short for 战斗力, praising a team's capability under pressure.

examples.text: 这支经过大直播考验的制作组是最有战力的团队。
examples.trans: Tested by live broadcasts, this unit is the strongest fighting team around.

examples.text: 核心成员回归之后，部门的整体战力瞬间拉满。
examples.trans: Once the core members returned, the unit's fighting strength surged.

战功赫赫.gloss: covered in battle glory, boasting illustrious achievements

meanings.en: covered in battle glory, boasting illustrious achievements
meanings.note: Playful praise for someone returning from a tough assignment.

examples.text: 看你这次出差战功赫赫，今天请喝咖啡！
examples.trans: Seeing you return covered in glory from the shoot, coffee is on me!

examples.text: 这支制作团队拍出了多部佳作，可谓战功赫赫。
examples.trans: Having made hit after hit, this crew boasts an illustrious record.

examples.text: 你真正的战场应该是在这边。
examples.trans: Your real battlefield should be over here.

examples.text: 这是战场。 (Example)
examples.trans: This is 战场.

examples.text: 希望作为最大的战略合作伙伴，能够帮我们把原创的节目打进西方主流市场。
examples.trans: When that day comes, we hope our strategic partner will help bring our original shows into mainstream global markets.

examples.text: 与星天的战略合作被总部收回重审，消息已经公布了。
examples.trans: Meanwhile, the overseas group's headquarters has pulled the strategic partnership back for review and announced the freeze.

examples.text: 十二歌王第三季，辛惠美战队的首秀即将登场！
examples.trans: In Season Three of Twelve Singers, Team Xin Huimei's debut performance is about to take the stage!

examples.text: 连我们其他战队的导师，都不知道她的真实身份。
examples.trans: Not even the mentors of our other teams know this singer's true identity.

meanings.note: Verb jié ('clip, screenshot, intercept').

examples.text: 就在那几分钟里已经有人截了图。
examples.trans: Within those few minutes someone already captured screenshots.

examples.text: 请把视频最后五秒钟截下来做预告。
examples.trans: Clip the final five seconds of video as a teaser.

截胡.gloss: snatch a deal or talent away at the last moment

meanings.en: snatch a deal or talent away at the last moment
meanings.note: Originally a mahjong term, widely used in entertainment business.

examples.text: 眼看就要签约的新人差点被竞争对手出高价截胡。
examples.trans: The newcomer about to sign was nearly poached at the last second by a rival.

examples.text: 为了防止别人截胡，经纪总监亲自飞去敲定合同。
examples.trans: To keep rivals from swooping in, the agency head flew out to seal the deal.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dài. Specifically for accessories placed on the head, face, neck, or wrist—contrast 穿 for clothes/shoes.

examples.text: 哎呀，怎么拿错了！我戴眼镜看看行李牌。
examples.trans: Dear me, what a mix-up! Let me put on my glasses and check the luggage tag.

examples.text: 完了！昨天我没戴眼镜，在平板上接了电话预订！
examples.trans: Disaster! Yesterday without my glasses I took a phone booking on the tablet!

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间房 ('a room').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng dōng. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位房东 ('a landlord').

examples.text: 房东律师寄来的？奇怪——我们房租一直交到明年夏天了。
examples.trans: Sent by the landlord's lawyer? Strange—our rent is paid right through next summer.

examples.text: 太好了……趁着等他们，我扫一眼这封房东来信。
examples.trans: Wonderful... while we wait, let me glance at this letter from the landlord.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng chǎn. Measure word (量词): 处, e.g. 一处房产 ('a piece of property').

examples.text: 邮递员刚让我签收的，上面盖着红色房产印章。
examples.trans: The postman just had me sign for it; it carries a red property-office stamp.

examples.text: 房产信？让志豪和我看看——我管市政合同，他懂老建筑保护法！
examples.trans: A property letter? Let Zhihao and me see it—I handle municipal contracts, and he knows heritage building law!

related.gloss: a piece of property (measure word 处)

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng hào. Short compound 房 ('room') + 号 ('number').

examples.text: 绿色登记本的每一页都记着日期和房号。
examples.trans: Every page of the green guest book records the date and room number.

examples.text: 请看钥匙牌上的房号，您的房间在二楼。
examples.trans: Please check the room number on the key tag; your room is on the second floor.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng zi. Measure word (量词): 栋 (dòng), e.g. 一栋房子 ('a house').

examples.text: 所以老房子自己会打招呼？
examples.trans: So the old house says hello by itself?

examples.text: 老房子每到星期二就松一颗螺丝。坐吧。
examples.trans: Every Tuesday an old house loosens one screw. Sit down.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng liáng. Measure word (量词): 根 (gēn), e.g. 一根房梁 ('a roof beam').

examples.text: 哇，看这间房！大木头房梁，窗户正对着院子！
examples.trans: Wow, look at this room! Big wooden beams, and a window facing the courtyard!

examples.text: 先生，到了。小心碰头，这根木房梁比较低。
examples.trans: Here we are, sir. Mind your head—this wooden beam is fairly low.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng zū. Measure word (量词): 笔 (bǐ), e.g. 一笔房租 ('a rent payment').

examples.text: 房东律师寄来的？奇怪——我们房租一直交到明年夏天了。
examples.trans: Sent by the landlord's lawyer? Strange—our rent is paid right through next summer.

examples.text: 这家小店每个月一号交房租。
examples.trans: This little shop pays its rent on the first of every month.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng jiān. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间房间 ('a room').

examples.text: 停电的时候，纸还能用。
examples.trans: Paper still works when the power goes out.

examples.text: 放心吧，周经理。房间干净，毛巾也是新的。
examples.trans: Relax, Manager Zhou. The room is clean, and the towels are fresh.

examples.text: 这一切都太巧了，所有事都太巧了。
examples.trans: All of this is far too coincidental — every single piece lines up too neatly.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: suó yǐ. Introduces a result or conclusion, often after 因为.

examples.text: 所以老房子自己会打招呼？
examples.trans: So the old house says hello by itself?

examples.text: 分贝？所以九分不是给我前台服务打的分？
examples.trans: Decibels? So nine points was not a score for my front-desk service?

examples.text: 据悉，诉讼包括歌曲利润所得三倍以上的天价索赔，以及星天娱乐公开道歉。
examples.trans: Reports say the lawsuit demands triple-profit damages along with a formal public apology from Xingtian Entertainment.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Formal nominal phrase suǒzhǐ (as in 话有所指, 'veiled point').

examples.text: 孙总，你刚才那番话有所指吗？
examples.trans: Mr Sun, were your remarks hinting at someone?

examples.text: 大家听得出他刚才的提问另有所指。
examples.trans: Everyone could tell his question carried a veiled point.

meanings.note: Pinyin: suó yǒu. Usually followed by 的 or a noun (所有的客人 'all the guests').

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 院子里所有的灯笼都亮起来了。
examples.trans: All the lanterns across the courtyard lit up.

examples.text: 所有人都来了。
examples.trans: Everyone is here.

examples.text: 他认识所有人。
examples.trans: He knows everyone.

examples.text: 作为版权的所有者，你愿意相信我的这位学员吗？
examples.trans: As the copyright holder, are you willing to place your trust in my student?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 这个圈子没有所谓的江湖规矩，你也不用瞻前顾后。
examples.trans: There are no unwritten underworld rules in this industry, so stop worrying over every step.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: biǎn. Describes thin, flattened objects (扁铁棒 'flat iron bar', 扁包裹 'flat parcel'); contrast 平 ('level, even').

examples.text: 老陈把扁铁棒轻轻伸进第三块石板的角落下面。
examples.trans: Chen slid the flat iron bar gently underneath the corner of the third flagstone.

examples.text: 志鹏在大门口接过了一个用牛皮纸包着的扁木头包裹。
examples.trans: At the gate Peng received a flat wooden parcel wrapped in brown kraft paper.

meanings.note: Pinyin: biǎn dòu. Literally 扁 ('flat') + 豆 ('bean/legume'), used for flat-podded beans and lentils.

examples.text: 加了柠檬和橄榄油的金黄扁豆汤又香又暖胃。
examples.trans: Golden lentil soup with lemon and olive oil is fragrant and warming.

examples.text: 小美前一天晚上先把扁豆洗干净泡好。
examples.trans: Mei washed and soaked the lentils the night before.

扇.gloss: measure word for doors and windows

meanings.en: measure word for doors and windows
meanings.note: Pinyin: shàn. Counts hinged or sliding doors and windows (一扇门 'a door', 一扇窗户 'a window').

examples.text: 上楼梯，平台往左拐，最上面最后一扇门。
examples.trans: Up the stairs, turn left at the landing, last door at the very top.

examples.text: 再往左拐进小广场，找一扇蓝木门。
examples.trans: Then turn left into the small square and look for a blue wooden door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shǒu. Measure word (量词): 双 (shuāng), e.g. 一双手 ('a pair of hands').

examples.text: 谢谢你，小美。刚才吓了一跳，手都凉了！
examples.trans: Thank you, Mei. That gave me such a start just now that my hands went cold!

examples.text: 我手在发抖——车上下来穿深灰色外套的高个子男人吗？
examples.trans: My hands are shaking—is a tall man in a dark grey coat stepping out?

related.gloss: a pair of hands (measure word 双)

meanings.note: Locative noun shǒushàng ('in someone's possession/hands').

examples.text: 那个嘉宾是从对手手上抢过来的吧？
examples.trans: That guest was snatched from our rival's hands, right?

examples.text: 我手上还有两份合同没看完。
examples.trans: I still have two contracts in hand left to read.

examples.text: 作为王尔的手下，你没有被连坐清除出星天，已经是很大的幸运了。
examples.trans: As Wang Er's intern, not getting swept out of Xingtian alongside him was already huge luck for you.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Locative phrase shǒuzhōng ('held in hand').

examples.text: 本应该属于我的机会，如今都已在我手中。
examples.trans: Opportunities meant for me are now back in my own hands.

examples.text: 主持人举起手中的信封，准备宣布冠军名单。
examples.trans: Raising the envelope in hand, the host prepared to name the winner.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shǒu xiě. Compound 手 ('hand') + 写 ('write'); frequently used before 的 to mean 'handwritten' (手写的菜单).

examples.text: 咖啡馆门口立着一块手写的木头菜单牌。
examples.trans: A handwritten wooden menu board stands by the café entrance.

examples.text: 这张手写的明信片比打印的更有温度。
examples.trans: This handwritten postcard feels much warmer than a printed one.

examples.text: 今天你男朋友不是过生日吗？你把你手头的活都交给我做，早点回家吧。
examples.trans: Isn't today your boyfriend's birthday? Hand all your tasks over to me and head home early.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shǒu tào. Combines 手 ('hand') + 套 ('protective sheath/cover'); measure word: 双 (shuāng, pair) or 只 (zhī, single); verb: 戴 (dài).

examples.text: 快戴上厚厚的烤箱手套，八个脆皮面包热腾腾出炉啦！
examples.trans: Quickly put on thick oven mitts—eight loaves of crusty bread are coming piping hot out of the oven!

examples.text: 冬天在院子里修剪树枝的时候，老陈总会戴上一双帆布手套。
examples.trans: When pruning branches in the courtyard in winter, Chen always puts on a pair of canvas gloves.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shǒu zhǐ. Compound 手 ('hand') + 指 ('digit/point'). Measure word: 根 (gēn), e.g. 两根手指 ('two fingers').

examples.text: 宋老师的手指轻轻落在黑白琴键上。
examples.trans: Teacher Song's fingers landed gently on the black and white piano keys.

examples.text: 墙上的油漆还没干，千万别用手指碰。
examples.trans: The paint on the wall isn't dry yet—don't touch it with your fingers.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shǒu zhǎng. Combines 手 ('hand') + 掌 ('palm/flat pad of the hand'); 手掌根 refers to the heel of the palm used in kneading dough.

examples.text: 揉面的时候要用手掌根往下推，折一次，转半圈。
examples.trans: When kneading dough, push down with the heel of your palm, fold once, and turn half a circle.

examples.text: 刚出炉的热茶杯握在手掌里，暖和极了。
examples.trans: Holding a freshly poured warm teacup in the palm of your hand feels wonderfully cozy.

手握.gloss: hold in one's hands, command (resources or rights)

meanings.en: hold in one's hands, command (resources or rights)
meanings.note: Concise verb highlighting leverage or assets.

examples.text: 他手握多档热门海外综艺的独家引进版权。
examples.trans: He holds exclusive import rights to several hit overseas formats.

examples.text: 集团如今手握充足资金，准备大力拓展新业务。
examples.trans: Holding ample capital, the group is ready to expand new lines.

meanings.note: Medical noun shǒushù ('surgical operation').

examples.text: 昨晚医院甚至做好了紧急手术准备。
examples.trans: Last night the hospital even prepped for surgery.

examples.text: 手术非常成功，病人很快就能出院。
examples.trans: The operation went smoothly and recovery will be quick.
