meanings.note: Noun shǒujī ('cellphone, smartphone').

examples.text: 视频是粉丝在盛典那天拿手机拍的。
examples.trans: Fans shot the video on a phone during the gala.

examples.text: 进录音棚以前请把手机调成静音。
examples.trans: Please silence your phone before entering the studio.

examples.text: 手柄旋转三百六以上，技术犯规。
examples.trans: Spinning the handle past three hundred sixty degrees is a technical foul.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shǒu diàn tǒng. Measure word (量词): 把 (bǎ), e.g. 一把手电筒 ('a flashlight').

examples.text: 手电筒拿稳，照着这儿的水管接口。
examples.trans: Hold the flashlight steady and shine it on the pipe joint here.

examples.text: 两位快拿手电筒——我的第二周现在就开始！
examples.trans: Grab the flashlight, both of you—my second week starts right now!

meanings.note: Required administrative steps and sign-offs.

examples.text: 节目送审的各项手续都已经全部办齐了。
examples.trans: All clearance paperwork for submitting the show is complete.

examples.text: 办理入职手续需要带上毕业证和身份证。
examples.trans: Onboarding formalities require your diploma and ID card.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shǒu jiǎo. Compound 手 ('hands') + 脚 ('feet'); idiomatic for agility and speed at tasks (手脚真快 'move really fast').

examples.text: 小晴收拾东西手脚真快，两分钟就整理好了。
examples.trans: Qing moves really fast tidying up; she had everything in order in two minutes.

examples.text: 冬天先喝碗热汤，手脚马上就暖和起来了。
examples.trans: Have a bowl of hot soup first in winter and your hands and feet warm right up.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shóu biǎo. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块手表 ('a wristwatch').

examples.text: 我手表七点二十九分。客人下楼了。
examples.trans: Seven twenty-nine on my watch. Guests are coming down the stairs.

examples.text: 只要一点黄油，谢谢。周经理，您怎么老看手表？
examples.trans: Just a little butter, thank you. Manager Zhou, why do you keep looking at your watch?

手边.gloss: right at hand; at one's elbow

meanings.en: right at hand; at one's elbow
meanings.note: Pinyin: shǒu biān. Place noun 手 ('hand') + 边 ('side'): within immediate arm's reach.

examples.text: 小美说切胡萝卜和洋葱可以在她手边的桌子上做。
examples.trans: Mei said chopping the carrots and onions can be done on the table right at her elbow.

examples.text: 修钢琴的时候，老陈喜欢把镊子和扳手都整齐地放在手边。
examples.trans: When repairing a piano, Chen likes keeping his tweezers and wrench neatly within reach.

meanings.note: Locative noun shǒulǐ ('in hand').

examples.text: 大家都先放下手里的活。
examples.trans: Everyone put down the work in your hands first.

examples.text: 光杏子手里就握着不少艺人资源。
examples.trans: Xingzi alone holds plenty of artist contacts in her hands.

meanings.note: Wrist jewelry made of jade, gold, or silver.

examples.text: 她礼貌地退回了对方送来的那只贵重手镯。
examples.trans: She politely returned the expensive bracelet he tried to give her.

examples.text: 母亲把珍藏多年的玉手镯送给了即将出嫁的女儿。
examples.trans: The mother gave her treasured jade bangle to her bride-to-be daughter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cái. Signals that something happened later than expected or in a small amount—contrast 就.

examples.text: 老砖房顶楼平时要等很久水才热。
examples.trans: Top floors in old brick houses usually wait ages before the water warms up.

examples.text: 因为房子只是砖头和木头，志鹏，家人才是留住的东西。
examples.trans: Because a house is only brick and timber, Zhipeng—family is what we keep.

meanings.note: Natural and cultivated creative gift.

examples.text: 观众真正喜爱的是主持人深厚的学识与才华。
examples.trans: What viewers truly love is the host's deep learning and talent.

examples.text: 好的平台应该让每一位年轻人的才华得到施展。
examples.trans: A good platform lets every young person's talent shine.

meanings.note: Modal phrase cáinéng ('only then be able to').

examples.text: 经历很多困难，才能成为核心人物。
examples.trans: Only after enduring many trials can one become a leader.

examples.text: 认真准备才能把节目做好。
examples.trans: Only careful preparation makes a good show.

meanings.note: Verb zhā ('plunge in, strike root').

examples.text: 毕业以后咱们得在城里扎个根。
examples.trans: After graduation we must strike roots in the city.

examples.text: 这棵老树把根扎得很深。
examples.trans: This old tree sank its roots deep.

examples.text: 是啊，辛惠美和黄金一班合体，经纪公司知道的全都扑上来了。
examples.trans: Right — once word got out that Xin Huimei and the Golden Class were reuniting, every agency came rushing over.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.en: cling to; hold onto; push aside
meanings.note: Pinyin: bā. Describes holding onto a doorway or ledge to peek inside (扒着门).

examples.text: 说这话的人每隔三十秒就扒着窗帘偷看一次！
examples.trans: Says the man peeking through the window curtain every thirty seconds!

examples.text: 小猫扒着窗台往外看。
examples.trans: The kitten clung to the windowsill looking outside.

meanings.en: hit; make (a call); give (a score); fetch
meanings.note: Pinyin: dǎ. Light verb forming dozens of everyday expressions (打电话 'make a phone call').

examples.text: 小晴，马上给火车站失物处打电话。
examples.trans: Qing, call the train station lost-and-found office right away.

examples.text: 我正在打……您好，请问有人找蓝色行李箱吗？
examples.trans: I am calling now... Hello, excuse me, is anyone looking for a blue suitcase?

meanings.note: Pinyin: dǎ jiǔ zhé. In Chinese retail, 打九折 means charging 9/10 (90%) of the list price—i.e. a 10% discount!

examples.text: 老板说买满十二个茶杯就给我们打九折。
examples.trans: The stall owner said if we buy a full twelve teacups, he'll give us ten percent off.

examples.text: 周二带自己的杯子买咖啡可以打九折。
examples.trans: Bringing your own mug for coffee on Tuesdays gets you ten percent off.

打交道.gloss: deal with, interact with, socialize with

meanings.en: deal with, interact with, socialize with
meanings.note: Engaging with certain kinds of people in work or life.

examples.text: 做公关每天都要跟媒体打交道。
examples.trans: Working in PR means dealing with media every day.

examples.text: 他不太擅长跟陌生人打交道。
examples.trans: He is not very good at dealing with strangers.

examples.text: 如果现在这个时候把她调到二部去，对她的打击会很大。
examples.trans: If I transfer her away to Unit Two at a moment like this, it will be a huge blow to her.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Verb-complement dǎdòng ('touch or persuade deeply').

examples.text: 你有把握打动老大让他过关吗？
examples.trans: Are you confident of winning over our boss?

examples.text: 真诚的策划最容易打动观众。
examples.trans: A sincere concept moves audiences most easily.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dǎ yìn. Combines 打 ('strike/produce') + 印 ('print/stamp'); 打印纸 is printer paper.

examples.text: 哈！老陈，你偷偷留了一份我打印的咖啡馆菜单？！
examples.trans: Aha! Did you secretly keep a copy of my printed café menu, Chen?!

examples.text: 小晴用前台的打印机打印了二十份新菜单。
examples.trans: Qing printed twenty copies of the new menu on the front-desk printer.

meanings.note: Pushing down rivals, morale, or domestic business.

examples.text: 过度依赖外援反而会打压本公司年轻艺人的成长空间。
examples.trans: Over-relying on outsiders stifles growth space for in-house artists.

examples.text: 他试图靠强硬手段打压老团队的士气。
examples.trans: He tried using heavy-handed tactics to crush the old team's morale.

examples.text: 这是打官司啊。
examples.trans: This is fight a lawsuit.

examples.text: 那个打官司好。
examples.trans: That fight a lawsuit is good.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dǎ kāi. Result compound for opening suitcases, envelopes, boxes, or laptops.

examples.text: 我的行李箱！快打开上面口袋……对，红丝带！
examples.trans: My suitcase! Let me open the top pocket... yes, the red ribbon!

examples.text: 先生？他说：请别打开白纸包，我星期五中午来。
examples.trans: Sir? He says: Please do not open the white paper parcel; I will come Friday at noon.

meanings.note: reduplicated verb 打 softening an action

examples.text: 你这几天就跟着杏子姐姐，给她打打下手。
examples.trans: For the next few days, shadow Sister Xingzi and lend her a hand.

examples.text: 周末我们一起去打打球吧。
examples.trans: Let us go play some ball together this weekend.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dá sǎo. Used for cleaning rooms and courtyards.

examples.text: 我打扫储藏室，把这个蓝色行李箱在这儿放五分钟。
examples.trans: While I sweep the storeroom, let me set this blue suitcase here for five minutes.

examples.text: 客房每天上午都会仔细打扫干净。
examples.trans: Every guest room is thoroughly cleaned each morning.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dá rǎo. Polite opener 打扰一下 ('excuse me for interrupting').

examples.text: 打扰一下，志豪先生？不好意思这么晚敲门。
examples.trans: Excuse me, Mr Zhihao? Sorry to knock so late.

examples.text: 打扰两位先生——热茶来了，热柠檬蛋糕马上到。
examples.trans: Excuse me, gentlemen—here is hot tea, and warm lemon cake is right on the way.

打抱不平.gloss: stand up against an injustice for someone else

meanings.en: stand up against an injustice for someone else
meanings.note: Defending the weak or wronged out of righteousness.

examples.text: 他这人最讲义气，见不得别人受欺负，总爱打抱不平。
examples.trans: Loyal to the core, he always stands up for people being bullied.

examples.text: 领导替受委屈的场务兄弟们打抱不平。
examples.trans: The boss stood up against the unfairness on the crew's behalf.

meanings.en: say hello; greet; give a heads-up
meanings.note: Pinyin: dǎ zhāo hu. Separable verb-object phrase.

examples.text: 所以老房子自己会打招呼？
examples.trans: So the old house says hello by itself?

examples.text: 每天早上路过花摊，她都会笑着打招呼。
examples.trans: Passing the flower stall each morning, she greets the owner with a smile.

meanings.note: Verb-complement dǎduàn ('interrupt someone speaking').

examples.text: 孙总，你突然打断嘉宾说话是干什么？
examples.trans: Mr Sun, why interrupt our guests mid-sentence?

examples.text: 别人发言的时候请不要随意打断。
examples.trans: Please do not interrupt while others are speaking.

meanings.note: Verb-object dǎjià ('brawl, fight').

examples.text: 他们两个人假装在红毯上打架。
examples.trans: The two of them pretended to fight on the red carpet.

examples.text: 原来那场打架只是为了制造新闻。
examples.trans: That fight turned out to be staged just for headlines.

examples.text: 我刚打球你不是看了吗？
examples.trans: Didn't you just watch me play a moment ago?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dǎ diàn huà. Separable verb-object phrase: 打 ('make/dial') + 电话 ('telephone'); recipient takes 给 (给老陈打电话).

examples.text: 周经理早上打电话订了花园木椅。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou made a phone call in the morning to order wooden garden chairs.

examples.text: 到车站以后记得给我打个电话。
examples.trans: Remember to give me a phone call once you reach the station.

meanings.note: Verb dǎpò ('break a record or silence').

examples.text: 这场直播的收视率都快打破电视史了吧？
examples.trans: Did the ratings of this live show practically break TV history?

examples.text: 他一句话打破了会议室里令人窒息的沉默。
examples.trans: With a single remark he broke the suffocating silence in the room.

meanings.note: Verb-complement dǎsuì ('smash, break apart').

examples.text: 他一次次把我的天真幻想打碎。
examples.trans: Again and again he shattered my naive illusions.

examples.text: 不小心打碎杯子要马上收拾干净。
examples.trans: Clean up right away if you accidentally break a glass.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dǎ mó. Combines 打 ('work/strike') + 磨 ('grind/rub smooth').

examples.text: 刷绿油漆以前，老陈先用细砂纸把旧木板打磨平整。
examples.trans: Before brushing on green paint, Chen sanded the old boards smooth with fine sandpaper.

examples.text: 这块老木头经过仔细打磨，露出了漂亮的木纹。
examples.trans: After careful sanding, this old piece of wood revealed beautiful grain.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dǎ suàn. Works as both verb ('plan to do') and noun ('a plan').

examples.text: 等等——您本来打算让店员把箱子交给他，自己躲在街对面看？！
examples.trans: Wait—you were planning to let the clerk hand him the bag and watch from across the street?!

examples.text: 明年春天我们打算把院子再修一修。
examples.trans: Next spring we plan to spruce up the courtyard again.

examples.text: 希望作为最大的战略合作伙伴，能够帮我们把原创的节目打进西方主流市场。
examples.trans: When that day comes, we hope our strategic partner will help bring our original shows into mainstream global markets.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

打造.gloss: build, craft, forge into a flagship

meanings.en: build, craft, forge into a flagship
meanings.note: Popular media/business verb for creating brands or teams.

examples.text: 总制作人花了四年心血一手打造出这支金牌团队。
examples.trans: The chief producer spent four years building this gold-medal team.

examples.text: 闻老师用心把这档访谈打造成了业内的口碑精品。
examples.trans: Mr Wen carefully crafted this talk show into an acclaimed gem.

examples.text: 九年前的著名歌手大赛梦想之声，打造出了流行乐坛的黄金一班。
examples.trans: Nine years ago, the famed singing competition Voice of Dreams forged pop music's legendary Golden Class.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: rēng. Used for tossing trash or items into a bin (扔进).

examples.text: 看，已经十二点零四分了。也许他把明信片扔进垃圾桶了。
examples.trans: Look, it is twelve-oh-four already. Maybe he tossed the postcard into the bin.

examples.text: 请把废纸扔进垃圾桶里。
examples.trans: Please toss the scrap paper into the trash bin.

examples.text: 我给了那个女人一笔钱，她就扔下小允出国去了，我不能丢下他不管。
examples.trans: I gave that woman a sum of money and she abandoned him to go abroad; I couldn't leave him behind.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: rēng diào. Resultative verb compound 扔 ('throw/toss') + 掉 ('away/off').

examples.text: 周经理擦台面的时候纸标签湿了，就把两张标签都扔掉了。
examples.trans: When Manager Zhou wiped the counter, the paper labels got damp, so he threw both of them away.

examples.text: 旧木箱里那些生锈断掉的钉子已经被老陈扔掉了。
examples.trans: The rusty broken nails inside the old wooden chest have already been thrown away by Chen.

examples.text: 钟小姐特别把这首歌和授权书专门托人带给我们。
examples.trans: Ms Zhong specially entrusted a messenger to bring both this new song and her authorization letter to us.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Verb káng ('carry someone/something heavy on shoulders').

examples.text: 上次他在路边难受，还是我把他扛回去的。
examples.trans: Last time he got sick outside, I carried him back.

examples.text: 再大的收视压力，总制作人都得扛住。
examples.trans: A chief producer shoulders even the heaviest pressure.

扛下来.gloss: shoulder a burden and see it through

meanings.en: shoulder a burden and see it through
meanings.note: Colloquial verb-complement kángxiàlái ('carry through').

examples.text: 咱们仨也不是饭桶，这事必须给扛下来。
examples.trans: The three of us are no slouches; we must shoulder this.

examples.text: 面对临时改期，整个制作组咬牙把任务扛下来了。
examples.trans: Facing a sudden reschedule, the crew gritted its teeth and pulled through.

meanings.note: Used in 扣工资 ('dock wages').

examples.text: 为了在会上替原创节目发声，她宁愿被扣一个月工资。
examples.trans: To speak up for original shows, she gladly let them dock a month's pay.

examples.text: 违反考勤制度的员工将会按规定被扣绩效分。
examples.trans: Staff who violate attendance rules have performance points deducted.

meanings.note: Legal verb kòuliú ('detain for questioning').

examples.text: 我作为嫌疑人在警局里被扣留了一夜。
examples.trans: As a suspect, I was held overnight at the station.

examples.text: 违禁物品在安检口会被工作人员扣留。
examples.trans: Prohibited items are held back at security.

meanings.note: Verb-object zhíqín ('stand duty at a post').

examples.text: 辛惠美来的时候也是我负责执勤的。
examples.trans: I was on duty when Xin Huimei visited too.

examples.text: 保安在门口认真执勤。
examples.trans: The guard is on duty at the entrance.

meanings.en: to carry out; to implement; to execute
meanings.note: Used for putting plans, orders, or production schedules into action (also in 执行导演 'executive/line director').

examples.text: 计划一旦确定，团队就必须严格执行。
examples.trans: Once the plan is set, the team must carry it out strictly.

examples.text: 现场的每一个环节都由执行导演负责把控。
examples.trans: Every stage on set is overseen by the line director.

meanings.note: TV production title zhíxíng jiānzhì ('executive producer').

examples.text: 我是这档节目的执行监制。
examples.trans: I am the executive producer of this programme.

examples.text: 执行监制正在后台协调各组人员。
examples.trans: The executive producer is coordinating crews backstage.

meanings.note: Verb kuòchōng ('expand staff or capacity').

examples.text: 总编室太忙，早就应该扩充人手了。
examples.trans: The office is swamped and should have added staff long ago.

examples.text: 今年公司计划扩充两个新制作团队。
examples.trans: The company plans to add two production teams this year.

examples.text: 你回来！现在不行，不要把这些事情扩大。
examples.trans: Come back here! Not right now — don't blow this matter up any further.

examples.text: 你听我说，不能让这件事情再扩大，不要再去翻这些旧账。
examples.trans: Listen to me: we cannot let this blow up further, and stop digging up those old scores.

meanings.note: Verb kuòsàn ('spread widely').

examples.text: 很多粉丝转发，视频影响力已经扩散了。
examples.trans: With fans reposting it, the video's reach has spread.

examples.text: 公关部必须在谣言扩散之前回应。
examples.trans: PR must respond before rumours spread further.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sǎo. Means 'sweep the floor', 'scan a code', or 'sweep one's eyes over' (扫一眼 'take a quick glance').

examples.text: 太好了……趁着等他们，我扫一眼这封房东来信。
examples.trans: Wonderful... while we wait, let me glance at this letter from the landlord.

examples.text: 他每天早上都会扫院子。
examples.trans: He sweeps the courtyard every morning.

examples.text: 干得漂亮！不过这个不要送到会议室，去扫描一下，交给闻思默老师！
examples.trans: Brilliant work! Don't take this into the conference room, though — scan a copy and send it straight to Mr Wen Simo!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: niǔ. Action verb for twisting or spraining a joint (扭了脚踝 'twisted an ankle') or turning a knob.

examples.text: 我的骨头没事，就是下木凳的时候右脚踝外侧扭了一下。
examples.trans: My bones are fine—I just twisted the outside of my right ankle slightly stepping off the wooden stool.

examples.text: 搬重木桌的时候要注意脚下，小心别扭了腰或脚踝。
examples.trans: Watch your step when carrying heavy wooden tables so you don't twist your back or ankle.

examples.text: 我们能不能不要再跟洛琳扯上任何关系？
examples.trans: Can we please stop getting entangled with Luo Lin in any way at all?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bān shou. Measure word (量词): 把 (bǎ), e.g. 一把扳手 ('a wrench').

examples.text: 关掉了，水也放空了。把左边那把重扳手递给我。
examples.trans: Turned off and drained. Pass me that heavy wrench on your left.

examples.text: 这把大铁扳手吗？给你。
examples.trans: This big iron wrench? Here you go.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fú zhù. Resultative verb compound 扶 ('support with the hand') + 住 ('firmly in place').

examples.text: 小美，你够最上面那层架子的时候，让我先扶住那个木凳！
examples.trans: Mei, let me hold that wooden stool steady while you reach for the top shelf!

examples.text: 志豪在下面稳稳扶住木梯子，让老陈安心挂好上面的窗板。
examples.trans: Hao held the wooden ladder steady from below so Chen could hang the upper shutter safely.

meanings.en: batch; lot; group (of people or goods)
meanings.note: Pronounced pī; collective measure word used after numerals or demonstratives (一批实习生, 这批资料).

meanings.en: to approve officially; to criticize or comment on
meanings.note: Used as a transitive verb in administrative and editorial contexts (e.g., 批预算 'approve a budget', 批评 'criticize').

examples.text: 老方，这批学生有没有好的？
examples.trans: Old Fang, are there any good ones in this batch of students?

examples.text: 公司刚进了一批最新的摄像设备。
examples.trans: The company just brought in a batch of the latest camera equipment.

meanings.en: to approve; to ratify; to grant permission
meanings.note: Pronounced pīzhǔn; used when a superior or institution formally authorizes a plan, request, or budget.

examples.text: 淳于总已经批准咱们的方案了。
examples.trans: Director Chun Yu has already approved our proposal.

examples.text: 只要台里批准预算，节目下周就能正式开机。
examples.trans: As soon as the network approves the budget, the show can officially start filming next week.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǎo. Focuses on searching; add 到 (找到) for actually finding.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 我正在打……您好，请问有人找蓝色行李箱吗？
examples.trans: I am calling now... Hello, excuse me, is anyone looking for a blue suitcase?

meanings.note: Colloquial potential complement zhǎobuzháo ('cannot locate').

examples.text: 杏子姐不接电话，其他人我也找不着。
examples.trans: Xingzi is not answering, and I cannot reach anyone else.

examples.text: 桌上的文件太多，一时找不着那份台本。
examples.trans: With so many papers on the desk, I cannot find the script.

examples.text: 我们也会尽快地找出事情的缘由，然后给大家一个说法。
examples.trans: We will get to the bottom of how this happened as quickly as possible and give the public a clear answer.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǎo dào. Resultative compound 找 ('look for') + 到 ('succeed in reaching/finding').

examples.text: 我们在绿色登记本里找到了三十年前那一页！
examples.trans: We found that page from thirty years ago in the green guest book!

examples.text: 你在最下面的抽屉里找到调音扳手了吗？
examples.trans: Did you find the tuning key in the bottom drawer?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǎo huí. Compound 找 ('give change / look for') + 回 ('back'); used for coins/notes returned after paying cash.

examples.text: 我付了五十块现金，老板找回六个硬币。
examples.trans: I paid fifty yuan in cash and the vendor gave back six coins in change.

examples.text: 小晴在坐垫下面找回了丢失的铜钥匙。
examples.trans: Qing recovered the missing brass key from underneath the seat cushion.

meanings.note: Verb chéngshòu ('bear risk or pressure').

examples.text: 艺人不能承受第一轮就被淘汰的风险啊。
examples.trans: Artists cannot bear the risk of early elimination.

examples.text: 总制片人每天都要承受巨大的收视压力。
examples.trans: A chief producer bears immense ratings pressure daily.

meanings.note: Verb chéngdān ('shoulder responsibility').

examples.text: 一切责任都由我们部门承担。
examples.trans: Our department shoulders all responsibility.

examples.text: 大人要学会承担责任。
examples.trans: Adults learn to bear responsibility.

meanings.note: Verb chéngrèn ('admit, acknowledge').

examples.text: 就算他醒过来也不会承认的。
examples.trans: Even when he wakes up, he will not admit it.

examples.text: 他勇敢地承认了自己的错误。
examples.trans: He bravely admitted his mistake.

examples.text: 然后就摸清了规则，技战术练了练。
examples.trans: Then I figured out all the rules and practiced the techniques and tactics.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Noun jìshù rényuán ('in-house technician').

examples.text: 内部的技术人员正在抢修设备。
examples.trans: In-house technicians are repairing the gear.

examples.text: 硬盘修不好，技术人员会按规定销毁。
examples.trans: If a drive cannot be fixed, technicians destroy it per rules.

examples.text: 手柄旋转三百六以上，技术犯规。
examples.trans: Spinning the handle past three hundred sixty degrees is a technical foul.

examples.text: 三次技术犯规，本场比赛取消。
examples.trans: Three technical fouls — this match is officially canceled.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a verb used in conversational Mandarin.

examples.text: 我有一个抄。
examples.trans: I have a 抄.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的抄。
examples.trans: This is a very good 抄.

meanings.en: measure word for handled objects; disposal marker
meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎ. Counts items with handles or backs (一把钥匙, 一把椅子); as a preposition, fronts a definite object before an action verb.

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎ shou. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个把手 ('a door/suitcase handle').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 旁边的把手上系着一张小纸牌。
examples.trans: There is a small paper card tied on the side handle.

meanings.note: Noun/verb bǎwò ('certainty of success; grasp').

examples.text: 你有把握让这份提案顺利过关吗？
examples.trans: Are you confident of getting this pitch approved?

examples.text: 我们要牢牢把握这次改版的机会。
examples.trans: We should firmly seize this revamp opportunity.

examples.text: 老大想拔除这个毒瘤已经很久了，上次是用连环计才抓住了他的把柄。
examples.trans: Our boss wanted to root out that rot for ages and used a double trap last year to catch him red-handed.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Verb zhuā ('catch, arrest, grasp').

examples.text: 合成照片的嫌疑人也已经抓到了。
examples.trans: The suspect behind the doctored photos has been caught.

examples.text: 做节目一定要抓住观众最关心的痛点。
examples.trans: A show must seize the pain points viewers care about.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuā zhù. Resultative compound 抓 ('grab') + 住 ('hold fast').

examples.text: 小晴稳稳抓住了第一扇木窗板的左头。
examples.trans: Qing grabbed firm hold of the left end of the first wooden shutter.

examples.text: 下梯子的时候请双手抓住两边的扶手。
examples.trans: When coming down the ladder, please hold tightly onto both side rails.

examples.text: 我们抓到了切实证据，董事长才开除了他。
examples.trans: Only after we caught rock-solid evidence did the chairwoman fire him.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

抓紧.gloss: make the most of; hurry up; grasp firmly

meanings.en: to make the most of (time or opportunity); to hurry up and attend to closely
meanings.note: Pronounced zhuājǐn; most frequently collocated with 时间 or 机会, or placed directly before another verb to urge prompt action.

meanings.en: to grasp firmly; to hold tight
meanings.note: Literal verb-resultative sense (抓 'grab' + 紧 'tight').

examples.text: 接下来抓紧时间，把最终稿交上来。
examples.trans: Next, make good use of the time and hand in the final draft.

examples.text: 离直播只剩半小时了，大家抓紧准备！
examples.trans: There is only half an hour left before the live broadcast — everyone hurry up and get ready!

meanings.note: Verb/noun tóurù ('put time/energy/funds into').

examples.text: 老大投入的时间和精力就会特别多。
examples.trans: The time and energy our boss pours in becomes huge.

examples.text: 她全身心投入到了新节目的筹备中。
examples.trans: She threw herself wholeheartedly into preparing the show.

meanings.note: Verb/noun tóuzī ('invest; investment').

examples.text: 没有平台愿意冒险去投资本土原创节目。
examples.trans: No platform wants to risk investing in homegrown originals.

examples.text: 多家实力企业争相投资这档S级音乐综艺。
examples.trans: Several major firms vied to invest in this flagship music show.

examples.text: 星天娱乐一直是备受投资界关注的明星企业，公司估值一度突破百亿。
examples.trans: Xingtian Entertainment has long been a star company watched closely by investors, with its valuation once topping ten billion.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Verb/noun kàngyì ('protest').

examples.text: 网上的留言全都是抗议。
examples.trans: Online comments are all protests.

examples.text: 粉丝在网站下面留言抗议。
examples.trans: Fans left comments protesting on the website.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhé. Used for folding chairs, blueprints, or paper.

examples.text: 等等，换房间我们给他打多少折？
examples.trans: Wait—what discount do we offer him for changing rooms?

examples.text: 快把那张纸折起来，塞进口袋里。
examples.trans: Fold up that sheet of paper right now and tuck it into your pocket.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhé dié. Used as a verb ('fold up') or directly before nouns to mean 'folding / collapsible' (折叠桌, 折叠谱架).

examples.text: 这种木头折叠桌不用的时候可以靠墙收好。
examples.trans: This wooden folding table can be folded against the wall when not in use.

examples.text: 请把这张大地图顺着折痕折叠起来。
examples.trans: Please fold this large map up along the creases.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhé dié yǐ. Measure word (量词): 把 (bǎ), e.g. 一把折叠椅 ('a folding chair').

examples.text: 老陈，热水器后面那三把折叠椅找到了吗？
examples.trans: Chen, did you find those three folding chairs behind the water heater?

examples.text: 客人多的时候，我们在院子里加四把木折叠椅。
examples.trans: When guests fill the yard, we set out four extra wooden folding chairs.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhé kòu. Noun for a price discount (有折扣 'there is a discount', 给点折扣 'give a small discount').

examples.text: 一次买两箱柠檬，老板给了很不错的折扣。
examples.trans: When we bought two crates of lemons at once, the seller gave a great discount.

examples.text: 星期六早市的水果新鲜，买多还有折扣。
examples.trans: Fruit at the Saturday morning market is fresh, and buying in bulk gets a discount.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhé hén. Measure word (量词): 道 (dào), e.g. 一道折痕 ('a crease'). Joins 折 ('fold') + 痕 ('mark').

examples.text: 顺着原来的折痕慢慢把画纸展开，别把纸撕破了。
examples.trans: Unfold the drawing paper slowly along its original crease so you do not tear it.

examples.text: 这张旧信纸在信封里折了三十年，折痕依然整整齐齐。
examples.trans: Folded inside the envelope for thirty years, this old note sheet still has crisp, neat creases.

meanings.note: Noun/verb zhémó ('hardship, ordeal').

examples.text: 重点在于用什么表情面对折磨。
examples.trans: What matters is what expression you wear facing trials.

examples.text: 等待结果真是一种折磨。
examples.trans: Waiting for results is quite an ordeal.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhé zhǐ. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张折纸 ('a folded sheet').

examples.text: 看合页边露出来的折纸图纸——一楼画着一扇暗门！
examples.trans: Look at the folded blueprint sticking out of the hinge—a hidden door is drawn on the ground floor!

examples.text: 桌子上放着一只小巧的蓝色折纸小鸟。
examples.trans: A neat little folded-paper blue bird sits on the table.

meanings.note: Colloquial verb zhēteng ('put through endless hassle').

examples.text: 我这些天跟二部折腾了多少回了！
examples.trans: How many times have I gone back and forth with Unit Two!

examples.text: 搬家真是太折腾人了。
examples.trans: Moving house is exhausting.

meanings.note: In 抛出来, means pitching a bold new idea or plan.

examples.text: 他在会上抛出了一个大胆的新方案。
examples.trans: At the meeting he pitched a bold new proposal.

examples.text: 这个问题一抛出来，大家都沉默了。
examples.trans: The moment this question was tossed out, everyone fell silent.

meanings.note: Idiom pāotóu-lùmiàn ('show one's face in public').

examples.text: 不欢迎我这个在台前抛头露面的人啊？
examples.trans: Is an on-camera public figure like me not welcome backstage?

examples.text: 幕后编导习惯了低调工作，很少抛头露面。
examples.trans: Backstage producers work quietly and rarely appear on camera.

examples.text: 别抛弃，别放弃，重出江湖，尚可一战！
examples.trans: Don't give up, don't back down — step back into the arena and fight!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiǎng. Used playfully for 'poaching staff' (抢人) or rushing to grab the bill.

examples.text: 啊！黄色柠檬糖霜——每个星期五我们俩都抢边角那一块！
examples.trans: Oh! Yellow lemon glaze—every single Friday the two of us fought over the corner piece!

examples.text: 别抢人，小美！小晴，你愿意留下来当正式前台主管吗？
examples.trans: No poaching, Mei! Qing, are you willing to stay on as our permanent front-desk manager?

examples.text: 我是不会给你抢戏的。
examples.trans: So I refuse to steal any of your spotlight.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Medical verb qiǎngjiù ('rescue, resuscitate').

examples.text: 我已经跟抢救的医生谈过了。
examples.trans: I have spoken with the emergency doctors.

examples.text: 医院正在全力抢救病人。
examples.trans: The hospital is working all out to save the patient.

抢滩登陆.gloss: seize a beachhead in the market

meanings.en: seize a beachhead in the market

examples.text: 可如果我们不跟他们合作，为了快速抢滩登陆，他们很有可能会跑到我们的竞争对手那边去。
examples.trans: Yet if we turn them down, in their rush to gain a foothold they may run straight into the arms of our competitors.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

报.gloss: sign up for, enrol in, report

meanings.en: sign up for, enrol in, report
meanings.note: With 培训/班/课, means registering for a course.

examples.text: 她给自己报了一个周末英语班。
examples.trans: She signed herself up for a weekend English class.

examples.text: 同事帮他报了一个短期培训。
examples.trans: A colleague enrolled him in a short training course.

examples.text: 报告情况。
examples.trans: Report the situation.

examples.text: 写报告。
examples.trans: Write a report.

meanings.note: Verb bàofèi ('write off as ruined/useless').

examples.text: 这种负面曝光再刷就彻底报废了。
examples.trans: Any more scandal publicity like that and her career is ruined.

examples.text: 那台进水的旧摄像机已经报废了。
examples.trans: That water-damaged old camera has been written off.

meanings.note: Verb-object bào'àn ('file a police report').

examples.text: 律师已经向警方撤回报案了。
examples.trans: The lawyer already withdrew the police report.

examples.text: 丢了钱包要马上报案。
examples.trans: Report a lost wallet to the police right away.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bào zhǐ. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng) for single sheets of newsprint, 份 (fèn) for a full issue.

examples.text: 摊主用干净的旧报纸把十二个白杯子包好。
examples.trans: The stallholder wrapped the twelve white cups securely in clean old newsprint.

examples.text: 爷爷每天早上喝茶的时候都要看一份报纸。
examples.trans: Grandpa reads a newspaper every morning while drinking his tea.

报警.gloss: call the police, report to the police

meanings.en: call the police, report to the police
meanings.note: Alerting law enforcement to an incident.

examples.text: 发现重要机密文件丢失后，公司立刻选择了报警。
examples.trans: Upon finding key files missing, the company called the police.

examples.text: 遇到紧急危险情况一定要第一时间报警。
examples.trans: In an emergency, call the police right away.

meanings.note: Noun/verb bàodào ('report, feature story').

examples.text: 你想写星天的深度报道没问题。
examples.trans: Writing an in-depth feature on Xingtian is no problem.

examples.text: 各大媒体纷纷报道了这次签约发布会。
examples.trans: Major outlets covered the signing press conference.

meanings.note: Workplace verb bàoxiāo ('submit expenses for reimbursement').

examples.text: 拿着这张医药单找你姐报销去吧！
examples.trans: Take this medical slip and ask your sister to reimburse it!

examples.text: 出差的车票可以回财务部按规定报销。
examples.trans: Business travel tickets can be reimbursed by Finance.

meanings.note: Verb pī ('drape a coat or blanket over shoulders').

examples.text: 要是觉得冷，那儿有个毯子你可以先披着。
examples.trans: If you feel chilly, grab that blanket over there and drape it on.

examples.text: 看她在风里发抖，他默默脱下西装披在她肩上。
examples.trans: Seeing her shiver in the wind, he draped his suit jacket on her.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tái. Means raising upward or two people lifting an object together.

examples.text: 我们俩一起把这扇长窗板抬进走廊吧。
examples.trans: Let's lift this tall shutter together and carry it into the hallway.

examples.text: 按下琴键时，里面的小琴槌就会稳稳抬起来。
examples.trans: When you press the piano key, the small hammer inside rises smoothly.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tái tóu. Separable verb-object compound; opposite of 低头.

examples.text: 高个子，深灰色外套，正抬头看我们客栈招牌呢！
examples.trans: Tall, dark grey coat, looking up at our inn sign right now!

examples.text: 抬头看夜空下那些金色灯笼——真宁静啊！
examples.trans: Look up at those golden lanterns against the night sky—how peaceful!

meanings.note: Pinyin: bào. Used for carrying a box, cushion, or child in both arms.

examples.text: 老陈，抱起那些纸箱，我们下楼吧！
examples.trans: Chen, pick up those cardboard boxes—down the stairs we go!

examples.text: 那抱着木头小火车的弟弟呢？
examples.trans: And what about the younger brother holding the wooden train?

meanings.note: Polite word for expressing regret or apology.

examples.text: 让你久等了，我感到非常抱歉。
examples.trans: I am very sorry to have kept you waiting so long.

examples.text: 请帮我向大家说一声抱歉。
examples.trans: Please say sorry to everyone on my behalf.

抵制.gloss: boycott, resist, refuse to take part in

meanings.en: boycott, resist, refuse to take part in
meanings.note: Organized or collective refusal.

examples.text: 几家经纪公司联合抵制这次改版。
examples.trans: Several talent agencies jointly boycotted this revamp.

examples.text: 大家应该自觉抵制不良风气。
examples.trans: Everyone should consciously resist unhealthy practices.

meanings.note: Verb/noun dǐchù ('push back against changes').

examples.text: 公司里一些元老一直比较抵触改革。
examples.trans: Some veterans at the company have resisted reform.

examples.text: 充分沟通能减少员工对新制度的抵触。
examples.trans: Clear communication reduces resistance to new rules.

meanings.note: Verb mǒ ('spread cream or hair oil').

examples.text: 你看他头发上的发油简直越抹越多。
examples.trans: Look at him slicking more and more oil onto his hair.

examples.text: 上镜之前化妆师先帮他抹了一点遮瑕。
examples.trans: Before cameras rolled, makeup dabbed on concealer.

押宝.gloss: place one's bet, back a side

meanings.en: place one's bet, back a side
meanings.note: Colloquial verb-object yābǎo ('bet on a winner').

examples.text: 我已经想好这次要在哪一边押宝了。
examples.trans: I have already decided which camp to place my bet on.

examples.text: 做投资不能把全部资金押宝在一个项目上。
examples.trans: Never bet every resource on a single project.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yā yùn. Separable verb-object compound; 押韵的线索 ('rhyming clue').

examples.text: 每张卡片下面都配着一句简短押韵的散步线索。
examples.trans: Underneath each card is paired a short rhyming walking clue.

examples.text: 这两句小诗读起来朗朗上口，最后一个字正好押韵。
examples.trans: These two short lines read smoothly aloud, with the final characters rhyming neatly.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chōu. Describes sliding a thin sheet, drawer, or card smoothly out of a tight space (抽出来).

examples.text: 他从书架中间轻轻抽出一本旧相册。
examples.trans: He gently slid an old photo album out from the middle of the bookshelf.

examples.text: 小心一点把信纸从信封里抽出来。
examples.trans: Slide the letter paper carefully out of the envelope.

meanings.note: Potential complement chōubuchū ('cannot free up time').

examples.text: 工作太满，我自己现在也抽不出空来。
examples.trans: With a packed schedule, I cannot spare time myself.

examples.text: 直播前夕全组连吃晚饭的时间都抽不出。
examples.trans: Right before air time, nobody can spare time for dinner.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chōu ti. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个抽屉 ('a drawer').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 备用钥匙放在前台右边的抽屉里。
examples.trans: The spare keys are kept in the right-hand drawer at reception.

meanings.note: Verb-object chōukòng ('carve out time').

examples.text: 您需要我抽空回一趟传媒学院吗？
examples.trans: Do you need me to find time to visit Media College?

examples.text: 周末我抽空去看望方老师。
examples.trans: I will find time this weekend to visit Professor Fang.

担任.gloss: serve as, hold the post of

meanings.en: serve as, hold the post of
meanings.note: Formal verb dānrèn ('serve in a role').

examples.text: 这次由淳于总来担任总监制。
examples.trans: Chun Yuqiao will serve as chief producer.

examples.text: 她担任我们班的班长。
examples.trans: She serves as our class monitor.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dān xīn. Common in 别担心 ('don't worry').

examples.text: 别担心！用冰气泡水一擦，橙汁就掉。
examples.trans: Do not worry! Wipe it once with cold sparkling water and orange juice comes right out.

examples.text: 请别担心！我们特意为您准备好了安静的三楼阁楼书房。
examples.trans: Please do not worry! We specially prepared our quiet third-floor attic study for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chāi. Used for tearing open envelopes, unwrapping packages, or dismantling old structures.

examples.text: 十二点以后再拆吧，老板！看钟：差五分十二点！
examples.trans: Open it after twelve, boss! Look at the clock: five minutes to twelve!

examples.text: 拆开白纸……不会吧！爷爷亲手雕的木头火车头！
examples.trans: Unwrap the white paper... no way! Grandfather's hand-carved wooden locomotive!

meanings.note: Pinyin: chāi xìn dāo. Measure word (量词): 把 (bǎ), e.g. 一把拆信刀 ('a paper knife'). Transparent compound: 'open-letter-knife'.

examples.text: 在谁碰拆信刀以前，先念念信封正面写的说明！
examples.trans: Before anyone touches a paper knife, read the instruction written across the front of the envelope first!

examples.text: 周经理前台的笔筒里插着一把小巧的黄铜拆信刀。
examples.trans: Tucked in the pen holder at Manager Zhou's front desk is a neat little brass letter opener.

meanings.note: Verb-complement chāikāi ('tear open a parcel or letter').

examples.text: 快递这么重，我来帮你拆开吧。
examples.trans: This parcel is heavy; let me open it for you.

examples.text: 她迫不及待地拆开了生日礼物。
examples.trans: She eagerly unwrapped her birthday present.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lā. Opposite of 推 ('push'); used for pulling doors, shutters, or suitcase handles.

examples.text: 电线本来就该拉直了。正常保养，别多想。
examples.trans: The wire needed straightening anyway. Routine maintenance—don't read into it.

examples.text: 让我把眼镜从额头上拉下来……九号房？！
examples.trans: Let me pull my glasses down from my forehead... Room Nine?!

拉不开.gloss: unable to widen or pull apart

meanings.en: unable to widen or pull apart
meanings.note: Potential complement lābukāi ('cannot create separation').

examples.text: 规则不改，我们就跟对手拉不开距离。
examples.trans: Without rule changes, we cannot pull ahead of rivals.

examples.text: 上半场比赛双方比分一直拉不开。
examples.trans: Neither side could open a lead in the first half.

examples.text: 挣钱越多麻烦越大，不想挣拉倒！
examples.trans: The more money you earn, the bigger the headaches — if you don't want the raise, forget it!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Verb-complement lākāi ('draw open; widen distance').

examples.text: 拉开跟对手的距离是老大一直在想的事。
examples.trans: Widening our lead over rivals is always on his mind.

examples.text: 红色大幕缓缓拉开，晚会正式开始。
examples.trans: As the red curtain drew open, the gala began.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lā liàn. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条拉链 ('a zipper').

examples.text: 看拉链旁边……对，有她的名字缩写！
examples.trans: Check beside the zipper... yes, her name initials are here!

examples.text: 蓝色行李箱侧面的拉链有点紧。
examples.trans: The side zipper on the blue suitcase is a little stiff.

meanings.note: Internet verb-object lāhēi ('block someone on chat/social media').

examples.text: 你上午退出群聊时，不是把我拉黑了吗？
examples.trans: Did you not block me when you quit the group chat this morning?

examples.text: 遇到恶意骚扰电话，直接拉黑是最省心的办法。
examples.trans: Blocking spam callers outright is the simplest way to handle them.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a verb used in conversational Mandarin.

examples.text: 我有一个拌。
examples.trans: I have a 拌.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的拌。
examples.trans: This is a very good 拌.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pāi. Used for clapping (拍手), patting someone, and taking photos (拍照).

examples.text: 您拍一下手——听，街上的声音多安静！
examples.trans: Clap your hands once—listen, how quiet the street sounds!

examples.text: 大家拍拍手，欢迎新同事！
examples.trans: Everyone, give a clap to welcome our new colleague!

meanings.note: Verb/noun pāishè ('shoot footage').

examples.text: 拍摄素材外流是行业大忌。
examples.trans: Leaking filmed footage is a grave taboo.

examples.text: 外景拍摄今天下午顺利结束。
examples.trans: Location filming wrapped up smoothly this afternoon.

meanings.note: Production noun pāishèzǔ ('camera unit').

examples.text: 星天已经派出五个外景拍摄组跟拍嘉宾。
examples.trans: Xingtian has dispatched five field camera units to follow the guests.

examples.text: 户外拍摄组冒着大雨保护摄像机镜头不被淋湿。
examples.trans: The outdoor camera unit shielded their lenses through pouring rain.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guǎi. Everyday direction verb (往左拐 'turn left').

examples.text: 上楼梯，平台往左拐，最上面最后一扇门。
examples.trans: Up the stairs, turn left at the landing, last door at the very top.

examples.text: 出大门往左拐，一直走到石桥。
examples.trans: Go out the front gate, turn left, and walk straight to the stone bridge.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guǎi wān. Separable verb-object compound for street directions.

examples.text: 拐弯小心点，别碰到墙！
examples.trans: Careful on the turn—do not bump the wall!

examples.text: 走到前面那棵大树再往左拐弯。
examples.trans: Walk up to that big tree ahead and turn left.

meanings.note: Verb jù ('refuse, decline').

examples.text: 粉红哥已经把对手那边给拒了！
examples.trans: Brother Fenhong already turned down the rival network!

examples.text: 面对不合理的要求要学会婉拒。
examples.trans: Learn to decline unreasonable requests politely.

meanings.note: Formal/emphatic four-character phrase.

examples.text: 对方态度强硬，一直拒不配合。
examples.trans: The other side took a hard line and flatly refused to cooperate.

examples.text: 如果合作方拒不配合，工作就很难推进。
examples.trans: If partners refuse to cooperate, the work is hard to advance.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jù jué. Used for declining an offer or request.

examples.text: 早上七点有热乎乎的肉桂面包，谁会拒绝呢。
examples.trans: At seven in the morning, who could say no to piping-hot cinnamon bread.

examples.text: 这么真诚的邀请，谁也舍不得拒绝。
examples.trans: No one could bear to turn down such a warm invitation.

meanings.note: Verb bá ('pull/draw out').

examples.text: 他会从医院里立刻拔了管就赶过来！
examples.trans: He would yank out his IV drip and rush straight here from hospital!

examples.text: 设备还没关机前千万不要随便拔电源线。
examples.trans: Never yank the power cord before shutting down the gear.

meanings.note: Resultative compound bádiào ('pull clean out').

examples.text: 眼线我都拔掉了。
examples.trans: I have pulled out every informant.

examples.text: 把插头拔掉吧。
examples.trans: Unplug the cord.

拔腿就跑.gloss: take to one's heels; bolt right off

meanings.en: take to one's heels; bolt right off
meanings.note: Pinyin: bá tuǐ jiù pǎo. Vivid four-character phrase 拔腿 ('pull up one's legs') + 就跑 ('and run right off').

examples.text: 周经理一听说罐子没贴标签，抓起围裙拔腿就跑去拿新纸条了！
examples.trans: The moment Manager Zhou heard the jars had no labels, he grabbed his apron and bolted off to get fresh paper slips!

examples.text: 小猫听见院子门口的铃声，吓得拔腿就跑进了花丛里。
examples.trans: Hearing the bell at the courtyard gate, the kitten bolted into the flower bushes.

examples.text: 老大想拔除这个毒瘤已经很久了，上次是用连环计才抓住了他的把柄。
examples.trans: Our boss wanted to root out that rot for ages and used a double trap last year to catch him red-handed.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 已有行业分析师论断，此事必将造成星天娱乐股权整合及上市进程大幅拖慢。
examples.trans: Industry analysts warn the lawsuit will severely delay Xingtian's share restructuring and public listing.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 原来这家振振有词控诉别人侵权的白石音乐公司，多年拖欠词曲作者钟阳子的版权收益！
examples.trans: It turns out Baishi Music, so self-righteous in suing others, has withheld royalties from songwriter Zhong Yangzi for years!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

拘泥.gloss: be rigidly confined to, cling stiffly to

meanings.en: be rigidly confined to, cling stiffly to
meanings.note: Verb/adjective jūnì ('rigidly bound, cramped').

examples.text: 我们要勇敢放弃演播厅这个拘泥的空间。
examples.trans: We must boldly let go of the cramped confines of the studio.

examples.text: 做真人秀切忌拘泥于死板台本，真实反应最动人。
examples.trans: Reality TV should never cling stiffly to scripts; candour moves people.

meanings.en: to recruit; to hire; to enroll (staff or students)
meanings.note: Pronounced zhāo; brisk everyday equivalent of 招聘 (for employees) or 招收 (for students/interns), e.g., 招人, 招实习生.
Used as a noun/measure word meaning a strategic move or ploy (e.g., 这一招很管用).

examples.text: 星天要招实习生？新鲜啊！
examples.trans: Xingtian wants to recruit an intern? Now that is something new!

examples.text: 你以前说总编室永远不招实习生。
examples.trans: You used to say the chief editor's office never takes interns.

meanings.note: Noun zhāohu ('greeting, advance notice').

examples.text: 这是我们公司的一哥，快过来打个招呼。
examples.trans: Here is our agency's leading man—come say hello.

examples.text: 进门见到前辈主动打声招呼是基本礼貌。
examples.trans: Greeting senior colleagues at the door is basic courtesy.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhāo dài. Combines 招 ('beckon/welcome') + 待 ('treat/attend to'), used for hosting guests with food, tea, and warmth.

examples.text: 你们真的觉得，简简单单地用热茶和面包招待客人就够了吗？
examples.trans: Do you really think simply welcoming our guests with hot tea and bread is enough?

examples.text: 每当老街坊走进小院，周经理总是笑眯眯地拿新泡的热茶招待大家。
examples.trans: Whenever old neighbours step into the courtyard, Manager Zhou always welcomes them warmly with freshly brewed tea.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhāo shǒu. Separable verb-object compound (朝我招手 'wave toward me').

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

examples.text: 她在咖啡馆门口笑着向我们招手。
examples.trans: Smiling at the café entrance, she waved to us.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhāo pái. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块招牌 ('a shop signboard').

examples.text: 店门外面有大招牌吗？
examples.trans: Is there a big shop sign outside the door?

examples.text: 正往前走……啊，看见金钥匙招牌和蓝木门了！
examples.trans: Walking forward now... oh, I see the golden key sign and the blue wooden door!

examples.text: 不要太着急了，招聘竞争都很激烈。
examples.trans: Do not get too anxious; the hiring competition is very fierce.

examples.text: 这是招聘。
examples.trans: This is 招聘.

meanings.note: Ironic four-character phrase bài nǐ suǒ cì ('courtesy of your doing').

examples.text: 老大病成这样，那还不是拜你所赐！
examples.trans: Our boss being this ill is all thanks to you!

examples.text: 今天全组重拍，全都是拜他的粗心所赐。
examples.trans: Today's reshoot is entirely thanks to his carelessness.

meanings.note: Polite verb bàituō ('entrust a request to someone').

examples.text: 今天邀您见面，有一件事想拜托您。
examples.trans: I invited you today because I have a favour to ask.

examples.text: 主任放下身段来拜托我们帮忙。
examples.trans: The director swallowed his pride to ask our help.

examples.text: 拜拜。
examples.trans: Bye now.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 拟定计划。
examples.trans: Draft a plan.

examples.text: 草稿拟好了。
examples.trans: The draft is ready.

meanings.note: Adjective/verb yōngdǔ ('heavily congested').

examples.text: 直播车正在直击暴雨拥堵的城市道路现场。
examples.trans: Broadcast vans are reporting live from rain-gridlocked city roads.

examples.text: 晚高峰遇上积水，整条主干道交通严重拥堵。
examples.trans: Evening rush hour plus standing water left the avenue gridlocked.

meanings.note: Holding resources, audiences, or blessings.

examples.text: 这档音乐节目拥有非常忠实的年轻观众。
examples.trans: This music show has a deeply loyal young audience.

examples.text: 珍惜自己现在所拥有的一切才最重要。
examples.trans: Cherishing everything you already have matters most.

meanings.note: Verb lán ('intercept, stop someone').

examples.text: 他是淳于乔，你去拦一个试试！
examples.trans: He is Chun Yuqiao — try stopping him yourself!

examples.text: 要是我在现场，我当然能去拦他。
examples.trans: Had I been there, of course I would have stepped in.

meanings.note: Verb-complement lánzhù ('hold someone back').

examples.text: 昨晚你把他拦住不让他喝酒不就行了吗？
examples.trans: Could you not have held him back from drinking last night?

examples.text: 保安在门口及时拦住了没有证件的人。
examples.trans: Security stopped unbadged visitors at the entrance.

拦得住.gloss: able to stop or hold back

meanings.en: able to stop or hold back
meanings.note: Potential complement lándezhù ('can stop someone').

examples.text: 他一旦做了决定，公司里谁能拦得住？
examples.trans: Once he makes up his mind, who here can stop him?

examples.text: 我去劝的话，我当然拦得住他！
examples.trans: If I step in, of course I can hold him back!

meanings.note: Verb-object lánchē ('flag down a taxi').

examples.text: 你先把药吃了，我去路边拦车送你去医院！
examples.trans: Take your medicine while I hail a cab by the road!

examples.text: 深夜演播厅外很难在路边直接拦车。
examples.trans: Late at night outside the studio, hailing cabs is tough.

meanings.note: Pinyin: níng. Used for twisting a tap, valve, wrench, or bottle cap (拧开 'twist open', 拧紧 'tighten').

examples.text: 当心那把角落椅子，等十秒我拧紧螺丝。
examples.trans: Mind that corner chair—wait ten seconds while I tighten the screw.

examples.text: 把蓝色转轮慢慢往左拧开——别太快。
examples.trans: Turn the blue wheel open slowly to the left—not too fast.

meanings.note: Idiom shìmù-yǐdài ('watch closely in anticipation').

examples.text: 谁会走上红毯？接下来我们拭目以待。
examples.trans: Who will walk the red carpet? Let us wait and see.

examples.text: 决赛结果如何，大家拭目以待。
examples.trans: Everyone waits eagerly to see how the finale turns out.

拯救.gloss: rescue, save from decline or danger

meanings.en: rescue, save from decline or danger
meanings.note: Dramatic verb for saving lives, ratings, or industries.

examples.text: 网友称赞这档未播先火的节目拯救了电视开机率。
examples.trans: Netizens praised the buzzworthy show for rescuing TV turn-on rates.

examples.text: 及时的公益危机公关成功拯救了受损的品牌形象。
examples.trans: Timely charity PR rescued the damaged brand image.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gǒng chuāng. Combines 拱 ('arch') + 窗 ('window').

examples.text: 九号房高高的拱窗擦干净以后透进满屋阳光。
examples.trans: Once Room Nine's tall arched windows were wiped clean, sunlight flooded the room.

examples.text: 站在木梯子上正好能够到拱窗的最顶端。
examples.trans: Standing on the wooden ladder lets you reach right to the top of the arched window.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gǒng mén. Compound 拱 ('arch') + 门 ('door/gate'). Measure word: 道 (dào) or 扇 (shàn).

examples.text: 志豪在速写本上画下了院子的石头拱门。
examples.trans: Hao sketched the courtyard's stone archway in his sketchbook.

examples.text: 穿过这道砖拱门，就能看见后面的小花园。
examples.trans: Walk through this brick archway and you can see the little garden behind.

examples.text: 我也不打算长期去拷贝国外的节目。
examples.trans: Nor do I intend to spend the long term copying foreign television shows.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Colloquial predicate pīn ('pushing oneself to the limit').

examples.text: 你太拼了！
examples.trans: You are pushing yourself way too hard!

examples.text: 为了节目大家都很拼。
examples.trans: Everyone goes all-out for the show.

meanings.note: Potential complement pīnbuguò ('cannot beat in head-to-head rivalry').

examples.text: 光拼媒体数量，咱们确实拼不过对手。
examples.trans: In sheer media count, we cannot outmatch our rival.

examples.text: 拼预算拼不过大台，我们就拼创意。
examples.trans: When outspent by giant networks, we win on ideas.

meanings.note: Verb/adverb pīnmìng ('go all out, spare no effort').

examples.text: 因为选题很好，所以我才拼命地争取。
examples.trans: Because the topic is strong, I fought all out for it.

examples.text: 有人拼命地想保护你，感觉挺好的。
examples.trans: Having someone try so hard to protect you feels nice.

examples.text: 对手那边拼着命地跟我们抢人。
examples.trans: The rival network is fighting tooth and nail with us to snap up talent.

examples.text: 对手那边拼着命地跟我们抢人。
examples.trans: The rival network is fighting tooth and nail with us to snap up talent.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ná. Core verb for holding or fetching objects in the hand.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

examples.text: 火车站有人拿错了我的蓝色行李箱！
examples.trans: Someone at the train station took my blue suitcase by mistake!

related.gloss: handle with care (lift gently, set down gently)

examples.text: 什么情况啊？你会唱歌？那好好唱，拿个话筒过去！
examples.trans: What's going on here? Oh, you're singing? Sing properly then — somebody hand her a microphone!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 义务？跟我谈恋爱，用不着拿出尽义务的心态。
examples.trans: Duty? Dating me doesn't call for the mindset of fulfilling an obligation!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 更让人想不到的是，星天娱乐竟然拿到了钟阳子的亲笔授权书，并将代表她反诉白石音乐公司！
examples.trans: Even more astonishing, Xingtian Entertainment has obtained Zhong Yangzi's handwritten authorization and will countersue Baishi on her behalf!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ná shǒu. Literally 拿 ('hold firmly') + 手 ('in hand'): describes a skill or dish one commands with effortless mastery (最拿手的事 'what one is best at').

examples.text: 热情好客正是这栋老房子八十多年来最拿手的事呀！
examples.trans: Warm hospitality is the very thing this old house has been best at for over eighty years!

examples.text: 酥脆酸甜的杏仁柠檬挞是小美主厨最拿手的招牌甜点。
examples.trans: Crisp, tangy-sweet almond lemon tart is Head Chef Mei's signature specialty dessert.

examples.text: 退房的时候请别忘了把充电器一起拿走。
examples.trans: When checking out, please do not forget to take your charger with you.

examples.text: 桌上的免费手绘地图，欢迎住客随时拿走参考。
examples.trans: Guests are welcome to take the free hand-drawn maps on the table at any time.

examples.text: 我已经做了打持久战的准备，十二歌王开播全靠你们自己了。
examples.trans: I am prepared for drawn-out talks abroad, so launching Twelve Singers rests entirely on your shoulders.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guà. Used for hanging keys, coats, lanterns, or hanging up a phone.

examples.text: 这面圆镜子挂哪儿？窗户左边还是右边？
examples.trans: Where should I hang this round mirror? Left of the window or right?

examples.text: 挂在书桌右边吧，那里光线好。
examples.trans: Hang it to the right of the desk, where the light is good.

挂不住.gloss: fail to stick; unable to hold onto a surface

meanings.en: fail to stick; unable to hold onto a surface
meanings.note: Pinyin: guà bú zhù. Negative potential complement 挂 ('hang/cling/coat') + 不住 ('cannot hold fast'); bù shifts to bú before zhù.

examples.text: 木头要是淋湿了，刷上去的油漆根本挂不住。
examples.trans: If the wood gets wet from rain, brushed-on paint will never stick.

examples.text: 墙面灰尘太多的话，胶带是挂不住的。
examples.trans: If there is too much dust on the wall, tape won't stick.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guà hào xìn. Measure word (量词): 封 (fēng), e.g. 一封挂号信 ('a registered letter').

examples.text: 比水管严重……中午房东寄来了一封挂号信。
examples.trans: Worse than a pipe... at noon a registered letter arrived from the landlord.

examples.text: 邮递员请前台签收一封市政厅寄来的挂号信。
examples.trans: The mail carrier asked reception to sign for a registered letter from City Hall.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guà duàn. Result compound meaning a phone line disconnected.

examples.text: 来不及了！他说了声谢谢就挂断了！
examples.trans: Too late! He said thank you and hung up!

examples.text: 信号不好，刚才的电话突然挂断了。
examples.trans: The reception was poor, and the call just dropped.

meanings.note: Colloquial medical verb-object guàshuǐ ('receive intravenous fluids').

examples.text: 昨晚他在急诊室洗胃、挂水折腾了一夜。
examples.trans: He spent all night in the ER getting his stomach pumped and on IV drips.

examples.text: 发高烧不退的时候需要去医院挂水。
examples.trans: A persistent high fever may require an IV drip.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guà zhōng. Combines 挂 ('hang on a wall') + 钟 ('clock').

examples.text: 前台后面的老挂钟每到整点就会轻轻敲响。
examples.trans: The old wall clock behind the front desk chimes softly every hour on the hour.

examples.text: 老陈修好了大堂里那座停了很久的挂钟。
examples.trans: Chen repaired the wall clock in the lobby that had been stopped for a long time.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guà gōu. Combines 挂 ('hang') + 钩 ('hook'); measure word: 个 (gè) or 只 (zhī).

examples.text: 这块木板在我手里十五年，一直只有一到八号挂钩。
examples.trans: For fifteen years in my hands, this wooden board only ever had hooks one through eight.

examples.text: 老陈把擦亮的九号黄铜挂钩稳稳拧在木板右边。
examples.trans: Chen screwed the polished brass number-nine hook firmly onto the right side of the wooden board.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ. Used for pointing toward a sign, map, or clue (指着).

examples.text: 谁也没走开！志豪正指着那两把椅子呢！
examples.trans: Neither of them walked away! Hao is pointing at those two chairs right now!

examples.text: 周经理，快看志豪先生用铅笔指的地方！
examples.trans: Manager Zhou, look where Mr Zhihao is pointing with his pencil!

meanings.note: Noun zhǐlìng ('logged instruction or command').

examples.text: 请直接通过办公系统下个指令。
examples.trans: Please log an instruction directly in the office system.

examples.text: 我今天没给行政下过任何指令。
examples.trans: I did not issue any instructions to admin today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ nán. Measure word (量词): 本 (běn), e.g. 一本指南 ('a guidebook').

examples.text: 除非他是写成都旅游指南的神秘评审员！
examples.trans: Unless he is a secret inspector writing the Chengdu Travel Guide!

examples.text: 冰凉的洗澡水？！成都旅游指南评审员就住在三楼啊！
examples.trans: Ice-cold shower water?! The Chengdu Travel Guide inspector is staying on floor three!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ nán zhēn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个指南针 ('a compass'). Literally 'south-pointing needle'.

examples.text: 小晴手里拿着黄铜指南针，顺着梧桐巷往东走。
examples.trans: Holding the brass compass in hand, Qing walks east along Wutong Lane.

examples.text: 这个实心黄铜指南针埋在地下三十年，依然非常准。
examples.trans: Buried underground for thirty years, this solid brass compass is still remarkably accurate.

meanings.note: Verb/noun zhǐdǎo ('coach, guide').

examples.text: 这份方案是在您的指导下完成的。
examples.trans: This proposal was completed under your guidance.

examples.text: 前辈耐心地指导新来的实习生。
examples.trans: Senior staff patiently guided the new interns.

meanings.note: Verb/noun zhǐhuī ('command, direct').

examples.text: 今晚您还是待在中控室里进行指挥吧。
examples.trans: Tonight you should stay in the control room to direct.

examples.text: 导演在现场指挥摄像。
examples.trans: The director commands the cameras on set.

meanings.note: Coordinating platform used during major live productions.

examples.text: 全组成员早上九点准时登入直播指挥系统。
examples.trans: At nine sharp the whole crew logged into the live command system.

examples.text: 通过指挥系统可以随时调配现场各个机位。
examples.trans: Every camera position can be coordinated via the command system.

meanings.note: Polite verb zhǐjiào ('please advise us').

examples.text: 听说两位老师有好建议，请多指教。
examples.trans: Hearing you have good suggestions, please advise us.

examples.text: 这是我第一次写台本，还请前辈多指教。
examples.trans: This is my first script; pointers are welcome.

examples.text: 我都搞不定，还指望她能攻破啊？
examples.trans: If even I can't crack them, do you really expect her to break through?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 你是专业的，请指点。
examples.trans: You're the specialist in advertising — lead the way.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Verb zhǐzé ('censure, blame').

examples.text: 文章异口同声指责星天服务不佳。
examples.trans: The article blamed Xingtian for poor studio service.

examples.text: 出了问题先找原因，不要互相指责。
examples.trans: When trouble hits, look for causes instead of blaming.

指针.gloss: needle (of a compass); hand (of a clock)

meanings.en: needle (of a compass); hand (of a clock)
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ zhēn. Measure word (量词): 根 (gēn), e.g. 一根指针 ('a pointer needle / clock hand').

examples.text: 把指南针平放在木桌上，蓝钢小指针马上稳稳指向北边。
examples.trans: Set the compass flat on the wooden table, and the blued-steel needle points steadily north at once.

examples.text: 大家都抬头盯着市政钟楼上高高的两根大指针。
examples.trans: Everyone looked up at the two tall clock hands high on the municipal clock tower.

meanings.note: Pinyin: àn. Used for pressing a doorbell, elevator button, or key (按门铃).

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 宋老师，怎么了？您按了门铃！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, what happened? You rang the bell!

meanings.note: Therapeutic rubbing to ease muscle tension and fatigue.

examples.text: 演出结束后做个肩颈按摩能缓解疲劳。
examples.trans: A neck and shoulder massage after a show eases fatigue.

examples.text: 医生建议配合轻柔的按摩来帮助入睡。
examples.trans: The doctor suggested gentle massage to help with sleep.

meanings.note: Trained professional giving massages.

examples.text: 助理已经提前请专业的按摩师在休息室等候了。
examples.trans: The assistant arranged for a massage therapist to wait backstage.

examples.text: 按摩师仔细核对了不会引起过敏的精油。
examples.trans: The massage therapist carefully checked the hypoallergenic oils.

meanings.note: Adverb ànshí ('punctually, on schedule').

examples.text: 我宣布今晚的总决赛直播将会按时开始。
examples.trans: I declare that tonight's grand-finale broadcast will begin on time.

examples.text: 不管工作多忙，医生叮嘱他必须按时吃胃药。
examples.trans: Busy or not, the doctor ordered him to take stomach pills on time.

examples.text: 按照计划进行。
examples.trans: Proceed according to plan.

examples.text: 按照他说的话做。
examples.trans: Do as he says.

examples.text: 这是原创策划，按规定是不能给别人看的。
examples.trans: This folder is a confidential original show proposal; company rules say outsiders aren't allowed a peek.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Noun ànniǔ ('button, switch').

examples.text: 一楼的电梯按钮都已经修过了。
examples.trans: The lift buttons on the first floor have been repaired.

examples.text: 按下红色按钮就能启动录音设备。
examples.trans: Press the red button to start the recording gear.

meanings.note: Verb tiāo ('choose carefully').

examples.text: 要不然从成熟的制片里挑两个留下来？
examples.trans: Why not pick two seasoned producers to stay on?

examples.text: 主编从十份提案里挑出了最好的一份。
examples.trans: The chief editor picked the best out of ten pitches.

meanings.note: Noun/verb tiǎozhàn ('challenge').

examples.text: 刚步入职场，每天都面临着未知的挑战。
examples.trans: Fresh in the workplace, we face unknown challenges every day.

examples.text: 跨国实景拍摄对整个制作团队是一次全新的挑战。
examples.trans: Shooting on location abroad is a fresh challenge for the crew.

meanings.note: Verb wā ('dig; unearth a story or poach talent').

examples.text: 如果您非要挖这件事，那就继续挖下去。
examples.trans: If you insist on digging into this, keep digging.

examples.text: 娱乐记者最擅长挖幕后的独家故事。
examples.trans: Tabloid reporters love digging up backstage scoops.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tà dǐ. Combines 挞 ('tart') + 底 ('base/crust').

examples.text: 用烤香的杏仁粉做的挞底既酥脆又香甜。
examples.trans: A tart crust made with toasted almond flour is crisp and fragrant.

examples.text: 把挞底烤成金黄色以后，再填入柠檬酱。
examples.trans: Bake the tart shell until golden, then fill it with lemon curd.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tà pí. Combines 挞 ('tart') + 皮 ('crust/shell/skin'); synonymous with 挞底; measure word: 个 (gè).

examples.text: 趁小美在厨房烤杏仁挞皮，宋老师去阳光房练了一遍钢琴。
examples.trans: While Mei was baking almond tart shells in the kitchen, Teacher Song went to the sunroom to practise the piano.

examples.text: 烤好的挞皮放凉以后，再填入温热浓稠的柠檬凝乳。
examples.trans: Once the baked tart shells have cooled, fill them with warm, thick lemon curd.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dǎng. Used for blocking wind, rain, or a doorway (挡住).

examples.text: 主要设计小图书馆和院子，测量老石墙怎么挡住街上噪音。
examples.trans: Mostly small libraries and courtyards, measuring how old stone walls block street noise.

examples.text: 大树挡住了下午的阳光。
examples.trans: The big tree shaded the afternoon sun.

挡枪.gloss: take a bullet for, act as a shield

meanings.en: take a bullet for, act as a shield
meanings.note: Colloquial verb-object dǎngqiāng ('serve as a shield against attacks').

examples.text: 他绝对不会拿节目资源为自己挡枪。
examples.trans: He would never use show resources as a shield for himself.

examples.text: 真正负责的主管不会让下属替自己挡枪。
examples.trans: A responsible boss never lets staff take the heat for him.

挡酒.gloss: block toasts, drink on someone's behalf

meanings.en: block toasts, drink on someone's behalf
meanings.note: Social verb-object dǎngjiǔ ('drink in someone else's place at banquets').

examples.text: 你在总编室的职责之一就是替老大挡酒！
examples.trans: One of your duties in this office is blocking drinks for our boss!

examples.text: 老大为了替我挡酒，自己喝了一杯。
examples.trans: To block a toast for me, our boss drank a glass himself.

examples.text: 挣钱越多麻烦越大，不想挣拉倒！
examples.trans: The more money you earn, the bigger the headaches — if you don't want the raise, forget it!

examples.text: 挣！挣挣挣！
examples.trans: I want it! I definitely want to earn it!

meanings.note: Used seriously or playfully ('stop squirming/denying').

examples.text: 在敏锐的好朋友面前，她再怎么掩饰挣扎都没用。
examples.trans: Before such a sharp-eyed friend, squirming and denying was useless.

examples.text: 创业初期团队曾在资金短缺的困境中苦苦挣扎。
examples.trans: In its early days, the startup struggled through cash shortages.

examples.text: 挣钱越多麻烦越大，不想挣拉倒！
examples.trans: The more money you earn, the bigger the headaches — if you don't want the raise, forget it!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

挤爆.gloss: jam to bursting, crash from traffic

meanings.en: jam to bursting, crash from traffic
meanings.note: Verb-complement jǐbào ('pack so full it bursts/crashes').

examples.text: 原野的官方网站都被粉丝挤爆了。
examples.trans: Yuanye's official site crashed from heavy fan traffic.

examples.text: 周末的商场被人挤爆了。
examples.trans: The mall was packed solid over the weekend.

挤破头.gloss: scramble desperately to get in; fight for a spot

meanings.en: to scramble desperately to get in; to fight tooth and nail for limited spots
meanings.note: Pronounced jǐ pò tóu (literally 'squeeze until one's head breaks'); vivid colloquial verb-object idiom describing fierce competition for prestigious jobs, schools, or opportunities.

examples.text: 那里多少人挤破头都进不去！
examples.trans: Countless people scramble desperately to get in there and still cannot make it!

examples.text: 每年毕业季，大家为了进顶尖传媒公司真是挤破头。
examples.trans: Every graduation season, people really fight tooth and nail to get into top media companies.

examples.text: 中国市场发展非常快，全世界的人都想挤进来，星天会是他们的第一选择。
examples.trans: The Chinese market is growing fast and everyone in the world wants in; naturally Xingtian is their first choice.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huī hui shǒu. Friendly reduplication of separable verb-object 挥手 ('wave a hand').

examples.text: 小晴透过干净的玻璃向院子里的大家挥挥手。
examples.trans: Qing waved through the clean glass to everyone in the courtyard.

examples.text: 火车开动的时候，他在站台上笑着向我们挥挥手。
examples.trans: As the train pulled out, he smiled on the platform and waved to us.

meanings.note: Colloquial adverb āigè ('each in turn').

examples.text: 既然人人都有份，那就挨个说吧。
examples.trans: Since everyone contributed, speak one by one in turn.

examples.text: 入场前工作人员挨个核对了嘉宾名单。
examples.trans: Before entry, staff checked the guest list one by one.

meanings.note: Colloquial V-O compound with passive marker 挨.

examples.text: 大家干活都格外仔细，谁也不想因为粗心挨骂。
examples.trans: Everyone worked with extra care so nobody would get scolded.

examples.text: 老大刚加班睡醒，谁现在去吵他准得挨骂。
examples.trans: The boss just fell asleep after overtime—wake him now and you will get an earful.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nuó dòng. Used for shifting furniture, stones, or one's feet a short distance; 一寸都不会挪动 ('won't budge an inch').

examples.text: 吃午饭以前，老陈和他的纸账本一寸都不会挪动。
examples.trans: Until lunch, Chen and his paper ledger will not budge a single inch.

examples.text: 请帮我把这张木头长椅往树荫底下挪动一点。
examples.trans: Please help me shift this wooden bench a little further under the shade of the tree.

examples.text: 很多歌迷听到这个消息无比振奋，观众对十二歌王的期待值正在飙升。
examples.trans: Countless music fans are thrilled by the news, and audience anticipation for Twelve Singers is skyrocketing.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 原来这家振振有词控诉别人侵权的白石音乐公司，多年拖欠词曲作者钟阳子的版权收益！
examples.trans: It turns out Baishi Music, so self-righteous in suing others, has withheld royalties from songwriter Zhong Yangzi for years!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tǐng. As an adverb, 'quite' (挺好); as a verb, 'straighten up' (挺起) or 'pull through' (挺过).

examples.text: 你看，早餐忙乱和神秘电话你都挺过来了！
examples.trans: Look, you made it through both the breakfast rush and the mystery phone call!

examples.text: 挺起肩膀，志豪先生。记住那三句简单的话——我去开门！
examples.trans: Shoulders back, Mr Zhihao. Remember those three simple lines—I will open the gate!

meanings.note: Verb wǎnhuí ('recover lost ground, undo harm').

examples.text: 我们必须要尽快挽回负面影响。
examples.trans: We must undo the negative impact right away.

examples.text: 公开道歉是为了挽回节目的声誉。
examples.trans: Apologising publicly helps restore the show's name.

meanings.note: Colloquial verb-complement tǒngchūlai ('leak or blow the lid off').

examples.text: 这事要是捅出来，会不会变成他的大麻烦？
examples.trans: If this gets blown open, could it cause him huge trouble?

examples.text: 谁也不敢把那晚的失误随便捅出来。
examples.trans: Nobody dared blow the lid off that night's mistake.

捉襟见肘.gloss: strapped for resources, stretched painfully thin

meanings.en: strapped for resources, stretched painfully thin
meanings.note: Idiom literally meaning pulling one's lapel exposes the elbow.

examples.text: 推掉好几部戏之后，就连大明星手头也有些捉襟见肘了。
examples.trans: After turning down several dramas, even a big star felt strapped.

examples.text: 后期时间紧任务重，人手安排显得捉襟见肘。
examples.trans: With post-production so tight, staffing was stretched thin.

meanings.note: Pinyin: niē. Action verb for picking up a tiny pinch of salt/sugar with the fingers or shaping dough by hand.

examples.text: 明天早上六点烤点心以前，我们先捏一点点白粉末尝尝就行。
examples.trans: Tomorrow morning at six before baking, we can just pinch a tiny bit of the white powder to taste.

examples.text: 小美教志鹏怎么用手指把杏仁挞皮的边缘捏出漂亮的花纹。
examples.trans: Mei showed Peng how to pinch a neat fluted pattern around the edge of the almond tart shells.

meanings.note: Verb juān ('donate money or goods').

examples.text: 我们已经捐了目标金额的百分之一百四。
examples.trans: We have already donated 140 percent of the goal.

examples.text: 同学们纷纷捐出自己的旧书。
examples.trans: Students donated their used books.

捐款.gloss: donate money, make a charitable contribution

meanings.en: donate money, make a charitable contribution
meanings.note: Used as a V-O verb or noun.

examples.text: 热心观众纷纷向慈善基金会踊跃捐款。
examples.trans: Warm-hearted viewers donated generously to the charity fund.

examples.text: 他们把卖车的钱全部作为善款捐款给了公益项目。
examples.trans: They donated the entire proceeds from the car to charity.

meanings.note: Verb-object juānqián ('contribute money').

examples.text: 连小叶今天都舍得捐钱了。
examples.trans: Even thrifty Xiaoye was willing to donate money today.

examples.text: 粉丝自发在网上捐钱支持偶像。
examples.trans: Fans voluntarily donated money online for their idol.

meanings.note: Idiom sǔnrén-lìjǐ ('self-serving at others' expense').

examples.text: 星天绝不让损人利己的人占便宜。
examples.trans: Xingtian never lets self-serving schemers gain an edge.

examples.text: 损人利己的做法在行业里走不远。
examples.trans: Harming others for personal gain gets you nowhere.

examples.text: 国际大单被退约，收入损失是小，可如果损害了她的声誉，会对以后的事业造成长远的影响。
examples.trans: Losing the fee is minor, whereas lasting damage to her reputation will hurt her entire career.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 说是惠美损害了他们想要的那种独立女性的形象。
examples.trans: They claim she damaged the independent-woman image their brand wants to project.

examples.text: 国际大单被退约，收入损失是小，可如果损害了她的声誉，会对以后的事业造成长远的影响。
examples.trans: Losing the fee is minor, whereas lasting damage to her reputation will hurt her entire career.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huàn. Used for swapping suitcases, changing rooms, or replacing broken parts.

examples.text: 上周刚换了新灯泡，有干净肥皂和热水。
examples.trans: Put in a new bulb last week, with clean soap and plenty of hot water.

examples.text: 等等，换房间我们给他打多少折？
examples.trans: Wait—what discount do we offer him for changing rooms?

meanings.note: Verb-object huànrén ('substitute another person').

examples.text: 去告诉二部，让他们马上换人。
examples.trans: Go tell Unit Two to replace the hosts right away.

examples.text: 比赛下半场教练决定换人。
examples.trans: The coach decided to substitute players in the second half.

换作.gloss: if it were (someone else instead), put in the place of

meanings.en: if it were (someone else instead), put in the place of
meanings.note: Introduces a hypothetical role swap.

examples.text: 如果换作是我，肯定也会做出同样的选择。
examples.trans: If it were me in your shoes, I would make the exact same choice.

examples.text: 换作一般人，早就承受不住这么大的压力了。
examples.trans: Anyone else would have buckled under such heavy pressure.

examples.text: 我拜托了，我昨天晚上太多活要干了，所以我没换衣服！
examples.trans: Give me a break — I had way too much work to finish last night, so I didn't change!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 据悉，诉讼包括歌曲利润所得三倍以上的天价索赔，以及星天娱乐公开道歉。
examples.trans: Reports say the lawsuit demands triple-profit damages along with a formal public apology from Xingtian Entertainment.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 据我所知，她和白石公司的合约没有任何法律效力，如果她不出来主张权利，咱们就没有办法。
examples.trans: From what I learned, her contract with Baishi has no legal validity — yet unless she steps forward to claim her rights, our hands are tied.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Noun jùdiǎn ('gathering spot, stronghold').

examples.text: 知道这里是同事们的据点，当然要来看看。
examples.trans: Knowing this is colleagues' hangout, of course I came by.

examples.text: 那家小茶馆是我们周末的据点。
examples.trans: That little teahouse is our weekend hangout.

掀开.gloss: lift open; fold back (a flap, lid, or cloth)

meanings.en: lift open; fold back (a flap, lid, or cloth)
meanings.note: Pinyin: xiān kāi. Resultative verb joining 掀 ('lift a cover or corner') + 开 ('open').

examples.text: 先掀开左边蜡布，再掀开右边，里面的红金铁盒就露出来了！
examples.trans: Fold back the left flap of waxed cloth, then the right, and out gleams the red-and-gold tin box!

examples.text: 小美轻轻掀开蒸笼盖子，热腾腾的甜香飘满厨房。
examples.trans: Mei gently lifted the steamer lid, filling the kitchen with warm sweet fragrance.

掀起.gloss: set off, spark, stir up (a wave or trend)

meanings.en: set off, spark, stir up (a wave or trend)
meanings.note: Often paired with 热潮 or 讨论.

examples.text: 这档旅行真人秀在业内掀起了本土原创热潮。
examples.trans: This travel reality show sparked a boom in domestic originals.

examples.text: 决赛之夜的即兴主持在网上掀起了热烈讨论。
examples.trans: The finale's impromptu hosting set off heated buzz online.

examples.text: 什么授权？法院的传票没看见吗！
examples.trans: What authorization? Haven't you seen the court summons sitting right here?!

examples.text: 授权附表和咱们系统里的记录对不上！
examples.trans: The signed licensing appendix doesn't match the record in our internal database!

examples.text: 就差这一首，对方没有授权给咱们。
examples.trans: That one single song is missing — they never licensed it to us.

examples.text: 更让人想不到的是，星天娱乐竟然拿到了钟阳子的亲笔授权书，并将代表她反诉白石音乐公司！
examples.trans: Even more astonishing, Xingtian Entertainment has obtained Zhong Yangzi's handwritten authorization and will countersue Baishi on her behalf!

examples.text: 钟小姐特别把这首歌和授权书专门托人带给我们。
examples.trans: Ms Zhong specially entrusted a messenger to bring both this new song and her authorization letter to us.

meanings.note: Pinyin: diào. As a verb, 'drop'; after another verb, marks removal or disposal (关掉 'turn off', 擦掉 'wipe away').

examples.text: 别担心！用冰气泡水一擦，橙汁就掉。
examples.trans: Do not worry! Wipe it once with cold sparkling water and orange juice comes right out.

examples.text: 冬天用掉最后一个了。只有桥那边的老五金店有这个尺寸。
examples.trans: Used the last one in winter. Only the old hardware shop past the bridge carries this size.

掉以轻心.gloss: let down one's guard, take something lightly

meanings.en: let down one's guard, take something lightly
meanings.note: Idiom diàoyǐqīngxīn ('treat casually without caution').

examples.text: 既然总监有意见，这事就绝不能掉以轻心。
examples.trans: Since the chief producer raised concerns, we cannot take this lightly.

examples.text: 直播安全关乎全局，任何一个环节都不能掉以轻心。
examples.trans: Broadcast safety affects everything; no detail may be taken lightly.

掉色.gloss: fade in colour; lose dye or ink

meanings.en: fade in colour; lose dye or ink
meanings.note: Pinyin: diào sè. Separable verb-object compound 掉 ('drop/lose') + 色 ('colour'); 不掉色 means 'colourfast / permanent ink'.

examples.text: 小美，快用不掉色的钢笔写进老陈的纸本子里！
examples.trans: Put it in Chen's paper ledger in permanent, non-fading ink, Mei!

examples.text: 这种亚麻桌布用温水洗多少次都不会掉色。
examples.trans: This linen tablecloth will never fade no matter how many times it is washed in warm water.

meanings.note: Noun zhǎngshēng ('clapping, applause').

examples.text: 下面让我们用热烈的掌声欢迎米娜先生！
examples.trans: Let us welcome Mr Mina with warm applause!

examples.text: 一曲唱罢，演播厅里响起了经久不息的掌声。
examples.trans: As the song ended, lasting applause filled the studio.

meanings.note: Verb zhǎngwò ('grasp, take charge of').

examples.text: 二部完全有能力单独掌握好节目制作。
examples.trans: Unit Two is fully able to handle the show's production.

examples.text: 小谷很快就掌握了现场调度的基本技巧。
examples.trans: Xiaogu quickly mastered the basics of floor coordination.

meanings.note: Colloquial TV verb qiā ('snip/cut a segment; pinch').

examples.text: 你要是把她这段掐了，粉丝肯定不答应。
examples.trans: If you cut her segment out, her fans will never accept it.

examples.text: 导播提醒主持人掐准最后的收尾时间。
examples.trans: The director reminded the host to time the closing to the second.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pái. Counts rows of keys, seats, or houses (一排钥匙 'a row of keys').

examples.text: 等星期五中午箱子主人进来，我一定坐第一排看！
examples.trans: When the suitcase owner walks in Friday at noon, I am sitting in the front row!

examples.text: 墙上整整齐齐挂着一排钥匙。
examples.trans: A neat row of keys hangs on the wall.

meanings.note: Used both as noun ('ranking') and verb ('rank').

examples.text: 新预告片的观众期待值目前排名第一。
examples.trans: Viewer anticipation for the new trailer currently ranks first.

examples.text: 本周的收视率排名刚刚公布出来。
examples.trans: This week's ratings rankings were just released.

examples.text: 对啊，他们之前一直排挤您，我早就看不顺眼了，觉得特别不公平。
examples.trans: Yes! Seeing them push you out back then never sat right with me — it felt completely unfair.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Keeping someone or a new idea at arm's length.

examples.text: 她很难过对方为什么突然这么排斥自己。
examples.trans: She was hurt that he suddenly shut her out so coldly.

examples.text: 优秀的创作者从不排斥新鲜的制作理念。
examples.trans: Great creators never reflexively reject fresh production ideas.

meanings.note: Eliminating possibilities or technical faults.

examples.text: 在真相查清之前，不能排除任何一种可能性。
examples.trans: Until the facts are clear, no possibility can be ruled out.

examples.text: 工程师花了一整晚排除了所有的信号故障。
