examples.trans: Engineers worked all night to clear every signal fault.

meanings.note: Testing the waters to learn someone's real view.

examples.text: 我先去探一探领导的口风。
examples.trans: Let me go sound out the boss's thinking first.

examples.text: 他答应三天之内去探个准信。
examples.trans: He promised to sound things out and get a firm answer within three days.

examples.text: 跟您聊天真长学问！我差不多该走了，明天好早点到公司帮您探听消息。
examples.trans: Chatting with you is such an education! I should head back so I can get to the office early tomorrow and gather intel for you.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

探病.gloss: visit a sick person, visit someone in hospital

meanings.en: visit a sick person, visit someone in hospital
meanings.note: Verb-object tànbìng ('visit a patient').

examples.text: 这么大阵仗哪是探病，完全是给人添乱嘛！
examples.trans: With a crowd this loud, that is hardly visiting a patient!

examples.text: 去医院探病最好轻声细语，别打扰病人休息。
examples.trans: Speak softly when visiting someone in hospital so they can rest.

meanings.note: Thoughtful discussion of professional or academic topics.

examples.text: 我想跟你探讨几个节目策划的问题。
examples.trans: I would like to discuss a few show-planning questions with you.

examples.text: 专家们聚在一起探讨行业未来。
examples.trans: Experts gathered to explore the future of the industry.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tànxiǎn. Measure word: 次.

examples.text: 他们计划去热带雨林探险。
examples.trans: They plan to go exploring in the tropical rainforest.

examples.text: 这次探险充满了未知的危险。
examples.trans: This expedition is full of unknown dangers.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiē. Used for answering calls (接电话), meeting someone at a station, or catching drips.

examples.text: 完了！昨天我没戴眼镜，在平板上接了电话预订！
examples.trans: Disaster! Yesterday without my glasses I took a phone booking on the tablet!

examples.text: 志豪接干毛巾的时候随手放下的！
examples.trans: Hao set it down casually when he took the dry towel!

meanings.en: next; after this; in the next step
meanings.note: Pronounced jiē xiàlái; used sentence-initially as a discourse connector (especially by hosts and directors) or before 的 + noun ('the upcoming...').

examples.text: 接下来抓紧时间，把最终稿交上来。
examples.trans: Next, make good use of the time and hand in the final draft.

examples.text: 女士们，先生们，接下来有请今晚的神秘嘉宾！
examples.trans: Ladies and gentlemen, up next please welcome tonight's mystery guest!

接任.gloss: succeed to a post, take over from a predecessor

meanings.en: succeed to a post, take over from a predecessor
meanings.note: Formal verb for replacing an outgoing leader.

examples.text: 董事会正在物色合适的人选接任总制作人一职。
examples.trans: The board is looking for the right person to take over as chief producer.

examples.text: 他以为自己来星天是直接接任首席内容官的。
examples.trans: He assumed he had come to Xingtian to succeed directly as CCO.

meanings.note: Person taking over a leadership post.

examples.text: 从市场资源来看，他确实是最合适的接任者。
examples.trans: In terms of market resources, he really is the most suitable successor.

examples.text: 前任主管把所有流程文档都完整交接给了接任者。
examples.trans: The outgoing head handed all workflow docs cleanly to his successor.

meanings.note: Tech verb jiērù ('connect/patch a feed in').

examples.text: 登录应用程序，导播台会把你接入电视信号。
examples.trans: Log into the app and the booth will patch you into the TV signal.

examples.text: 五路户外移动信号已经全部稳定接入主控室。
examples.trans: All five mobile field feeds are now patched stably into master control.

meanings.note: Verb jiēshòu ('accept an apology, offer, or task').

examples.text: 我在正式向你道歉，接受吧。
examples.trans: I am formally apologising to you — accept it.

examples.text: 这位歌手很少接受电视访谈。
examples.trans: This singer rarely accepts television interviews.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiē kǒu. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个接口 ('a pipe joint').

examples.text: 手电筒拿稳，照着这儿的水管接口。
examples.trans: Hold the flashlight steady and shine it on the pipe joint here.

examples.text: 老陈用扳手把铜管接口拧紧了。
examples.trans: Chen tightened the copper pipe joint with a wrench.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiē dài. Hospitality verb for welcoming and serving guests.

examples.text: 完全正确！目前你们四张桌子只接待住店客人。
examples.trans: Exactly right! Right now your four tables only serve overnight inn guests.

examples.text: 这家小客栈一天最多接待十位客人。
examples.trans: This boutique inn hosts at most ten guests a day.

meanings.note: Verb-object jiēshǒu ('take charge from a predecessor').

examples.text: 淳于乔接手了几周就让节目改头换面。
examples.trans: Within weeks of taking over, Chun Yuqiao transformed the show.

examples.text: 下个月由新团队正式接手后期剪辑。
examples.trans: Next month a new team takes over post-editing.

examples.text: 我有把握让孤岛以同样的品质接棒十二歌王甚至超越。但是老板，留给你的时间不多。
examples.trans: I am confident Lonely Island will match or surpass Twelve Singers in quality — though boss, you don't have much time left to decide.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

接洽.gloss: liaise; coordinate; take up a matter with

meanings.en: to liaise; to coordinate; to discuss business arrangements with
meanings.note: Pronounced jiēqià; formal professional verb typically constructed as 跟/与 + [party] + 接洽.

examples.text: 吉总您好，王尔老师让我来跟您接洽。
examples.trans: Hello President Ji; Teacher Wang Er sent me to coordinate with you.

examples.text: 关于版权引进的细节，法务部正在跟对方接洽。
examples.trans: Regarding the details of licensing the rights, the legal department is currently liaising with the other party.

接着.gloss: continuing on, right after that, keep on

meanings.en: continuing on, right after that, keep on
meanings.note: Adverb before a verb meaning carry right on doing.

examples.text: 喝口热茶歇五分钟，咱们再接着对台本。
examples.trans: Have some hot tea for five minutes, then let us keep going over the script.

examples.text: 主持人念完感谢名单，接着宣布了最终冠军。
examples.trans: After reading the credits, the host went on to announce the champion.

meanings.note: Verb jiēguǎn ('take over management of').

examples.text: 我已经让一部接管了文娱论的演播室。
examples.trans: I already had Unit One take over Entertainment Talk's studio.

examples.text: 新经理下周正式接管这个项目。
examples.trans: The new manager formally takes over this project next week.

meanings.note: Verb jiēchù ('contact, meet').

examples.text: 两周之内不宜与明星艺人接触。
examples.trans: You should not have contact with celebrities for two weeks.

examples.text: 这是我第一次接触电视制作。
examples.trans: This is my first contact with TV production.

examples.text: 接近他。
examples.trans: Approach him.

examples.text: 很难接近。
examples.trans: Hard to approach.

meanings.note: Verb/noun kòngzhì ('keep under control').

examples.text: 虽然是急性胃出血，不过已经控制住了。
examples.trans: Though it was acute stomach bleeding, it is under control now.

examples.text: 直播导演必须精准控制每一个环节的时长。
examples.trans: A live director must tightly control every segment's runtime.

examples.text: 原来这家振振有词控诉别人侵权的白石音乐公司，多年拖欠词曲作者钟阳子的版权收益！
examples.trans: It turns out Baishi Music, so self-righteous in suing others, has withheld royalties from songwriter Zhong Yangzi for years!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tuī. Opposite of 拉 ('pull'); used for pushing doors open.

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 这扇木门往里推就开了。
examples.trans: Push this wooden door inward and it opens.

meanings.note: Verb tuīchū ('release a new show or product').

examples.text: 一档好节目一经推出就会受到关注。
examples.trans: Once rolled out, a strong programme draws immediate notice.

examples.text: 今年秋天卫视将推出两档原创音乐综艺。
examples.trans: This autumn the network launches two original music shows.

meanings.note: Verb tuīdòng ('propel, drive forward').

examples.text: 现在有了外部力量推动，改革更容易落地。
examples.trans: With external momentum driving it, reform lands more easily.

examples.text: 技术创新推动了电视制作水准的提升。
examples.trans: Tech innovation has driven higher TV production standards.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tuī kāi. Resultative verb compound 推 ('push') + 开 ('open').

examples.text: 志豪把院子上面的气窗推开两厘米，让干爽的空气吹过走廊。
examples.trans: Hao pushed the courtyard transom window open two centimetres so dry air could flow down the hallway.

examples.text: 推开九号房的木门，迎面就是明亮的拱窗和温暖的阳光。
examples.trans: Push open the wooden door of Room Nine and you are greeted by bright arched windows and warm sunlight.

meanings.note: Verb-complement tuīfān ('scrap a plan, overturn').

examples.text: 要是老大从医院出来把一切推翻重来就太紧了。
examples.trans: If the boss leaves hospital and scraps everything, time will be tight.

examples.text: 经过三次讨论，团队推翻了原先保守的想法。
examples.trans: After three talks, the team scrapped the safe old idea.

examples.text: 感觉非常好，还要谢谢方老师推荐。
examples.trans: It feels great, and I also want to thank Professor Fang for the recommendation.

examples.text: 这是推荐。
examples.trans: This is 推荐.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tuīchē. Measure word: 辆.

examples.text: 他在超市里推着一辆推车。
examples.trans: He is pushing a shopping cart in the supermarket.

examples.text: 婴儿在推车里睡着了。
examples.trans: The baby fell asleep in the stroller.

meanings.note: Verb tuījìn ('make steady headway').

examples.text: 外面的合作谈判还在稳步推进。
examples.trans: Outside partnership talks are still moving ahead.

examples.text: 各小组按计划推进下周的录影筹备。
examples.trans: Every team is advancing next week's taping prep on schedule.

meanings.note: Verb tuīchí ('put off, delay').

examples.text: 论文明天是最后一天，绝不能再推迟了。
examples.trans: Tomorrow is the last day for the paper; no more delays.

examples.text: 因为下雨，比赛推迟到下周。
examples.trans: Because of rain, the match was postponed to next week.

examples.text: 系统推送了更新。
examples.trans: The system pushed an update.

examples.text: 我收到了推送消息。
examples.trans: I received a push notification.

掰.gloss: bend or break apart with both hands

meanings.en: bend or break apart with both hands
meanings.note: Pinyin: bāi. Depicts two hands (手 + 分 + 手) pulling or bending something by finger force (掰弯 'bend', 掰开 'break in two').

examples.text: 老铁盒盖子咬得很紧，千万别用手硬掰。
examples.trans: The old tin lid is wedged tight—never try to force or bend it open bare-handed.

examples.text: 小美把刚烤好的热面包掰成两半递给小晴。
examples.trans: Mei broke the freshly baked warm roll in half with her hands and passed a piece to Qing.

揉.gloss: rub, knead (figurative in 眼里揉不进沙子)

meanings.en: rub, knead (figurative in 眼里揉不进沙子)
meanings.note: Used literally ('rub eyes') or in the idiom for zero tolerance of deceit.

examples.text: 熬夜剪片子眼睛发酸，她轻轻揉了揉眼角。
examples.trans: With tired eyes from overnight editing, she rubbed the corners gently.

examples.text: 董事长向来眼里揉不进沙子，绝不容忍账目造假。
examples.trans: The chairwoman tolerates zero grit in her eye and brooks no fake accounts.

meanings.note: Verb miáoxiě ('portray, describe').

examples.text: 文章详细描写了二位真诚和解。
examples.trans: The piece described in detail how you two reconciled.

examples.text: 这段文字把后台紧张的气氛描写得很生动。
examples.trans: This passage vividly depicts the tense backstage mood.

meanings.en: lift up; carry (by a handle); mention
meanings.note: Pinyin: tí. Used for lifting a door handle or carrying a bag by its strap/handle.

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.note: Formal verb tíjiāo ('submit a proposal or report').

examples.text: 你们提交的改版方案十分精彩。
examples.trans: The revamp proposal you submitted is brilliant.

examples.text: 请在周五下班前提交下季度的预算表。
examples.trans: Please submit next quarter's budget before Friday evening.

examples.text: 星天也在用我们提供的数据。
examples.trans: Xingtian is also using the data we provide.

examples.text: 这是提供。
examples.trans: This is 提供.

examples.text: 王尔不止那一次泄密，他一直给我们的竞争对手提供情报。
examples.trans: Wang Er didn't leak secrets just once; he acted like an informant feeding intel to our competitors for years.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Verb tíchū ('propose a request or question').

examples.text: 电视台正式提出要派人常驻星天。
examples.trans: The network formally proposed stationing staff at Xingtian.

examples.text: 她在策划会上提出了一个新颖的想法。
examples.trans: She put forward a fresh idea at the planning meeting.

meanings.en: to mention; to bring up; to refer to
meanings.note: Pronounced tídào; transitive verb-complement compound (提 + 到) taking a person, topic, or clause as its direct object.

examples.text: 有些人的名字不能提，你提到他，他就会出现。
examples.trans: Some people's names must not be mentioned; if you mention him, he will appear.

examples.text: 最近这两天一直有人在电视上吵架，并且频频提到了我的名字。
examples.trans: Over the past couple of days people kept arguing on television and repeatedly brought up my name.

related.gloss: to bring up; to speak of

meanings.note: shift a scheduled event earlier than planned

examples.text: 王尔老师，淳于总提前了录影时间！
examples.trans: Teacher Wang Er, Director Chun Yu moved up the taping time!

examples.text: 如有变动请提前通知大家。
examples.trans: If there are changes, please notify everyone in advance.

meanings.note: Workplace noun/verb tí'àn ('pitch a show plan; proposal').

examples.text: 文娱论我们只管监制，提案归二部。
examples.trans: We only supervise the show; pitching belongs to Unit Two.

examples.text: 这一定今天会上最好的提案。
examples.trans: This is bound to be today's strongest proposal.

meanings.note: Compound noun tí'ànhuì ('programme pitch review meeting').

examples.text: 明天的提案会，你跟别人正常竞争。
examples.trans: At tomorrow's pitch meeting, compete fairly with everyone.

examples.text: 提案会马上开始了，大家进来吧。
examples.trans: The pitch meeting is starting — come on inside.

meanings.note: Formal suggestion at a meeting or to a board.

examples.text: 她在办公会上正式提议召回离职的总制作人。
examples.trans: At the meeting she formally proposed recalling the chief producer.

examples.text: 大家一致赞成策划组提议的公益特别节目。
examples.trans: Everyone backed the charity special proposed by the planning team.

meanings.note: Verb tíqǐ ('bring up in conversation').

examples.text: 把硬盘放回去，跟谁都不要提起。
examples.trans: Put the drives back and mention this to nobody.

examples.text: 他从来不向别人提起过去的苦。
examples.trans: He never brings up past hardships to others.

examples.text: 这个白石爱贪小便宜，按照合约应该付给人家作者钱，可是他们从来没跟作者提过这件事！
examples.trans: Baishi loves cutting petty corners; under the contract they owed the songwriter payment, yet they never breathed a word to her!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Verb tíxǐng ('remind, tip off').

examples.text: 快提醒他上个月跳槽的那个女主持人。
examples.trans: Remind him of the female host who left last month.

examples.text: 谢谢你提醒我带雨伞。
examples.trans: Thank you for reminding me to bring an umbrella.

examples.text: 各位媒体同仁，接下来可以自由提问了。
examples.trans: Members of the press, the floor is now open for your questions.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 如果我们台能够率先垂范接受这个方案，不仅会提高我们的品牌价值。
examples.trans: If our network sets the example by adopting this plan, it will elevate our entire brand value.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chā. Used for inserting a key into a keyhole or plugging in a cord.

examples.text: 插上老陈的铜台灯……哇，黄色灯光真暖和！
examples.trans: Plug in Chen's brass lamp... wow, how warm that yellow light is!

examples.text: 他把铜钥匙插进锁孔里。
examples.trans: He inserted the brass key into the keyhole.

插嘴.gloss: butt in, chime in uninvited, interrupt

meanings.en: butt in, chime in uninvited, interrupt
meanings.note: Speaking out of turn in someone else's discussion.

examples.text: 大人们商量正事的时候，小孩子别随便插嘴。
examples.trans: Do not butt in casually when elders are discussing serious business.

examples.text: 这是公司高层的决定，轮不到外人来插嘴。
examples.trans: This is an executive decision where outsiders have no say.

meanings.en: latch; bolt (on a window or door)
meanings.note: Pinyin: chā xiāo. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个插销 ('a latch').

examples.text: 我先画一下窗户的插销，让院子里的新鲜空气进来。
examples.trans: First let me sketch the window latches, so fresh air comes in from the courtyard.

examples.text: 窗户的插销坏了，关不上。
examples.trans: The window latch is broken, so it won't close.

meanings.note: Verb wò ('grasp, hold').

examples.text: 光杏子手里就握着不少艺人的关系。
examples.trans: Xingzi alone holds plenty of artist contacts.

examples.text: 两人见面时热情地握手。
examples.trans: The two shook hands warmly when they met.

揣.gloss: tuck inside one's pocket or coat

meanings.en: tuck inside one's pocket or coat
meanings.note: Pinyin: chuāi. Warm everyday spoken verb: 把指南针揣进口袋里 ('tuck the compass snug into one's pocket').

examples.text: 小晴把黄铜指南针稳稳揣进口袋，准备出发去走线索。
examples.trans: Qing tucked the brass compass safely into her pocket, ready to set off on the clue walk.

examples.text: 老陈总是把一截木工铅笔揣在工装上衣口袋里。
examples.trans: Chen always keeps a carpenter's pencil tucked in his work-jacket pocket.

揣摩.gloss: try to figure out, fathom, read between the lines

meanings.en: try to figure out, fathom, read between the lines
meanings.note: Studying a character's psychology or a boss's unspoken wishes.

examples.text: 好演员会反复研读剧本，仔细揣摩角色的内心。
examples.trans: Good actors reread scripts to fathom the character's inner world.

examples.text: 与其花心思揣摩领导意图，不如专心做好内容。
examples.trans: Rather than trying to guess the boss's mind, focus on content.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǎo. Action verb for stirring liquids, sauces, or batters with a spoon or whisk.

examples.text: 小晴开着小火不停地搅，不让锅底的柠檬酱煮开。
examples.trans: Qing stirred nonstop over low heat so the lemon curd at the bottom of the pot wouldn't boil.

examples.text: 喝热红茶的时候，他喜欢放一小勺蜂蜜轻轻搅一下。
examples.trans: When drinking hot black tea, he likes adding a small spoonful of honey and giving it a gentle stir.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǎo dòng. Resultative/coordinate verb compound 搅 ('stir') + 动 ('move/set in motion').

examples.text: 你看我用木棍搅动铁罐里的油漆——像梧桐树叶那样的深绿色！
examples.trans: Look at the paint in the tin when I stir it—deep green just like wutong leaves!

examples.text: 小晴轻轻搅动着茶壶里的热水，让洋甘菊的香气散发出来。
examples.trans: Qing gently stirred the hot water in the teapot to release the aroma of chamomile.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǎo yún. Resultative verb compound 搅 ('stir') + 匀 ('even/uniform'), used when blending butter, sugar, or seasonings thoroughly into a mixture.

examples.text: 关火以后马上放一块冰的无盐黄油进去搅匀！
examples.trans: Right after turning off the heat, drop in a cube of cold unsalted butter and stir until smooth!

examples.text: 先把蛋黄和柠檬汁在碗里搅匀，再倒进温热的锅里。
examples.trans: Whisk the egg yolks and lemon juice until smooth in a bowl first, then pour them into the warm pot.

examples.text: 你可以上网搜一下。
examples.trans: You can search it online.

examples.text: 他在搜集资料。
examples.trans: He is searching for materials.

meanings.note: Verb sōují ('gather evidence or materials').

examples.text: 你们想搜集我违约的证据吧？
examples.trans: You wanted to gather proof I breached my contract, right?

examples.text: 记者正在搜集新闻资料。
examples.trans: The reporter is gathering news materials.

examples.text: 最想搞掉的就是那个淳于乔。
examples.trans: The one you want to take down most is that Chun Yuqiao.

examples.text: 这是搞。
examples.trans: This is 搞.

examples.text: 我都搞不定，还指望她能攻破啊？
examples.trans: If even I can't crack them, do you really expect her to break through?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

搞好.gloss: build well, do a good job on

meanings.en: build well, do a good job on
meanings.note: Verb-complement gǎohǎo ('handle or maintain well').

examples.text: 和粉丝后援会搞好关系至关重要。
examples.trans: Building good relations with fan clubs is vital.

examples.text: 大家齐心协力把这期改版节目搞好。
examples.trans: Everyone is pulling together to make the revamp shine.

examples.text: 这是搞定啊。
examples.trans: This is done.

examples.text: 那个搞定好。
examples.trans: That done is good.

examples.text: 这是搞清楚啊。
examples.trans: This is find out.

examples.text: 那个搞清楚好。
examples.trans: That find out is good.

meanings.note: Meaning: ruined.

examples.text: 被我全搞砸了，我该怎么办啊？
examples.trans: I ruined the whole thing — what should I do?

examples.text: 这是搞砸。
examples.trans: This is 搞砸.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bān. Used for moving furniture, boxes, or moving house.

examples.text: 四个纸箱五分钟就能搬走。现在就上去看！
examples.trans: We can move four boxes in five minutes. Let's go up and look right now!

examples.text: 请帮我把这张桌子搬到院子里。
examples.trans: Please help me move this table out to the courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bān jiā. Separable verb-object compound.

examples.text: 搬家公司清空房子之前，我从阁楼架子救下了这个盒子。
examples.trans: Before the movers cleared the house, I saved this box from the attic shelf.

examples.text: 上个月他们刚搬家到梧桐巷附近。
examples.trans: Last month they moved house to the Wutong Lane neighborhood.

examples.text: 搬家公司的货车一大早就停在客栈门口了。
examples.trans: The moving company's van parked outside the guesthouse gate early in the morning.

examples.text: 我们请了最靠谱的搬家公司来搬运那架老钢琴。
examples.trans: We hired the most reliable moving company to move that old piano.

搭把手.gloss: lend a hand, pitch in briefly

meanings.en: lend a hand, pitch in briefly
meanings.note: Colloquial northern phrase for helping someone carry or do something.

examples.text: 这箱器材太沉了，快过来搭把手。
examples.trans: This crate of gear is heavy—come lend a hand.

examples.text: 看他忙不过来，同事主动上去搭把手。
examples.trans: Seeing him swamped, a colleague stepped up to lend a hand.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dā dàng. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位搭档 ('a partner').

examples.text: 三分钟就能送上三楼。今天跑得漂亮，搭档。
examples.trans: Three minutes to reach the third floor. Fine run today, partner.

examples.text: 小晴和老陈已经是配合默契的好搭档了。
examples.trans: Qing and Chen have already become a great team.

meanings.note: Production noun shèxiàngshī ('cameraperson').

examples.text: 从明天开始，跟组摄像师就得全程跟拍。
examples.trans: Starting tomorrow, crew camera operators follow you nonstop.

examples.text: 三位摄像师默契配合，拍下了精彩的舞台瞬间。
examples.trans: Working in sync, three camera operators captured the magic.

meanings.note: Professional television or film camera.

examples.text: 扛着沉重的摄像机跑一整天非常消耗体力。
examples.trans: Carrying a heavy video camera all day takes real stamina.

examples.text: 现场一共架设了十二台高清摄像机。
examples.trans: Twelve high-definition cameras were set up across the venue.

examples.text: 进摄像棚。
examples.trans: Enter the studio.

examples.text: 在摄像棚里。
examples.trans: Inside the studio.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎi. Used for setting out plates, chairs, or flowers neatly (摆好).

examples.text: 四张桌子，八把椅子，全摆好了！
examples.trans: Four tables, eight chairs—everything is set in place!

examples.text: 桌子上摆好了四个蓝茶杯。
examples.trans: Four blue teacups are neatly set out on the table.

meanings.note: Verb/noun bǎifàng ('lay out neatly, display').

examples.text: 工作人员弄错了冠名商的产品摆放。
examples.trans: Staff mixed up the sponsor's product placement.

examples.text: 桌上的话筒和台本摆放得很整齐。
examples.trans: Microphones and cue cards sit neatly on the desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tān. Open-air market table or vendor stall (水果摊 'fruit stall', 陶瓷摊 'pottery stall'). Measure word: 个 (gè).

examples.text: 星期六广场上摆满了卖鲜花和水果的小摊。
examples.trans: On Saturdays, the square is lined with stalls selling fresh flowers and fruit.

examples.text: 转角那个陶瓷摊的茶杯又厚又好看。
examples.trans: The teacups at that pottery stall on the corner are both thick and handsome.

meanings.note: Verb shuāi ('fling down, smash').

examples.text: 谢谢您那天没把杯子往我们脸上摔。
examples.trans: Thank you for not smashing the cup toward us that day.

examples.text: 路很滑，小心别摔了。
examples.trans: The road is slippery; careful not to fall.

meanings.en: to fall down; to lose one's footing and tumble
meanings.note: Pronounced shuāidǎo; intransitive resultative compound (摔 'tumble' + 倒 'topple over').

examples.text: 慢点，小心别摔倒了！
examples.trans: Slow down — be careful not to trip and fall!

examples.text: 舞台刚拖过地有点滑，彩排的时候千万别摔倒。
examples.trans: The stage was just mopped and is a bit slippery, so be sure not to fall during rehearsal.

related.gloss: to break or injure from a fall

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhāi. Used for picking herbs, fruit, or flowers, and also for taking off glasses or hats.

examples.text: 这碗番茄汤里放了刚从院子里摘的新鲜香草。
examples.trans: This bowl of tomato soup has fresh herbs just picked from the courtyard.

examples.text: 宋老师摘下眼镜，轻轻合上了那本旧登记本。
examples.trans: Teacher Song took off her glasses and gently closed the old guest book.

examples.text: 他在口袋里摸了半天，终于找出了大门的钥匙。
examples.trans: He felt around in his pocket for a while and finally pulled out the key to the front gate.

examples.text: 猫儿顺着墙角轻轻走过来，用脑袋蹭着摸她的手背。
examples.trans: The cat padded softly along the corner of the wall and brushed its head against the back of her hand.

examples.text: 你摸摸这暖气片，是不是已经热起来了？
examples.trans: Feel this radiator—has it warmed up already?

examples.text: 小猫乖乖地趴在台阶上，谁路过都想弯腰摸摸它。
examples.trans: The kitten lay quietly on the steps, and everyone passing by wanted to bend down and pet it.

examples.text: 然后就摸清了规则，技战术练了练。
examples.trans: Then I figured out all the rules and practiced the techniques and tactics.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Potential complement chēngbuzhù ('cannot hold up').

examples.text: 我估计那条新闻两天都撑不住。
examples.trans: I reckon that story would not have lasted two days.

examples.text: 他太困了，实在撑不住了。
examples.trans: He was too sleepy to keep his eyes open.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sǎ. Used for sprinkling powdered sugar or salt over food.

examples.text: 好。端上去之前，在上面撒这些新鲜绿香草。
examples.trans: Good. Before serving them, sprinkle these fresh green herbs on top.

examples.text: 他爷爷会切热柠檬蛋糕，上面撒一层白糖粉！
examples.trans: His grandfather sliced warm lemon cake with a dusting of powdered sugar on top!

meanings.note: Pinyin: sī. Pairs with resultative complements: 撕成两半 ('tear into two halves'), 撕破 ('tear/rip').

examples.text: 有人从正中间把这张菜谱卡片齐齐地撕成了两半！
examples.trans: Someone tore this recipe card cleanly into two halves right across the middle!

examples.text: 小心揭开胶带，别把旧信封背面的纸撕破了。
examples.trans: Peel the tape gently so you do not tear the paper on the back of the old envelope.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a verb used in conversational Mandarin.

examples.text: 我有一个撕破。
examples.trans: I have a 撕破.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的撕破。
examples.trans: This is a very good 撕破.

meanings.note: Idiom sīpòliǎn ('tear off all politeness, turn openly hostile').

examples.text: 你跟公司撕破脸，对谁也没有好处。
examples.trans: Falling out openly with the company helps nobody.

examples.text: 大家还是朋友，别撕破脸。
examples.trans: We are still friends; let us not fall out.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuàng. Used for bumping into someone or rushing through a doorway.

examples.text: 老弟，你到底撞进了一家什么神奇客栈？
examples.trans: Little brother, what kind of magical inn did you stumble into?

examples.text: 他跑得太急，差点撞到门上。
examples.trans: He ran so fast he nearly bumped into the door.

examples.text: 今儿真是撞邪了。
examples.trans: Today has honestly gone completely sideways.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Verb chè ('remove props; knock off work/leave').

examples.text: 快把台上摆错的水给我撤了。
examples.trans: Clear the wrong water bottles off the stage right now.

examples.text: 老大，你也早点撤吧。
examples.trans: Boss, you should head home early too.

meanings.note: Verb-complement chèchū ('pull staff out of a project').

examples.text: 主任要求二部所有人全部撤出这档节目。
examples.trans: The director ordered everyone in Unit Two off the show.

examples.text: 录制结束后工作人员有序撤出演播厅。
examples.trans: After taping, crew withdrew smoothly from the studio.

meanings.note: Verb chèhuí ('withdraw formally').

examples.text: 请立即撤回报案。
examples.trans: Please withdraw the police report at once.

examples.text: 律师今天早上向警方撤回报案了。
examples.trans: The lawyer withdrew the report with police this morning.

meanings.note: Verb-complement chèdiào ('pull offline, remove').

examples.text: 这条视频您看方不方便把它撤掉？
examples.trans: Would it be convenient for you to take down this video?

examples.text: 如果你愿意撤掉视频，我们提供资源。
examples.trans: If you take down the video, we will offer resources.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiào. Action verb for levering a stone or lid with a bar or tool (硬撬 'pry by brute force').

examples.text: 老铁盒千万别硬撬，滴一小滴温机油就能松开。
examples.trans: Never pry an old tin box open by brute force—one tiny drop of warm oil will loosen it.

examples.text: 老陈用扁铁棒轻轻一撬，第三块石板就抬起来了。
examples.trans: With one gentle lever of his flat iron bar, Chen eased the third flagstone up.

meanings.note: Verb bō ('air on TV or radio').

examples.text: 等这两天节目一播，全网都会讨论。
examples.trans: Once the episode airs in a couple of days, everyone will talk.

examples.text: 那期特别节目定在下周六晚上播。
examples.trans: That special episode is slated to air next Saturday night.

meanings.note: Broadcast verb bōchū ('air on television or radio').

examples.text: 文娱论在我们手里每周都要播出。
examples.trans: Under our supervision, the show airs every week.

examples.text: 我们电视播出的画面没有任何错误。
examples.trans: The footage we aired on television had zero mistakes.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bō fàng. Used for playing recorded messages, music tracks, or videos (contrast 弹 tán for playing piano).

examples.text: 小晴按下按钮，播放前台电话里的语音留言。
examples.trans: Qing pressed the button to play the voice message on the front-desk phone.

examples.text: 咖啡厅里正在轻轻播放一首钢琴曲。
examples.trans: A piano piece is playing softly in the café right now.

meanings.note: Media noun bōfàngliàng ('online video play count').

examples.text: 这条后台视频的播放量还挺高的呢！
examples.trans: The view count on this backstage clip is quite high!

examples.text: 新节目的网络播放量突破了一千万。
examples.trans: Online views for the new episode topped ten million.

撮.gloss: pinch (measure word for salt, tea leaves, or powder)

meanings.en: pinch (measure word for salt, tea leaves, or powder)
meanings.note: Pinyin: cuō. Classifier for a tiny quantity picked up between thumb and fingertips (一小撮盐 'a small pinch of salt').

examples.text: 用细绳绑两小枝新鲜香草，最后再往汤里放一小撮盐。
examples.trans: Tie two small sprigs of fresh herbs with string, and finally add a small pinch of salt to the soup.

examples.text: 泡茶的时候抓一小撮干薄荷叶放进壶里，香气马上就出来了。
examples.trans: Toss a small pinch of dried mint leaves into the pot when brewing tea and the aroma rises at once.

examples.text: 我其实不太擅长谈恋爱。那不是应该的吗？这是我作为男朋友的义务啊。
examples.trans: Truthfully, I'm not very skilled at romance — isn't taking your words seriously my duty as your boyfriend?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Verb cāozuò ('handle a project or equipment').

examples.text: 你在一部操作过多少国际艺人团队？
examples.trans: How many international artist teams did you handle in Unit One?

examples.text: 这台新调音台操作起来非常顺手。
examples.trans: This new mixing console is smooth to operate.

examples.text: 让他知道一线制作确实不用太操心了。
examples.trans: Let's show him he truly doesn't need to worry about frontline production anymore.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Verb cāokòng ('steer behind the scenes, control').

examples.text: 他总觉得自己能操控台前幕后的一切。
examples.trans: He thinks he can control everything onstage and off.

examples.text: 导播熟练地操控着切换台。
examples.trans: The switcher operator skillfully runs the console.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cā. Used for wiping tables, drying water, or polishing lanterns.

examples.text: 别担心！用冰气泡水一擦，橙汁就掉。
examples.trans: Do not worry! Wipe it once with cold sparkling water and orange juice comes right out.

examples.text: 先生，给您干毛巾擦外套，还有一碗热汤。
examples.trans: Sir, here is a dry towel to wipe your coat, plus a bowl of hot soup.

meanings.note: Colloquial verb zǎn ('collect or save up').

examples.text: 我攒了好多个问题想要问你。
examples.trans: I have saved up plenty of questions I want to ask you.

examples.text: 她攒了半年的工资去买专业耳机。
examples.trans: She saved half a year's pay for studio headphones.

meanings.en: to save up; to accumulate bit by bit and retain
meanings.note: Pronounced zǎnxià; verb 攒 ('accumulate/hoard') + resultative的下 indicating kept savings, contacts, or resources.

examples.text: 这些资源都是我多年攒下的。
examples.trans: All of these contacts are ones I saved up over many years.

examples.text: 他靠自己辛辛苦苦攒下的积蓄成立了工作室。
examples.trans: He founded the studio using the savings he had painstakingly put aside on his own.

支.gloss: classifier for trailers, songs, bands, pens

meanings.en: classifier for trailers, songs, bands, pens
meanings.note: Used for music videos, promotional clips, and teams.

examples.text: 节目的第一支宣传预告片昨天正式上线了。
examples.trans: The show's very first promotional trailer went live yesterday.

examples.text: 那支来自南方的乐队演奏得非常精彩。
examples.trans: That band from the south played brilliantly.

meanings.note: Verb/noun zhīchí ('back up, support').

examples.text: 如果没有各位的支持，也不会合作得这么好。
examples.trans: Without everyone's support, cooperation would not go so well.

examples.text: 谢谢观众朋友们一直以来的支持。
examples.trans: Thank you to our viewers for your steady support.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shōu. Versatile verb meaning 'gather / put away / fold shut' (收起来, 收平) as well as 'receive'.

examples.text: 快下雨了，我们把院子里的布伞收起来吧。
examples.trans: It's about to rain—let's fold up the cloth umbrellas in the courtyard.

examples.text: 木椅子收好以后，走廊一下子宽敞多了。
examples.trans: Once the wooden chairs were folded away, the corridor immediately felt much roomier.

收一收.gloss: tone down a bit, rein in, dial back

meanings.en: tone down a bit, rein in, dial back
meanings.note: Colloquial reduplicated verb meaning to hold back slightly.

examples.text: 如果报道写得太过分，就让他们稍微收一收。
examples.trans: If the coverage goes too far, tell them to tone it down a bit.

examples.text: 快上台了，大家把玩笑的心思收一收。
examples.trans: We go on stage soon—everyone dial back the joking.

meanings.note: Noun shōurù ('income').

examples.text: 这会直接影响到我们艺人的广告收入。
examples.trans: That directly affects endorsement income for our artists.

examples.text: 版权出口为节目组带来了可观的额外收入。
examples.trans: Format exports brought the show sizable extra revenue.

meanings.note: Verb shōudào ('received; radio/workplace "copy that"').

examples.text: 收到，我们会继续盯着直播。
examples.trans: Copy that; we will keep watching the live feed.

examples.text: 我已经收到你发的邮件了。
examples.trans: I have received the email you sent.

meanings.note: Verb shōuhuí ('take back words or items').

examples.text: 那我收回刚才的言论。
examples.trans: Then I take back my remark just now.

examples.text: 说出去的话很难收回。
examples.trans: Words spoken aloud are hard to take back.

收尾.gloss: wrap up, record the closing segment

meanings.en: wrap up, record the closing segment
meanings.note: Verb-object shōuwěi ('finish off, wrap').

examples.text: 咱们最后再录一个简短的收尾就好。
examples.trans: We just need to tape one brief closing wrap at the end.

examples.text: 后期剪辑已经进入最后的收尾阶段。
examples.trans: Post-production editing has entered its final wrap stage.

收工.gloss: wrap up work for the day

meanings.en: wrap up work for the day

examples.text: 凯文跟杏子都收工了，你怎么知道的？
examples.trans: How on earth did you know that even Kaiwen and Xingzi already clocked off?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 收拾什么呀？
examples.trans: Why are we packing up our desks?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shōu jù. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张收据 ('a receipt').

examples.text: 不在，只有我的笔和三张旧收据！
examples.trans: Not there—only my pen and three old receipts!

examples.text: 钱箱里拿五十块，记得要收据！
examples.trans: Here is fifty yuan from the cash box; remember to get a receipt!

meanings.note: Financial or career gains from a venture.

examples.text: 高风险往往伴随着不稳定的收益。
examples.trans: High risk often comes with uncertain returns.

examples.text: 节目成功会给各方带来可观的收益。
examples.trans: A hit show brings sizable returns to every side.

examples.text: 现场的各位媒体同仁，以及收看直播的所有观众朋友们，大家好。
examples.trans: To our media colleagues in the hall and all viewers watching the live broadcast, hello everyone.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Television noun shōushì ('TV ratings').

examples.text: 这包括文娱论三个月的收视数据。
examples.trans: This includes three months of ratings for Entertainment Talk.

examples.text: 昨晚决赛的收视创下了新高。
examples.trans: Last night's finale ratings hit a new record.

meanings.note: Broadcast noun shōushìlǜ ('TV viewership rating percentage').

examples.text: 好节目一经推出，如果收视率还不错。
examples.trans: When a good show launches and earns solid ratings.

examples.text: 昨晚决赛的全国收视率排在第一位。
examples.trans: Last night's finale ranked number one in national ratings.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gǎi. Used for changing plans or converting a building.

examples.text: 超过八十年的小院建筑，只要一楼每天服务街坊邻居，禁止改成私人办公室。
examples.trans: Any courtyard building over eighty years old may not become private offices as long as the ground floor serves neighbours daily.

examples.text: 我们把见面时间改到下午吧。
examples.trans: Let's change our meeting time to the afternoon.

meanings.note: Concise maxim gǎizéshēng ('change and survive').

examples.text: 改则生，不改则死！
examples.trans: Reform and live, fail to reform and die!

examples.text: 老牌栏目唯有秉持改则生的勇气才能常青。
examples.trans: Veteran shows stay evergreen only with the courage to reform.

examples.text: 改变主意。
examples.trans: Change mind.

examples.text: 改变结果。
examples.trans: Change outcome.

meanings.note: Verb-object phrase gǎibiàn zhǔyi ('change one's decision').

examples.text: 我改变主意了，你回行政部吧。
examples.trans: I changed my mind—head back to administration.

examples.text: 原本定在室外拍，因为下雨临时改变主意了。
examples.trans: Originally set outdoors, rain made us change our minds.

examples.text: 一夜之间，广告商全改口支持咱们了啊！
examples.trans: Overnight, every single advertiser changed their tune to back us!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Idiom gǎitóu huànmiàn ('take on a completely new look').

examples.text: 他接手短短几周就让老节目改头换面。
examples.trans: Weeks after taking over, he gave the old show a fresh face.

examples.text: 改版后的演播室彻底改头换面了。
examples.trans: After the revamp, the studio looked brand new.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gǎi jiàn. Used for remodeling an old building into something new.

examples.text: 志豪先生，看第一页：下个月改建商业办公室。我们完了！
examples.trans: Mr Zhihao, look at page one: commercial office conversion next month. We are finished!

examples.text: 这间书房是由老阁楼改建成的。
examples.trans: This study was converted from the old attic.

meanings.note: Media verb/noun gǎibǎn ('overhaul a programme format').

examples.text: 既然文娱论正在酝酿改版，就从这期开始。
examples.trans: Since the show is preparing a revamp, start here.

examples.text: 改版以后的栏目更受年轻观众欢迎。
examples.trans: The revamped show is much more popular with youth.

meanings.note: Verb-object gǎiháng ('enter a new line of work').

examples.text: 淳于乔路子太野了，我看我还是改行算了。
examples.trans: Chun Yuqiao's moves are so wild I might as well switch careers.

examples.text: 他以前当记者，后来改行做电视编导了。
examples.trans: He used to be a reporter before switching to TV directing.

meanings.note: Verb gǎijìn ('make improvements to').

examples.text: 哪些点不满意你提出来，我们改进。
examples.trans: Point out whichever parts fall short and we will improve.

examples.text: 团队每周都会开会改进制作流程。
examples.trans: The team meets weekly to improve production workflow.

改邪归正.gloss: turn over a new leaf, mend one's ways

meanings.en: turn over a new leaf, mend one's ways
meanings.note: Idiom gǎixié-guīzhèng ('give up crooked ways for honest work').

examples.text: 所以我愿意改邪归正，好好跟星天合作。
examples.trans: So I am ready to turn over a new leaf and partner with Xingtian.

examples.text: 只要真心改邪归正，大家还是欢迎合作的。
examples.trans: Anyone who genuinely mends their ways is welcome to cooperate.

meanings.note: Verb/noun gǎigé ('institutional reform').

examples.text: 公司里一些元老一直比较抵触管理改革。
examples.trans: Some company veterans have pushed back against reform.

examples.text: 这次改革提高了整个制作事业部的效率。
examples.trans: This reform boosted efficiency across the whole division.

meanings.note: Verb/noun gōngjī ('attack verbally or physically').

examples.text: 这种恶意的攻击和构陷非常无耻。
examples.trans: Such malicious attacks and framing are shameless.

examples.text: 不要在网络上对他人进行人身攻击。
examples.trans: Do not make personal attacks against others online.

examples.text: 我都搞不定，还指望她能攻破啊？
examples.trans: If even I can't crack them, do you really expect her to break through?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fàng. Everyday verb for placing an object somewhere (放在桌子上).

examples.text: 我们不知道。有人放在台阶上，按了门铃。
examples.trans: We do not know. Someone set it on the step and rang the bell.

examples.text: 小勺子和餐巾放在哪里？
examples.trans: Where do the small spoons and napkins go?

related.gloss: handle with care (lift gently, set down gently)

examples.text: 那天其实我就是随便说说，你不用把我的话放在心上。
examples.trans: That night I was just chatting casually; you really didn't need to take my words so much to heart.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.en: to give up; to abandon; to waive (a goal, opportunity, or right)
meanings.note: Pronounced fàngqì; can be used intransitively ('quit trying') or transitively before an opportunity, plan, or right.

examples.text: 你真的想放弃去电视台工作的机会吗？
examples.trans: Do you really want to give up the opportunity to work at the TV station?

examples.text: 就算遇到再大的困难，我们团队也绝不会轻易放弃。
examples.trans: No matter how great the difficulties we encounter, our team will never give up easily.

related.gloss: to part with; to let go of

meanings.note: Pinyin: fàng xīn. Literally 'set one's heart down' (请放心 'rest assured!').

examples.text: 放心吧，周经理。房间干净，毛巾也是新的。
examples.trans: Relax, Manager Zhou. The room is clean, and the towels are fresh.

examples.text: 放心吧，老陈，我们替你保密！
examples.trans: Rest assured, Chen—we will keep your secret!

related.gloss: handle with care (lift gently, set down gently)

examples.text: 大家一致认为本土化是电视发展的正途。你就放心大胆干吧，我保证他们通过改版。
examples.trans: Everyone agrees homegrown innovation is television's true path forward — go ahead boldly, and I guarantee they'll approve it.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Verb-object fàngshǒu ('let go, move on').

examples.text: 既然分手了，就彻底放手吧。
examples.trans: Since we broke up, let us let go completely.

examples.text: 放心放手去做吧。
examples.trans: Go ahead and do it boldly.

examples.text: 淳于总这个人高深莫测，后招很多的，我劝您也别太放松了。
examples.trans: Mr Chun Yu is unfathomable and always keeps backup moves up his sleeve, so I advise you not to relax too soon either.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Giving free rein to emotions, impulses, or habits.

examples.text: 她暗下决心，以后绝不再任性地放纵自己的情绪。
examples.trans: She vowed never to indulge her emotional impulses like that again.

examples.text: 高强度工作之余，偶尔吃顿夜宵也算小小的放纵。
examples.trans: Alongside intense work, a late-night snack is a small indulgence.

meanings.note: Adjective fàngsì ('reckless, unrestrained').

examples.text: 你要是不教训他，他会越来越放肆的。
examples.trans: If you do not check him, he only grows more reckless.

examples.text: 在公开场合说话不能这么放肆。
examples.trans: One cannot speak so recklessly in public.

meanings.note: Letting go of tension or overwork.

examples.text: 准备工作都做好了，你就尽管放轻松吧。
examples.trans: All prep is done, so go ahead and take it easy.

examples.text: 深呼吸一下，上台演讲时尽量放轻松。
examples.trans: Take a deep breath and stay relaxed on stage.

examples.text: 把新鲜的柠檬片放进去，红茶的味道会更清香。
examples.trans: Put the fresh lemon slices in and the black tea will smell even more fragrant.

examples.text: 木盒太小了，这本厚厚的相册恐怕没法放进去。
examples.trans: The wooden box is too small; I am afraid this thick photo album cannot fit inside.

meanings.note: Sensitive risk beyond ordinary commercial loss.

examples.text: 跨国取景拍摄有时会面临意想不到的政治风险。
examples.trans: Filming across borders can run into unexpected political risks.

examples.text: 这种敏感的政治风险根本无法用金钱来衡量。
examples.trans: Sensitive political risk like this cannot be measured in money.

meanings.note: Noun zhèngcè ('official policy').

examples.text: 这是谁定的公关政策？
examples.trans: Who set this public-relations policy?

examples.text: 公司出台了新的福利政策。
examples.trans: The company introduced a new benefits policy.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gù shi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个故事 ('a story').

examples.text: 宋老师早上讲了我们星期五的故事，小美特意烤的。
examples.trans: After Teacher Song told our Friday story this morning, Mei baked it specially.

examples.text: 这栋老砖房里有很多温暖的故事。
examples.trans: This old brick house holds many warm stories.

故作潇洒.gloss: put on a carefree front, feign nonchalance

meanings.en: put on a carefree front, feign nonchalance
meanings.note: Pretending to breeze off lightly despite real reluctance.

examples.text: 明明心里舍不得离开，他表面上却还在故作潇洒。
examples.trans: Reluctant at heart to leave, on the surface he put on a breezy front.

examples.text: 分手那天两人都故作潇洒地微笑着挥手道别。
examples.trans: On the day they parted, both put on a brave, carefree smile.

meanings.note: Adverb gùyì ('intentionally').

examples.text: 如果让老大知道，他只会故意不理。
examples.trans: If our boss finds out, he will deliberately ignore it.

examples.text: 对不起，我刚才不是故意打断你的。
examples.trans: Sorry, I did not interrupt you on purpose just now.

meanings.note: Polite verb xiàoláo ('serve, lend a hand').

examples.text: 请问有什么可以为您效劳的吗？
examples.trans: How may I be of service to you?

examples.text: 能为优秀的音乐人效劳是我们的荣幸。
examples.trans: Serving talented musicians is an honour for us.

examples.text: 效果好。
examples.trans: Good effect.

examples.text: 看效果。
examples.trans: See the result.

examples.text: 总编室是个讲究效率的地方。
examples.trans: The chief editor's office is a place that cares about efficiency.

examples.text: 总编室是个讲究效率的地方。
examples.trans: The chief editor's office is a place that cares about efficiency.

meanings.note: Noun xiàoyì ('financial return or benefit').

examples.text: 跟风模仿只是为了追求短期的效益。
examples.trans: Copycatting merely chases short-term returns.

examples.text: 优秀原创节目能带来长期的品牌效益。
examples.trans: Original hit shows bring lasting brand value.

meanings.note: Noun dí ('enemy, opponent').

examples.text: 亲可成仇，敌可化友。
examples.trans: Close allies can become foes, and enemies can become friends.

examples.text: 商场如战场，但也不必把同行都当成敌。
examples.trans: Business is tough, yet peers need not be treated as foes.

meanings.note: An opponent or rival one stands against.

examples.text: 在商场上不要轻易树敌，把朋友变成敌人。
examples.trans: In business, do not turn friends into enemies lightly.

examples.text: 懒惰才是进步最大的敌人。
examples.trans: Laziness is the greatest enemy of progress.

meanings.note: Applies to touchy public issues or perceptive people.

examples.text: 上市公司高层的人事变动对外界而言非常敏感。
examples.trans: Senior personnel shifts at a listed firm are sensitive externally.

examples.text: 他其实是个心思细腻敏感、自尊心很强的人。
examples.trans: Beneath the surface he is sensitive, perceptive, and proud.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù. Used for saving a historic building or rescuing breakfast.

examples.text: 你们这些好人真是救了我这趟旅行。
examples.trans: You kind people have truly saved this whole trip of mine.

examples.text: 呼，好在反应快，早餐又有救了！
examples.trans: Phew, quick thinking saves breakfast once again!

examples.text: 多亏邻居及时帮忙，才在暴风雨前救下了庭院里的花盆。
examples.trans: Thanks to the neighbor's timely help, the flowerpots in the courtyard were saved before the storm.

examples.text: 他在旧书摊上偶然救下了这本差点被当废纸卖掉的日记。
examples.trans: At a secondhand bookstall he happened to rescue this diary that was nearly sold off as scrap paper.

meanings.note: Verb/noun jiùzhù ('charitable relief, rescue').

examples.text: 提前选好几家需要资助的救助中心。
examples.trans: Pre-select several aid centres in need of support.

examples.text: 基金会长期参与儿童医疗救助。
examples.trans: The foundation supports children's medical aid.

meanings.note: Noun jiùhùchē ('emergency ambulance').

examples.text: 这样不行，我马上给您叫救护车！
examples.trans: This will not do — I am calling an ambulance right now!

examples.text: 救护车五分钟之内就赶到了路口。
examples.trans: The ambulance arrived at the intersection within five minutes.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù xīng. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位救星 ('a lifesaver').

examples.text: 小晴你真是救星！先给我牛奶冲咖啡。
examples.trans: Qing, you are a lifesaver! Hand me the milk first to make coffee.

examples.text: 你带了备用伞来，真是我的大救星！
examples.trans: You brought a spare umbrella—you are a real lifesaver!

救火.gloss: put out a fire; step into an emergency crisis

meanings.en: put out a fire; step into an emergency crisis
meanings.note: Verb-object jiùhuǒ ('troubleshoot an urgent crisis').

examples.text: 听见外面乱成一团，你又想去帮他们救火了？
examples.trans: Hearing chaos outside, are you itching to go rescue them again?

examples.text: 每次节目遇到突发状况，大家都指望他出面救火。
examples.trans: Whenever a show hits an emergency, everyone counts on him to save it.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiāo. Read first tone jiāo when teaching a skill or person (教钢琴 'teach piano').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 何止认识！整整六年，每个星期五我都爬那座木楼梯教钢琴！
examples.trans: More than know it! Every Friday for six whole years I climbed those wooden stairs to teach piano!

meanings.note: Pronounced jiàoshòu; placed after a surname when used as a form of address (e.g., 方教授 'Professor Fang').
Pronounced jiàoshòu (or jiāoshòu in older usage) as a formal transitive verb meaning 'to impart knowledge or skills'.

examples.text: 我想问一下，方教授在哪办公啊？
examples.trans: May I ask where Professor Fang has his office?

examples.text: 小谷同学，先来认识一下学位评委的各位教授。
examples.trans: Xiaogu, come meet the professors on the degree committee first.

meanings.note: Noun jiàoliàn ('coach, trainer').

examples.text: 这位就是咱们节目组请的资深潜水教练。
examples.trans: Here is the senior scuba instructor hired by our show.

examples.text: 下水之前请认真听潜水教练讲解安全手势。
examples.trans: Listen closely as the diving coach explains safety hand signals.

meanings.note: Verb/noun jiàoxun ('chasten; hard lesson').

examples.text: 这种自大的人真该好好教训一下。
examples.trans: Someone that arrogant needs to be taught a lesson.

examples.text: 我们要从这次失误里吸取教训。
examples.trans: We must draw lessons from this mistake.

meanings.en: throw wide open; leave wide open
meanings.note: Pinyin: chǎng kāi. Describes gates or windows opened wide.

examples.text: 敬好邻居、热面包，还有敞开的大门！
examples.trans: To good neighbours, warm bread, and wide-open gates!

examples.text: 每天早上八点，小院木门准时敞开。
examples.trans: Every morning at eight, the wooden courtyard gates swing wide open.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gǎn. Modal verb expressing courage to act (不敢相信 'dare not believe').

examples.text: 真不敢相信您也住在这家客栈，宋老师。
examples.trans: I can hardly believe you are staying at this very same inn, Teacher Song.

examples.text: 我真不敢相信这个好消息。
examples.trans: I can hardly believe this good news.

meanings.note: Rhetorical challenge rallying courage.

examples.text: 为了讨回公道，你们敢不敢跟我一起去？
examples.trans: To seek justice, do you dare come with me or not?

examples.text: 这么大胆的直播方案，你敢不敢试一次？
examples.trans: With a live plan this bold, do you dare give it a shot?

meanings.note: Colloquial verb for a group splitting up.

examples.text: 不管遇到多大阻力，总编室铁三角绝不散伙。
examples.trans: Whatever resistance they face, the editorial trio will never break up.

examples.text: 乐队成员约定毕业以后也绝对不散伙。
examples.trans: The band members promised never to disband even after graduation.

meanings.note: Verb-object sànhuì ('dismiss a meeting').

examples.text: 没什么问题的话，那咱们就散会。
examples.trans: If there are no further questions, let us adjourn.

examples.text: 散会以后请大家留一下。
examples.trans: Please stay a moment after the meeting adjourns.

meanings.note: Lyrical prose with poetic rhythm and imagery.

examples.text: 网友把那段优美的即兴主持誉为一首动人的散文诗。
examples.trans: Netizens hailed that lyrical impromptu hosting as a moving prose poem.

examples.text: 她在读书会上朗诵了一篇关于雨夜的散文诗。
examples.trans: At the book club she recited a prose poem about a rainy night.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sàn bù. Separable verb-object compound (散一会儿步 'stroll for a while'); 散步线索 ('walking clue').

examples.text: 每张卡片上都写着一句押韵的梧桐巷散步线索。
examples.trans: Written on each card is a rhyming walking clue along Wutong Lane.

examples.text: 吃过晚饭，邻居们喜欢在公园树荫底下慢慢散步。
examples.trans: After dinner, neighbours love strolling unhurriedly beneath the park's shady trees.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jìng. Used when raising a teacup or glass in honor of someone (敬你一杯 'toast you a cup').

examples.text: 敬好邻居、热面包，还有敞开的大门！
examples.trans: To good neighbours, warm bread, and wide-open gates!

examples.text: 我以热茶代酒，敬您一杯。
examples.trans: With hot tea in place of wine, I raise a cup to you.

examples.text: 当然要尊重她的意思，但是她一向都很敬业，工作上一直都很认真。
examples.trans: Naturally we respect her wishes, though she has always been thoroughly dedicated to her work.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.en: respect deeply; hold in high esteem
meanings.note: Pinyin: jìng zhòng. Warm, respectful verb for admiring elders or teachers.

examples.text: 别瞒了，小晴，我们很专业！先生，我们敬重成都旅游指南！
examples.trans: No hiding it, Qing, let's be professional! Sir, we respect the Chengdu Travel Guide!

examples.text: 整条巷子的街坊都很敬重宋老师。
examples.trans: Neighbors all along the lane deeply respect Teacher Song.

meanings.note: Noun shù ('count; certainty in 心里有数').

examples.text: 你以为雷总心里一点数都没有吗？
examples.trans: Do you think Director Lei has no idea what goes on?

examples.text: 经费还剩多少，我心里有数。
examples.trans: I have a clear count of how much budget remains.

examples.text: 就一定能够征服有数千年文化情感的东方观众？
examples.trans: is enough to win over Eastern audiences shaped by thousands of years of cultural emotion?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shù zì. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个数字 ('a number / digit').

examples.text: 全是灰色小数字！我看到第一页心就停了！
examples.trans: Nothing but tiny grey numbers! My heart stopped at page one!

examples.text: 把上面铜牌的灰尘擦掉……等等，快念那个数字！
examples.trans: Brush the dust off the brass plate on top... wait, read that number!

examples.text: 这部分数据是实习助理布小谷做的。
examples.trans: This section of data was prepared by intern assistant Bu Xiaogu.

examples.text: 这部分数据是实习助理布小谷做的。
examples.trans: This section of data was prepared by intern assistant Bu Xiaogu.

meanings.note: Structured report backed by audience or market metrics.

examples.text: 粉团科技连夜赶制出了一份详实的数据报告。
examples.trans: Fentuan Tech worked overnight to produce a thorough data report.

examples.text: 用权威的数据报告说话比空口推荐更有说服力。
examples.trans: Speaking with an authoritative data report persuades far better than talk.

examples.text: 数量很大。
examples.trans: The quantity is very large.

examples.text: 保证数量。
examples.trans: Guarantee the quantity.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiāo. Used for knocking on doors or pipes clanking.

examples.text: 听……街口钟楼开始敲十二下了！
examples.trans: Listen... the clock tower at the end of the street is starting to strike twelve!

examples.text: 十二下敲完了……大门外面街上空荡荡的。
examples.trans: Twelve chimes have finished... and the street outside the gate is completely empty.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiāo zhòng. Resultative compound 敲 ('strike/knock') + 中 (zhòng, 4th tone 'hit the target').

examples.text: 包着毛毡的琴槌稳稳敲中了三根钢丝琴弦。
examples.trans: The felt-wrapped piano hammer struck the three steel strings squarely.

examples.text: 鼓槌清脆地敲中鼓心，发出了洪亮的声音。
examples.trans: The drumstick struck the center of the drum crisply with a resonant sound.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiāo jī. Describes rhythmic tapping or knocking in pipes.

examples.text: 非常安静！不过刚才你听到奇怪的金属敲击声了吗？
examples.trans: Very quiet! Though did you hear a strange metallic knocking sound just now?

examples.text: 雨点轻轻敲击着三楼的木窗。
examples.trans: Raindrops tapped softly against the third-floor wooden window.

examples.text: 这是敲定啊。
examples.trans: This is lock in.

examples.text: 那个敲定好。
examples.trans: That lock in is good.

敲敲.gloss: give a quick tap; knock lightly

meanings.en: give a quick tap; knock lightly
meanings.note: Pinyin: qiāo qiāo. Reduplication of 敲 ('knock, tap'), expressing a brief, tentative, or friendly tap.

examples.text: 老陈，用你的木头把手敲敲石板中间，听听是不是空的。
examples.trans: Chen, tap the middle of the flagstone with your wooden handle to hear whether it is hollow.

examples.text: 进四号房以前，小晴先在木门上轻轻敲敲。
examples.trans: Before stepping into Room Four, Qing gave a gentle tap on the wooden door first.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiāo mén. Separable verb-object compound.

examples.text: 打扰一下，志豪先生？不好意思这么晚敲门。
examples.trans: Excuse me, Mr Zhihao? Sorry to knock so late.

examples.text: 进客人的房间以前一定要先敲门。
examples.trans: Always knock before entering a guest's room.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhěng. Combines with a measure word to mean 'the entire' (整条街 'the whole street', 整栋楼 'the whole building').

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

examples.text: 今晚半价，而且一整周早餐免费！
examples.trans: Half price tonight, plus free breakfast all week!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhěng gè. Combines 整 ('whole') + 个; modifies singular nouns directly without another measure word (整个中央八度).

examples.text: 修好那根琴槌以后，宋老师给整个中央八度调了音。
examples.trans: After fixing that hammer, Teacher Song tuned the entire middle octave.

examples.text: 柠檬挞的香味飘满了整个咖啡角。
examples.trans: The aroma of lemon tart drifted through the entire café corner.

meanings.note: Verb zhěnghé ('merge and align resources').

examples.text: 一个小时之后两个团队开始整合。
examples.trans: In one hour the two teams begin integrating.

examples.text: 台里希望把红毯资源整合进来。
examples.trans: The network wants to integrate the red-carpet coverage.

meanings.note: Phrase zhěngtuán ('a whole organized group').

examples.text: 一会儿有整团的粉丝要过来占位置。
examples.trans: A whole group of fans is coming over shortly.

examples.text: 整团的演员都已经到了后台。
examples.trans: The entire troupe of performers has arrived backstage.

examples.text: 上个月你三天绕地球飞了一整圈，回来开电话会议，中文英文一个字没错过。
examples.trans: Last month you flew around the globe in three days and took a bilingual conference call without missing a single word!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhěng yè. Combines 整 ('whole') + 夜 ('night').

examples.text: 三十年前的那个五月十号，成都整夜都在下大雨。
examples.trans: On that May tenth thirty years ago, heavy rain fell all night in Chengdu.

examples.text: 春雨整夜轻轻敲打着小院的青瓦屋顶。
examples.trans: Spring rain pattered softly on the courtyard's grey-tiled roof all night.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhěng tiān. Combines 整 ('whole') + 天 ('day').

examples.text: 要是星期一整天都下大雨，我们就没法在院子里刷漆了。
examples.trans: If heavy rain falls all day Monday, we won't be able to paint in the courtyard.

examples.text: 小美整天都在厨房里忙着试烤新点心。
examples.trans: Mei was busy in the kitchen all day test-baking new pastries.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhěng pái. Combines 整 ('whole') + measure word 排 ('row/line').

examples.text: 透过擦亮的玻璃，能看见院子里整排金黄的灯笼。
examples.trans: Through the polished glass, you can see the whole line of golden lanterns in the courtyard.

examples.text: 钢琴盖打开后，露出了里面整整齐齐的整排琴槌。
examples.trans: Once the piano panel opened, it revealed the neat whole row of hammers inside.

meanings.note: Verb zhěnggǎi ('inspect and reform after an issue').

examples.text: 节目现在暂时停播整改。
examples.trans: The show is temporarily suspended for overhaul.

examples.text: 工厂下周完成安全整改。
examples.trans: The plant finishes safety rectifications next week.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhéng zhěng. Placed before numbers to stress entirety (整整六年 'six whole years').

examples.text: 何止认识！整整六年，每个星期五我都爬那座木楼梯教钢琴！
examples.trans: More than know it! Every Friday for six whole years I climbed those wooden stairs to teach piano!

examples.text: 这架老钢琴他已经弹了整整三十年。
examples.trans: He has played this old piano for a full thirty years.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhěng zhěng qí qí. AABB reduplication of 整齐 ('neat/orderly'), often followed by 地 before verbs or 的 before nouns.

examples.text: 十二个白茶杯整整齐齐地摆在木托盘上。
examples.trans: Twelve white teacups are lined up neatly on the wooden tray.

examples.text: 小晴把前台的账本和钥匙收得整整齐齐。
examples.trans: Qing tidied up the front-desk ledgers and keys in neat order.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhéng lǐ. Used for tidying a room, desk, or luggage.

examples.text: 失陪一下，宋老师，我先回办公室整理一下！
examples.trans: Excuse me a moment, Teacher Song; I shall step back to my office to tidy up!

examples.text: 擦亮铜钥匙、整理领带十五年……三十天就全没了！
examples.trans: Fifteen years of polishing brass keys and straightening ties... gone in thirty days!

meanings.note: Determiner+classifier zhěngpiān ('the whole piece of writing').

examples.text: 您不会打算让我整篇报道都发不出去吧？
examples.trans: Surely you will not block my entire article from coming out?

examples.text: 主编把整篇采访稿从头到尾审了一遍。
examples.trans: The editor reviewed the entire interview piece end to end.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhěng qí. Describes neatly arranged keys, chairs, or handwriting.

examples.text: 上面怎么用铅笔整齐画了这条街三家客栈？
examples.trans: Why are three inns on this street neatly sketched in pencil on it?

examples.text: 明信片上整齐的方格字，我两秒钟就认出来了。
examples.trans: That neat block handwriting on the postcard—I recognized it in two seconds.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wén jiàn. Measure word (量词): 份 (fèn), e.g. 一份文件 ('a document').

examples.text: 整份文件还没读完呢，周经理，别先认输。
examples.trans: We have not even finished reading the whole document, Manager Zhou—don't give up yet.

examples.text: 请把桌上的那份合同文件拿给我。
examples.trans: Please hand me that contract document on the desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wén jiàn jiā. Combines 文件 ('document/file') + 夹 ('clip/folder'); measure word: 个 (gè).

examples.text: 门外站着一个人，手里还拿着一个正式的文件夹呢！
examples.trans: Someone is standing outside the front gate holding an official file folder!

examples.text: 周经理把市政厅寄来的审核清单整齐地收进了蓝色文件夹里。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou filed the review checklist from City Hall neatly inside a blue folder.

meanings.note: Noun wénhuà ('culture').

examples.text: 现在的粉丝文化已经很发达了。
examples.trans: Fan culture today has grown very developed.

examples.text: 优秀的电视节目能传播传统文化。
examples.trans: Great television shows help share traditional culture.

meanings.note: Noun wénhuàrén ('cultured scholar/commentator').

examples.text: 你说你作为一个文化人。
examples.trans: Look at you, calling yourself a person of culture.

examples.text: 这位老教授是一位受人尊敬的文化人。
examples.trans: This senior professor is a respected person of culture.

文化大国.gloss: major cultural nation, country rich in heritage

meanings.en: major cultural nation, country rich in heritage
meanings.note: Set phrase in cultural commentary.

examples.text: 作为历史悠久的文化大国，我们不缺好故事。
examples.trans: As a nation rich in cultural heritage, we never lack good stories.

examples.text: 把文化大国的底蕴转化为好节目需要创新。
examples.trans: Turning rich cultural heritage into great shows takes innovation.

meanings.note: Formal noun wénběn ('written document or script text').

examples.text: 因为老大病着，最终文本还没有给他过目。
examples.trans: With our boss ill, he has not seen the final text yet.

examples.text: 请法务再核对一遍合同的正式文本。
examples.trans: Have legal double-check the formal contract text.

meanings.note: Noun wénzhāng ('written article').

examples.text: 我们已经把整件事写成了文章。
examples.trans: We have already written the whole affair up as an article.

examples.text: 她写的行业评论文章观点非常犀利。
examples.trans: Her industry commentary articles have sharp insights.

斗.gloss: contend with, fight against, vie with

meanings.en: contend with, fight against, vie with
meanings.note: Competing or clashing in workplace or games.

examples.text: 在专业能力上他从来斗不过那位王牌制作人。
examples.trans: In sheer professional skill he could never beat that ace producer.

examples.text: 与其在公司内部勾心斗角跟人斗，不如联手做大市场。
examples.trans: Instead of office infighting, team up to grow the market.

examples.text: 布小谷，你别告诉我你到现在还觉得是老大在搞人事斗争！
examples.trans: Bu Xiaogu, don't tell me you still think our boss ousted him over petty office politics!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Colloquial noun liào ('newsworthy scoop; material').

examples.text: 这些狗仔也太没料了，去医院也要拍。
examples.trans: These paparazzi have zero real scoops, filming a hospital trip.

examples.text: 这期访谈干货满满，全都是观众爱听的猛料。
examples.trans: This interview is packed with great stories viewers love.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xié. Describes sunlight slanting across a courtyard or a tilted angle.

examples.text: 听我把箱子斜过来——里面有金属东西滑了一下。
examples.trans: Listen as I tilt the box—something metal slid inside.

examples.text: 温暖的阳光斜照在木地板上。
examples.trans: Warm sunlight slants across the wooden floor.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiépō. Measure word: 个.

examples.text: 汽车艰难地爬上了陡峭的斜坡。
examples.trans: The car climbed the steep slope with difficulty.

examples.text: 小孩子们喜欢在斜坡上滑草。
examples.trans: Children like to grass-ski on the slope.

meanings.note: Pinyin: duàn. Often a result after another verb: 烧断 ('burn through'), 摔断 ('break in a fall').

examples.text: 是旧电线，把一楼的保险丝烧断了。
examples.trans: It was the old wire—it blew the ground-floor fuse.

examples.text: 电话突然断了。
examples.trans: The phone call suddenly cut off.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīn. Everyday adjective for new people, items, or beginnings.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 放心吧，周经理。房间干净，毛巾也是新的。
examples.trans: Relax, Manager Zhou. The room is clean, and the towels are fresh.

examples.text: 你们星天要是不嫌弃的话，我个人愿意出任新一季十二歌王的主持人。
examples.trans: If Xingtian doesn't mind, I would personally love to serve as host for the new season of Twelve Singers.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 想带新人随便，但是别带到制作会上来。
examples.trans: Mentor newcomers all you like, but do not bring them to the production meeting.

examples.text: 想带新人随便，但是别带到制作会上来。
examples.trans: Mentor newcomers all you like, but do not bring them to the production meeting.

meanings.note: Attributive xīnrèn ('newly appointed to office').

examples.text: 这是我们星天新任的首席内容官。
examples.trans: This is Xingtian's newly appointed Chief Content Officer.

examples.text: 新任制片人一上任就提出了大胆的改革。
examples.trans: Right on taking office, the new producer proposed bold reforms.

meanings.note: Media noun xīnjù ('new TV/stage drama').

examples.text: 希望中国观众能够早日看到您的这部新剧。
examples.trans: We hope Chinese viewers will soon see your new drama series.

examples.text: 这部职场新剧开播首日就拿下了收视冠军。
examples.trans: This new workplace drama topped ratings on opening night.

meanings.note: Noun xīnyì ('creative novelty').

examples.text: 相比之下，布小谷的策划更有新意。
examples.trans: By comparison, Bu Xiaogu's plan has fresher ideas.

examples.text: 观众喜欢有新意的访谈环节。
examples.trans: Viewers love talk-show segments with fresh angles.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīn shǒu. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个新手 ('a newcomer').

examples.text: 第二天上班，干得不错，新手。
examples.trans: For day two on the job, nicely done, rookie.

examples.text: 虽然她是新手，做事却非常有条理。
examples.trans: Even though she is new to the job, she works very methodically.

新来乍到.gloss: newly arrived, brand-new to a place

meanings.en: newly arrived, brand-new to a place
meanings.note: Idiom for being a newcomer unfamiliar with local ways.

examples.text: 咱们新来乍到，还是先低调一点摸清情况再说。
examples.trans: Since we just arrived, better keep a low profile and learn the ropes first.

examples.text: 同事们热情地帮助新来乍到的实习生熟悉环境。
examples.trans: Colleagues warmly helped the newly arrived interns settle in.

examples.text: 十二歌王第二期今晚录影，今天晚上我们会推出一首新歌，作者是钟阳子。
examples.trans: Episode Two of Twelve Singers tapes tonight, and this evening we will debut a brand-new song written by Zhong Yangzi.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Noun xīnqìxiàng ('revitalised spirit and look').

examples.text: 监制四期之后，节目有了点新气象。
examples.trans: After four supervised episodes, the show has a fresh look.

examples.text: 新的一年，办公室里到处是新气象。
examples.trans: The new year brings a fresh energy to the office.

meanings.note: Noun xīnbǎn ('new version').

examples.text: 新版的文娱论完全符合电视台的要求。
examples.trans: The revamped talk show fully meets network standards.

examples.text: 新版的片头曲听起来更有活力。
examples.trans: The new version's theme music sounds livelier.

meanings.note: Noun xīnxiù ('promising new talent').

examples.text: 双败淘汰制增加了歌坛新秀的出镜率。
examples.trans: Double elimination boosts screen time for rising vocal talents.

examples.text: 今年比赛涌现出好几位实力不俗的乐坛新秀。
examples.trans: Several impressive musical newcomers emerged this season.

examples.text: 没事没事，你买了新车？
examples.trans: I'm fine — wait, you bought a new car?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 我看新闻了。
examples.trans: I watched the news.

examples.text: 这是一个大新闻。
examples.trans: This is big news.

meanings.note: Academic noun xīnwénxué ('the field of journalism').

examples.text: 我是新闻学和艺术管理双硕士毕业。
examples.trans: I graduated with dual master's degrees in journalism and arts.

examples.text: 她在大学里主修广播电视新闻学。
examples.trans: She majored in broadcast journalism at university.

examples.text: 我们的战略合作也签约了，现在正是我们有余力开发新项目的时候。
examples.trans: Our overseas strategic partnership is signed too, so right now is the exact moment we have the strength to develop new projects.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīn xiān. Describes fresh fruit, fresh juice, or fresh herbs.

examples.text: 好。端上去之前，在上面撒这些新鲜绿香草。
examples.trans: Good. Before serving them, sprinkle these fresh green herbs on top.

examples.text: 闻闻看！热面包、热炒蛋，还有新鲜香草。
examples.trans: Smell that! Warm bread, hot scrambled eggs, and fresh herbs.

examples.text: 兔子不吃窝边草，明白吗？你要是天天上班下班跟她见面，新鲜感没有了。
examples.trans: A smart rabbit doesn't graze right by its burrow, get it? If you see her at work every single day, all the spark disappears.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 感觉非常好，还要谢谢方老师推荐。
examples.trans: It feels great, and I also want to thank Professor Fang for the recommendation.

examples.text: 这是方。
examples.trans: This is 方.

meanings.note: Polite A-not-A fāngbufāngbiàn ('is it convenient or alright?').

examples.text: 这条视频您看方不方便把它撤掉？
examples.trans: Would it be convenient for you to remove this clip?

examples.text: 请问您现在方不方便接个电话？
examples.trans: Is now a convenient time for you to take a call?

examples.text: 很方便。
examples.trans: Very convenient.

examples.text: 不方便。
examples.trans: Not convenient.

meanings.note: Noun fāngxiàng ('direction, strategic course').

examples.text: 大家都知道要改，问题是往哪个方向改？
examples.trans: Everyone knows we must change — the question is which direction.

examples.text: 总制作人明确了下一季的创作方向。
examples.trans: The chief producer set a clear creative direction.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fāngxiànggǎn.

examples.text: 我的方向感很差，经常迷路。
examples.trans: My sense of direction is very poor, and I often get lost.

examples.text: 在森林里，良好的方向感非常重要。
examples.trans: In the forest, a good sense of direction is very important.

meanings.note: How an action or communication is carried out.

examples.text: 每个人表达关心的方式都不一样。
examples.trans: Everyone has a different way of showing care.

examples.text: 我们可以换一种更温和的沟通方式。
examples.trans: We can switch to a gentler way of communicating.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fāng gé. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个方格 ('a grid square').

examples.text: 明信片上整齐的方格字，我两秒钟就认出来了。
examples.trans: That neat block handwriting on the postcard—I recognized it in two seconds.

examples.text: 他的方格笔记本上画满了建筑草图。
examples.trans: His grid notebook is filled with architectural sketches.

meanings.en: plan; proposal; actionable program or pitch
meanings.note: Pronounced fāng'àn; refers to a structured, concrete plan of action in business or media production (measure words: 个, 套, 份).

examples.text: 淳于总已经批准咱们的方案了。
examples.trans: Director Chun Yu has already approved our proposal.

examples.text: 我们的艺人方案特别重要，不能泄露！
examples.trans: Our guest-artist plan is especially important; it must not leak!

meanings.note: Workplace noun fāng'ànhuì ('pitch/proposal meeting').

examples.text: 还有四天就到十二歌王的方案会了。
examples.trans: The Twelve Singers pitch meeting is only four days away.

examples.text: 大家熬夜准备好了明天方案会要用的资料。
examples.trans: Everyone stayed up preparing materials for tomorrow's pitch.

examples.text: 我自有我的方法，我们这些小员工也不是白痴啊！钟阳子对于这件事情的解决至关重要。
examples.trans: I have my own methods — us junior staffers aren't idiots! Zhong Yangzi is vital to resolving this whole crisis.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: High-level organizational direction.

examples.text: 管理层在年会上明确了坚持原创的战略方针。
examples.trans: At the annual summit management affirmed its original-content policy.

examples.text: 如果按照他的新方针执行，好几档老节目都要调整。
examples.trans: Under his proposed new policy, several established shows would shift.

meanings.note: Noun fāngmiàn ('aspect, area').

examples.text: 就算再努力，在这方面顶多打个平手。
examples.trans: Even at full strength, in this area we tie at best.

examples.text: 她在节目策划和现场执行两方面都很出色。
examples.trans: She excels in both planning and floor execution.

meanings.note: Pinyin: páng. Compact locality noun placed after nouns (钢琴旁 'beside the piano', 窗旁 'by the window').

examples.text: 宋老师正坐在阳光房的钢琴旁微笑呢。
examples.trans: Teacher Song is sitting beside the piano in the sunroom smiling.

examples.text: 客栈大门旁挂着一块擦得发亮的铜牌。
examples.trans: Beside the inn's front gate hangs a brightly polished brass plaque.

meanings.note: Pinyin: páng biān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 旁边位置 ('a spot beside').

examples.text: 旁边的把手上系着一张小纸牌。
examples.trans: There is a small paper card tied on the side handle.

examples.text: 看拉链旁边……对，有她的名字缩写！
examples.trans: Check beside the zipper... yes, her name initials are here!

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǚ yóu. Everyday word for leisure travel.

examples.text: 除非他是写成都旅游指南的神秘评审员！
examples.trans: Unless he is a secret inspector writing the Chengdu Travel Guide!

examples.text: 冰凉的洗澡水？！成都旅游指南评审员就住在三楼啊！
examples.trans: Ice-cold shower water?! The Chengdu Travel Guide inspector is staying on floor three!

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǚ xíng. Measure word (量词): 次 (cì), e.g. 一次旅行 ('a trip').

examples.text: 你们这些好人真是救了我这趟旅行。
examples.trans: You kind people have truly saved this whole trip of mine.

examples.text: 坐早班火车去成都是一次难忘的旅行。
examples.trans: Taking the morning train to Chengdu was an unforgettable trip.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xuán lǜ. Musical melody or tune. Measure word: 段 (duàn, 'passage/melody').

examples.text: 这段钢琴旋律听起来既温柔又熟悉。
examples.trans: This piano melody sounds both gentle and familiar.

examples.text: 哪怕过了很多年，我还是记得那首歌的旋律。
examples.trans: Even after many years, I still remember the melody of that song.

examples.text: 手柄旋转三百六以上，技术犯规。
examples.trans: Spinning the handle past three hundred sixty degrees is a technical foul.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 去年十月二十号的一个会议流程，系统无记录，你有办法查出来吗？
examples.trans: There's an October twentieth workflow from last year missing from the digital system — can you dig it up?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: A-not-A adjective wúbuwúliáo ('are you really that bored/petty?').

examples.text: 发别人的旧照片，你无不无聊啊？
examples.trans: Posting someone's old photo, have you nothing better to do?

examples.text: 老开这种玩笑，你无不无聊？
examples.trans: Making jokes like that, are you really that bored?

examples.text: 她说为了表示对星天公司和淳于乔先生的谢意，这首歌无偿赠给我们。
examples.trans: To express her gratitude to Xingtian and to me, she gifted this song to us completely free of charge.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

无奈之举.gloss: a move made out of necessity

meanings.en: a move made out of necessity
meanings.note: Idiom wúnài-zhījǔ ('reluctant last-resort measure').

examples.text: 写八卦也是无奈之举，为了博个眼球嘛。
examples.trans: Writing gossip was only out of necessity to grab attention.

examples.text: 临时推迟录制实在是无奈之举。
examples.trans: Postponing the taping was truly a reluctant necessity.

无妨.gloss: it does not matter, no harm done

meanings.en: it does not matter, no harm done
meanings.note: Polite literary verb wúfáng ('no harm, quite alright').

examples.text: 客气了，这点小事无妨。
examples.trans: You are too polite—think nothing of so small a matter.

examples.text: 初稿哪怕有些不成熟的想法也无妨，尽管提出来。
examples.trans: Even rough ideas in a first draft are fine—bring them up.

examples.text: 除了工作，我什么都无所谓。所以现在，契约解除。
examples.trans: Outside of work, nothing matters to me at all. So as of right now, our pact is dissolved.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wú dí. Literally 无 ('without') + 敌 ('match/rival'); lively spoken praise for great food or skill.

examples.text: 酥脆的杏仁挞底配上新鲜柠檬，味道简直无敌了！
examples.trans: Crisp almond crust paired with fresh lemon is simply unbeatable!

examples.text: 小美烤的热面包在整条梧桐巷都是无敌的。
examples.trans: Mei's warm baked bread is unbeatable on all of Wutong Lane.

meanings.note: Adverb wúbǐ ('immensely, unmatched').

examples.text: 只要带新人，老大就会无比认真。
examples.trans: Whenever he mentors newcomers, our boss is dead serious.

examples.text: 听到策划通过，她心里无比激动。
examples.trans: Hearing her pitch passed, she felt thrilled beyond words.

无法.gloss: unable to, have no way to

meanings.en: unable to, have no way to
meanings.note: Verb wúfǎ ('cannot, have no means to').

examples.text: 真无法想象他经历了多少困难。
examples.trans: It is impossible to imagine how much he went through.

examples.text: 今天航班延误，无法按时到达。
examples.trans: With flights delayed today, we cannot arrive on time.

无理取闹.gloss: make a scene unreasonably, pick a quarrel on purpose

meanings.en: make a scene unreasonably, pick a quarrel on purpose
meanings.note: Idiom wúlǐ-qǔnào ('be deliberately unreasonable').

examples.text: 我刚才就是无理取闹，而且是故意的！
examples.trans: I was making an unreasonable scene just now—and on purpose!

examples.text: 遇到分歧要讲道理，胡乱无理取闹解决不了问题。
examples.trans: Talk disagreements through calmly; making a scene solves nothing.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wú yán. Baking label meaning 'salt-free' (无盐黄油 'unsalted butter').

examples.text: 那是海盐咸黄油！甜果酱面包卷要无盐黄油！
examples.trans: That is sea-salt butter! Sweet jam rolls need unsalted butter!

examples.text: 烤柠檬蛋糕需要用新鲜的无盐黄油。
examples.trans: Baking lemon cake calls for fresh unsalted butter.

meanings.note: Adjective wúchǐ ('without shame').

examples.text: 这种恶意构陷是非常无耻的。
examples.trans: Such malicious framing is utterly shameless.

examples.text: 抄袭别人心血的行为十分无耻。
examples.trans: Plagiarising someone else's hard work is shameless.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wú liáo. Describes dull paperwork or feeling bored.

examples.text: 欢迎来到小院客栈，小晴。明天不会无聊了。
examples.trans: Welcome to Courtyard Inn, Qing. Tomorrow will not be boring.

examples.text: 多半是粉刷街边木窗那种无聊通知吧。
examples.trans: Probably some boring notice about painting the street shutters.

无论.gloss: no matter (who, what, how), regardless of

meanings.en: no matter (who, what, how), regardless of
meanings.note: Conjunction wúlùn ('regardless of').

examples.text: 无论在什么样的人面前，我也只是做自己。
examples.trans: No matter who stands before me, I am simply myself.

examples.text: 无论遇到多大困难，直播都不能中断。
examples.trans: No matter how big the hurdle, the broadcast must go on.

meanings.note: Fixed phrase wúlùnrúhé ('under any circumstances').

examples.text: 无论如何，这次一定要让他们顺利上节目。
examples.trans: No matter what, we must get them onto the show smoothly.

examples.text: 无论如何我今晚都要把方案改完。
examples.trans: No matter what, I will finish revising the plan tonight.

meanings.note: Adjective wúxiànliàng ('without limit').

examples.text: 老大投入的时间和精力就会无限量地多。
examples.trans: The time and energy our boss invests becomes limitless.

examples.text: 休息室里无限量供应热茶和咖啡。
examples.trans: Hot tea and coffee are available without limit in the lounge.

meanings.note: Adverb wúfēi ('merely, simply').

examples.text: 你们拍视频无非是为了回馈粉丝。
examples.trans: You shot the video simply to give back to fans.

examples.text: 大家加班无非是想把节目做到最好。
examples.trans: Everyone works late simply to make the best show.

meanings.note: Correlative conjunction jì ('both ... and ...').

examples.text: 这样做既能体现价值，又很务实。
examples.trans: Doing this both reflects values and stays practical.

examples.text: 这位主持人既幽默又专业。
examples.trans: This host is both witty and professional.

examples.text: 既然来了。
examples.trans: Since arrived.

examples.text: 既然如此。
examples.trans: Since it is so.
