meanings.note: Pinyin: rì guāng. Combines 日 ('sun/day') + 光 ('light').

examples.text: 挂好四扇绿窗板以后，你看那温暖的绿色在日光下多漂亮！
examples.trans: Now that all four green shutters are hung, look how lovely that warm green looks in the daylight!

examples.text: 阳光房最大的好处就是白天完全可以靠自然的日光看书。
examples.trans: The best thing about the sunroom is being able to read by natural daylight all day long.

meanings.note: Pinyin: rì zi. Measure word (量词): 段, e.g. 一段好日子 ('happy days').

examples.text: 小时候就住隔两条街。星期五对我来说……是重要日子。
examples.trans: Two streets over, when I was little. Friday for me... is an important day.

examples.text: 在小院喝茶看书的日子真舒服。
examples.trans: Days spent drinking tea and reading in the courtyard are lovely.

meanings.note: Pinyin: rì qī. Calendar date written on a letter, ticket, or score (对比 星期 'day of the week').

examples.text: 明信片右下角写着三十年前五月的日期。
examples.trans: The bottom right corner of the postcard bears a date from May thirty years ago.

examples.text: 订车票的时候一定要看清楚出发日期。
examples.trans: Always double-check the departure date when booking train tickets.

meanings.note: Noun rìchéng ('schedule').

examples.text: 我还是挺担心台里接下来的日程呢。
examples.trans: I am still quite concerned about the network's schedule.

examples.text: 请把下周的彩排日程发给每一位导师。
examples.trans: Please send next week's rehearsal schedule to every mentor.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù. Describes old houses, pipes, or letters—never a person's age (use 老 for people).

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 不在，只有我的笔和三张旧收据！
examples.trans: Not there—only my pen and three old receipts!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù shì. Measure word (量词): 件 (jiàn), e.g. 一件旧事 ('an old matter').

examples.text: 说实话，我选这一带，也是为了一桩家里的旧事。
examples.trans: Honestly, I also chose this neighbourhood for an old family matter.

examples.text: 老朋友见面，聊起许多二十年前的旧事。
examples.trans: Old friends met up and chatted about many memories from twenty years ago.

meanings.note: Noun jiùyuàn ('long-standing bad blood').

examples.text: 这两位主持人之间有四年的旧怨。
examples.trans: Those two hosts have a four-year feud.

examples.text: 工作上不要因为旧怨影响合作。
examples.trans: Never let old grudges disrupt teamwork.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù wù. Measure word (量词): 件 (jiàn), e.g. 一件旧物 ('an old keepsake').

examples.text: 原来留着爷爷旧物的神秘人一直是你，志豪。
examples.trans: So the mystery person holding Grandfather's keepsake was you all along, Zhihao.

examples.text: 木盒里整整齐齐收着几件珍贵的旧物。
examples.trans: Several treasured keepsakes are tucked neatly inside the wooden box.

examples.text: 你听我说，不能让这件事情再扩大，不要再去翻这些旧账。
examples.trans: Listen to me: we cannot let this blow up further, and stop digging up those old scores.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǎo. Alone as a greeting, 早！ means a brisk, friendly 'Morning!'.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǎo shang. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个早上 ('a morning').

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

meanings.note: Adverb zǎojiù ('early on, long since').

examples.text: 这件事我早就知道了。
examples.trans: I knew about this long ago.

examples.text: 他一大早就去演播厅了。
examples.trans: He went to the studio first thing in the morning.

meanings.note: Polite adverb zǎorì ('soon, before long').

examples.text: 希望观众能够早日看到您的这部新剧。
examples.trans: We hope viewers will soon get to watch your new series.

examples.text: 同事们都祝愿他早日康复回到工作岗位。
examples.trans: Colleagues all wished him a speedy recovery back to work.

早晚.gloss: sooner or later; morning and evening

meanings.note: Pronounced zǎowǎn; used adverbially before 会, 要, or 是 to express certainty that something is bound to happen.
Literal noun sense referring to the start and end of the day (e.g., 早晚温差大 'large temperature difference between morning and night').

examples.text: 你早晚会成长的，要对自己有信心。
examples.trans: Sooner or later you will grow; you need to have confidence in yourself.

examples.text: 不用担心，淳于乔不会在那个位置上待太久的，总编室早晚是我的！
examples.trans: Don't worry — Chun Yuqiao won't last long in that seat, and the chief editor's office will be mine sooner or later!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǎo chén. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个早晨 ('an early morning').

examples.text: 小晴早！经理您好！雨后的早晨真晴朗。
examples.trans: Morning, Qing! Hello, Manager! How bright the morning is after the rain.

examples.text: 雨后的早晨，院子里全是草木清香。
examples.trans: On a morning after rain, the courtyard is filled with fresh greenery.

examples.text: 我本来是想着可以把她留在总编室，早点转正。
examples.trans: Originally I was planning to keep her in the chief editor's office and make her permanent early.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǎo jiān. Measure word (量词): 班 (bān), e.g. 早间火车 ('a morning train').

examples.text: 每天服务街坊邻居——就像对公众开放的早间咖啡馆？！
examples.trans: Serves neighbours daily—like a morning café open to the public?!

examples.text: 早间七点的街道安静又清爽。
examples.trans: At seven in the morning, the street is quiet and crisp.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǎo cān. Measure word (量词): 顿 (dùn), e.g. 一顿早餐 ('a breakfast').

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

examples.text: 太好了！现在我想吃一顿丰盛的早餐。
examples.trans: Wonderful! Now I would like to eat a big breakfast.

meanings.note: Noun zǎocāndiàn ('breakfast eatery').

examples.text: 太早了，路边的早餐店都没开门。
examples.trans: It is so early that roadside breakfast shops are closed.

examples.text: 楼下新开了一家早餐店。
examples.trans: A new breakfast shop opened downstairs.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǎo fàn. Measure word (量词): 顿 (dùn), e.g. 一顿早饭 ('a breakfast').

examples.text: 我弟弟早饭还没吃完，就拿着卷尺跑下来了。
examples.trans: My little brother grabbed his tape measure before he even finished breakfast.

examples.text: 你吃早饭了吗？
examples.trans: Have you had breakfast?

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个时期 ('a time').

examples.text: 因为星期一晚上我走过来时，看见我哥哥正走在这条街上！
examples.trans: Because when I walked here Monday night, I saw my older brother walking down this street!

examples.text: 不看纸条，他走进大门时我说什么？
examples.trans: Without my notes, what do I say when he walks in the gate?

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí hou. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 这个时候 ('this moment').

examples.text: 停电的时候，纸还能用。
examples.trans: Paper still works when the power goes out.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

meanings.note: Noun shíkè ('moment, juncture').

examples.text: 这一刻不是媒体人应该退缩逃脱的时刻。
examples.trans: This is no moment for media professionals to shrink back.

examples.text: 越是到了关键时刻，越需要总导演保持冷静。
examples.trans: The more critical the moment, the calmer the chief director must stay.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí kè biǎo. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张时刻表 ('a timetable').

examples.text: 十九条理由？！您是迎接哥哥，还是念火车时刻表呀？
examples.trans: Nineteen reasons?! Are you welcoming your brother or reading a train timetable?

examples.text: 墙上贴着去成都东站的最新火车时刻表。
examples.trans: The latest train timetable for Chengdu East Station is posted on the wall.

examples.text: 有什么情况你随时给我打电话，不要管时差的事，我在美国会二十四小时开机。
examples.trans: Call me anytime something comes up regardless of the time difference; my phone will stay on twenty-four hours a day.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Noun shíqī ('era, period').

examples.text: 每一个时期的古籍注解都不一样。
examples.trans: Commentaries from every era differ from one another.

examples.text: 改版是节目发展的关键时期。
examples.trans: A revamp is a pivotal phase in a show's growth.

meanings.note: Noun shíjī ('the right moment').

examples.text: 之前调职的时机不行，现在可以了。
examples.trans: The timing for a transfer was wrong before; now it works.

examples.text: 推出新节目的时机选得非常准。
examples.trans: The timing chosen to launch the new show was spot on.

时至今日.gloss: down to the present day, even now

meanings.en: down to the present day, even now
meanings.note: Formal time phrase emphasizing continuity up to today.

examples.text: 时至今日，这支制作团队依然保持着行业最高水准。
examples.trans: Even today, this production team maintains top industry standards.

examples.text: 当年立下的三十七条军规时至今日仍在发挥作用。
examples.trans: The thirty-seven ground rules set back then still work today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí jiān. Measure word (量词): 段, e.g. 一段时间 ('a period of time').

examples.text: 新买家来看房子之前，只给我们三十天时间！
examples.trans: Before new buyers inspect the building, they give us only thirty days!

examples.text: 离火车开还有半个小时的时间。
examples.trans: There is still half an hour before the train departs.

related.gloss: a period of time (measure word 段)

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí jiān jiāo náng. Compound 时间 ('time') + 胶囊 ('capsule'); measure word: 个 (gè).

examples.text: 出远门回家以前，我和您姑姑藏了一个小铁盒时间胶囊。
examples.trans: Before my long journey home, your aunt and I hid a small tin time capsule.

examples.text: 时间胶囊里装着三十年前的手绘地图和一张旧照片。
examples.trans: Inside the time capsule were a thirty-year-old hand-drawn map and an old photograph.

meanings.note: Planned timetable of tasks or duty shifts.

examples.text: 值班的时间表已经排好了，发在工作群里。
examples.trans: The duty schedule is set and posted in the work chat.

examples.text: 请严格按照时间表推进后期的每一项工作。
examples.trans: Please advance every post-production task strictly on schedule.

旷工.gloss: skip work without leave, be absent from duty

meanings.en: skip work without leave, be absent from duty
meanings.note: Workplace verb-object kuànggōng ('play truant from work').

examples.text: 跟着董事长出门，我还得做好旷工一天的准备？
examples.trans: Going out with the Chairwoman means bracing to skip work all day?

examples.text: 有急事请提前在系统里请假，不能无故旷工。
examples.trans: File leave in the system for emergencies rather than skip work.

meanings.note: Pinyin: míng liàng. Describes both well-lit spaces and clear, ringing musical tones.

examples.text: 擦掉灰尘以后，九号房变得格外宽敞明亮。
examples.trans: After wiping away the dust, Room Nine became remarkably spacious and bright.

examples.text: 这个琴键弹出来的声音干净又明亮。
examples.trans: The sound played by this piano key is clean and bright.

meanings.note: Pinyin: míng xìn piàn. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张明信片 ('a postcard').

examples.text: 从那天起我们就再没说过话。上周我给他寄了一张明信片。
examples.trans: Since that day we have not spoken again. Last week I mailed him a postcard.

examples.text: 看，已经十二点零四分了。也许他把明信片扔进垃圾桶了。
examples.trans: Look, it is twelve-oh-four already. Maybe he tossed the postcard into the bin.

meanings.note: Pinyin: míng tiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 明天一天 ('all day tomorrow').

examples.text: 欢迎来到小院客栈，小晴。明天不会无聊了。
examples.trans: Welcome to Courtyard Inn, Qing. Tomorrow will not be boring.

examples.text: 晚安，小晴。明天早餐见。
examples.trans: Good night, Qing. See you at breakfast tomorrow.

meanings.note: Friendly workplace farewell míngtiān jiàn.

examples.text: 我先走了，明天见！
examples.trans: I am heading off, see you tomorrow!

examples.text: 大家辛苦了，明天见！
examples.trans: Great work everyone, see you tomorrow!

meanings.note: Pinyin: míng nián. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 明年一年 ('next year').

examples.text: 两个都买下！留一个备用明年冬天也省心。
examples.trans: Buy both! Keeping a spare saves worry next winter too.

examples.text: 房东律师寄来的？奇怪——我们房租一直交到明年夏天了。
examples.trans: Sent by the landlord's lawyer? Strange—our rent is paid right through next summer.

meanings.note: Pinyin: míng zǎo. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 明天早上 ('tomorrow morning').

examples.text: 定好闹钟吧，老陈。明早我们跑赢冷水！
examples.trans: Set your alarm, Chen. Tomorrow morning we outrun the cold water!

examples.text: 明早七点半我们在楼下咖啡馆见。
examples.trans: Let's meet downstairs in the café tomorrow morning at seven thirty.

meanings.note: Pinyin: míng míng. Highlights a clear fact that contradicts what just happened.

examples.text: 哎呀！透过窗户看见周经理了？我明明加倍用力微笑了！
examples.trans: Oh dear! You spotted Manager Zhou through the window? I smiled twice as wide!

examples.text: 钥匙明明放在桌上，怎么不见了？
examples.trans: The key was clearly on the table—how did it vanish?

examples.text: 你把他家地址告诉我，这件事跟工作毫无关系，我要明明白白地跟他说！
examples.trans: Give me his home address! This has nothing to do with work — I'm going to tell him clearly!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 此外就是客座明星的人选问题。
examples.trans: Besides that, there is the question of choosing the guest star.

examples.text: 此外就是客座明星的人选问题。
examples.trans: Besides that, there is the question of choosing the guest star.

meanings.note: Adjective míngxiǎn.

examples.text: 这次证据太明显了。
examples.trans: The evidence this time was way too obvious.

examples.text: 进步很明显。
examples.trans: The progress is obvious.

meanings.note: Pinyin: míng zhì. Praises a sensible choice.

examples.text: 太明智了！旁边要配蜂蜜还是苹果果酱？
examples.trans: Wise choice! Would you like honey or apple jam on the side?

examples.text: 提前预订向阳的房间是个明智的选择。
examples.trans: Booking a sunny room in advance was a wise choice.

明智之举.gloss: a wise move, a sensible course of action

meanings.en: a wise move, a sensible course of action
meanings.note: Formal four-character evaluation.

examples.text: 暂停争议广告并主动推出公益节目实属明智之举。
examples.trans: Pulling the disputed ad and launching charity specials was a wise move.

examples.text: 打压自家艺人去捧外援绝不是什么明智之举。
examples.trans: Undercutting in-house artists to boost outsiders is far from wise.

meanings.note: verb meaning to understand or realize clearly

examples.text: 我终于明白为什么你们不去见吉秀了。
examples.trans: I finally understand why none of you went to see Ji Xiu.

examples.text: 我明白王老师的意思。
examples.trans: I understand what Teacher Wang means.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng. Measure word (量词): 颗 (kē), e.g. 一颗星 ('a star').

examples.text: 只剩三十五分钟了！他肯定会写一星差评！
examples.trans: Only thirty-five minutes left! He will surely write a one-star bad review!

examples.text: 晴朗的夜空能看见很多星。
examples.trans: On a clear night sky you can see many stars.

meanings.en: Xingtian (short for 星天娱乐, Xingtian Entertainment)
meanings.note: Pronounced Xīngtiān; proper name of the leading television and variety-show production company at the center of Behind the Scenes (幕后之王).

examples.text: 欢迎来到星天，这会儿正在录像呢。
examples.trans: Welcome to Xingtian; they are taping right at this moment.

examples.text: 星天要招实习生？新鲜啊！
examples.trans: Xingtian wants to recruit an intern? Now that is something new!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng xing. Measure word (量词): 颗 (kē), e.g. 一颗星星 ('a star'). Neutral tone on the second syllable in spoken Mandarin.

examples.text: 黄铜盖子里面刻着一颗小星星和名字缩写。
examples.trans: Engraved inside the brass cover is a tiny star beside initials.

examples.text: 晴朗的夏夜，站在小院阳台上能看见满天星星。
examples.trans: On a clear summer night, you can see a sky full of stars from the courtyard balcony.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng qī. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个星期 ('a week').

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

examples.text: 脑子转得快，小晴。志豪每星期都读城市建筑规定。
examples.trans: Quick thinking, Qing. Hao reads city building rules every single week.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng qī yī. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 上星期一 ('last Monday').

examples.text: 呀，这就是星期一火车上那只双胞胎箱子吗？
examples.trans: Oh, is this that twin suitcase from Monday's train?

examples.text: 您尽管看，宋老师。星期一下午大堂暗。
examples.trans: Go right ahead, Teacher Song. Monday afternoon the lobby was dim.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng qī sān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 这星期三 ('this Wednesday').

examples.text: 等等——星期三晚上你又用真名住进来了？
examples.trans: Wait—and Wednesday night you checked in here under your real name?

examples.text: 每到星期三下午，小美都会试烤新甜点。
examples.trans: Every Wednesday afternoon, Mei test-bakes a new pastry.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng qī èr. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 这星期二 ('this Tuesday').

examples.text: 老房子每到星期二就松一颗螺丝。坐吧。
examples.trans: Every Tuesday an old house loosens one screw. Sit down.

examples.text: 甚至星期二您还打电话提过白纸包的事！
examples.trans: Even after you called us on Tuesday about the white parcel!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng qī wǔ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 每个星期五 ('every Friday').

examples.text: 我念念：对不起拿错了，请帮我保管到星期五。
examples.trans: Let me read it: Sorry for taking the wrong one; please keep mine until Friday.

examples.text: 到星期五？没写名字，也没签名！
examples.trans: Until Friday? No name written, and no signature either!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng qī liù. Literally 'week-day six'; Mainland standard alongside informal 周六 (zhōu liù).

examples.text: 每个星期六早上，这条老街都有热闹的集市。
examples.trans: Every Saturday morning, this old street hosts a lively market.

examples.text: 星期六下午来院子里喝杯热柠檬茶吧。
examples.trans: Come to the courtyard for a cup of hot lemon tea on Saturday afternoon.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng qī sì. Literally 'week-day four'; Mainland standard alongside informal 周四 (zhōu sì).

examples.text: 周经理本来想让司机星期四下午送椅子来。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou originally meant to have the driver deliver the chairs on Thursday afternoon.

examples.text: 我们每个星期四晚上都会核对一次账本。
examples.trans: Every Thursday evening we check the account ledger together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng qī tiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个星期天 ('a Sunday').

examples.text: 从那天起我们就再没说过话。上周我给他寄了一张明信片。
examples.trans: Since that day we have not spoken again. Last week I mailed him a postcard.

examples.text: 星期天早上大家都不急着赶车，慢慢喝早茶。
examples.trans: On Sunday mornings nobody rushes for trains, lingering over tea instead.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng jí. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 五星级 ('a five-star rating').

examples.text: 仔细看这一页——记的是分贝和安静度，不是酒店星级！
examples.trans: Look closely at this page—it records decibels and quietness, not hotel stars!

examples.text: 小客栈虽小，干净程度不输星级酒店。
examples.trans: Though small, the inn is every bit as spotless as a star-rated hotel.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chūn tiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个春天 ('a spring season').

examples.text: 五分钟演讲稿，列了十九条理由解释那年春天我们都错了。
examples.trans: A five-minute speech listing nineteen reasons why we were both wrong that spring.

examples.text: 春天一到，院子里的老树就发新芽了。
examples.trans: As soon as spring arrives, the old courtyard tree puts out fresh shoots.

meanings.note: Idiom chūnfēng déyì ('basking in smooth success').

examples.text: 外界都觉得他在公司混得春风得意。
examples.trans: Outsiders think he is riding high effortlessly here.

examples.text: 连赢三期收视冠军，整个团队春风得意。
examples.trans: After winning ratings three weeks running, the team beamed.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuó tiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 昨天一天 ('yesterday').

examples.text: 完了！昨天我没戴眼镜，在平板上接了电话预订！
examples.trans: Disaster! Yesterday without my glasses I took a phone booking on the tablet!

examples.text: 是的，我叫志豪。昨天打电话订了七号房。
examples.trans: Yes, my name is Zhihao. Yesterday I booked room seven by phone.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuó wǎn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 昨天晚上 ('last night').

examples.text: 宋老师早上好！看昨晚大门口送来了什么。
examples.trans: Good morning, Teacher Song! Look what arrived at our front gate last night.

examples.text: 昨晚您的本子在柜台翻开了，我们看到九分……
examples.trans: Last night your notebook fell open on the counter, and we saw nine points...

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì. Links two nouns (我是小晴); do NOT use simple 是 before plain adjectives like 好 or 忙.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì bú shì. A-not-A affirmative-negative question tag; bù shifts to bú before 4th-tone shì.

examples.text: 我们俩是不是刚升职当上正式试吃员了？
examples.trans: Did the two of us just get promoted to official taste testers?

examples.text: 你是不是把绿色登记本夹在胳膊底下了？
examples.trans: Didn't you tuck the green guest book under your arm?

examples.text: 我想问一问，贵公司是否认为单凭你们在海外娱乐产业发达的经验和资源，
examples.trans: Let me ask you one question: does your group truly believe that relying solely on your overseas entertainment experience and resources

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

昼夜.gloss: day and night, round the clock

meanings.en: day and night, round the clock
meanings.note: Both daytime and nighttime without interruption.

examples.text: 总编室安排了专人值班，确保昼夜都有人盯守。
examples.trans: The editorial office scheduled shifts so someone watches day and night.

examples.text: 抢修人员昼夜不停地检查所有线路。
examples.trans: Repair crews checked every line day and night.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎn de. Linking verb introducing how something looks by comparison or lighting (显得多大 'looks how big').

examples.text: 两面都透着干净玻璃，院子显得宽敞多了！
examples.trans: With clean glass showing on two sides, the courtyard looks so much bigger!

examples.text: 刷上暖绿色油漆以后，旧木窗板显得很有精神。
examples.trans: Painted warm green, the old wooden shutters look lively and fresh.

meanings.note: Marks something plain for anyone to see.

examples.text: 很显然，他还没有下定最后的决心。
examples.trans: Obviously, he has not made his final decision yet.

examples.text: 这个借口显然说服不了大家。
examples.trans: This excuse obviously will not convince anyone.

meanings.note: What data, screens, or notices reveal.

examples.text: 最新数据显示，节目的网络热度还在上升。
examples.trans: Latest data shows online buzz for the show is still climbing.

examples.text: 公告栏的通知显示人事安排有了新变动。
examples.trans: The notice on the board indicates a change in staffing.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huǎng. As huǎng (3rd tone), means 'flash past / dazzle the eyes' (晃眼); as huàng (4th tone), means 'sway/shake'.

examples.text: 小晴，那准是磨砂玻璃灯罩晃了眼。
examples.trans: Must be the frosted glass lampshade playing a trick on your eyes, Qing.

examples.text: 正午的阳光照在水面上，亮得有点晃眼。
examples.trans: The midday sunlight shining on the water is bright enough to dazzle the eyes.

examples.text: 你很快会晋升，不要在这些琐事上浪费太多精力。
examples.trans: You will be promoted very soon, so don't waste too much energy on trivial errands like these.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Verb-complement yūndǎo ('pass out, collapse').

examples.text: 李先生在舞台上突然晕倒了。
examples.trans: Mr Li suddenly collapsed onstage.

examples.text: 天气太热，有人差点晕倒。
examples.trans: It was so hot that someone nearly fainted.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a verb used in conversational Mandarin.

examples.text: 我有一个晕开。
examples.trans: I have a 晕开.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的晕开。
examples.trans: This is a very good 晕开.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǎn. Describes arriving late or evening time.

examples.text: 打扰一下，志豪先生？不好意思这么晚敲门。
examples.trans: Excuse me, Mr Zhihao? Sorry to knock so late.

examples.text: 这是我这个月睡得最香的一晚，洗澡水也热极了！
examples.trans: Best sleep I have had all month, and the shower water was wonderfully hot!

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǎn shang. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个晚上 ('an evening').

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǎn shang hǎo. Polite evening greeting formed from 晚上 ('evening') + 好 ('good/well').

examples.text: 朋友们晚上好，欢迎回到九号房的星期五晚茶。
examples.trans: Good evening, friends, and welcome back to Friday evening tea in Room Nine.

examples.text: 晚上好，周经理，院子里的大圆桌还空着吗？
examples.trans: Good evening, Manager Zhou—is the big round table in the courtyard still free?

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǎn ān. Warm bedtime greeting.

examples.text: 晚安，小晴。明天早餐见。
examples.trans: Good night, Qing. See you at breakfast tomorrow.

examples.text: 时间不早了，早点休息，晚安！
examples.trans: It is getting late—get some rest, good night!

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǎn chá. Compound 晚 ('evening') + 茶 ('tea'): an early-evening tea gathering with light pastries.

examples.text: 三十年前，客栈每个星期五都办花园晚茶。
examples.trans: Thirty years ago, the inn hosted garden evening tea every Friday.

examples.text: 晚茶时间到了，小美端出了一盘刚烤好的柠檬塔。
examples.trans: When evening tea time arrived, Mei brought out a tray of freshly baked lemon tarts.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǎn fàn. Measure word (量词): 顿 (dùn), e.g. 一顿晚饭 ('a dinner').

examples.text: 宋老师，志豪和我订了附近安静的晚饭——明天请您一起去好吗？
examples.trans: Teacher Song, Hao and I booked a quiet dinner nearby—will you join us tomorrow?

examples.text: 今晚我们在附近安静的小饭馆吃晚饭。
examples.trans: Tonight we are having dinner at a quiet little restaurant nearby.

meanings.note: Adjective pǔtōng ('ordinary, commonplace').

examples.text: 她也适合找男朋友，不过普通的男孩子不行。
examples.trans: She is suited to dating, except an ordinary guy will not do.

examples.text: 哪怕最普通的岗位也能做出精彩的成绩。
examples.trans: Even the most ordinary post can yield standout work.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qíng tiān. Combines 晴 ('clear/sunny sky') + 天 ('day/weather').

examples.text: 姑姑把乐谱收进琴盖里，等着晴天再拿出来弹。
examples.trans: My aunt tucked the score inside the piano lid, waiting for sunny weather to play it again.

examples.text: 大家都盼着明天是个大晴天，好把油漆晒干。
examples.trans: Everyone is hoping tomorrow is a bright sunny day so the paint can dry.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qíng lǎng. Describes bright skies after rain.

examples.text: 小晴早！经理您好！雨后的早晨真晴朗。
examples.trans: Morning, Qing! Hello, Manager! How bright the morning is after the rain.

examples.text: 下了一夜雨，今天终于晴朗起来了。
examples.trans: After raining all night, the sky has finally cleared up today.

meanings.note: Reduplicated suffix in 亮晶晶 or 粉晶晶.

examples.text: 舞台灯光照在她粉晶晶的礼服上格外好看。
examples.trans: Stage lights gleamed prettily across her glittery pink dress.

examples.text: 小姑娘眨着一双亮晶晶的眼睛认真听讲。
examples.trans: The young girl listened intently with bright, sparkling eyes.

meanings.note: Noun zhìshāng ('intelligence quotient').

examples.text: 那都是低智商的谣言。
examples.trans: Those are all low-IQ tabloid rumours.

examples.text: 观众的审美和智商可千万不能低估。
examples.trans: Never underestimate the audience's taste and intelligence.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liàng jià. Combines 晾 ('air-dry/cool in open air') + 架 ('rack/stand'); in baking, wire racks that keep pastry bottoms crisp.

examples.text: 二十个酥脆的杏仁挞底已经在金属晾架上整整齐齐排好了。
examples.trans: Twenty crisp almond tart shells are already lined up neatly on the wire cooling rack.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包要先放在晾架上散掉热气，表皮才会保持酥脆。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread should rest on a cooling rack first to let off steam so the crust stays crisp.

暂且.gloss: for the time being, provisionally for now

meanings.en: for the time being, provisionally for now
meanings.note: Setting something aside temporarily.

examples.text: 争议较大的议题咱们暂且搁置，先讨论急事。
examples.trans: Let us set disputed items aside for now and tackle urgent business.

examples.text: 手头没有确凿证据，这件事暂且不要声张。
examples.trans: Without hard proof in hand, keep this quiet for the time being.

meanings.note: Adverb zànshí ('for the time being').

examples.text: 虽然节目暂时停播，但还会拍下一季。
examples.trans: Though paused for now, the show will film another season.

examples.text: 这个问题暂时解决了。
examples.trans: This issue is settled for the time being.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nuǎn. Describes cozy warmth of tea, sunlight, or clothing.

examples.text: 每次弹完琴，他都问为什么下雨天钢琴声音更暖。
examples.trans: Whenever I finished playing, he asked why the piano sounded warmer on rainy days.

examples.text: 喝碗热汤，身子一下子就暖了。
examples.trans: Drink a bowl of hot soup and you warm right up.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nuǎn huo. Note neutral-tone huo in spoken Mandarin ('cozy and warm').

examples.text: 真的可以吗？看着又好看又暖和！
examples.trans: Is that really alright? It looks both lovely and warm!

examples.text: 干燥、暖和、安静。快说还缺什么。
examples.trans: Dry, warm, and quiet. Tell me quickly what is still missing.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nuán nuǎn. Affectionate reduplicated verb (暖暖身子 'warm yourself up').

examples.text: 早上好！在楼上就闻到暖暖的肉桂香味了！
examples.trans: Good morning! All the way upstairs I smelled warm cinnamon!

examples.text: 先喝碗热汤暖暖手和胃吧。
examples.trans: Drink a bowl of hot soup first to warm up.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nuǎn fēng. Combines 暖 ('warm') + 风 ('wind/air current'); measure word: 阵 (zhèn) or 股 (gǔ).

examples.text: 只要我们在地上铺好牛皮纸，让暖风顺着走廊吹，油漆很快就干了。
examples.trans: As long as we lay brown kraft paper on the floor and let warm air blow down the hallway, the paint will dry quickly.

examples.text: 春天的暖风吹过梧桐巷，树梢上长出了嫩绿的新叶。
examples.trans: As the warm spring breeze blew down Wutong Lane, tender green leaves sprouted on the treetops.

meanings.note: Pinyin: àn. Describes dim lighting or a concealed door.

examples.text: 您尽管看，宋老师。星期一下午大堂暗。
examples.trans: Go right ahead, Teacher Song. Monday afternoon the lobby was dim.

examples.text: 走廊里的灯光有点暗。
examples.trans: The light in the hallway is a little dim.

meanings.note: Verb ànzhǐ ('allude to, insinuate').

examples.text: 声明里还是暗指星天没照顾好艺人。
examples.trans: The statement still hints Xingtian neglected the artist.

examples.text: 他刚才的话是在暗指谁？
examples.trans: Who was his remark hinting at just now?

meanings.note: Pinyin: àn mén. Measure word (量词): 扇 (shàn), e.g. 一扇暗门 ('a hidden door').

examples.text: 看合页边露出来的折纸图纸——一楼画着一扇暗门！
examples.trans: Look at the folded blueprint sticking out of the hinge—a hidden door is drawn on the ground floor!

examples.text: 老书架后面居然藏着一扇窄暗门。
examples.trans: Behind the old bookshelf was hidden a narrow secret door.

meanings.note: Quick to flare up in anger.

examples.text: 工作太累的时候人容易变得暴躁。
examples.trans: People easily grow irritable when exhausted from work.

examples.text: 他性格沉稳，平时一点儿也不暴躁。
examples.trans: He is steady by nature and not hot-tempered at all.

meanings.note: Heavy downpour.

examples.text: 暴雨直播那天，全组人员在雨里坚守到了最后。
examples.trans: On the day of the storm broadcast, the whole crew stood fast in the rain.

examples.text: 窗外下起了瓢泼暴雨，街上行人很少。
examples.trans: Torrential rain poured outside, leaving few people on the street.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bào fēng yǔ. Combines 暴 ('fierce/sudden') + 风 ('wind') + 雨 ('rain').

examples.text: 暴风雨来得真快，幸好我们及时把窗板搬进了走廊。
examples.trans: The storm came on fast; thankfully we carried the shutters into the hallway in time.

examples.text: 暴风雨过后，院子里的树叶被洗得翠绿发亮。
examples.trans: After the storm passed, the leaves in the courtyard were washed bright emerald green.

examples.text: 我也不能让父母的事情曝光在大众的视线里面，我必须得保护他。
examples.trans: Nor can I let their private pain be exposed to the public eye — I have to protect him.

examples.text: 但是现在孩子已经曝光了，压力也很快就会来。
examples.trans: Still, now that the child has been photographed, intense pressure will arrive any moment.

meanings.note: Media noun bàoguānglǜ ('public visibility').

examples.text: 大家估计她就是在刷曝光率吧。
examples.trans: People figure she is just chasing media exposure.

examples.text: 新节目开播后，几位选手的曝光率大增。
examples.trans: Since launch, the contestants' exposure has soared.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qǔ zi. Conversational word for an instrumental piece or song tune (second syllable neutral tone). Measure word: 首 (shǒu).

examples.text: 这首轻快的小曲子是姑姑年轻时手写的。
examples.trans: This lively little tune was handwritten by my aunt when she was young.

examples.text: 吃完晚饭，宋老师常在阳光房弹两首曲子。
examples.trans: After dinner, Teacher Song often plays a couple of pieces in the sunroom.

meanings.note: Songs selected for a concert or broadcast.

examples.text: 四位嘉宾都已经和乐队敲定了明晚的演出曲目。
examples.trans: All four guests have finalised tomorrow night's songs with the band.

examples.text: 决赛的备选曲目需要提前办理版权许可。
examples.trans: Backup songs for the finale need copyright clearance in advance.

meanings.note: Noun qūxiàn ('plotted curve').

examples.text: 这是二部成立以来的业绩曲线。
examples.trans: Here is Unit Two's performance curve since launch.

examples.text: 收视曲线在九点钟达到了最高点。
examples.trans: The ratings curve peaked at nine o'clock.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gèng. Placed before an adjective or mental verb to form a comparative ('even better' 更好).

examples.text: 每次弹完琴，他都问为什么下雨天钢琴声音更暖。
examples.trans: Whenever I finished playing, he asked why the piano sounded warmer on rainy days.

examples.text: 生活安排的二重奏比我们自己写得更妙，孩子们。
examples.trans: Life arranges finer duets than we write ourselves, boys.

examples.text: 由此引发的股东内部分歧与高管层问责风暴，可能是比侵权本身更为严重的企业危机。
examples.trans: The resulting shareholder rifts and executive accountability storm may prove even deadlier than the lawsuit itself.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Verb gēnggǎi ('amend, revise').

examples.text: 请立即更改你们团队的声明。
examples.trans: Please revise your team's statement immediately.

examples.text: 密码已经成功更改了。
examples.trans: The password was changed successfully.

meanings.note: Verb gēngxīn ('update').

examples.text: 气象台的暴雨预警刚刚又更新了！
examples.trans: The weather bureau's rainstorm alert has just been updated again!

examples.text: 节目官方微博每十分钟更新一次路况互助信息。
examples.trans: The show's official Weibo updates road mutual-aid info every ten minutes.

meanings.note: Adverb céngjīng ('in the past, once').

examples.text: 因为我曾经很傻。
examples.trans: Because I used to be very foolish.

examples.text: 他曾经在知名卫视担任王牌制片人。
examples.trans: He once served as an ace producer at a major network.

meanings.en: for; in place of; on behalf of
meanings.note: Pinyin: tì. Introduces the person you step in to help (替我念 'read it for me').

examples.text: 小晴，炒蛋真好吃，替我夸夸小美！
examples.trans: The scrambled eggs are delicious, Qing. Tell Mei my compliments!

examples.text: 放心吧，老陈，我们替你保密！
examples.trans: Rest assured, Chen—we will keep your secret!

meanings.note: Verb tìdài ('take the place of').

examples.text: 快找人去替代布小谷。
examples.trans: Find someone to replace Bu Xiaogu right away.

examples.text: 没有人能替代你的位置。
examples.trans: Nobody can take your place.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuì. Superlative adverb placed before adjectives or feeling verbs (最好 'best', 最喜欢 'like best').

examples.text: 只有裙子、乐谱，还有我最喜欢的茶杯！
examples.trans: Only dresses, sheet music, and my favourite teacup!

examples.text: 最上面架子上金色包装那包。怎么了？
examples.trans: The gold-wrapped packet on the top shelf. Why?

examples.text: 吉秀？我告诉你，那是全中国嘴巴最严的女人！
examples.trans: Ji Xiu? Let me tell you, she is the tightest-lipped woman in the entire country!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Compound noun zuìdījià ('rock-bottom price').

examples.text: 传单上写着最低价租房。
examples.trans: The flyer advertises lowest-priced rentals.

examples.text: 这是全城最低价了。
examples.trans: This is the lowest price in town.

meanings.note: formal superlative adjective meaning top or optimal

examples.text: 尹正宇是我们确定的三个最佳人选之一。
examples.trans: Yin Zhengyu is one of the three top candidates we settled on.

examples.text: 他是这次比赛的最佳歌手。
examples.trans: He is the top singer of this competition.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuì hòu. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 最后一个 ('the last one').

examples.text: 上楼梯，平台往左拐，最上面最后一扇门。
examples.trans: Up the stairs, turn left at the landing, last door at the very top.

examples.text: 冬天用掉最后一个了。只有桥那边的老五金店有这个尺寸。
examples.trans: Used the last one in winter. Only the old hardware shop past the bridge carries this size.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuì duō. Gives an upper limit on time or quantity.

examples.text: 只有三个小纸箱！最多四个！
examples.trans: Only three small cardboard boxes! Four at most!

examples.text: 小美，你的烤箱每天早上最多能烤多少肉桂卷和柠檬蛋糕？
examples.trans: Mei, how many cinnamon rolls and lemon cakes can your oven bake each morning?

examples.text: 希望作为最大的战略合作伙伴，能够帮我们把原创的节目打进西方主流市场。
examples.trans: When that day comes, we hope our strategic partner will help bring our original shows into mainstream global markets.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 杏子姐，我到公司才不到一年就升职这么快，我是咱们史上升职最快的吗？
examples.trans: Xingzi, I've been at the company less than a year and got promoted so fast — am I the fastest promotion in company history?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Most recent update or release.

examples.text: 一有海外剧组的最新消息，请马上向我汇报。
examples.trans: As soon as the latest word comes from abroad, report to me.

examples.text: 大家正在讨论今年市场上最新的综艺趋势。
examples.trans: Everyone is discussing the latest variety-show trends.

meanings.note: Pronounced zuìzhōng; non-predicative adjective modifying nouns directly without 的 in fixed compounds (最终稿 'final draft', 最终结果 'final outcome').
Also used adverbially before a verb to introduce the eventual outcome after a long process.

examples.text: 接下来抓紧时间，把最终稿交上来。
examples.trans: Next, make good use of the time and hand in the final draft.

examples.text: 这样吧，明天之前给我一个最终答复。
examples.trans: How about this, give me a final answer before tomorrow.

meanings.note: Adverb zuìqǐmǎ ('at minimum, at least').

examples.text: 最起码闻思默老师现在还是单身啊。
examples.trans: At the very least, Mr Wen Simo is still single right now.

examples.text: 上台做提案，最起码要把核心赛制讲清楚。
examples.trans: When pitching onstage, at least explain the core rules clearly.

meanings.note: time word for the recent period

examples.text: 吉总推荐最近两个星期的最佳人选尹正宇。
examples.trans: President Ji recommends the top candidate of the past two weeks, Yin Zhengyu.

examples.text: 你最近工作忙不忙？
examples.trans: Have you been busy with work recently?

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuè. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个月 ('a month').

examples.text: 这是我这个月睡得最香的一晚，洗澡水也热极了！
examples.trans: Best sleep I have had all month, and the shower water was wonderfully hot!

examples.text: 志豪先生，看第一页：下个月改建商业办公室。我们完了！
examples.trans: Mr Zhihao, look at page one: commercial office conversion next month. We are finished!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuè dǐ. Built from 月 ('month') + 底 ('bottom'); opposite of 月初 ('start of the month').

examples.text: 而且城里要我们月底以前开咖啡馆！
examples.trans: And the city wants our café open before the end of the month!

examples.text: 房租要在月底以前付。
examples.trans: The rent has to be paid before the end of the month.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǒu. Expresses both possession ('I have') and existence ('there is'); ALWAYS negated with 没 (没有), never 不.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

有一天.gloss: one day; someday (in the future or past)

meanings.en: one day; someday (in the future or past)
meanings.note: Pinyin: yǒu yì tiān. Fixed time expression 有 ('there is/was') + 一天 ('one day', with yī -> yì before 1st-tone tiān).

examples.text: 如果你们有一天重开九号房，从老树往北数三块平石板！
examples.trans: If you ever reopen Room Nine one day, count three flat flagstones north from the old tree!

examples.text: 她一直相信，有一天这首圆舞曲会在阳光房里重新响起。
examples.trans: She always believed that one day this waltz would ring out again in the sunroom.

examples.text: 外卡？每个导师确实有个外卡名额，但是你之前已经放弃了。
examples.trans: A wild card? Every mentor does get one wild-card spot, except you already waived yours earlier.

examples.text: 有个事情找你帮个忙，惠美想安排个外卡歌手。
examples.trans: I need a favor from you — Huimei wants to add a wild-card singer to tonight's show.

examples.text: 这是有事啊。
examples.trans: This is have something.

examples.text: 那个有事好。
examples.trans: That have something is good.

meanings.note: Pronounced yǒuxiē; determiner placed directly before a noun without an additional classifier (有些人, 有些事).
Used as a degree adverb before adjectives or psychological verbs (e.g., 有些担心 'somewhat worried'), slightly more formal than 有点儿.

examples.text: 有些人的名字不能提，你提到他，他就会出现。
examples.trans: Some people's names must not be mentioned; if you mention him, he will appear.

examples.text: 要不先这样吧，有些事别太较真。
examples.trans: Maybe let it be for now; some things need not be pushed too hard.

meanings.en: someone; somebody; there is someone who
meanings.note: Pronounced yǒurén; existential-indefinite expression introducing an unspecified person as the agent of the following verb, or indicating that a room/seat is occupied.

examples.text: 尹正宇来不了这边，当然是有人泄露了消息。
examples.trans: Yin Zhengyu cannot come to our side; obviously someone leaked the news.

examples.text: 要不是有人爆了照片，我估计两天都撑不住。
examples.trans: Had someone not leaked that photo, I reckon it would not have lasted two days.

有何指教.gloss: what advice do you have for me?

meanings.en: what advice do you have for me?
meanings.note: Polite/formal question yǒuhé-zhǐjiào ('how may you instruct me?').

examples.text: 闻先生特意在幕后等我，有何指教？
examples.trans: Waiting for me backstage, Mr Wen Simo—what advice do you have?

examples.text: 前辈今天大驾光临，不知有何指教？
examples.trans: Honoured by your visit today—what guidance do you bring?

examples.text: 请问有何贵干？
examples.trans: May I ask what is your business?

examples.text: 找我有什么贵干？
examples.trans: What is your business looking for me?

meanings.note: Verb yǒuguān ('have to do with').

examples.text: 突然改行当行政，不会跟那晚的事有关吧？
examples.trans: Switching suddenly to admin — is it related to that night?

examples.text: 所有与直播安全有关的细节都要检查。
examples.trans: Check every detail related to broadcast safety.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǒu lì. Describes firm handwriting or steady hands.

examples.text: 大门门铃响了。干脆有力的一下。
examples.trans: There goes the gate bell. One firm, decisive ring.

examples.text: 虽然八十岁了，老先生握手依然很有力。
examples.trans: Even at eighty, the old gentleman still has a firm handshake.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǒu jìn. Literally 有 ('have') + 劲 ('strength/vigour/drive'); describes strong arms/shoulders or lively musical tone.

examples.text: 志鹏肩膀很有劲，明天早上六点的面包面团就交给他揉了！
examples.trans: Peng has strong shoulders, so tomorrow morning's six-o'clock bread dough goes to him to knead!

examples.text: 修好后的钢琴每一个低音听起来都沉稳又有劲。
examples.trans: Every bass note on the repaired piano sounds steady and full of vigour.

有备无患.gloss: better safe than sorry, preparedness prevents calamity

meanings.en: better safe than sorry, preparedness prevents calamity
meanings.note: Classic idiom praising thorough advance preparation.

examples.text: 趁雨还没下大先启动预案，总归是有备无患。
examples.trans: Activating the plan before the rain worsens keeps us safe rather than sorry.

examples.text: 多准备一套备用设备，现场才能有备无患。
examples.trans: Preparing a spare set of gear keeps the live set worry-free.

有完没完.gloss: will it never end?, enough already!

meanings.en: will it never end?, enough already!
meanings.note: Colloquial rhetorical phrase yǒuwán-méiwán ('is there no end to this?').

examples.text: 又是这些无聊八卦，到底有完没完了呀？
examples.trans: More pointless gossip—will it never end?

examples.text: 同一个问题问了三遍，你有完没完呀？
examples.trans: Asking the same question three times—give it a rest!

meanings.note: Polite verb/adverb yǒuxìng ('be honoured to').

examples.text: 今天我们有幸请到了爱美会的会长。
examples.trans: Today we have the honour of welcoming the club president.

examples.text: 大学时我有幸听过方老师的讲座。
examples.trans: In college I was fortunate to attend Professor Fang's talk.

meanings.note: Adjective yǒuyìsi ('interesting, fun').

examples.text: 我今天想跟你聊一件更有意思的事。
examples.trans: Today I want to chat about something far more interesting.

examples.text: 这个访谈选题既有深度又很有意思。
examples.trans: This interview topic has both depth and real charm.

examples.text: 可是前几年您与白石公司签订了一份合约，按照法律来讲，对您的权益是有所损害的。
examples.trans: Yet a few years ago you signed a contract with Baishi that legally infringed upon your own rights.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

有把握.gloss: be confident, be sure of success

meanings.en: be confident, be sure of success
meanings.note: Verb phrase yǒu bǎwò ('have confidence/certainty').

examples.text: 你对我这么有把握？
examples.trans: Are you really that confident about me?

examples.text: 排练了三次之后，大家对直播很有把握。
examples.trans: After three rehearsals, everyone feels confident.

examples.text: 这是有日子啊。
examples.trans: This is for days.

examples.text: 那个有日子好。
examples.trans: That for days is good.

meanings.note: Adverb yǒushí ('sometimes').

examples.text: 成败有时取决于你想问题的角度。
examples.trans: Success or failure sometimes depends on your angle.

examples.text: 总编室工作很忙，有时周末也要加班。
examples.trans: The editorial office is busy and sometimes works weekends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǒu shí hou. Placed before or after the subject.

examples.text: 啊！老水管晚上有时候会进一点空气。
examples.trans: Oh! Old water pipes sometimes get a little air bubble at night.

examples.text: 有时候院子里安静得只听见风吹树叶。
examples.trans: Sometimes the courtyard is so quiet you hear only wind in the leaves.

有没有.gloss: have or not; whether there is

meanings.en: is there or isn't there; do (you) have or not; did (something) happen or not
meanings.note: Pronounced yǒu méiyǒu; affirmative-negative (A-not-A) question pattern for possession/existence, and also used before a verb to ask about completed experience ('have you ever / did you...').
Used in embedded clauses (e.g., 有没有关系 'whether it matters or not') where it functions as an indirect 'whether' condition rather than a direct question.

examples.text: 老方，这批学生有没有好的？
examples.trans: Old Fang, are there any good ones in this batch of students?

examples.text: 有没有关系，你说了不算。
examples.trans: Whether it is related or not is not up to you to decide.

related.gloss: is or isn't; whether or not

meanings.note: Pinyin: yóu diǎn. Placed BEFORE an adjective/feeling verb (有点冷 'a bit cold')—contrast 一点 after adjectives.

examples.text: 声音轻，很有礼貌，大概三十多岁，有点紧张。
examples.trans: Soft-spoken, very polite, around thirty-something, and a bit nervous.

examples.text: 墙上也没镜子，地上没铺地毯有点空。
examples.trans: No mirror on the wall either, and the floor feels bare without a rug.

meanings.note: Adjective yǒuyòng ('useful').

examples.text: 那我现在去买个同款水杯有用吗？
examples.trans: Would going out to buy a matching water mug help?

examples.text: 方老师讲的辩证道理对做策划特别有用。
examples.trans: Professor Fang's lesson on dialectics proved super useful.

meanings.note: Verb-object yǒukòng ('be free').

examples.text: 有空的话，我们可以一起坐坐吗？
examples.trans: When you are free, could we sit down for a chat?

examples.text: 周末你有空一起看电影吗？
examples.trans: Are you free this weekend to see a movie?

有缘.gloss: brought together by fate, clicking well

meanings.en: brought together by fate, clicking well
meanings.note: Adjective yǒuyuán ('fated to meet, congenial').

examples.text: 咱们都是双硕士，我看咱俩挺有缘的。
examples.trans: Both holding master's degrees, I say the two of us click.

examples.text: 能在同一个节目组共事也是一种有缘。
examples.trans: Working on the same show crew is a lucky bond.

meanings.note: Backed by solid evidence or logic.

examples.text: 想打动大导演，必须拿出一份有说服力的演员资料。
examples.trans: To win over the director, you need a convincing actor dossier.

examples.text: 详实的收视曲线让她的发言显得非常有说服力。
examples.trans: Detailed ratings curves made her presentation deeply persuasive.

meanings.note: polished stage host phrase inviting a guest out

examples.text: 有请本场十二歌王的客座导师，刘凡先生！
examples.trans: Please welcome tonight's Twelve Singers guest mentor, Mister Liu Fan!

examples.text: 下面有请第一位歌手登场！
examples.trans: Next, please welcome our first singer to the stage!

examples.text: 这就是我前两天的见闻。淳于总的过去有过洛琳，有过钟阳子，现在都已经不在他的生活里了。
examples.trans: That's what I witnessed overseas these past two days: Luo Lin and Zhong Yangzi were chapters of Mr Chun Yu's past, and neither is in his life anymore.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

有过之而无不及.gloss: match and even surpass (for better or worse)

meanings.en: match and even surpass (for better or worse)
meanings.note: Classic idiom comparing one person or thing to another.

examples.text: 论现场应变能力，这位年轻编导比起前辈有过之而无不及。
examples.trans: In live adaptability, this young director matches or surpasses veterans.

examples.text: 他自夸制作实力比起前任总监有过之而无不及。
examples.trans: He boasted that his production skill matched or topped his predecessor's.

meanings.note: Adjective yǒuxiàn ('limited in time or resources').

examples.text: 闻老师的档期也有限，今天必须录完。
examples.trans: Mr Wen Simo's schedule is limited too; we must wrap today.

examples.text: 虽然预算有限，但舞台效果依然做得很精致。
examples.trans: Despite a tight budget, the stage design looks refined.

meanings.note: Pinyin: péng you. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个朋友 ('a friend').

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 今天有两位老朋友从外地来看我。
examples.trans: Two old friends are visiting me from out of town today.

examples.text: 朋友们，大家好。
examples.trans: Hello, friends.

examples.text: 我的朋友们来了。
examples.trans: My friends have come.

朋友圈.gloss: social feed, WeChat Moments, circle of friends

meanings.en: social feed, WeChat Moments, circle of friends
meanings.note: Social media feed where friends share articles and photos.

examples.text: 今天这篇文章在大家的社交朋友圈里刷屏了。
examples.trans: Today this article went viral across everyone's social feeds.

examples.text: 她很少在朋友圈里发自己的私人生活。
examples.trans: She rarely posts about her private life on her social feed.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fú wù. Measure word (量词): 项, e.g. 一项服务 ('a service').

examples.text: 我们客栈都是五星级服务……哎呀！
examples.trans: At our inn, everything is five-star service... whoops!

examples.text: 分贝？所以九分不是给我前台服务打的分？
examples.trans: Decibels? So nine points was not a score for my front-desk service?

examples.text: 我知道当年我拿总冠军，你们心里没一个服气的，还敢再战吗？
examples.trans: I know none of you were convinced inside when I won the championship back then — dare to battle me again?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Formal medical verb-object fúyào ('take medicine').

examples.text: 失职导致嘉宾服药过量引发了心脏病。
examples.trans: The lapse led to the guest taking excess medication.

examples.text: 请严格按照医生的嘱咐按时服药。
examples.trans: Please take medication strictly on schedule as ordered.

望.gloss: expectations, hopes; prestige (in 不负所望)

meanings.en: expectations, hopes; prestige (in 不负所望)
meanings.note: Literary noun used in 所望 or 众望.

examples.text: 新节目首播夺冠，总算不负大家一直以来的厚望。
examples.trans: Taking number one on premiere night lived up to everyone's high hopes.

examples.text: 他站在窗前远远望着灯火通明的演播大楼。
examples.trans: Standing by the window, he gazed toward the brightly lit broadcast tower.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cháo. Describes which way a window faces or waving toward someone (朝院子 'facing the courtyard').

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Classifier qī for episodes of a weekly show.

examples.text: 我们正式邀请您录制一期谈话节目。
examples.trans: We formally invite you to record an episode of our show.

examples.text: 最近几期节目收视率涨得很快。
examples.trans: Ratings climbed fast over the past few episodes.

meanings.note: Verb/noun qīdài ('eagerly anticipate').

examples.text: 请问您最期待的明星是哪位？
examples.trans: Which star are you looking forward to most?

examples.text: 大家都很期待下一季的节目。
examples.trans: Everyone is looking forward to next season.

examples.text: 很多歌迷听到这个消息无比振奋，观众对十二歌王的期待值正在飙升。
examples.trans: Countless music fans are thrilled by the news, and audience anticipation for Twelve Singers is skyrocketing.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Time noun qījiān ('during a period').

examples.text: 二部在改版期间得到了充分的锻炼。
examples.trans: Unit Two received thorough training during the revamp period.

examples.text: 录制期间请所有观众把手机调成静音。
examples.trans: During taping, please set all mobile phones to silent.

examples.text: 这是期限啊。
examples.trans: This is deadline.

examples.text: 那个期限好。
examples.trans: That deadline is good.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块木头 ('a piece of wood').

examples.text: 有，结实的木床、干净书桌，风景全院最好。
examples.trans: Yes, a solid wooden bed, a clean desk, and the best view in the courtyard.

examples.text: 先生，到了。小心碰头，这根木房梁比较低。
examples.trans: Here we are, sir. Mind your head—this wooden beam is fairly low.

related.gloss: a piece of wood (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù dèng. Combines 木 ('wood/wooden') + 凳 ('stool/bench without a backrest'); measure word: 把 (bǎ) or 张 (zhāng).

examples.text: 小美，你踩着木凳够最上面那层架子的时候，让我扶住它！
examples.trans: Mei, let me hold that wooden stool steady while you stand on it to reach the top shelf!

examples.text: 老陈在工具间里做了一把结实的小木凳。
examples.trans: Chen built a sturdy little wooden stool in the workshop.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù jiang. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位木匠 ('a carpenter').

examples.text: 那里住着一位老木匠和两个孙子——哥哥弹钢琴，弟弟最爱小火车！
examples.trans: An old carpenter lived there with two grandsons—the older brother played piano, and the younger loved toy trains!

examples.text: 老木匠……还有箱子里的木头小火车！
examples.trans: An old carpenter... and the wooden toy train inside the bag!

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù tou. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块木头 ('a piece of wood').

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

examples.text: 怪不得这么重，全是木头和皮鞋！
examples.trans: No wonder it was so heavy—all wood and leather shoes!

related.gloss: a piece of wood (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù xiè. Measure word (量词): 把 (bǎ) or 点 (diǎn). Joins 木 ('wood') + 屑 ('tiny fragments, shavings').

examples.text: 铁盒一打开，里面飘出淡淡的雪松木屑香。
examples.trans: As soon as the tin opened, out drifted the faint scent of cedarwood shavings.

examples.text: 老陈修完木头椅子，把地上的木屑扫得干干净净。
examples.trans: After repairing the wooden chair, Chen swept all the wood shavings cleanly off the floor.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù gōng. Combines 木 ('wood') + 工 ('craft/artisan'); modifies tools and materials like 木工胶水 ('woodworking glue').

examples.text: 老陈的工具箱里常备着细砂纸和木工胶水。
examples.trans: Chen's toolbox always keeps fine sandpaper and woodworking glue on hand.

examples.text: 这把结实的圆木椅是一位老木工亲手做的。
examples.trans: This sturdy wooden chair was handmade by a veteran carpenter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù gōng fáng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间木工房 ('a carpentry workshop').

examples.text: 这是爷爷木工房里那个旧深蓝箱子吗？
examples.trans: Is that the old dark-blue case from Grandfather's carpentry workshop?

examples.text: 爷爷以前在一楼后面的木工房做小木车。
examples.trans: Grandfather used to carve toy wooden trains in the back carpentry workshop.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù tiáo. Combines 木 ('wood') + 条 ('long narrow strip/slat'); measure word: 根 (gēn).

examples.text: 周经理拍拍胸口说：“我就刷窗板底下整整齐齐的三根木条！”
examples.trans: Manager Zhou said confidently, 'I will just paint the three neat wooden slats at the bottom of the shutter!'

examples.text: 老陈用砂纸把每一根百叶木条都打磨得光光滑滑。
examples.trans: Chen sanded every single wooden louver slat with sandpaper until it was completely smooth.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù bǎn. Combines 木 ('wood') + 板 ('board/plank'); measure word: 块 (kuài).

examples.text: 这块木板在我手里十五年，一直只有一到八号挂钩。
examples.trans: For fifteen years in my hands, this wooden board only ever held hooks one through eight.

examples.text: 老陈挑了两块干燥的厚木板来做新书架。
examples.trans: Chen picked out two thick dry wooden boards to build the new bookshelf.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù zhuō. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张木桌 ('a wooden table').

examples.text: 把小木桌放在树下面吧，离门口远一点。
examples.trans: Let's put the small wooden table right under the tree, a little farther from the doorway.

examples.text: 阳光照在擦得发亮的旧木桌上。
examples.trans: Sunlight falls across the polished old wooden table.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù pái. Combines 木 ('wooden') + 牌 ('signboard/plaque'); measure word: 块 (kuài).

examples.text: 看看我们准备挂在街门上的小木牌——简短、温暖，又容易读。
examples.trans: Look at the small wooden sign we are hanging on the street gate—short, warm, and easy to read.

examples.text: 小晴用端正的黑字在木牌上写下了咖啡角的营业时间。
examples.trans: Qing wrote the café corner's opening hours on the wooden sign in neat black lettering.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù chuāng. Measure word (量词): 扇 (shàn), e.g. 一扇木窗 ('a wooden window').

examples.text: 多半是粉刷街边木窗那种无聊通知吧。
examples.trans: Probably some boring notice about painting the street shutters.

examples.text: 推开二楼的木窗就能闻到桂花香。
examples.trans: Push open the second-floor wooden window and smell sweet osmanthus.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù xiāng. Combines 木 ('wood') + 箱 ('chest/box').

examples.text: 最下面的抽屉里没有的话，再找找那个旧木箱吧。
examples.trans: If it isn't in the bottom drawer, check inside that old wooden chest.

examples.text: 老陈把修钢琴的小工具整齐地收进木箱。
examples.trans: Chen packed the small piano-repair tools neatly into the wooden chest.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù wén. Combines 木 ('wood') + 纹 ('natural grain/pattern/lines').

examples.text: 老陈叮嘱小晴顺着木纹薄薄地把绿油漆刷匀。
examples.trans: Chen reminded Qing to brush the green paint thinly and evenly along the wood grain.

examples.text: 擦上木蜡油以后，核桃木钢琴表面漂亮的木纹全都显露出来了。
examples.trans: Once rubbed with wood oil, the beautiful wood grain of the walnut piano shone through.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù huā jià. Combines 木 ('wooden') + 花 ('flower/vine') + 架 ('frame/trellis').

examples.text: 我们轻轻把绿藤条抬到旁边的木花架上。
examples.trans: We gently lifted the green vine onto the wooden trellis beside it.

examples.text: 院子角落的木花架上爬满了常春藤。
examples.trans: The wooden trellis in the corner of the courtyard is covered in climbing ivy.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù mén. Measure word (量词): 扇 (shàn), e.g. 一扇木门 ('a wooden door').

examples.text: 再往左拐进小广场，找一扇蓝木门。
examples.trans: Then turn left into the small square and look for a blue wooden door.

examples.text: 正往前走……啊，看见金钥匙招牌和蓝木门了！
examples.trans: Walking forward now... oh, I see the golden key sign and the blue wooden door!

meanings.note: Formal negation wèi ('not yet; un-').

examples.text: 未经过允许的拍摄属于侵犯版权。
examples.trans: Filming without permission counts as copyright violation.

examples.text: 合同尚未签字，细节还能商量。
examples.trans: The contract is not signed yet, so details are open.

meanings.note: Adverb wèibì ('may not turn out to be').

examples.text: 派人监督节目质量，我想这未必是件坏事。
examples.trans: Sending people to oversee quality may not be a bad thing.

examples.text: 投资最大的节目未必收视率最高。
examples.trans: The biggest-budget show does not always top ratings.

examples.text: 这一季节目未播先火，我是真没想到。
examples.trans: This season is already red-hot before airing a single frame; I truly didn't see this coming.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Time noun wèilái ('future').

examples.text: 我们感怀的，始终是走过的过去和未来。
examples.trans: What moves our hearts is always our shared past and future.

examples.text: 本土原创节目代表着中国电视行业的未来方向。
examples.trans: Domestic original formats represent the future of television.

meanings.note: Attributive/noun wèizhī ('unknown').

examples.text: 年轻人每天都面临着很多未知的挑战。
examples.trans: Young people face plenty of uncharted challenges every day.

examples.text: 真人秀最大的魅力就在于下一秒永远充满未知。
examples.trans: Reality TV's magic is that the next moment is always unknown.

本.gloss: measure word for books and notebooks

meanings.en: measure word for books and notebooks
meanings.note: Pinyin: běn. Counts bound volumes, notebooks, ledgers, and albums (一本书, 一本账本).

examples.text: 等等——柜台上这本棕色小皮笔记本是谁的？
examples.trans: Wait—whose small brown leather notebook is this on the counter?

examples.text: 书桌上放着两本旧乐谱。
examples.trans: Two old music books sit on the desk.

meanings.note: Noun běnshi ('capability, guts').

examples.text: 你有本事当着老大的面说呀！
examples.trans: If you have the nerve, say that to our boss's face!

examples.text: 他年纪不大，本事却不小。
examples.trans: Though young, he has real skill.

meanings.note: Emphasises direct personal contact rather than proxies.

examples.text: 必须联系到艺人本人，确认他现在是否安全。
examples.trans: We must reach the artist in person to confirm he is safe.

examples.text: 领奖的时候需要获奖者本人亲自到场。
examples.trans: Accepting the award requires the winner to attend in person.

meanings.note: Attributive/noun běntǔ ('native, domestic').

examples.text: 很少有平台敢冒险投资纯粹的本土原创节目。
examples.trans: Few platforms dare risk funding purely homegrown original shows.

examples.text: 把国际制作水准与本土文化结合是我们的目标。
examples.trans: Pairing world-class craft with local culture is our goal.

meanings.note: Media noun/verb běntǔhuà ('localization').

examples.text: 我就一直在做这档节目的本土化研究。
examples.trans: I have been researching the localization of this format.

examples.text: 海外综艺引进之后必须做好本土化改造。
examples.trans: Imported shows need strong localization to click locally.

meanings.note: Pinyin: běn dì. Modifies nouns directly or with 的 (本地蜂蜜 'local honey', 本地人 'locals').

examples.text: 集市上卖的全是本地果园早上摘的水果。
examples.trans: Everything sold at the market is fruit picked this morning from local orchards.

examples.text: 本地人最喜欢去转角那家小店喝早茶。
examples.trans: Locals love going to that little shop on the corner for morning tea.

examples.text: 三次技术犯规，本场比赛取消。
examples.trans: Three technical fouls — this match is officially canceled.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: běn zi. Measure word (量词): 本 (běn), e.g. 一本本子 ('a notebook').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Formal determiner běnjiè ('this edition of an annual event').

examples.text: 本届的星光盛典由卫视和星天共同呈现。
examples.trans: This year's Star Night is jointly presented by the network and Xingtian.

examples.text: 本届比赛吸引了许多年轻歌手。
examples.trans: This edition of the contest drew many young singers.

meanings.note: Pinyin: běn lái. Indicates what was originally planned or true.

examples.text: 等等——您本来打算让店员把箱子交给他，自己躲在街对面看？！
examples.trans: Wait—you were planning to let the clerk hand him the bag and watch from across the street?!

examples.text: 电线本来就该拉直了。正常保养，别多想。
examples.trans: The wire needed straightening anyway. Routine maintenance—don't read into it.

meanings.note: Campus noun běnkē ('undergraduate level').

examples.text: 我从念本科的时候就视淳于总为偶像了。
examples.trans: Ever since my undergraduate days, Chun Yuqiao has been my idol.

examples.text: 她本科读的是广播电视编导专业。
examples.trans: Her undergraduate major was television directing.

meanings.note: Refers back to the core nature of a person or thing.

examples.text: 这个创意本身是非常优秀的。
examples.trans: This creative concept is excellent in itself.

examples.text: 问题出在艺人本身，而不是团队。
examples.trans: The issue lies with the artist personally, not the team.

朵.gloss: measure word for flowers, blossoms, and clouds

meanings.en: measure word for flowers, blossoms, and clouds
meanings.note: Pinyin: duǒ. Standard classifier for flowers, flower-shaped emblems, and clouds (一朵花 'a flower', 一朵云 'a cloud').

examples.text: 卡片右下角画着一朵小小的八角罗盘花。
examples.trans: In the bottom-right corner of the card is drawn a tiny eight-point compass rose.

examples.text: 院子角落里开了好几朵香喷喷的白茉莉花。
examples.trans: Several fragrant white jasmine blossoms have opened in the corner of the courtyard.

meanings.note: jīhuì — commonly takes the classifier 个 (gè) and collocates with verbs like 抓住 (seize), 把握 (grasp), 错过 (miss), and 放弃 (give up).

examples.text: 抓住机会，锻炼自己。
examples.trans: Seize the opportunity and toughen yourself through practice.

examples.text: 你真的想放弃去电视台工作的机会吗？
examples.trans: Do you really want to give up the opportunity to work at the TV station?

examples.text: 比起资本风险，更关键的是机会成本。
examples.trans: Compared with capital risk, the far bigger issue is opportunity cost.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Broadcast noun jīwèi ('camera setup/unit on set').

examples.text: 请问四号机位已经就位了吗？
examples.trans: Is Camera Four in position yet?

examples.text: 导演在彩排时调整了三个机位。
examples.trans: The director adjusted three camera positions at rehearsal.

meanings.note: Self-sustaining organizational process.

examples.text: 优秀的领导者懂得为公司建立独立运行的成熟机制。
examples.trans: A great leader builds a mature mechanism that runs independently.

examples.text: 完善的审核机制能有效避免虚假广告混入节目。
examples.trans: A sound vetting mechanism keeps fraudulent ads off the air.

meanings.note: Noun jīqì ('machine').

examples.text: 他把制作一部打造成一部超级机器。
examples.trans: He built Unit One into a super machine.

examples.text: 这台咖啡机器很好用。
examples.trans: This coffee machine is very easy to use.

meanings.note: Noun jīchǎng ('airport').

examples.text: 难得你睡得好没叫你，我自己去机场了。
examples.trans: You were sleeping soundly so I headed to the airport myself.

examples.text: 大巴提前三个小时出发送摄制组去国际机场。
examples.trans: The coach left three hours early to take the crew to the airport.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jī yóu. Combines 机 ('machinery/mechanism') + 油 ('oil').

examples.text: 往生锈的合页轴上滴两滴机油，窗板就容易打开了。
examples.trans: Put two drops of lubricating oil on the rusty hinge pin and the shutter opens easily.

examples.text: 老陈随身带着一小瓶机油，专门对付发紧的旧门锁。
examples.trans: Chen carries a small bottle of machine oil specifically for stiff old locks.

meanings.note: Ticket for air travel.

examples.text: 她已经订好了明天一早出国的机票。
examples.trans: She has already booked an international flight ticket for tomorrow.

examples.text: 旺季出差一定要提前几天预订机票。
examples.trans: For peak-season trips, book plane tickets several days ahead.

examples.text: 我求求大家了，我真的不会唱歌，你们干脆杀了我吧！
examples.trans: I'm begging everyone — I truly can't sing a note, so just put me out of my misery!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Idiom praising resolute, no-nonsense executive action.

examples.text: 董事长在关键时刻杀伐决断，迅速稳住了大局。
examples.trans: Decisive at critical moments, the chairwoman quickly steadied the ship.

examples.text: 管理这么大的传媒集团需要杀伐决断的魄力。
examples.trans: Running such a large media group takes resolute executive nerve.

meanings.note: Everyday minor tasks distracting from what matters.

examples.text: 你专心照顾病人就行，公司里的杂事都别管。
examples.trans: Focus on caring for the patient and ignore office chores.

examples.text: 助理帮导演处理掉了许多繁琐的日常杂事。
examples.trans: The assistant handled plenty of tedious daily chores for the director.

meanings.note: Noun záwù ('miscellaneous office chores').

examples.text: 行政助理负责全公司的杂务。
examples.trans: Admin assistants handle chores across the whole company.

examples.text: 今天办公室的杂务特别多。
examples.trans: There are lots of office chores today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zá yīn. Combines 杂 ('mixed/stray') + 音 ('sound'): mechanical buzz, rattle, or static interfering with pure musical tone.

examples.text: 老陈修好琴槌以后，中央瑞音一点儿杂音都没有了。
examples.trans: After Chen repaired the piano hammer, middle D had not the slightest squeak or buzz.

examples.text: 关上朝马路的那扇小窗，屋里就听不见外面的杂音了。
examples.trans: Close that small window facing the main road and you won't hear any stray noise inside.

examples.text: 据我所知，她和白石公司的合约没有任何法律效力，如果她不出来主张权利，咱们就没有办法。
examples.trans: From what I learned, her contract with Baishi has no legal validity — yet unless she steps forward to claim her rights, our hands are tied.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 可是前几年您与白石公司签订了一份合约，按照法律来讲，对您的权益是有所损害的。
examples.trans: Yet a few years ago you signed a contract with Baishi that legally infringed upon your own rights.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Workplace/IT noun quánxiàn ('scope of authority/access').

examples.text: 公司所有的会议日程，我都有权限知道。
examples.trans: I hold the authority to view every meeting across the company.

examples.text: 只有总编室成员才有打开这个文件夹的权限。
examples.trans: Only editorial staff have permission to open this folder.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xìng rén. Combines 杏 ('apricot/almond') + 仁 ('nut kernel').

examples.text: 小美端来了一盘刚出炉的温热杏仁饼干。
examples.trans: Mei brought over a plate of warm almond biscuits fresh from the oven.

examples.text: 用杏仁粉做的柠檬挞底吃起来特别香酥。
examples.trans: A lemon tart crust made with ground almonds tastes wonderfully crisp and nutty.

meanings.note: senior producer Xingzi on Chun Yuqiao's team (literally 'apricot')

examples.text: 你这几天就跟着杏子姐姐，给她打打下手。
examples.trans: For the next few days, shadow Sister Xingzi and lend her a hand.

examples.text: 谢谢你，杏子姐！
examples.trans: Thank you, Sister Xingzi!

meanings.note: Meaning: Sister Xingzi.

examples.text: 杏子姐，你在这儿干吗？
examples.trans: Sister Xingzi, what are you doing here?

examples.text: 杏子姐，是我，我要道歉。
examples.trans: Sister Xingzi, it was my fault — I need to apologise.

meanings.note: Documents/data prepared for review, or physical materials.

examples.text: 她整理好全套演员资料和舆情材料送去演播室。
examples.trans: She compiled the full actor profile and sentiment materials for the studio.

examples.text: 申请立项之前请把所有预算材料准备齐全。
examples.trans: Please prepare all budget materials before filing for greenlight.

条.gloss: measure word for streets, rivers, towels, clauses

meanings.en: measure word for streets, rivers, towels, clauses
meanings.note: Pinyin: tiáo. Counts long, narrow, or winding things: streets, rivers, scarves, towels, trousers, and legal clauses (一条街).

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 行，你说吧，什么条件？
examples.trans: Alright, go ahead and name your condition.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiáo lì. Measure word (量词): 部, e.g. 一部条例 ('a municipal regulation').

examples.text: 《成都老城区法案》第十四条，而且这里我哥哥刚刚也点头了！
examples.trans: Clause fourteen of the Chengdu Old Quarter Act—and my brother here just nodded!

examples.text: 根据城市历史街区条例，老砖墙必须保留。
examples.trans: Under the historic district regulation, the old brick wall must stay.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiáo wén. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条条文 ('a legal clause').

examples.text: 法律条文我戴两副眼镜看都头疼！
examples.trans: Legal clauses give me a headache even with two pairs of glasses!

examples.text: 律师把合同里的每一条条文都读了一遍。
examples.trans: The lawyer read through every single clause in the contract.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lái. Movement toward the speaker, as main verb or directional complement (进来 'come in').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

来不了.gloss: cannot come; unable to make it

meanings.en: cannot come; unable to attend or make it
meanings.note: láibuliǎo — negative potential complement formed from 来 (come) + 不了 (unable to); the affirmative counterpart is 来得了 (able to come).

examples.text: 尹正宇来不了这边，当然是有人泄露了消息。
examples.trans: Yin Zhengyu cannot come to our side; obviously someone leaked the news.

examples.text: 辛惠美临时有事，今晚来不了了。
examples.trans: Something came up for Xin Huimei at the last minute, so she cannot make it tonight.

related.gloss: able to come; can make it

meanings.en: not have enough time; be too late
meanings.note: Pinyin: lái bu jí. Opposite of 来得及 ('make it in time').

examples.text: 来不及了！他说了声谢谢就挂断了！
examples.trans: Too late! He said thank you and hung up!

examples.text: 再不出发就来不及赶八点的火车了！
examples.trans: If we do not head out now, we will never make the eight o'clock train!

meanings.note: Pinyin: lái xìn. Measure word (量词): 封 (fēng), e.g. 一封来信 ('a letter received').

examples.text: 太好了……趁着等他们，我扫一眼这封房东来信。
examples.trans: Wonderful... while we wait, let me glance at this letter from the landlord.

examples.text: 啊！忙着行李箱、热水器和来信，我完全忘了！
examples.trans: Oh! With the suitcases, the water heater, and the letter, I completely forgot!

来到.gloss: to come to; to arrive at

meanings.en: to come to; to arrive at (a place or stage)
meanings.note: láidào — verb-complement compound (来 + 到) that directly takes a location noun phrase as its object, especially common in 欢迎来到… (welcome to…).

examples.text: 欢迎来到星天，这会儿正在录像呢。
examples.trans: Welcome to Xingtian; they are taping right at this moment.

examples.text: 欢迎大家来到《十二歌王》的现场！
examples.trans: Welcome everyone to the live studio of Twelve Kings of Song!

related.gloss: to attend; to be present in person

meanings.note: Pinyin: lái huí. Describes pacing back and forth or a round trip.

examples.text: 十分钟之内你能跑个来回吗？
examples.trans: Can you run there and back within ten minutes?

examples.text: 从客栈到五金店走一个来回只要十分钟。
examples.trans: A round trip on foot from the inn to the hardware shop takes ten minutes.

meanings.note: Potential phrase láidejí ('still in time to do something').

examples.text: 那份合同我还没有来得及看。
examples.trans: I have not had time to read that contract yet.

examples.text: 现在出发去演播厅还来得及。
examples.trans: Leaving for the studio now will still get us there in time.

来日方长.gloss: there is plenty of time ahead (warm or warning)

meanings.en: there is plenty of time ahead (warm or warning)
meanings.note: Can express patience with friends or 'we will settle scores later'.

examples.text: 今天没聊尽兴没关系，咱们来日方长，下次再聚。
examples.trans: No matter if we ran out of time today—we have plenty of days ahead.

examples.text: 受挫之后他丢下一句咱们来日方长便拂袖而去。
examples.trans: Stung by the setback, he tossed out 'this is not over yet' and stormed off.

meanings.note: Verb láizì ('originate from').

examples.text: 他就是来自泰国著名的喜剧大咖。
examples.trans: He is a famous comedy star hailing from Thailand.

examples.text: 现场观众来自全国各地不同的城市。
examples.trans: Studio audience members hail from cities nationwide.

examples.text: 可是前几年您与白石公司签订了一份合约，按照法律来讲，对您的权益是有所损害的。
examples.trans: Yet a few years ago you signed a contract with Baishi that legally infringed upon your own rights.

examples.text: 从法律层面上来讲，这家公司已经违约在先了，所以他们手中的这份合约已经失效。
examples.trans: Legally speaking, the publisher breached its contract first, rendering the agreement in its hands null and void.

meanings.note: Postposition láishuō paired with 对 ('for someone').

examples.text: 对我来说，这份工作已经足够了。
examples.trans: For me, this job is more than enough.

examples.text: 对新人来说，这是个好机会。
examples.trans: For a newcomer, this is a great opportunity.

杯.gloss: measure word for cups and glasses

meanings.en: measure word for cups and glasses
meanings.note: Pinyin: bēi. Counts cups of tea, coffee, water, or juice (一杯热茶 'a cup of hot tea').

examples.text: 太客气了，周经理。半杯就好。
examples.trans: How polite of you, Manager Zhou. Half a glass is fine.

examples.text: 坐下吧，小晴！早上你跑了半条街，喝杯咖啡。
examples.trans: Sit down, Qing! You ran half the street this morning—drink a cup of coffee.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bēi zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个杯子 ('a cup').

examples.text: 每个蓝杯子旁边放一张餐巾和一把小勺子。
examples.trans: Beside every blue cup, put one napkin and one small spoon.

examples.text: 请往我的杯子里再加一点热水。
examples.trans: Please add a little more hot water to my cup.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sōng. Describes a loose screw/handle or relaxing tension (松一口气 'breathe a sigh of relief').

examples.text: 老房子每到星期二就松一颗螺丝。坐吧。
examples.trans: Every Tuesday an old house loosens one screw. Sit down.

examples.text: 太松一口气了！志豪先生，给您银钥匙。
examples.trans: What a relief! Mr Zhihao, here is your silver key.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jí le. Follows directly after an adjective to boost it to the max (棒极了！ 'amazing!', 热极了 'super hot!').

examples.text: 等等，咸黄油配果酱不行，做炒蛋却棒极了！
examples.trans: Wait—salted butter fails with jam, yet for scrambled eggs it is amazing!

examples.text: 这是我这个月睡得最香的一晚，洗澡水也热极了！
examples.trans: Best sleep I have had all month, and the shower water was wonderfully hot!

examples.text: 这些人也太夸张了吧，变得太极端了吧！
examples.trans: These people are outrageous — talk about a complete one-eighty!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: News term used in international security reports.

examples.text: 新闻报道称已有极端组织对此次事件发表声明。
examples.trans: News reports said extremist groups issued statements on the incident.

examples.text: 各国都在加强合作，严防极端组织的破坏活动。
examples.trans: Countries are working together against extremist threats.

meanings.note: Noun jíxiàn ('breaking point, maximum limit').

examples.text: 所有员工的加班时间已经到了极限。
examples.trans: Overtime hours for every staffer have hit the limit.

examples.text: 连续直播五小时挑战了团队的体能极限。
examples.trans: A five-hour live broadcast tested the crew's limits.

meanings.note: Formal verb gòuxiàn ('fabricate charges against').

examples.text: 这种恶意的攻击和构陷非常无耻。
examples.trans: Such malicious attacks and framing are shameless.

examples.text: 真相查清后，恶意构陷他的人道了歉。
examples.trans: Once the truth emerged, those who framed him apologised.

meanings.note: Usually negated (不枉费) to mean hard work paid off.

examples.text: 节目反响这么好，真是不枉费大家辛苦一场。
examples.trans: With reception this strong, nobody's hard work went in vain.

examples.text: 你不听劝告，简直枉费了朋友的一番苦心。
examples.trans: Ignoring the advice wastes all your friend's painstaking care.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhěn tou. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个枕头 ('a pillow').

examples.text: 储藏室里有两个软枕头和一块蓝地毯！
examples.trans: In the storeroom there are two soft pillows and a blue rug!

examples.text: 小晴，把床单角塞紧！放上两个软枕头。
examples.trans: Qing, tuck the sheet corner tight! On go the two soft pillows.

枚.gloss: classifier for rings, medals, coins, stamps

meanings.en: classifier for rings, medals, coins, stamps
meanings.note: Measure word for small flat or ring-shaped items.

examples.text: 他在口袋里悄悄准备了一枚精致的银戒指。
examples.trans: He quietly tucked a delicate silver ring into his pocket.

examples.text: 运动健儿在国际赛场上赢得了一枚宝贵的金牌。
examples.trans: The athlete won a precious gold medal on the world stage.

meanings.note: Literally fruit, figuratively hard-won results.

examples.text: 全组齐心协力，终于收获了甜美的工作果实。
examples.trans: Pulling together, the whole crew reaped sweet fruits of their work.

examples.text: 秋天到了，果园里的树上挂满了果实。
examples.trans: Autumn arrived, weighing the orchard trees down with fruit.

meanings.note: Noun guǒzhī ('fruit juice').

examples.text: 我想喝点有味道的，比如鲜榨果汁。
examples.trans: I want something with flavour, like fruit juice.

examples.text: 冰箱里还有两瓶冰镇果汁。
examples.trans: There are still two bottles of chilled juice in the fridge.

meanings.note: Adverb guǒrán ('as expected').

examples.text: 辛惠美的车果然也到了。
examples.trans: Sure enough, Xin Huimei's car arrived too.

examples.text: 天气预报说有雨，下午果然下了。
examples.trans: Rain was forecast, and sure enough it rained this afternoon.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guǒ jiàng. Measure word (量词): 瓶 (píng), e.g. 一瓶果酱 ('a jar of jam').

examples.text: 那是海盐咸黄油！甜果酱面包卷要无盐黄油！
examples.trans: That is sea-salt butter! Sweet jam rolls need unsalted butter!

examples.text: 咸黄油能配甜草莓果酱吗？
examples.trans: Can salted butter go with sweet strawberry jam?

related.gloss: a jar of jam (measure word 瓶)

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhī. Classifier for slender plant stems, flower sprays, or herb sprigs (两小枝香草 'two small sprigs of herbs', 一枝玫瑰 'a rose stem').

examples.text: 小美让志鹏用细棉绳绑好两小枝刚摘下来的新鲜香草。
examples.trans: Mei had Peng tie two small sprigs of freshly picked herbs together with fine cotton string.

examples.text: 小晴在玻璃花瓶里插了一枝嫩绿的枝叶，桌子一下子亮了起来。
examples.trans: Qing placed a sprig of fresh green foliage in the glass vase, brightening the table right up.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhī tiáo. Combines 枝 ('branch') + 条 ('slender twig/strip').

examples.text: 请把常春藤的绿枝条轻轻挂到花架上。
examples.trans: Please drape the green branch of ivy gently onto the trellis.

examples.text: 春风一吹，柳树的细枝条在院墙外轻轻摇晃。
examples.trans: When the spring breeze blows, slender willow branches sway gently outside the courtyard wall.

架.gloss: measure word for pianos, planes, framed machines

meanings.en: measure word for pianos, planes, framed machines
meanings.note: Pinyin: jià. Counts pianos, airplanes, and framed instruments (一架钢琴 'a piano').

examples.text: 三年前爷爷去世以后，我和志鹏因为卖老房子大吵了一架。
examples.trans: Three years ago after Grandfather passed away, Zhipeng and I argued bitterly over selling the old house.

examples.text: 客厅角落里放着一架老钢琴。
examples.trans: An old piano stands in the corner of the living room.

架势.gloss: posture, the look of things, stance

meanings.en: posture, the look of things, stance
meanings.note: Colloquial noun for the visible vibe or setup.

examples.text: 看你们俩有说有笑这架势，最近相处得不错啊！
examples.trans: Going by the look of you two chatting away, things are going great!

examples.text: 乌云压得很低，看这架势马上就要下大雨了。
examples.trans: Dark clouds hang low—by the look of it, heavy rain is coming.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jià zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个架子 ('a shelf').

examples.text: 最上面架子上金色包装那包。怎么了？
examples.trans: The gold-wrapped packet on the top shelf. Why?

examples.text: 他拿旧阀门比对了——架子上正好还剩两个！
