examples.trans: He matched it against the old valve—he has two left on the shelf!

架空.gloss: strip of real authority, make a figurehead of

meanings.en: strip of real authority, make a figurehead of
meanings.note: Workplace verb jiàkōng ('sideline and hollow out someone's power').

examples.text: 趁他生病找别人接手，你这是明摆着架空他！
examples.trans: Handing his show off while he is ill is blatantly sidelining him!

examples.text: 没有核心编导团队配合，新上任的主管很快被架空了。
examples.trans: Without core producers backing him, the new supervisor was sidelined.

某.gloss: a certain, some single (person or thing)

meanings.en: a certain, some single (person or thing)
meanings.note: Determiner mǒu ('a certain unspecified').

examples.text: 合作是看中整个团队，而不是某一个人。
examples.trans: Our partnership values the whole team rather than any single person.

examples.text: 不能因为某一个环节出错就否定整场演出的努力。
examples.trans: One slip in a single segment does not erase the whole crew's effort.

examples.text: 全世界的人都在议论说白杨的声音和某个人很像，其实我并不这么认为。
examples.trans: Everyone out there is gossiping that Bai Yang's voice sounds just like someone else's, yet I don't see it that way at all.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Indefinite pronoun mǒurén ('someone unspecified').

examples.text: 就是请你看准机会，帮某人一个忙。
examples.trans: Just watch for the right moment and do someone a favour.

examples.text: 桌上放着某人悄悄送来的热咖啡。
examples.trans: Hot coffee left quietly by someone sat on the desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: róu huà. Describes wooden beams or curtains softening echoes.

examples.text: 因为湿木头百叶窗会柔化石板路传回来的回声……
examples.trans: Because wet wooden shutters soften the echo bouncing off the flagstones...

examples.text: 厚实的棉窗帘柔化了早晨刺眼的阳光。
examples.trans: Thick cotton curtains softened the bright morning sun.

meanings.note: Pinyin: róu hé. Describes soothing light, warm colours, or gentle acoustic tones.

examples.text: 磨砂玻璃让顶灯的光线变得非常柔和。
examples.trans: Frosted glass makes the light from the ceiling lamp wonderfully soft.

examples.text: 傍晚柔和的阳光照在院子的石桌子上。
examples.trans: Soft late-afternoon sunlight falls across the stone table in the courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: róu ruǎn. Near-synonym compound 柔 ('supple/gentle') + 软 ('soft'); used for well-kneaded dough, cushions, or fabrics.

examples.text: 发酵好的面团又光滑又柔软，轻轻按下去就会弹回来。
examples.trans: The risen dough is both smooth and soft, springing right back when pressed gently.

examples.text: 小美把受伤的脚踝放在两个柔软的枕头上休息。
examples.trans: Mei rested her injured ankle on two soft pillows.

meanings.note: Citrus fruit yòuzi.

examples.text: 秋天吃柚子很好。
examples.trans: Eating pomelo in autumn is great.

examples.text: 我点了一杯蜂蜜柚子茶。
examples.trans: I ordered a honey pomelo tea.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guì tái. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个柜台 ('a counter').

examples.text: 等等——柜台上这本棕色小皮笔记本是谁的？
examples.trans: Wait—whose small brown leather notebook is this on the counter?

examples.text: 昨晚您的本子在柜台翻开了，我们看到九分……
examples.trans: Last night your notebook fell open on the counter, and we saw nine points...

meanings.note: Pinyin: guì zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个柜子 ('a cabinet').

examples.text: 先生，箱子安全锁在柜子里。请问您贵姓？
examples.trans: Sir, the bag is locked safely in our closet. May I ask your surname?

examples.text: 我去柜子拿干净的白床单！
examples.trans: I will fetch clean white bedsheets from the cupboard!

meanings.note: Pinyin: níng méng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个柠檬 ('a lemon').

examples.text: 他爷爷会切热柠檬蛋糕，上面撒一层白糖粉！
examples.trans: His grandfather sliced warm lemon cake with a dusting of powdered sugar on top!

examples.text: 啊！黄色柠檬糖霜——每个星期五我们俩都抢边角那一块！
examples.trans: Oh! Yellow lemon glaze—every single Friday the two of us fought over the corner piece!

meanings.note: Pinyin: níng méng tǎ. Compound 柠檬 ('lemon') + 塔 ('tart', phonetic loan). Measure word: 个 (gè) or 块 (kuài).

examples.text: 小美用新鲜黄柠檬烤了一盘香喷喷的柠檬塔。
examples.trans: Mei baked a fragrant tray of lemon tarts with fresh yellow lemons.

examples.text: 酸酸甜甜的柠檬塔最适合配热红茶。
examples.trans: Sweet-and-tangy lemon tarts pair best with hot black tea.

meanings.note: Pinyin: níng méng tà. Combines 柠檬 ('lemon') + 挞 ('tart', phonetic loan from English 'tart').

examples.text: 星期二我们要修好琴键，还要烤星期三的柠檬挞！
examples.trans: On Tuesday we will fix the piano key and bake Wednesday's lemon tarts!

examples.text: 酸甜清香的杏仁柠檬挞成了咖啡角的招牌甜点。
examples.trans: Sweet-tart, fragrant almond lemon tart became the café corner's signature dessert.

meanings.note: Pinyin: níng méng zhī. Combines 柠檬 ('lemon') + 汁 ('squeezed juice').

examples.text: 碗里已经准备好了四个蛋黄、新鲜柠檬汁和三勺白糖。
examples.trans: Four egg yolks, fresh lemon juice, and three spoons of sugar are already waiting in the bowl.

examples.text: 挤几滴新鲜柠檬汁在热茶里，喝起来格外清爽。
examples.trans: Squeeze a few drops of fresh lemon juice into hot tea for a wonderfully bright taste.

meanings.note: Pinyin: níng méng jiàng. Combines 柠檬 ('lemon') + 酱 ('thick culinary spread/curd/jam'): rich custard cooked from lemon juice, egg yolks, sugar, and butter.

examples.text: 快看锅里，金黄的柠檬酱变得又浓稠又发亮！
examples.trans: Look in the pot—the golden lemon curd has turned so thick and glossy!

examples.text: 在酥脆的杏仁挞底里盛满温热的柠檬酱，香气扑鼻。
examples.trans: Filling the crisp almond tart shells with warm lemon curd sends up a mouthwatering aroma.

examples.text: 查资料。
examples.trans: Look up information.

examples.text: 查一下字典。
examples.trans: Look it up in the dictionary.

examples.text: 到底怎么侵的权，你们怎么还没查出来啊？
examples.trans: How on earth did we infringe copyright — why haven't you tracked down the cause yet?!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Four-character phrase chá wú cǐ rén ('records show no such person').

examples.text: 那个传说中后来查无此人的员工就是你吧？
examples.trans: That rumoured employee who vanished from records is you, right?

examples.text: 快递员按旧地址找过去，结果查无此人。
examples.trans: The courier checked the old address and found nobody listed.

meanings.note: Reduplicated casual form of 查.

examples.text: 请帮我在人事系统里查查这项任命的登记信息。
examples.trans: Please check the HR system for the registration of this appointment.

examples.text: 播出前再仔细查查字幕里有没有错别字。
examples.trans: Double-check the subtitles for typos one more time before air.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhàlán. Measure word: 道.

examples.text: 农场周围有一道木质的栅栏。
examples.trans: There is a wooden fence around the farm.

examples.text: 狗跳过了院子的栅栏。
examples.trans: The dog jumped over the yard's fence.

meanings.note: Pinyin: biāo. Action verb for marking numbers, symbols, or prices on a surface (标着一到四号 'marked one through four').

examples.text: 四张水彩卡片的右上角都标着清楚的号码。
examples.trans: Clear numbers are marked in the upper-right corner of all four watercolour cards.

examples.text: 志豪在地图上用红笔标出了小院客栈的位置。
examples.trans: Hao marked the location of Courtyard Inn on the map in red pen.

meanings.note: Noun/adj biāozhǔn ('criterion; standard').

examples.text: 找男朋友还有什么标准吗？
examples.trans: Are there any other criteria for a boyfriend?

examples.text: 淳于乔对节目音质的要求非常高标准。
examples.trans: Chun Yuqiao holds audio quality to a high standard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: biāo qiān. Combines 标 ('mark/sign') + 签 ('inscribed slip/tag'); measure word: 张 (zhāng); verb: 贴标签 ('stick on a label').

examples.text: 睡觉以前，先把那两个神秘白罐子都贴上清楚的大红标签。
examples.trans: Before going to bed, stick clear bright red labels onto both of those mysterious white jars.

examples.text: 贴好“白糖”和“海盐”的标签以后，早上做点心就再也不会拿错了。
examples.trans: Once the 'Sugar' and 'Sea Salt' labels are stuck on, nobody will mix them up during morning baking.

meanings.note: Pinyin: biāo tí. Written title at the top of a score, article, or notice.

examples.text: 乐谱最上面用黑墨水写着一行漂亮的标题。
examples.trans: At the very top of the score, a handsome title is written in black ink.

examples.text: 看清楚通知的标题，检查时间改到星期三了。
examples.trans: Read the heading of the notice carefully—the inspection time moved to Wednesday.

栋.gloss: measure word for buildings and houses

meanings.en: measure word for buildings and houses
meanings.note: Pinyin: dòng. Counts whole standalone buildings (一栋老房子 'an old building').

examples.text: 二十五年前？就在同一栋房子里？
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago? Right inside that very same house?

examples.text: 产权转让通知：八号小院整栋建筑将作为商业办公楼出售。
examples.trans: Property Transfer Notice: Courtyard Building Eight offered for sale as commercial offices.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a noun used in conversational Mandarin. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个栏杆 ('a 栏杆').

examples.text: 我有一个栏杆。
examples.trans: I have a 栏杆.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的栏杆。
examples.trans: This is a very good 栏杆.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shù. Measure word (量词): 棵, e.g. 一棵树 ('a tree').

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

examples.text: 只有院子里的老树和雨声。
examples.trans: Only the old tree in the courtyard and the sound of rain.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shù xià. Measure word (量词): 片 (piàn), e.g. 树下阴凉 ('shade under the tree').

examples.text: 我把蓝色行李箱放在树下志豪桌子边了。
examples.trans: I placed the blue suitcase right beside Hao's table under the tree.

examples.text: 小晴，隔着玻璃看——他们俩在树下面对面站着呢！
examples.trans: Qing, look through the glass—the two of them are standing face to face under the tree!

related.gloss: shade under the tree (measure word 片)

meanings.note: Pinyin: shù yè. Measure word (量词): 片 (piàn), e.g. 一片树叶 ('a leaf').

examples.text: 没错。外面大街很吵，进了院子却只听见树叶和小鸟。
examples.trans: Exactly. Outside on the main road it is noisy, yet inside the courtyard you only hear leaves and birds.

examples.text: 风一吹，绿树叶沙沙地响。
examples.trans: When the breeze blows, the green leaves rustle softly.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shùyīn. Measure word: 片.

examples.text: 老人在树荫下乘凉。
examples.trans: The old man is enjoying the cool breeze in the shade of the tree.

examples.text: 夏天的午后，树荫里非常凉快。
examples.trans: On summer afternoons, it is very cool in the shade of the trees.

examples.text: 举办了一届校际桌式足球比赛。
examples.trans: So I put together an intercollegiate table-football tournament.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Noun xiàofēng ('tradition and character of a school').

examples.text: 大概这就是我们传媒学院的校风吧。
examples.trans: Perhaps that is the ethos of our Media College.

examples.text: 这所大学一直保持着严谨的校风。
examples.trans: This university keeps a rigorous academic spirit.

meanings.note: Classifier yàng ('kind, type of thing').

examples.text: 世上有两样东西是管不住的。
examples.trans: Two things in this world cannot be controlled.

examples.text: 桌上有好几样点心。
examples.trans: There are several kinds of snacks on the table.

meanings.note: Noun yàngzi ('state, appearance').

examples.text: 怎么现在变成这个样子了？
examples.trans: How did things turn into this state now?

examples.text: 看他胸有成竹的样子，一定想到办法了。
examples.trans: Seeing his calm look, he must have found a solution.

meanings.note: Formal verb hézhǔn ('verify and authorize').

examples.text: 这项制度是斯戴拉姐亲自核准的。
examples.trans: Stella personally approved this policy.

examples.text: 预算报告已经核准了。
examples.trans: The budget report has been approved.

meanings.note: Verb héduì ('check carefully against records').

examples.text: 我只核对了米娜一个人的饮食习惯。
examples.trans: I only verified Mina's own dietary habits.

examples.text: 开播前导播再次核对了一遍字幕名单。
examples.trans: Before airing, the director cross-checked the credits.

meanings.note: héxīn — used as a noun or attributively before nouns (e.g., 核心业务 core business, 核心人物 key figure, 核心竞争力 core competitiveness).

examples.text: 我问你个问题，节目制作的核心业务在哪儿？
examples.trans: Let me ask you a question: where does the core business of show production lie?

examples.text: 真无法想象一个人经历了多少，才能成为公司的核心人物。
examples.trans: It is hard to imagine how much one person endures to become a central figure in the company.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé tao mù. Rich dark hardwood prized for upright pianos and classic furniture (note neutral-tone tao).

examples.text: 擦干净以后，老钢琴的核桃木外壳亮极了。
examples.trans: After being wiped clean, the old piano's walnut wood case gleams.

examples.text: 这张核桃木书桌已经在房间里放了四十年。
examples.trans: This walnut desk has stood in the room for forty years.

根.gloss: measure word for pipes, wires, sticks

meanings.en: measure word for pipes, wires, sticks
meanings.note: Pinyin: gēn. Counts long, thin rod-like or cord-like objects (一根水管 'a water pipe', 一根电线 'a wire').

examples.text: 先生，到了。小心碰头，这根木房梁比较低。
examples.trans: Here we are, sir. Mind your head—this wooden beam is fairly low.

examples.text: 老木匠换了一根新的铜水管。
examples.trans: The carpenter replaced it with a new copper water pipe.

meanings.note: Preposition/noun gēnjù ('based on, under').

examples.text: 根据公司的规定，签字就能生效。
examples.trans: Under company rules, signing takes effect at once.

examples.text: 请根据实际情况做决定。
examples.trans: Please decide based on actual conditions.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gēn běn. Emphatic adverb before 不/没/无法 meaning 'simply never / not at all'.

examples.text: 木板要是淋湿了，绿油漆根本挂不住。
examples.trans: If the wooden boards get rained on, green paint will never stick at all.

examples.text: 半夜十二点，梧桐巷里根本没有大卡车。
examples.trans: At twelve midnight, there are no big trucks on Wutong Lane at all.

meanings.note: Academic/business noun ànlì ('case study').

examples.text: 就以孤岛争取立项的过程作为论文案例。
examples.trans: Use Lonely Island's greenlighting journey as your case study.

examples.text: 这期改版成了传媒教材里的经典成功案例。
examples.trans: This revamp became a classic success case in media textbooks.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuō. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张桌子 ('a table').

examples.text: 等等——小美这会儿正要把蛋糕端到他们那桌去。
examples.trans: Wait—Mei is taking the cake out to their table right now.

examples.text: 从明天早上八点开始！屋里四张桌，树下三张桌！
examples.trans: Starting tomorrow morning at eight! Four tables indoors, three tables under the tree!

examples.text: 桌上的东西你可以看看。
examples.trans: Take a look at the folder I left on your desk.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuō zi. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张桌子 ('a table').

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuō bù. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块桌布 ('a tablecloth').

examples.text: 给，干净白桌布和两只蓝茶杯。
examples.trans: Here—a clean white tablecloth and two blue teacups.

examples.text: 每张餐桌上都换上了干净的白桌布。
examples.trans: Every dining table was dressed in a crisp white tablecloth.

examples.text: 举办了一届校际桌式足球比赛。
examples.trans: So I put together an intercollegiate table-football tournament.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Noun zhuōmiàn ('desktop screen or table surface').

examples.text: 会议电脑桌面上的保守方案是我改掉的。
examples.trans: I swapped out the conservative file on the meeting desktop.

examples.text: 请把今天上会要用的演示稿放在电脑桌面上。
examples.trans: Put today's presentation file right on the desktop.

meanings.note: Media classifier dàng for broadcast shows or time slots.

examples.text: 主任希望老大直接全面接管这档节目。
examples.trans: The director wants our boss to take over this programme.

examples.text: 歌手比赛类的节目我平时主要看两档。
examples.trans: Among singing competitions, I mostly watch two shows.

examples.text: 这是档期啊。
examples.trans: This is schedule.

examples.text: 那个档期好。
examples.trans: That schedule is good.

examples.text: 公司系统里面有档案，档案上有我的生日。
examples.trans: The company system has personnel files, and my birthday is on my file.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiáo. Measure word (量词): 座 (zuò), e.g. 一座桥 ('a bridge').

examples.text: 冬天用掉最后一个了。只有桥那边的老五金店有这个尺寸。
examples.trans: Used the last one in winter. Only the old hardware shop past the bridge carries this size.

examples.text: 出门左拐，直走到桥。要过河吗？
examples.trans: Left out the gate, straight to the bridge. Do I cross the river?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuāng. Counts weighty matters or pieces of business (一桩事 'a matter').

examples.text: 说实话，我选这一带，也是为了一桩家里的旧事。
examples.trans: Honestly, I also chose this neighbourhood for an old family matter.

examples.text: 这可是一桩让人高兴的好事。
examples.trans: This really is a happy piece of news.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tǒng. Counts liquids by the bucket or can (两桶油漆 'two cans of paint'); also a noun for 'bucket'.

examples.text: 看我的单子：两桶绿油漆，十二个简单的杯子，还有市场的柠檬。
examples.trans: Look at my list: two cans of green paint, twelve simple cups, and lemons from the market.

examples.text: 老陈提来一桶热水。
examples.trans: Chen carried over a bucket of hot water.

examples.text: 能在老街上开一家温暖的小客栈是她梦寐以求的事。
examples.trans: Opening a cozy little guesthouse on the old street was something she had long dreamed of.

examples.text: 他终于找到了那本梦寐以求的旧版建筑画册。
examples.trans: He finally found that out-of-print architectural album he had long dreamed of.

meanings.note: Adjective mènghuàn ('dreamy, magical').

examples.text: 这座梦幻般的大都会今夜笼罩在风雨之中。
examples.trans: Tonight this dreamlike metropolis lies wrapped in wind and rain.

examples.text: 舞美师用柔光灯带打造出梦幻般的舞台效果。
examples.trans: Set designers used soft light ribbons to build a dreamlike stage.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mèng xiǎng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个梦想 ('a dream').

examples.text: 我梦寐以求的咖啡馆，就开在自家庭院里！等着瞧我去告诉整条街的人吧！
examples.trans: My dream café—right in our own courtyard! Wait until I tell the whole street!

examples.text: 开一家温暖的院子咖啡馆一直是她的梦想。
examples.trans: Opening a cozy courtyard café has always been her dream.

梦见.gloss: dream about, see in a dream

meanings.en: dream about, see in a dream
meanings.note: Verb-complement mèngjiàn ('dream of').

examples.text: 你刚才睡着的时候是不是梦见我了？
examples.trans: Were you dreaming about me while asleep just now?

examples.text: 因为睡得太多，他老在医院梦见工作的事。
examples.trans: Sleeping so much in hospital, he kept dreaming about work.

梧桐.gloss: wutong tree; Chinese parasol or plane tree

meanings.en: wutong tree; Chinese parasol or plane tree
meanings.note: Pinyin: wú tóng. Classic shade tree (*Firmiana simplex* and London plane) lining traditional lanes like 梧桐巷 ('Wutong Lane'); measure word: 棵 (kē).

examples.text: 你看铁罐里搅匀的油漆颜色——就像院子外梧桐树叶那样的深绿色！
examples.trans: Look at the stirred paint colour in the tin—deep green just like the wutong leaves outside the courtyard!

examples.text: 高大的梧桐树为整条小巷撑起了一片清凉的绿荫。
examples.trans: Tall wutong trees spread a cool canopy of green shade along the entire lane.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wú tóng xiàng. Tree-lined lane in Chengdu where Courtyard Inn stands.

examples.text: 等一下……梧桐巷十二号，角落里还写着两个童年名字的首字母！
examples.trans: Wait a moment... Number twelve, Wutong Lane, with two childhood initials written in the corner!

examples.text: 宋老师，您一脸惊讶！您认识梧桐巷十二号吗？
examples.trans: Teacher Song, you look amazed! Do you know Number twelve, Wutong Lane?

meanings.note: Pinyin: tī zi. Second syllable neutral tone. Measure word: 把 (bǎ) or 架 (jià).

examples.text: 老陈站在木梯子上换天花板顶灯的电线。
examples.trans: Chen stood on the wooden stepladder replacing the wires for the ceiling lamp.

examples.text: 爬梯子的时候，下面最好有人帮忙扶着。
examples.trans: When climbing a ladder, it is best to have someone steady it from below.

meanings.note: Checking machinery or vehicles thoroughly before use.

examples.text: 直播前技术人员把所有转播车都检修了一遍。
examples.trans: Before going live, technicians inspected every broadcast truck.

examples.text: 演播厅的灯光架每周都要定期检修。
examples.trans: The studio lighting rigs undergo routine maintenance weekly.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǎn chá. Used for checking pipes, tags, or rooms.

examples.text: 我只是检查安全。这是我的工作。
examples.trans: I am simply checking security. That is my job.

examples.text: 谢谢您这么体谅！老陈马上去地下室检查。
examples.trans: Thank you for being so understanding! Chen will check the basement right away.

检点.gloss: mindful of one's conduct, discreet, proper

meanings.en: mindful of one's conduct, discreet, proper
meanings.note: Watching one's behaviour to avoid gossip or misunderstanding.

examples.text: 公众人物在外面行事更要检点。
examples.trans: Public figures must be extra discreet in how they act.

examples.text: 说话做事检点一些，省得惹人误会。
examples.trans: Be mindful in word and deed to avoid misunderstandings.

棉纸.gloss: cotton rag paper; handmade mulberry/cotton paper

meanings.en: cotton rag paper; handmade mulberry/cotton paper
meanings.note: Pinyin: mián zhǐ. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张棉纸 ('a sheet of cotton paper').

examples.text: 这四张线索卡是画在结实的厚棉纸上的。
examples.trans: These four clue cards are painted on sturdy, heavy cotton paper.

examples.text: 厚棉纸吸水均匀，最适合画水彩风景和地图。
examples.trans: Heavy cotton paper absorbs water evenly, making it ideal for watercolour landscapes and maps.

related.gloss: a sheet of cotton paper (measure word 张)

meanings.note: literal game piece or figurative pawn in someone's strategy

examples.text: 只是他的一个棋子。
examples.trans: Just one chess piece of his.

examples.text: 谁都不想成为别人的棋子。
examples.trans: Nobody wants to become someone else's pawn.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bàng. Warm colloquial adjective for praising food, work, or ideas (太棒了！).

examples.text: 等等，咸黄油配果酱不行，做炒蛋却棒极了！
examples.trans: Wait—salted butter fails with jam, yet for scrambled eggs it is amazing!

examples.text: 太棒了！用钢笔把你的名字正式写进老陈的大纸本子里！
examples.trans: Wonderful! Your name goes into Chen's big paper ledger in fountain-pen ink!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zōng sè. Measure word (量词): 种 (zhǒng), e.g. 一种棕色 ('a shade of brown').

examples.text: 两双棕色大男鞋，还有灰色毛衣。
examples.trans: Two pairs of big brown men's shoes, plus grey sweaters.

examples.text: 等等——柜台上这本棕色小皮笔记本是谁的？
examples.trans: Wait—whose small brown leather notebook is this on the counter?

related.gloss: a shade of brown (measure word 种)

meanings.en: studio; soundstage (in film, TV, and music production)
meanings.note: péng — industry shorthand for 演播棚 (broadcast studio), 摄影棚 (soundstage), or 录音棚 (recording studio); e.g., 一号棚 (Studio One), 进棚 (enter the studio to record).
Literal sense referring to a temporary roofed structure or awning.

examples.text: 这就是一号棚，星天的门面。
examples.trans: This right here is Studio One, the showcase of Xingtian.

examples.text: 快过去看看，录音棚里出事了。
examples.trans: Hurry over and take a look — something happened in the recording studio.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sēn lín. Ideographic compound 森 (three trees: dense forest) + 林 (two trees: woods); measure word: 片 (piàn).

examples.text: 周经理的眼镜片沾上了绿油漆，他大叫眼前全像一片森林！
examples.trans: With green paint on his spectacle lens, Manager Zhou cried out that everything before his eyes looked like a forest!

examples.text: 雨后的森林里空气清新，到处都能闻到松树和泥土的香气。
examples.trans: In the forest after rain the air is fresh, filled everywhere with the scent of pine and earth.

棵.gloss: measure word for trees and plants

meanings.en: measure word for trees and plants
meanings.note: Pinyin: kē. Standard botanical classifier for individual trees, cabbages, or herbs rooted in the ground (这棵大树 'this big tree').

examples.text: 挂上绿窗板以后，九号房就像本来就属于院子里这棵大树一样！
examples.trans: With the green shutters hung, Room Nine looks as though it belonged to this big courtyard tree all along!

examples.text: 老陈年轻的时候亲手在院子中央种下了这棵梧桐树。
examples.trans: When Chen was young, he planted this wutong tree in the center of the courtyard with his own hands.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǐ. Single-character bound root of 椅子 ('chair'), productive in compounds like 木椅 ('wooden chair') and 折叠椅 ('folding chair').

examples.text: 花园里摆着八把新刷好漆的木椅。
examples.trans: Eight freshly painted wooden chairs are arranged in the garden.

examples.text: 靠窗那把藤椅坐起来特别舒服。
examples.trans: That rattan chair by the window is especially comfortable to sit in.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǐ zi. Measure word (量词): 把 (bǎ), e.g. 一把椅子 ('a chair').

examples.text: 四张桌子，八把椅子，全摆好了！
examples.trans: Four tables, eight chairs—everything is set in place!

examples.text: 当心那把角落椅子，等十秒我拧紧螺丝。
examples.trans: Mind that corner chair—wait ten seconds while I tighten the screw.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lóu. Measure word (量词): 栋 (dòng), e.g. 一栋楼 ('a building').

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, room four on the second floor! Was the train ride tiring?

examples.text: 等等——三楼楼梯上面是什么地方？
examples.trans: Wait—what is above the stairs on the third floor?

meanings.note: Pinyin: lóu shàng. Measure word (量词): 层 (céng), e.g. 楼上房间 ('an upstairs floor').

examples.text: 老陈早！楼上洗澡水真的已经凉了吗？
examples.trans: Morning, Chen! Is the shower water upstairs really cold already?

examples.text: 早上好！在楼上就闻到暖暖的肉桂香味了！
examples.trans: Good morning! All the way upstairs I smelled warm cinnamon!

meanings.note: Pinyin: lóu xià. Measure word (量词): 层 (céng), e.g. 楼下大堂 ('the floor downstairs').

examples.text: 快拿到楼下灯光下面看看吧！
examples.trans: Let's bring it downstairs under the light and take a look!

examples.text: 楼下我的工具房里有一盏铜台灯。
examples.trans: Downstairs in my workshop there is a brass desk lamp.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lóu tī. Measure word (量词): 座 (zuò), e.g. 一座楼梯 ('a staircase').

examples.text: 正合我心意。楼梯在哪儿？
examples.trans: Just what I wanted. Where are the stairs?

examples.text: 等等——三楼楼梯上面是什么地方？
examples.trans: Wait—what is above the stairs on the third floor?

meanings.note: Pinyin: lóu tī kǒu. Compound 楼梯 ('stairs') + 口 ('opening/landing'): the doorway or landing right where a staircase meets the floor.

examples.text: 别把大纸箱堆在楼梯口，客人上下楼不方便。
examples.trans: Don't stack big cardboard boxes at the foot of the stairs; guests won't be able to get up and down easily.

examples.text: 楼梯口新装了一盏小夜灯，晚上走路很安全。
examples.trans: A small night-light was newly installed by the stairs, making it safe to walk at night.

examples.text: 最后留下的概率并不是很高。
examples.trans: The chance of staying on at the end is really not very high.

examples.text: 这是概率。
examples.trans: This is 概率.

meanings.note: Verb/noun mófǎng ('copy, mimic').

examples.text: 好节目一推出，很快就会引起大家的模仿。
examples.trans: Once a good show launches, imitators quickly follow.

examples.text: 一味模仿别人永远做不出王牌节目。
examples.trans: Blindly copying others never builds a flagship show.

meanings.note: Noun móshì ('programme format, business model').

examples.text: 十二歌王原本的模式是经过市场证明的。
examples.trans: The original format of Twelve Singers is market-proven.

examples.text: 这档新综艺开创了全新的户外真人秀模式。
examples.trans: This new show pioneered a fresh outdoor reality format.

meanings.note: Pinyin: héng dāng. Combines 横 ('horizontal') + 档 ('crosspiece/rung of a ladder, stool, or chair'); measure word: 根 (gēn).

examples.text: 小美往下迈的时候，右脚鞋子在矮凳最下面那根横档上滑了一下。
examples.trans: When Mei stepped down, her right shoe slipped on the bottom rung of the low stool.

examples.text: 老陈检查了木椅子的四条腿和底下的每一根横档，确保稳固安全。
examples.trans: Chen checked all four legs and every bottom rung of the wooden chairs to make sure they were solid and safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gǎn lǎn yóu. Combines 橄榄 ('olive') + 油 ('oil').

examples.text: 在热扁豆汤里滴几滴橄榄油，味道更香醇。
examples.trans: Adding a few drops of olive oil to hot lentil soup makes it even richer.

examples.text: 小美用橄榄油和新鲜香草烤了一盘番茄。
examples.trans: Mei roasted a tray of tomatoes with olive oil and fresh herbs.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a noun used in conversational Mandarin. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个橙子 ('a 橙子').

examples.text: 我有一个橙子。
examples.trans: I have a 橙子.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的橙子。
examples.trans: This is a very good 橙子.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chéng zhī. Measure word (量词): 杯 (bēi), e.g. 一杯橙汁 ('a glass of orange juice').

examples.text: 宋老师，让我来给您倒新鲜橙汁！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, allow me to pour fresh orange juice for you!

examples.text: 别担心！用冰气泡水一擦，橙汁就掉。
examples.trans: Do not worry! Wipe it once with cold sparkling water and orange juice comes right out.

related.gloss: a glass of orange juice (measure word 杯)

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a noun used in conversational Mandarin. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个橙皮 ('a 橙皮').

examples.text: 我有一个橙皮。
examples.trans: I have a 橙皮.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的橙皮。
examples.trans: This is a very good 橙皮.

meanings.note: Second-highest storm alert tier in China's four-colour warning system.

examples.text: 暴雨刚刚升级为橙色预警，必须马上加固棚架。
examples.trans: The rainstorm just hit an orange alert; reinforce the rigs now.

examples.text: 发布橙色预警后，户外活动应当及时调整。
examples.trans: Once an orange alert is issued, outdoor events should adjust promptly.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàng mù. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块橡木 ('a piece of oak').

examples.text: 老橡木，八十年了，一滴水都不漏。
examples.trans: Old oak, eighty years old—not a single drop leaks.

examples.text: 这张大书桌是用结实的橡木做的。
examples.trans: This big desk is crafted from solid oak.

related.gloss: a piece of oak (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: cì. Standard verbal measure word counting how many times an action happens (一次 'once', 下次 'next time').

examples.text: 每次弹完琴，他都问为什么下雨天钢琴声音更暖。
examples.trans: Whenever I finished playing, he asked why the piano sounded warmer on rainy days.

examples.text: 说这话的人每隔三十秒就扒着窗帘偷看一次！
examples.trans: Says the man peeking through the window curtain every thirty seconds!

meanings.note: Pinyin: huān kuài. Combines 欢 ('joyful') + 快 ('brisk/lively'), especially for upbeat rhythms and melodies.

examples.text: 这首曲子的结尾应该用欢快的节奏，还是温柔的节奏？
examples.trans: Should the ending of this piece use a brisk, cheerful rhythm or a gentle one?

examples.text: 院子里传来了孩子们欢快的笑声。
examples.trans: Cheerful laughter of children drifted from the courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huān yíng. Warm greeting to arriving guests (欢迎！ / 欢迎光临！).

examples.text: 大家早上好！欢迎你，小晴。都准备好了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning, everyone! Welcome, Qing. Is everything ready?

examples.text: 欢迎光临！早上好，您好！
examples.trans: Welcome! Good morning, hello!

meanings.note: Pinyin: huān yíng cí. Combines 欢迎 ('welcome') + 词 ('speech/words/lines'); measure word: 段 (duàn) or 篇 (piān).

examples.text: 周经理正在镜子前面紧张地练习他的五页欢迎词呢！
examples.trans: Manager Zhou is standing in front of the mirror nervously practising his five-page welcome speech!

examples.text: 其实最好的欢迎词就是一句真诚的“下午好，请进屋喝杯热茶”。
examples.trans: In truth, the best welcome speech is simply a sincere 'Good afternoon, please come in for a cup of hot tea.'

meanings.note: Valuing someone's talent, character, or art.

examples.text: 制作人非常欣赏她的工作态度。
examples.trans: The producer deeply admires her attitude toward work.

examples.text: 周末我们一起去音乐厅欣赏演出吧。
examples.trans: Let us go appreciate a concert together this weekend.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ōu qín. Combines 欧 ('European') + 芹 ('celery/parsley family herb'): flat-leaf or curly garden parsley.

examples.text: 主厨，接下来要往扁豆汤里放院子种的百里香和欧芹吗？
examples.trans: Chef, should we add the thyme and parsley from the courtyard to the lentil soup next?

examples.text: 出锅以前撒一点切碎的新鲜欧芹，热汤看起来翠绿诱人。
examples.trans: Sprinkle a little chopped fresh parsley right before serving and the hot soup looks bright green and inviting.

meanings.note: Verb qīfu ('pick on, wrong someone').

examples.text: 当初淳于乔欺负你的时候，是惠美帮你出头。
examples.trans: Back when Chun Yuqiao wronged you, Huimei stood up for you.

examples.text: 老员工都很照顾新人，从不欺负实习生。
examples.trans: Senior staff look after newcomers and never pick on interns.

款.gloss: measure word for menu items, styles, or models

meanings.en: measure word for menu items, styles, or models
meanings.note: Pinyin: kuǎn. Classifier for curated varieties, dishes, cakes, or product designs (一款特色蛋糕 'one signature cake').

examples.text: 每一家街坊咖啡馆都需要一款拿手的特色蛋糕。
examples.trans: Every neighborhood café needs one signature specialty cake.

examples.text: 这两款热茶都很适合搭配杏仁饼干。
examples.trans: Both of these hot teas pair wonderfully with almond biscuits.

examples.text: 歇一会儿吧。
examples.trans: Rest for a while.

examples.text: 我们需要歇一下。
examples.trans: We need to rest a bit.

歇会儿.gloss: rest for a bit, take a breather

meanings.en: rest for a bit, take a breather
meanings.note: Colloquial erhua expression for pausing briefly to rest.

examples.text: 你忙了一上午，先坐下来歇会儿吧。
examples.trans: You worked all morning—sit down and rest for a bit.

examples.text: 搬完这几箱东西咱们就歇会儿。
examples.trans: Right after moving these boxes, let us take a breather.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiàn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个歉意 ('an apology').

examples.text: 先生，上楼之前，我要诚恳跟您道个歉。
examples.trans: Sir, before going upstairs, I owe you an honest apology.

examples.text: 昨天是我不对，向你道个歉。
examples.trans: Yesterday was my fault; let me offer you an apology.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gē. Measure word (量词): 首 (shǒu), e.g. 一首歌 ('a song').

examples.text: 老陈，好好修一次老钢琴，它会记得每一首歌。
examples.trans: Chen, repair an old piano properly once, and it will remember every song.

examples.text: 这首歌我小时候常常听。
examples.trans: I often listened to this song when I was little.

examples.text: 这是歌手啊。
examples.trans: This is singer.

examples.text: 那个歌手好。
examples.trans: That singer is good.

meanings.note: Noun gēxīng ('celebrated singer').

examples.text: 他是一位堂堂的老牌歌星。
examples.trans: He is an illustrious veteran singer.

examples.text: 很多年轻人都喜欢这位歌星。
examples.trans: Many young people love this singer.

examples.text: 这竞演歌曲是洛琳的代表作吧，是不是有点不妥啊？
examples.trans: Isn't this competition song Luo Lin's signature piece? Could that be a bit unwise?

examples.text: 据悉，诉讼包括歌曲利润所得三倍以上的天价索赔，以及星天娱乐公开道歉。
examples.trans: Reports say the lawsuit demands triple-profit damages along with a formal public apology from Xingtian Entertainment.

examples.text: 另外，我们现在也在尽量去找歌曲作者本人。
examples.trans: In addition, we are doing everything we can to reach the song's original author in person.

meanings.note: noun

examples.text: 今天是十二歌王决赛之夜！
examples.trans: Tonight is the finals night of Twelve Singers!

examples.text: 今天是十二歌王决赛之夜！
examples.trans: Tonight is the finals night of Twelve Singers!

examples.text: 很多歌迷听到这个消息无比振奋，观众对十二歌王的期待值正在飙升。
examples.trans: Countless music fans are thrilled by the news, and audience anticipation for Twelve Singers is skyrocketing.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.en: right in the middle of; squarely; right
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèng. Before a verb, marks an action in progress right now; before 对着, means 'directly/squarely'.

examples.text: 正合我心意。楼梯在哪儿？
examples.trans: Just what I wanted. Where are the stairs?

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

meanings.note: Noun zhèngshì ('real work that matters').

examples.text: 你整天不干正事，净在这儿说废话！
examples.trans: Skipping real work all day just to chatter!

examples.text: 先谈完明天的录影正事再聊别的。
examples.trans: Settle tomorrow's taping business before chatting.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèng zài. Placed before a verb to mark an action happening at this very moment.

examples.text: 我正在打……您好，请问有人找蓝色行李箱吗？
examples.trans: I am calling now... Hello, excuse me, is anyone looking for a blue suitcase?

examples.text: 老板正在开锁呢！别挂电话，等我一秒钟。
examples.trans: The owner is unlocking it right now! Stay on the phone, wait one second.

meanings.en: just right; happen to; right on the dot
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèng hǎo. Marks a lucky coincidence or exact fit.

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

examples.text: 他拿旧阀门比对了——架子上正好还剩两个！
examples.trans: He matched it against the old valve—he has two left on the shelf!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèng cháng. Describes normal water pressure or normal operation.

examples.text: 电线本来就该拉直了。正常保养，别多想。
examples.trans: The wire needed straightening anyway. Routine maintenance—don't read into it.

examples.text: 修好阀门以后，三楼水压完全正常了。
examples.trans: After fixing the valve, third-floor water pressure is completely normal.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèng shì. Describes formal speech or a permanent job after probation.

examples.text: 我一紧张，句子就变得又长又正式！
examples.trans: Whenever I get nervous, my sentences turn long and formal!

examples.text: 周经理，要是你不正式聘用她，我就请她进我厨房！
examples.trans: Manager Zhou, if you do not hire her permanently, I am hiring her into my kitchen!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèngfāngxíng. Measure word: 个.

examples.text: 这个盒子的底面是一个正方形。
examples.trans: The base of this box is a square.

examples.text: 请在这张纸上画一个正方形。
examples.trans: Please draw a square on this piece of paper.

examples.text: 我们的战略合作也签约了，现在正是我们有余力开发新项目的时候。
examples.trans: Our overseas strategic partnership is signed too, so right now is the exact moment we have the strength to develop new projects.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèng què. Praises an exact answer.

examples.text: 完全正确！目前你们四张桌子只接待住店客人。
examples.trans: Exactly right! Right now your four tables only serve overnight inn guests.

examples.text: 您填写的电话号码和地址完全正确。
examples.trans: The phone number and address you wrote down are completely correct.

meanings.note: In 说正经的, shifts from teasing back to serious talk.

examples.text: 不开玩笑了，咱们现在说点正经的工作吧。
examples.trans: Enough joking—let us talk serious work now.

examples.text: 他平时爱耍贫嘴，办起正事来倒很正经。
examples.trans: He jokes around normally, yet gets very serious on real tasks.

examples.text: 我正要锁上大门，就听见有人在外面按门铃。
examples.trans: I was just about to lock the front gate when I heard someone ringing the doorbell outside.

examples.text: 她正要出门去邮局，恰好在门口遇上了送信的邮递员。
examples.trans: She was just about to head out to the post office when she ran into the mail carrier at the gate.

examples.text: 大家一致认为本土化是电视发展的正途。你就放心大胆干吧，我保证他们通过改版。
examples.trans: Everyone agrees homegrown innovation is television's true path forward — go ahead boldly, and I guarantee they'll approve it.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Attributive/noun zhèngmiàn ('positive coverage; front').

examples.text: 你想写深度报道没问题，但得写正面报道。
examples.trans: An in-depth piece is fine, provided it is positive coverage.

examples.text: 这次慈善演出收获了大量正面评价。
examples.trans: The charity concert earned plenty of positive reviews.

examples.text: 已有行业分析师论断，此事必将造成星天娱乐股权整合及上市进程大幅拖慢。
examples.trans: Industry analysts warn the lawsuit will severely delay Xingtian's share restructuring and public listing.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Time noun cǐkè ('at this moment').

examples.text: 哪怕是此刻的我，也不知道直播会走向何处。
examples.trans: Even I at this very moment do not know where the broadcast will go.

examples.text: 此时此刻，成千上万的观众正守在屏幕前。
examples.trans: At this very moment, tens of thousands are watching their screens.

examples.text: 爆炸性地公布了恋情，此前的隐婚传闻被证明为谣言。
examples.trans: With this bombshell romance announcement, the earlier secret-marriage rumors have been proven false.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 此外就是客座明星的人选问题。
examples.trans: Besides that, there is the question of choosing the guest star.

examples.text: 此外就是客座明星的人选问题。
examples.trans: Besides that, there is the question of choosing the guest star.

examples.text: 此次严重侵权事件恐将打击星天信誉价值，实际造成的损失尚不可预期。
examples.trans: This serious infringement case threatens Xingtian's reputation, and the full financial losses remain unpredictable.

examples.text: 关于此次我公司的侵权事件，表示非常抱歉。
examples.trans: Regarding our company's copyright incident, we express our deepest apologies.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bù. Counts footsteps or stages (一步 'one step').

examples.text: 真的？您不介意多爬几步楼梯？
examples.trans: Really? You do not mind climbing a few extra stairs?

examples.text: 茶壶也烫好了！大家从窗边退后一步！
examples.trans: And the teapot is hot! Everybody step back from the window!

meanings.note: Formal verb bùrù ('enter a new stage').

examples.text: 我们九零后刚刚毕业步入职场。
examples.trans: Our post-90s cohort has just graduated and entered the workplace.

examples.text: 走过红毯之后，嘉宾们依次步入主会场。
examples.trans: After walking the red carpet, guests stepped into the main hall.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bùzi. Measure word: 步.

examples.text: 他的步子迈得很大。
examples.trans: He takes very large steps.

examples.text: 她放慢了步子，等后面的人跟上。
examples.trans: She slowed her pace to wait for the people behind to catch up.

步步.gloss: step by step, at every step

meanings.en: step by step, at every step
meanings.note: Adverb bùbù ('step by step').

examples.text: 过去的事情不纠结，步步向前看。
examples.trans: Do not dwell on the past; look forward step by step.

examples.text: 这档益智节目环节紧凑，步步惊心。
examples.trans: This quiz show is tightly paced at every step.

meanings.note: Verb/noun qíshì ('discriminate against; bias').

examples.text: 你这是年龄歧视还是地位歧视啊？
examples.trans: Is that age bias or status discrimination?

examples.text: 职场上不应该有任何形式的歧视。
examples.trans: Workplaces should have no discrimination of any kind.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wāi. Describes something tilting off straight alignment (歪向一边 'lean to one side').

examples.text: 琴键按下去的时候，里面的小琴槌歪向了一边。
examples.trans: When the piano key went down, the little hammer inside leaned sideways.

examples.text: 墙上的木框画有点歪，我们把它扶正吧。
examples.trans: The wood-framed picture on the wall is tilting a bit; let's straighten it.

meanings.en: to die; to pass away; (figuratively) to be finished or doomed
meanings.note: sǐ — in workplace banter (as in 下周你就死了), often used hyperbolically to mean being eliminated, fired, or doomed in a competition.
Follows adjectives or psychological verbs with 了 to express extreme degree, e.g., 累死了 (dead tired), 吓死了 (scared to death).

examples.text: 用不着了，下周你就死了。
examples.trans: You will not need that anymore — next week you are dead.

examples.text: 这几天连续加班，真是累死我了。
examples.trans: Working overtime for several days straight has completely exhausted me.

meanings.note: Colloquial noun for fiercely loyal friends.

examples.text: 凯文和杏子是追随总制作人多年的铁杆死党。
examples.trans: Kaiwen and Xingzi are loyal diehard allies who followed the boss for years.

examples.text: 遇到困难时最先冲上来帮忙的永远是那几个死党。
examples.trans: When trouble hits, your closest buddies are always first to rush in.

死性不改.gloss: refuse to mend one's ways, incorrigible

meanings.en: refuse to mend one's ways, incorrigible
meanings.note: Colloquial idiom criticizing someone repeating old bad habits.

examples.text: 才刚换了新公司，他竟然死性不改又在账目上做手脚。
examples.trans: Barely at a new firm, incorrigible as ever, he fudged accounts again.

examples.text: 屡次劝告都不听，真是死性不改。
examples.trans: Ignoring repeated warnings, he refuses to change his ways.

死磕.gloss: grind away relentlessly, battle to the end

meanings.en: grind away relentlessly, battle to the end
meanings.note: Colloquial verb sǐkē ('doggedly hammer away at').

examples.text: 整个律师团队都在那儿死磕一份合同。
examples.trans: Their entire legal team is grinding relentlessly over one contract.

examples.text: 为了完美镜头，导演跟灯光细节死磕到底。
examples.trans: For a perfect shot, the director obsessed over every light.

meanings.note: A choice offering no safe way out.

examples.text: 无论提前播还是删戏份，现在看两条路都是死路。
examples.trans: Airing early or cutting the scenes—right now both look like dead ends.

examples.text: 盲目抄袭别人对制作公司来说是一条死路。
examples.trans: Blindly copying others is a dead end for a production company.

meanings.note: Standard respectful term in public welfare and law.

examples.text: 城市公共设施应当为残疾人提供便利的无障碍通道。
examples.trans: Public facilities should provide barrier-free access for disabled people.

examples.text: 这期公益节目专门为受骗的老人和残疾人追回损失。
examples.trans: This charity special helps defrauded seniors and disabled people recover losses.

段.gloss: measure word for sections, passages, or stretches

meanings.en: measure word for sections, passages, or stretches
meanings.note: Pinyin: duàn. Counts musical passages (一段开头 'an opening section'), paragraphs, road stretches, or periods of time.

examples.text: 周经理的姑姑写了一段轻快明亮的圆舞曲开头。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou's aunt wrote a light, bright opening passage for the waltz.

examples.text: 从客栈走到老集市只有一小段路。
examples.trans: From the inn to the old market is only a short stretch of road.

examples.text: 闻老师，你不愧是独步江湖的段子手，我们开个讨论会你还卖关子呢。
examples.trans: Mr Wen, you truly live up to your reputation as a master storyteller — keeping us in suspense during a review meeting!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Literary noun diàntáng ('grand hall or realm of an art').

examples.text: 那一刻我才踏入真正的制作殿堂。
examples.trans: Only then did I step into the true realm of production.

examples.text: 这座剧院是音乐人心中的艺术殿堂。
examples.trans: This theatre is a hall of art for musicians.

meanings.note: Respectful form mǔqīn ('mother').

examples.text: 我安排她母亲住这儿。
examples.trans: I arranged for her mother to stay here.

examples.text: 他很孝顺母亲。
examples.trans: He is very devoted to his mother.

meanings.note: Pinyin: měi. Usually followed by a measure word (每个星期 'every week', 每位客人 'every guest').

examples.text: 每个蓝杯子旁边放一张餐巾和一把小勺子。
examples.trans: Beside every blue cup, put one napkin and one small spoon.

examples.text: 老房子每到星期二就松一颗螺丝。坐吧。
examples.trans: Every Tuesday an old house loosens one screw. Sit down.

examples.text: 外卡？每个导师确实有个外卡名额，但是你之前已经放弃了。
examples.trans: A wild card? Every mentor does get one wild-card spot, except you already waived yours earlier.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Time phrase měizhōu ('each week').

examples.text: 这档访谈节目每周都要准时播出。
examples.trans: This talk show has to air on schedule every week.

examples.text: 制作部每周一上午开选题会。
examples.trans: Production holds a topic meeting every Monday morning.

examples.text: 这是每天啊。
examples.trans: This is every day.

examples.text: 那个每天好。
examples.trans: That every day is good.

meanings.note: Pinyin: měi rì. Concise written equivalent of 每天 ('every day'), common on shop signs and menus (每日营业 'Open Daily').

examples.text: 木牌最后写着四个大字：每日营业，欢迎街坊常来坐坐。
examples.trans: At the bottom of the wooden sign are four bold characters: Open Daily—neighbours are always welcome.

examples.text: 小美的厨房每日都会准备新鲜熬制的蔬菜高汤。
examples.trans: Mei's kitchen prepares freshly simmered vegetable stock daily.

meanings.note: Pinyin: měi cì. Combines 每 ('every') + 次 ('time/occasion'), usually followed by 都 in the main clause.

examples.text: 小时候擦窗户，你每次都把水溅到我衬衫上！
examples.trans: When we washed windows as kids, you splashed water on my shirt every single time!

examples.text: 每次闻到烤柠檬挞的香味，大家都想进厨房看看。
examples.trans: Every time people smell baking lemon tarts, everyone wants to peek into the kitchen.

examples.text: 老大想拔除这个毒瘤已经很久了，上次是用连环计才抓住了他的把柄。
examples.trans: Our boss wanted to root out that rot for ages and used a double trap last year to catch him red-handed.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bǐ. Forms comparisons in A 比 B + adj ('A is more adj than B').

examples.text: 说实话，我比以前灰色办公室喜欢这儿多了。
examples.trans: Honestly, I like this place far better than my old grey office.

examples.text: 听听他说的！老陈比我们好奇两倍！
examples.trans: Listen to him! Chen is twice as curious as we are!

meanings.note: Pinyin: bǐ lì. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个比例 ('a proportion').

examples.text: 哇……你们看这木头屋顶的比例！
examples.trans: Wow... look at the proportions of this timber roof!

examples.text: 做面包的时候，面粉和水的比例很重要。
examples.trans: When baking bread, the ratio of flour to water matters a lot.

meanings.en: compare side by side; match against
meanings.note: Pinyin: bǐ duì. Used for matching a spare part or handwriting sample.

examples.text: 他拿旧阀门比对了——架子上正好还剩两个！
examples.trans: He matched it against the old valve—he has two left on the shelf!

examples.text: 前台仔细比对了两个蓝色行李箱上的名字。
examples.trans: Reception carefully compared the names on both blue suitcases.

meanings.note: Colloquial phrase bǐfangshuō ('for instance').

examples.text: 比方说大家都很熟悉的十二歌王。
examples.trans: Take, for instance, the familiar Twelve Singers.

examples.text: 很多细节都能加分，比方说现场灯光。
examples.trans: Many details add polish — stage lighting, for example.

meanings.note: Verb/noun bǐsài ('competition').

examples.text: 歌手比赛类的节目我平时就看两档。
examples.trans: Among singer competition shows, I normally watch two.

examples.text: 今晚的歌唱比赛吸引了上千万观众。
examples.trans: Tonight's singing contest drew tens of millions.

meanings.note: Compound noun bǐsài guīzé ('contest rules/format').

examples.text: 下一季的比赛规则必须得彻底改一改。
examples.trans: Next season's competition rules must be overhauled.

examples.text: 主持人开场先宣读了本轮的比赛规则。
examples.trans: At the start, the host read out this round's rules.

examples.text: 比起资本风险，更关键的是机会成本。
examples.trans: Compared with capital risk, the far bigger issue is opportunity cost.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bǐ jiào. Before an adjective, means 'fairly/rather'.

examples.text: 先生，到了。小心碰头，这根木房梁比较低。
examples.trans: Here we are, sir. Mind your head—this wooden beam is fairly low.

examples.text: 二楼靠院子的房间晚上比较安静。
examples.trans: Second-floor rooms facing the courtyard are fairly quiet at night.

meanings.note: Separable verb bìyè.

examples.text: 她今年夏天毕业。
examples.trans: She graduates this summer.

examples.text: 毕业以后你想做什么？
examples.trans: What do you want to do after graduation?

meanings.note: Adverb bìjìng ('when all is said and done, after all').

examples.text: 毕竟你们才是一个公司的同事。
examples.trans: After all, the two of you belong to the same company.

examples.text: 她毕竟是新人，需要多一点时间。
examples.trans: She is a newcomer after all and needs a bit of time.

meanings.note: Currency classifier máo ('ten cents').

examples.text: 星天不会让他们占到半毛钱便宜。
examples.trans: Xingtian will not let them gain half a dime's advantage.

examples.text: 以前坐公交车只要几毛钱。
examples.trans: Riding the bus used to cost just a few dimes.

meanings.note: Pinyin: máo jīn. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条毛巾 ('a towel').

examples.text: 放心吧，周经理。房间干净，毛巾也是新的。
examples.trans: Relax, Manager Zhou. The room is clean, and the towels are fresh.

examples.text: 先生，给您干毛巾擦外套，还有一碗热汤。
examples.trans: Sir, here is a dry towel to wipe your coat, plus a bowl of hot soup.

meanings.note: Pinyin: máo mao yǔ. Literally 毛毛 ('fine down/fuzz', second syllable neutral tone) + 雨 ('rain'): mist-like drizzle; measure word: 阵 (zhèn).

examples.text: 周经理站在外面的毛毛雨里看新窗板，连大衣都忘了穿！
examples.trans: Manager Zhou is standing outside in the fine drizzle admiring the new shutters, having even forgotten his coat!

examples.text: 成都春天的毛毛雨轻轻落下来，把石板路润得发亮。
examples.trans: Chengdu's fine spring drizzle falls softly, making the flagstones glisten.

meanings.note: Pinyin: máo zhān. Combines 毛 ('wool/hair') + 毡 ('pressed felt'), used inside piano actions for dampers, bushings, and hammers.

examples.text: 三十年前潮湿的空气只是让小小的毛毡轴套变松了。
examples.trans: The damp air thirty years ago merely loosened the tiny felt bushing.

examples.text: 椅子脚底下贴了毛毡垫，挪动时一点声音也没有。
examples.trans: Felt pads are stuck under the chair legs so they make no sound when moved.

meanings.note: Pinyin: máo yī. Measure word (量词): 件 (jiàn), e.g. 一件毛衣 ('a sweater').

examples.text: 两双棕色大男鞋，还有灰色毛衣。
examples.trans: Two pairs of big brown men's shoes, plus grey sweaters.

examples.text: 妈妈织的灰色羊毛毛衣特别暖和。
examples.trans: The gray wool sweater Mother knitted is wonderfully warm.

examples.text: 你把他家地址告诉我，这件事跟工作毫无关系，我要明明白白地跟他说！
examples.trans: Give me his home address! This has nothing to do with work — I'm going to tell him clearly!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: háo mǐ. Metric unit taking numbers directly without 个.

examples.text: 二十毫米、铜的、热水器阀门——我一路念过去！
examples.trans: Twenty millimetres, brass, water-heater valve—I will repeat it all the way!

examples.text: 一定看准里面铜圈是二十毫米宽。
examples.trans: Make sure the brass ring inside is twenty millimetres wide.

meanings.note: Noun tǎnzi ('blanket').

examples.text: 沙发那儿有个厚毯子，冷的话可以先披着。
examples.trans: There is a warm blanket on the sofa you can drape on if cold.

examples.text: 夜班剪辑室空调太足，她常备一条小毯子盖腿。
examples.trans: Because the night edit bay is chilly, she keeps a small blanket handy.

meanings.note: Collective noun mínzhòng ('citizens, residents').

examples.text: 许多民众看了直播后自发开放私家住处。
examples.trans: After watching the livestream, many citizens opened their homes.

examples.text: 真实温暖的新闻报道赢得了广大民众的赞誉。
examples.trans: Honest, warm reporting earned praise from the general public.

meanings.note: Collective view of viewers or citizens.

examples.text: 真实的数据报告能够客观反映广大网民的民意。
examples.trans: An honest data report objectively reflects online public sentiment.

examples.text: 选角团队在做决定前认真参考了观众的民意。
examples.trans: Before deciding, the casting team weighed audience sentiment seriously.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qì. Measure word (量词): 口 (kǒu), e.g. 一口气 ('a breath').

examples.text: 太松一口气了！志豪先生，给您银钥匙。
examples.trans: What a relief! Mr Zhihao, here is your silver key.

examples.text: 老陈，求你告诉我只是水管进了一点气！
examples.trans: Chen, please tell me it was just a tiny bit of air in the pipe!

meanings.note: Physical odor or figurative trace of someone.

examples.text: 雨后的花园里弥漫着青草和泥土清新的气味。
examples.trans: After the rain, the garden filled with the fresh scent of grass.

examples.text: 她开玩笑说旧办公椅上还留着熟悉的气味。
examples.trans: She teased that a familiar presence still lingered on the old chair.

meanings.note: Noun qìfēn ('vibe, atmosphere').

examples.text: 今天总编室的气氛不太好。
examples.trans: The atmosphere in the chief editor's office is tense today.

examples.text: 晚会现场的气氛非常热烈。
examples.trans: The atmosphere at the gala hall is electric.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qì pào shuǐ. Measure word (量词): 瓶 (píng), e.g. 一瓶气泡水 ('a bottle of sparkling water').

examples.text: 别担心！用冰气泡水一擦，橙汁就掉。
examples.trans: Do not worry! Wipe it once with cold sparkling water and orange juice comes right out.

examples.text: 加一片新鲜柠檬在冰气泡水里特别清爽。
examples.trans: A slice of fresh lemon in chilled sparkling water is super refreshing.

related.gloss: a bottle of sparkling water (measure word 瓶)

meanings.note: Pinyin: qì chuāng. Combines 气 ('air/ventilation') + 窗 ('window'): a small hinged transom window high on a wall; measure word: 扇 (shàn).

examples.text: 把朝院子的气窗推开两厘米，屋里的空气就能顺着走廊流动了。
examples.trans: Push the transom window facing the courtyard open two centimetres and the indoor air will circulate down the hall.

examples.text: 虽然外面在下雨，只要打开高处的气窗，厨房里就不会闷热。
examples.trans: Even when it rains outside, opening the high transom window keeps the kitchen from feeling stuffy.

气色.gloss: complexion, healthy colour in one's face

meanings.en: complexion, healthy colour in one's face
meanings.note: Noun qìsè ('facial colour/vitality').

examples.text: 你虽然瘦了点，但是气色比之前好多了。
examples.trans: Though a bit thinner, your complexion looks much healthier.

examples.text: 休息了一个周末，她的气色明显红润起来。
examples.trans: After resting all weekend, her colour looked rosy again.

meanings.note: Graceful bearing or distinctive personal presence.

examples.text: 她站在舞台上特别有气质。
examples.trans: She has remarkable poise standing on stage.

examples.text: 读书能慢慢提升一个人的气质。
examples.trans: Reading gradually refines a person's poise.

meanings.note: Noun fēnwéi ('mood, atmosphere').

examples.text: 其实那天红毯现场的氛围挺好的。
examples.trans: Actually, the vibe at the red carpet that day was great.

examples.text: 轻松的聊天氛围能让嘉宾敞开心扉。
examples.trans: A relaxed vibe helps guests open up.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuǐ. Measure word (量词): 杯 (bēi), e.g. 一杯水 ('a glass of water').

examples.text: 老橡木，八十年了，一滴水都不漏。
examples.trans: Old oak, eighty years old—not a single drop leaks.

examples.text: 摸摸热水管——下面是温的，上面变凉了。
examples.trans: Feel the hot-water pipe—the bottom is warm, while the top is turning cool.

related.gloss: a glass of water (measure word 杯)

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuǐ cǎi. Literally 'water-colour'; 水彩画 ('watercolour painting'), 水彩卡片 ('watercolour card').

examples.text: 厚棉纸上画着四幅精致的水彩街景小画。
examples.trans: Four delicate little watercolour street sketches are painted on the heavy cotton paper.

examples.text: 雨水把蓝墨水晕开了，看起来倒像一幅水彩画！
examples.trans: Rainwater blurred the blue ink until it actually looked like a watercolour painting!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuǐ xìng. Combines 水 ('water') + 性 ('nature/property'); 水性油漆 ('water-based paint') dries fast with minimal odour.

examples.text: 这是水性的花园木器漆，气味很小，吹着风干得特别快。
examples.trans: This is water-based garden wood paint—very low odour, and it dries fast in a breeze.

examples.text: 小晴选了水性墨水笔来写菜单卡，字迹清楚又不容易晕开。
examples.trans: Qing chose a water-based ink pen to write the menu cards so the lettering stays crisp.

meanings.note: Noun shuǐbēi ('water mug/bottle').

examples.text: 买个跟她一样的同款水杯有用吗？
examples.trans: Would buying a matching water mug do any good?

examples.text: 出门去演播厅别忘了带上自己的保温水杯。
examples.trans: Do not forget your insulated water mug when heading to set.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuǐ tǒng. Combines 水 ('water') + 桶 ('bucket/pail/tub').

examples.text: 小晴和志豪提着两只装满温肥皂水的水桶走进九号房。
examples.trans: Qing and Hao carried two buckets of warm soapy water into Room Nine.

examples.text: 梯子上面小心点儿，让水留在水桶里吧！
examples.trans: Careful up on the ladder—keep the water inside the bucket!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuǐchí. Measure word: 个.

examples.text: 公园中央有一个漂亮的水池。
examples.trans: There is a beautiful pool in the center of the park.

examples.text: 他正在厨房的水池里洗碗。
examples.trans: He is washing dishes in the kitchen sink.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuǐ hén. Combines 水 ('water') + 痕 ('mark/trace/streak').

examples.text: 温水里加一滴白醋，擦完的老玻璃一点水痕都不留。
examples.trans: Add one drop of vinegar to warm water and the wiped old glass leaves zero water streaks.

examples.text: 请用干棉布把木桌上的水痕擦干净。
examples.trans: Please wipe the water marks off the wooden table with a dry cotton cloth.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuí guǎn. Measure word (量词): 根 (gēn), e.g. 一根水管 ('a water pipe').

examples.text: 啊！老水管晚上有时候会进一点空气。
examples.trans: Oh! Old water pipes sometimes get a little air bubble at night.

examples.text: 老陈，求你告诉我只是水管进了一点气！
examples.trans: Chen, please tell me it was just a tiny bit of air in the pipe!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuǐ fá. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个水阀 ('a water valve').

examples.text: 拿稳了！你已经关掉总水阀了吗？
examples.trans: Steady! Did you turn off the main water valve already?

examples.text: 修水管以前，记得先把总水阀关掉。
examples.trans: Before fixing a water pipe, remember to shut off the main water valve.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuǐ lóng tóu. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个水龙头 ('a water tap').

examples.text: 摸摸热水管——下面是温的，上面变凉了。
examples.trans: Feel the hot-water pipe—the bottom is warm, while the top is turning cool.

examples.text: 其实我下楼是想问问，洗手间水龙头怎么有点凉。
examples.trans: Actually, I came down to ask why the bathroom tap felt a bit cool.

meanings.note: Literary adverb yǒng ('forever, never').

examples.text: 万物之理，永不凝固。
examples.trans: The principle of all things never freezes forever.

examples.text: 经典作品的魅力永不过时。
examples.trans: The charm of classic works never goes out of style.

examples.text: 乔木的演唱权，永久授权给白杨！
examples.trans: The performance rights to Arbor are hereby granted permanently to Bai Yang!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Adverb yǒngyuǎn ('forever / always').

examples.text: 总编室永远不招实习生。
examples.trans: The chief editor's office never takes interns.

examples.text: 我永远支持你。
examples.trans: I will support you forever.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a noun used in conversational Mandarin. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个汁 ('a 汁').

examples.text: 我有一个汁。
examples.trans: I have a 汁.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的汁。
examples.trans: This is a very good 汁.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiú. Used for earnest requests (求你了 'please, I beg you!').

examples.text: 老陈，求你告诉我只是水管进了一点气！
examples.trans: Chen, please tell me it was just a tiny bit of air in the pipe!

examples.text: 我求他再给我们一天时间。
examples.trans: I pleaded with him to give us one more day.

meanings.note: Reduplicated verb qiúqiu ('beg earnestly').

examples.text: 求求您了，再给我一个机会吧！
examples.trans: I beg you, please give me one more chance!

examples.text: 我求求老天快让他的胃病好起来。
examples.trans: I am begging heaven for his stomach illness to heal.

meanings.note: Formally reporting progress or proposals to superiors or partners.

examples.text: 下午我们要去电视台汇报改版方案。
examples.trans: This afternoon we are going to the station to present the revamp plan.

examples.text: 请每周五向总监汇报一次项目进度。
examples.trans: Please report project progress to the director every Friday.

examples.text: 这个圈子没有所谓的江湖规矩，你也不用瞻前顾后。
examples.trans: There are no unwritten underworld rules in this industry, so stop worrying over every step.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

江湖险恶.gloss: the world out there is treacherous

meanings.en: the world out there is treacherous
meanings.note: Wuxia-flavoured idiom used playfully for office or industry politics.

examples.text: 职场如战场，真是江湖险恶啊。
examples.trans: The workplace is a battlefield—a tricky world indeed.

examples.text: 前辈笑着提醒新人江湖险恶，说话要留心。
examples.trans: The senior jokingly warned the newcomer that the world is tricky, so watch what you say.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tāng. Measure word (量词): 碗 (wǎn), e.g. 一碗汤 ('a bowl of soup').

examples.text: 先生，给您干毛巾擦外套，还有一碗热汤。
examples.trans: Sir, here is a dry towel to wipe your coat, plus a bowl of hot soup.

examples.text: 热汤？在冷雨中走过来之后，这听起来太棒了。
examples.trans: Hot soup? After that cold walk in the rain, that sounds wonderful.

related.gloss: a bowl of soup (measure word 碗)

meanings.note: Pinyin: tāng wǎn. Measure word (量词): 只 (zhǐ), e.g. 一只汤碗 ('a soup bowl').

examples.text: 您刚才忘在楼下前台汤碗旁边了。
examples.trans: You left it downstairs beside the soup bowl at the front desk.

examples.text: 热蔬菜汤装在白瓷汤碗里端上来了。
examples.trans: Hot vegetable soup came out in a white porcelain soup bowl.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qì chē. Measure word (量词): 辆 (liàng), e.g. 一辆汽车 ('a car').

examples.text: 你们听一秒……街上一辆汽车的声音都听不到。
examples.trans: Listen for a second... you cannot hear a single car from the street.

examples.text: 难怪昨晚您在阁楼听街上有没有汽车声！
examples.trans: No wonder you listened in the attic last night for car sounds from the street!

related.gloss: be stuck in a traffic jam

沁.gloss: seep into, permeate, soak gently into

meanings.en: seep into, permeate, soak gently into
meanings.note: Literary/vivid verb for scent, coolness, or moisture soaking in.

examples.text: 淡淡的茶香仿佛已经沁到了木头桌椅的纹理里。
examples.trans: The subtle tea aroma seemed to have soaked into the wood grain.

examples.text: 清晨凉爽的微风迎面吹来，格外沁人心脾。
examples.trans: The cool morning breeze felt wonderfully refreshing.

examples.text: 你就算沉不住气，也不能这么着急给她转正啊！
examples.trans: Even if you lost your cool, you shouldn't have rushed to promote her like that!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Adjective chénzhòng ('heavy in mood or weight').

examples.text: 孤岛这个名字听起来稍微有点太沉重了。
examples.trans: The title Lonely Island sounds a little too heavy in mood.

examples.text: 轻松幽默的综艺不宜起一个过于沉重的标题。
examples.trans: Lighthearted variety shows should avoid overly heavy titles.

meanings.note: Verb qī ('infuse tea with hot water').

examples.text: 这个话题得沏壶茶慢慢地聊。
examples.trans: For this topic we ought to brew a pot of tea and chat slowly.

examples.text: 方老师给小谷沏了一壶清香的绿茶。
examples.trans: Professor Fang brewed Xiaogu a pot of fragrant green tea.

meanings.note: Literal sand or figurative flaw/corruption in 眼里揉不进沙子.

examples.text: 海浪退去后，金黄色的沙子上留下了串串脚印。
examples.trans: As the tide ebbed, footprints trailed across the golden sand.

examples.text: 风吹起一阵细沙子，大家连忙眯起了眼睛。
examples.trans: When wind kicked up fine sand, everyone squinted right away.

examples.text: 我们先沟通好了，以免将来产生误会。
examples.trans: Let us communicate clearly first, so we avoid misunderstandings in the future.

examples.text: 我们先沟通好了，以免将来产生误会。
examples.trans: Let us communicate clearly first, so we avoid misunderstandings in the future.

meanings.note: Pinyin: méi. Short form of 没有; negates 有 and past/completed actions (没锁 'isn't locked / didn't lock').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: everyday phrase meaning unhurt or 'it is nothing'

examples.text: 您没事吧？我是布小谷。
examples.trans: Are you alright? I am Bu Xiaogu.

examples.text: 我没事，休息一会儿就好了。
examples.trans: I am fine; I will be alright after resting a bit.

meanings.note: Colloquial phrase méishénme ('nothing at all; no big deal').

examples.text: 这件事没什么好解释的。
examples.trans: There is nothing worth explaining about this.

examples.text: 没什么大不了的，别担心。
examples.trans: It is no big deal; do not worry.

meanings.note: Pinyin: méi guān xi. Warm reply to 对不起 ('no problem at all').

examples.text: 没关系！您就是志豪先生吧？
examples.trans: No problem at all! You must be Mr Zhihao, right?

examples.text: 不小心洒了一点水没关系，我拿布擦一下就好。
examples.trans: Spilling a drop of water is no problem—I will wipe it right up.

examples.text: 学校几个球友打不过我，嫌没劲。
examples.trans: None of the campus players could beat me, so they complained it wasn't fun.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Colloquial emphatic refusal leaving zero room to bargain.

examples.text: 触犯原则的事情绝对没商量。
examples.trans: Anything that crosses a line of principle is non-negotiable.

examples.text: 让他降低节目标准，那肯定没商量。
examples.trans: Asking him to lower the show's standards is out of the question.

meanings.note: Phrase méixiǎngdào ('did not expect at all').

examples.text: 没想到你会做出这种事。
examples.trans: I never thought you would do something like this.

examples.text: 真没想到在这儿遇见你。
examples.trans: I never expected to run into you here.

examples.text: 我一个人去没意思，你们要不要一块儿，就像当年咱们那次比赛一样再玩一把？
examples.trans: Going by myself would be boring — want to join in together and have one more round just like our contest nine years ago?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.en: not have; there is not; did not
meanings.note: Pinyin: méi yǒu. Negates 有 ('have / there is') and past actions.

examples.text: 可惜没有电话号码，只有两个字母和老街名字。
examples.trans: Unfortunately there is no phone number, only two letters and an old street name.

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

examples.text: 我没法去。
examples.trans: I have no way to go.

examples.text: 这门坏了，没法打开。
examples.trans: This door is broken, there's no way to open it.

meanings.en: have no free time; be tied up
meanings.note: Pinyin: méi kòng. Note fourth tone kòng ('free time').

examples.text: 老陈，两个铜阀门给你！喘口气？没空！
examples.trans: Chen, here are both brass valves! Catch my breath? No time!

examples.text: 早上客人太多，我忙得连喝水都没空。
examples.trans: There were so many morning guests that I had no time even for a sip of water.

examples.text: 这是没见啊。
examples.trans: This is not seen.

examples.text: 那个没见好。
examples.trans: That not seen is good.

meanings.note: Pinyin: méi cuò. Enthusiastic agreement ('Spot on! / Exactly!').

examples.text: 没错！你已经很习惯这儿了。
examples.trans: Exactly! You already fit right in here.

examples.text: 没错。外面大街很吵，进了院子却只听见树叶和小鸟。
examples.trans: Exactly. Outside on the main road it is noisy, yet inside the courtyard you only hear leaves and birds.

meanings.note: Verb lúnluò ('fall into a lower state').

examples.text: 我已经沦落到被你们保护的地步了吗？
examples.trans: Have I been reduced to needing all of you to protect me?

examples.text: 那档老节目收视下滑，沦落到了深夜档。
examples.trans: With falling ratings, that old show sank to a late-night slot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条河 ('a river').

examples.text: 出门左拐，直走到桥。要过河吗？
examples.trans: Left out the gate, straight to the bridge. Do I cross the river?

examples.text: 小石桥下面是一条安静的河。
examples.trans: Beneath the small stone bridge runs a quiet river.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé shuǐ. Measure word (量词): 片 (piàn), e.g. 一片河水 ('river water').

examples.text: 跟河水一样凉。把这个坏铜阀门装进外套口袋。
examples.trans: Cold as river water. Put this broken brass valve into your coat pocket.

examples.text: 春天到了，桥下的河水清澈又安静。
examples.trans: Spring is here, and the river water beneath the bridge runs clear and calm.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé shā. Measure word (量词): 层 (céng, 'a layer of') or 把 (bǎ, 'a handful of'). Clean, dry sand washed from a riverbed.

examples.text: 石板下面的方坑里铺着一层干净干燥的河沙。
examples.trans: Spread inside the square pit under the flagstone is a layer of clean, dry river sand.

examples.text: 细细的河沙能排水透气，让包裹保持干爽。
examples.trans: Fine river sand drains water and breathes well, keeping the parcel dry.

examples.text: 这首歌曲的侵权事件前几天闹得沸沸扬扬，可是现在却有了一个戏剧性的转变。
examples.trans: The copyright uproar around this song raged for days, yet now it has taken a dramatic turn.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yóu. General noun for cooking oil (橄榄油 'olive oil'), wood oil, or lubricating oil (上油 'oil a hinge/gate').

examples.text: 老陈已经给院子的大门上了油，推开的时候一点声音都没有。
examples.trans: Chen already oiled the front courtyard gate, so it swings open without a sound.

examples.text: 等平底锅里的油温热了，再把切好的洋葱丁放进去。
examples.trans: Wait until the oil in the pan is warm before adding the diced onions.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yóu qī. Measure word (量词): 桶, e.g. 一桶油漆 ('a bucket of paint').

examples.text: 一到七号钥匙全拿走了，八号房刚刷了油漆。
examples.trans: Every key from one to seven is taken, and room eight just got fresh paint.

examples.text: 木门上的蓝油漆还是去年新刷的。
examples.trans: The blue paint on the wooden door was freshly brushed on last year.

related.gloss: a bucket of paint (measure word 桶)

meanings.note: Verb-object zhìbìng ('treat/cure sickness').

examples.text: 女朋友要是会治病，那还要医生干嘛？
examples.trans: If a girlfriend could cure illnesses, what would doctors be for?

examples.text: 生了病要遵医嘱按时吃药治病，不能硬扛。
examples.trans: When ill, follow medical advice to treat it instead of toughing it out.

沾.gloss: touch upon, have to do with; moisten

meanings.en: touch upon, have to do with; moisten
meanings.note: Verb zhān ('have contact with, touch').

examples.text: 不靠谱这三个字跟他永远沾不上边。
examples.trans: The word unreliable never comes anywhere near describing him.

examples.text: 为了保护嗓子，演出前一周她滴酒不沾。
examples.trans: To protect her voice, she touches zero alcohol the week before singing.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhān dì. Separable verb-object compound 沾 ('lightly touch/contact') + 地 ('ground/floor'), usually negated (不沾地 / 严禁沾地).

examples.text: 志鹏把两个结实的枕头垫在小美脚下，宣布今天右脚严禁沾地。
examples.trans: Peng tucked two firm pillows under Mei's foot and declared her right foot strictly forbidden to touch the floor today.

examples.text: 忙了一整个早上，小晴在厨房和前厅之间跑得脚不沾地。
examples.trans: Busy all morning, Qing hurried between the kitchen and front hall so fast her feet barely touched the floor.

examples.text: 你现在需要做的就是仔仔细细地想清楚，去年王尔做这份合同的时候你有没有沾过手。
examples.trans: Right now you need to think back carefully on whether you ever handled that contract for Wang Er last year.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 王尔不止那一次泄密，他一直给我们的竞争对手提供情报。
examples.trans: Wang Er didn't leak secrets just once; he acted like an informant feeding intel to our competitors for years.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 我们的艺人方案特别重要，不能泄露！
examples.trans: Our guest-artist plan is especially important; it must not leak!

examples.text: 这是泄露。
examples.trans: This is 泄露.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fǎ. Measure word (量词): 部, e.g. 一部法律 ('a law').

examples.text: 房产信？让志豪和我看看——我管市政合同，他懂老建筑保护法！
examples.trans: A property letter? Let Zhihao and me see it—I handle municipal contracts, and he knows heritage building law!

examples.text: 我们要遵守老城区的保护法。
examples.trans: We follow the Old Quarter preservation act.

examples.text: 他一手把真的合同递到了法务，一手把假的授权列表备案到我们版权库里头。
examples.trans: With one hand he sent the real contract to legal, and with the other he logged a fake song list into our copyright database.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Legal noun fǎtíng ('law court').

examples.text: 那咱们就法庭上见吧。
examples.trans: Then see you in court.

examples.text: 律师明天代表她去法庭。
examples.trans: Her lawyer represents her in court tomorrow.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fǎ lǜ. Measure word (量词): 部, e.g. 一部法律 ('a law').

examples.text: 法律条文我戴两副眼镜看都头疼！
examples.trans: Legal clauses give me a headache even with two pairs of glasses!

examples.text: 那你们的客栈租约就受市里法律再保护十年！
examples.trans: Then your inn lease is protected by city law for another ten years!

examples.text: 据我所知，她和白石公司的合约没有任何法律效力，如果她不出来主张权利，咱们就没有办法。
examples.trans: From what I learned, her contract with Baishi has no legal validity — yet unless she steps forward to claim her rights, our hands are tied.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 市议会正在讨论老城区历史建筑保护法案。
examples.trans: The city council is debating the historic building preservation bill for the old quarter.

examples.text: 这项新法案通过以后，整条老街的建筑都能得到修缮补贴。
examples.trans: Once this new bill passes, buildings along the entire old street will qualify for restoration grants.

examples.text: 什么授权？法院的传票没看见吗！
examples.trans: What authorization? Haven't you seen the court summons sitting right here?!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Verb pào ('steep tea or brew coffee').

examples.text: 请你每天给我们主任泡一杯红茶。
examples.trans: Please brew a cup of black tea for our director daily.

examples.text: 小谷泡的咖啡太棒了。
examples.trans: The coffee Xiaogu brews is fantastic.

波.gloss: measure word for waves, bursts, or rounds

meanings.en: measure word for waves, bursts, or rounds
meanings.note: Pinyin: bō. Literally 'wave'; counts successive waves of rain, guests, or events (第一波大雨点 'the first wave of big raindrops').

examples.text: 第一波大雨点已经啪嗒啪嗒掉在院子石板上了！
examples.trans: The first big raindrops are already pattering onto the courtyard stones!

examples.text: 中午第一波喝汤的客人刚刚满意地离开。
examples.trans: The first wave of midday soup guests just left happily.

注意.gloss: pay attention to, watch out for

meanings.en: pay attention to, watch out for
meanings.note: Verb zhùyì.

examples.text: 要注意身体啊！
examples.trans: Take care of your health!

examples.text: 请注意时间。
examples.trans: Please watch the time.

meanings.note: Noun zhùyìlì ('focus of attention').

examples.text: 他们吵架转移了红毯的注意力。
examples.trans: Their quarrel diverted attention from the red carpet.

examples.text: 好的开场能立刻抓住观众的注意力。
examples.trans: A strong opening grabs viewer attention right away.

meanings.note: Scholarly noun/verb zhùjiě ('explanatory notes on a text').

examples.text: 这一句光是古人的注解就有三页。
examples.trans: On this single line, commentary alone fills three pages.

examples.text: 每个出版社的注解版本都不一样。
examples.trans: Each publisher's annotated edition is different.

meanings.note: Verb zhùzhòng ('lay stress on, value').

examples.text: 一线卫视最注重的就是节目的品质。
examples.trans: What top networks care about most is show quality.

examples.text: 写新闻报道一定要注重事实的真实性。
examples.trans: News reporting must always prioritise factual truth.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lèi shuǐ. Combines 泪 ('tears') + 水 ('water/liquid'), slightly more poetic and vivid than everyday 眼泪.

examples.text: 老先生眼眶里全是泪水，说这琴声听起来就像周经理的姑姑。
examples.trans: The older gentleman's eyes were full of tears as he said the piano sounded just like Manager Zhou's aunt.

examples.text: 听到失传三十年的旋律重新响起，大家都忍不住擦了擦感动的泪水。
examples.trans: Hearing the melody that had been lost for thirty years ring out again, everyone wiped away tears of emotion.

meanings.note: Language noun Tàiyǔ ('Thai language').

examples.text: 你不是在美国留学吗？怎么泰语也会说？
examples.trans: Did you not study in America? How do you speak Thai too?

examples.text: 这位翻译能够流利地进行中文和泰语互译。
examples.trans: This interpreter translates fluently between Chinese and Thai.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yáng gān jú. Botanical compound 洋 ('Western/introduced') + 甘 ('sweet') + 菊 ('chrysanthemum/daisy'): soothing chamomile flowers brewed as herbal tea.

examples.text: 小美请小晴去泡三大壶热茶：薄荷茶、洋甘菊茶和红茶。
examples.trans: Mei asked Qing to brew three big pots of hot tea: mint, chamomile, and black tea.

examples.text: 晚上睡觉以前喝一杯温热的洋甘菊茶，整个人都会安静下来。
examples.trans: Drinking a warm cup of chamomile tea before bed helps you wind down peacefully.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yáng cōng. Combines 洋 ('foreign/introduced from overseas') + 葱 ('allium/scallion'); measure word: 个 (gè) or 颗 (kē).

examples.text: 锅里的橄榄油热了，洋葱和胡萝卜现在可以下锅了吗？
examples.trans: The olive oil in the pot is warm—should the onions and carrots go into the pot now?

examples.text: 把洋葱用小火慢慢炒三分钟，就能炒出自然的甜味。
examples.trans: Sauté the onions gently over low heat for three minutes to bring out their natural sweetness.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sǎ. Used for liquids spilling out of a cup or pot.

examples.text: 天哪！桌子上一滴没洒……全洒在我领带上了！
examples.trans: Good heavens! Not a drop spilled on the table... it all spilled on my tie!

examples.text: 小心端稳，别把热茶洒出来。
examples.trans: Carry it steadily so you do not spill the hot tea.

洒满.gloss: flood with light; sprinkle all over

meanings.en: flood with light; sprinkle all over
meanings.note: Pinyin: sǎ mǎn. Resultative compound 洒 ('sprinkle/cast') + 满 ('fill completely'), vivid for sunlight pouring across a room.

examples.text: 打开窗板以后，温暖的阳光洒满了全部四张木桌。
examples.trans: Once the shutters opened, warm sunlight poured across all four wooden tables.

examples.text: 秋风吹过，金黄的梧桐叶洒满了整条小巷。
examples.trans: When the autumn breeze blew, golden plane-tree leaves carpeted the whole lane.

meanings.note: Verb xǐ ('wash with water').

examples.text: 纸质的书容易脏，先去洗一下手。
examples.trans: Paper books soil easily, so wash your hands first.

examples.text: 喝完咖啡顺手把杯子洗干净。
examples.trans: Wash your mug clean right after finishing coffee.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xí shǒu chí. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个洗手池 ('a bathroom sink').

examples.text: 摸摸热水管——下面是温的，上面变凉了。
examples.trans: Feel the hot-water pipe—the bottom is warm, while the top is turning cool.

examples.text: 洗手池上面的小镜子擦得一尘不染。
examples.trans: The mirror above the bathroom washbasin is wiped spotless.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xí shǒu jiān. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间洗手间 ('a bathroom').

examples.text: 隔壁的小洗手间呢？灯亮吗？
examples.trans: What about the small bathroom next door? Does the light work?

examples.text: 听到了！好像是隔壁洗手间的热水管响了。
examples.trans: I heard it! It sounded like the hot-water pipe in the bathroom next door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xí zǎo. Separable verb-object compound.

examples.text: 谢天谢地！那明天早上客人洗澡呢？
examples.trans: Thank heavens! What about morning showers for the guests?

examples.text: 跑了一身汗，洗个热水澡最舒服了。
examples.trans: After working up a sweat, a hot shower feels best of all.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xí záo shuǐ. Measure word (量词): 缸, e.g. 一缸洗澡水 ('hot bathwater').

examples.text: 到明天早上，淋浴喷头的水就会冰凉。
examples.trans: By tomorrow morning, the shower water will be ice-cold.

examples.text: 冰凉的洗澡水？！成都旅游指南评审员就住在三楼啊！
examples.trans: Ice-cold shower water?! The Chengdu Travel Guide inspector is staying on floor three!

meanings.note: Medical verb-object xǐwèi ('perform gastric lavage').

examples.text: 昨晚到了急诊室，医生马上安排洗胃。
examples.trans: In the emergency room last night, doctors pumped his stomach.

examples.text: 严重酒精中毒有时需要紧急洗胃。
examples.trans: Severe alcohol poisoning can require stomach pumping.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huó. Measure word (量词): 件 (jiàn), e.g. 一件活儿 ('a piece of work').

examples.text: 不许盯着客人看。把箱子交还，干自己的活。
examples.trans: No staring at guests. Hand back the bag and do our own work.

examples.text: 手里的活做完就可以休息了。
examples.trans: Once we finish the work in hand, we can rest.

related.gloss: a piece of work (measure word 件)

meanings.note: Everyday northern Mandarin for assignments or craft.

examples.text: 有什么棘手的活儿尽管交给我们组来办！
examples.trans: Hand whatever tricky tasks you have got straight to our unit!

examples.text: 这位老灯光师干了一辈子舞台，手上的活儿特别地道。
examples.trans: After a lifetime on stage, this veteran lighting tech does impeccable work.

meanings.note: Noun huódòng ('public or social event').

examples.text: 活动上有一个人，我想了想还是见一见吧。
examples.trans: There is someone at the event whom I decided to meet.

examples.text: 公关部正在筹备下个月的粉丝见面会活动。
examples.trans: PR is organizing next month's fan meet-and-greet event.

examples.text: 这是派啊。
examples.trans: This is dispatch.

examples.text: 那个派好。
