examples.trans: That dispatch is good.

meanings.note: Verb-complement pàichū ('send out teams/personnel').

examples.text: 公司已经派出了五支外景拍摄组跟拍嘉宾。
examples.trans: The company has dispatched five field crews to film the guests.

examples.text: 电视台连夜派出多路记者前往积水路段采访。
examples.trans: The station sent out multiple reporters overnight to flooded streets.

meanings.note: Loanword noun pàiduì ('social party').

examples.text: 刚才派对的时候你一直黑着脸。
examples.trans: Throughout the party just now you wore a dark frown.

examples.text: 首播破二之后，剧组举办了一个小型庆祝派对。
examples.trans: After ratings topped two percent, the crew threw a small party.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liú dòng. Coordinate verb 流 ('flow') + 动 ('move'), used for air circulating through a hallway or water flowing in a stream.

examples.text: 只要走廊里的干爽空气一直流动，水性油漆下午就能干透。
examples.trans: As long as dry air keeps circulating through the hallway, the water-based paint will dry completely by afternoon.

examples.text: 推开两扇拱窗以后，院子里的微风就在阳光房里自由流动起来。
examples.trans: Once the two arched windows are pushed open, the courtyard breeze circulates freely through the sunroom.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liú tǎng. Coordinate verb 流 ('flow') + 淌 ('stream/trickle'), used both for water and for music or time flowing effortlessly.

examples.text: 你听这首圆舞曲的后半段接上前半段，流淌得多自然呀！
examples.trans: Listen to how naturally the second half of the waltz flows right out of the first half!

examples.text: 温柔的钢琴声像清澈的溪水一样在阳光房里静静流淌。
examples.trans: Gentle piano music flowed quietly through the sunroom like a clear stream.

meanings.note: Step-by-step sequence of an event or operation.

examples.text: 导演正在和主持人最后核对一遍晚会流程。
examples.trans: The director is running a final check of the gala rundown with the host.

examples.text: 熟悉现场流程能大大减少直播时的失误。
examples.trans: Knowing the stage flow cuts down live broadcast mistakes.

examples.text: 九年前的著名歌手大赛梦想之声，打造出了流行乐坛的黄金一班。
examples.trans: Nine years ago, the famed singing competition Voice of Dreams forged pop music's legendary Golden Class.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 下面这首歌曾经在中国的流行乐史上留下过浓重的一笔，请欣赏！
examples.trans: This next song left a vivid mark on Chinese pop music history — please enjoy!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Letting feelings or private footage slip into view.

examples.text: 要是这段视频流露出去，肯定会引起轩然大波。
examples.trans: If this video clip leaked out, it would stir an uproar.

examples.text: 他的眼神里流露出对舞台深深的不舍。
examples.trans: His eyes revealed a deep reluctance to leave the stage.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a verb used in conversational Mandarin.

examples.text: 我有一个浇。
examples.trans: I have a 浇.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的浇。
examples.trans: This is a very good 浇.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cè liáng. Used for measuring dimensions or sound levels.

examples.text: 满分十分给九分？！没人会去测量庭院，除非……
examples.trans: Nine out of ten?! Nobody measures courtyards unless...

examples.text: 主要设计小图书馆和院子，测量老石墙怎么挡住街上噪音。
examples.trans: Mostly small libraries and courtyards, measuring how old stone walls block street noise.

meanings.note: Verb liúlǎn ('browse web pages or documents').

examples.text: 包括你平时上网浏览的每一张图片。
examples.trans: Including every single picture you browse on the web.

examples.text: 开会前他快速浏览了一遍今天的议程表。
examples.trans: Before the meeting he quickly skimmed today's agenda.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nóng. Describes rich honey, strong tea/coffee, or deep fragrance; opposite of 淡 (dàn, 'light/mild').

examples.text: 这种深色山蜂蜜花香很浓，泡茶只要半勺。
examples.trans: This dark mountain honey has a rich floral aroma—half a spoonful is enough for tea.

examples.text: 爷爷早上喜欢喝一杯浓一点的热红茶。
examples.trans: Grandpa likes drinking a slightly stronger cup of hot black tea in the morning.

meanings.note: Noun nóngdù ('brew strength').

examples.text: 下次我一定注意咖啡的浓度。
examples.trans: Next time I will watch the strength of the coffee.

examples.text: 这杯美式咖啡的浓度刚刚好。
examples.trans: The strength of this Americano is just right.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nóng chóu. Combines 浓 ('rich/concentrated') + 稠 ('thick/dense'), describing custards, curds, sauces, or slow-simmered soups.

examples.text: 小火不停地搅动五分钟后，金黄的柠檬酱变得又浓稠又亮。
examples.trans: After five minutes of continuous stirring over low heat, the golden lemon curd turned thick and glossy.

examples.text: 红扁豆在热高汤里慢慢炖煮，汤汁变得越来越浓稠。
examples.trans: As the red lentils simmered gently in hot broth, the soup grew thicker and richer.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a adv used in conversational Mandarin.

examples.text: 我有一个浓缩。
examples.trans: I have a 浓缩.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的浓缩。
examples.trans: This is a very good 浓缩.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nóng yù. Describes rich soups, coffee, tea, or floral fragrance.

examples.text: 这碗烤番茄汤味道浓郁，配脆皮面包太合适了。
examples.trans: This bowl of roasted tomato soup is rich and full-bodied, ideal with crusty bread.

examples.text: 早晨的咖啡角飘着浓郁的热咖啡香气。
examples.trans: Rich aroma of hot coffee drifts through the café corner in the morning.

examples.text: 下面这首歌曾经在中国的流行乐史上留下过浓重的一笔，请欣赏！
examples.trans: This next song left a vivid mark on Chinese pop music history — please enjoy!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Full of romance and sweet thoughtfulness.

examples.text: 收到神秘鲜花真是一件浪漫的事。
examples.trans: Receiving mysterious flowers is truly romantic.

examples.text: 他平时严肃，没想到也有浪漫的一面。
examples.trans: He is usually stern; nobody expected his romantic side.

meanings.note: Verb/adjective浪fèi (làngfèi).

examples.text: 别浪费时间。
examples.trans: Do not waste time.

examples.text: 努力白白浪费了。
examples.trans: The effort went to waste.

meanings.note: Adjective fúkuā ('ostentatious, hammy').

examples.text: 演技纯熟，就是有些时候略显浮夸。
examples.trans: Your acting is smooth, just slightly overdone at times.

examples.text: 好的主持人主持风格自然，从不浮夸。
examples.trans: A great host stays natural onstage and never hammy.

meanings.note: Locative noun hǎiwài ('overseas').

examples.text: 现在的状况是过度依赖海外版权。
examples.trans: Today's problem is excessive reliance on overseas IP.

examples.text: 这档原创节目今年成功发行到了海外市场。
examples.trans: This original show was distributed overseas this year.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎi shuǐ. Combines 海 ('sea/ocean') + 水 ('water').

examples.text: 小晴尝了一小口说：“右边这勺白粉末像海水一样咸！”
examples.trans: Qing tasted a tiny pinch and cried, 'This spoonful on the right is as salty as seawater!'

examples.text: 夏天在海边散步的时候，微风里总是带着淡淡的海水味道。
examples.trans: When walking along the shore in summer, the breeze always carries a faint scent of seawater.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎi yán. Measure word (量词): 撮, e.g. 一撮海盐 ('a pinch of sea salt').

examples.text: 那是海盐咸黄油！甜果酱面包卷要无盐黄油！
examples.trans: That is sea-salt butter! Sweet jam rolls need unsalted butter!

examples.text: 小晴买了海盐黄油，今天我们做嫩炒蛋！
examples.trans: Qing bought sea-salt butter, so today we are making soft scrambled eggs!

related.gloss: a pinch of sea salt (measure word 撮)

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎi mián. Combines 海 ('sea') + 绵 ('soft silk floss'), originally sea sponge and now any cleaning or cushion sponge.

examples.text: 把干净的海绵蘸进温水里，轻轻擦拭拱窗玻璃。
examples.trans: Dip the clean sponge into warm water and gently wipe the arched window glass.

examples.text: 用完海绵以后要拧干水分放在通风处。
examples.trans: After using a sponge, wring it out and set it in an airy spot.

涂.gloss: spread on; coat; brush on (wax, paint, or glaze)

meanings.en: spread on; coat; brush on (wax, paint, or glaze)
meanings.note: Pinyin: tú. Action verb for applying a smooth layer of beeswax, butter, glaze, or paint onto a surface.

examples.text: 在厚亚麻布上涂一层蜂蜡，雨水就渗不进去了。
examples.trans: Coat heavy linen cloth with a layer of beeswax, and rainwater cannot seep inside.

examples.text: 小美在温热的蛋糕表面轻轻涂了一层金黄蜂蜜。
examples.trans: Mei gently brushed a coat of golden honey over the top of the warm cake.

meanings.note: Verb xiāohuà ('digest food or absorb figuratively').

examples.text: 你们的这片心意，我现在可消化不了。
examples.trans: Right now I really cannot stomach your gesture of goodwill.

examples.text: 胃病刚好的时候要吃容易消化的软食。
examples.trans: Right after stomach illness, eat soft, easy-to-digest food.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiāo xi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个好消息 ('a piece of good news').

examples.text: 宋老师，真对不起，那边还没有消息。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, I am truly sorry; they have no news over there yet.

examples.text: 坏消息。老热水器上的铜压力阀门裂了。
examples.trans: Bad news. The brass pressure valve on the old water heater cracked.

related.gloss: a piece of good news (measure word 个)

meanings.note: Journalism noun xiāoxīyuán ('source of news').

examples.text: 主流公司才是最好的消息源。
examples.trans: Mainstream companies are the very best news source.

examples.text: 记者在发稿前必须核实消息源的真伪。
examples.trans: Reporters must verify their news sources before publishing.

消消气.gloss: cool down, calm one's anger a bit

meanings.en: cool down, calm one's anger a bit
meanings.note: Polite separable V-O phrase soothing someone upset.

examples.text: 先喝杯凉茶消消气，有什么问题咱们慢慢商量。
examples.trans: Have some herbal tea to cool down first, and let us talk it through.

examples.text: 助理连忙递上文件劝正在发火的主管消消气。
examples.trans: The assistant hurried over, urging the fuming manager to calm down.

消肿.gloss: reduce swelling; go down in swelling

meanings.en: reduce swelling; go down in swelling
meanings.note: Pinyin: xiāo zhǒng. Separable verb-object compound 消 ('dissipate/subside') + 肿 ('swelling').

examples.text: 把脚垫高休息了一整晚，小美的脚踝已经消肿一半了。
examples.trans: After propping her foot up and resting all night, Mei's ankle swelling has already gone down by half.

examples.text: 扭伤脚踝以后先敷冰袋，能帮助更快消肿。
examples.trans: Applying an ice pack right after spraining an ankle helps the swelling go down faster.

meanings.note: Target segment of viewers or buyers.

examples.text: 年轻观众是目前综艺市场最活跃的消费群体。
examples.trans: Young viewers are the liveliest audience group in variety TV.

examples.text: 不同节目的定位对应着不同的消费群体。
examples.trans: Different show formats serve different audience demographics.

涉嫌.gloss: be suspected of (an offense or violation)

meanings.en: be suspected of (an offense or violation)
meanings.note: Formal legal and media verb.

examples.text: 那条被紧急撤下的中插广告涉嫌夸大宣传和产品虚假。
examples.trans: The pulled mid-roll commercial was suspected of false product claims.

examples.text: 法务部正在核查合作方是否涉嫌违约。
examples.trans: Legal is investigating whether the partner is suspected of breach.

examples.text: 四号房的淋浴喷头有点漏水，陈师傅已经修好了。
examples.trans: The showerhead in room four was leaking slightly, and Master Chen has already fixed it.

examples.text: 换上新的淋浴喷头以后，二楼浴室的水压大多了。
examples.trans: After installing the new showerhead, the water pressure in the second-floor bathroom is much stronger.

淋湿.gloss: get drenched by rain; soak through

meanings.en: get drenched by rain; soak through
meanings.note: Pinyin: lín shī. Resultative verb compound 淋 ('drench/pour upon') + 湿 ('wet').

examples.text: 那时我是个年轻的制图员，你们阳光房的热茶救了我淋湿的地图。
examples.trans: Back then I was a young mapmaker, and your sunroom tea saved my rain-soaked maps.

examples.text: 快进屋喝杯姜茶吧，你的外套都被雨水淋湿了。
examples.trans: Come inside for a cup of ginger tea—your coat has been soaked by the rain.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lín tòu. Resultative compound 淋 ('drench/pour on') + 透 ('all the way through').

examples.text: 要是刚打磨好的干木头今晚淋透了，油漆就刷不上了。
examples.trans: If the freshly sanded dry wood gets soaked through tonight, the paint won't go on.

examples.text: 忘带雨伞的客人被半夜的大雨淋透了。
examples.trans: The guest who forgot an umbrella got soaked through by the midnight downpour.

examples.text: 他被淘汰了。
examples.trans: He was eliminated.

examples.text: 这个产品已经被淘汰了。
examples.trans: This product is obsolete.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dàn. Describes faint memories, light tea, or lightly salted food.

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 这壶绿茶味道很清淡。
examples.trans: This pot of green tea has a light, clean taste.

淡淡.gloss: faint; delicate; light (of scent, flavour, or colour)

meanings.en: faint; delicate; light (of scent, flavour, or colour)
meanings.note: Pinyin: dàn dàn. Reduplication of 淡 ('light, mild'), usually followed by 的 (淡淡的薄荷香 'faint scent of mint').

examples.text: 铁盒里还留着三十年前淡淡的薄荷香气。
examples.trans: Inside the tin still lingers a faint, delicate scent of mint from thirty years ago.

examples.text: 每张卡片外侧边缘都画着一条淡淡的蓝线。
examples.trans: Along the outer edge of each card is drawn a faint blue line.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shēn. Describes deep breaths (深呼吸) or dark shades of color (深蓝色 'dark blue').

examples.text: 等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！
examples.trans: Wait—it is dark blue, the same as yours!

examples.text: 又是深蓝色行李箱！这是宋老师的吗？
examples.trans: Another dark-blue suitcase! Is this Teacher Song's?

meanings.note: Noun/attributive shēndù ('depth; in-depth').

examples.text: 你想写星天的深度报道没问题。
examples.trans: Writing an in-depth feature on Xingtian is fine.

examples.text: 观众越来越喜欢有深度的访谈节目。
examples.trans: Viewers increasingly enjoy in-depth interview shows.

examples.text: 这点我深有体会。我在这个圈子混了二十年了，这样的改版方案我前所未见。
examples.trans: I know that firsthand. In twenty years in this industry, I have never seen a revamp proposal like this.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shēn sè. Built from 深 ('deep') + 色 ('color'); opposite of 浅色 ('light-colored').

examples.text: 一，二……哇！看这深色的亮木头！
examples.trans: One, two... wow! Look at this dark, shiny wood!

examples.text: 他喜欢穿深色的衣服。
examples.trans: He likes wearing dark clothes.

meanings.en: Chunyu, a traditional Chinese compound surname (specifically referring to lead producer Chunyu Qiao 淳于乔 in Behind the Scenes)
meanings.note: Chúnyú — one of the classic two-character Chinese surnames (复姓); in workplace settings, combined with professional titles such as 淳于总 (Director/Producer Chunyu).

examples.text: 请问，淳于总在哪儿？
examples.trans: Excuse me, where is Producer Chunyu?

examples.text: 我刚才听见她打电话了，她要出卖淳于总！
examples.trans: I just heard her on the phone — she is going to betray Producer Chunyu!

examples.text: 最重要的部门还是这边，淳于乔领导的制作部。
examples.trans: Still, the most important department is right here: the production unit led by Chun Yuqiao.

examples.text: 这是淳于乔。 (Example)
examples.trans: This is 淳于乔.

examples.text: 淳于总是睡着了吗？
examples.trans: Has Director Chun Yu fallen asleep?

examples.text: 淳于总是睡着了吗？
examples.trans: Has Director Chun Yu fallen asleep?

meanings.note: Verb hùn ('mix, blend carelessly').

examples.text: 药这样混着吃，不会有问题吗？
examples.trans: Will mixing pills like this not cause trouble?

examples.text: 别把不同种类的药混在一起。
examples.trans: Do not mix different kinds of medicine together.

混血儿.gloss: mixed-race child, person of mixed heritage

meanings.en: mixed-race child, person of mixed heritage
meanings.note: Child whose parents come from different ethnic/national backgrounds.

examples.text: 那个聪明可爱的小女孩是个混血儿。
examples.trans: That bright, adorable little girl is mixed-race.

examples.text: 混血儿往往从小就能接触两种不同的语言。
examples.trans: Mixed-race children often grow up around two languages.

examples.text: 差点淹死。
examples.trans: Almost drowned.

examples.text: 被水淹死。
examples.trans: Drowned in water.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiān. Used for refilling tea or politely apologizing for causing extra trouble (添麻烦).

examples.text: 给你们添麻烦了，老陈。谢谢这一周帮我看管箱子。
examples.trans: Sorry for causing you trouble, Chen. Thank you for guarding the bag all week.

examples.text: 真不好意思，又给您添麻烦了。
examples.trans: So sorry to have caused you extra trouble again.

examples.text: 杏子姐，你别给我瞎添乱了，你逗我呢，怎么可能！
examples.trans: Xingzi, please don't add to the mess — you must be teasing me, how could that be!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

添麻烦.gloss: cause trouble for, put someone out

meanings.en: cause trouble for, put someone out
meanings.note: Polite apologetic phrase.

examples.text: 不好意思，这么晚还打扰您，又给您添麻烦了。
examples.trans: Sorry to bother you this late and put you to trouble again.

examples.text: 他凡事都尽量自己扛下，从不愿给同事添麻烦。
examples.trans: He shoulders everything himself rather than trouble colleagues.

meanings.note: In 全清, means background/account checks came back 100% clean.

examples.text: 所有嘉宾的背景核查都已经是全清状态。
examples.trans: Background checks on every guest came back completely clean.

examples.text: 清晨的空气格外清，让人精神一振。
examples.trans: Morning air is extra clear and refreshing.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qīng liàng. Combines 清 ('clear/pure') + 亮 ('bright/resonant'), describing bell-like piano notes, singing voices, or clear eyes.

examples.text: 听这颗中央瑞音，既清亮又圆润，木头里一点杂音都没有！
examples.trans: Listen to this middle D—clear and mellow, with zero rattle in the wood!

examples.text: 清晨的院子里传来了清亮的鸟鸣声。
examples.trans: Clear, ringing birdsong echoed through the morning courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qīngliáng.

examples.text: 夏天的夜晚有一阵清凉的风。
examples.trans: There is a cool breeze on the summer night.

examples.text: 喝一杯冰水感觉非常清凉。
examples.trans: Drinking a glass of ice water feels very refreshing.

meanings.note: Noun qīngdān ('list, inventory').

examples.text: 这是我的欧洲代购清单，先谢谢你啦。
examples.trans: Here is my European shopping list—thanks in advance!

examples.text: 出发前场务对照设备清单清点了所有器材箱。
examples.trans: Before departure crew checked every gear case against the list.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qīng chu. Describes clear speech, clear handwriting, or hearing clearly (听得很清楚).

examples.text: 听得很清楚。你站在小石头喷泉旁边吗？
examples.trans: Loud and clear. Are you standing beside the little stone fountain?

examples.text: 这三年我很想你。真诚又清楚。第三句呢？
examples.trans: I missed you very much these three years. Honest and clear. And the third line?

meanings.note: Describes food low in oil, salt, and spice.

examples.text: 生病恢复期应该多吃清淡的食物。
examples.trans: While recovering from illness, eat light food.

examples.text: 这道汤味道很清淡，特别舒服。
examples.trans: This soup tastes light and soothing.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qīng qīng chǔ chǔ. AABB reduplication of 清楚 ('clear/distinct'); often used after 看得 or 听得 ('see/hear clearly').

examples.text: 老陈，你在笑呢！我在灯光底下看得清清楚楚！
examples.trans: You are smiling, Chen! I saw it crystal clear under the lamplight!

examples.text: 院子里的每一个人都把小提琴和钢琴的合奏听得清清楚楚。
examples.trans: Everyone in the courtyard heard the violin and piano duet crystal clear.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qīng qī. Combines 清 ('clear/transparent') + 漆 ('lacquer/varnish').

examples.text: 您看右边——清漆下面本来就有两个小小的螺丝孔。
examples.trans: Look on the right—there were two tiny screw holes under the clear varnish all along.

examples.text: 刷上一层薄薄的清漆以后，老木头的纹理更漂亮了。
examples.trans: After brushing on a thin coat of clear varnish, the grain of the old wood looks even lovelier.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qīng shuǎng. Combines 清 ('clear/fresh') + 爽 ('brisk/refreshing'), used for citrus aromas, morning air, or clean flavours.

examples.text: 闻闻这股清爽的柠檬热气，整个一楼都飘着香味！
examples.trans: Smell this waft of bright, refreshing lemon steam—the whole ground floor is filled with aroma!

examples.text: 雨后的院子空气格外清爽，连石板路都洗得干干净净。
examples.trans: After the rain, the air in the courtyard is extra crisp and refreshing, and even the flagstones are washed clean.

meanings.note: Adjective qīngbái ('clear and white').

examples.text: 她是清白的。
examples.trans: She is innocent.

examples.text: 我要证明自己的清白。
examples.trans: I want to prove my innocence.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qīng kōng. Result compound meaning 'clear out everything inside'.

examples.text: 搬家公司清空房子之前，我从阁楼架子救下了这个盒子。
examples.trans: Before the movers cleared the house, I saved this box from the attic shelf.

examples.text: 搬家以前，我们把储藏室全部清空了。
examples.trans: Before moving, we emptied out the entire storage room.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qīng cuì. Combines 清 ('clear/pure') + 脆 ('crisp/ringing'), describing bell-like musical notes, birdsong, or crisp food.

examples.text: 修好后的钢琴每一个音符都温暖又清脆，特别是中央瑞音！
examples.trans: Every single note on the repaired piano is warm and clear, especially middle D!

examples.text: 下午三点整，院子大门口传来了清脆的铜铃声。
examples.trans: At three o'clock sharp in the afternoon, the clear ring of the brass bell sounded from the front gate.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qīng chá. Combines 清 ('clear/pure/unadulterated') + 茶 ('tea'): freshly brewed green or herbal tea served without heavy additions; measure word: 杯 (bēi) or 壶 (hú).

examples.text: 欢迎木牌上写着：鲜汤、热面包、柠檬挞与清茶——每日营业。
examples.trans: On the welcome sign it reads: Fresh Soup, Warm Bread, Lemon Tart & Fragrant Tea—Open Daily.

examples.text: 午后坐在阳光房里喝一杯清茶、读几页书，真是舒服极了。
examples.trans: Sitting in the sunroom in the afternoon with a cup of pure tea and a few pages of a book is pure bliss.

examples.text: 作为王尔的手下，你没有被连坐清除出星天，已经是很大的幸运了。
examples.trans: As Wang Er's intern, not getting swept out of Xingtian alongside him was already huge luck for you.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Used as an adjective or reduplicated verb 清静清静 (get some peace and quiet).

examples.text: 这间小会议室平时特别清静。
examples.trans: This small meeting room is usually nice and quiet.

examples.text: 办公室太吵了，我想出去清静清静。
examples.trans: The office is noisy; I want to step out for some peace and quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shèn. Describes liquid or oil gradually working into tiny gaps or porous surfaces (渗进去 'seep in').

examples.text: 先等十秒钟，让两滴机油慢慢渗进生锈的合页里。
examples.trans: Wait ten seconds first to let the two drops of oil seep slowly into the rusty hinge.

examples.text: 屋顶修好以后，雨水再也不会渗进天花板了。
examples.trans: Now that the roof is repaired, rainwater will never seep into the ceiling again.

examples.text: 其实找到钟阳子不是我的功劳，是公司全部的同事群策群力，才帮公司渡过难关。
examples.trans: Honestly, finding Zhong Yangzi wasn't my solo credit — every colleague in the company pooled their strength to help us weather the crisis.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Colloquial slang noun zhānán ('scumbag boyfriend').

examples.text: 需要给一个渣男道歉吗？
examples.trans: Does anyone need to apologise to a cad?

examples.text: 电视剧里的那个反派角色是个典型的渣男。
examples.trans: That villain in the drama is a textbook cad.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wēn. Describes lukewarm water or mild temperatures.

examples.text: 摸摸热水管——下面是温的，上面变凉了。
examples.trans: Feel the hot-water pipe—the bottom is warm, while the top is turning cool.

examples.text: 壶里的水还是温的，正好喝。
examples.trans: The water in the pot is still warm—just right to drink.

meanings.note: Everyday noun wēnkāishuǐ ('lukewarm boiled water').

examples.text: 我先去给你打点温开水吧。
examples.trans: Let me go get you some warm boiled water first.

examples.text: 上台唱歌之前喝口温开水润润嗓子。
examples.trans: Sip some warm water to soothe your throat before singing.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wēn nuǎn. Warmer and more emotional than plain 暖; used for sunshine, sound, and kindness.

examples.text: 听……有点低，很温暖，等等——中间这个琴键没有声音！
examples.trans: Listen... a little low, very warm, and wait—this middle key makes no sound!

examples.text: 谢谢你，你的话让我很温暖。
examples.trans: Thank you, your words make me feel warm inside.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wēn róu. Describes a gentle melody, warm voice, or kind manner.

examples.text: 这首圆舞曲的开头温柔得像春天的微风。
examples.trans: The opening of this waltz is as gentle as a spring breeze.

examples.text: 宋老师说话的声音总是很温柔。
examples.trans: Teacher Song's speaking voice is always gentle and warm.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wēn shuǐ. Combines 温 ('warm/mild') + 水 ('water').

examples.text: 用加了一滴醋的温水擦玻璃最干净。
examples.trans: Wiping glass with warm water and a drop of vinegar cleans best.

examples.text: 早上起床先喝一杯温水对嗓子很好。
examples.trans: Drinking a glass of warm water first thing in the morning is soothing for the throat.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wēn rè. Combines 温 ('mildly warm') + 热 ('hot'): gently warm to the touch or taste without burning.

examples.text: 盘子里装着刚出炉、还带着温热的杏仁饼干。
examples.trans: On the plate are freshly baked almond biscuits that are still warm.

examples.text: 喝一口温热的薄荷茶，整个人都放松下来了。
examples.trans: After a sip of warm mint tea, you feel completely relaxed.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wēn xīn. Favorite praise for a homey inn or café.

examples.text: 听屋顶上的雨声，这儿真温馨！
examples.trans: Listen to the rain on the roof—it feels so cosy up here!

examples.text: 暖黄色的台灯让整间客房显得格外温馨。
examples.trans: Warm yellow lamps make the whole guest room feel extra cozy.

meanings.note: Media noun yóuxìxìng ('game quality/fun').

examples.text: 逃亡这个动词听起来特别有游戏性。
examples.trans: The verb escape carries a strong sense of game-like fun.

examples.text: 户外真人秀的关卡设计既要有挑战又要有游戏性。
examples.trans: Outdoor reality challenges need both stakes and game-like fun.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shī. Describes clothes, shoes, or streets wet from rain.

examples.text: 晚上好。不好意思，把干净地板弄湿了。
examples.trans: Good evening. Sorry for getting your clean floor wet.

examples.text: 因为湿木头百叶窗会柔化石板路传回来的回声……
examples.trans: Because wet wooden shutters soften the echo bouncing off the flagstones...

meanings.note: Pinyin: shī qì. Uncountable noun (一点湿气 / 一滴湿气 'a trace/drop of dampness'); joins 湿 ('wet') + 气 ('vapour, air').

examples.text: 蜡布封得真严实，铁盒里面连一点湿气都没有。
examples.trans: The waxed cloth sealed it so snugly that not a trace of dampness reached inside the tin.

examples.text: 成都春天有时候湿气重，饼干一定要放进密封铁盒。
examples.trans: Spring in Chengdu can be damp at times, so biscuits should always go into an airtight tin.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shī tòu. Resultative compound 湿 ('wet') + 透 ('completely through').

examples.text: 把最后两扇窗板抢进走廊时，我的袖子全湿透了！
examples.trans: By the time we rushed the last two shutters into the hallway, my sleeves were soaked through!

examples.text: 快把湿透的外套挂在暖气旁边烘干吧。
examples.trans: Hang your soaked jacket beside the heater to dry.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiàn. Describes droplets flying outward onto clothes or surfaces (溅到衬衫上).

examples.text: 擦高处窗户的时候小心点，别把肥皂水溅到衣服上。
examples.trans: Be careful wiping the high windows so you don't splash soapy water onto your clothes.

examples.text: 汽车开过水洼，把雨水溅到了路边的石墙上。
examples.trans: A car drove through a puddle and splashed rainwater onto the roadside stone wall.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huá. Describes wet stone steps being slippery or an object sliding down.

examples.text: 周经理！这回您眼镜从鼻子上滑下来是因为太高兴啦！
examples.trans: Manager Zhou! This time your glasses slid off your nose from sheer joy!

examples.text: 听我把箱子斜过来——里面有金属东西滑了一下。
examples.trans: Listen as I tilt the box—something metal slid inside.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huá chū lái. Directional compound 滑 ('slide/slip') + 出来 ('come out').

examples.text: 那根细小的黄铜轴销从木头孔里滑出来一半。
examples.trans: That tiny brass hinge pin slipped halfway out of the hole in the wood.

examples.text: 夹在旧书里的一张明信片轻轻滑出来落在桌上。
examples.trans: A postcard tucked inside the old book slipped gently out onto the table.

examples.text: 这是滚啊。
examples.trans: This is get out.

examples.text: 那个滚好。
examples.trans: That get out is good.

examples.text: 这是滚出去啊。
examples.trans: This is get out.

examples.text: 那个滚出去好。
examples.trans: That get out is good.

滚蛋.gloss: get lost, scram, pack off (blunt slang)

meanings.en: get lost, scram, pack off (blunt slang)
meanings.note: Harsh colloquial command used in heated arguments.

examples.text: 他气得失去理智，冲着走廊里的老员工大喊滚蛋。
examples.trans: Losing his temper, he yelled at the veteran staff in the hall to get lost.

examples.text: 让不守规矩的骗子广告商趁早滚蛋！
examples.trans: Tell shady advertisers who break the rules to pack up and get lost!

meanings.note: Pinyin: mǎn. Describes a full cup or a fully booked hotel.

examples.text: 外面下着大雨，街上酒店全满了！我们怎么办？
examples.trans: It is pouring rain outside and every hotel on the street is full! What do we do?

examples.text: 啊……下这么大的雨，车站附近酒店全满了。
examples.trans: Ah... in rain this heavy, every hotel near the station was full.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mǎn fēn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个满分 ('a perfect score').

examples.text: 满分十分给九分？！没人会去测量庭院，除非……
examples.trans: Nine out of ten?! Nobody measures courtyards unless...

examples.text: 请一定写下来！三楼热水：满分十分！
examples.trans: Please be sure to write that down! Third-floor hot water: ten out of ten!

examples.text: 凭着我五千个小时的主播生涯，我一定让这个满嘴谎话的女人当场现出原形！
examples.trans: With five thousand hours as a live host behind me, I will expose that lying woman's true colors right on camera!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mǎn yì. Describes happy guests or hosts.

examples.text: 周经理的意思是……希望每位客人都觉得有十分满意！
examples.trans: What Manager Zhou means is... we hope every guest feels ten-out-of-ten satisfied!

examples.text: 客人们对今天的现烤早餐非常满意。
examples.trans: The guests were very pleased with today's freshly baked breakfast.

meanings.note: Hyperbolic noun mǎnjiē ('all across town').

examples.text: 四年前他们俩吵得满街都是新闻。
examples.trans: Four years ago their spat was news all over town.

examples.text: 节日里满街都挂着红灯笼。
examples.trans: Red lanterns hang down every street during the holiday.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dī. Used as a verb ('drip') or measure word for drops of liquid.

examples.text: 天哪！桌子上一滴没洒……全洒在我领带上了！
examples.trans: Good heavens! Not a drop spilled on the table... it all spilled on my tie!

examples.text: 老橡木，八十年了，一滴水都不漏。
examples.trans: Old oak, eighty years old—not a single drop leaks.

meanings.note: Pinyin: piào liang. Praises attractive rooms or a job done with flair.

examples.text: 三分钟就能送上三楼。今天跑得漂亮，搭档。
examples.trans: Three minutes to reach the third floor. Fine run today, partner.

examples.text: 这盘金黄色的柠檬蛋糕做得真漂亮！
examples.trans: This plate of golden lemon cake turned out beautifully!

meanings.note: Pinyin: qī. Measure word (量词): 桶 (tǒng), e.g. 一桶漆 ('a can of paint').

examples.text: 快看木头后面！白漆，还有一个铜钥匙孔！
examples.trans: Look behind the wood! White paint, and a brass keyhole!

examples.text: 门上的白漆有点旧了。
examples.trans: The white paint on the door is getting a bit old.

related.gloss: a can of paint (measure word 桶)

meanings.note: Pinyin: lòu. Used for leaking pipes or roofs (漏水) and omitted items.

examples.text: 老橡木，八十年了，一滴水都不漏。
examples.trans: Old oak, eighty years old—not a single drop leaks.

examples.text: 一滴水都不漏！现在可以点着热水器了吗？
examples.trans: Not a single drop leaking! Can we light the water heater now?

meanings.note: Pinyin: lòu shuǐ. Separable verb-object compound.

examples.text: 小美，里面出什么事了吗？难道锅炉又坏了？
examples.trans: Mei, is something wrong inside? Did the boiler break again?

examples.text: 老陈检查了一遍，厨房水槽没有漏水。
examples.trans: Chen checked everything over, and the kitchen sink is not leaking.

meanings.note: Noun lòudòng ('gap or flaw in a system').

examples.text: 这次不是公关体系的漏洞。
examples.trans: This was not a flaw in our PR system.

examples.text: 我们要及时补上工作中的漏洞。
examples.trans: We must promptly fix flaws in our workflow.

meanings.note: Core verb for acting on screen or stage.

examples.text: 粉丝们都特别希望这位敬业的年轻演员能演男主角。
examples.trans: Fans badly want this dedicated young actor to play the male lead.

examples.text: 这段对手戏两位老戏骨演得格外自然动人。
examples.trans: The two veteran actors played this two-hander scene movingly.

examples.text: 这是演出啊。
examples.trans: This is performances.

examples.text: 那个演出好。
examples.trans: That performances is good.

meanings.note: Compound verb describing how a talk or event develops.

examples.text: 本来只是聊公事，聊着聊着又演变成了谈心。
examples.trans: What began as work talk gradually turned into a heart-to-heart.

examples.text: 小小的沟通误会如果处理不当可能演变成大危机。
examples.trans: Handled poorly, a small misunderstanding can snowball into a crisis.

meanings.note: Noun yǎnyuán ('actor or actress').

examples.text: 你们的演技比专业演员还纯熟。
examples.trans: Your acting is smoother than professional actors.

examples.text: 化妆间里几位演员正在认真对台词。
examples.trans: Several actors are rehearsing lines in the dressing room.

meanings.note: Verb/noun yǎnchàng ('sing onstage').

examples.text: 看到宝石他才有信心完成演唱。
examples.trans: Only seeing the gem gives him confidence to finish singing.

examples.text: 今晚他要现场演唱两首歌。
examples.trans: Tonight he will sing two songs live.

examples.text: 乔木的演唱权，永久授权给白杨！
examples.trans: The performance rights to Arbor are hereby granted permanently to Bai Yang!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Noun yǎnjì ('craft of acting').

examples.text: 二位的演技比演员还纯熟。
examples.trans: Your acting skills are smoother than real actors.

examples.text: 这位老戏骨的演技让全场观众折服。
examples.trans: This veteran actor's skill won over the whole audience.

meanings.note: Television noun yǎnbōtīng ('TV studio hall').

examples.text: 在我管理的演播厅里，一切都很清楚。
examples.trans: In the broadcast studio I manage, I know every detail.

examples.text: 观众正在进入一号演播厅。
examples.trans: The audience is entering Studio One.

meanings.note: Television noun yǎnbōshì ('broadcast studio room').

examples.text: 一部已经接管了文娱论的演播室。
examples.trans: Unit One has taken over Entertainment Talk's studio.

examples.text: 主持人正在四号演播室准备录影。
examples.trans: The host is preparing to tape in Studio Four.

meanings.note: Workplace noun yǎnshìgǎo ('slide presentation').

examples.text: 改版方案的演示稿我已经连夜赶出来了。
examples.trans: I stayed up rushing out the slide deck for the revamp plan.

examples.text: 上台汇报之前请再检查一遍演示稿的排版。
examples.trans: Double-check the slide deck layout before presenting.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yán jiáng gǎo. Measure word (量词): 份 (fèn), e.g. 一份演讲稿 ('a speech draft').

examples.text: 五分钟演讲稿，列了十九条理由解释那年春天我们都错了。
examples.trans: A five-minute speech listing nineteen reasons why we were both wrong that spring.

examples.text: 他在安静的书桌前修改明天的演讲稿。
examples.trans: At the quiet desk he revised tomorrow's lecture notes.

meanings.note: Describes winters, waits, or recovery.

examples.text: 熬过漫长的低谷期之后，这位演员终于迎来了新机会。
examples.trans: After enduring a long dry spell, the actor finally landed a fresh break.

examples.text: 后期团队度过了一个漫长却充实的通宵剪辑夜。
examples.trans: The post crew spent a long yet fulfilling all-night editing session.

meanings.note: Verb shù ('rinse the mouth').

examples.text: 我替他喝完了这杯酒，先去漱个口。
examples.trans: Having finished that toast for him, let me go rinse my mouth.

examples.text: 上镜说话之前她习惯先去洗手间漱个口。
examples.trans: Before speaking on camera she likes rinsing her mouth first.

潜力股.gloss: rising star, person with great potential

meanings.en: rising star, person with great potential
meanings.note: Metaphorical noun qiánlìgǔ ('growth stock; promising talent').

examples.text: 男朋友最好是一个潜力股。
examples.trans: Ideally a boyfriend should be someone with high potential.

examples.text: 布小谷在总编室眼里是个十足的潜力股。
examples.trans: In the editorial office's eyes, Xiaogu is a true rising star.

meanings.note: Sport verb-object qiánshuǐ ('dive underwater').

examples.text: 今天上午集训的第一个项目就是潜水。
examples.trans: The first training event this morning is scuba diving.

examples.text: 水下摄影师背着氧气瓶潜入池底准备跟拍。
examples.trans: Wearing oxygen tanks, underwater camera operators prepped the shot.

examples.text: 他把自己股份的百分之九十九全捐出来了，研究人类的潜能开发了。
examples.trans: He donated ninety-nine percent of his own shares to research unlocking human potential.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cháo shī. Combines 潮 ('moist/damp') + 湿 ('wet').

examples.text: 三十年前那个雨夜潮湿的空气让毛毡轴套变松了。
examples.trans: The damp air on that rainy night thirty years ago loosened the felt bushing.

examples.text: 梅雨季节空气潮湿，木头窗户要常常通风。
examples.trans: During the rainy season the air is humid, so wooden windows need regular airing.

examples.text: 这事澄不澄清都一样。
examples.trans: It's the same whether this matter is cleared or not.

examples.text: 他到底澄不澄清事实？
examples.trans: Will he clarify the facts or not?

examples.text: 澄清事实。
examples.trans: Clarify the facts.

examples.text: 必须澄清误会。
examples.trans: Must clarify the misunderstanding.

meanings.note: Adjective jīdòng ('emotionally worked up').

examples.text: 大家先别激动，等医院的消息。
examples.trans: Everyone stay calm first and wait for hospital news.

examples.text: 听到好消息，她激动得哭了。
examples.trans: Hearing the good news, she cried with emotion.

examples.text: 不要太着急了，招聘竞争都很激烈。
examples.trans: Do not get too anxious; the hiring competition is very fierce.

examples.text: 这是激烈。
examples.trans: This is 激烈.

meanings.note: Verb guàn ('force drinks on someone; pour').

examples.text: 当时我在酒桌上被他们灌多了。
examples.trans: At the table they poured far too many drinks into me.

examples.text: 录制前先给暖手宝灌满热水。
examples.trans: Fill the hand warmer with hot water before taping.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huǒ. Measure word (量词): 团, e.g. 一团火 ('a fire').

examples.text: 火苗亮了——稳稳的蓝火，正合适。
examples.trans: The flame is lit—steady blue fire, right as it should be.

examples.text: 炉子上的小火还开着。
examples.trans: The low flame on the stove is still on.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huǒ qī. Literally 'fire-lacquer'; 火漆印章 = 'wax seal' melted over a candle flame to seal envelopes.

examples.text: 小方信封背面的红色火漆印章完全没拆过！
examples.trans: The red wax seal on the back of the tiny square envelope is still completely unbroken!

examples.text: 老教授在火漆还没干的时候，印上了八角罗盘花。
examples.trans: Before the sealing wax cooled, the old professor pressed his eight-point compass rose into it.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huǒ miáo. Measure word (量词): 朵, e.g. 一朵火苗 ('a small flame').

examples.text: 火苗亮了——稳稳的蓝火，正合适。
examples.trans: The flame is lit—steady blue fire, right as it should be.

examples.text: 热水器里蓝色的火苗烧得很稳。
examples.trans: The blue flame inside the water heater is burning steadily.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huǒ chē. Measure word (量词): 列 (liè), e.g. 一列火车 ('a train').

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, room four on the second floor! Was the train ride tiring?

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.note: Pinyin: huǒ chē tóu. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个火车头 ('a toy/train locomotive').

examples.text: 拆开白纸……不会吧！爷爷亲手雕的木头火车头！
examples.trans: Unwrap the white paper... no way! Grandfather's hand-carved wooden locomotive!

examples.text: 木头小火车头的轮子还能灵活转动。
examples.trans: The wheels on the little wooden locomotive still spin smoothly.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huǒ chē zhàn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个火车站 ('a train station').

examples.text: 火车站有人拿错了我的蓝色行李箱！
examples.trans: Someone at the train station took my blue suitcase by mistake!

examples.text: 小晴，马上给火车站失物处打电话。
examples.trans: Qing, call the train station lost-and-found office right away.

meanings.note: noun

examples.text: 职场是一个火锅，想想真的够吓人的。
examples.trans: The workplace is a hotpot; just thinking about it is scary enough.

examples.text: 职场是一个火锅，想想真的够吓人的。
examples.trans: The workplace is a hotpot; just thinking about it is scary enough.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dēng. Measure word (量词): 盏 (zhǎn), e.g. 一盏灯 ('a lamp').

examples.text: 因为楼梯窄，而且周经理在那儿放了旧灯箱子。
examples.trans: Because the stairs are narrow, and Manager Zhou put old lamp boxes up there.

examples.text: 隔壁的小洗手间呢？灯亮吗？
examples.trans: What about the small bathroom next door? Does the light work?

meanings.note: Pinyin: dēng guāng. Measure word (量词): 片 (piàn), e.g. 一片灯光 ('warm lamplight').

examples.text: 快拿到楼下灯光下面看看吧！
examples.trans: Let's bring it downstairs under the light and take a look!

examples.text: 插上老陈的铜台灯……哇，黄色灯光真暖和！
examples.trans: Plug in Chen's brass lamp... wow, how warm that yellow light is!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dēng pào. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个灯泡 ('a light bulb').

examples.text: 上周刚换了新灯泡，有干净肥皂和热水。
examples.trans: Put in a new bulb last week, with clean soap and plenty of hot water.

examples.text: 走廊里的灯泡坏了，我马上去换个新的。
examples.trans: The hallway light bulb went out; I will replace it right away.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dēng long. Measure word (量词): 盏 (zhǎn), e.g. 一盏灯笼 ('a lantern').

examples.text: 老陈，你在为中午挂纸灯笼吗？
examples.trans: Chen, are you hanging those paper lanterns for noon?

examples.text: 抬头看夜空下那些金色灯笼——真宁静啊！
examples.trans: Look up at those golden lanterns against the night sky—how peaceful!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dēng zhào. Compound 灯 ('lamp') + 罩 ('cover/shade'). Measure word: 个 (gè).

examples.text: 老陈小心地擦干净了磨砂玻璃灯罩上的灰尘。
examples.trans: Chen carefully wiped the dust off the frosted glass lampshade.

examples.text: 换上奶白色的灯罩以后，灯光一点也不刺眼。
examples.trans: With the cream-white lampshade on, the light doesn't glare at all.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huī. Stative colour adjective ('grey'); also used as a noun for dust/ash.

examples.text: 我每天走过那几扇灰窗板，竟然都没注意到它们。
examples.trans: I walked past those grey shutters every day and stopped noticing them.

examples.text: 这些干燥的灰木头明天刷上暖绿油漆就漂亮了。
examples.trans: Once this dry grey wood gets brushed with warm green paint tomorrow, it will look lovely.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huī chén. Measure word (量词): 层 (céng), e.g. 一层灰尘 ('a layer of dust').

examples.text: 把上面铜牌的灰尘擦掉……等等，快念那个数字！
examples.trans: Brush the dust off the brass plate on top... wait, read that number!

examples.text: 他用干布擦掉了木盒上面的灰尘。
examples.trans: He wiped the dust off the wooden box with a dry cloth.

related.gloss: a layer of dust (measure word 层)

meanings.note: Noun huīdù ('greyscale, moral/strategic nuance').

examples.text: 在灰度不同的对局之下，黑白有时会颠覆。
examples.trans: Across matches of shifting grey, black and white can flip.

examples.text: 现实生活往往不是非黑即白，而是充满灰度。
examples.trans: Real life is rarely black and white, but full of grey.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huī xīn. Literally 'ash-hearted' (别灰心 'don't lose heart').

examples.text: 先别灰心坐下！继续往街角看。
examples.trans: Do not sit down discouraged yet! Keep looking toward the street corner.

examples.text: 一次没烤好没关系，千万别灰心。
examples.trans: If one batch does not bake right, never mind—do not lose heart.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huī jiāng. Masonry mixture of lime/cement, sand, and water between bricks or flagstones (边缘灰浆 'edge mortar').

examples.text: 第三块石板边缘的旧灰浆已经有点松了。
examples.trans: The old mortar along the edge of the third flagstone had already come a bit loose.

examples.text: 老陈调了一点新灰浆，把庭院台阶的砖缝补平。
examples.trans: Chen mixed a bit of fresh mortar to repoint the brick joints on the courtyard steps.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huī sè. Measure word (量词): 种 (zhǒng), e.g. 一种灰色 ('a shade of gray').

examples.text: 两双棕色大男鞋，还有灰色毛衣。
examples.trans: Two pairs of big brown men's shoes, plus grey sweaters.

examples.text: 说实话，我比以前灰色办公室喜欢这儿多了。
examples.trans: Honestly, I like this place far better than my old grey office.

related.gloss: a shade of gray (measure word 种)

meanings.note: Pinyin: líng. Describes acute senses (耳朵真灵 'what a keen ear!'), nimble hands, or a quick mind.

examples.text: 宋老师夸赞道：“老陈，您的耳朵真灵！一下就听出高音弦低了一点点。”
examples.trans: Teacher Song praised him: 'Chen, your ears are so keen! You heard right away that the treble string was a hair flat.'

examples.text: 虽然老陈上了年纪，修起精细的钟表和钢琴来手脚还是特别灵。
examples.trans: Even though Chen is getting on in years, his hands are still remarkably nimble when repairing watches and pianos.

meanings.note: Noun zāihài ('natural disaster').

examples.text: 繁华都市骤然陷入罕见的特大暴雨灾害之夜。
examples.trans: The bustling city suddenly plunged into a night of storm disaster.

examples.text: 极端天气灾害发生时，应急广播显得尤为重要。
examples.trans: Emergency broadcasting is vital when extreme weather strikes.

meanings.note: Noun zāiqíng ('severity/status of a disaster').

examples.text: 向全国观众直播现场，呼吁网民关注灾情。
examples.trans: Stream the scenes live nationwide and urge netizens to heed the storm.

examples.text: 前方记者冒雨发回了第一手道路积水灾情报道。
examples.trans: Field reporters braved the rain to file first-hand flood updates.

meanings.note: Noun zāinàn ('disaster, catastrophe').

examples.text: 今天的特大暴雨对整座城市是一场灾难。
examples.trans: Today's torrential cloudburst is a disaster for the whole city.

examples.text: 灾难面前，普通人守望相助的善意最让人动容。
examples.trans: In the face of disaster, everyday mutual aid is deeply moving.

meanings.note: Causing severe damage or failure.

examples.text: 盲目跟风会带来灾难性的后果。
examples.trans: Blindly copying trends brings disastrous consequences.

examples.text: 这次失误对团队来说几乎是灾难性的。
examples.trans: This blunder was nearly disastrous for the team.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lú zi. Combines 炉 ('stove/furnace') + nominal suffix 子 (zi); measure word: 台 (tái) or 个 (gè).

examples.text: 小美！你看你，两只脚稳稳站在炉子前了！
examples.trans: Mei! Look at you standing steady in front of the stove on both feet!

examples.text: 炉子上的大铁锅里正咕嘟咕嘟煮着红扁豆汤。
examples.trans: In the big pot on the stove, red lentil soup is simmering away.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a noun used in conversational Mandarin. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个炉架 ('a 炉架').

examples.text: 我有一个炉架。
examples.trans: I have a 炉架.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的炉架。
examples.trans: This is a very good 炉架.

meanings.note: Media verb chǎo ('manufacture buzz; stir-fry').

examples.text: 想要借着星天的平台炒炒热度，没问题。
examples.trans: Wanting to stir up a bit of buzz on Xingtian's platform is fine.

examples.text: 这盘家常菜刚炒出来，趁热吃吧。
examples.trans: This home-style dish was just stir-fried—eat it hot.

examples.text: 网络炒作。
examples.trans: Internet hype.

examples.text: 不要恶意炒作。
examples.trans: Do not hype maliciously.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chǎo dàn. Measure word (量词): 盘, e.g. 一盘炒蛋 ('a plate of scrambled eggs').

examples.text: 等等，咸黄油配果酱不行，做炒蛋却棒极了！
examples.trans: Wait—salted butter fails with jam, yet for scrambled eggs it is amazing!

examples.text: 小晴买了海盐黄油，今天我们做嫩炒蛋！
examples.trans: Qing bought sea-salt butter, so today we are making soft scrambled eggs!

related.gloss: a plate of scrambled eggs (measure word 盘)

meanings.note: Pinyin: tàn bǐ. Measure word (量词): 支 (zhī), e.g. 一支炭笔 ('a charcoal stick/pencil'). Joins 炭 ('charcoal') + 笔 ('pen/brush').

examples.text: 慢慢展开画纸，免得上面的炭笔线条蹭花了。
examples.trans: Unfold the drawing paper slowly so the charcoal lines on it do not smudge.

examples.text: 这位制图员只用一支炭笔，就把五个朋友画得活灵活现。
examples.trans: With just a single stick of charcoal, the mapmaker sketched all five friends full of life.

meanings.note: Colloquial metaphor pàohuī ('pawn sacrificed in office politics').

examples.text: 以后请不要把我们小行政当炮灰。
examples.trans: Please never treat junior admin staff as expendable pawns.

examples.text: 谁也不想在部门争斗里当炮灰。
examples.trans: Nobody wants to be cannon fodder in office turf wars.

炸毛.gloss: bristle, freak out, fly into a tizzy

meanings.en: bristle, freak out, fly into a tizzy
meanings.note: Colloquial metaphor from a cat's fur standing on end.

examples.text: 一听说要改方案，合作方全都炸毛了。
examples.trans: The moment they heard the plan was changing, every partner bristled.

examples.text: 别逗她了，小心她一会儿炸毛。
examples.trans: Stop teasing her or she will bristle in a second.

meanings.note: Pinyin: diǎn. Marks hours on the clock (八点 'eight o'clock') or 'a bit' (一点).

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: diǎnr. Colloquial erhua form of 一点 after adjectives and imperatives (小心点儿 'be a bit careful', 快点儿 'hurry a bit').

examples.text: 你们两个站在梯子上小心点儿！
examples.trans: Be careful up there on the ladder, you two!

examples.text: 夜里石板路有点滑，走的时候慢点儿。
examples.trans: The stone path is a bit slippery at night; walk a little slower.

meanings.note: Verb-object diǎnmíng ('single out by name; take roll call').

examples.text: 主任点名要求我们制作一部来善后。
examples.trans: The director singled out Unit One to clean up the mess.

examples.text: 开会前老师先在教室里点名。
examples.trans: Before class, the teacher took roll call.

meanings.note: Pinyin: diǎn tóu. Separable verb-object compound showing agreement.

examples.text: 《成都老城区法案》第十四条，而且这里我哥哥刚刚也点头了！
examples.trans: Clause fourteen of the Chengdu Old Quarter Act—and my brother here just nodded!

examples.text: 听了小晴的建议，大家都笑着点头。
examples.trans: Hearing Qing's suggestion, everyone smiled and nodded.

meanings.note: Pinyin: diǎn xin. Literally 点 ('touch lightly') + 心 ('heart'): small baked pastries, cakes, or snacks served with tea; second syllable is neutral tone.

examples.text: 九号房里准备好了新鲜热茶和刚出炉的柠檬点心。
examples.trans: Fresh hot tea and freshly baked lemon pastries are ready inside Room Nine.

examples.text: 客人们喜欢在下午三点坐下来，喝一杯薄荷茶配两块小点心。
examples.trans: Guests love sitting down at three in the afternoon for a cup of mint tea and two small pastries.

examples.text: 看点评。
examples.trans: Look at critique.

examples.text: 专家点评。
examples.trans: Expert critique.

meanings.note: Verb-object diǎnjiǔ ('order a drink at a bar').

examples.text: 既然大家都喝酒，那我也要点酒。
examples.trans: Since everyone drinks here at night, I will order a drink too.

examples.text: 服务员过来问客人要不要点酒。
examples.trans: The server asked whether the guests wanted to order drinks.

meanings.note: Pinyin: diǎn zhōng. Combines 点 ('hour point on the clock') + 钟 ('clock/bell'), slightly fuller and more rhythmic than bare 点.

examples.text: 四十个柠檬，正好烤四大盘六点钟的杏仁柠檬挞！
examples.trans: Forty lemons is just right to bake four big trays of almond lemon tart for six o'clock!

examples.text: 每天早上六点钟，厨房里就会飘出热面包的香味。
examples.trans: Every morning at six o'clock, the aroma of warm bread drifts out of the kitchen.

examples.text: 一团烂摊子。
examples.trans: A terrible mess.

examples.text: 烂苹果。
examples.trans: Rotten apple.

examples.text: 闻思默，我求你了行吗？我不是真的不能面对过去，那些陈年烂事可以挖。
examples.trans: Wen Simo, I'm begging you, alright? It isn't that I can't face the past — you could dig up all that old mess.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Noun lièjiǔ ('high-proof spirits').

examples.text: 他有严重的胃病，真的喝不了烈酒！
examples.trans: With his serious stomach ailment, he cannot drink spirits!

examples.text: 医生叮嘱胃病患者绝对不能碰烈酒。
examples.trans: Doctors warn stomach patients never to touch spirits.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hōng kǎo. Used as verb or attributive noun (烘烤时间 'baking time', 烘烤温度 'baking temperature').

examples.text: 半张卡片上没写烘烤时间，也没写秘密糖霜！
examples.trans: The half card lists neither the baking time nor the secret glaze!

examples.text: 杏仁莓果蛋糕需要放进烤箱慢慢烘烤四十分钟。
examples.trans: The almond-and-berry cake needs to bake slowly in the oven for forty minutes.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kǎo. Used for baking bread, rolls, and cakes in an oven.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

examples.text: 多烤几块边角，好姑娘！
examples.trans: Bake plenty of corner pieces, dear girl!

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a noun used in conversational Mandarin. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个烤盘 ('a 烤盘').

examples.text: 我有一个烤盘。
examples.trans: I have a 烤盘.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的烤盘。
examples.trans: This is a very good 烤盘.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kǎo xiāng. Measure word (量词): 台, e.g. 一台烤箱 ('an oven').

examples.text: 还好烤箱里的面团已经放进去了。
examples.trans: My dough is already in the oven, at least.

examples.text: 宋老师早！我的肉桂卷刚出烤箱。
examples.trans: Morning, Teacher Song! My cinnamon rolls just came out of the oven.

meanings.note: Adjective/verb fán ('fed up, bothered').

examples.text: 以为我每天看着你发呆不烦呀？
examples.trans: Do you think watching you daydream never wears me out?

examples.text: 事情太多的时候也别心烦。
examples.trans: Do not get flustered even when tasks pile up.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fán xīn shì. Measure word (量词): 件 (jiàn), e.g. 一件烦心事 ('a worrying matter').

examples.text: 哎呀，怎么好意思拿房东烦心事打扰付钱的客人！
examples.trans: Oh dear, how could we bother a paying guest with our landlord troubles!

examples.text: 喝杯热甜茶，把今天的烦心事都放下吧。
examples.trans: Have a cup of hot sweet tea and set aside today's worries.

examples.text: 毕竟这些俗事对淳于总还有我们来说，也是抛不开的尘世烦恼。
examples.trans: After all, for Mr Chun Yu and the rest of us, these worldly tangles are troubles we cannot simply shake off.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

烦死.gloss: pester to death, annoy no end

meanings.en: pester to death, annoy no end
meanings.note: Colloquial verb-complement fánsǐ ('drive crazy with hassle').

examples.text: 你不怕整个公关部被粉丝烦死吗？
examples.trans: Are you not afraid PR will be hounded to death by fans?

examples.text: 电话响个不停，真是快把人烦死了。
examples.trans: The phone keeps ringing nonstop—it is driving me crazy.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shāo. Used for fire, heating water (烧水), and electrical burnouts (烧断 'burn through').

examples.text: 是旧电线，把一楼的保险丝烧断了。
examples.trans: It was the old wire—it blew the ground-floor fuse.

examples.text: 我去烧一壶开水。
examples.trans: I'll go and boil a kettle of water.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tàng. Describes piping-hot tea/soup or ironing clothes neat (烫好).

examples.text: 茶壶也烫好了！大家从窗边退后一步！
examples.trans: And the teapot is hot! Everybody step back from the window!

examples.text: 汤刚出锅，小心很烫。
examples.trans: The soup just came off the stove—careful, it is piping hot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: rè. Describes hot tea, hot water, or warm weather.

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

meanings.note: Pinyin: rè hū hū. Cozy ABB-pattern adjective for warm pastries or soup.

examples.text: 早上七点有热乎乎的肉桂面包，谁会拒绝呢。
examples.trans: At seven in the morning, who could say no to piping-hot cinnamon bread.

examples.text: 早上吃一个热乎乎的肉桂卷真幸福。
examples.trans: Eating a piping-warm cinnamon roll in the morning is pure bliss.

热场.gloss: warm up the crowd/audience ahead of a show

meanings.en: warm up the crowd/audience ahead of a show
meanings.note: Showbiz verb-object rèchǎng ('warm up an audience').

examples.text: 对手节目居然提前半小时开播开始热场了。
examples.trans: Our rival show actually went on air half an hour early to warm up!

examples.text: 正式开录前，现场导演先带观众鼓掌互动热场。
examples.trans: Before cameras roll, the floor director warms up the studio crowd.

examples.text: 这是热度啊。
examples.trans: This is heat degree.

examples.text: 那个热度好。
examples.trans: That heat degree is good.

meanings.note: Adjective rèqíng ('warmhearted, enthusiastic').

examples.text: 现场聚集了许多热情的观众朋友们。
examples.trans: Many enthusiastic audience friends gathered on site.

examples.text: 林姐对新来的同事其实很热情。
examples.trans: Lin Jie is actually warm toward hardworking newcomers.

meanings.note: Internet noun rèsōubǎng ('social-media trending list').

examples.text: 十二歌王的话题已经冲上热搜榜第一名了！
examples.trans: Twelve Singers has surged to number one on the trending chart!

examples.text: 节目金句一经播出就迅速登上了微博热搜榜。
examples.trans: Memorable lines from the show quickly climbed the Weibo trending list.

meanings.note: Widely shared online article.

examples.text: 这篇写幕后故事的报道成了今天的朋友圈热文。
examples.trans: This behind-the-scenes piece became today's viral article.

examples.text: 编辑部正在分析最近几篇网络热文的特点。
examples.trans: The editorial desk is studying what made recent viral posts click.

meanings.note: Pinyin: rè shuǐ. Measure word (量词): 壶, e.g. 一壶热水 ('a pot of hot water').

examples.text: 小晴，把热水倒进茶壶里，他们来了！
examples.trans: Qing, pour the hot water into the teapot—here they come!

examples.text: 上周刚换了新灯泡，有干净肥皂和热水。
examples.trans: Put in a new bulb last week, with clean soap and plenty of hot water.

related.gloss: a pot of hot water (measure word 壶)

meanings.note: Pinyin: rè shuǐ qì. Measure word (量词): 台, e.g. 一台热水器 ('a water heater').

examples.text: 坏消息。老热水器上的铜压力阀门裂了。
examples.trans: Bad news. The brass pressure valve on the old water heater cracked.

examples.text: 二十毫米、铜的、热水器阀门——我一路念过去！
examples.trans: Twenty millimetres, brass, water-heater valve—I will repeat it all the way!

meanings.note: Pinyin: rè shuí guǎn. Measure word (量词): 根 (gēn), e.g. 一根热水管 ('a hot-water pipe').

examples.text: 听到了！好像是隔壁洗手间的热水管响了。
examples.trans: I heard it! It sounded like the hot-water pipe in the bathroom next door.

examples.text: 小美，里面出什么事了吗？难道锅炉又坏了？
examples.trans: Mei, is something wrong inside? Did the boiler break again?

examples.text: 厨房里炖着一锅鲜美的热汤，满屋子都是香味。
examples.trans: A pot of savory hot soup is simmering in the kitchen, filling the whole house with its aroma.

examples.text: 请趁热喝下这碗热汤，身上的寒气马上就散了。
examples.trans: Please drink this bowl of hot soup while it is hot, and the chill in your bones will vanish right away.

meanings.note: Media noun rèdiǎn ('trending news spot').

examples.text: 这里有最广的热点娱乐资讯。
examples.trans: Here we cover the widest trending entertainment stories.

examples.text: 这档节目专门讨论每周的社会热点。
examples.trans: This programme discusses weekly trending topics.

examples.text: 请大家用最热烈的掌声，有请黄金一班和中国天后辛惠美！
examples.trans: With your warmest applause, please welcome the Golden Class alongside pop diva Xin Huimei!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

热爱.gloss: love deeply, have ardent passion for

meanings.en: love deeply, have ardent passion for
meanings.note: Used as verb or noun for devotion to a craft.

examples.text: 她深深懂得总制作人对电视行业那份纯粹的热爱。
examples.trans: She deeply understood the chief producer's pure passion for television.

examples.text: 正是因为热爱原创，大家才愿意留下来并肩奋斗。
examples.trans: Out of love for original work, everyone chose to stay and fight together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: rè téng téng. Vivid ABB adjective 热 ('hot') + 腾腾 ('rising in puffs of steam'), used for bread fresh from the oven or bowls of hot soup.

examples.text: 八个金黄的脆皮面包热腾腾出炉啦，快戴上烤箱手套！
examples.trans: Eight golden loaves of crusty bread are coming piping hot out of the oven—put on your oven mitts!

examples.text: 志豪端出一大锅热腾腾的红扁豆汤，香气一下子充满了厨房。
examples.trans: Hao brought out a big pot of steaming hot red lentil soup, filling the kitchen with fragrance.

meanings.note: Pinyin: rè shēn. Separable verb-object compound.

examples.text: 凉？啊——对！老街水管早上需要慢慢热身！
examples.trans: Cool? Ah—yes! Old-street water pipes need a gentle morning warm-up!

examples.text: 正式弹曲子以前，她先弹音阶热身。
examples.trans: Before playing the piece, she warmed up with scales.

meanings.note: Literally 'hot gate/door'—contrasts with 冷门 ('niche, little-known').

examples.text: 这首歌最近在网上特别热门。
examples.trans: This song has been especially popular online lately.

examples.text: 他是今年最热门的冠军人选之一。
examples.trans: He is one of the hottest contenders for champion this year.

meanings.note: Pinyin: rè nao. Positive praise for cheerful, bustling streets or gatherings.

examples.text: 为小院客栈干杯——成都最热闹的安静角落！
examples.trans: Cheers to Courtyard Inn—the liveliest quiet corner in Chengdu!

examples.text: 早上八点一过，整条老街就热闹起来了。
examples.trans: Right past eight in the morning, the whole historic street comes alive.

meanings.note: Pinyin: rán hòu. Connects sequential events across clauses.

examples.text: 过桥，右边经过绿药店。然后呢？
examples.trans: Cross the bridge, green pharmacy on the right. And after that?

examples.text: 先把门把手往上提，然后再往里推。
examples.trans: Lift the door handle upward first, and then push inward.

meanings.en: shine; follow/according to; take a photo
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhào. Means sunlight shining in, or acting according to a plan (照着).

examples.text: 手电筒拿稳，照着这儿的水管接口。
examples.trans: Hold the flashlight steady and shine it on the pipe joint here.

examples.text: 早上的阳光照进安静的书房。
examples.trans: Morning sunlight shines into the quiet study.

meanings.note: Verb zhàoyìng ('look out for, assist').

examples.text: 凯文居然还让我照应你。
examples.trans: Kaiwen actually asked me to look after you.

examples.text: 出差在外，同事之间要多互相照应。
examples.trans: While travelling on duty, coworkers should look out for each other.

照样.gloss: all the same, just as well

meanings.en: all the same, just as well

examples.text: 就算他们是蓄谋已久的，我们照样陪着你闯过来！
examples.trans: Even if they plotted this trap long ago, we will charge right through it at your side!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhào piàn. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张照片 ('a photo').

examples.text: 看这张黑白照片，院子里的树那时候才到二楼！
examples.trans: Look at this black-and-white photo—back then the courtyard tree only reached the second floor!

examples.text: 带上明信片——周经理一看这张照片，肯定说好！
examples.trans: Bring the postcard—once Manager Zhou sees this photo, he'll surely say yes!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhào gu. Used for tending guests, plants, or family.

examples.text: 总得有人照顾院子里的花草嘛。
examples.trans: Somebody has to look after the courtyard plants, after all.

examples.text: 这几天多亏你们细心照顾。
examples.trans: Thank you so much for looking after me so thoughtfully these past few days.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǔ. Core culinary verb for cooking in liquid (煮汤 'simmer soup', 煮茶 'brew tea by boiling', 煮面 'boil noodles').

examples.text: 真有意思，三年前我们在电话里吵架，今天却一起在厨房煮汤。
examples.trans: Funny how three years ago we argued on the phone, and today we are cooking soup together in the kitchen.

examples.text: 厨房炉子上的红扁豆汤已经用小火慢慢煮了四十分钟。
examples.trans: The red lentil soup on the kitchen stove has been simmering gently over low heat for forty minutes.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǔ kāi. Resultative verb compound 煮 ('cook/heat liquid') + 开 ('reach a rolling boil').

examples.text: 做柠檬酱的时候要开小火慢慢搅，千万别让锅底煮开了！
examples.trans: When making lemon curd, stir gently over low heat and whatever you do, don't let the bottom of the pot boil!

examples.text: 等锅里的高汤煮开以后，再把火调小盖上锅盖慢炖。
examples.trans: Once the broth in the pot comes to a boil, turn the heat down low and cover the pot to simmer.

meanings.note: Adjective shú ('well acquainted with').

examples.text: 您上周还说我熟那边。
examples.trans: Last week you said I knew that area well.

examples.text: 我跟这儿的同事都很熟。
examples.trans: I know the colleagues here very well.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shú rén. Combines 熟 ('familiar/well-known') + 人 ('person'); 老熟人 means an old friend or longtime neighbourhood regular.

examples.text: 到星期五晚上，小美就能站起来迎接街上的每一位老熟人了。
examples.trans: By Friday evening, Mei will be able to stand up and greet every longtime regular from the street.

examples.text: 在梧桐巷住了十年，老陈走在街上到处都能遇见熟人。
examples.trans: Having lived on Wutong Lane for ten years, Chen runs into familiar faces everywhere he walks.

meanings.note: Adjective/verb shúxi ('familiar with').

examples.text: 前台这边我不太熟悉。
examples.trans: I am not very familiar with the front desk.

examples.text: 新员工需要时间熟悉环境。
examples.trans: New staff need time to learn the ropes.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yùn. Action verb for pressing cloth flat with a heated iron (熨衣服 'iron clothes', 熨桌布 'iron a tablecloth').

examples.text: 小晴一大早就把四块白亚麻桌布熨得平平的。
examples.trans: Early in the morning, Qing ironed all four white linen tablecloths nice and flat.

examples.text: 周经理为了下午的审核，特意把自己的白衬衫重新熨了一遍。
examples.trans: For the afternoon review, Manager Zhou specially ironed his white shirt all over again.

熬夜.gloss: to stay up late; to pull an all-nighter

meanings.en: to stay up late or all night
meanings.note: áoyè — separable verb-object compound (熬 + 夜); modifiers or aspect particles can be inserted between the two characters, e.g., 熬了一整夜 (stayed up a whole night).

examples.text: 这杯苏打水是我熬夜的利器。
examples.trans: This cup of soda water is my secret weapon for staying up late.

examples.text: 你是不是最近熬夜太凶了？注意身体啊。
examples.trans: Have you been staying up way too late recently? Take care of your health.

meanings.note: Media verb bào ('break big news online; burst').

examples.text: 有人在网上爆了他的旧照片。
examples.trans: Someone leaked his old photo online.

examples.text: 这条消息一出来就爆了。
examples.trans: The story blew up the instant it came out.

meanings.note: Used for scandals, applause, storms, or booms.

examples.text: 昨晚突然爆发的虚假广告风波让总编室彻夜未眠。
examples.trans: The false-ad scandal that broke out last night kept the office up all night.

examples.text: 精彩演出结束时，全场观众爆发出了雷鸣般的掌声。
examples.trans: When the performance ended, thunderous applause erupted across the hall.

meanings.note: Modern industry buzzword for a runaway hit show or product.

examples.text: 这档音乐综艺成了今年的超级爆款。
examples.trans: This music variety show became the year's biggest smash hit.

examples.text: 每个制作人都梦想打造出下一个爆款。
examples.trans: Every producer dreams of creating the next smash hit.

meanings.note: Verb/noun bàozhà ('explosion, detonate').

examples.text: 家人听说他当时去了其中一处爆炸现场。
examples.trans: His family heard he went to one of the explosion sites.

examples.text: 动作片剧组在郊外封闭场地完成了爆炸特效拍摄。
examples.trans: The action film crew shot pyrotechnic effects on a closed lot.

examples.text: 爆炸性地公布了恋情，此前的隐婚传闻被证明为谣言。
examples.trans: With this bombshell romance announcement, the earlier secret-marriage rumors have been proven false.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pá. Used for climbing stairs, hills, or ladders.

examples.text: 真的？您不介意多爬几步楼梯？
examples.trans: Really? You do not mind climbing a few extra stairs?

examples.text: 何止认识！整整六年，每个星期五我都爬那座木楼梯教钢琴！
examples.trans: More than know it! Every Friday for six whole years I climbed those wooden stairs to teach piano!

meanings.note: Pinyin: pá guò. Resultative/directional compound 爬 ('climb/creep') + 过 ('across/past'), used for people or climbing vines.

examples.text: 绿油油的常春藤正好爬过了中间的铁钩。
examples.trans: The lush green ivy grew right across the middle iron hook.

examples.text: 一只小壁虎飞快地爬过了院子的石墙。
examples.trans: A little gecko darted across the courtyard stone wall.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ài. Expresses love for people, places, or favorite habits.

examples.text: 那里住着一位老木匠和两个孙子——哥哥弹钢琴，弟弟最爱小火车！
examples.trans: An old carpenter lived there with two grandsons—the older brother played piano, and the younger loved toy trains!

examples.text: 街坊们都爱来院子里喝早茶。
examples.trans: The neighbors all love coming to the courtyard for morning tea.

meanings.note: Verb-complement àishàng ('come to love').

examples.text: 原来爱上一个人的时候会变成这个样子。
examples.trans: So falling in love with someone can change a person like this.

examples.text: 看了一次现场录制，她就彻底爱上了电视行业。
examples.trans: Watching one live taping made her fall in love with television.

meanings.note: Noun àihào ('personal hobby').

examples.text: 收藏同一本书是您的特殊爱好吗？
examples.trans: Is collecting editions of one book your special hobby?

examples.text: 工作之余，她的爱好是研究老电影。
examples.trans: Outside work, her hobby is studying classic films.

爱惜.gloss: cherish, take good care of (health or things)

meanings.en: cherish, take good care of (health or things)
meanings.note: Verb àixī ('treasure and protect').

examples.text: 你是第一个来看我没有让我爱惜身体的人。
examples.trans: You are the first visitor not to lecture me to spare my health.

examples.text: 常年熬夜做节目，更要懂得爱惜自己的身体。
examples.trans: Working late nights in TV, take extra care of your health.

examples.text: 他叫小允，是我父亲的儿子。我从来都不知道我父亲会出轨。
examples.trans: His name is little Yun — he is my father's son. I never imagined my father would have an affair.

examples.text: 我父亲答应不再和那个女人联系，才保住了他们的婚姻，但他确实是我的亲弟弟。
examples.trans: My father promised never to contact that woman again to save their marriage, yet the boy is truly my half-brother.

examples.text: 我也不能让父母的事情曝光在大众的视线里面，我必须得保护他。
examples.trans: Nor can I let their private pain be exposed to the public eye — I have to protect him.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yé ye. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位爷爷 ('a grandfather').

examples.text: 三年前爷爷去世以后，我和志鹏因为卖老房子大吵了一架。
examples.trans: Three years ago after Grandfather passed away, Zhipeng and I argued bitterly over selling the old house.

examples.text: 我只写了：星期五中午，爷爷留的东西在小院客栈等你。
examples.trans: I only wrote: Friday at noon, something left by Grandfather is waiting for you at Courtyard Inn.

meanings.note: Kinship noun bàba ('father').

examples.text: 你一个人在外打拼，不在爸爸妈妈身边。
examples.trans: Working out here alone, you are away from your dad and mum.

examples.text: 爸爸每次打电话都会叮嘱她按时吃晚饭。
examples.trans: Every time Dad calls, he reminds her to eat dinner on time.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuáng lǎng. Describes warm, ringing laughter.

examples.text: 哥哥性格爽朗声音大，弹音阶总是急匆匆的。
examples.trans: The older brother was bold and loud, always rushing through his scales.

examples.text: 院子里传来老陈爽朗的笑声。
examples.trans: Chen's hearty laughter rang across the courtyard.

片.gloss: measure word for slices, leaves, tablets

meanings.en: measure word for slices, leaves, tablets
meanings.note: Pinyin: piàn. Counts thin, flat slices of bread, lemon, cheese, or leaves (一片面包 'a slice of bread').

examples.text: 请给我不加糖的红茶，再来一片热面包。
examples.trans: Black tea without added sugar, please, and one slice of warm bread.

examples.text: 他在红茶里放了一片新鲜柠檬。
examples.trans: He put a slice of fresh lemon into his black tea.

meanings.note: Everyday industry term for a cut video or show.

examples.text: 他亲自带队拍出来的片子质量就是高。
examples.trans: Footage shot with him leading the crew always turns out great.

examples.text: 剪辑师今晚加班，要把最新的片子剪出来。
examples.trans: The editor is working late tonight to cut the newest episode.

片酬.gloss: appearance fee, star's pay for a show or film

meanings.en: appearance fee, star's pay for a show or film
meanings.note: Industry term for performer compensation.

examples.text: 一线大牌艺人的片酬通常非常高。
examples.trans: Top-tier stars usually command very high appearance fees.

examples.text: 节目预算不能全都花在片酬上。
examples.trans: The show's budget cannot go entirely toward star fees.

meanings.note: Noun bǎnběn ('published edition or draft version').

examples.text: 每一个时代和每一个版本都不一样。
examples.trans: Every era and every edition differs.

examples.text: 请把最新版本的策划案发给我。
examples.trans: Please send me the latest version of the proposal.

meanings.note: Legal noun bǎnquán ('copyright').

examples.text: 未经允许的拍摄是属于侵犯版权的。
examples.trans: Filming without permission infringes copyright.

examples.text: 引进海外节目必须先购买正式版权。
examples.trans: Adapting an overseas show requires buying official rights.

examples.text: 他一手把真的合同递到了法务，一手把假的授权列表备案到我们版权库里头。
examples.trans: With one hand he sent the real contract to legal, and with the other he logged a fake song list into our copyright database.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Used literally for cards or figuratively for leverage.

examples.text: 这是我们谈判手里最后一张牌了。
examples.trans: This is the very last card in our hand for the talks.

examples.text: 把好牌打好，才能赢得最后的胜利。
examples.trans: Only by playing good cards well can you win in the end.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pái zi. Wooden or chalk signboard at a shop or stall (also means 'brand'). Measure word: 块 (kuài).

examples.text: 水果摊的木牌子上用粉笔写着今天的特价。
examples.trans: Today's special prices are written in chalk on the fruit stall's wooden sign.

examples.text: 大门口挂着“营业中”的小木牌子。
examples.trans: A small wooden 'Open' sign hangs at the front entrance.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a noun used in conversational Mandarin. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个牙齿 ('a 牙齿').

examples.text: 我有一个牙齿。
examples.trans: I have a 牙齿.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的牙齿。
examples.trans: This is a very good 牙齿.

meanings.note: Pinyin: niú nǎi. Measure word (量词): 杯 (bēi), e.g. 一杯牛奶 ('a glass of milk').

examples.text: 送牛奶的车在城外坏了。你们看冰箱！
examples.trans: The milk delivery van broke down outside town. Look at the fridge!

examples.text: 只有一点点牛奶、两个鸡蛋，一点黄油都没有！
examples.trans: Only a tiny bit of milk, two eggs, and no butter at all!

related.gloss: a glass of milk (measure word 杯)

meanings.note: Food noun niúpái ('steak').

examples.text: 今天的员工餐连牛排和鲍鱼都有。
examples.trans: Today's staff meal even includes steak and abalone.

examples.text: 这家西餐厅的牛排很嫩。
examples.trans: The steak at this restaurant is very tender.

meanings.note: Pinyin: niú pí zhǐ. Literally 牛皮 ('cowhide/buff leather') + 纸 ('paper'), named for its tough tear-resistant fiber and tan leather colour; measure word: 张 (zhāng) or 卷 (juǎn).

examples.text: 只要我们在走廊地上铺好牛皮纸，刷油漆就不会弄脏地板。
examples.trans: As long as we lay brown kraft paper on the hallway floor, painting the shutters won't spot the floor.

examples.text: 书店老板用结实的牛皮纸把那本旧乐谱整整齐齐包好了。
examples.trans: The bookshop owner wrapped the old music book neatly in sturdy brown kraft paper.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wù lǐ. Combines 物 ('matter/things') + 理 ('underlying principle/law of nature').

examples.text: 志豪一本正经地说：“大小一样的菜丁熟得一样快，这是基本物理！”
examples.trans: Hao said earnestly, 'Vegetable cubes of the same size cook at the same speed—that is basic physics!'

examples.text: 无论是修钢琴的琴弦还是烤面包，背后其实都有有趣的物理道理。
examples.trans: Whether tuning piano strings or baking bread, there are fascinating principles of physics behind both.

examples.text: 这件事牵扯很多人。
examples.trans: This matter involves many people.

examples.text: 别把我牵扯进去。
examples.trans: Don't involve me in it.

meanings.note: Being caught up in fallout caused by another party.

examples.text: 代理商审核不严，导致播出平台也无辜受到了牵连。
examples.trans: Lax vetting by the ad agency unfairly implicated the broadcast platform too.

examples.text: 他主动承担全部责任，就是不想牵连组里的年轻人。
examples.trans: He shouldered full blame so none of the young crew would be implicated.

meanings.note: Colloquial adverb tè ('super, terribly').

examples.text: 当时病房里没人陪，我的心也特凉。
examples.trans: With nobody beside me in the ward, my heart felt super cold.

examples.text: 这家小馆子熬的小米粥味道特香。
examples.trans: Millet porridge at this little diner smells super fragrant.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tè jià. Combines 特 ('special') + 价 ('price'); often used attributively (特价椅子 'bargain chairs').

examples.text: 周经理，你那二十四把特价椅子，每一把都有客人坐啦！
examples.trans: Every single one of your twenty-four bargain chairs has a guest sitting in it, Manager Zhou!

examples.text: 集市上的新鲜黄柠檬今天特价，我们一下买了四十个。
examples.trans: Fresh yellow lemons were on special at the market today, so we bought forty at once.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tè bié. Very common intensifier before adjectives/verbs ('especially'), or adjective ('special').

examples.text: 很安静，谢谢，不过这个行李箱今天特别重。
examples.trans: Very quiet, thank you, though this suitcase feels especially heavy today.

examples.text: 都没有！他特别喜欢安静的木房梁，还谢谢我们呢。
examples.trans: Neither! He loved the quiet wooden beams and even thanked us.

meanings.en: specially; purposely; out of one's way
meanings.note: Pinyin: tè yì. Highlights thoughtful effort done specifically for someone.

examples.text: 请别担心！我们特意为您准备好了安静的三楼阁楼书房。
examples.trans: Please do not worry! We specially prepared our quiet third-floor attic study for you.

examples.text: 宋老师早上讲了我们星期五的故事，小美特意烤的。
examples.trans: After Teacher Song told our Friday story this morning, Mei baked it specially.

meanings.note: Noun tèquán ('privilege').

examples.text: 她是品牌代言人，穿高定当然有特权呗。
examples.trans: She endorses the label, so wearing couture is her special perk.

examples.text: 在总编室里人人平等，谁也没有迟到的特权。
examples.trans: Everyone is equal in the editorial office with zero late privileges.

meanings.note: Adjective tèshū ('particular, special').

examples.text: 收集不同版本是您的特殊爱好吗？
examples.trans: Is collecting different editions a special hobby of yours?

examples.text: 今天情况特殊，大家需要临时加班。
examples.trans: Today's situation is special, so we need brief overtime.

特立独行.gloss: fiercely independent, walk one's own path

meanings.en: fiercely independent, walk one's own path
meanings.note: Idiom tèlì-dúxíng ('stand apart and act independently').

examples.text: 他这人特立独行，最喜欢走蓝海路线。
examples.trans: He is fiercely independent and loves charting blue-ocean paths.

examples.text: 这位音乐制作人风格特立独行，从不跟风。
examples.trans: This music producer has a fiercely independent style.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tè sè. Combines 特 ('special/distinctive') + 色 ('character/quality'), common on café and restaurant menus.

examples.text: 杏仁柠檬挞成了小美咖啡角的特色蛋糕。
examples.trans: Almond lemon tart became the signature pastry of Mei's café corner.

examples.text: 这家成都老茶馆很有川西小院的特色。
examples.trans: This old Chengdu teahouse has the distinctive charm of a western Sichuan courtyard.

meanings.note: Adjective xīlì ('trenchant, sharp-tongued').

examples.text: 难怪您能写出那么犀利的稿子。
examples.trans: No wonder you write such sharp articles.

examples.text: 这位记者的提问非常犀利。
examples.trans: This reporter's questions are very pointed.

犯得着.gloss: be worth the bother, have reason to stoop to

meanings.en: be worth the bother, have reason to stoop to
meanings.note: Rhetorical colloquial verb ('is it worth...?').

examples.text: 为了一句玩笑话生这么大气，你犯得着吗？
examples.trans: Is it really worth getting that furious over a passing joke?

examples.text: 咱们做好自己的本职工作，犯得着跟那种人计较吗？
examples.trans: Let us focus on our own work—why bother stooping to argue with him?

meanings.note: Noun zhuàngkuàng ('state, condition').

examples.text: 以淳于总现在的身体状况，这事急不得。
examples.trans: Given Mr Chun Yuqiao's current health condition, do not rush.

examples.text: 现场导播必须随时应对各种突发状况。
examples.trans: A live director must handle unexpected situations at any moment.

examples.text: 喜欢我的人是因为我的魅力，爱我的人是因为我的心，你不需要做出以身相许的状态。
examples.trans: People like me for my charm and love me for my heart; you don't need to act like you owe me your life.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Entertainment slang gǒuzǎi ('tabloid paparazzi').

examples.text: 外面那几个狗仔好像还一路跟着呢。
examples.trans: Those few paparazzi outside still seem to be trailing us.

examples.text: 知名艺人出门常常被狗仔跟拍。
examples.trans: Famous stars are often trailed by paparazzi outside.

meanings.note: Adjective hěn ('unsparing, sharp').

examples.text: 老大拒绝人的办法越来越狠了。
examples.trans: Our boss's way of turning people down keeps getting sharper.

examples.text: 他对自己的工作要求特别狠。
examples.trans: He sets fiercely high standards on his own work.

examples.text: 王尔实在是太狡猾了，他趁着我们去年系统升级的时候钻了这个空子。
examples.trans: Wang Er was remarkably cunning; he exploited a gap during our internal system upgrade last autumn.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 办公室恋情多有不便。以小谷的资质，你把她调到二部，独当一面完全没问题啊。
examples.trans: Office romances bring endless headaches. With Xiaogu's talent, transferring her to Unit Two to lead projects on her own would work great.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Making unilateral decisions without listening to others.

examples.text: 他在专业上很严格，但并不独断。
examples.trans: He is strict on craft, yet never autocratic.

examples.text: 好的团队负责人不会凡事独断。
examples.trans: A good team leader does not decide everything unilaterally.

独断专行.gloss: act autocratically, rule with an iron fist

meanings.en: act autocratically, rule with an iron fist
meanings.note: Four-character idiom for unilateral bossiness.

examples.text: 大家原本以为新总监是个独断专行的人。
examples.trans: Everyone initially thought the new director would act autocratically.

examples.text: 在团队合作中，独断专行很容易失去支持。
examples.trans: In teamwork, acting autocratically easily loses support.

examples.text: 闻老师，你不愧是独步江湖的段子手，我们开个讨论会你还卖关子呢。
examples.trans: Mr Wen, you truly live up to your reputation as a master storyteller — keeping us in suspense during a review meeting!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Adjective/verb dúlì ('independent').

examples.text: 辛惠美的形象现代而又独立。
examples.trans: Xin Huimei's public image is modern and independent.

examples.text: 刚毕业的年轻人要学会独立生活。
examples.trans: Fresh graduates learn to live independently.

meanings.note: Outside professional invited onto an academic or review panel.

examples.text: 学院特意邀请了一位资深制作人担任独立专家。
examples.trans: The college invited a veteran producer to serve as independent expert.

examples.text: 独立专家的评审意见往往更加贴近行业实际。
examples.trans: Feedback from an independent expert stays close to industry reality.

meanings.note: Recruiter who approaches experienced talent for rival firms.

examples.text: 总监离职的消息一传开，猎头的电话就打爆了办公室。
examples.trans: Once rumors of the chief's exit spread, headhunters flooded the phones.

examples.text: 面对猎头开出的三倍高薪，两位老搭档依然选择留下。
examples.trans: Despite triple-pay offers from headhunters, both partners stayed.

meanings.note: Adjective chāngjué ('rampant, unchecked').

examples.text: 过度依赖海外版权，国内跟风很猖獗。
examples.trans: Over-relying on foreign IP, copycatting at home runs rampant.

examples.text: 平台出手整治之后，恶意刷票行为不再猖獗。
examples.trans: After platform crackdowns, vote-rigging is no longer rampant.

meanings.note: Surmising an answer without being told.

examples.text: 你猜今天是谁给我送的礼物？
examples.trans: Guess who sent me a gift today?

examples.text: 不用猜了，我已经知道答案了。
examples.trans: No need to guess—I already know the answer.

meanings.note: Verb-complement cāidào ('figure out beforehand').

examples.text: 我猜到了她要做策划，没想到你也参与了。
examples.trans: I guessed she would draft a plan, not that you joined in.

examples.text: 观众谁也没猜到最后出场的神秘嘉宾。
examples.trans: No viewer guessed the final mystery guest.
