meanings.note: Pinyin: cāi cai. Playful reduplication of 猜 ('guess').

examples.text: 让我猜猜，你把没有的房间答应给别人了？
examples.trans: Let me guess: you promised someone a room we do not have?

examples.text: 你猜猜今天早上谁来我们咖啡馆了？
examples.trans: Guess who stopped by our café this morning?

猜着.gloss: guess right, figure out by guessing

meanings.en: guess right, figure out by guessing
meanings.note: 猜 plus resultative 着 (zháo), meaning successfully guessing.

examples.text: 你不说我也能猜着是怎么回事。
examples.trans: Even if you stay quiet, I can guess what is going on.

examples.text: 这么多谜语，她一下子就猜着了。
examples.trans: Out of all those riddles, she guessed it right away.

meanings.note: Domestic feline.

examples.text: 打开视频一看，他心心念念的宝贝原来是一只猫！
examples.trans: Opening the video revealed his beloved darling was actually a cat!

examples.text: 那只橘黄色的小猫懒洋洋地趴在沙发上晒太阳。
examples.trans: The ginger cat lounged lazily in the sun on the sofa.

meanings.note: Idiom xiànyīnqín ('fawn over, be overly attentive').

examples.text: 你觉得来病房献殷勤我们就能原谅你吗？
examples.trans: Do you think fawning at the ward wins our forgiveness?

examples.text: 他今天突然跑来献殷勤。
examples.trans: He suddenly came over today trying to curry favour.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàn gěi. Respectful verb-complement compound used in musical dedications, book inscriptions, and gifts.

examples.text: 曲谱第一行写着：“献给星期五晚茶的朋友们。”
examples.trans: The first line of the score reads: 'Dedicated to our Friday evening tea friends.'

examples.text: 她把这首歌献给了教她弹琴的老师。
examples.trans: She dedicated this song to the teacher who taught her piano.

examples.text: 如果我们台能够率先垂范接受这个方案，不仅会提高我们的品牌价值。
examples.trans: If our network sets the example by adopting this plan, it will elevate our entire brand value.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 王老师，二十二分钟之后总编室开会。
examples.trans: Teacher Wang, there is a meeting in the chief editor's office in twenty-two minutes.

examples.text: 王老师，二十二分钟之后总编室开会。
examples.trans: Teacher Wang, there is a meeting in the chief editor's office in twenty-two minutes.

meanings.en: Wang Er, a character name in Behind the Scenes
meanings.note: Wáng Ěr — addressed respectfully in the entertainment industry as 王尔老师 (Teacher Wang Er).

examples.text: 吉总您好，王尔老师让我来跟您接洽。
examples.trans: Hello President Ji; Teacher Wang Er sent me to coordinate with you.

examples.text: 王尔老师对舞台音效的要求非常严格。
examples.trans: Teacher Wang Er has very strict standards for stage sound effects.

related.gloss: respectful form of address for industry professionals

meanings.note: Noun/adjective wángpái ('ace, flagship show').

examples.text: 今夜现场是对手电视台的王牌节目。
examples.trans: Tonight Live is the rival network's flagship show.

examples.text: 制作一部是星天娱乐的王牌团队。
examples.trans: Production Unit One is Xingtian's ace team.

meanings.note: Often 钻石王老五 ('eligible bachelor').

examples.text: 闻老师自嘲说自己这个清闲王老五突然成了大忙人。
examples.trans: Mr Wen joked that a carefree bachelor like him had turned super busy.

examples.text: 朋友们经常热心地想给那位单身王老五介绍对象。
examples.trans: Friends are always eager to set that eligible bachelor up on dates.

meanings.note: Verb wán ('play; pull a stunt').

examples.text: 你自己也知道昨晚玩得太过火了吧？
examples.trans: Even you know last night's stunt went too far, right?

examples.text: 周末休息的时候大家一起出去玩。
examples.trans: Everyone goes out to relax over the weekend.

examples.text: 王总，开什么玩笑呢？
examples.trans: Director Wang, what kind of joke is this?

examples.text: 王总，开什么玩笑呢？
examples.trans: Director Wang, what kind of joke is this?

环.gloss: link (in a chain of events); ring

meanings.en: link (in a chain of events); ring
meanings.note: Noun/classifier huán ('link in a sequence').

examples.text: 后来我查过这事，每一环我都查明白了。
examples.trans: I checked the case afterward and pieced every link together.

examples.text: 现场直播一环扣一环，不能有半点疏忽。
examples.trans: Live TV links tightly together with zero room for slips.

meanings.note: Noun huánjìng ('surroundings, ambience').

examples.text: 这家古典茶艺社的环境非常不错。
examples.trans: The setting at this classical teahouse is lovely.

examples.text: 安静的办公环境有助于专心写策划。
examples.trans: A quiet office setting helps when writing proposals.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàn dài. Describes modern buildings or appliances.

examples.text: 热！小晴你听到没？稳定、现代、五星级热水！
examples.trans: Hot! Qing, did you hear that? Reliable, modern, five-star hot water!

examples.text: 老房子外观古朴，里面的浴室却很现代。
examples.trans: The old house looks classic outside, yet its bathrooms are modern.

examples.text: 凭着我五千个小时的主播生涯，我一定让这个满嘴谎话的女人当场现出原形！
examples.trans: With five thousand hours as a live host behind me, I will expose that lying woman's true colors right on camera!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàn zài. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 现在这时候 ('this moment right now').

examples.text: 现在他的箱子还安全锁着呢。
examples.trans: For now, his suitcase stays safely locked up.

examples.text: 太好了！现在我想吃一顿丰盛的早餐。
examples.trans: Wonderful! Now I would like to eat a big breakfast.

related.gloss: this moment right now (measure word 个)

examples.text: 这是现场啊。
examples.trans: This is site.

examples.text: 那个现场好。
examples.trans: That site is good.

examples.text: 在现场组。
examples.trans: In the floor crew.

examples.text: 去现场组。
examples.trans: Go to the floor crew.

meanings.note: Adjective/noun xiànshí ('real-world, starkly practical').

examples.text: 他们要面对最现实的每一天。
examples.trans: They have to face the most realistic everyday life.

examples.text: 理想很美，但现实很严格。
examples.trans: Ideals are lovely, yet reality is strict.

meanings.note: How someone or something stands right now.

examples.text: 当务之急是确认海外拍摄人员目前的现状。
examples.trans: The top priority is confirming the current status of the overseas crew.

examples.text: 只有敢于改变现状，节目才能重新焕发活力。
examples.trans: Only by daring to change the status quo can the show revive.

meanings.note: Noun xiànxiàng ('observable trend or phenomenon').

examples.text: 今天让我们聊一聊电视节目同质化的现象。
examples.trans: Today let us discuss the trend of look-alike TV shows.

examples.text: 跟风模仿是行业里常见的一种现象。
examples.trans: Copycatting is a common phenomenon across the industry.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàn jīn. Measure word (量词): 笔 (bǐ), e.g. 一笔现金 ('a sum of cash').

examples.text: 给我袋子和现金！路口市场七点开门。
examples.trans: Give me a bag and cash! The corner market opens at seven.

examples.text: 付了现金！打开工具箱等我，我往桥那边跑回来了！
examples.trans: Paid in cash! Open your toolbox and wait—I am running back across the bridge!

related.gloss: a sum of cash (measure word 笔)

meanings.note: Pinyin: bō li. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块玻璃 ('a pane of glass').

examples.text: 小晴，隔着玻璃看——他们俩在树下面对面站着呢！
examples.trans: Qing, look through the glass—the two of them are standing face to face under the tree!

examples.text: 擦干净玻璃窗以后，屋里亮多了。
examples.trans: After wiping the glass window clean, the room is much brighter.

related.gloss: a pane of glass (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Verb zhēnxī ('cherish an opportunity or bond').

examples.text: 能跟淳于老大合作，我一定好好珍惜。
examples.trans: Getting to work with Boss Chun Yuqiao, I will truly cherish it.

examples.text: 布小谷非常珍惜在总编室学习的每一天。
examples.trans: Bu Xiaogu treasures every day learning in the editorial office.

meanings.note: Verb zhēncáng ('cherish and store safely').

examples.text: 不属于我的感情，就悄悄地珍藏起来吧。
examples.trans: Feelings that do not belong to me I will quietly treasure away.

examples.text: 方老师签名的那本古书她一直小心珍藏着。
examples.trans: She carefully treasures that classic book signed by Professor Fang.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhēn guì. Describes keepsakes, memories, or historic craft.

examples.text: 谢谢老陈。里面的木头小火车看着很珍贵。
examples.trans: Thank you, Chen. The little wooden train inside looked very precious.

examples.text: 而你们两个孩子把十二号最珍贵的部分留在这儿了。
examples.trans: And you two boys kept the most precious part of Number twelve right here.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bān. Counts scheduled trains/flights (同一班火车 'the same train') and work shifts (上班).

examples.text: 真奇怪！我们坐同一班早火车到同一个区。
examples.trans: How strange! We rode the very same morning train to the same district.

examples.text: 等等——星期一你们坐同一班火车，并拿走了她的箱子？
examples.trans: Wait—so you rode the same train on Monday and took her suitcase?

examples.text: 按规则这球得重新来。
examples.trans: Under tournament rules, this ball has to be replayed.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 学校几个球友打不过我，嫌没劲。
examples.trans: None of the campus players could beat me, so they complained it wasn't fun.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Verb lǐ ('respond to, heed').

examples.text: 不理它，谣言自然就过去了。
examples.trans: Ignore it, and the rumour will blow over naturally.

examples.text: 他生气了，一句话也不理我。
examples.trans: He is upset and will not say a word to me.

meanings.note: Noun lǐniàn ('core philosophy/concept').

examples.text: 淳于总设计的这个核心理念是逃离孤岛。
examples.trans: The core philosophy Chun Yuqiao designed is escaping isolation.

examples.text: 尊重音乐本身是制作一部一贯坚持的创作理念。
examples.trans: Respecting music itself is Unit One's abiding creative philosophy.

meanings.note: Contrasts with 感性 or 感情用事.

examples.text: 他在审核节目方案时一向保持着高度的理性。
examples.trans: When reviewing show proposals, he always stays coolly rational.

examples.text: 越是在舆论喧嚣的时候，媒体越应该发出理性的声音。
examples.trans: The louder online chatter gets, the more media should offer rational voices.

meanings.note: Noun/adjective lǐxiǎng ('cherished ideal').

examples.text: 这次不是为了理想，而是为了一个人。
examples.trans: This time was not for an ideal, rather for one person.

examples.text: 那个让我仰望的人就像理想一样遥远。
examples.trans: The person I look up to feels like a distant ideal.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǐ yóu. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个理由 ('a reason').

examples.text: 五分钟演讲稿，列了十九条理由解释那年春天我们都错了。
examples.trans: A five-minute speech listing nineteen reasons why we were both wrong that spring.

examples.text: 十九条理由？！您是迎接哥哥，还是念火车时刻表呀？
examples.trans: Nineteen reasons?! Are you welcoming your brother or reading a train timetable?

meanings.note: Verb/noun lǐjiě ('understand').

examples.text: 我不知道你们怎么理解职场。
examples.trans: I do not know how people your age understand the workplace.

examples.text: 谢谢大家对我们工作的理解。
examples.trans: Thank you all for understanding our work.

examples.text: 你很快会晋升，不要在这些琐事上浪费太多精力。
examples.trans: You will be promoted very soon, so don't waste too much energy on trivial errands like these.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 老大，你要是真看上那姑娘了，别琢磨了，赶快行动吧！
examples.trans: Boss, if you have really fallen for that girl, stop overthinking and make your move fast!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qín. Measure word (量词): 架 (jià), e.g. 一架琴 ('a piano').

examples.text: 每次弹完琴，他都问为什么下雨天钢琴声音更暖。
examples.trans: Whenever I finished playing, he asked why the piano sounded warmer on rainy days.

examples.text: 她从小就喜欢每天练琴。
examples.trans: She has loved practicing the piano every day since childhood.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qín xián. Combines 琴 ('stringed/keyboard instrument') + 弦 ('taut string').

examples.text: 哆音的琴槌稳稳抬起来，敲中了三根明亮的琴弦。
examples.trans: The C hammer rose smoothly and struck the three bright piano strings.

examples.text: 调音的时候要轻轻转动扳手，免得拉断旧琴弦。
examples.trans: Turn the wrench gently while tuning so you don't snap an old piano string.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qín chuí. Combines 琴 ('piano') + 槌 ('wooden mallet/hammer'): the felt-covered wooden hammer inside a piano action.

examples.text: 一旦那根歪掉的琴槌站直了，钢琴就能重新调音了。
examples.trans: Once that tilted piano hammer stands straight, the piano can be tuned again.

examples.text: 打开立式钢琴的前面板，就能看见整排包着毛毡的琴槌。
examples.trans: Lift off the upright piano's front panel and you can see the whole row of felt-wrapped hammers.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qín gài. Combines 琴 ('piano') + 盖 ('lid/cover').

examples.text: 姑姑把没写完的圆舞曲收进琴盖里面等着晴天。
examples.trans: My aunt tucked the unfinished waltz inside the piano lid to wait for sunny weather.

examples.text: 弹完钢琴以后，宋老师总是轻轻合上木头琴盖。
examples.trans: After playing the piano, Teacher Song always closes the wooden lid gently.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qín xiāng. Combines 琴 ('piano/stringed instrument') + 箱 ('wooden case/resonating cabinet'); measure word: 台 (tái) or 个 (gè).

examples.text: 瞧瞧——这台老核桃木琴箱发出的共鸣把整间玻璃房都装满了！
examples.trans: Look at that—the resonance from this old walnut piano case fills the entire glass sunroom!

examples.text: 老陈用软棉布把核桃木琴箱擦拭得温润发亮。
examples.trans: Chen wiped the walnut piano case with a soft cotton cloth until it glowed warmly.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qín jiàn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个琴键 ('a piano key').

examples.text: 小晴，你看这些白琴键，又干净又完整。
examples.trans: Qing, look at these white keys—clean and whole.

examples.text: 听……有点低，很温暖，等等——中间这个琴键没有声音！
examples.trans: Listen... a little low, very warm, and wait—this middle key makes no sound!

meanings.note: Pinyin: ruì yīn. Combines Chinese solfège 瑞 (ruì, 'Re / D') + 音 ('musical note').

examples.text: 第二十八小节的旋律正好稳稳落在中央瑞音上！
examples.trans: The melody in bar twenty-eight lands squarely on middle D!

examples.text: 修好轴销以后，中央瑞音终于重新发出了清脆的声音。
examples.trans: Once the hinge pin was fixed, middle D finally rang out clearly again.

meanings.note: Pinyin: píng. Counts bottles of water, milk, or jam (一瓶气泡水 'a bottle of sparkling water').

examples.text: 三瓶牛奶、二十个鸡蛋、黄油、奶酪和红苹果！
examples.trans: Three bottles of milk, twenty eggs, butter, cheese, and red apples!

examples.text: 冰箱里还有两瓶冰牛奶。
examples.trans: There are still two bottles of cold milk in the fridge.

meanings.note: Compound noun píngzhuāngshuǐ ('bottled drinking water').

examples.text: 幸好没有让错误的瓶装水出现在电视里。
examples.trans: Luckily the wrong bottled water stayed off television.

examples.text: 休息室的桌子上放着一箱瓶装水。
examples.trans: A case of bottled water sits on the lounge table.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cí. High-fired glazed porcelain; used in 瓷杯 ('porcelain cup') and 瓷保险丝 ('porcelain fuse carrier').

examples.text: 老房子电盒里用的是结实的白瓷保险丝。
examples.trans: The junction box in the old house uses a sturdy white porcelain fuse.

examples.text: 这套薄薄的白瓷茶具是景德镇出产的。
examples.trans: This thin white porcelain tea set was made in Jingdezhen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cí bēi. Combines 瓷 ('porcelain/china') + 杯 ('cup'); measure word: 个 (gè) or 只 (zhī).

examples.text: 我们让周经理负责把十二个白瓷杯擦得闪闪发亮。
examples.trans: Let's put Manager Zhou in charge of polishing all twelve white porcelain teacups until they gleam.

examples.text: 洁白的瓷杯里盛着翠绿的薄荷茶，看起来格外清雅。
examples.trans: Bright green mint tea inside a white porcelain cup looks wonderfully refined.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cízhuān. Measure word: 块.

examples.text: 浴室的墙上贴满了蓝色的瓷砖。
examples.trans: The bathroom walls are covered with blue ceramic tiles.

examples.text: 这块瓷砖不小心被打碎了。
examples.trans: This ceramic tile was accidentally broken.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cí guàn. Combines 瓷 ('porcelain/ceramic') + 罐 ('jar/canister'); measure word: 个 (gè) or 只 (zhī).

examples.text: 那两个装白糖和海盐的白瓷罐底下原本贴着小纸标签呢！
examples.trans: Those two white ceramic jars holding sugar and sea salt originally had small paper labels stuck underneath!

examples.text: 把茶叶存放在密封的白瓷罐里，香气能保持很久。
examples.trans: Storing tea leaves in a sealed porcelain canister keeps their fragrance fresh for a long time.

meanings.note: Formal verb/noun zhēnxuǎn ('handpick').

examples.text: 这家五星级酒店是我们老大亲自甄选的。
examples.trans: This five-star hotel was personally handpicked by our boss.

examples.text: 节目组从上千名报名者中甄选出十二位实力唱将。
examples.trans: Producers handpicked twelve powerhouse vocalists from thousands.

examples.text: 他忙得一整天甚至连一口热茶都没顾上喝。
examples.trans: He was so busy all day that he did not even have time for a sip of hot tea.

examples.text: 这架老钢琴音色极佳，甚至连专业的音乐老师都赞不绝口。
examples.trans: This old piano has such a fine tone that even professional music teachers are full of praise.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tián. Describes sweet pastries, fruit, or tea with honey.

examples.text: 那是海盐咸黄油！甜果酱面包卷要无盐黄油！
examples.trans: That is sea-salt butter! Sweet jam rolls need unsalted butter!

examples.text: 咸黄油能配甜草莓果酱吗？
examples.trans: Can salted butter go with sweet strawberry jam?

meanings.note: Pinyin: tián wèi. Combines 甜 ('sweet') + 味 ('taste/flavour').

examples.text: 把洋葱丁和胡萝卜丁先炒三分钟，就能炒出自然的甜味。
examples.trans: Sautéing the diced onions and carrots for three minutes first brings out their natural sweetness.

examples.text: 柠檬汁的酸香配上蜂蜜的甜味，喝起来恰到好处。
examples.trans: The bright tang of lemon juice paired with the sweetness of honey tastes just right.

meanings.note: Verb shēng ('survive, live').

examples.text: 改则生，不改则死！
examples.trans: Reform and live, fail to reform and die!

examples.text: 绝境之中往往能激发出求生与创新的力量。
examples.trans: Tight corners often spark the drive to survive and innovate.

examples.text: 这是生命啊。
examples.trans: This is lives.

examples.text: 那个生命好。
examples.trans: That lives is good.

meanings.note: Verb shēngpà ('greatly fear that').

examples.text: 你在网上骂他，生怕别人听不着。
examples.trans: You roasted him online as if afraid anyone might miss it.

examples.text: 她轻手轻脚地关上门，生怕吵醒大家。
examples.trans: She closed the door softly lest she wake everyone.

meanings.note: Everyday word for commercial transactions.

examples.text: 朋友叙旧归叙旧，谈生意的时候还是要按规矩报价。
examples.trans: Catching up as friends is one thing; business deals still follow clear quotes.

examples.text: 这家老字号茶馆凭着诚信经营，生意一直十分红火。
examples.trans: Run with honesty, this time-honored teahouse enjoys booming business.

meanings.note: Legal/corporate verb shēngxiào ('enter into force').

examples.text: 总监签字以后就能立即生效。
examples.trans: Once the director signs, it takes effect immediately.

examples.text: 新合同下周一正式生效。
examples.trans: The new contract takes effect next Monday.

生无可恋.gloss: utterly joyless, looking as if life holds nothing left to love

meanings.en: utterly joyless, looking as if life holds nothing left to love
meanings.note: Humorous modern idiom for looking thoroughly dejected.

examples.text: 连加三天班之后，他累得一脸生无可恋。
examples.trans: After three straight days of overtime, he looked utterly drained.

examples.text: 被心上人躲着，他整天都是一副生无可恋的样子。
examples.trans: Avoided by the girl he liked, he walked around looking utterly gloomy.

meanings.note: Annual anniversary of one's birth.

examples.text: 今天正好是我好朋友的生日。
examples.trans: Today happens to be my close friend's birthday.

examples.text: 我从来没跟同事提过自己的生日。
examples.trans: I have never mentioned my birthday to coworkers.

meanings.note: Standard birthday greeting.

examples.text: 大家一起唱歌唱着祝她生日快乐。
examples.trans: Everyone sang together wishing her a happy birthday.

examples.text: 卡片上端端正正写着生日快乐四个字。
examples.trans: Happy Birthday was written neatly across the card.

meanings.note: A gift given to celebrate someone's birthday.

examples.text: 她收到了一份特别可爱的生日礼物。
examples.trans: She received an especially cute birthday present.

examples.text: 我正在挑选给妹妹的生日礼物。
examples.trans: I am picking out a birthday gift for my younger sister.

生死不明.gloss: uncertain whether dead or alive, unaccounted for

meanings.en: uncertain whether dead or alive, unaccounted for
meanings.note: Four-character phrase shēngsǐbùmíng ('fate unknown').

examples.text: 那位重要嘉宾的亲人在恐袭里生死不明。
examples.trans: Our featured guest's relative is unaccounted for after the attack.

examples.text: 失联超过一天，家属焦急地等待生死不明的亲人消息。
examples.trans: Cut off for over a day, families anxiously awaited word.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shēng qì. Literally 'generate air/steam'—separable verb-object compound.

examples.text: 因为怕你还在生气。这三年我很想你。
examples.trans: Because I was afraid you were still angry. I missed you very much these three years.

examples.text: 只是一场小误会，别再生气啦。
examples.trans: It was only a small mix-up—do not stay mad anymore.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shēng huó. Measure word (量词): 种 (zhǒng), e.g. 一种生活 ('a way of life').

examples.text: 生活安排的二重奏比我们自己写得更妙，孩子们。
examples.trans: Life arranges finer duets than we write ourselves, boys.

examples.text: 大家都喜欢成都这种慢节奏的生活。
examples.trans: Everyone loves this unhurried pace of life in Chengdu.

related.gloss: a way of life (measure word 种)

meanings.note: Four-character noun shēnghuó-qǐjū ('everyday routine').

examples.text: 录制期间您的生活起居都由导演组对接。
examples.trans: During filming your daily routine is handled by our directors.

examples.text: 艺人助理负责照顾嘉宾在外的生活起居。
examples.trans: An artist's assistant looks after daily needs on the road.

examples.text: 凭着我五千个小时的主播生涯，我一定让这个满嘴谎话的女人当场现出原形！
examples.trans: With five thousand hours as a live host behind me, I will expose that lying woman's true colors right on camera!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòng. Works as main verb ('use a key') or preposition ('with/using').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 别担心！用冰气泡水一擦，橙汁就掉。
examples.trans: Do not worry! Wipe it once with cold sparkling water and orange juice comes right out.

用不着.gloss: no need to; have no use for

meanings.en: not need to; there is no need to
meanings.note: yòngbuzháo — followed by a verb phrase to indicate that an action is unnecessary (synonymous with 不必 or 不用, with a brisk, colloquial tone).
Takes a noun object (or stands alone when the object is understood from context) to mean an item is unneeded.

examples.text: 用不着了，下周你就死了。
examples.trans: You will not need that anymore — next week you are dead.

examples.text: 跟我谈恋爱，用不着拿出尽义务的心态。
examples.trans: Dating me does not call for the mindset of fulfilling an obligation.

用作品说话.gloss: let one's work speak for itself

meanings.en: let one's work speak for itself
meanings.note: Idiom-like phrase yòng zuòpǐn shuōhuà ('prove oneself by work').

examples.text: 我向来都是用作品说话的。
examples.trans: I have always let my work speak for itself.

examples.text: 真正的制作人从不炒作，只用作品说话。
examples.trans: True producers skip hype and let their work speak.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòng lì. Literally 'use force'.

examples.text: 哎呀！透过窗户看见周经理了？我明明加倍用力微笑了！
examples.trans: Oh dear! You spotted Manager Zhou through the window? I smiled twice as wide!

examples.text: 这把旧锁有点紧，往右转的时候要用力。
examples.trans: This old lock is stiff; turn firmly to the right.

meanings.note: Putting earnest effort into study or preparation.

examples.text: 你们准备得这么用功，一点小差错都挑不出来。
examples.trans: You prepared so diligently that not a single flaw can be found.

examples.text: 她读书的时候就是班里最用功的学生。
examples.trans: Back in school she was the most diligent student in class.

meanings.note: Adjective/verb yòngxīn ('put real heart and care into').

examples.text: 茶艺师都提前约好了，你安排得够用心的。
examples.trans: Even booking the tea master early — how thoughtful of you.

examples.text: 只要用心打磨内容，观众一定看得出来。
examples.trans: Put real care into content and viewers always notice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a adv used in conversational Mandarin.

examples.text: 我有一个用来。
examples.trans: I have a 用来.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的用来。
examples.trans: This is a very good 用来.

examples.text: 你甭纠结，他基本上不会记得你是谁。
examples.trans: Do not agonise over it — he basically will not remember who you are.

examples.text: 你甭纠结，他基本上不会记得你是谁。
examples.trans: Do not agonise over it — he basically will not remember who you are.

meanings.note: Northern spoken contraction of 不用管.

examples.text: 甭管遇到什么困难，咱们一起扛。
examples.trans: No matter what difficulties come up, we face them together.

examples.text: 你甭管是谁说的，先听听道理对不对。
examples.trans: Never mind who said it—just see whether it makes sense.

examples.text: 这样吧，还是由我来亲自讲。
examples.trans: How about this — let me explain it myself instead.

examples.text: 这样吧，还是由我来亲自讲。
examples.trans: How about this — let me explain it myself instead.

meanings.note: Colloquial noun yóutou ('convenient pretext').

examples.text: 说实话，来写报道其实只是个由头。
examples.trans: Honestly, writing an article was merely a pretext.

examples.text: 他借着送资料的由头过来打听消息。
examples.trans: Using file delivery as a pretext, he came fishing for news.

examples.text: 由此引发的股东内部分歧与高管层问责风暴，可能是比侵权本身更为严重的企业危机。
examples.trans: The resulting shareholder rifts and executive accountability storm may prove even deadlier than the lawsuit itself.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Appealing an unfair penalty or decision to higher authority.

examples.text: 大家都想去向董事长为被免职的总监申诉。
examples.trans: Everyone wanted to appeal to the chairwoman for the dismissed director.

examples.text: 如果对处理结果有异议，可以按规定提出申诉。
examples.trans: If you disagree with the ruling, you may file an appeal.

meanings.note: Submitting a request for leave, funding, or approval.

examples.text: 因为要修改毕业论文，她向领导申请留在国内。
examples.trans: Needing to revise her thesis, she requested leave from the trip abroad.

examples.text: 使用一号演播厅需要提前一周提交书面申请。
examples.trans: Using Studio One requires submitting a written request a week ahead.

meanings.note: Pinyin: diàn gōng. Refers to an electrician or modifies trade supplies like 电工胶带 ('electrical tape').

examples.text: 老陈年轻的时候跟师傅学过三年电工。
examples.trans: When Chen was young, he apprenticed for three years in electrical work.

examples.text: 抽屉里有一卷黑色的电工胶带和一把螺丝刀。
examples.trans: In the drawer there is a roll of black electrical tape and a screwdriver.

meanings.note: Noun diàntī ('elevator').

examples.text: 一楼的电梯按钮都已经修过了。
examples.trans: The first-floor elevator buttons have all been fixed.

examples.text: 早高峰坐电梯的人多，咱们走楼梯吧。
examples.trans: The lift is crowded at morning rush—let us take the stairs.

meanings.note: Pinyin: diàn dēng. Combines 电 ('electricity') + 灯 ('lamp/light'); measure word: 盏 (zhǎn).

examples.text: 我们请周经理明天负责检查九号房的每一盏电灯和每一个开关。
examples.trans: We asked Manager Zhou to take charge of checking every electric light and switch in Room Nine tomorrow.

examples.text: 傍晚六点，走廊和院子里的暖黄色电灯一盏接一盏亮了起来。
examples.trans: At six in the evening, the warm yellow electric lights in the hallway and courtyard came on one after another.

meanings.note: Pinyin: diàn hé. Short everyday compound 电 ('electric') + 盒 ('box') for a wall junction or fuse box.

examples.text: 新的铜电线已经安全地接进了墙角的电盒。
examples.trans: The new copper wire has been safely connected into the corner junction box.

examples.text: 打开电盒以前，老陈先关掉了总电源。
examples.trans: Before opening the junction box, Chen switched off the main power first.

meanings.note: Pinyin: diàn xiàn. Measure word (量词): 根 (gēn), e.g. 一根电线 ('an electric wire').

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 电线本来就该拉直了。正常保养，别多想。
examples.trans: The wire needed straightening anyway. Routine maintenance—don't read into it.

meanings.note: Pinyin: diàn nǎo. Measure word (量词): 台, e.g. 一台电脑 ('a computer').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 我在前台电脑上查到了您的预订记录。
examples.trans: I found your reservation on the front-desk computer.

meanings.note: Noun diànshì ('TV').

examples.text: 看了二十年电视。
examples.trans: Watched television for twenty years.

examples.text: 我想做电视节目。
examples.trans: I want to make TV shows.

meanings.note: diànshìtái — takes the classifier 家 (jiā); often shortened to 台里 (at the station) in industry speech.

examples.text: 我决定放弃电视台，去星天娱乐工作。
examples.trans: I decided to give up the TV station and go work at Xingtian Entertainment.

examples.text: 你真的想放弃去电视台工作的机会吗？
examples.trans: Do you really want to give up the opportunity to work at the TV station?

meanings.note: Noun diànshìshǐ ('television history').

examples.text: 今晚这场云端直播都快打破电视史纪录了吧？
examples.trans: Did tonight's cloud finale nearly make television history?

examples.text: 这档经典音乐综艺在电视史上留下了浓墨重彩的一页。
examples.trans: That classic music show left a vivid page in television history.

meanings.note: Informal collective noun for TV professionals.

examples.text: 自从进了节奏飞快的电视圈，他再也没空每天去健身了。
examples.trans: Once he entered the fast-paced TV world, daily workouts vanished.

examples.text: 这档现象级直播在十年前的电视圈创下了收视神话。
examples.trans: That landmark live broadcast set a ratings legend in television circles.

meanings.note: Noun diànshìjī ('TV set').

examples.text: 欢迎现场以及电视机前的观众朋友们。
examples.trans: Welcome viewers in the studio and before your TV sets.

examples.text: 客厅里放着一台新电视机。
examples.trans: There is a new TV set in the living room.

examples.text: 对于一个引进节目做这种高度的本土化创新，这在中国的电视界从来没有过。
examples.trans: Taking an imported format and giving it such deep homegrown innovation has never been done in Chinese television.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: diàn huà. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个电话 ('a phone call').

examples.text: 上面有名字或者电话号码吗？
examples.trans: Is there a name or a phone number on it?

examples.text: 可惜没有电话号码，只有两个字母和老街名字。
examples.trans: Unfortunately there is no phone number, only two letters and an old street name.

examples.text: 上个月你三天绕地球飞了一整圈，回来开电话会议，中文英文一个字没错过。
examples.trans: Last month you flew around the globe in three days and took a bilingual conference call without missing a single word!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Adjective/noun nán ('male').

examples.text: 那天有一个男的拉了好几车粉丝过来。
examples.trans: A man brought several busloads of fans over that day.

examples.text: 今晚晚会由一男一女两位主持人搭档。
examples.trans: Tonight's gala pairs one male and one female host.

meanings.note: Industry term for the number-one male role.

examples.text: 无论是演技还是形象，他都完全能够胜任这部剧的男一号。
examples.trans: In both acting and presence, he is fully up to playing the male lead.

examples.text: 导演组面试了十几位演员才最终敲定新剧的男一号。
examples.trans: The directors auditioned over a dozen actors before picking the male lead.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nán rén. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个男人 ('a man').

examples.text: 我手在发抖——车上下来穿深灰色外套的高个子男人吗？
examples.trans: My hands are shaking—is a tall man in a dark grey coat stepping out?

examples.text: 穿深灰西装的那个男人是位建筑师。
examples.trans: That man in the dark gray suit is an architect.

examples.text: 男友是被誉为天才制作人的淳于乔，出现在大众媒体的面前。
examples.trans: Her boyfriend is none other than genius producer Chun Yuqiao, stepping before the public media together.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Colloquial noun nánháizi ('boy, young guy').

examples.text: 普通的男孩子可配不上她。
examples.trans: An ordinary young guy will not do for her.

examples.text: 组里新来的男孩子干活特别麻利。
examples.trans: The new young guy on the crew works briskly.

meanings.note: Entertainment noun nánxīng ('male star').

examples.text: 当初采访她时，我还傻乎乎问她喜欢哪款男星。
examples.trans: Back when I interviewed her, I asked what kind of male star she liked.

examples.text: 几位人气男星在公益晚会上合唱了主题曲。
examples.trans: Several popular male stars sang the theme song at the charity gala.

meanings.note: Noun nánpéngyou ('boyfriend').

examples.text: 她不适合找男朋友吗？
examples.trans: Is she not suited to finding a boyfriend?

examples.text: 她周末打算跟男朋友一起去逛画展。
examples.trans: She plans to visit an art show with her boyfriend this weekend.

meanings.note: Colloquial slang noun nánshén ('adored male star/crush').

examples.text: 你的男神还挺多，一点也不挑啊。
examples.trans: You certainly have plenty of male idols and are not picky.

examples.text: 这位才华横溢的歌手是无数年轻歌迷心中的男神。
examples.trans: This gifted singer is the dream idol of countless young fans.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nán xié. Measure word (量词): 双 (shuāng), e.g. 一双男鞋 ('a pair of men's shoes').

examples.text: 两双棕色大男鞋，还有灰色毛衣。
examples.trans: Two pairs of big brown men's shoes, plus grey sweaters.

examples.text: 鞋架下面放着两双棕色的男鞋。
examples.trans: Two pairs of brown men's shoes sit on the bottom of the rack.

related.gloss: a pair of men's shoes (measure word 双)

meanings.note: Pinyin: huà. Used for drawing blueprints or painting signs.

examples.text: 上面怎么用铅笔整齐画了这条街三家客栈？
examples.trans: Why are three inns on this street neatly sketched in pencil on it?

examples.text: 门上方只画着一把金色钥匙。拿旧阀门给店员看。
examples.trans: Only a golden key painted above the door. Show the clerk the old valve.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huà kuàng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个画框 ('a picture frame'). Joins 画 ('picture') + 框 ('frame').

examples.text: 我们把这幅炭笔素描装进核桃木画框里挂起来吧！
examples.trans: Let us put this charcoal sketch inside a walnut picture frame and hang it up!

examples.text: 木工店师傅做了一个大小刚好的实木画框。
examples.trans: The carpenter in the woodshop made a solid-wood picture frame of the exact right size.

meanings.note: Broadcast noun huàmiàn ('video frame or camera feed').

examples.text: 等会儿，请切回上一个画面。
examples.trans: Hold on, switch back to the previous camera shot.

examples.text: 直播的画面非常清晰。
examples.trans: The live broadcast image is crystal clear.

meanings.note: Noun jièxiàn ('demarcation, boundary').

examples.text: 个性和商业之间的界限很难区分。
examples.trans: The line between individuality and commerce is hard to draw.

examples.text: 工作和私生活之间最好保持清晰的界限。
examples.trans: It is best to keep a clear line between work and private life.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liú. Used for leaving a note/keepsake, saving food, or staying on (留下来).

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 为什么把鞋和木头小火车留到星期五呢？
examples.trans: Why leave the shoes and little wooden train here until Friday?

examples.text: 最后留下的概率并不是很高。
examples.trans: The chance of staying on at the end is really not very high.

examples.text: 这是留下。
examples.trans: This is 留下.

meanings.note: Directional compound liúxiàlái ('remain here going forward').

examples.text: 布小谷留下来了。
examples.trans: Bu Xiaogu stayed on.

examples.text: 希望你能留下来。
examples.trans: I hope you can stay on.

examples.text: 留在这里。
examples.trans: Stay here.

examples.text: 留在家里。
examples.trans: Stay at home.

meanings.note: Verb-object liúxué ('pursue studies overseas').

examples.text: 你不是在美国留学的吗？泰语也会说？
examples.trans: Did you not study abroad in America? You speak Thai too?

examples.text: 她大学毕业后去英国留学读了两年传媒。
examples.trans: After college she studied media in Britain for two years.

留守.gloss: stay behind to hold the fort

meanings.en: stay behind to hold the fort
meanings.note: Verb liúshǒu ('remain at home base on duty').

examples.text: 你们飞去欧洲打前站，我在家留守。
examples.trans: You two fly ahead to Europe while I stay behind holding the fort.

examples.text: 外景组出发后，总编室留守人员负责协调后勤。
examples.trans: Once the location unit departs, home-base staff coordinate support.

留意.gloss: pay close attention, keep an eye out

meanings.en: pay close attention, keep an eye out
meanings.note: Verb-object liúyì ('observe attentively').

examples.text: 你留意观察整个立项推进的过程。
examples.trans: Keep an attentive eye on the whole greenlighting process.

examples.text: 上下舞台台阶有点滑，请各位嘉宾多留意脚下。
examples.trans: Stage steps are slick, so guests please watch your step.

留着.gloss: keep on hand, save for later

meanings.en: keep on hand, save for later
meanings.note: Verb+aspect liúzhe ('keep in reserve').

examples.text: 已经做好的保守方案咱们先留着备用。
examples.trans: Let us keep the finished conservative plan on standby.

examples.text: 这张首场录制的嘉宾工作证她一直留着做纪念。
examples.trans: She kept the pass from her first taping as a keepsake.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liú gěi. Verb + recipient marker 留 ('keep/leave behind') + 给 ('for/to').

examples.text: 小美把最后两块柠檬塔留给了修电线的老陈。
examples.trans: Mei saved the last two lemon tarts for Chen while he rewired the room.

examples.text: 靠窗最安静的那张桌子留给宋老师吧。
examples.trans: Let's keep the quietest table by the window for Teacher Song.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liú yán. Compound 留 ('leave') + 言 ('words'); used as a noun (一条语音留言 'a voice message') or separable verb.

examples.text: 前台电话里有一条市政厅留下的语音留言。
examples.trans: There is a voice message from City Hall on the front-desk phone.

examples.text: 客人退房的时候，在登记本上写了一段温暖的留言。
examples.trans: When checking out, the guest wrote a warm note in the guest book.

meanings.note: Literary verb lüèxiǎn ('seem slightly').

examples.text: 演技不错，就是有些时候略显浮夸。
examples.trans: Nice acting, though at times it seems slightly overdone.

examples.text: 第一次上台主持，他的神情略显紧张。
examples.trans: Hosting onstage for the first time, he looked slightly tense.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fān qié. Standard word for tomato across southern/southwest China (including Chengdu) and menus nationwide.

examples.text: 左边这勺是配了新鲜香草的热烤番茄汤。
examples.trans: This left spoonful is hot roasted tomato soup with fresh herbs.

examples.text: 夏天集市上的熟番茄又红又甜。
examples.trans: Ripe tomatoes at the summer market are bright red and sweet.

examples.text: 不好意思啊，我应该在出差之前多找时间陪陪你的，我疏忽了。
examples.trans: I'm sorry — I should have carved out more time to spend with you before my trip; that was careless of me.

examples.text: 你这个人呀是够疏忽的，就连个男朋友的人影都看不到。
examples.trans: You certainly are careless! After going public in grand style, I haven't even caught sight of my boyfriend.

疏远.gloss: distance oneself from, drift apart, shun

meanings.en: distance oneself from, drift apart, shun
meanings.note: Growing or acting distant toward someone.

examples.text: 不管发生什么误会，我都不应该故意疏远你。
examples.trans: Whatever misunderstanding arises, I should never purposely shun you.

examples.text: 好朋友之间要是长期不联系，感情容易变疏远。
examples.trans: Close friends can drift apart if they lose touch for too long.

meanings.en: to go mad; to lose one's mind; to go wild
meanings.note: fēng — very commonly used with 了 (疯了) in rhetorical questions like 你是不是疯了？ (Are you crazy?) or to describe frenzied excitement.

examples.text: 布小谷，你是不是疯了？
examples.trans: Bu Xiaogu, have you lost your mind?

examples.text: 辛惠美的粉丝疯了，都在网上刷屏了。
examples.trans: Xin Huimei's fans have gone wild and flooded every screen online.

related.gloss: to lose one's mind; to go berserk

examples.text: 你听那个疯婆子胡说！我之所以拿这件事情做文章，就是因为我算准了全世界没有人能找到钟阳子！
examples.trans: Don't listen to that crazy woman's nonsense! The whole reason I built my trap around this song is that nobody on earth can find Zhong Yangzi!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 我的头很疼。
examples.trans: My head hurts a lot.

examples.text: 腿疼。
examples.trans: Leg hurts.

meanings.note: Noun bìng ('illness, disease').

examples.text: 这种病我以前听说过。
examples.trans: I have heard of this illness before.

examples.text: 生了病要及时看医生。
examples.trans: See a doctor promptly when you fall ill.

meanings.note: Someone recovering from illness or medical care.

examples.text: 刚出院的病人不能熬夜加班。
examples.trans: A patient fresh out of the hospital must not work late.

examples.text: 护士耐心地照顾病房里的每一位病人。
examples.trans: The nurse patiently cared for every patient on the ward.

meanings.note: Medical term bìngwēi (as in 病危通知, 'critical-condition notice').

examples.text: 昨晚医院甚至下达了紧急病危通知。
examples.trans: Last night the hospital even issued a critical notice.

examples.text: 经过一夜抢救，病人终于脱离了病危状态。
examples.trans: After overnight care, the patient is out of danger.

病情.gloss: patient's condition, course of an illness

meanings.en: patient's condition, course of an illness
meanings.note: Medical noun bìngqíng ('medical condition').

examples.text: 关于他的胃病病情该如何医治，全听医生安排。
examples.trans: On how to treat his stomach condition, we follow the doctor.

examples.text: 经过一夜输液观察，病人的病情已经明显好转。
examples.trans: After overnight IV monitoring, the patient's condition improved.

meanings.note: Noun bìngfáng ('hospital room').

examples.text: 你来病房看望也没有用。
examples.trans: Coming to visit the hospital room will not help.

examples.text: 病房里需要保持安静。
examples.trans: Quiet must be kept inside the hospital ward.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǎng. Stative adjective describing an itch (鼻子有点痒 'my nose is a bit itchy').

examples.text: 周经理手里拿着绿刷子说：“等等……我的鼻子有点痒。”
examples.trans: Holding the green paintbrush in his hand, Manager Zhou said, 'Wait... my nose itches a bit.'

examples.text: 被蚊子叮了一下以后，手背上一直有点痒。
examples.trans: After a mosquito bite, the back of my hand kept itching slightly.

meanings.note: Physical mark or digital log trail.

examples.text: 他们帮忙打开了素材库，没有留下任何出入痕迹。
examples.trans: They opened the footage room without leaving any access trace.

examples.text: 雨水冲刷过后，地面上看不出一点儿泥泞的痕迹。
examples.trans: After the rain washed the ground, not a trace of mud remained.

痛下杀手.gloss: strike a ruthless blow, move to kill off mercilessly

meanings.en: strike a ruthless blow, move to kill off mercilessly
meanings.note: Dramatic idiom used figuratively for axing a rival project.

examples.text: 新主管打算绕过部门负责人，直接对那档原创节目痛下杀手。
examples.trans: The new head plans to go over the director to kill off that original show.

examples.text: 缩减预算时管理层对几个亏损项目痛下杀手。
examples.trans: While trimming budgets, management ruthlessly axed several losing projects.

meanings.note: Adjective tòngkuai ('glad, unburdened').

examples.text: 要是心里有什么不痛快的，下班一起来聊聊。
examples.trans: Whenever something weighs on your mind, come chat after work.

examples.text: 把话说开了，大家心里都痛快。
examples.trans: Speaking frankly leaves everyone feeling better.

examples.text: 平时最痛恨的就是你的官僚作风，今天你真是立大功了！
examples.trans: Normally I can't stand your bureaucratic paper slips, yet today your habit saved the company!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 这是瘦啊。
examples.trans: This is thin.

examples.text: 那个瘦好。
examples.trans: That thin is good.

meanings.note: Verb tānhuàn ('crash completely; be paralyzed').

examples.text: 好几个关联公司的网站全都瘫痪了。
examples.trans: Several related company websites crashed completely.

examples.text: 大雨让城里的交通一度瘫痪。
examples.trans: Heavy rain briefly paralyzed city traffic.

登入.gloss: log in, sign in to a system

meanings.en: log in, sign in to a system
meanings.note: Entering credentials to join a software or command system.

examples.text: 请全体导演在九点前准时登入直播指挥系统。
examples.trans: All directors please log into the live command system before nine.

examples.text: 输入工号和密码就可以登入内部办公平台。
examples.trans: Enter your staff ID and password to log into the internal platform.

examples.text: 这是登台啊。
examples.trans: This is go on stage.

examples.text: 那个登台好。
examples.trans: That go on stage is good.

examples.text: 十二歌王第三季，辛惠美战队的首秀即将登场！
examples.trans: In Season Three of Twelve Singers, Team Xin Huimei's debut performance is about to take the stage!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Tech verb dēnglù ('log in to an app or account').

examples.text: 请各位歌手立刻登录星天直播应用程序。
examples.trans: Singers, please log in to the Xingtian live app immediately.

examples.text: 工作人员使用内部账号登录后台查看实时在线人数。
examples.trans: Staff logged into the backend to check live concurrent viewers.

examples.text: 请先在前台的纸本子上登记您的姓名和房号。
examples.trans: Please register your name and room number in the paper ledger at the front desk first.

examples.text: 所有住店客人的行李都已经妥善登记并送上了楼。
examples.trans: All the guests' luggage has been properly logged and carried upstairs.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dēng jì běn. Compound 登记 ('register / check in') + 本 ('bound book'). Measure word: 本 (běn).

examples.text: 每一位住店的客人都要在前台登记本上签字。
examples.trans: Every guest staying at the inn signs the register book at the front desk.

examples.text: 阁楼木箱里保存着三十年前的绿色客人登记本。
examples.trans: A green guest register from thirty years ago is preserved in the attic wooden chest.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bái. Describes white paper, sugar, or tablecloths.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

examples.text: 看，把手上贴着一个白信封。
examples.trans: Look, there is a white envelope taped onto the handle.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bái tiān. Combines 白 ('bright/daylight') + 天 ('day/sky'); contrasts with 晚上 ('evening/night').

examples.text: 白天我画安静的房间，志鹏从市政厅下班就带爷爷的木工工具过来！
examples.trans: By day I draw quiet rooms, and after work at City Hall Peng brings Grandfather's woodworking tools over!

examples.text: 这间阳光房白天阳光充足，晚上点起灯笼又特别温馨。
examples.trans: This sunroom is flooded with sunlight during the day and extra cosy when lanterns are lit at night.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bái bǎn. Combines 白 ('white') + 板 ('board').

examples.text: 小晴在咖啡角的白板上清楚地写下了三天的计划。
examples.trans: Qing wrote out the three-day plan clearly on the café corner's whiteboard.

examples.text: 每做完一件事，周经理就在白板上画一个勾。
examples.trans: Each time a task is finished, Manager Zhou checks it off on the whiteboard.

meanings.note: Colloquial noun báishuǐ ('plain unflavoured water').

examples.text: 白水喝腻了，我想试试咖啡。
examples.trans: Tired of plain water, I want to try some coffee.

examples.text: 感冒的时候医生建议多喝温热的白水。
examples.trans: When you have a cold, doctors advise drinking plain warm water.

examples.text: 我自有我的方法，我们这些小员工也不是白痴啊！钟阳子对于这件事情的解决至关重要。
examples.trans: I have my own methods — us junior staffers aren't idiots! Zhong Yangzi is vital to resolving this whole crisis.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Reduplicated adverb báibái ('for nothing').

examples.text: 努力白白浪费了。
examples.trans: All the hard work went to waste for nothing.

examples.text: 别白白错过机会。
examples.trans: Do not miss the chance for nothing.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bái shā táng. Combines 白 ('white') + 砂 ('fine sand-like crystal grains') + 糖 ('sugar').

examples.text: 周经理说两个罐子里的东西看起来一模一样，都像白砂糖！
examples.trans: Manager Zhou said the contents of both jars looked identical—both looked just like white caster sugar!

examples.text: 烤杏仁挞底和熬柠檬酱都需要用到颗粒细小的白砂糖。
examples.trans: Both baking almond tart shells and cooking lemon curd call for fine-grained white caster sugar.

examples.text: 她轻轻解开白纸包，里面是一辆精巧的木头小火车。
examples.trans: She gently untied the white paper parcel; inside was a delicate little wooden train.

examples.text: 柜台上的白纸包里装着刚从药铺买来的薄荷糖。
examples.trans: The white paper parcel on the counter holds peppermint candies just bought from the apothecary.

白费.gloss: go to waste, be in vain

meanings.en: go to waste, be in vain
meanings.note: Verb báifèi ('expend in vain').

examples.text: 否则前期投入的广告可就全都白费了。
examples.trans: Otherwise all the upfront ad spending goes to waste.

examples.text: 只要观众看得开心，大家熬夜的心血就没白费。
examples.trans: As long as viewers enjoy it, our late nights were not in vain.

meanings.note: Colloquial phrase báipǎo-yítàng ('come all this way for nothing').

examples.text: 今天真是抱歉，让同学们白跑一趟了。
examples.trans: So sorry today for making everyone come all this way in vain.

examples.text: 去之前先打个电话，免得白跑一趟。
examples.trans: Call ahead before going so you do not make a wasted trip.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎi. Requires a digit before it in Mandarin (一百 'one hundred', never bare 百 for 100).

examples.text: 留下来跟大家在一起？愿意——一百个愿意！
examples.trans: Stay here together with all of you? Yes—a hundred times yes!

examples.text: 这棵老树已经有一百多年了。
examples.trans: This old tree is already more than a hundred years old.

meanings.note: Large round number common in follower and ratings counts.

examples.text: 短短一夜之间，他的个人账号粉丝数就突破了百万。
examples.trans: In a single night, his personal account topped a million followers.

examples.text: 这支公益短片上线当天播放量就超过了五百万。
examples.trans: On launch day alone, the charity clip topped five million views.

examples.text: 星天娱乐一直是备受投资界关注的明星企业，公司估值一度突破百亿。
examples.trans: Xingtian Entertainment has long been a star company watched closely by investors, with its valuation once topping ten billion.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Prefix phrase bǎifēnzhī ('parts per hundred, %').

examples.text: 粉丝已经捐了目标金额的百分之一百四。
examples.trans: Fans have donated 140 percent of the target sum.

examples.text: 我们有百分之百的信心做好直播。
examples.trans: We have 100 percent confidence in the live broadcast.

examples.text: 他把自己股份的百分之九十九全捐出来了，研究人类的潜能开发了。
examples.trans: He donated ninety-nine percent of his own shares to research unlocking human potential.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Standard spoken and written form for 50%.

examples.text: 公司决定扣除他这个季度百分之五十的奖金。
examples.trans: The company decided to dock fifty percent of his quarterly bonus.

examples.text: 新方案让我们节省了百分之五十的搭建时间。
examples.trans: The new plan saved us fifty percent of stage-setup time.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎi yè chuāng. Measure word (量词): 扇 (shàn), e.g. 一扇百叶窗 ('a louvered shutter').

examples.text: 因为湿木头百叶窗会柔化石板路传回来的回声……
examples.trans: Because wet wooden shutters soften the echo bouncing off the flagstones...

examples.text: 午后把木百叶窗放下一半，屋里既凉快又柔和。
examples.trans: Lowering the wooden shutters halfway at noon keeps the room cool and soft.

百忙之中.gloss: amidst a packed schedule, despite being swamped

meanings.en: amidst a packed schedule, despite being swamped
meanings.note: Polite or playful phrase highlighting how busy someone was.

examples.text: 感谢各位老师在百忙之中抽出时间参加答辩。
examples.trans: Thank you, professors, for taking time out of busy schedules for the defence.

examples.text: 他在百忙之中还记着给同事带礼物。
examples.trans: Even amid a hectic trip, he remembered gifts for his coworkers.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎi huā. Literally 'a hundred flowers'; standard name for multi-floral wildflower honey (百花蜂蜜).

examples.text: 春天采的百花蜂蜜颜色金黄，香气清甜。
examples.trans: Wildflower honey harvested in spring has a golden colour and a clean, sweet aroma.

examples.text: 四月暖和起来，院子里百花盛开。
examples.trans: Once April warms up, all kinds of flowers bloom across the courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎi lǐ xiāng. Literally 百里 ('a hundred li') + 香 ('fragrant'): aromatic culinary herb thyme (*Thymus vulgaris*).

examples.text: 志鹏去院子的花坛边摘了两小枝新鲜的百里香和欧芹。
examples.trans: Peng went to the courtyard flowerbed and picked two small sprigs of fresh thyme and parsley.

examples.text: 炖蔬菜高汤的时候放一枝百里香，整锅汤都会带着温和的草木清香。
examples.trans: Add a sprig of thyme when simmering vegetable stock and the whole pot takes on a gentle herbal aroma.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Links modifiers or owners to nouns (我的书 'my book', 安静的院子 'quiet courtyard').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: de shí hou. High-frequency temporal frame placed at the end of a verb or clause to mean 'when / while ...' (往下迈的时候 'when stepping down').

examples.text: 小美够最上面那层架子的时候，小晴赶紧上前扶住了木凳。
examples.trans: While Mei was reaching for the top shelf, Qing hurried over to steady the wooden stool.

examples.text: 我擦厨房台面的时候，罐子底下的纸标签不小心被水弄湿了。
examples.trans: When I was wiping the kitchen counter, the paper labels under the jars got damp.

examples.text: 明天下雨的话，我不去。
examples.trans: If it rains tomorrow, I am not going.

examples.text: 有时间的话，来我家玩。
examples.trans: If you have time, come to my house.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pí. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张皮 ('a piece of leather').

examples.text: 等等——柜台上这本棕色小皮笔记本是谁的？
examples.trans: Wait—whose small brown leather notebook is this on the counter?

examples.text: 啊，我的皮笔记本！谢谢！我正到处找呢。
examples.trans: Oh, my leather notebook! Thank you! I was looking everywhere for it.

related.gloss: a piece of leather (measure word 张)

meanings.note: Pinyin: pí xié. Measure word (量词): 双 (shuāng), e.g. 一双皮鞋 ('a pair of leather shoes').

examples.text: 怪不得这么重，全是木头和皮鞋！
examples.trans: No wonder it was so heavy—all wood and leather shoes!

examples.text: 下雨天出门，最好别穿新皮鞋。
examples.trans: Heading out in the rain, it is best not to wear new leather shoes.

related.gloss: a pair of leather shoes (measure word 双)

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhòu. Pairs with 眉头 in 皱眉头 ('furrow one's brow / frown').

examples.text: 他说什么？你怎么皱眉头了？
examples.trans: What is he saying? Why are you frowning?

examples.text: 当然记得！每到星期五弹错一个音，他就对着墙皱眉头。
examples.trans: Of course I remember! Every Friday when he missed a note, he frowned at the wall.

盏.gloss: measure word for lamps and lanterns

meanings.en: measure word for lamps and lanterns
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǎn. Counts lamps and lanterns (一盏台灯 'a desk lamp', 一盏灯笼 'a lantern').

examples.text: 楼下我的工具房里有一盏铜台灯。
examples.trans: Downstairs in my workshop there is a brass desk lamp.

examples.text: 门口挂着两盏红灯笼。
examples.trans: Two red lanterns hang by the entrance.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yán. Core culinary noun for table or sea salt; measure word: 勺 (sháo, spoonful) or 撮 (cuō, pinch).

examples.text: 用细绳绑好新鲜香草放进锅里，最后再加一小撮盐调味。
examples.trans: Tie the fresh herbs with string and put them in the pot, then add a small pinch of salt at the end.

examples.text: 小晴给右边的白瓷罐贴上了“盐”字标签，免得大家再跟白糖弄混。
examples.trans: Qing stuck a 'Salt' label on the white ceramic jar on the right so nobody would confuse it with sugar again.

meanings.note: Broadcast noun/verb jiānzhì ('supervising producer').

examples.text: 这次项目以淳于总为核心监制。
examples.trans: This project centres on Chun Yuqiao as lead producer.

examples.text: 他监制过好几部热门节目。
examples.trans: He has executive-produced several hit shows.

meanings.note: Noun/verb jiānkòng ('CCTV surveillance').

examples.text: 我有演播厅的监控录像。
examples.trans: I have the studio's security footage.

examples.text: 走廊里安装了二十四小时监控。
examples.trans: Twenty-four-hour security cameras are in the hall.

meanings.note: Verb/noun jiāndū ('monitor quality or compliance').

examples.text: 电视台派人过来是为了监督节目质量。
examples.trans: The network sent staff over to oversee show quality.

examples.text: 公开透明的流程欢迎所有人一起监督。
examples.trans: A transparent process welcomes oversight from everyone.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé. Single-character bound/free noun for small boxes (木盒 'wooden box', 盒子 'box'); also a measure word ('a box of').

examples.text: 雪松木盒里整齐地放着一叠旧明信片。
examples.trans: A stack of old postcards sits neatly inside the cedar box.

examples.text: 小晴买了一盒彩色粉笔写咖啡馆黑板。
examples.trans: Qing bought a box of coloured chalk to write on the café blackboard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个盒子 ('a small box').

examples.text: 搬家公司清空房子之前，我从阁楼架子救下了这个盒子。
examples.trans: Before the movers cleared the house, I saved this box from the attic shelf.

examples.text: 这个小木头盒子装的是老照片。
examples.trans: This little wooden box holds old photographs.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gài. Used for stamping an official seal (盖印章) or putting on a lid.

examples.text: 邮递员刚让我签收的，上面盖着红色房产印章。
examples.trans: The postman just had me sign for it; it carries a red property-office stamp.

examples.text: 文件下面已经盖好了红色印章。
examples.trans: The red official seal has already been stamped at the bottom of the document.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gài zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个木头盖子 ('a wooden lid').

examples.text: 开了！老陈，快打开木头盖子！
examples.trans: It's open! Chen, quick, lift the wooden lid!

examples.text: 盖子要小心一点——它已经关了几十年了。
examples.trans: Careful with the lid—it has been closed for decades.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gài zhāng. Separable verb-object compound 盖 ('press/stamp from above') + 章 ('official seal/chop'); also used attributively (盖章信封 'stamped envelope').

examples.text: 小晴，快读读隔壁书店老板递给你的市政厅盖章信封！
examples.trans: Qing, quickly read the stamped City Hall envelope that the next-door bookshop owner handed you!

examples.text: 办事员微笑着在审核表格最下面盖章，正式批准九号房开业。
examples.trans: Smiling, the clerk stamped the bottom of the review form, officially approving Room Nine to open.

盘.gloss: tray; plate; dish (measure word for trays of baked goods or dishes)

meanings.en: tray; plate; dish (measure word for trays of baked goods or dishes)
meanings.note: Pinyin: pán. Classifier for trays, pans, or plates of food (一盘柠檬挞 'a tray/plate of lemon tart', 四大盘 'four big trays').

examples.text: 四十个柠檬，正好烤四大盘六点钟的杏仁柠檬挞！
examples.trans: Forty lemons works out right to bake four big trays of almond lemon tart for six o'clock!

examples.text: 幸好小美多烤了两盘热乎乎的肉桂卷。
examples.trans: Luckily Mei baked two extra trays of piping-hot cinnamon rolls.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pán zi. Combines 盘 ('plate/tray') + nominal suffix 子 (zi); measure word: 个 (gè) or 只 (zhī).

examples.text: 干净盘子先放五分钟，你们俩快到门口来听！
examples.trans: Leave the clean plates for five minutes, both of you—come listen at the door!

examples.text: 小晴把烤好的柠檬挞切开，整整齐齐摆在白瓷盘子里。
examples.trans: Qing sliced the baked lemon tart and arranged it neatly on white porcelain plates.

meanings.note: Noun shèngdiǎn ('major celebration gala').

examples.text: 后台队伍全力保障盛典直播。
examples.trans: The backstage crew is securing the live gala broadcast.

examples.text: 年底的音乐盛典非常热闹。
examples.trans: The year-end music gala is grand and lively.

meanings.note: Noun shèngyàn ('sumptuous feast, artistic extravaganza').

examples.text: 总决赛本该是一场属于音乐与歌声的盛宴。
examples.trans: The grand finale was meant to be a feast of music and song.

examples.text: 跨年晚会为全国观众献上了一场视听盛宴。
examples.trans: The New Year's Eve gala offered viewers an audiovisual feast.

meanings.note: Formal noun shèngqíng ('generous warmth').

examples.text: 既然孙总盛情邀请了，咱们就去参加吧。
examples.trans: Since Mr Sun invited us so warmly, let us attend.

examples.text: 实在难却主人的盛情，大家都坐了下来。
examples.trans: Touched by the host's warmth, everyone stayed.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù qián. Measure word (量词): 段, e.g. 目前阶段 ('the current stage').

examples.text: 完全正确！目前你们四张桌子只接待住店客人。
examples.trans: Exactly right! Right now your four tables only serve overnight inn guests.

examples.text: 目前八间客房周末都已经订满了。
examples.trans: At present, all eight guest rooms are booked for the weekend.

meanings.note: Noun mùbiāo ('goal, target').

examples.text: 众筹很快就超过了目标金额。
examples.trans: Crowdfunding quickly passed the target amount.

examples.text: 她的目标是成为一名优秀的制作人。
examples.trans: Her goal is to become an outstanding producer.

meanings.note: Noun mùdì ('underlying aim').

examples.text: 我来这儿更主要的目的是谈下营销单。
examples.trans: My main objective in coming is landing the marketing deal.

examples.text: 开短会的目的是快速解决手头的问题。
examples.trans: The purpose of a short meeting is solving issues fast.

meanings.en: stare at; keep eyes fixed on
meanings.note: Pinyin: dīng. Usually pairs with 着 (盯着 'staring closely at').

examples.text: 不许盯着客人看。把箱子交还，干自己的活。
examples.trans: No staring at guests. Hand back the bag and do our own work.

examples.text: 他盯着墙上的地图看了很久。
examples.trans: He stared at the map on the wall for a long time.

meanings.note: Verb-complement dīngzhù ('watch closely without letting go').

examples.text: 今天晚上全程盯住这位嘉宾。
examples.trans: Keep a close eye on this guest all evening.

examples.text: 请大家盯住手头的工作细节。
examples.trans: Everyone keep a close watch on your work details.

盯紧.gloss: keep a close eye on, watch closely

meanings.en: keep a close eye on, watch closely
meanings.note: Verb-complement dīngjǐn ('watch closely').

examples.text: 那两个人没动静，一定要盯紧他们。
examples.trans: Those two have been quiet—keep a close eye on them.

examples.text: 直播倒计时最后十秒，请大家盯紧屏幕。
examples.trans: For the final ten-second countdown, watch the monitors closely.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhí. Describes straight lines or walking straight ahead (直走).

examples.text: 出门左拐，直走到桥。要过河吗？
examples.trans: Left out the gate, straight to the bridge. Do I cross the river?

examples.text: 电线本来就该拉直了。正常保养，别多想。
examples.trans: The wire needed straightening anyway. Routine maintenance—don't read into it.

直击.gloss: report live on the scene, witness first-hand

meanings.en: report live on the scene, witness first-hand
meanings.note: Media verb zhíjī ('cover live on the spot').

examples.text: 所有户外直播车转移镜头，直击暴雨拥堵现场。
examples.trans: Every broadcast van swung its cameras to cover the storm live.

examples.text: 特别报道将带您直击总决赛后台的紧张筹备。
examples.trans: Our special feature takes you live backstage before the finale.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhí dào. Combines 直 ('straight') + 到 ('reach/until').

examples.text: 志豪决定留在成都，直到星期五的开幕之夜。
examples.trans: Hao decided to stay in Chengdu right until Friday's opening night.

examples.text: 这场大雨从半夜一直下，直到第二天中午才停。
examples.trans: This heavy rain fell from midnight until noon the next day before stopping.

直奔主题.gloss: cut straight to the main topic

meanings.en: cut straight to the main topic
meanings.note: Idiom-like phrase zhíbèn-zhǔtí ('head straight to the subject').

examples.text: 那咱们就开门见山，直奔主题吧。
examples.trans: Let us cut out small talk and head straight to the main topic.

examples.text: 时间有限，今天的评审会我们直接直奔主题。
examples.trans: With time tight, let us go straight to the topic today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhí jiē. Describes doing something directly without detours.

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

examples.text: 您为什么不直接去志鹏家门口把木头小火车交给他呢？
examples.trans: Why not go straight to Zhipeng's door and hand him the wooden train?

examples.text: 看直播。
examples.trans: Watch live broadcast.

examples.text: 网络直播。
examples.trans: Network live broadcast.

meanings.note: Online video/streaming app or website.

examples.text: 传统电视人与新兴直播平台的互动擦出了奇妙火花。
examples.trans: Veteran TV hosts sparked fresh magic interacting on streaming platforms.

examples.text: 决赛后台花絮在各大直播平台同步播出。
examples.trans: Backstage finale highlights streamed simultaneously across platforms.

meanings.note: Broadcast noun zhíbōchē ('mobile television broadcast truck').

examples.text: 通知停在场馆外的直播车立刻打开转播设备。
examples.trans: Order the broadcast vans parked outside to power up their gear.

examples.text: 高清卫星直播车已经提前一天开进体育场待命。
examples.trans: The HD satellite broadcast truck pulled into the stadium a day early.

meanings.note: Virtual or physical room for live online broadcasts.

examples.text: 昨晚有上百万观众涌进了直播间。
examples.trans: Last night over a million viewers poured into the livestream.

examples.text: 主持人在直播间里跟粉丝热情互动。
examples.trans: The host interacted warmly with fans in the livestream room.

meanings.note: Colloquial slang noun zhínán ('blunt, utilitarian guy').

examples.text: 黑白灰装修，这直男的房间也太冷清了吧。
examples.trans: All grey and bare—this guy's bachelor flat is ultra-spartan!

examples.text: 他不懂甜言蜜语，连送礼物都是标准的直男风格。
examples.trans: Hopeless at sweet talk, even his gifts are peak literal-guy style.

examples.text: 我直话直说，你们星天的经纪部太弱了，我希望你能够亲自出马。
examples.trans: Speaking frankly, Xingtian's talent management unit is far too weak — I hope you will step in personally.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Verb zhíshuō ('say plainly without beating around the bush').

examples.text: 我直说吧，我们担心你和她有前嫌。
examples.trans: Let me speak frankly: we worry there is bad blood between you.

examples.text: 有什么意见尽管直说。
examples.trans: Feel free to speak frankly if you have suggestions.

examples.text: 我们俩就不要相互吹捧了。
examples.trans: The two of us don't need to flatter each other.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

相亲.gloss: go on a blind date (arranged by friends/family)

meanings.en: go on a blind date (arranged by friends/family)
meanings.note: Meeting a prospective romantic partner through matchmaking.

examples.text: 家里长辈周末给她安排了一场相亲。
examples.trans: Relatives set up a blind date for her over the weekend.

examples.text: 听说她最近正忙着相亲，同事们都很吃惊。
examples.trans: Hearing she was busy going on blind dates surprised her coworkers.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiāng xìn. Used for trusting people or believing news.

examples.text: 真不敢相信您也住在这家客栈，宋老师。
examples.trans: I can hardly believe you are staying at this very same inn, Teacher Song.

examples.text: 我相信你们一定能把咖啡馆办好。
examples.trans: I believe you will definitely run a wonderful café.

meanings.note: Attributive/verb xiāngguān ('related').

examples.text: 整个过程当中一切的相关细节都向你开放。
examples.trans: Every relevant detail across the process is open to you.

examples.text: 法务部已经整理好了与海外拍摄相关的全部文件。
examples.trans: Legal compiled all documents related to shooting overseas.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiāng tóng. Combines 相 ('mutually') + 同 ('same'); slightly more formal/precise than 一样, often modifying nouns with 的.

examples.text: 宋老师用完全相同的调性补写了最后十六个小节。
examples.trans: Teacher Song wrote the final sixteen bars in the exact same musical key.

examples.text: 这两把黄铜钥匙的形状几乎完全相同。
examples.trans: These two brass keys are almost identical in shape.

meanings.note: Verb xiāngchǔ ('interact and get along').

examples.text: 你跟她平时相处的关系不好吗？
examples.trans: Do you not get along well with her day to day?

examples.text: 总编室的同事们虽然严厉，但很好相处。
examples.trans: Though strict, colleagues in the editorial office are easy to get along with.

meanings.note: Explains what a situation practically means.

examples.text: 所有合作方反对，就相当于寸步难行。
examples.trans: Every partner objecting amounts to being unable to move an inch.

examples.text: 走这段山路相当于爬了二十层楼。
examples.trans: Walking this mountain trail equals climbing twenty flights.

meanings.note: Verb xiāngbǐ ('in comparison with').

examples.text: 其他部门和一部相比简直是天壤之别。
examples.trans: Compared with Unit One, the other units are worlds apart.

examples.text: 与上一季相比，今年的舞台灯光更漂亮。
examples.trans: Compared with last season, this year's stage lights shine.

盼.gloss: long for, look forward to, hope eagerly

meanings.en: long for, look forward to, hope eagerly
meanings.note: Waiting hopefully for a good outcome.

examples.text: 大家一直盼着这档新节目早日开播。
examples.trans: Everyone has been looking forward to the show's premiere.

examples.text: 父母最盼着孩子平平安安。
examples.trans: Parents hope above all that their children stay safe and sound.

盼着.gloss: long for, look forward eagerly to

meanings.en: long for, look forward eagerly to
meanings.note: Verb+aspect pànzhe ('eagerly await').

examples.text: 从考进学院那天起，我就一直盼着这一天了。
examples.trans: Ever since entering Media College, I have longed for this day.

examples.text: 全国观众都盼着新一季音乐节目早点开播。
examples.trans: Viewers nationwide are eagerly awaiting the new season.

meanings.note: Verb shěng ('save or spare').

examples.text: 这也算省了我公关部的麻烦了。
examples.trans: I suppose that spared my PR department some trouble.

examples.text: 提前定好机位能省下不少现场彩排时间。
examples.trans: Setting camera positions early saves plenty of rehearsal time.

省得.gloss: so as to save trouble; lest; so nobody ends up...

meanings.en: so as to save trouble; lest; so nobody ends up...
meanings.note: Pinyin: shěng de. Colloquial spoken connector introducing an unwanted outcome being prevented (synonymous with 免得).

examples.text: 我把石板放回原位，省得大家被一号桌绊倒。
examples.trans: I will set the flagstone back in place so nobody trips over table one.

examples.text: 顺便带上雨伞吧，省得下午突然下雨淋湿了。
examples.trans: Take an umbrella along while you are at it, so you do not get caught in an afternoon shower.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shěng xīn. Praises reliable designs or helpful people.

examples.text: 两个都买下！留一个备用明年冬天也省心。
examples.trans: Buy both! Keeping a spare saves worry next winter too.

examples.text: 把修理工具分类放好，找起来最省心。
examples.trans: Sorting repair tools neatly makes finding them trouble-free.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shěng qián. Separable verb-object compound 省 ('save/economize') + 钱 ('money').

examples.text: 早市的水果又新鲜又便宜，比去大超市省钱。
examples.trans: Fruit at the morning market is fresh and affordable, saving money compared with big supermarkets.

examples.text: 买一打茶杯有折扣，帮客栈省了不少钱。
examples.trans: Buying a dozen teacups came with a discount, saving the inn quite a bit of money.

meanings.note: Pinyin: méi tóu. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 紧锁眉头 ('furrowed brows').

examples.text: 他说什么？你怎么皱眉头了？
examples.trans: What is he saying? Why are you frowning?

examples.text: 当然记得！每到星期五弹错一个音，他就对着墙皱眉头。
examples.trans: Of course I remember! Every Friday when he missed a note, he frowned at the wall.

meanings.note: Pinyin: méi mao. Measure word (量词): 道 (dào) or 条 (tiáo), e.g. 两道眉毛 ('two eyebrows'). Neutral tone on 毛.

examples.text: 周经理，您的老花镜就在眉毛上面架着呢！
examples.trans: Manager Zhou, your reading glasses are perched right above your eyebrows!

examples.text: 老陈听到这么酸的柠檬汁，两条眉毛都皱起来了。
examples.trans: Hearing about lemon juice that sour made both of Chen's eyebrows scrunch right up.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn. Covers looking at something, reading silently, or visiting someone; add 见/到 for 'catch sight of'.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

meanings.note: Reduplicated verb kànyikàn ('have a look').

examples.text: 随时欢迎你们来看一看。
examples.trans: You are welcome anytime to come take a look.

examples.text: 先看一看今天的节目流程吧。
examples.trans: Take a look at today's show rundown first.

看上.gloss: take a liking to, fall for, set one's heart on

meanings.en: take a liking to, fall for, set one's heart on
meanings.note: Choosing something or romantically liking someone.

examples.text: 她一眼就看上了橱窗里的那件外套。
examples.trans: At first glance she took a liking to that coat in the window.

examples.text: 你是不是看上人家姑娘了？
examples.trans: Have you fallen for that young woman?

看不出来.gloss: unable to tell, fail to notice

meanings.en: unable to tell, fail to notice
meanings.note: Potential complement meaning something cannot be spotted.

examples.text: 他们俩这么明显，难道还有谁看不出来吗？
examples.trans: When the two of them are this obvious, who could fail to notice?

examples.text: 一点儿也看不出来他昨晚熬了整个通宵。
examples.trans: You cannot tell at all that he pulled an all-nighter.

看不着.gloss: unable to see, fail to catch sight of

meanings.en: unable to see, fail to catch sight of
meanings.note: Colloquial potential complement (着 pronounced zháo).

examples.text: 要是哪天在办公室看不着他，心里就觉得空落落的。
examples.trans: If a day passes without seeing him at work, her heart feels empty.

examples.text: 坐在最后一排，连舞台上的字幕都看不着。
examples.trans: Sitting in the back row, I cannot even see the stage captions.

看不见.gloss: unable to see; fail to notice

meanings.en: unable to see; fail to notice
meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn bú jiàn. Negative potential complement 看 ('look') + 不见 ('not perceive'); bù shifts to bú before 4th-tone jiàn.

examples.text: 每天走过那几扇旧灰窗板，久了竟然都看不见它们了。
examples.trans: Walking past those old grey shutters every day, after a while I stopped even seeing them.

examples.text: 玻璃上全是灰尘的时候，外面什么都看不见。
examples.trans: When the glass was covered in dust, nothing outside could be seen.

examples.text: 对啊，他们之前一直排挤您，我早就看不顺眼了，觉得特别不公平。
examples.trans: Yes! Seeing them push you out back then never sat right with me — it felt completely unfair.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

看中.gloss: set one's sights on, value and choose

meanings.en: set one's sights on, value and choose
meanings.note: Verb-complement kànzhòng ('spot value in, favour').

examples.text: 平台这次合作是看中整个团队，而非某个人。
examples.trans: For this partnership the network values the whole team, not one star.

examples.text: 总导演一眼就看中了她扎实的策划功底。
examples.trans: At first glance the chief director valued her solid planning skills.

meanings.note: Verb-complement kànzhǔn ('judge the right moment or target').

examples.text: 请你在会上看准机会，帮某人一个忙。
examples.trans: Spot the right moment in the meeting and help someone out.

examples.text: 优秀的制作人总能看准观众真正想看的内容。
examples.trans: Great producers spot what audiences truly want to watch.

看出.gloss: to discern; to make out; to tell

meanings.en: to see; to discern; to figure out from observation
meanings.note: kànchū — verb-resultative compound (看 + 出); in spoken Mandarin often expanded to 看出来 (kàn chūlái) withpotential forms 看得出 / 看不出.

examples.text: 从喜欢的明星，就能看出一个人的性格。
examples.trans: From the celebrity someone likes, you can tell a person's personality.

examples.text: 你从这份策划案里看出什么问题了吗？
examples.trans: Have you spotted any issues in this proposal?

related.gloss: to see through (a scheme or person)

meanings.note: Meaning: saw.

examples.text: 吉秀看到了，一定是我泄露了消息。
examples.trans: Ji Xiu saw it — it must have been me who leaked the news.

examples.text: 这是看到。
examples.trans: This is 看到.

meanings.note: Potential complement indicating something is obvious.

examples.text: 她喜欢你的那点心思，连傻子都看得出来。
examples.trans: Even a fool can tell how much she likes you.

examples.text: 从细节就能看得出来，这份方案花了不少心血。
examples.trans: You can tell from the details how much care went into this plan.

meanings.note: Verb-complement kàndǒng ('make sense of what one sees').

examples.text: 一个人往往要花很多时间才能真正看懂。
examples.trans: It often takes a long time to truly understand someone.

examples.text: 好的电视节目要让普通观众一眼就能看懂。
examples.trans: A good TV show makes sense to viewers right away.

examples.text: 看来他不会来了。
examples.trans: It seems he is not coming.

examples.text: 看来要下雨了。
examples.trans: It seems it will rain.

meanings.note: Noun kànfǎ ('way of looking at something').

examples.text: 有些事情，男人和女人的看法不一样。
examples.trans: On some matters, men and women see things differently.

examples.text: 欢迎大家在会上畅所欲言，发表看法。
examples.trans: Everyone is welcome to share views openly in the meeting.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn qīng. Resultative verb compound 看 ('look/read') + 清 ('clear').

examples.text: 就算不戴老花镜，周经理站在两米外都能看清木牌上的大数字！
examples.trans: Even without wearing his reading glasses, Manager Zhou can read the big numbers on the wooden sign clearly from two metres away!

examples.text: 把走廊的灯打开吧，这样大家才能看清台阶。
examples.trans: Turn on the hallway light so everyone can see the steps clearly.

meanings.en: take a look; have a quick look
meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn kan. Friendly reduplicated form of 看.

examples.text: 快拿到楼下灯光下面看看吧！
examples.trans: Let's bring it downstairs under the light and take a look!

examples.text: 哎呀，怎么拿错了！我戴眼镜看看行李牌。
examples.trans: Dear me, what a mix-up! Let me put on my glasses and check the luggage tag.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kān guǎn. Note first tone kān when meaning 'watch over / guard'.

examples.text: 给你们添麻烦了，老陈。谢谢这一周帮我看管箱子。
examples.trans: Sorry for causing you trouble, Chen. Thank you for guarding the bag all week.

examples.text: 我们替他看管了一周蓝箱子，他一定愿意帮忙！
examples.trans: After we guarded his blue suitcase all week, he will gladly help!

meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn huā. Pairs with 眼 in 看花眼 ('eyes playing tricks').

examples.text: 小晴，替我念第一行。快说是我眼镜又看花眼了！
examples.trans: Qing, read the top line for me. Tell me my glasses are playing tricks on my eyes!

examples.text: 小字看久了，眼睛容易看花。
examples.trans: Read tiny print too long and your eyes start blurring.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn jiàn. Result compound: 看 ('look') + 见 ('perceive') = 'actually see'.

examples.text: 正往前走……啊，看见金钥匙招牌和蓝木门了！
examples.trans: Walking forward now... oh, I see the golden key sign and the blue wooden door!

examples.text: 因为星期一晚上我走过来时，看见我哥哥正走在这条街上！
examples.trans: Because when I walked here Monday night, I saw my older brother walking down this street!

meanings.note: Evaluative verb phrase judging by outward appearance.

examples.text: 他和老朋友一边喝茶一边聊天，神情看起来非常轻松。
examples.trans: Chatting over tea with an old friend, he looked thoroughly relaxed.

examples.text: 这份策划案表面上看起来简单，执行起来却很有难度。
examples.trans: This proposal looks simple on paper yet takes real skill to execute.

meanings.note: Treating someone's ability or worth lightly.

examples.text: 就算别人看轻你，你也一定要相信自己。
examples.trans: Even if others underestimate you, believe in yourself.

examples.text: 千万不要看轻任何一个年轻人的潜力。
examples.trans: Never underestimate the potential of any young person.

examples.text: 我在飞机上已经看过了，基本能过。
examples.trans: I already read it on the plane; overall it passes.

examples.text: 我在飞机上已经看过了，基本能过。
examples.trans: I already read it on the plane; overall it passes.

examples.text: 谢谢您这么看重我，可是兴许明天那帮人就把我开除了。
examples.trans: Thank you for thinking so highly of me, though that crowd might fire me first thing tomorrow.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 我最近也发现，以前是我看错他了。
examples.trans: Lately I've realized it myself — I completely misjudged him before.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhēn. Exclamatory adverb before adjectives (真好！ 'How nice!') or adjective 'genuine'.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

examples.text: 真奇怪！我们坐同一班早火车到同一个区。
examples.trans: How strange! We rode the very same morning train to the same district.

meanings.note: TV genre noun zhēnrénxiù ('reality television').

examples.text: 这是我入行以来第一次做大型真人秀！
examples.trans: This is my very first time producing a major reality show!

examples.text: 户外真人秀最考验团队的现场应变能力。
examples.trans: Outdoor reality TV tests a crew's on-the-spot adaptability.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhēn míng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个真名 ('a real name').

examples.text: 等等——星期三晚上你又用真名住进来了？
examples.trans: Wait—and Wednesday night you checked in here under your real name?

examples.text: 那是他的小名，很少有人知道他的真名。
examples.trans: That is his childhood nickname; few people know his formal name.

meanings.note: Adjective zhēnshí ('true, authentic').

examples.text: 他一次次带我看到他更真实的面孔。
examples.trans: Again and again he showed me his truer face.

examples.text: 观众最喜欢看嘉宾真实自然的一面。
examples.trans: Viewers love seeing guests at their most genuine.

meanings.note: Abstract noun zhēnshíxìng ('factual accuracy').

examples.text: 写娱乐新闻也要注重事情的真实性。
examples.trans: Even entertainment news must care about factual truth.

examples.text: 编辑发稿前必须核实消息来源的真实性。
examples.trans: Editors verify the truth of sources before publishing.

meanings.note: Adjective/noun zhēnxīn ('wholehearted sincerity').

examples.text: 其实林姐她们对你是一片真心。
examples.trans: Truthfully, Lin Jie and her team feel genuine goodwill toward you.

examples.text: 观众总是能感受到创作者的真心。
examples.trans: Viewers can always feel a creator's genuine heart.

真心话.gloss: honest truth, words spoken from the heart

meanings.en: honest truth, words spoken from the heart
meanings.note: Candid personal feelings.

examples.text: 咱们认识这么多年，今天我跟你说几句真心话。
examples.trans: After all these years as friends, let me tell you the honest truth.

examples.text: 酒桌上的玩笑别当真，清醒时说的才是真心话。
examples.trans: Ignore table banter—what is said sober is the honest truth.

meanings.note: Emphatic adverb zhēnshi ('really is').

examples.text: 您真是厉害，写出这么好的稿子。
examples.trans: You are truly impressive to write such sharp pieces.

examples.text: 今天真是辛苦大家了。
examples.trans: Everyone truly worked hard today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhēn zhèng. Attributive adjective ('genuine').

examples.text: 哈哈！跟我到院子里来一分钟，给你们看我真正做什么！
examples.trans: Haha! Come out to the courtyard for a minute—let me show you what I really do!

examples.text: 遇到急事的时候，才看得出真正的朋友。
examples.trans: In an emergency, you see who your true friends are.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhēn de. Used standalone ('Really?!' 真的吗？！) or before verbs as an emphatic adverb.

examples.text: 真的吗？！你真的把火车票改到星期六早上了？
examples.trans: Really?! Did you really move your train ticket to Saturday morning?

examples.text: 加了杏仁粉的柠檬挞真的特别香！
examples.trans: The lemon tart made with almond flour is truly fragrant!

meanings.note: Noun zhēnxiàng ('the actual truth').

examples.text: 如果这不是真相，你为什么不澄清呢？
examples.trans: If this is not the truth, why not clarify it?

examples.text: 事情的真相终于查清楚了。
examples.trans: The truth of the matter has finally come to light.

meanings.note: Colloquial predicate zhēnxíng ('really capable' or ironic 'listen to you!').

examples.text: 都四十好几了还叫小名，你可真行啊！
examples.trans: Giving nicknames past forty — listen to you!

examples.text: 三天就写完改版方案，这个新人真行！
examples.trans: Finishing the revamp plan in three days — she is sharp!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhēn chéng. Praises heartfelt honesty.

examples.text: 这三年我很想你。真诚又清楚。第三句呢？
examples.trans: I missed you very much these three years. Honest and clear. And the third line?

examples.text: 她真诚的笑容让每位客人都觉得亲切。
examples.trans: Her genuine smile makes every guest feel welcome.

examples.text: 请说真话。
examples.trans: Please tell the truth.

examples.text: 他从来不说真话。
examples.trans: He never tells the truth.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mī. Action verb for narrowing the eyes into a slit to read small print or smile warmly (眯着眼睛看 'squint to read').

examples.text: 小晴把价钱写得很大很清楚，谁都不用眯着眼睛费力去看。
examples.trans: Qing wrote the prices big and clear so nobody has to squint to read them.

examples.text: 院子里的老猫晒着太阳，舒服得眯起了眼睛。
examples.trans: Basking in the sun in the courtyard, the old cat narrowed its eyes contentedly.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǎn. Counts quick looks after verbs of looking (看一眼, 扫一眼 'take a quick look').

examples.text: 太好了……趁着等他们，我扫一眼这封房东来信。
examples.trans: Wonderful... while we wait, let me glance at this letter from the landlord.

examples.text: 小晴，替我念第一行。快说是我眼镜又看花眼了！
