examples.trans: Qing, read the top line for me. Tell me my glasses are playing tricks on my eyes!

眼前.gloss: before one's eyes; right in front of one

meanings.en: before one's eyes; right in front of one
meanings.note: Pinyin: yǎn qián. Place noun 眼 ('eye') + 前 ('in front of'): one's immediate field of view.

examples.text: 左边的镜片刷上了绿油漆，周经理惊呼眼前全像一片绿森林！
examples.trans: With green paint brushed across his left lens, Manager Zhou exclaimed that everything before his eyes looked like a green forest!

examples.text: 推开阳光房的大门，眼前是一片洒满阳光的整洁木桌。
examples.trans: Pushing open the doors of the sunroom, a neat array of sunlit wooden tables opens up before your eyes.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǎn lèi. Combines 眼 ('eye') + 泪 ('tears'); common verb collocations: 掉眼泪 ('shed tears'), 流眼泪 ('cry'), 擦眼泪 ('wipe tears').

examples.text: 小美笑着打趣道：“好啦，两兄弟，先别掉眼泪——我的面包计时器响了！”
examples.trans: Mei teased warmly, 'All right, brothers, no shedding tears yet—my bread timer just went off!'

examples.text: 切洋葱的时候如果怕熏出眼泪，可以先把洋葱放在冷水里泡一下。
examples.trans: If you want to avoid shedding tears when chopping onions, soak the peeled onion briefly in cold water first.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǎn shú. Literally 'eye-familiar'.

examples.text: 真好奇！那张行李牌上的字看着很眼熟。
examples.trans: How curious! The handwriting on that tag looked very familiar.

examples.text: 这位先生看着很眼熟，好像在哪儿见过。
examples.trans: This gentleman looks familiar, as if we met somewhere before.

meanings.note: Noun yǎnqiú ('viewer attention').

examples.text: 写八卦也是无奈之举，博个眼球嘛。
examples.trans: Writing gossip was just to grab eyeballs.

examples.text: 光靠夸张标题吸引眼球是留不住观众的。
examples.trans: Flashy headlines grab eyeballs but never keep viewers.

meanings.note: Noun yǎnjiè ('breadth of outlook').

examples.text: 很多事要打开眼界才能够看得明白。
examples.trans: Many things require broader horizons to see clearly.

examples.text: 参与大型晚会大大拓宽了新人的眼界。
examples.trans: Working on major galas broadens newcomers' horizons.

眼眶.gloss: eye socket; rim of the eye

meanings.en: eye socket; rim of the eye
meanings.note: Pinyin: yǎn kuàng. Combines 眼 ('eye') + 眶 ('frame/socket of the eye'), frequently used in descriptions of emotion (眼眶湿润 'eyes brimming with tears').

examples.text: 听见窗里传出的十六个小节，老先生眼眶里全是泪水。
examples.trans: Hearing the sixteen bars drifting through the window, the older gentleman's eyes filled with tears.

examples.text: 周经理看着那枚蓝色的保护印章，眼眶也一下子红了。
examples.trans: Looking at that round blue heritage stamp, Manager Zhou's eyes grew misty too.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǎn jing. Measure word (量词): 双 (shuāng), e.g. 一双眼睛 ('a pair of eyes').

examples.text: 天哪……看这双眼睛！第三级台阶上的小志豪？！
examples.trans: Good heavens... look at those eyes! Little Zhihao from the third step?!

examples.text: 咬一口……志豪，闭上眼睛！跟爷爷的蛋糕味道一模一样！
examples.trans: One bite... Zhihao, close your eyes! That tastes exactly like Grandfather's cake!

related.gloss: a pair of eyes (measure word 双)

meanings.note: Literally 'eye-thread' (yǎnxiàn): someone planted to spy and report back.

examples.text: 你的眼线没用。
examples.trans: Your informant was useless.

examples.text: 眼线都被拔掉了。
examples.trans: Every informant was pulled out.

meanings.note: compound location noun used in 在……眼里 ('in someone's view')

examples.text: 在他眼里，我们都是工具。
examples.trans: In his eyes, we are all tools.

examples.text: 在观众眼里，舞台效果最重要。
examples.trans: In the audience's eyes, stage impact matters most.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǎn jìng. Measure word (量词): 副 (fù), e.g. 一副眼镜 ('a pair of glasses').

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 我的眼镜怎么会在……哎呀！在我头上！
examples.trans: Why would my glasses be in... oh dear! They are on my head!

related.gloss: a pair of glasses (measure word 副)

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhe. Placed right after a verb to show a state or posture continues (门开着 'the door stands open').

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.note: Verb-object zháoliáng ('catch a cold from chill air').

examples.text: 外面风大雨急，披上外套千万别着凉了。
examples.trans: It is windy and pouring outside—put on a coat and do not catch cold.

examples.text: 淋雨拍完外景后，场务赶紧煮了姜茶防大家着凉。
examples.trans: After filming in the rain, crew brewed ginger tea against chills.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zháo jí. Note second tone zháo here (别着急 'no rush / don't worry').

examples.text: 您先坐下，别着急，我们马上看行李牌。
examples.trans: Please sit down first and do not worry; we will check the luggage tag right away.

examples.text: 离发车还有一个小时，您不用着急。
examples.trans: There is still an hour until departure, so no need to rush.

着迷.gloss: be fascinated, fall under someone's spell

meanings.en: be fascinated, fall under someone's spell
meanings.note: Verb-object zháomí ('be captivated/infatuated').

examples.text: 她就是那种能让男人为她着迷的女人。
examples.trans: She is the kind of woman who captivates everyone around her.

examples.text: 小谷从小就对舞台灯光和导播口令深深着迷。
examples.trans: Since childhood Xiaogu has been captivated by stage lights.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuì. Everyday verb for sleeping (睡得好 'sleep well').

examples.text: 今晚我应该能睡个好觉了。
examples.trans: Tonight I should be able to sleep well after all.

examples.text: 祝您睡个好觉。早餐七点半在楼下。
examples.trans: Sleep well, sir. Breakfast is at seven thirty downstairs.

examples.text: 淳于总是睡着了吗？
examples.trans: Has Director Chun Yu fallen asleep?

examples.text: 淳于总是睡着了吗？
examples.trans: Has Director Chun Yu fallen asleep?

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuì jiào. Separable verb-object compound 睡 ('sleep') + 觉 (jiào, 'a sleep/nap', NOT jué 'feel').

examples.text: 小晴，去睡觉以前先把那两个白罐子贴上标签吧。
examples.trans: Qing, before going to bed, stick labels on those two white jars first.

examples.text: 危机解除了，大家快回房间睡觉——明天早上六点还要进厨房呢！
examples.trans: Crisis averted—everyone head to bed quickly, because the six-o'clock kitchen shift comes early tomorrow!

meanings.note: Resultative verb compound.

examples.text: 通宵盯完后期成片，他直到第二天中午才刚刚睡醒。
examples.trans: After supervising post all night, he barely woke up at noon the next day.

examples.text: 小猫在温暖的沙发垫上睡醒后懒洋洋地伸了个懒腰。
examples.trans: Waking up on the warm sofa cushion, the kitten stretched lazily.

督促.gloss: supervise and urge, make sure someone follows through

meanings.en: supervise and urge, make sure someone follows through
meanings.note: Keeping after someone constructively.

examples.text: 朋友每天督促我早睡早起。
examples.trans: My friend urges me every day to sleep and rise early.

examples.text: 请帮我督促他按时把药吃了。
examples.trans: Please help me make sure he takes his medicine on time.

examples.text: 杏子姐，你别给我瞎添乱了，你逗我呢，怎么可能！
examples.trans: Xingzi, please don't add to the mess — you must be teasing me, how could that be!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 怎么可能，你能别瞎扯吗？
examples.trans: How could that be true — can you stop making up nonsense?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Colloquial verb xiāshuō ('talk rubbish/jinx things').

examples.text: 医院里探病呢，写回忆录这种事能瞎说吗？
examples.trans: We are visiting a patient—is memoirs something to joke wildly about?

examples.text: 没有核实过的传闻千万别在镜头前瞎说。
examples.trans: Never repeat unverified rumours carelessly in front of a camera.

meanings.en: hide the truth from; keep in the dark
meanings.note: Pinyin: mán. Used when keeping a secret from someone.

examples.text: 别瞒了，小晴，我们很专业！先生，我们敬重成都旅游指南！
examples.trans: No hiding it, Qing, let's be professional! Sir, we respect the Chengdu Travel Guide!

examples.text: 我们都是好朋友，别瞒着我。
examples.trans: We are good friends—do not keep me in the dark.

meanings.note: Potential complement mánbuguò ('unable to slip past').

examples.text: 老大就是老大，什么都还是瞒不过你。
examples.trans: You really are the boss; nothing gets past you.

examples.text: 你的小心思根本瞒不过杏子姐。
examples.trans: Your little plan could never fool Xingzi.

meanings.note: Verb-complement mánzhù ('keep hidden from someone').

examples.text: 还得瞒住许天泽，拿出老大同意的方案。
examples.trans: And keeping Xu Tianze unaware, win our boss's sign-off.

examples.text: 为了给她惊喜，大家一直瞒住了消息。
examples.trans: To surprise her, everyone kept the secret under wraps.

瞒着.gloss: hide the truth from, keep in the dark

meanings.en: hide the truth from, keep in the dark
meanings.note: Verb+aspect mánzhe ('conceal from').

examples.text: 他恐水这个事，经纪公司不应该瞒着我们。
examples.trans: Your agency never should have hidden his water phobia from us.

examples.text: 怕父母担心，她生病住院的事一直瞒着家里。
examples.trans: Lest her parents worry, she hid her hospital stay from home.

examples.text: 你瞧，窗台上的茉莉花今天早上全开了！
examples.trans: Look—the jasmine flowers on the windowsill all bloomed this morning!

examples.text: 快去瞧瞧，是谁把这包点心留在门廊的长椅上了？
examples.trans: Go take a quick look—who left this parcel of pastries on the porch bench?

瞧瞧.gloss: take a look; look at that

meanings.en: take a look; look at that
meanings.note: Pinyin: qiáo qiao. Reduplication of colloquial northern/standard verb 瞧 ('look/see'); second syllable is neutral tone.

examples.text: 瞧瞧——这台老核桃木琴箱的琴声把整间玻璃房都装满了！
examples.trans: Just look at that—the sound from this old walnut piano fills the entire glass room!

examples.text: 快过来瞧瞧老陈刚挂好的四扇绿窗板，多精神呀！
examples.trans: Come take a look at the four green shutters Chen just hung—how sharp they look!

examples.text: 这个圈子没有所谓的江湖规矩，你也不用瞻前顾后。
examples.trans: There are no unwritten underworld rules in this industry, so stop worrying over every step.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: A-not-A verb zhībuzhīdào ('do you realise?').

examples.text: 你知不知道你在总编室的职责之一是挡酒？
examples.trans: Do you not know blocking drinks is part of your job here?

examples.text: 你知不知道这篇策划今晚八点就要交？
examples.trans: Do you realise this proposal is due at eight tonight?

examples.text: 您跟他也是知己？我听说您在这边是为了研究音乐。
examples.trans: Are you a kindred spirit of his as well? I heard you settled here to study music.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

知情.gloss: be informed, know the facts of a situation

meanings.en: be informed, know the facts of a situation
meanings.note: Being in the loop on developments.

examples.text: 轮流值班是为了确保任何时候都有人知情。
examples.trans: Rotating shifts ensures someone is informed at every hour.

examples.text: 这件事一直保密，只有少数几位高管知情。
examples.trans: This matter stayed confidential, with only a few executives informed.

examples.text: 我现在是你的女朋友，我有这个知情权！我也不是傻子！
examples.trans: I am your girlfriend now, and I have a right to know! I am nobody's fool!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Learned facts and professional understanding.

examples.text: 她在大学里学到了丰富的传媒知识。
examples.trans: She learned rich media knowledge in college.

examples.text: 工作中还要不断补充新的专业知识。
examples.trans: On the job, keep adding fresh professional knowledge.

知道.gloss: know (a fact or piece of information)

meanings.en: know (a fact or piece of information)
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhī dào. Contrast 认识 ('know a person or place').

examples.text: 太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
examples.trans: Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

examples.text: 我们不知道。有人放在台阶上，按了门铃。
examples.trans: We do not know. Someone set it on the step and rang the bell.

meanings.note: Adjective duǎn ('short in time or length').

examples.text: 在这么短的时间里，只能争取到这样了。
examples.trans: In such a short time, this is the most we could secure.

examples.text: 冬天的白天比较短。
examples.trans: Winter days are relatively short.

meanings.note: Time noun/adjective duǎnqī ('short-term').

examples.text: 盲目模仿只是为了追求短期的效益。
examples.trans: Blind imitation merely chases short-term gains.

examples.text: 公司为新员工安排了为期两周的短期培训。
examples.trans: The firm set up a two-week short-term training course.

meanings.note: Brief intensive course for practical skills.

examples.text: 公司周末安排了一次新员工短期培训。
examples.trans: The company arranged a short training course for new staff.

examples.text: 他报名参加了一个制作技术的短期培训。
examples.trans: He signed up for a short course in production skills.

meanings.note: Metaphor from the shortest stave of a wooden barrel.

examples.text: 不擅长社交一直是他的短板。
examples.trans: Weak social skills have always been his shortcoming.

examples.text: 我们要尽快补齐团队在宣传上的短板。
examples.trans: We must quickly shore up the team's weak spot in publicity.

meanings.note: Pinyin: duǎn huà. Measure word (量词): 句 (jù), e.g. 一句短话 ('a short note').

examples.text: 先说三句短话。第一句：你好，志鹏，谢谢你来。
examples.trans: Start with three short lines. First: Hello, Zhipeng, thank you for coming.

examples.text: 他在明信片背面留了一句温暖的短话。
examples.trans: He left a warm short note on the back of the postcard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ǎi dèng. Combines 矮 ('low/short in height') + 凳 ('stool'); measure word: 把 (bǎ) or 张 (zhāng).

examples.text: 小美笑着说：“这把小矮凳我一星期爬十次，拿个茶壶很快的！”
examples.trans: Mei laughed, 'I climb this little low stool ten times a week—grabbing the teapot will only take a second!'

examples.text: 擦窗框底下的时候，坐在小矮凳上干活最省力。
examples.trans: When wiping the lower window frames, sitting on a low stool saves the most effort.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí qiáng. Measure word (量词): 堵 (dǔ), e.g. 一堵石墙 ('a stone wall').

examples.text: 主要设计小图书馆和院子，测量老石墙怎么挡住街上噪音。
examples.trans: Mostly small libraries and courtyards, measuring how old stone walls block street noise.

examples.text: 院子北边的老石墙上爬满了绿藤。
examples.trans: Green vines climb across the old stone wall on the north side.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí tou. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块石头 ('a stone').

examples.text: 我来帮您。哎呀，里面装了石头吗？
examples.trans: Let me help you. Goodness, did you pack stones inside?

examples.text: 等等，低头看石头台阶上。
examples.trans: Wait—look down on the stone step.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí bǎn. Combines 石 ('stone') + 板 ('slab/plank'); measure word: 块 (kuài).

examples.text: 如果你们有一天重开九号房，从老树往北数三块平石板！
examples.trans: If you ever reopen Room Nine, count three flat flagstones north from the old tree!

examples.text: 雨后的院子石板路干干净净，映着温暖的灯光。
examples.trans: After the rain, the courtyard flagstone path is spotless and reflects the warm lamplight.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí bǎn lù. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条石板路 ('a flagstone lane').

examples.text: 因为湿木头百叶窗会柔化石板路传回来的回声……
examples.trans: Because wet wooden shutters soften the echo bouncing off the flagstones...

examples.text: 梧桐巷的青石板路已经走过了几代街坊。
examples.trans: Generations of neighbors have walked along Wutong Lane's flagstone path.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí qiáo. Measure word (量词): 座 (zuò), e.g. 一座石桥 ('a stone bridge').

examples.text: 出大门往左拐，一直走到石桥。
examples.trans: Go out the front gate, turn left, and walk straight to the stone bridge.

examples.text: 过了前面那座小石桥就到梧桐巷了。
examples.trans: Cross that small stone bridge ahead and you reach Wutong Lane.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mǎ. Follows numbers directly for shoe and clothing sizes (四十四码 'size 44').

examples.text: 我可不穿四十四码的鞋！
examples.trans: I certainly do not wear size forty-four shoes!

examples.text: 这双棕色皮鞋是四十二码的。
examples.trans: This pair of brown leather shoes is size forty-two.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shā zhǐ. Combines 砂 ('grit/sand') + 纸 ('paper').

examples.text: 老陈今晚先用细砂纸把四扇木窗板打磨光滑。
examples.trans: Tonight Chen is sanding all four wooden shutters smooth with fine sandpaper first.

examples.text: 刷油漆之前先用砂纸磨掉翘起来的旧漆皮。
examples.trans: Before painting, use sandpaper to rub off any peeling old paint.

砌.gloss: lay bricks or stones; build a wall

meanings.en: lay bricks or stones; build a wall
meanings.note: Pinyin: qì. Architectural verb specifically for building masonry walls with brick, stone, or mortar (砌墙 'build a wall').

examples.text: 办事员说修复一间老阳光房，而不是随便砌一面新墙，简直太聪明了！
examples.trans: The clerk said restoring an old sunroom instead of just bricking up a new wall was downright genius!

examples.text: 小院外面的矮墙是用青灰色的老砖一块一块砌起来的。
examples.trans: The low wall outside the courtyard was laid brick by brick with old blue-grey bricks.

meanings.note: Abbreviated campus noun yányī ('master's year one').

examples.text: 我从研一就开始研究十二歌王了。
examples.trans: I began studying Twelve Singers in my first year of grad school.

examples.text: 研一上学期她选修了方老师的电视文化课。
examples.trans: In her first grad term she took Professor Fang's media seminar.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yán jiū. Works as both verb and noun.

examples.text: 一位研究成都历史小院建筑的建筑师啊！
examples.trans: An architect who studies historic courtyard buildings in Chengdu!

examples.text: 他专门研究南方老城区的木结构建筑。
examples.trans: He specializes in studying timber architecture in historic southern quarters.

meanings.note: noun

examples.text: 我是传媒学院的研究生，年级第一名。
examples.trans: I am a graduate student at the Media College, first in my year.

examples.text: 我是传媒学院的研究生，年级第一名。
examples.trans: I am a graduate student at the Media College, first in my year.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuān. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块砖 ('a brick').

examples.text: 四米宽，六米长，左边是砖墙，上面是木头天花板。
examples.trans: Four metres wide, six metres long, a brick wall on the left, a wooden ceiling above.

examples.text: 一点也不会——很厚的砖墙挡住了楼梯那边的声音。
examples.trans: Not at all—the thick brick wall blocks the sound from the stairs.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuān qiáng. Measure word (量词): 堵 (dǔ), e.g. 一堵砖墙 ('a brick wall').

examples.text: 老砖墙保暖，房间到天亮都暖和，放心。
examples.trans: Old brick walls hold heat, so the rooms stay warm until daybreak—don't worry.

examples.text: 椅子找到了——在一堵旧砖墙后面，我还发现了这个。
examples.trans: Found the chairs—and behind an old brick partition wall, I also uncovered this.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuān tou. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块砖头 ('a brick').

examples.text: 因为房子只是砖头和木头，志鹏，家人才是留住的东西。
examples.trans: Because a house is only brick and timber, Zhipeng—family is what we keep.

examples.text: 墙角整整齐齐码着二十块红砖头。
examples.trans: Twenty red bricks are stacked neatly in the corner.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuān fáng. Measure word (量词): 栋 (dòng), e.g. 一栋砖房 ('a brick house').

examples.text: 老砖房顶楼平时要等很久水才热。
examples.trans: Top floors in old brick houses usually wait ages before the water warms up.

examples.text: 这栋两层老砖房冬暖夏凉。
examples.trans: This two-story old brick house stays warm in winter and cool in summer.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pò. Describes torn paper, cracked cups, or worn-out items.

examples.text: 一点没破！是谁送回来的？
examples.trans: Not cracked at all! Who brought it back?

examples.text: 快去跟他聊聊，小晴，不然木地板都要踩破了！
examples.trans: Go talk to him quickly, Qing, or he will wear right through the wooden floorboards!

examples.text: 都给你破格转正了，你还看不出来啊？
examples.trans: He bent the rules to make you permanent early — can't you tell?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 真的，我觉得太破费了。
examples.trans: Really, I feel you spent far too much.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Academic noun shuòshì ('master's degree holder').

examples.text: 我是传媒学院大众传播专业的硕士。
examples.trans: I hold a master's degree in mass communication.

examples.text: 今年来公司应聘的毕业生里有很多硕士。
examples.trans: Many applicants to the company this year hold master's degrees.

meanings.note: Adjective/adverb yìng ('by sheer force, despite pain').

examples.text: 老大，你胃不好还这样硬喝不要命了吗？
examples.trans: Boss, forcing down drinks with a bad stomach risks your life!

examples.text: 虽然发着低烧，他还是硬撑着录完了全场。
examples.trans: Despite a fever, he toughed it out through the taping.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yìng bì. Literally 'hard currency' (硬 + 币), contrasting with 纸币 ('banknotes'). Measure word: 枚 (méi) or 个 (gè).

examples.text: 零钱袋里装着十几个亮晶晶的一元硬币。
examples.trans: Inside the coin pouch are more than a dozen shiny one-yuan coins.

examples.text: 买报纸需要两枚硬币，正好我口袋里有。
examples.trans: Buying the newspaper takes two coins, and I happen to have them in my pocket.

meanings.note: Tech noun yìngpán ('computer hard disk').

examples.text: 公司的素材硬盘从来没有拿出去修过。
examples.trans: Company footage hard drives are never repaired offsite.

examples.text: 这八块硬盘其实根本没坏。
examples.trans: These eight hard drives are actually not broken at all.

meanings.note: Taking concrete steps so nothing goes wrong.

examples.text: 我们要反复检查线路，确保明晚直播万无一失。
examples.trans: We must double-check every line to ensure tomorrow's broadcast goes smoothly.

examples.text: 排好值班表能确保二十四小时都有人响应。
examples.trans: Setting a shift roster ensures round-the-clock response.

meanings.note: Verified and free of guesswork.

examples.text: 我已经有确切的证据能证明这件事。
examples.trans: I already have solid proof to confirm this.

examples.text: 确切来说，比赛推迟到了下周三。
examples.trans: Strictly speaking, the match was postponed to next Wednesday.

meanings.note: verb meaning to decide firmly or confirm

examples.text: 尹正宇是我们确定的三个最佳人选之一。
examples.trans: Yin Zhengyu is one of the three top candidates we settled on.

examples.text: 请先确定明天的录影时间。
examples.trans: Please confirm tomorrow's taping time first.

meanings.note: Adverb/adjective quèshí ('really, undeniably').

examples.text: 老大的胃病最近确实越来越严重了。
examples.trans: Our boss's stomach ailment has indeed worsened lately.

examples.text: 这份修改后的策划案确实很有新意。
examples.trans: This revised proposal really is full of fresh ideas.

meanings.note: Verb quèrèn ('confirm').

examples.text: 你确认真的可以入职吗？
examples.trans: Are you sure you can really join the company?

examples.text: 请再次确认明天的航班时间。
examples.trans: Please confirm tomorrow's flight time again.

meanings.note: Verb/adjective suì ('shatter into fragments').

examples.text: 那一刻，她心里的偶像碎了。
examples.trans: In that moment, the idol in her heart shattered.

examples.text: 小心别把玻璃杯摔碎了。
examples.trans: Be careful not to shatter the glass.

meanings.note: Noun phrase suìbōli ('shattered glass').

examples.text: 一楼的碎玻璃都已经清理修好了。
examples.trans: The broken glass on the first floor has been fixed.

examples.text: 地上有碎玻璃，走路的时候请当心。
examples.trans: There is broken glass on the floor—watch your step.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǎn. Measure word (量词): 只 (zhǐ), e.g. 一只碗 ('a bowl').

examples.text: 先生，给您干毛巾擦外套，还有一碗热汤。
examples.trans: Sir, here is a dry towel to wipe your coat, plus a bowl of hot soup.

examples.text: 热汤？在冷雨中走过来之后，这听起来太棒了。
examples.trans: Hot soup? After that cold walk in the rain, that sounds wonderful.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pèng. Used for touching objects or running into someone (碰到 'bump into').

examples.text: 拐弯小心点，别碰到墙！
examples.trans: Careful on the turn—do not bump the wall!

examples.text: 我在街口正好碰到了老邻居。
examples.trans: I happened to run into an old neighbor at the corner.

meanings.note: Verb-complement pèngshàng ('bump into, meet').

examples.text: 我怕她们两个在节目上碰上会出事。
examples.trans: I worry trouble will flare if those two meet on air.

examples.text: 下班路上我正好碰上了以前的同学。
examples.trans: Walking home after work, I bumped into an old classmate.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pèng dào. Resultative verb compound 碰 ('touch/bump') + 到 ('reach/contact').

examples.text: 周经理得意地说：“看，我的白衬衫完全没碰到湿油漆！”
examples.trans: Manager Zhou said proudly, 'Look, my white shirt didn't touch the wet paint at all!'

examples.text: 搬折叠椅进门的时候慢一点，小心别碰到刚刷好的绿窗框。
examples.trans: Go slowly when carrying the folding chairs through the door so you don't bump the freshly painted green window frames.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pèng tóu. Casual verb-object compound meaning 'meet in person'.

examples.text: 先生，到了。小心碰头，这根木房梁比较低。
examples.trans: Here we are, sir. Mind your head—this wooden beam is fairly low.

examples.text: 今天中午十二点我们在大堂碰头吧。
examples.trans: Let's meet up in the lobby at twelve noon today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kē pò. Resultative compound 磕 ('knock against a hard edge') + 破 ('broken/chipped').

examples.text: 洗碗的时候小心一点，别把茶杯边磕破了。
examples.trans: Be careful when washing up so you don't chip the rims of the teacups.

examples.text: 厚粗陶杯很结实，碰到桌面也不容易磕破。
examples.trans: Thick stoneware mugs are sturdy and won't chip easily if they bump the tabletop.

meanings.note: In 磨破嘴皮子, means wearing out one's voice talking.

examples.text: 劝了他整整一个下午，嘴皮子都快磨破了。
examples.trans: Spending all afternoon persuading him nearly wore my voice out.

examples.text: 新皮鞋刚穿的时候有点磨脚。
examples.trans: Brand-new leather shoes chafe the feet a bit at first.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mó shā. Literally 'ground with sand'; describes frosted glass (磨砂玻璃) that diffuses glare into a soft glow.

examples.text: 九号房的天花板上挂着一盏磨砂玻璃吊灯。
examples.trans: A frosted-glass pendant lamp hangs from the ceiling of Room Nine.

examples.text: 磨砂玻璃窗既能透光，又能保护隐私。
examples.trans: Frosted glass windows let daylight in while keeping the room private.

meanings.note: Colloquial verb móceng ('move slowly, stall').

examples.text: 手续都办好了，你还在这儿磨蹭什么呀？
examples.trans: The transfer is all set — why are you still dawdling?

examples.text: 别磨蹭了，再不走就要错过地铁了。
examples.trans: Stop stalling or we will miss the subway.

meanings.note: Colloquial noun lǐbài ('week').

examples.text: 这么大的项目，台里不能早一个礼拜说吗？
examples.trans: On a project this big, could the network not tell us a week earlier?

examples.text: 下个礼拜我们去外地录节目。
examples.trans: Next week we travel out of town to tape a show.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a noun used in conversational Mandarin. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个礼物 ('a 礼物').

examples.text: 我有一个礼物。
examples.trans: I have a 礼物.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的礼物。
examples.trans: This is a very good 礼物.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǐ mào. Measure word (量词): 种 (zhǒng), e.g. 一种礼貌 ('good manners').

examples.text: 声音轻，很有礼貌，大概三十多岁，有点紧张。
examples.trans: Soft-spoken, very polite, around thirty-something, and a bit nervous.

examples.text: 小伙子对每位长辈说话都很有礼貌。
examples.trans: The young man speaks politely to every elder.

meanings.note: Interpersonal etiquette and social life.

examples.text: 基本的社交礼仪每个人都应该懂。
examples.trans: Everyone ought to understand basic social etiquette.

examples.text: 他平时只顾做节目，很少参加社交活动。
examples.trans: He focuses solely on making shows and rarely socialises.

meanings.note: Used for social impact, responsibility, and public reach.

examples.text: 一档优秀的评论节目应当具备积极正面的社会影响力。
examples.trans: A strong commentary show should carry positive social influence.

examples.text: 虚假医药广告不仅欺骗消费者，更造成了恶劣的社会影响。
examples.trans: Fake health ads cheat consumers and cause harmful public fallout.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhù. Opens warm wishes (祝您睡个好觉 'Wish you a good sleep').

examples.text: 祝您睡个好觉。早餐七点半在楼下。
examples.trans: Sleep well, sir. Breakfast is at seven thirty downstairs.

examples.text: 祝你今天工作顺利！
examples.trans: Wishing you a smooth day at work today!

examples.text: 那祝你好运吧。喂，杰瑞。
examples.trans: Then I wish you good luck. Hello?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Verb/noun zhùfú ('wish well; good wishes').

examples.text: 咱们以茶代酒，谢谢你的真诚祝福！
examples.trans: Let us toast with tea — thank you for your warm wishes!

examples.text: 大家纷纷向新节目送上祝福。
examples.trans: Everyone sent warm wishes for the new programme.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shén qí. Expresses delighted wonder.

examples.text: 老弟，你到底撞进了一家什么神奇客栈？
examples.trans: Little brother, what kind of magical inn did you stumble into?

examples.text: 拧紧那个小阀门，响声真神奇地消失了！
examples.trans: Tighten that small valve and the clanking magically vanished!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shén mì. Describes a mystery guest or locked box.

examples.text: 你看，早餐忙乱和神秘电话你都挺过来了！
examples.trans: Look, you made it through both the breakfast rush and the mystery phone call!

examples.text: 除非他是写成都旅游指南的神秘评审员！
examples.trans: Unless he is a secret inspector writing the Chengdu Travel Guide!

meanings.note: Noun piào ('vote' or 'ticket').

examples.text: 真正关键的是公关总监手里的这一票。
examples.trans: What truly counts is the vote held by the PR director.

examples.text: 决赛现场的观众入场票早就发完了。
examples.trans: Audience tickets for the live finale ran out long ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jìn zhǐ. Formal verb on signs and notices.

examples.text: 超过八十年的小院建筑，只要一楼每天服务街坊邻居，禁止改成私人办公室。
examples.trans: Any courtyard building over eighty years old may not become private offices as long as the ground floor serves neighbours daily.

examples.text: 院子客房区晚上十点以后禁止大声喧哗。
examples.trans: Loud noise is prohibited in the guest-room courtyard after ten p.m.

meanings.note: Noun fúlì ('employee or fan perk, welfare').

examples.text: 拿手机跟拍红毯，这应该是粉丝福利吧？
examples.trans: Phone footage of the red carpet must be a fan perk, right?

examples.text: 这家公司的员工福利一直很不错。
examples.trans: Staff benefits at this company have always been generous.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lí. Frames distance between two places or times: A 离 B 很近 ('A is close to B').

examples.text: 把小木桌放在树下面吧，离门口远一点。
examples.trans: Let's put the small wooden table right under the tree, a little farther from the doorway.

examples.text: 客栈离火车站只有十分钟路。
examples.trans: The inn is only ten minutes away from the train station.

meanings.note: Potential complement líbuliǎo ('cannot part from').

examples.text: 我也知道我的工作离不了这儿。
examples.trans: I know my career cannot leave this place either.

examples.text: 现代人的生活离不了手机。
examples.trans: Modern life can hardly do without a phone.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lí kāi. Compound 离 ('part from') + 开 ('away'); takes a direct place or object without 从.

examples.text: 开电闸以前，请先离开木梯子退后一步。
examples.trans: Before flipping the breaker, please step clear of the wooden ladder and stand back.

examples.text: 火车快开了，旅客们陆续离开候车室。
examples.trans: The train is about to depart, and passengers are leaving the waiting room one after another.

meanings.note: Workplace verb-object lízhí ('leave employment').

examples.text: 负责观众工作的同事前两天离职了。
examples.trans: The colleague handling audience seating resigned two days ago.

examples.text: 离职之前要办好工作交接。
examples.trans: Complete your work handover before leaving a post.

meanings.note: Contrasts with 公 ('official/public').

examples.text: 她把要办的事情分成了公和私两个部分逐一落实。
examples.trans: She split her agenda into official and personal tasks to tackle in turn.

examples.text: 真正的职业经理人在重大决策中绝不夹带一丁点私心，始终公私分明。
examples.trans: True professionals keep public duty and private interest strictly apart.

meanings.note: Adverb sīxià ('off the record, one-on-one').

examples.text: 另一个人要求对方必须先私下向他道歉。
examples.trans: The other insists on receiving a private apology first.

examples.text: 有问题我们可以会后私下沟通。
examples.trans: We can talk through any issues privately after the meeting.

meanings.note: Adverb sīxiàlǐ ('in private').

examples.text: 难不成咱们私下里去医院找他？
examples.trans: Should we perhaps go see him privately at the hospital?

examples.text: 台上是竞争对手，私下里他们其实是老同学。
examples.trans: Rivals onstage, in private they are actually old classmates.

meanings.note: Noun sīshì ('personal business').

examples.text: 我的私事没有必要告诉你。
examples.trans: There is no need to tell you my private affairs.

examples.text: 上班时间最好不要花太久处理私事。
examples.trans: Avoid spending long on personal matters during work hours.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sī rén. Opposite of 公共 ('public').

examples.text: 超过八十年的小院建筑，只要一楼每天服务街坊邻居，禁止改成私人办公室。
examples.trans: Any courtyard building over eighty years old may not become private offices as long as the ground floor serves neighbours daily.

examples.text: 这是客人的私人信件，请妥善保管。
examples.trans: This is a guest's private letter—please keep it safe.

meanings.note: Personal photo not released as publicity material.

examples.text: 这位低调的制作人网上几乎找不到一张私人照。
examples.trans: Hardly a single private photo of this low-key producer exists online.

examples.text: 未经允许千万不要随便公开别人的私人照。
examples.trans: Never publish someone's private photos without permission.

meanings.note: Adjective sījiā ('privately owned').

examples.text: 不少市民自发开放自己的私家住处供人避雨。
examples.trans: Many citizens voluntarily opened their private homes as rain shelters.

examples.text: 场馆周边车位有限，建议观众尽量少开私家车。
examples.trans: Parking around the arena is tight, so avoid driving private cars.

meanings.note: Noun sīmìxìng ('degree of privacy').

examples.text: 这家餐厅私密性很好，不会有人偷拍。
examples.trans: Privacy at this restaurant is great; nobody will sneak photos.

examples.text: 贵宾休息室的私密性设计得非常周到。
examples.trans: The VIP green room is thoughtfully designed for privacy.

examples.text: 这是私照啊。
examples.trans: This is private photo.

examples.text: 那个私照好。
examples.trans: That private photo is good.

examples.text: 网上说那小孩是惠美的私生子！
examples.trans: People online are claiming that child is Huimei's child out of wedlock!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

私聊.gloss: chat privately, talk one-on-one behind closed doors

meanings.en: chat privately, talk one-on-one behind closed doors
meanings.note: Colloquial verb for a private conversation or message.

examples.text: 散会之后，她特意留下来找部门主管单独私聊了几句。
examples.trans: After the meeting adjourned, she stayed behind to chat privately with the head.

examples.text: 涉及人事变动的敏感问题最好关起门来私聊。
examples.trans: Sensitive personnel questions are best discussed privately behind closed doors.

私自.gloss: without authorization, on one's own initiative

meanings.en: without authorization, on one's own initiative
meanings.note: Acting without notifying or getting approval from superiors.

examples.text: 任何工作人员都不得私自向外界透露未公布的节目素材。
examples.trans: No staff member may leak unreleased show footage without authorization.

examples.text: 她承认自己当时太冲动，不该瞒着团队私自报警。
examples.trans: She admitted acting on impulse by calling police on her own.

meanings.note: Verb sīcáng ('treasure privately').

examples.text: 小粉红笔记本？杏子姐这是你私藏的吗？
examples.trans: A little pink notebook? Is this from your secret stash?

examples.text: 他拿出了自己私藏多年的好茶叶。
examples.trans: He brought out fine tea leaves from his private stash.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiū tiān. Compound 秋 ('autumn') + 天 ('season/sky').

examples.text: 秋天的山蜂蜜味道最浓，颜色也偏深。
examples.trans: Mountain honey gathered in autumn has the richest flavour and a deeper amber colour.

examples.text: 成都的秋天凉快又舒服，最适合在院子里喝茶。
examples.trans: Autumn in Chengdu is cool and comfortable—ideal for drinking tea in the courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǒng. Read zhǒng as a measure word for kinds/types (这种, 那种); read zhòng as the verb 'plant/grow'.

examples.text: 老陈，这些香草是你自己种的吗？
examples.trans: Chen, did you grow these herbs yourself?

examples.text: 老房子连着旧回忆——那种争吵最伤人。
examples.trans: Old houses are tied to old memories—arguments like that cut deepest.

meanings.note: Noun zhǒnglèi ('variety, category').

examples.text: 食堂里鱼的种类越来越多。
examples.trans: The varieties of fish in the canteen keep growing.

examples.text: 这家书店里杂志的种类很全。
examples.trans: This bookshop carries a full range of magazines.

种花种草.gloss: grow flowers and plants, do gardening

meanings.en: grow flowers and plants, do gardening
meanings.note: Relaxing hobby of tending potted plants or a garden.

examples.text: 退休以后爷爷每天在家种花种草。
examples.trans: Since retiring, Grandpa tends flowers and plants at home daily.

examples.text: 阳台上种花种草能让心情变好。
examples.trans: Growing flowers and plants on the balcony lifts one's mood.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kē. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个科室 ('a department').

examples.text: 等等，志鹏——你还在市政厅合同科工作？！
examples.trans: Wait, Zhipeng—you still work at City Hall's contract office?!

examples.text: 请去二楼的合同科签字。
examples.trans: Please go to the contracts section on the second floor to sign.

meanings.note: Used as a noun ('science') or adjective ('rational/scientific').

examples.text: 我们要用更科学的方法安排工作。
examples.trans: We should arrange our work in a more scientific way.

examples.text: 合理的饮食和运动才是最科学的。
examples.trans: Balanced diet and exercise are the most sensible approach.

meanings.note: kējì — portmanteau abbreviation of 科学技术 (kēxué jìshù); ubiquitous in company names (e.g., 粉团科技 Fentuan Tech) and compounds like 高科技 (high-tech).

examples.text: 小谷，你负责跟进粉团科技的项目。
examples.trans: Xiaogu, you are in charge of following up on the Fentuan Tech project.

examples.text: 现代科技正在彻底改变传统节目的制作方式。
examples.trans: Modern technology is completely transforming how traditional shows are produced.

meanings.note: Pinyin: miǎo. Counts seconds directly without 个 (十秒 'ten seconds').

examples.text: 当心那把角落椅子，等十秒我拧紧螺丝。
examples.trans: Mind that corner chair—wait ten seconds while I tighten the screw.

examples.text: 你们听一秒……街上一辆汽车的声音都听不到。
examples.trans: Listen for a second... you cannot hear a single car from the street.

meanings.note: Pinyin: miǎo zhōng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 几秒钟 ('a few seconds').

examples.text: 志鹏不会走的。他总是嘴硬五秒钟，心马上就软了。
examples.trans: Zhipeng will not leave. He always talked tough for five seconds, then softened right away.

examples.text: 明信片上整齐的方格字，我两秒钟就认出来了。
examples.trans: That neat block handwriting on the postcard—I recognized it in two seconds.

秘不发丧.gloss: keep a ruler's death/departure secret to preserve stability

meanings.en: keep a ruler's death/departure secret to preserve stability
meanings.note: Historical idiom used humorously for hiding a boss's resignation.

examples.text: 为了稳住外部合作方，公司暂时采取了秘不发丧的策略。
examples.trans: To reassure external partners, the firm kept his departure quiet for now.

examples.text: 她没料到历史剧里的秘不发丧竟然会在现代职场上演。
examples.trans: She never imagined a palace-drama secrecy ploy happening in a modern office.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mì mì. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个秘密 ('a secret').

examples.text: 真的吗？我厨房的墙后面真的有一个秘密房间？
examples.trans: Is it true? Is there really a secret room behind my kitchen wall?

examples.text: 这是我们两个人的秘密。
examples.trans: This is a secret between the two of us.

秘诀.gloss: secret trick; key to success; culinary secret

meanings.en: secret trick; key to success; culinary secret
meanings.note: Pinyin: mì jué. Combines 秘 ('secret') + 诀 ('knack/formula'); measure word: 个 (gè).

examples.text: 告诉二号桌，秘诀是我星期三收的两个厨房徒弟！
examples.trans: Tell table two the secret trick was the two kitchen apprentices I took on Wednesday!

examples.text: 烤出酥脆挞皮的秘诀，就是黄油一定要够冰。
examples.trans: The secret to baking a crisp tart crust is making sure the butter is ice-cold.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zū. Used both for renting a property from someone and leasing it out (租给).

examples.text: 那我们平时为什么不租给客人呢？
examples.trans: Then why do we never rent it out to guests?

examples.text: 他们把一楼租给了花店老板。
examples.trans: They leased the ground floor to the flower-shop owner.

meanings.note: Verb-object zūfáng ('rent housing').

examples.text: 传单上写着最低价租房。
examples.trans: The flyer advertises lowest-priced apartment rentals.

examples.text: 刚毕业的大学生大多在城里租房。
examples.trans: Most fresh graduates rent flats in the city.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zū yuē. Measure word (量词): 份 (fèn), e.g. 一份租约 ('a lease').

examples.text: 那你们的客栈租约就受市里法律再保护十年！
examples.trans: Then your inn lease is protected by city law for another ten years!

examples.text: 星期一你打开了卡住的门；这一周你救了客房、水管、早餐和租约。
examples.trans: On Monday you opened our sticking door; this week you saved rooms, pipes, breakfast, and our lease.

meanings.en: Qin Xiao, a character in Behind the Scenes (a fellow intern and peer of Bu Xiaogu)
meanings.note: Qín Xiāo — Chinese personal name combining the surname 秦 (Qín) with 箫 (xiāo, vertical bamboo flute).

examples.text: 小谷，秦箫，你们两个快进来吧。
examples.trans: Xiaogu, Qin Xiao, come right on in, both of you.

examples.text: 秦箫，你早上出门怎么不叫我一声呀？
examples.trans: Qin Xiao, why didn't you call me when you headed out this morning?

meanings.note: Noun jījíxìng ('keenness, motivation').

examples.text: 现在的学生对于这种事积极性没以前高了。
examples.trans: Students nowadays have less enthusiasm for gigs like this.

examples.text: 好制度能提高员工的积极性。
examples.trans: Fair rules boost staff motivation.

称.gloss: call, style, measure up to a title

meanings.en: call, style, measure up to a title
meanings.note: Verb chēng ('call, merit a name').

examples.text: 别开我玩笑了，我可称不上什么天后。
examples.trans: Stop teasing me—I could hardly claim the title of diva.

examples.text: 这部匠心之作完全称得上今年的诚意精品。
examples.trans: This finely crafted show truly merits calling a gem.

examples.text: 按规矩，我应该怎么称呼您？
examples.trans: By proper etiquette, how should I address you?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a adj used in conversational Mandarin.

examples.text: 我有一个稀。
examples.trans: I have a 稀.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的稀。
examples.trans: This is a very good 稀.

meanings.note: Legal, corporate, or technical sequence of steps.

examples.text: 法务部门已经启动了常规的法律程序追究违约方责任。
examples.trans: Legal has initiated standard procedures to hold the breaching party liable.

examples.text: 所有项目立项都必须严格履行预算审批程序。
examples.trans: Every project greenlight must go through formal budget approval procedures.

meanings.note: Noun chéngdù ('extent, degree').

examples.text: 从这一点就能看出台里面的重视程度了。
examples.trans: From that alone you see how highly the station values it.

examples.text: 观众对新栏目的喜爱程度超出了预期。
examples.trans: Viewer fondness for the new show beat expectations.

examples.text: 老师，我稍微感觉有点失望。
examples.trans: Professor, I feel slightly disappointed.

examples.text: 这是稍微。
examples.trans: This is 稍微.

稍等.gloss: wait a moment, hold on briefly

meanings.en: wait a moment, hold on briefly
meanings.note: Polite verb phrase shāoděng ('just a moment').

examples.text: 你们已经到我家门口了？行，请稍等一下。
examples.trans: You are right outside my front door? Alright, give me a moment.

examples.text: 信号正在切换中，请现场主持人和观众稍等片刻。
examples.trans: Signals are switching over—host and audience, please hold a moment.

examples.text: 您稍等一下啊。总编室，杏子。
examples.trans: Please hold for just a moment. Chief editor's office, Xingzi speaking.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuì wù. Combines 税 ('tax/duty') + 务 ('administrative affairs').

examples.text: 老陈笑道：“老板，您要是像念税务课本一样说话，办事员站着都会睡着！”
examples.trans: Chen chuckled, 'Boss, if you talk like you're reading a tax textbook aloud, the clerk will fall asleep standing up!'

examples.text: 每个月底，周经理都会在账房里仔细整理客栈的账本和税务表格。
examples.trans: At the end of every month, Manager Zhou carefully organizes the inn's ledgers and tax forms in the office.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wěn. Describes holding something steadily or playing music evenly.

examples.text: 手电筒拿稳，照着这儿的水管接口。
examples.trans: Hold the flashlight steady and shine it on the pipe joint here.

examples.text: 拿稳了！你已经关掉总水阀了吗？
examples.trans: Steady! Did you turn off the main water valve already?

meanings.note: Verb-complement wěnzhù ('hold someone steady, keep talking').

examples.text: 你先稳住许天泽，让我想想办法。
examples.trans: Keep Xu Tianze steady first while I think of a plan.

examples.text: 越是关键时刻，主持人越要稳住全场。
examples.trans: At crucial moments, a host must steady the whole room.

meanings.note: Adjective wěntuǒ ('sound, dependable').

examples.text: 主任夸赞你们提交的方案已经十分稳妥了。
examples.trans: The director praised your submitted plan as rock-solid.

examples.text: 直播前多检查一遍设备才最稳妥。
examples.trans: Checking gear one extra time before air is safest.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wěn dìng. Describes steady water temperature or reliable work.

examples.text: 热！小晴你听到没？稳定、现代、五星级热水！
examples.trans: Hot! Qing, did you hear that? Reliable, modern, five-star hot water!

examples.text: 修好热水器后，水温一直很稳定。
examples.trans: Since repairing the heater, the water temperature has stayed steady.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wén wěn. Reduplicated adverb describing steady hands or footing.

examples.text: 火苗亮了——稳稳的蓝火，正合适。
examples.trans: The flame is lit—steady blue fire, right as it should be.

examples.text: 她双手稳稳地端起盛满热茶的托盘。
examples.trans: With both hands she lifted the tray of hot tea steadily.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wěn zhòng. Warm compliment for a poised person or tone of voice.

examples.text: 我心跳得好快！小晴你去说，你声音稳重诚实！
examples.trans: My heart is pounding! Qing, you explain it—you sound calm and honest!

examples.text: 别看她年轻，处理急事却非常稳重。
examples.trans: Though young, she handles emergencies with calm poise.

meanings.note: gǎo — functions both as a noun (often in compounds like 初稿 first draft, 最终稿 final draft, 台词稿 script) and as a measure word for iterations of a draft (e.g., 写完一稿 finish one draft, 改了三稿 revised three drafts).

examples.text: 接下来抓紧时间，把最终稿交上来。
examples.trans: Next, make good use of the time and hand in the final draft.

examples.text: 出发之前写完一稿，到了欧洲你就没时间写了。
examples.trans: Finish a full first draft before departure; once you land in Europe you will have zero time to write.

related.gloss: to finalize a manuscript or draft

meanings.note: Media noun gǎozi ('written article or script').

examples.text: 难怪您能写出那么犀利的稿子。
examples.trans: No wonder you write such sharp articles.

examples.text: 这篇新闻稿子今晚要发出去。
examples.trans: This news draft goes out tonight.

究竟.gloss: actually, after all, what on earth

meanings.en: actually, after all, what on earth
meanings.note: Intensifies questions or realisations about the real truth.

examples.text: 直到今天我才明白，自己当时究竟在说什么。
examples.trans: Only today did I grasp what I had truly been saying back then.

examples.text: 这件怪事背后究竟隐藏着什么原因呢？
examples.trans: What reason actually lies behind this strange incident?

examples.text: 如果你是个穷人的话，你会让自己生活得更好。
examples.trans: If you are poor, you work hard to give yourself a better life.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kōng. Describes an unoccupied room or bare floor.

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 老陈……小晴……快告诉我今晚六号房空着。
examples.trans: Chen... Qing... please tell me room six is free tonight.

空城.gloss: empty city/fort (figurative for a leaderless office)

meanings.en: empty city/fort (figurative for a leaderless office)
meanings.note: Alludes to Zhuge Liang's Empty Fort Strategy.

examples.text: 哪怕总制作人不在，她也要凭一己之力守住这座空城。
examples.trans: Even with the chief producer gone, she vowed to guard this empty fort.

examples.text: 节假日里平时热闹非凡的写字楼安静得像一座空城。
examples.trans: Over the holidays the bustling office tower grew quiet as an empty city.

空城计.gloss: Empty Fort Strategy (bluffing strength while short-handed)

meanings.en: Empty Fort Strategy (bluffing strength while short-handed)
meanings.note: Famous Three Kingdoms stratagem used in business.

examples.text: 公司对外隐瞒总监离职的消息，其实是在摆空城计。
examples.trans: Keeping the chief's resignation quiet outside was an empty fort bluff.

examples.text: 两位老搭档义无反顾地回来陪她一起唱这出空城计。
examples.trans: Both old partners came right back to help her stage the empty fort.

examples.text: 王尔实在是太狡猾了，他趁着我们去年系统升级的时候钻了这个空子。
examples.trans: Wang Er was remarkably cunning; he exploited a gap during our internal system upgrade last autumn.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kōng qì. Measure word (量词): 口 (kǒu), e.g. 一口新鲜空气 ('a breath of fresh air').

examples.text: 啊！老水管晚上有时候会进一点空气。
examples.trans: Oh! Old water pipes sometimes get a little air bubble at night.

examples.text: 打开窗户，让雨后新鲜的空气进来吧。
examples.trans: Open the window and let the fresh post-rain air in.

related.gloss: a breath of fresh air (measure word 口)

meanings.note: Pinyin: kòng bái. Note 空 is read 4th-tone kòng ('unfilled space') here, not 1st-tone kōng ('sky/hollow')!

examples.text: 曲谱第二页的下半部分还是空白的。
examples.trans: The lower half of page two of the music score is still blank.

examples.text: 请在表格右下角的空白地方签上名字。
examples.trans: Please sign your name in the blank space at the bottom right of the form.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a adj used in conversational Mandarin.

examples.text: 我有一个空空。
examples.trans: I have a 空空.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的空空。
examples.trans: This is a very good 空空.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kōng dàng dàng. Vivid ABB-pattern adjective.

examples.text: 十二下敲完了……大门外面街上空荡荡的。
examples.trans: Twelve chimes have finished... and the street outside the gate is completely empty.

examples.text: 客人们出门游玩后，中午的大堂空荡荡的。
examples.trans: After the guests head out sightseeing, the lobby is empty at midday.

meanings.note: Noun kōngtiáo ('air conditioning').

examples.text: 你觉得冷吗？我去给你把房间空调打开。
examples.trans: Are you cold? Let me go turn on the air conditioning for you.

examples.text: 演播厅灯光热度高，录制时得把中央空调调低两度。
examples.trans: Studio lights run hot, so lower the central air by two degrees.

examples.text: 惠美一直要求清空所有的日程，现在一周里面有半周她都是空闲的。
examples.trans: Huimei insisted I clear her bookings, so now she leaves half of every week completely open.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Noun kōngjiān ('physical or creative space').

examples.text: 来建立围绕你自己的音乐空间。
examples.trans: Come build a musical space centred around yourself.

examples.text: 优秀的团队会给新人留出成长的空间。
examples.trans: Great teams leave room for newcomers to grow.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chuān. Used for garments and footwear that the body steps or slips into.

examples.text: 我可不穿四十四码的鞋！
examples.trans: I certainly do not wear size forty-four shoes!

examples.text: 宋老师，您穿着很合适。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, it fits you very well.

穿小鞋.gloss: make life hard covertly, give someone tight shoes to wear

meanings.en: make life hard covertly, give someone tight shoes to wear
meanings.note: Colloquial idiom for petty retaliation by a boss or peer.

examples.text: 心胸狭窄的人一旦掌权，总爱给意见不同的同事穿小鞋。
examples.trans: Petty bosses love making life miserable for colleagues who disagree.

examples.text: 他怀疑老部下故意在工作流程里给自己穿小鞋。
examples.trans: He suspected the old guard of covertly making life hard for him.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chuānguò.

examples.text: 火车穿过了一条长长的隧道。
examples.trans: The train passed through a long tunnel.

examples.text: 我们必须穿过这片森林才能到达目的地。
examples.trans: We must go through this forest to reach our destination.

突兀.gloss: abrupt, unexpected, out of the blue

meanings.en: abrupt, unexpected, out of the blue
meanings.note: Adjective tūwù ('sudden, jarring').

examples.text: 真没想到你会提这个，有点突兀。
examples.trans: I truly did not expect that—it feels rather abrupt.

examples.text: 这段广告插在剧情中间显得有点突兀。
examples.trans: Placing this ad mid-scene feels a bit jarring.

突围.gloss: break out of an encirclement; achieve a breakthrough

meanings.en: break out of an encirclement; achieve a breakthrough
meanings.note: Overcoming industry stagnation or tight competition.

examples.text: 国产原创综艺正在寻找新的创新与突围方向。
examples.trans: Original domestic variety shows are seeking fresh breakthroughs.

examples.text: 面对激烈竞争，只有靠品质才能成功突围。
examples.trans: Facing fierce competition, only quality achieves a real breakthrough.

meanings.note: Adjective/adverb tūrán ('all of a sudden').

examples.text: 不好意思，现场的安排突然有点变化。
examples.trans: Sorry, the on-site schedule suddenly changed.

examples.text: 下午突然下起了一场大雨。
examples.trans: A heavy rain suddenly started in the afternoon.

meanings.note: Idiom tūrán-xíjī ('spring an ambush').

examples.text: 所以你是故意把会提前，突然袭击我们的。
examples.trans: So you moved the meeting up to spring a surprise ambush on us.

examples.text: 面对主持人的突然袭击提问，嘉宾对答如流。
examples.trans: Facing a surprise question from the host, the guest answered smoothly.

examples.text: 星天娱乐一直是备受投资界关注的明星企业，公司估值一度突破百亿。
examples.trans: Xingtian Entertainment has long been a star company watched closely by investors, with its valuation once topping ten billion.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Compound noun tūpòkǒu ('point of entry to crack a problem').

examples.text: 我原以为年轻助理是个容易的突破口。
examples.trans: I thought a young assistant would be an easy opening.

examples.text: 团队终于找到了老节目改版的突破口。
examples.trans: The team finally found a breakthrough angle for the revamp.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǎi. Opposite of 宽 ('wide'); describes narrow alleys or stairs.

examples.text: 因为楼梯窄，而且周经理在那儿放了旧灯箱子。
examples.trans: Because the stairs are narrow, and Manager Zhou put old lamp boxes up there.

examples.text: 走花摊旁边第二条路，别进窄巷子。
examples.trans: Take the second lane beside the flower stall; do not enter the narrow alley.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǎi zhǎi. Vivid reduplication of 窄 ('narrow'), paired with 的 before nouns (窄窄的小巷 'narrow little lane').

examples.text: 客栈外面是一条窄窄的青石板老巷子。
examples.trans: Outside the inn runs a narrow old lane paved with bluestone slabs.

examples.text: 二十四把椅子堆在窄窄的走廊里可走不通。
examples.trans: Twenty-four chairs piled in a narrow corridor would block the way completely.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chuāng. Measure word (量词): 扇 (shàn), e.g. 一扇窗 ('a window').

examples.text: 一点也不介意！窗下这张宽书桌正适合我工作。
examples.trans: Not at all! And this wide desk beneath the window suits my work ideally.

examples.text: 打开木窗就能看见院子里的老树。
examples.trans: Open the wooden window and you can see the old tree in the courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chuāngtái. Measure word: 个.

examples.text: 她在窗台上放了一盆花。
examples.trans: She placed a pot of flowers on the windowsill.

examples.text: 猫喜欢趴在窗台上晒太阳。
examples.trans: The cat likes to lie on the windowsill and bask in the sun.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chuāng wài. Measure word (量词): 片 (piàn), e.g. 窗外风景 ('the view outside the window').

examples.text: 《成都老城区法案》第十四条，而且这里我哥哥刚刚也点头了！
examples.trans: Clause fourteen of the Chengdu Old Quarter Act—and my brother here just nodded!

examples.text: 窗外的老梧桐树在风里轻轻摇晃。
examples.trans: Outside the window, the old plane tree sways gently in the breeze.

related.gloss: the view outside the window (measure word 片)

meanings.note: Pinyin: chuāng lián. Measure word (量词): 幅, e.g. 一幅窗帘 ('a curtain').

examples.text: 说这话的人每隔三十秒就扒着窗帘偷看一次！
examples.trans: Says the man peeking through the window curtain every thirty seconds!

examples.text: 天亮了，她拉开蓝色的布窗帘。
examples.trans: At daybreak she drew open the blue fabric curtains.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chuāng hu. Measure word (量词): 扇 (shàn), e.g. 一扇窗户 ('a window').

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

examples.text: 哇，看这间房！大木头房梁，窗户正对着院子！
examples.trans: Wow, look at this room! Big wooden beams, and a window facing the courtyard!

meanings.note: Pinyin: chuāng bǎn. Measure word (量词): 扇 (shàn), e.g. 一扇窗板 ('a shutter').

examples.text: 外面的窗板都关着，所以在院子里谁也没发现！
examples.trans: The shutters outside are all closed, so nobody in the courtyard ever noticed!

examples.text: 还有六天：擦玻璃，刷窗板，烤柠檬蛋糕！
examples.trans: Six days left: clean the glass, paint the shutters, bake lemon cake!

meanings.note: Pinyin: chuāng biān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 窗边座位 ('a window seat').

examples.text: 茶壶也烫好了！大家从窗边退后一步！
examples.trans: And the teapot is hot! Everybody step back from the window!

examples.text: 宋老师最喜欢坐在窗边喝热薄荷茶。
examples.trans: Teacher Song loves sitting by the window with hot mint tea.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lì. Verb meaning to stand upright or erect furniture/structures (书架立起来了 'the bookcase went up').

examples.text: 后来走廊里立起了一排高高的木头书架。
examples.trans: Later on, a tall wooden bookcase was set up in the hallway.

examples.text: 请把擦干净的长梯子稳稳立在墙角。
examples.trans: Please stand the wiped-clean ladder steadily in the corner.

立了项.gloss: got officially greenlit as a project

meanings.en: got officially greenlit as a project
meanings.note: Separable verb 立项 with perfective 了 inserted.

examples.text: 大家筹备半年，这档新节目好不容易才立了项。
examples.trans: After half a year of prep, this new show finally got greenlit.

examples.text: 项目一旦立了项，预算和人员就会马上到位。
examples.trans: Once a project gets greenlit, budget and staffing fall into place.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lì kè. Crisp adverb for immediate action.

examples.text: 你们两位都懂？！放下茶杯——现在立刻跟我进来！
examples.trans: Both of you?! Put down your teacups—come inside with me this instant!

examples.text: 接到电话后，他立刻赶回客栈帮忙。
examples.trans: Right after getting the call, he hurried back to the inn to help.

meanings.note: Formal adverb lìjí ('immediately').

examples.text: 公关总监签字就能立即生效。
examples.trans: Once the PR director signs, it takes effect immediately.

examples.text: 接到通知后请立即出发。
examples.trans: Please set out immediately upon notice.

立场.gloss: position, standpoint, ground to stand on

meanings.en: position, standpoint, ground to stand on
meanings.note: One's role-based right or perspective.

examples.text: 作为下属和朋友，我没有立场故意疏远他。
examples.trans: As a colleague and friend, I have no ground to shun him.

examples.text: 谈判的时候双方都要先明确各自的立场。
examples.trans: In negotiations, both sides clarify their respective positions first.

examples.text: 平时最痛恨的就是你的官僚作风，今天你真是立大功了！
examples.trans: Normally I can't stand your bureaucratic paper slips, yet today your habit saved the company!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lì shì. Attributive modifier 立 ('stand upright') + 式 ('style/type'), standard in 立式钢琴 ('upright piano').

examples.text: 阳光房靠墙放着一架深棕色的立式钢琴。
examples.trans: Against the wall of the sunroom stands a dark brown upright piano.

examples.text: 角落里那台立式电风扇吹出来的风很凉快。
examples.trans: The upright floor fan in the corner blows a nice cool breeze.

meanings.note: Workplace verb-object lìxiàng ('approve project launch').

examples.text: 我在思考这个原创节目立项的难度。
examples.trans: I was thinking about how tough greenlighting this show will be.

examples.text: 经过三轮论证，新综艺终于在台里正式立项了。
examples.trans: After three reviews, the network officially greenlit the show.

meanings.en: immediately; at once; on the spot
meanings.note: Brisk colloquial adverb (literally 'standing by one's horse'), slightly livelier than 立刻 or 马上.

examples.text: 接到通知以后，他立马赶到了录音棚。
examples.trans: After receiving the notice, he rushed to the recording studio right away.

examples.text: 有问题我们立马改，绝不拖延。
examples.trans: If there is a problem we will fix it immediately, with no delay.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhàn. As a verb, 'stand' (站在旁边); as a noun, 'station/stop' (火车站).

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

examples.text: 听得很清楚。你站在小石头喷泉旁边吗？
examples.trans: Loud and clear. Are you standing beside the little stone fountain?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhàn tái. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个站台 ('a station platform').

examples.text: 热汤？在冷雨中走过来之后，这听起来太棒了。
examples.trans: Hot soup? After that cold walk in the rain, that sounds wonderful.

examples.text: 谁能想到，星期一早上志豪在二站台拿错了蓝箱子。
examples.trans: Who would have thought that on Monday morning Hao grabbed the wrong blue bag on Platform Two.

站好岗.gloss: stand firmly at one's post, fulfil one's duty faithfully

meanings.en: stand firmly at one's post, fulfil one's duty faithfully
meanings.note: Separable verb 站岗 with resultative 好.

examples.text: 制作人不在的时候，我们更要替他站好岗。
examples.trans: While the producer is away, we must stand faithfully at our posts.

examples.text: 不管职位怎么变动，她都会站好岗直到最后一天。
examples.trans: Whatever role changes come, she fulfils her duties to the last day.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhàn zhí. Resultative compound 站 ('stand') + 直 ('straight/upright').

examples.text: 只要那根歪掉的琴槌重新站直了，琴键就能响了。
examples.trans: Once that leaning piano hammer stands straight again, the key will sound.

examples.text: 拍照的时候请大家站直，看镜头微笑！
examples.trans: Please stand up straight and smile at the camera for the photo!

examples.text: 选边站队。
examples.trans: Choose sides.

examples.text: 别站队。
examples.trans: Do not take sides.

examples.text: 不要太着急了，招聘竞争都很激烈。
examples.trans: Do not get too anxious; the hiring competition is very fierce.

examples.text: 这是竞争。
examples.trans: This is 竞争.

meanings.note: Noun jìngzhēng duìshǒu ('business rival').

examples.text: 这两家饮料公司是直接的竞争对手。
examples.trans: These two beverage firms are direct competitors.

examples.text: 我们要认真研究竞争对手的节目。
examples.trans: We study our competitors' shows carefully.

examples.text: 十二歌王要改版了，他们约我去参加竞唱。
examples.trans: Twelve Singers is revamping its format, and they invited me to compete.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 这竞演歌曲是洛琳的代表作吧，是不是有点不妥啊？
examples.trans: Isn't this competition song Luo Lin's signature piece? Could that be a bit unwise?

examples.text: 辛惠美在第一支竞演曲目里，启用了神秘的外卡队员与她同场演出。
examples.trans: For her very first competition song, Xin Huimei has brought in a mysterious wild-card singer to perform alongside her.

meanings.note: Adverb jìng ('to one's surprise, actually').

examples.text: 我竟这样完成了我的第一个节目策划。
examples.trans: That was how I unexpectedly finished my first proposal.

examples.text: 没想到随口提的建议竟被采纳了。
examples.trans: A casual suggestion was unexpectedly adopted.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jìng rán. Marks speaker surprise that something happened contrary to expectation.

examples.text: 我每天从窗板旁边经过，竟然一直没注意到那个铁钩！
examples.trans: I walked past the shutters every day and surprisingly never noticed that iron hook!

examples.text: 锁了三十年的钢琴，里面的木头竟然一点都没裂。
examples.trans: After thirty years locked away, the wood inside the piano wasn't cracked at all!

meanings.note: Classifier/noun zhāng ('chapter of a book or thesis').

examples.text: 我的论文就还剩最后一章。
examples.trans: My thesis has only the final chapter left.

examples.text: 这本书一共有十章。
examples.trans: This book has ten chapters in all.

examples.text: 他在老城区度过了无忧无虑的童年时光。
examples.trans: He spent a carefree childhood in the old quarter of town.

examples.text: 这首老歌总能勾起她对童年夏夜的美好回忆。
examples.trans: This old song always brings back fond memories of summer nights in her childhood.

meanings.note: Pinyin: duān. Specifically describes carrying dishes, soup, or tea level in the hands.

examples.text: 好。端上去之前，在上面撒这些新鲜绿香草。
examples.trans: Good. Before serving them, sprinkle these fresh green herbs on top.

examples.text: 她端着一盘热面包走出来。
examples.trans: She walked out carrying a tray of warm bread.

meanings.note: Pinyin: duān zhuāng. Describes graceful bearing.

examples.text: 有进步！今天小院迎接兄弟重逢——大家保持安静端庄！
examples.trans: Progress! Today our courtyard hosts a brotherly reunion—quiet dignity from everyone!

examples.text: 照片里的年轻钢琴老师神态端庄。
examples.trans: In the photograph, the young piano teacher looks poised and graceful.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhú lán. Combines 竹 ('bamboo') + 篮 ('basket'); measure word: 个 (gè) or 只 (zhī).

examples.text: 宋老师问小晴有没有在门边留一个装共享图书的小竹篮。
examples.trans: Teacher Song asked Qing if she had left a small bamboo basket by the door for shared books.

examples.text: 小美提着一只干净的竹篮去集市挑选新鲜的黄柠檬和香草。
examples.trans: Mei carried a clean bamboo basket to the market to pick out fresh yellow lemons and herbs.

meanings.note: Verb/noun xiào ('smile, laugh').

examples.text: 你看着我的笔记笑什么？
examples.trans: Why are you smiling at my notes?

examples.text: 听到这个好消息，大家都开心地笑了。
examples.trans: Hearing the good news, everyone smiled happily.

meanings.note: Something told for laughs.

examples.text: 老板难得讲个笑话，可惜听起来有点老套。
examples.trans: The boss rarely cracks a joke, though it sounded a bit dated.

examples.text: 大家听了他的冷笑话都忍不住笑了起来。
examples.trans: Hearing his dry joke, everyone could not help laughing.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bǐ. Measure word (量词): 支, e.g. 一支笔 ('a pen').

examples.text: 不在，只有我的笔和三张旧收据！
examples.trans: Not there—only my pen and three old receipts!

examples.text: 请借我一支笔签个名。
examples.trans: Please lend me a pen to sign my name.

meanings.note: Noun bǐlù ('written notes/transcript').

examples.text: 主任今天来不了会场，派我过来做会议笔录。
examples.trans: My director could not attend today and sent me to take notes.

examples.text: 助理把长达两小时的策划讨论整理成了详细笔录。
examples.trans: The assistant typed two hours of brainstorming into clear minutes.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bí tǐng. Literally 'brush-straight'—used for posture or crisp suits.

examples.text: 笔挺又干净，周经理！连眼镜都戴在鼻子上，没在额头上。
examples.trans: Crisp and spotless, Manager Zhou! Even your glasses are on your nose instead of your forehead.

examples.text: 为了见重要客人，经理穿了一身笔挺的西装。
examples.trans: To meet an important guest, the manager wore a crisply pressed suit.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bǐzhí.

examples.text: 这条公路笔直地通向远方。
examples.trans: This highway stretches straight into the distance.

examples.text: 他站得笔直，像个士兵一样。
examples.trans: He stood perfectly straight, like a soldier.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bǐ jì běn. Measure word (量词): 本 (běn), e.g. 一本笔记本 ('a notebook').

examples.text: 等等——柜台上这本棕色小皮笔记本是谁的？
examples.trans: Wait—whose small brown leather notebook is this on the counter?

examples.text: 啊，我的皮笔记本！谢谢！我正到处找呢。
examples.trans: Oh, my leather notebook! Thank you! I was looking everywhere for it.

examples.text: 这是笔迹啊。
examples.trans: This is handwritings.

examples.text: 那个笔迹好。
examples.trans: That handwritings is good.

meanings.note: Verb fúhé.

examples.text: 封面不符合她的形象。
examples.trans: The cover does not match her image.

examples.text: 这个方案符合要求。
examples.trans: This plan meets the requirements.

meanings.note: Adjective bèn ('clumsy, slow on the uptake').

examples.text: 如果新人有一点笨，老大就会花更多精力。
examples.trans: If a rookie is a bit slow, our boss invests endless time.

examples.text: 笨鸟先飞，多做准备总不会错。
examples.trans: Starting early and preparing hard never goes wrong.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dì. Placed before any number to turn it into an ordinal (第一 'first', 第二天 'the second day').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: ordinal number

examples.text: 我是传媒学院的研究生，年级第一名。
examples.trans: I am a graduate student at the Media College, first in my year.

examples.text: 我是传媒学院的研究生，年级第一名。
examples.trans: I am a graduate student at the Media College, first in my year.

examples.text: 辛惠美在第一支竞演曲目里，启用了神秘的外卡队员与她同场演出。
examples.trans: For her very first competition song, Xin Huimei has brought in a mysterious wild-card singer to perform alongside her.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

第一时间.gloss: the very first moment, immediately, firsthand

meanings.en: the very first moment, immediately, firsthand
meanings.note: Right away as soon as something happens.

examples.text: 一有海外剧组的消息，请第一时间通知我！
examples.trans: The moment word comes from the overseas crew, tell me right away!

examples.text: 记者在事发后第一时间赶到了新闻现场。
examples.trans: Reporters rushed to the scene immediately after it happened.

examples.text: 杰瑞，是我。我有一个外卡歌手，需要参加第一期的录制。
examples.trans: Hello? It's me — I have a wild-card singer who needs to join our Episode One taping.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 来看你啊！我可是人生第一次尝试传说中的办公室恋爱。
examples.trans: I came to see you! This is my very first time trying out a legendary office romance.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Ordinal numeral dìsān ('third').

examples.text: 接下来介绍第三季的全面改版计划。
examples.trans: Next we present the full overhaul plan for Season Three.

examples.text: 今晚的第三位竞演歌手即将登台演唱。
examples.trans: Tonight's third competing singer is about to take the stage.

examples.text: 欢迎各位来到十二歌王第三季新闻发布会的现场。
examples.trans: Welcome to the official press conference for Season Three of Twelve Singers.

examples.text: 十二歌王第三季将于下个月重新启幕，我们将融入全新的节目改版。
examples.trans: Season Three of Twelve Singers premieres next month, featuring a brand-new revamped competition format.

examples.text: 这是第二啊。
examples.trans: This is second.

examples.text: 那个第二好。
examples.trans: That second is good.

examples.text: 上周的报告看了吗？十二歌王收视率第一，超过第二名三个点，这是历史纪录。
examples.trans: Did you read last week's report? Twelve Singers ranked number one in ratings, beating second place by three full points — a historic record.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 这联赛就没有再举办过第二届。
examples.trans: And that league never held a second tournament again.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 你是我见到的第二快。
examples.trans: You're the second fastest I've ever seen.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

第二把交椅.gloss: second-in-command, the number-two seat of authority

meanings.en: second-in-command, the number-two seat of authority
meanings.note: Colorful idiom from classic tales meaning the runner-up post.

examples.text: 他开玩笑把年轻师妹吹嘘成总编室的第二把交椅。
examples.trans: He jokingly billed his junior colleague as number two in the editorial office.

examples.text: 合并后的经纪公司在集团内部稳坐第二把交椅。
examples.trans: After the merger, the talent agency held the number-two spot in the group.

examples.text: 十二歌王第二期今晚录影，今天晚上我们会推出一首新歌，作者是钟阳子。
examples.trans: Episode Two of Twelve Singers tapes tonight, and this evening we will debut a brand-new song written by Zhong Yangzi.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 请翻到登记簿的第十四页，上面有去年的记录。
examples.trans: Please turn to the fourteenth page of the ledger, where last year's records are kept.

examples.text: 他们在这条街的第十四号院子里住了整整三十年。
examples.trans: They lived in courtyard number fourteen on this street for a full thirty years.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dì sì. Ordinal number formed with prefix 第 (dì) + 四 ('four').

examples.text: 小美，第四盘柠檬挞还剩几块？
examples.trans: How many slices of lemon tart are left on the fourth tray, Mei?

examples.text: 顺着梧桐巷往前走，第四家店就是老先生的提琴工坊。
examples.trans: Walk down Wutong Lane and the fourth shop is the older gentleman's violin workshop.

meanings.note: Pinyin: děng. Everyday verb for waiting (等一下 'wait a moment').

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

examples.text: 等一下，小晴……你拿了哪一包黄油？
examples.trans: Wait a second, Qing... which packet of butter did you grab?

meanings.note: Pinyin: děng deng. Urgent or casual reduplication of 等 ('wait!').

examples.text: 等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！
examples.trans: Wait—it is dark blue, the same as yours!

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

meanings.note: Verb dá ('answer questions').

examples.text: 给你十分钟时间，先答我几个问题。
examples.trans: Ten minutes—answer a few questions for me first.

examples.text: 面对评委犀利的追问，选手对答得十分从容。
examples.trans: Facing sharp judge questions, the contestant answered calmly.

答不上来.gloss: unable to answer, stumped for an answer

meanings.en: unable to answer, stumped for an answer
meanings.note: Potential complement after 答.

examples.text: 一会儿老板提问，谁要是答不上来就得请客。
examples.trans: When the boss asks questions later, anyone stumped buys dinner.

examples.text: 这个问题太专业了，一时半会儿真答不上来。
examples.trans: That question is so technical I cannot answer it offhand.

examples.text: 这是答复啊。
examples.trans: This is answer.

examples.text: 那个答复好。
examples.trans: That answer is good.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dā ying. Means agreeing to a request or giving one's word.

examples.text: 让我猜猜，你把没有的房间答应给别人了？
examples.trans: Let me guess: you promised someone a room we do not have?

examples.text: 既然答应了别人，就一定要准时做到。
examples.trans: Once you give someone your word, be sure to follow through on time.

examples.text: 那就请你们在这儿等我们的回复吧，花点时间你会得到答案的。
examples.trans: Then please wait right here for our formal reply — give us a little time and you will have your answer.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Media verb/noun cèhuà ('show concept/proposal; devise').

examples.text: 布小谷的策划比二部的更有新意。
examples.trans: Bu Xiaogu's proposal is fresher than Unit Two's.

examples.text: 我竟这样完成了自己的第一个策划。
examples.trans: That was how I completed my very first show proposal.

meanings.note: Compound noun cèhuà'àn ('formal proposal document').

examples.text: 以上就是我准备的全部策划案。
examples.trans: That concludes the full proposal I prepared.

examples.text: 今天为了这个策划案的事你说了这么多。
examples.trans: Today you spoke up at length for this show proposal.

meanings.note: Verb chóu ('raise funds').

examples.text: 粉丝在网上筹到了好多钱。
examples.trans: Fans raised a huge sum of money online.

examples.text: 他们正在为新电影筹集资金。
examples.trans: They are raising funds for a new film.

筹备.gloss: prepare and plan (an event or show)

meanings.en: prepare and plan (an event or show)
meanings.note: Organising logistics, scripts, and crew ahead of launch.

examples.text: 这档大型户外节目我们已经精心筹备了大半年。
examples.trans: We spent over half a year carefully planning this outdoor show.

examples.text: 晚会的各项筹备工作正在有条不紊地推进。
examples.trans: Preparations for the gala are advancing methodically.

meanings.note: Production noun chóubèiqī ('preparation stage').

examples.text: 新一季将在一个月后正式进入筹备期。
examples.trans: The new season enters pre-production in one month.

examples.text: 大型晚会的筹备期通常需要三个月以上。
examples.trans: Pre-production for a major gala usually takes over three months.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiān. Used for signing names, contracts, or delivery slips.

examples.text: 哈！你怕签了名字，倔脾气大哥就不出门了！
examples.trans: Aha! You feared that if you signed your name, stubborn big brother would stay home!

examples.text: 请在这份收据下面签上名字。
examples.trans: Please sign your name at the bottom of this receipt.

examples.text: 签个字，这是下一期闻娱论，我要让洛琳上这个节目跟她好好聊一聊！
examples.trans: Sign right here — for the next episode of my talk show, I'm bringing Luo Lin on air for a proper chat!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiān míng. Separable verb-object compound.

examples.text: 到星期五？没写名字，也没签名！
examples.trans: Until Friday? No name written, and no signature either!

examples.text: 请您在这张登记表右下角签名。
examples.trans: Please sign your name in the lower-right corner of this registration form.

meanings.note: Verb-object qiānzì ('affix a signature').

examples.text: 我这个公关总监签字就能生效。
examples.trans: My signature as PR director puts it into effect.

examples.text: 请在这份文件下面签字。
examples.trans: Please sign at the bottom of this document.

meanings.note: Corporate noun qiānzìhán ('official signed letter').

examples.text: 林姐拿到了布小谷送去的亲笔签字函。
examples.trans: Lin Jie received the signed authorization letter Xiaogu brought.

examples.text: 有了总监的签字函才能调动设备。
examples.trans: Equipment can only be moved with a director's signed letter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiān shōu. Used when signing for registered mail or packages.

examples.text: 邮递员刚让我签收的，上面盖着红色房产印章。
examples.trans: The postman just had me sign for it; it carries a red property-office stamp.

examples.text: 前台刚帮四号房客人签收了一个包裹。
examples.trans: Reception just signed for a parcel on behalf of Room Four.

meanings.note: Verb-object qiānyuē ('sign an agency or business contract').

examples.text: 我现在还没正式签约，不过也快了。
examples.trans: I have not formally signed a contract yet, though soon.

examples.text: 这位年轻歌手刚刚和东海签约。
examples.trans: This young singer just signed with Donghai.

meanings.note: Singer under contract with the show or label.

examples.text: 参加明晚总决赛的签约歌手已经全部到齐了。
examples.trans: All signed singers for tomorrow's finale have arrived.

examples.text: 唱片公司正在为几位新签约歌手录制专辑。
examples.trans: The label is recording albums for several newly signed singers.

meanings.note: Entertainer under exclusive management or show contract.

examples.text: 公司今年新招了好几位年轻的签约艺人。
examples.trans: The company signed several young artists this year.

examples.text: 改版方案对签约艺人的要求更高了。
examples.trans: The revamp plan places higher demands on signed artists.

examples.text: 可是前几年您与白石公司签订了一份合约，按照法律来讲，对您的权益是有所损害的。
examples.trans: Yet a few years ago you signed a contract with Baishi that legally infringed upon your own rights.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 惠美是我签进星天的，我责无旁贷，你放心。
examples.trans: I was the one who brought Huimei to Xingtian; it is my responsibility, so rest assured.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǎn dān. Everyday adjective for straightforward tasks.

examples.text: 挺起肩膀，志豪先生。记住那三句简单的话——我去开门！
examples.trans: Shoulders back, Mr Zhihao. Remember those three simple lines—I will open the gate!

examples.text: 这道炒蛋做法很简单，味道却极好。
examples.trans: This scrambled-egg recipe is simple, yet tastes wonderful.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǎn zhí. Emphatic adverb expressing enthusiastic amazement (简直无敌了 'simply unbeatable!').

examples.text: 杏仁挞底配上新鲜柠檬，味道简直无敌了！
examples.trans: Almond crust paired with fresh lemon is simply unbeatable!

examples.text: 擦亮玻璃后的阳光房简直像变了一间新屋子。
examples.trans: With the glass polished bright, the sunroom looks practically like a brand-new room.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǎn duǎn. Combines 简 ('simple/concise') + 短 ('short in length'), used for signs, messages, or speeches.

examples.text: 挂在街门上的欢迎木牌写得简短、温暖，又容易读。
examples.trans: The welcome sign hanging on the street gate is brief, warm, and easy to read.

examples.text: 小晴用简短清楚的几句话，把星期三的准备工作都记了下来。
examples.trans: In a few brief, clear sentences, Qing wrote down all the preparation tasks for Wednesday.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǎn jiǎn dān dān. AABB reduplication of 简单 ('simple'), emphasizing warmth, sincerity, and lack of fuss; takes 地 before verbs.

examples.text: 你们真的觉得，简简单单地招待客人就比念五页演讲稿更好吗？
examples.trans: Do you really think welcoming our guests nice and simply is better than reading a five-page speech?

examples.text: 一碗热扁豆汤配两片脆皮面包，简简单单却让人吃得心里暖洋洋的。
examples.trans: A bowl of hot lentil soup with two slices of crusty bread is simple and unpretentious, yet warms the heart.

meanings.note: Pinyin: suàn. Means 'calculate' or 'count as'.

examples.text: 明天早上八点，你们的第一杯小院咖啡算客栈请客！
examples.trans: And tomorrow morning at eight, your first courtyard coffees are on the house!

examples.text: 我算了一下，一共十五块钱。
examples.trans: I added it up—fifteen yuan in total.

examples.text: 那就算了。
examples.trans: Then forget it.

examples.text: 算了不去了。
examples.trans: Forget it, not going.

examples.text: 你听那个疯婆子胡说！我之所以拿这件事情做文章，就是因为我算准了全世界没有人能找到钟阳子！
examples.trans: Don't listen to that crazy woman's nonsense! The whole reason I built my trap around this song is that nobody on earth can find Zhong Yangzi!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

算得上.gloss: can be counted among, rank legitimately as

meanings.en: can be counted among, rank legitimately as
meanings.note: Idiomatic verb complement expressing fair high praise.

examples.text: 论海外节目引进经验，他在国内确实算得上一流高手。
examples.trans: In overseas format imports, he genuinely ranks among the top pros.

examples.text: 这档坚持了十年的读书栏目算得上台里的常青树。
examples.trans: Running ten years strong, this book show counts as a station evergreen.

examples.text: 这是算是啊。
examples.trans: This is counts as.

examples.text: 那个算是好。
examples.trans: That counts as is good.

meanings.note: Plotting behind someone's back for selfish gain.

examples.text: 把心思都花在算计同行上，永远做不出打动人心的好节目。
examples.trans: Spend all your energy scheming against peers and you will never make great TV.

examples.text: 真诚待人的团队从不屑于在背后算计别人。
examples.trans: An honest team never stoops to scheming behind people's backs.

meanings.note: Pinyin: suànhuà.

examples.text: 他是个说话算话的人。
examples.trans: He is a man of his word.

examples.text: 你答应过我的事情一定要算话。
examples.trans: You must keep your word regarding what you promised me.

meanings.note: Verb-object suànzhàng ('hold someone to account; tally a bill').

examples.text: 我现在就去找二部算账！
examples.trans: I am going to settle scores with Unit Two right now!

examples.text: 吃完饭咱们再去前台算账。
examples.trans: Let us pay the bill at the front desk after eating.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guǎn. As a verb, 'be in charge of / mind'; in compounds, 'pipe/tube' (水管).

examples.text: 房产信？让志豪和我看看——我管市政合同，他懂老建筑保护法！
examples.trans: A property letter? Let Zhihao and me see it—I handle municipal contracts, and he knows heritage building law!

examples.text: 前台钥匙归她一个人管。
examples.trans: The front-desk keys are in her charge.

meanings.note: Potential complement guǎnbuzhù ('cannot keep under control').

examples.text: 世上有两样东西是管不住的。
examples.trans: Two things in this world cannot be controlled.

examples.text: 别人怎么说，我们管不住。
examples.trans: We cannot control what other people say.

examples.text: 这事我管不着。
examples.trans: I cannot control this matter.

examples.text: 你管不着。
examples.trans: You have no say in this.

管事.gloss: run affairs, step in on matters

meanings.en: run affairs, step in on matters
meanings.note: Verb-object guǎnshì ('meddle or step in as manager').

examples.text: 你以为雷总平时不管事，心里就没数吗？
examples.trans: Do you think because Director Lei stays hands-off, she misses anything?

examples.text: 他是现场最管事的负责人。
examples.trans: He is the person truly in charge on set.
