管得着.gloss: have the authority/business to boss around

meanings.en: have the authority/business to boss around
meanings.note: Usually rhetorical (谁管得着 = who can control him?).

examples.text: 他现在名气这么大，一般人哪儿管得着他呀？
examples.trans: Now that he is such a big star, who can tell him what to do?

examples.text: 这是我自己的私事，外人可管不着，只有家人管得着。
examples.trans: This is my private matter—outsiders have no say in it.

meanings.note: Verb/noun guǎnlǐ ('manage; management').

examples.text: 在我管理的演播厅里，一切都很清楚。
examples.trans: In the studio I manage, I know every detail.

examples.text: 项目大，最忌讳的是管理分散。
examples.trans: Big projects cannot afford scattered management.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guǎn yòng. Colloquial stative adjective/verb 管 ('govern/take care of') + 用 ('use/function').

examples.text: 垫着枕头歇了两天真管用——今天一点也不疼了！
examples.trans: Resting two days propped on pillows really worked wonders—it doesn't hurt a bit today!

examples.text: 老陈修门窗的小办法简单又管用。
examples.trans: Chen's little tricks for fixing doors and windows are simple and effective.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiàn tóu. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个箭头 ('an arrow').

examples.text: 看这个箭头——指着走廊里的书架！
examples.trans: Look at this arrow—it points at the bookcase in the hallway!

examples.text: 跟着地上的箭头走，就能找到前台。
examples.trans: Follow the arrows on the floor and you will find the front desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiāng. Bound/free root of 箱子 ('chest/box/suitcase'), used in 木箱 ('wooden chest') and 工具箱 ('toolbox').

examples.text: 阁楼角落里放着一只带铜锁的旧木箱。
examples.trans: In the corner of the attic sits an old wooden chest with a brass lock.

examples.text: 这箱新鲜黄柠檬是今天早上刚从果园运来的。
examples.trans: This crate of fresh yellow lemons was brought straight from the orchard this morning.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiāng zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个箱子 ('a suitcase / box').

examples.text: 小晴，快看里面！这不是我的箱子！
examples.trans: Qing, look inside quickly! This is not my case!

examples.text: 告诉他们，我箱子上面口袋里有红丝带！
examples.trans: Tell them there is a red ribbon inside the top pocket of my case!

meanings.note: Classifier piān for articles and essays.

examples.text: 上一期录制的时候，这篇新闻出现了。
examples.trans: During the last taping, this news article appeared.

examples.text: 照您这意思，我这篇报道就写不成了？
examples.trans: By what you mean, can I not write this article after all?

meanings.note: Pinyin: lán zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个篮子 ('a basket').

examples.text: 篮子里正躺着六个黄柠檬呢——厨房就等今天了！
examples.trans: Six yellow lemons are sitting in my basket right now—this kitchen was waiting for today!

examples.text: 竹篮子里装着刚烤好的热面包卷。
examples.trans: Freshly baked warm bread rolls sit inside the bamboo basket.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mǐ. As a measure word after numbers, means 'meter' (十米 'ten meters'); as a noun, 'uncooked rice'.

examples.text: 等等——现在十米外的院子里坐着谁？
examples.trans: Wait—who is sitting ten metres away in our courtyard right now?

examples.text: 五金店就在前面五十米的地方。
examples.trans: The hardware store is fifty meters ahead.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mǐbái.

examples.text: 她穿了一件米白的毛衣。
examples.trans: She wore an off-white sweater.

examples.text: 墙壁被粉刷成了米白色。
examples.trans: The walls were painted off-white.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mǐ sè. Joins 米 ('rice') + 色 ('color'). Refers to the pale yellowish color of unpolished rice.

examples.text: 信封是用厚实的米色纸张做的，摸起来很有质感。
examples.trans: The envelope is made of thick beige paper and feels highly textured.

examples.text: 小美今天穿了一件米色的毛衣，显得特别温柔。
examples.trans: Mei wore a beige sweater today, making her look especially gentle.

meanings.note: Noun/classifier lèi ('genre, category').

examples.text: 歌手比赛类的节目我平时主要看两档。
examples.trans: Among singer-competition shows, I mostly watch two.

examples.text: 观众很喜欢看贴近生活的访谈类节目。
examples.trans: Viewers enjoy down-to-earth talk shows.

meanings.note: Category of television shows, films, or products.

examples.text: 预告片走红后，好几家电视台纷纷筹备同类型的新节目。
examples.trans: After the trailer went viral, several stations planned shows of the same genre.

examples.text: 观众渴望在荧屏上看到更多元、更新颖的节目类型。
examples.trans: Audiences want more diverse, refreshing programme genres on screen.

meanings.note: Short color adjective modifying clothes or decor.

examples.text: 为了迎接好消息，她特意穿了一件亮眼的粉外套上班。
examples.trans: Expecting good news, she wore a bright pink jacket to work.

examples.text: 春天来了，公园里的樱花开得粉嫩迷人。
examples.trans: Spring arrived, and cherry blossoms bloomed soft pink across the park.

examples.text: 他有很多粉丝。
examples.trans: He has many fans.

examples.text: 感谢粉丝的支持。
examples.trans: Thanks for the support from the fans.

meanings.note: Media noun fěnsītuán ('fan club').

examples.text: 连粉丝团的大人物你都不知道吗？
examples.trans: Do you not even know the leaders of the fan club?

examples.text: 歌手的粉丝团在场外整齐排队。
examples.trans: The singer's fan club queued neatly outside the venue.

meanings.note: Noun fěnsīquān ('the fan community').

examples.text: 他在整个粉丝圈里边很有影响力。
examples.trans: He holds major clout across fan circles.

examples.text: 这条消息很快在粉丝圈里传开了。
examples.trans: The news spread quickly through fan circles.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fěn shuā. Used for repainting exterior woodwork or walls.

examples.text: 多半是粉刷街边木窗那种无聊通知吧。
examples.trans: Probably some boring notice about painting the street shutters.

examples.text: 春天天气干爽，最适合粉刷外墙。
examples.trans: Dry spring weather is ideal for painting exterior walls.

meanings.en: Fentuan (name of the entertainment data company 粉团科技 Fentuan Technology); literally "fan club/group"
meanings.note: Fěntuán — coined from 粉丝团 (fěnsītuán, fan club); in the show, 粉团科技 is a fan-community and entertainment tech company.

examples.text: 小谷，你负责对接粉团科技。
examples.trans: Xiaogu, you are in charge of liaising with Fentuan Tech.

examples.text: 每次要请什么艺人，问问粉团科技的吉秀不就好了吗？
examples.trans: Every time we want to invite an artist, wouldn't it be fine to just ask Ji Xiu at Fentuan Tech?

meanings.note: Base makeup applied to even skin tone.

examples.text: 上镜之前化妆师先给她打了一层薄薄的粉底。
examples.trans: Before going on camera, the stylist applied light foundation.

examples.text: 这款粉底颜色很自然，一点儿也不显得厚重。
examples.trans: This foundation shade looks natural and never feels heavy.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fěn bǐ. Literally 'powder pen' (粉 + 笔). Measure word: 支 (zhī) or 根 (gēn).

examples.text: 小美用白粉笔在小黑板上写下今天的甜点。
examples.trans: Mei wrote today's desserts on the little blackboard in white chalk.

examples.text: 陶瓷摊的牌子上用粉笔写着“一打九折”。
examples.trans: Written in chalk on the pottery stall's sign is '10% off a dozen'.

meanings.note: Colour noun fěnhóngsè ('pink').

examples.text: 重点不要放在我的粉红色笔记本上！
examples.trans: Stop focusing on my pink notebook!

examples.text: 应援牌全都是醒目的粉红色。
examples.trans: The cheering signs were all bright pink.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a adj used in conversational Mandarin.

examples.text: 我有一个粗。
examples.trans: I have a 粗.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的粗。
examples.trans: This is a very good 粗.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cū táo. Compound 粗 ('coarse-grained/earthy') + 陶 ('pottery'): thick, high-fired stoneware prized for keeping tea hot.

examples.text: 粗陶茶杯拿在手里沉甸甸的，保温特别好。
examples.trans: A stoneware teacup feels reassuringly solid in the hand and holds heat wonderfully.

examples.text: 小晴挑了十二个奶白色的手工粗陶杯。
examples.trans: Qing picked out twelve handmade cream-white stoneware cups.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a verb used in conversational Mandarin.

examples.text: 我有一个粘。
examples.trans: I have a 粘.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的粘。
examples.trans: This is a very good 粘.

meanings.note: Noun jīnglì ('mental and physical energy').

examples.text: 老大投入的时间和精力就会无限量地多。
examples.trans: The time and energy our boss pours in becomes boundless.

examples.text: 她把全部精力都放在了新节目上。
examples.trans: She put all her energy into the new programme.

meanings.note: Noun jīnghuá ('the best part, essence').

examples.text: 一如既往，我们会保留一些节目的精华。
examples.trans: As always, we will preserve the finest elements of the show.

examples.text: 五分钟的集锦浓缩了整季比赛的精华。
examples.trans: The five-minute highlight reel distills the season's best.

精品.gloss: high-quality gem, flagship work of excellence

meanings.en: high-quality gem, flagship work of excellence
meanings.note: Used as noun or modifier for top-craft productions.

examples.text: 这档深度文化访谈是全组人用心打磨出来的口碑精品。
examples.trans: This cultural talk show is an acclaimed gem polished with care.

examples.text: 公司坚持走精品路线，绝不为迎合短期流量降低标准。
examples.trans: The company sticks to flagship quality rather than chasing cheap clicks.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jīng cǎi. Praises a great performance, story, or reaction.

examples.text: 等周经理听说他为分贝慌了一整夜，表情一定精彩！
examples.trans: Wait until Manager Zhou hears he panicked all night over decibels!

examples.text: 昨晚音乐厅的钢琴二重奏太精彩了！
examples.trans: Last night's piano duet at the concert hall was brilliant!

meanings.note: Aromatic plant oil used in massage and aromatherapy.

examples.text: 她对好几种花草精油过敏，用之前一定要看配方。
examples.trans: She is allergic to several floral essential oils, so check the formula.

examples.text: 睡前点几滴薰衣草精油有助于放松安神。
examples.trans: A few drops of lavender essential oil before bed help one relax.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jīng què. Combines 精 ('fine/meticulous') + 确 ('accurate/exact').

examples.text: 切胡萝卜丁和洋葱丁需要精确的刀工，交给建筑师志豪最合适了！
examples.trans: Dicing carrots and onions calls for precise knife work, making architect Hao the ideal person for the job!

examples.text: 钟表匠修理齿轮的时候，每一个动作都非常精确。
examples.trans: When a watchmaker repairs gears, every single movement is remarkably precise.

meanings.note: Noun jīngshén ('essential spirit; energy').

examples.text: 老子五千言，核心的精神是辩证二字。
examples.trans: The core spirit of Laozi's text lies in dialectics.

examples.text: 喝完一杯浓咖啡，大家又打起了精神。
examples.trans: After strong coffee, everyone perked right up.

meanings.note: Noun jīngyīng ('cream of the crop, elite').

examples.text: 星天总编室的精英团队果然名不虚传。
examples.trans: Xingtian's elite editorial team truly lives up to its fame.

examples.text: 这次盛典集合了全公司各部门的业务精英。
examples.trans: The gala brought together top talent from every unit.

meanings.note: Colloquial verb hùnong ('do slipshod work, brush off').

examples.text: 我办事什么时候糊弄过呀？
examples.trans: When have I ever cut corners on a task?

examples.text: 对待观众绝对不能糊弄。
examples.trans: Never cut corners when serving the audience.

meanings.note: Colloquial noun phrase hútushì ('foolish mistake').

examples.text: 我做事向来我行我素，但从来不做糊涂事。
examples.trans: I do things my own way, yet I never commit foolish blunders.

examples.text: 越是着急的时候越要冷静，别做糊涂事。
examples.trans: Stay calm when rushed so you do not make foolish mistakes.

meanings.note: Pinyin: táng. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块糖 ('a piece of candy / sugar cube').

examples.text: 请给我不加糖的红茶，再来一片热面包。
examples.trans: Black tea without added sugar, please, and one slice of warm bread.

examples.text: 太好了！请加牛奶和一点糖。
examples.trans: Wonderful! With milk and a little sugar, please.

related.gloss: a piece of candy / sugar cube (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a noun used in conversational Mandarin. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个糖浆 ('a 糖浆').

examples.text: 我有一个糖浆。
examples.trans: I have a 糖浆.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的糖浆。
examples.trans: This is a very good 糖浆.

meanings.note: Pinyin: táng fěn. Measure word (量词): 层 (céng), e.g. 一层糖粉 ('a dusting of powdered sugar').

examples.text: 他爷爷会切热柠檬蛋糕，上面撒一层白糖粉！
examples.trans: His grandfather sliced warm lemon cake with a dusting of powdered sugar on top!

examples.text: 趁蛋糕还温热，在上面筛一层白糖粉。
examples.trans: While the cake is still warm, dust white powdered sugar on top.

related.gloss: a dusting of powdered sugar (measure word 层)

meanings.note: Pinyin: táng shuāng. Measure word (量词): 层 (céng), e.g. 一层糖霜 ('a layer of frosting').

examples.text: 啊！黄色柠檬糖霜——每个星期五我们俩都抢边角那一块！
examples.trans: Oh! Yellow lemon glaze—every single Friday the two of us fought over the corner piece!

examples.text: 正在架子上放凉呢——金黄外皮配甜柠檬糖霜！
examples.trans: Cooling on the rack right now—golden crust with sweet lemon glaze!

related.gloss: a layer of frosting (measure word 层)

meanings.note: Pinyin: zāo le. Spoken exclamation when realizing a mistake.

examples.text: 糟了！周经理，小晴，厨房出急事了！
examples.trans: Oh no! Manager Zhou, Qing, we have a kitchen emergency!

examples.text: 糟了，我把雨伞忘在出租车上了！
examples.trans: Oh no, I left my umbrella in the taxi!

meanings.note: Colloquial northern word for vexing situations or people.

examples.text: 他自嘲说幸好对方没有自己这么让人糟心的弟弟。
examples.trans: He joked that luckily she had no worrisome younger brother like him.

examples.text: 接连不断的突发状况真是让人觉得既疲惫又糟心。
examples.trans: Non-stop emergencies left everyone exhausted and exasperated.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zāo gāo. Exclamation when something goes wrong; as an adjective it means 'terrible' (天气很糟糕).

examples.text: 糟糕——我听到小美在厨房里叫我们！
examples.trans: Uh-oh—I can hear Mei calling us from the kitchen!

examples.text: 糟糕，我忘了带钥匙！
examples.trans: Oh no, I forgot to bring my key!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jì. Read jì when tying shoelaces, ribbons, or luggage tags (系着一张纸牌).

examples.text: 旁边的把手上系着一张小纸牌。
examples.trans: There is a small paper card tied on the side handle.

examples.text: 出门以前先把鞋带系紧。
examples.trans: Tie your shoelaces tight before heading out.

examples.text: 这是一系列活动。
examples.trans: This is a series of events.

examples.text: 他写了一系列文章。
examples.trans: He wrote a series of articles.

meanings.note: Noun xìtǒng ('system').

examples.text: 星天的职位系统很健全。
examples.trans: Xingtian's position system is well structured.

examples.text: 电脑系统今天刚刚升级。
examples.trans: The computer system was upgraded today.

examples.text: 王尔实在是太狡猾了，他趁着我们去年系统升级的时候钻了这个空子。
examples.trans: Wang Er was remarkably cunning; he exploited a gap during our internal system upgrade last autumn.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sù miáo. Measure word (量词): 幅 (fú) or 张 (zhāng). Joins 素 ('plain, white') + 描 ('to trace, to draw').

examples.text: 卡片背面是一幅用木炭画的建筑素描。
examples.trans: On the back of the card is a charcoal sketch of a building.

examples.text: 志豪大学时经常带着速写本在老街画素描。
examples.trans: In college, Hao often took his sketchbook to the old street to draw sketches.

meanings.note: Production noun sùcái ('recorded raw video/audio material').

examples.text: 拍摄素材外流是行业大忌。
examples.trans: Leaking raw footage is a major industry taboo.

examples.text: 剪辑师正在整理昨晚的直播素材。
examples.trans: The editor is sorting last night's broadcast footage.

meanings.note: Studio noun sùcáifáng ('vault/room storing footage drives').

examples.text: 快把这八块硬盘放回素材房。
examples.trans: Put these eight hard drives right back in the archive room.

examples.text: 进入素材房必须先登记。
examples.trans: Entering the media archive room requires signing in.

meanings.note: Noun sùzhì ('personal conduct/calibre').

examples.text: 往别人衣服上抹脏东西，就这素质还当艺人呢？
examples.trans: Wiping dirt on someone's coat—calling himself an artist with manners like that?

examples.text: 遇到突发状况不慌乱体现了专业团队的高素质。
examples.trans: Staying calm in emergencies shows a crew's high calibre.

meanings.note: Pinyin: suǒ dà diào. Combines solfège note 索 ('Sol / G') + 大调 ('major key'): G major.

examples.text: 宋老师从容地按下了琴键，弹出一串明亮温暖的索大调和弦。
examples.trans: Teacher Song calmly pressed the keys, playing a bright, warm G-major chord.

examples.text: 周经理姑姑写的那首《小院圆舞曲》正是用欢快的索大调写成的。
examples.trans: The 'Courtyard Waltz' written by Manager Zhou's aunt was composed in bright G major.

examples.text: 据悉，诉讼包括歌曲利润所得三倍以上的天价索赔，以及星天娱乐公开道歉。
examples.trans: Reports say the lawsuit demands triple-profit damages along with a formal public apology from Xingtian Entertainment.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jǐn. Describes tightening a valve (拧紧) or a tight schedule.

examples.text: 当心那把角落椅子，等十秒我拧紧螺丝。
examples.trans: Mind that corner chair—wait ten seconds while I tighten the screw.

examples.text: 小晴，把床单角塞紧！放上两个软枕头。
examples.trans: Qing, tuck the sheet corner tight! On go the two soft pillows.

meanings.note: Describes partnerships, schedules, or logic.

examples.text: 制作中心与各大卫视长期保持着非常紧密的合作关系。
examples.trans: The production center maintains close partnerships with major networks.

examples.text: 只有台前幕后紧密配合，大型直播才能万无一失。
examples.trans: Only tight coordination onstage and backstage makes live TV seamless.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jǐn zhāng. Describes stage fright or first-day nerves.

examples.text: 声音轻，很有礼貌，大概三十多岁，有点紧张。
examples.trans: Soft-spoken, very polite, around thirty-something, and a bit nervous.

examples.text: 为了一个木头小火车紧张？这事越来越怪了。
examples.trans: Nervous over a wooden toy train? This story gets stranger by the hour.

meanings.note: Military phrase used playfully for calling teammates together fast.

examples.text: 她发了一条消息把两位搭档叫到休息区紧急集合。
examples.trans: She sent a message summoning both partners for an urgent huddle.

examples.text: 听到导演喊紧急集合，全体场务立刻跑到舞台前集合。
examples.trans: Hearing the director call an urgent huddle, the crew gathered at once.

紧挨.gloss: be right next to; sit flush beside

meanings.en: be right next to; sit flush beside
meanings.note: Pinyin: jǐn āi. Combines 紧 ('tightly/closely') + 挨 ('be next to'), usually followed by 着.

examples.text: 现在请按一下紧挨着哆音的那个琴键。
examples.trans: Now please press the piano key right next to C.

examples.text: 咖啡角紧挨着洒满阳光的小院子。
examples.trans: The café corner sits right next to the sunlit courtyard.

examples.text: 时间紧迫。
examples.trans: Time is urgent.

examples.text: 任务紧迫。
examples.trans: The task is urgent.

meanings.note: Noun jǐnpògǎn ('feeling of urgency').

examples.text: 逃亡这个词既有游戏性，而且还有紧迫感。
examples.trans: The word escape feels playful and carries real urgency.

examples.text: 倒计时铃声一响，全场的紧迫感立刻拉满了。
examples.trans: Once the countdown bell rang, urgency filled the studio.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lèi. Describes physical fatigue after travel or work.

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, room four on the second floor! Was the train ride tiring?

examples.text: 坐了一上午火车，您一定累了吧？
examples.trans: After riding the train all morning, you must be tired.

meanings.note: Formal verb paired with 错误 or 偏差.

examples.text: 她希望等真相证明之后，公司能够及时纠正这个错误。
examples.trans: She hoped that once proven right, the company would correct this mistake.

examples.text: 录音师在彩排时耐心帮年轻歌手纠正发音细节。
examples.trans: During rehearsal the sound engineer helped the singer correct pronunciation.

examples.text: 你甭纠结，他基本上不会记得你是谁。
examples.trans: Do not agonise over it — he basically will not remember who you are.

examples.text: 你甭纠结，他基本上不会记得你是谁。
examples.trans: Do not agonise over it — he basically will not remember who you are.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hóng. Describes the color red; note that 红茶 is what English calls 'black tea'.

examples.text: 告诉他们，我箱子上面口袋里有红丝带！
examples.trans: Tell them there is a red ribbon inside the top pocket of my case!

examples.text: 我的行李箱！快打开上面口袋……对，红丝带！
examples.trans: My suitcase! Let me open the top pocket... yes, the red ribbon!

meanings.note: Noun hóngtǎn ('red carpet at ceremonies').

examples.text: 红毯仪式和媒体组织由台里负责。
examples.trans: The red-carpet ceremony and press are run by the network.

examples.text: 嘉宾们陆续走上红毯。
examples.trans: Guests walked onto the red carpet one after another.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hóng sè. Measure word (量词): 种 (zhǒng), e.g. 一种红色 ('a shade of red').

examples.text: 邮递员刚让我签收的，上面盖着红色房产印章。
examples.trans: The postman just had me sign for it; it carries a red property-office stamp.

examples.text: 大门口挂着两盏喜庆的红色灯笼。
examples.trans: Two festive red lanterns hang at the front gate.

related.gloss: a shade of red (measure word 种)

meanings.note: Pinyin: hóng chá. Measure word (量词): 杯 (bēi), e.g. 一杯红茶 ('a cup of black tea').

examples.text: 宋老师早！您想喝咖啡还是红茶？
examples.trans: Morning, Teacher Song! Would you like coffee or black tea?

examples.text: 请给我不加糖的红茶，再来一片热面包。
examples.trans: Black tea without added sugar, please, and one slice of warm bread.

related.gloss: a cup of black tea (measure word 杯)

meanings.note: Noun hóngjiǔ ('red wine').

examples.text: 那家会所收藏的红酒味道还不错。
examples.trans: The red wine served at that private club is quite good.

examples.text: 庆功宴上大家举起红酒共同庆祝首播成功。
examples.trans: At the wrap party everyone raised red wine to toast launch night.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuē. Used for arranging a meeting time or meal.

examples.text: 约他星期五中午在这儿见面吗？
examples.trans: Asking him to meet you here on Friday at noon?

examples.text: 我约了老朋友明天中午喝茶。
examples.trans: I arranged to meet an old friend for tea tomorrow at noon.

meanings.note: Noun/verb yuēhuì ('social date or personal appointment').

examples.text: 我今天晚上还有个约会，没那工夫。
examples.trans: I have an appointment tonight and cannot spare the time.

examples.text: 你今晚跟谁约会啊？
examples.trans: Who is your date with tonight?

meanings.note: Verb/noun yuēdìng ('agreed terms; arrange').

examples.text: 约定之外的制作项目我们实在没法兼顾。
examples.trans: We cannot juggle extra projects beyond what was agreed.

examples.text: 大家按照事先的约定准时在茶馆见面。
examples.trans: Everyone met promptly at the teahouse as agreed.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jí. Counts steps of a staircase (十八级台阶 'eighteen steps') or star ratings.

examples.text: 安静极了！他坐在第三级台阶上，听每一个音符。
examples.trans: So quiet! He sat on the third step, listening to every single note.

examples.text: 天哪……看这双眼睛！第三级台阶上的小志豪？！
examples.trans: Good heavens... look at those eyes! Little Zhihao from the third step?!

meanings.note: Noun jíbié ('official rank or tier').

examples.text: 请问三部的制片都是什么级别？
examples.trans: May I ask what rank Unit Three's producers hold?

examples.text: 这次会议的级别非常高。
examples.trans: This meeting is high-level.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jìniànrì. Measure word: 个.

examples.text: 明天是他们的结婚纪念日。
examples.trans: Tomorrow is their wedding anniversary.

examples.text: 这个节日是用来作为一个重要历史事件的纪念日。
examples.trans: This holiday serves as a memorial day for an important historical event.

examples.text: 这是纯啊。
examples.trans: This is pure.

examples.text: 那个纯好。
examples.trans: That pure is good.

meanings.note: Adjective chúnshú ('masterful, practised').

examples.text: 二位的演技比专业演员还纯熟。
examples.trans: Your acting is even more polished than real actors.

examples.text: 摄像师手法纯熟，镜头切换非常流畅。
examples.trans: With practiced skill, the camera operator switched shots smoothly.

meanings.note: Noun pīlòu ('careless slip or omission').

examples.text: 就算星天出了什么纰漏，也有时间修改。
examples.trans: Even if Xingtian makes a slip-up, there will be time to fix it.

examples.text: 直播流程核对了三遍，确保不出半点纰漏。
examples.trans: The live rundown was checked thrice so zero slips occur.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张纸 ('a sheet of paper').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

related.gloss: a sheet of paper (measure word 张)

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ bāo. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个纸包 ('a paper packet').

examples.text: 先生？他说：请别打开白纸包，我星期五中午来。
examples.trans: Sir? He says: Please do not open the white paper parcel; I will come Friday at noon.

examples.text: 甚至星期二您还打电话提过白纸包的事！
examples.trans: Even after you called us on Tuesday about the white parcel!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ zhāng. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng) or 叠 (dié). Joins 纸 ('paper') + 张 (classifier for flat objects).

examples.text: 这些纸张虽然有些褪色，但依然保存完好。
examples.trans: Although this paper has somewhat faded, it is still perfectly preserved.

examples.text: 小晴把桌上的纸张叠得整整齐齐。
examples.trans: Qing folded the paper on the table neatly.

meanings.en: slip of paper; short written note
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ tiáo. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张纸条 ('a paper slip / note').

examples.text: 他留了纸条，请我们保管到星期五。
examples.trans: He left a note asking us to keep it until Friday.

examples.text: 对。我一慌，按了门铃，把星期五纸条贴在把手上。
examples.trans: Yes. In a panic I rang the bell and taped the Friday note onto the handle.

related.gloss: a paper slip / note (measure word 张)

examples.text: 傍晚时分，廊檐下挂起了一排温暖的红纸灯笼。
examples.trans: At dusk, a row of warm red paper lanterns was hung beneath the eaves.

examples.text: 小美亲手在纸灯笼上画了几枝淡雅的梅花。
examples.trans: Mei painted a few delicate plum branches on the paper lantern by hand.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ pái. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张纸牌 ('a paper card / tag').

examples.text: 旁边的把手上系着一张小纸牌。
examples.trans: There is a small paper card tied on the side handle.

examples.text: 趁着阳光亮，我能再看看那张小纸牌吗？
examples.trans: While the sunlight is bright, may I look at that small paper tag again?

related.gloss: a paper card / tag (measure word 张)

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ xiāng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个纸箱 ('a cardboard box').

examples.text: 只有三个小纸箱！最多四个！
examples.trans: Only three small cardboard boxes! Four at most!

examples.text: 四个纸箱五分钟就能搬走。现在就上去看！
examples.trans: We can move four boxes in five minutes. Let's go up and look right now!

meanings.note: Adjective zhǐzhì ('paper-based, printed').

examples.text: 纸质的书容易弄脏，看之前先洗手。
examples.trans: Paper books get dirty easily, so wash up before reading.

examples.text: 现在很多人还是喜欢阅读纸质书。
examples.trans: Many people today still love reading printed books.

纹丝不动.gloss: not budge a single hair; stay completely still

meanings.en: not budge a single hair; stay completely still
meanings.note: Pinyin: wén sī bú dòng. Vivid four-character idiom: 纹丝 ('a fine thread') + 不动 ('does not move'); bù shifts to bú before dòng.

examples.text: 周经理使劲拉了一下生锈的窗板，窗板却纹丝不动。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou pulled hard on the rusty shutter, but it didn't budge a millimetre.

examples.text: 大风吹过院子，厚重的石桌依然纹丝不动。
examples.trans: Strong wind blew across the courtyard, yet the heavy stone table didn't budge at all.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàn. Measure word (量词): 根 (gēn) or 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一根线 ('a wire / thread').

examples.text: 墙里的旧布线已经老化，老陈全换成了新铜线。
examples.trans: The old cloth-wrapped wire inside the wall had aged, so Chen replaced it all with new copper wire.

examples.text: 妈妈用一根白棉线把掉下来的扣子缝好了。
examples.trans: Mum sewed the fallen button back on with a length of white cotton thread.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàn tiáo. Measure word (量词): 根 (gēn). Joins 线 ('thread, line') + 条 ('strip').

examples.text: 罗盘上的线条刻画得非常精细。
examples.trans: The lines on the compass are engraved with exquisite detail.

examples.text: 他用铅笔勾勒出几根简单的线条，一座小院的轮廓就出来了。
examples.trans: He outlined a few simple lines with a pencil, and the silhouette of a courtyard emerged.

meanings.note: Noun xiànsuǒ ('investigative lead').

examples.text: 是你们自己走漏了风声，才让我有了线索。
examples.trans: Your own leak was what gave me the lead.

examples.text: 记者顺着这条小线索查清了来龙去脉。
examples.trans: Following that small lead, the reporter pieced it together.

meanings.note: Verb liàn ('practise a skill').

examples.text: 要么你就好好练练你的厨艺。
examples.trans: Either you practise your cooking skills properly...

examples.text: 为了唱好高音，歌手每天在琴房练四个小时。
examples.trans: To nail the high notes, the singer practises four hours daily.

examples.text: 上大学的时候，为了练习做节目。
examples.trans: Back in university, I wanted practice organizing a live program.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.en: production crew; unit; working team; group
meanings.note: zǔ — in film/TV production, shorthand for 节目组 (show crew) or 剧组 (film/drama crew), e.g., 进组 / 上组 (join a production crew), 现场组 (floor/on-site team); also used as a classifier for sets or teams (三组导演 three teams of directors).

examples.text: 我去那儿当实习生，就能上《十二歌王》的组。
examples.trans: If I go there as an intern, I can join the production crew of Twelve Kings of Song.

examples.text: 电视台同步了全流程，三组导演已经全部就位。
examples.trans: The TV station synced the full rundown, and all three director teams are in position.

meanings.note: Noun/verb zǔzhī ('organization; arrange').

examples.text: 红毯仪式和媒体组织由台里负责。
examples.trans: The red carpet and press organization belong to the network.

examples.text: 学生会正在组织周末的活动。
examples.trans: The student union is organizing weekend events.

examples.text: 现在就需要问一下台下的这位绅士，淳于乔先生。
examples.trans: Now we just need to ask the gentleman seated below the stage — Mr Chun Yuqiao.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xì. Describes slender tools (细镊子 'thin tweezers'), fine grit (细砂纸), or careful work.

examples.text: 明天早上给我一把细镊子和一点木工胶水就行。
examples.trans: Just give me thin tweezers and a little woodworking glue tomorrow morning.

examples.text: 春天的细雨轻轻落在院子的常春藤叶上。
examples.trans: Fine spring rain fell softly onto the ivy leaves in the courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xì xiǎo. Combines 细 ('slender/fine') + 小 ('small').

examples.text: 那根细小的黄铜轴销从木头里滑出来了一半。
examples.trans: That tiny brass hinge pin slipped halfway out of the wood.

examples.text: 老陈戴上眼镜，仔细检查每一个细小的零件。
examples.trans: Chen put on his glasses and carefully inspected every tiny part.

examples.text: 这是细节啊。
examples.trans: This is details.

examples.text: 那个细节好。
examples.trans: That details is good.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhōng yú. Expresses relief or accomplishment when something long awaited happens.

examples.text: 把大难题分成三件小事，周经理终于能松口气了！
examples.trans: With the big problem divided into three small jobs, Manager Zhou could finally breathe again!

examples.text: 锁了三十年的木头窗板今天终于重新打开了。
examples.trans: The wooden shutters locked for thirty years finally swung open again today.

终结.gloss: bring to a permanent end, terminate

meanings.en: bring to a permanent end, terminate
meanings.note: Strong, dramatic verb for ending an era or rival project.

examples.text: 他暗下狠心，想要借电视台之手让那档节目彻底终结。
examples.trans: He resolved to use network brass to terminate that show for good.

examples.text: 这场酣畅淋漓的胜利终结了对手连续三年的收视垄断。
examples.trans: That decisive win ended the rival's three-year ratings monopoly.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bàn dǎo. Joins 绊 ('to trip, to stumble') + 倒 ('to fall, to topple').

examples.text: 老陈没注意脚下的台阶，差点被绊倒。
examples.trans: Chen didn't notice the step under his feet and almost tripped and fell.

examples.text: 黑暗中，志鹏被一卷粗粗的麻绳绊倒了。
examples.trans: In the dark, Peng tripped over a thick coil of hemp rope.

meanings.note: Verb/noun jīnglì ('experience, live through').

examples.text: 无法想象一个人经历了多少困难。
examples.trans: It is hard to imagine how much one person has been through.

examples.text: 这段工作经历非常宝贵。
examples.trans: This work experience is very valuable.

meanings.note: Adverb jīngcháng ('frequently').

examples.text: 我经常听小谷在办公室说起您。
examples.trans: I often hear Xiaogu speak about you in the office.

examples.text: 总编室经常在深夜开会讨论新方案。
examples.trans: The editorial office often meets late at night on pitches.

meanings.note: In 经济问题, specifically refers to financial/accounting impropriety.

examples.text: 账目不清的经济问题在任何正规公司都是绝对红线。
examples.trans: Murky financial dealings are a strict red line at any proper company.

examples.text: 文化产业的蓬勃发展为城市注入了新的经济活力。
examples.trans: Booming cultural industries injected fresh economic vitality into the city.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jīng lǐ. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位经理 ('a manager').

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

examples.text: 放心吧，周经理。房间干净，毛巾也是新的。
examples.trans: Relax, Manager Zhou. The room is clean, and the towels are fresh.

meanings.note: Noun jīngjì ('artist management').

examples.text: 过了几天没有经纪公司的日子还挺轻松。
examples.trans: A few days without a management company felt relaxing.

examples.text: 东海是业内规模最大的经纪公司。
examples.trans: Donghai is the largest talent agency in the industry.

meanings.note: Showbiz noun jīngjìrén ('artist's manager').

examples.text: 你做我经纪人这么多年了。
examples.trans: You have been my manager for so many years.

examples.text: 您好，我是李先生的经纪人。
examples.trans: Hello, I am Mr Li's manager.

meanings.note: Company representing singers and actors.

examples.text: 那家经纪公司旗下有很多著名歌手。
examples.trans: That talent agency represents many famous singers.

examples.text: 制作组正在跟各大经纪公司沟通档期。
examples.trans: The production team is coordinating schedules with talent agencies.

meanings.note: Entertainment noun jīngjì hétong ('management contract').

examples.text: 一份经纪合同让整个律师团队死磕。
examples.trans: One agency contract has their whole legal team grinding away.

examples.text: 签经纪合同之前一定要逐条看清条款。
examples.trans: Read every clause carefully before signing an agency contract.

meanings.note: Refers to the agency representing an artist in negotiations.

examples.text: 合同细节还需要跟艺人的经纪方确认。
examples.trans: Contract details still need confirmation with the artist's agency.

examples.text: 几个大牌歌手的经纪方态度都很谨慎。
examples.trans: The management teams for several stars are very cautious.

meanings.note: Showbiz noun jīngjìbù ('artist management unit').

examples.text: 星天经纪部一直没有什么起色。
examples.trans: Xingtian's talent-management unit has struggled to take off.

examples.text: 新签约的歌手归经纪部负责。
examples.trans: Newly signed singers fall under talent management.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jīng guò. Describes walking past a landmark.

examples.text: 对，过了桥，右手边会经过一家绿药店。
examples.trans: Right, after crossing the bridge, you pass a green pharmacy on your right.

examples.text: 过桥，右边经过绿药店。然后呢？
examples.trans: Cross the bridge, green pharmacy on the right. And after that?

meanings.en: experience; practical knowledge gained from doing
meanings.note: jīngyàn — refers to accumulated skill or know-how (e.g., 有经验 experienced, 工作经验 work experience), distinct from 经历 (jīnglì), which refers to personal life events one has lived through.

examples.text: 不要老想着自己是实习生没经验。
examples.trans: Stop always thinking that you are an intern with no experience.

examples.text: 多亏咱们提前做好了准备，杏子姐，还是你有经验。
examples.trans: Thankfully we prepared in advance — Xingzi, you really do have the experience.

related.gloss: personal experience; what one has lived through

meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎng. Action verb for tying herbs, parcels, or cords into a bundle with string or ribbon.

examples.text: 小美教志鹏用细棉绳绑好两小枝新鲜香草，做成香草束放进汤锅。
examples.trans: Mei showed Peng how to tie two small sprigs of fresh herbs with fine cotton string to make a herb bundle for the soup pot.

examples.text: 老陈把修剪下来的树枝整整齐齐绑成一捆，放在院子角落。
examples.trans: Chen tied the pruned branches neatly into a bundle and set them in the corner of the courtyard.

meanings.note: Holding someone captive by force.

examples.text: 警方正在全力核实失踪人员是否遭到了绑架。
examples.trans: Police are checking whether the missing persons were kidnapped.

examples.text: 这部悬疑电影讲述了一场惊心动魄的跨国绑架案。
examples.trans: This thriller tells the story of a gripping abduction case.

meanings.note: Pinyin: róng bù. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài) or 匹 (pǐ). Joins 绒 ('fluff, down') + 布 ('cloth').

examples.text: 盒子里垫着一块深红色的软绒布。
examples.trans: The box was lined with a piece of dark red soft velvet.

examples.text: 宋老师的钢琴上盖着一块防尘的黑绒布。
examples.trans: Teacher Song's piano is covered with a black velvet dust cloth.

examples.text: 把侯总的账结了。
examples.trans: Please settle the gentleman's tab on our way out.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Verb jiéhé ('combine').

examples.text: 勇气和青春结合到一起，就有一个字：傻！
examples.trans: Combine courage and youth together and you get one word: foolish!

examples.text: 新舞台把传统戏曲与现代电子乐巧妙结合起来。
examples.trans: The new stage artfully blends traditional opera with synth pop.

examples.text: 她就是结婚了对吧，还是隐婚？
examples.trans: Could she really have gotten married in secret?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiē shi. Note first tone jiē + neutral shi ('solidly built').

examples.text: 有，结实的木床、干净书桌，风景全院最好。
examples.trans: Yes, a solid wooden bed, a clean desk, and the best view in the courtyard.

examples.text: 好位置。两把结实椅子，朝着花草，别朝着大堂窗户。
examples.trans: Good spot. Two sturdy chairs, facing the plants rather than the lobby window.

结尾.gloss: ending; finale (of a song, book, or film)

meanings.en: ending; finale (of a song, book, or film)
meanings.note: Pinyin: jié wěi. Noun 结 ('tie up/conclude') + 尾 ('tail/end').

examples.text: 这首星期五圆舞曲的结尾应该温暖又从容。
examples.trans: The ending of this Friday waltz should feel warm and unhurried.

examples.text: 故事的结尾让每个人都露出了微笑。
examples.trans: The ending of the story brought a smile to everyone's face.

meanings.note: Noun jiéjú ('how a story or dispute ends').

examples.text: 谁也没想到最后竟然结局大反转。
examples.trans: Nobody expected such a dramatic twist at the end.

examples.text: 大家都希望这个温暖的故事有个好结局。
examples.trans: Everyone hopes this warm story gets a happy ending.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jié shù. Verb meaning to come to an end or finish an event/piece.

examples.text: 到了傍晚六点，这首圆舞曲该怎么结束呢？
examples.trans: When six in the evening arrives, how should this waltz end?

examples.text: 星期五的音乐会将在晚上九点温暖结束。
examples.trans: Friday's concert will come to a warm close at nine in the evening.

meanings.note: Noun jiégòu ('organizational or script structure').

examples.text: 你们公司内部到底是什么管理结构啊？
examples.trans: How is your company structured internally?

examples.text: 修改以后，整期节目的叙事结构更紧凑了。
examples.trans: After revisions, the episode's structure is tighter.

meanings.en: as a result; as it turned out; outcome
meanings.note: Pinyin: jié guǒ. Introduces an unexpected outcome or final result.

examples.text: 星期五之前我想在附近找个安静地方，结果不好意思要回箱子！
examples.trans: I needed a quiet place nearby before Friday, and honestly felt too shy to ask for my bag!

examples.text: 以为今天会下雨，结果出了一整天太阳。
examples.trans: We thought it would rain today, and as it turned out the sun shone all day.

meanings.note: Noun jiélùn ('final conclusion').

examples.text: 这件事情今天已经有了正式的官方结论。
examples.trans: This matter already has an official conclusion today.

examples.text: 没有调查清楚之前不要轻易下结论。
examples.trans: Never jump to conclusions before checking the facts.

examples.text: 几天前我确实是单身，没有处在任何情感关系中，更没有结过婚。
examples.trans: Up until a few days ago I really was single — not in any relationship, and certainly never married.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 上个月你三天绕地球飞了一整圈，回来开电话会议，中文英文一个字没错过。
examples.trans: Last month you flew around the globe in three days and took a bilingual conference call without missing a single word!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Verb-complement ràokāi ('bypass someone, detour around').

examples.text: 邓主任已经绕开孙总，直接找我们一部。
examples.trans: Director Deng bypassed Mr Sun to come straight to Unit One.

examples.text: 写策划不能绕开最核心的预算问题。
examples.trans: A proposal cannot skirt the core issue of budget.

绕过.gloss: bypass, go around (an obstacle or person in the chain)

meanings.en: bypass, go around (an obstacle or person in the chain)
meanings.note: Going over someone's head or detouring around.

examples.text: 他居然想绕过项目负责人，直接找电视台高层施压。
examples.trans: He actually tried bypassing the project head to pressure network brass.

examples.text: 为了避开拥堵路段，司机绕过市中心走外环赶往机场。
examples.trans: To avoid traffic, the driver bypassed downtown on the ring road.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gěi. As main verb, 'give'; as preposition/complement, marks the recipient (给你 'for/to you', 递给我 'pass to me').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

给面子.gloss: show respect, do someone the honour

meanings.en: show respect, do someone the honour
meanings.note: Verb-object phrase gěi miànzi ('grant face/honour').

examples.text: 淳于先生肯来赴约，真是很给面子呀。
examples.trans: Coming to keep our appointment truly does me great honour.

examples.text: 大牌嘉宾亲自到场支持，非常给节目组面子。
examples.trans: The star guest attended in person, showing great respect.

meanings.note: Emphatic adverb jué ('absolutely never').

examples.text: 论文明天绝不能再推迟了。
examples.trans: The thesis absolutely cannot be delayed past tomorrow.

examples.text: 我绝不会放弃自己的梦想。
examples.trans: I will never give up on my dream.

meanings.note: Emphatic negation juébù ('absolutely will not').

examples.text: 老大康复之前，工作上的事我们绝不打扰他。
examples.trans: Until our boss recovers, we will never bother him with work.

examples.text: 在节目品质上，一部绝不敷衍了事。
examples.trans: On show quality, Unit One never cuts corners.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jué duì. Strong emphatic adverb.

examples.text: 而且大哥想装作镇定的时候，绝对不会早到。
examples.trans: Besides, when older brothers want to act calm, they never arrive early.

examples.text: 用咸黄油炒出来的鸡蛋绝对香！
examples.trans: Scrambled eggs made with salted butter are guaranteed to smell amazing!

meanings.note: Adjective/verb juéwàng ('in despair, having lost hope').

examples.text: 刚出家门就被大雨困住，我简直已经绝望了。
examples.trans: Trapped by pouring rain right outside home, I had given up hope.

examples.text: 越是在看似绝望的逆境里，越能激发出惊人创意。
examples.trans: Seemingly hopeless setbacks often spark the boldest ideas.

meanings.note: Adverb/adj tǒngyī ('uniformly, centrally').

examples.text: 节目组其他的艺人都是统一住在驻地酒店。
examples.trans: All the other artists on the show are housed together uniformly.

examples.text: 所有外景工作人员统一穿印有台标的深色马甲。
examples.trans: All location crew wear matching vests bearing the logo.

统一口径.gloss: align talking points, give one unified story

meanings.en: align talking points, give one unified story
meanings.note: Idiom/workplace phrase tǒngyī kǒujìng ('keep everyone on the same message').

examples.text: 那件事你们公司内部早就统一口径了吧？
examples.trans: Your company already aligned its talking points on that, right?

examples.text: 新闻发布会前公关部先跟各方统一口径。
examples.trans: Before the press briefing, PR aligned everyone's message.

统辖.gloss: govern, exercise direct authority over multiple units

meanings.en: govern, exercise direct authority over multiple units
meanings.note: Formal verb describing executive jurisdiction.

examples.text: 前任首席内容官凭实力统辖公司旗下的四个制作部。
examples.trans: The former CCO oversaw all four production departments on merit.

examples.text: 集团调整架构后，各事业部不再由一人统一统辖。
examples.trans: After restructuring, business units were no longer under one person.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jì xù. Followed directly by another verb or used alone.

examples.text: 先别灰心坐下！继续往街角看。
examples.trans: Do not sit down discouraged yet! Keep looking toward the street corner.

examples.text: 喝口热茶休息五分钟，我们再继续整理。
examples.trans: Take a five-minute tea break, and then we will carry on tidying.

续住.gloss: extend one's stay (at an inn or hotel)

meanings.en: extend one's stay (at an inn or hotel)
meanings.note: Pinyin: xù zhù. Hospitality compound 续 ('continue/renew') + 住 ('stay/lodge').

examples.text: 等等——宋老师，您想在我们这儿续住吗？！
examples.trans: Wait—Teacher Song, you want to extend your stay here with us?!

examples.text: 四号房的客人非常喜欢院子里的琴声，决定再续住两个星期。
examples.trans: The guest in Room Four loved the courtyard music so much she decided to extend her stay by two weeks.

examples.text: 杏子，十二歌王什么时候续约啊？我们整个经纪团队可都等着呢！
examples.trans: Xingzi, when are we renewing our Twelve Singers contract? Our whole management team is waiting!

examples.text: 亲爱的何总，咱们之前不是说艺人没档期不续约了吗？
examples.trans: Didn't we hear earlier that your artist had no open dates and wouldn't be renewing?

meanings.note: Media noun fēiwén ('romantic or tabloid gossip').

examples.text: 大众关心的是艺人之间的绯闻。
examples.trans: What the public follows is gossip among stars.

examples.text: 他从来不理会网上的绯闻。
examples.trans: He never pays attention to online gossip.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shéng. General noun for twisted cord or twine (细绳 'fine string/twine', 棉绳 'cotton string'); measure word: 根 (gēn) or 条 (tiáo).

examples.text: 用一根干净的厨房细绳把百里香和欧芹绑在一起，煮完汤方便捞出来。
examples.trans: Tie the thyme and parsley together with a clean piece of kitchen twine so they are easy to lift out after simmering.

examples.text: 木牌上面系着一根结实的麻绳，正好可以挂在大门口的铁钩上。
examples.trans: A sturdy hemp cord is tied to the top of the wooden sign so it hangs right on the iron hook outside the gate.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shéng zi. Measure word (量词): 根 (gēn) or 条 (tiáo).

examples.text: 包裹外面用一根粗糙的麻绳子紧紧缠着。
examples.trans: The parcel was tightly wrapped on the outside with a rough hemp rope.

examples.text: 小美找来一根红色的短绳子，把礼盒系上。
examples.trans: Mei found a short red string and tied up the gift box.

meanings.note: Keeping order, stability, or relationships intact.

examples.text: 特殊时期大家更要齐心协力维持制作部门的正常运转。
examples.trans: In tough times everyone must pull together to keep the unit running.

examples.text: 靠短期噱头很难长久维持一档节目的高收视率。
examples.trans: Short-term gimmicks rarely sustain high ratings for long.

examples.text: 这是综艺啊。
examples.trans: This is variety.

examples.text: 那个综艺好。
examples.trans: That variety is good.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǜ. Describes green leaves, doors, or green tea.

examples.text: 好。端上去之前，在上面撒这些新鲜绿香草。
examples.trans: Good. Before serving them, sprinkle these fresh green herbs on top.

examples.text: 对，过了桥，右手边会经过一家绿药店。
examples.trans: Right, after crossing the bridge, you pass a green pharmacy on your right.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǜ yè. Combines 绿 ('green') + 叶 ('leaf'); measure word: 片 (piàn).

examples.text: 小晴在每个小玻璃花瓶里插了一片新鲜的绿叶，显得格外清雅。
examples.trans: Qing placed a single fresh green leaf in each small glass vase, looking wonderfully simple and elegant.

examples.text: 春雨过后，院子老树上的绿叶在阳光下闪闪发亮。
examples.trans: After the spring rain, the green leaves on the old courtyard tree glistened in the sunlight.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǜ sè. Measure word (量词): 种 (zhǒng), e.g. 一种绿色 ('a shade of green').

examples.text: 小美，帮我把这些绿色的大书放到椅子上。
examples.trans: Mei, help me put these big green books on the chair.

examples.text: 她穿了一件绿色的外套。
examples.trans: She is wearing a green coat.

related.gloss: a shade of green (measure word 种)

meanings.note: Pinyin: huǎn màn. Combines 缓 ('unhurried/gradual') + 慢 ('slow').

examples.text: 圆舞曲的最后几小节节奏温柔缓慢。
examples.trans: The final few bars of the waltz have a gentle, slow tempo.

examples.text: 乌云在傍晚的天空上缓慢地移动。
examples.trans: Dark clouds drifted slowly across the evening sky.

meanings.note: Softening tension, insomnia, or pressure.

examples.text: 轻柔的按摩能有效缓解演出后的失眠和疲劳。
examples.trans: Gentle massage effectively eases post-concert insomnia and fatigue.

examples.text: 加开临时班车缓解了观众散场时的交通压力。
examples.trans: Extra shuttle buses eased traffic pressure as the crowd left.

meanings.note: Verb biān ('make up a story; weave, edit').

examples.text: 淳于总可真会编故事啊。
examples.trans: Mr Chun Yuqiao really knows how to make up stories.

examples.text: 别编借口骗大家了。
examples.trans: Stop making up excuses.

examples.text: 我们也会尽快地找出事情的缘由，然后给大家一个说法。
examples.trans: We will get to the bottom of how this happened as quickly as possible and give the public a clear answer.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chán. Action of winding or binding something around an object.

examples.text: 细细的金线缠在卡片的边缘。
examples.trans: A fine gold thread is wrapped around the edge of the card.

examples.text: 那只小猫被毛线球缠住了爪子，正急得喵喵叫。
examples.trans: The little cat had its paws tangled in the ball of yarn and was meowing anxiously.

meanings.note: Pinyin: suō xiě. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个缩写 ('an initial / abbreviation').

examples.text: 看拉链旁边……对，有她的名字缩写！
examples.trans: Check beside the zipper... yes, her name initials are here!

examples.text: 等一下……梧桐巷十二号，角落里还写着两个童年名字的首字母！
examples.trans: Wait a moment... Number twelve, Wutong Lane, with two childhood initials written in the corner!

meanings.en: lack; be short of; be missing
meanings.note: Pinyin: quē. Describes what is still missing from a room or recipe (还缺什么 'what is still missing').

examples.text: 干燥、暖和、安静。快说还缺什么。
examples.trans: Dry, warm, and quiet. Tell me quickly what is still missing.

examples.text: 做柠檬蛋糕还缺两个鸡蛋。
examples.trans: We are still two eggs short for making the lemon cake.

meanings.note: Missing a needed quality such as innovation or experience.

examples.text: 跟风模仿的节目往往缺乏真正的原创活力。
examples.trans: Copycat shows invariably lack genuine creative vitality.

examples.text: 他虽然年轻，但并不缺乏大型直播的实战经验。
examples.trans: Though young, he does not lack live-broadcast experience.

meanings.note: Pinyin: quē shǎo. Combines 缺 ('be short of/incomplete') + 少 ('few/missing').

examples.text: 宋老师主动提出补写乐谱上缺少的十六个小节。
examples.trans: Teacher Song offered to write the sixteen missing bars on the score.

examples.text: 这锅番茄汤味道不错，只是还缺少一点点盐。
examples.trans: This pot of tomato soup tastes good; it is just missing a tiny pinch of salt.

meanings.note: Sharp colloquial criticism of unethical conduct.

examples.text: 造谣中伤同行、欺骗老年消费者真是太缺德了。
examples.trans: Smearing peers and defrauding elderly consumers lacks basic decency.

examples.text: 做节目要有良心，绝不能为了博眼球干缺德事。
examples.trans: Producers must have a conscience and never do indecent things for clicks.

罐.gloss: jar of; pot of; tin of

meanings.en: jar of; pot of; tin of
meanings.note: Pinyin: guàn. Serves both as a noun (罐子 'jar/crock') and as a measure word for jars or tins (两罐蜂蜜 'two jars of honey').

examples.text: 竹篮子里装着两罐沉甸甸的百花蜂蜜。
examples.trans: Packed inside the bamboo basket are two heavy jars of wildflower honey.

examples.text: 小美做了四小罐草莓果酱放在厨房架子上。
examples.trans: Mei made four small jars of strawberry jam and set them on the kitchen shelf.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guàn zi. Combines 罐 ('jar/pot/canister') + noun suffix 子; measure word: 个 (gè) or 只 (zhī).

examples.text: 厨房架子上整整齐齐摆着两个装白糖和海盐的白瓷罐子。
examples.trans: Two white ceramic jars holding sugar and sea salt sit neatly on the kitchen shelf.

examples.text: 小晴把刚烤好的杏仁饼干装进密封玻璃罐子里，防止受潮。
examples.trans: Qing packed the freshly baked almond biscuits into an airtight glass jar to keep them crisp.

examples.text: 他经常上网。
examples.trans: He often goes online.

examples.text: 网络很好。
examples.trans: The network is very good.

meanings.note: Place noun wǎngshàng.

examples.text: 现在网上大家只看热闹。
examples.trans: Online nowadays, everyone just watches the drama.

examples.text: 网上有很多新闻。
examples.trans: There is lots of news online.

meanings.note: Internet noun wǎngyǒu ('fellow internet user').

examples.text: 很多热心网友都在微博上自发转帖帮忙。
examples.trans: Countless warm-hearted netizens are sharing rescue posts online.

examples.text: 节目弹幕里网友们的实时评论既犀利又好笑。
examples.trans: Live bullet-screen comments from netizens are sharp and funny.

meanings.note: Collective noun wǎngmín ('netizens at large').

examples.text: 通过直播呼吁所有网民共同关注暴雨灾情。
examples.trans: Use the livestream to urge internet users everywhere to heed the storm.

examples.text: 这则暖心短视频一夜间引发了数百万网民共鸣。
examples.trans: Overnight that heartwarming clip resonated with millions online.

meanings.note: Noun wǎngzhàn ('website').

examples.text: 原野的官方网站都被挤爆了。
examples.trans: Yuanye's official website crashed from traffic.

examples.text: 今晚星天的网站差一点也挂了。
examples.trans: Xingtian's website nearly went down tonight too.

examples.text: 这是网络啊。
examples.trans: This is internet.

examples.text: 那个网络好。
examples.trans: That internet is good.

meanings.note: Pinyin: luó pán. Measure word (量词): 面 (miàn) or 个 (gè). Joins 罗 ('net, to gather') + 盘 ('plate, tray').

examples.text: 抽屉深处藏着一面古董航海罗盘。
examples.trans: Hidden deep in the drawer is an antique nautical compass.

examples.text: 制图员教授当年就是用这面罗盘在山里测绘的。
examples.trans: The mapmaker professor used this very compass to survey in the mountains back in the day.

罪责.gloss: blame, culpability, responsibility for a fault

meanings.en: blame, culpability, responsibility for a fault
meanings.note: Formal noun paired with 承担 ('bear the blame').

examples.text: 为了保住整个团队，他一个人默默承担了延播的罪责。
examples.trans: To shield the whole crew, he quietly bore the blame for the delay.

examples.text: 事实还没查清之前，不该把所有罪责都推给一个人。
examples.trans: Before facts are clear, full blame should not be pinned on one person.

署名.gloss: put one's name on credits, sign

meanings.en: put one's name on credits, sign
meanings.note: Verb-object shǔmíng ('carry creator credit').

examples.text: 新版的文娱论，他决定不准备署名。
examples.trans: On the revamped talk show, he declines to put his name.

examples.text: 每一期节目片尾都会为全体工作人员署名。
examples.trans: End credits list the names of the entire crew.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yáng máo. Measure word (量词): 团, e.g. 一团羊毛 ('a ball of wool').

examples.text: 您看，这件软羊毛开衫是全新的，试试吧。
examples.trans: Look, this soft wool cardigan is brand-new; try it on.

examples.text: 这条灰色围巾是用纯羊毛织成的。
examples.trans: This gray scarf is knitted from pure wool.

related.gloss: a ball of wool (measure word 团)

meanings.note: Pinyin: yáng máo zhān. Combines 羊毛 ('sheep's wool') + 毡 ('pressed felt'), prized inside acoustic pianos for warm tone.

examples.text: 立式钢琴的琴槌头上包着厚实柔软的羊毛毡。
examples.trans: The heads of an upright piano's hammers are wrapped in thick, soft wool felt.

examples.text: 钢琴不过是实在的木头、羊毛毡和钢丝。
examples.trans: A piano is simply honest wood, wool felt, and steel wire.

meanings.note: Pinyin: měi. Core stative adjective for visual, musical, or atmospheric beauty (美极了 'sounds/looks wonderful!').

examples.text: 在这间玻璃房里听您轻轻哼出旋律，真是美极了！
examples.trans: Hearing you hum the melody softly in this glass room is truly wonderful!

examples.text: 傍晚亮起灯笼的小院子特别美。
examples.trans: The little courtyard lit with lanterns at dusk is especially beautiful.

meanings.note: Pinyin: měihǎo.

examples.text: 童年的记忆总是美好的。
examples.trans: Childhood memories are always beautiful.

examples.text: 祝你有一个美好的未来。
examples.trans: I wish you a bright and beautiful future.

meanings.note: Pinyin: měi miào. Praises music, mornings, or delightful moments.

examples.text: 我？哦，我只是喜欢准时！七点十四分真美妙！
examples.trans: Me? Oh, I simply love punctuality! Seven fourteen is a lovely minute!

examples.text: 清晨院子里的鸟叫声真是美妙。
examples.trans: Morning birdsong in the courtyard is truly lovely.

examples.text: 这是美式啊。
examples.trans: This is American-style.

examples.text: 那个美式好。
examples.trans: That American-style is good.

meanings.note: Formal noun měiyù ('honourable praise').

examples.text: 您给我的这个美誉，真让我受宠若惊。
examples.trans: High praise like that from you truly flatters me.

examples.text: 这档文化访谈在业内一直享有零差评的美誉。
examples.trans: This cultural talk show enjoys a spotless reputation.

meanings.note: Classifier qún for a group of people.

examples.text: 是我的一群朋友约我跟老大出去喝酒。
examples.trans: A group of my friends invited me and our boss out.

examples.text: 演播厅门口围着一群热情的年轻观众。
examples.trans: A crowd of enthusiastic young viewers gathered outside.

examples.text: 其实找到钟阳子不是我的功劳，是公司全部的同事群策群力，才帮公司渡过难关。
examples.trans: Honestly, finding Zhong Yangzi wasn't my solo credit — every colleague in the company pooled their strength to help us weather the crisis.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fān. Used for flipping open a notebook (翻开) or doubling an amount (翻一倍).

examples.text: 当然不能偷看……咦，自己翻开在中间那页了！
examples.trans: Of course we must not peek... oh, it fell open to the middle page by itself!

examples.text: 昨晚您的本子在柜台翻开了，我们看到九分……
examples.trans: Last night your notebook fell open on the counter, and we saw nine points...

翻来覆去.gloss: over and over, front to back

meanings.en: over and over, front to back

examples.text: 别查了，翻来覆去查了好几遍了，没有。
examples.trans: Stop searching; I checked the pages front to back over and over, and it isn't there.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

翻江倒海.gloss: churning like overturned seas, in turmoil

meanings.en: churning like overturned seas, in turmoil
meanings.note: Idiom fānjiāng-dǎohǎi ('roiling tumult').

examples.text: 这么一改，各方老板心里可就翻江倒海了。
examples.trans: A shake-up like this has every boss's stomach churning.

examples.text: 上台领奖那一刻，他心里激动得翻江倒海。
examples.trans: Stepping up for the award, his heart churned with emotion.

meanings.note: Noun/verb fānyì ('interpreter; translate').

examples.text: 现在现场翻译没了，今天还怎么录啊？
examples.trans: With our on-set interpreter gone, how can we tape today?

examples.text: 你刚才那几句泰语翻译得非常地道。
examples.trans: Those lines of Thai you just translated were spot-on.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǎo. Describes longtime friends, historic lanes, or warm respect before a colleague's surname (老陈).

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 所以老房子自己会打招呼？
examples.trans: So the old house says hello by itself?

meanings.note: Colloquial noun lǎodōngjia ('one's previous company').

examples.text: 原野毕竟是老东家，我不想太伤他们。
examples.trans: Yuanye is my former label after all; I hate to hurt them.

examples.text: 离开老东家以后，他创立了新工作室。
examples.trans: After leaving his former firm, he started a studio.

meanings.note: Colloquial noun phrase lǎojiāoqing ('old friendship').

examples.text: 跟电视机前的老朋友们都是老交情了。
examples.trans: With old friends watching at home, our bond goes way back.

examples.text: 凭着多年的老交情，这位名嘴一口答应来帮忙。
examples.trans: Out of old friendship, the star host readily agreed to help.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǎo rén. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位老人 ('an older person').

examples.text: 声音客气吗？年轻人还是老人？
examples.trans: Was the voice polite? A young person or an older person?

examples.text: 巷子里的老人们早上爱聚在一起喝茶。
examples.trans: Seniors along the lane love gathering for morning tea.

meanings.note: Colloquial noun lǎodìfang ('our usual meeting spot').

examples.text: 好，那咱们晚上老地方见。
examples.trans: Alright, see you tonight at the usual place.

examples.text: 下班后同事们约在街角的老地方聚餐。
examples.trans: After work coworkers met for dinner at their usual spot.

examples.text: 老城区的青石板路在雨后格外安静。
examples.trans: The cobblestone streets of the old town are especially quiet after the rain.

examples.text: 许多游客专门来老城区探访这些保存完好的四合院。
examples.trans: Many visitors come specifically to the old town to explore these well-preserved courtyard houses.

examples.text: 这是老大啊。
examples.trans: This is boss.

examples.text: 那个老大好。
examples.trans: That boss is good.

meanings.note: Colloquial noun lǎotiān ('good heavens').

examples.text: 我求求老天赶快派个人来照顾老大吧！
examples.trans: I am begging heaven to send someone to care for our boss!

examples.text: 谢老天，今晚的户外直播没有下雨。
examples.trans: Thank goodness it did not rain during tonight's broadcast.

meanings.note: Colloquial noun lǎotóu ('old fellow', playful or blunt).

examples.text: 你才是老头呢，我们家闻老师哪儿老了？
examples.trans: You are the old guy — how is Wen Simo old at all?

examples.text: 那位精神抖擞的老头是退休的老台长。
examples.trans: That spirited older gentleman is the retired station head.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǎo shī. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位老师 ('a teacher').

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, room four on the second floor! Was the train ride tiring?

examples.text: 宋老师，怎么了？您按了门铃！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, what happened? You rang the bell!

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǎo dì. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个老弟 ('a younger brother').

examples.text: 倔了三年……说实话，老弟，我也想你。
examples.trans: Three stubborn years... honestly, little brother, I missed you too.

examples.text: 老弟，你到底撞进了一家什么神奇客栈？
examples.trans: Little brother, what kind of magical inn did you stumble into?

老方.gloss: Old Fang (familiar address for Mr. Fang)

meanings.en: Old Fang (affectionate or familiar form of address for a peer or senior colleague surnamed Fang)
meanings.note: Lǎo Fāng — formed with the prefix 老 + surname, standard in Mandarin among friends, classmates, and longtime colleagues to signal warmth and familiarity.

examples.text: 老方，这批学生里有没有苗子好的？
examples.trans: Old Fang, are there any promising talents in this batch of students?

examples.text: 我跟老方认识十几年了，他的为人我最清楚。
examples.trans: I have known Old Fang for over ten years; I know his character best.

related.gloss: Little Fang (address for a younger person surnamed Fang)

meanings.note: Pinyin: láo bǎn. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位老板 ('a boss / shop owner').

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

examples.text: 老板正在开锁呢！别挂电话，等我一秒钟。
examples.trans: The owner is unlocking it right now! Stay on the phone, wait one second.

related.gloss: a boss / shop owner (measure word 位)

meanings.note: Colloquial noun phrase lǎomáobìng ('old recurring complaint').

examples.text: 胃疼是老毛病了，已经三年了。
examples.trans: Stomach pain is an old ailment I have had for three years.

examples.text: 一紧张就语速加快是不少新主持人的老毛病。
examples.trans: Speaking too fast when nervous is a classic rookie habit.

meanings.note: Adjective lǎopái ('veteran, time-honoured').

examples.text: 他是一位堂堂的老牌歌星。
examples.trans: He is a celebrated veteran pop star.

examples.text: 这是一家老牌制作公司。
examples.trans: This is a long-established production firm.

meanings.note: Behaving properly without playing tricks.

examples.text: 别再耍大牌了，老老实实配合导演组录节目吧。
examples.trans: Stop acting like a diva and record the show properly with the crew.

examples.text: 犯了错就要老老实实承认，不要找借口。
examples.trans: When you make a mistake, own up honestly without excuses.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǎo huā jìng. Combines 老花 ('presbyopia / farsightedness of middle age') + 镜 ('glasses/lenses'); measure word: 副 (fù).

examples.text: 周经理摸了摸额头问：“等等——我的老花镜现在是不是又架在额头上？”
examples.trans: Manager Zhou felt his forehead and asked, 'Wait—are my reading glasses perched up on my forehead again right now?'

examples.text: 老陈看细小的钢琴零件时，总会从口袋里拿出那副老花镜戴上。
examples.trans: Whenever Chen inspects tiny piano parts, he takes that pair of reading glasses out of his pocket and puts them on.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǎo jiē. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条老街 ('an old street').

examples.text: 凉？啊——对！老街水管早上需要慢慢热身！
examples.trans: Cool? Ah—yes! Old-street water pipes need a gentle morning warm-up!

examples.text: 傍晚亮灯以后，整条老街好看极了。

examples.trans: The hardware store's phone number is written on the back of the receipt.

related.gloss: the back of a sheet (measure word 面)

胜任.gloss: be fully qualified for, be equal to (a role or post)

meanings.en: be fully qualified for, be equal to (a role or post)
meanings.note: Formal verb taking a job or role as object.

examples.text: 无论论演技还是敬业态度，他都完全能够胜任男主角。
examples.trans: In both craft and dedication, he is fully equal to the leading role.

examples.text: 扎实的专业训练让她很快就胜任了高级制作人的工作。
examples.trans: Solid training soon enabled her to excel as a senior producer.

meanings.note: Noun shèngdì ('famous or favourite spot').

examples.text: 这家酒吧就是同事们的吐槽胜地。
examples.trans: This lounge is colleagues' favourite go-to spot for venting.

examples.text: 杭州是著名的旅游胜地。
examples.trans: Hangzhou is a famous scenic destination.

meanings.note: Adverb húluàn ('wildly, without care').

examples.text: 没有制止他胡乱吃药是我们的失误。
examples.trans: Failing to stop him taking pills carelessly was our error.

examples.text: 别在纸上胡乱画画。
examples.trans: Do not scribble carelessly on the paper.

examples.text: 我怎么会胡思乱想呢，我不会的。
examples.trans: How could I ever harbor wild ideas — I never would.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hú luó bo. Combines 胡 ('introduced via Central Asia/Silk Road') + 萝卜 ('radish/root vegetable'); final syllable is neutral tone; measure word: 根 (gēn).

examples.text: 志豪菜板上的每一颗胡萝卜丁都切得一模一样。
examples.trans: Every single cube of diced carrot on Hao's chopping board is cut identically.

examples.text: 把胡萝卜和洋葱用橄榄油炒香，煮出来的红扁豆汤颜色金黄。
examples.trans: Sautéing carrots and onions in olive oil gives the simmered red lentil soup a golden glow.

examples.text: 你听那个疯婆子胡说！我之所以拿这件事情做文章，就是因为我算准了全世界没有人能找到钟阳子！
examples.trans: Don't listen to that crazy woman's nonsense! The whole reason I built my trap around this song is that nobody on earth can find Zhong Yangzi!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Idiom húshuōbādào ('spout baseless nonsense').

examples.text: 他只会故意不理，任由他们胡说八道。
examples.trans: He will ignore them and let them talk nonsense.

examples.text: 没有证据的事千万别在节目上胡说八道。
examples.trans: Never spout unproven claims on a broadcast.

meanings.note: Verb húnào ('make mischief, carry on wildly').

examples.text: 你就由着她这么胡闹啊？
examples.trans: You just let her carry on with a stunt like that?

examples.text: 直播现场纪律严明，谁也不能胡闹。
examples.trans: Studio discipline is strict; nobody may fool around.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gē bo. Everyday spoken noun for the arm (shoulder to wrist); second syllable is neutral tone.

examples.text: 那本绿色的旧登记本不就夹在你胳膊底下吗？
examples.trans: Isn't that old green guest book tucked right under your arm?

examples.text: 抬了四扇厚木窗板，我的两条胳膊都有点酸了。
examples.trans: After carrying four thick wooden shutters, both my arms are a bit sore.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiāo dài. Compound 胶 ('glue/rubber') + 带 ('tape/ribbon'). Measure word: 卷 (juǎn, 'roll').

examples.text: 老陈用黑胶带把电线接头一圈一圈包紧。
examples.trans: Chen wrapped the wire splice tightly turn by turn with black tape.

examples.text: 打包瓷器的时候，箱子外面要多贴两道胶带。
examples.trans: When packing crockery, put a couple of extra strips of tape around the outside of the box.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiāo shuǐ. Combines 胶 ('glue/resin') + 水 ('liquid').

examples.text: 老陈用一滴木工胶水把松动的毛毡轴套粘牢了。
examples.trans: Chen used a tiny drop of woodworking glue to secure the loose felt bushing.

examples.text: 等胶水完全干透以后，再试着按一下琴键。
examples.trans: Wait until the glue dries completely before testing the piano key.

meanings.note: Pinyin: néng. Expresses practical ability or whether circumstances allow something (能睡个好觉).

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

examples.text: 今晚我应该能睡个好觉了。
examples.trans: Tonight I should be able to sleep well after all.

meanings.note: Noun nénglì ('skill, competence').

examples.text: 大家都认可淳于总的节目制作能力很强。
examples.trans: Everyone agrees Chun Yuqiao has strong production skills.

examples.text: 独立带项目最能锻炼新人的综合能力。
examples.trans: Leading a project builds a newcomer's all-round skills.

meanings.note: Modal verb nénggòu ('can, be capable of').

examples.text: 这样做既能够体现价值，又很实在。
examples.trans: Doing this can reflect values while staying practical.

examples.text: 他总觉得自己能够掌控全场。
examples.trans: He always feels capable of steering the whole show.

meanings.note: Adjective nénggàn ('able and efficient').

examples.text: 你们总编室的团队真是非常能干。
examples.trans: Your team in the chief editor's office is truly capable.

examples.text: 新调来的助理策划既细心又能干。
examples.trans: The newly transferred assistant planner is sharp and able.

meanings.note: Noun néngliàng ('influence/clout; energy').

examples.text: 我就是一小助理呗，哪有那么大能量啊。
examples.trans: I am just a junior assistant—how could I have that much clout?

examples.text: 她的笑容总是能给整个团队带来满满的正能量。
examples.trans: Her smile always brings warm energy to the whole crew.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a adj used in conversational Mandarin.

examples.text: 我有一个脆。
examples.trans: I have a 脆.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的脆。
examples.trans: This is a very good 脆.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cuì pí. Combines 脆 ('crisp/crunchy') + 皮 ('crust/skin'), especially for artisanal bread (脆皮面包 'crusty bread').

examples.text: 下雨的下午，一碗浓番茄汤配热脆皮面包最舒服了。
examples.trans: On a rainy afternoon, a bowl of rich tomato soup with warm crusty bread is pure comfort.

examples.text: 刚烤好的法式脆皮面包一掰开就咔嚓响。
examples.trans: Freshly baked crusty bread crackles crisp when broken open.

meanings.note: zāng — functions both as a stative adjective (手脏了 hands got dirty) and as a resultative complement after verbs like 弄 or 搞 (弄脏 get something dirty). Note the homograph 脏 (zàng, internal organ).

examples.text: 小谷，对不起啊，把你的本子都弄脏了。
examples.trans: Xiaogu, I am so sorry — I got your notebook all dirty.

examples.text: 那贾喆上午手脏了，他伸手就往我衣服上抹！
examples.trans: That Jia Zhe got dirt on his hand this morning and wiped it straight onto my coat!

related.gloss: to get something dirty; to soil

examples.text: 泼脏水。
examples.trans: Pour dirty water / Slander.

examples.text: 水很脏。
examples.trans: The water is very dirty.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǎo zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个好脑子 ('a sharp mind').

examples.text: 脑子转得快，小晴。志豪每星期都读城市建筑规定。
examples.trans: Quick thinking, Qing. Hao reads city building rules every single week.

examples.text: 遇到突发急事，她的脑子反而更清醒。
examples.trans: In a sudden pinch, her mind grows even sharper.

meanings.note: Lower extremity of the leg.

examples.text: 蹲了太久，我的脚都有点麻了。
examples.trans: After squatting so long, my foot went a bit numb.

examples.text: 走了一整天路，脚特别酸。
examples.trans: After walking all day, my feet are really sore.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǎo xià. Built from 脚 ('foot') + 下 ('under'); 小心脚下 is the standard 'watch your step'.

examples.text: 宋老师，小心脚下。请帮我叠这块白布。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, watch your step. Please help me fold this white sheet.

examples.text: 楼梯很窄，请小心脚下。
examples.trans: The stairs are narrow, so please watch your step.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǎo hòu gēn. Compound 脚 ('foot') + 后跟 ('back heel'); measure word: 个 (gè) or 只 (zhī).

examples.text: 志鹏在小美的脚后跟底下垫了两个结实的枕头，让她舒服地靠着。
examples.trans: Peng propped two firm pillows beneath Mei's heel so she could rest comfortably.

examples.text: 穿新皮鞋走远路的时候，要注意别磨破了脚后跟。
examples.trans: When walking a long way in new leather shoes, be careful not to blister your heels.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǎo bù shēng. Measure word (量词): 阵, e.g. 一阵脚步声 ('the sound of footsteps').

examples.text: 快点——我刚听到二楼楼梯有脚步声！
examples.trans: Hurry—I just heard footsteps on the second-floor stairs!

examples.text: 木楼梯上传来轻轻的脚步声。
examples.trans: Light footsteps sounded on the wooden stairs.

related.gloss: the sound of footsteps (measure word 阵)

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǎo zhǐ. Combines 脚 ('foot') + 趾 ('toe/digit of the foot'); measure word: 个 (gè) or 根 (gēn).

examples.text: 小美动了动脚趾说：“脚趾动得好好的，骨头一点没事！”
examples.trans: Mei wiggled her toes and said, 'My toes move just fine—nothing broken at all!'

examples.text: 冬天穿上一双厚羊毛袜，连脚趾头都是暖乎乎的。
examples.trans: Put on a pair of thick wool socks in winter and even your toes stay toasty warm.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǎo huái. Combines 脚 ('foot') + 踝 ('ankle joint'); measure word: 只 (zhī) or 个 (gè).

examples.text: 志鹏关心地问：“小美，今天早上你的脚踝感觉怎么样？”
examples.trans: Peng asked warmly, 'Mei, how does your ankle feel this morning?'

examples.text: 休息了一天半以后，小美扭伤的脚踝已经消肿，到星期五就能站起来了。
examples.trans: After a day and a half of rest, Mei's sprained ankle has gone down in swelling and she will be able to stand by Friday.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tuō. Opposite of 穿; often pairs with 掉 (脱掉 'take off').

examples.text: 坐下吧，志鹏，脱掉厚外套，看看这个蓝色行李箱。
examples.trans: Sit down, Zhipeng, take off your heavy coat, and look at this blue suitcase.

examples.text: 进屋很暖和，把厚外套脱掉吧。
examples.trans: It is warm inside—take off your heavy coat.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liǎn. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张脸 ('a face').

examples.text: 宋老师，您一脸惊讶！您认识梧桐巷十二号吗？
examples.trans: Teacher Song, you look amazed! Do you know Number twelve, Wutong Lane?

examples.text: 他用温水洗了一把脸。
examples.trans: He washed his face with warm water.

meanings.note: Locative noun liǎnshàng ('on one's face').

examples.text: 谢谢您没把杯子往我们脸上摔。
examples.trans: Thank you for not throwing the cup in our faces.

examples.text: 她脸上露出了开心的笑容。
examples.trans: A happy smile appeared on her face.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liǎn sè. Measure word (量词): 种 (zhǒng), e.g. 一种脸色 ('a facial expression').

examples.text: 周经理！您脸色全白了！快坐下——信上写了什么？
examples.trans: Manager Zhou! Your face went completely white! Sit down quickly—what does the letter say?

examples.text: 睡了一觉起来，您的脸色好多了。
examples.trans: After a good sleep, you look much more refreshed.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pí qi. Measure word (量词): 种 (zhǒng), e.g. 一种脾气 ('a temperament').

examples.text: 哈！你怕签了名字，倔脾气大哥就不出门了！
examples.trans: Aha! You feared that if you signed your name, stubborn big brother would stay home!

examples.text: 老木匠手艺好，脾气也特别温和。
examples.trans: The veteran carpenter has fine craft and a gentle temperament.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nì. Describes desserts or rich food that feel overly heavy or cloying; 一点也不腻 ('not cloying at all') is high praise!

examples.text: 这款蜂蜜柠檬塔酸甜适中，吃起来一点也不腻。
examples.trans: This honey-lemon tart balances sweet and tart, so it doesn't taste cloying at all.

examples.text: 油炸的点心吃多了容易觉得腻，配杯清茶正好。
examples.trans: Rich fried pastries can feel heavy if you eat too many—a cup of clear tea balances them nicely.

腾不出来.gloss: unable to free up (time, people, space)

meanings.en: unable to free up (time, people, space)
meanings.note: Potential complement téngbuchūlái ('cannot spare/free up').

examples.text: 那么多人居然腾不出来一个律师。
examples.trans: With all those staff, they cannot even free up one lawyer.

examples.text: 这周演播厅排满了，实在腾不出来空档。
examples.trans: Studios are booked solid this week with no slot to spare.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tuǐ. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条腿 ('a leg').

examples.text: 啊……不好。我的椅子在哪儿？我腿发软。
examples.trans: Oh... oh no. Where is my chair? My legs feel weak.

examples.text: 走了一整天，我的两条腿都酸了。
examples.trans: After walking all day, both my legs are tired.

meanings.note: Preposition zìcóng ('ever since a past event').

examples.text: 自从李铭基出事以后，两边关系很紧张。
examples.trans: Ever since Li Mingji's incident, ties have been tense.

examples.text: 自从调到总编室，她每天都学到新东西。
examples.trans: Ever since joining the office, she learns daily.

自作多情.gloss: flatter oneself, imagine feelings are mutual

meanings.en: flatter oneself, imagine feelings are mutual
meanings.note: Four-character idiom for reading romance into someone's actions.

examples.text: 他故意板着脸叫她别再自作多情了。
examples.trans: Putting on a cold face, he told her to stop flattering herself.

examples.text: 没弄清楚对方的心意之前，我可不敢自作多情。
examples.trans: Before knowing how the other person feels, I dare not flatter myself.

meanings.note: Verb/adjective zìzhì ('fan-made or self-produced').

examples.text: 爱美会的自制视频里拍到了错误的水。
examples.trans: The fan club's homemade clip caught the wrong water.

examples.text: 自制视频肯定比不上电视台的专业拍摄。
examples.trans: Homemade clips cannot match professional TV shoots.

自发.gloss: spontaneously, voluntarily, of one's own accord

meanings.en: spontaneously, voluntarily, of one's own accord
meanings.note: Adverb/adjective zìfā ('voluntarily without prompting').

examples.text: 市民看了报道后，自发开放住处帮助受困者。
examples.trans: After watching the report, residents voluntarily opened their homes.

examples.text: 歌迷们在场外自发排成整齐队伍，秩序井然。
examples.trans: Outside the venue, fans spontaneously formed neat, orderly lines.

meanings.note: Adjective zìdà ('self-important, arrogant').

examples.text: 像他这种自大的人，我在圈里见得多了。
examples.trans: Arrogant people like him are common in this industry.

examples.text: 取得一点成绩千万不能骄傲自大。
examples.trans: Never grow conceited over a small success.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zì jiā. Warm home-turf word ('our very own').

examples.text: 我梦寐以求的咖啡馆，就开在自家庭院里！等着瞧我去告诉整条街的人吧！
examples.trans: My dream café—right in our own courtyard! Wait until I tell the whole street!

examples.text: 这些薄荷叶都是我们自家院子里种的。
examples.trans: These mint leaves were all grown right in our own courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zì jǐ. Follows pronouns to stress 'by oneself' (你自己 'you yourself').

examples.text: 所以老房子自己会打招呼？
examples.trans: So the old house says hello by itself?

examples.text: 那个人为什么不拿回自己的箱子就跑了？
examples.trans: Why did that person run off without taking his own suitcase back?

meanings.note: Colloquial noun zìjǐrén ('part of the family/circle').

examples.text: 主任说了，今天到场的都是自己人。
examples.trans: Our director said everyone here today counts as one of us.

examples.text: 既然都是自己人，有什么困难就直说吧。
examples.trans: Since we are all family here, speak plainly about any hurdle.

自找麻烦.gloss: ask for trouble, bring trouble on oneself

meanings.en: ask for trouble, bring trouble on oneself
meanings.note: Idiom-like phrase zìzhǎo-máfán ('invite trouble').

examples.text: 我名声这么差，签我不是自找麻烦吗？
examples.trans: With my bad press, is signing me not asking for trouble?

examples.text: 不按安全流程操作纯粹是自找麻烦。
examples.trans: Skipping safety procedures is simply asking for trouble.

examples.text: 我自有我的方法，我们这些小员工也不是白痴啊！钟阳子对于这件事情的解决至关重要。
examples.trans: I have my own methods — us junior staffers aren't idiots! Zhong Yangzi is vital to resolving this whole crisis.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Adverb/adjective zìrán ('naturally, of its own accord').

examples.text: 不理它，谣言自然就过去了。
examples.trans: Ignore it, and the rumour will naturally pass.

examples.text: 她在镜头前表现得很自然。
examples.trans: She acts very naturally in front of the camera.

meanings.note: Adjective/noun zìyóu ('free from constraints').

examples.text: 最重要的是我们家惠美自由了！
examples.trans: What matters most is that our Huimei is free now!

examples.text: 解约以后她可以自由选择新歌。
examples.trans: After ending the contract she can freely choose new songs.

examples.text: 但是如果现在另有安排，是不是太自私啊？
examples.trans: If I make other arrangements for my own sake now, wouldn't that be far too selfish?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 你总自虐干吗呀？哪回你自虐，最后受苦的不是我们？
examples.trans: Why do you always torture yourself? Every time you do, aren't we the ones who suffer too?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

自觉.gloss: conscious; aware; on one's own initiative

meanings.en: conscious; aware; on one's own initiative
meanings.note: Pinyin: zì jué. Joins 自 ('self') + 觉 ('to feel, to realize').

examples.text: 大家都非常自觉地压低了声音，怕打扰宋老师弹琴。
examples.trans: Everyone very consciously lowered their voices, afraid of disturbing Teacher Song's piano playing.

examples.text: 客人走后，老陈很自觉地拿起了扫把打扫院子。
examples.trans: After the guests left, Chen very proactively picked up the broom to sweep the courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zì háo. Combines 自 ('self') + 豪 ('spirited/proud'): positive, heartfelt pride in good work or a team's achievement.

examples.text: 小美靠在厨房门口，自豪地看着两位徒弟端出热腾腾的面包和柠檬挞。
examples.trans: Leaning in the kitchen doorway, Mei watched proudly as her two apprentices brought out steaming bread and lemon tarts.

examples.text: 老陈提起这栋八十年历史的院子时，语气里总是充满了自豪。
examples.trans: Whenever Chen talks about this eighty-year-old courtyard, his voice is full of pride.

meanings.note: Used in 节目自身 or 自身实力.

examples.text: 排播规划不能只看短期利益，还要兼顾平台自身定位。
examples.trans: Scheduling must weigh platform identity alongside short-term gains.

examples.text: 打铁还需自身硬，提升自身实力才是最好的回应。
examples.trans: Strengthening your own capability is always the best answer.

自首.gloss: turn oneself in, confess to authorities

meanings.en: turn oneself in, confess to authorities
meanings.note: Voluntarily reporting one's own offence to police.

examples.text: 听说警察到了楼下，她起身说现在就去自首。
examples.trans: Hearing police were downstairs, she stood up to turn herself in.

examples.text: 主动投案自首在法律上可以获得从轻处理。
examples.trans: Turning oneself in voluntarily earns leniency under the law.

至于.gloss: as for, when it comes to

meanings.en: as for, when it comes to
meanings.note: Preposition zhìyú introducing a new topic ('as for').

examples.text: 至于你说的那家公司，我不会签他们的。
examples.trans: As for the agency you mentioned, I will not sign.

examples.text: 方案先定下来，至于预算我们明天再谈。
examples.trans: Settle the plan first; as for budget, let us talk tomorrow.

meanings.note: Four-character phrase zhìguān zhòngyào ('of vital importance').

examples.text: 和后援会搞好关系对于做节目至关重要。
examples.trans: Good ties with fan clubs are vital to producing shows.

examples.text: 开场前三分钟对整场直播至关重要。
examples.trans: The first three minutes are crucial to any live show.

meanings.note: Placed after 2-syllable adjectives like 理性至极 or 精彩至极.

examples.text: 他在专业判断上理性至极，从不被外界噪音左右。
examples.trans: Utterly rational in professional judgment, he ignores outside noise.

examples.text: 决赛舞台上的那段清唱真挚动人，精彩至极。
examples.trans: That unaccompanied solo on the finale stage was breathtaking.

舍不得.gloss: be reluctant to part with; linger fondly

meanings.en: be reluctant to part with; linger fondly
meanings.note: Pinyin: shě bu de. Idiomatic potential compound 舍 ('give up/leave') + 不得 ('cannot bear to').

examples.text: 好朋友围着最后一杯热茶聊天，谁都舍不得走。
examples.trans: Good friends gathered around their last cup of hot tea, reluctant to leave.

examples.text: 这盘柠檬挞太香了，老陈都舍不得一口吃完。
examples.trans: This plate of lemon tart is so fragrant that Chen couldn't bear to finish his slice in one bite.

meanings.note: Verb shěde ('not begrudge spending').
