examples.text: 连小叶平时那么省钱，今天都舍得捐钱了。
examples.trans: Even frugal Xiaoye was willing to donate money today.

examples.text: 这本旧笔记她一直不舍得扔。
examples.trans: She could never bear to throw away this old notebook.

meanings.note: Idiom shěshēng qǔyì ('give up oneself for righteousness', used playfully or earnestly).

examples.text: 看你这么舍生取义地护着上司，我都感动了。
examples.trans: Watching you shield your boss so nobly almost moves me.

examples.text: 古人常常用舍生取义来形容崇高的气节。
examples.trans: Classics use this phrase for noble self-sacrifice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shū fu. Everyday praise for comfy chairs, warm water, or pleasant rooms.

examples.text: 我床上有厚被子，今晚睡着很舒服。
examples.trans: I have a thick quilt on my bed, so sleeping tonight is very comfortable.

examples.text: 换上干爽的毛衣，整个人都舒服了。
examples.trans: Slipping into a dry sweater feels wonderful.

examples.text: 在舞台上。
examples.trans: On the stage.

examples.text: 大舞台。
examples.trans: Big stage.

meanings.note: Compound noun wǔtái kǒngjùzhèng ('stage phobia/fright').

examples.text: 李铭基其实有舞台恐惧症。
examples.trans: Li Mingji actually suffers from stage fright.

examples.text: 很多歌手年轻时都有舞台恐惧症。
examples.trans: Many singers experience stage fright early on.

meanings.note: Postpositional particle bān ('like, dreamlike').

examples.text: 这座梦幻般的大都会突然迎来了狂风暴雨。
examples.trans: This dreamlike metropolis was suddenly hit by driving rain.

examples.text: 舞台中央洒下星光般的灯光，美得令人屏息。
examples.trans: Starlight-like beams spilled across centre stage, breathtakingly lovely.

examples.text: 我们的艺人方案特别重要，不能泄露！
examples.trans: Our guest-artist plan is especially important; it must not leak!

examples.text: 这是艺人。
examples.trans: This is 艺人.

meanings.note: Executive overseeing a company's roster of performers.

examples.text: 她是星天经纪部经验最丰富的艺人总监。
examples.trans: She is the most seasoned talent director in Xingtian's agency arm.

examples.text: 艺人总监正在帮歌手处理公关危机。
examples.trans: The talent director is helping the singer handle a PR crisis.

meanings.note: Noun yìshù ('art').

examples.text: 我是新闻学和艺术管理双硕士毕业。
examples.trans: I hold dual master's degrees in journalism and arts management.

examples.text: 电视制作是一门结合技术与创意的艺术。
examples.trans: TV production is an art blending craft and creativity.

examples.text: 不要节外生枝。
examples.trans: Do not cause extra trouble.

examples.text: 事情又节外生枝了。
examples.trans: The matter caused extra trouble again.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jié zòu. Combines 节 ('metrical beat/joint') + 奏 ('play music').

examples.text: 宋老师用手指在木桌上轻轻敲出了两种节奏。
examples.trans: Teacher Song lightly tapped out two rhythms with her fingers on the wooden table.

examples.text: 圆舞曲有着轻盈好听的三拍子节奏。
examples.trans: A waltz has a graceful, lilt-like three-beat rhythm.

meanings.note: Used seriously in classical contexts or jokingly ('shamelessly').

examples.text: 老搭档笑着自嘲说自己没节操地又跑回总编室帮忙了。
examples.trans: Laughing at himself, the old partner said he came shamelessly back to help.

examples.text: 面对高薪诱惑依然坚守原则，这才是真正的职业节操。
examples.trans: Standing by principles despite rich offers shows real integrity.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jié rì. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè). Joins 节 ('joint, festival') + 日 ('day').

examples.text: 客栈在每个传统节日都会挂上大红灯笼。
examples.trans: The inn hangs large red lanterns during every traditional festival.

examples.text: 中秋节是中国人团聚的重要节日。
examples.trans: The Mid-Autumn Festival is an important holiday for Chinese people to reunite.

节目.gloss: program; show; item on a bill

meanings.en: TV or radio program; show; performance item
meanings.note: jiémù — takes classifiers 档 (dàng, for a scheduled TV/variety series, e.g., 一档综艺节目) or 个 (gè, for an individual show or performance act); collocates with 录 (tape/record) and 播 (broadcast).

examples.text: 我问你个问题，节目制作的核心业务在哪儿？
examples.trans: Let me ask you a question: where does the core business of show production lie?

examples.text: 明天就要录节目了，那咱们现在怎么办啊？
examples.trans: We are taping the show tomorrow — what do we do now?

related.gloss: schedule; booking notice for an artist

meanings.note: Compound noun jiémù zhǔchí ('programme host').

examples.text: 这次由闻思默老师担任新版栏目的节目主持。
examples.trans: Wen Simo will serve as host of the revamped programme.

examples.text: 优秀的节目主持能控住任何突发场面。
examples.trans: A skilled show host can steady any unexpected moment.

meanings.note: Television noun jiémùzǔ ('programme production team').

examples.text: 节目组备有常备药箱。
examples.trans: The show crew keeps a stocked medical kit.

examples.text: 节目组正在开会讨论决赛。
examples.trans: The production crew is meeting about the finale.

meanings.note: Verb/noun huā ('spend time/money').

examples.text: 我花了六年的时间学习电视节目制作。
examples.trans: I spent six full years studying TV production.

examples.text: 这笔宣传预算必须花在刀刃上。
examples.trans: This publicity budget must be spent where it counts.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huā yuán. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个小花园 ('a small garden').

examples.text: 啊！看这儿：一楼，九号房，花园阳光房！
examples.trans: Aha! Look here: ground floor, Room Nine, garden sunroom!

examples.text: 等等，我们一楼有一个花园阳光房？
examples.trans: Wait, we have a garden sunroom on the ground floor?

meanings.note: Pinyin: huā tān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个花摊 ('a flower stall').

examples.text: 走花摊旁边第二条路，别进窄巷子。
examples.trans: Take the second lane beside the flower stall; do not enter the narrow alley.

examples.text: 街口花摊每天早上都有新鲜百合。
examples.trans: The corner flower stall has fresh lilies every morning.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huā píng. Combines 花 ('flower') + 瓶 ('vase/bottle'); measure word: 个 (gè) or 只 (zhī).

examples.text: 宋老师夸赞说，每个小玻璃花瓶里插一片绿叶多好看呀。
examples.trans: Teacher Song remarked how lovely a single green leaf looked inside each small glass vase.

examples.text: 阳光透过拱窗照在桌上的玻璃花瓶里，映出清澈的光影。
examples.trans: Sunlight shone through the arched window onto the glass vases on the tables, casting clear reflections.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huā pén. Compound 花 ('flower') + 盆 ('pot/basin'). Measure word: 个 (gè).

examples.text: 院子台阶两旁摆着六个红陶花盆。
examples.trans: Six terracotta flowerpots sit along both sides of the courtyard steps.

examples.text: 小美买了薄荷和迷迭香，准备种在花盆里。
examples.trans: Mei bought mint and rosemary to plant in the flowerpots.

meanings.note: Media noun huāxù ('behind-the-scenes tidbits/highlights').

examples.text: 热场阶段先播一段往期节目的幕后花絮。
examples.trans: During warm-up, roll a reel of behind-the-scenes outtakes.

examples.text: 正片结束后的彩蛋花絮往往是观众最爱看的部分。
examples.trans: Post-credits blooper reels are often viewers' favourite part.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huā cǎo. Measure word (量词): 盆, e.g. 一盆花草 ('a pot of plants').

examples.text: 总得有人照顾院子里的花草嘛。
examples.trans: Somebody has to look after the courtyard plants, after all.

examples.text: 好位置。两把结实椅子，朝着花草，别朝着大堂窗户。
examples.trans: Good spot. Two sturdy chairs, facing the plants rather than the lobby window.

related.gloss: a pot of plants (measure word 盆)

meanings.note: Everyday V-O compound.

examples.text: 做精品节目要把钱花在刀刃上，不能盲目花钱买噱头。
examples.trans: Flagship shows spend money where it counts, not on empty gimmicks.

examples.text: 对手不惜花钱四处打听我们新项目的嘉宾阵容。
examples.trans: Rivals spared no expense prying into our new project's guest lineup.

苏打水.gloss: soda water; club soda; sparkling water

meanings.en: soda water; club soda; carbonated water
meanings.note: sūdǎshuǐ — hybrid loanword from苏打 (sūdǎ, English "soda") + 水 (shuǐ, water); takes classifiers 杯 (bēi, cup/glass), 瓶 (píng, bottle), or 罐 (guàn, can).

examples.text: 这杯苏打水是我熬夜的利器。
examples.trans: This cup of soda water is my secret weapon for staying up late.

examples.text: 服务员，麻烦给我来一瓶冰镇的无糖苏打水。
examples.trans: Waiter, could I please have a bottle of chilled sugar-free club soda?

examples.text: 很苦。
examples.trans: Very bitter.

examples.text: 工作太苦。
examples.trans: Work is too tough.

苦心人.gloss: person who pours painstaking effort into a goal

meanings.en: person who pours painstaking effort into a goal
meanings.note: From the famous couplet 苦心人，天不负.

examples.text: 苦心人天不负，他们熬夜打磨的方案终于获得了认可。
examples.trans: Heaven rewards painstaking effort: their overnight plan won approval.

examples.text: 每一个成功的原创项目背后都有一群默默付出的苦心人。
examples.trans: Behind every hit original stands a crew of devoted strivers.

meanings.note: Used for tearjerker dramas or teasing a friend's love woes.

examples.text: 闺蜜笑着打断了她的苦情倾诉，拉她回归正题谈工作。
examples.trans: Her friend teasingly cut short the heartbreak report to talk business.

examples.text: 观众已经看腻了刻意煽情的苦情戏，更喜欢真实的温暖。
examples.trans: Tired of contrived tearjerkers, viewers prefer genuine warmth.

meanings.note: Modifier for workflows, humor, or design.

examples.text: 这位海归制作人擅长英式综艺严谨细致的工业化流程。
examples.trans: This UK-trained producer excels at rigorous British format workflows.

examples.text: 休息室里摆着一套精致的英式下午茶茶具。
examples.trans: A refined British afternoon-tea set sat in the lounge.

meanings.note: Noun Yīngwén ('written or spoken English').

examples.text: 八十页的英文合同，您这么快就看完了？
examples.trans: An eighty-page English contract, read this fast?

examples.text: 她能流利地阅读英文节目模式资料。
examples.trans: She reads English format bibles fluently.

meanings.note: Pinyin: píng guǒ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个苹果 ('an apple').

examples.text: 三瓶牛奶、二十个鸡蛋、黄油、奶酪和红苹果！
examples.trans: Three bottles of milk, twenty eggs, butter, cheese, and red apples!

examples.text: 九分钟！牛奶、鸡蛋和苹果都买来了！
examples.trans: Nine minutes! The milk, eggs, and apples are all here!

meanings.note: Noun píngguǒzhī ('apple juice').

examples.text: 行政部的茶水间好像有苹果汁。
examples.trans: The administration pantry seems to have apple juice.

examples.text: 魔鬼鱼今天居然想要喝苹果汁！
examples.trans: Manta Ray actually wants to drink apple juice today!

meanings.note: Used in 大范围 ('widespread/large-scale') or 范围内.

examples.text: 及时的澄清声明成功控制住了大范围的网络负面舆论。
examples.trans: A timely clarification brought widespread online backlash under control.

examples.text: 预算调整必须控制在董事会批准的范围之内。
examples.trans: Budget adjustments must stay within board-approved limits.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chá. Measure word (量词): 杯 (bēi), e.g. 一杯茶 ('a cup of tea').

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 先喝杯热茶，吃个肉桂卷坐十分钟吧！
examples.trans: Have a cup of hot tea and a cinnamon roll for ten minutes first!

related.gloss: a cup of tea (measure word 杯)

meanings.note: Pinyin: chá xù. Graceful compound 茶 ('tea') + 叙 ('chat warmly/converse'): an informal social gathering over tea.

examples.text: 木牌下面还有一行小字：星期五傍晚六点钢琴茶叙。
examples.trans: Underneath on the wooden sign is a line in smaller letters: Friday Piano Tea Social at Six O'Clock.

examples.text: 三十年前的每个星期五，九号房都会举办热闹的街坊音乐茶叙。
examples.trans: Every Friday thirty years ago, Room Nine hosted a lively neighbourhood music and tea social.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chá hú. Measure word (量词): 把 (bǎ), e.g. 一把茶壶 ('a teapot').

examples.text: 小晴，把热水倒进茶壶里，他们来了！
examples.trans: Qing, pour the hot water into the teapot—here they come!

examples.text: 茶壶也烫好了！大家从窗边退后一步！
examples.trans: And the teapot is hot! Everybody step back from the window!

meanings.note: Pinyin: chá shì. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间茶室 ('a tea room').

examples.text: 我想起来了！我十岁的时候，叔叔叫它冬天茶室！
examples.trans: Now I remember! When I was ten, my uncle called it the winter tea room!

examples.text: 下午，客人们喜欢在茶室里聊天。
examples.trans: In the afternoon, guests like to chat in the tea room.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chá bēi. Measure word (量词): 只 (zhǐ), e.g. 一只茶杯 ('a teacup').

examples.text: 只有裙子、乐谱，还有我最喜欢的茶杯！
examples.trans: Only dresses, sheet music, and my favourite teacup!

examples.text: 里面的茶杯呢？还完好吗？
examples.trans: And the teacup inside? Is it still intact?

meanings.note: Noun cháshuǐ ('tea and drinking water').

examples.text: 雷总让你待会儿去会议室送茶水。
examples.trans: Director Lei wants you to serve tea at the meeting shortly.

examples.text: 休息室里准备了热茶水。
examples.trans: Hot tea and water are ready in the lounge.

meanings.note: Workplace noun cháshuǐjiān ('tea/coffee pantry').

examples.text: 行政部的茶水间就在走廊左边。
examples.trans: The admin pantry is right down the hall on the left.

examples.text: 休息的时候大家喜欢去茶水间冲杯咖啡。
examples.trans: On breaks everyone likes making coffee in the pantry.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chá dié. Compound 茶 ('tea') + 碟 ('small dish/saucer'). Measure word: 个 (gè).

examples.text: 厚陶土茶杯放在配套的茶碟上，声音很轻。
examples.trans: When the thick stoneware teacup is set on its matching saucer, it makes a soft, quiet sound.

examples.text: 小晴擦干了十二个白茶碟，整整齐齐叠在柜子里。
examples.trans: Qing wiped the twelve white saucers dry and stacked them neatly in the cupboard.

meanings.note: Profession noun cháyìshī ('skilled tea brewer').

examples.text: 你喜欢的茶艺师我已经提前帮你约好了。
examples.trans: I booked your favourite tea master in advance.

examples.text: 茶艺师优雅地为大家冲泡了一壶龙井。
examples.trans: The tea master gracefully brewed a pot of green tea.

meanings.note: Compound noun cháyìshè ('tea-art house').

examples.text: 我今天先带你去一家环境清幽的茶艺社。
examples.trans: Today I am taking you to a peaceful garden teahouse.

examples.text: 周末约老朋友在茶艺社喝茶聊天很放松。
examples.trans: Meeting old friends for tea at a teahouse is relaxing.

meanings.note: Literary noun jīngjí ('thorny undergrowth, obstacles').

examples.text: 靠近他的时候，脚下总是荆棘遍地。
examples.trans: Approaching him, the path underfoot is full of thorns.

examples.text: 追逐梦想的路上难免会有荆棘。
examples.trans: Thorns are inevitable along the road to a dream.

examples.text: 洛琳确实是个麻烦，但没必要草木皆兵。
examples.trans: Luo Lin is certainly trouble, though there's no need to panic at every shadow.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a noun used in conversational Mandarin. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个草本 ('a 草本').

examples.text: 我有一个草本。
examples.trans: I have a 草本.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的草本。
examples.trans: This is a very good 草本.

meanings.note: Acting without thorough preparation.

examples.text: 这么重大的决定绝不能做得太草率。
examples.trans: Such a major decision must never be made too hastily.

examples.text: 她担心自己写的初稿太草率了。
examples.trans: She worried the first draft she wrote was too hasty.

meanings.note: Noun cǎogǎo ('preliminary draft').

examples.text: 进了星天之后，我就做了这么一个草稿。
examples.trans: Right after joining Xingtian, I put together this rough draft.

examples.text: 她在笔记本上画满了新舞台设计的草稿。
examples.trans: She filled her notebook with rough sketches for the new stage.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cǎo méi. Measure word (量词): 颗 (kē), e.g. 一颗草莓 ('a strawberry').

examples.text: 咸黄油能配甜草莓果酱吗？
examples.trans: Can salted butter go with sweet strawberry jam?

examples.text: 桌上的小玻璃瓶里装着自制草莓果酱。
examples.trans: Homemade strawberry jam fills the small glass jar on the table.

examples.text: 咱俩都是了解她的，怎么可能会有这种事呢，真是荒谬。
examples.trans: Both of us know her well; how could anything like that be true? It's utterly absurd.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Polite adjective róngxìng ('deeply honoured').

examples.text: 我们很荣幸邀请到两位老师加入今天的会议。
examples.trans: We are honoured to invite both teachers to today's meeting.

examples.text: 非常荣幸能参与这档王牌节目的制作。
examples.trans: It is an honour to help produce this flagship show.

examples.text: 你需要吃药。
examples.trans: You need to take medicine.

examples.text: 这药很苦。
examples.trans: This medicine is very bitter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yào jì shī. Combines 药剂 ('pharmaceutical preparation') + 师 ('qualified master/professional'); measure word: 位 (wèi).

examples.text: 书店老板、药店药剂师、面包师的表弟，还有十二位邻居！
examples.trans: The bookshop owner, the pharmacy pharmacist, the baker's cousin, and twelve neighbours!

examples.text: 转角绿药店的药剂师给小美拿了一盒消肿冰袋。
examples.trans: The pharmacist at the green corner pharmacy gave Mei a pack of ice pads for the swelling.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yào diàn. Measure word (量词): 家 (jiā), e.g. 一家药店 ('a pharmacy').

examples.text: 对，过了桥，右手边会经过一家绿药店。
examples.trans: Right, after crossing the bridge, you pass a green pharmacy on your right.

examples.text: 过桥，右边经过绿药店。然后呢？
examples.trans: Cross the bridge, green pharmacy on the right. And after that?

meanings.note: Noun yàoxiāng ('medicine box').

examples.text: 节目组有常备药箱，不用出去买。
examples.trans: The show crew has a medicine kit, so no need to go buy any.

examples.text: 办公室的药箱放在前台。
examples.trans: The office first-aid kit is kept at the front desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: méi guǒ. Measure word (量词): 颗 (kē) or 篮 (lán). Joins 莓 ('berry') + 果 ('fruit').

examples.text: 小美在蛋糕顶上点缀了几颗新鲜的红莓果。
examples.trans: Mei garnished the top of the cake with a few fresh red berries.

examples.text: 这罐果酱是用后院刚摘的野莓果熬制的。
examples.trans: This jar of jam was simmered from wild berries just picked in the backyard.

examples.text: 莫不是因为小谷的事，有点后悔了是不是？
examples.trans: Wait — you're already regretting snapping at Xiaogu, aren't you?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Verb huòdé ('obtain, gain').

examples.text: 公司派你来获得视频资料吗？
examples.trans: Did the company send you to obtain video footage?

examples.text: 这部作品获得了观众的好评。
examples.trans: This work won praise from audiences.

meanings.note: cài — general term for prepared dishes in a meal or leafy vegetables (measure word 道 dào or 盘 pán for dishes)
colloquial slang in 是某人的菜, meaning someone or something that suits one's personal or romantic taste

examples.text: 这个是你的菜吧？不好意思了！
examples.trans: This one is your type, right? Now you are embarrassed!

examples.text: 你觉得他们家菜还合口吧？
examples.trans: Do the dishes at this place suit your taste?

meanings.note: Pinyin: cài dān. Combines 菜 ('dishes/courses') + 单 ('list/sheet').

examples.text: 星期三咖啡角的开业菜单已经全部定好了！
examples.trans: Wednesday's opening menu for the café corner is all set!

examples.text: 小美用漂亮的手写字把今日菜单抄在木牌上。
examples.trans: Mei copied today's menu onto the wooden board in neat handwriting.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cài dān kǎ. Combines 菜单 ('menu') + 卡 ('card'); measure word: 张 (zhāng).

examples.text: 小晴写好了四张干净漂亮的菜单卡，准备放到每张木桌上。
examples.trans: Qing wrote out four clean, attractive menu cards to set on each of the wooden tables.

examples.text: 我把这些刚写好的菜单卡拿到厨房去，顺便看看小美。
examples.trans: I'll carry these freshly written menu cards into the kitchen and check on Mei while I'm at it.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cài bǎn. Combines 菜 ('vegetables/food') + 板 ('wooden board'); synonymous with 砧板; measure word: 块 (kuài).

examples.text: 快看志豪的木头菜板，上面排着整整齐齐的胡萝卜丁和洋葱丁。
examples.trans: Look at Hao's wooden chopping board, lined with neat rows of diced carrots and onions.

examples.text: 切完蔬菜以后，志鹏马上用温水把菜板洗干净立在架子上晾干。
examples.trans: Right after chopping the vegetables, Peng washed the cutting board with warm water and stood it on the rack to dry.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cài pǔ. Measure word (量词): 份 (fèn) or 本 (běn). Joins 菜 ('dish, vegetable') + 谱 ('register, manual').

examples.text: 这张泛黄的纸原来是半份祖传的蛋糕菜谱。
examples.trans: This yellowed paper turned out to be half of an ancestral cake recipe.

examples.text: 周经理正坐在前台翻看附近新开饭店的菜谱。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou is sitting at the front desk flipping through the menu of a newly opened restaurant nearby.

examples.text: 职场菜鸟。
examples.trans: Workplace rookie.

examples.text: 他是个菜鸟。
examples.trans: He is a rookie.

营业.gloss: be open for business; operate commercially

meanings.en: be open for business; operate commercially
meanings.note: Pinyin: yíng yè. Verb-object compound 营 ('run/operate') + 业 ('business'); 每日营业 ('Open Daily') and 营业时间 ('business hours') are standard storefront terms.

examples.text: 九号房花园咖啡角每日营业，为街坊供应鲜汤、热面包和清茶。
examples.trans: Room Nine Garden Café Corner is open daily, serving fresh soup, warm bread, and fragrant tea to the neighbourhood.

examples.text: 街坊们看到门口挂出了营业木牌，都好奇地停下来看菜单。
examples.trans: Seeing the 'Open for Business' wooden sign hung at the gate, neighbours stopped curiously to read the menu.

meanings.note: Profession noun yíngyǎngshī ('nutritionist').

examples.text: 节目组为您配备了助理和随队营养师。
examples.trans: Production assigned you assistants and a team nutritionist.

examples.text: 高强度体能拍摄期间，营养师负责搭配健康三餐。
examples.trans: During intense shoots, the nutritionist balances healthy meals.

meanings.note: Business verb/noun yíngxiāo ('marketing, promotion').

examples.text: 路条网最主要的业务不是报道，而是营销。
examples.trans: Lutiao's main business is marketing rather than news.

examples.text: 斯戴拉在公司里分管公关和市场营销。
examples.trans: Stella oversees PR and marketing at the company.

meanings.note: Workplace noun yíngxiāodān ('marketing business order').

examples.text: 我来这儿主要是想帮网站拿到星天的营销单。
examples.trans: My real goal here is winning Xingtian's marketing contract.

examples.text: 年底市场部签下了好几笔大额营销单。
examples.trans: Marketing closed several major contracts at year-end.

meanings.note: Pinyin: luò. Used both literally for raindrops/leaves falling and musically for a phrase landing on a note (落在中央瑞音上).

examples.text: 到了第二十八小节，整段旋律稳稳落在了中央瑞音上。
examples.trans: In bar twenty-eight, the whole melody lands squarely on middle D.

examples.text: 几片金黄的梧桐叶轻轻落在院子的石桌上。
examples.trans: Several golden plane-tree leaves drifted gently down onto the courtyard stone table.

落地.gloss: be put into execution on the ground, materialize locally

meanings.en: be put into execution on the ground, materialize locally
meanings.note: Business/media verb for turning a pitch or foreign format into reality.

examples.text: 再漂亮的海外概念，也得结合本土文化才能真正落地。
examples.trans: Even the slickest overseas concept must fit local culture to take root.

examples.text: 他夸口能让豪华国际阵容的引进项目马上在公司落地。
examples.trans: He boasted he could land star-studded imported formats right away.

落实.gloss: follow through on, put into practice, confirm

meanings.en: follow through on, put into practice, confirm
meanings.note: Making sure concrete details get executed.

examples.text: 会上的决定今天之内必须全部落实。
examples.trans: Decisions from the meeting must all be carried out today.

examples.text: 请先把嘉宾的机票和酒店落实好。
examples.trans: Please confirm the guests' flights and hotels first.

meanings.note: Adjective zhùmíng ('well-known, celebrated').

examples.text: 他就是来自泰国著名的喜剧大咖。
examples.trans: He is a celebrated comedy star from Thailand.

examples.text: 今晚担任压轴评委的是著名的音乐制作人。
examples.trans: Serving as head judge tonight is a renowned music producer.

examples.text: 董事会已经要求召开董事大会问责。
examples.trans: And Xingtian's board has demanded an emergency board meeting to assign blame.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 董事会已经要求召开董事大会问责。
examples.trans: And Xingtian's board has demanded an emergency board meeting to assign blame.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Corporate title dǒngshìzhǎng ('board chair').

examples.text: 听说董事长也连夜赶飞机回来了。
examples.trans: I hear the chairwoman flew back overnight too.

examples.text: 董事长今天上午主持会议。
examples.trans: The chairperson is chairing the meeting this morning.

examples.text: 就算他们是蓄谋已久的，我们照样陪着你闯过来！
examples.trans: Even if they plotted this trap long ago, we will charge right through it at your side!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lán. Describes blue suitcases, doors, or teacups.

examples.text: 每个蓝杯子旁边放一张餐巾和一把小勺子。
examples.trans: Beside every blue cup, put one napkin and one small spoon.

examples.text: 储藏室里有两个软枕头和一块蓝地毯！
examples.trans: In the storeroom there are two soft pillows and a blue rug!

meanings.note: Pinyin: lán tiān. Combines 蓝 ('blue') + 天 ('sky').

examples.text: 擦亮第一块方格玻璃后，外面露出了蓝天和绿树叶！
examples.trans: After wiping the first square pane clean, blue sky and green leaves shone outside!

examples.text: 雨过天晴，成都的蓝天显得格外干净。
examples.trans: After the rain cleared, Chengdu's blue sky looked extra crisp.

meanings.note: Business metaphor lánhǎi ('untapped market space').

examples.text: 他特立独行，做节目喜欢走蓝海路线。
examples.trans: Fiercely original, he likes charting blue-ocean territory.

examples.text: 避开扎堆跟风，原创文化节目成了一片新蓝海。
examples.trans: Avoiding copycats, original cultural shows opened a blue ocean.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lán sè. Measure word (量词): 种 (zhǒng), e.g. 一种蓝色 ('a shade of blue').

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

examples.text: 等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！
examples.trans: Wait—it is dark blue, the same as yours!

related.gloss: a shade of blue (measure word 种)

蓝色预警.gloss: blue weather alert (lowest tier of storm warning)

meanings.en: blue weather alert (lowest tier of storm warning)
meanings.note: Initial caution tier in China's four-colour weather alert system.

examples.text: 气象台早间发布了大风和降雨的蓝色预警。
examples.trans: This morning the weather bureau issued a blue alert for wind and rain.

examples.text: 虽然只是蓝色预警，户外搭建还是得做好防雨措施。
examples.trans: Even under a blue alert, outdoor staging needs rain protection.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shū cài. Measure word (量词): 盘, e.g. 一盘蔬菜 ('a dish of vegetables').

examples.text: 他上楼之前把蔬菜汤喝得一干二净。
examples.trans: Before going upstairs, he drank every last drop of the vegetable soup.

examples.text: 早市刚买回来的绿叶蔬菜特别新鲜。
examples.trans: The leafy vegetables just bought at the morning market are super fresh.

related.gloss: a dish of vegetables (measure word 盘)

meanings.note: Pinyin: báo. Colloquially read 2nd-tone báo when standalone ('thin cup/paper', opposite of 厚 hòu); literary compounds often use bó.

examples.text: 这种薄玻璃杯盛冰柠檬水最好看。
examples.trans: This kind of thin glass cup looks prettiest filled with iced lemon water.

examples.text: 春天的早晚还有点凉，别只穿一件薄外套。
examples.trans: Spring mornings and evenings are still chilly—don't wear just a thin jacket.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bò he. Measure word (量词): 片 (piàn) or 把 (bǎ). Note the special pronunciation bò he for this specific plant name.

examples.text: 茶杯里飘出淡淡的薄荷清香。
examples.trans: A faint, refreshing mint fragrance wafted from the teacup.

examples.text: 小晴摘下几片薄荷叶，洗干净后放进了冰水里。
examples.trans: Qing picked a few mint leaves, washed them clean, and dropped them into the ice water.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bò he chá. Measure word (量词): 壶, e.g. 一壶薄荷茶 ('a pot of mint tea').

examples.text: 宋老师，给您热薄荷茶和蜂蜜。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, here is hot mint tea and honey for you.

examples.text: 晚饭后喝一壶热薄荷茶最助眠了。
examples.trans: A pot of hot mint tea after dinner helps you sleep soundly.

related.gloss: a pot of mint tea (measure word 壶)

meanings.note: Pinyin: báo báo. Reduplication of 薄 ('thin', colloquial reading báo); before 地 + verb (薄薄地刷匀), it describes applying a light, even coat.

examples.text: 小晴，顺着木纹薄薄地刷匀，油漆太厚就会一直发黏。
examples.trans: Qing, brush it on thinly and evenly along the wood grain; if the paint is too thick, it stays sticky.

examples.text: 在刚烤好的杏仁柠檬挞上薄薄地撒一层糖粉，看起来真漂亮。
examples.trans: Dusting a thin, light layer of powdered sugar over the freshly baked almond lemon tart looks lovely.

meanings.note: Polished everyday word for regular pay.

examples.text: 比起猎头开出的高额薪水，他们更看重并肩作战的情谊。
examples.trans: More than high headhunter salaries, they valued team camaraderie.

examples.text: 公司决定为表现突出的年轻编导上调今年的薪水。
examples.trans: The company decided to raise salaries for standout young directors.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cáng. Read cáng for 'hide'; often followed by 在 + place (藏在走廊里 'hidden in the hallway').

examples.text: 一扇真的门，就藏在走廊里！
examples.trans: A real door, hidden right here in the hallway!

examples.text: 小猫藏在桌子下面。
examples.trans: The kitten is hiding under the table.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cáng bǎo tú. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng). Joins 藏 ('to hide') + 宝 ('treasure') + 图 ('map').

examples.text: 孩子们兴奋地把那张旧水彩画当成了藏宝图。
examples.trans: The children excitedly treated that old watercolor painting as a treasure map.

examples.text: 传说这附近有一张明朝留下来的藏宝图。
examples.trans: Legend has it that there is a treasure map left over from the Ming Dynasty nearby.

meanings.note: Pinyin: téng tiáo. Combines 藤 ('climbing vine/creeper') + 条 ('long supple stem').

examples.text: 别剪断那根常春藤藤条，把它轻轻挪到花架上就行。
examples.trans: Don't cut that ivy vine; just lift it gently onto the trellis.

examples.text: 院墙上的绿藤条顺着木架一直往上爬。
examples.trans: The green vines on the courtyard wall climb all the way up the wooden frame.

蘸.gloss: dip lightly in liquid or sauce

meanings.en: dip lightly in liquid or sauce
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhàn. Used for dipping a sponge in water, a brush in ink/paint, or bread in soup.

examples.text: 先把海绵蘸进温水里，拧半干再去擦玻璃。
examples.trans: Dip the sponge in warm water first and wring it half dry before wiping the glass.

examples.text: 用热脆皮面包蘸着浓番茄汤吃真香呀！
examples.trans: Dipping warm crusty bread into rich tomato soup is delicious!

examples.text: 这是虐死啊。
examples.trans: This is abused to death.

examples.text: 那个虐死好。
examples.trans: That abused to death is good.

examples.text: 这是虐残啊。
examples.trans: This is abused to disability.

examples.text: 那个虐残好。
examples.trans: That abused to disability is good.

examples.text: 这是虐跑啊。
examples.trans: This is abused to running away.

examples.text: 那个虐跑好。
examples.trans: That abused to running away is good.

meanings.note: Adjective xū ('physically weak').

examples.text: 你刚输完液身体还这么虚，怎么能乱跑呢！
examples.trans: You are still so weak right after your drip—how can you run off!

examples.text: 大病初愈身子虚，这礼拜千万别再熬夜审片了。
examples.trans: Recovering from illness leaves you weak; no late-night edits this week.

meanings.note: Adjective xūjiǎ ('false, untrue').

examples.text: 我们把虚假报道上线又删除的事写成了文章。
examples.trans: We wrote an article on that fake report going up and vanishing.

examples.text: 新闻工作者绝不能发布任何虚假消息。
examples.trans: Journalists must never publish fabricated news.

meanings.note: Legal and media term for deceptive ads.

examples.text: 电视台对损害观众利益的虚假广告一律采取零容忍态度。
examples.trans: The network takes a zero-tolerance stance toward fraudulent commercials.

examples.text: 为了消除虚假广告带来的负面影响，团队连夜策划公益行动。
examples.trans: To undo fallout from the false ad, the team planned charity specials overnight.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a noun used in conversational Mandarin. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个虫 ('a 虫').

examples.text: 我有一个虫。
examples.trans: I have a 虫.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的虫。
examples.trans: This is a very good 虫.

meanings.note: Conjunction suīrán paired with 但是 ('although ...').

examples.text: 虽然暂时停播，但是我们肯定拍下一季。
examples.trans: Although paused for now, we will definitely shoot next season.

examples.text: 虽然工作很累，但是她很开心。
examples.trans: Although work is tiring, she is happy.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a noun used in conversational Mandarin. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个蚂蚁 ('a 蚂蚁').

examples.text: 我有一个蚂蚁。
examples.trans: I have a 蚂蚁.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的蚂蚁。
examples.trans: This is a very good 蚂蚁.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dàn gāo. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块蛋糕 ('a piece of cake').

examples.text: 他爷爷会切热柠檬蛋糕，上面撒一层白糖粉！
examples.trans: His grandfather sliced warm lemon cake with a dusting of powdered sugar on top!

examples.text: 十一点二十分。小美，蛋糕好了吗？
examples.trans: Eleven twenty. Mei, is the cake ready?

related.gloss: a piece of cake (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: dàn huáng. Combines 蛋 ('egg') + 黄 ('yellow yolk'); contrasts with 蛋白/蛋清 ('egg white'); measure word: 个 (gè).

examples.text: 小晴在碗里准备好了四个新鲜蛋黄、柠檬汁和三勺白糖。
examples.trans: Qing had four fresh egg yolks, lemon juice, and three spoons of sugar ready in the bowl.

examples.text: 做柠檬酱只用蛋黄不用蛋白，这样熬出来的酱才会金黄浓稠。
examples.trans: Lemon curd is made with egg yolks rather than whites so that the cooked curd turns out golden and rich.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a noun used in conversational Mandarin. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个蜂 ('a 蜂').

examples.text: 我有一个蜂。
examples.trans: I have a 蜂.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的蜂。
examples.trans: This is a very good 蜂.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fēng mì. Measure word (量词): 勺, e.g. 一勺蜂蜜 ('a spoonful of honey').

examples.text: 宋老师，给您热薄荷茶和蜂蜜。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, here is hot mint tea and honey for you.

examples.text: 太明智了！旁边要配蜂蜜还是苹果果酱？
examples.trans: Wise choice! Would you like honey or apple jam on the side?

related.gloss: a spoonful of honey (measure word 勺)

meanings.note: Pinyin: fēng là. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài) or 层 (céng). Joins 蜂 ('bee') + 蜡 ('wax').

examples.text: 信封的开口处滴着一圈红色的封印蜂蜡。
examples.trans: The opening of the envelope is dripped with a ring of red sealing beeswax.

examples.text: 老陈用一块天然蜂蜡仔细打磨着木雕。
examples.trans: Chen carefully polished the wood carving with a piece of natural beeswax.

meanings.note: Pinyin: là. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài) or 滴 (dī). The general term for wax.

examples.text: 桌面上滴落了一滩白色的烛蜡。
examples.trans: A puddle of white candle wax dripped onto the tabletop.

examples.text: 宋老师的皮鞋总是用专用的鞋蜡擦得铮亮。
examples.trans: Teacher Song's leather shoes are always polished bright with special shoe wax.

meanings.note: Pinyin: là bù. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài). Joins 蜡 ('wax') + 布 ('cloth'). Used for waterproofing.

examples.text: 这个古董木匣外面包裹着一层厚厚的防潮蜡布。
examples.trans: This antique wooden casket is wrapped in a thick layer of moisture-proof wax cloth.

examples.text: 下雨天，老陈总是穿着一件旧蜡布雨衣。
examples.trans: On rainy days, Chen always wears an old oilcloth raincoat.

examples.text: 十二歌王第三季将于下个月重新启幕，我们将融入全新的节目改版。
examples.trans: Season Three of Twelve Singers premieres next month, featuring a brand-new revamped competition format.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: luó sī. Measure word (量词): 颗 (kē), e.g. 一颗螺丝 ('a screw').

examples.text: 当心那把角落椅子，等十秒我拧紧螺丝。
examples.trans: Mind that corner chair—wait ten seconds while I tighten the screw.

examples.text: 老房子每到星期二就松一颗螺丝。坐吧。
examples.trans: Every Tuesday an old house loosens one screw. Sit down.

meanings.note: Pinyin: luó sī dāo. Measure word (量词): 把 (bǎ), e.g. 一把螺丝刀 ('a screwdriver').

examples.text: 这么快就修好了？老陈你随身带着螺丝刀啊！
examples.trans: Fixed that fast? Chen, you carry a screwdriver everywhere on you!

examples.text: 门把手松了，用十字螺丝刀拧两下就好。
examples.trans: The handle came loose—two turns with a screwdriver will tighten it.

meanings.note: Pinyin: luó wén. Measure word (量词): 圈 (quān), e.g. 一圈螺纹 ('a turn of threading').

examples.text: 一圈，两圈……看新铜螺纹咬合得多干净。
examples.trans: One turn, two turns... look how cleanly the new brass thread fits.

examples.text: 拧螺丝的时候要先对准里面的螺纹。
examples.trans: Line up the threads carefully before turning the screw.

related.gloss: a turn of threading (measure word 圈)

meanings.note: Pinyin: xuè yā. Measure word (量词): 项, e.g. 一项血压 ('blood pressure').

examples.text: 小晴，你真是天生的店长！我的血压保住了！
examples.trans: Qing, you are a born innkeeper! My blood pressure is saved!

examples.text: 医生叮嘱他平时少着急，注意血压。
examples.trans: The doctor reminded him not to fret and to mind his blood pressure.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xíng. Read xíng when meaning 'that works / okay' (不行 'won't work'); read háng when counting lines of text (第一行).

examples.text: 等等，咸黄油配果酱不行，做炒蛋却棒极了！
examples.trans: Wait—salted butter fails with jam, yet for scrambled eggs it is amazing!

examples.text: 小晴，替我念第一行。快说是我眼镜又看花眼了！
examples.trans: Qing, read the top line for me. Tell me my glasses are playing tricks on my eyes!

meanings.note: Meaning: won't work.

examples.text: 后备方案也行不通了！
examples.trans: The backup plan fell through too!

examples.text: 这是行不通。
examples.trans: This is 行不通.

meanings.note: Noun hángyè ('line of business, industry').

examples.text: 大不了我离开公司，永远离开这个行业。
examples.trans: At worst I leave the firm and quit this industry forever.

examples.text: 我们电视台目前在行业里排在第一位。
examples.trans: Our network currently ranks first in the industry.

meanings.note: Formal verb xíngshì ('conduct oneself').

examples.text: 闻老师，我行事向来有自己的分寸。
examples.trans: Mr Wen Simo, I have my own sense of measure in how I act.

examples.text: 在复杂的职场里行事既要果断又要稳重。
examples.trans: In a complex workplace, act decisively yet steadily.

examples.text: 我们要采取行动。
examples.trans: We must take action.

examples.text: 行动开始。
examples.trans: The action begins.

examples.text: 他的行动力很强。
examples.trans: His action power is very strong.

examples.text: 缺乏行动力。
examples.trans: Lack action power.

meanings.note: Noun xíngzhèng ('administrative operations').

examples.text: 像这样选择做行政的毕业生很少见。
examples.trans: Graduates choosing administrative work like this are rare.

examples.text: 星天一直重业务轻行政。
examples.trans: Xingtian prioritizes production over administration.

meanings.note: Corporate noun xíngzhèngchù ('administration office').

examples.text: 有什么命令请通过系统下达到行政处。
examples.trans: Send any orders to the administrative office via the system.

examples.text: 办公用品可以去行政处领取。
examples.trans: Office supplies can be picked up from administration.

meanings.note: Noun xíngzhèngbù ('admin department').

examples.text: 公司没有专门的行政部。
examples.trans: The company has no separate admin department.

examples.text: 行政部负责采购办公用品。
examples.trans: The admin department handles office supplies.

meanings.note: Suitcases and gear packed for travel.

examples.text: 出发去机场前，他帮大家把行李搬上了车。
examples.trans: Before heading to the airport, he loaded everyone's luggage aboard.

examples.text: 出差几天而已，带一件轻便的随身行李就够了。
examples.trans: For just a few days away, one light carry-on bag is plenty.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xíng li pái. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张行李牌 ('a luggage tag').

examples.text: 您先坐下，别着急，我们马上看行李牌。
examples.trans: Please sit down first and do not worry; we will check the luggage tag right away.

examples.text: 哎呀，怎么拿错了！我戴眼镜看看行李牌。
examples.trans: Dear me, what a mix-up! Let me put on my glasses and check the luggage tag.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xíng li xiāng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个行李箱 ('a suitcase').

examples.text: 很安静，谢谢，不过这个行李箱今天特别重。
examples.trans: Very quiet, thank you, though this suitcase feels especially heavy today.

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

examples.text: 忙着呢，而且你要是问她的行程，你得问她的经纪人啊。
examples.trans: She's tied up right now — besides, if you're asking after her schedule, you ought to ask her manager here.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

行行好.gloss: do me a favour, have a heart (pleading/exasperated)

meanings.en: do me a favour, have a heart (pleading/exasperated)
meanings.note: Colloquial plea or exasperated remark (pronounced xíngxínghǎo).

examples.text: 你行行好，别再给我添乱了好不好？
examples.trans: Do me a favour and stop making things messier for me, alright?

examples.text: 大伙儿都累了一整天，您就行行好让大家早点下班吧。
examples.trans: Everyone worked all day—have a heart and let us head home early.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiē. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条街 ('a street').

examples.text: 可惜没有电话号码，只有两个字母和老街名字。
examples.trans: Unfortunately there is no phone number, only two letters and an old street name.

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiē shang. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 整条街上 ('along the street').

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiē kǒu. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个街口 ('a street corner').

examples.text: 听……街口钟楼开始敲十二下了！
examples.trans: Listen... the clock tower at the end of the street is starting to strike twelve!

examples.text: 出了院门走到街口就能打到出租车。
examples.trans: Walk out the gate to the end of the lane and you can hail a cab.

meanings.en: neighbors; folks on the same street
meanings.note: Pinyin: jiē fang. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位街坊 ('a neighborhood resident').

examples.text: 超过八十年的小院建筑，只要一楼每天服务街坊邻居，禁止改成私人办公室。
examples.trans: Any courtyard building over eighty years old may not become private offices as long as the ground floor serves neighbours daily.

examples.text: 每天服务街坊邻居——就像对公众开放的早间咖啡馆？！
examples.trans: Serves neighbours daily—like a morning café open to the public?!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiē jiǎo. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个街角 ('a street corner').

examples.text: 先别灰心坐下！继续往街角看。
examples.trans: Do not sit down discouraged yet! Keep looking toward the street corner.

examples.text: 街角那家绿色招牌的药店九点开门。
examples.trans: That green-signed pharmacy on the corner opens at nine.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiē biān. Measure word (量词): 排 (pái), e.g. 街边店铺 ('streetfront shops').

examples.text: 多半是粉刷街边木窗那种无聊通知吧。
examples.trans: Probably some boring notice about painting the street shutters.

examples.text: 街边摆着四张木桌，坐满了喝早茶的人。
examples.trans: Four wooden tables along the streetfront are filled with morning tea drinkers.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiē dào. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条街道 ('a street').

examples.text: 看我们这家旁边写着：院子宽度、街道声音、安静九分！
examples.trans: Look beside ours: Courtyard width, street noise, quiet score nine points!

examples.text: 这一周的街道记录全在里面，多亏了你。
examples.trans: All my street notes from this week are inside—thanks to you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiē mén. Combines 街 ('street') + 门 ('gate/door'): the outer gate opening from a courtyard house onto the lane; measure word: 扇 (shàn).

examples.text: 看看我们挂在街门上的小木牌——简短、温暖，又容易读。
examples.trans: Look at the small wooden sign we hung on the street gate—brief, warm, and easy to read.

examples.text: 星期三下午，小院的街门向整条梧桐巷的街坊敞开。
examples.trans: On Wednesday afternoon, the courtyard's street gate stood wide open to neighbours all along Wutong Lane.

examples.text: 全公司的人都知道了，昨天他接你下班，今天又来送你上班，你的衣服也没有换。
examples.trans: The whole company knows! He picked you up yesterday, drove you in today, and you haven't even changed clothes.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

补写.gloss: write in missing parts; compose the remainder

meanings.en: write in missing parts; compose the remainder
meanings.note: Pinyin: bǔ xiě. Combines 补 ('patch/supplement/fill in') + 写 ('write').

examples.text: 周经理，我可以为您姑姑的圆舞曲补写最后十六个小节吗？
examples.trans: Manager Zhou, may I write the missing sixteen bars for your aunt's waltz?

examples.text: 小晴把登记本上漏掉的房号仔细补写好了。
examples.trans: Qing carefully filled in the room number that had been left off the guest book.

补齐.gloss: make up in full, complete missing parts

meanings.en: make up in full, complete missing parts
meanings.note: Verb-complement bǔqí ('fill in missing data/items').

examples.text: 你去年论文缺少的调研数据现在补齐了吗？
examples.trans: Have you finished filling in the missing data for your thesis?

examples.text: 报销之前请把缺少的两张餐饮发票补齐。
examples.trans: Please supply the two missing meal receipts before filing.

meanings.note: Verb biǎo ('express one's stance').

examples.text: 我代表淳于总先向您表个态。
examples.trans: Let me state a clear gesture on Chun Yuqiao's behalf.

examples.text: 这束鲜花用来表一点大家的心意。
examples.trans: These flowers express everyone's warm regards.

meanings.note: Pinyin: biǎo gē. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位表哥 ('an older cousin').

examples.text: 完全是意外！到表哥家打开一看，里面是乐谱和红丝带。
examples.trans: Completely by accident! At my cousin's home I opened it and saw sheet music and a red ribbon.

examples.text: 我表哥在火车站旁边的邮局上班。
examples.trans: My older cousin works at the post office beside the train station.

表弟.gloss: younger male cousin (on the mother's or aunt's side)

meanings.en: younger male cousin (on the mother's or aunt's side)
meanings.note: Pinyin: biǎo dì. Combines 表 ('cousin through female/marriage line') + 弟 ('younger brother'); measure word: 个 (gè) or 位 (wèi).

examples.text: 书店老板、药店药剂师、面包师的表弟，还有十二位邻居！
examples.trans: The bookshop owner, the pharmacist, the baker's cousin, and twelve neighbours!

examples.text: 面包师的表弟今天也来小院咖啡馆尝新鲜柠檬挞了。
examples.trans: The baker's younger cousin also came to the courtyard café today to taste the fresh lemon tart.

meanings.note: Pinyin: biǎo qíng. Measure word (量词): 副 (fù), e.g. 一副表情 ('a facial expression').

examples.text: 等周经理听说他为分贝慌了一整夜，表情一定精彩！
examples.trans: Wait until Manager Zhou hears he panicked all night over decibels!

examples.text: 看到那块大蛋糕，孩子们脸上全是开心的表情。
examples.trans: Seeing that big cake, the children's faces lit up with joy.

examples.text: 精彩表演。
examples.trans: Wonderful performance.

examples.text: 看表演。
examples.trans: Watch performance.

表现.gloss: perform, show what one can do

meanings.en: perform, show what one can do
meanings.note: Verb/noun biǎoxiàn ('acquit oneself; performance').

examples.text: 星天准备得很到位，咱们也得好好表现。
examples.trans: Xingtian prepared thoroughly, so we should perform well too.

examples.text: 小谷在现场的表现非常稳重。
examples.trans: Xiaogu handled herself very steadily on set.

表白.gloss: confess romantic feelings, declare one's love

meanings.en: confess romantic feelings, declare one's love
meanings.note: Telling someone openly that one likes or loves them.

examples.text: 他鼓起勇气向喜欢的姑娘表白了。
examples.trans: He summoned his courage and confessed his feelings to the girl.

examples.text: 突然在办公室被人表白让她很尴尬。
examples.trans: Being confessed to out of the blue at work embarrassed her.

examples.text: 关于此次我公司的侵权事件，表示非常抱歉。
examples.trans: Regarding our company's copyright incident, we express our deepest apologies.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Verb biǎodá ('express feelings or ideas').

examples.text: 我总得先表达一下我的诚意。
examples.trans: I ought to express my sincerity first.

examples.text: 这首歌把年轻人追梦的心情表达得很到位。
examples.trans: This song expresses young dreamers' feelings spot-on.

meanings.note: Noun biǎomiàn ('surface').

examples.text: 从表面的形式上已经说明了辩证的道理。
examples.trans: From its surface form it already illustrates dialectics.

examples.text: 看问题不能只看表面，要看背后的逻辑。
examples.trans: Look past the surface to see the logic underneath.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chèn shān. Measure word (量词): 件 (jiàn), e.g. 一件衬衫 ('a shirt').

examples.text: 看楼上阁楼窗户：志豪已经换了三件衬衫了！
examples.trans: Look up at the attic window: Hao has changed shirts three times already!

examples.text: 他今天穿了一件干净的白衬衫上班。
examples.trans: He wore a crisp white shirt to work today.

meanings.note: Classifier/noun dài ('bagful').

examples.text: 麻烦你们把这袋硬盘送回素材房。
examples.trans: Please carry this bag of hard drives back to the archive room.

examples.text: 她买了一袋新鲜苹果。
examples.trans: She bought a bag of fresh apples.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dài zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个袋子 ('a bag').

examples.text: 给我袋子和现金！路口市场七点开门。
examples.trans: Give me a bag and cash! The corner market opens at seven.

examples.text: 请用纸袋子把这四个热面包卷装起来。
examples.trans: Please pack these four warm bread rolls in a paper bag.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiù zi. Combines 袖 ('garment sleeve') + noun suffix 子.

examples.text: 大家挽起袖子，开始擦洗九号房高大的拱窗。
examples.trans: Everyone rolled up their sleeves and started washing Room Nine's tall arched windows.

examples.text: 抢搬最后两扇窗板进走廊时，我的袖子全被雨淋透了。
examples.trans: While rushing the last two shutters into the hallway, my sleeves got completely soaked.

meanings.note: Meaning: by (passive).

examples.text: 被我全搞砸了，我该怎么办啊？
examples.trans: I ruined the whole thing — what should I do?

examples.text: 这是被。
examples.trans: This is 被.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bèi zi. Measure word (量词): 床 (chuáng), e.g. 一床被子 ('a quilt').

examples.text: 我床上有厚被子，今晚睡着很舒服。
examples.trans: I have a thick quilt on my bed, so sleeping tonight is very comfortable.

examples.text: 阁楼床上铺着一床厚实暖和的棉被子。
examples.trans: A thick, cozy cotton quilt is spread on the attic bed.

被打脸.gloss: get publicly contradicted, eat one's words

meanings.en: get publicly contradicted, eat one's words
meanings.note: Colloquial passive phrase bèi dǎliǎn ('be humiliated by facts').

examples.text: 等节目一播，简直就是等着被打脸了。
examples.trans: Once the show airs, it looks like instant public humiliation.

examples.text: 刚说完不会下雨，出门就被大雨打脸了。
examples.trans: Right after saying it would not rain, a downpour proved him wrong.

被毙.gloss: get shot down, be rejected (of a pitch)

meanings.en: get shot down, be rejected (of a pitch)
meanings.note: Colloquial passive phrase bèibì ('have a proposal killed').

examples.text: 这方案提前跟谁都没沟通过，上会肯定被毙。
examples.trans: Cleared with nobody beforehand, this pitch will get shot down.

examples.text: 连续三个创意被毙之后，第四稿终于通过了。
examples.trans: After three rejected concepts, the fourth draft finally passed.

examples.text: 男友是被誉为天才制作人的淳于乔，出现在大众媒体的面前。
examples.trans: Her boyfriend is none other than genius producer Chun Yuqiao, stepping before the public media together.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 这次你又被骗了，你又被利用了，我会生气，我会心疼。
examples.trans: This time you were deceived and used all over again — that makes me angry, and it hurts me.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Verb/noun xíjī ('sudden attack').

examples.text: 他领养的弟弟在那场突发袭击里失踪了。
examples.trans: His adopted younger brother went missing in that sudden attack.

examples.text: 沿海城市提前做好了防御强台风袭击的准备。
examples.trans: Coastal cities prepared early against the oncoming typhoon strike.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liè. Describes cracked porcelain, wood, or pipes.

examples.text: 坏消息。老热水器上的铜压力阀门裂了。
examples.trans: Bad news. The brass pressure valve on the old water heater cracked.

examples.text: 旧茶杯边上裂了一道小口子。
examples.trans: A tiny crack appeared on the rim of the old teacup.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liè kāi. Resultative compound 裂 ('crack/split') + 开 ('apart/open').

examples.text: 太好了，钢琴里面的老木头一点都没裂开！
examples.trans: Wonderful—none of the old wood inside the piano is cracked!

examples.text: 冬天空气太干燥时，旧木板有时会裂开一道细缝。
examples.trans: When winter air gets too dry, old wooden boards sometimes crack slightly.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuāng. Used for packing items into a bag/box (装进) or fitting hardware.

examples.text: 我来帮您。哎呀，里面装了石头吗？
examples.trans: Let me help you. Goodness, did you pack stones inside?

examples.text: 他没要回那个装木头小火车的箱子吗？
examples.trans: Did he not ask back for that case with the wooden train?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuāng huí. Resultative compound 装 ('install/fit') + 回 ('back into place').

examples.text: 老陈能把这么细小的黄铜轴销稳稳装回木头孔里。
examples.trans: Chen can seat a tiny brass hinge pin that small cleanly back into the wood.

examples.text: 等绿油漆干透以后，我们再把四扇窗板装回合页上。
examples.trans: Once the green paint dries completely, we will hang all four shutters back on their hinges.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuāng mǎn. Resultative verb compound 装 ('fill/load/hold') + 满 ('full').

examples.text: 这台老核桃木琴箱发出的温暖琴声，把整间玻璃房都装满了！
examples.trans: The warm sound from this old walnut piano case filled the entire glass room!

examples.text: 周经理睡觉以前把小美那两个大白瓷罐都装满了。
examples.trans: Before going to bed, Manager Zhou filled both of Mei's big white ceramic jars to the brim.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qún zi. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条裙子 ('a skirt / dress').

examples.text: 只有裙子、乐谱，还有我最喜欢的茶杯！
examples.trans: Only dresses, sheet music, and my favourite teacup!

examples.text: 她穿了一条浅蓝色的长裙子去音乐厅。
examples.trans: She wore a light-blue dress to the concert hall.

裸辞.gloss: resign without another job lined up

meanings.en: resign without another job lined up
meanings.note: Modern workplace term for quitting clean without a backup offer.

examples.text: 当年经历变故之后，他毅然选择裸辞离开了自己成名的公司。
examples.trans: After that upheaval, he resolutely quit his old firm with nothing lined up.

examples.text: 职场前辈建议年轻人在裸辞之前先做好清晰的职业规划。
examples.trans: Veteran mentors advise planning carefully before quitting without an offer.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tuì sè. Joins 褪 ('to take off, to shed') + 色 ('color'). Can also be pronounced tùn sè.

examples.text: 阳光晒久了，墙上的旧海报已经严重褪色。
examples.trans: Having been exposed to the sun for a long time, the old poster on the wall has severely faded.

examples.text: 这件深蓝色的外套洗了几次后，有点褪色了。
examples.trans: After a few washes, this dark blue jacket has faded a little.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīběi.

examples.text: 风从西北方向吹来。
examples.trans: The wind is blowing from the northwest.

examples.text: 中国的西北地区气候比较干燥。
examples.trans: The climate in the northwest region of China is relatively dry.

examples.text: 希望作为最大的战略合作伙伴，能够帮我们把原创的节目打进西方主流市场。
examples.trans: When that day comes, we hope our strategic partner will help bring our original shows into mainstream global markets.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xī zhuāng. Combines 西 ('Western') + 装 ('attire/suit'); measure word: 套 (tào, full suit) or 件 (jiàn, suit jacket).

examples.text: 老陈笑着说：“您的老花镜安安全全装在西装口袋里呢，老板！”
examples.trans: Chen smiled and said, 'Your reading glasses are tucked safe and sound in your suit pocket, boss!'

examples.text: 为了迎接下午三点的审核，周经理特意穿上了一套整洁的深蓝西装。
examples.trans: To welcome the three-o'clock review, Manager Zhou put on a neat dark-blue suit.

meanings.note: Restaurant serving Western cuisine.

examples.text: 公司楼下新开了一家环境很好的西餐厅。
examples.trans: A nice Western restaurant just opened downstairs from the office.

examples.text: 中午我让附近的西餐厅送两份牛排过来。
examples.trans: At noon I will have the nearby Western restaurant deliver steak.

meanings.en: want; need; will / be going to
meanings.note: Pinyin: yào. Direct verb for ordering/requesting ('want'), obligation ('need to'), or imminent future (要下雨了).

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

meanings.note: yàobù — placed before a clause to tentatively propose an alternative or offer help
introduces an undesirable consequence if the preceding situation does not change (short for 要不然)

examples.text: 在那边，要不我带您过去？
examples.trans: Over there — how about I take you over?

examples.text: 快走吧，要不我们就要迟到了。
examples.trans: Let's hurry up, otherwise we are going to be late.

要不是.gloss: if it were not for, had it not been for

meanings.en: if it were not for, had it not been for
meanings.note: Counterfactual conjunction yàobúshì ('were it not for').

examples.text: 那天要不是总编室拦住，假新闻早传遍了。
examples.trans: Had the editorial office not stopped them, the fake story would have spread.

examples.text: 要不是你及时提醒，我差点忘了带工牌。
examples.trans: If you had not reminded me, I would have forgotten my badge.

meanings.note: Conjunction yàobùrán ('how about instead; otherwise').

examples.text: 要不然咱们从成熟的制片里挑两个留下来？
examples.trans: How about picking two seasoned producers to stay on?

examples.text: 快记下来吧，要不然一会儿就忘了。
examples.trans: Write it down quickly, otherwise you will forget.

meanings.note: Correlative conjunction yàome ('either... or...').

examples.text: 要么好好练厨艺，要么你就别下厨房了。
examples.trans: Either practise your cooking properly or stay out of the kitchen.

examples.text: 周末她要么去图书馆看书，要么在机房看片。
examples.trans: On weekends she either reads at the library or studies tapes.

要回.gloss: to get back, ask back for

examples.text: 他终于从旧货店老板手里要回了祖父的怀表。
examples.trans: He finally got his grandfather's pocket watch back from the antique shop owner.

examples.text: 如果那份老合同还在档案室里，我们一定要把它要回来。
examples.trans: If that old contract is still in the archives, we must make sure to get it back.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yào shi. Everyday spoken 'if', often paired with 就 in the main clause.

examples.text: 等等——要是每天早上打开院门，卖街坊咖啡和热面包……
examples.trans: Wait—if we open our courtyard gate every morning for neighbourhood coffee and warm bread...

examples.text: 周经理，要是你不正式聘用她，我就请她进我厨房！
examples.trans: Manager Zhou, if you do not hire her permanently, I am hiring her into my kitchen!

examples.text: 这是要求啊。
examples.trans: This is demands.

examples.text: 那个要求好。
examples.trans: That demands is good.

meanings.note: Often in 身体要紧 ('health comes first').

examples.text: 工作永远干不完，还是先把身体养好最要紧。
examples.trans: Work never ends—getting your health back comes first.

examples.text: 擦破一点皮不要紧，贴上创可贴就好了。
examples.trans: A tiny scrape is nothing serious—a plaster will fix it.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiàn. Appears in farewells (再见, 明天见) and as result complement of perception (看见, 听见).

examples.text: 晚安，小晴。明天早餐见。
examples.trans: Good night, Qing. See you at breakfast tomorrow.

examples.text: 老陈，听得见吗？我刚经过绿药店！
examples.trans: Chen, can you hear me? I just passed the green pharmacy!

examples.text: 见到你的大师兄了，感觉怎么样？
examples.trans: Now that you have met your senior alumnus, how does it feel?

examples.text: 见到你的大师兄了，感觉怎么样？
examples.trans: Now that you have met your senior alumnus, how does it feel?

meanings.note: Colloquial predicate jiàndeduōle ('seen this sort countless times').

examples.text: 像这种自大的人，我在圈里见得多了。
examples.trans: I have seen plenty of arrogant types like him.

examples.text: 直播现场的小状况老导演见得多了。
examples.trans: Veteran directors have seen every small studio hiccup.

examples.text: 这就是我前两天的见闻。淳于总的过去有过洛琳，有过钟阳子，现在都已经不在他的生活里了。
examples.trans: That's what I witnessed overseas these past two days: Luo Lin and Zhong Yangzi were chapters of Mr Chun Yu's past, and neither is in his life anymore.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiàn miàn. Separable verb-object compound (跟朋友见面 'meet a friend').

examples.text: 约他星期五中午在这儿见面吗？
examples.trans: Asking him to meet you here on Friday at noon?

examples.text: 好久不见，真高兴今天能在成都见面！
examples.trans: Long time no see—how wonderful to meet in person in Chengdu today!

meanings.note: noun

examples.text: 观众朋友们，欢迎各位！
examples.trans: Friends in the audience, welcome everyone!

examples.text: 观众朋友们，欢迎各位！
examples.trans: Friends in the audience, welcome everyone!

meanings.note: Verb/noun guānchá ('watch closely; clinical observation').

examples.text: 医生说他还得在医院住几天观察一下。
examples.trans: Doctors say he must stay a few days for observation.

examples.text: 优秀的编导善于观察生活中的小细节。
examples.trans: Good producers observe small details in daily life.

meanings.note: Comprehensive planning for development or careers.

examples.text: 他在战略大会上展示了未来三年的节目引进与研发规划。
examples.trans: At the summit he unveiled a three-year content roadmap.

examples.text: 清晰的职业规划能帮助新人在忙碌的行业里稳步成长。
examples.trans: A clear career roadmap helps newcomers grow steadily.

meanings.note: Noun guīzé ('rules of a game or competition').

examples.text: 你总不能把节目的基本规则都改了吧？
examples.trans: Surely you cannot change all the basic rules of the show?

examples.text: 新赛制的比赛规则既公平又充满悬念。
examples.trans: The new format's rules are fair and full of suspense.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guī dìng. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条规定 ('a regulation').

examples.text: 脑子转得快，小晴。志豪每星期都读城市建筑规定。
examples.trans: Quick thinking, Qing. Hao reads city building rules every single week.

examples.text: 按照新规定，早晨八点起向邻居开放。
examples.trans: Under the new rule, we open to neighbors starting at eight a.m.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guī ju. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条规矩 ('a house rule').

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 老茶馆有个好规矩：进门先送一杯热茶。
examples.trans: Old teahouses have a warm custom: a hot cup of tea right as you walk in.

examples.text: 我也不能让父母的事情曝光在大众的视线里面，我必须得保护他。
examples.trans: Nor can I let their private pain be exposed to the public eye — I have to protect him.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 我看了一个视频。
examples.trans: I watched a video.

examples.text: 你可以拍视频吗？
examples.trans: Can you shoot a video?

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiào. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个好觉 ('a good sleep').

examples.text: 今晚我应该能睡个好觉了。
examples.trans: Tonight I should be able to sleep well after all.

examples.text: 祝您睡个好觉。早餐七点半在楼下。
examples.trans: Sleep well, sir. Breakfast is at seven thirty downstairs.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jué de. Introduces personal impressions or feelings.

examples.text: 周经理的意思是……希望每位客人都觉得有十分满意！
examples.trans: What Manager Zhou means is... we hope every guest feels ten-out-of-ten satisfied!

examples.text: 我觉得这间向阳的书房最安静。
examples.trans: I think this sunny study is the quietest room of all.

examples.text: 我觉着非常不妥，演技浮夸。
examples.trans: I thought throwing the game looked clumsy — the acting was way over the top.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǎo. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个角落 ('a corner').

examples.text: 小晴，把床单角塞紧！放上两个软枕头。
examples.trans: Qing, tuck the sheet corner tight! On go the two soft pillows.

examples.text: 信封右上角贴着一张邮票。
examples.trans: A stamp is stuck on the upper-right corner of the envelope.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǎo shang. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 箱子角上 ('on the suitcase corner').

examples.text: 等一下……梧桐巷十二号，角落里还写着两个童年名字的首字母！
examples.trans: Wait a moment... Number twelve, Wutong Lane, with two childhood initials written in the corner!

examples.text: 木桌角上贴着防撞的软布条。
examples.trans: Soft protective strips are taped onto the corners of the wooden table.

related.gloss: on the suitcase corner (measure word 个)

meanings.note: Noun jiǎodù ('angle, viewpoint').

examples.text: 成败有时取决于你从哪个角度出发去想。
examples.trans: Success sometimes hinges on which angle you think from.

examples.text: 换一个机位角度拍摄，舞台效果好多了。
examples.trans: Shooting from another camera angle makes the stage pop.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǎo luò. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个角落 ('a corner').

examples.text: 当心那把角落椅子，等十秒我拧紧螺丝。
examples.trans: Mind that corner chair—wait ten seconds while I tighten the screw.

examples.text: 为小院客栈干杯——成都最热闹的安静角落！
examples.trans: Cheers to Courtyard Inn—the liveliest quiet corner in Chengdu!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiě. Takes directional complements like 解下 ('untie and take off') or 解开 ('untie/unfasten').

examples.text: 解下围裙吧——星期五六点到了！
examples.trans: Untie your aprons—six o'clock on Friday is here!

examples.text: 志鹏解开绑香草束的细麻绳，把百里香放进汤锅里。
examples.trans: Peng untied the kitchen twine around the herb bundle and placed the thyme into the soup pot.

meanings.note: workplace verb for settling a problem

examples.text: 出了点问题，我解决一下。
examples.trans: A small problem came up; I will take care of it.

examples.text: 这个技术故障已经解决了。
examples.trans: This technical glitch has already been resolved.

解开.gloss: untie, unfasten, lift (a burden or knot)

meanings.en: untie, unfasten, lift (a burden or knot)
meanings.note: Loosening a physical knot or an emotional/heavy burden.

examples.text: 把误会说清楚，心里的结就解开了。
examples.trans: Talk through the misunderstanding and the knot in your heart unties.

examples.text: 他帮大家解开了困扰很久的难题。
examples.trans: He helped everyone untangle a long-standing puzzle.

meanings.note: Releasing someone from overwork or constraint.

examples.text: 大家分担事务，就能把老板从琐事里解放出来了。
examples.trans: Sharing tasks frees the boss from endless minutiae.

examples.text: 新工具大大解放了后期剪辑师的双手。
examples.trans: New tools freed up the post-production editors enormously.

examples.text: 解约了。
examples.trans: Canceled contract.

examples.text: 想解约。
examples.trans: Want to cancel contract.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiě shì. Works as both verb and noun.

examples.text: 五分钟演讲稿，列了十九条理由解释那年春天我们都错了。
examples.trans: A five-minute speech listing nineteen reasons why we were both wrong that spring.

examples.text: 听完她的耐心解释，客人笑着表示理解。
examples.trans: After her patient explanation, the guest smiled in understanding.

examples.text: 除了工作，我什么都无所谓。所以现在，契约解除。
examples.trans: Outside of work, nothing matters to me at all. So as of right now, our pact is dissolved.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Noun yánlùn ('spoken remarks, statements').

examples.text: 那我收回刚才的言论。
examples.trans: Then I retract my remark just now.

examples.text: 网上的不实言论很快就会过去。
examples.trans: False remarks online blow over quickly.

meanings.note: Noun jǐngchá ('police').

examples.text: 从来没有人被警察带出过公司。
examples.trans: Nobody has ever been led out of the firm by police.

examples.text: 有困难可以找路边的警察帮忙。
examples.trans: Ask a police officer nearby if you need help.

meanings.note: Short noun jǐngjú ('police station').

examples.text: 快把我的人从警局里放出来。
examples.trans: Have my person released from the police station at once.

examples.text: 她在警局里配合做完了笔录。
examples.trans: She finished giving her statement at the police station.

meanings.note: Formal collective noun jǐngfāng ('the police').

examples.text: 律师已经向警方撤回报案了。
examples.trans: The lawyer has withdrawn the report with the police.

examples.text: 警方正在调查昨晚的事故。
examples.trans: The police are investigating last night's incident.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jì huà. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个计划 ('a plan').

examples.text: 那是星期一胆小的计划……那时候还没认识你们。
examples.trans: That was Monday's timid plan... before I met all of you.

examples.text: 周末开院子咖啡馆的计划大家都赞成。
examples.trans: Everyone is in favor of the plan to open the courtyard café.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jì shí qì. Compound 计时 ('count/measure time') + 器 ('instrument/device'); measure word: 个 (gè).

examples.text: 先别掉眼泪，我的厨房面包计时器叮铃铃响了！
examples.trans: Don't shed tears just yet—my kitchen bread timer just rang!

examples.text: 小美把烤箱旁边的计时器定在三十五分钟，提醒志鹏准时取面包。
examples.trans: Mei set the timer beside the oven for thirty-five minutes to remind Peng to take the bread out on time.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dìng. Specifically used for reserving rooms, tickets, or restaurant tables (订房间).

examples.text: 早上好，姑娘。我有一个宋名下的预订。
examples.trans: Good morning, young lady. I have a booking for Song.

examples.text: 是谁啊？又有人订周末的房间吗？
examples.trans: Who is it? Someone else booking a room for the weekend?

meanings.note: Pinyin: rèn. Core verb in 认识 ('know'), 认出来 ('recognize'), and 认输 ('admit defeat').

examples.text: 留下来，小美。就算他转身走出大门，我也认了。
examples.trans: I am staying, Mei. Even if he turns around and walks straight out the gate.

examples.text: 明信片上整齐的方格字，我两秒钟就认出来了。
examples.trans: That neat block handwriting on the postcard—I recognized it in two seconds.

examples.text: 大家一致认为本土化是电视发展的正途。你就放心大胆干吧，我保证他们通过改版。
examples.trans: Everyone agrees homegrown innovation is television's true path forward — go ahead boldly, and I guarantee they'll approve it.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 得到认可。
examples.trans: Get approval.

examples.text: 不认可。
examples.trans: Do not approve.

认命.gloss: accept one's lot, resign oneself playfully to fate

meanings.en: accept one's lot, resign oneself playfully to fate
meanings.note: Used seriously or jokingly when outshone.

examples.text: 学生们都找帅气的嘉宾拍照，老师只好笑着认命。
examples.trans: With students flocking to the handsome guest for photos, the professor jokingly accepted his fate.

examples.text: 遇到困难别急着认命，再努力试一次也许就成了。
examples.trans: Do not give up so fast when trouble hits—try once more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: rèn de. Joins 认 ('to recognize') + 得 (complement particle). Usually used for recognizing people or familiar objects.

examples.text: 志鹏一眼就认得这是弟弟小时候的字迹。
examples.trans: At a glance, Peng recognized this as his younger brother's childhood handwriting.

examples.text: 小晴刚来客栈没多久，还不认得所有的常客。
examples.trans: Qing hasn't been at the inn for long, and still doesn't recognize all the regular guests.

meanings.note: Verb-complement rènqīng ('see clearly, tell apart').

examples.text: 端茶送水也得先认清各个部门。
examples.trans: Even serving tea requires knowing every department clearly.

examples.text: 我们要认清目前的形势。
examples.trans: We need to see the current situation clearly.

examples.text: 很认真。
examples.trans: Very earnest.

examples.text: 认真学习。
examples.trans: Study earnestly.

meanings.note: Pinyin: rèn shi. Contrast 知道 ('know a fact').

examples.text: 你好，小美，很高兴认识你！好香啊！
examples.trans: Hello, Mei, nice to meet you! Something smells wonderful!

examples.text: 真的吗？您在成都认识什么人吗？
examples.trans: Really? Do you know someone here in Chengdu?

meanings.note: Pinyin: rèn shū. Separable verb-object compound.

examples.text: 整份文件还没读完呢，周经理，别先认输。
examples.trans: We have not even finished reading the whole document, Manager Zhou—don't give up yet.

examples.text: 事情还没到最后一步，我们绝不认输。
examples.trans: Until the very last step, we will never give up.

meanings.note: Idiom tǎojià-huánjià ('haggle back and forth').

examples.text: 你应该清楚我的脾气，我从来不讨价还价。
examples.trans: As you ought to know well, I never haggle over terms.

examples.text: 涉及舞台安全底线的要求绝不能讨价还价。
examples.trans: Safety baselines onstage are never up for bargaining.

meanings.note: Verb/adjective tǎoyàn ('detest, dislike').

examples.text: 他最讨厌被别人拿私事来威胁。
examples.trans: He hates most of all being threatened over private matters.

examples.text: 你不是最讨厌做琐碎的行政工作了吗？
examples.trans: Do you not hate doing routine admin chores the most?

meanings.note: Verb/noun tǎolùn ('discuss').

examples.text: 今天请大家来，想讨论一下共同制作的事。
examples.trans: We invited everyone today to discuss co-production.

examples.text: 策划会在热烈的讨论中持续了两个小时。
examples.trans: The planning meeting ran two hours in lively discussion.

examples.text: 刚才秦箫跟我说，电视台的邓主任要开那个改版讨论会，正在会议室等您呢。
examples.trans: Qin Xiao just told me the network director is here for the revamp discussion and waiting for you in the conference room.

examples.text: 闻老师，你不愧是独步江湖的段子手，我们开个讨论会你还卖关子呢。
examples.trans: Mr Wen, you truly live up to your reputation as a master storyteller — keeping us in suspense during a review meeting!

meanings.note: Pinyin: ràng. Everyday causative/polite-offer verb (让我看看 'let me have a look').

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 宋老师，让我来给您倒新鲜橙汁！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, allow me to pour fresh orange juice for you!

让开.gloss: step aside, get out of the way

meanings.en: step aside, get out of the way

examples.text: 让开。
examples.trans: Out of my way.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 这些人现在全都不接我电话了，估计全都不打算让步了。
examples.trans: None of those agency reps will even pick up my calls now — clearly none of them plan to budge.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 全世界的人都在议论说白杨的声音和某个人很像，其实我并不这么认为。
examples.trans: Everyone out there is gossiping that Bai Yang's voice sounds just like someone else's, yet I don't see it that way at all.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jì. Used both for jotting down notes (记下) and holding in memory (记住).

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

examples.text: 快问他叫什么名字！记下来！
examples.trans: Quick, ask him what his name is! Write it down!

meanings.note: Verb-complement jìxialai ('write down for reference').

examples.text: 麻烦你把要求记下来。
examples.trans: Please write these requests down.

examples.text: 好主意要马上记下来。
examples.trans: Write good ideas down right away.

meanings.note: Holding instructions or lessons in memory.

examples.text: 医生交代的忌口事项，我已经全部记住了。
examples.trans: I have memorised every dietary rule the doctor gave.

examples.text: 请大家一定要记住紧急出口的位置。
examples.trans: Please keep the location of the emergency exits in mind.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jì hao. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè). Joins 记 ('to record') + 号 ('symbol'). Neutral tone on the second syllable.

examples.text: 树干上刻着一个三角形的记号。
examples.trans: A triangular mark is carved into the tree trunk.

examples.text: 老陈在修好的管子上画了个红色的记号。
examples.trans: Chen drew a red mark on the repaired pipe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jì lù. Measure word (量词): 份 (fèn), e.g. 一份记录 ('a written record').

examples.text: 这一周的街道记录全在里面，多亏了你。
examples.trans: All my street notes from this week are inside—thanks to you.

examples.text: 这本厚账本记录着客栈十年的故事。
examples.trans: This thick ledger records ten years of the inn's stories.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jì de. Describes recalling something from memory.

examples.text: 钱箱里拿五十块，记得要收据！
examples.trans: Here is fifty yuan from the cash box; remember to get a receipt!

examples.text: 这么多年过去了，您还记得？
examples.trans: After all these years, you still remember that?

meanings.note: Potential complement jìdeqīng ('able to recall clearly').

examples.text: 八卦新闻每天这么多，我哪记得清啊？
examples.trans: With so much gossip daily, how could I remember it clearly?

examples.text: 每一期节目的收视数据她都记得清。
examples.trans: She remembers every episode's ratings figures clearly.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jì yì. Measure word (量词): 段, e.g. 一段记忆 ('a memory').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 柠檬蛋糕的香味唤醒了童年的温暖记忆。
examples.trans: The scent of lemon cake awakened warm childhood memories.

meanings.note: Holding onto spite over a past clash.

examples.text: 当年因为账目问题被批评后，他一直在心里记恨前任主管。
examples.trans: Rebuked once over accounts, he harbored a grudge against the old boss.

examples.text: 心胸开阔的创作者只记别人的帮忙，从不记恨一时的摩擦。
examples.trans: Open-hearted creators remember kindness, never petty friction.

meanings.note: Profession noun jìzhě ('news reporter').

examples.text: 做公关的以媒体关系为本，怎么能拒绝记者呢？
examples.trans: PR rests on media ties — how could we turn away reporters?

examples.text: 散会后几位娱乐记者在门口等候采访。
examples.trans: Several entertainment reporters waited outside after the meeting.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǎng. Used for telling a story or explaining rules (讲讲 'tell about').

examples.text: 宋老师早上讲了我们星期五的故事，小美特意烤的。
examples.trans: After Teacher Song told our Friday story this morning, Mei baked it specially.

examples.text: 爷爷最喜欢给孩子们讲老故事。
examples.trans: Grandfather loves telling old stories to the children.

examples.text: 总编室是个讲究效率的地方。
examples.trans: The chief editor's office is a place that cares about efficiency.

examples.text: 总编室是个讲究效率的地方。
examples.trans: The chief editor's office is a place that cares about efficiency.

examples.text: 我觉得还是让她来讲解一下比较好。
examples.trans: I think it would be better to have her explain it.

examples.text: 我觉得还是让她来讲解一下比较好。
examples.trans: I think it would be better to have her explain it.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǎng jiang. Friendly reduplicated form of 讲.

examples.text: 宋老师，快多讲讲梧桐巷那两兄弟吧！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, tell me more about those two brothers on Wutong Lane!

examples.text: 快给我们讲讲你是怎么找到那个旧阀门的！
examples.trans: Tell us how you tracked down that vintage brass valve!

讲话.gloss: speak, deliver remarks (V-O verb or noun)

meanings.en: speak, deliver remarks (V-O verb or noun)
meanings.note: Addressing a meeting or speaking casually.

examples.text: 她在高管大会上珍惜短短几分钟的讲话机会，用数据打动全场。
examples.trans: Cherishing her brief chance to speak at the summit, she won the room with data.

examples.text: 公关部提醒高管们在公开场合讲话一定要谨慎得体。
examples.trans: PR reminded executives to speak carefully and appropriately in public.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xǔ. Appears with 不 in 不许 ('not allowed / no …ing').

examples.text: 不许盯着客人看。把箱子交还，干自己的活。
examples.trans: No staring at guests. Hand back the bag and do our own work.

examples.text: 当然好啊，志鹏，只要谁也不许提卖旧钢琴！
examples.trans: Gladly, Zhipeng, as long as nobody mentions selling old pianos!

meanings.note: Literary time noun xǔjiǔ ('for a long while').

examples.text: 许久后我才明白他当时的决定。
examples.trans: Only much later did I understand his decision back then.

examples.text: 两位老朋友在茶馆里聊了许久。
examples.trans: The two old friends chatted for a long while at the teahouse.

meanings.note: Reduplicated adjective xǔxǔduōduō ('vast numbers of').

examples.text: 这场互助直播实实在在帮助了许许多多的人。
examples.trans: This mutual-aid livestream genuinely helped countless people.

examples.text: 一部好剧背后凝结着许许多多幕后人员的心血。
examples.trans: Behind every fine drama lies the sweat of countless crew members.

meanings.note: Slightly formal word for giving one's word.

examples.text: 那位重情义的演员一直记着当初在餐桌上给大家的许诺。
examples.trans: The loyal actor remembered the promise he made over dinner.

examples.text: 没有把握做到的事情，他从来不会轻易向合作伙伴许诺。
examples.trans: He never lightly promises partners anything he cannot deliver.

meanings.note: lùnwén — formal scholarly article or degree dissertation (measure word 篇 piān)

examples.text: 你们俩的论文初稿都已经通过了。
examples.trans: Both of your first thesis drafts have already passed.

examples.text: 而且我的论文还没写完呢。
examples.trans: And on top of that, I have not finished writing my thesis yet.

examples.text: 已有行业分析师论断，此事必将造成星天娱乐股权整合及上市进程大幅拖慢。
examples.trans: Industry analysts warn the lawsuit will severely delay Xingtian's share restructuring and public listing.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Noun shèbèi ('studio or technical equipment').

examples.text: 演播室里的设备一人盯一台。
examples.trans: Assign one person to watch each piece of studio gear.

examples.text: 直播前技术组仔细测试了所有设备。
examples.trans: Before going live, tech staff tested all equipment.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shè jì. Works as both verb ('design') and noun ('a design').

examples.text: 声学建筑师！您设计音乐厅吗？
examples.trans: An acoustic architect! Do you design concert halls?

examples.text: 主要设计小图书馆和院子，测量老石墙怎么挡住街上噪音。
examples.trans: Mostly small libraries and courtyards, measuring how old stone walls block street noise.

meanings.note: Media noun/verb fǎngtán ('sit-down interview').

examples.text: 为什么要做这期慈善访谈节目？
examples.trans: Why produce this charity interview episode?

examples.text: 辛惠美以前从来不上电视访谈节目。
examples.trans: Xin Huimei never used to go on TV talk shows.

meanings.note: Internet noun fǎngwènliàng ('site visit volume').

examples.text: 同一时间访问量过大，网站瘫痪了。
examples.trans: Simultaneous web traffic was too heavy and crashed the site.

examples.text: 新节目的主页访问量很高。
examples.trans: The new show's page traffic is very high.

meanings.note: Verb zhèngshí ('confirm as true').

examples.text: 我还想在你嘴里得到证实。
examples.trans: I still want to hear it confirmed from your own lips.

examples.text: 官方声明证实了两位歌手即将同台合唱。
examples.trans: The official statement confirmed the two singers' duet.

meanings.note: Noun zhèngjù.

examples.text: 这次证据太明显了。
examples.trans: The evidence this time was too obvious.

examples.text: 我们找到了新证据。
examples.trans: We found new evidence.

meanings.note: Verb/noun zhèngmíng.

examples.text: 可以证明谁是内鬼。
examples.trans: It proves who the mole is.

examples.text: 时间会证明一切。
examples.trans: Time will prove everything.

meanings.note: Pinyin: píng jià. Combines 评 ('comment/judge') + 价 ('value/worth'); functions as both a transitive verb and a noun ('assessment/review').

examples.text: 宋老师关切地问：“周经理，市政厅办事员是怎么评价九号房的？”
examples.trans: Teacher Song asked eagerly, 'Manager Zhou, what did the City Hall clerk say about Room Nine?'

examples.text: 喝过热扁豆汤的邻居们都对小美厨房的手艺给出了很高的评价。
examples.trans: Every neighbour who tasted the hot lentil soup gave high praise to the cooking from Mei's kitchen.

meanings.note: Objective appraisal of risk, value, or performance.

examples.text: 总编室在决定是否延播前，对海外安全风险做了全面评估。
examples.trans: Before delaying broadcast, the office thoroughly assessed overseas risks.

examples.text: 评估一位制作人的水平应当客观公正、就事论事。
examples.trans: Evaluating a producer's caliber should be objective and merit-based.

meanings.note: Noun/verb píngfēn ('score').

examples.text: 不知道我在你那份背景调查里的评分怎么样？
examples.trans: I wonder what score I got in your background check?

examples.text: 首播结束后，这档新节目在网上拿到了九点二的高评分。
examples.trans: After launch night, the new show earned a 9.2 rating online.

meanings.note: Judge on a competition or academic thesis panel.

examples.text: 答辩教室里坐着五位神情认真的学位评委。
examples.trans: Five earnest degree-committee examiners sat in the defence room.

examples.text: 音乐比赛的评委给出了非常中肯的专业建议。
examples.trans: The music contest judges gave fair, constructive feedback.

meanings.note: Media noun/verb píngshěn ('judging panel; evaluate').

examples.text: 要是去掉所有媒体评审，宣传怎么配合？
examples.trans: If we drop the entire media jury, how does publicity work?

examples.text: 五十位大众评审在现场投票选出冠军。
examples.trans: Fifty audience jurors voted live to pick the winner.

meanings.note: Pinyin: píng shěn yuán. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位评审员 ('an inspector').

examples.text: 除非他是写成都旅游指南的神秘评审员！
examples.trans: Unless he is a secret inspector writing the Chengdu Travel Guide!

examples.text: 冰凉的洗澡水？！成都旅游指南评审员就住在三楼啊！
examples.trans: Ice-cold shower water?! The Chengdu Travel Guide inspector is staying on floor three!

meanings.note: Formal verb píngduàn ('weigh and judge').

examples.text: 我只是客观地评断每一份策划方案。
examples.trans: I simply evaluate every programme proposal objectively.

examples.text: 作品好不好，最终由观众来评断。
