examples.trans: Whether a show is good is judged by viewers.

meanings.note: Verb/noun pínglùn ('comment on; commentary').

examples.text: 我用不着别人来随便评论我。
examples.trans: I have no need for others to casually comment on me.

examples.text: 节目播出后，网上出现了许多精彩的评论。
examples.trans: Wonderful comments appeared online after the broadcast.

meanings.note: Media noun pínglùnyuán ('guest commentator').

examples.text: 建议不要让那两位评论员同台出现。
examples.trans: He advises against putting those two commentators onstage together.

examples.text: 红毯两侧坐着特邀评论员。
examples.trans: Guest commentators sit beside the red carpet.

meanings.note: Broadcast noun pínglùnxí ('commentators' booth/table').

examples.text: 你看评论席，那不是那两位主持人吗？
examples.trans: Look at the commentary desk — are those not the two hosts?

examples.text: 灯光照亮了红毯边的评论席。
examples.trans: Lights lit up the commentary desk by the red carpet.

meanings.note: Wishing bad luck on someone, often used jokingly.

examples.text: 你在纸上写名字，是在诅咒人家吗？
examples.trans: Writing names on paper—are you putting a hex on them?

examples.text: 童话里的公主被女巫诅咒了。
examples.trans: The princess in the fairy tale was cursed by a witch.

识时务.gloss: know which way the wind blows, be pragmatic about timing

meanings.en: know which way the wind blows, be pragmatic about timing
meanings.note: From 识时务者为俊杰; can be praise or ironic flattery.

examples.text: 新主管见她主动进来沟通，以为她是个懂得顺风转舵、识时务的人。
examples.trans: Seeing her walk in to chat, the new head thought she knew how to play along.

examples.text: 在关键转折点上保持清醒判断，才是真正的识时务。
examples.trans: Keeping clear judgment at turning points is true pragmatism.

诈.gloss: bluff information out of someone, trick into revealing

meanings.en: bluff information out of someone, trick into revealing
meanings.note: Pretending to know something so the other person spills the truth.

examples.text: 我随口说了两句，就把他的实话诈出来了。
examples.trans: With two casual lines I bluffed the truth right out of him.

examples.text: 别信他的话，他是在故意诈你呢。
examples.trans: Do not buy it—he is deliberately bluffing it out of you.

examples.text: 据悉，诉讼包括歌曲利润所得三倍以上的天价索赔，以及星天娱乐公开道歉。
examples.trans: Reports say the lawsuit demands triple-profit damages along with a formal public apology from Xingtian Entertainment.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 像您这样的词曲作家，听到您还搞音乐，真的是令人期待。
examples.trans: Hearing that a songwriter like you is still creating music truly fills people with anticipation.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 原来这家振振有词控诉别人侵权的白石音乐公司，多年拖欠词曲作者钟阳子的版权收益！
examples.trans: It turns out Baishi Music, so self-righteous in suing others, has withheld royalties from songwriter Zhong Yangzi for years!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì. Often reduplicated softly as 试试 ('give it a try').

examples.text: 摸摸热水管——下面是温的，上面变凉了。
examples.trans: Feel the hot-water pipe—the bottom is warm, while the top is turning cool.

examples.text: 这件羊毛开衫很暖和，您试试吧。
examples.trans: This wool cardigan is very warm—try it on.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì chī yuán. Combines 试吃 ('sample/taste-test food') + playful role suffix 员 ('official member').

examples.text: 志豪和志鹏笑着宣布他们当上了咖啡角的正式试吃员。
examples.trans: Hao and Peng joked that they had been appointed official taste testers for the café corner.

examples.text: 当小美厨房的试吃员真是全客栈最幸福的工作！
examples.trans: Being a taste tester in Mei's kitchen really is the happiest job in the whole inn!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì yòng qī. Measure word (量词): 段, e.g. 一段试用期 ('a trial period').

examples.text: 还有，小晴，今天是星期五——你五天试用期的最后一天。
examples.trans: And now, Qing, today is Friday—the last day of your five-day trial period.

examples.text: 五天试用期里，她把前台管得井井有条。
examples.trans: During her five-day trial period, she kept reception running smoothly.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì shi. Warm, low-pressure invitation to try something.

examples.text: 您看，这件软羊毛开衫是全新的，试试吧。
examples.trans: Look, this soft wool cardigan is brand-new; try it on.

examples.text: 这把备用钥匙能不能开，插进去试试就知道了。
examples.trans: Slip this spare key in and try it to see if it unlocks.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chéng shí. Praises straightforward honesty.

examples.text: 我心跳得好快！小晴你去说，你声音稳重诚实！
examples.trans: My heart is pounding! Qing, you explain it—you sound calm and honest!

examples.text: 做生意最重要的就是诚实守信。
examples.trans: In running a shop, honesty and trust matter most.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chéng kěn. Describes an earnest apology or tone.

examples.text: 先生，上楼之前，我要诚恳跟您道个歉。
examples.trans: Sir, before going upstairs, I owe you an honest apology.

examples.text: 他道歉的态度十分诚恳。
examples.trans: His apology was thoroughly sincere.

meanings.note: Noun chéngyì ('good faith, sincerity').

examples.text: 我愿意好好合作，先表达我的诚意。
examples.trans: I want to cooperate properly and show my sincerity first.

examples.text: 这份详尽的方案体现了团队满满的诚意。
examples.trans: This detailed proposal shows the team's full sincerity.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huà. Measure word (量词): 句 (jù), e.g. 一句话 ('a sentence / remark').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 我修水管和椅子。人的话得自己修。
examples.trans: I fix water pipes and chairs. People have to fix their own words.

examples.text: 什么情况啊？你会唱歌？那好好唱，拿个话筒过去！
examples.trans: What's going on here? Oh, you're singing? Sing properly then — somebody hand her a microphone!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

话说回来.gloss: come to think of it, then again, that said

meanings.en: come to think of it, then again, that said
meanings.note: Conversational pivot returning to another side of the topic.

examples.text: 不过话说回来，他的出发点其实是好的。
examples.trans: Still, come to think of it, his intentions were good.

examples.text: 话说回来，这件事也不能全怪他。
examples.trans: Then again, you cannot blame this whole thing on him.

meanings.note: Phrase huàlǐ ('between the lines of what was said').

examples.text: 声明的话里还是暗指星天。
examples.trans: Between the lines, the statement still hints at Xingtian.

examples.text: 我听出他话里的意思了。
examples.trans: I caught the meaning behind his words.

meanings.note: Noun huàtí ('discussion topic').

examples.text: 这广播今天的话题不是德才兼备吗？
examples.trans: Is today's radio topic not virtue and talent?

examples.text: 别想拿我的名字去网上刷话题。
examples.trans: Do not use my name to drum up trending topics online.

meanings.en: should; ought to; be someone's turn
meanings.note: Pinyin: gāi. Short everyday form of 应该 ('should').

examples.text: 电线本来就该拉直了。正常保养，别多想。
examples.trans: The wire needed straightening anyway. Routine maintenance—don't read into it.

examples.text: 热茶和柠檬蛋糕！小晴，你该给紧张的弟弟开个学校。
examples.trans: Hot tea and lemon cake! Qing, you ought to open a school for nervous brothers.

meanings.note: Adjective xiángxì ('in detail, thorough').

examples.text: 文章详细描写了二位在后台和解。
examples.trans: The article described in detail how you two reconciled.

examples.text: 小谷把彩排流程做成了详细的表格。
examples.trans: Xiaogu turned the rehearsal schedule into a detailed chart.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǔ yīn. Compound 语 ('speech') + 音 ('sound'); everyday word for recorded voice messages (语音留言).

examples.text: 如果你没空打字，直接给我发一条语音就行。
examples.trans: If you're too busy to type, just send me a voice message.

examples.text: 前台电话闪着红灯，提示有一条新语音留言。
examples.trans: The front-desk phone is blinking red to show a new recorded voice message.

examples.text: 我们先沟通好了，以免将来产生误会。
examples.trans: Let us communicate clearly first, so we avoid misunderstandings in the future.

examples.text: 我们先沟通好了，以免将来产生误会。
examples.trans: Let us communicate clearly first, so we avoid misunderstandings in the future.

meanings.note: Misreading someone's motives or words.

examples.text: 坦诚沟通是消除部门之间误解最直接有效的办法。
examples.trans: Candid talk is the most direct way to clear up misunderstandings.

examples.text: 他把老员工基于事实的批评轻描淡写地说成是对他的误解。
examples.trans: He brushed off factual criticism from veterans as mere misunderstanding.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuō. Most common verb of speaking.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

examples.text: 我还没喝早咖啡呢，千万别说急事！
examples.trans: I have not had my morning coffee yet; please do not say emergency!

说一不二.gloss: mean every word, stand firmly by what one says

meanings.en: mean every word, stand firmly by what one says
meanings.note: Idiom describing decisive authority where one's word is final.

examples.text: 这位制作人在工作上向来说一不二。
examples.trans: At work, this producer has always meant every word he says.

examples.text: 他是个说一不二的人，答应的事一定会办到。
examples.trans: He means what he says and always delivers on a promise.

说一套做一套.gloss: say one thing and do another

meanings.en: say one thing and do another
meanings.note: Idiom shuō-yítào-zuò-yítào ('be two-faced, break promises behind someone's back').

examples.text: 二部真是说一套做一套，最后还是把他们请来了。
examples.trans: Unit Two said one thing and did another, inviting them anyway.

examples.text: 合作伙伴最怕说一套做一套。
examples.trans: Partners hate it when someone says one thing and does another.

examples.text: 小谷这丫头路子野，说不定不会影响你们感情。
examples.trans: Xiaogu is a spirited girl — working together might not hurt your chances after all.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

说不通.gloss: make no sense, fail to get through in persuasion

meanings.en: make no sense, fail to get through in persuasion
meanings.note: Cannot be justified logically or will not persuade the listener.

examples.text: 这个理由在逻辑上根本说不通。
examples.trans: This excuse makes zero logical sense.

examples.text: 跟只看重利益的人讲情怀是说不通的。
examples.trans: Preaching idealism to people who care only about profit will not get through.

说到底.gloss: at bottom, when all is said and done

meanings.en: at bottom, when all is said and done
meanings.note: Gets down to the fundamental reason.

examples.text: 说到底，大家还是害怕承担风险。
examples.trans: When all is said and done, everyone is simply afraid of risk.

examples.text: 这件事说到底还是沟通不够。
examples.trans: At bottom, this issue comes down to too little communication.

说实话.gloss: to tell the truth, frankly speaking

meanings.en: to tell the truth, frankly speaking
meanings.note: Discourse phrase shuō shíhuà ('frankly').

examples.text: 但说实话，今天上会的事没人通知我。
examples.trans: Yet frankly speaking, nobody told me this went before a meeting today.

examples.text: 说实话，这份新人的策划案比我想象的还要成熟。
examples.trans: Frankly, this newcomer's pitch is more mature than I expected.

meanings.note: Verb/noun shuōmíng ('illustrate, demonstrate').

examples.text: 这已经说明了辩证的道理。
examples.trans: This already illustrates the dialectical principle.

examples.text: 收视率上升充分说明观众喜欢这个环节。
examples.trans: Rising ratings clearly show viewers love this segment.

meanings.note: Verb-complement shuōfú ('convince').

examples.text: 明天我们再见一面，我一定说服你。
examples.trans: Let us meet again tomorrow and I will convince you.

examples.text: 昨天杏子姐已经成功说服他们俩道歉了。
examples.trans: Yesterday Xingzi convinced both of them to apologise.

examples.text: 我们也会尽快地找出事情的缘由，然后给大家一个说法。
examples.trans: We will get to the bottom of how this happened as quickly as possible and give the public a clear answer.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuō huà. Separable verb-object compound ('speak words').

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 从那天起我们就再没说过话。上周我给他寄了一张明信片。
examples.trans: Since that day we have not spoken again. Last week I mailed him a postcard.

说说.gloss: talk briefly / go ahead and say

meanings.en: talk briefly / go ahead and say
meanings.note: reduplicated 说 inviting someone to speak casually

examples.text: 跟你开玩笑的，说说。
examples.trans: I was joking with you — go ahead and tell me.

examples.text: 你先说说你的具体想法吧。
examples.trans: Go ahead and tell me your specific thoughts first.

meanings.note: Verb shuōqǐ ('mention, talk about').

examples.text: 我经常听小谷在办公室说起您。
examples.trans: I often hear Xiaogu bring you up in the office.

examples.text: 一说起做节目，她的眼睛立刻亮了起来。
examples.trans: Whenever TV production comes up, her eyes light right up.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qǐng. At the start of a request, means 'please' (请进, 请坐, 请问); before a person, 'invite / treat'.

examples.text: 太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
examples.trans: Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

请假.gloss: ask for leave, take time off work

meanings.en: ask for leave, take time off work
meanings.note: Requesting approved absence from work or class.

examples.text: 我想看看过两天能不能向公司请假陪你逛逛。
examples.trans: Let me see if I can take leave in two days to show you around.

examples.text: 身体不舒服就赶紧请假去医院，别硬撑着。
examples.trans: If you feel unwell, take sick leave and see a doctor.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qǐng kè. Separable verb-object compound (我请客 'my treat!').

examples.text: 明天早上八点，你们的第一杯小院咖啡算客栈请客！
examples.trans: And tomorrow morning at eight, your first courtyard coffees are on the house!

examples.text: 今天发工资，晚上的热汤面我请客！
examples.trans: Today is payday—tonight's hot noodle soup is my treat!

meanings.note: Polite verb qǐngjiào ('seek guidance from someone senior').

examples.text: 我有好多事情想向师兄请教。
examples.trans: I have many things I would love to ask your advice on.

examples.text: 遇到不懂的问题要虚心请教。
examples.trans: Ask politely for advice whenever something is unclear.

examples.text: 我来跟您请示一下，能不能要一份您的工作日程啊？
examples.trans: I came to ask if I might get a copy of your work schedule.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 请进。
examples.trans: Come on in.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qǐng wèn. Polite question opener used everywhere in Mandarin.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 我正在打……您好，请问有人找蓝色行李箱吗？
examples.trans: I am calling now... Hello, excuse me, is anyone looking for a blue suitcase?

meanings.note: Pinyin: dú. Used for reading books, rules, or documents.

examples.text: 整份文件还没读完呢，周经理，别先认输。
examples.trans: We have not even finished reading the whole document, Manager Zhou—don't give up yet.

examples.text: 脑子转得快，小晴。志豪每星期都读城市建筑规定。
examples.trans: Quick thinking, Qing. Hao reads city building rules every single week.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dú shū. Combines 读 ('read') with 书 ('book'); also means 'to be at school'. Before a noun it means 'for reading' (读书咖啡馆 'reading café').

examples.text: 等等——为了保护老房子，我们答应过城里开读书咖啡馆！
examples.trans: Wait—to protect the old house, we promised the city a reading café!

examples.text: 她每天晚上都在床上读书。
examples.trans: She reads in bed every evening.

meanings.note: Gathering where authors and readers discuss books.

examples.text: 周末下午举办的线下读书会吸引了许多喜爱文学的年轻粉丝。
examples.trans: The weekend book club drew crowds of young literature fans.

examples.text: 主持人在读书会结束时真诚感谢每一位到场交流的读者。
examples.trans: Wrapping up the book club, the host thanked every reader who came.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dú shū jiǎo. Combines 读书 ('read books') + 角 ('corner/nook'); measure word: 个 (gè).

examples.text: 对公众开放的咖啡角、街坊读书角，还有现场音乐——样样俱全！
examples.trans: A public café corner, a neighbourhood reading nook, and live music—every single piece is in place!

examples.text: 钢琴旁边的读书角摆着一篮干净的旅行书，谁都可以借阅。
examples.trans: Beside the piano, the reading corner has a basket of clean travel books that anyone is welcome to borrow.

读读.gloss: read a little; have a read

meanings.en: read a little; have a read
meanings.note: Pinyin: dú du. Reduplication of 读 ('read'); the neutral-tone second syllable softens a request into a warm, unhurried invitation.

examples.text: 小晴，快读读隔壁书店老板递给你的市政厅盖章信封。
examples.trans: Qing, quickly have a read of the stamped City Hall envelope the next-door bookshop owner handed you.

examples.text: 坐下来喝杯热茶，顺便读读桌上那本记录小院故事的旧册子吧。
examples.trans: Sit down with a cup of hot tea and have a read through that old album of courtyard stories on the table.

meanings.note: Verb/noun fěibàng ('slander, libel').

examples.text: 网上有很多诽谤你的话。
examples.trans: There are many slanderous remarks about you online.

examples.text: 恶意诽谤别人是违法的。
examples.trans: Maliciously slandering others breaks the law.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kè běn. Combines 课 ('lesson/course') + 本 ('bound book'); measure word: 本 (běn) or 册 (cè).

examples.text: 您要是像念税务课本一样一字一句地念演讲稿，客人站着都会睡着。
examples.trans: If you read your speech word for word like a tax textbook, our guest will fall asleep standing up.

examples.text: 隔壁书店的架子上既有文学小说，也有音乐学院用的钢琴课本。
examples.trans: On the shelves of the bookshop next door are both literary novels and piano textbooks used at the conservatory.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuí. Question pronoun for people; stays in the exact spot of the answer (这是谁的？ 'Whose is this?').

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

examples.text: 一点没破！是谁送回来的？
examples.trans: Not cracked at all! Who brought it back?

examples.text: 调时间。
examples.trans: Adjust time.

examples.text: 调一下。
examples.trans: Adjust a bit.

meanings.note: Workplace noun diàolìng ('personnel transfer notice').

examples.text: 刚接到调令，明天调你去总编室做助理策划。
examples.trans: A transfer order arrived moving you to assistant planner.

examples.text: 人事部的正式调令今天下午已经生效了。
examples.trans: HR's official transfer order took effect this afternoon.

examples.text: 办公室恋情多有不便。以小谷的资质，你把她调到二部，独当一面完全没问题啊。
examples.trans: Office romances bring endless headaches. With Xiaogu's talent, transferring her to Unit Two to lead projects on her own would work great.

examples.text: 如果现在这个时候把她调到二部去，对她的打击会很大。
examples.trans: If I transfer her away to Unit Two at a moment like this, it will be a huge blow to her.

meanings.note: Verb diàodòng ('arouse enthusiasm; transfer staff').

examples.text: 请大家高声呼喊，把现场情绪调动起来。
examples.trans: Cheer loudly to stir up excitement on set.

examples.text: 好主持人懂得调动观众的气氛。
examples.trans: A skilled host knows how to energize the crowd.

meanings.note: Pinyin: diào xìng. Combines 调 (diào, 4th tone 'musical key/mode') + 性 ('quality/system').

examples.text: 我会用和姑姑完全相同的调性把这首圆舞曲写完。
examples.trans: I will finish writing this waltz in the exact same key as your aunt.

examples.text: 明亮的大调调性让整首曲子听起来温暖而有希望。
examples.trans: A bright major key makes the whole piece sound warm and hopeful.

examples.text: 调整一下。
examples.trans: Adjust a bit.

examples.text: 调整计划。
examples.trans: Adjust plan.

meanings.note: Verb/noun diàochá ('look into').

examples.text: 我都调查过了，这两个人最近没啥问题。
examples.trans: I checked into it, and those two had no recent trouble.

examples.text: 节目组做了详细的观众调查。
examples.trans: The crew conducted a detailed audience survey.

examples.text: 这是调派啊。
examples.trans: This is dispatch.

examples.text: 那个调派好。
examples.trans: That dispatch is good.

meanings.note: Verb diàoyòng ('call in staff or resources').

examples.text: 各部的制片力量全部要调用进来。
examples.trans: Production staff from every unit will be called in.

examples.text: 项目组可以随时调用设备。
examples.trans: The project team can deploy equipment anytime.

meanings.note: Verb-object diàozhí ('reassignment of post').

examples.text: 雷总刚才已经正式通知我调职了。
examples.trans: Director Lei just officially notified me of my transfer.

examples.text: 调职到总编室是她梦寐以求的机会。
examples.trans: Transferring to the chief editor's office was her dream.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiáo yīn. Separable verb-object compound 调 (tiáo, 2nd tone 'adjust/harmonize') + 音 ('pitch/tone').

examples.text: 等老陈修好那根琴槌，宋老师就能给钢琴调音了。
examples.trans: Once Chen fixes that piano hammer, Teacher Song will be able to tune the piano.

examples.text: 音乐会开始前，调音师花了一个小时给钢琴仔细调音。
examples.trans: Before the concert began, the technician spent an hour carefully tuning the piano.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiáo yīn bān shǒu. Combines 调音 ('tune') + 扳手 ('wrench/spanner'): the star-tip L-lever used on piano tuning pins.

examples.text: 老陈在木箱最下面的抽屉里找到了一把旧调音扳手。
examples.trans: Chen found an old tuning wrench in the bottom drawer of the wooden chest.

examples.text: 使用调音扳手的时候手腕要稳，每次只轻轻转一点点。
examples.trans: Keep your wrist steady with a tuning wrench, turning only a tiny fraction at a time.

meanings.note: Verb tán ('talk, speak with').

examples.text: 我已经跟抢救的医生谈过了。
examples.trans: I have spoken with the emergency doctors.

examples.text: 坐下来好好谈吧。
examples.trans: Sit down and talk it over calmly.

meanings.note: Reduplicated verb tányitán ('talk things over').

examples.text: 我们可以找律师一起谈一谈。
examples.trans: We can bring the lawyers and have a talk together.

examples.text: 下班后我想跟你谈一谈。
examples.trans: I would like to have a chat with you after work.

meanings.note: Verb/noun tánpàn ('business negotiation').

examples.text: 老大今天在外面有一个非常重要的谈判。
examples.trans: Our boss has a crucial negotiation outside today.

examples.text: 版权引进的谈判还在稳步推进。
examples.trans: Talks over licensing the format are moving forward.

examples.text: 谈到义务了，你跟洛琳的过去到底是怎么一回事？
examples.trans: Speaking of duty, then — what exactly happened in the past between you and Luo Lin?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Open, candid conversation between friends.

examples.text: 好朋友之间应该多找时间谈心。
examples.trans: Close friends should make time for heart-to-heart talks.

examples.text: 晚饭后他们坐在阳台上聊工作、谈心。
examples.trans: After dinner they sat on the balcony chatting heart to heart.

examples.text: 您说得都对，但是她现在谈恋爱了呀。
examples.trans: Everything you say is true — except now she is in love!

examples.text: 我其实不太擅长谈恋爱。那不是应该的吗？这是我作为男朋友的义务啊。
examples.trans: Truthfully, I'm not very skilled at romance — isn't taking your words seriously my duty as your boyfriend?

examples.text: 义务？跟我谈恋爱，用不着拿出尽义务的心态。
examples.trans: Duty? Dating me doesn't call for the mindset of fulfilling an obligation!

meanings.note: Noun/verb tánhuà ('talk, chat; talk show').

examples.text: 我们诚意邀请您录制一期谈话节目。
examples.trans: We warmly invite you to record an episode of our talk show.

examples.text: 这次深入的谈话解开了两人的误会。
examples.trans: That candid talk cleared up the misunderstanding.

meanings.note: Softened reduplicated form of 谈心.

examples.text: 今天中午有空，我想跟你谈谈心。
examples.trans: Since we are free at noon, I want to have a heart-to-heart chat with you.

examples.text: 看她心情不好，姐姐过去陪她谈谈心。
examples.trans: Seeing her down, her sister went over for a heart-to-heart chat.

examples.text: 凭着我五千个小时的主播生涯，我一定让这个满嘴谎话的女人当场现出原形！
examples.trans: With five thousand hours as a live host behind me, I will expose that lying woman's true colors right on camera!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mí tuán. Combines 谜 ('riddle/puzzle') + 团 ('ball/cluster'); 解开谜团 means 'to solve a mystery'; measure word: 个 (gè).

examples.text: 两位先生，快提上灯笼——九号房开张了，下一个谜团就在树底下！
examples.trans: Grab the lantern, gentlemen—Room Nine is open, and our next mystery starts right under the tree!

examples.text: 三十年前那首圆舞曲的谜团，今天终于全部解开了。
examples.trans: The mystery of that thirty-year-old waltz has finally been completely solved today.

meanings.note: transitive verb meaning to thank someone

examples.text: 不用谢我，你要真想谢我，就好好工作。
examples.trans: No need to thank me; if you really want to thank me, just work hard.

examples.text: 我真不知道该怎么谢你才好。
examples.trans: I really do not know how best to thank you.

meanings.en: thank goodness!; thank heaven and earth!
meanings.note: Pinyin: xiè tiān xiè dì. Relieved four-character exclamation.

examples.text: 谢天谢地！那明天早上客人洗澡呢？
examples.trans: Thank heavens! What about morning showers for the guests?

examples.text: 谢天谢地，赶在下大雨以前到家了！
examples.trans: Thank goodness we made it home before the downpour started!

examples.text: 谢总好。
examples.trans: Hello Director Xie.

examples.text: 这是谢总的办公室。
examples.trans: This is Director Xie's office.

examples.text: 她说为了表示对星天公司和淳于乔先生的谢意，这首歌无偿赠给我们。
examples.trans: To express her gratitude to Xingtian and to me, she gifted this song to us completely free of charge.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiè xie. Standard expression of gratitude; takes an optional person after it (谢谢您).

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

meanings.note: Noun yáoyán ('groundless rumour').

examples.text: 那都是低智商的谣言。
examples.trans: Those are all low-grade rumours.

examples.text: 在事实面前，不实的谣言很快就不攻自破。
examples.trans: In the face of facts, false rumours quickly collapse.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pǔ jià. Compound 谱 ('musical score') + 架 ('stand/rack'): either a freestanding stand or a piano's hinged music rest.

examples.text: 立式钢琴的木头谱架后面藏着一张旧纸。
examples.trans: Behind the upright piano's wooden music rest hid a folded old sheet of paper.

examples.text: 宋老师把翻开的曲谱平平地放在谱架上。
examples.trans: Teacher Song placed the open music score flat on the music desk.

meanings.note: Adjective háohuá ('luxurious').

examples.text: 好好享受这趟二十四小时加班的豪华旅行吧！
examples.trans: Enjoy your round-the-clock overtime luxury trip!

examples.text: 今年的跨年演唱会请来了无比豪华的歌手阵容。
examples.trans: This New Year concert boasts a deluxe lineup of singers.

meanings.note: Verb fù ('bear liability').

examples.text: 动手打了人，你们必须负相应的法律责任！
examples.trans: Having started a fight, you must bear legal responsibility!

examples.text: 总制片人对整档节目的安全与品质负总责。
examples.trans: The chief producer bears overall responsibility for the show.

meanings.note: Noun fùhè ('workload or electrical load').

examples.text: 准备好迎接二十四小时超工作负荷的拍摄吧！
examples.trans: Get ready for a twenty-four-hour overloaded filming schedule!

examples.text: 同时开三台大型灯光设备要注意电路负荷。
examples.trans: Watch circuit load when running three heavy lighting rigs.

负责.gloss: to be in charge of; responsible

meanings.en: to be in charge of; to take responsibility for
meanings.note: fùzé — takes a task, project, or client directly as an object, or pairs with 对...负责 (to be accountable for)
stative usage describing someone who handles duties reliably (e.g., 很负责)

examples.text: 小谷，你负责粉团科技。
examples.trans: Xiaogu, you are in charge of Fentuan Tech.

examples.text: 王尔要负责，已经被公司开除了。
examples.trans: Wang Er had to take responsibility and has already been fired by the company.

meanings.note: Standard organizational title.

examples.text: 第二制作部的负责人在会上就栏目定位提出了尖锐问题。
examples.trans: The head of Unit Two raised pointed questions on show positioning.

examples.text: 每个外景小组都指定了一名经验丰富的现场安全负责人。
examples.trans: Every location unit appointed a seasoned on-site safety lead.

meanings.note: Verb-object/adjective fùzérèn ('bear responsibility').

examples.text: 这件事只是我在负责任，不关别人的事。
examples.trans: I alone am taking responsibility; it concerns nobody else.

examples.text: 他是一位对每帧画面都极其负责任的制作人。
examples.trans: He is a producer who takes responsibility for every frame.

meanings.note: Adjective fùmiàn ('negative').

examples.text: 你就只想要负面新闻赶快过去吗？
examples.trans: Do you just want negative news to blow over fast?

examples.text: 公司正在处理那条负面消息。
examples.trans: The company is handling that negative report.

meanings.note: Corporate finance and expense compliance.

examples.text: 任何走项目报销的票据都必须符合公司严格的财务制度。
examples.trans: Every project expense receipt must meet strict corporate finance rules.

examples.text: 她决定先把对方财务违规的线索留作日后的伏笔。
examples.trans: She chose to hold onto clues of financial misconduct as future leverage.

meanings.note: Noun zérèn ('duty, liability').

examples.text: 责任必须落实到人。
examples.trans: Responsibility must be assigned to an individual.

examples.text: 作为制片人，我有责任保护团队。
examples.trans: As producer, I have a duty to protect my team.

examples.text: 惠美是我签进星天的，我责无旁贷，你放心。
examples.trans: I was the one who brought Huimei to Xingtian; it is my responsibility, so rest assured.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 把侯总的账结了。
examples.trans: Please settle the gentleman's tab on our way out.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Noun zhànghù ('digital or financial account').

examples.text: 那台旧电脑上面登录的都是我的账户。
examples.trans: That old computer is still logged into my user account.

examples.text: 离开公共电脑前请记得退出自己的个人账户。
examples.trans: Remember to log out of your account on shared computers.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhàng běn. Measure word (量词): 本 (běn), e.g. 一本账本 ('an account ledger').

examples.text: 说得对。公事等一等——先放在账本旁边。
examples.trans: Right you are. Paperwork can wait—set it beside the ledger for now.

examples.text: 每天关门以前，经理都会核对一遍账本。
examples.trans: Before closing up each night, the manager checks the ledger.

meanings.note: Itemized records of income and expenses.

examples.text: 每一期节目的制作经费账目都必须做到公开透明、一清二楚。
examples.trans: Every episode's production accounts must be transparent and crystal clear.

examples.text: 两位老搭档一直怀疑那位前同事经手的项目账目有问题。
examples.trans: Both partners long suspected shady items in that ex-colleague's accounts.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huò chē. Compound 货 ('goods/cargo') + 车 ('vehicle'). Measure word: 辆 (liàng).

examples.text: 一辆蓝色的家具货车刚刚停在巷子口。
examples.trans: A blue furniture delivery van just pulled up at the entrance to the lane.

examples.text: 司机关好货车后门，把送货单递给周经理。
examples.trans: The driver shut the back doors of the van and handed the delivery slip to Manager Zhou.

meanings.note: Verb/noun zhìyí ('question sceptically').

examples.text: 全面改版这种事一向都是受质疑的。
examples.trans: A sweeping format overhaul always faces skepticism.

examples.text: 用扎实的收视成绩回应外界的一切质疑。
examples.trans: Answer outside doubts with solid ratings results.

examples.text: 产品质量好。
examples.trans: The product quality is good.

examples.text: 生活质量。
examples.trans: Quality of life.

meanings.note: Colloquial noun fànzi ('peddler, monger').

examples.text: 你怎么还有这种专门倒卖消息的八卦贩子朋友？
examples.trans: How do you have a gossip peddler like that in your circle of friends?

examples.text: 门口安保严查倒票黄牛贩子，维护观众权益。
examples.trans: Gate security cracked down on ticket scalpers to protect fans.

examples.text: 这个白石爱贪小便宜，按照合约应该付给人家作者钱，可是他们从来没跟作者提过这件事！
examples.trans: Baishi loves cutting petty corners; under the contract they owed the songwriter payment, yet they never breathed a word to her!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Speaking of someone or oneself as worth less.

examples.text: 千万不要因为一次失败就贬低自己。
examples.trans: Never belittle yourself over a single setback.

examples.text: 真正自信的人不会靠贬低别人来抬高自己。
examples.trans: Truly confident people never put others down to lift themselves up.

meanings.note: Written list of items to buy.

examples.text: 出国前同事塞给他一张长长的代购购物清单。
examples.trans: Before he went abroad, a coworker handed him a long shopping list.

examples.text: 去超市前先列好购物清单，省得买回一堆没用的。
examples.trans: Make a shopping list before the supermarket so you buy only what you need.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiē. Used for taping envelopes, labels, or notices onto a surface.

examples.text: 看，把手上贴着一个白信封。
examples.trans: Look, there is a white envelope taped onto the handle.

examples.text: 对。我一慌，按了门铃，把星期五纸条贴在把手上。
examples.trans: Yes. In a panic I rang the bell and taped the Friday note onto the handle.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guì. Opposite of 便宜 ('cheap'); 太贵了 ('too expensive') is the classic market complaint.

examples.text: 这张老照片我真喜欢，可是新的家具太贵了！
examples.trans: I truly love this old photo, but new furniture costs a fortune!

examples.text: 周经理，谁说要买很贵的新家具了？
examples.trans: Manager Zhou, who said anything about buying expensive new furniture?

meanings.note: Pinyin: guì xìng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 您的贵姓 ('your surname (polite)').

examples.text: 先生，箱子安全锁在柜子里。请问您贵姓？
examples.trans: Sir, the bag is locked safely in our closet. May I ask your surname?

examples.text: 您好，请问先生贵姓？有预订吗？
examples.trans: Hello, sir, may I ask your surname? Do you have a reservation?

meanings.note: Used formally for VIP guests or playfully for an important admirer.

examples.text: 今天演播厅要接待几位重要的贵宾。
examples.trans: Today the studio is hosting several important VIPs.

examples.text: 送这么好的礼物，是不是你忘了哪位贵宾？
examples.trans: Sending such a nice gift—did you forget some special VIP?

meanings.note: Noun fèiyòng ('expenses, charges').

examples.text: 医疗设备还有医生出诊费用没有任何问题。
examples.trans: Medical gear and the doctor's house-call fees are no problem at all.

examples.text: 外景超期拍摄产生的额外费用需要重新报批。
examples.trans: Extra expenses from location overruns require fresh approval.

meanings.note: Noun zéi ('thief').

examples.text: 你带着硬盘一出门，现在已经是贼了。
examples.trans: The instant you step outside with those drives, you look like a thief.

examples.text: 保安抓住了偷东西的小贼。
examples.trans: Security caught the petty thief.

meanings.note: Verb/noun zīzhù ('provide financial aid').

examples.text: 最后由嘉宾选定一家想要资助的对象。
examples.trans: Finally the guest selects one recipient to fund.

examples.text: 基金会每年资助几十所乡村学校。
examples.trans: The foundation funds dozens of rural schools yearly.

meanings.note: zīliào — compiled documents, background records, or recorded media used for research or production (measure word 份 fèn)

examples.text: 这些资料，还有这四百个小时的录像资料。
examples.trans: These files, plus these four hundred hours of video recordings.

examples.text: 原野公司不是派你去星天获得视频资料吗？
examples.trans: Did Yuanye not send you to Xingtian to get video footage?

examples.text: 比起资本风险，更关键的是机会成本。
examples.trans: Compared with capital risk, the far bigger issue is opportunity cost.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Noun zīgé ('standing or right to participate').

examples.text: 告诉外边那行政助理，她没资格上提案会。
examples.trans: Tell that admin assistant she is not qualified to pitch.

examples.text: 入职满一年的制片才有资格独立带组。
examples.trans: Producers need a full year on the job to lead a unit.

meanings.note: Attributive zīshēn ('deeply experienced').

examples.text: 这位就是咱们节目组聘请的资深潜水教练。
examples.trans: Here is the seasoned diving instructor hired by our crew.

examples.text: 评审团由五位资深的音乐制作人和乐评人组成。
examples.trans: The panel comprises five veteran producers and critics.

meanings.note: zīyuán — material, financial, or institutional assets available to support a project
widely used in entertainment and business for accumulated contacts, backing, and casting or broadcast slots

examples.text: 这些资源都是我多年攒下的。
examples.trans: All of these contacts are ones I saved up over many years.

examples.text: 如果你愿意撤掉视频，我们愿意出一些电视制作资源作为交换。
examples.trans: If you are willing to take down the video, we will offer television production resources in exchange.

meanings.note: Media noun zīxùn ('up-to-date news').

examples.text: 这里有最广的热点娱乐资讯。
examples.trans: Here you get the widest entertainment news updates.

examples.text: 手机上随时能看到最新的行业资讯。
examples.trans: You can check the latest industry updates anytime on a phone.

examples.text: 办公室恋情多有不便。以小谷的资质，你把她调到二部，独当一面完全没问题啊。
examples.trans: Office romances bring endless headaches. With Xiaogu's talent, transferring her to Unit Two to lead projects on her own would work great.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 乔木这首歌非常充满东方风味，我觉得这是上天赐给你不二的选择。
examples.trans: This song Arbor brims with Eastern poetic charm; I believe it is a match made in heaven for you.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Verb/noun péicháng ('pay compensation').

examples.text: 解约的话，你也得赔偿违约金。
examples.trans: If you break the contract, you still owe damages.

examples.text: 损坏公物需要照价赔偿。
examples.trans: Damaged property must be compensated at cost.

examples.text: 王老师，一言为定！您快跟我讲讲，这个白石公司怎么这么厉害，三倍的赔偿金吓死人了！
examples.trans: Mr Wang, it's a deal! Tell me quickly — how is this Baishi company so fierce with that terrifying triple-damages claim?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Verb-object péizuì ('offer an apology with a gesture').

examples.text: 我买了点吃的喝的，来给大家赔罪。
examples.trans: I bought snacks and drinks to apologize to everyone.

examples.text: 他专门请朋友喝茶赔罪。
examples.trans: He treated his friend to tea to make amends.

meanings.note: Verb zhuàn ('make a profit').

examples.text: 跟风竞争确实是赚了一些快钱。
examples.trans: Copycat competition did indeed make some quick money.

examples.text: 好口碑比短期多赚一点广告费更重要。
examples.trans: Strong word of mouth matters more than quick ad money.

examples.text: 谢你什么？谢你给我机会，帮你家公司赚钱吗？
examples.trans: Thank you for what? For giving me the chance to make money for your family's company?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 这篇帖子有很多赞。
examples.trans: This post has many likes.

examples.text: 给他点个赞。
examples.trans: Give him a like.

examples.text: 她说为了表示对星天公司和淳于乔先生的谢意，这首歌无偿赠给我们。
examples.trans: To express her gratitude to Xingtian and to me, she gifted this song to us completely free of charge.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yíng. Opposite of 输; can serve as a result complement (跑赢 'outrun / win the race').

examples.text: 定好闹钟吧，老陈。明早我们跑赢冷水！
examples.trans: Set your alarm, Chen. Tomorrow morning we outrun the cold water!

examples.text: 弟弟今天下棋赢了哥哥一次。
examples.trans: The younger brother beat his older brother once at chess today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǒu. Means 'walk' (走路, 直走) or 'leave / head off' (我先走了).

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǒu bu liǎo lù. Potential complement phrase 走 ('walk') + 不了 (bu liǎo, 'unable to') + object 路 ('road/steps').

examples.text: 今晚你要是硬站在肿起来的脚踝上，接下来两星期都走不了路！
examples.trans: If you stubbornly stand on a swollen ankle tonight, you won't be able to walk for two weeks!

examples.text: 提着这么重的两桶水，谁都走不了快路。
examples.trans: Carrying two buckets of water this heavy, nobody can walk fast.

meanings.note: Stage/TV term for walking through cues, marks, and lighting.

examples.text: 助演嘉宾下午已经在演播厅顺利完成了走台。
examples.trans: The guest performers finished stage blocking in the studio this afternoon.

examples.text: 正式开录之前，所有歌手必须按顺序走台一次。
examples.trans: Before taping starts, every singer must walk their stage marks once.

走向.gloss: head toward, move in the direction of

meanings.en: head toward, move in the direction of
meanings.note: Verb/noun zǒuxiàng ('head toward; trajectory').

examples.text: 谁也不知道这场特殊直播正在走向何处。
examples.trans: Nobody knows where this extraordinary live broadcast is heading.

examples.text: 年轻的中国原创综艺正在一步步走向国际市场。
examples.trans: Young domestic original shows are steadily heading global.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǒu láng. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条走廊 ('a hallway').

examples.text: 看这个箭头——指着走廊里的书架！
examples.trans: Look at this arrow—it points at the bookcase in the hallway!

examples.text: 一扇真的门，就藏在走廊里！
examples.trans: A real door, hidden right here in the hallway!

meanings.note: Putting genuine feeling into work or relationships.

examples.text: 感情这回事，太走心了有时候反而觉得累。
examples.trans: In romance, caring too deeply can leave a person exhausted.

examples.text: 这段告别戏拍得特别走心，把现场观众都看哭了。
examples.trans: That farewell scene was so heartfelt it moved the studio audience to tears.

meanings.note: Verb zǒulòu (as in 走漏风声, 'let word slip').

examples.text: 是你们公关部自己走漏了风声，我才有线索。
examples.trans: Your own PR office let word slip, giving me the lead.

examples.text: 决赛神秘嘉宾的名单千万不能走漏消息。
examples.trans: Never let the finale mystery guest list leak out.

examples.text: 这是走着啊。
examples.trans: This is walk.

examples.text: 那个走着好。
examples.trans: That walk is good.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǒu lù. Separable verb-object compound 走 ('walk') + 路 ('road'); placed before 去 + place to mean 'walk to…'.

examples.text: 星期六集市离客栈很近，我们走路去只要五分钟。
examples.trans: The Saturday market is right near the inn—it only takes us five minutes to walk there.

examples.text: 吃过晚饭去河边走走路，浑身都舒服。
examples.trans: Taking a walk by the river after dinner makes you feel great all over.

走过.gloss: walk past; pass by on foot

meanings.en: walk past; pass by on foot
meanings.note: Pinyin: zǒu guò. Directional/resultative compound 走 ('walk') + 过 ('past/across').

examples.text: 周经理每天早上走过那几扇灰窗板，却一直没留意它们。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou walked past those grey shutters every morning without noticing them.

examples.text: 走过梧桐巷的青石板路，就能看见小院客栈的灯笼。
examples.trans: Walk down the flagstones of Wutong Lane and you will spot Courtyard Inn's lanterns.

meanings.note: Formal verb-object fùyuē ('attend a scheduled meeting').

examples.text: 淳于先生肯来赴约，很给面子呀。
examples.trans: Mr Chun Yuqiao keeping our appointment does me great honour.

examples.text: 尽管工作很忙，他还是准时赶来赴约了。
examples.trans: Despite a packed schedule, he arrived on time for the meeting.

meanings.note: Verb gǎn ('hurry; catch a plane or deadline').

examples.text: 董事长也连夜赶飞机回来了。
examples.trans: The chairwoman rushed onto a night flight back too.

examples.text: 我今晚得赶一篇稿子。
examples.trans: I have to rush an article tonight.

赶上.gloss: make it in time for, catch up with

meanings.en: make it in time for, catch up with
meanings.note: Meeting a tight deadline or catching transport.

examples.text: 全组加班加点，总算是赶上了明天的交片时间。
examples.trans: Working flat out, the crew finally made tomorrow's delivery deadline.

examples.text: 幸亏跑得快，我们正好赶上了最后一班地铁。
examples.trans: Running fast let us catch the very last train.

meanings.note: Verb-complement gǎnchūlai ('turn out work against a deadline').

examples.text: 我今晚一定把最后一章赶出来。
examples.trans: I will definitely rush out the final chapter tonight.

examples.text: 设计图明天早上能赶出来吗？
examples.trans: Can the design draft be rushed out by tomorrow morning?

meanings.note: Working overtime to finish on schedule.

examples.text: 为了按期播出，后期团队连续赶工了整整一个月。
examples.trans: To air on schedule, post-production rushed work for a full month.

examples.text: 虽然是在紧急赶工，剪辑质量却一点没打折扣。
examples.trans: Even while rushing to meet the deadline, editing quality stayed high.

examples.text: 赶快去吧。
examples.trans: Go quickly.

examples.text: 我们得赶快。
examples.trans: We need to hurry.

examples.text: 我以为在这儿都得这么说话呢！快走吧，我赶着回上海！
examples.trans: I thought everyone had to speak in classical poetry around here! Let's hurry — I'm rushing back to Shanghai!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Urgent conversational adverb gǎnjǐn.

examples.text: 赶紧告诉我。
examples.trans: Hurry up and tell me.

examples.text: 赶紧去休息吧。
examples.trans: Hurry and get some rest.

meanings.note: Verb-object phrase gǎn fēijī ('rush to catch a plane').

examples.text: 明天一早还要赶飞机呢，快去休息吧。
examples.trans: You have an early flight to catch tomorrow—go get some rest.

examples.text: 为了赶飞机去外景地，大家天没亮就出发了。
examples.trans: To catch the flight to location, everyone left before dawn.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qǐ. Used for rising or lifting upward (抱起 'pick up in arms').

examples.text: 老陈，抱起那些纸箱，我们下楼吧！
examples.trans: Chen, pick up those cardboard boxes—down the stairs we go!

examples.text: 从那天起我们就再没说过话。上周我给他寄了一张明信片。
examples.trans: Since that day we have not spoken again. Last week I mailed him a postcard.

examples.text: 如果您愿意出来主张一下，对我们的公司会起到非常大的帮助。
examples.trans: If you are willing to step forward and assert your rights, it will help our company immensely.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Colloquial verb-object qǐhòng ('jeer or crowd-pressure someone').

examples.text: 朋友们在旁边起哄，非让老大也喝一杯。
examples.trans: Friends egged him on from the side to drink a glass.

examples.text: 大家别跟着起哄，听主持人把话说完。
examples.trans: Stop egging them on and let the host finish speaking.

起床.gloss: get out of bed, get up

meanings.en: get out of bed, get up
meanings.note: Verb-object qǐchuáng ('get up in the morning').

examples.text: 不是，我还没起床呢，你们千万别录！
examples.trans: Hold on—I am not even out of bed yet, stop filming!

examples.text: 外景组每天早上五点半准时起床集合。
examples.trans: The location unit gets up promptly at five-thirty every morning.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qǐ lái. Marks standing up or beginning/evaluating an action.

examples.text: 摸摸铜管！已经热起来了！
examples.trans: Touch the copper pipe! It is warming up already!

examples.text: 快把那张纸折起来，塞进口袋里。
examples.trans: Fold up that sheet of paper right now and tuck it into your pocket.

meanings.note: Noun qǐsè ('turnaround, improvement').

examples.text: 星天的经纪部一直没有什么起色。
examples.trans: Xingtian's talent unit has shown little improvement.

examples.text: 换了新方案后，收视率终于有了起色。
examples.trans: After switching plans, ratings finally picked up.

meanings.note: Formal verb qǐcǎo ('draw up a draft').

examples.text: 他们腾不出来一个律师给我们起草合同。
examples.trans: They cannot spare a single lawyer to draft our contract.

examples.text: 法务部正在起草新一季的合作协议。
examples.trans: Legal is drafting the cooperation agreement for next season.

meanings.note: Legal verb qǐsù ('bring a suit in court').

examples.text: 律师团队已经正式起诉了。
examples.trans: The legal team has formally filed a lawsuit.

examples.text: 她决定向法院起诉违约方。
examples.trans: She decided to sue the breaching party in court.

起雾.gloss: fog up; mist over; become foggy

meanings.en: fog up; mist over; become foggy
meanings.note: Pinyin: qǐ wù. Separable verb-object compound 起 ('rise/form') + 雾 ('fog/mist'), used for weather or steamed-up glasses and windows.

examples.text: 连我的眼镜都起雾了——而且这一回我知道它在哪儿！
examples.trans: Even my glasses have fogged up—and this time I know right where they are!

examples.text: 热茶端上来的时候，玻璃窗上轻轻起雾了。
examples.trans: When the hot tea was carried out, the glass windowpanes gently misted over.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chèn. Introduces a favorable moment before it passes (趁热吃 'eat while it's hot').

examples.text: 趁着阳光亮，我能再看看那张小纸牌吗？
examples.trans: While the sunlight is bright, may I look at that small paper tag again?

examples.text: 太好了……趁着等他们，我扫一眼这封房东来信。
examples.trans: Wonderful... while we wait, let me glance at this letter from the landlord.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chèn rè. Classic table invitation: 趁热喝 / 趁热吃 ('enjoy it while hot!').

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

examples.text: 肉桂卷刚出炉，快趁热吃一个吧！
examples.trans: The cinnamon rolls just came out of the oven—eat one while it's hot!

examples.text: 王尔实在是太狡猾了，他趁着我们去年系统升级的时候钻了这个空子。
examples.trans: Wang Er was remarkably cunning; he exploited a gap during our internal system upgrade last autumn.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Prefix/verb chāo ('exceed, overload').

examples.text: 这是一趟二十四小时超工作负荷的旅行。
examples.trans: This is a twenty-four-hour, over-capacity working trip.

examples.text: 今晚的直播时长一分钟也不能超。
examples.trans: Tonight's live broadcast must not run even a minute over.

meanings.note: Surpassing expectations, limits, or imagination.

examples.text: 他对团队的信任远远超出了我们的想象。
examples.trans: His trust in the team went far beyond our imagination.

examples.text: 这次演出的效果超出了所有人的预期。
examples.trans: The impact of this performance surpassed everyone's expectations.

meanings.note: Noun chāoshì ('supermarket').

examples.text: 行，我现在就去楼下超市买苹果汁。
examples.trans: Alright, I will go down to the supermarket right now to buy juice.

examples.text: 下班顺路去超市买点水果和牛奶吧。
examples.trans: Let us stop by the supermarket after work for fruit and milk.

meanings.note: Adjective chāojí ('super, mega').

examples.text: 好多华人都是您的超级粉丝。
examples.trans: Many Chinese viewers are your super fans.

examples.text: 他把一部打造成一部超级机器。
examples.trans: He built Unit One into a super machine.

examples.text: 我有把握让孤岛以同样的品质接棒十二歌王甚至超越。但是老板，留给你的时间不多。
examples.trans: I am confident Lonely Island will match or surpass Twelve Singers in quality — though boss, you don't have much time left to decide.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chāo guò. Followed by a number, age, or limit.

examples.text: 超过八十年的小院建筑，只要一楼每天服务街坊邻居，禁止改成私人办公室。
examples.trans: Any courtyard building over eighty years old may not become private offices as long as the ground floor serves neighbours daily.

examples.text: 这棵大梧桐树的树龄已经超过八十年了。
examples.trans: This grand plane tree is already over eighty years old.

meanings.note: Correlative adverb yuè in 越 A 越 B.

examples.text: 再这么闹下去，部门关系越闹越僵。
examples.trans: Pressing this further will only make ties stiffer and stiffer.

examples.text: 雨越下越大了。
examples.trans: The rain is falling harder and harder.

meanings.note: Adverb yuèfā ('increasingly, more than ever').

examples.text: 认识他之后，我越发地相信当初的决定对了。
examples.trans: After knowing him, I grew all the more sure my choice was right.

examples.text: 排练了五遍之后，乐队的配合越发默契了。
examples.trans: After five run-throughs, the band played in ever tighter sync.

examples.text: 挣钱越多麻烦越大，不想挣拉倒！
examples.trans: The more money you earn, the bigger the headaches — if you don't want the raise, forget it!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuè lái yuè. Placed before an adjective or feeling verb (越来越好 'better and better').

examples.text: 为了一个木头小火车紧张？这事越来越怪了。
examples.trans: Nervous over a wooden toy train? This story gets stranger by the hour.

examples.text: 立春以后，成都的天气越来越暖和了。
examples.trans: After the start of spring, Chengdu's weather grows warmer and warmer.

examples.text: 我越界了。事关你们的私事，应该你们自己去处理。
examples.trans: I overstepped. This touches on your private life, so the two of you should handle it yourselves.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Verb yuèguò ('cross over, bypass').

examples.text: 他们两个越过那边直接来接触咱们了。
examples.trans: The two of them bypassed the other side to contact us directly.

examples.text: 汇报工作请按流程来，不要随便越过主管。
examples.trans: Follow workflow when reporting instead of bypassing your lead.

趟.gloss: measure word for trips and errands

meanings.en: measure word for trips and errands
meanings.note: Pinyin: tàng. Counts round trips or errands (跑一趟 'make a trip').

examples.text: 你们这些好人真是救了我这趟旅行。
examples.trans: You kind people have truly saved this whole trip of mine.

examples.text: 我下午得去一趟市政厅。
examples.trans: I need to make a trip to City Hall this afternoon.

meanings.note: Describes full energy, confidence, or preparation.

examples.text: 休息了一晚，大家今天干劲都很足。
examples.trans: After a night's rest, everyone's drive is high today.

examples.text: 准备得越充分，上台时底气就越足。
examples.trans: The better prepared you are, the fuller your confidence on stage.

meanings.note: Formal adverb before a verb like 证明 or 说明.

examples.text: 这份详实的舆情报告足以证明观众对原创节目的高度期待。
examples.trans: This thorough report is more than enough to prove viewer anticipation.

examples.text: 危机时刻全组人的默契表现足以说明日常流程的价值。
examples.trans: The crew's seamless crisis response amply proves the workflow's value.

meanings.note: Adjective/verb zúgòu ('more than enough').

examples.text: 对我来说，这个机会已经足够了。
examples.trans: For me, this opportunity is already enough.

examples.text: 我们有足够的时间准备决赛。
examples.trans: We have enough time to prepare for the finale.

examples.text: 举办了一届校际桌式足球比赛。
examples.trans: So I put together an intercollegiate table-football tournament.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pǎo. Everyday verb for running.

examples.text: 那个人为什么不拿回自己的箱子就跑了？
examples.trans: Why did that person run off without taking his own suitcase back?

examples.text: 十分钟之内你能跑个来回吗？
examples.trans: Can you run there and back within ten minutes?

meanings.note: Noun jùlí ('distance or competitive lead').

examples.text: 不改规则就跟对手的节目拉不开距离。
examples.trans: Without rule changes, we cannot open a lead over rivals.

examples.text: 保持适当镜头距离能让画面更自然。
examples.trans: Keeping proper camera distance makes shots look natural.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gēn. As a verb, 'follow' (跟我来 'follow me'); as a preposition, 'with' (跟你一样 'same as yours').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 淳总。你跟我走，升职培训！高级制作人有三十七条内部守则，淳总定的。
examples.trans: Mr Chun. Now come with me for promotion training — senior producers have thirty-seven internal rules set by Mr Chun himself.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Production verb gēnpāi ('follow and film continuously').

examples.text: 从明天开始，摄像师就得二十四小时跟拍。
examples.trans: Starting tomorrow, camera operators shadow and film you nonstop.

examples.text: 跟拍导演需要敏锐捕捉嘉宾最自然的反应。
examples.trans: A follow-cam director captures guests' natural reactions.

meanings.en: to work under; to shadow or apprentice with
meanings.note: gēnzhe — 跟 + durative aspect particle 着; idiomatic in professional settings for working on a mentor's or boss's team
indicates accompanying someone physically or acting immediately in sequence

examples.text: 跟着我，肯定是上十二歌王了。
examples.trans: Working under me, it will definitely be on Twelve Singers.

examples.text: 你这几天就跟着杏子姐姐，给她打打下手。
examples.trans: For the next few days, shadow Sister Xingzi and lend her a hand.

meanings.note: Used in 跟踪研究 or 跟踪报道.

examples.text: 节目延播期间，她一直坚持对市场反响做系统性的跟踪研究。
examples.trans: During the delay, she systematically tracked market response.

examples.text: 记者对这起公益维权事件进行了长达一个月的跟踪报道。
examples.trans: Reporters did a month-long follow-up series on the consumer-aid case.

跟风.gloss: jump on the bandwagon, copy trends

meanings.en: jump on the bandwagon, copy trends
meanings.note: Verb-object gēnfēng ('blindly imitate hits').

examples.text: 过度依赖海外版权，国内跟风很猖獗。
examples.trans: Over-relying on overseas IP, domestic bandwagon-copying runs wild.

examples.text: 真正优秀的制作人只做原创，绝不盲目跟风。
examples.trans: Great producers create originals rather than chase trends.

examples.text: 我给你跪了，谢谢！
examples.trans: I bow down to you in gratitude — thank you!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

跪下.gloss: kneel down, drop to one's knees

meanings.en: kneel down, drop to one's knees
meanings.note: Kneeling literally or hyperbolically in pleading.

examples.text: 为了求她收下礼物，那小子当时就差给她跪下了。
examples.trans: Begging her to take the gift, that fellow stopped just short of kneeling.

examples.text: 古装剧里的角色在殿前恭恭敬敬地跪下谢恩。
examples.trans: The period-drama character knelt respectfully in the hall.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lù. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条路 ('a road').

examples.text: 走花摊旁边第二条路，别进窄巷子。
examples.trans: Take the second lane beside the flower stall; do not enter the narrow alley.

examples.text: 雨停了，石板路还有点滑。
examples.trans: The rain stopped, and the stone path is still a bit slippery.

examples.text: 在路上。
examples.trans: On the way.

examples.text: 路上小心。
examples.trans: Careful on the way.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lù rén. Combines 路 ('road/street') + 人 ('person'); measure word: 位 (wèi) or 个 (gè).

examples.text: 快看外面：走在梧桐巷上的路人，都停在大门口听了！
examples.trans: Look outside: passers-by walking down Wutong Lane have all stopped by the front gate to listen!

examples.text: 木牌挂出去不到十分钟，就有好几位路人停下来看菜单。
examples.trans: Less than ten minutes after the wooden sign was hung out, several passers-by stopped to read the menu.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lù kǒu. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个路口 ('an intersection').

examples.text: 给我袋子和现金！路口市场七点开门。
examples.trans: Give me a bag and cash! The corner market opens at seven.

examples.text: 过马路的时候请在路口等绿灯。
examples.trans: Please wait for the green light at the crossing before crossing.

meanings.note: Colloquial noun lùzi ('tactical style, playbook').

examples.text: 淳于乔做公关的路子实在太野了。
examples.trans: Chun Yuqiao's crisis-PR playbook is truly wild.

examples.text: 这个新导演拍综艺的路子跟别人都不一样。
examples.trans: This new director's variety-show approach is unlike anyone else's.

meanings.note: Colloquial word for someone's characteristic method.

examples.text: 两位制作人的创作路数完全不同，一个擅长原创，一个专攻引进。
examples.trans: The two producers have totally different playbooks: originals vs imports.

examples.text: 跟老对手交锋多次，大家早就摸清了他的惯用路数。
examples.trans: After clashing many times, everyone knew his usual playbook inside out.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lùdēng. Measure word: 盏.

examples.text: 天黑了，路灯都亮了起来。
examples.trans: It got dark, and all the streetlights came on.

examples.text: 他一个人走在昏暗的路灯下。
examples.trans: He walked alone under the dim streetlights.

meanings.note: Noun lùxiàn ('strategic line, course').

examples.text: 他特立独行，喜欢走创新的蓝海路线。
examples.trans: Fiercely independent, he likes taking a blue-ocean course.

examples.text: 星天决定为辛惠美打造尊重个性的艺术路线。
examples.trans: Xingtian chose an artist-first direction for Xin Huimei.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lù biān. Measure word (量词): 排 (pái), e.g. 路边小树 ('roadside trees').

examples.text: 别动，你们俩。听到路边汽车停下的声音了吗？
examples.trans: Hold still, both of you. Hear that car engine stopping at the curb?

examples.text: 路边新开了一家卖热豆浆的小早点铺。
examples.trans: A breakfast stall selling hot soy milk just opened by the roadside.

meanings.note: Going past a place on one's way elsewhere.

examples.text: 我下午路过门口的时候看见他了。
examples.trans: When I walked past the entrance this afternoon, I saw him.

examples.text: 下班路过花店，她顺便买了一束花。
examples.trans: Passing the flower shop after work, she bought a bouquet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiào. Describes jumping or a racing heartbeat (心跳得好快).

examples.text: 谢谢你，小美。刚才吓了一跳，手都凉了！
examples.trans: Thank you, Mei. That gave me such a start just now that my hands went cold!

examples.text: 我心跳得好快！小晴你去说，你声音稳重诚实！
examples.trans: My heart is pounding! Qing, you explain it—you sound calm and honest!

meanings.note: Workplace verb-object tiàocáo ('jump ship to a rival company').

examples.text: 提醒他上个月跳槽的那个女主持人。
examples.trans: Remind him about the female host who switched stations last month.

examples.text: 年底有不少行业新人准备跳槽。
examples.trans: At year's end several newcomers consider changing firms.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiào yuè. Combines 跳 ('jump') + 跃 ('leap'), often describing lively, dancing musical figures.

examples.text: 圆舞曲的开头轻快跳跃，就像清晨院子里的脚步声。
examples.trans: The waltz's opening is light and dancing, like morning footsteps in the courtyard.

examples.text: 阳光透过树叶，在干净的木地板上轻轻跳跃。
examples.trans: Sunlight filters through the leaves and dances lightly across the clean wooden floor.

meanings.note: Formal verb tàrù ('set foot into a hall or field').

examples.text: 那一刻我才真正踏入他的制作殿堂。
examples.trans: Only then did I truly step into his world of production.

examples.text: 毕业后她满怀期待地踏入了电视行业。
examples.trans: After graduating she eagerly stepped into television.

踏板.gloss: pedal (of a piano or bicycle); footboard

meanings.en: pedal (of a piano or bicycle); footboard
meanings.note: Pinyin: tà bǎn. Combines 踏 ('step on/tread') + 板 ('board/plate'); measure word: 个 (gè) or 根 (gēn); verb: 踩 (cǎi).

examples.text: 连钢琴底下的黄铜延音踏板，老陈都擦得像黄金一样亮！
examples.trans: Chen even polished the brass sustain pedal beneath the piano until it shone like gold!

examples.text: 宋老师轻轻踩下右边的踏板，让最后一个和弦在阳光房里久久回响。
examples.trans: Teacher Song gently pressed the right pedal, letting the final chord linger softly in the sunroom.

meanings.note: In 踏破门槛, hyperbole for endless visitors crowding in.

examples.text: 来找他谈合作的人快把门槛都踏破了。
examples.trans: People coming to pitch deals have nearly worn down his threshold.

examples.text: 抗议的人太多，办公室门槛都快被踏破了。
examples.trans: So many protesters came that the office threshold was nearly worn flat.

踏踏实实.gloss: steadily, with peace of mind, groundedly

meanings.en: steadily, with peace of mind, groundedly
meanings.note: Free of anxiety or showiness.

examples.text: 有我们在前面盯着，您就踏踏实实在后面坐镇吧。
examples.trans: With us watching the front line, you can relax with complete peace of mind.

examples.text: 做节目没有捷径，只能一步一个脚印踏踏实实地干。
examples.trans: There are no shortcuts in production—just steady step-by-step work.

meanings.note: Striking with the foot.

examples.text: 孩子们正在操场上高兴地踢足球。
examples.trans: Children are happily kicking a football on the field.

examples.text: 他开玩笑说惹急了她就会挨踢。
examples.trans: He joked that annoying her gets him kicked.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cǎi. Used for stepping onto stairs, puddles, or boxes.

examples.text: 快去跟他聊聊，小晴，不然木地板都要踩破了！
examples.trans: Go talk to him quickly, Qing, or he will wear right through the wooden floorboards!

examples.text: 下楼请慢点，小心别踩空了。
examples.trans: Walk slowly downstairs and take care where you step.

meanings.note: Pinyin: duó bù. Joins 踱 ('to pace') + 步 ('step'). Usually implies walking back and forth thoughtfully.

examples.text: 周经理焦急地在客栈大堂里来回踱步。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou paced back and forth anxiously in the inn's lobby.

examples.text: 宋老师喜欢傍晚时分在院子里慢慢踱步。
examples.trans: Teacher Song likes to pace slowly in the courtyard at dusk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cèng. Action of grazing, rubbing, or smearing.

examples.text: 那只流浪猫撒娇地蹭了蹭小美的裤腿。
examples.trans: The stray cat rubbed coquettishly against Mei's trouser leg.

examples.text: 他不小心在刚刷好漆的门框上蹭了一下，弄脏了袖子。
examples.trans: He accidentally scraped against the freshly painted doorframe and dirtied his sleeve.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shēn shang. Measure word (量词): 件 (jiàn), e.g. 身上衣服 ('clothes on oneself').

examples.text: 不怪你们。只是我身上只有这件外套！
examples.trans: It is not your fault. Still, I only have this one coat on me!

examples.text: 出门忘了带现金，好在身上还有交通卡。
examples.trans: I forgot cash heading out, though luckily I still had my transit card on me.

examples.text: 连我们其他战队的导师，都不知道她的真实身份。
examples.trans: Not even the mentors of our other teams know this singer's true identity.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Noun shēntǐ ('physical health').

examples.text: 要注意身体啊！
examples.trans: Take care of your health!

examples.text: 他身体很好。
examples.trans: He is in good health.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shēn hòu. Measure word (量词): 步 (bù), e.g. 身后一步 ('a step behind').

examples.text: 老陈，看身后木头钥匙板：一、二、三、四、五、六、七、八！
examples.trans: Chen, look at the wooden key board behind us: one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight!

examples.text: 关门的时候请看一眼身后有没有人。
examples.trans: When closing the gate, glance behind you to see if anyone is coming.

examples.text: 我欣赏的生活态度，就是不管你身处在什么处境，你都要做最好的自己。
examples.trans: The life attitude I admire is striving to be your very best self, no matter what circumstances you are in.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Compound noun shēnxīn ('physical and mental well-being').

examples.text: 趁着假期好好休息，现在身心都恢复了。
examples.trans: After resting well on holiday, body and mind feel refreshed.

examples.text: 适度运动有助于缓解加班带来的身心疲劳。
examples.trans: Moderate exercise eases fatigue in body and mind.

meanings.note: Noun shēnduàn (as in 放下身段, 'set aside pride/status').

examples.text: 邓主任已经放下身段来拜托我们帮忙了。
examples.trans: Director Deng set aside his pride to ask our help.

examples.text: 优秀的制片人懂得在沟通时放下身段。
examples.trans: Good producers know when to set aside airs in talks.

meanings.note: Idiom shēnjīngbǎizhàn ('highly experienced, battle-tested').

examples.text: 您身经百战，今晚一定会很精彩。
examples.trans: You are a seasoned veteran; tonight will be wonderful.

examples.text: 他是一位身经百战的老导演。
examples.trans: He is a veteran director tested by countless shows.

meanings.note: Compound shēnbiān ('beside one's body').

examples.text: 不要在我身边安插眼线。
examples.trans: Stop planting informants around me.

examples.text: 朋友都在身边。
examples.trans: Friends are all around me.

躬.gloss: bow (of the body, in 鞠躬)

meanings.en: bow (of the body, in 鞠躬)
meanings.note: Pinyin: gōng. Bound noun object of the separable verb 鞠躬 ('to bow'); 鞠个躬 means 'take a bow'.

examples.text: 周经理，快鞠个躬，笑着把菜单卡片发给大家吧！
examples.trans: Take a bow, Manager Zhou, and hand out the menu cards to everyone with a smile!

examples.text: 演出结束的时候，宋老师和老先生一起向大家鞠了一个躬。
examples.trans: When the performance ended, Teacher Song and the older gentleman took a bow together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: duǒ. Used for ducking out of rain or hiding away.

examples.text: 等等——您本来打算让店员把箱子交给他，自己躲在街对面看？！
examples.trans: Wait—you were planning to let the clerk hand him the bag and watch from across the street?!

examples.text: 当然来了。为什么躲在神秘纸条后面？
examples.trans: Of course I came. Why hide behind a mystery note?

meanings.note: Pinyin: tǎng. Describes lying flat on a bed or sofa, or an item lying in a drawer.

examples.text: 篮子里正躺着六个黄柠檬呢——厨房就等今天了！
examples.trans: Six yellow lemons are sitting in my basket right now—this kitchen was waiting for today!

examples.text: 旧铜钥匙静静地躺在木盒里。
examples.trans: The old brass key lay quietly inside the wooden box.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chē. Measure word (量词): 辆 (liàng), e.g. 一辆车 ('a vehicle').

examples.text: 送牛奶的车在城外坏了。你们看冰箱！
examples.trans: The milk delivery van broke down outside town. Look at the fridge!

examples.text: 门口停着一辆蓝色的出租车。
examples.trans: A blue taxi is parked outside the gate.

related.gloss: be stuck in a traffic jam

车上.gloss: on the train / in the car

meanings.en: on the train / in the car
meanings.note: Pinyin: chē shang. Measure word (量词): 节, e.g. 车上座位 ('a seat on the train').

examples.text: 我手在发抖——车上下来穿深灰色外套的高个子男人吗？
examples.trans: My hands are shaking—is a tall man in a dark grey coat stepping out?

examples.text: 早班火车上很安静，不少人都在看书。
examples.trans: It was quiet aboard the morning train, with many passengers reading.

related.gloss: a seat on the train (measure word 节)
be stuck in a traffic jam

meanings.note: Pinyin: chē piào. Combines 车 ('train/coach') + 票 ('ticket').

examples.text: 志豪给搭档打了电话，把回家的车票改到了星期六早上。
examples.trans: Hao called his partner and moved his train ticket home to Saturday morning.

examples.text: 请把印好座位的车票收在口袋里，检票时要用。
examples.trans: Keep your printed seat ticket in your pocket for ticket inspection.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chē zhàn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个车站 ('a station').

examples.text: 啊……下这么大的雨，车站附近酒店全满了。
examples.trans: Ah... in rain this heavy, every hotel near the station was full.

examples.text: 雨天打车难，我们早点去车站吧。
examples.trans: Hailing a cab in the rain takes longer, so let's head to the station early.

related.gloss: be stuck in a traffic jam

车身.gloss: vehicle body; side of a van/car

meanings.en: vehicle body; side of a van/car
meanings.note: Pinyin: chē shēn. Compound 车 ('vehicle') + 身 ('body').

examples.text: 蓝色货车的车身上印着家具店的电话号码。
examples.trans: The furniture shop's phone number is printed on the side of the blue van.

examples.text: 下过雨以后，司机用干布把车身擦得干干净净。
examples.trans: After the rain, the driver wiped the body of the van spotless with a dry cloth.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chē lún. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个车轮 ('a wheel').

examples.text: 看车轮底下——铅笔写的你和我的名字还在那儿。
examples.trans: Look underneath the wheels—your name and mine in pencil are still right there.

examples.text: 行李箱底下的四个小车轮滑得很顺。
examples.trans: The four small wheels underneath the suitcase roll smoothly.

related.gloss: be stuck in a traffic jam

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuàn. Read zhuàn for spinning wheels or quick wits (脑子转得快 'mind works fast').

examples.text: 脑子转得快，小晴。志豪每星期都读城市建筑规定。
examples.trans: Quick thinking, Qing. Hao reads city building rules every single week.

examples.text: 风一吹，纸风车就飞快地转起来。
examples.trans: When the breeze blows, the paper pinwheel spins fast.

转一转.gloss: stroll around, look around a place

meanings.en: stroll around, look around a place
meanings.note: Casual sightseeing walk (pronounced zhuànyizhuàn).

examples.text: 难得来一趟，我陪你去城里到处转一转吧。
examples.trans: Since you rarely visit, let me take you strolling around town.

examples.text: 午饭后去院子里转一转，呼吸点新鲜空气。
examples.trans: Take a stroll around the courtyard after lunch for fresh air.

examples.text: 请转发这条消息。
examples.trans: Please repost this message.

examples.text: 他的文章被转发了很多次。
examples.trans: His article was reposted many times.

meanings.note: Social media metric tracking how widely a post spreads.

examples.text: 那篇八卦文章发出不到半天，转发量就破了十万。
examples.trans: Within half a day, reposts of that gossip piece topped a hundred thousand.

examples.text: 优质内容自然会带来很高的点赞和转发量。
examples.trans: Quality content naturally draws high likes and reposts.

examples.text: 这首歌曲的侵权事件前几天闹得沸沸扬扬，可是现在却有了一个戏剧性的转变。
examples.trans: The copyright uproar around this song raged for days, yet now it has taken a dramatic turn.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 请转告他。
examples.trans: Please pass the message to him.

examples.text: 我会转告的。
examples.trans: I will pass the message.

meanings.note: Mobile control-room truck transmitting live television feeds.

examples.text: 院子里停着三辆大型高清电视转播车。
examples.trans: Three large HD broadcast trucks are parked in the courtyard.

examples.text: 工程师已经完成了全部转播车的信号检修。
examples.trans: Engineers have completed signal checks on every broadcast truck.

examples.text: 我本来是想着可以把她留在总编室，早点转正。
examples.trans: Originally I was planning to keep her in the chief editor's office and make her permanent early.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Verb zhuǎnyí ('divert attention, shift').

examples.text: 他们俩吵架转移了红毯的注意力。
examples.trans: Their quarrel diverted attention away from the red carpet.

examples.text: 主持人巧妙地转移了尴尬的话题。
examples.trans: The host deftly steered away from the awkward topic.

转移话题.gloss: change the subject, deflect the topic

meanings.en: change the subject, deflect the topic
meanings.note: Steering conversation away from an awkward or serious point.

examples.text: 我问的是正事，你别故意跟我转移话题。
examples.trans: I am asking about real business—stop changing the subject.

examples.text: 一聊到感情问题，他总是巧妙地转移话题。
examples.trans: Whenever romance comes up, he deftly changes the subject.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuǎn jiǎo. Note 转 is read 3rd-tone zhuǎn ('change direction/turn a corner') here, not 4th-tone zhuàn ('spin in circles')!

examples.text: 往前走五十米，转角就是那家很有名的陶瓷摊。
examples.trans: Walk fifty metres ahead and the famous pottery stall is right at the corner.

examples.text: 梧桐巷转角新开了一家飘着麦香的面包房。
examples.trans: A bakery smelling of toasted wheat just opened on the corner of Wutong Lane.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuǎn ràng. Legal/property verb for transferring a lease or title.

examples.text: 产权转让通知：八号小院整栋建筑将作为商业办公楼出售。
examples.trans: Property Transfer Notice: Courtyard Building Eight offered for sale as commercial offices.

examples.text: 原房东决定不转让这栋老院子了。
examples.trans: The landlord decided not to transfer ownership of the old courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuǎn shēn. Separable verb-object compound.

examples.text: 留下来，小美。就算他转身走出大门，我也认了。
examples.trans: I am staying, Mei. Even if he turns around and walks straight out the gate.

examples.text: 他刚一转身，就看见弟弟站在门口。
examples.trans: Right as he turned around, he saw his brother standing in the doorway.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuàn lún. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个转轮 ('a caster wheel').

examples.text: 把蓝色转轮慢慢往左拧开——别太快。
examples.trans: Turn the blue wheel open slowly to the left—not too fast.

examples.text: 给行李箱的小转轮滴点油就不卡了。
examples.trans: A drop of oil keeps the suitcase caster wheel rolling smoothly.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuǎn dá. Polite verb for relaying a message.

examples.text: 一定转达！请慢用。
examples.trans: I certainly will! Please enjoy your meal.

examples.text: 等宋老师下楼，我一定把您的话转达给她。
examples.trans: As soon as Teacher Song comes downstairs, I will pass your message on.

meanings.note: Classifier/noun lún ('round').

examples.text: 外面的合作谈判还需要再谈几轮吧。
examples.trans: Outside partnership talks will take a few more rounds.

examples.text: 经过三轮激烈比拼，冠军终于诞生了。
examples.trans: After three intense rounds, a champion emerged.

meanings.note: Workplace verb lúnxiū ('rotate rest shifts').

examples.text: 启动三班制以后，我们可以轮休对不对？
examples.trans: Once three shifts start, we can rotate breaks, right?

examples.text: 节假日现场员工实行轮休。
examples.trans: Floor staff take rotating breaks over holidays.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lún dào. Verb-complement compound 轮 ('take turns') + 到 ('reach'); followed by the person whose turn has arrived.

examples.text: 电线都接好了，小晴，现在轮到你按开关啦！
examples.trans: The wires are all connected—Qing, now it's your turn to press the switch!

examples.text: 大家排好队，很快就轮到我们买热烧饼了。
examples.trans: Line up nicely—it'll be our turn to buy hot sesame flatbreads very soon.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ruǎn. Describes soft bread, cushions, or softened cardboard.

examples.text: 您看，这件软羊毛开衫是全新的，试试吧。
examples.trans: Look, this soft wool cardigan is brand-new; try it on.

examples.text: 储藏室里有两个软枕头和一块蓝地毯！
examples.trans: In the storeroom there are two soft pillows and a blue rug!

meanings.note: Pinyin: ruǎn diàn. Combines 软 ('soft') + 垫 ('cushion/pad'); measure word: 个 (gè) or 块 (kuài).

examples.text: 小美哭笑不得地说：“你是想让我坐在软垫上指挥大家干活？！”
examples.trans: Mei laughed half in disbelief: 'You want me to sit on a soft cushion and direct everyone at work?!'

examples.text: 木椅子上加了一块厚实的亚麻软垫，坐一整个下午也不累。
examples.trans: With a thick linen cushion added to the wooden chair, you can sit all afternoon in comfort.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhóu. Refers to a cylindrical pivot pin, hinge pin (合页轴), or axle around which a part turns.

examples.text: 老陈在每个生锈的合页轴上都滴了两滴机油。
examples.trans: Chen put two drops of lubricating oil on every rusty hinge pin.

examples.text: 门扇转动不顺的时候，擦干净合页轴就会好很多。
examples.trans: When a door swings stiffly, wiping the hinge pin clean helps a lot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhóu tào. Combines 轴 ('pivot pin/axle') + 套 ('lining sleeve'): in a piano action, the tiny cloth/felt ring lining a pin hole.

examples.text: 潮湿空气让细小的毛毡轴套松了，所以轴销才会滑出来。
examples.trans: Damp air loosened the tiny felt bushing, which let the hinge pin slip out.

examples.text: 换上紧实的毛毡轴套以后，琴槌就不再左右摇晃了。
examples.trans: Once fitted with a snug felt bushing, the piano hammer no longer wobbles sideways.

轴销.gloss: hinge pin; center pin (in piano action)

meanings.en: hinge pin; center pin (in piano action)
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhóu xiāo. Combines 轴 ('pivot') + 销 ('metal pin/peg'): the tiny brass center pin on which a piano hammer pivots.

examples.text: 把手电筒照近一点，就能看见那根黄铜轴销滑出来一半。
examples.trans: Shine the light closer and you can see that brass hinge pin slipped halfway out.

examples.text: 老陈用细镊子夹住黄铜轴销，稳稳地推回了原位。
examples.trans: Chen gripped the brass pin with fine tweezers and seated it steadily back in place.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qīng. Opposite of 重 ('heavy'); also describes gentle footsteps or soft voices.

examples.text: 声音轻，很有礼貌，大概三十多岁，有点紧张。
examples.trans: Soft-spoken, very polite, around thirty-something, and a bit nervous.

examples.text: 这个小皮箱很轻，我来拿吧。
examples.trans: This small suitcase is very light—let me carry it.

related.gloss: handle with care (lift gently, set down gently)

meanings.note: Pinyin: qīng kuài. Combines 轻 ('light') + 快 ('brisk/lively'), used for footsteps, melodies, or moods.

examples.text: 姑姑写的圆舞曲开头十分轻快，让人一听就想微笑。
examples.trans: The waltz opening written by his aunt is brisk and light, making you smile right away.

examples.text: 忙完一天的活儿，大家迈着轻快的脚步回客栈喝汤。
examples.trans: After a day's work, everyone walked back to the inn with light steps for hot soup.

轻拿轻放.gloss: handle with care (lift gently, set down gently)

meanings.en: handle with care (lift gently, set down gently)
meanings.note: Pinyin: qīng ná qīng fàng. Classic four-character phrase on fragile parcels.

examples.text: 轻拿轻放啊，老陈——明天就是星期五中午！
examples.trans: Handle it gently, Chen—Friday at noon is tomorrow!

examples.text: 纸箱外面写着四个大字：轻拿轻放。
examples.trans: Four large characters on the outside of the carton read: Handle with Care.

meanings.note: Usually with 不/别 to mean not doing something casually.

examples.text: 她是个从来不轻易许诺的人。
examples.trans: She is someone who never makes promises lightly.

examples.text: 遇到困难千万不要轻易放弃。
examples.trans: When facing difficulties, never give up easily.

examples.text: 今天是最轻松的一天了。
examples.trans: Today is actually the easiest day.

examples.text: 这是轻松。 (Example)
examples.trans: This is 轻松.

轻装上阵.gloss: march into battle travelling light, move ahead unburdened

meanings.en: march into battle travelling light, move ahead unburdened
meanings.note: Idiom for shedding baggage to move nimbly.

examples.text: 他主动揽下争议离职，是为了让星天能够卸下包袱轻装上阵。
examples.trans: He resigned over the dispute so Xingtian could move forward unburdened.

examples.text: 放下过去的得失心，年轻团队反而能够轻装上阵再创佳绩。
examples.trans: Letting go of past baggage lets the young team charge ahead freely.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qīng qīng. Reduplication of 轻 ('light/soft'), used directly before short verbs or with 地 (轻轻地抽出来).

examples.text: 宋老师用两根手指把旧乐谱轻轻抽了出来。
examples.trans: Teacher Song gently slid the old music sheet out with two fingers.

examples.text: 怕吵醒午睡的客人，小晴轻轻关上了木门。
examples.trans: So as not to wake guests napping at noon, Qing closed the wooden door softly.

meanings.note: Reduplicated adverb emphasising lack of strain.

examples.text: 以前录节目，大家轻轻松松就能完成任务。
examples.trans: Recording the old show, everyone finished effortlessly.

examples.text: 充分准备之后，她轻轻松松通过了考核。
examples.trans: After thorough preparation, she passed the assessment with ease.

meanings.note: Colloquial verb-object jiàozhēn ('insist rigidly on every detail').

examples.text: 要不先这样吧，有些事别太较真。
examples.trans: Maybe leave it for now; do not push every point too hard.

examples.text: 淳于总在节目质量上一向很较真。
examples.trans: Chun Yuqiao never compromises on show quality.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liàng. Counts cars, taxis, buses, and bicycles (一辆出租车 'a taxi').

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

examples.text: 你们听一秒……街上一辆汽车的声音都听不到。
examples.trans: Listen for a second... you cannot hear a single car from the street.

meanings.note: Verb shū ('lose a contest').

examples.text: 谁输了谁买单。
examples.trans: Whoever loses pays the bill.

examples.text: 这次我们不能输。
examples.trans: We cannot lose this time.

examples.text: 工作很辛苦。
examples.trans: The work is very hard.

examples.text: 大家辛苦了。
examples.trans: Thanks everyone for the hard work.

辜负.gloss: let down, fail to live up to

meanings.en: let down, fail to live up to
meanings.note: Disappointing someone's trust, goodwill, or expectations.

examples.text: 我一定好好干，绝不辜负大家的信任。
examples.trans: I will work hard and never let down everyone's trust.

examples.text: 随便发脾气很容易辜负别人的好心意。
examples.trans: Losing your temper carelessly easily lets down others' goodwill.

meanings.note: Verb-object cízhí ('hand in one's resignation').

examples.text: 小叶，你天天计划着辞职，怎么还不走？
examples.trans: Xiaoye, you talk of quitting every day, so why stay?

examples.text: 她决定辞职去读研究生。
examples.trans: She decided to quit her job for graduate school.

meanings.note: cízhíxìn — compound of 辞职 (to resign) + 信 (letter); formal written notice of leaving a job (measure word 封 fēng)

examples.text: 我们累到没有时间去写辞职信。
examples.trans: We are so tired that we have no time to write a resignation letter.

examples.text: 他昨天已经把辞职信交给了人事部。
examples.trans: He already handed his resignation letter in to the HR department yesterday.

meanings.note: Verb biànjiě ('speak in self-defence').

examples.text: 当时我错怪了你，你一句都没有辩解。
examples.trans: When I wronged you last time, you never argued back.

examples.text: 出了差错先想办法补救，不要急着辩解。
examples.trans: Fix mistakes first instead of rushing to make excuses.

meanings.note: Philosophy adj/noun biànzhèng ('dialectical').

examples.text: 核心的精神是辩证二字。
examples.trans: The core spirit lies in the word dialectical.

examples.text: 我们要学会用辩证的眼光看待每一次危机。
examples.trans: We should learn to view every crisis dialectically.

meanings.note: Pinyin: biān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一边 ('one side').

examples.text: 对，过了桥，右手边会经过一家绿药店。
examples.trans: Right, after crossing the bridge, you pass a green pharmacy on your right.

examples.text: 快坐在向阳窗户边，宋老师！先别急着上楼！
