examples.trans: Sit right down by the sunny window, Teacher Song! No rush to go back upstairs yet!

meanings.note: Pinyin: biān kuàng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè) or 圈 (quān). Joins 边 ('edge') + 框 ('frame').

examples.text: 相片的四周围着一圈精致的银色边框。
examples.trans: The photograph is surrounded by an exquisite silver border.

examples.text: 老陈正在修理窗户腐烂的木头边框。
examples.trans: Chen is repairing the rotten wooden frame of the window.

meanings.note: Pinyin: biān yuán. Joins 边 ('edge') + 缘 ('hem, margin').

examples.text: 杯子的边缘缺了一个小小的口子。
examples.trans: There is a small chip on the edge of the cup.

examples.text: 这张旧地图的边缘已经磨损得非常厉害了。
examples.trans: The edges of this old map have become heavily frayed.

meanings.note: Pinyin: biān jiǎo. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块边角 ('a corner piece').

examples.text: 啊！黄色柠檬糖霜——每个星期五我们俩都抢边角那一块！
examples.trans: Oh! Yellow lemon glaze—every single Friday the two of us fought over the corner piece!

examples.text: 多烤几块边角，好姑娘！
examples.trans: Bake plenty of corner pieces, dear girl!

meanings.note: Formal verb dáchéng ('reach a deal or consensus').

examples.text: 她昨天跟原野已经达成了庭外和解。
examples.trans: Yesterday she reached an out-of-court settlement with Yuanye.

examples.text: 两家公司很快达成了合作。
examples.trans: The two firms quickly reached a partnership.

meanings.note: Verb qiānjiù ('give in to someone's wishes').

examples.text: 为什么我不管做什么，你都要一味地迁就我？
examples.trans: Why do you endlessly humour me no matter what I do?

examples.text: 在艺术标准上他从不迁就任何敷衍的做法。
examples.trans: On artistic standards he never accommodates sloppy work.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guò. Read neutral-tone guo after a verb for 'have ever done' (见过); read guò as a verb meaning 'cross/pass' (过河 'cross the river').

examples.text: 早跟你说过，那个平板是个坑。
examples.trans: Told you before, that tablet is a trap.

examples.text: 出门左拐，直走到桥。要过河吗？
examples.trans: Left out the gate, straight to the bridge. Do I cross the river?

examples.text: 他这样做过不过激？
examples.trans: Is doing this too aggressive or not?

examples.text: 你说这过不过激？
examples.trans: Do you say this is too aggressive or not?

meanings.note: Formal adverb guòyú ('excessively').

examples.text: 其实你没必要对你的下属太过于严苛。
examples.trans: There is really no need to be overly harsh on your staff.

examples.text: 上台主持只要自然大方就好，不必过于拘谨。
examples.trans: Stay natural onstage—no need to be overly stiff.

meanings.note: Verb-object guòguān ('clear a review hurdle').

examples.text: 你有把握打动老大让这份方案过关吗？
examples.trans: Are you confident of winning our boss's approval?

examples.text: 彩排必须每一项细节都过关才行。
examples.trans: Every detail in rehearsal must pass muster.

meanings.note: Adjective guòfèn ('crossing the line, excessive').

examples.text: 在网上发这种假照片有点太过了，真过分。
examples.trans: Posting fake photos like that online really goes too far.

examples.text: 开玩笑要适度，千万不要说得太过了太伤人，太过了就过分了。
examples.trans: Keep jokes gentle—going too far hurts feelings.

meanings.note: Verb guòbàn ('exceed half').

examples.text: 红毯仪式现在时间已经过半了。
examples.trans: The red-carpet ceremony is now past the halfway mark.

examples.text: 本季的录制进度已经顺利过半。
examples.trans: Taping for this season is smoothly past halfway.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guò qù. Directional compound moving across toward another spot.

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

examples.text: 二十毫米、铜的、热水器阀门——我一路念过去！
examples.trans: Twenty millimetres, brass, water-heater valve—I will repeat it all the way!

meanings.note: Adjective guòdà ('too large, overloaded').

examples.text: 同一时间访问量过大。
examples.trans: Simultaneous traffic volume was excessively heavy.

examples.text: 压力过大的时候要学会放松。
examples.trans: Learn to relax when pressure gets too heavy.

过奖.gloss: praise too highly, flatter ('you flatter me')

meanings.en: praise too highly, flatter ('you flatter me')
meanings.note: Modest set reply 过奖过奖 to compliments.

examples.text: 面对大家潮水般的夸赞，闻老师谦虚地连声说不敢当、过奖过奖。
examples.trans: Met with lavish praise, Mr Wen modestly replied 'You flatter me.'

examples.text: 前辈笑着摆摆手说您过奖了，这都是全组人共同努力的结果。
examples.trans: Waving modestly, the veteran said credit belonged to the whole crew.

meanings.note: Used sarcastically for treating serious business like child's play.

examples.text: 电视台排播节目是严肃的大事，你以为是小孩过家家呢？
examples.trans: Network scheduling is serious business, not kids playing house!

examples.text: 小时候院子里的孩子们最喜欢凑在一起玩过家家。
examples.trans: As kids, children in the courtyard loved playing house together.

meanings.note: Adverb/adj guòdù ('overly, beyond proper limits').

examples.text: 现在的行业毛病是过度依赖海外版权。
examples.trans: Today's industry flaw is over-relying on overseas formats.

examples.text: 连续熬夜会导致身体过度疲劳。
examples.trans: Working late nights in a row causes excessive fatigue.

examples.text: 去年一面之缘之后，很久没有你的消息了，过得还好吗？
examples.trans: Since our brief encounter last year, I haven't heard news of you in ages — how have you been?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

过意不去.gloss: feel apologetic, feel bad about troubling someone

meanings.en: feel apologetic, feel bad about troubling someone
meanings.note: Warm colloquial expression of guilt/gratitude.

examples.text: 因为我们的事连累了您，大家心里都很过意不去。
examples.trans: Everyone feels awful that our mess ended up dragging you down.

examples.text: 老麻烦你帮忙跑腿，我真是太过意不去了。
examples.trans: Putting you out with errands again really makes me feel bad.

过敏.gloss: have an allergic reaction, be allergic

meanings.en: have an allergic reaction, be allergic
meanings.note: Medical verb/noun guòmǐn ('allergy; be allergic').

examples.text: 翻译对蜂蜜过敏，工作餐里刚好有蜂蜜！
examples.trans: The interpreter is allergic to honey, which was in the meal!

examples.text: 准备嘉宾餐饮前一定要问清有没有食物过敏。
examples.trans: Always ask about food allergies before ordering guest meals.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guò lái. Directional compound moving across toward the speaker.

examples.text: 你看，早餐忙乱和神秘电话你都挺过来了！
examples.trans: Look, you made it through both the breakfast rush and the mystery phone call!

examples.text: 因为星期一晚上我走过来时，看见我哥哥正走在这条街上！
examples.trans: Because when I walked here Monday night, I saw my older brother walking down this street!

meanings.note: Pinyin: guò dù. Literally 过 ('cross over') + 渡 ('ferry across a river'): a connecting transition or musical bridge (过渡段 'transition passage') between two sections.

examples.text: 听我弹一下钢琴上接到第二十八小节的那段过渡段。
examples.trans: Listen to me play the transition passage on the piano that leads into bar twenty-eight.

examples.text: 宋老师写了四个温暖的和弦，让前半段和后半段之间的过渡非常自然。
examples.trans: Teacher Song wrote four warm chords that make the transition between the first and second halves completely natural.

examples.text: 言辞过激。
examples.trans: Words are too aggressive.

examples.text: 行为过激。
examples.trans: Behavior is too extreme.

examples.text: 惊喜！谢谢大家给我过生日，谢谢！
examples.trans: What a surprise! Thank you everyone for celebrating my birthday!

examples.text: 不好意思，我昨天晚上过生日，所以睡得晚，起得就晚了点。
examples.trans: I'm so sorry — I celebrated my birthday last night, so I slept late and woke up a little behind.

meanings.note: Polite verb-object guòmù ('review a document').

examples.text: 因为老大病着，最终文本还没有给他过目。
examples.trans: With our boss ill, he has not looked over the final text.

examples.text: 台本改好了，请主编先过目一下。
examples.trans: The script is revised; would the editor look it over?

meanings.note: Noun guòchéng ('whole course of events').

examples.text: 这就是我在化妆间里的全部过程。
examples.trans: That is the entire course of events in the dressing room.

examples.text: 准备节目的过程非常辛苦。
examples.trans: The process of preparing a show is grueling.

meanings.note: Adjective/adverb guòliàng ('in excess of safe dosage').

examples.text: 失职导致嘉宾服药过量引发了意外。
examples.trans: The lapse led to the guest taking an excess dose.

examples.text: 浓缩咖啡虽提神，但也不宜饮用过量。
examples.trans: Espresso wakes you up, yet avoid drinking too much.

meanings.note: Verb guòwèn ('check up on or question').

examples.text: 现在公司上下没人敢随便过问这事。
examples.trans: Right now nobody across the company dares question this.

examples.text: 只要大方向没错，总监很少过问具体小事。
examples.trans: So long as the big picture holds, the director rarely micromanages.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mài. Action verb for lifting one's foot and stepping forward or down (往下迈 'step down', 迈进大门 'step through the gate').

examples.text: 我从矮凳往下迈的时候，右脚鞋子在最下面那根横档上滑了一下。
examples.trans: When I stepped down from the low stool, my right shoe slipped on the bottom rung.

examples.text: 周经理整理好领带，微笑着迈出大门去迎接市政厅的办事员。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou straightened his tie and stepped out the front gate with a smile to greet the City Hall clerk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yíng. Used for greeting guests at the door.

examples.text: 志豪，中午十二点你真的留在院子里迎志鹏吗？
examples.trans: Zhihao, are you really staying in the courtyard at twelve noon to greet Zhipeng?

examples.text: 店主笑着出门迎客。
examples.trans: The innkeeper stepped out smiling to greet the guests.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yíng jiē. Used for stepping out to greet an arriving guest.

examples.text: 十九条理由？！您是迎接哥哥，还是念火车时刻表呀？
examples.trans: Nineteen reasons?! Are you welcoming your brother or reading a train timetable?

examples.text: 有进步！今天小院迎接兄弟重逢——大家保持安静端庄！
examples.trans: Progress! Today our courtyard hosts a brotherly reunion—quiet dignity from everyone!

examples.text: 欢迎回来！按照规则，我们终于迎来了在上一场排名第一的辛惠美战队的外卡歌手，有请白杨！
examples.trans: Welcome back! Under our rules, please welcome the wild-card singer from first-place Team Xin Huimei — Bai Yang!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Running a department, company, or artist campaign.

examples.text: 没有核心主创团队在背后支撑，这么大的制作部很难高效运作。
examples.trans: Without the core creative team, such a big unit can hardly operate well.

examples.text: 好的演员除了自身演技过硬，也需要专业经纪团队用心运作。
examples.trans: Beyond strong acting, a good actor needs smart agency management.

meanings.note: Physical exercise or athletic activity.

examples.text: 下班后去跑步是他最喜欢的运动。
examples.trans: Going for a run after work is his favourite exercise.

examples.text: 每天坚持半小时运动对身体很有好处。
examples.trans: Half an hour of daily exercise does wonders for health.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yùn qi. Measure word (量词): 种 (zhǒng), e.g. 一种好运气 ('good luck').

examples.text: 全靠运气——加上星期一早上火车上拿错的蓝色行李箱！
examples.trans: Pure luck—plus one swapped blue suitcase on Monday morning's train!

examples.text: 刚出门雨就停了，今天运气真好！
examples.trans: The rain stopped the moment we stepped outside—what good luck today!

meanings.note: Business verb/noun yùnyíng ('media/platform operations').

examples.text: 如果去掉媒体评审，后台宣传运营怎么配合？
examples.trans: Without a media jury, how do publicity operations tie in?

examples.text: 新媒体团队专门负责节目官方账号的运营。
examples.trans: The digital team runs the show's official accounts.

运行.gloss: run, operate smoothly (of systems, mechanisms, or software)

meanings.en: run, operate smoothly (of systems, mechanisms, or software)
meanings.note: Standard verb for workflows, machines, and systems.

examples.text: 经过四年打磨，总编室建立起了一套能够独立高效运行的机制。
examples.trans: After four years of refinement, the office built a self-running system.

examples.text: 直播指挥系统在暴雨期间连续七十二小时稳定运行。
examples.trans: The broadcast command system ran steadily for seventy-two hours in the storm.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jìn. Stative adjective ('near') and resultative complement after verbs (照近一点 'shine closer').

examples.text: 请把台灯照近一点，好让我看清楚里面的小零件。
examples.trans: Please shine the lamp a little closer so I can see the tiny parts inside clearly.

examples.text: 小院客栈离星期六的蔬菜集市非常近。
examples.trans: Courtyard Inn is very close to the Saturday vegetable market.

近况.gloss: recent condition, how someone has been lately

meanings.en: recent condition, how someone has been lately
meanings.note: Polite word for someone's recent wellbeing or whereabouts.

examples.text: 好久没见老同学了，很想打听一下他的近况。
examples.trans: Having not seen my old classmate in ages, I wondered how he has been.

examples.text: 打电话是想问问那位艺人从海外回来后的近况。
examples.trans: I called to ask how that artist has been doing recently.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jìnlù. Measure word: 条.

examples.text: 我们抄近路走吧，这样能快点到。
examples.trans: Let's take a shortcut so we can get there faster.

examples.text: 这条近路比较难走。
examples.trans: This shortcut is rather difficult to walk on.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hái. Everyday adverb meaning 'still' (还在), 'not yet' (还没), or 'even more' after 比.

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

examples.text: 宋老师，真对不起，那边还没有消息。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, I am truly sorry; they have no news over there yet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hái hǎo. Relieved adverb ('thank goodness!') or mild 'not bad'.

examples.text: 还好烤箱里的面团已经放进去了。
examples.trans: My dough is already in the oven, at least.

examples.text: 还好你跑得快，赶在关门前买到了阀门。
examples.trans: Good thing you ran fast and bought the valve before closing time.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hái shi. Joins choices in questions (茶还是咖啡？ 'tea or coffee?') or means 'still'.

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

examples.text: 宋老师早！您想喝咖啡还是红茶？
examples.trans: Morning, Teacher Song! Would you like coffee or black tea?

meanings.en: and also; in addition; still have
meanings.note: Pinyin: hái yǒu. Adds another item to a list ('plus…').

examples.text: 只有裙子、乐谱，还有我最喜欢的茶杯！
examples.trans: Only dresses, sheet music, and my favourite teacup!

examples.text: 两双棕色大男鞋，还有灰色毛衣。
examples.trans: Two pairs of big brown men's shoes, plus grey sweaters.

examples.text: 感觉非常好，还要谢谢方老师推荐。
examples.trans: It feels great, and I also want to thank Professor Fang for the recommendation.

examples.text: 这是还要。
examples.trans: This is 还要.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè. Proximal demonstrative; pairs with a measure word before nouns (这个 'this one', 这间房 'this room').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 就差这一首，对方没有授权给咱们。
examples.trans: That one single song is missing — they never licensed it to us.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 我们不用电脑，一直用这个大纸本子记账。
examples.trans: We do not use a computer; we always use this big paper ledger to keep accounts.

examples.text: 这个木头小火车是老木匠专门为孩子们做的礼物。
examples.trans: This little wooden train is a gift made specially for the children by the old carpenter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè me. Proximal degree adverb (这么快 'this fast', 这么重 'so heavy').

examples.text: 怪不得这么重，全是木头和皮鞋！
examples.trans: No wonder it was so heavy—all wood and leather shoes!

examples.text: 这么快就修好了？老陈你随身带着螺丝刀啊！
examples.trans: Fixed that fast? Chen, you carry a screwdriver everywhere on you!

examples.text: 你就是知道！这件事情发生了这么久，你从来都不说的人，就是你想保护的人。
examples.trans: Because you do know! Through this whole crisis you never once mentioned her — the person you never name is the person you want to protect.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 这事你是从哪儿知道的？
examples.trans: Where did you find that out?

examples.text: 别去打扰他，这事我们自己解决。你说是王尔动的手脚，有证据吗？
examples.trans: Don't disturb Yuqiao — we'll solve this ourselves. You say Wang Er tampered with the files, so do we have proof?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè xiē. Plural of 这个, needing no extra measure word before the noun.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

examples.text: 你们这些好人真是救了我这趟旅行。
examples.trans: You kind people have truly saved this whole trip of mine.

examples.text: 这个白石爱贪小便宜，按照合约应该付给人家作者钱，可是他们从来没跟作者提过这件事！
examples.trans: Baishi loves cutting petty corners; under the contract they owed the songwriter payment, yet they never breathed a word to her!

examples.text: 你听那个疯婆子胡说！我之所以拿这件事情做文章，就是因为我算准了全世界没有人能找到钟阳子！
examples.trans: Don't listen to that crazy woman's nonsense! The whole reason I built my trap around this song is that nobody on earth can find Zhong Yangzi!

examples.text: 你听我说，不能让这件事情再扩大，不要再去翻这些旧账。
examples.trans: Listen to me: we cannot let this blow up further, and stop digging up those old scores.

examples.text: 你现在需要做的就是仔仔细细地想清楚，去年王尔做这份合同的时候你有没有沾过手。
examples.trans: Right now you need to think back carefully on whether you ever handled that contract for Wang Er last year.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 雨这会儿越下越大，你先在屋里喝杯热茶吧。
examples.trans: The rain is coming down harder right now—have a cup of hot tea inside first.

examples.text: 老陈这会儿正在地下室检查热水锅炉。
examples.trans: Right now Old Chen is down in the basement checking the hot-water boiler.

examples.text: 现在就需要问一下台下的这位绅士，淳于乔先生。
examples.trans: Now we just need to ask the gentleman seated below the stage — Mr Chun Yuqiao.

examples.text: 作为版权的所有者，你愿意相信我的这位学员吗？
examples.trans: As the copyright holder, are you willing to place your trust in my student?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèr. Spoken variant of 这里 ('here').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 没错！你已经很习惯这儿了。
examples.trans: Exactly! You already fit right in here.

examples.text: 原来这家振振有词控诉别人侵权的白石音乐公司，多年拖欠词曲作者钟阳子的版权收益！
examples.trans: It turns out Baishi Music, so self-righteous in suing others, has withheld royalties from songwriter Zhong Yangzi for years!

examples.text: 从法律层面上来讲，这家公司已经违约在先了，所以他们手中的这份合约已经失效。
examples.trans: Legally speaking, the publisher breached its contract first, rendering the agreement in its hands null and void.

examples.text: 这是什么套啊？
examples.trans: What kind of setup?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 但是我们一定不能打扰老大，必须独立把这期节目做起来！
examples.trans: Still, we must not disturb our boss abroad — we have to pull off this episode on our own!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè yàng. Points to a manner or result close at hand; at the start of a clause it means 'that way, so that' (这样就轻了 'that way it gets light').

examples.text: 先拿最上面一层，这样书架就轻了。
examples.trans: Take the top shelf first, so the bookcase gets lighter.

examples.text: 城里那封信要的，就是这样一个房间！
examples.trans: And this is exactly the room the city letter asked for!

examples.text: 这样吧，还是由我来亲自讲。
examples.trans: How about this — let me explain it myself instead.

examples.text: 这样吧，还是由我来亲自讲。
examples.trans: How about this — let me explain it myself instead.

examples.text: 这次的事董事长都未必顶得住。
examples.trans: Even our chairwoman may not be able to weather a storm this big.

examples.text: 这次你又被骗了，你又被利用了，我会生气，我会心疼。
examples.trans: This time you were deceived and used all over again — that makes me angry, and it hurts me.

examples.text: 王尔老师，他们说这次是您出手做局，是真的吗？
examples.trans: Mr Wang Er, people at the office say you engineered this whole setup — is that true?

examples.text: 这歌是惠美自己定的，她觉得白杨唱这首歌效果肯定特别好。
examples.trans: Huimei picked the song herself; she's convinced Bai Yang singing it will bring a phenomenal response.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 我代表星天总编室欢迎您啊！惠美全国巡演就要开始了，这段时间特别忙，录完这期节目就得出发。
examples.trans: On behalf of Xingtian's chief editor's office, welcome! Huimei's national tour kicks off soon, so she has to set off right after taping.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 我觉得他们以前那么对您，就算您做出这种事情来也不是没有道理。
examples.trans: Given how badly they treated you before, even if you did pull this off, I wouldn't blame you.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 你就愿意顶着这身脏水被黑一辈子？你还有没有原则了，你怕什么呀？
examples.trans: Are you willing to wear this filthy slander for the rest of your life? Where are your principles — what are you afraid of?!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè biān. Location word for the near side; pairs with 往 for direction (往我这边 'toward me').

examples.text: 一，二，三——左边往我这边拉！
examples.trans: One, two, three—pull the left side toward me!

examples.text: 请往这边走，房间在二楼。
examples.trans: This way, please; the room is on the second floor.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè lǐ. Standard location pronoun meaning 'here' (spoken variant 这儿).

examples.text: 这里就是梧桐巷十二号。
examples.trans: Right here is Number Twelve, Wutong Lane.

examples.text: 请在这里签上您的名字。
examples.trans: Please sign your name right here.

examples.text: 这歌是惠美自己定的，她觉得白杨唱这首歌效果肯定特别好。
examples.trans: Huimei picked the song herself; she's convinced Bai Yang singing it will bring a phenomenal response.

examples.text: 下面这首歌曾经在中国的流行乐史上留下过浓重的一笔，请欣赏！
examples.trans: This next song left a vivid mark on Chinese pop music history — please enjoy!

examples.text: 你们的意思是王尔老师操作这首歌陷害我们？不可能啊！
examples.trans: Are you saying Mr Wang Er tampered with that song to frame us? That's impossible!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jìn. Movement into an enclosed space (请进 'come in!', 倒进 'pour into').

examples.text: 小晴，把热水倒进茶壶里，他们来了！
examples.trans: Qing, pour the hot water into the teapot—here they come!

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

meanings.en: unable to enter; cannot get in
meanings.note: jìnbuqù — negative potential complement (进 + 不 + 去), used both literally for physical spaces and figuratively for elite companies or circles (affirmative: 进得去)

examples.text: 那里多少人挤破头都进不去！
examples.trans: Countless people fight tooth and nail and still cannot get into that place!

examples.text: 门锁坏了，我没带钥匙根本进不去。
examples.trans: The door lock is broken, and without my key I cannot get in at all.

related.gloss: to scramble fiercely to get in

进修.gloss: pursue further study or professional training

meanings.en: pursue further study or professional training
meanings.note: Going to an academy or abroad to deepen expertise.

examples.text: 结束巡演之后，她打算去国外音乐学院进修一年。
examples.trans: After her tour wraps, she plans to study at a music academy abroad.

examples.text: 公司每年都会选派优秀编导去海外进修学习。
examples.trans: Every year the company sends standout directors abroad for training.

examples.text: 请进入房间。
examples.trans: Please enter the room.

examples.text: 我们进入了一个新阶段。
examples.trans: We have entered a new phase.

进去.gloss: go in; seep in (away from speaker)

meanings.en: go in; seep in (away from speaker)
meanings.note: Pinyin: jìn qù. Directional complement 进 ('enter') + 去 ('away from speaker'), e.g. 渗进去 ('seep in').

examples.text: 等机油渗进去十秒钟，我们再一起拉窗板。
examples.trans: Give the oil ten seconds to seep in, then let's pull the shutter together.

examples.text: 九号房已经擦干净了，快进去看看有多亮堂吧！
examples.trans: Room Nine is all wiped clean—go on in and see how bright it is!

examples.text: 布小谷那边有什么进展吗？
examples.trans: Has there been any progress on Bu Xiaogu's end?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jìn lái. Friendly invitation 请进来 ('please come in').

examples.text: 等星期五中午箱子主人进来，我一定坐第一排看！
examples.trans: When the suitcase owner walks in Friday at noon, I am sitting in the front row!

examples.text: 晚上好！先生，快进来避避雨吧。
examples.trans: Good evening! Sir, come inside quickly out of the rain.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jìn bù. Works as both verb and noun.

examples.text: 有进步！今天小院迎接兄弟重逢——大家保持安静端庄！
examples.trans: Progress! Today our courtyard hosts a brotherly reunion—quiet dignity from everyone!

examples.text: 才上班五天，她的前台工作进步飞快。
examples.trans: After just five days on the job, her front-desk work has improved fast.

examples.text: 已有行业分析师论断，此事必将造成星天娱乐股权整合及上市进程大幅拖慢。
examples.trans: Industry analysts warn the lawsuit will severely delay Xingtian's share restructuring and public listing.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Formal verb jìnxíng ('conduct, carry on').

examples.text: 今晚您待在中控室里进行指挥吧。
examples.trans: Stay in the control room tonight to conduct direction.

examples.text: 会议正在顺利进行。
examples.trans: The meeting is proceeding smoothly.

进门.gloss: walk in the door; step inside

meanings.en: walk in the door; step inside
meanings.note: Pinyin: jìn mén. Separable verb-object compound 进 ('enter') + 门 ('door').

examples.text: 星期三下午三点，市政厅的办事员就要进门了！
examples.trans: On Wednesday afternoon at three o'clock, the city hall clerk walks in the door!

examples.text: 客人一进门就能闻到柠檬挞和热茶的香味。
examples.trans: The moment guests walk in the door, they can smell lemon tart and hot tea.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuǎn. Opposite of 近 ('near').

examples.text: 把小木桌放在树下面吧，离门口远一点。
examples.trans: Let's put the small wooden table right under the tree, a little farther from the doorway.

examples.text: 药店不远，拐个弯就到了。
examples.trans: The pharmacy is not far—just turn the corner and you are there.

远远.gloss: from afar; by a wide margin

meanings.en: from afar; by a wide margin
meanings.note: Pinyin: yuǎn yuǎn. Reduplication of 远 ('far/distant'), functioning adverbially before verbs (远远超出 'far exceed', 远远看见 'spot from afar').

examples.text: 多亏老陈的巧手，这台老钢琴现在的音色远远超出了我的希望！
examples.trans: Thanks to Chen's skilled hands, the tone of this old piano now far exceeds my hopes!

examples.text: 走在梧桐巷口，远远就能闻到九号房飘出的柠檬挞香气。
examples.trans: Walking at the entrance to Wutong Lane, you can smell the aroma of lemon tarts drifting from Room Nine from afar.

meanings.note: Going against established rules.

examples.text: 你刚才冲动的做法，知道违反了多少条规定吗？
examples.trans: Do you realise how many rules your impulsive move just broke?

examples.text: 直播现场严禁任何违反安全操作规程的行为。
examples.trans: Any violation of safety rules on a live set is strictly forbidden.

meanings.note: Verb-object wéiyuē ('break contractual terms').

examples.text: 你们想搜集我违约的证据吧？
examples.trans: You wanted proof that I breached my contract, right?

examples.text: 双方都不能随便违约。
examples.trans: Neither side may casually breach the contract.

meanings.note: Legal noun wéiyuējīn ('breach-of-contract penalty').

examples.text: 你也得向公司赔偿违约金。
examples.trans: You will also have to pay penalty fees to the company.

examples.text: 合同里写清楚了违约金的数额。
examples.trans: The contract specifies the penalty amount.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lián. Pairs with 都/也 to highlight 'even X' (连名字都一样), or means 'connect' as a verb.

examples.text: 老房子连着旧回忆——那种争吵最伤人。
examples.trans: Old houses are tied to old memories—arguments like that cut deepest.

examples.text: 笔挺又干净，周经理！连眼镜都戴在鼻子上，没在额头上。
examples.trans: Crisp and spotless, Manager Zhou! Even your glasses are on your nose instead of your forehead.

examples.text: 作为王尔的手下，你没有被连坐清除出星天，已经是很大的幸运了。
examples.trans: As Wang Er's intern, not getting swept out of Xingtian alongside him was already huge luck for you.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Adverb liányè ('working or traveling overnight without delay').

examples.text: 昨晚一出事，他们就连夜开会了。
examples.trans: The moment trouble happened last night, they met overnight.

examples.text: 董事长连夜赶飞机回来了。
examples.trans: The chairwoman caught an overnight flight back.

examples.text: 老大想拔除这个毒瘤已经很久了，上次是用连环计才抓住了他的把柄。
examples.trans: Our boss wanted to root out that rot for ages and used a double trap last year to catch him red-handed.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

连累.gloss: implicate, drag into trouble through no fault of theirs

meanings.en: implicate, drag into trouble through no fault of theirs
meanings.note: Causing an innocent helper or boss to suffer fallout.

examples.text: 真对不起，都是因为我们的失误才连累了你。
examples.trans: I am truly sorry our mistake ended up dragging you into trouble.

examples.text: 他宁可自己受罚，也不愿意连累手下的工作人员。
examples.trans: He would rather take the penalty himself than implicate his crew.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chí dào. Used for arriving late to work, class, or an appointment.

examples.text: 快请坐，宋老师！千万别说我上课迟到了二十五年！
examples.trans: Please sit down, Teacher Song! Tell me I am not twenty-five years late for my lesson!

examples.text: 她每天提前十分钟到店，从来不迟到。
examples.trans: She arrives ten minutes early every day and is never late.

迷.gloss: be infatuated with, be a big fan of

meanings.en: be infatuated with, be a big fan of
meanings.note: Verb/noun mí ('be crazy about; fan').

examples.text: 小谷迷荣思纶的歌已经有一阵子了。
examples.trans: Xiaogu has been a devoted fan of Rong Silun for a while.

examples.text: 大学时她彻底迷上了现场导播的工作。
examples.trans: In college she fell head over heels for live TV directing.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mí rén. Joins 迷 ('to fascinate, to bewilder') + 人 ('person').

examples.text: 夜晚的小院在柔和的灯光下显得格外迷人。
examples.trans: The courtyard at night looks especially charming under the soft lighting.

examples.text: 宋老师弹奏的钢琴曲有一种迷人的魅力。
examples.trans: The piano piece played by Teacher Song possesses a charming appeal.

examples.text: 你这半辈子都没追过人，都是人追你的。
examples.trans: Half your life you have never chased anyone — people have always chased you.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

追上.gloss: win someone's heart; catch up with

meanings.en: win someone's heart; catch up with
meanings.note: Verb-complement zhuīshàng ('successfully court; catch up').

examples.text: 你要是懂女人心思，早把我追上了。
examples.trans: If you understood a woman's heart, you would have won me long ago.

examples.text: 她一路小跑，终于在电梯关门前追上了同事。
examples.trans: Jogging down the hall, she caught up right before the lift closed.

meanings.note: Literary verb zhuīxún ('pursue earnestly').

examples.text: 没有什么事比追寻自己的梦想更重要了。
examples.trans: Nothing matters more than pursuing one's own dream.

examples.text: 纪录片讲述了一群音乐人追寻民间旋律的故事。
examples.trans: The documentary follows musicians pursuing folk melodies.

meanings.note: Verb/noun zhuīqiú ('chase after, strive for').

examples.text: 跟风模仿只是为了追求短期的效益。
examples.trans: Blind copying merely chases short-term returns.

examples.text: 他对每一帧画面的品质都有极高的追求。
examples.trans: He pursues top quality in every single frame.

追随.gloss: follow loyally, stand behind (a mentor or leader)

meanings.en: follow loyally, stand behind (a mentor or leader)
meanings.note: Working alongside an admired leader over years.

examples.text: 两位资深制作人从上一家公司起就一直坚定地追随着他。
examples.trans: Both senior producers have loyally followed him since their last firm.

examples.text: 年轻编导们追随的不仅是个人魅力，更是坚持原创的专业精神。
examples.trans: What young directors follow is dedication to original craftsmanship.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tuì. Used for stepping back, refunding money (退钱), or checking out of a room.

examples.text: 怎么样？他发火了吗？要退钱吗？
examples.trans: How did it go? Did he lose his temper? Did he ask for a refund?

examples.text: 如果不合适，七天之内可以退钱。
examples.trans: If it does not fit, you can get a refund within seven days.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tuì xiū. Joins 退 ('to retreat, to withdraw') + 休 ('to rest').

examples.text: 宋老师退休前是音乐学院的钢琴教授。
examples.trans: Before she retired, Teacher Song was a piano professor at the music academy.

examples.text: 那位制图员老爷爷已经退休三十多年了。
examples.trans: That old mapmaker grandfather has been retired for over thirty years.

meanings.note: Verb tuìchū ('pull out of a project').

examples.text: 我们制作一部全团队正式退出这个项目。
examples.trans: Our entire Production Unit One team is stepping back from it.

examples.text: 如果两轮比赛都失利，选手就要遗憾退出舞台。
examples.trans: Losing two rounds in a row means bowing out of the contest.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tuì hòu. Used when clearing space safely.

examples.text: 茶壶也烫好了！大家从窗边退后一步！
examples.trans: And the teapot is hot! Everybody step back from the window!

examples.text: 开烤箱门有热气，请往后退后一步。
examples.trans: Hot steam comes out when the oven opens—please step back.

meanings.note: Verb-object tuìxué ('leave school before graduating').

examples.text: 我当年为什么要退学，你已经查到了？
examples.trans: So you already found out why I left school back then?

examples.text: 无论遇到多大困难，老师都劝他千万别冲动退学。
examples.trans: Whatever the hurdle, his teacher urged him not to drop out.

examples.text: 他的成绩退步了。
examples.trans: His grades have regressed.

examples.text: 不要退步。
examples.trans: Do not regress.

examples.text: 国际大单被退约，收入损失是小，可如果损害了她的声誉，会对以后的事业造成长远的影响。
examples.trans: Losing the fee is minor, whereas lasting damage to her reputation will hurt her entire career.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.en: deliver; give (as a gift/complimentary); see off
meanings.note: Pinyin: sòng. Covers delivering items, offering something free of charge, and walking guests to the gate.

examples.text: 宋老师早上好！看昨晚大门口送来了什么。
examples.trans: Good morning, Teacher Song! Look what arrived at our front gate last night.

examples.text: 一点没破！是谁送回来的？
examples.trans: Not cracked at all! Who brought it back?

examples.text: 我一进公司就听人说那边的人来开会，我想把这个送上去，或许有帮助！
examples.trans: The moment I walked in, I heard they were meeting upstairs, so I rushed to bring this up in case it helps!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 干得漂亮！不过这个不要送到会议室，去扫描一下，交给闻思默老师！
examples.trans: Brilliant work! Don't take this into the conference room, though — scan a copy and send it straight to Mr Wen Simo!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sòng lái. Directional compound 送 ('deliver/bring') + 来 ('toward speaker').

examples.text: 小美特意给宋老师送来了热薄荷茶和杏仁饼干。
examples.trans: Mei specially sent over hot mint tea and almond biscuits for Teacher Song.

examples.text: 街坊花店早上给客栈送来了一篮新鲜黄玫瑰。
examples.trans: This morning the neighborhood flower shop brought over a basket of fresh yellow roses.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sòng huò chē. Three-character compound 送货 ('deliver goods') + 车 ('van/truck'). Measure word: 辆 (liàng).

examples.text: 下午两点整，家具店的送货车准时到了大门口。
examples.trans: At two o'clock sharp in the afternoon, the furniture shop's delivery van arrived at the gate.

examples.text: 这条巷子窄，大送货车开不进来，只能停在路口。
examples.trans: This lane is narrow, so big delivery trucks can't drive in and have to park at the corner.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì hé. Takes a person or purpose as object (适合弹琴 'suited for playing piano').

examples.text: 一点也不介意！窗下这张宽书桌正适合我工作。
examples.trans: Not at all! And this wide desk beneath the window suits my work ideally.

examples.text: 很高兴我们安静的小院子适合您的……工作。
examples.trans: We are glad our quiet courtyard suits your... work.

meanings.note: Verb shìyìng ('get accustomed to').

examples.text: 以后你慢慢就适应这儿的节奏了。
examples.trans: Before long you will get used to the pace here.

examples.text: 小谷很快就适应了行政工作。
examples.trans: Xiaogu quickly adapted to administrative work.

meanings.note: Running away from confinement or hospital.

examples.text: 他待不住病房，一大早就偷偷从医院逃出来了。
examples.trans: Restless on the ward, he sneaked out of hospital early this morning.

examples.text: 遇到困难总想着逃是解决不了任何问题的。
examples.trans: Running away whenever trouble hits solves nothing.

meanings.note: Verb/noun táowáng ('escape, flight').

examples.text: 逃亡这个动词很有游戏性和紧迫感。
examples.trans: The verb escape feels playful like a game and carries urgency.

examples.text: 这档户外竞技节目的灵感来自一场限时逃亡游戏。
examples.trans: This outdoor game show drew inspiration from a timed chase.

meanings.note: Verb táolí ('break free from').

examples.text: 淳于总设计的核心理念是逃离精神孤岛。
examples.trans: The core concept Chun Yuqiao designed is escaping isolation.

examples.text: 周末去郊外露营能让都市人暂时逃离喧嚣。
examples.trans: Weekend camping lets city dwellers briefly escape the bustle.

meanings.note: Verb táotuō ('flee, evade responsibility').

examples.text: 危急关头绝不是媒体人该逃脱责任的时刻。
examples.trans: A crisis is never the moment for journalists to shirk duty.

examples.text: 任何弄虚作假的数据最终都无法逃脱观众的眼睛。
examples.trans: No faked numbers can ultimately escape the audience's eyes.

examples.text: 犯人逃走了。
examples.trans: The prisoner fled.

examples.text: 他们想逃走。
examples.trans: They want to escape.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xuǎn. Everyday verb for choosing options.

examples.text: 说实话，我选这一带，也是为了一桩家里的旧事。
examples.trans: Honestly, I also chose this neighbourhood for an old family matter.

examples.text: 您可以选靠窗或者靠院子的座位。
examples.trans: You may choose a seat by the window or facing the courtyard.

meanings.note: Verb-complement xuǎndìng ('pick officially').

examples.text: 最后由辛惠美当场选定一家资助对象。
examples.trans: Finally Xin Huimei selects one recipient on site.

examples.text: 新节目的录制场地已经正式选定了。
examples.trans: The studio venue for the new show has been selected.

examples.text: 一号选手。
examples.trans: Contestant number one.

examples.text: 优秀选手。
examples.trans: Excellent contestant.

meanings.note: Dedicated lodging compound for show contestants during finals.

examples.text: 所有参赛歌手今晚统一住在封闭管理的选手村。
examples.trans: All competing singers are staying at the contestant village tonight.

examples.text: 大巴车每天早上准时从选手村接歌手去演播厅。
examples.trans: Shuttles pick singers up from the contestant village every morning.

meanings.note: Verb/noun xuǎnzé ('choose; choice').

examples.text: 像这样选择做行政的很少见。
examples.trans: Choosing to work in admin like this is rare.

examples.text: 她从来不后悔自己的选择。
examples.trans: She never regrets her own choice.

选角.gloss: cast roles, hold casting (V-O verb or noun)

meanings.en: cast roles, hold casting (V-O verb or noun)
meanings.note: Entertainment term where 角 is pronounced jué.

examples.text: 那部备受期待的古装大剧最近正在全国范围内公开选角。
examples.trans: That anticipated costume drama is currently holding casting nationwide.

examples.text: 选角导演认为他的气质与原著里的男主角高度契合。
examples.trans: The casting director felt his aura matched the novel's hero perfectly.

meanings.note: Media noun xuǎntí ('selected programme topic').

examples.text: 粉丝众筹做慈善是个特别好的选题。
examples.trans: Fans crowdfunding a charity is an excellent show topic.

examples.text: 主编觉得这期访谈的选题很有意义。
examples.trans: The chief editor finds this interview topic meaningful.

透.gloss: let light/air pass through; show through

meanings.en: let light/air pass through; show through
meanings.note: Pinyin: tòu. Used both as a main verb (两面透着玻璃 'showing glass on two sides') and resultative complement ('thoroughly').

examples.text: 阳光房两面都透着干净玻璃，整个院子亮堂极了。
examples.trans: With clean glass showing on two sides of the sunroom, the whole courtyard looks bright.

examples.text: 清晨的阳光透过薄窗帘照在木头地板上。
examples.trans: Early morning sunlight shone through the sheer curtains onto the wooden floor.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tòu guò. Describes light or sound passing through an opening.

examples.text: 哎呀！透过窗户看见周经理了？我明明加倍用力微笑了！
examples.trans: Oh dear! You spotted Manager Zhou through the window? I smiled twice as wide!

examples.text: 早晨的阳光透过树叶照在白桌布上。
examples.trans: Morning sunshine filters through the leaves onto the white tablecloth.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tòu lù. Used for sharing confidential information.

examples.text: 先别对外面透露一个字！让两兄弟先过完这个星期五下午！
examples.trans: Not a single word to anyone outside yet! Let the two brothers have their Friday afternoon first!

examples.text: 评审结果正式公布以前不能向外透露。
examples.trans: Results cannot be disclosed before the official announcement.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dì. Used for passing tools, napkins, or cups directly from hand to hand (递给我).

examples.text: 关掉了，水也放空了。把左边那把重扳手递给我。
examples.trans: Turned off and drained. Pass me that heavy wrench on your left.

examples.text: 他双手把热茶递给客人。
examples.trans: He handed the hot tea to the guest with both hands.

examples.text: 他一手把真的合同递到了法务，一手把假的授权列表备案到我们版权库里头。
examples.trans: With one hand he sent the real contract to legal, and with the other he logged a fake song list into our copyright database.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 杏子姐，你别给我瞎添乱了，你逗我呢，怎么可能！
examples.trans: Xingzi, please don't add to the mess — you must be teasing me, how could that be!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Complement/adjective tōng ('coherent, clear through').

examples.text: 这三个字反过来读也能读得通。
examples.trans: Read in reverse, these three characters still make sense.

examples.text: 电话终于打通了，快跟他说正事。
examples.trans: The call finally went through — tell him right away.

meanings.en: show booking; media appearance schedule; call sheet
meanings.note: tōnggào — entertainment industry term for an artist's scheduled TV, promotional, or filming engagements (接通告 = to accept bookings; 跑通告 = to make the rounds on shows)
formal announcement issued to the public or staff by an organization (measure word 则 zé or 份 fèn)

examples.text: 他不能再上其他的节目，只能取消通告。
examples.trans: He cannot appear on any other shows, so we can only cancel the booking.

examples.text: 对，公司只给她接综艺节目的通告。
examples.trans: Right, the company only accepts variety show bookings for her.

examples.text: 他在。他最近要去美国出差了，我去帮您通报一下。
examples.trans: He's inside preparing for his upcoming overseas business trip — let me let him know you're here.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tōng zhī. Measure word (量词): 份 (fèn), e.g. 一份通知 ('an official notice').

examples.text: 多半是粉刷街边木窗那种无聊通知吧。
examples.trans: Probably some boring notice about painting the street shutters.

examples.text: 产权转让通知：八号小院整栋建筑将作为商业办公楼出售。
examples.trans: Property Transfer Notice: Courtyard Building Eight offered for sale as commercial offices.

related.gloss: know (a fact or piece of information)

meanings.note: Noun tōngxùn ('telecommunications').

examples.text: 所有个人通讯设备都已经上交给节目组了。
examples.trans: All personal communication devices have been turned in.

examples.text: 山区外景地提前架设了应急通讯信号车。
examples.trans: An emergency comms van was stationed at the mountain set.

meanings.en: to pass; to be approved; to go through
meanings.note: tōngguò — verbal sense used for passing reviews, exams, proposals, or physical passageways
prepositional usage introducing the channel, system, or intermediary by which an action is accomplished

examples.text: 你们俩的论文初稿都已经通过了。
examples.trans: Both of your first thesis drafts have already passed.

examples.text: 有什么命令直接通过办公系统下达到行政处，我随时奉命。
examples.trans: Send any order straight to administration through the office system, and I will carry it out.

meanings.note: Noun tōngdào ('dedicated passage or entrance').

examples.text: 我去艺人通道那边帮忙吧。
examples.trans: Let me go help at the artist passageway.

examples.text: 请保持安全通道畅通。
examples.trans: Please keep the safety corridor clear.

meanings.note: Verb guàng ('stroll and shop').

examples.text: 论体力，陪您逛一天商场我肯定能逛。
examples.trans: Stamina-wise, I can happily browse shops all day with you.

examples.text: 收工太晚商场关门了，大家就在夜市逛了一圈。
examples.trans: Too late for malls after wrap, everyone strolled the night market.

meanings.note: Verb-object guàngjiē ('go window-shopping/shopping').

examples.text: 逛街我是能逛，可您今天讲的八卦太劲爆了。
examples.trans: I love going shopping, yet your gossip today was explosive!

examples.text: 难得休息一天，杏子约小谷周末一起去逛街。
examples.trans: With a rare day off, Xingzi invited Xiaogu shopping.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sù dù. Measure word (量词): 种 (zhǒng), e.g. 一种速度 ('a speed').

examples.text: 速度真快！店主给你收据了吗？
examples.trans: Impressive speed! Did the shopkeeper give you a receipt?

examples.text: 两个人一起摆桌子，速度比平时快一倍。
examples.trans: With two people setting tables together, it goes twice as fast.

meanings.note: Literally rebel; colloquially staging an office revolt.

examples.text: 看你们气势汹汹往楼里冲，这是打算去造反吗？
examples.trans: Marching toward the building like that—were you staging a mutiny?

examples.text: 再不让大家去吃晚饭，肚子都要闹造反了。
examples.trans: If we do not break for dinner soon, our stomachs will mutiny.

meanings.note: Verb zàochéng ('give rise to, cause').

examples.text: 这次延误没有造成严重后果。
examples.trans: This delay did not cause serious consequences.

examples.text: 大雪造成了航班晚点。
examples.trans: Heavy snow caused flight delays.

meanings.note: Inventing untrue gossip.

examples.text: 媒体写的那句准夫君，到底是不是在造谣呀？
examples.trans: When the press called him her husband-to-be, was that a rumour or not?

examples.text: 面对恶意造谣，公司法务部立刻发表了严正声明。
examples.trans: Facing malicious rumours, legal immediately issued a firm statement.

meanings.note: Orderly way of thinking.

examples.text: 单子上的问题顺序，完全符合总制作人的思维逻辑。
examples.trans: The order of questions on the sheet matches the producer's exact logic.

examples.text: 写策划案最重要的是条理清晰、逻辑严密。
examples.trans: Clear structure and tight logic matter most when drafting proposals.

逼.gloss: force, drive into a corner, compel

meanings.en: force, drive into a corner, compel
meanings.note: Pushing someone until they take drastic action.

examples.text: 别把大家逼得太紧，给团队留一点缓冲时间。
examples.trans: Do not push everyone too hard—leave some buffer time.

examples.text: 大概是被逼急了，他才想出这么笨的办法。
examples.trans: Driven to desperation, he came up with that clumsy stunt.

遍.gloss: time (once through, from start to finish)

meanings.en: time (once through, from start to finish)
meanings.note: Pinyin: biàn. Counts complete run-throughs of an action (再算一遍 'count it through once more'); compare 次 for simple occurrences.

examples.text: 等等……让我再算一遍。整个房间只要这么一点钱？
examples.trans: Wait... let me add it up again. The whole room needs only this much money?

examples.text: 请您再说一遍，好吗？
examples.trans: Could you say that once more, please?

meanings.note: Noun/adjective biàndì ('covering the ground everywhere').

examples.text: 靠近他的时候，脚下总是荆棘遍地。
examples.trans: Stepping closer to him, thorns cover the path underfoot.

examples.text: 春天到了，公园里遍地都是鲜花。
examples.trans: Spring is here, and flowers bloom everywhere in the park.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dào. Appears in split verb-object phrases like 道个歉 ('offer an apology').

examples.text: 先生，上楼之前，我要诚恳跟您道个歉。
examples.trans: Sir, before going upstairs, I owe you an honest apology.

examples.text: 临走的时候，他特意来道谢。
examples.trans: Before leaving, he came specially to say thank you.

related.gloss: know (a fact or piece of information)

道可道.gloss: the Way that can be spoken of

meanings.en: the Way that can be spoken of
meanings.note: Classical opening phrase Dào kě dào of Laozi.

examples.text: 这本书的第一句话就是道可道。
examples.trans: The opening phrase of this classic is Dao Ke Dao.

examples.text: 道可道反过来读，你也能读得通。
examples.trans: Read Dao Ke Dao backwards and it still makes sense.

meanings.note: Meaning: apologise.

examples.text: 杏子姐，是我，我要道歉。
examples.trans: Sister Xingzi, it was my fault — I need to apologise.

examples.text: 道歉？道什么歉？
examples.trans: Apologise? Apologise for what?

meanings.note: Pinyin: dào lǐ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个道理 ('a sound reason').

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

examples.text: 老陈的话虽然简单，却非常有道理。
examples.trans: Chen's words may be simple, yet they make complete sense.

related.gloss: know (a fact or piece of information)

examples.text: 你的职业道路是做一个真正的制作人，而不是长时间做任何人的助理。
examples.trans: Your career path is becoming a true producer, not spending years acting as anyone's assistant.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.en: take shelter briefly; duck out of
meanings.note: Pinyin: bì bi. Softened reduplication of 避 (避避雨 'shelter from the rain').

examples.text: 晚上好！先生，快进来避避雨吧。
examples.trans: Good evening! Sir, come inside quickly out of the rain.

examples.text: 外面雨下大了，快进屋喝杯热茶避避雨吧。
examples.trans: The rain is coming down hard—step inside for hot tea until it passes.

meanings.note: Verb-object bìyǔ ('shelter from rain').

examples.text: 热心居民开放自家客厅，给路上受困者避雨。
examples.trans: Kind residents opened their living rooms so commuters could shelter.

examples.text: 大雨来得太急，路人纷纷跑进地铁站口避雨。
examples.trans: Caught in a sudden downpour, passers-by ducked into metro entrances.

meanings.note: Formal verb yāo ('invite').

examples.text: 我今天邀您见面，有一件事想拜托您。
examples.trans: I invited you to meet today to ask a favour.

examples.text: 节目组特邀三位资深乐评人到场。
examples.trans: The show specially invited three senior music critics.

meanings.note: Common in media and business for performance invitations or project offers.

examples.text: 新专辑发布后，她收到了好几个节目的演出邀约。
examples.trans: After the new album came out, she received performance offers from several shows.

examples.text: 经纪人正在认真考虑这次的合作邀约。
examples.trans: The manager is seriously considering this collaboration offer.

meanings.note: Verb/noun yāoqǐng ('invite').

examples.text: 这次盛典必须要邀请辛惠美。
examples.trans: We definitely must invite Xin Huimei to this gala.

examples.text: 钱一到位，我们邀请她就没有障碍了。
examples.trans: Once payment clears, inviting her faces no obstacle.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà. Distal demonstrative before measure words (那个 'that one'); at clause start, means 'then / well then'.

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

examples.text: 最想搞掉的就是那个淳于乔。
examples.trans: The one you want to take down most is that Chun Yuqiao.

examples.text: 这是那个。
examples.trans: This is 那个.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà me. Opens a conclusion drawn from what was just said (那么，门在哪儿？ 'So where is the door?'); before an adjective it means 'that (much)'.

examples.text: 那么，那些旧书后面有第九扇门！
examples.trans: So behind those old books, there's a ninth door!

examples.text: 那么小美的咖啡馆和宋老师的钢琴，不会吵醒楼上的客人吧？
examples.trans: So Mei's café and Teacher Song's piano won't wake the guests upstairs?

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà xiē. Plural of 那个 ('those').

examples.text: 老陈，抱起那些纸箱，我们下楼吧！
examples.trans: Chen, pick up those cardboard boxes—down the stairs we go!

examples.text: 抬头看夜空下那些金色灯笼——真宁静啊！
examples.trans: Look up at those golden lanterns against the night sky—how peaceful!

meanings.note: Colloquial time phrase nàhuìr ('back then').

examples.text: 那会儿这段视频在网上传得特别火。
examples.trans: Back then, that video went viral online.

examples.text: 那会儿我还在传媒学院读书。
examples.trans: Back then I was still studying at Media College.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nàr. Spoken variant of 那里 ('there').

examples.text: 因为楼梯窄，而且周经理在那儿放了旧灯箱子。
examples.trans: Because the stairs are narrow, and Manager Zhou put old lamp boxes up there.

examples.text: 看车轮底下——铅笔写的你和我的名字还在那儿。
examples.trans: Look underneath the wheels—your name and mine in pencil are still right there.

examples.text: 那天我不在家。
examples.trans: I was not at home that day.

examples.text: 还记得那天发生的事吗？
examples.trans: Do you remember what happened that day?

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà tóu. Colloquial locative noun ('the far end / across'), contrasting with 这头 ('this end').

examples.text: 哪怕坐在阳光房那头，也能听清钢琴的旋律。
examples.trans: Even sitting at the far end of the sunroom, you can hear the piano melody clearly.

examples.text: 老陈在走廊那头喊我们过去帮忙扶书架。
examples.trans: From the other end of the corridor, Chen called us over to help steady the bookcase.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a part used in conversational Mandarin.

examples.text: 我有一个那就。
examples.trans: I have a 那就.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的那就。
examples.trans: This is a very good 那就.

examples.text: 谢谢您这么看重我，可是兴许明天那帮人就把我开除了。
examples.trans: Thank you for thinking so highly of me, though that crowd might fire me first thing tomorrow.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà shí. Time noun combining 那 ('that') + 时 ('time/period'), equivalent to 那时候.

examples.text: 那时我是个年轻的制图员，你们阳光房的热茶救了我淋湿的地图。
examples.trans: Back then I was a young mapmaker, and your sunroom tea saved my rain-soaked maps.

examples.text: 三十年前我刚来小院客栈工作，那时这棵梧桐树还没有现在这么高。
examples.trans: Thirty years ago when I first started working at Courtyard Inn, back then this plane tree was not nearly as tall as it is now.

meanings.note: Demonstrative nàyàng ('in that state or manner').

examples.text: 别装了，看你一天到晚魂不守舍那样。
examples.trans: Stop pretending — look how distracted you act all day.

examples.text: 事情没有你担心的那样复杂。
examples.trans: Things are not as complicated as you worry.

examples.text: 去年的事我当然记得，那段时间心情不好，惹了不少事。
examples.trans: Of course I remember last year; I was in a bad mood back then and stirred up plenty of trouble.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà biān. Points to a location or party on the other end.

examples.text: 宋老师，真对不起，那边还没有消息。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, I am truly sorry; they have no news over there yet.

examples.text: 冬天用掉最后一个了。只有桥那边的老五金店有这个尺寸。
examples.trans: Used the last one in winter. Only the old hardware shop past the bridge carries this size.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà lǐ. Distal location pronoun ('there').

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

examples.text: 挂在书桌右边吧，那里光线好。
examples.trans: Hang it to the right of the desk, where the light is good.

examples.text: 这是邮件啊。
examples.trans: This is email.

examples.text: 那个邮件好。
examples.trans: That email is good.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yóu chuō. Combines 邮 ('post/mail') + 戳 ('stamp/seal'); measure word: 个 (gè).

examples.text: 快看两个星期前的邮戳！谁会从国外给小院客栈写信呢？
examples.trans: Look at the postmark from two weeks ago! Who would write to Courtyard Inn from abroad?

examples.text: 这张旧明信片上的邮戳虽然有点淡，还能看清是一九九六年的五月。
examples.trans: Although the postmark on this old postcard is a bit faded, you can still make out May 1996.

meanings.note: Noun yóuxiāng ('email account or postbox').

examples.text: 所有的背景资料都已经发你邮箱里了。
examples.trans: All the background files have been sent to your inbox.

examples.text: 每天上班第一件事就是查工作邮箱。
examples.trans: First thing at work every day is checking work email.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yóu dì yuán. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位邮递员 ('a mail carrier').

examples.text: 邮递员刚让我签收的，上面盖着红色房产印章。
examples.trans: The postman just had me sign for it; it carries a red property-office stamp.

examples.text: 穿绿制服的邮递员每天上午十点准时路过。
examples.trans: The mail carrier in green passes by right at ten every morning.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lín jū. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位邻居 ('a neighbor').

examples.text: 超过八十年的小院建筑，只要一楼每天服务街坊邻居，禁止改成私人办公室。
examples.trans: Any courtyard building over eighty years old may not become private offices as long as the ground floor serves neighbours daily.

examples.text: 每天服务街坊邻居——就像对公众开放的早间咖啡馆？！
examples.trans: Serves neighbours daily—like a morning café open to the public?!

meanings.note: Serious and sincere in manner.

examples.text: 为昨晚的失礼，我现在郑重地向你道个歉。
examples.trans: For my rudeness last night, I solemnly apologise to you now.

examples.text: 他在全体员工面前郑重宣布了这个决定。
examples.trans: Before the entire staff he solemnly announced the decision.

meanings.note: Classifier/noun bù ('unit/department; classifier for machines or works').

examples.text: 他把团队打造成一部超级机器。
examples.trans: He built the team into a super machine.

examples.text: 这部电影非常好看。
examples.trans: This movie is great.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bù fen. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一部分 ('one part').

examples.text: 而你们两个孩子把十二号最珍贵的部分留在这儿了。
examples.trans: And you two boys kept the most precious part of Number twelve right here.

examples.text: 一楼的大部分空间都留给了院子咖啡馆。
examples.trans: Most of the ground floor is dedicated to the courtyard café.

examples.text: 星天有很多部门，这些部门之间都是平行的。
examples.trans: Xingtian has many departments, and all of these departments are on equal footing.

examples.text: 这是部门。 (Example)
examples.trans: This is 部门.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dōu. Summarizes everything BEFORE it and always stands directly before the verb/adjective (我们都喜欢).

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pèi. Used for pairing foods together or cutting spare keys.

examples.text: 咸黄油能配甜草莓果酱吗？
examples.trans: Can salted butter go with sweet strawberry jam?

examples.text: 等等，咸黄油配果酱不行，做炒蛋却棒极了！
examples.trans: Wait—salted butter fails with jam, yet for scrambled eggs it is amazing!

meanings.note: Verb pèihé ('cooperate, coordinate smoothly').

examples.text: 如果有不配合的员工，马上停职。
examples.trans: Anyone who refuses to cooperate is suspended at once.

examples.text: 你应该知道主持人怎么跟制作人配合。
examples.trans: You know how a host works in sync with a producer.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pèi tào. Describes pieces designed to go together as a set (配套的茶碟和牛奶壶).

examples.text: 买十二个白茶杯，老板还送了一个配套的牛奶壶。
examples.trans: When we bought twelve white teacups, the owner included a matching milk jug.

examples.text: 这把铜钥匙跟花园木门上的旧锁是配套的。
examples.trans: This brass key matches the old lock on the wooden garden door.

meanings.note: Exact mix of ingredients or essential oils.

examples.text: 助理亲自盯着芳疗师调配不含过敏成分的精油配方。
examples.trans: The assistant watched the therapist mix an allergen-free oil formula.

examples.text: 这家老字号甜品店的招牌糕点有着独特的配方。
examples.trans: This time-honoured bakery uses a signature recipe for its pastries.

meanings.note: Noun jiǔ ('alcoholic drink').

examples.text: 那我也点一杯酒，大家一般点什么？
examples.trans: Then I will order a drink too; what do people usually get?

examples.text: 要我给你杯子里再加一点酒吗？
examples.trans: Shall I top up a little more drink in your glass?

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǔ diàn. Measure word (量词): 家 (jiā), e.g. 一家酒店 ('a hotel').

examples.text: 外面下着大雨，街上酒店全满了！我们怎么办？
examples.trans: It is pouring rain outside and every hotel on the street is full! What do we do?

examples.text: 啊……下这么大的雨，车站附近酒店全满了。
examples.trans: Ah... in rain this heavy, every hotel near the station was full.

meanings.note: Noun jiǔjīng ('ethyl alcohol').

examples.text: 医生说这次急性发病是酒精引起的。
examples.trans: Doctors say this acute flare-up was caused by alcohol.

examples.text: 胃病患者平时应当远离含有酒精的饮品。
examples.trans: Stomach patients should steer clear of alcoholic drinks.

meanings.note: Noun jiǔliàng ('how much alcohol someone can hold').

examples.text: 老大那个酒量，喝多了身体根本受不了。
examples.trans: With our boss's low tolerance, heavy drinking wrecks him.

examples.text: 知道自己酒量小，在饭桌上就别硬撑。
examples.trans: Knowing your tolerance is low, never force drinks.

meanings.note: Verb yùnniàng ('mull over and prepare').

examples.text: 既然文娱论正在酝酿改版，不如现在开始。
examples.trans: Since the show is mulling a revamp, why not start now?

examples.text: 这个新节目构想他已经酝酿了半年。
examples.trans: He has been developing this show concept for half a year.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sū pí. Combines 酥 ('flaky/crisp') + 皮 ('pastry crust').

examples.text: 左边这片柠檬挞用的是薄酥皮，右边用的是杏仁挞底。
examples.trans: The lemon tart slice on the left uses thin flaky pastry; the right uses an almond crust.

examples.text: 刚出炉的苹果派酥皮金黄松脆，香气扑鼻。
examples.trans: Fresh from the oven, the apple pie's flaky pastry is golden, crisp, and fragrant.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sū cuì. Combines 酥 ('flaky/short/tender-crisp') + 脆 ('crunchy/crisp'), the ideal texture for tart shells, biscuits, and bread crusts.

examples.text: 二十个金黄酥脆的杏仁挞底已经在晾架上排好了。
examples.trans: Twenty golden, crisp and flaky almond tart shells are already lined up on the cooling rack.

examples.text: 刚出炉的面包外皮酥脆，里面却非常柔软。
examples.trans: Fresh from the oven, the bread has a crisp, flaky crust while staying soft inside.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a adj used in conversational Mandarin.

examples.text: 我有一个酸。
examples.trans: I have a 酸.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的酸。
examples.trans: This is a very good 酸.

meanings.note: Traditional sweet-tart drink suānméitāng served with hotpot.

examples.text: 快把酸梅汤喝了吧。
examples.trans: Hurry and drink up the sour-plum drink.

examples.text: 我点了一杯冰酸梅汤。
examples.trans: I ordered an iced sour-plum drink.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cù. Everyday culinary vinegar; a drop in warm water also cuts limescale when washing glass.

examples.text: 温水里加一滴白醋，擦出来的老玻璃透亮得像新的一样。
examples.trans: Add one drop of white vinegar to warm water and old glass wipes clean as new.

examples.text: 吃成都热饺子的时候，大家都喜欢蘸一点香醋。
examples.trans: When eating hot dumplings in Chengdu, everyone likes dipping them in fragrant vinegar.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xǐng. Used when guests wake up in the morning.

examples.text: 快跑吧，小晴。四号房七点一刻就醒！
examples.trans: Run fast, Qing. Room four wakes up at a quarter past seven!

examples.text: 早上七点，我听见小鸟叫就醒了。
examples.trans: At seven in the morning, I woke to the sound of birds.

醒悟.gloss: come to realize, awaken to truth

meanings.en: come to realize, awaken to truth
meanings.note: Verb xǐngwù ('awaken, grasp an insight').

examples.text: 但你是所有学生里醒悟得最早的一个。
examples.trans: Yet among all the students, you awakened the earliest.

examples.text: 经历这次挫折之后，他终于彻底醒悟了。
examples.trans: After this setback, he finally came to a clear realization.

meanings.note: Verb-complement xǐngguòlai ('come to, wake up').

examples.text: 就算李哥醒过来也不会承认的。
examples.trans: Even when Brother Li wakes up, he will not admit it.

examples.text: 病人手术后已经醒过来了。
examples.trans: The patient has woken up after surgery.

meanings.note: Reduplicated verb xǐngxing ('stay conscious, wake up').

examples.text: 你先坐一会儿别动，快醒醒啊！
examples.trans: Sit still for a moment and stay awake!

examples.text: 快醒醒，到演播厅门口该下车了。
examples.trans: Wake up — we are at the studio entrance.

meanings.note: Formal verb cǎinà ('adopt suggestions').

examples.text: 你的这条宝贵建议，我必须采纳。
examples.trans: As for your valuable advice, I will certainly adopt it.

examples.text: 总制片人当场采纳了实习生提出的新环节创意。
examples.trans: The chief producer adopted the intern's segment idea on the spot.

meanings.note: Media verb/noun cǎifǎng ('interview').

examples.text: 这次折腾了四天的采访对象是谁啊？
examples.trans: Who is the interview subject who took four days?

examples.text: 记者正在红毯旁边采访到场的歌手。
examples.trans: Reporters are interviewing arriving singers by the carpet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǐ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 里面 ('the inside').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

examples.text: 他一手把真的合同递到了法务，一手把假的授权列表备案到我们版权库里头。
examples.trans: With one hand he sent the real contract to legal, and with the other he logged a fake song list into our copyright database.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Colloquial noun lǐzi (paired with 面子, 'inner dignity/substance').

examples.text: 依我的意思，连里子我都不想给你留。
examples.trans: Left to me, I would not spare a shred of your pride.

examples.text: 做节目既要有好看的面子，也要有扎实的里子。
examples.trans: A great show needs both outer polish and inner substance.

examples.text: 职场里边很复杂，你听我的，先顾自己。
examples.trans: Inside the workplace things are complicated; listen to me and look after yourself first.

examples.text: 这是里边。
examples.trans: This is 里边.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǐ miàn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 箱子里面 ('inside the suitcase').

examples.text: 我来帮您。哎呀，里面装了石头吗？
examples.trans: Let me help you. Goodness, did you pack stones inside?

examples.text: 小晴，快看里面！这不是我的箱子！
examples.trans: Qing, look inside quickly! This is not my case!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhòng. Describes heavy luggage, heavy tools, or serious matters.

examples.text: 很安静，谢谢，不过这个行李箱今天特别重。
examples.trans: Very quiet, thank you, though this suitcase feels especially heavy today.

examples.text: 怪不得这么重，全是木头和皮鞋！
examples.trans: No wonder it was so heavy—all wood and leather shoes!

重出江湖.gloss: come out of retirement into the fray

meanings.en: come out of retirement into the fray

examples.text: 别抛弃，别放弃，重出江湖，尚可一战！
examples.trans: Don't give up, don't back down — step back into the arena and fight!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 你要重回综艺舞台？闻老师，一言为定！
examples.trans: You're returning to the variety stage? Mr Wen, it's a deal!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chóng fù. Note polyphone 重 reads 2nd-tone chóng ('again/layer') here, NOT zhòng ('heavy').

examples.text: 结尾高一个八度轻轻重复开头的四个音符，听起来真温暖。
examples.trans: Repeating the opening four notes softly one octave higher at the end sounds so warm.

examples.text: 没听清楚的话，请让我再慢慢重复一遍。
examples.trans: If you didn't catch that clearly, let me repeat it slowly once more.

meanings.note: Adjective zhòngdà ('major, significant').

examples.text: 理由就是重大公关事故。
examples.trans: The reason is a major public-relations incident.

examples.text: 这是一个非常重大的决定。
examples.trans: This is a major decision.

examples.text: 与星天的战略合作被总部收回重审，消息已经公布了。
examples.trans: Meanwhile, the overseas group's headquarters has pulled the strategic partnership back for review and announced the freeze.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Figurative load of duty or worry carried on one's shoulders.

examples.text: 项目顺利结束，大家身上的重担终于放下了。
examples.trans: With the project done smoothly, the heavy burden lifted from everyone.

examples.text: 年轻制作人勇敢地挑起了节目改版的重担。
examples.trans: The young producer bravely shouldered the burden of revamping the show.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chóng xīn. Read chóng here; placed before a verb to redo it from scratch (重新打开 'reopen').

examples.text: 等等——你想下星期五六点，重新打开九号房？
examples.trans: Wait—you want to reopen Room Nine next Friday at six?

examples.text: 写错了没关系，重新写一遍。
examples.trans: It's fine if you made a mistake; write it again from the start.

重新开业.gloss: reopening (of a shop, café, or inn)

meanings.en: reopening (of a shop, café, or inn)
meanings.note: Pinyin: chóng xīn kāi yè. Phrase 重新 (chóng xīn, 'anew') + 开业 ('open for business').

examples.text: 宋老师愿意为我们星期三的重新开业补写完那首圆舞曲！
examples.trans: Teacher Song is willing to finish writing that waltz for our Wednesday reopening!

examples.text: 老街上的书店翻修一新，下周末就要重新开业了。
examples.trans: The bookstore on the old street has been freshly renovated and reopens next weekend.

重来.gloss: start all over again, redo from scratch

meanings.en: start all over again, redo from scratch
meanings.note: Verb chónglái ('do over from the beginning').

examples.text: 要是老大出来把一切推翻重来，时间就太紧了。
examples.trans: If the boss scraps everything to start over, time will be tight.

examples.text: 刚才那条收音有点杂音，麻烦大家重来一遍。
examples.trans: There was static on that take—let us run it once more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhòng huó. Combines 重 (zhòng, 4th tone 'heavy') + 活 ('work/chores').

examples.text: 周经理星期二严禁干任何重活——也不准再靠近湿油漆和白罐子！
examples.trans: On Tuesday, Manager Zhou is strictly forbidden from doing any heavy work—or going near wet paint and white jars!

examples.text: 搬木桌、抬窗板这些重活，志鹏和志豪两兄弟一会儿就干完了。
examples.trans: Heavy work like moving wooden tables and lifting shutters was finished in no time by the brothers Peng and Hao.

meanings.note: Noun zhòngdiǎn ('crux, main point').

examples.text: 重点在于用什么表情面对困难。
examples.trans: The key point is how you face hardship.

examples.text: 请把今天会议的重点记下来。
examples.trans: Please note down the key points of today's meeting.

重用.gloss: to put in a key position

meanings.en: to put in an important position; to entrust with heavy responsibilities
meanings.note: zhòngyòng — literally 'employ heavily'; very common in passive/receptive collocations such as 受重用 or 得到重用 (to be highly valued by superiors)

examples.text: 我不像你那么受重用。
examples.trans: I am not as highly valued as you are.

examples.text: 这位新总监能力出众，很快就得到了老板的重用。
examples.trans: The new director has outstanding ability and was soon entrusted with key responsibilities by the boss.

related.gloss: to entrust with a major task

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhòng yào. Core A1/A2 adjective for important guests or matters.

examples.text: 小时候就住隔两条街。星期五对我来说……是重要日子。
examples.trans: Two streets over, when I was little. Friday for me... is an important day.

examples.text: 今天中午十二点有一位重要的客人要来。
examples.trans: An important guest is arriving at twelve noon today.

重视.gloss: value highly, attach great weight to

meanings.en: value highly, attach great weight to
meanings.note: Verb/noun zhòngshì ('take seriously, prize').

examples.text: 从这一点就能看出台里面的重视程度了。
examples.trans: From that alone you see how highly the network values it.

examples.text: 总编室非常重视新人的每一个原创想法。
examples.trans: The office values every original idea from newcomers.

meanings.en: reunite; meet again after years apart
meanings.note: Pinyin: chóng féng. Note second tone chóng ('again') here.

examples.text: 有进步！今天小院迎接兄弟重逢——大家保持安静端庄！
examples.trans: Progress! Today our courtyard hosts a brotherly reunion—quiet dignity from everyone!

examples.text: 我在做梦吗？！志豪，这场重逢是你安排的吗？
examples.trans: Am I dreaming?! Zhihao, did you plan this whole reunion?

meanings.note: Metaphorical noun/attributive zhòngliàngjí ('heavyweight').

examples.text: 今天节目有幸请到了一位重量级的嘉宾。
examples.trans: Today our show is honoured to welcome a heavyweight guest.

examples.text: 年度盛典公布了一份重量级的评委阵容。
examples.trans: The annual gala unveiled a heavyweight judging panel.

meanings.note: Adjective yě ('unruly, daringly unconventional').

examples.text: 淳于乔路子太野了！
examples.trans: Chun Yuqiao's tactical style is wild!

examples.text: 那帮网络推手做事路子很野。
examples.trans: Those online promoters operate in a wild, unruly way.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a noun used in conversational Mandarin. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个野花 ('a 野花').

examples.text: 我有一个野花。
examples.trans: I have a 野花.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的野花。
examples.trans: This is a very good 野花.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liáng. Note 2nd-tone reading liáng for the verb 'measure' (contrasting with 4th-tone noun 数量 shù liàng 'quantity').

examples.text: 志豪已经用尺子量过九号房的平面图了，里面刚好摆四张方木桌。
examples.trans: Hao has already measured Room Nine's floor plan with a ruler—four square wooden tables fit inside just right.

examples.text: 做烘焙讲究精确，小美总是仔细量好每一勺面粉和白糖。
examples.trans: Baking requires precision, so Mei always carefully measures every spoonful of flour and sugar.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jīn. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块金子 ('a piece of gold').

examples.text: 正往前走……啊，看见金钥匙招牌和蓝木门了！
examples.trans: Walking forward now... oh, I see the golden key sign and the blue wooden door!

examples.text: 阳光下，铜招牌闪着金光。
examples.trans: In the sunlight, the brass sign gleamed gold.

related.gloss: a piece of gold (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a adj used in conversational Mandarin.

examples.text: 我有一个金光闪闪。
examples.trans: I have a 金光闪闪.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的金光闪闪。
examples.trans: This is a very good 金光闪闪.

examples.text: 是金子就会发光的，别的不用理它。
examples.trans: True gold will always shine — ignore everything else.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jīn shǔ. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块金属 ('a piece of metal').

examples.text: 快合上送上去——等等，那是什么金属响声？
examples.trans: Close it quickly and take it up—wait, what was that metallic clanking sound?

examples.text: 非常安静！不过刚才你听到奇怪的金属敲击声了吗？
examples.trans: Very quiet! Though did you hear a strange metallic knocking sound just now?

related.gloss: a piece of metal (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: jīn bì. Measure word (量词): 枚 (méi) or 块 (kuài). Joins 金 ('gold') + 币 ('currency').

examples.text: 盒子最底层静静地躺着一枚古老的纪念金币。
examples.trans: At the very bottom of the box quietly lay an ancient commemorative gold coin.

examples.text: 孩子们在沙滩上挖到了巧克力做的假金币。
examples.trans: The children dug up fake gold coins made of chocolate on the beach.

meanings.note: Noun/attributive jīnpái ('gold-medal, top-notch').

examples.text: 不敢当，你才是真正的金牌制作人。
examples.trans: You flatter me—you are the true gold-medal producer.

examples.text: 幕后团队请来了业内顶尖的金牌音响师。
examples.trans: The crew brought in the industry's top sound engineer.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jīn sè. Measure word (量词): 种 (zhǒng), e.g. 一种金色 ('a golden color').

examples.text: 最上面架子上金色包装那包。怎么了？
examples.trans: The gold-wrapped packet on the top shelf. Why?

examples.text: 门上方只画着一把金色钥匙。拿旧阀门给店员看。
examples.trans: Only a golden key painted above the door. Show the clerk the old valve.

meanings.note: Formal noun jīn'é ('amount of money').

examples.text: 我们已经捐了目标金额的百分之一百四。
examples.trans: We have donated 140 percent of the target amount.

examples.text: 付款前请核对账单上的金额。
examples.trans: Please check the sum on the bill before paying.

meanings.note: jīnfànwǎn — idiomatic metaphor for a well-paid, prestigious position (often paired with 端上 'hold up' and contrasted with 铁饭碗, an 'iron rice bowl' emphasizing lifelong job security)

examples.text: 你敢说你不是为了他，放弃到手的金饭碗？
examples.trans: Dare you say it wasn't for him that you gave up the lucrative job you already had in hand?

examples.text: 在很多人眼里，进这家顶尖传媒公司就是端上了金饭碗。
examples.trans: In many people's eyes, getting into this top media company means landing a golden career.

related.gloss: secure job for life ('iron rice bowl')

meanings.note: Pinyin: jīn huáng. Praises freshly baked pastry crusts.

examples.text: 正在架子上放凉呢——金黄外皮配甜柠檬糖霜！
examples.trans: Cooling on the rack right now—golden crust with sweet lemon glaze!

examples.text: 刚烤出来的面包卷外皮一片金黄。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls came out golden-brown.

meanings.note: Noun zhēn ('needle').

examples.text: 舞台上多了一根针我都会清楚。
examples.trans: I notice even one extra needle on the stage.

examples.text: 掉在地上的一根针很难找。
examples.trans: A needle dropped on the floor is hard to spot.

针对.gloss: aimed at, tailored to, in view of

meanings.en: aimed at, tailored to, in view of
meanings.note: Directing measures or remarks at a specific case.

examples.text: 针对目前的情况，我们制定了新计划。
examples.trans: In view of the current situation, we drew up a new plan.

examples.text: 这些建议都是专门针对你的问题提出的。
examples.trans: These suggestions were tailored specifically to your issue.

针眼.gloss: needle prick mark; eye of a needle

meanings.en: needle prick mark; eye of a needle
meanings.note: Noun zhēnyǎn ('IV/injection puncture mark').

examples.text: 你手上这一串打点滴留下的针眼挺疼吧？
examples.trans: That row of IV needle marks on your hand must hurt, right?

examples.text: 护士手法很轻，拔针后只留下一个小小的针眼。
examples.trans: With a gentle hand, the nurse left only a tiny prick mark.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhōng. Measure word (量词): 座 (zuò), e.g. 一座钟 ('a clock').

examples.text: 十二点以后再拆吧，老板！看钟：差五分十二点！
examples.trans: Open it after twelve, boss! Look at the clock: five minutes to twelve!

examples.text: 大堂墙上的老钟敲了十二下。
examples.trans: The old clock on the lobby wall struck twelve.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhōngshēng. Measure word: 阵, 声.

examples.text: 远处传来了教堂的钟声。
examples.trans: The sound of a church bell came from afar.

examples.text: 新年的钟声即将敲响。
examples.trans: The New Year's bell is about to ring.

meanings.note: Colloquial noun zhōngtóu ('hour').

examples.text: 网站过了七个钟头还没恢复。
examples.trans: The website had not recovered after seven hours.

examples.text: 我等了你足足两个钟头。
examples.trans: I waited a full two hours for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhōng lóu. Measure word (量词): 座 (zuò), e.g. 一座钟楼 ('a clock tower').

examples.text: 听……街口钟楼开始敲十二下了！
examples.trans: Listen... the clock tower at the end of the street is starting to strike twelve!

examples.text: 老广场北边的石钟楼每到整点都会敲钟。
examples.trans: The stone clock tower north of the plaza chimes every hour on the hour.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhōng biǎo jiàng. Combines 钟表 ('clocks and watches') + craftsperson suffix 匠 ('artisan/master craftsperson'); measure word: 位 (wèi).

examples.text: 宋老师敬佩地说：“老陈，您的手像钟表匠一样稳！”
examples.trans: Teacher Song said admiringly, 'Chen, your hands are as steady as a watchmaker's!'

examples.text: 一位经验丰富的老钟表匠能听出齿轮里最细微的声音。
examples.trans: An experienced master watchmaker can hear the faintest sound inside the gears.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gāng. Hard carbon-iron alloy used for tools and piano strings (钢调音扳手 'steel tuning wrench', 钢丝 'steel wire').

examples.text: 老陈拿起结实的钢调音扳手，往右轻轻拧了一丝丝。
examples.trans: Chen picked up the sturdy steel tuning wrench and turned it a tiny fraction to the right.

examples.text: 厨房里那把切胡萝卜丁的厨师刀是用好钢打造的。
examples.trans: The chef's knife used for dicing carrots in the kitchen is forged from fine steel.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gāng sī. Combines 钢 ('steel') + 丝 ('fine wire/filament'), the high-tension wire used for treble and middle piano strings.

examples.text: 钢琴里面全是实在的木头、羊毛毡和紧绷的钢丝。
examples.trans: Inside a piano it is all honest wood, wool felt, and taut steel wire.

examples.text: 老陈用钳子把那根松掉的细钢丝重新固定好。
examples.trans: Chen used pliers to fasten the loose steel wire securely back in place.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gāng qín. Measure word (量词): 架 (jià), e.g. 一架钢琴 ('a piano').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 何止认识！整整六年，每个星期五我都爬那座木楼梯教钢琴！
examples.trans: More than know it! Every Friday for six whole years I climbed those wooden stairs to teach piano!

meanings.note: Pinyin: gāng bǐ. Measure word (量词): 支, e.g. 一支钢笔 ('a fountain pen').

examples.text: 太棒了！用钢笔把你的名字正式写进老陈的大纸本子里！
examples.trans: Wonderful! Your name goes into Chen's big paper ledger in fountain-pen ink!

examples.text: 他从上衣口袋里拿出一支黑色钢笔。
examples.trans: He took a black fountain pen from his jacket pocket.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yào shi. Measure word (量词): 把 (bǎ), e.g. 一把钥匙 ('a key').

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yào shi kǒng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个钥匙孔 ('a keyhole').

examples.text: 快看木头后面！白漆，还有一个铜钥匙孔！
examples.trans: Look behind the wood! White paint, and a brass keyhole!

examples.text: 天太黑，我找不到钥匙孔。
examples.trans: It is too dark; I can't find the keyhole.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yào shi bǎn. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块钥匙板 ('a wooden key board').

examples.text: 老陈，看身后木头钥匙板：一、二、三、四、五、六、七、八！
examples.trans: Chen, look at the wooden key board behind us: one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight!

examples.text: 前台后面的木钥匙板上编着一到八号。
examples.trans: The wooden key board behind reception is numbered one through eight.

related.gloss: a wooden key board (measure word 块)

examples.text: 不是吧？洛琳亲口说是原作者钦点她唱这首歌的！
examples.trans: No way! Luo Lin claimed with her own mouth that the songwriter personally handpicked her to sing that song!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a noun used in conversational Mandarin. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个钩子 ('a 钩子').

examples.text: 我有一个钩子。
examples.trans: I have a 钩子.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的钩子。
examples.trans: This is a very good 钩子.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qián. Measure word (量词): 笔 (bǐ), e.g. 一笔钱 ('a sum of money').

examples.text: 怎么样？他发火了吗？要退钱吗？
examples.trans: How did it go? Did he lose his temper? Did he ask for a refund?

examples.text: 买黄油和牛奶一共花了十二块钱。
examples.trans: Buying butter and milk cost twelve yuan altogether.

related.gloss: a sum of money (measure word 笔)

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiánbāo. Measure word: 个.

examples.text: 我的钱包不见了。
examples.trans: My wallet is missing.

examples.text: 她从钱包里拿出了一张纸币。
examples.trans: She took a banknote out of her wallet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qián xiāng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个钱箱 ('a cash box').

examples.text: 钱箱里拿五十块，记得要收据！
examples.trans: Here is fifty yuan from the cash box; remember to get a receipt!

examples.text: 找完零钱以后，记得把钱箱锁好。
examples.trans: After making change, remember to lock the cash box.

examples.text: 王尔实在是太狡猾了，他趁着我们去年系统升级的时候钻了这个空子。
examples.trans: Wang Er was remarkably cunning; he exploited a gap during our internal system upgrade last autumn.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiě. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块铁 ('a piece of iron').

examples.text: 这把大铁扳手吗？给你。
examples.trans: This big iron wrench? Here you go.

examples.text: 一辆黄色出租车刚停在铁大门外头！
examples.trans: A yellow taxi just pulled up outside the iron gate!

related.gloss: a piece of iron (measure word 块)

铁三角.gloss: iron triangle, inseparable trio of partners

meanings.en: iron triangle, inseparable trio of partners
meanings.note: Popular metaphor for a rock-solid three-person team.

examples.text: 在大家心里，他们三位早就是总编室密不可分的黄金铁三角。
