examples.trans: To everyone, the three of them are the editorial office's golden iron trio.

examples.text: 只要铁三角齐心协力留在公司，就没有扛不过去的难关。
examples.trans: As long as the iron trio sticks together, no hurdle is insurmountable.

examples.text: 您是东海经纪的涂盛涂总吗？我是荣思伦哥哥的铁杆大影迷，你能不能跟他说一声我要嫁给他！
examples.trans: Wait — are you Director Tu Sheng of Donghai Talent? I'm Rong Silun's biggest die-hard fan; please tell him I want to marry him!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a noun used in conversational Mandarin. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个铁环 ('a 铁环').

examples.text: 我有一个铁环。
examples.trans: I have a 铁环.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的铁环。
examples.trans: This is a very good 铁环.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiě guàn. Combines 铁 ('iron/metal') + 罐 ('can/tin/jar'); measure word: 个 (gè) or 只 (zhī).

examples.text: 小晴搅动着铁罐里的花园油漆，颜色像梧桐树叶一样绿。
examples.trans: Qing stirred the garden paint inside the metal tin—a deep green just like wutong leaves.

examples.text: 剩下的杏仁饼干装进密封的铁罐里，放一星期还是酥脆的。
examples.trans: Pack the remaining almond biscuits into an airtight metal tin and they stay crisp for a whole week.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiě gōu. Combines 铁 ('iron') + 钩 ('hook').

examples.text: 外墙的常春藤正好长过了窗板中间的那个旧铁钩。
examples.trans: The ivy on the outside wall grew right across that old iron hook in the middle of the shutter.

examples.text: 把防风灯笼稳稳挂在廊檐下的铁钩上吧。
examples.trans: Hang the windproof lantern securely on the iron hook under the eaves.

meanings.note: Pinyin: líng. Measure word (量词): 只 (zhǐ), e.g. 一只铃铛 ('a small bell').

examples.text: 您好好休息，有事随时按铃。
examples.trans: Rest well, ma'am; ring the bell anytime if you need anything.

examples.text: 有客人按了前台的小铜铃。
examples.trans: A guest rang the small brass bell at reception.

meanings.note: Pinyin: líng xiǎng. Combines 铃 ('bell') + 响 ('sound/ring'); measure word: 声 (shēng, 'peal/ring').

examples.text: 我倒很喜欢那两声铃响——下个星期四号房还空着吗？
examples.trans: I have actually grown quite fond of those two bell rings—is Room Four still free next week?

examples.text: 前门清脆的铃响告诉大家，今天的第一位客人到了。
examples.trans: The crisp ring of the front-gate bell told everyone that the first guest of the day had arrived.

meanings.note: Pinyin: líng shēng. Measure word (量词): 阵, e.g. 一阵铃声 ('a bell chime').

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 清脆的门铃声说明又有新客人到了。
examples.trans: A crisp chime of the bell means another guest has arrived.

meanings.note: Pinyin: líng dang. Measure word (量词): 只 (zhǐ), e.g. 一只铃铛 ('a small bell').

examples.text: 我在看天气，小美！铃铛旁边这封厚信是谁放的？
examples.trans: I am checking the weather, Mei! Who put this thick letter beside the bell?

examples.text: 木门上挂着一只风一吹就响的小铜铃铛。
examples.trans: A little brass bell hangs on the wooden door and chimes in the breeze.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiān bǐ. Measure word (量词): 支, e.g. 一支铅笔 ('a pencil').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 上面怎么用铅笔整齐画了这条街三家客栈？
examples.trans: Why are three inns on this street neatly sketched in pencil on it?

meanings.note: Pinyin: tóng. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块铜 ('a piece of brass').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 楼下我的工具房里有一盏铜台灯。
examples.trans: Downstairs in my workshop there is a brass desk lamp.

related.gloss: a piece of brass (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: tóng quān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个铜圈 ('a brass ring').

examples.text: 一定看准里面铜圈是二十毫米宽。
examples.trans: Make sure the brass ring inside is twenty millimetres wide.

examples.text: 阀门接口里面少了一个密封用的小铜圈。
examples.trans: A small sealing brass ring was missing inside the valve joint.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tóng pái. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块铜牌 ('a brass plaque').

examples.text: 把上面铜牌的灰尘擦掉……等等，快念那个数字！
examples.trans: Brush the dust off the brass plate on top... wait, read that number!

examples.text: 院门左边挂着老城区的历史建筑铜牌。
examples.trans: A historic-building brass plaque hangs to the left of the courtyard gate.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tóng guǎn. Measure word (量词): 根 (gēn), e.g. 一根铜管 ('a copper pipe').

examples.text: 摸摸铜管！已经热起来了！
examples.trans: Touch the copper pipe! It is warming up already!

examples.text: 老房子里的热水铜管已经用了三十年。
examples.trans: The copper hot-water pipes in the old house have served thirty years.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yín. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块银子 ('a piece of silver').

examples.text: 这是三楼阁楼门的小银钥匙。
examples.trans: Here is the small silver key to the third-floor attic door.

examples.text: 太松一口气了！志豪先生，给您银钥匙。
examples.trans: What a relief! Mr Zhihao, here is your silver key.

related.gloss: a piece of silver (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: pū. Read first tone pū when spreading a rug, tablecloth, or bedsheet (铺地毯).

examples.text: 墙上也没镜子，地上没铺地毯有点空。
examples.trans: No mirror on the wall either, and the floor feels bare without a rug.

examples.text: 她在木桌上铺了一块白桌布。
examples.trans: She spread a white tablecloth over the wooden table.

meanings.note: Noun/verb pūdiàn ('preliminary build-up').

examples.text: 前期的铺垫沟通不到位，上会容易被否定。
examples.trans: Without proper groundwork beforehand, pitches easily get vetoed.

examples.text: 开场五分钟的短片为整期访谈做了很好的铺垫。
examples.trans: The five-minute intro clip laid great groundwork for the talk.

examples.text: 今天的稿子铺满，全网推送！
examples.trans: Flood every channel with today's story and push it across the entire web!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Formal verb xiāohuǐ ('destroy sensitive items/drives').

examples.text: 内部修不好的硬盘宁可当场销毁。
examples.trans: Drives that cannot be fixed in-house are destroyed instead.

examples.text: 过期文件需要按规定销毁。
examples.trans: Expired files must be destroyed per regulations.

meanings.note: Pinyin: suǒ. Works as both verb ('lock the door' 锁门) and noun ('a lock' 一把锁).

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

meanings.note: Pinyin: suó kǒng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个锁孔 ('a keyhole').

examples.text: 前面锁扣有个小锁孔，再看底下贴着：一把旧铜钥匙！
examples.trans: There is a tiny keyhole on the front latch, and taped underneath: an old brass key!

examples.text: 地下室太暗，他用手电筒照着找锁孔。
examples.trans: In the dim cellar, he shone a flashlight to find the keyhole.

meanings.en: latch; clasp (on a suitcase or box)
meanings.note: Pinyin: suǒ kòu. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个锁扣 ('a latch').

examples.text: 前面锁扣有个小锁孔，再看底下贴着：一把旧铜钥匙！
examples.trans: There is a tiny keyhole on the front latch, and taped underneath: an old brass key!

examples.text: 老木盒正面的铜锁扣依然扣得很紧。
examples.trans: The brass clasp on the front of the wooden box still latches tight.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guō. General culinary vessel for boiling, simmering, or stir-frying; measure word: 口 (kǒu) or 个 (gè).

examples.text: 锅里的橄榄油已经热了，可以把洋葱丁和胡萝卜丁放进去了。
examples.trans: The olive oil in the pot is warm now, so we can put in the diced onions and carrots.

examples.text: 石头厨房的炉灶上炖着一大锅香气四溢的红扁豆汤。
examples.trans: A big pot of fragrant red lentil soup is simmering on the stove in the stone kitchen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guō dǐ. Combines 锅 ('pot/pan') + 底 ('bottom/base').

examples.text: 熬柠檬酱的时候要用木勺贴着锅底不停地搅，千万别让锅底煮开了。
examples.trans: When cooking lemon curd, stir continuously along the bottom of the pot with a wooden spoon so it never boils.

examples.text: 浓汤很容易粘在锅底，所以一定要开小火慢慢炖。
examples.trans: Thick soup catches easily on the bottom of the pot, so be sure to simmer it gently over low heat.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guō lú. Combines 锅 ('cauldron/pressure vessel') + 炉 ('furnace/stove').

examples.text: 老陈修过客栈的热水锅炉、门锁和挂钟，手艺样样精通。
examples.trans: Chen has fixed the inn's hot-water boiler, door locks, and wall clocks—skilled at every trade.

examples.text: 入冬以前，我们要请师傅把暖气锅炉检查一遍。
examples.trans: Before winter sets in, we will have a technician inspect the heating boiler.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cuò. Describes mistakes or serves as a result complement meaning 'wrongly' (拿错 'take the wrong one').

examples.text: 火车站有人拿错了我的蓝色行李箱！
examples.trans: Someone at the train station took my blue suitcase by mistake!

examples.text: 哎呀，怎么拿错了！我戴眼镜看看行李牌。
examples.trans: Dear me, what a mix-up! Let me put on my glasses and check the luggage tag.

meanings.note: Verb cuòguài ('misjudge and blame unfairly').

examples.text: 上次是我错怪你了，对不起。
examples.trans: Last time I blamed you unfairly; I am sorry.

examples.text: 了解真相以后，他发现自己错怪了同事。
examples.trans: Learning the truth, he realised he misjudged his colleague.

meanings.note: Noun/adjective cuòwù ('incorrect; mistake').

examples.text: 我们电视播出的画面没有任何错误。
examples.trans: The footage we aired on TV had no errors at all.

examples.text: 自制视频里出现了摆放错误的产品。
examples.trans: The misplaced product showed up in the homemade clip.

meanings.en: to temper; to hone skills through hands-on practice
meanings.note: duànliàn — used as a verb (锻炼自己) or nominalized object (得到锻炼) for building capability through real-world challenges

meanings.en: to work out; to exercise physically
meanings.note: everyday sense referring to physical fitness and sports (e.g., 锻炼身体)

examples.text: 抓住机会，锻炼自己。
examples.trans: Seize the opportunity and toughen yourself through practice.

examples.text: 制作二部在改版期间得到了充分的锻炼。
examples.trans: Production Unit Two gained thorough hands-on training during the revamp.

镇台之宝.gloss: crown-jewel star of a TV network

meanings.en: crown-jewel star of a TV network
meanings.note: Four-character phrase zhèntái zhī bǎo ('flagship host who anchors a network').

examples.text: 这次我们台里特意请出了镇台之宝担任主持。
examples.trans: Our network brought out its crown-jewel host for this show.

examples.text: 这位资深主持人一直是卫视的镇台之宝。
examples.trans: This veteran presenter has long been the network's treasure.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèn dìng. Describes staying cool in a crisis.

examples.text: 而且大哥想装作镇定的时候，绝对不会早到。
examples.trans: Besides, when older brothers want to act calm, they never arrive early.

examples.text: 不管多忙，前台说话都要保持温和镇定。
examples.trans: No matter how busy it gets, reception stays warm and composed.

meanings.note: Pinyin: niè zi. Combines 镊 ('pinch with fine tongs') + noun suffix 子.

examples.text: 整首圆舞曲的中央瑞音，现在全靠老陈手里那把细镊子啦！
examples.trans: Middle D for the whole waltz now rests on that pair of fine tweezers in Chen's hand!

examples.text: 修手表和修钢琴一样，都离不开顺手的细尖镊子。
examples.trans: Repairing watches, just like repairing pianos, relies on fine-tipped tweezers.

meanings.note: Film/TV noun jìngtóu ('camera lens or shot').

examples.text: 请各位歌手在镜头前做最真实的你们自己。
examples.trans: Singers, simply be your truest selves in front of the camera.

examples.text: 户外直播车迅速转移镜头，对准积水严重的路口。
examples.trans: The broadcast van swung its lenses toward the flooded intersection.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jìng zi. Measure word (量词): 面 (miàn), e.g. 一面镜子 ('a mirror').

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

examples.text: 墙上也没镜子，地上没铺地毯有点空。
examples.trans: No mirror on the wall either, and the floor feels bare without a rug.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jìng piàn. Combines 镜 ('mirror/glasses/optical lens') + 片 ('thin flat slice/disc'); measure word: 片 (piàn) or 块 (kuài).

examples.text: 老陈憋着笑说：“因为您刚把老花镜左边的镜片刷成了亮绿色！”
examples.trans: Holding back a laugh, Chen said, 'Because you just painted the left lens of your reading glasses bright green!'

examples.text: 小晴用温水和软布轻轻一擦，镜片马上又变得跟新的一样干净。
examples.trans: With one gentle wipe of warm water and a soft cloth, Qing made the lens clean as new again.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cháng. Read cháng when meaning 'long' (又长又正式), and zhǎng when meaning 'grow' (长得高).

examples.text: 让我好好看看你，志豪！你长得比钢琴还高了！
examples.trans: Let me look at you properly, Zhihao! You grew taller than the piano!

examples.text: 我一紧张，句子就变得又长又正式！
examples.trans: Whenever I get nervous, my sentences turn long and formal!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǎng dà. Note 长 is read 3rd-tone zhǎng ('grow') here, not 2nd-tone cháng ('long')!

examples.text: 志鹏就在离星期六集市三条街的老院子里长大。
examples.trans: Peng grew up in an old courtyard three streets away from the Saturday market.

examples.text: 院子角落那棵小柠檬树慢慢长大了。
examples.trans: That little lemon tree in the corner of the courtyard has slowly grown up.

examples.text: 跟您聊天真长学问！我差不多该走了，明天好早点到公司帮您探听消息。
examples.trans: Chatting with you is such an education! I should head back so I can get to the office early tomorrow and gather intel for you.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 你的职业道路是做一个真正的制作人，而不是长时间做任何人的助理。
examples.trans: Your career path is becoming a true producer, not spending years acting as anyone's assistant.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Time noun chángqī ('over a long period').

examples.text: 长期研究下来，他的改版思路我就明白了。
examples.trans: Studying it over the long run, I grasped his revamp logic.

examples.text: 长期不规律饮食很容易引发慢性胃病。
examples.trans: Irregular meals over the long term easily cause stomach trouble.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chángyǐ. Measure word: 张, 把.

examples.text: 公园里有几张木制的长椅。
examples.trans: There are several wooden benches in the park.

examples.text: 他们坐在长椅上聊天。
examples.trans: They sat on the bench chatting.

meanings.note: Idiom chángpiān-dàlùn ('long speech/essay').

examples.text: 如果公司支持，你刚刚的长篇大论不就白说了吗？
examples.trans: If the company backs it, was your big speech just now in vain?

examples.text: 提案会上请直接讲重点，不要空谈长篇大论。
examples.trans: In pitch meetings stick to key points instead of long speeches.

meanings.note: Idiom chánghuà-duǎnshuō ('keep it brief').

examples.text: 时间紧，我就长话短说吧。
examples.trans: Time is short, so let me keep a long story short.

examples.text: 离登机只有十分钟了，咱们长话短说。
examples.trans: Ten minutes until boarding—let us keep a long story short.

meanings.note: Often used with 有/没 in spoken evaluations.

examples.text: 工作半年以来，她的业务能力很有长进。
examples.trans: Over half a year on the job, her skills have shown real progress.

examples.text: 老犯同样的错误，真是太没长进了。
examples.trans: Making the same mistake again shows zero progress.

meanings.note: Adjective chángyuǎn ('long-range, long-term').

examples.text: 做新闻将来要是想有长远发展，得靠主流平台。
examples.trans: For long-term growth in journalism, stick with mainstream outlets.

examples.text: 做品牌要有长远眼光，不能只看眼前利益。
examples.trans: Building a brand takes long-term vision beyond quick gains.

meanings.note: Vivid reduplicated adjective (pronounced chángchángde).

examples.text: 出发之前，他给助理列了一张长长的注意事项单。
examples.trans: Before leaving, he wrote out a long checklist of reminders.

examples.text: 售票处门口一大早就排起了长长的队伍。
examples.trans: Early in the morning a long queue formed outside the box office.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mén. Measure word (量词): 扇 (shàn), e.g. 一扇门 ('a door').

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 这是三楼阁楼门的小银钥匙。
examples.trans: Here is the small silver key to the third-floor attic door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mén kǒu. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 大门口 ('at the doorway').

examples.text: 等等——那星期一晚上门口台阶……第二个蓝箱子……
examples.trans: Wait—then Monday night on our front step... the second blue suitcase...

examples.text: 您为什么不直接去志鹏家门口把木头小火车交给他呢？
examples.trans: Why not go straight to Zhipeng's door and hand him the wooden train?

门户网站.gloss: web portal, major news portal site

meanings.en: web portal, major news portal site
meanings.note: Large mainstream internet news site.

examples.text: 这条独家消息一旦放出，各大门户网站都会转载。
examples.trans: Once this exclusive breaks, every major web portal will pick it up.

examples.text: 她在一家知名门户网站的娱乐频道当主编。
examples.trans: She works as chief editor on the entertainment desk of a web portal.

meanings.note: Literally a doorway sill; figuratively an entry standard.

examples.text: 来拜访的人太多，门槛都快被踩平了。
examples.trans: So many visitors came that the threshold was nearly worn flat.

examples.text: 这档专业音乐节目的准入门槛很高。
examples.trans: The entry bar for this professional music show is high.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mén pái. Combines 门 ('door/gate') + 牌 ('numbered plaque/plate'); measure word: 块 (kuài) or 个 (gè).

examples.text: 小晴惊讶地认出他来：“您是梧桐巷十号门牌小提琴店的老邻居？！”
examples.trans: Qing recognized him in surprise: 'Are you our old neighbour from the violin shop at number ten Wutong Lane?!'

examples.text: 老陈把擦得干干净净的铜门牌端端正正钉在大门旁边。
examples.trans: Chen nailed the freshly polished brass doorplate squarely beside the front gate.

meanings.note: Electronic keycard/password security system on doors.

examples.text: 机房安装了最新的门禁系统，外人根本进不去。
examples.trans: The suite has a new access-control system keeping outsiders out.

examples.text: 行政部的电脑后台可以查看门禁系统的刷卡记录。
examples.trans: Admin's backend computer displays keycard logs from the door system.

门边.gloss: beside the door; by the doorway

meanings.en: beside the door; by the doorway
meanings.note: Pinyin: mén biān. Place noun 门 ('door/gate') + 边 ('side/beside').

examples.text: 小晴在九号房的门边放了一个小竹篮，里面装着共享图书。
examples.trans: Beside the door of Room Nine, Qing placed a small bamboo basket filled with shared books.

examples.text: 雨伞架就放在走廊门边，客人们进出拿取都很方便。
examples.trans: The umbrella stand sits right beside the hallway door so guests can reach it easily coming and going.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mén líng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个门铃 ('a doorbell').

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mén suǒ. Clear disyllabic noun 门 ('door') + 锁 ('lock').

examples.text: 九号房那把老铜门锁滴了两滴机油后就很好开了。
examples.trans: After two drops of oil, Room Nine's old brass door lock turned smoothly.

examples.text: 晚上关店的时候，小晴总会把前后两道门锁检查一遍。
examples.trans: When closing up at night, Qing always double-checks both the front and back door locks.

meanings.note: ménmian — figurative sense for the showpiece asset or representative figure of an organization (撑门面 = to keep up appearances / serve as the public showcase)
literal street-facing entrance and exterior of a commercial shop

examples.text: 这就是一号棚，星天的门面。
examples.trans: This right here is Studio One, the showcase of Xingtian.

examples.text: 这档王牌节目一直是电视台撑门面的招牌。
examples.trans: This flagship show has always been the signature program that upholds the TV station's prestige.

related.gloss: to keep up appearances; be the showpiece

meanings.note: Pinyin: shǎn. Describes a blinking indicator light, camera flash, or lightning.

examples.text: 前台电话上的小红灯一直在闪，肯定有新留言。
examples.trans: The little red light on the front-desk phone keeps blinking—there must be a new message.

examples.text: 夜空里的星星一闪一闪的，特别亮。
examples.trans: Stars in the night sky twinkle brightly off and on.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shǎn diàn. Combines 闪 ('flash') + 电 ('lightning/electricity').

examples.text: 半夜没有大卡车，你看大堂玻璃外面——那是闪电！
examples.trans: There are no big trucks at midnight—look outside the lobby glass, that's lightning!

examples.text: 一道明亮的闪电划过夜空，紧接着响起了雷声。
examples.trans: A bright flash of lightning streaked across the night sky, followed right away by thunder.

meanings.note: Verb shǎnyào ('sparkle, shine').

examples.text: 众星闪耀的红毯仪式即将开始。
examples.trans: The glittering star-studded red carpet begins shortly.

examples.text: 舞台上的灯光闪耀夺目。
examples.trans: Lights onstage shone dazzingly.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bì. Specifically used for closing one's eyes or mouth (闭上眼睛).

examples.text: 咬一口……志豪，闭上眼睛！跟爷爷的蛋糕味道一模一样！
examples.trans: One bite... Zhihao, close your eyes! That tastes exactly like Grandfather's cake!

examples.text: 他闭上眼睛，仔细听院子里的风声。
examples.trans: He closed his eyes and listened closely to the breeze in the courtyard.

examples.text: 闭上眼睛尝一口，是不是跟小时候的味道一模一样？
examples.trans: Close your eyes and take a bite—doesn't it taste just like when we were children?

examples.text: 天冷风大，进屋后请随手把木门闭上。
examples.trans: It is cold and windy out; please pull the wooden door shut behind you after coming inside.

meanings.note: Blunt verb-object bìzuǐ ('stop talking').

examples.text: 凯文，你先闭嘴坐下。
examples.trans: Kaiwen, keep quiet and sit down.

examples.text: 录影红灯亮起的时候，后台所有人必须闭嘴。
examples.trans: When the recording light goes on, backstage falls silent.

闭门羹.gloss: a slammed door, cold refusal to meet

meanings.en: a slammed door, cold refusal to meet
meanings.note: Idiom noun bìméngēng ('eat a closed-door refusal').

examples.text: 那天要不是总编室给二位吃了闭门羹。
examples.trans: Had the editorial office not turned you two away at the door...

examples.text: 记者没提前预约，结果在门口吃了闭门羹。
examples.trans: Arriving without an appointment, the reporter was turned away.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wèn. Everyday verb for asking a question (请问 'may I ask').

examples.text: 等等——先生您好！您问那个深蓝色行李箱吗？
examples.trans: Wait—hello, sir! Are you asking about that dark-blue suitcase?

examples.text: 快问他叫什么名字！记下来！
examples.trans: Quick, ask him what his name is! Write it down!

examples.text: 我想问一问，贵公司是否认为单凭你们在海外娱乐产业发达的经验和资源，
examples.trans: Let me ask you one question: does your group truly believe that relying solely on your overseas entertainment experience and resources

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 这是问到啊。
examples.trans: This is asked.

examples.text: 那个问到好。
examples.trans: That asked is good.

meanings.note: Verb-object wènzuì ('come to call someone to account').

examples.text: 他们一早上就来问罪了。
examples.trans: They came first thing this morning to demand answers.

examples.text: 先查清楚事实，别急着问罪。
examples.trans: Check the facts first before pointing fingers.

examples.text: 由此引发的股东内部分歧与高管层问责风暴，可能是比侵权本身更为严重的企业危机。
examples.trans: The resulting shareholder rifts and executive accountability storm may prove even deadlier than the lawsuit itself.

examples.text: 董事会已经要求召开董事大会问责。
examples.trans: And Xingtian's board has demanded an emergency board meeting to assign blame.

问起.gloss: ask about, bring up in questioning

meanings.en: ask about, bring up in questioning
meanings.note: Verb-complement wènqǐ ('inquire about').

examples.text: 不管你在何时何地问起这件事，我都会这么答。
examples.trans: Whenever and wherever you ask about this, my answer stands.

examples.text: 刚才开会时主编还特意问起了你的近况。
examples.trans: At the meeting just now, the editor asked how you were doing.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wèn wen. Friendly reduplication of 问.

examples.text: 其实我下楼是想问问，洗手间水龙头怎么有点凉。
examples.trans: Actually, I came down to ask why the bathroom tap felt a bit cool.

examples.text: 不知道路的话，我们去问问街口的花店老板。
examples.trans: If unsure of the way, let's ask the flower-shop owner at the corner.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wèn tí. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个问题 ('a question / problem').

examples.text: 哦？我的预订有问题吗？
examples.trans: Oh? Is there a problem with my booking?

examples.text: 水管已经修好了，洗澡水没有任何问题。
examples.trans: The water pipe is repaired, and the shower water has zero issues.

examples.text: 就算他们是蓄谋已久的，我们照样陪着你闯过来！
examples.trans: Even if they plotted this trap long ago, we will charge right through it at your side!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

闲.gloss: idle, free, having nothing to do

meanings.en: idle, free, having nothing to do
meanings.note: Having spare time on one's hands.

examples.text: 你今天怎么这么闲，不用去盯彩排吗？
examples.trans: How come you have so much free time today—no rehearsal to watch?

examples.text: 忙习惯了的人一旦闲下来反而不适应。
examples.trans: People used to staying busy feel odd once they are idle.

闲得慌.gloss: have too much idle time on one's hands

meanings.en: have too much idle time on one's hands
meanings.note: Colloquial adj phrase xiándehuāng ('bored from having nothing to do').

examples.text: 跑来演播室看热闹，你这人真闲得慌。
examples.trans: Dropping by a TV set for fun—you really have too much free time.

examples.text: 刚休假两天他就闲得慌，又跑回机房看片了。
examples.trans: Two days into vacation he got restless and returned to the edit bay.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiān. Counts rooms of all kinds: bedrooms, guest rooms, studies, kitchens (一间客房 'a guest room').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那间向阳的旧阁楼书房……快跟我来！
examples.trans: That sunny old attic study... follow me, quickly!

examples.text: 公司有间谍！
examples.trans: There is a spy in the company!

examples.text: 这是间谍。
examples.trans: This is 间谍.

examples.text: 这是闹啊。
examples.trans: This is make trouble.

examples.text: 那个闹好。
examples.trans: That make trouble is good.

meanings.note: Colloquial verb-complement nàobāi ('break off relations in a quarrel').

examples.text: 我这么做是为了不让你跟公司闹掰。
examples.trans: I did this so you would not split with the company.

examples.text: 他们因为一点小事闹掰了。
examples.trans: They fell out over a trivial matter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nào zhōng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个闹钟 ('an alarm clock').

examples.text: 定好闹钟吧，老陈。明早我们跑赢冷水！
examples.trans: Set your alarm, Chen. Tomorrow morning we outrun the cold water!

examples.text: 为了赶早班火车，我定了六点的闹钟。
examples.trans: To catch the morning train, I set my alarm clock for six.

meanings.note: Affectionate northern Mandarin word for daughter.

examples.text: 听说严厉的老板居然已经有一个五岁的闺女了。
examples.trans: Everyone was surprised the stern boss has a five-year-old daughter.

examples.text: 老张一提起自己懂事的闺女就笑得合不拢嘴。
examples.trans: Old Zhang beams from ear to ear whenever he mentions his daughter.

meanings.note: Colloquial term for close girlfriends (often used humorously by male pals).

examples.text: 周末她约了大学时代最好的闺蜜一起逛街。
examples.trans: Over the weekend she met her college bestie for shopping.

examples.text: 两位老编辑笑着打趣说大家早就是无话不谈的闺蜜了。
examples.trans: The two veteran editors joked that they were already besties.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wén. Everyday verb for smelling aromas (闻到香味 'smell a fragrance').

examples.text: 早上好！在楼上就闻到暖暖的肉桂香味了！
examples.trans: Good morning! All the way upstairs I smelled warm cinnamon!

examples.text: 一进门就闻到了烤面包的香味。
examples.trans: Right on stepping inside, I smelled baking bread.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wén wen. Friendly reduplication of 闻.

examples.text: 闻闻看！热面包、热炒蛋，还有新鲜香草。
examples.trans: Smell that! Warm bread, hot scrambled eggs, and fresh herbs.

examples.text: 来闻闻这壶刚泡好的薄荷茶香不香！
examples.trans: Come smell how fragrant this freshly steeped pot of mint tea is!

meanings.note: Pinyin: fá mén. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个阀门 ('a valve').

examples.text: 坏消息。老热水器上的铜压力阀门裂了。
examples.trans: Bad news. The brass pressure valve on the old water heater cracked.

examples.text: 工具箱里有备用的铜阀门吗？
examples.trans: Is there a spare brass valve in your toolbox?

meanings.note: Pinyin: gé lóu. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间阁楼 ('an attic room').

examples.text: 那间向阳的旧阁楼书房……快跟我来！
examples.trans: That sunny old attic study... follow me, quickly!

examples.text: 这是三楼阁楼门的小银钥匙。
examples.trans: Here is the small silver key to the third-floor attic door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: duì. Measure word (量词): 支 (zhī) or 排 (pái). Also a classifier itself (一队人 'a line of people').

examples.text: 小晴和老陈组成了一队，参加客栈的寻宝游戏。
examples.trans: Qing and Chen formed a team to participate in the inn's treasure hunt game.

examples.text: 孩子们排成整齐的一队，跟着老师走进了博物馆。
examples.trans: The children lined up in a neat row and followed the teacher into the museum.

meanings.note: Noun duìwu ('crew, organized group').

examples.text: 我们有一百三十个人的后台队伍。
examples.trans: We have a 130-person backstage crew.

examples.text: 观众排起了整齐的队伍。
examples.trans: Viewers lined up in an orderly queue.

examples.text: 辛惠美在第一支竞演曲目里，启用了神秘的外卡队员与她同场演出。
examples.trans: For her very first competition song, Xin Huimei has brought in a mysterious wild-card singer to perform alongside her.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: duìzhǎng. Measure word: 位, 个.

examples.text: 他是我们篮球队的队长。
examples.trans: He is the captain of our basketball team.

examples.text: 队长带领大家完成了任务。
examples.trans: The team leader led everyone to complete the task.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yáng guāng. Measure word (量词): 缕, e.g. 一缕阳光 ('a ray of sunlight').

examples.text: 趁着阳光亮，我能再看看那张小纸牌吗？
examples.trans: While the sunlight is bright, may I look at that small paper tag again?

examples.text: 雨过天晴，温暖的阳光洒满整个小院。
examples.trans: After the rain cleared, warm sunshine filled the whole courtyard.

related.gloss: a ray of sunlight (measure word 缕)

meanings.note: Pinyin: yáng guāng fáng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间阳光房 ('a sunroom').

examples.text: 啊！看这儿：一楼，九号房，花园阳光房！
examples.trans: Aha! Look here: ground floor, Room Nine, garden sunroom!

examples.text: 等等，我们一楼有一个花园阳光房？
examples.trans: Wait, we have a garden sunroom on the ground floor?

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a noun used in conversational Mandarin. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个阳台 ('a 阳台').

examples.text: 我有一个阳台。
examples.trans: I have a 阳台.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的阳台。
examples.trans: This is a very good 阳台.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a noun used in conversational Mandarin. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个阴影 ('a 阴影').

examples.text: 我有一个阴影。
examples.trans: I have a 阴影.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的阴影。
examples.trans: This is a very good 阴影.

meanings.note: Classical philosophy noun yīnyáng ('yin and yang').

examples.text: 天道循环，阴阳反背。
examples.trans: Heaven's way cycles round, and yin and yang reverse.

examples.text: 中国传统哲学讲究阴阳平衡。
examples.trans: Classical Chinese philosophy values balance between yin and yang.

阴魂不散.gloss: linger like a haunting ghost, refuse to go away

meanings.en: linger like a haunting ghost, refuse to go away
meanings.note: Colloquial idiom used impatiently about persistent rivals or issues.

examples.text: 在他眼里，那档还没播出的原创节目简直像阴魂不散的影子。
examples.trans: To him, that un-aired original show lingered like an inescapable shadow.

examples.text: 造假风波平息之后，再也没有阴魂不散的网络水军来捣乱了。
examples.trans: Once the ad scandal was cleared up, persistent trolls vanished.

meanings.note: Showbiz noun zhènróng ('cast or guest lineup').

examples.text: 今晚这里有最强的明星阵容。
examples.trans: Tonight features the strongest celebrity lineup.

examples.text: 新节目的主持阵容已经确定了。
examples.trans: The hosting lineup for the new show is finalized.

meanings.note: Noun jiēcéng ('social class or tier').

examples.text: 你这是年龄歧视还是阶层地位歧视啊？
examples.trans: Is that age bias or class-and-status discrimination?

examples.text: 大众节目要照顾不同阶层观众的喜好。
examples.trans: Mass-appeal shows serve viewers from every walk of life.

examples.text: 我们处于第一阶段。
examples.trans: We are in the first phase.

examples.text: 这是一个重要阶段。
examples.trans: This is an important phase.

meanings.note: Forces opposing change or progress.

examples.text: 推行新方案往往会遇到很大的阻力。
examples.trans: Pushing through a new plan often meets strong resistance.

examples.text: 只要大家齐心协力，再大的阻力也能克服。
examples.trans: As long as everyone pulls together, any resistance can be overcome.

meanings.note: Intervening before something harmful occurs.

examples.text: 当务之急是立刻行动起来，阻止对方在电视台高层面前撤掉节目。
examples.trans: The top priority is acting fast to stop him from getting the show axed.

examples.text: 暴雨并没有阻止忠实观众守在屏幕前观看决赛直播。
examples.trans: Heavy rain did not stop loyal viewers from tuning in live.

examples.text: 授权附表和咱们系统里的记录对不上！
examples.trans: The signed licensing appendix doesn't match the record in our internal database!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fù jìn. Measure word (量词): 片 (piàn), e.g. 附近一带 ('the nearby area').

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 闻思默，我求你了行吗？我不是真的不能面对过去，那些陈年烂事可以挖。
examples.trans: Wen Simo, I'm begging you, alright? It isn't that I can't face the past — you could dig up all that old mess.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mò shēng. Describes an unfamiliar place or stranger (陌生人).

examples.text: 一家雨夜修阁楼台灯、还替陌生人守箱子的客栈。
examples.trans: One that fixes attic lamps on a rainy night and guards a stranger's bag.

examples.text: 第一次来成都，她却一点也不觉得陌生。
examples.trans: Even on her first visit to Chengdu, nothing felt unfamiliar.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mò shēng rén. Combines 陌生 ('unfamiliar/strange') + 人 ('person'); measure word: 个 (gè) or 位 (wèi).

examples.text: 街上的陌生人怎么会知道锁在房间里三十年没发表过的圆舞曲呢？
examples.trans: How could a stranger on the street know a waltz that was locked away unpublished in a room for thirty years?

examples.text: 走进九号房喝过一杯热茶以后，陌生人也很快变成了老朋友。
examples.trans: After stepping into Room Nine and sharing a cup of hot tea, even strangers quickly become old friends.

meanings.note: Verb jiàngdī ('reduce, drop').

examples.text: 可是明星导师们的戏份也跟着降低了。
examples.trans: Yet the star mentors' share of screen time drops as well.

examples.text: 双机位同时拍摄有效降低了补录的时间成本。
examples.trans: Shooting with two cameras cut down pickup-shot time.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuàn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个院子 ('a courtyard').

examples.text: 有，结实的木床、干净书桌，风景全院最好。
examples.trans: Yes, a solid wooden bed, a clean desk, and the best view in the courtyard.

examples.text: 前院种着花草，后院十分安静。
examples.trans: Flowers grow in the front yard, and the back courtyard is quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuàn zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个院子 ('a courtyard').

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuàn mén. Measure word (量词): 扇 (shàn), e.g. 一扇院门 ('a courtyard gate').

examples.text: 等等——要是每天早上打开院门，卖街坊咖啡和热面包……
examples.trans: Wait—if we open our courtyard gate every morning for neighbourhood coffee and warm bread...

examples.text: 晚上十一点以后，客栈会把院门锁好。
examples.trans: After eleven at night, the inn locks the outer courtyard gate.

meanings.note: Preposition chú ('except for, besides').

examples.text: 他是除我父母之外给我影响最深的人。
examples.trans: Apart from my parents, he has influenced me most deeply.

examples.text: 除总决赛采用直播外，其余各期均为提前录播。
examples.trans: Except for the live finale, all episodes are pre-taped.

meanings.note: Marks an exception or addition.

examples.text: 除了他以外，办公室里其他人都下班了。
examples.trans: Apart from him, everyone else in the office has gone home.

examples.text: 这件事除了好朋友，我谁也没告诉。
examples.trans: Besides my close friend, I told nobody about this.

meanings.note: Connective phrase asking or adding what else exists.

examples.text: 除了确认名单，除此之外还有别的消息吗？
examples.trans: Apart from confirming the list, is there any other news?

examples.text: 这间屋子摆了一张书桌，除此之外再没有多余的家具。
examples.trans: Aside from a single desk, the room holds no extra furniture.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chú fēi. Introduces the single exception ('unless…').

examples.text: 满分十分给九分？！没人会去测量庭院，除非……
examples.trans: Nine out of ten?! Nobody measures courtyards unless...

examples.text: 除非他是写成都旅游指南的神秘评审员！
examples.trans: Unless he is a secret inspector writing the Chengdu Travel Guide!

险恶.gloss: treacherous, perilous, hostile (of conditions or motives)

meanings.en: treacherous, perilous, hostile (of conditions or motives)
meanings.note: Describes dangerous situations or malicious intent.

examples.text: 助手提醒他眼下内部形势险恶，最好先跟同事搞好关系。
examples.trans: His deputy warned the internal climate was tricky and urged goodwill.

examples.text: 无论外部竞争环境多么险恶，团队始终坚守内容品质底线。
examples.trans: However tough outside competition gets, the team guards quality.

meanings.note: Verb péi ('keep company, spend time with').

examples.text: 还要肯花时间陪女朋友。
examples.trans: He must also be willing to spend time with his girlfriend.

examples.text: 周末她留在医院陪刚做完手术的同事。
examples.trans: Over the weekend she stayed at the hospital with her coworker.

陪床.gloss: stay overnight by a hospital bed to care for a patient

meanings.en: stay overnight by a hospital bed to care for a patient
meanings.note: Medical verb-object péichuáng ('keep bedside watch in hospital').

examples.text: 没想到你竟然专门请假留在医院这儿陪床！
examples.trans: Who knew you actually took leave to keep bedside watch here!

examples.text: 住院期间每间病房晚上只允许一名家属陪床。
examples.trans: Each ward allows one family member overnight for bedside care.

examples.text: 不好意思啊，我应该在出差之前多找时间陪陪你的，我疏忽了。
examples.trans: I'm sorry — I should have carved out more time to spend with you before my trip; that was careless of me.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: táo tǔ. Compound 陶 ('pottery') + 土 ('earth/clay'): natural clay body fired into earthenware or stoneware.

examples.text: 用厚陶土烧出来的杯子端在手里暖乎乎的。
examples.trans: A cup fired from thick potter's clay feels cosy and warm in your hands.

examples.text: 手艺人正在木桌前揉一块湿润的陶土。
examples.trans: The potter is kneading a lump of moist clay at a wooden worktable.

meanings.note: Pinyin: táo cí. Collective compound joining 陶 ('earthenware/stoneware') + 瓷 ('porcelain').

examples.text: 广场转角的陶瓷摊摆满了白碗、茶杯和花瓶。
examples.trans: The ceramics stall on the corner of the square is covered in white bowls, teacups, and vases.

examples.text: 包陶瓷餐具的时候一定要多垫几层旧报纸。
examples.trans: Always pad ceramic tableware with extra layers of old newspaper when wrapping it.

meanings.note: Verb xiànrù ('fall/plunge into a state').

examples.text: 整座繁华都市骤然陷入特大暴雨灾害之夜。
examples.trans: The bustling city was suddenly plunged into a night of storm crisis.

examples.text: 主唱临时失声，让整场晚会筹备一度陷入僵局。
examples.trans: When the lead singer lost his voice, gala prep hit a deadlock.

meanings.note: Verb xiànhài ('set someone up to take blame').

examples.text: 那你们俩就是承认陷害我了！
examples.trans: So the two of you admit that you framed me!

examples.text: 真相查清楚了，没有人能陷害她。
examples.trans: With the truth clear, nobody can frame her.

examples.text: 有人给我们埋了一个陷阱，而且已经埋很久了。
examples.trans: Someone planted a trap for us inside our own system — and buried it a long time ago.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 现在我就要隆重介绍一下我的男朋友，星天娱乐的首席内容官，淳于乔先生。
examples.trans: Allow me to proudly introduce my boyfriend — Xingtian Entertainment's chief content officer, Mr Chun Yuqiao.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 想带新人随便，但是别带到制作会上来。
examples.trans: Mentor newcomers all you like, but do not bring them to the production meeting.

examples.text: 想带新人随便，但是别带到制作会上来。
examples.trans: Mentor newcomers all you like, but do not bring them to the production meeting.

meanings.note: Adverb suíkǒu ('off the cuff, casually').

examples.text: 不就是主持人在电视上随口说了几句吗？
examples.trans: Was that not just the host making casual remarks on air?

examples.text: 没想到她随口提的点子成了全场的亮点。
examples.trans: An offhand idea she mentioned became the highlight.

随口一说.gloss: say casually off the cuff, mention in passing

meanings.en: say casually off the cuff, mention in passing
meanings.note: Speaking without deep calculation.

examples.text: 我刚才只是随口一说，你千万别往心里去。
examples.trans: I was just speaking off the cuff—do not take it to heart.

examples.text: 没想到她随口一说的点子最后成了整期节目的亮点。
examples.trans: Who knew her offhand remark would become the highlight of the episode.

meanings.en: conveniently; right at hand without extra effort
meanings.note: Pinyin: suí shǒu. Literally 'following the hand' (随手关门).

examples.text: 志豪接干毛巾的时候随手放下的！
examples.trans: Hao set it down casually when he took the dry towel!

examples.text: 离开储藏室的时候请随手关灯。
examples.trans: Please turn off the light on your way out of the storeroom.

meanings.note: Pinyin: suí shí. Warm hospitality word (随时告诉我 'tell me anytime').

examples.text: 您好好休息，有事随时按铃。
examples.trans: Rest well, ma'am; ring the bell anytime if you need anything.

examples.text: 前台二十四小时有人，有事请随时按铃。
examples.trans: Reception is staffed around the clock—ring anytime you need help.

meanings.en: on one's person; carried with one
meanings.note: Pinyin: suí shēn. Literally 'following the body' (随身带着 'carry everywhere with you').

examples.text: 这么快就修好了？老陈你随身带着螺丝刀啊！
examples.trans: Fixed that fast? Chen, you carry a screwdriver everywhere on you!

examples.text: 坐火车旅行的时候，贵重物品要随身带好。
examples.trans: When traveling by train, keep valuables with you.

meanings.note: Reduplicated form of 随便.

examples.text: 现在的学生真幸福，随随便便就能跟偶像合影。
examples.trans: Students today have it easy—snapping photos with their idol effortlessly.

examples.text: 任何一档好节目都不是随随便便就能做出来的。
examples.trans: No great show is ever thrown together casually.

examples.text: 网上那些关于惠美的东西你看到了吧？说辛惠美隐婚。
examples.trans: You've seen everything circulating online about Huimei, right — claiming she is secretly married?

examples.text: 她就是结婚了对吧，还是隐婚？
examples.trans: Could she really have gotten married in secret?

examples.text: 爆炸性地公布了恋情，此前的隐婚传闻被证明为谣言。
examples.trans: With this bombshell romance announcement, the earlier secret-marriage rumors have been proven false.

meanings.note: Noun yǐnsī ('personal privacy').

examples.text: 你整天对人家八卦隐私那么感兴趣。
examples.trans: All day long you pry into other people's gossip and privacy.

examples.text: 媒体报道应当尊重受访者的个人隐私。
examples.trans: Media coverage should respect interviewees' personal privacy.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gé. Describes being separated by a wall, door, or interval of time (隔着).

examples.text: 小时候就住隔两条街。星期五对我来说……是重要日子。
examples.trans: Two streets over, when I was little. Friday for me... is an important day.

examples.text: 说这话的人每隔三十秒就扒着窗帘偷看一次！
examples.trans: Says the man peeking through the window curtain every thirty seconds!

meanings.note: Pinyin: gé bì. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 隔壁房间 ('the room next door').

examples.text: 隔壁的小洗手间呢？灯亮吗？
examples.trans: What about the small bathroom next door? Does the light work?

examples.text: 听到了！好像是隔壁洗手间的热水管响了。
examples.trans: I heard it! It sounded like the hot-water pipe in the bathroom next door.

related.gloss: the room next door (measure word 间)

meanings.note: Pinyin: gé yīn. Combines 隔 ('partition/block off') + 音 ('sound'); used as a noun or attributive modifier (隔音木板 'acoustic wooden panels').

examples.text: 晚上和周末，我们一起做木桌子和隔音木板！
examples.trans: Evenings and weekends, we are building wooden tables and acoustic panels together!

examples.text: 志豪设计的隔音木窗既好看，又能挡住街上的车声。
examples.trans: The soundproof wooden windows Hao designed look handsome and keep out the street traffic noise.

meanings.note: Noun zhàng'ài ('hurdle, obstacle').

examples.text: 等到钱一到位，邀请她就没有障碍了。
examples.trans: Once the money clears, there is no obstacle to inviting her.

examples.text: 沟通顺畅才能减少工作中的障碍。
examples.trans: Smooth communication removes obstacles at work.

meanings.note: Adjective nán ('difficult').

examples.text: 富豪大佬很难进得来。
examples.trans: Wealthy moguls would have a hard time getting inside.

examples.text: 万事开头难，只要坚持下去就会顺利。
examples.trans: Every beginning is hard, yet persistence smooths the way.

meanings.note: Potential complement nánbudǎo ('nothing can baffle').

examples.text: 不是什么都难不倒布小谷吗？
examples.trans: Can anything ever stump Bu Xiaogu?

examples.text: 这点小问题难不倒他。
examples.trans: A small problem like this will not stump him.

难不成.gloss: could it be that..., surely not...

meanings.en: could it be that..., surely not...
meanings.note: Colloquial rhetorical adverb nánbùchéng ('do you mean to say...?').

examples.text: 难不成咱们私下里去医院找他商量？
examples.trans: Could it be that we should go see him privately in hospital?

examples.text: 这么晚灯还亮着，难不成他们还在机房加班？
examples.trans: Lights are still on this late—could they still be working overtime?

难免.gloss: hard to avoid, bound to happen

meanings.en: hard to avoid, bound to happen
meanings.note: Adjective/adverb nánmiǎn ('inevitably').

examples.text: 如果只在内部强推改革，难免会伤感情。
examples.trans: Pushing reform purely internally is bound to bruise feelings.

examples.text: 第一次独立做策划，紧张也是难免的。
examples.trans: Feeling nervous on your first solo pitch is only natural.

难办.gloss: hard to handle, tricky, awkward to fix

meanings.en: hard to handle, tricky, awkward to fix
meanings.note: Colloquial adjective for thorny interpersonal or practical messes.

examples.text: 要是把合作方得罪了，后面的事就难办了。
examples.trans: If we offend our partners, things later on will get tricky.

examples.text: 这件事情确实有点难办，得慢慢商量。
examples.trans: This matter really is tricky and needs careful discussion.

meanings.note: Adjective nánshòu ('feeling sick or miserable').

examples.text: 上次他在路边难受成那样，是我送他回去的。
examples.trans: Last time he felt that sick outside, I got him home.

examples.text: 胃里难受的时候先喝点温水暖一暖。
examples.trans: Sip warm water whenever your stomach feels unwell.

难堪.gloss: painfully embarrassing, awkward, hard to bear

meanings.en: painfully embarrassing, awkward, hard to bear
meanings.note: Emotional distress from public awkwardness or betrayal.

examples.text: 那场突如其来的感情变故曾让年轻时的他陷入极度难堪的境地。
examples.trans: That sudden personal upheaval once left him in painful embarrassment.

examples.text: 体面的沟通能够给彼此留足余地，避免当众难堪。
examples.trans: Graceful communication leaves room for dignity and avoids embarrassment.

meanings.note: Noun nándù ('difficulty level').

examples.text: 我在思考这个原创节目立项的难度。
examples.trans: I was considering the difficulty of greenlighting this original show.

examples.text: 水下长镜头拍摄在技术上有相当大的难度。
examples.trans: Shooting long underwater takes poses high technical difficulty.

meanings.note: Adjective nándé ('rarely seen').

examples.text: 您居然也会忘事？真是难得。
examples.trans: Even you forget things sometimes? How rare!

examples.text: 今天是个难得的好天气。
examples.trans: Today is a rare stretch of lovely weather.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nán guài. Close cousin of 怪不得 ('hard to blame it—no wonder!').

examples.text: 难怪昨晚您在阁楼听街上有没有汽车声！
examples.trans: No wonder you listened in the attic last night for car sounds from the street!

examples.text: 甚至星期二您还打电话提过白纸包的事！
examples.trans: Even after you called us on Tuesday about the white parcel!

meanings.note: Colloquial adjective nángǎo ('tough to handle').

examples.text: 那两个嘉宾实在是太难搞了。
examples.trans: Those two guests are honestly impossible to handle.

examples.text: 采访对象是谁啊，怎么这么难搞？
examples.trans: Who is the interview guest that is proving so tough?

meanings.note: Adjective nánkàn ('unsightly, ungraceful').

examples.text: 一味跟风虽然赚了钱，但是吃相太难看。
examples.trans: Blind copycatting made money, yet it looks unseemly.

examples.text: 准备不足上台忘词，场面就会非常难看。
examples.trans: Forgetting lines onstage from poor prep looks awkward.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nán guò. Everyday adjective for feeling sad.

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

examples.text: 看到老房子能留下来，大家再也不难过了。
examples.trans: Seeing the old house saved, nobody felt sad anymore.

examples.text: 这把铜钥匙上面刻着四号，难道不是四号房的吗？
examples.trans: This brass key has the number four engraved on it—could it not be for room four?

examples.text: 外面的地面全都湿透了，难道夜里下过一场大雨？
examples.trans: The ground outside is completely soaked—could it have poured rain during the night?

集体待命.gloss: stand by together as a group

meanings.en: stand by together as a group
meanings.note: All performers or crew waiting ready in one place.

examples.text: 全体参赛歌手已经抵达后台，正在休息室集体待命。
examples.trans: All competing singers have arrived backstage and are standing by together.

examples.text: 为了应对突发降雨，工程组在场外集体待命。
examples.trans: To handle sudden rain, the engineering crew stood by together outside.

meanings.note: Verb jíhé ('assemble in one place').

examples.text: 大家都放下手里的活，所有人集合！
examples.trans: Everyone put down your tasks and gather round!

examples.text: 明天早上八点在公司楼下集合。
examples.trans: Assemble downstairs at the office at eight tomorrow.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jí shì. Traditional open-air neighbourhood or farmers' market (星期六集市 'Saturday market').

examples.text: 星期六一早，小晴和小美提着竹篮去逛集市。
examples.trans: First thing Saturday morning, Qing and Mei carry bamboo baskets to browse the street market.

examples.text: 集市上的本地蜂蜜和黄柠檬比超市新鲜多了。
examples.trans: Local honey and yellow lemons at the street market are much fresher than in supermarkets.

meanings.note: Pinyin: diāo. Used for carved wood or stone details.

examples.text: 拆开白纸……不会吧！爷爷亲手雕的木头火车头！
examples.trans: Unwrap the white paper... no way! Grandfather's hand-carved wooden locomotive!

examples.text: 木窗上雕着精致的花纹。
examples.trans: Delicate patterns are carved into the wooden window.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǔ. Measure word (量词): 场 (chǎng), e.g. 一场雨 ('a rain').

examples.text: 晚上好！先生，快进来避避雨吧。
examples.trans: Good evening! Sir, come inside quickly out of the rain.

examples.text: 啊……下这么大的雨，车站附近酒店全满了。
examples.trans: Ah... in rain this heavy, every hotel near the station was full.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǔ hòu. Measure word (量词): 场 (chǎng), e.g. 雨后清晨 ('a morning after rain').

examples.text: 小晴早！经理您好！雨后的早晨真晴朗。
examples.trans: Morning, Qing! Hello, Manager! How bright the morning is after the rain.

examples.text: 雨后的石板路干净得像洗过一样。
examples.trans: After the rain, the flagstones looked freshly washed.

related.gloss: a morning after rain (measure word 场)

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǔ shēng. Measure word (量词): 阵, e.g. 一阵雨声 ('the sound of rain').

examples.text: 听屋顶上的雨声，这儿真温馨！
examples.trans: Listen to the rain on the roof—it feels so cosy up here!

examples.text: 只有院子里的老树和雨声。
examples.trans: Only the old tree in the courtyard and the sound of rain.

related.gloss: the sound of rain (measure word 阵)

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǔ yè. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个雨夜 ('a rainy night').

examples.text: 一家雨夜修阁楼台灯、还替陌生人守箱子的客栈。
examples.trans: One that fixes attic lamps on a rainy night and guards a stranger's bag.

examples.text: 寒冷的雨夜里，一碗热蔬菜汤最暖心。
examples.trans: On a chilly rainy night, a bowl of hot vegetable soup warms the heart.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǔ shuǐ. Combines 雨 ('rain') + 水 ('water').

examples.text: 登记本上写着：整夜大雨，雨水滴到了阳光房的钢琴上。
examples.trans: In the guest book it reads: Heavy rain all night; rainwater dripped onto the sunroom piano.

examples.text: 院子石槽里的雨水把青石板冲刷得干干净净。
examples.trans: Rainwater in the courtyard stone channel washed the flagstones clean.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǔ diǎn. Combines 雨 ('rain') + 点 ('drop/dot').

examples.text: 快去拿灯笼，第一波大雨点已经掉下来了！
examples.trans: Grab the lantern quickly—the first big raindrops are already falling!

examples.text: 大颗的雨点敲在芭蕉叶上，发出清脆的声响。
examples.trans: Big raindrops pattered crisply onto the banana leaves.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xuě sōng. Literally 'snow pine' (雪 + 松); aromatic cedar wood prized for keepsake boxes that repel damp and moths.

examples.text: 那个装明信片的老盒子是用香喷喷的雪松木做的。
examples.trans: That old box holding the postcards is made of fragrant cedar wood.

examples.text: 打开雪松木盒，还能闻到淡淡的木头清香。
examples.trans: Opening the cedar box, you can still smell a faint, clean woody scent.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xuě bái. Vivid noun-adjective colour compound 雪 ('snow') + 白 ('white'), describing spotless shirts, linen, or porcelain.

examples.text: 老板，您身上穿着雪白的衬衫，小心别碰到湿油漆呀！
examples.trans: Boss, you are wearing a snow-white shirt—be careful not to brush against the wet paint!

examples.text: 四张方木桌上铺着雪白的亚麻桌布，衬得绿窗板格外好看。
examples.trans: Snow-white linen tablecloths cover the four square wooden tables, setting off the green shutters beautifully.

examples.text: 这是雪藏啊。
examples.trans: This is frozen.

examples.text: 那个雪藏好。
examples.trans: That frozen is good.

meanings.note: Pinyin: líng. Used in phone/room numbers and for zero placeholders inside larger numbers (一百零五).

examples.text: 看，已经十二点零四分了。也许他把明信片扔进垃圾桶了。
examples.trans: Look, it is twelve-oh-four already. Maybe he tossed the postcard into the bin.

examples.text: 房间号码是二百零四。
examples.trans: The room number is two-oh-four.

meanings.en: small change; coins and small bills
meanings.note: Pinyin: líng qián. Measure word (量词): 把 (bǎ), e.g. 一把零钱 ('a handful of small change').

examples.text: 在这儿！一共三十八块，找回十二块零钱。
examples.trans: Right here! Thirty-eight yuan in total, with twelve yuan back in change.

examples.text: 买早点最好备一点一块五块的零钱。
examples.trans: For morning street snacks, it helps to keep small bills and coins handy.

related.gloss: a handful of small change (measure word 把)

meanings.note: Pinyin: líng qián dài. Compound 零钱 ('small change / petty cash') + 袋 ('pouch/bag').

examples.text: 去集市买菜以前，别忘了带上桌上的小零钱袋。
examples.trans: Before heading to the market, don't forget to take the small cash pouch from the desk.

examples.text: 小晴把找回来的硬币全都放进了布零钱袋里。
examples.trans: Qing tucked all the coins from her change into the cloth coin purse.

meanings.note: Noun língshí ('packaged snacks').

examples.text: 这些零食和饮料一共是一千七百块。
examples.trans: These snacks and drinks come to 1,700 yuan.

examples.text: 休息间里放着巧克力和零食。
examples.trans: Chocolate and snacks are kept in the lounge.

meanings.note: Noun xūqiú ('need, request').

examples.text: 您要是有任何需求，尽管喊我就行。
examples.trans: If you have any need at all, just call me.

examples.text: 我们要了解观众的真实需求。
examples.trans: We need to understand viewers' real needs.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xū yào. Polite everyday verb and noun ('need').

examples.text: 太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
examples.trans: Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

examples.text: 凉？啊——对！老街水管早上需要慢慢热身！
examples.trans: Cool? Ah—yes! Old-street water pipes need a gentle morning warm-up!

meanings.note: Colloquial reading: lòu in 露出来 (peek or stick out into view); literary reading: lù (as in 透露, 露水).

examples.text: 看合页边露出来的折纸图纸——一楼画着一扇暗门！
examples.trans: Look at the folded blueprint sticking out of the hinge—a hidden door is drawn on the ground floor!

examples.text: 信封角上露出一张旧照片。
examples.trans: An old photo peeked out from the corner of the envelope.

meanings.note: Verb-complement lùchū ('let show on one's face').

examples.text: 老大刚刚露出了复仇之笑！
examples.trans: The boss just flashed a smile of revenge!

examples.text: 看到策划案通过，小谷脸上露出了笑容。
examples.trans: Seeing her pitch approved, Xiaogu broke into a smile.

meanings.note: Verb-object lòumiàn ('appear in public or on air').

examples.text: 星天娱乐所有的节目他们都不准露面。
examples.trans: They may not appear on any Xingtian programme.

examples.text: 解约风波之后，她今天第一次公开露面。
examples.trans: She made her first public appearance today since the dispute.

meanings.note: Noun qīngchūn ('youth').

examples.text: 勇气和青春结合到一起，往往什么都敢闯。
examples.trans: Put courage and youth together and you dare try anything.

examples.text: 这群幕后年轻人把最美好的青春献给了舞台。
examples.trans: These young crew members poured their brightest youth into TV.

examples.text: 就静静地待在那儿，他们有什么动静了你就来告诉我，前途不可限量。
examples.trans: Stay quietly right where you are, report every move they make back to me, and your future will be boundless.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Adverb fēi ('insist stubbornly on').

examples.text: 朋友们在旁边起哄，非让老大也喝一杯。
examples.trans: Friends egged him on, insisting our boss drink a glass too.

examples.text: 雨下得这么大，你非要今晚赶回去吗？
examples.trans: In rain this heavy, must you really rush back tonight?

meanings.note: Pinyin: fēi cháng. Stronger than 很 ('extremely quiet' 非常安静).

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

examples.text: 非常安静！不过刚才你听到奇怪的金属敲击声了吗？
examples.trans: Very quiet! Though did you hear a strange metallic knocking sound just now?

meanings.note: Strong modal expressing stubborn insistence.

examples.text: 医生让你休息，你为什么非要爬起来加班呢？
examples.trans: The doctor ordered rest—why must you insist on working?

examples.text: 没人拦着你，不是我非要跟你作对。
examples.trans: Nobody is stopping you; I am not out to oppose you.

meanings.note: Formal noun/verb fēiyì ('public criticism, carping').

examples.text: 他是幕后制作人，从来不怕被别人非议。
examples.trans: As a backstage producer, he never fears outside carping.

examples.text: 只要问心无愧，就不必在意无端的非议。
examples.trans: With a clear conscience, ignore groundless criticism.

meanings.en: lean against; be next to; rely on
meanings.note: Pinyin: kào. Describes sitting by the window (靠窗) or relying on luck (全靠运气).

examples.text: 全靠运气——加上星期一早上火车上拿错的蓝色行李箱！
examples.trans: Pure luck—plus one swapped blue suitcase on Monday morning's train!

examples.text: 她喜欢坐在靠窗的安静位置。
examples.trans: She likes sitting in the quiet spot by the window.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kào diàn. Combines 靠 ('lean against') + 垫 ('pad/cushion'); measure word: 个 (gè).

examples.text: 小美在厨房门口垫着柔软的靠垫，自豪地看完了审核的全过程。
examples.trans: With her ankle propped on a soft cushion in the kitchen doorway, Mei proudly watched the whole review.

examples.text: 阳光房的木椅子上放着亚麻布缝制的靠垫，坐起来非常舒服。
examples.trans: Linen-covered cushions rest on the wooden chairs in the sunroom, making them very comfortable to sit in.

meanings.note: Colloquial adj kàopǔ ('dependable, solid').

examples.text: 难免也会不靠谱一下，以后绝对不会了。
examples.trans: Even I slip up once in a while; it will never happen again.

examples.text: 凯文办事一向靠谱，交给他大家都很放心。
examples.trans: Kaiwen is always reliable, putting everyone at ease.

meanings.note: Verb kàojìn ('move closer to').

examples.text: 每次靠近他的时候，脚下总是荆棘遍地。
examples.trans: Whenever I step closer to him, thorns line the path.

examples.text: 直播开始前请不要靠近舞台边缘。
examples.trans: Please stay clear of the stage edge before air time.

meanings.note: Pinyin: miàn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一面 ('one side').

examples.text: 这面圆镜子挂哪儿？窗户左边还是右边？
examples.trans: Where should I hang this round mirror? Left of the window or right?

examples.text: 墙上挂着一面干净的大镜子。
examples.trans: A clean large mirror hangs on the wall.

meanings.note: Standing directly before challenges, choices, or pressure.

examples.text: 传统电视节目正面临着转型的挑战。
examples.trans: Traditional TV shows are facing the challenge of transformation.

examples.text: 这是我们团队目前面临的最大难题。
examples.trans: This is the biggest hurdle our team currently faces.

meanings.note: Locative noun miànqián ('right before someone').

examples.text: 负责任的人不是就在你面前吗？
examples.trans: Is the person responsible not standing right before you?

examples.text: 她在众人面前一点也不紧张。
examples.trans: She is not nervous at all in front of a crowd.

meanings.note: Pinyin: miàn bāo. Measure word (量词): 片 (piàn), e.g. 一片面包 ('a slice of bread').

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 闻闻看！热面包、热炒蛋，还有新鲜香草。
examples.trans: Smell that! Warm bread, hot scrambled eggs, and fresh herbs.

related.gloss: a slice of bread (measure word 片)

meanings.note: Pinyin: miàn bāo juǎn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个面包卷 ('a bread roll').

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

examples.text: 那是海盐咸黄油！甜果酱面包卷要无盐黄油！
examples.trans: That is sea-salt butter! Sweet jam rolls need unsalted butter!

meanings.note: Pinyin: miàn bāo shī. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位面包师 ('a baker').

examples.text: 看下一张：请给面包师和老师留两把角落的椅子。
examples.trans: Look at the next one: 'Please save two corner chairs for the baker and the teacher.'

examples.text: 这家店的面包师每天四点起床。
examples.trans: The baker at this shop gets up at four every day.

meanings.note: Pinyin: miànbāodiàn. Measure word: 家.

examples.text: 这家面包店的牛角包很好吃。
examples.trans: The croissants at this bakery are very delicious.

examples.text: 早上空气里飘着面包店的香味。
examples.trans: The smell of the bakery wafted through the morning air.

meanings.note: Pinyin: miàn bāo fáng. Combines 面包 ('bread') + 房 ('house/workshop/room'); measure word: 家 (jiā) or 间 (jiān).

examples.text: 小美笑着对志鹏和小晴说：“两位徒弟，我的面包房交给你们放心了！”
examples.trans: Mei smiled at Peng and Qing and said, 'Apprentices, I can rest easy leaving my bakery in your hands!'

examples.text: 每天早上六点，一楼的面包房就会飘出烤面包和黄油的香气。
examples.trans: Every morning at six o'clock, the aroma of baking bread and butter drifts from the ground-floor bakery.

meanings.note: Pinyin: miàn tuán. Measure word (量词): 团, e.g. 一团面团 ('a ball of dough').

examples.text: 还好烤箱里的面团已经放进去了。
examples.trans: My dough is already in the oven, at least.

examples.text: 揉好的面团放在温暖的地方醒发一小时。
examples.trans: Set the kneaded dough in a warm spot to rise for an hour.

related.gloss: a ball of dough (measure word 团)

meanings.note: Noun miànzi ('social face, dignity').

examples.text: 你不用谢我刚才在会上给你留面子。
examples.trans: Do not thank me for sparing your face in the meeting.

examples.text: 大家都是老同事，说话还是要留点面子。
examples.trans: Among old colleagues, leave everyone a bit of face.

meanings.note: Noun miànkǒng ('face, true visage').

examples.text: 他一次次带我看到他更真实的面孔。
examples.trans: Again and again he showed me his truer face.

examples.text: 今年总编室来了好几张年轻的新面孔。
examples.trans: Several young new faces joined the office this year.

meanings.note: Verb miànduì ('face squarely').

examples.text: 他们要面对最现实的每一天。
examples.trans: They have to face the most realistic everyday challenges.

examples.text: 用平静的表情面对困难。
examples.trans: Face difficulties with a calm expression.

meanings.note: Pinyin: miàn duì miàn. Used before verbs of talking or sitting.

examples.text: 小晴，隔着玻璃看——他们俩在树下面对面站着呢！
examples.trans: Qing, look through the glass—the two of them are standing face to face under the tree!

examples.text: 有什么误会，坐下来面对面说清楚最好。
examples.trans: Whatever the misunderstanding, sitting down face to face clears it up best.

meanings.note: Pinyin: miàn bǎn. Compound 面 ('surface/face') + 板 ('plate/board'): flat cover plate of a wall switch or control panel.

examples.text: 铜开关面板用两颗小螺丝紧紧固定在砖墙上。
examples.trans: The brass switch faceplate is fastened tightly against the brick wall with two small screws.

examples.text: 装好灯以后，老陈用干布擦亮了开关面板。
examples.trans: After installing the lamp, Chen polished the switch plate bright with a dry cloth.

meanings.note: Idiom miànmù-quánfēi ('utterly altered from the original').

examples.text: 原本成熟的模式现在已经被改得面目全非了。
examples.trans: The proven original format has been changed beyond recognition.

examples.text: 初稿被外行乱改一通之后，变得面目全非。
examples.trans: After careless edits by outsiders, the draft was unrecognizable.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a noun used in conversational Mandarin. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个面糊 ('a 面糊').

examples.text: 我有一个面糊。
examples.trans: I have a 面糊.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的面糊。
examples.trans: This is a very good 面糊.

meanings.note: Verb/noun miànshì ('job interview').

examples.text: 我天天加班，哪有时间去别的公司面试？
examples.trans: Working overtime daily, when would I interview elsewhere?

examples.text: 明天上午她有一场重要的面试。
examples.trans: She has an important interview tomorrow morning.

meanings.note: Formal verb/noun géxīn ('innovate from the ground up').

examples.text: 必须从基本的规则开始完全革新。
examples.trans: We must innovate thoroughly starting from the core rules.

examples.text: 数字技术带来了电视制作流程的全面革新。
examples.trans: Digital tech brought sweeping innovation to TV workflows.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xié. Measure word (量词): 双 (shuāng), e.g. 一双鞋 ('a pair of shoes').

examples.text: 我可不穿四十四码的鞋！
examples.trans: I certainly do not wear size forty-four shoes!

examples.text: 为什么把鞋和木头小火车留到星期五呢？
examples.trans: Why leave the shoes and little wooden train here until Friday?

related.gloss: a pair of shoes (measure word 双)

meanings.note: Pinyin: xié zi. Combines 鞋 ('shoe') + noun suffix 子; measure word: 双 (shuāng, pair) or 只 (zhī, single); verbs: 穿 ('put on/wear'), 脱 ('take off').

examples.text: 我从矮凳往下迈的时候，右脚鞋子在横档上滑了一下。
examples.trans: When I stepped down from the low stool, my right shoe slipped on the bottom rung.

examples.text: 进屋以前，大家都在门口的垫子上把鞋子底下的雨水擦干。
examples.trans: Before stepping indoors, everyone wiped the rainwater off the soles of their shoes on the doormat.

鞠.gloss: bow (the body in respect, in 鞠躬)

meanings.en: bow (the body in respect, in 鞠躬)
meanings.note: Pinyin: jū. Verb component of the separable compound 鞠躬 ('to bow'); takes aspect/measure words before 躬 (鞠个躬 'take a bow').

examples.text: 周经理，快鞠个躬，笑着把菜单卡片发给大家吧！
examples.trans: Take a bow, Manager Zhou, and hand out the menu cards to everyone with a smile!

examples.text: 小美笑着给鼓掌的邻居们鞠了个躬。
examples.trans: Smiling, Mei took a bow for the applauding neighbours.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yīn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个音 ('a musical note').

examples.text: 当然记得！每到星期五弹错一个音，他就对着墙皱眉头。
examples.trans: Of course I remember! Every Friday when he missed a note, he frowned at the wall.

examples.text: 这架老钢琴每个音都很准。
examples.trans: Every note on this old piano is right in tune.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yīn yuè. Measure word (量词): 首 (shǒu), e.g. 一首音乐 ('a piece of music').

examples.text: 一点回声也没有！木头和玻璃让音乐更好听。
examples.trans: No echo at all! Wood and glass make music sound even better.

examples.text: 每个星期五六点！整条街的人都来这儿喝茶听音乐！
examples.trans: Every Friday at six! People from the whole street came here for tea and music!

related.gloss: a piece of music (measure word 首)

meanings.note: Pinyin: yīn yuè tīng. Measure word (量词): 座 (zuò), e.g. 一座音乐厅 ('a concert hall').

examples.text: 声学建筑师！您设计音乐厅吗？
examples.trans: An acoustic architect! Do you design concert halls?

examples.text: 成都城市音乐厅离这条老街只有三站路。
examples.trans: Chengdu Concert Hall is only three stops from this historic street.

examples.text: 改流程吧，让音乐组把伴奏准备出来。
examples.trans: Update the rundown and have the music team prepare the backing track.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yīn fú. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个音符 ('a musical note').

examples.text: 安静极了！他坐在第三级台阶上，听每一个音符。
examples.trans: So quiet! He sat on the third step, listening to every single note.

examples.text: 旧乐谱上的每一个音符都是手写的。
examples.trans: Every musical note on the vintage score was written by hand.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yīn jiē. Measure word (量词): 段, e.g. 一段音阶 ('a musical scale').

examples.text: 哥哥性格爽朗声音大，弹音阶总是急匆匆的。
examples.trans: The older brother was bold and loud, always rushing through his scales.

examples.text: 我还在等你把音阶慢慢弹稳呢，志鹏！
examples.trans: Still waiting for you to play your scales slowly and steadily, Zhipeng!

meanings.note: Media noun yīnpín ('audio track/channel').

examples.text: 现场所有的音频，该调好的提前调好。
examples.trans: Make sure every studio audio channel is tuned ahead of time.

examples.text: 导出成片之前请仔细核对视频和音频是否同步。
examples.trans: Check audio-video sync carefully before exporting the master.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yè. Counts pages directly without 个 (第二页 'page two').

examples.text: 当然不能偷看……咦，自己翻开在中间那页了！
examples.trans: Of course we must not peek... oh, it fell open to the middle page by itself!

examples.text: 仔细看这一页——记的是分贝和安静度，不是酒店星级！
examples.trans: Look closely at this page—it records decibels and quietness, not hotel stars!

meanings.note: Verb dǐng ('cover a post temporarily; withstand').

examples.text: 总编室真的得找个人来顶你的班。
examples.trans: The office really must find someone to cover your post.

examples.text: 关键时刻多亏有前辈在前面顶着。
examples.trans: At the crunch moment, senior staff held the line.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dǐng shang. Combines 顶 ('summit/crown/top') + neutral-tone locality suffix 上.

examples.text: 我和志豪站在木梯子上，正好能够到顶上的拱窗。
examples.trans: Standing on the wooden ladder, Hao and I can reach the arched window at the top.

examples.text: 书架顶上放着一只装旧照片的木盒子。
examples.trans: On top of the bookcase sits a wooden box of old photographs.

顶包.gloss: take the rap/fall for someone else

meanings.en: take the rap/fall for someone else
meanings.note: Colloquial verb for stepping in as a scapegoat.

examples.text: 这件大事由我自己承担，用不着你跑出来替我顶包！
examples.trans: I bear this myself—no need for you to take the fall for me!

examples.text: 监控拍得清清楚楚，谁想替他顶包都没用。
examples.trans: Security cameras caught it clearly, so nobody can take the rap for him.

meanings.note: Colloquial adverb dǐngduō ('at the very most').

examples.text: 就算再努力，在这方面顶多也只能打个平手。
examples.trans: Even going all out, at best we fight to a draw there.

examples.text: 从公司走到茶馆顶多只要十分钟。
examples.trans: Walking from the office to the teahouse takes ten minutes at most.

examples.text: 这次的事董事长都未必顶得住。
examples.trans: Even our chairwoman may not be able to weather a storm this big.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dǐng lóu. Measure word (量词): 层 (céng), e.g. 最顶楼 ('the top floor').

examples.text: 老砖房顶楼平时要等很久水才热。
examples.trans: Top floors in old brick houses usually wait ages before the water warms up.

examples.text: 顶楼阁楼有一扇朝南看院子的木窗。
examples.trans: The top-floor attic has a wooden window looking south over the courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dǐng dēng. Compound 顶 ('ceiling/top') + 灯 ('lamp'). Measure word: 盏 (zhǎn).

examples.text: 九号房的磨砂玻璃顶灯一亮，整间屋子都暖洋洋的。
examples.trans: Once Room Nine's frosted-glass ceiling lamp lights up, the whole room glows warmly.

examples.text: 睡觉以前记得关掉客厅的顶灯，只留小台灯。
examples.trans: Remember to turn off the living-room ceiling light before bed and leave just the small desk lamp.

meanings.note: Classifier xiàng for projects, tasks, or policies.

examples.text: 负责这项工作的同事前两天离职了。
examples.trans: The colleague handling this task left two days ago.

examples.text: 公司今年启动了三项新计划。
examples.trans: The company launched three new initiatives this year.

meanings.note: Noun xiàngmù ('work project').

examples.text: 项目大，最忌讳的是管理分散。
examples.trans: When a project is huge, scattered management is taboo.

examples.text: 下周我们启动新项目。
examples.trans: We launch the new project next week.

meanings.note: Ranking noun shùnwèi ('order of priority').

examples.text: 在阵容安排上，我们的第一顺位是荣先生。
examples.trans: In our lineup plan, Mr Rong Silun was our first-choice pick.

examples.text: 按照积分排名决定下一轮歌手的出场顺位。
examples.trans: Point standings decide the singers' performance order next round.

顺便.gloss: along the way; while at it; conveniently

meanings.en: along the way; while at it; conveniently
meanings.note: Pinyin: shùn biàn. Placed before a second action done conveniently on the same trip without an extra detour.

examples.text: 你去集市买柠檬的时候，顺便帮我买一卷黑胶带吧。
examples.trans: While you're at the market buying lemons, pick up a roll of black tape for me along the way.

examples.text: 我下楼拿快递，顺便把院子里的花浇了。
examples.trans: I went downstairs to pick up a parcel and watered the courtyard flowers while I was at it.

meanings.note: Adjective shùnlì ('smooth, unhindered').

examples.text: 这次一定要让嘉宾顺利上我们的节目。
examples.trans: We must get the guests onto our show smoothly this time.

examples.text: 祝今天下午的录影一切顺利！
examples.trans: Wishing this afternoon's studio taping smooth sailing!

meanings.note: Arrangement of items one after another.

examples.text: 请按照单子上的先后顺序逐一核对准备工作。
examples.trans: Please check off preparations in the exact sequence on the sheet.

examples.text: 歌手明晚出场的顺序将由现场抽签决定。
examples.trans: The order singers perform tomorrow night will be drawn by lot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shùn zhe. Preposition 顺 ('follow along in the same direction') + continuous particle 着 (顺着走廊吹 'blow down the hallway', 顺着木纹刷 'brush along the wood grain').

examples.text: 小晴顺着木纹薄薄地刷油漆，刷出来的窗板又平整又漂亮。
examples.trans: Qing brushed the paint thinly along the wood grain, giving the shutters a smooth, even finish.

examples.text: 顺着梧桐巷的青石板路一直往前走，就能看见九号房的木牌。
examples.trans: Walk straight along the flagstones of Wutong Lane and you will spot the wooden sign for Room Nine.

examples.text: 职场里边很复杂，你听我的，先顾自己。
examples.trans: Inside the workplace things are complicated; listen to me and look after yourself first.

examples.text: 这是顾。
examples.trans: This is 顾.

meanings.note: Personal awkwardness or concern holding someone back.

examples.text: 大家都是自己人，有什么话尽管说，别有顾忌。
examples.trans: We are all on the same side—speak freely without hesitation.

examples.text: 你是不是对她有什么顾忌，才不愿开口？
examples.trans: Do you have some misgiving about her that keeps you from asking?

meanings.note: Pinyin: dùn. Counts meals (一顿早餐 'a breakfast', 一顿晚饭 'a dinner').

examples.text: 太好了！现在我想吃一顿丰盛的早餐。
examples.trans: Wonderful! Now I would like to eat a big breakfast.

examples.text: 我们一起吃了一顿丰盛的晚饭。
examples.trans: We had a hearty dinner together.

meanings.note: Short promotional preview of an upcoming show or film.

examples.text: 新节目的第一支预告片刚上线就登上了热搜榜。
examples.trans: The show's first trailer hit the trending chart right after release.

examples.text: 剪辑师花了一整周打磨这支两分钟的预告片。
examples.trans: The editor spent a full week polishing this two-minute trailer.

meanings.note: Adjective/verb yùdìng ('scheduled in advance').

examples.text: 距离总决赛开播预定时间不到两个小时了。
examples.trans: Less than two hours remain until the scheduled finale airtime.

examples.text: 直播车按照预定路线准时抵达了中心广场。
examples.trans: The broadcast van reached central plaza on schedule along its route.

examples.text: 此次严重侵权事件恐将打击星天信誉价值，实际造成的损失尚不可预期。
examples.trans: This serious infringement case threatens Xingtian's reputation, and the full financial losses remain unpredictable.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yù suàn. Compound 预 ('in advance') + 算 ('calculate'): planned spending limit.

examples.text: 今天集市打折，买齐所有东西还比预算省了三十块！
examples.trans: With today's market discounts, buying everything on our list still came in thirty yuan under budget!

examples.text: 小晴把每一笔支出都清清楚楚地记在预算本上。
examples.trans: Qing recorded every single expense clearly in the budget notebook.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yù yán. Joins 预 ('beforehand') + 言 ('words, to speak'). Can also function as a noun.

examples.text: 制图员教授当年预言，这棵银杏树会长得比屋顶还高。
examples.trans: The mapmaker professor predicted back then that this ginkgo tree would grow taller than the roof.

examples.text: 没想到那个古老的预言今天竟然成真了。
examples.trans: Unexpectedly, that ancient prophecy has actually come true today.

meanings.note: Noun/verb yùjǐng ('official warning alert').

examples.text: 市气象台的暴雨预警刚刚升级为红色预警！
examples.trans: The city weather bureau just upgraded the storm alert to red!

examples.text: 户外大型活动必须建立完善的极端天气预警机制。
examples.trans: Large outdoor events need robust extreme-weather alert plans.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yù dìng. Works as both verb and noun at hotels/restaurants.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 完了！昨天我没戴眼镜，在平板上接了电话预订！
examples.trans: Disaster! Yesterday without my glasses I took a phone booking on the tablet!

领先.gloss: lead, stay ahead in first place

meanings.en: lead, stay ahead in first place
meanings.note: Holding the top position in ratings or technology.

examples.text: 凭借多档现象级节目，这家年轻公司在业内一直保持领先位置。
examples.trans: Backed by hit shows, this young firm holds a leading spot in the field.

examples.text: 上半场投票结束时，三号歌手以微弱优势暂时领先。
examples.trans: At halftime voting, Singer Three held a narrow lead.

meanings.note: Verb lǐngyǎng ('legally adopt').

examples.text: 他幼年被一对善良的法国夫妇领养了。
examples.trans: As a young child he was adopted by a kind couple in France.

examples.text: 小谷周末常去流浪动物中心看望待领养的小猫。
examples.trans: On weekends Xiaogu visits kittens awaiting adoption at the shelter.

meanings.note: Literal territory or figurative personal sphere.

examples.text: 每个人的内心都有一块属于自己的领地。
examples.trans: Everyone has a private territory inside their heart.

examples.text: 他对工作和生活都有着不容打扰的领地。
examples.trans: In both work and life he guards a territory not to be disturbed.

meanings.note: Noun lǐngyù ('professional or cultural field').

examples.text: 两国在文化领域上的合作愈加频繁。
examples.trans: Cooperation between the two nations in culture grows frequent.

examples.text: 淳于乔在音乐综艺领域拥有极高的声望。
examples.trans: Chun Yuqiao commands high prestige in music variety TV.

examples.text: 最重要的部门还是这边，淳于乔领导的制作部。
examples.trans: Still, the most important department is right here: the production unit led by Chun Yuqiao.

examples.text: 这是领导。 (Example)
examples.trans: This is 领导.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǐng dài. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条领带 ('a necktie').

examples.text: 天哪！桌子上一滴没洒……全洒在我领带上了！
examples.trans: Good heavens! Not a drop spilled on the table... it all spilled on my tie!

examples.text: 小晴，今天我的领带怎么样？一滴橙汁都没有！
examples.trans: Qing, how does my tie look today? Not a single drop of orange juice!

领教.gloss: experience firsthand (someone's tough methods); ask advice

meanings.en: experience firsthand (someone's tough methods); ask advice
meanings.note: Often used ironically after witnessing someone's formidable skill.

examples.text: 早听说你办事果断狠辣，今天我总算真正领教了。
examples.trans: I heard how ruthless and decisive you are—today I saw it firsthand.

examples.text: 有机会一定向各位前辈好好领教节目制作的经验。
examples.trans: Given the chance, I hope to learn production craft from our seniors.

颇深.gloss: quite deep, considerable (of impressions, ties, or misunderstandings)

meanings.en: quite deep, considerable (of impressions, ties, or misunderstandings)
meanings.note: Polished literary modifier placed after nouns like 误解 or 渊源.

examples.text: 两位老员工与新主管素来不合，彼此之间的成见与误解颇深。
examples.trans: Never seeing eye to eye, the veterans and new head had deep misgivings.

examples.text: 这位老教授与传媒学院的几代毕业生都有着颇深的渊源。
examples.trans: The veteran professor has deep ties with generations of media graduates.

meanings.note: Adjective pínfán ('occurring often').

examples.text: 这几年文化领域上的交流合作愈加频繁。
examples.trans: Cultural exchanges in recent years have grown ever more frequent.

examples.text: 直播前机位切换不能过于频繁，免得观众眼花。
examples.trans: Avoid switching cameras too frequently during live songs.

meanings.note: Adverb pínpín ('frequently, repeatedly').

examples.text: 最近有人在电视上吵架，并且频频提到我的名字。
examples.trans: People argued on TV lately and repeatedly mentioned my name.

examples.text: 台下观众频频点头，表示非常赞同。
examples.trans: Audience members nodded repeatedly in agreement.

颗.gloss: measure word for small round things

meanings.en: measure word for small round things
meanings.note: Pinyin: kē. Counts stars, pearls, beans, buttons, and hearts (一颗星 'a star').

examples.text: 老房子每到星期二就松一颗螺丝。坐吧。
examples.trans: Every Tuesday an old house loosens one screw. Sit down.

examples.text: 小盘子里放着五颗新鲜草莓。
examples.trans: Five fresh strawberries sit on the small plate.

meanings.note: Title of an essay/thesis or exam item.

examples.text: 她硕士毕业论文的题目关注的是本土电视创新。
examples.trans: Her master's thesis title focuses on original domestic TV innovation.

examples.text: 演讲开始前，主持人先念出了今天讨论的题目。
examples.trans: Before the talk began, the host read out today's topic.

meanings.note: Modern Mandarin term for visual appeal of actors.

examples.text: 那位年轻演员不仅颜值出众，扎实的台词功底更让人佩服。
examples.trans: Beyond standout screen presence, the actor has impressive line delivery.

examples.text: 观众选角既看重演员的颜值，更看重角色塑造的演技。
examples.trans: Viewers care about screen appeal and even more about real acting.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yán sè. Combines 颜 ('countenance/hue') + 色 ('colour/tint'); measure word: 种 (zhǒng).

examples.text: 你看我搅动铁罐里的颜色——就像梧桐树叶那样的深绿色！
examples.trans: Look at the colour in the tin when I stir it—deep green just like wutong leaves!

examples.text: 刷完两遍油漆以后，绿窗板的颜色在阳光下显得温暖又明亮。
examples.trans: After two coats of paint, the colour of the green shutters looks warm and bright in the sunlight.

meanings.note: Pinyin: é tóu. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个额头 ('a forehead').

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

examples.text: 笔挺又干净，周经理！连眼镜都戴在鼻子上，没在额头上。
examples.trans: Crisp and spotless, Manager Zhou! Even your glasses are on your nose instead of your forehead.

meanings.note: Verb diānfù ('upend, completely reverse').

examples.text: 黑白在灰度对局之下有时是完全颠覆的。
examples.trans: Black and white can sometimes invert completely in grey matches.

examples.text: 这个新颖的赛制彻底颠覆了传统音乐节目。
examples.trans: This fresh format upended traditional music shows.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fēng. Measure word (量词): 阵, e.g. 一阵风 ('a gust of wind').

examples.text: 热汤？在冷雨中走过来之后，这听起来太棒了。
examples.trans: Hot soup? After that cold walk in the rain, that sounds wonderful.

examples.text: 春天下午的风又轻又暖。
examples.trans: The spring afternoon breeze is gentle and warm.

related.gloss: a gust of wind (measure word 阵)

examples.text: 乔木这首歌非常充满东方风味，我觉得这是上天赐给你不二的选择。
