examples.trans: This song Arbor brims with Eastern poetic charm; I believe it is a match made in heaven for you.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Noun fēngshēng (as in 走漏风声, 'leak word').

examples.text: 是你们自己走漏了风声，才让我有了线索。
examples.trans: Your own team leaked word of it, giving me the trail.

examples.text: 新节目的嘉宾阵容目前一点风声都没露。
examples.trans: Not a whisper of the new guest lineup has leaked yet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fēng shàn. Combines 风 ('wind/breeze') + 扇 ('fan'); measure word: 台 (tái).

examples.text: 小晴问志豪：“这台小风扇应该朝哪儿吹呢？”
examples.trans: Qing asked Hao, 'Where should we point this small fan?'

examples.text: 走廊里开着小风扇，干爽的微风稳稳吹过刚刷好漆的木窗板。
examples.trans: With the small fan running in the hallway, a steady dry breeze blew across the freshly painted wooden shutters.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fēng jǐng. Measure word (量词): 片 (piàn), e.g. 一片好风景 ('a lovely view').

examples.text: 有，结实的木床、干净书桌，风景全院最好。
examples.trans: Yes, a solid wooden bed, a clean desk, and the best view in the courtyard.

examples.text: 从三楼窗户往外看，老街风景美极了。
examples.trans: Looking out from the third-floor window, the view of the old lane is lovely.

meanings.note: Noun fēngjǐngqū ('scenic resort zone').

examples.text: 对手外景地选在广西风景区，今天天气晴朗。
examples.trans: Our rival's shoot is at a Guangxi scenic area with sunny skies.

examples.text: 新一季旅行真人秀计划前往西南山水风景区取景。
examples.trans: The next travel show plans to film across southwestern scenic spots.

examples.text: 由此引发的股东内部分歧与高管层问责风暴，可能是比侵权本身更为严重的企业危机。
examples.trans: The resulting shareholder rifts and executive accountability storm may prove even deadlier than the lawsuit itself.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fēng gé. Joins 风 ('wind, custom') + 格 ('pattern, standard').

examples.text: 小美新做的蛋糕充满了法式甜点的风格。
examples.trans: Mei's newly baked cake is full of French dessert style.

examples.text: 客栈的装修保留了老成都传统的建筑风格。
examples.trans: The inn's renovation preserves the traditional architectural style of old Chengdu.

meanings.note: General atmosphere and habits of a group or company.

examples.text: 这家创意公司一向鼓励自由表达，内部讨论风气非常开放。
examples.trans: Encouraging free expression, this creative studio has an open culture.

examples.text: 严明公正的奖惩制度有助于树立风清气正的团队风气。
examples.trans: Fair rules foster an upright, healthy team culture.

meanings.note: Major cultural or industry movement.

examples.text: 他早年制作的音乐选秀在电视界掀起了一股全新的审美风潮。
examples.trans: His early music talent shows set a fresh creative trend across television.

examples.text: 盲目跟随市场风潮不如沉下心来开创属于自己的新形态。
examples.trans: Better to pioneer fresh formats than blindly chase market trends.

风生水起.gloss: thriving with flair, going from strength to strength

meanings.en: thriving with flair, going from strength to strength
meanings.note: Idiom describing someone running business or projects brilliantly.

examples.text: 他在欧洲版权引进领域人脉极广，这几年把改版节目做得风生水起。
examples.trans: Well-connected in European licensing, he ran format remakes with flair.

examples.text: 几个年轻人合伙创办的工作室如今在业内干得风生水起。
examples.trans: The studio co-founded by those young creators is now thriving.

meanings.note: Noun fēngxiǎn ('risk, hazard').

examples.text: 淳于总觉得这个红毯方案有点风险。
examples.trans: Chun Yuqiao feels this red-carpet proposal carries risk.

examples.text: 直播前要提前排除所有风险。
examples.trans: Eliminate every risk ahead of a live broadcast.

风雨.gloss: wind and rain, storm; trials and hardships

meanings.en: wind and rain, storm; trials and hardships
meanings.note: Noun fēngyǔ ('wind and rain; storms of life').

examples.text: 不管狂暴的风雨在这个黑夜里如何肆虐。
examples.trans: However fiercely wind and rain rage through this dark night.

examples.text: 一路走来历经风雨，团队之间的默契更加深厚。
examples.trans: Having weathered storms together, the team's bond grew deeper.

风靡全球.gloss: sweep the globe, become a worldwide sensation

meanings.en: sweep the globe, become a worldwide sensation
meanings.note: Idiom for international cultural hits.

examples.text: 那档源自英国的音乐真人秀在短短两年内迅速风靡全球。
examples.trans: That British music reality format swept the globe within two years.

examples.text: 融合传统美学的优秀原创内容同样有机会走向海外、风靡全球。
examples.trans: Original shows rooted in local aesthetics can go global too.

meanings.note: Pinyin: piāo. Describes music, fragrance, leaves, or clouds floating gently through the air (飘出去 'drift out', 飘到树底下 'float out under the tree').

examples.text: 把对着院子的两扇拱窗敞开吧，让钢琴声飘到外面的梧桐巷去。
examples.trans: Open wide the two arched windows facing the courtyard so the piano music can drift out to Wutong Lane.

examples.text: 开头的四个音符从阳光房飘出来，一直飘到院子的大树底下。
examples.trans: The opening four notes floated out from the sunroom all the way under the big courtyard tree.

examples.text: 很多歌迷听到这个消息无比振奋，观众对十二歌王的期待值正在飙升。
examples.trans: Countless music fans are thrilled by the news, and audience anticipation for Twelve Singers is skyrocketing.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 上个月你三天绕地球飞了一整圈，回来开电话会议，中文英文一个字没错过。
examples.trans: Last month you flew around the globe in three days and took a bilingual conference call without missing a single word!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 我在飞机上已经看过了，基本能过。
examples.trans: I already read it on the plane; overall it passes.

examples.text: 我在飞机上已经看过了，基本能过。
examples.trans: I already read it on the plane; overall it passes.

meanings.note: Noun shípǐn ('prepared food items').

examples.text: 休息间里准备好了一些食品和饮品。
examples.trans: Some food and drinks are ready in the lounge.

examples.text: 购买食品要注意保质期。
examples.trans: Check expiration dates when buying food.

examples.text: 这是食物啊。
examples.trans: This is food.

examples.text: 那个食物好。
examples.trans: That food is good.

meanings.note: Workplace noun cānquàn ('staff meal ticket').

examples.text: 我让行政给你多加了一份员工餐券。
examples.trans: I had administration add an extra staff meal voucher for you.

examples.text: 新员工凭工牌和餐券就可以在食堂用餐。
examples.trans: New staff dine in the canteen with their badge and meal voucher.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cān jīn. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张餐巾 ('a napkin').

examples.text: 小勺子和餐巾放在哪里？
examples.trans: Where do the small spoons and napkins go?

examples.text: 每个蓝杯子旁边放一张餐巾和一把小勺子。
examples.trans: Beside every blue cup, put one napkin and one small spoon.

meanings.note: Noun fàn ('meal, food').

examples.text: 到饭点了，快把饭送这儿来。
examples.trans: It is mealtime; bring the meals over here.

examples.text: 忙了一上午，先去吃口热饭吧。
examples.trans: After a busy morning, go have a hot meal first.

meanings.note: Colloquial slang noun fàntǒng ('useless person').

examples.text: 咱们仨也不是饭桶，这事必须扛下来。
examples.trans: The three of us are no slouches; we must carry this through.

examples.text: 谁说新人干不了大事？咱们绝不当混日子的饭桶。
examples.trans: Who says rookies cannot deliver? We refuse to be dead weight.

meanings.note: Colloquial noun fàndiǎn ('lunchtime or dinnertime').

examples.text: 已经到饭点了，大家先吃饭吧。
examples.trans: It is lunchtime already; everyone eat first.

examples.text: 一到饭点，楼下的餐厅就坐满了。
examples.trans: Come mealtime, restaurants downstairs fill right up.

meanings.note: Noun yǐnpǐn ('drinks, beverages').

examples.text: 桌上放着新鲜的水果和饮品。
examples.trans: Fresh fruit and drinks are on the table.

examples.text: 您想喝点什么热饮品？
examples.trans: What warm beverage would you like?

meanings.note: Noun yǐnliào ('bottled drink, beverage').

examples.text: 台上的冠名饮料摆错了品牌。
examples.trans: The sponsor drinks onstage are the wrong brand.

examples.text: 小谷买了很多零食和饮料给大家。
examples.trans: Xiaogu bought plenty of snacks and drinks for everyone.

meanings.note: Noun yǐnshí ('dietary habits').

examples.text: 我只核对了米娜一个人的饮食习惯。
examples.trans: I only verified Mina's own dietary habits.

examples.text: 胃不好的人平时一定要注意规律饮食。
examples.trans: Anyone with a sensitive stomach should keep regular eating habits.

meanings.note: Adjective bǎo ('satisfied after eating').

examples.text: 没事，大家先一起吃饱吧。
examples.trans: It is fine; everyone eat your fill together first.

examples.text: 晚饭吃得太饱睡不着觉。
examples.trans: Eating too much at dinner makes it hard to sleep.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bǐng gān. Combines 饼 ('flat baked cake') + 干 (gān, 'dry'): dry baked biscuits or cookies.

examples.text: 小美烤了一盘温热酥脆的杏仁饼干配薄荷茶。
examples.trans: Mei baked a tray of warm, crisp almond biscuits to go with mint tea.

examples.text: 把剩下的饼干收进铁盒里，明天吃还是脆的。
examples.trans: Store the remaining biscuits in a tin so they stay crisp tomorrow.

meanings.note: Pinyin: è. Describes feeling hungry (饿了 'got hungry').

examples.text: 七点半有八位饿肚子的客人下楼啊！
examples.trans: At seven thirty, eight hungry guests are coming downstairs!

examples.text: 忙了一上午，肚子真有点饿了。
examples.trans: After a busy morning, I am getting hungry.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a verb used in conversational Mandarin.

examples.text: 我有一个馋。
examples.trans: I have a 馋.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的馋。
examples.trans: This is a very good 馋.

首.gloss: measure word for songs and poems

meanings.en: measure word for songs and poems
meanings.note: Pinyin: shǒu. Counts songs, poems, and pieces of music (一首歌 'a song').

examples.text: 老陈，好好修一次老钢琴，它会记得每一首歌。
examples.trans: Chen, repair an old piano properly once, and it will remember every song.

examples.text: 宋老师给我们弹了一首老歌。
examples.trans: Teacher Song played an old song for us.

meanings.note: Adverb shǒuxiān ('first, to begin with').

examples.text: 首先，有请今晚的神秘嘉宾出场。
examples.trans: First, please welcome tonight's mystery guest.

examples.text: 做事前首先要定好计划。
examples.trans: First set a clear plan before acting.

examples.text: 旧皮箱的铜扣上刻着主人名字的首字母。
examples.trans: The initials of the owner's name are engraved on the brass clasp of the old leather trunk.

examples.text: 请在这份确认单的右下角签上您姓名的首字母。
examples.trans: Please sign your initials in the lower right corner of this confirmation slip.

meanings.note: Executive title shǒuxí nèiróngguān ('Chief Content Officer').

examples.text: 恭喜您升任星天的首席内容官！
examples.trans: Congratulations on your promotion to Chief Content Officer!

examples.text: 首席内容官负责把关公司所有核心节目的品质。
examples.trans: The Chief Content Officer oversees quality across all flagship shows.

meanings.note: Lead showbiz journalist at a media outlet.

examples.text: 写这篇报道的是路条网最著名的首席娱记。
examples.trans: This piece was written by Lutiao's best-known chief showbiz reporter.

examples.text: 首席娱记往往掌握着圈内第一手的独家消息。
examples.trans: A chief entertainment reporter often holds firsthand exclusives.

examples.text: 十二歌王第三季，辛惠美战队的首秀即将登场！
examples.trans: In Season Three of Twelve Singers, Team Xin Huimei's debut performance is about to take the stage!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Noun shǒuxuǎn ('top preference').

examples.text: 毕业生的首选工作一般是在电视台。
examples.trans: Graduates' first-choice job is usually at a TV network.

examples.text: 坐地铁是上班的首选。
examples.trans: Taking the subway is the top choice for commuting.

examples.text: 打开网站的首页。
examples.trans: Open the front page of the website.

examples.text: 新闻在首页上。
examples.trans: The news is on the front page.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiāng. Puts warm praise on fragrant tea/bread and even deep, restful sleep (睡得香).

examples.text: 你好，小美，很高兴认识你！好香啊！
examples.trans: Hello, Mei, nice to meet you! Something smells wonderful!

examples.text: 这是我这个月睡得最香的一晚，洗澡水也热极了！
examples.trans: Best sleep I have had all month, and the shower water was wonderfully hot!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiāng wèi. Measure word (量词): 股, e.g. 一股香味 ('a waft of aroma').

examples.text: 早上好！在楼上就闻到暖暖的肉桂香味了！
examples.trans: Good morning! All the way upstairs I smelled warm cinnamon!

examples.text: 热黄油和肉桂的香味飘到了院子里。
examples.trans: The aroma of warm butter and cinnamon drifted out into the courtyard.

related.gloss: a waft of aroma (measure word 股)

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiāng bǎi mù. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块香柏木 ('a piece of cedarwood').

examples.text: 一个小香柏木箱子？我在这儿十五年从没见过！
examples.trans: A small cedar chest? In fifteen years here I have never seen it!

examples.text: 香柏木做的旧盒子一打开就有淡淡木香。
examples.trans: Open the vintage cedarwood box and a gentle woody scent rises.

related.gloss: a piece of cedarwood (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a adj used in conversational Mandarin.

examples.text: 我有一个香甜。
examples.trans: I have a 香甜.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的香甜。
examples.trans: This is a very good 香甜.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiāng cǎo. Measure word (量词): 盆, e.g. 一盆香草 ('a pot of herbs').

examples.text: 好。端上去之前，在上面撒这些新鲜绿香草。
examples.trans: Good. Before serving them, sprinkle these fresh green herbs on top.

examples.text: 老陈，这些香草是你自己种的吗？
examples.trans: Chen, did you grow these herbs yourself?

related.gloss: a pot of herbs (measure word 盆)

meanings.note: Pinyin: mǎ shàng. Literally 'on horseback'—everyday word for 'right now!'.

examples.text: 您先坐下，别着急，我们马上看行李牌。
examples.trans: Please sit down first and do not worry; we will check the luggage tag right away.

examples.text: 小晴，马上给火车站失物处打电话。
examples.trans: Qing, call the train station lost-and-found office right away.

meanings.note: Verb mà ('scold, rail against').

examples.text: 你在网络广播上骂他，生怕别人听不着。
examples.trans: You roasted him on online radio lest anyone miss it.

examples.text: 出了差错先想办法补救，光骂人没用。
examples.trans: When mistakes happen, fix them—just scolding helps nothing.

meanings.note: Verb piàn ('deceive / fool').

examples.text: 你们把我骗得太惨了！
examples.trans: You fooled me completely!

examples.text: 我不会骗你的。
examples.trans: I would never trick you.

examples.text: 你别骗人了，又没有人跟你抢。
examples.trans: Stop trying to fool me; nobody here is competing with you for him.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Literary adverb zhòurán ('all of a sudden').

examples.text: 晴朗的夜空骤然变脸，下起了倾盆大雨。
examples.trans: The clear night sky changed abruptly and unleashed pouring rain.

examples.text: 灯光骤然熄灭，追光灯一束打在舞台中央。
examples.trans: House lights went out abruptly and a single spotlight hit centre stage.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gǔ tou. Combines 骨 ('bone') + nominal suffix 头 (neutral tone); measure word: 根 (gēn) or 块 (kuài).

examples.text: 小美动了动脚趾，放心地说：“骨头没事，只是脚踝扭了一下。”
examples.trans: Mei wiggled her toes and said with relief, 'The bones are fine—I just twisted my ankle slightly.'

examples.text: 用牛骨头和新鲜蔬菜慢火熬出来的高汤味道特别浓郁。
examples.trans: Stock simmered slowly from beef bones and fresh vegetables has an especially rich flavour.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gāo. Describes tall people, high ceilings, or high scores.

examples.text: 让我好好看看你，志豪！你长得比钢琴还高了！
examples.trans: Let me look at you properly, Zhihao! You grew taller than the piano!

examples.text: 我手在发抖——车上下来穿深灰色外套的高个子男人吗？
examples.trans: My hands are shaking—is a tall man in a dark grey coat stepping out?

meanings.note: Pinyin: gāo xìng. Classic greeting word in 很高兴认识你 ('Nice to meet you').

examples.text: 你好，小美，很高兴认识你！好香啊！
examples.trans: Hello, Mei, nice to meet you! Something smells wonderful!

examples.text: 很高兴我们安静的小院子适合您的……工作。
examples.trans: We are glad our quiet courtyard suits your... work.

meanings.note: Colloquial adjective gāolěng ('cool and distant').

examples.text: 大家都传魔鬼鱼在公司里是天下第一高冷。
examples.trans: Word around the industry is that Manta Ray is famously aloof.

examples.text: 别看他平时外表高冷，遇到真本事的新人其实很惜才。
examples.trans: Aloof as he looks, he quietly champions talented newcomers.

meanings.note: Noun gāodì ('elevated ground safe from flooding').

examples.text: 大巴进退不得，歌手们现在在一块高地上躲着。
examples.trans: With the coach stranded, the singers are sheltering on high ground.

examples.text: 遇到城市内涝积水，行人应尽快转移到附近高地。
examples.trans: During urban flash flooding, pedestrians should move to high ground.

meanings.note: Adverb gāoshēng ('loudly').

examples.text: 请大家高声呼喊，调动现场气氛。
examples.trans: Please cheer loudly to lift the mood on set.

examples.text: 观众在台下高声为歌手加油。
examples.trans: Viewers below the stage cheered loudly for the singers.

meanings.note: Fashion noun gāodìng ('haute couture').

examples.text: 他穿的那件衬衫是高定的，国内买不到。
examples.trans: That shirt he is wearing is haute couture you cannot buy locally.

examples.text: 红毯压轴嘉宾身着一袭手工高定礼服亮相。
examples.trans: The finale guest stepped onto the red carpet in haute couture.

meanings.note: Noun gāocéng ('top executives').

examples.text: 高层在会议室里开了好几个小时会。
examples.trans: Senior executives met inside for several hours.

examples.text: 公司高层非常重视这次直播。
examples.trans: Senior management values this live broadcast highly.

examples.text: 对于一个引进节目做这种高度的本土化创新，这在中国的电视界从来没有过。
examples.trans: Taking an imported format and giving it such deep homegrown innovation has never been done in Chinese television.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Noun gāoshǒu ('top expert, grandmaster').

examples.text: 我看了他提的那些问题，这个人是个高手。
examples.trans: Reading the questions he raised, this person is a master.

examples.text: 跟真正的高手合作能学到很多东西。
examples.trans: Working alongside a true master teaches you a great deal.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gāo tāng. Combines 高 ('fine/rich/elevated') + 汤 ('soup/stock'): clear, flavourful culinary stock simmered from vegetables or bones.

examples.text: 把洋葱和胡萝卜炒出甜味以后，再加红扁豆和热高汤。
examples.trans: Once you sauté the onions and carrots until sweet, add the red lentils and hot broth.

examples.text: 小美每天早上都会用新鲜蔬菜和香草熬一锅清澈金黄的高汤。
examples.trans: Every morning Mei simmers a pot of clear golden stock from fresh vegetables and herbs.

examples.text: 淳于总这个人高深莫测，后招很多的，我劝您也别太放松了。
examples.trans: Mr Chun Yu is unfathomable and always keeps backup moves up his sleeve, so I advise you not to relax too soon either.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 由此引发的股东内部分歧与高管层问责风暴，可能是比侵权本身更为严重的企业危机。
examples.trans: The resulting shareholder rifts and executive accountability storm may prove even deadlier than the lawsuit itself.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Adjective gāojí ('senior, advanced').

examples.text: 制作一部都是高级员工，没有实习生。
examples.trans: Everyone in Unit One is a senior employee; there are no interns.

examples.text: 这是一家高级酒店。
examples.trans: This is an upscale hotel.

meanings.note: Senior creative and operational producer rank.

examples.text: 她在自我介绍时落落大方地报出了总编室高级制作人的职务。
examples.trans: Introducing herself with poise, she gave her title as senior producer.

examples.text: 两位高级制作人在战略会议上共同为本土原创项目据理力争。
examples.trans: Both senior producers made a compelling case for domestic originals.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gāo gāo. Reduplication of 高 ('high') for emphasis.

examples.text: 周经理高高地举起那个旧信封，对着光看里面的内容。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou held the old envelope high up, looking at its contents against the light.

examples.text: 梧桐巷的尽头，高高地矗立着一座古老的钟楼。
examples.trans: At the end of Wutong Lane, an ancient clock tower stands towering.

meanings.note: Idiom húnbùshǒushè ('soul not at home — utterly distracted').

examples.text: 别装了，看你一天到晚魂不守舍那样。
examples.trans: Stop pretending — look how distracted you are all day.

examples.text: 等提案结果的时候，她急得有点魂不守舍。
examples.trans: Waiting on the pitch verdict, she was too anxious to focus.

examples.text: 喜欢我的人是因为我的魅力，爱我的人是因为我的心，你不需要做出以身相许的状态。
examples.trans: People like me for my charm and love me for my heart; you don't need to act like you owe me your life.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Noun yú ('fish').

examples.text: 你们刚才怎么吃那么多鱼啊？
examples.trans: Why did you all eat so much fish just now?

examples.text: 食堂做的鱼种类越来越多。
examples.trans: The canteen cooks more and more varieties of fish.

meanings.note: Food noun bàoyú ('abalone').

examples.text: 今天的员工餐连牛排和鲍鱼都有。
examples.trans: Today's staff meal even has steak and abalone.

examples.text: 这道鲍鱼汤煮得非常鲜美。
examples.trans: This abalone soup is cooked deliciously.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiān. Describes freshly picked/prepared ingredients (鲜汤 'fresh soup', 鲜花 'fresh flowers') and natural umami savouriness.

examples.text: 九号房花园咖啡角每日供应鲜汤、热面包、柠檬挞与清茶。
examples.trans: Room Nine Garden Café Corner serves fresh soup, warm bread, lemon tarts, and fragrant tea daily.

examples.text: 刚摘下来的百里香和欧芹煮进扁豆汤里，味道格外鲜美。
examples.trans: Freshly picked thyme and parsley simmered in the lentil soup give it a wonderfully bright, savoury flavour.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiān liàng. Joins 鲜 ('fresh, bright') + 亮 ('bright, clear').

examples.text: 刚刷完漆的木门看起来非常鲜亮。
examples.trans: The freshly painted wooden door looks extremely vibrant.

examples.text: 小美穿了一件颜色鲜亮的黄裙子，像一朵向日葵。
examples.trans: Mei wore a bright-colored yellow dress, looking like a sunflower.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiānhóng.

examples.text: 她涂了鲜红色的口红。
examples.trans: She wore bright red lipstick.

examples.text: 秋天的枫叶变得鲜红。
examples.trans: The autumn maple leaves turn bright red.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a noun used in conversational Mandarin. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个鸟 ('a 鸟').

examples.text: 我有一个鸟。
examples.trans: I have a 鸟.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的鸟。
examples.trans: This is a very good 鸟.

meanings.note: Pinyin: niǎokàntú. Measure word: 张, 幅.

examples.text: 这是一张城市的鸟瞰图。
examples.trans: This is a bird's-eye view map of the city.

examples.text: 从飞机上可以看到岛屿的鸟瞰图。
examples.trans: You can see a bird's-eye view of the island from the airplane.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jī dàn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个鸡蛋 ('an egg').

examples.text: 只有一点点牛奶、两个鸡蛋，一点黄油都没有！
examples.trans: Only a tiny bit of milk, two eggs, and no butter at all!

examples.text: 三瓶牛奶、二十个鸡蛋、黄油、奶酪和红苹果！
examples.trans: Three bottles of milk, twenty eggs, butter, cheese, and red apples!

meanings.note: Physical pins-and-needles numbness from sitting or squatting long.

examples.text: 在台阶上坐得太久，我的腿都麻了。
examples.trans: After sitting on the steps too long, my legs went numb.

examples.text: 站起来活动一下，脚就不麻了。
examples.trans: Stand up and move around so your foot stops feeling numb.

meanings.note: Pinyin: má fan. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个麻烦 ('a bother / trouble').

examples.text: 给你们添麻烦了，老陈。谢谢这一周帮我看管箱子。
examples.trans: Sorry for causing you trouble, Chen. Thank you for guarding the bag all week.

examples.text: 这点小事一点也不麻烦，您尽管放心。
examples.trans: Such a small thing is no trouble at all—please rest assured.

examples.text: 你觉得我是那个被人当枪使的傻子，还是天天需要被你保护的麻烦精啊？
examples.trans: Do you see me as a fool used as someone's pawn, or a walking disaster who needs your protection every day?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: máquè. Measure word: 只.

examples.text: 几只麻雀在地上啄食。
examples.trans: Several sparrows were pecking at food on the ground.

examples.text: 虽然麻雀很小，但飞得很快。
examples.trans: Although the sparrow is small, it flies very fast.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huáng. Describes yellow flowers, brass, or butter.

examples.text: 篮子里正躺着六个黄柠檬呢——厨房就等今天了！
examples.trans: Six yellow lemons are sitting in my basket right now—this kitchen was waiting for today!

examples.text: 秋天到了，院子里的树叶黄了。
examples.trans: Autumn has arrived, and the courtyard leaves have turned yellow.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huáng yóu. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块黄油 ('a block of butter').

examples.text: 只有一点点牛奶、两个鸡蛋，一点黄油都没有！
examples.trans: Only a tiny bit of milk, two eggs, and no butter at all!

examples.text: 三瓶牛奶、二十个鸡蛋、黄油、奶酪和红苹果！
examples.trans: Three bottles of milk, twenty eggs, butter, cheese, and red apples!

related.gloss: a block of butter (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a noun used in conversational Mandarin. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个黄糖 ('a 黄糖').

examples.text: 我有一个黄糖。
examples.trans: I have a 黄糖.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的黄糖。
examples.trans: This is a very good 黄糖.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huáng sè. Measure word (量词): 种 (zhǒng), e.g. 一种黄色 ('a shade of yellow').

examples.text: 插上老陈的铜台灯……哇，黄色灯光真暖和！
examples.trans: Plug in Chen's brass lamp... wow, how warm that yellow light is!

examples.text: 啊！黄色柠檬糖霜——每个星期五我们俩都抢边角那一块！
examples.trans: Oh! Yellow lemon glaze—every single Friday the two of us fought over the corner piece!

related.gloss: a shade of yellow (measure word 种)

meanings.note: Pinyin: huáng tóng. Literally 黄 ('yellow/golden') + 铜 ('copper/bronze'): copper-zinc brass alloy.

examples.text: 钢琴琴槌里面的细小轴销是用结实的黄铜做的。
examples.trans: The tiny hinge pins inside piano hammers are made of sturdy brass.

examples.text: 老陈把前台的黄铜小铃铛擦得金光发亮。
examples.trans: Chen polished the little brass bell on the front desk until it gleamed.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hēi. Describes black color or no light; 灯黑了 means the lights went out.

examples.text: 大厅的灯黑了！我把厨房的烤箱也弄坏了吗？
examples.trans: The lobby lamp went dark! Did I break the kitchen oven too?

examples.text: 天黑了，我们回去吧。
examples.trans: It's getting dark; let's head back.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a adj used in conversational Mandarin.

examples.text: 我有一个黑乎乎。
examples.trans: I have a 黑乎乎.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的黑乎乎。
examples.trans: This is a very good 黑乎乎.

examples.text: 每个人都有黑历史。
examples.trans: Everyone has a dark history.

examples.text: 他不想提起他的黑历史。
examples.trans: He doesn't want to mention his dark history.

meanings.note: Noun hēiyè ('dark night').

examples.text: 不管风雨在这个漫长的黑夜里如何肆虐。
examples.trans: No matter how wind and rain rage through this long dark night.

examples.text: 温暖的歌声像一盏灯，照亮了风雨交加的黑夜。
examples.trans: Warm singing shone like a lantern through the stormy dark night.

examples.text: 他的电脑被黑掉了。
examples.trans: His computer was hacked.

examples.text: 有人把我的网站黑掉了。
examples.trans: Someone hacked my website.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hēi bái. Joins 黑 ('black') and 白 ('white') with no word for 'and' (黑白照片 'a black-and-white photo').

examples.text: 看这张黑白照片，院子里的树那时候才到二楼！
examples.trans: Look at this black-and-white photo—back then the courtyard tree only reached the second floor!

examples.text: 奶奶家里有很多黑白照片。
examples.trans: Grandma has lots of black-and-white photos at home.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hēi sè. Full colour noun 黑 ('black') + 色 ('colour'); usually takes 的 before nouns (黑色的胶带), unlike bare 黑.

examples.text: 老陈工具包里装着两卷黑色的电工胶带。
examples.trans: Chen's tool bag holds two rolls of black electrical tape.

examples.text: 白色纸上写着几行清楚的黑色墨水字。
examples.trans: Several neat lines of black ink are written across the white paper.

meanings.note: Noun/adj mòqì ('tacit understanding').

examples.text: 二位在节目上故意吵架、默契炒作。
examples.trans: You two staged an argument and hyped things up in tacit sync.

examples.text: 搭档多年，两位主持人配合得十分默契。
examples.trans: Partners for years, the two hosts work in seamless rapport.

meanings.note: Verb mòrèn ('give silent consent').

examples.text: 最让人寒心的是，连董事长居然也默认了。
examples.trans: What stung most was that even the chairwoman tacitly went along.

examples.text: 他没有出声反对，大家便当他是默认了这个方案。
examples.trans: Since he raised no objection, everyone took it as tacit consent.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bí zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个鼻子 ('a nose').

examples.text: 笔挺又干净，周经理！连眼镜都戴在鼻子上，没在额头上。
examples.trans: Crisp and spotless, Manager Zhou! Even your glasses are on your nose instead of your forehead.

examples.text: 周经理！这回您眼镜从鼻子上滑下来是因为太高兴啦！
examples.trans: Manager Zhou! This time your glasses slid off your nose from sheer joy!

meanings.note: Used as resultative complement (买齐/到齐) meaning nothing missing.

examples.text: 单子上列的东西，我跑了好几趟全都给你买齐了。
examples.trans: After several trips, I bought every single item on your list.

examples.text: 参会人员都已经到齐了，咱们现在开始开会吧。
examples.trans: Everyone for the meeting is here—let us get started.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qí qí. Reduplication of 齐 ('neat, even'). Often used as 整整齐齐.

examples.text: 三个人的目光齐齐地转向了门口的那只流浪猫。
examples.trans: The gazes of all three people uniformly turned toward the stray cat at the door.

examples.text: 桌子上的水彩笔被小晴摆得齐齐的。
examples.trans: The watercolor pens on the table were arranged neatly by Qing.
